title: TACET: Context-Appropriate Acoustic-Social Navigation for Quadrupeds
summary: Quadruped robots entering hospitals, care homes, and quiet offices must be context-appropriate not only in where they move but in how loudly they move: a legged robot's locomotion noise, dominated by foot-ground impacts, is itself a social variable. Prior social navigation respects human space but treats the robot as acoustically uniform, while quiet-locomotion methods reduce noise to an operator-specified, context-blind level. We present TACET, a context-appropriate acoustic-social navigation method that infers social context from the robot's egocentric view and decides both where it walks and how loudly, coupling a slow fine-tuned vision-language reasoner to a fast reactive controller through a single compact behavior token, <gait, speed, social_cost>. The same token conditions both a social costmap (where to go) and a quiet locomotion policy (how loudly to move), while a structured out-of-view memory keeps recently seen people in the reasoner's context after they leave the camera view. On a real quadruped, context-conditioned locomotion lowers locomotion noise by up to 9.3 dBA at matched speed, and across our scenarios the full method keeps personal-space compliance at 100% with low acoustic intrusion (<=2.9 dBA), jointly improving spatial and acoustic performance in the evaluated scenarios. The project page is available at https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/tacet/.

AI.tldr: 提出TACET，一种情境感知的声学-社会导航方法，利用机器人自我视角推断社会情境，通过单一行为令牌同时决定"走到哪"和"走多响"。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人进入医院、养老院和安静办公室时，噪声（主要来自足-地碰撞）本身是一种社会变量。既有社会导航只尊重人类空间却把机器人视为声学均匀体，而静音运动方法又只按操作者指定、脱离情境地降噪，二者割裂。
AI.method: TACET通过慢速微调的视觉-语言推理器与快速反应式控制器，用单一紧凑行为令牌<gait, speed, social_cost>耦合：该令牌同时条件化社会代价地图（去哪）与静音运动策略（多响）；并用结构化视野外记忆保留刚离开摄像头的人。
AI.result: 真实四足机器人上，情境条件化运动在相同速度下最多降低9.3 dBA噪声；各场景中完整方法保持100%个人空间合规，声学侵入≤2.9 dBA，同时改善空间与声学性能。
AI.conclusion: TACET将社会导航与静音运动统一为情境感知框架，实现空间与声学性能的联合优化，验证了噪声作为社会变量的可行性。

title: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
summary: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region. The shared closed-loop primitive then establishes stable contact from this approximate initialization, and a pose-conditioned controller tracks the desired object motion. Reach specifications may come from future-aware planning, external models, or human demonstrations, while the primitive and tracking backend remain unchanged. Simulation and real-world experiments show that GOTT is able to establish robust contact across diverse objects, arm-hand platforms, and seen and unseen hand morphologies. It also consistently improves end-to-end task success over open-loop grasp execution.

AI.tldr: GOTT是一种基于跨本体接触获取原语的"接近-获取-移动"框架，将操作意图转化为多指手行为，在多物体、多平台、多手型上实现稳健接触并提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 基础模型与大规模人类数据提供了丰富的操作意图来源，但将这些意图转化为多指机器人行为仍然困难；灵巧手缺乏可复用、能跨任务与跨本体可靠建立接触的低层原语。
AI.method: GOTT围绕单一跨本体接触获取原语构建"接近-获取-移动"框架：给定与机器人无关的物体轨迹和接近规格，先把手带到任务相关的接触区域附近；共享的闭环原语从该近似初始化建立稳定接触；再由位姿条件控制器跟踪期望物体运动。接近规格可来自未来感知规划、外部模型或人类演示，而原语与跟踪后端保持不变。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明，GOTT能在多样物体、臂-手平台以及已见和未见过的手部形态上建立稳健接触，并相较开环抓取执行持续提升端到端任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的跨本体接触获取原语与解耦的接近/跟踪接口，为将操作意图可靠落地到灵巧手行为提供了有效途径，且对平台与手型具有泛化性。

title: MOSAIC-SV: Real-Time Adaptive Identification of Vessel Dynamics for the Control and Deployment of Aquatic Robots
summary: Model-based control of an aquatic robotic platform depends on a hydrodynamic model that is costly to identify and specific to the hull, payload, and conditions it was measured in. Here, we present MOSAIC-SV, a deployable real-time adaptive dynamics identification and control system that identifies a control-sufficient dynamics model from a spec-sheet engineering prior, without dedicated identification trials, and re-estimates it at every control step of a closed-loop mission while the controller plans on it. A physically admissible unscented Kalman filter re-estimates hydrodynamic, disturbance, and actuator parameters at every control step of the closed-loop mission; while a command-dependent consider projection withholds corrections the current command cannot attribute between actuator effectiveness and external force; and a model predictive path integral controller plans on the current estimate. In simulation on a CyberShip II plant, MOSAIC-SV recovers the transit performance of the calibrated model under static mismatch and transient changes, and stays within 20% of its own transit time at the unscaled prior when its inertia or damping prior is wrong by an order of magnitude. In on-water field trials on the Blue Robotics BlueBoat, a twin-thruster catamaran, MOSAIC-SV transits at least 25% faster and predicts its own motion with at least 56% less error than its frozen engineering prior, including under an unmodeled payload. The same MOSAIC-SV system concept was also feasibly deployed on a 6.3-tonne dual outboard monohull.

AI.tldr: 提出MOSAIC-SV，一种可部署的实时自适应动力学辨识与控制系统，从规格书先验出发、无需专门辨识试验，在闭环任务每个控制步在线重估水动力模型并据此规划控制。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的水面机器人控制依赖水动力模型，而该模型辨识成本高、且强依赖于船体、载荷与测量条件；需要一种无需专门辨识试验、能在线自适应的动力学建模与控制方案。
AI.method: 以规格书工程先验为起点，采用物理可容许的无迹卡尔曼滤波在每个控制步在线重估水动力、扰动与执行器参数；通过命令相关的consider投影，抑制当前命令无法在"执行器效能"与"外力"间归因的参数修正；外层由模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器基于当前估计进行规划。
AI.result: CyberShip II仿真中：在静态失配与瞬态变化下恢复标定模型的航行性能；当惯量或阻尼先验偏差达一个数量级时，航行时间仍保持在其未缩放先验下的自身结果20%以内。BlueBoat双推进器双体船实航中：相比冻结的工程先验，航行至少快25%、自运动预测误差至少降低56%，且包含未建模载荷情形；同一系统概念亦成功部署于6.3吨双舷外机单体船。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC-SV证明可从工程先验出发实现免辨识试验的在线自适应水动力辨识与闭环控制，在仿真与实航中均显著优于冻结先验，并具备跨平台可部署性。

title: Sparse Calibration-Based Personalization of Kernel-Based Gait Phase and Speed Estimation Using Wearable IMUs
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, The 26th International Conference on Control, Automation, and Systems (ICCAS 2026)
summary: This paper presents sparse calibration-based personalization for kernel-based gait phase and walking speed co-estimation from wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs). A 28-speed reference library was constructed from bilateral thigh and shank trajectories in a 20-subject locomotion dataset. Rather than directly applying population-average kernels, the method combines a user-specific baseline estimated from three calibration speeds with a principal-component (PC) model of baseline-centered kinematic deviations. Offline validation showed that personalized kernels reduced phase error relative to the population kernel. In a single-participant online pilot evaluation, the personalized kernels produced numerically lower mean phase and speed errors and ran in real time on embedded hardware. However, the speed effect was not significant, and pairwise phase differences did not remain significant after multiple-comparison correction. The pilot evaluation establishes wearable implementation feasibility while indicating reference-to-online dataset mismatch and the need for larger-cohort validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于稀疏校准的个性化核方法，用于可穿戴IMU步态相位与步速联合估计。
AI.motivation: 总体平均核难以适配个体差异，需通过少量校准实现个性化以降低相位与步速估计误差。
AI.method: 构建20名受试者、双侧大腿与小腿轨迹的28速参考库；以3个校准速度估计用户基线，并建立以基线为中心的动力学偏差主成分（PC）模型，组合生成个性化核。
AI.result: 离线验证中个性化核较总体核降低相位误差；单受试者在线试验中相位与速度平均误差数值更低且可在嵌入式硬件实时运行，但速度效应不显著，相位差异经多重比较校正后不显著。
AI.conclusion: 验证了可穿戴实现的可行性，同时表明参考与在线数据集存在不匹配，需更大规模队列验证。

title: Fractal Cross Product: Theory, Differentiable Implementation and Application to Medical Image Analysis
summary: The magnitude of the generalized Euclidean cross product is a Gram volume whose degree under common scaling is fixed by the integer dimension of the spanning frame. We formulate a generalized Fractal Cross Product (FCP) as a nonlinear radial deformation with a prescribed positive degree $D$, which may be non-integer. The scalar construction applies in any ambient dimension $m\geq k$, while its canonically oriented vector form requires codimension one. It recovers the classical generalized cross product exactly at $D=k$ and retains orthogonality, alternation, rotation equivariance, and $D$-homogeneity, but is generally not multilinear. For exact self-similar frame systems, the construction also obeys a scale-balance law at the similarity dimension. We derive a differentiable, dimensionless image response and a non-circular empirical accumulation exponent obtained by regressing raw angular Gram responses across patch widths. Binary64 calculations recover the finite-frame identities to roundoff, while raster experiments recover the Sierpiński-triangle value 1.5849625 at three resolutions. In five-seed medical-imaging comparisons, FCP-centered fusion increased mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.7264 to 0.8135 and from 0.5843 to 0.6765 on the random and hospital-separated Retinal Image Database for Optic Nerve Evaluation partitions, respectively, and from 0.7403 to 0.7475 on FracAtlas. On FracAtlas, balanced accuracy increased from 0.6186 to 0.6721 and the harmonic mean of precision and sensitivity from 0.3669 to 0.4457. These results support the utility of the complete fusion framework, but do not isolate the effect of FCP from that of its complementary descriptors and fusion head.

AI.tldr: 提出广义分形叉积(FCP)：以预设正次数D的径向非线性变形推广经典广义叉积，保持正交性、反对称性、旋转等变性，并用于医学图像融合与分形维数估计。
AI.motivation: 经典广义欧氏叉积的Gram体积在常规缩放下次数由生成框架的整数维数固定，无法刻画非整数维的分形结构，因此需要一种可规定任意正次数D的推广形式。
AI.method: 将FCP构造为次数为D的径向非线性变形，标量形式适用于任意m≥k的嵌入维数，向量形式需余维为一；由可微、无量纲的图像响应，通过对原始角向Gram响应跨patch宽度回归得到非循环的经验积累指数；在Binary64下验证有限框架恒等式，并在栅格图像上做分形实验与五种子医学影像融合对比。
AI.result: Binary64计算将有限框架恒等式恢复到舍入误差；栅格实验在三个分辨率下复现Sierpiński三角值1.5849625；五种子医学影像比较中，FCP中心融合在随机与医院分离的RIGD-ONE分区上把平均AUC从0.7264提升至0.8135、从0.5843提升至0.6765，在FracAtlas上从0.7403提升至0.7475，平衡准确率从0.6186升至0.6721，精确率与灵敏度的调和平均从0.3669升至0.4457。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持完整融合框架的实用性，但未能将FCP本身的贡献与其互补描述子和融合头的作用分离开来。

title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
summary: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ADSD 框架，将数值求解器的性能诊断与可复用技能发现相结合，把求解器自我改进从试错式编辑转变为“诊断—发现—实现”的结构化流程。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体虽能生成科学代码，但生成代码不等于改进底层算法。对于数值求解器，执行反馈只能暴露性能不佳，却难以揭示其根本原因及改进方向。
AI.method: ADSD 采用诊断优先范式：先解释求解器表现不佳的原因，再以该诊断指导合适数值方法的发现，并将所得知识封装为可复用的求解器技能。
AI.result: 在潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程和异质扩散偏微分方程四个数值领域，ADSD 一致提升求解器精度、鲁棒性与效率；在 GOC-500 潮流问题上平均误差降低近 71 倍，且改进可迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
AI.conclusion: 将数值诊断与技能发现相连接，可有效支持求解器的可复用自我改进，并具备跨任务泛化能力。

title: Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出"接收方相对有界协调"框架，将消息效用表示为接收方增益减去协议税，揭示了压缩与原始上下文、更强发送方何时有益的边界条件。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，发送方拥有宽泛上下文而执行方仅有局部视野。需要明确：何时短消息能改善执行方决策，何时原始上下文更优，以及何时更强的发送方有帮助。
AI.method: 构建"接收方相对有界协调"框架，将消息效用表达为接收方增益减去协议税；提出三阶段分解（外化、吸收、动作闭合）以解释正确内容到达后仍存在错误的原因；在单交叉条件下分析发送方升级的作用。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，同一Qwen协议将ContextBench联合准确率从0.633提升至0.775，但将ToolSandbox从0.889降至0.653。固定消息重放显示，即便正确工件恢复，仍存在动作闭合失败。
AI.conclusion: 当税收节省超过信息遗漏与解码器失配的损失时，压缩优于原始上下文；即使贝叶斯充分压缩也可能因有界执行方无法使用其表面形式而失败。上述结果可用于指导推理时的选择器，改善所评估通信机制下的准确率-成本前沿。

title: REDIRECT: A 1% Fix for Bad Robot Habits
summary: Robots can acquire bad habits from a few defective moments in otherwise useful teleoperation. In mixed-quality robot data, normal and problematic demonstrations share most task behavior and differ only at a local action continuation. Full retraining is costly, while fine-tuning on clean data alone offers limited recovery under a small update budget. We ask whether the local difference can instead be fixed with only 1% of the full-training sample-backward budget. Using only episode-level retained/problematic labels, REDIRECT localizes the branch, assigns a coherent retained continuation to the original observations around it, and anchors shared behavior, without frame-level annotations or additional interaction. Across three randomized ManiSkill tasks and three seeds, REDIRECT raises the mean success rate from 68.2% to 90.3%, recovering 88.8% of the clean-retraining gap versus 22.1% for matched-compute fine-tuning. On a PiPER arm, it recovers 86.7-92.9% of the clean-only gap across cup insertion and towel folding. Local robot habits can therefore be repaired by spending the update budget on the behavioral difference rather than relearning shared behavior.

AI.tldr: REDIRECT方法仅用约1%的完整训练样本-反向传播预算，通过定位并修复机器人示教数据中的局部缺陷行为，将平均成功率从68.2%提升至90.3%。
AI.motivation: 遥操作数据中，少数缺陷片段会让机器人习得"坏习惯"。在混合质量数据里，正常与问题示教的大部分行为相同，仅局部动作延续处存在差异。完整重训练代价高昂，而在小更新预算下仅用干净数据微调恢复能力有限。本文探究能否用极低预算（1%完整训练预算）直接修复这一局部差异。
AI.method: REDIRECT仅依赖回合级（episode-level）的保留/问题标签，无帧级标注也无需额外交互。它先定位行为分支点，围绕该分支为原始观测分配一致的保留式动作延续，并锚定共享行为，从而将更新预算集中在行为差异上而非重学共享行为。
AI.result: 在三个随机化ManiSkill任务、三个随机种子上，REDIRECT将平均成功率从68.2%提升至90.3%，恢复了干净重训练差距的88.8%，而同等算力微调仅为22.1%；在PiPER机械臂的杯具插入与毛巾折叠任务上，恢复了干净数据差距的86.7–92.9%。
AI.conclusion: 局部机器人坏习惯可通过将更新预算用于行为差异而非重学共享行为来修复，REDIRECT以极低预算实现了接近干净重训练的恢复效果。

title: Do Motion Tokenizers for Co-Speech Gesture Generation Encode Gesture Semantics?
summary: Discrete motion tokenizers encode motion as atomic units and are widely used for co-speech gesture generation. It remains unclear which motion properties, especially those relevant to gesture semantics, are recoverable from these codebooks. We probe a reconstruction-trained codebook using 19 co-speech gesture descriptors spanning from raw motion to abstract communicative function. Results show that geometry and handedness are readily decodable from token embeddings, while motion category is only weakly decoded despite showing systematic differences in discrete code usage. This gap between reconstruction quality and descriptor decodability suggests that reconstruction objectives alone do not guarantee that gesture semantics are captured, and that evaluating codebooks on such properties can guide the design of more semantic motion tokenizers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过19种共语手势描述符对重建训练的离散动作分词器码本进行探针分析，发现几何与左右手性易解码，而动作类别仅弱可解码，揭示重建目标不足以捕捉手势语义。
AI.motivation: 离散动作分词器广泛用于共语手势生成，但其码本究竟保留了哪些动作属性（尤其是与手势语义相关的属性）尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用涵盖从原始动作到抽象交际功能的19种共语手势描述符，对一个经重建训练的分词器码本进行探针（probing）分析。
AI.result: 几何信息与左右手性可从token嵌入中直接解码；动作类别仅弱可解码，尽管离散码的使用呈现系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 重建质量与描述符可解码性之间的差距表明，仅靠重建目标不能保证捕捉手势语义；基于此类属性评估码本可指导更具语义性的动作分词器设计。

title: REACT: Physically and Chemically Consistent Reconstruction of Marine Active Tracers
summary: Reconstructing global sea surface pH from sparse observations is critical for monitoring ocean acidification and understanding marine carbon cycling. Traditional assimilation and inverse models are physically grounded but costly for large-scale reconstruction. Recent black-box and physics-guided AI models improve efficiency, but are mainly designed for passive tracers, where the reconstructed variable is also the transported inventory. In contrast, pH is an active carbonate tracer: it is the prediction target, while dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) is the conserved carbon inventory. This mismatch can produce low pH error while violating carbonate closure and source-free carbon conservation. To address this, we introduce \textbf{REACT}, a carbon-first reconstruction framework that decouples transport, active correction, and chemical decoding. REACT transports a latent carbonate state with a conservative advection--diffusion solver, captures non-conservative carbon-cycle variations with a source module, decodes the corrected state into pH, and constrains the output through carbonate equilibrium. This design keeps pH as the target while enforcing consistency on the underlying carbon state. On simulation data, REACT reduces pH NRMSE by (14.7%) and chemical consistency error by (24.0%) over the best baseline. Cross-temporal-scale evaluations show robustness against error accumulation from coarse to fine temporal scales, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出碳优先重构框架REACT，解耦输运、主动校正与化学解码，通过守恒输运潜在碳状态并约束碳酸盐平衡，实现海表pH重构，在模拟数据上降低pH NRMSE 14.7%、化学一致性误差24.0%。
AI.motivation: 海表pH重构对监测海洋酸化与理解海洋碳循环至关重要。传统同化与反演模型物理基础扎实但大规模重构代价高；近期黑箱与物理引导AI模型虽提升效率，却主要面向被动示踪物（被重构变量即被输运的量）。而pH是主动碳酸盐示踪物：预测目标是pH，守恒碳库存却是溶解无机碳（DIC）。这种错配可导致pH误差低但违反碳酸盐闭合与无源碳守恒。
AI.method: 提出碳优先重构框架REACT，将输运、主动校正与化学解码解耦：用守恒对流-扩散求解器输运潜在碳酸盐状态；用源模块刻画非守恒碳循环变化；将校正后的状态解码为pH；并通过碳酸盐平衡约束输出。该设计在保持pH为目标的同时，对底层碳状态施加一致性约束。
AI.result: 在模拟数据上，REACT相比最优基线将pH NRMSE降低14.7%，化学一致性误差降低24.0%。跨时间尺度评估显示其对从粗到细时间尺度上的误差累积具有鲁棒性，消融实验验证了各组成部分的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以碳为先的重构思路可兼顾pH预测精度与底层碳状态的一致性，为主动碳酸盐示踪物的重构提供了有效途径。

title: Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting
summary: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

AI.tldr: 该文对比两类时间序列预测程序：一类直接在"将被报告"的坐标上最小化解码潜变量的误差（forecast program），另一类先以固定秩拟合整个下一潜向量、冻结编码器再接预测头（representation loss，如 LeNEPA）。分析表明，标量目标加线性解码器时，只要潜秩≥1，前者等价于普通最小二乘，各向同性约束仅为重缩放；而后者在四维序列（后三坐标共享同一自回归）上会退化。
AI.motivation: 作者希望厘清"预测下一位潜表示"的表示损失与"直接预测被报告的未来值"的预测损失之间的本质差别，说明二者是同一瓶颈上的不同最小二乘问题，从而解释表示学习式预测为何可能偏离真正的预测目标。
AI.method: 将两种目标显式写成优化程序：forecast program 在被报告坐标上最小化解码潜变量的误差；表示损失程序先按固定秩拟合整个下一潜向量，再冻结编码器并附加预测头。以标量目标+线性解码器进行理论分析，并用一个四维序列实验（后三坐标共享同一自回归）作秩1与秩2对比。
AI.result: 标量目标+线性解码器下，潜秩≥1时 forecast program 等价于普通最小二乘，各向同性约束经解码器重拟合后不改变预测。四维序列实验中，秩1表示拟合把 0.9998 的质量放在重复坐标上，对剩余信号的预测仅给出边际方差 2.794；而 forecast program 把质量 1 放在信号上，匹配创新方差 0.992。秩2时向量拟合获得第二个方向，两程序结果一致。对拟合的一步系数 0.803 迭代，开环误差从一步 0.992 升至八步 2.700。
AI.conclusion: 预测程序与表示损失程序在同一瓶颈上求解不同最小二乘问题；在低秩且存在冗余维度时，表示式拟合会被无关方向主导而导致预测失败，而直接面向报告坐标的预测程序则匹配真实创新方差。秩足够时二者收敛一致，但迭代一步系数会显著放大开环误差。

title: SUAVE: Unified Video-Action Models via Masked Diffusion
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit strong semantic grounding from pretrained vision-language backbones but are typically optimized for predicting actions rather than future observations. They can see and act, but they do not imagine the future before acting. World action models (WAMs) built on video diffusion backbones can imagine but treat language as frozen conditioning on a continuous latent space. Unified models bring these modalities into one architecture, but they either decode autoregressively, one token at a time, or keep video continuous with an auxiliary action head. In this work, we present SUAVE, a Single vocabulary Unified Action-Video modEl in which a masked diffusion transformer generates video and actions conditioned on language, with all three modalities represented as discrete tokens in a shared sequence. Choosing which tokens to mask at inference turns the same network into a world model, a robot policy, or a video-action model. For action-free co-training, the action positions of unlabeled video are filled with mask tokens and excluded from the loss. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate two findings. First, a single SUAVE model predicts long-horizon video and acts as a policy, competitive with dedicated world models and specialized action policies on static and dynamic manipulation tasks. On a real robot, our model generates subgoal images and an action chunk spanning one second of motion in 1,030 ms on an RTX 5090 GPU, sustaining closed-loop control at 2.5 actions per second. Second, pretraining on robot video and co-training on human video substantially improves policy performance and zero-shot robustness to distribution shift. Together, these results show that masked diffusion is a practical and versatile foundation for unified video-action modeling.

AI.tldr: SUAVE是一种将语言、视频与动作统一表示为离散token序列的掩码扩散Transformer，通过选择推理时的掩码位置，同一网络可充当世界模型、机器人策略或视频-动作模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）擅长动作预测却无法想象未来，世界动作模型（WAM）能想象未来却仅将语言作为冻结条件；统一模型则受限于逐token自回归解码或需额外动作头的连续视频方案。作者希望用单一架构、共享词表同时建模三类模态。
AI.method: 提出SUAVE（Single vocabulary Unified Action-Video modEl）：基于掩码扩散Transformer，在语言条件下生成视频与动作，语言、视频、动作全部离散化为token置于同一序列。推理时通过选择掩码token的位置，使同一网络分别表现为世界模型、策略或视频-动作模型。无动作协同训练时，将无标注视频的动作位置填入掩码token并从损失中排除。
AI.result: 单一SUAVE模型可预测长时域视频并作为策略，在静态与动态操作任务上与专用世界模型及专用动作策略性能相当。在真实机器人上，模型于RTX 5090上1030 ms内生成子目标图像与覆盖1秒运动的动作块，实现2.5次/秒的闭环控制。在机器人视频上预训练并在人类视频上协同训练，可显著提升策略性能及对分布偏移的零样本鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码扩散是统一视频-动作建模的实用且通用的基础范式，兼顾想象能力与动作决策，并受益于异构视频数据的协同训练。

title: LoRA Direction Extraction for Controllable Light Toggling in FLUX.1 Kontext
summary: We propose a fine-tuning method for flow-matching diffusion models aimed at realistic artificial light modeling without the need for a large training dataset. We address the task of controllable interior image editing, where the goal is to turn artificial light sources on or off while preserving the scene geometry, object placement, materials, and visual identity of the original image. To achieve this, we decompose the task into two independent formulations. We introduce the LoRA Direction Training Method, which extracts the pure direction of the LoRA adapter effect in the diffusion model flow field, and we also introduce specialized loss functions to ensure the realism of the inverse transformation. Additionally, the resulting increment map is used for more precise adjustment of the lighting color and temperature.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向flow-matching扩散模型的微调方法，无需大规模数据集即可实现逼真的人造光建模，用于可控室内图像编辑（开/关光源并保持场景几何、物体布局、材质与视觉身份）。
AI.motivation: 现实的人造光建模通常依赖大规模训练数据；本文希望在无需大训练集的前提下，完成可控的室内图像光照编辑，并在开/关光源时保持原图场景几何、物体位置、材质与视觉身份不变。
AI.method: 将任务分解为两个独立子问题；提出LoRA Direction Training Method，在扩散模型流场中提取LoRA适配器效应的纯方向；引入专门损失函数以保证逆变换的真实性；并利用所得增量图（increment map）对光照颜色与色温进行更精细调节。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果，主要报告方法层面的效果：可实现人造光源开/关的可控室内编辑，保持场景几何、物体布局、材质与视觉身份，并支持光照颜色与色温的精确调整。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为flow-matching扩散模型提供了一种数据高效的微调范式，通过LoRA方向提取、专门损失与增量图调节，实现了逼真且可控的室内光照编辑。

title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
summary:
A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples.
  We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call.
  On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练的轻量级代理模型并行运行方法，利用开源权重的替代模型通过多种互补读出方式，为LLM智能体的工具调用提供错误检测信号，在编码任务上显著优于智能体自身置信度与自一致性采样。
AI.motivation: 已部署的LLM智能体在执行工具调用、查询和代码时可能悄无声息地出错，而错误暴露时动作已执行。前沿聊天API隐藏了模型的token概率，智能体自述置信度对关键错误几乎与随机猜测无异，重采样也无济于事，因为前沿模型高度重复，多次采样会复现相同的调用。因此亟需一种能从外部恢复缺失错误信号的方法。
AI.method: 采用低成本开源权重替代模型并行运行，读取与智能体相同的上下文、schema和候选动作，通过一族互补读出对其log-probability打分：教师强制（teacher forcing）与请求-PMI（request-PMI）评估各参数值的似然；判别式判定（discriminative verdict）整体判断调用对错；工具选择竞争（tool-choice competition）将函数与其同类进行对比。遵循一条原则：生成式似然定位错误的参数值，判定式读出捕捉整体性错误调用；错误类型未知时，集成（ensemble）是低遗憾默认选择。整个读出过程无需训练，无需访问智能体内部，仅需一次预填充（prefill）即可与工具调用并行完成。
AI.result: 在困难编码任务上达到AUROC 0.825，而智能体自述置信度接近随机（0.598）；生成式读出在另外三个智能体上比其领先+0.07至+0.28。相对自一致性（self-consistency）在近确定性智能体上提升+0.14至+0.19，成本仅为其1/K。该信号驱动两种部署模式：实时门控将最不可信的调用升级审查（50%覆盖率下接受动作准确率提升+0.05至+0.30）；置信反馈将工具结果与分数一并返回使智能体调整下一步，在实时执行基准上提升任务成功率（+0.119与+0.137，p ≤ 1e-4），并在错误静默的步骤上击败随机值对照（+0.078，p = 0.003）。
AI.conclusion: 通过低成本开源权重替代模型的并行读出，可在不访问智能体内部、无需训练的情况下恢复前沿模型缺失的错误信号，该信号既能用于实时门控审查低可信调用，也能作为置信反馈提升智能体的任务成功率。

title: Memory-State Critic for Asymmetric Actor-Critic with Application to Vision-Based Pursuit-Evasion
comment: Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026), Lille, France. Non-archival workshop
summary: In partially observable Markov decision processes, the optimal policy generally depends on the history of observations and past actions. Asymmetric actor-critic methods have become popular to learn such policies when additional information, such as the true state of the environment, is available during training. The critic, which is not needed at execution, is given access to the state. A critic conditioned on the state alone is generally ill-defined and yields biased policy gradients. Conditioning on the state and the history, the history-state critic restores both. In this paper, we show that conditioning the critic on the state and the policy's own memory, i.e., the internal representation of the history through which the policy selects its actions, is already well-defined and gives unbiased policy gradients, removing the need for a second recurrent approximator of the history. We call it the memory state critic. It follows that a critic based on the policy's memory need not backpropagate its loss into that memory, even though the memory is a lossy encoding of the history. We evaluate the memory-state critic in a vision-based pursuit-evasion environment between two quadrotors across two arena types. The pursuer is the learning agent, and the evader is sampled per episode from a fixed pool of heuristic behaviours. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. In addition to being unbiased compared to the state-only critic, it maintains a slight edge in the wall arena, where the actor's history carries information that the privileged state alone does not.

AI.tldr: 提出"记忆状态评论家"(memory-state critic):让评论家仅以真实状态与策略自身记忆为条件,即已well-defined并给出无偏策略梯度,无需第二个循环网络近似历史,也无需将损失反传进记忆;视域内四旋翼追逃实验显示其优于history-state critic且收敛更快。
AI.motivation: POMDP中最优策略依赖观测与动作历史;非对称actor-critic在训练期可利用特权信息(真实状态),但仅以状态为条件的评论家定义不良、策略梯度有偏。现有做法是让评论家同时以状态和历史为条件(history-state critic)才恢复well-defined与无偏性,但这需要额外的循环近似器来编码历史,代价较高。
AI.method: 将评论家条件化为(state, 策略自身记忆):策略的记忆是其选择动作所依据的历史内部表征。理论上论证该"memory-state critic"已well-defined且策略梯度无偏;由此推出基于策略记忆的评论家无需把损失反传进该记忆,即使该记忆是历史的有损编码。在两个arena类型(含wall arena)的视觉四旋翼追逃任务中评估:pursuer为学习智能体,evader每回合从固定启发式行为池中采样。
AI.result: memory-state critic优于history-state critic且收敛更快;相较state-only critic保持无偏,并在wall arena中保有轻微优势——该场景下actor的历史携带了特权状态所不具备的信息。
AI.conclusion: 以策略记忆加状态作为评论家条件,足以获得well-defined且无偏的策略梯度,从而省去第二个历史循环近似器,并可避免对策略记忆的反向传播,在部分可观测的视觉控制任务中带来更快收敛与更优性能。

title: Return-to-Home Feasible Micro-Aerial Vehicle Exploration for 3D Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction
comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on INTELLIGENT ROBOTS & SYSTEMS 2026
summary: Micro aerial vehicles (MAVs) enable rapid indoor 3D reconstruction for inspection and time-critical situational awareness, but must operate under strict flight-time budgets and safety constraints that require explicit return-to-home (RTH) feasibility with a conservative margin. We present a topology-first active reconstruction framework that decouples high-fidelity rendering from navigation. A dense 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) map is optimized as the reconstruction target, while a lightweight Truncated Signed Distance Field (TSDF)/occupancy scaffold supports conservative collision checking and online construction of a sparse 3D Voronoi skeleton roadmap. Since directly extracting roadmaps from TSDF geometry can be unstable under noisy and incomplete online fusion, we validate nodes and edges using carved free-space consistency and dense visibility checks, which suppress behind-wall phantom structure and stabilize planning. Viewpoints are selected on the roadmap using a flight-time-budget-aware objective and a lightweight receding-horizon lookahead to improve non-myopic exploration behavior. We evaluate on photorealistic indoor simulation benchmarks (ReplicaCAD, Gibson, and HM3D), reporting reconstruction coverage/error, RTH success, and computational cost. Results demonstrate improved or competitive performance relative to recent GS-based baselines under identical flight-time budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出拓扑优先的主动重建框架，将高保真渲染与导航解耦：以稠密3DGS为重建目标，用轻量TSDF/占据脚手架构建稀疏3D Voronoi骨架路线图，并用自由空间一致性与可见性校验稳定规划。
AI.motivation: 微小型飞行器（MAV）可在室内快速三维重建，但飞行时间预算严格、安全性要求高，需显式保证返航（RTH）可行并留有余量；现有GS类方法将渲染与导航耦合，在噪声与不完整在线融合下路线图提取不稳定。
AI.method: 拓扑优先的主动重建框架。稠密3DGS地图作为重建目标；轻量TSDF/占据栅格作为脚手架，支持保守碰撞检测与在线构建稀疏3D Voronoi骨架路线图。针对TSDF几何直接提取路线图不稳定的问题，采用被雕刻自由空间一致性与稠密可见性检查校验节点和边，抑制墙后幻影结构。基于飞行时间预算的目标函数在路线图上选择视点，并引入轻量滚动时域前瞻以改善非短视探索。
AI.result: 在ReplicaCAD、Gibson、HM3D照片级真实感室内仿真基准上评估，报告重建覆盖率/误差、RTH成功率与计算开销；在相同飞行时间预算下，性能优于或可比于近期基于GS的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高保真渲染与导航解耦、并以拓扑骨架驱动规划，可在严格飞行时间与安全约束下实现更稳健的室内主动重建与返航可行性；拓扑校验机制有效抑制幻影结构并稳定在线规划。

title: Energy Variation in Training Modern Computer Vision Architectures
comment: International Conference on Next-Generation AI Technologies (ICNGAIT) Shanghai, China, 5 pages, 1 table
summary: The rapid growth of deep learning has substantially increased the energy consumption associated with model training, making energy efficiency an increasingly relevant design criterion. This study empirically measures the energy variation of training seven modern computer vision architectures, MobileNetV3-Small, MobileNetV3-Large, EfficientNet-B0, EfficientNet-B1, ViT-B/32, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and ViT-B/16 for the ImageNet-1k classification task, using a homogeneous 10,000-image subset (ImageNet-10k) and a uniform 40-epoch baseline configuration executed on two NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs at the Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Center of Colombia (BIOS). Energy was recorded directly via NVML and contrasted with the computational complexity of each model. The results show a Pearson correlation of 0.85 between floating-point operations (GFLOPs) and energy consumption in kWh, indicating that computational complexity is a strong but imperfect predictor of energy expenditure: architectures with comparable GFLOPs exhibited consumption differing by up to 3.1x due to differences in the hardware efficiency of their dominant operations. The EfficientNet variants offered the best balance between classification performance (Val Top-5 up to 97.15%) and energy efficiency (0.457-0.611 kWh), while Vision Transformers exhibited the highest relative energy consumption and lower classification performance under the evaluated configuration. These findings guide architecture selection in energy-constrained computing environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究对7种现代计算机视觉架构在ImageNet-10k上以统一40轮配置训练，用NVML直接测量能耗，发现GFLOPs与能耗（kWh）的Pearson相关系数为0.85，说明计算复杂度是能耗的强但非完美预测因子；EfficientNet在性能与能效间取得最佳平衡，而ViT能耗最高且性能较低。
AI.motivation: 深度学习快速增长导致模型训练能耗显著上升，能效已成为越来越重要的设计准则，因此需要实证量化不同现代视觉架构的能耗差异。
AI.method: 在哥伦比亚生物信息学与计算生物学中心（BIOS）的两块NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPU上，使用同质的10,000张图像子集（ImageNet-10k）和统一的40轮基线配置，训练MobileNetV3-Small、MobileNetV3-Large、EfficientNet-B0、EfficientNet-B1、ViT-B/32、ConvNeXt-Tiny和ViT-B/16共7种架构；通过NVML直接记录能耗，并与各模型的计算复杂度进行对比分析。
AI.result: GFLOPs与能耗（kWh）的Pearson相关系数为0.85，表明计算复杂度是能耗的强但非完美预测因子：GFLOPs相近的架构因主导算子的硬件效率差异，能耗可相差达3.1倍。EfficientNet变体在分类性能（Val Top-5最高97.15%）与能效（0.457–0.611 kWh）之间平衡最佳；Vision Transformer在该配置下相对能耗最高且分类性能较低。
AI.conclusion: 计算复杂度不能完全决定能耗，算子级硬件效率是重要影响因素；EfficientNet适合能效优先场景，ViT在该训练配置下能效较差。研究结论可为能源受限计算环境下的架构选择提供实证依据。

title: SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts
comment: Accepted at the AI for Chip Design Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Existing analog integrated circuit design benchmarks make two questions hard to answer: whether a model has learned transferable circuit skills rather than recalled familiar examples, and whether its output works under defined process and test conditions. We introduce a benchmark built from human-designed, open-source circuits associated with Tiny Tapeout manufacturing shuttles. The collection contains 273 topologically distinct top-level designs. Every source is retrieved at the revision recorded for its shuttle submission and processed in a fixed containerized environment. The pipeline exports each eligible schematic image and its SPICE netlist from the same source file, giving transcription an exact structural reference. Commit dates support model-specific training-cutoff analysis, while author testbenches provide the simulation context for sizing. The benchmark evaluates schematic-to-netlist transcription and device sizing. Across seven models on a fixed set of 66 transcription tasks, the strongest model reaches 56.1% exact graph isomorphism, and six of seven models drop sharply from the small to the medium tier. For one frontier model, removing author-chosen labels reduces exact matches while preserving aggregate structural F1, suggesting that labels can aid connectivity tracing. On the 17 sizing tasks, the leading model converges on all 17 proposals and reaches 91.2 out of 100 against the human reference, while the two newest Claude models refuse 4 and 11 of the same prompts they transcribe without objection; a proposal without sizes scores zero. The two tasks produce different model rankings, exposing distinct visual and design capabilities and, in one family, a policy rather than capability limit.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于Tiny Tapeout开源模拟电路的新基准，包含273个拓扑不同的顶层设计，评估原理图到网表转录与器件尺寸确定两项任务，揭示模型排名差异及能力与策略性限制。
AI.motivation: 现有模拟集成电路设计基准难以回答两个问题：模型学到的究竟是可迁移的电路技能还是对熟悉样例的记忆；以及其输出能否在指定的工艺与测试条件下正常工作。为弥补这一缺口，作者构建了更贴近真实工程流程的基准。
AI.method: 从与Tiny Tapeout制造班车关联的人工设计开源电路中构建基准，共273个拓扑不同的顶层设计。每个源文件按提交时记录的版本获取，并在固定的容器化环境中处理。流水线从同一源文件导出原理图图像及其SPICE网表，为转录提供精确的结构参照。提交日期支持按模型训练截止时间进行分析，作者提供的testbench为尺寸确定任务提供仿真上下文。评估两项任务：原理图到网表转录和器件尺寸确定。
AI.result: 在固定的66个转录任务上评测七个模型，最强模型达到56.1%的精确图同构，七个模型中有六个从小规模到中等规模档位性能急剧下降。对某前沿模型，去掉作者选择的标签会降低精确匹配数，但整体结构F1得以保持，说明标签有助于连通性追踪。在17个尺寸任务上，领先模型对全部17个方案均收敛，相对人工参考得分为91.2/100；而两个最新的Claude模型对同样可无异议转录的提示分别拒绝4个和11个，未给出尺寸的方案得分为零。两项任务产生不同的模型排名，揭示出不同的视觉与设计能力，并在某一模型家族中体现出策略性而非能力性限制。
AI.conclusion: 该基准通过转录与尺寸两类任务区分了模型的视觉理解与电路设计能力，且能识别策略性拒绝等非能力限制。其真实工艺与测试上下文、训练截止时间信息和精确结构参照，使可迁移性与可制造性评估更具可靠性。

title: Where Does Jagged Competence Come From?
summary: Capable systems often show jagged competence: low average error alongside failures on particular inputs. We ask where it comes from in a task built from two known layers. A lower layer A computes five per-slot sums from records; an upper layer B uses the slot-1 sum and a mode carried over from earlier boards to predict the next board's category, so B cannot be computed from the current A alone: B is a strict extension of A. We train small recurrent networks on B and measure, against exact ground truth, what they acquire of A. The central finding is that learning B gives the network a jagged version of A, measured through probe readability and supervised outputs. It is readable where B needs it (slot 1, 97-98% by a linear probe) and becomes less readable where B does not (the other slots, 5-10%); category misreads concentrate near the slot-1 cutoffs; and when A is trained explicitly it comes out only approximately right. The networks show jagged competence in B: natural KL below $3\times10^{-4}$ bits coexists with a maximum law TV of about 0.25 on constructed histories. Matched experiments show that even a good A is not enough: connecting a learned A to B cuts misreads 1.3 to 17-fold, the same exact A gives fewer misreads as one-hot inputs (0-2) than as numerical inputs (10-317), one B update makes an exact A inexact unless the B gradient is blocked, and exact A still leaves some B failures. In this task, uneven acquisition, access and preservation of the lower theory explain part of the jagged competence of a network that learns the theory built on it; some failures remain unexplained. Whether the same holds in larger systems is a test to run.

AI.tldr: 在网络学习由两层构成的任务时，下层理论A的习得是不均匀的：仅在与上层B相关的部分（slot 1）可读性高，其余部分低，从而部分解释了系统能力的"锯齿状"（jagged competence）表现。
AI.motivation: 现实中的能力系统常表现出"锯齿状能力"：平均误差很低，却在个别输入上失败。作者希望在一个由两层已知结构搭建的任务中，追问这种失败从何而来，特别是上层理论依赖下层理论时的习得与保持问题。
AI.method: 构造两层任务：下层A从记录计算五个逐槽（slot）之和；上层B使用slot-1之和及从先前棋盘遗留下来的mode来预测下一个棋盘的类别，因此B无法仅由当前A算出，是A的严格扩展。训练小型循环网络学习B，并用精确真值（ground truth）度量其对A的习得，包括线性探针可读性和监督输出；并做匹配实验（学习到的A接入B、精确A以one-hot与数值输入、阻塞B梯度等）。
AI.result: 学习B得到的A是"锯齿状"的：B需要的slot 1可读性达97–98%，B不需要的其他槽降到5–10%；类别误读集中在slot-1阈值附近；显式训练A也只能近似正确。B上自然KL低于3×10⁻⁴ bits，同时构造历史上的最大law TV约为0.25。匹配实验显示：好的A并不够——接入可把误读降低1.3–17倍；同一精确A以one-hot输入误读0–2，以数值输入则为10–317；一次B更新会使精确A变得不精确，除非阻塞B梯度；精确A仍留下部分B失败。
AI.conclusion: 在该任务中，下层理论的不均匀习得、访问与保持，部分解释了学习其上层理论的网络的锯齿状能力；但仍有部分失败未被解释。作者提出，这一现象是否在更大系统中成立有待检验。

title: A Biomimetic Gaze Control to Restore Head-Neck Movements
summary: Powered neck exoskeletons are developed to restore head-neck motions for those with neck muscle weakness. Current methods using hand-held input devices to control these robotic systems are unintuitive or non-viable for these populations. Alternatively, the eyes coordinate with the head to accomplish many daily tasks. Therefore, movements of the eyes can be a useful signal to control the neck exoskeletons without needing to use the hands. However, previous control models lack biobehavioral basis as well as means to personalize the control behavior, causing unnatural head-neck movements. This paper presents a novel eye-tracking controller design leveraging the vestibulo-ocular reflex to emulate natural eyehead coordination. Personalization tools were also designed, consisting of sliders to allow users to adjust the parameters of this controller. Here, we present the technical design and validation of this system in human users. Compared to the previous eye-tracking model, the new controller provides natural head motions personalized to the user through more natural velocity profiles and a 24 percent average increase of accurate motion intent detection. This system provides a powerful platform for studying eye-tracking controllers in the context of personalization and preference, and ultimately restoring the lost head-neck mobility in patient populations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于前庭眼反射的眼动控制器，用于颈部外骨骼，并设计个性化调节工具，实现自然且个性化的头颈运动控制。
AI.motivation: 现有手持输入设备控制颈部外骨骼不直观或对颈部肌无力人群不可行，而既往眼动控制模型缺乏生物行为依据和个性化手段，导致头颈运动不自然。
AI.method: 利用前庭眼反射机制设计新型眼动控制器以模拟自然的眼-头协调，并开发个性化工具，通过滑块让用户调节控制器参数。
AI.result: 相比既往眼动模型，新控制器提供了更自然的角速度曲线及个性化头部运动，精确运动意图检测平均提升24%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为研究眼动控制器的个性化与偏好提供了有力平台，有望最终恢复患者丧失的头颈活动能力。

title: What Do Verifiable Rewards Teach Video-Language Models About Time? A Controlled Multi-Model Study
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has produced large reasoning gains in language models, and verifiable video benchmarks make it applicable to causal-temporal video question answering. We study what RLVR teaches video-language models about time. We fine-tune four open models (Qwen3-VL-8B/4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Gemma-3-12B) with group relative policy optimization under three data recipes: verified (synthetic CLEVRER questions with exact answer and event-order rewards), unverified (self-supervised pretext tasks over 43,751 real web videos), and a 1:1 mixture, plus a verified+real arm that adds 4,000 verifiable questions on real video. Each cell is evaluated in-domain and on out-of-domain real video (a NExT-QA temporal stress set and an MVBench subset), with frames in order, shuffled, and absent. (1) Verified training yields large in-domain gains that shrink as base competence grows (+14 to +19 points on weaker models; +6 on the strongest). (2) Much of the gain is non-visual: accuracy with no frames rises nearly as much as with frames. (3) Verified-only training can severely degrade out-of-domain accuracy with no sign during training: Qwen3-VL-8B loses 26.7 and 25.2 points on the two real-video sets, while the mixture never significantly degrades a model trained on it. Adding real verified questions removes that loss (-2.3 points, within noise of base) and keeps a +9.3 in-domain gain, so the cause is narrow synthetic-only data, not verification. (4) No recipe induces temporal-order grounding: across 41 evaluations the ordered-versus-shuffled gap is indistinguishable from zero in 39 and marginal in two, despite an event-order reward. Verifiable rewards improve benchmark accuracy without temporal understanding. Report no-frame controls, and mix in real video to guard against out-of-domain degradation.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察了可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）对视频语言模型"时间理解"的影响。结果显示：验证式训练能大幅提升领域内准确率，但增益多与视觉无关（无帧输入同样涨分），且仅用合成数据会严重损害域外性能；混合真实视频可消除退化，但没有任何配方能让模型真正建立时序顺序 grounding。
AI.motivation: RLVR 已在语言模型推理上取得显著收益，且可验证视频基准使其适用于因果-时序视频问答。但"RLVR 究竟教给视频语言模型什么"尚不清楚，尤其它是否真正赋予模型时序理解能力，还是仅提升基准分数。作者因此希望厘清可验证奖励对时间建模的真实作用，并识别训练数据构成带来的风险。
AI.method: 微调四个开源模型（Qwen3-VL-8B/4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Gemma-3-12B），使用 GRPO，比较三种数据配方：verified（合成 CLEVRER 问题，含精确答案与事件顺序奖励）、unverified（43,751 个真实网络视频上的自监督 pretext 任务）及其 1:1 混合，另加一组 verified+real（补充 4,000 个真实视频可验证问题）。每格在域内及域外真实视频（NExT-QA 时序压力集与 MVBench 子集）上评估，并设置帧有序、打乱、缺失三种条件，配合无帧对照。
AI.result: (1) 验证式训练带来大幅域内增益，但随基座能力增强而衰减（弱模型 +14~+19 分，最强模型 +6 分）。(2) 相当部分增益与视觉无关：无帧准确率提升几乎与有帧相当。(3) 仅验证式训练会严重损害域外准确率且训练中无预警（Qwen3-VL-8B 在两个真实视频集上分别下降 26.7 与 25.2 分），而混合配方从不显著退化；加入真实可验证问题后该损失消失（-2.3 分，在基座噪声范围内）并保留 +9.3 的域内增益，说明成因是纯合成数据过窄而非验证机制本身。(4) 没有任何配方诱导出时序顺序 grounding：41 项评估中，有序-打乱差距在 39 项上不可区分于零，仅 2 项边缘显著，尽管使用了事件顺序奖励。
AI.conclusion: 可验证奖励能提升基准准确率，却不带来真正的时序理解；仅合成数据还会在无预警情况下造成域外退化。建议在报告时加入无帧对照，并混入真实视频以防域外性能下降。

title: MLLMs Fail to Refuse when Using Tools Agentically
summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently pushed the frontier of visual reasoning by calling tools such as zooming and tagging. Despite the recent strong success of agentic MLLMs, this work uncovers a critical safety failure in the tool-use paradigm: agentic tool-using MLLMs become less capable of refusing harmful requests. Our experiments confirm that, across three popular safety benchmarks, all the top open- and closed-weight MLLMs we test exhibit significantly lower safety in tool-using settings than in non-tool settings, with a relative refusal failure rate increase of up to 68.7%. Based on analysis of 100,000+ responses, including extended experiments, we also propose two possible reasons for this safety degradation.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现：具备工具调用能力的代理式多模态大模型（agentic MLLMs）在工具使用场景下拒绝有害请求的能力显著下降，安全基准上的相对拒绝失败率最高增加68.7%。
AI.motivation: 代理式MLLM通过缩放、打标签等工具调用推动了视觉推理前沿，但其工具使用范式中可能存在被忽视的安全风险。作者旨在检验工具使用是否削弱模型拒绝有害请求的能力。
AI.method: 在三个主流安全基准上，对多个顶级开源与闭源权重MLLM，对比其工具使用设置与非工具设置下的安全性表现；并基于100,000+条回复及扩展实验进行分析，提出安全退化的可能原因。
AI.result: 所有受测MLLM在工具使用设置下的安全性均显著低于非工具设置，相对拒绝失败率最高增加68.7%；通过10万+回复分析归纳出两类可能原因。
AI.conclusion: 工具使用范式会系统性削弱代理式MLLM的安全对齐，尤其在拒绝有害请求方面存在关键安全失效，需引起重视并加以改进。

title: LLM-enhanced spatio-temporal learning for grid-level docked bike sharing demand prediction
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
summary: Short-term bike-sharing demand forecasting is complicated by spatial-temporal non-stationarity and the practical difficulty of incorporating unstructured external text into numerical pipelines. Conventional approaches rely on historical flow sequences and fixed graph structures, thereby constraining their accuracy when anomalous social events perturb normal travel patterns. We propose a forecasting framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) drives a semantic shockwave mechanism that converts free-form urban text, such as municipal event schedules, local news, and transit bulletins, into quantified spatial-temporal perturbation fields. The LLM extracts three physically interpretable parameters per event (intensity, spatial reach, and temporal lag), from which Gaussian decay fields are constructed and injected into a Zero-Inflated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ZI-ASTGCN). To handle the pronounced sparsity of grid-level measurements, the model couples a dual-branch output head with a multi-task zero-inflated loss that jointly trains a gating probability and a conditional flow intensity. Experiments on the operational Barcelona Bicing dataset show that ZI-ASTGCN outperforms established neural baselines, with particularly strong gains during high-demand periods, validating the utility of physics-grounded semantic signals in spatial-temporal mobility forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM驱动的语义冲击波机制，将城市自由文本转换为量化时空扰动场并注入ZI-ASTGCN，用于共享单车需求预测，在巴塞罗那Bicing数据上优于现有神经基线，高需求时段提升尤为显著。
AI.motivation: 短期共享单车需求预测面临时空非平稳性，以及非结构化外部文本难以嵌入数值流程的实际困难。传统方法依赖历史流量序列与固定图结构，当异常社会事件扰动正常出行模式时，预测精度受限。
AI.method: 构建由大语言模型驱动的语义冲击波机制：LLM从市政活动安排、本地新闻、交通公告等自由文本中，为每个事件抽取三个具物理可解释性的参数（强度、空间影响范围、时间滞后），据此构建高斯衰减场并注入零膨胀自适应时空图卷积网络（ZI-ASTGCN）。针对网格级测量的显著稀疏性，模型采用双分支输出头与多任务零膨胀损失，联合训练门控概率与条件流量强度。
AI.result: 在运营中的巴塞罗那Bicing数据集上，ZI-ASTGCN优于已有的神经基线，尤其在高需求时段增益明显，验证了物理化语义信号在时空出行预测中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM抽取的物理可解释事件参数转化为时空扰动场，可有效融合非结构化文本与数值预测流程，缓解异常事件下的预测偏差，为时空出行需求预测提供了语义—物理融合的新范式。

title: Reward-DAgger: Robot-Gated Interactive Imitation Learning with General-Purpose Progress-Based Reward Models
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have enabled generalist control policies capable of completing a wide range of tasks. However, their performance degrades when deployed in unseen environments, making it critical to detect failures and teach recovery behaviors. Existing runtime monitoring methods often require task- and policy-specific training or hyperparameter tuning, limiting cross-task deployment and introducing additional overhead during iterative policy updates. We present Reward-DAgger, a robot-gated interactive imitation learning framework that uses dense progress signals from a general-purpose reward model to determine when human intervention is needed. Our approach is agnostic to the underlying policy architecture, requires no access to policy internals, and can be applied across tasks without retuning the gating mechanism. Our results show that Reward-DAgger achieves a better failure-detection accuracy-latency tradeoff than existing runtime monitoring baselines. Across eight simulated and real-world tasks, Reward-DAgger consistently improves the downstream policy's autonomous success rate throughout interactive learning and achieves strong return on human effort, outperforming the baselines in most settings. Importantly, the same gating configuration is used across tasks without task-specific hyperparameter tuning, demonstrating transfer across tasks, environments, and policy architectures. Code and videos are available at https://liralab.usc.edu/reward-dagger.

AI.tldr: 提出Reward-DAgger：利用通用奖励模型的稠密进度信号进行机器人门控式交互模仿学习，无需任务特定调参即可跨任务检测失败并触发人类干预，在8个仿真与真实任务上提升了自主成功率与人力回报。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略在未见环境中性能下降，因此需要检测失败并教授恢复行为。但现有运行时监控方法依赖任务与策略特定的训练或超参调优，难以跨任务部署，并在策略迭代更新时引入额外开销。
AI.method: Reward-DAgger是一种机器人门控（robot-gated）交互模仿学习框架，使用通用奖励模型输出的稠密进度信号来判断何时需要人类干预。该方法与策略架构无关，无需访问策略内部信息，且门控机制跨任务无需重新调参。
AI.result: 相比现有运行时监控基线，Reward-DAgger在失败检测准确率—延迟权衡上更优；在8个仿真和真实任务中，交互学习过程中持续提升下游策略的自主成功率，并获得较高的人力回报，在多数场景下优于基线；同一门控配置跨任务通用，无需任务特定超参调优，体现了跨任务、环境与策略架构的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: Reward-DAgger证明基于通用奖励模型的稠密进度信号可实现免调参、策略无关的失败检测与干预门控，有效支持跨任务交互模仿学习并提升自主成功率与人力效率。

title: WAMJET: A Harness for World Action Model Acceleration
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video foundation models for robot manipulation, but their large backbones and video-action co-prediction are expensive. Although existing acceleration techniques offer many ways to reduce this cost, selecting and composing them requires substantial engineering for each model and hardware platform. To tackle this bottleneck, we present WAMJET, an agentic harness that accelerates WAM inference by equipping coding agents with reusable optimization guidance and measurement and validation tools. WAMJET follows a bottleneck-driven workflow where the agent profiles inference, modifies targeted code, validates effects, and iteratively refines the acceleration stack as bottlenecks shift, while preserving action quality. Experiments span six WAMs, three coding agents, and two GPU architectures. WAMJET achieves up to 9.95x lossless speedup over upstream implementations. Approximation and hardware-aware optimization yield additional latency reductions, with comparable success rates. The results show that WAMJET can produce effective acceleration stacks for WAM deployment.

AI.tldr: WAMJET 是一个智能体框架，通过为编码智能体配备可复用的优化指导、测量与验证工具，自动为世界动作模型（WAM）构建加速栈，实现最高 9.95 倍无损推理加速。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型借助预训练视频基础模型完成机器人操作，但其大型骨干网络与视频-动作联合预测带来高昂计算成本。现有加速技术种类虽多，但针对每个模型和硬件平台选择与组合这些技术需要大量工程投入，成为部署瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 WAMJET——一种智能体化（agentic）加速框架。它给编码智能体提供可复用的优化指南，以及测量与验证工具。工作流以瓶颈驱动为核心：智能体先剖析（profile）推理性能，再定向修改代码，验证加速效果，并随瓶颈迁移迭代优化加速栈，同时保持动作质量。实验覆盖 6 个 WAM、3 个编码智能体与 2 种 GPU 架构。
AI.result: WAMJET 相对上游实现取得最高 9.95 倍的无损加速；近似优化与硬件感知优化可进一步降低延迟，且成功率相当。
AI.conclusion: WAMJET 能为 WAM 部署生成有效的加速栈，表明智能体化的瓶颈驱动优化流程可自动化地解决跨模型、跨硬件的加速工程难题。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model Decision-Making for Autonomous Driving Guided by Chinese Philosophical Wisdom
summary: Autonomous driving decision systems must balance safety, efficiency, and social norms in complex traffic interactions. Philosophical and ethical considerations have received limited attention in existing autonomous driving decision-making approaches based on numerical optimization, sequence prediction, and large language models (LLMs). We propose Chinese Philosophical Wisdom-Guided Driving (CPW-Drive), a closed-loop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that incorporates value guidance derived from Chinese philosophy into autonomous driving decision-making. Using Chinese Confucian thought as its knowledge source, CPW-Drive consolidates LLM-extracted keywords from relevant classical texts into driving-relevant value principles through manual screening and validation. It then contextualizes these principles through scenario-specific cases to form retrievable and reusable value guidance. We further propose Physics-aware Spatial Similarity Retrieval (PSSR), which compares vehicle layouts and velocity-extrapolated states to retrieve physically relevant historical cases. On Highway-env's multilane highway-driving task, CPW-Drive achieves success rates of 93.0%, 86.0%, and 72.0% across three traffic configurations. These results outperform the strongest baseline by 8.0, 22.5, and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. Across all configurations, CPW-Drive achieves the highest collision-free step count and maintains a low lane-change frequency. The results suggest that structured value guidance can improve simulated closed-loop safety and stability while introducing efficiency and latency trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CPW-Drive，一个将中国哲学价值引导融入自动驾驶决策的闭环 RAG 框架，并设计物理感知空间相似检索（PSSR）方法，在多车道高速任务上显著优于基线，同时存在效率与延迟的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于数值优化、序列预测和大语言模型的自动驾驶决策方法，对哲学与伦理层面的考量关注有限，难以在复杂交通交互中兼顾安全、效率与社会规范，因此需要引入结构化的价值引导机制。
AI.method: 提出 CPW-Drive 闭环 RAG 框架：以中国儒家思想为知识源，将由 LLM 从经典文本中提取的关键词经人工筛选与验证整合为驾驶相关价值原则，并通过场景化案例将其情境化，形成可检索、可复用的价值引导；同时提出物理感知空间相似检索（PSSR），通过比较车辆布局与速度外推状态来检索物理相关的历史案例。
AI.result: 在 Highway-env 多车道高速驾驶任务中，CPW-Drive 在三种交通配置下成功率分别为 93.0%、86.0% 和 72.0%，较最强基线分别高出 8.0、22.5 和 25.0 个百分点；在所有配置下均取得最高的无碰撞步数，并保持较低的变道频率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，结构化的价值引导能够提升模拟闭环环境下的安全性与稳定性，但同时会带来效率与延迟方面的权衡。

title: KVE-KD: Key Visual Evidence-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation is crucial for deploying vision-language models on resource-constrained devices. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision across visual tokens or rely on static token selection, which confuses task-relevant cues with background noise and degrades cross-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Key Visual Evidence-guided Knowledge Distillation (KVE-KD), a framework that dynamically focuses feature distillation on task-relevant visual tokens identified by the teacher model. Specifically, KVE-KD appoints the final pre-generation textual token as a unified semantic anchor and identifies the target cross-modal fusion layer by analyzing changes in the anchor representation through iterative visual-token contribution removal. Within this layer, KVE-KD ranks visual tokens via the anchor-conditioned attention distribution and selects the most informative visual tokens as key visual evidence with normalized entropy. The key visual evidence subsequently guides focused visual feature distillation, making the student align closely with the teacher's task-relevant visual representations while suppressing irrelevant background information. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that KVE-KD outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal distillation methods, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring complex reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. Importantly, these improvements are achieved without introducing any inference-time overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/zhangjianbin07/KVE-KD.

AI.tldr: 提出KVE-KD框架，利用教师模型识别任务相关视觉token（关键视觉证据），引导聚焦式特征蒸馏，在六个基准上超越SOTA且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型知识蒸馏方法对视觉token施加均匀监督或采用静态token选择，难以区分任务相关线索与背景噪声，导致跨模态推理能力下降。为将VLM部署于资源受限设备，需要更有效的蒸馏监督方式。
AI.method: KVE-KD以生成前的最后一个文本token作为统一语义锚点，通过迭代移除视觉token贡献、分析锚点表示变化来定位目标跨模态融合层；在该层内依据锚点条件注意力分布对视觉token排序，并用归一化熵选取信息量最大的token作为关键视觉证据，进而指导聚焦式视觉特征蒸馏，使学生对齐教师任务相关的视觉表示并抑制无关背景。
AI.result: 在六个基准上的实验表明，KVE-KD优于现有跨模态蒸馏方法，在需要复杂推理和细粒度视觉理解的任务上提升尤为显著，且不引入任何推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: KVE-KD通过动态、任务相关的视觉token选择实现聚焦式跨模态知识蒸馏，在无推理开销前提下显著提升学生模型性能，为资源受限设备上部署VLM提供了有效方案。

title: Terrain-Dependent Intra-Cycle Leg Timing for Effective Locomotion on Granular Slopes
summary: Locomotion on granular slopes such as sand dunes remains a fundamental challenge for legged robots due to reduced shear strength and gravity-induced anisotropic yielding of granular media. Using a hexapedal robot on a tiltable granular bed, we systematically measure locomotion speed together with slope-dependent normal and shear granular resistive forces. While normal penetration resistance remains nearly unchanged with inclination, shear resistance decreases substantially as slope angle increases. Guided by these measurements, we develop a simple robot-terrain interaction model that predicts anchoring timing, step length, and resulting robot speed, as functions of terrain strength and slope angle. The model reveals that slope-induced performance loss is primarily governed by delayed anchoring and increased backward slip rather than excessive sinkage. By extending the model to generalized terrain conditions, we construct failure phase diagrams that identify sinkage- and slippage-induced failure regimes, enabling quantitative risk estimation for locomotion on granular slopes. This physics-informed framework provides predictive insight into terrain-dependent failure mechanisms and offers guidance for safer and more robust robot operation on deformable inclines.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过六足机器人在可倾斜颗粒床上的实验，测量坡度相关的法向与剪切阻力，建立机器人-地形相互作用模型，揭示颗粒坡面上性能损失主要由锚定延迟和后滑增加（而非过度下陷）导致，并构建失效相图以量化风险。
AI.motivation: 颗粒坡面（如沙丘）因剪切强度降低和重力诱导的各向异性屈服，对足式机器人运动构成根本性挑战；需厘清坡度相关的阻力机制并预测失效，以支持更安全稳健的机器人运行。
AI.method: 在可倾斜颗粒床上使用六足机器人，系统测量运动速度及随坡度变化的法向与剪切颗粒阻力；基于测量建立简化的机器人-地形相互作用模型，预测锚定时机、步长与速度，并推广至广义地形条件构建失效相图。
AI.result: 法向贯入阻力随倾角几乎不变，而剪切阻力随坡度显著下降；模型表明坡度导致的性能损失主要源于锚定延迟与后滑增加，而非过度下陷；失效相图识别出下陷型与滑移型失效区域，可定量估计风险。
AI.conclusion: 该物理信息框架为颗粒坡面上地形依赖的失效机制提供预测性洞察，并为可变形斜坡上更安全、更鲁棒的机器人作业提供指导。

title: StepCAD: Mesh-to-CAD Code Generation via LLM Policy and Geometry-Guided Search
summary: Recovering executable CAD programs from 3D meshes is challenging due to the compositional nature of CAD construction and the interaction between discrete modeling choices and continuous parameters. Many learning-based methods predict complete programs in a single pass and rely predominantly on sketch-extrude representations, limiting operation diversity and opportunities to correct geometric errors during reconstruction. We introduce StepCAD, a generative optimization approach that combines a state-conditioned CAD policy with geometry-guided search. Given an input mesh, the policy predicts construction actions conditioned on both target and intermediate geometry, and an IoU-guided tree search refines the resulting program through local edits. We also introduce ARCADE-1.5M, a large-scale dataset of 1.5M executable CAD programs spanning diverse operations, sequences with a maximum length of 150+ counted operations, and 12.5M intermediate state-action transitions. Experiments across multiple CAD reconstruction benchmarks show that StepCAD achieves state-of-the-art geometric reconstruction accuracy with consistently high validity, yielding up to 87.2% relative IoU improvement over the strongest evaluated baseline, with particularly large gains on complex shapes. Project page: https://ghadinehme.com/stepcad.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出StepCAD，一种状态条件CAD策略与几何引导搜索相结合的生成式优化方法，从3D网格恢复可执行CAD程序，并发布ARCADE-1.5M数据集，在多个基准上取得最优几何重构精度。
AI.motivation: 从3D网格恢复可执行CAD程序具有挑战性：CAD构建具有组合性，且离散建模选择与连续参数相互耦合。现有学习方法多采用单次完整预测，且主要依赖草图-拉伸（sketch-extrude）表示，导致操作多样性受限，重构过程中缺乏纠正几何误差的机会。
AI.method: StepCAD将状态条件的CAD策略与几何引导搜索相结合：给定输入网格，策略以目标几何与中间几何为条件预测构建动作；再通过IoU引导的树搜索以局部编辑方式精化所得程序。同时构建ARCADE-1.5M数据集，包含150万条可执行CAD程序，覆盖多样操作、最长达150+个计数的操作序列及1250万条中间状态-动作转移。
AI.result: 在多个CAD重构基准上，StepCAD取得最先进的几何重构精度并保持高有效率，相较最强评测基线相对IoU提升最高达87.2%，在复杂形状上增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 状态条件生成策略与IoU引导树搜索的结合有效提升了CAD程序恢复的几何精度与有效性，尤其适用于复杂形状；配套大规模数据集ARCADE-1.5M为相关研究提供了支撑。

title: LatentQuant: Preserving the Policy-Facing Latent Contract under NVFP4 VAE Quantization
summary: Recent world action models (WAMs) reuse pretrained video VAEs whose encoder latents directly condition downstream action policies. Quantization must therefore preserve not only reconstruction fidelity but also the policy-facing latent contract expected by the frozen policy. Direct NVFP4 leaves W4A4 quantization error uncompensated, whereas joint quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover reconstruction by moving this representation. On Wan2.1, joint QAT nearly matches FP32 VBench-7 (0.7403 versus 0.7409), yet LIBERO success collapses from 95.5% to 10.5%. Controlled decoder-only experiments show that activation quantize-dequantize operations alter the reconstruction signal and decoder Jacobian, redirecting the gradient returned to the encoder and inducing persistent latent drift. Based on this mechanism, we introduce LatentQuant, a two-stage NVFP4 QAT framework that first aligns the quantized encoder with its high-precision counterpart, then freezes it while adapting the decoder. Across Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, LatentQuant preserves near-baseline control and high reconstruction quality, achieving 95.75% success on LIBERO and 68.8% on RoboTwin. On NVIDIA B300 GPUs, NVFP4 execution achieves 1.17x-1.26x end-to-end VAE speedups over BF16 cuDNN.

AI.tldr: 本文针对世界动作模型（WAMs）中视频VAE量化问题提出LatentQuant：一个两阶段NVFP4量化感知训练（QAT）框架，先对齐量化编码器与高精度编码器，再冻结编码器适配解码器，从而同时保持重建质量与下游动作策略性能。
AI.motivation: WAMs复用预训练视频VAE，其编码器潜变量直接用于条件化下游动作策略，因此量化不仅要保持重建保真度，还需维持冻结策略所期望的潜变量契约。直接NVFP4（W4A4）会留下未补偿的量化误差；而联合QAT虽能通过移动表征恢复重建质量，却会破坏策略性能。
AI.method: 作者首先通过实验揭示机制：仅解码器（decoder-only）对照实验表明，激活量化-反量化操作会改变重建信号与解码器雅可比，进而重定向回传至编码器的梯度，导致持续的潜变量漂移。基于该机制，提出LatentQuant两阶段NVFP4 QAT框架：第一阶段将量化编码器与其高精度对应版本对齐，第二阶段冻结编码器并适配解码器。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1上，联合QAT的重建几乎匹配FP32 VBench-7（0.7403 vs 0.7409），但LIBERO成功率从95.5%骤降至10.5%。LatentQuant在Wan2.1与Wan2.2上均保持接近基线的控制性能与高重建质量，在LIBERO上达到95.75%成功率，在RoboTwin上达到68.8%。在NVIDIA B300 GPU上，NVFP4执行相比BF16 cuDNN实现1.17x-1.26x的端到端VAE加速。
AI.conclusion: 量化对WAMs的关键在于维护策略所依赖的潜变量契约，而非仅追求重建保真度。LatentQuant通过解耦编码器对齐与解码器适配，成功在NVFP4下兼顾重建质量、动作策略性能与推理加速。

title: BAT-NO: A Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator for Crashworthiness Prediction of Vehicle Components
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations provide accurate crashworthiness predictions, but their cost limits iterative design exploration. Deep learning surrogates can reduce this cost, but many component-level models are developed under a single prescribed boundary condition, limiting generalisation to boundary variations. This work proposes a Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator (BAT-NO) for autoregressive prediction of transient displacement fields and scalar crashworthiness responses under variations in geometry and boundary conditions. A B-pillar simulation framework evaluates generalisation across variations in geometry, impact position and velocity, and support stiffness. BAT-NO combines recurrent mesh processing with latent-grid Fourier operator processing. Boundary-condition information is transferred to the latent grid through a hybrid local--global mechanism. Slice-based attention models interactions among physically related regions, while direct boundary-to-grid projection preserves local spatial structure. Across the validation sets for the shape-only, shape-and-loading, and shape-loading-boundary cases, BAT-NO achieves the lowest mean final-step mean nodal Euclidean displacement error among the evaluated baselines. In the most challenging case, it reduces the mean error by 32.6% relative to the second-best model. Hyperparameter tuning reduces the validation error from 0.451 to 0.269 mm, with a comparable error of 0.267 mm on 300 unseen test simulations sampled within the investigated design space. An attention-based scalar decoder jointly predicts six response trajectories with a mean relative error of 2.46%. Most derived crashworthiness indicators have median errors below 3%. These results show that explicit local and global boundary-condition representations improve crashworthiness prediction over expanded component-level design spaces.

AI.tldr: 提出边界条件感知的 Transformer 神经算子 BAT-NO，实现几何与边界条件变化下的瞬态位移场与碰撞性响应自回归预测，在最难场景中相比次优模型误差降低 32.6%。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元碰撞仿真精度高但计算成本大，限制了迭代式设计探索；深度学习代理模型可降低成本，但多数部件级模型仅在单一预设边界条件下建模，难以泛化到边界条件变化的情形。
AI.method: 构建边界条件感知 Transformer 神经算子（BAT-NO），将循环网格处理与潜网格傅里叶算子处理相结合；通过局部—全局混合机制把边界条件信息传递至潜网格，采用切片式注意力建模物理相关区域间交互，并通过边界到网格的直接投影保留局部空间结构。以 B 柱仿真框架为对象，评估在几何、冲击位置与速度、支撑刚度变化下的泛化能力，并以基于注意力的标量解码器联合预测响应轨迹。
AI.result: 在仅形状、形状与载荷、形状—载荷—边界三类验证集上，BAT-NO 均取得最低的平均末步节点欧氏位移误差；最难场景中较次优模型平均误差降低 32.6%。超参数调优使验证误差由 0.451 mm 降至 0.269 mm，在 300 个未见过测试仿真上误差为 0.267 mm。标量解码器联合预测六条响应轨迹的平均相对误差为 2.46%，多数导出碰撞性指标中位误差低于 3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的局部与全局边界条件表征可提升在扩展部件级设计空间中的碰撞性预测性能，表明边界条件感知神经算子在变边界碰撞代理建模中具有有效性与泛化优势。

title: Autoware in Construction: Gap Analysis and LiDAR Perception Toward Off-Road Autonomous Driving
comment: 2026 IROS 5th Workshop on Future of Construction, 4 pages, 5 figures
summary: Autoware is an open-source autonomous driving software platform widely adopted by researchers and industry developers. Originally developed primarily for public-road applications, including passenger vehicles, taxis, and buses, Autoware is increasingly being extended to off-road environments such as construction and agricultural sites. Construction sites, however, differ fundamentally from public roads and challenge many assumptions underlying conventional autonomous driving systems. They are characterized by unstructured terrain, airborne dust, continuously evolving site conditions, and construction-specific objects. This paper presents lessons learned from ongoing efforts to extend an Autoware-based autonomous driving system to large dump trucks operating at construction sites. We identify gaps between public-road and off-road construction applications across the sensing, mapping, localization, perception, planning, and control modules of the Autoware stack. We then discuss potential solutions for addressing these gaps, with particular emphasis on ongoing LiDAR-based perception pipeline development and findings from field testing. Finally, we propose a roadmap toward end-to-end autonomous driving for construction vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文总结将开源自动驾驶平台 Autoware 从公开道路场景扩展至建筑工地大型自卸卡车应用的经验教训，分析各模块差距并提出解决方案与路线图。
AI.motivation: Autoware 最初主要面向公开道路应用（乘用车、出租车、公交车），但正日益被扩展到建筑、农业等非结构化越野环境。建筑工地与公开道路存在本质差异，对传统自动驾驶系统的基本假设构成挑战，因此需要系统性梳理这些差距与适配经验。
AI.method: 以建筑工地大型自卸卡车为对象，在 Autoware 技术栈的感知（sensing）、建图（mapping）、定位（localization）、感知理解（perception）、规划（planning）与控制（control）六大模块上，系统对比公开道路与越野建筑工地应用之间的差距，并针对差距讨论潜在解决方案，重点围绕正在进行中的基于 LiDAR 的感知流水线开发与现场测试发现。
AI.result: 识别出公开道路与越野建筑工地应用在 Autoware 各模块上的具体差距；提出了相应的潜在解决方案，并给出了基于 LiDAR 的感知流水线开发进展及现场测试（field testing）的初步发现。
AI.conclusion: 面向建筑工地的自动驾驶面临非结构化地形、扬尘、持续变化的场地条件和特定施工物体等特有挑战，需针对 Autoware 各模块进行适配；论文最后提出面向建筑车辆端到端自动驾驶的发展路线图。

title: Beyond Token Accuracy: Prioritizing What Matters for Visual Reconstruction
summary: Tokens have become a unified interface for multimodal foundation models, making visual-token communication a natural paradigm for efficient image delivery. However, existing methods typically rely on static policies that cannot jointly adapt to image content and channel conditions. Moreover, their token-level utility objectives do not necessarily translate into improved image reconstruction quality. In this paper, we propose AdapToC, an adaptive, reconstruction-oriented visual-token communication framework. At the transmitter, an adaptive selector jointly models image content, channel state, and communication budget to perform instance-wise resource allocation. Rather than using a fixed token rate and protection policy, it dynamically determines how many tokens should be transmitted and assigns different protection levels according to token importance and current channel conditions. At the receiver, an adaptive MaskGIT receiver incorporates channel reliability into contextual token modeling. It distinguishes tokens with different reliability levels, preserves high-confidence observations, corrects potentially corrupted tokens, and iteratively reconstructs missing content from the received evidence and global visual context. By co-designing token quantity, unequal protection, and reliability-aware recovery for image-level reconstruction quality, AdapToC achieves a peak mean PSNR gain of 4.20 dB over the strongest static baseline under matched communication costs and state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated visual-token communication methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdapToC，一种自适应、面向重建的视觉 token 通信框架，通过联合设计 token 数量分配、非等保护与可靠性感知恢复，在匹配通信开销下相比最强静态基线取得最高 4.20 dB 的均值 PSNR 增益。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型以 token 作为统一接口，使视觉 token 通信成为高效图像传输的自然范式。但现有方法多采用静态策略，无法同时适应图像内容与信道条件；且其 token 级效用目标并不必然转化为图像重建质量的提升。
AI.method: 发射端设计自适应选择器，联合建模图像内容、信道状态与通信预算，进行实例级资源分配：动态决定传输的 token 数量，并依据 token 重要性与当前信道条件分配不同保护等级。接收端设计自适应 MaskGIT 接收器，将信道可靠性纳入上下文 token 建模，区分不同可靠性等级的 token，保留高置信观测、纠正潜在受损 token，并从接收证据与全局视觉上下文中迭代重建缺失内容。
AI.result: 在匹配通信开销条件下，AdapToC 相比最强静态基线峰值平均 PSNR 提升 4.20 dB，在所评估的视觉 token 通信方法中达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 面向图像级重建质量对 token 数量、非等保护与可靠性感知恢复进行协同设计，是提升视觉 token 通信效率与重建质量的有效途径。

title: ROAR: Unifying Runs across Heterogeneous AI-Driven Research Systems
summary: Each run of an AI-driven research system (ADRS) is an expensive search over a vast solution space, and dependable evaluation requires many runs, making run data both costly to produce and valuable to retain for large-scale analysis. Yet this data remains fragmented: teams operate in isolation, ADRS frameworks emit results in different formats, and no shared infrastructure exists to aggregate or compare runs across problems and systems. We present ROAR, a solution for systematically unifying and analyzing heterogeneous ADRS outputs. ROAR addresses two challenges: reconciling heterogeneous ADRS outputs and enabling analytics across runs with different objectives and scoring functions. We achieve this through a relational schema and parsing layer that normalize heterogeneous ADRS outputs while preserving data lineage and temporal structure, and accommodating new systems without requiring schema modifications. From building a corpus of more than 900 runs from multiple ADRS, we show how pooled data can reveal properties of problem landscapes that are difficult to observe. Consistent with prior work, runs with identical configurations may converge to different scores. We find that many runs realize most gains early, and that the effectiveness of different strategies for incorporating prior solutions into the search process varies across problems. We further show that the pooled corpus is actionable and not merely analytical by using ROAR to configure ADRS runs. Together, these results illustrate how pooled ADRS data can expose problem-dependent structure in search behavior that is difficult to detect from any single system, team, or benchmark. Such cross-cutting insights are difficult to obtain while runs remain siloed; ROAR is the first infrastructure designed to unify them.

AI.tldr: 提出ROAR系统，通过关系模式与解析层统一异构ADRS输出，构建900+次运行语料库，实现跨系统、跨问题的汇聚分析与可操作配置。
AI.motivation: ADRS单次运行成本高、需多次运行才能可靠评估，运行数据既昂贵又有价值；但数据高度碎片化：团队各自为战、各框架输出格式不一、缺乏跨问题与跨系统的聚合比较基础设施。
AI.method: 设计关系模式（relational schema）与解析层，归一化异构ADRS输出，同时保留数据血缘与时间结构，并支持在不修改模式的前提下接入新系统；据此构建来自多个ADRS的900余次运行语料库，开展跨运行分析并用于ADRS运行配置。
AI.result: 相同配置的运行可能收敛到不同分数；许多运行在早期即获得大部分收益；将先验解纳入搜索过程的策略有效性因问题而异；汇聚语料库具备可操作性，可用于配置ADRS运行。
AI.conclusion: 汇聚ADRS数据能揭示单一系统、团队或基准难以发现的问题依赖型搜索行为结构；ROAR是首个旨在统一此类异构运行数据的基础设施，突破运行数据孤岛化带来的分析局限。

title: Retrieval-Centric Deep Learning in Growing Nonparametric Neural Networks
summary: We investigate a general-purpose layer for deep learning that, instead of compressing arbitrary-size training data into fixed-size weight matrices, stores a new pair of key-value representations for every data point during training, and retrieves and recombines these representations through an attention mechanism at inference time - resulting in a growing neural net (NN). While Irie et al. (arXiv:2202.05798) have put forward this perspective from the classic duality expressing any linear layer in a deep NN trained by gradient descent as linear attention (LA) over the training data points, replacing LA by more powerful attention functions, as they suggest, turns out to be non-trivial: we show that naively applying learning rules from the LA case to advanced kernels does not lead to principled optimization. Here we fill this gap and develop functional gradient-based learning rules for kernelized attention layers, based on radial basis function (RBF) and softmax-like kernels - establishing the principled "retrieval-centric deep learning" (RCDL) paradigm. Empirically, we demonstrate the promising performance and learning-efficiency of RCDL on image classification and synthetic teacher-student learning tasks. Moreover, we show that replacing LA in the dual form of NNs by advanced LA variants, namely MesaNet/DeltaNet, yields a formal connection to recently proposed optimizers for conventional fixed-size NNs, offering a novel perspective on deep learning optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"检索中心深度学习"（RCDL）范式：为每个训练样本存储键值表示并在推理时通过注意力检索重组，形成可增长的神经网络，并给出了核化注意力层的函数梯度学习规则。
AI.motivation: 传统深度网络将任意规模训练数据压缩为固定大小权重矩阵；已有工作提出用线性注意力（LA）对训练数据点建模，但直接将其学习规则推广到更强注意力核并非易事，缺乏有原则的优化方法，需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于径向基函数（RBF）与类softmax核，推导核化注意力层的函数梯度学习规则；构造检索中心深度学习（RCDL）范式，将训练中的键值对存储与推理时的注意力检索重组结合，形成增长式神经网络；并考察用MesaNet/DeltaNet替换NN对偶形式中LA的连接。
AI.result: 在图像分类与合成师生学习任务上，RCDL表现出良好性能与学习效率；同时证明以MesaNet/DeltaNet替换对偶形式中的LA，可与近期针对固定尺寸NN的优化器建立形式化联系。
AI.conclusion: RCDL为强注意力核提供了有原则的函数梯度优化途径，验证了检索中心范式的有效性，并为深度学习优化提供了新的理论视角。

title: Bi-manual Stabilization of the Cervical Spine for Safe Physical Human-Robot Interaction in Rolling Maneuvers
summary: The neck, specifically the cervical spine, is a highly fragile and mobile part of the body with a high risk of catastrophic injury. Whether someone is injured on a battlefield, in a natural disaster, or in an athletic event, great care is always taken with the cervical spine when transporting, rolling, or moving the patient. In this work, we present an algorithm and adaptations for bi-manual robots to stabilize the cervical spine during rolling maneuvers. We investigate techniques to maximize grip strength within safety bounds and present a control approach for proper neck rotation. We found that with our approach, a bi-manual robot is capable of achieving human-level performance in maintaining target rotational alignments. The axial alignment for the robot with prediction was within .21 degrees of human novices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双臂机器人在翻滚转运过程中稳定颈椎的算法与控制方法，机器人在轴向对齐精度上达到人类新手水平。
AI.motivation: 颈椎（颈部）极为脆弱且活动度大，无论在战场、自然灾害还是体育赛事中受伤，转运、翻滚或移动患者时都需格外小心保护颈椎。因此有必要研究机器人自主完成颈椎稳定操作的能力。
AI.method: 提出面向双臂机器人的算法与适配方案，用于翻滚动作中稳定颈椎；研究在安全约束下最大化抓握力的技术，并提出实现正确颈部旋转的控制方法。
AI.result: 双臂机器人能够达到人类水平的旋转对齐保持性能；带预测的机器人轴向对齐误差在0.21度以内，与人类新手水平相当。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使双臂机器人在颈椎稳定任务中具备接近人类的性能，验证了机器人辅助颈椎保护操作的可行性。

title: Are We Measuring Anticipation? Auditing Privileged Information in Procedural Video Evaluation
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
summary:
Benchmark scores license claims about the capabilities being evaluated. We audit the inference licensed by an evaluation protocol, rather than the predictive model alone. Using procedural action anticipation as a controlled case study, we study a broader evaluation-validity failure mode: a protocol can remain temporally causal and free of classical target leakage while still supplying a privileged intermediate representation. The failure is not merely optimistic accuracy, but a mismatch between the capability claimed and the construct actually measured.
  On Breakfast, matched recognizer-history and GT-history regimes score 30.3% and 62.3% (Delta_PH(R_BA) = +32.0, 95% Student-t interval [+24.1, +39.8]). A fixed-checkpoint 2 x 2 intervention isolates a +14.6-point test-time oracle contrast; a matched no-video provenance probe yields a +26.8-point gap; and a boundary-independent query/history control retains a +19.4-point gap. We refer to this discrepancy as a privileged-information gap, defined relative to a specified non-oracle recovery pipeline, and propose a reusable four-condition audit. Across five evaluation settings the gap is heterogeneous; a standard 50 Salads long-term-anticipation re-implementation provides cautious support beyond the audit-specific next-action construction.

AI.tldr: 本文以程序性动作预期为受控案例，揭示一种评测效度失效模式：评测协议虽满足时间因果性且无经典目标泄漏，仍可能提供特权中间表征，使基准分数所授权的“能力主张”与实际测量的构念不符。作者提出“特权信息差”概念及可复用的四条件审计方法，并在多个设置中验证该差异的异质性。
AI.motivation: 基准分数常被用来支撑关于被评测能力的主张，但作者关注的不是预测模型本身，而是评测协议所授权的推断是否成立。现有工作多聚焦于乐观精度或经典目标泄漏，却忽略了协议在保持时间因果性、无目标泄漏的情况下，仍可能悄悄注入特权中间表征，从而造成“声称能力”与“实际测量构念”之间的错配。
AI.method: 采用程序性动作预期作为受控案例研究。在Breakfast数据集上比较匹配的“识别器历史”与“真实标注历史”两种机制（30.3% vs 62.3%，Delta_PH(R_BA)=+32.0，95% Student-t区间[+24.1,+39.8]）。进一步执行固定检查点的2×2干预以隔离+14.6个百分点的测试时oracle对比；进行匹配的无视频来源探针得到+26.8个百分点差距；以及边界独立的查询/历史控制保留+19.4个百分点差距。据此提出相对于指定非oracle恢复流程定义的“特权信息差”，并设计可复用的四条件审计。
AI.result: 在Breakfast上，匹配的识别器历史与GT历史机制得分为30.3%与62.3%，差异达+32.0个百分点（95% Student-t区间[+24.1,+39.8]）。固定检查点2×2干预隔离出+14.6个百分点的测试时oracle对比；无视频来源探针产生+26.8个百分点差距；边界独立控制仍保留+19.4个百分点差距。跨五种评测设置，该差距呈现异质性；在50 Salads长期预期上的标准重实现为超出审计特定“下一动作”构造提供了谨慎支持。
AI.conclusion: 评测协议即使在时间因果性和无经典目标泄漏方面看似合规，仍可能通过特权中间表征导致评测效度失效，其本质是所声称能力与实际测量构念之间的错配，而非单纯的精度乐观。作者提出的“特权信息差”及四条件审计可作为可复用工具识别此类问题；该差距在多种设置下异质存在，并在50 Salads长期预期重实现中获得初步外部支持。

title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
summary: Autonomous coding agents solve repository issues by reading code, running commands, editing files, and submitting patches. Extra inference-time compute yields gains only when it produces a useful repair and supplies reliable evidence for choosing one. Three behaviors decide both, and we argue they are teachable rather than byproducts of scale, so a policy can carry them instead of a scaffold. Location diversity remains narrow, since attempts return to the same site and extra samples add no coverage. Edit diversity is left unexploited, since methodologies that differ resolve complementary issues no single run reaches. Verification misleads, since a test the agent writes for its own patch accepts many incorrect ones. Directing search by execution feedback and scoring each patch against its own reverted tree resolves 52.8% of SWE-bench Verified using 48.1% of the agent-steps an eight-sample baseline spends. Training moves these behaviors into the policy. On the 270 issues held out from SFT and RL training, weighted supervised fine-tuning raises pass@1 from 31.9% to 35.2% and pass@8 from 46.7% to 51.1%.
