A reinforcement objective then trains the verifier against gold-labeled repairs and incorrect variants, crediting the assertions that detect them. It raises pass@1 to 43.0% and pass@8 to 60.7%, lifts verifier precision from 26.8% to 41.7%, and more than halves false acceptance. Resolution improves on two of three out-of-distribution suites and verifier precision on all three, and the gains hold at 7B, 14B, and 30B against published coder baselines.

AI.tldr: 自主编码智能体的解决能力可通过训练获得三种可教行为（定位、编辑、验证），直接搜索由执行反馈引导、并以回退树自评分补丁，从而在更少步骤下大幅提升解析率与验证精度。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到推理时额外计算的收益仅在产生有用修复并提供可靠选择证据时才存在，而当前智能体存在三类缺陷：定位多样性狭窄（反复回到同一位置，额外采样不增覆盖）、编辑多样性未被利用（不同方法论可解决互补问题）、验证误导（自写测试会接受大量错误补丁）。作者主张这些行为是可教的，应由策略本身承载而非依赖外部脚手架。
AI.method: 以执行反馈引导搜索，将每个补丁与其自身的回退树（reverted tree）对照评分；随后通过训练把三种行为注入策略：先做加权监督微调（weighted SFT），再采用强化学习目标，针对金标修复与错误变体训练验证器，并奖励能检测出错误的断言。
AI.result: 直接搜索方案以八样本基线48.1%的智能体步数解析SWE-bench Verified的52.8%。在SFT与RL留出的270个问题上，加权SFT将pass@1从31.9%提升到35.2%、pass@8从46.7%到51.1%；强化目标进一步将pass@1提到43.0%、pass@8到60.7%，验证器精度从26.8%升到41.7%，错误接受率减半以上。解析率在三个分布外套件中两个提升，验证器精度三个全部提升；在7B、14B、30B模型上均优于已发表的coder基线。
AI.conclusion: 定位、编辑与验证三种行为是可训练的，而非规模的副产品；通过执行反馈引导搜索与自对照评分，并配合SFT与强化式验证器训练，可在显著降低计算开销的同时同时提升解析率与验证可靠性，且效果在不同模型规模与分布外任务上稳定成立。

title: Reinforcement Learning on the Discrete Composition Channel of a Crystal Generator: Validated Gains and Reward Hacking
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/paprakash/OMatGRPO. Models and structures: https://huggingface.co/paprakash/OMatGRPO
summary: Inverse materials design is a long-standing goal of computational materials discovery. Generative models for crystalline materials are typically trained to match the distribution of a structure database, while nothing in their training objective points them at specific design goals such as targeted properties. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to align a generative model based on stochastic interpolants and discrete flow matching with general black-box reward functions through reinforcement learning. Atom types are generated by a discrete flow and the policy gradient of our generalization of GRPO directly acts on the likelihoods of the atom-type transitions, which differentiates our work from previous reinforcement-learning approaches for diffusion and flow-based generative models of crystalline materials. We introduce a reward function that raises the yield of metastable, unique and novel structures (mSUN) from 13.4% for the pretrained model to 45.5% for the reinforced model, as evaluated by a community benchmark. Our reward also improves the performance of a reinforcement learning framework for crystalline materials based on latent denoising diffusion models. At the same time, we find that directly reinforcing atom-type transition likelihoods enables reward exploitation that has to be prevented with explicit guards. The same analysis also exposes a gap in the community metric. Single-element structures in distinct packings are counted as metastable, unique and novel materials and inflate mSUN without yielding any new compounds. A stability claim is only as good as its reference hull. We report every result split by the number of reference phases behind it and argue that benchmarks should do the same.

AI.tldr: 该工作用GRPO强化学习将晶体生成模型与黑盒奖励对齐，直接对原子类型转移似然施加策略梯度，使mSUN产率从13.4%提升到45.5%，同时揭示了奖励利用漏洞与社区基准（mSUN）在稳定性判定上的缺陷，呼吁基准按参考相数量分层报告结果。
AI.motivation: 晶体材料的逆向设计长期是计算材料发现的目标。现有晶体生成模型通常只被训练去匹配结构数据库的分布，其训练目标并不指向特定设计目标（如目标性质），因此无法直接用于按需生成。作者希望用强化学习把生成模型与通用黑盒奖励函数对齐，实现可定向优化的晶体生成。
AI.method: 以随机插值（stochastic interpolants）与离散流匹配（discrete flow matching）为基础的生成模型，采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行强化学习对齐。原子类型由离散流生成，作者推广的GRPO策略梯度直接作用于原子类型转移的似然，这与以往针对扩散/流模型的强化学习做法不同。引入奖励函数以提高亚稳、独特且新颖（mSUN）结构的产率，并设计显式防护机制抑制对原子类型转移似然的奖励利用（reward exploitation）。该方法还被用于改进一个基于隐空间去噪扩散模型的晶体强化学习框架。
AI.result: 按社区基准评测，mSUN产率从预训练模型的13.4%提升至强化模型的45.5%；该奖励同样提升了基于隐空间去噪扩散模型的强化学习框架性能。同时发现直接强化原子类型转移似然会导致奖励利用，必须用显式防护加以阻止。分析还暴露出社区指标的缺口：不同堆积方式的单元素结构被计为亚稳、独特且新颖材料，虚增mSUN却不产生任何新化合物。
AI.conclusion: 直接对原子类型转移似然施加策略梯度可有效将晶体生成模型对齐到黑盒奖励，但存在奖励利用风险，需显式防护。稳定性主张的可信度取决于参考凸包（reference hull），因此作者按支撑每个结果的参考相数量分别报告结果，并主张社区基准也应采用同样的分层报告方式。

title: Continual Humanoid Motion Learning
summary: Humanoid whole-body controllers can now track a diverse set of dynamic motions, but they are typically trained offline and then frozen, so teaching such a controller a new skill tends to erode the skills it already mastered. We study continual learning for humanoid whole-body motion, where a single controller must acquire skills from a sequential task stream without revisiting past data. We introduce Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN, a progressive neural network (PNN) policy that prevents catastrophic forgetting by construction while reusing knowledge across skills through lightweight low-rank adaptation. A two-level motion-similarity measure, built from dynamic time warping aggregated by optimal transport, decides which prior skill to build on and how much new capacity to allocate, yielding strong forward transfer and large efficiency gains. Across six sequentially learned skill categories, our similarity-guided LoRA policy attains the best forward transfer (0.125 vs. 0.079) and the highest average accuracy among all methods, while saving up to 94.5% of trainable parameters and 40.8% of training time. The resulting controller reaches 96.13% sim-to-sim transfer and is deployed on a physical Unitree G1. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/continual-humanoid-learning-35D3.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究人形机器人全身运动的持续学习，提出相似度引导的LoRA-PNN策略，在避免灾难性遗忘的同时实现知识复用，并在Unitree G1真机上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有人形全身控制器多为离线训练后冻结，学习新技能会侵蚀已掌握的技能，难以在序列任务流中持续扩展能力。
AI.method: 提出Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN：基于渐进神经网络（PNN）结构，从构造上防止灾难性遗忘；通过轻量低秩适配（LoRA）实现跨技能知识复用。设计两级运动相似度度量，由动态时间规整（DTW）经最优传输（OT）聚合而成，用于决定复用哪个先前技能以及分配多少新容量。
AI.result: 在六个顺序学习的技能类别上，方法取得最佳前向迁移（0.125 vs. 0.079）和最高平均准确率，节省最多94.5%可训练参数和40.8%训练时间；控制器达到96.13% sim-to-sim迁移率，并部署于实体Unitree G1。
AI.conclusion: 相似度引导的LoRA-PNN有效实现人形全身运动持续学习，兼顾抗遗忘、前向迁移与参数/时间效率，并具备从仿真到真机的可部署性。

title: Streaming Multi-Track Timeline Control for 3D Human Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven human motion generation has advanced substantially, yet most methods assume instructions are available before synthesis. Interactive applications require responding to new instructions while continuing ongoing actions, such as answering a phone while walking. Existing approaches address streaming generation or simultaneous composition without explicitly combining streaming instruction arrival with independently timed, overlapping actions. We introduce streaming multi-track timeline control and propose TimelineControl to incorporate new instructions alongside ongoing actions. Interval-aware conditioning preserves instruction timing, while causal part-structured representations and part-aware denoising coordinate concurrent actions across body regions. We also construct TimelineMotion, a dataset with overlapping instruction intervals and body-part annotations. Experiments on TimelineMotion and MTT demonstrate improved semantic alignment and temporal adherence over evaluated streaming baselines, including models retrained on the same data. Ablations and human evaluations validate our design, complemented by spatial conditioning and humanoid execution demonstrations. Our code, data and models will become publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出流式多轨时间线控制任务与TimelineControl方法，实现在动作进行中响应新指令的重叠并发动作生成，并构建TimelineMotion数据集验证了语义对齐与时序遵循的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动人体动作生成多假设指令在合成前已完整给定，无法满足交互式应用需求（如边走边接电话）。已有工作分别处理流式生成或同步组合，但未显式结合"流式指令到达"与"独立计时的重叠动作"。
AI.method: 提出流式多轨时间线控制任务及TimelineControl框架：采用区间感知条件化（interval-aware conditioning）保留指令时序；引入因果部分结构化表示（causal part-structured representations）与部分感知去噪（part-aware denoising）以协调身体不同区域的并发动作；同时构建含重叠指令区间与身体部位标注的TimelineMotion数据集。
AI.result: 在TimelineMotion与MTT上，相比所评估的流式基线（包括在同一数据上重训练的模型），语义对齐与时序遵循均有提升；消融实验与人类评估验证了设计有效性，并补充了空间条件化与类人执行演示。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效支持流式指令到达下重叠并发动作的生成，代码、数据与模型将公开。

title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic personas representing survey respondents. Their validity as substitutes for particular respondents depends on whether they reproduce individuals' decisions. We examine what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices, using five conditions that add progressively richer information: no personal information, demographics, personality traits, cognitive scores, and finally the respondent's earlier survey choices as behavioral history. We use a two-wave panel of 845 US adults who completed measures of 14 behavioral biases (spanning risk, time preferences, overconfidence, and reasoning), so each respondent's earlier answers provide a human test-retest benchmark; in the behavioral-history condition, all items that score the target bias are withheld. At the population level, the average number of biases per respondent in every condition is close to the human average (7.1-8.1 biases, against 7.1 for humans). This aggregate similarity masks differences in variance: persona descriptions recover only 53-67% of human between-person variation, whereas adding behavioral history restores it to approximately the human level. At the individual level, description-based personas achieve only 7-12% of the informedness observed in human test-retest responses, while adding behavioral history raises this to 28%. The condition including behavioral history has the highest estimated informedness in all 17 demographic groups, whereas description-based conditions provide little or no information for some groups. Synthetic responses also exhibit stronger education- and income-related differences than human responses. For LLM synthetic personas, a respondent's past answers add more to individual-level prediction than a description of who they are.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两波845名美国成年人的面板数据，比较五类信息条件下LLM合成被试对个体后续选择的预测能力，发现行为历史比人口学、人格等描述信息更能提升个体层面预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作代表调查受访者的合成被试，但其作为特定个体替代物的有效性取决于能否复现个体决策；因此需要厘清哪些信息有助于合成被试预测每个个体的后续选择。
AI.method: 使用845名美国成年人的两波面板数据，测量14种行为偏差（涵盖风险、时间偏好、过度自信与推理）；设置五个逐步增加信息量的条件：无个人信息、人口学特征、人格特质、认知分数、受访者早期调查选择作为行为历史；在行为历史条件下，所有用于计分目标偏差的题目被剔除；以人类重测结果作为基准，比较群体与个体层面的表现。
AI.result: 群体层面各条件下人均偏差数为7.1-8.1，接近人类的7.1；但描述型被试仅恢复53-67%的个体间变异，加入行为历史后恢复到接近人类水平。个体层面，描述型被试仅达到人类重测知情度的7-12%，加入行为历史后提升至28%。含行为历史的条件在全部17个人口学群体中估计知情度最高，而描述型条件对部分群体几乎无信息。合成回答还表现出比人类更强的教育与收入相关差异。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM合成被试而言，受访者过去的答案比对其身份的描述更能提升个体层面的预测能力。

title: AdaEva: Accelerating LLM-Driven Algorithm Design with Adaptive Partial Evaluation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated algorithm design. However the computational cost of evaluating the generated algorithms can be excessive. We consider the common LLM-driven automated algorithm design (LLM4AD) setting in which a candidate algorithm is evaluated by aggregating its performance over a shared set of training instances. This instance-wise structure raises a natural question: must every candidate be evaluated on the entire instance set before deciding whether it remains competitive? Taking inspiration from algorithm configuration, we introduce AdaEva, a drop-in adaptive partial-evaluation framework that progressively evaluates candidates on larger subsets of the same instance pool and eliminates unpromising candidates as evidence accumulates. Importantly, AdaEva leaves the underlying LLM4AD procedure and per-instance evaluator unchanged and requires no prior knowledge about instance difficulty. We instantiate this idea using successive halving (AdaEva-S) and statistical racing (AdaEva-R), and evaluate both mechanisms across three representative LLM4AD frameworks, multiple LLM backbones, and optimization domains spanning combinatorial and continuous black-box optimization. Under matched evaluation budgets, AdaEva more reliably balances evaluation effort across candidates than fixed partial-evaluation strategies, yielding strong search efficiency and anytime performance together with improved held-out generalization across the evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AdaEva，一种面向LLM4AD的自适应部分评估框架，通过逐步扩大候选算法的评估实例子集并淘汰劣质候选，在不改变原流程与评估器、无需实例难度先验的前提下提升搜索效率与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的自动化算法设计（LLM4AD）中，候选算法需在共享训练实例集上聚合性能进行评估，计算开销过大。核心疑问：是否必须在整个实例集上评估每个候选后，才能判断其是否仍具竞争力。
AI.method: 受算法配置（algorithm configuration）启发，提出AdaEva这一即插即用的自适应部分评估框架：对候选算法在实例池的逐步扩大子集上评估，随证据积累淘汰无望候选；不修改底层LLM4AD流程与单实例评估器，且无需实例难度先验。具体实例化为两种机制——逐次减半（AdaEva-S）与统计竞速（AdaEva-R）。
AI.result: 在三个代表性LLM4AD框架、多种LLM骨干以及覆盖组合与连续黑盒优化的多个优化域上进行评估。在匹配评估预算下，AdaEva比固定部分评估策略更可靠地在候选间平衡评估投入，带来更强的搜索效率与随时性能（anytime performance），并改善了留出泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应部分评估可有效降低LLM4AD评估成本，在不改动原有框架的前提下提升搜索效率与泛化，为实例级评估资源分配提供了通用且无需先验的解决方案。

title: Humanoid Rickshaw Pulling: Whole-Body Locomotion under Coupled Wheeled Loads
summary: Humanoid robots could transport payloads substantially heavier than themselves by pulling passive wheeled vehicles instead of carrying the load. This capability, however, creates a coupled locomotion problem: the robot must maintain persistent upper-body contact while adapting to unknown, configuration-dependent forces arising from the payload, vehicle, and terrain. We present a whole-body control framework for humanoid rickshaw pulling that tracks commanded vehicle motion while preserving balance and stable grasps under uncertain load dynamics. During training, a privileged teacher exploits vehicle states, interaction forces, and load properties. Its actions and latent are distilled into a history-conditioned student that implicitly infers coupled dynamics from proprioceptive responses, followed by reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. Comparisons with \emph{No History} and \emph{Only History} baselines show that the resulting policy achieves accurate vehicle tracking while reducing vehicle oscillation, torso tilt, and actuation cost. Behavioral analysis shows that Unitree G1 propels the rickshaw and generates gait-synchronized whole-body reactions that stabilize its lateral and roll motions. Moreover, pulling redistributes joint effort and yields a lower robot-normalized cost-of-transport proxy than unloaded walking over most tested load--speed conditions. On hardware, a single policy performs starting, sustained pulling, turning, and stopping with both rigid payloads and human passengers, handling a loaded rickshaw mass of up to 115~kg without load-specific retuning. These results demonstrate robust heavy-load transportation through coordinated and persistent humanoid--vehicle interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出人形机器人拉人力车的全身控制框架，通过特权教师蒸馏到历史条件学生策略，实现未知载荷动态下的车辆轨迹跟踪与平衡保持，硬件上无需重调即可拉动含乘客、总质量达115 kg的车。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人拉被动轮式车辆可运输远超自身重量的载荷，但由此产生耦合运动问题：机器人须在维持持续上身接触的同时，适应由载荷、车辆和地形引起的未知且随构型变化的力。现有方法难以在不确定负载动力学下兼顾车辆轨迹跟踪、平衡与稳定抓握。
AI.method: 提出面向人形机器人拉车的全身控制框架。训练阶段使用特权教师策略，可利用车辆状态、交互力与负载属性；将其动作与隐变量蒸馏到一个以历史观测为条件的学生策略，使学生从本体感知响应中隐式推断耦合动力学，随后进行强化学习微调。以 No History 和 Only History 作为基线进行对比。
AI.result: 相比两个基线，所得策略实现更准确的车辆跟踪，同时降低车辆振荡、躯干倾斜与驱动代价。行为分析显示 Unitree G1 能推动人力车并产生与步态同步的全身反应，稳定侧向与滚转运动；拉车使关节负荷重新分配，在多数载荷—速度条件下机器人归一化运输成本代理指标低于空载行走。硬件上单一策略完成起步、持续拉行、转向与停止，适配刚性载荷与真人乘客，载车总质量最高115 kg且无需按载荷重调。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过协调且持续的人—车交互，人形机器人可实现鲁棒的重载运输；历史条件学生策略结合特权蒸馏与强化学习微调，是应对未知耦合负载动力学的有效方案。

title: DABACO: A Multi-Camera Dataset and Benchmark for Screen Localization and Pointing Estimation
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22797835. Code and toolkit: https://domondo.github.io/dabaco-dataset-toolkit/
summary:
Screen localization and pointing estimation are key to low-cost interactive devices. Yet developing and evaluating these algorithms requires realistic data: synthetic captures cannot fully reproduce the optical distortion, rolling shutter, motion blur, and display processing of a physical acquisition, and most existing datasets provide static images rather than the video needed to assess continuous pointing. In this paper, we introduce the DABACO Dataset. Developed within the DABACO (Dispositivo Apuntador de BAjo COste, or Low-Cost Pointing Device) project, this dataset supports the development and evaluation of screen detection and camera-based pointing algorithms for embedded systems. It comprises video sequences captured with multiple low-cost camera sensors, including monochrome global-shutter and color rolling-shutter modules, on embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3.
  We present a systematic annotation pipeline combining temporary visual watermarking, optical-flow tracking, manual verification, and marker removal. Both the original marked captures and the marker-free images, together with explicit corner annotations and modification masks, are released to support auditing and the study of potential reconstruction bias.
  In addition, we release an open-source evaluation toolkit with two reference baselines: a classical screen-detection pipeline based on edge and contour geometry, and a closed-vocabulary, off-the-shelf YOLOv8 segmentation model evaluated without dataset-specific training. Both are evaluated on a general-purpose computer using Intersection over Union, corner error, and pointing error, establishing initial reference results for future embedded implementations. Overall, DABACO addresses a gap in existing resources and is intended to support the development and evaluation of new low-cost screen-localization and pointing systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了 DABACO 数据集，用于低成本指针设备的屏幕定位与指向估计研究，包含多类低成本相机与嵌入式平台采集的视频序列、系统化标注流程、开源评测工具包及两个参考基线结果。
AI.motivation: 现有算法开发与评测缺乏真实数据：合成采集无法复现光学畸变、卷帘快门、运动模糊和显示处理等物理采集效应；且多数已有数据集仅提供静态图像，无法评估连续指向。因此需要一个面向低成本嵌入式场景的、包含真实视频序列的数据集来支撑屏幕检测与相机指向算法的研发和评测。
AI.method: 构建 DABACO 数据集，采集自多种低成本相机传感器（黑白全局快门、彩色卷帘快门模块）与嵌入式平台（Raspberry Pi 4B、ESP32-S3）的视频序列。采用系统化标注流程：临时视觉水印、光流跟踪、人工校验与标记去除，并同时发布原始带标记采集、去标记图像、显式角点标注和修改掩码以支持审计和重建偏差研究。同时发布开源评测工具包，含两个参考基线：基于边缘与轮廓几何的经典屏幕检测流程，以及未经数据集专用训练的闭词表现成 YOLOv8 分割模型。在通用计算机上使用 IoU、角点误差和指向误差进行评测。
AI.result: 建立了两类基线的初始参考结果：经典几何屏幕检测流程与现成 YOLOv8 分割模型，在通用计算机上以 IoU、角点误差和指向误差为指标完成评测，为后续嵌入式实现提供基准。
AI.conclusion: DABACO 数据集填补了现有资源在真实视频采集与低成本嵌入式指向评测方面的空白，旨在支持新型低成本屏幕定位与指向系统的开发与评测，并为嵌入式实现提供初始参考基准。

title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
summary: Executable Agent Skills combine natural-language instructions and scripts into reusable packages for LLM agents, and revising them requires fixing errors without breaking correct behavior. Existing benchmarks do not systematically distinguish documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when evaluating skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark designed to evaluate these capabilities separately. From a survey of over 35,000 GitHub-hosted Skill roots, we select 100 packages and construct 150 repair tasks. Each task pairs a package containing injected script faults with a maintenance request and executable checks of the required behavior. A complementary controlled track contains 200 tasks from 50 packages, each evaluated under the same maintenance request in four states: clean, documentation faults, script faults, and faults in both. Across four LLMs, methods that edit both documentation and scripts can repair script faults but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision on documentation repair or preservation. We therefore introduce AST-Guided Skill Revision, which uses abstract syntax trees and calling relationships to link maintenance requirements to relevant code locations. It restricts script edits to these locations and updates the documentation to match the revised scripts. Averaged across models, this revision stage yields absolute gains in repair success of 21.9% for Raw Package and 27.7% for CoEvoSkills on faulty packages. Absolute gains in the proportion of tasks solved in all three runs reach 20.8% and 31.5%, respectively, indicating more consistent repair success across repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillScriptBench 基准（350 任务），区分文档修复、脚本修复与保持性，并引入 AST-Guided Skill Revision 方法，在故障包上带来最高 27.7% 的修复成功率绝对提升。
AI.motivation: 可执行 Agent Skills 结合自然语言指令与脚本，其修订需在修复错误的同时不破坏正确行为。现有基准未能系统区分文档修复、脚本修复与保持性，缺乏对技能自演化能力的细粒度评估。
AI.method: 构建 SkillScriptBench：从 35,000+ GitHub Skill 根目录调研中选取 100 个包、构造 150 个修复任务，每个任务将注入脚本故障的包与维护请求及可执行行为检查配对；另设受控赛道，200 个任务（50 个包）在干净、文档故障、脚本故障、双重故障四种状态下用同一维护请求评估。提出 AST-Guided Skill Revision，利用抽象语法树与调用关系将维护需求定位到相关代码位置，限制脚本编辑范围并同步更新文档。
AI.result: 四个 LLM 上，同时编辑文档与脚本的方法能修复脚本故障，但在文档修复或保持性上并未稳定优于仅改 Markdown 的方法。AST-Guided Skill Revision 在模型平均下，于故障包上修复成功率绝对提升 21.9%（Raw Package）与 27.7%（CoEvoSkills）；三次运行均解出的任务比例绝对提升 20.8% 与 31.5%，表明重复运行下的修复更一致。
AI.conclusion: 技能自演化需分离评估文档修复、脚本修复与保持性；基于 AST 与调用关系的限定性编辑可显著且稳定地提升修复成功率与跨运行一致性。

title: COVER: Learning to Accept More in Selective Sleep Staging
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; code and frozen-result reproduction: https://github.com/Kevin11Kaikai/COVER-Selective-Sleep-Staging
summary: Traditional sleep-staging methods apply the same model to every EEG epoch. Such uniform deployment expends computation on epochs that a smaller model could handle reliably, motivating cascades in which a primary classifier accepts its reliable predictions and defers the remainder to a more capable model. In this paper, we study the first stage of such a cascade: maximizing the coverage of fixed primary predictions subject to a prescribed accepted-risk target. We propose COVER (COVerage-oriented Error Ranking), which integrates two key innovations: (i) auxiliary-informed primary-error learning, which replaces maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a learned error score while preserving the primary labels, and (ii) fixed-scale scorer refinement, which builds on this score to directly maximize coverage under an empirical accepted-risk constraint rather than error-prediction accuracy over all epochs. We evaluate COVER on Sleep-EDF-20 at a 5% accepted-risk target, with subjects held out from all fitting and selection. Auxiliary-informed error learning raises mean subject coverage from 31.5% for MSP to 48.8% at similar subject-equal risk. At equal acceptance volume, with MSP accepting the same number of epochs as the learned scorer in each subject (20,639 in total), errors fall from 1,467 to 867. Fixed-scale refinement then adds 1.7 percentage points of coverage over its initialization in nested development, and COVER attains the highest mean coverage among eight evaluated scorers, 50.4% at 4.5% subject-equal risk, above the selective-ranking baseline SELE (49.3%) and the probability-fusion comparator DuoF (43.6%). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to combine auxiliary-informed primary-error learning with fixed-scale coverage refinement for selective sleep staging, offering a basis for reliability-aware allocation of computation in cascaded sleep staging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COVER方法，用于睡眠分期级联系统的第一阶段：在满足指定接受风险目标下最大化固定主分类器的覆盖度。COVER结合辅助信息引导的主误差学习与固定尺度评分器精炼，在Sleep-EDF-20上以5%接受风险目标取得50.4%平均覆盖度，优于SELE（49.3%）和DuoF（43.6%）等八个评分器。
AI.motivation: 传统睡眠分期方法对每个EEG片段都使用同一模型，这种均匀部署会在小模型本可可靠处理的片段上浪费算力。因此需要构建级联系统：主分类器接受其可靠预测，将剩余部分交给更强模型处理。本文聚焦级联第一阶段的核心问题——在给定接受风险目标下最大化固定主预测的覆盖度。
AI.method: 提出COVER（面向覆盖度的误差排序），包含两项创新：(i) 辅助信息引导的主误差学习，用学习到的误差分数替代最大softmax概率（MSP），同时保留主标签；(ii) 固定尺度评分器精炼，基于该误差分数，在经验接受风险约束下直接最大化覆盖度，而非优化所有片段上的误差预测准确率。在Sleep-EDF-20上评估，目标接受风险为5%，被试从所有拟合与选择过程中留出。
AI.result: 辅助信息引导的误差学习将平均被试覆盖度从MSP的31.5%提升到48.8%（被试等风险相近）。在相同接受量下——MSP与学习评分器在每个被试中接受相同数量的片段（共20,639个）——错误数从1,467降至867。固定尺度精炼在嵌套开发中相较其初始化额外增加1.7个百分点覆盖度。COVER在八个评分器中取得最高平均覆盖度：4.5%被试等风险下为50.4%，高于选择性排序基线SELE（49.3%）和概率融合对比方法DuoF（43.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个将辅助信息引导的主误差学习与固定尺度覆盖度精炼相结合用于选择性睡眠分期的工作，为级联睡眠分期中可靠性感知的算力分配提供了基础。

title: Attention-Based Surface Representation Learning for Robot State Prediction and Open-Ended Surface Classification
summary: For ground robots operating in outdoor environments, understanding the properties of the underlying terrain is essential for ensuring reliable operation. In most perception-based studies, this problem is formulated as categorical classification with a fixed number of classes defined during training. We propose an approach that enables new surface classes to be added as trainable vectors, which can subsequently be used to address higher-level tasks. By employing a learning paradigm based on predicting the robot's next state in time and using attention blocks, we improved classification accuracy to 98.56% on the Belyaev-Kushnarev dataset and 94.8% on BorealTC.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可扩展的地形分类方法，支持在训练后新增地表类别作为可训练向量，并用于更高层任务；通过预测机器人未来状态的学习范式与注意力模块，在Belyaev-Kushnarev和BorealTC数据集上分别达到98.56%和94.8%的分类精度。
AI.motivation: 室外地面机器人需要理解地形属性以保障可靠运行，但现有基于感知的研究多将地形问题建模为类别数固定的封闭集分类，难以适应新地表类型。
AI.method: 将新地表类别表示为可训练向量以支持增量扩展；采用基于预测机器人下一时刻状态的学习范式，并结合注意力模块（attention blocks）进行地形表征与分类。
AI.result: 在Belyaev-Kushnarev数据集上分类精度达98.56%，在BorealTC上达94.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法突破了固定类别数的限制，使新增地表类别可训练并服务于更高层任务，同时取得了较高的地形分类精度。

title: Dynamic Time Step Prediction in Inverse Heat Dissipation for Blur-Like Image Restoration Tasks
summary: When using diffusion models to target image restoration problems, diffusion inversion is typically employed to retain relevant image information from the degraded images. Instead of inverting back to the initial time step (i.e., T), many methods invert to a pre-determined intermediate time step, in order to better preserve information from degraded source images. However, a pre-determined time step for inversion is not ideal for reconstruction, as a severely degraded image requires an earlier starting time step than a mildly degraded one. In addition, DDIM-based models corrupt the original signal by adding Gaussian noise, which can be mismatched to the nature of blur-like degradations, such as blur, haze, and low-light. To address these problems, we propose two solutions: (1) we adopt an alternative diffusion process, called the Inverse Heat Dissipation Model, that diffuses the input image by gradually blurring a data point (2) we propose to implement a time predictor to estimate the starting time step for the inversion, with the model learning to adapt to the degradation severity. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations, with excellent generalization to many restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出逆热耗散模型(IHDM)与时间步预测器，改进扩散模型在图像复原中的扩散反演策略，实现自适应起始时间步选择并解决高斯噪声与模糊类退化不匹配问题，在多个复原任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散反演方法通常反转至预先设定的中间时间步以保留退化图像信息，但固定时间步不理想：退化严重的图像需要更早的起始时间步，而轻微退化则不需要。此外，基于DDIM的模型通过添加高斯噪声破坏原始信号，这与模糊、雾霾、低光等模糊类退化的本质不匹配。
AI.method: 提出两点解决方案：（1）采用一种替代扩散过程——逆热耗散模型(Inverse Heat Dissipation Model)，通过逐步模糊数据点来对输入图像进行扩散；（2）提出时间预测器(time predictor)，估计反演所需的起始时间步，使模型能够自适应退化严重程度。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在定量与定性评估中均取得最先进性能，并对多种复原任务具有出色的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应时间步预测与模糊式扩散过程替代传统高斯噪声扩散反演，可有效提升扩散模型在图像复原中的适应性与复原质量，具备良好的任务泛化性。

title: Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning, while the allocation of learning signal shapes which solutions remain accessible under repeated sampling. Group-relative objectives assign equal advantages to equally rewarded responses, making aggregate credit proportional to sampled mode frequency. We introduce Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization (ExPPO), a lightweight advantage-shaping rule that redistributes credit using prompt-relative, length-normalized response surprisal and prompt pass rate. ExPPO combines bounded shaping with shared normalization to preserve verifier polarity and approximately maintain each prompt group's total absolute sequence-advantage mass. Our analysis characterizes response-level credit allocation alongside sampled mode updates, deriving local conditions for gains in entropy and correct-mode discovery. Experiments show improved in-domain and out-of-domain reasoning coverage, higher aggregate response accuracy, and strong coverage at large sampling budgets. A controlled multi-answer evaluation further demonstrates increased correct-mode yield and gains in diversity among verified-correct responses. Code is available at https://github.com/jinhangzhan/ExPPO

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization (ExPPO)，一种轻量级优势塑形规则，利用 prompt 相对、长度归一化的 response surprisal 与 prompt 通过率重新分配信用，从而在保持验证器极性的同时提升推理探索覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习能提升推理能力，但学习信号的分配方式决定了重复采样下哪些解可被保留。组相对目标对同等奖励的响应赋予相同优势，使总信用与采样模式频率成正比，导致少数但正确的模式被压制、探索多样性下降。因此需要一种能重新分配信用、保留探索的方法。
AI.method: ExPPO 采用轻量级优势塑形规则，基于 prompt 相对的、长度归一化的响应 surprisal 和 prompt 通过率来重新分配信用。其结合有界塑形（bounded shaping）与共享归一化（shared normalization），以保留验证器极性，并近似维持每个 prompt 分组的总绝对序列优势质量。理论上分析了响应级信用分配与采样模式更新，推导出熵增益与正确模式发现的局部条件。
AI.result: 实验显示 ExPPO 提升了域内与域外推理覆盖率、更高的总体响应准确率，并在大采样预算下保持强覆盖。受控的多答案评估进一步表明正确模式产出率提高，且经验证正确的响应多样性增加。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新分配组内信用并保持优势质量守恒，ExPPO 有效缓解了组相对目标中频次主导信用的问题，在提升推理准确率的同时增强了解的正确模式多样性与探索覆盖率，为可验证奖励下的强化学习提供了简单有效的优势塑形方案。

title: TreeWalker: Partial Evaluation for Grouped Tree-Ensemble Inference
comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Shopify/treewalker
summary:
Many inference workloads evaluate a trained tree ensemble on row groups that share feature values: discrete-time survival models expand each patient into $G$ time steps, click-through-rate models score every item in a search session, and scenario analyses vary a few inputs while holding the rest fixed. Standard inference treats each row independently and repeats the shared work $G$ times.
  We present TreeWalker, which applies partial evaluation to grouped inference: constant features are static, varying features dynamic. It walks each tree once per group, partitions a row bitmask at varying splits, and skips empty subtrees. Training is unchanged: TreeWalker reads standard LightGBM and XGBoost models.
  We prove a structural work decomposition: per-tree work splits into the constant-projected subtree size $|T_c|$, $G$ leaf writes, and a predicate-mask provisioning cost $Q$. For the trace evaluator, per-row work approaches a $(d_v+1)/(d+1)$ fraction of a row-independent walk as $G \to \infty$.
  On Intel, TreeWalker is 2.5-3.2$\times$ faster than a row-independent traversal at the reference configuration ($T=500$, $L=8$) and 6.8-7.8$\times$ faster at $G=128$ on the survival datasets, with larger gains on Arm. On a scenario-analysis benchmark it is faster in all 16 configurations on both architectures. For f64 models, outputs match treelite's GTIL up to summation order; for f32 models, f64 accumulation is closer to a Kahan-compensated reference than native f32 on 99.98% of rows and never farther.

AI.tldr: TreeWalker 对分组推理采用部分求值，将常量特征视为静态、变化特征视为动态，每组每棵树只走一次，从而避免重复共享工作。它支持标准 LightGBM/XGBoost 模型，训练不变。理论上给出结构性工作分解；实测在 Intel 上比逐行遍历快 2.5–3.2×（参考配置）和 6.8–7.8×（G=128），Arm 上收益更大；精度与 treelite GTIL 一致或用 f64 累加更接近 Kahan 参考。
AI.motivation: 许多推理负载在同一行组内共享特征值：离散时间生存模型将每个患者展开为 G 个时间步、CTR 模型对一次搜索会话中的每个条目打分、情景分析只改动少量输入而保持其余固定。标准推理逐行独立处理，会把共享工作重复 G 次，造成冗余计算。
AI.method: 提出 TreeWalker，将部分求值用于分组推理：常量特征为静态、变化特征为动态。每组每棵树只遍历一次，在动态分裂处对行位掩码进行分区，并跳过空子树。训练流程不变，直接读取标准 LightGBM 和 XGBoost 模型。作者证明结构性工作分解：每棵树的工作拆分为常量投影子树大小 |T_c|、G 次叶写入以及谓词掩码供给成本 Q。对 trace 求值器，当 G→∞ 时，每行工作量趋近于逐行独立遍历的 (d_v+1)/(d+1) 比例。
AI.result: 在 Intel 上，参考配置（T=500，L=8）下 TreeWalker 比逐行独立遍历快 2.5–3.2×，在生存数据集上 G=128 时快 6.8–7.8×，Arm 上收益更大；在情景分析基准的 16 种配置、两种架构上均更快。精度方面：f64 模型输出与 treelite 的 GTIL 在求和顺序范围内一致；f32 模型上，f64 累加在 99.98% 的行上比原生 f32 更接近 Kahan 补偿参考，且从不更差。
AI.conclusion: TreeWalker 通过部分求值消除分组推理中的共享冗余，在保持训练与模型兼容性的同时获得显著加速，并维持甚至改善数值精度，适用于生存分析、CTR 与情景分析等共享特征场景。

title: ROOT: Discovering Rewards for User-Specified Embodied Behaviors
summary: Reinforcement learning for embodied control remains constrained by the difficulty of reward specification. Although recent large language model (LLM)-based methods can synthesize reward functions from natural-language descriptions, they often fail to capture subtle behavioral properties that humans care about, such as natural gait, posture, and movement style. This limitation arises because many desired behaviors are easier to recognize visually than to encode in a reward function. We introduce Reward Optimization via Observable Trees (ROOT), a framework for discovering reward functions that align learned policies with user-specified embodied behaviors. Rather than relying solely on scalar training statistics, ROOT casts reward design as an observation-guided search over a persistent experiment tree that stores reward programs, trained policies, and rollout observations, together with behavioral insights distilled by a video-language model, to diagnose behavioral failures and guide subsequent reward refinements. We evaluate ROOT on seven tasks across four embodiments: simulated Hopper, HalfCheetah, Ant, Unitree Go2, and as well as the real-world Unitree Go2. ROOT produces behaviors that better align with user intent than those generated by existing LLM-based reward-generation methods, achieving up to 86.8% locomotion-completeness accuracy and improving Vid-LLM behavioral alignment from 3.56/5 to 4.14/5, a 16.5% improvement over baselines. Human evaluations further support these results, with ROOT preferred in 51-63% of pairwise comparisons.

AI.tldr: ROOT框架将奖励设计转化为基于观测引导的搜索问题，利用持久化实验树存储奖励程序、策略和rollout观测，并由视频-语言模型提炼行为洞察以诊断失败并迭代改进奖励函数，在四个embodiment七个任务上优于现有LLM奖励生成方法。
AI.motivation: 强化学习embodied control的奖励设定困难；现有基于LLM的方法虽能从自然语言合成奖励函数，却难以捕捉人类关心的细微行为属性（如自然步态、姿态和运动风格）。根本原因是许多期望行为"视觉上易识别、编码为奖励函数却很难"。
AI.method: 提出ROOT（Reward Optimization via Observable Trees）：不依赖单纯的标量训练统计，而是把奖励设计建模为观测引导的搜索，在一棵持久化实验树上进行。该树存储奖励程序、已训练策略、rollout观测以及由video-language model提炼的行为洞察，用于诊断行为失败并指导后续奖励改进。
AI.result: 在四个embodiment（仿真Hopper、HalfCheetah、Ant、Unitree Go2，以及真实世界Unitree Go2）共七个任务上评估。ROOT生成的行为比现有LLM奖励生成方法更符合用户意图：locomotion-completeness准确率达86.8%；Vid-LLM行为对齐分从3.56/5提升至4.14/5，相比基线提升16.5%；人类评估中ROOT在51-63%的成对比较中被偏好。
AI.conclusion: ROOT通过观测引导的树式搜索与视频-语言模型洞察，有效弥合了自然语言规格与细粒度行为对齐之间的差距，在仿真与真实机器人任务上均优于现有LLM奖励生成基线，并获得人类偏好支持。

title: FADE: Frame-Aware Diffusion-Transformer-based Multi-Concept Erasure for Video Unlearning
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can reproduce copyrighted, violent, or explicit content, which motivates concept erasure: removing designated concepts from a pretrained model while preserving its behavior on everything else. Existing T2V erasure methods leave two problems open. Their frame-agnostic suppression can leave isolated frames in which an erased concept resurfaces, a frame-reactivation gap that clip-level averages obscure; and they are usually evaluated with one target concept or category at a time. We propose Frame-Aware Diffusion Erasure (FADE), a multi-concept video unlearning framework. FADE first applies a joint closed-form key/value edit that suppresses all target concepts, then trains per-concept frame-aware low-rank adapters whose strength is gated by the frame index and the denoising timestep to remove residual per-frame leakage. Each adapter is trained with the other targets' prompts as hard negatives, which keeps the concept-specific components of different adapters well separated, and a similarity-based soft router combines the adapters according to the prompt. With 16 concepts (objects, artistic styles, and nudity) erased from a single Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, FADE reduces the residual accuracy on the object benchmark to 4.9%, against 15.5% for the strongest of eight baselines, while keeping the VBench average within 0.9% of the unedited model. The ranking is unchanged under a VLM judge and a blinded human study, and the advantage over the strongest baseline carries over to prompts that combine several erased concepts, to 30 simultaneously erased celebrity identities, and to Wan2.1-T2V-14B, CogVideoX-2B, and HunyuanVideo-1.5.

AI.tldr: 提出FADE框架，通过联合闭式键值编辑与逐概念帧感知LoRA适配器，实现多概念文本到视频扩散模型擦除，显著降低逐帧泄漏同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到视频擦除方法存在两个未解决问题：一是帧无关抑制会留下孤立帧使被擦除概念重新出现，即"帧重激活鸿沟"，被片段级平均指标掩盖；二是通常一次仅评估单个目标概念或类别，缺乏多概念场景下的验证。
AI.method: FADE先施加联合闭式键/值编辑以抑制所有目标概念，再训练逐概念的帧感知低秩适配器，其强度由帧索引与去噪时间步门控，用于消除残余的逐帧泄漏。每个适配器以其他目标的提示作为硬负样本训练，使不同适配器的概念特定分量保持良好分离，并通过基于相似度的软路由器按提示组合各适配器。
AI.result: 在单个Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B骨干上擦除16个概念（物体、艺术风格与裸露）时，FADE将物体基准上的残余准确率降至4.9%，优于八个基线中最强者的15.5%，同时VBench平均值与未编辑模型相差在0.9%以内。该排名在VLM评判与盲测人类研究中保持一致，且相对最强基线的优势可迁移到组合多个被擦除概念的提示、30个同时擦除的公众人物身份，以及Wan2.1-T2V-14B、CogVideoX-2B与HunyuanVideo-1.5等模型。
AI.conclusion: FADE是一种有效的多概念文本到视频概念擦除框架，能够解决帧重激活问题并在多概念、多骨干设置下持续优于现有基线，同时保持视频生成质量。

title: Beyond the Parameter Monolith: Reconstructive Memories, Executable Skills, and Residual Assembly for Language Models
summary: Language-model systems can separate contextual computation, persistent storage, and exact execution instead of updating all capabilities through one shared parameter system. We investigate FEM-ASM, a finite-element-method-inspired organization in which independently constructed document states and deterministic executable skills contribute typed proposals to a shared language-model state. An explicit residual operator reconciles proposals attached to common interface nodes. We evaluate this organization through controlled experiments and negative results rather than claiming a physical finite-element formulation of language. An attention-free Multi-Mesh prototype learns causal language modeling but does not establish competitive general capability. A versioned store contains 52,809 reconstructive memory elements near a 1.7-billion-floating-value budget; reconstruction is incomplete, with approximately 75\% token accuracy. Support-aware lexical indices make these elements addressable under provenance-controlled query construction. For executable arithmetic, positional result observations substantially improve neural rendering relative to a repeated global result vector, and output substitutions change the model's preferred answer. A bounded attachment demonstration further measures the effect of making selected evidence available, without establishing the utility of loading an entire multi-billion-value store. The results support a separation of storage, execution, and neural coordination, while identifying unresolved limitations in question-only retrieval, unrestricted answer generation, and end-to-end efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究 FEM-ASM——一种受有限元方法启发的语言模型组织方式，将独立构建的文档状态、确定性可执行技能与共享语言模型状态分离，通过显式残差算子协调接口节点上的类型化提议，并以受控实验和负面结果评估其可行性。
AI.motivation: 作者希望探索语言模型系统能否将上下文计算、持久存储与精确执行分离开来，而不是通过单一共享参数系统更新所有能力，从而避免能力耦合带来的效率与可解释性问题。
AI.method: 借鉴有限元方法组织架构：独立构建的文档状态与确定性可执行技能向共享语言模型状态贡献类型化提议，由显式残差算子协调公共接口节点上的提议。通过受控实验评估，包括无注意力 Multi-Mesh 原型、版本化存储（52,809 个重构记忆元素，约 17 亿浮点值预算）、支持感知词法索引、可执行算术的位置结果观测与输出替换，以及有界附着演示。作者强调这是组织性研究而非语言的物理有限元表述。
AI.result: 无注意力 Multi-Mesh 原型可学习因果语言建模，但未建立有竞争力的通用能力；记忆重构不完整，token 准确率约 75%；支持感知词法索引在来源受控的查询构建下使元素可寻址；对于可执行算术，位置结果观测相比重复全局结果向量显著改善神经渲染，输出替换会改变模型偏好答案；有界附着演示测量了提供选定证据的效果，但未确立加载整个数十亿值存储的效用。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持存储、执行与神经协调的分离，同时指出在仅问题检索、无限制答案生成和端到端效率方面仍存在未解决的局限。

title: DePICT: Decision-Preserving Interface for Constrained Downstream Tasks
summary: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. This raises a fundamental question: which inputs does a decision making system truly depend on? Building on this question, we introduce DePICT, a procedure for constructing decision preserving interfaces by ranking context directions according to the optimizer's solution sensitivity and aggregating them across an operating regime. We study this problem in a high dimensional setting where primitive context parameterizes a constrained task and the downstream agent observes only a selected subset of context directions. For locally regular constrained programs, we derive a Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) based characterization of when a context direction is optimizer relevant. Our analysis shows that appearing in the active optimization problem does not necessarily imply that a variable affects the final decision. Some context directions can alter the KKT conditions while leaving the optimal solution unchanged because their effect is absorbed by the dual variables. DePICT is designed to remove exactly these directions. In a controlled diagnosis, it recovers the decision relevant interface exactly and reduces linear predictor regret to 0.009, compared with 0.475 for the strongest competing baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出DePICT方法，通过KKT条件刻画上下文中对优化器解真正敏感的方向，构造保留决策的接口，剔除不影响最优解的冗余方向。
AI.motivation: 约束优化问题的目标与积极约束中可能含参数，但最终决策对小参数变化不敏感。作者想回答：决策系统真正依赖哪些输入？即如何识别对最优解有影响、与仅改变KKT条件但被对偶变量吸收的方向。
AI.method: DePICT：按优化器解灵敏度对上下文方向排序，并在运行区间上聚合，从而构造decision preserving interface。在高维设定下，原始上下文参数化约束任务，下游智能体只观测被选中的上下文方向子集；针对局部正则约束规划，基于KKT条件给出"上下文方向对优化器相关"的刻画。
AI.result: 分析表明出现在积极优化问题中不一定意味着变量影响最终决策；某些方向改变KKT条件但最优解不变，因为其效应被对偶变量吸收。DePICT正是为剔除这些方向而设计。在受控诊断中，它精确恢复决策相关接口，并将线性预测器regret降至0.009，而最强竞争基线为0.475。
AI.conclusion: 决策相关性不等同于出现在优化问题中；基于KKT灵敏度排序与聚合的DePICT能精确构造决策保留接口，显著优于基线。

title: Grounded in Time: A Multi-Source Dataset and Benchmark for Temporal Grounding in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation often requires inferring task-relevant states from past interactions when the current observation alone is insufficient to determine the appropriate action. Despite progress in benchmarking memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models, application-oriented tasks requiring history-dependent semantic inference remain underrepresented. We introduce GiT (Grounded in Time), a dataset and benchmark for grounding manipulation decisions in past events across biolaboratory, household, and industrial scenarios. It includes real-robot and Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) style demonstrations covering 18 bimanual tasks, together with simulation data and a ManiSkill-based evaluation suite covering nine tasks. Fine-grained subtask annotations and annotated counterfactual task pairs, in which similar current observations require different actions depending on prior events, support policy learning and targeted evaluation of history use. Evaluations of representative end-to-end VLA models in simulation and on selected real-world tasks reveal substantial room for improvement in history-dependent manipulation. The dataset and benchmark are available at the project page.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了GiT（Grounded in Time）数据集与基准，用于在生物实验室、家庭和工业场景中评估依赖历史事件的操作决策，涵盖18个双臂任务及基于ManiSkill的9项仿真评估，揭示现有VLA模型在历史依赖操作上仍有较大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中，仅凭当前观测往往无法确定合适动作，需要从过去交互中推断任务相关状态。尽管记忆增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基准已有进展，但面向应用、需要依赖历史的语义推理任务仍缺乏代表性覆盖。
AI.method: 构建GiT数据集与基准，覆盖生物实验室、家庭和工业场景；包含真实机器人与UMI风格演示，涉及18个双臂任务，并提供仿真数据及基于ManiSkill的评估套件（9项任务）。同时提供细粒度子任务标注与反事实任务对标注（当前观测相似但需依据先前事件采取不同动作），以支持策略学习和历史使用的针对性评估。
AI.result: 在仿真与部分真实世界任务上对代表性端到端VLA模型进行评估，结果显示其在历史依赖操作方面仍有显著改进空间。
AI.conclusion: GiT为依赖历史语义推理的操作决策提供了数据集与基准，通过反事实任务对等设计可系统评估模型对历史信息的使用，并表明现有VLA模型在该方向能力不足。

title: Masked Privileged-Information Distillation for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification Under Missing Clinical Metadata
summary: Multimodal skin lesion classification combines clinical images with patient metadata to improve diagnostic accuracy. However, complete metadata available during training may be only partially accessible at deployment, and resource-constrained settings additionally require computational efficiency. We address these challenges with a privileged-information distillation framework in which a multimodal teacher trained on complete metadata supervises a 9.2x smaller student trained with randomly masked clinical fields. Clinical fields are masked as whole groups at a per-sample rate drawn from U(0,1), so one training run covers the full metadata availability range. Fusion is residual, with metadata added as a gated correction to an unconditional image base. On the PAD-UFES-20 dataset, distillation under masked training improves balanced accuracy over cross-entropy training at every availability level, by an average of +4.7 points versus +1.8 points without masking. The masked student loses only 7.8 balanced-accuracy points as metadata decreases from complete to absent, compared with 36.6 points for the same student trained on complete metadata, highlighting the role of masked training in graceful degradation beyond distillation alone. Grad-CAM visualizations further show that the masked student's attention generally remains lesion-centered as metadata is withdrawn. The resulting compact model targets point-of-care settings, where clinical metadata is often incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文提出特权信息蒸馏框架：用完整元数据训练的多模态教师模型指导小9.2倍、且以随机掩码临床字段训练的学生模型，在PAD-UFES-20上实现全元数据可用范围内的稳健皮肤病变分类。
AI.motivation: 多模态皮肤病变分类虽结合临床图像与患者元数据提升精度，但部署时元数据往往只有部分可用，且资源受限场景要求计算高效；现有方法多假设训练与部署时元数据完整，缺乏对元数据缺失的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用特权信息蒸馏：教师模型在完整元数据上训练，学生模型小9.2倍、训练时临床字段按样本以U(0,1)速率整组随机掩码，单次训练覆盖全元数据可用范围；融合采用残差方式，元数据作为门控修正叠加到无条件图像基线上。
AI.result: 在PAD-UFES-20上，掩码训练下的蒸馏在各可用性水平均提升平衡准确率，平均+4.7点（无掩码为+1.8点）；元数据从完整到缺失时，掩码学生仅损失7.8点，而同一学生在完整元数据训练下损失36.6点；Grad-CAM显示元数据撤除时注意力仍总体集中于病变区域。
AI.conclusion: 掩码训练结合蒸馏能实现元数据缺失下的平滑退化，优于仅靠蒸馏，所得紧凑模型适用于临床元数据常不完整的即时诊疗场景。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Graph Representation Strategies for Cyber Attack Detection
summary: Graph based cyber attack detection studies employ various graph construction and representation strategies across different cybersecurity application domains. This diversity motivates a quantitative examination of how representation strategies are distributed across these application domains. This study presents a quantitative analysis of 37 original studies published between 2019 and 2026. Each study was coded according to publication year, application domain, graph representation type, feature extraction strategy, learning paradigm, algorithm, and dataset. Frequency analysis, cross tabulation, and statistical association tests were applied. Automated representation learning was the most frequently employed strategy, accounting for 73.0% of the studies, while handcrafted representation strategies accounted for 27.0%. The Fisher Freeman Halton exact test revealed a statistically significant association between application domain and representation strategy (exact p = 0.008; Cramer's V = 0.540). The findings indicate that automated representation learning predominates within the analyzed corpus and that the distribution of representation strategies differs across cybersecurity application domains.

AI.tldr: 对2019—2026年37项图基网络攻击检测研究进行定量编码分析，发现自动表示学习占比73.0%，且应用领域与表示策略显著相关（Fisher-Freeman-Halton 精确 p=0.008，Cramer's V=0.540）。
AI.motivation: 图基网络攻击检测研究在不同网络安全应用领域中采用多样化的图构建与表示策略，这种多样性促使研究者需要定量考察表示策略在各应用领域间的分布情况。
AI.method: 对2019至2026年间发表的37项原创研究进行系统编码，编码维度包括发表年份、应用领域、图表示类型、特征提取策略、学习范式、算法与数据集；采用频数分析、交叉列联表及统计关联检验进行分析。
AI.result: 自动表示学习是最常采用的策略，占73.0%，手工设计表示策略占27.0%；Fisher-Freeman-Halton精确检验显示应用领域与表示策略之间存在统计显著关联（精确p=0.008；Cramer's V=0.540）。
AI.conclusion: 在所分析语料中自动表示学习占主导地位，且表示策略的分布在不同网络安全应用领域之间存在差异。

title: Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers
summary: Finding a compact formula that fits a set of input-output pairs and predicts outputs on unseen inputs is a fundamental problem in science. Symbolic regression automates the search for such formulae: search-based methods explore the space of possible formulae directly, while transformers pre-trained on synthetic data produce formulae of comparable quality substantially faster. Existing transformers, however, are prone to overfitting --- they find formulae that fit the training data well but do not extrapolate to input ranges unseen during training. We address this by shaping the set of formulae used to train a transformer, and show that the resulting formulae extrapolate substantially better. Fine-tuning the transformer on data with noise-corrupted target values further makes the synthesized formulae robust to noise in the observations. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench our transformer synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget. Search-based methods surpass our accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.

AI.tldr: 提出通过塑造训练公式集合与噪声微调，使符号回归Transformer生成的外推性更强、抗噪性更好的公式。
AI.motivation: 符号回归旨在从输入-输出对中找到紧凑公式并预测未见输入，是科学中的基础问题。现有基于搜索的方法直接探索公式空间，而预训练Transformer虽速度快，却容易过拟合——找到的公式虽拟合训练数据良好，却无法外推到训练时未见过的输入范围。
AI.method: 通过塑造（shaping）用于训练Transformer的公式集合，使生成的公式具备更好外推能力；并进一步在目标值含噪声的数据上微调Transformer，使合成公式对观测噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在SRBench和LLM-SRBench上，该Transformer约十秒即可合成一个公式，在可比预算下外推表现优于所有被评估方法；基于搜索的方法只有在多花一到三个数量级时间时，才能超越其精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过约束训练公式分布并进行噪声微调，可显著改善Transformer符号回归的外推性与鲁棒性，在精度-时间权衡上优于搜索式方法。

title: Real-Time Conformal-Seeded Hybrid Inverse Kinematics for Offset Redundant Manipulators
summary: This paper presents a conformal-seeded hybrid strategy for solving inverse kinematics of offset, redundant 7-DoF robot arms of the humanoid class. Analytical inverse kinematics (AIK) provides closed-form solutions with very low computational cost. However, for offset kinematic structures, the exact closed-form solution is generally unavailable, and practical AIK must rely on an approximate or simplified kinematic model. In contrast, numerical inverse kinematics (NIK) can achieve high-precision solutions on the full kinematic model. However, its convergence is highly sensitive to initialization. To overcome these limitations, we propose a two-stage hybrid inverse kinematics framework with conformal-calibrated seed selection. First, an approximate analytical model efficiently enumerates a finite set of candidate joint solutions. Second, we rank these candidates using a lightweight learned predictor of post-refinement difficulty, wrapped by split-conformal prediction into a calibrated upper bound that serves as the selection score. The best-ranked seed is then refined using a Levenberg-Marquardt solver on the full kinematic model. The proposed method combines fast candidate generation, learned seed ranking with a calibrated difficulty bound, and accurate numerical refinement, achieving real-time performance of less than 40us and a success rate of 100% in our evaluation on reachable targets. We validate the approach through large-scale stochastic simulation across the workspace and experimental demonstrations with motion planning on a humanoid robot arm. Demonstration videos are available at https://youtu.be/aeiBmw1XRbw.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向偏置冗余7自由度人形机械臂的共形校准混合逆运动学框架：先用近似解析模型枚举有限候选关节解，再用带分裂共形预测的学习预测器对候选排序，最后用LM求解器在全模型上精修，实现<40us实时性与100%成功率。
AI.motivation: 偏置运动学结构下精确闭式解一般不可得，解析逆运动学（AIK）只能依赖近似/简化模型；而数值逆运动学（NIK）虽能在完整模型上高精度求解，却对初始化高度敏感，易收敛失败。
AI.method: 两阶段混合框架：1）近似解析模型高效枚举有限候选关节解；2）用轻量学习预测器估计候选"精修后难度"，并以分裂共形预测包裹为校准上界，作为候选选择得分；3）选取最优种子，在完整运动学模型上用Levenberg-Marquardt求解器精修。
AI.result: 在可达目标评估中实现低于40us的实时性能与100%成功率；通过工作空间内大规模随机仿真及人形机械臂运动规划实验演示验证方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该混合策略融合快速候选生成、校准难度上界的学习种子排序与精确数值精修，克服了AIK近似误差与NIK初始化敏感的双重局限，适用于偏置冗余人形机械臂的实时高成功率逆运动学求解。

title: Verifier-Guided Synthetic Augmentation for 3D Human Shape Generation
summary: Limited training data diversity constrains generative modeling of 3D human bodies: conservative models remain close to observed examples, whereas exploratory models often violate basic body proportions. We introduce a verifier-guided augmentation framework that uses global and mode-local PCA to generate inexpensive candidates, screens them using correspondence-derived skeletal proportions and body-part geometry, and retrains a diffusion model on accepted candidates. Elastic registration provides both the modal structure used by distributed PCA and the dense anatomical correspondence needed for scalable screening without per-candidate body-model fitting. A blinded human study supports the verifier as a conservative gatekeeper, favoring verifier-accepted over rejected outputs. We evaluate full-pool verifier acceptance separately from the coverage and departure of accepted samples and combine them through EAUC. On 4,498 registered DFAUST surfaces, distributed-PCA augmentation achieves 86.32% acceptance, the highest CP-AUC (0.871), and the highest EAUC (0.752), improving EAUC by 32% over real-only and self-augmented diffusion. These results show that mode-local, verifier-guided proposals broaden diffusion generation while maintaining high agreement with calibrated body measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"验证器引导的数据增强"框架，用全局与局部PCA生成候选3D人体样本，再以骨骼比例与部位几何作为验证器筛选，最后用被接受的样本重训练扩散模型，从而在保持人体测量合理性前提下拓宽生成多样性。
AI.motivation: 3D人体生成建模受限于训练数据多样性不足：保守模型过于贴近观测样本，探索性模型又常违反基本人体比例。核心动机是在"多样性"与"解剖合理性"之间取得平衡，让扩散模型能生成更广但仍符合人体测量约束的形体。
AI.method: 框架分三步：(1) 用全局PCA与模式局部PCA(基于弹性配准得到的模态结构)廉价生成候选样本；(2) 用对应关系导出的骨骼比例和身体部位几何进行筛选，借助弹性配准提供的稠密解剖对应，无需对每个候选做body-model拟合即可可扩展地验证；(3) 在通过验证的候选上重训练扩散模型。评测上把"验证器整体接受率"与"被接受样本的覆盖度及其对真实分布的偏离"分开度量，并用EAUC综合。
AI.result: 在4,498个配准后的DFAUST曲面上，分布式PCA增强达到86.32%接受率、最高CP-AUC(0.871)和最高EAUC(0.752)，EAUC较仅用真实数据和自增强扩散提升32%。盲测人类研究显示验证器作为保守把关者有效，更偏好其接受而非拒绝的输出。
AI.conclusion: 模式局部、验证器引导的候选生成能在维持与标定人体测量高度一致的同时，有效拓宽扩散模型的生成范围，为数据稀缺下的人体生成提供可行路径。

title: The Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating: A Framework for Disclosing Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Generative artificial intelligence has become increasingly incorporated into digital media and more generally into production workflows with which the public frequently interacts. Current provenance standards and disclosure methods frequently rely on binary categorizations, differentiating only between entirely human-authored and AI-generated content, or depend on technical watermarking that lacks user-facing clarity. However, there are very different risks and outcomes depending on the different uses of AI in the creation and consumption of end products. Therefore, we propose the Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating framework which addresses these concerns by introducing a six-tier scale (Levels 0-5) that discloses the extent of AI involvement in both product creation and user experience. This paper details the structural methodology of the REAL Rating system and the specifics of its application across text, image, audio, video, and software products.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 REAL（Reported Engagement with AI Level）评级框架，用六级量表（0-5 级）披露生成式 AI 在产品创作与用户体验中的参与程度，替代现有二分式标注与缺乏用户可读性的水印方案，并给出其在文本、图像、音频、视频与软件产品中的具体应用方法。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 已深度嵌入数字媒体与生产工作流，但现有溯源标准与披露方法存在两大不足：一是采用二元划分，仅区分"完全由人创作"与"AI 生成"；二是依赖技术性水印，对用户缺乏可读性。而 AI 在最终产品创作与消费中的不同使用方式会带来差异显著的风险与后果，因此需要更细粒度的披露机制。
AI.method: 提出 REAL Rating 框架，构建六级量表（Levels 0-5），从"产品创作"与"用户体验"两个维度披露 AI 参与程度；论文阐述该评级系统的结构性方法学，并说明其在文本、图像、音频、视频和软件五类产品上的具体应用细则。
AI.result: 论文给出了 REAL 评级系统的结构方法及其在五类媒体产品（文本、图像、音频、视频、软件）中的应用规范，形成可跨模态使用的统一披露分级方案。
AI.conclusion: REAL Rating 通过多层级、双维度（创作与体验）的披露方式，克服了二元分类与低可读性水印的局限，为不同 AI 参与程度的数字产品提供了更精细、面向用户的透明度框架。

title: Evolving LLM-Generated Features for Interpretable Classification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as classifiers, yet they operate as opaque systems whose decisions are difficult to interpret, which complicates their use in regulated domains such as credit scoring or medical diagnosis. We propose an evolutionary framework that iteratively discovers natural language feature definitions (rubrics) for interpretable classification. An LLM generates candidate binary features, evaluates each sample against them, and the resulting vectors can be used to train a transparent classifier such as logistic regression. The feature set evolves over multiple iterations guided by classification errors, per-class activation rates, and feature ablation scores. We evaluate across three benchmarks, including a credit risk dataset representative of regulated domains, comparing single-shot LLM rubrics, evolved rubrics, and direct zero-shot LLM classification. Evolved features improve over single-shot rubrics by +2.9 pp on average and outperform zero-shot LLM classification on two of three tasks, while providing fully auditable decision logic. On the credit risk task, the zero-shot LLM performs at chance (50.7%) with a strong bias toward a single class, whereas evolved features achieve balanced, interpretable predictions. Crucially, this failure is invisible in aggregate accuracy and surfaces only under per-class auditing. Analysis reveals that evolution is most effective when label boundaries cannot be inferred from category names alone or when the LLM lacks reliable domain-specific reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出进化式框架，用LLM迭代发现自然语言特征定义（评分标准），训练透明分类器，实现可审计的分类。
AI.motivation: LLM作为分类器虽广泛使用，但其决策不透明，难以在信贷评分、医疗诊断等受监管领域应用。
AI.method: LLM生成候选二值特征并逐样本评估，形成特征向量训练逻辑回归等透明分类器；依分类错误、各类激活率和特征消融分数多轮进化特征集。在三个基准（含信贷风险数据集）上对比单次LLM评分标准、进化评分标准与零样本LLM直接分类。
AI.result: 进化特征平均比单次评分标准提升+2.9个百分点，在三项任务中两项优于零样本LLM分类，且决策逻辑完全可审计。信贷任务中零样本LLM仅达随机水平（50.7%）且强烈偏向单一类别，而进化特征实现均衡、可解释预测；该失败在总体准确率中不可见，仅在各类别审计下暴露。
AI.conclusion: 当标签边界无法仅靠类别名称推断或LLM缺乏可靠领域推理时，进化方法最有效；各类别审计对发现隐藏偏见至关重要。

title: Asynchronous Tracking, Optical Communication and 3D Motion Capture using Event-based Sensors
summary: Inter-robot communication is a key enabling technology in cooperative robotics applications. While wireless communication is ubiquitous, simple, and effective, it has inherent limitations: the receiving robot cannot easily localise the source of an incoming signal, clock synchronisation is challenging, and signals are broadcast to all nearby devices rather than targeted recipients. Optical communication provides a complementary channel that is inherently directional and spatially localised, directly addressing these limitations. Event cameras are bio-inspired dynamic vision sensors that respond to changes in image intensity with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low latency, making them well-suited as receivers for high-rate optical communication in cooperative robotic systems. In this paper, we propose the Asynchronous Tracking and Optical Communication (ATOC) system, which integrates LED smart-beacon modulation, event-based detection, optical tracking, and event-data demodulation in a single pipeline. By simultaneously tracking and demodulating multiple LED smart beacons, ATOC transforms a conventional visual marker into a robust communication channel suitable for a wide range of high-impact robotics applications. We validate ATOC in a suite of laboratory studies and two 'applications': a smart-city demonstration and a 3D motion-capture system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATOC系统，将LED信标调制、事件相机检测、光学跟踪与事件数据解调集成于统一流程，实现多LED信标同时跟踪与解调，把视觉标记转变为面向协作机器人的鲁棒光通信通道。
AI.motivation: 无线通信虽普遍易用，但接收方难以定位信号源、时钟同步困难、且为广播式而非定向传输。光通信方向性强、空间局部化，可互补上述缺陷；事件相机具备高时间分辨率、高动态范围与低延迟，适合作为高速光通信接收器。
AI.method: 提出异步跟踪与光通信（ATOC）系统，集成LED智能信标调制、基于事件的检测、光学跟踪与事件数据解调于单一流水线，可同时跟踪并解调多个LED智能信标。
AI.result: 通过一系列实验室研究验证ATOC，并展示两个应用：智慧城市演示与3D动作捕捉系统。
AI.conclusion: ATOC将常规视觉标记转化为鲁棒通信通道，适用于广泛的高影响力机器人应用场景。

title: VolS-GS: Relightable Gaussian Splatting with Volumetric Subsurface Scattering
summary: We present VolS-GS, a relightable Gaussian splatting framework that reconstructs objects from one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) captures and renders them under novel lighting and viewpoints. Relightable Gaussian Splatting methods typically model appearance independently at each primitive, which makes non-local effects difficult to represent. This limitation is particularly apparent for subsurface scattering, where light entering the object at one location can emerge at another. Rather than modeling this effect solely with a neural network or a local kernel at each primitive, we use the spatial support of the Gaussian scene as the domain of a differentiable finite-volume transport solver, so that light can propagate through the object's interior. A small network predicts scattering and absorption coefficients for each Gaussian, and the solve redistributes incident light through the resulting field. The coefficients are fit to images rather than measured, so the solve supplies a transport-shaped path for aggregating per-primitive appearance, not a measurement of the material. To keep the learned shadow and specular terms from taking over the other components, our shadow term is predicted from visibility together with the transmittances and the scattering the solve produces, and a regularizer suppresses specular highlights in regions the shadow term predicts to be unlit. Experiments on three OLAT benchmarks show that VolS-GS consistently improves relighting quality on held-out lights and views.

AI.tldr: VolS-GS 将高斯场景的空间支撑作为可微有限体积传输求解器的域，实现光在物体内部的传播，并在三个 OLAT 基准上提升了新光照与新视角的重光照质量。
AI.motivation: 可重光照高斯泼溅方法通常在每个基元上独立建模外观，难以表示非局部效应，尤其是次表面散射——光从一处进入、从另一处射出。单独依靠神经网络或局部核难以刻画这种跨位置的光传输。
AI.method: 以高斯场景的空间支撑作为可微有限体积传输求解器的求解域，使光能在物体内部传播；用一个小型网络为每个高斯预测散射与吸收系数，求解器据此重分布入射光。系数由图像拟合而非实测，因此求解提供的是聚合逐基元外观的"传输形状"路径。阴影项由可见性、透射率及求解产生的散射共同预测；并用正则项抑制阴影项判定为未受光区域的高光。
AI.result: 在三个 OLAT 基准上的实验表明，VolS-GS 在留出光照与视角下的重光照质量持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可微有限体积光传输引入高斯泼溅，VolS-GS 有效建模了包括次表面散射在内的非局部效应，并借助阴影与高光的耦合约束提升了重光照的泛化质量。

title: Agent Policy-Value Audit: Separating Transition Composition from Event Selection in Financial LLM Agents
summary: Financial LLM agents are often evaluated by comparing their end-to-end returns with those of a baseline and testing the paired difference against zero. This measures whether deploying the agent changes realized performance, but it does not isolate event-selection skill. An agent that frequently changes positions from flat to long can earn a positive paired return from an upward-drifting event pool even when it selects events at random. We propose the Agent Policy-Value Audit, which holds fixed the observed count of each ordered action-change type and randomly reassigns them across eligible events. The average payoff from these reassignments is the composition benchmark; the difference between observed deployment value and this benchmark is selection value. In semi-synthetic benchmarks based on real earnings-event returns, a zero-centered paired test falsely attributes passive exposure to selection skill in $11.6\%$ of no-skill replications, while the transition-matched audit reduces this rate to $5.3\%$. Applied retrospectively to 723 earnings events at 44 U.S. consumer-facing firms, the audit decomposes the agent's gross deployment value of $+15.2$ bps/event into a $+25.8$ composition benchmark and a $-10.6$ selection value. The agent does not detectably outperform matched random assignments. Financial-agent evaluations should report deployment value separately from event-selection value.

AI.tldr: 提出"Agent Policy-Value Audit"审计方法，通过固定动作变化类型的数量并随机重分配到合格事件上，将智能体的"部署价值"分解为"组合基准"与"选择价值"，以分离事件选择技能与被动暴露。
AI.motivation: 现有金融LLM智能体评估通过配对差异检验与零比较来衡量端到端收益，仅能反映部署是否改变实际表现，无法识别事件选择技能。当事件池整体上行时，频繁由空仓转为多头（flat-to-long）的智能体即使随机选事件也能获得正配对收益，导致被动暴露被误判为技能。
AI.method: 提出Agent Policy-Value Audit：保持每种有序动作变化类型的观测数量固定，将其在合格事件间随机重新分配；随机重分配的平均收益作为组合基准（composition benchmark），观测部署价值与该基准之差即为选择价值（selection value）。在基于真实财报事件收益的半合成基准上检验两类检验的错误归因率，并回溯应用于44家美国消费类企业的723个财报事件。
AI.result: 半合成基准中，以零为中心的配对检验在11.6%的无技能重复实验中错误地将被动暴露归因为选择技能，而过渡匹配审计将该比例降至5.3%。对723个财报事件的回溯应用显示，智能体+15.2 bps/事件的毛部署价值被分解为+25.8的组合基准与-10.6的选择价值；智能体未能可检测地优于匹配随机分配。
AI.conclusion: 金融智能体评估应将部署价值与事件选择价值分开报告。配对零检验会系统性高估选择技能，过渡匹配审计提供了更可靠的技能度量。

authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
title: One-Step Curvature Probes Miss the Fitting Operator: Retained Capacity and Terminal Null-Space Correction for Continual Learning
summary: A one-step curvature probe evaluates an initial direction, whereas continual learners are judged after reaching comparable new-task fit. In an overparameterized linearization, projected gradient descent converges to $Δ_P=PJ^\top(JPJ^\top)^{-1}r$, and its squared-displacement inflation is exactly the reciprocal of the retained fitting capacity $c_P(r)$. More generally, the terminal old-task quadratic ratio factorizes as $1/[c_P(r)G_{\rm end}(P,r)]$, where $G_{\rm end}$ compares curvature along endpoint directions. In the rank-one case, $G_{\rm end}$ equals the one-step probe gain; for multiple outputs, the two gains can differ. The terminal quadratic also separates into a curvature-optimal fitting floor and an algorithm-dependent null-space excess, motivating terminal null-space correction, which preserves linearized new-task outputs on its Jacobian batch. Controlled checks validate the local quadratic and show that projection can greatly reduce matched-norm curvature while barely changing terminal forgetting. Across common-threshold configurations, projection yields the larger signed old-task loss change in 73/99 matched pairs, retained fitting capacity falls with rank, and fixed-rank comparisons separate terminal forgetting even when probe gain is approximately matched. On Permuted MNIST and Split CIFAR-100, terminal correction decreases signed old-task loss in 166/180 method--dataset--seed pairs under the all-seed intention-to-correct analysis; because acceptance and outcome reporting use the same held-out split, this result is descriptive and test-conditioned. Overall, terminal cost depends jointly on retained fitting capacity, endpoint-direction curvature, and the null-space component selected by optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文用过度参数化线性化框架分析持续学习中的遗忘：终端旧任务二次代价可分解为保留拟合容量、端点方向曲率与算法相关零空间超额，并提出终端零空间校正方法，在实验中大幅降低旧任务损失。
AI.motivation: 一步曲率探针只评估初始方向，而持续学习者的遗忘应在达到可比新任务拟合后评判，因此需要更贴切的终端评估理论。
AI.method: 在过度参数化线性化下分析投影梯度下降的收敛解，将终端旧任务二次比分解为1/[c_P(r)G_end(P,r)]，区分保留拟合容量、端点方向曲率及零空间超额；据此提出终端零空间校正，在其雅可比批次上保持线性化新任务输出。
AI.result: 秩一情形下G_end等于一步探针增益，多输出时可不同；共同阈值配置下投影在73/99匹配对中产生更大带符号旧任务损失变化，保留拟合容量随秩下降；Permuted MNIST与Split CIFAR-100上终端校正在166/180方法-数据集-种子对中降低带符号旧任务损失（描述性、受测试条件限制）。
AI.conclusion: 终端成本共同取决于保留拟合容量、端点方向曲率与优化所选的零空间分量；终端零空间校正提供了一种有效的遗忘缓解手段。

title: TacOT: Learning Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Tactile-Guided Optimal Transport
summary: Learning contact-rich dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations provides a scalable source of interaction data, yet transferring such skills to robots remains challenging due to unreliable human--robot correspondence. Existing human-to-robot transfer methods typically rely on visual appearance or motion similarity, which may associate similar motions with different contact states and force patterns. Tactile dynamics provide interaction-aware cues to distinguish manipulation processes with similar motions but different contact states. We introduce tactile-guided optimal transport (TacOT), a framework for human-to-robot contact-rich manipulation. TacOT leverages action--tactile dynamic time warping to identify human--robot demonstration correspondences with consistent interaction dynamics and uses these correspondences to guide soft optimal transport alignment in a shared policy representation space. This enables human demonstrations to provide contact-rich supervision for robot policy learning without requiring predefined frame-level human--robot pairing. Across four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, TacOT improves closed-loop success rates over action-guided OT by up to 17 points on in-distribution tasks and 20 points under targeted human-to-robot out-of-distribution transfer. Further analyses show that tactile-guided correspondence selects demonstration pairs with more consistent contact dynamics and produces latent representations that better reflect interaction-state evolution. These results demonstrate that tactile dynamics provide an effective semantic signal for establishing reliable human-to-robot correspondence in contact-rich dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TacOT（tactile-guided optimal transport）框架，利用触觉动力学信号建立人类演示与机器人演示之间的可靠对应关系，从而将接触丰富型灵巧操作技能从人类迁移到机器人。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示中学习接触丰富的灵巧操作能提供可扩展的交互数据，但人类-机器人对应关系不可靠导致技能迁移困难。现有迁移方法依赖视觉外观或运动相似性，会把相似运动但不同接触状态与力学模式的情况错误关联。触觉动力学能提供交互感知线索，区分运动相似但接触状态不同的操作过程。
AI.method: TacOT采用动作-触觉动态时间规整（action-tactile dynamic time warping）来识别具有一致交互动力学的人类-机器人演示对应关系，并用这些对应关系在共享策略表示空间中引导软最优传输（soft optimal transport）对齐。该方法无需预定义的帧级人类-机器人配对，即可使人类演示为机器人策略学习提供接触丰富的监督信号。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界灵巧操作任务上，TacOT相比动作引导的最优传输（action-guided OT），在分布内任务上闭环成功率提升最多17个百分点，在针对性的人类-机器人分布外迁移场景下提升最多20个百分点。进一步分析表明，触觉引导的对应关系能选出接触动力学更一致的演示配对，并产生更能反映交互状态演化的潜在表示。
AI.conclusion: 触觉动力学为接触丰富型灵巧操作中建立可靠的人类-机器人对应关系提供了有效的语义信号。

title: PhysMamba: Selective State Space Models as Learned Articulated Body Simulators
comment: CVPR 2026 Workshop on Physically Grounded Human Perception and Modeling -- 1st PhysHuman
summary: We introduce the first learned articulated body simulator based on a selective state space model (SSM), called PhysMamba. PhysMamba predicts next-frame full-body state from position, rotation, and joint-action history, without velocity inputs. We compare four architectures under partial- and full-observation inputs and three training protocols. The from-scratch rollout training protocol gives Mamba2 strong short- and mid-horizon accuracy under partial observation (s10 = 43 mm, 2/50 diverged), while the two-stage teacher-based rollout protocol stabilizes GRU but fails for Mamba2. With CUDA graph compilation, Mamba2 reaches 0.107 ms per frame (9,334 FPS) on an H100 GPU, within 1.1$\times$ of GRU's un-compiled throughput, adding under 1% latency to a 30 Hz HMR pipeline and enabling integration as a differentiable physics module for video-based mesh recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的可学习关节体模拟器 PhysMamba，在部分观测下实现高精度与实时吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有可学习关节体模拟器多依赖RNN等架构，在部分观测、长时预测精度与推理效率之间难以兼顾，且缺乏对SSM类架构在人体运动模拟中的系统评估。
AI.method: PhysMamba以位置、旋转与关节动作历史为输入（不含速度），预测下一帧全身状态。作者对比四种架构（含Mamba2与GRU），在部分/全观测输入及三种训练协议下进行评估，并采用CUDA graph编译优化推理。
AI.result: 从零开始（from-scratch）的rollout训练协议使Mamba2在部分观测下具备较强的短中期精度（s10 = 43 mm，发散2/50）；两阶段教师式rollout协议可稳定GRU但对Mamba2失效。经CUDA graph编译，Mamba2在H100上达0.107 ms/帧（9,334 FPS），接近GRU未编译吞吐的1.1倍，在30 Hz HMR流水线中增加不足1%延迟。
AI.conclusion: PhysMamba验证了SSM在关节体模拟中的可行性与高效性，可作为可微物理模块集成到基于视频的网格恢复流程中。

title: The Cost of a Hop: Benchmarking NLIP and A2A
summary: Autonomous agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) need standardized protocols to interoperate across systems. Several now exist (A2A, MCP, ACP, ANP, NLIP), but the Natural Language Interaction Protocol (NLIP) has not appeared in any controlled performance study, and no work has measured where an agent protocol's latency is spent. We compare NLIP and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol empirically, decomposing latency into message creation, connection, and send phases across three independent hardware environments. For lightweight coordination, NLIP is 8.4-9.6x faster than the baseline A2A SDK implementation on two environments and about 4x on a third; the direction of the advantage is consistent, its magnitude depends on the hardware. The advantage is stage-specific: for the end-to-end pipeline, where LLM inference dominates, the protocols are near parity. The difference comes almost entirely from connection setup. To test A2A at its best, we also ran A2A SDK with connection caching enabled; caching narrows its gap with NLIP by a hardware-dependent amount, from 2.75x on one machine to near-parity on faster hardware, where at scale a cache-optimized A2A-SDK matches NLIP. We report these as measured conditions without a single causal account of the residual send-phase cost. Against the more optimized Python-A2A, NLIP leads by about 4x on the same stage. We close with a protocol-selection guide keyed to workload characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对NLIP与A2A两种LLM智能体互操作协议进行受控性能对比，在三套独立硬件上将延迟分解为消息创建、连接、发送三阶段：轻量协调场景NLIP快8.4–9.6倍（两套环境）与约4倍（第三套），但端到端含LLM推理时两者接近持平，差异主要源于连接建立开销。
AI.motivation: LLM自主智能体跨系统互操作需要标准化协议，目前已有A2A、MCP、ACP、ANP、NLIP等多个协议，但NLIP从未出现在受控性能研究中，且尚无工作量化智能体协议延迟具体消耗在哪个阶段，因此缺乏协议选型的实证依据。
AI.method: 在三种独立硬件环境中对NLIP与A2A进行实证对比，将延迟分解为消息创建、连接建立、发送三个阶段；同时测试启用连接缓存的A2A SDK以考察其最优表现，并与更优化的Python-A2A实现进行同阶段对照。
AI.result: 轻量协调下NLIP比基线A2A SDK快8.4–9.6倍（两套环境）、约4倍（第三套），优势方向一致但幅度依硬件而异；端到端含LLM推理时两协议近乎持平；差异几乎全部来自连接建立。启用连接缓存后A2A与NLIP差距缩小（某机器2.75倍至较快硬件上接近持平），规模化时缓存优化版A2A-SDK可与NLIP持平；对比Python-A2A，NLIP在同阶段领先约4倍。
AI.conclusion: NLIP的性能优势是阶段特定且依赖硬件的，主要集中在连接建立而非传输本身；端到端推理主导场景下协议选择影响有限。作者按工作负载特征给出协议选型指南，并明确将残余发送阶段开销作为测量条件报告，未给出单一因果解释。

title: Probabilistic Algorithms for Ising Machines from Optimization to Generative AI
summary: Ising machines have emerged as promising hardware accelerators for intractable optimization and sampling problems, yet their practical impact increasingly hinges on the co-design of algorithms and hardware, where algorithmic demands shape new architectures and new hardware capabilities inspire entirely new algorithms. In this Review, we survey probabilistic algorithms designed for portability across diverse Ising platforms, advocating a top-down perspective that prioritizes principled methods with provable guarantees. We cover foundational methods such as simulated annealing and parallel tempering, including two-dimensional extensions that natively encode hard constraints, and examine approaches that expand the scale of solvable problems from cluster mean-field methods to variational samplers. We highlight the Probabilistic Approximate Optimization Algorithm (PAOA), a classical analog of QAOA that emerged directly from probabilistic hardware development, and explore how generative AI and Ising machines might reinforce each other: learned models propose global moves to accelerate optimization, while probabilistic techniques improve inference in large language models. Much as quantum computing has seen algorithms co-evolve with hardware, probabilistic and Ising computing stand at a similar inflection point. We outline a co-design framework for accelerating the capabilities and adoption of next-generation Ising machines.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，从"算法—硬件协同设计"的自顶向下视角梳理面向多种Ising平台的概率算法，涵盖模拟退火、并行回火、团平均场、变分采样器及PAOA，并探讨生成式AI与Ising机器的相互促进，提出协同设计框架以加速下一代Ising机器的能力提升与落地。
AI.motivation: Ising机器作为求解难解优化与采样问题的硬件加速器，其实际影响力日益取决于算法与硬件的协同设计：算法需求塑造新架构，新硬件能力又催生全新算法。作者希望为跨平台可移植的概率算法提供统一的、有原则且具可证保证的自顶向下梳理。
AI.method: 综述性方法：梳理基础方法（模拟退火、并行回火）及其原生编码硬约束的二维扩展；归纳从团平均场方法到变分采样器等扩展可解问题规模的方法；重点介绍PAOA（QAOA的经典类比，源自概率硬件发展）；并分析生成式AI与Ising机器的相互增强机制——学习模型提出全局移动以加速优化，概率技术改进大语言模型推理。最终提出协同设计框架。
AI.result: 系统性地呈现了面向Ising机器的概率算法谱系，明确了PAOA作为硬件驱动型算法的定位，并论证生成式AI与Ising机器可双向促进；指出概率与Ising计算正处于与量子计算算法—硬件共同演化相似的关键拐点。
AI.conclusion: Ising机器与概率计算正处于类似量子计算曾经历的拐点，算法与硬件需协同演化；论文提出协同设计框架，以加速下一代Ising机器能力的提升与实际采用。

title: Human Behavior-Informed Crash Scenario Generation with Real-World Crash Priors for Autonomous Vehicle Safety Evaluation
summary: Reliable safety evaluation of autonomous vehicles (AVs) is essential to improving road safety, yet it depends critically on realistic simulation of rare crashes. Existing crash scenario generation methods can increase collision occurrence, but often fail to realistically reproduce how crashes evolve before impact or the distribution of crash types observed in the real world. Here, we present CrashSim, a human behavior-informed crash scenario generation framework that uses real-world crash priors to guide generative multi-agent traffic simulation for more reliable AV safety evaluation. These priors capture how real-world crashes evolve before impact and how different crash types are distributed, allowing limited crash data to guide realistic and scalable scenario generation across naturalistic driving contexts. We evaluate CrashSim against competing methods, showing that it more closely reproduces real-world pre-impact behavior, collision dynamics, collision geometry and crash-type distributions. We further use CrashSim to construct nuCrash dataset, containing over 4,000 crash and near-crash scenarios. Closed-loop evaluation of five AV planners shows that nuCrash more effectively exposes differences in planner safety capabilities than nuScenes. An LLM-assisted evaluation agent further analyzes planner failures to provide capability-level diagnoses and targeted improvement guidance. Together, CrashSim enables realistic and scalable crash generation for more informative AV safety evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 CrashSim 框架，利用真实事故先验引导多智能体生成式交通仿真，生成高保真碰撞场景，并构建 nuCrash 数据集与 LLM 评估智能体，实现更具信息量的自动驾驶安全评测。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶安全评估依赖对稀有碰撞场景的真实仿真，但现有碰撞场景生成方法虽能提高碰撞发生率，却难以真实复现碰撞发生前的演化过程以及真实世界的碰撞类型分布。
AI.method: CrashSim 是一个人类行为驱动的碰撞场景生成框架：以真实世界碰撞先验（刻画碰撞前演化方式与碰撞类型分布）指导生成式多智能体交通仿真，从而在有限碰撞数据下实现自然驾驶情境中真实且可扩展的场景生成；并基于该框架构建 nuCrash 数据集；同时引入 LLM 辅助评估智能体分析规划器失效。
AI.result: 与对比方法相比，CrashSim 更贴近真实世界的碰撞前行为、碰撞动力学、碰撞几何与碰撞类型分布；nuCrash 包含 4000 余个碰撞与近碰撞场景；对五种自动驾驶规划器的闭环评估显示，nuCrash 比 nuScenes 更能有效区分规划器的安全能力差异。
AI.conclusion: CrashSim 实现了真实且可扩展的碰撞场景生成，为自动驾驶安全评估提供了更具信息量的手段；LLM 评估智能体可进一步给出能力层面的诊断与针对性改进指导。

title: ClasSAE: Class-Aligned Sparse Autoencoders via Differentiable Feature-Class Affinity
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) began as an unsupervised tool for decomposing neural representations into sparse, interpretable features, and are increasingly used not only for passive analysis but also for active interventions such as unlearning, bias mitigation, and concept editing. A central challenge for these editing and steering methods is reliably matching features to target concepts; most current approaches address this by computing post-hoc scores over an already-trained, frozen dictionary. We instead introduce ClasSAE, a novel method that both automatically assigns classes to features and guides the encoder toward class-separable representations during training. Specifically, we apply a differentiable top-$k$ operator to a trainable feature--class affinity matrix with per-feature budgets, coupling the features selected for each sample to the classes they are trained to represent. Because gradients flow through the selection of active features rather than only through their magnitudes, the encoder and the affinity matrix co-adapt rather than being fit in separate stages. The result is a dictionary that is both class-separable and class-annotated, with no need for post-hoc probing. We propose three variants for enforcing sparsity within this framework, which achieve comparable overall performance with slightly different trade-offs. Using CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings on ImageNet, we show that the learned affinity matrix agrees closely with an independently estimated post-hoc feature-class matrix computed on held-out data. The model also supports direct class prediction from the encoder and affinity matrix alone, without a separately fitted classifier, and its more class-aligned encoder yields improved separation in Targeted Probe Perturbation evaluations. https://github.com/St0pien/ClasSAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ClasSAE，一种在训练过程中自动为稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征分配类别并引导编码器学习类别可分表示的方法，无需事后探测。
AI.motivation: SAE 越来越多用于主动干预（如去学习、偏差缓解、概念编辑），其核心挑战是可靠地将特征匹配到目标概念；现有方法多在已训练好的冻结字典上做事后打分，特征与类别匹配与表示学习相互分离。
AI.method: 对可训练的特征–类别亲和矩阵施加可微 top-k 算子，并为每个特征设置预算，将样本所选的激活特征与其被训练代表的类别耦合；梯度流经活跃特征的选择而非仅其幅度，使编码器与亲和矩阵联合自适应；并提出三种在该框架内施加稀疏性的变体。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上使用 CLIP ViT-L/14 嵌入时，学到的亲和矩阵与在留出数据上独立估计的事后特征–类别矩阵高度一致；模型仅凭编码器与亲和矩阵即可直接进行类别预测，无需单独拟合分类器；其更类别对齐的编码器在 Targeted Probe Perturbation 评估中取得更好的分离效果。
AI.conclusion: ClasSAE 提供了兼具类别可分离与类别标注的字典，免去事后探测，为 SAE 的特征识别与概念编辑提供了端到端、可解释的训练方案。

title: Discrete Diffusion for Large Graph Generation via Structural Candidate Restriction
summary: Synthesizing realistic graphs at scale is vital when the graphs of interest are large and real-world samples are limited or access-sensitive. Diffusion-based generators have recently driven much of the progress, offering high modeling capacity, but most such methods have quadratic computational complexity and are hence restricted to small-scale networks, currently up to 3k nodes. Existing non-quadratic methods remain limited by memorization issues and a trade-off between scalability and generation quality. Our goal is to generate large graphs whose structural statistics --- e.g., degree distribution, clustering, and path length --- faithfully reflect those of real-world sparse graphs, without resorting to memorizing the training data. We introduce a discrete graph diffusion model that restricts training to a structurally motivated subset of node pairs --- observed edges and their wedge non-edges --- reducing training complexity below quadratic in the number of nodes. To keep the noisy graph informative throughout both the forward and reverse trajectories, we design a three-class absorbing forward process governed by a \emph{degree-aware, floored} cosine noise schedule: unlike a structure-blind schedule that adds noise to every pair identically, ours adapts to each node's degree and never fully erases the graph's structure, keeping the noisy graph informative at every step. Experiments across diverse datasets show that our model consistently ranks among the top methods for structural fidelity against existing discrete diffusion baselines in large graph generation.
