Inspired by neural network pruning, in this paper, we study harness pruning as a means of striking a better balance between task performance and token cost. We propose SHarP (Saliency-based Harness Pruning), a simple yet effective pruning strategy based on the saliency of each harness module with respect to performance and efficiency. Specifically, we first identify tools, instructions, and supporting mechanisms as components that can be individually disabled. We then estimate the saliency of each module by ablating it and assessing its task performance and token cost relative to the full set of single-module ablations. Modules with the smallest contribution to performance or largest computational overhead are subsequently pruned. Our evaluation across various harnesses on held-out validation sets reveals a surprising finding: most harnesses that we studied are highly redundant and can maintain comparable performance and efficiency even after a substantial portion of their modules are pruned. Our pruning approach and empirical findings provide new perspectives on agent harness design and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文将神经网络剪枝思想引入智能体框架（harness）优化，提出基于显著性的剪枝策略SHarP，通过逐模块消融评估各模块对性能与token成本的影响，剔除冗余模块。实验发现多数harness高度冗余，剪除大量模块后仍能保持相当的性能与效率。
AI.motivation: Agent harness 为满足任务需求并修复失败，常通过修改和打补丁的方式迭代优化其指令、工具与工作流，导致复杂度持续上升。由此引发疑问：某些模块是否冗余，只带来大量 token 开销却几乎没有性能收益。作者受神经网络剪枝启发，希望通过 harness 剪枝在任务性能与 token 成本之间取得更优平衡。
AI.method: 提出 SHarP（Saliency-based Harness Pruning）剪枝策略：首先将工具、指令及支撑机制识别为可单独禁用的组件；然后通过消融各模块，相对全部单模块消融集合评估其对任务性能和 token 成本的显著性；最后剪除对性能贡献最小或计算开销最大的模块。
AI.result: 在多个 harness 的留出验证集上评估发现：所研究的大多数 harness 高度冗余，即使剪除相当大比例的模块，仍能保持可比的性能与效率。
AI.conclusion: SHarP 剪枝方法与相关实证发现为智能体 harness 的设计与优化提供了新视角，表明在 harness 构建中应重视模块冗余问题及性能-成本权衡。

title: Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints
comment: Accepted to the LMP Workshop at EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Abhinav Rajput and Acey Vogelstein contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Abhinav0710rajput/coding_llms_cmdp
summary: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically require separate coefficient tuning swept across all clarification budget levels. We formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian to optimize coding accuracy, subject to an expected question-budget constraint. Evaluated on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle simulator, the resulting policies reveal that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient: budget-constrained policies can simultaneously achieve higher accuracy and lower clarification rates than the baseline model. Across budget levels, we observe a log-shaped Pareto frontier with diminishing returns to additional clarification. Gains arise not from simply asking more questions overall, but from improved question targeting and better code generation under ambiguity. Without explicit supervision, trained policies learn to allocate clarification budget non-uniformly, asking more frequently on tougher (multi-degradation) tasks. These results suggest that unconstrained interactive LLM systems may systematically use clarification inefficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文将代码智能体的澄清行为建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，在期望提问预算约束下优化编码准确率。
AI.motivation: 智能体在模糊指令下需在"主动提问澄清"与"直接求解"之间权衡：澄清可提升正确性，但每次交互都带来用户与系统成本，形成准确率与效率的显式取舍。现有工作虽研究澄清行为，却未在可强制执行的澄清预算下训练策略；基于惩罚的方法通常需为每个预算水平单独调参，难以泛化。
AI.method: 将澄清问题形式化为CMDP，以期望提问预算为约束、编码准确率为目标；基于PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练。在HumanEvalComm上以GPT-4o-mini作为oracle模拟器评估，并跨多个预算水平考察策略表现。
AI.result: 未调优的澄清行为是帕累托低效的：受预算约束的策略能同时取得更高准确率与更低澄清率。跨预算水平呈现对数形帕累托前沿，额外澄清的边际收益递减。性能提升并非来自提问更多，而是源于提问目标更精准、模糊条件下代码生成更好。无需显式监督，策略即学会非均匀分配预算，在更难的多重退化任务上更频繁提问。
AI.conclusion: 无约束的交互式LLM系统可能系统性地低效使用澄清交互。将澄清显式建模为带预算约束的决策问题，可在不牺牲甚至提升准确率的前提下降低交互开销，为构建高效交互式编码智能体提供可行路径。

title: ForeAct3D: Policy-Grounded Future World Modeling for VLA Policies
summary: Robots need to anticipate how their actions will change the world, since manipulation success hinges on the resulting contacts and object motions. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that predict future observations from shared features leave the forecast decoupled from the actions the policy will actually execute, and impose no physical constraints on how the scene may evolve. We introduce ForeAct3D, a framework for policy-grounded future world modeling within VLA policies. Learnable geometric queries decode depth, semantic segmentation, and camera pose from the policy representation into current and future semantic 3D scene states, and the future queries are conditioned on the policy-generated action chunk to ground the forecast in the planned interaction. A physical-consistency closure relates the two states through background staticity and instance-level rigidity, and anchors the wrist-camera pose to end-effector kinematics. These objectives shape the shared representation used for action generation during training, and no future prediction is required at inference. Without robot pretraining, ForeAct3D achieves 98.3\% average success on LIBERO and an average task length of 3.73 on CALVIN, outperforming its base policy on every suite. Ablations show that semantic 3D supervision, physical consistency, and action conditioning each improve manipulation performance, and that action conditioning substantially improves future object localization. Real-world experiments on spatial placement, object insertion, and sequential manipulation further raise average success from 6.7\% to 37.8\% over the base policy. The project page and code are available at https://github.com/anthonytao80-crypto/ForeAct3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ForeAct3D，一种在 VLA 策略内部进行策略锚定未来世界建模的框架。通过可学习几何查询从策略表示中解码当前与未来语义 3D 场景状态，并将未来查询以动作块为条件，施加物理一致性约束，从而改进共享表示与动作生成。无需机器人预训练，在 LIBERO、CALVIN 与真实任务上均显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作成功依赖对未来接触与物体运动的预判，但现有 VLA 策略在共享特征上预测未来观测时，预测与策略实际执行的动作解耦，且未对场景演化施加物理约束，导致未来建模对策略帮助有限。
AI.method: 提出 ForeAct3D：使用可学习几何查询，从策略表示中解码深度、语义分割和相机位姿，形成当前与未来的语义 3D 场景状态；未来查询以策略生成的动作块为条件，使预测锚定于计划交互。引入物理一致性闭合项，通过背景静止性与实例级刚性关联两种状态，并将腕部相机位姿锚定到末端执行器运动学。这些目标在训练时塑造用于动作生成的共享表示，推理时无需未来预测。
AI.result: 无需机器人预训练，ForeAct3D 在 LIBERO 上达到 98.3% 平均成功率，在 CALVIN 上平均任务长度为 3.73，在每个套件上均优于其基础策略。消融显示语义 3D 监督、物理一致性与动作条件化各自提升操作性能，且动作条件化显著改善未来物体定位。真实世界空间放置、物体插入与顺序操作实验将平均成功率从基线 6.7% 提升至 37.8%。
AI.conclusion: 策略锚定、物理约束的语义 3D 未来世界建模可有效增强 VLA 策略的共享表示，在不增加推理成本、无需机器人预训练的情况下一致提升仿真与真实操作性能。

title: UniBRep: Learning Unified Geometry and Topology for Image-conditioned B-Rep Generation
summary: Generating a boundary representation (B-rep) conditioned on a single image requires faithful reconstruction of geometry, valid topology, and support for complex shapes. We present UniBRep, a geometry-first framework that adapts a pretrained image-to-3D model to generate a feature mesh as a unified intermediate representation. Its surface provides a geometric scaffold, while spatially aligned learned features encode face-separation cues for topology recovery. Dual decoder branches generate the geometry and face-separation features; a geometry- and feature-guided construction pipeline then fits parametric surfaces, recovers boundary curves and connectivity, and assembles an explicit B-rep using a CAD kernel. Recovering topology from mesh regions avoids predefined architectural face-count limits, allowing face count to scale with shape complexity. On the standard DeepCAD benchmark, UniBRep produces valid B-reps for 80.49\% of inputs and reduces face Chamfer distance from 0.1096 to 0.0345 relative to CADDreamer. In a matched comparison, UniBRep also outperforms the HoLa public demo across all reported metrics. Further evaluations demonstrate scalability to high-complexity shapes beyond the standard 30-face range, generalization to objects outside the CAD training distribution, and qualitative transfer to real photographs.

AI.tldr: UniBRep：以预训练图像到3D模型生成特征网格作为统一中间表示，几何优先地重建B-rep，在DeepCAD基准上有效率达80.49%，面Chamfer距离从0.1096降至0.0345。
AI.motivation: 单图条件生成B-rep需同时保证几何保真、拓扑有效及复杂形状支持；现有方法受预设面数上限约束，难以随形状复杂度扩展。
AI.method: 适配预训练图像到3D模型生成特征网格：表面提供几何支架，空间对齐的学习特征编码面分离线索以恢复拓扑；双解码分支分别生成几何与面分离特征；几何与特征引导的构建管线拟合参数曲面、恢复边界曲线与连通性，并用CAD内核组装显式B-rep。
AI.result: DeepCAD基准上80.49%输入生成有效B-rep，面Chamfer距离由0.1096降至0.0345（相对CADDreamer）；匹配比较中所有报告指标优于HoLa公开演示；可扩展至超30面高复杂度形状，泛化至CAD训练分布外物体，并定性迁移到真实照片。
AI.conclusion: 从网格区域恢复拓扑规避了预定义面数限制，使面数随形状复杂度伸缩，验证了几何优先特征网格中间表示在单图B-rep重建中的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Language Model Activations Inhabit Privileged Error-Correcting Basins
summary: Language models exhibit remarkable robustness, continuing to produce coherent text even when their activations are perturbed by interventions like linear steering. We hypothesize that this robustness is a result of passive dynamics, i.e., constraining mechanisms in the forward pass that funnel activations toward "good" regions that produce coherent outputs. To investigate these hypothesized error-correcting mechanisms, we probe the geometry of language model activation space by observing the action of model layers on low-dimensional curves. In doing so, we discover that model activations occur within a cluster of distinct attracting basins, which differentiate natural activations geometrically from distributionally similar synthetic activations. Applying this lens to language model steering, we observe feature-specific basins along semantic steering directions, and find that steering moves activations between these basins. To demonstrate the active role of this geometry in neural computation, we show that adaptively modulating steering strength to transport activations across basins improves inter-language steering, significantly increasing the probability of sampling tokens from the target language compared to fixed-strength steering. Our findings establish analysis of activation space geometry as a promising approach to interpreting and controlling language models.

AI.tldr: 语言模型的鲁棒性源于前向传播中被动的纠错动力学：激活空间存在多个吸引盆，引导激活趋向产生连贯输出的"良好"区域；利用该几何结构自适应调节引导强度可提升跨语言引导效果。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在激活被线性引导等干预扰动时仍能保持连贯输出，其鲁棒性来源尚不明确。作者假设这种鲁棒性来自前向传播中的被动动力学——存在某种约束机制将激活推向能产生连贯输出的"良好"区域，并希望探究这些误差纠正机制。
AI.method: 通过观测模型各层对低维曲线的作用，探测语言模型激活空间的几何结构；分析激活是否落入不同的吸引盆，并区分自然激活与分布相似的合成激活。进一步将该视角应用于语义引导方向，考察特征特定的吸引盆及引导如何在盆间移动激活；最后通过自适应调制引导强度，将激活跨盆传输以改进跨语言引导。
AI.result: 发现模型激活位于一组不同的吸引盆中，这些盆在几何上将自然激活与分布相似的合成激活区分开来；语义引导方向上存在特征特定的吸引盆，引导操作会在这些盆之间移动激活；自适应调制引导强度以跨盆传输激活，相比固定强度引导显著提高了采样到目标语言词元的概率。
AI.conclusion: 激活空间几何分析是一种有前景的语言模型解释与控制方法，揭示了被动力学在模型鲁棒性中的主动作用，并为改进引导策略提供了依据。

title: Robust blind unmixing: A geometric approach to overcoming basis variation
summary: Signal separation problems are common in science. A prominent example of this occurs during the use of diffraction or spectroscopy to identify the individual components of a mixture by measuring it. In the simplest case, the measured signal is a linear combination of basis patterns corresponding to the constituent parts. The unmixing problem is to infer all or some of these basis patterns and abundances of components from measurements of distinct mixtures. One of the core challenges of this task is the variation of the basis from mixture to mixture due to noise and the exact physics of the measurement process. This is usually addressed with tailored model-based and parametric methods that are then limited in use to specific application domains by the nature of the assumptions made. We propose a novel geometric approach to unmixing problems which views the generation of data during measurement through a metric space lens, thereby shifting the focus from parametrised models to a general relationship between basis transformations and the corresponding geometry. We take advantage of the optimal transport distances to capture commonly occurring basis variations, and use minimisation of in-class variance of candidate solutions to drive the optimisation. We pay special attention to the one-dimensional case due to its practical importance and availability of efficient distance and transport map routines. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on a range of unmixing tasks using random Gaussian mixture models, simulated powder X-ray diffraction, and laboratory hyperspectral imaging datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于度量空间与最优传输距离的几何式信号解混方法，通过最小化候选解类内方差来优化，摆脱传统参数化模型对特定领域的依赖，并在高斯混合、模拟粉末X射线衍射及实验室高光谱成像任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 信号分离（解混）在科学中普遍存在，如衍射或光谱识别混合物组分。最简情形下测量信号是基模式的线性组合，核心挑战在于基会因噪声与测量物理过程而在不同混合物间发生变化。传统方法依赖定制的基于模型与参数化的手段，其假设限制了适用范围，仅能用于特定应用领域，因此需要一种更通用的、摆脱参数化模型的解混思路。
AI.method: 提出一种新的几何式解混方法，从度量空间视角看待测量数据生成过程，将关注点从参数化模型转向基变换与其对应几何之间的通用关系。利用最优传输距离（optimal transport）刻画常见出现的基变化，并以最小化候选解的类内方差来驱动优化。特别关注一维情形，因其具有实际重要性且已有高效的传输距离与传输映射算法。
AI.result: 在多种解混任务上验证了方法的有效性，包括随机高斯混合模型、模拟粉末X射线衍射数据以及实验室高光谱成像数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以度量空间和最优传输为核心，提供了一种不依赖特定参数化假设的通用解混框架，在传统方法受限的多个场景下展示了适用性与有效性，尤其适合一维情形。

title: Exploiting Hierarchical Controller Structure in Contextual Parameter Learning for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Hierarchical control architectures are widely used to decompose complex control problems into interacting control levels and are particularly important in robotics, where planning, whole-body motion, and lower-level control must be coordinated across different levels of abstraction and time scales. Their overall closed-loop performance, however, depends strongly on parameters distributed across the hierarchy, such that tuning controllers on different levels independently may neglect relevant cross-layer interactions. We propose a contextual Bayesian optimization framework for joint parameter learning in hierarchical control systems. Rather than modeling closed-loop performance only as a scalar black-box function, we retain separate observations of task performance, realization quality, and control effort. A correlated multi-output Gaussian process models these performance components, while their known aggregation into the overall closed-loop objective is evaluated analytically. The formulation exploits three complementary consequences of hierarchical control: informative performance quantities exposed by the hierarchy, coupling between parameters of different controller levels, and variations of these relations with operating conditions. We evaluate the approach for humanoid loco-manipulation, jointly tuning a centroidal predictive controller and a whole-body controller for physical box pushing under varying box mass. The proposed method achieves the lowest mean empirical regret during both training and adaptation among the considered baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文贝叶斯优化框架，针对分层控制系统的参数联合学习，利用多输出高斯过程建模分层暴露的性能分量并解析聚合，在人形机器人推箱任务中取得最低经验遗憾。
AI.motivation: 分层控制架构广泛用于分解复杂控制问题，但其整体闭环性能高度依赖分布在各层的参数，逐层独立调参会忽略跨层交互。因此需要一种能够联合学习跨层参数、并考虑工况变化的方法。
AI.method: 提出上下文贝叶斯优化（contextual Bayesian optimization）框架。不将闭环性能仅视为标量黑箱函数，而是保留任务性能、实现质量与控制代价三部分的独立观测；用相关多输出高斯过程建模这些性能分量，并对其已知的聚合关系进行解析评估。方法利用分层控制的三个互补特性：分层暴露的信息性性能量、不同控制层参数间的耦合、以及这些关系随工况的变化。
AI.result: 在人形机器人locomanipulation任务上评估，联合调节质心预测控制器与全身控制器，在变化的箱体质量下进行物理推箱。所提方法在训练与自适应阶段的平均经验遗憾均为所比较基线中最低。
AI.conclusion: 利用分层结构暴露的中间性能信息与跨层参数耦合，进行上下文感知的联合参数学习，可有效提升分层控制系统的闭环性能与适应能力。

title: Scaling 3D Visual Grounding in Abdominal CT
summary: Visual grounding models can enhance radiology workflows by linking report findings to image regions. This is particularly valuable for 3D CT, where findings often occupy a tiny fraction of the volume. Training 3D grounding models requires large sets of paired phrases and regions, and building such datasets is expensive, requiring radiologists to annotate images by hand. We posit that this supervision is already created implicitly during routine reporting, as radiologists frequently place 2D annotations (e.g., distance measurement, arrows) on key images to make measurements and to support report interpretation. We introduce an automated pipeline that converts these routine clinical annotations into large-scale phrase-region supervision for 3D visual grounding. The pipeline links each annotation to the corresponding finding in the report through metadata matching, then uses a promptable 3D segmentation model to convert the 2D annotation into a volumetric mask. This produces phrase-mask-volume datasets without requiring additional radiologist annotation. Applied to a single institution's clinical picture archiving and communication system (PACS), our approach generated 105K phrase-mask-volume triplets from 59K abdominal CT exams. We also introduce two abdominal CT grounding benchmarks, LocusBench-Onc and LocusBench-ED, which comprise 240 oncology and 260 emergency-department radiologist-reviewed phrase-mask-volume triplets, respectively, with the latter spanning 13 distinct categories such as appendicitis, hematoma, and hernia. We further introduce LocusCT, a 3D visual grounding model trained on this dataset, which achieves hit rates of 0.725 on LocusBench-Onc and 0.773 on LocusBench-ED, substantially outperforming comparator models. These results show that routine PACS annotations are a scalable, previously unused source of supervision for 3D visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出自动化流水线，将放射科日常PACS中的2D标注转化为大规模短语-区域监督，用于3D CT视觉定位，生成105K三元组并训练出LocusCT模型。
AI.motivation: 3D CT视觉定位对影像工作流有价值，但训练需大量短语-区域配对数据，人工标注成本高昂。作者认为放射科医生在日常报告中的2D标注（如测距、箭头）已隐式提供了这种监督信号。
AI.method: 构建自动化流水线：通过元数据匹配将2D标注与报告中的发现关联，再用可提示3D分割模型将2D标注转为体积掩膜，无需额外放射科标注，生成短语-掩膜-体积数据集；并训练3D视觉定位模型LocusCT。
AI.result: 在单机构PACS上从59K腹部CT检查生成105K短语-掩膜-体积三元组；构建LocusBench-Onc（240例肿瘤）与LocusBench-ED（260例急诊，覆盖13类）基准；LocusCT命中率达0.725和0.773，显著优于对比模型。
AI.conclusion: 日常PACS标注是3D视觉定位可扩展且此前未被利用的监督来源。

title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Design Their Own Evaluations?
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration. Human experts reduce this cost by selecting benchmark subsets or designing compact suites. We ask whether AI agents can automate this design process and introduce EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research. Given target materials, development references, candidate APIs, and fixed time and API budgets, an agent called the researcher selects or synthesizes tasks, implements graders, and revises them in pilot tests before freezing an executable evaluator for coding, co-work, and reasoning. We study 9 researchers and 13 candidate models and compare each frozen evaluator with 14 target benchmarks on score concordance and pairwise agreement. The best evaluators order about 75\% of candidate pairs as the targets do, below the 91\% ceiling set by disagreements among the targets. No researcher leads on every metric, and the best evaluator on development targets is not the best on sealed targets hidden from the researcher. A human-designed sample of public tasks remains a strong baseline, and the evaluator with the lowest recorded execution cost attains the highest pairwise agreement. Agents repair tasks and graders through pilot feedback, yet their evaluators can still truncate answers, exhaust the evaluation budget, or let a few questions dominate a domain score.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EvalResearchBench（ERB），用于评估AI智能体自主设计评测方案（自动选/造任务、写并迭代评分器）的能力；在编码、协作、推理三类场景中研究9个"研究者"智能体与13个候选模型，并与14个目标基准比对一致性。最佳评测器对候选配对排序与目标基准一致率约75%，低于目标基准间分歧设定的91%上限；无单一智能体在所有指标领先，开发目标上的最佳评测器在密封目标上并非最佳；人工设计的公开任务样本仍是强基线，执行成本最低的评测器反而获得最高成对一致性。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进依赖评测反馈评估进展并指导后续研究，但反复运行复杂基准成本高昂、拖慢迭代。人类专家通过选取基准子集或设计紧凑套件来降低成本，本文追问AI智能体能否自动化这一评测设计过程。
AI.method: 提出ERB基准：给定目标材料、开发参考、候选API以及固定的时间与API预算，名为"researcher"的智能体需选择或合成任务、实现评分器，并在试点测试中迭代修订，最终冻结出针对编码、协作、推理三类场景的可执行评测器。研究9类研究者与13个候选模型，将每个冻结评测器与14个目标基准在分数一致性与成对一致性上进行比对。
AI.result: 最佳评测器对约75%的候选配对给出的排序与目标基准一致，但仍低于目标基准间分歧所设定的91%上限。没有任何研究者智能体在全部指标上领先；在开发目标上表现最好的评测器，在隐藏的密封目标上并非最佳。人工设计的公开任务样本仍构成强基线，而记录执行成本最低的评测器获得了最高的成对一致性。智能体可通过试点反馈修复任务与评分器，但其评测器仍可能出现截断回答、耗尽评测预算或让少数题目主导某一领域得分等问题。
AI.conclusion: 智能体已能初步自动化评测研究流程并逼近（但未达到）目标基准的一致性上限，然而缺乏全面领先者、开发与密封目标表现不一致、成本与质量关系反常，且仍存在截断、预算耗尽与题目权重失衡等系统性缺陷，说明自主评测设计尚不成熟。

title: Beyond Masked Sparsity: SNACK Enables Truly Sparse Neural Networks on GPU
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/JafarBadour/Snack-SNN
summary: Deep neural networks continue to grow in parameter count, driving up training and inference cost on GPUs. Sparse neural networks and Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) promise to reduce these costs, but most implementations rely on binary masks over dense tensors and recover little of the theoretical compute, memory, or energy savings. We propose SNACK, a truly sparse GPU layer that stores and computes only non-zero connections. SNACK exposes a simple PyTorch API for restructuring connections and backpropagating gradients entirely in the sparse paradigm, and ships SNACK-COO, a custom COO-format SpMM CUDA kernel with a batch-to-Streaming-Multiprocessor mapping tuned for the small-batch, high-sparsity regime typical of large-model training and single-stream inference. At the kernel level, SNACK is up to 7x faster than the masked dense baseline (Dense+Mask) and competitive with cuSPARSE, Sputnik, and FlashSparse at 95% sparsity. At 90% sparsity, a single SNACK layer accelerates training by 8x and 3.7x, and inference by 4x and 2x, over Dense+Mask and fully dense layers, respectively, while using 72% less memory than dense and substantially less energy. End-to-end, SNACK reduces GPT-2 peak training memory by up to 40% and graph-style inference latency by 4.8x over Dense+Mask at 99% sparsity.

AI.tldr: 提出SNACK——一种真正稀疏的GPU层，仅存储和计算非零连接，配套自定义COO格式SpMM CUDA内核，在训练与推理中实现显著加速、显存与能耗降低。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络参数量不断增长，推高GPU训练与推理成本。稀疏神经网络与动态稀疏训练（DST）虽有望降低成本，但多数实现依赖稠密张量上的二值掩码，难以回收理论上的计算、内存与能耗收益。
AI.method: 提出SNACK：仅在稀疏范式下存储和计算非零连接，并提供简洁的PyTorch API用于重构连接与反向传播梯度；同时给出SNACK-COO，一种自定义COO格式的SpMM CUDA内核，采用batch到流多处理器（SM）的映射，针对大模型训练和单流推理典型的小批量、高稀疏场景进行调优。
AI.result: 内核层面，95%稀疏度下SNACK比掩码稠密基线（Dense+Mask）快至多7倍，与cuSPARSE、Sputnik、FlashSparse相当；90%稀疏度下，单层训练比Dense+Mask和全稠密层分别加速8倍与3.7倍，推理加速4倍与2倍，内存比稠密少72%且能耗显著更低。端到端上，99%稀疏度下将GPT-2峰值训练内存最多降低40%，图式推理延迟较Dense+Mask降低4.8倍。
AI.conclusion: SNACK通过真正的稀疏存储与计算及面向小批量高稀疏场景的定制CUDA内核，切实兑现了稀疏网络在计算、内存与能耗上的理论收益，在训练和推理端到端场景中均有显著效果。

title: An End-to-End Framework for Modelling Pneumatic Soft Robots Based on Differentiable Finite Element Methods
comment: Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Soft robots present significant modelling challenges due to their non-linearity, complex dynamics and potentially intricate geometries. These difficulties in accurate system identification and dynamics modelling limit their applications in precise robotics tasks. Prior modelling approaches typically suffer from trade-offs in accuracy, computational efficiency, or speed. The differentiable finite element method (FEM) offers a promising balance between these desiderata for soft robot modelling, and enables the use of gradients for efficient calibration and trajectory optimisation. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end differentiable FEM-based framework designed to streamline modelling and system identification for pneumatic soft robots, enabling the generation of reliable models for downstream tasks. The framework automates the conversion of computer-aided designs into voxelised tetrahedral viscoelastic FEM meshes that accurately represent the robot's geometry and actuation mechanism. By integrating easily acquired point cloud data with differentiable FEM, the framework achieves precise identification of material and dynamic actuation parameters using a minimal experimental setup. Additionally, the differentiable nature of the model facilitates trajectory optimisation by leveraging gradients from robot dynamics and contact interactions. We validate the framework by modelling a complex bellow-shaped pneumatic soft robot and demonstrate its efficacy in real-world motion planning tasks. Experimental results indicate high modelling accuracy, with a maximum positional error of less than 3 mm, and successful application in tasks such as path following and grasping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端可微分有限元（FEM）框架，用于气动软体机器人的建模与系统辨识，可自动将CAD转换为体素化四面体黏弹性网格，结合点云数据辨识材料与驱动参数，并支持轨迹优化。在波纹管状气动软体机器人上验证，最大位置误差小于3 mm，成功完成路径跟踪与抓取任务。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人存在非线性、复杂动力学与复杂几何，导致系统辨识与动力学建模困难，限制其在精密任务中的应用；既有方法在精度、计算效率与速度之间存在权衡，难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建端到端可微分FEM框架：自动把CAD设计转换为体素化四面体黏弹性FEM网格，以准确表征几何与驱动机制；将易获取的点云数据与可微分FEM结合，用极小实验装置辨识材料参数与动态驱动参数；借助机器人动力学与接触交互的梯度进行轨迹优化。
AI.result: 在复杂波纹管状气动软体机器人上验证，建模精度高，最大位置误差小于3 mm；在真实运动规划任务中表现有效，成功完成路径跟踪与抓取。
AI.conclusion: 该可微分FEM框架在软体机器人建模精度、系统辨识效率与下游任务（运动规划、控制）之间取得良好平衡，可为气动软体机器人提供可靠模型，具备实际应用潜力。

title: Where Does the Semantic Gain Come From? A Reproduction and Extension of Semantic Knowledge-driven Contrastive Learning for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Semantic Knowledge-driven Contrastive Learning (SKCL) uses a language model to decide which classes are related, and pulls each image towards the prototypes of its semantic neighbours. On CIFAR-100-LT (beta = 100) it reports 54.02% top-1 accuracy, 2.01 points above Balanced Contrastive Learning (BCL), the method it builds on. The code and the class descriptions are not public. I reimplement SKCL, BCL and ConCutMix in one framework, check it against the public baseline code, and run every configuration with three seeds. The two baselines reproduce within 1.5 points, but SKCL built on BCL, as the paper describes it, ends up 0.56 points below BCL. To find out why, I add SKCL to the authors' own ConCutMix code. Trained for the paper's 300 epochs, it reaches 53.69, only 0.33 below the published number. At the same budget, however, the semantic graph adds just 0.23 points over ConCutMix, while training ConCutMix for 100 more epochs adds 1.04. Together with ConCutMix's published lead over BCL (1.15), this explains the claimed gain. A BCL model that never sees the graph already shares 41.2% of the graph's top-2 neighbours with its own most-confused classes (2.0% by chance), which shows why the graph adds so little on these benchmarks. I also test several changes to SKCL. Combining it with the CutMix branch improves it by 1.06 points, and an adaptive version of the graph improves it slightly (+0.34 and +0.28 in two codebases), although these gains are within seed noise.

AI.tldr: 该文对SKCL进行复现与实证检验，发现其相对BCL的增益主要来自骨干方法（ConCutMix）与训练轮数差异，语义图本身贡献很小。
AI.motivation: SKCL报告在CIFAR-100-LT上比BCL高2.01个点，但代码与类描述未公开，且增益来源不明，因此需要独立复现以验证其真实性与成因。
AI.method: 在同一框架内复现SKCL、BCL与ConCutMix，与公开基线代码对齐，每种配置运行三个随机种子；将SKCL移植到作者自己的ConCutMix代码中，并控制训练轮数（300与400轮）做消融；测量BCL模型的混淆类与语义图Top-2邻居的重合率；并测试CutMix分支结合与自适应语义图等改进。
AI.result: 两个基线复现误差在1.5点内，但按论文描述构建的SKCL在BCL上反而低0.56点；在ConCutMix代码中训练300轮达53.69，仅比公布值低0.33；相同预算下语义图仅带来0.23点提升，而多训练100轮带来1.04点；BCL模型与语义图Top-2邻居重合率达41.2%（随机为2.0%）；结合CutMix分支提升1.06点，自适应图分别提升0.34与0.28点，但均在种子噪声范围内。
AI.conclusion: SKCL所声称的增益可由ConCutMix本身的领先（1.15点）与更长训练轮数解释，语义知识图的边际贡献有限，原因在于BCL模型自身已隐含与语义图高度重合的类间结构；改进方案收益不稳健。

title: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
summary: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization Test: Visualization of Rotations (Revised PSVT:R). We improvised the Revised PSVT:R by superimposing additional graphical and contextual features to evaluate how different Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning strategies influence model performance. The results indicate that structured CoT reasoning improves the spatial reasoning performance of the base GPT-5.6 model in both datasets (PSVT:R and PSVT:R with coordinate system). We used three CoT approaches - (1) Structured CoT, (2) few-shot Structured CoT, and Structured CoT with Self-optimized Prompt. The three CoT approaches evaluated in this study showed no significant performance difference. Results showed that combining structured CoT reasoning with relevant contextual information leads to considerable improvements in VLM performance on 3D rotation tasks, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI for more effective spatial reasoning. However, when contextual information is removed, structured CoT reasoning alone provides limited improvement, and the models continue to exhibit notable difficulties in understanding spatial transformations. These findings suggest that effective spatial reasoning in VLMs relies on the integration of visual, textual, and reasoning-based information in future agentic AI systems for spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本研究以Revised PSVT:R为基础构造旋转图任务，考察GPT-5.6等生成式Agentic AI模型的3D空间旋转理解能力，并比较三种Chain-of-Thought策略的影响。结果显示：结构化CoT在含坐标/上下文信息的数据集上显著提升表现，但若移除上下文，单靠结构化CoT改善有限；三种CoT策略之间差异不显著。
AI.motivation: 具备语言与视觉能力的人工智能在空间推理上仍存在局限，尤其是对3D物体旋转的理解。作者希望探究先进生成式AI（含Agentic AI）的空间智能水平，并厘清CoT推理策略与上下文信息如何影响其在空间旋转任务上的表现，从而为未来空间智能系统设计提供依据。
AI.method: 以修订版普渡空间可视化测试（Revised PSVT:R）为任务框架，训练并评估生成式Agentic AI模型GPT-5.6的空间旋转理解能力。对PSVT:R进行改造：叠加额外图形与上下文特征，构建含坐标系的增强数据集（PSVT:R with coordinate system）。比较三种CoT推理策略：(1) 结构化CoT；(2) 少样本结构化CoT；(3) 带自优化提示（Self-optimized Prompt）的结构化CoT；并在基础模型与不同数据集上做对照评估。
AI.result: 结构化CoT推理在PSVT:R与含坐标系数据集上均提升了基础GPT-5.6模型的空间推理表现；将结构化CoT与相关上下文信息结合，可显著改善视觉语言模型（VLM）在3D旋转任务上的性能。三种CoT策略之间未表现出显著性能差异。移除上下文信息后，仅依靠结构化CoT带来的提升有限，模型在理解空间变换方面仍存在明显困难。
AI.conclusion: 有效的VLM空间推理依赖于视觉、文本与推理信息的整合，而非单一推理策略；Agentic AI在3D旋转等空间任务上具有潜力，但需借助上下文信息才能发挥结构化CoT的优势。研究提示未来空间智能Agentic AI系统应融合多模态信息与推理机制。

title: Progressive Multi-Ancestor Bit-Depth Distillation
summary: Model compression strategies are widely employed to reduce memory footprint and network complexity, particularly for devices with constrained computational, memory, and energy resources. Prior works that rely on simultaneous conversion from floating-point high-precision (FP32) to integer low-precision (INT4) representations and distillation into smaller models suffer from unstable training and drastic degradation of prediction performance. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework, known as \textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}ncestor \textbf{B}it-depth \textbf{D}istillation (PMABD), that progressively compresses the network while transferring knowledge through a growing pool of higher-precision ancestor teachers. PMABD generates a sequence of intermediate teachers that each learn from all higher-precision ancestors and jointly supervise the final target student. This multi-ancestor, multi-stage design stabilizes ultra-low-bit quantization by lowering quantization noise profiles across training and ensuring stable quantization. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 with ResNet-20/32/18, and Tiny-ImageNet with MobileNetV2 show that PMABD outperforms state-of-the-art compression frameworks, results in 1.06$\%$ increase in performance of W2A2 (ResNet-18/CIFAR-100) student model. We show that a saturation-based stopping criterion contributes to improve the performance of our final student.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架PMABD，通过渐进式多祖先比特深度蒸馏，稳定超低比特量化训练，性能优于现有压缩框架。
AI.motivation: 现有方法同时进行FP32到INT4转换与蒸馏，导致训练不稳定和预测性能严重下降。
AI.method: PMABD生成一系列中间教师，每个教师学习所有更高精度祖先并共同监督最终学生，采用多祖先、多阶段设计降低量化噪声，并使用基于饱和的停止准则。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100（ResNet-20/32/18）和Tiny-ImageNet（MobileNetV2）上，PMABD优于最先进压缩框架，W2A2（ResNet-18/CIFAR-100）学生模型性能提升1.06%。
AI.conclusion: PMABD有效稳定超低比特量化并提升压缩模型性能，饱和停止准则有助于提升最终学生性能。

title: PerturBot: Breaking Shortcut Priors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Perturbative Training
summary: A vision--language--action (VLA) policy can complete complex tasks while ignoring the evidence that should determine its actions. An object held near the wrist camera can displace the instructed target. Language and action show the same pattern: a familiar noun can trigger the operation it was paired with in training even after the verb changes, and a gripper that closed on nothing may lift anyway. We call these dependencies modality shortcuts: regularities in successful demonstrations make visual, lexical, or motor cues sufficient to predict expert actions without the task evidence needed for the underlying decision. More demonstrations of the same kind can raise task success while leaving these shortcuts intact. We propose Perturbot which makes task-relevant evidence easier to use and shortcuts insufficient on their own: it applies task-preserving wrist-view perturbations, enriches instructions with decision-relevant captions, and adds random and failed trajectory segments relabeled with the behavior they contain. It complements scaling by changing what is scaled, and leaves inference unchanged. Moreover, we propose GroundingFscore, an offline score that diagnoses how severely a policy relies on modality shortcuts. Task success rate shows whether a policy improves, while GroundingFscore reveals whether the policy scales healthily, relying on task evidence rather than shortcuts. Together, Perturbot and GroundingFscore provide a training-and-evaluation framework for disentangling VLA decisions from shortcut priors while preserving responsiveness to task-relevant evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模态捷径"概念，并给出Perturbot训练框架与GroundingFscore评估指标，以解耦VLA策略决策与捷径先验。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在完成复杂任务时可能忽略本应决定其动作的证据：腕部相机附近的物体可挤占指令目标；语言与动作也呈现同类模式——熟悉名词即使动词改变仍触发配对操作，夹爪未夹到物体却仍抬升。作者将这些依赖称为模态捷径：成功示范中的规律性使视觉、词汇或运动线索足以预测专家动作，而无需底层决策所需的任务证据。同类示范增多虽能提升任务成功率，却不会消除这些捷径。
AI.method: 提出Perturbot，使任务相关证据更易被利用、使捷径自身不足：施加任务保持的腕部视角扰动；用与决策相关的描述丰富指令；加入随机与失败轨迹片段并按其实际行为重新标注。该方法与规模化互补——改变"被规模化的内容"，且推理阶段不变。同时提出GroundingFscore，一种离线评分，用于诊断策略对模态捷径的依赖程度。
AI.result: 任务成功率反映策略是否提升；GroundingFscore则揭示策略是否"健康地"规模化——即依赖任务证据而非捷径。
AI.conclusion: Perturbot与GroundingFscore共同构成训练与评估框架，在保持对任务相关证据响应的同时，将VLA决策与捷径先验解耦。

title: From Sight to Foresight: Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Predicting future spatial states supports collision avoidance and timely decision-making in dynamic environments. However, existing vision-language models (VLMs) and benchmarks for spatial reasoning primarily focus on observed scenes, leaving predictive spatial reasoning beyond the observed interval underexplored. To this end, we introduce SpatialMind, a metric-scale VLM for spatial reasoning and future prediction. Its metric depth adapter anchors spatial reasoning to real-world scale, while its progressive state chain establishes current spatial states and observed dynamics as the foundation for future prediction. Given a video prefix, SpatialMind predicts distances, motion directions, and spatial relations in both observed and unseen future frames. For training and evaluation, we build a scalable data engine that grounds entity descriptions in metric geometry to generate question-answer pairs and state supervision. Using this engine, we construct the SpatialMind-30K dataset and the SpatialMind-2K benchmark, both covering driving and everyday egocentric scenes. The benchmark spans eight tasks across three levels: current-state understanding, observed-dynamics understanding, and future prediction. Experiments show that SpatialMind substantially outperforms both general and spatially specialized models on our benchmark while achieving competitive zero-shot performance on VSI-Bench, OSI-Bench, and VLM4D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialMind——一个度量尺度的视觉语言模型,用于空间推理与未来预测,并配套构建了SpatialMind-30K数据集与SpatialMind-2K基准。
AI.motivation: 预测未来空间状态对动态环境中的避障与及时决策至关重要,但现有VLM及空间推理基准主要聚焦已观测场景,观测区间之外的预测性空间推理仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: SpatialMind包含度量深度适配器(将空间推理锚定到真实世界尺度)和渐进式状态链(以当前空间状态与已观测动态作为未来预测基础)。给定视频前缀,模型预测已观测帧与未观测未来帧中的距离、运动方向及空间关系。同时构建可扩展数据引擎,将实体描述基于度量几何生成问答对与状态监督,据此构造SpatialMind-30K数据集与SpatialMind-2K基准,覆盖驾驶与日常第一人称场景。
AI.result: 基准涵盖三个层次共八项任务:当前状态理解、已观测动态理解与未来预测。实验表明SpatialMind在本基准上显著优于通用及空间专用模型,并在VSI-Bench、OSI-Bench、VLM4D上取得有竞争力的零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: SpatialMind通过度量深度适配与渐进式状态链,将空间推理拓展至未观测未来帧,并在多项基准上验证了其有效性,为预测性空间推理提供了模型、数据与评测的一体化方案。

title: MemLeak: Cross-User Semantic Leakage in Multi-Tenant AI Agent Memory
summary: Personal AI agents in enterprise multi-tenant deployments share a common vector store for long-term memory. Shared embedding spaces create a surface for cross-user memory leakage: a user's query can retrieve semantically adjacent memories belonging to another user through ordinary cosine-similarity retrieval, without any exploit. We formalize this as cross-user admissibility failure and evaluate it across six experiments, plus follow-up ablations, under both sparse (TF-IDF) and production-faithful (MiniLM-L6-v2) retrieval. Non-adversarial, incidental leakage reaches 70--100\% under pooled {same-team} retrieval; adversarially crafted memories achieve 90--100\% top-$k$ placement, exceeding weaker keyword-based attacker baselines, with score lifts of $+0.416$ to $+0.511$ under production-faithful dense retrieval (Config B); and end-to-end response contamination reaches 5.00/5 under a production retrieval path and 4.67/5 with Claude Sonnet~4.5, with contaminated responses often scoring as helpful or more helpful than clean ones, a gap validated against human judgment. Among three architectural mitigations, only hard post-retrieval ownership gating consistently restores the clean baseline (1.00/5) across {two generation models, at a measured latency overhead of roughly 1.4~ms per query.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了企业多租户个人AI代理共享向量存储中的"跨用户可采纳性失效"问题：在无恶意攻击的普通余弦相似度检索下，用户查询即可检索到其他用户的语义相近记忆，泄漏率达70–100%；对抗性构造记忆可获90–100%的top-k命中，端到端响应污染在真实检索路径下达5.00/5分。三种架构缓解措施中，仅检索后硬性所有权门控能稳定恢复干净基线（1.00/5），延迟开销约1.4ms/查询。
AI.motivation: 企业多租户部署中的个人AI代理通常共享同一向量存储以支持长期记忆。共享嵌入空间导致跨用户记忆泄漏面：普通余弦相似度检索即可让一个用户的查询召回另一用户的语义相邻记忆，无需任何漏洞利用。作者旨在形式化并系统评估这一非对抗性、附带性泄漏风险。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为"跨用户可采纳性失效"，设计六组实验加后续消融，在稀疏（TF-IDF）与生产级（MiniLM-L6-v2）两种检索配置下评估；涵盖非对抗附带泄漏、对抗性构造记忆的top-k放置，与基于关键词的攻击者基线对比；并测试三种架构缓解措施，以人判断验证响应质量差距。
AI.result: 非对抗附带泄漏在池化{同团队}检索下达70–100%；对抗性记忆实现90–100% top-k命中，超越关键词攻击者基线，生产级稠密检索（Config B）下分数提升+0.416至+0.511；端到端响应污染在生产检索路径下达5.00/5，使用Claude Sonnet 4.5时达4.67/5，且污染响应常被评比干净响应更有帮助，该差距经人判断验证。三种架构缓解中，仅检索后硬性所有权门控能在两种生成模型下稳定恢复干净基线（1.00/5），延迟开销约1.4ms/查询。
AI.conclusion: 共享向量存储的多租户AI代理存在系统性跨用户记忆泄漏，非对抗场景下即普遍发生且易被对抗放大，并显著污染生成响应。检索后硬性所有权门控是唯一在各生成模型上稳定有效的缓解方案，且延迟成本可忽略（约1.4ms/查询）。

title: Physics is the Best Teacher: Consistency Learning for Time-Invariant Operators of Chaotic Dynamics
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Accepted for the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Accelerating the prediction of long-term behavior in chaotic systems is crucial in scientific computing. However, existing methods rely on numerical solvers or autoregressive models that advance one small step at a time, which makes long horizons expensive. We instead view this problem as learning the system's time-invariant evolution operator, which jumps the state across a large time span in a single evaluation. To this end, we derive the consistency equations a time-invariant operator must satisfy, with differential and compositional objectives in physical time. These equations also connect the learned operator to the physics-prescribed instant dynamics, enabling physics embedding in consistency learning. Across five chaotic systems, we find that physics-distilled consistency makes both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics more accurate. The learned operator survives temporal extrapolation and requires one-tenth as many evaluations as autoregressive rollout, offering an efficient route to long-term simulation of chaotic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 将混沌系统长期预测视为学习时间不变的演化算子，通过一致性方程实现单次大步跳转，精度更优且评估次数降至自回归的十分之一。
AI.motivation: 混沌系统的长期行为预测在科学计算中至关重要，但现有数值求解器或自回归模型只能逐步推进小步长，导致长时程预测代价高昂。
AI.method: 学习系统的时间不变演化算子，使其在单次评估中跨越大时间跨度；推导该算子必须满足的一致性方程，包含物理时间下的微分目标与复合目标；这些方程将学习算子与物理给定的瞬时动力学相连接，从而在一致性学习中嵌入物理约束。
AI.result: 在五个混沌系统上，物理蒸馏一致性使短期轨迹与长期统计量均更准确；所学算子可经受时间外推，所需评估次数仅为自回归滚动的一成。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为混沌动力学的长期仿真提供了一条高效路径。

title: RoboIRS: Inference-Time Internal Representation Steering for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) often degrade under out-of-distribution task variations despite retaining partial task capability. To recover such capability, we propose RoboIRS, an inference-time internal representation steering method that uses successful and failed rollouts to train linear classifiers, select outcome-relevant intervention locations, and derive task-specific steering directions without updating policy parameters. On 15 simulation tasks with a frozen $π0.5$ policy, RoboIRS improves the average success rate from 44.4% to 66.2%, outperforming alternative inference-time intervention baselines while adding little inference time. We further validate RoboIRS on real-robot manipulation using the same $π0.5$ policy and demonstrate its applicability to a world-action model Cosmos Policy, where the average success rate improves from 35.4% to 55.4%. These results show that directly steering internal robot-policy representations can improve the performance of robot policies at inference time. Project website is available at https://rollingoat.github.io/roboirs/.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboIRS，一种基于内部表征引导的推理时干预方法，可在不更新策略参数的情况下恢复VLA/WAM在分布外任务中的能力。
AI.motivation: VLA与世界动作模型（WAM）在分布外任务变化下性能退化，但仍保留部分任务能力，亟需一种无需重训练即可恢复该能力的推理时方法。
AI.method: 利用成功与失败轨迹训练线性分类器，筛选与结果相关的干预位置，并推导任务特定的引导方向，在推理时对内部表征进行干预，不更新策略参数。
AI.result: 在15个仿真任务与冻结的π0.5策略上，平均成功率由44.4%提升至66.2%，优于其他推理时干预基线且推理时间开销极小；在真实机器人操作及Cosmos Policy上，成功率由35.4%提升至55.4%。
AI.conclusion: 直接引导机器人策略的内部表征可提升推理时的策略性能，验证了该方法在仿真与真实场景中的有效性。

title: Watermarks and Fingerprints as Soft Bindings for Content Provenance: An Open-Licence Benchmark for Images, Audio and Video
comment: 59 pages. Code, recorded results and manuscript source: https://github.com/Original-Pictures/soft-bindings-benchmark (v1.0)
summary: Content-provenance standards such as C2PA let a platform recover a stripped manifest through a soft binding: an invisible watermark read from the content, or a fingerprint looked up in a registry. We benchmarked both families under one protocol, restricted to openly available models whose licences we audited, on public media, with false-match rates calibrated on held-out negatives and source-level bootstrap intervals for performance estimates. For watermarking we evaluated 25 image, 7 audio and 7 video configurations from 12 methods on perceptual quality, robustness, false positives and cost; for fingerprinting, 35 methods on registries of up to 98,985 images, partial edits and adversarial attacks. PixelSeal gave the best balance for image and video watermarks and AudioSeal for audio, but the error-correcting detector of every TrustMark variant fired on 5.9 to 15.3% of unmarked images, so a verifier should test the expected payload. Among fingerprints, copy detectors trained on non-commercial data detected up to 75.5% of transformed images at a pair-level false-match rate of $10^{-7}$ and DINOv2, the best permissively licensed method, 65.0%; near-copies in a product catalogue dominated the false matches, and no detection improvement from geometric verification was observed under a matched calibration false-binding constraint in the evaluated image pipelines. On the same attacked copies the two families failed differently: the union of watermark and fingerprint successes covered 69% of image copies; fingerprints covered more audio queries, whereas expected-key watermark verification covered more video queries. Embedding a watermark moved the ISCC code of 62.0% of images past its match threshold, and platform-dependent colour conversion changed watermark bits between x86 and ARM hosts.

AI.tldr: 该论文在一个统一协议下对C2PA软绑定技术（水印与指纹）进行了大规模基准测试，涵盖25种图像/7种音频/7种视频水印配置与35种指纹方法，发现两类技术在图像、音频、视频场景中各有优劣，且存在误报与跨平台不稳定等关键问题。
AI.motivation: C2PA等内容溯源标准允许平台通过软绑定（水印或指纹）在清单被剥离后恢复来源信息，但缺乏对水印与指纹两大技术族在统一条件下的系统性对比，难以指导实际验证系统的设计选型。
AI.method: 在单一协议下基准测试两族方法：仅采用经许可审计的公开可用模型与公开媒体；假匹配率在留出负样本上校准，性能估计使用源级bootstrap区间。水印方面评估来自12种方法的25种图像、7种音频、7种视频配置，考察感知质量、鲁棒性、假阳性与开销；指纹方面评估35种方法，注册库规模最高达98,985张图像，并测试部分编辑与对抗攻击。
AI.result: 水印方面：PixelSeal在图像与视频中平衡最佳，AudioSeal适用于音频；但所有TrustMark变体的纠错检测器在5.9%–15.3%的未标记图像上误触发，故验证器应检验预期载荷。指纹方面：非商业数据训练的拷贝检测器在变换图像上检出率达75.5%（对级假匹配率10⁻⁷），许可最宽松的DINOv2为65.0%；产品目录中的近拷贝主导了误匹配，在所评估图像流程中几何验证未带来检测提升。攻击副本上两族失败模式不同：水印与指纹成功并集覆盖69%图像副本；指纹覆盖更多音频查询，而预期密钥水印验证覆盖更多视频查询。此外，嵌入水印使62.0%图像的ISCC码超过其匹配阈值，且平台相关的颜色转换导致水印比特在x86与ARM主机间发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 水印与指纹具有互补性，单一技术难以全面覆盖；实际验证系统需结合预期载荷检验以抑制水印误报，并注意ISCC码偏移与跨平台颜色转换带来的比特不稳定性，同时应针对媒体类型选择适配技术。

title: Asynchronous Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: LLM-based long-horizon agentic post-training is often bottlenecked by rollout generation: trajectories span many interaction turns, completion times vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers waiting for stragglers. Asynchronous reinforcement learning which has been adopted in LLM post-training addresses this inefficiency by consuming trajectories as they arrive, but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) offer a backpropagation-free alternative for LLM post-training, yet it relies on a larger number of rollouts and existing practices have remained largely synchronous. In this short-form paper, we introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and demonstrate it on Endless Terminals benchmark using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across three evaluation seeds, natural Async-1 matches synchronous ES, achieving 25.9\% versus 25.4\% held-out success. Controlled schedules that delay 10\% of each update cohort by four or eight policy updates reduce success by only 1.6 and 3.1 percentage points, respectively, without explicit off-policy correction. GRPO performs better overall, reaching 29.0\% held-out success, but importantly our results show that ES tolerates moderate policy staleness with limited degradation, opening possibilities for future improvement of ES-based post-training with asynchronous algorithms. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate the effectiveness of sync and async ES on a multi-turn terminal style agentic coding task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有界陈旧度的异步进化策略（ES），在Endless Terminals多轮终端编码任务上用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct验证：异步ES性能与同步ES相当，且对适度策略陈旧具有容忍性，为ES后训练的异步化提供依据。
AI.motivation: LLM长时程智能体后训练受限于rollout生成：轨迹跨多轮交互、完成时间差异大，同步更新屏障导致快worker等待慢worker。异步强化学习虽提升效率但引入策略滞后与离策略优化问题；ES作为无反向传播的替代方案需大量rollout，且现有实践基本为同步，效率受限。
AI.method: 提出有界陈旧度异步ES，并在Endless Terminals基准上以Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct进行验证。设置了自然异步（Async-1）以及受控调度：将每次更新队列中10%的轨迹延迟四个或八个策略更新，均不进行显式离策略校正，并与同步ES及GRPO对比。
AI.result: 三个评估种子下，自然Async-1与同步ES持平，保留集成功率为25.9%对25.4%；延迟10%轨迹四个和八个更新的受控调度仅分别下降1.6和3.1个百分点。GRPO整体更优，达29.0%的保留集成功率。
AI.conclusion: ES能够容忍中等程度的策略陈旧且性能退化有限，表明异步算法有望用于改进基于ES的后训练。作者称是首个在多轮终端风格智能体编码任务上验证同步与异步ES有效性工作。

title: SEER: Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Real-world time series are frequently driven by exogenous events and structural shifts, rendering conventional forecasting based solely on historical numerical observations insufficient. While language models can retrieve external news, standard retrieval-augmented approaches struggle with high noise, missing signals, and an inability to reason causally about event impacts. We propose SEER (Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval), a closed-loop framework that dynamically optimizes event conditioning for time series forecasting. SEER translates prediction errors into two decoupled feedback mechanisms: (i) a reflective retrieval memory that refines subsequent search queries and filters spurious noise, and (ii) a persistent causal knowledge base that distills transferable domain dynamics. SEER enforces strict chronological boundaries across both event retrieval and reflection, preventing look-ahead bias and data leakage. Across six volatile time-series benchmarks, SEER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art time series foundation models and language model baselines.

AI.tldr: SEER 是一个闭环自演化框架，将预测误差转化为两种解耦反馈机制（反思式检索记忆与持久因果知识库），动态优化事件条件化，在六个波动时间序列基准上超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现实时间序列常受外生事件与结构性变化驱动，仅依赖历史数值观测的传统预测方法不足。语言模型虽能检索外部新闻，但标准检索增强方法面临高噪声、信号缺失以及无法对事件影响进行因果推理的问题。
AI.method: 提出 SEER 框架：将预测误差转化为两种解耦反馈：(i) 反思式检索记忆，用于优化后续搜索查询并过滤虚假噪声；(ii) 持久因果知识库，用于蒸馏可迁移的领域动态。同时在事件检索与反思中强制严格时间顺序边界，防止前视偏差与数据泄漏。
AI.result: 在六个波动时间序列基准上，SEER 持续优于最先进的时间序列基础模型与语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: SEER 通过闭环自演化的事件推理与检索，有效提升事件驱动的时间序列预测能力，并保持严格无泄漏的时间一致性。

title: Test-Time Training as Residual Memory for Robot Policies
summary: Memory is essential for long-horizon robotic manipulation, where successful actions may depend on past events that are no longer recoverable from the current observation. As episodes grow longer, however, retaining the full history becomes increasingly costly, creating a fundamental scalability challenge for memory-augmented policies. Existing approaches address this challenge by either storing selected past observations in a bounded memory bank or compressing interaction history into a fixed-size parametric state through Test-Time Training (TTT). Yet these formulations do not explicitly distinguish between historical information that can already be recovered from the policy's current context and information that must persist beyond it. We introduce TTT-RM, which repurposes TTT as Residual Memory, using fast weights not to generically compress history but to complement a bounded memory bank by preserving task-relevant historical information that cannot be recovered from the policy's current context. Concretely, TTT-RM learns a history decoder that reconstructs historical representations from the current observation and retrieved memory. The resulting reconstruction residual captures what this context fails to explain and serves as the learning target for TTT. The TTT slow weights are optimized against this residual target so that online fast-weight updates learn to encode complementary historical information over time. The fast-weight state is then queried to produce a residual memory representation that conditions action generation. Extensive experiments on memory-intensive simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks show that TTT-RM consistently improves across multiple memory designs, outperforms diverse baselines, and supports sustained execution on a three-minute, eight-stage stowing task.

AI.tldr: 提出TTT-RM，将Test-Time Training改造为"残差记忆"，用快速权重编码当前上下文无法恢复的历史信息，以补充有界记忆库，在记忆密集型仿真与真实任务上持续提升表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作依赖历史信息，但保留完整历史代价高昂，存在可扩展性瓶颈。现有方法（有界记忆库、TTT压缩历史）未显式区分"当前上下文已可恢复的历史信息"与"必须跨上下文持久保留的信息"，导致记忆被冗余内容占用。
AI.method: TTT-RM将TTT重新定位为残差记忆：学习一个历史解码器，从当前观测与检索到的记忆中重建历史表示；重建残差即当前上下文无法解释的部分，作为TTT的学习目标。慢权重针对该残差目标优化，使在线快速权重更新逐步编码互补性历史信息；随后查询快速权重状态，生成残差记忆表示以条件化动作生成。
AI.result: 在记忆密集型仿真基准与真实世界任务上，TTT-RM在多种记忆设计下均取得一致性提升，优于多种基线，并支持在三分钟、八阶段的收纳任务中持续执行。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并只保留"当前上下文不可恢复"的历史信息，是可扩展记忆增强策略的有效原则；TTT-RM为长时程机器人操作提供了一种可插拔、可扩展的记忆机制。

title: Kepler4D: Controllable Future Video Generation via 4D Scene State Evolution
summary: Video world models aim to preserve scene structure and predict how dynamic objects evolve beyond visual observations. We present Kepler4D, a framework for future video generation through explicit 4D scene state evolution. Given a monocular video, Kepler4D constructs a shared 3D representation of background geometry, object motion histories, coarse spatial supports, and semantic context. Chain-of-Motion summarizes observed motion and uses a vision-language model to select structured speed and heading decisions and decide whether to bound object-center height from below. A deterministic rollout converts these decisions into future object trajectories for inspection and editing before synthesis. We render the evolving proxies into geometric controls for a pretrained video generator, separating coarse object motion from the synthesis of appearance and articulation. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate that Kepler4D enables controllable object motion and plausible future rollout while preserving scene consistency.

AI.tldr: Kepler4D 通过显式 4D 场景状态演化实现单目视频的未来生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型难以在超出视觉观测的情况下同时保持场景结构并预测动态物体的演化。作者希望以显式的 4D 场景状态建模来增强未来视频生成的可控性与一致性。
AI.method: 给定单目视频，构建包含背景几何、物体运动历史、粗略空间支撑与语义上下文的共享 3D 表示；提出 Chain-of-Motion，总结观测运动并借助视觉语言模型选择结构化的速度与朝向决策，同时判定是否对物体中心高度施加下界约束；通过确定性 rollout 将决策转为未来物体轨迹，供合成前检查与编辑；再将演化代理渲染为几何控制信号，驱动预训练视频生成器，从而将粗粒度物体运动与外观及关节化合成解耦。
AI.result: 在真实世界视频上的实验表明，Kepler4D 支持可控的物体运动与合理的未来推演，同时保持场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: 显式 4D 场景状态演化可有效衔接运动规划与视频合成，为可控未来视频生成提供可行框架。

title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable fast generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but their practical adoption remains limited by a persistent quality gap relative to comparably sized autoregressive (AR) models. We attribute this gap to a computation-difficulty mismatch: within a partially observed sequence, some unknown tokens are easy to predict, while others require substantially more computation. Existing DLMs nevertheless apply uniform computational depth to all unknown positions at each denoising step. We introduce ALoDLM, which replaces uniform computation with token-adaptive latent recurrence. At each denoising step, ALoDLM iteratively refines latent representations and allocates computation according to token difficulty. Tokens ready to commit are fed back as discrete context, while unresolved tokens retain and further refine their latent states through additional recurrent passes. To learn token prediction and computation allocation jointly, we formulate token-wise computation schedules as latent variables and derive a conditional negative evidence lower bound (NELBO). We train ALoDLM at 1.7B and 8B parameter scales. Across eleven benchmarks, ALoDLM outperforms all evaluated DLMs and the corresponding AR baselines in average benchmark score at both scales. ALoDLM also retains fast parallel decoding, yielding a strong quality-efficiency trade-off among evaluated autoregressive and diffusion models under optimized inference engines.

AI.tldr: ALoDLM 用「按 token 难度自适应的隐状态递归」取代扩散语言模型中的统一计算深度，通过条件 NELBO 联合学习 token 预测与计算分配，在 1.7B/8B 规模、11 个基准上平均分超过所有对比 DLM 与同规模 AR 基线，并保持并行解码的效率优势。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）虽能并行预测多个 token 实现快速生成，但与同规模自回归（AR）模型相比长期存在质量差距，限制了实际采用。作者将此归因于「计算—难度失配」：在部分观测序列中，不同未知 token 的预测难度差异很大，有的很容易，有的需要更多计算；而现有 DLM 在每个去噪步对所有未知位置施加相同的计算深度，造成算力错配。
AI.method: 提出 ALoDLM，以「token 自适应的隐状态递归」替代统一计算。每个去噪步中迭代精炼隐表示并按 token 难度分配计算：已可确定的 token 作为离散上下文回馈（commit），未解决的 token 保留隐状态并经额外递归轮次继续精炼。为联合学习 token 预测与计算分配，将 token 级的计算调度建模为隐变量，并推导条件负证据下界（conditional NELBO）作为训练目标。在 1.7B 与 8B 两个参数规模上训练。
AI.result: 在 11 个基准上，ALoDLM 在两个规模下的平均基准得分均优于所有被评测的 DLM 以及对应的 AR 基线；同时保留快速并行解码能力，在优化推理引擎下于所评测的自回归与扩散模型中取得较强的质量—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: token 自适应的潜在递归计算分配能有效缩小 DLM 相对 AR 的质量差距，并在不牺牲并行解码速度的前提下实现更优的质量—效率折中，说明「计算深度随难度变化」是提升扩散语言建模实用性的关键设计原则。

title: Sharp Convergence and Sample Complexity of Policy Mirror Descent for Average-Reward MDPs
summary: Policy mirror descent (PMD) has a mature finite-time theory in discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs), but less is known in the average-reward setting, a more natural objective for many control applications. We give a finite-time, finite-sample analysis of PMD in ergodic average-reward MDPs built around a single master recursion that governs convergence for any critic, without external regularization. Its specializations yield linear rates for exact, inexact-tabular, and linear function approximation (LFA) updates, with a superlinear regime for exact PMD. We complement these convergence results with end-to-end sample complexities of order $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ in both tabular ($|S||A|$-dependent) and LFA ($d$-dependent) settings. Our LFA sample complexity sharpens the prior best $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^5$ mixing dependence to $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3$, and matching information-theoretic lower bounds establish that the critic's $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ sample complexity is unimprovable in both settings.

AI.tldr: 本文对遍历式平均奖励MDP中的策略镜像下降(PMD)进行了有限时间、有限样本分析，围绕单一主递归统一刻画收敛性，得到线性收敛率与超线性收敛，并将LFA样本复杂度从t_mix^5改进至t_mix^3且证明其不可改进。
AI.motivation: PMD在折扣MDP中已有成熟的有限时间理论，但在平均奖励设定下理论尚不完善；而平均奖励目标对许多控制应用更为自然，因此需要建立该设定下PMD的有限时间、有限样本理论。
AI.method: 围绕一个支配任意critic收敛性的单一主递归(master recursion)构建分析框架，不引入外部正则化，并将该框架特化到精确、非精确表格及线性函数逼近(LFA)更新情形。
AI.result: 得到精确、非精确表格及LFA更新的线性收敛率，精确PMD具有超线性收敛区间；在表格(|S||A|相关)与LFA(d相关)两种设定下给出t_mix^3/ε^2量级的端到端样本复杂度；LFA样本复杂度将此前最优的t_mix^5混合依赖改进为t_mix^3；并给出匹配的信息论下界，证明critic的t_mix^3/ε^2样本复杂度在两种设定下均不可改进。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了平均奖励MDP中PMD有限时间理论的空白，所给样本复杂度达到最优，为平均奖励设定下策略优化提供了紧致的理论基础。

title: Emergent Underactuation in Fully Actuated Multirotors by Minimizing a Homogeneous Allocation Cost
summary: Full actuation is commonly valued for independent position and attitude tracking. This work establishes a complementary principle: when only a position trajectory is prescribed, minimizing a positively homogeneous allocation cost selects underactuated-like behavior on a fully actuated multirotor. This cost class includes norms and power laws, including standard minimum-norm pseudoinverse allocation. We use fiberwise infimization to transport the actuator-output cost to wrench space, yielding a homogeneous infimal allocation cost. Restriction to unit zero-moment forces defines a directional landscape whose minimizing directions are independent of force magnitude. We show that aligning any fixed minimizing direction with the required world-frame force minimizes instantaneous and integrated zero-moment allocation costs. The resulting body force remains in a fixed one-dimensional subspace without transverse components. We derive an exact optimality-gap decomposition quantifying the additional cost of every other attitude trajectory and characterizing the minimum-cost class. When a disturbance or prescribed-motion change modifies the required-force direction, a fully actuated platform can immediately generate the modified force using transverse authority and reorient toward the new minimum-cost family. A structurally underactuated platform must reorient before generating that force. Thus, homogeneous allocation-cost minimization explains why optimal nominal motion can be underactuated-like, while full actuation remains valuable for disturbance rejection and transient force generation.

AI.tldr: 当仅给定位置轨迹时，对正齐次分配代价进行最小化会使全驱动多旋翼呈现欠驱动式行为，本文用纤维化下确界与方向性代价景观刻画了该原理。
AI.motivation: 全驱动通常以独立位姿跟踪为价值取向，但尚不清楚在仅规定位置轨迹的任务下，最小化分配代价会产生何种偏好行为，以及全驱动相对欠驱动的真实优势何在。作者希望建立一个互补性原理，解释"最优标称运动可以是欠驱动式的、而全驱动仍对扰动抑制有价值"这一现象。
AI.method: 将正齐次执行器-输出代价通过纤维化（fiberwise）下确界映射到力旋量空间，得到齐次的下确界分配代价；限制到单位零力矩力上定义方向性代价景观；证明将任一固定最小化方向与所需世界系力对齐可最小化瞬时与积分零力矩分配代价；推导精确的最优性间隙分解。
AI.result: 最小化方向与力幅值无关；机体力保持在固定的一维子空间内、无横向分量；最优性间隙分解刻画了任何其他姿态轨迹的额外代价与最小代价类；扰动或运动变化改变所需力方向时，全驱动平台可立即用横向能力生成修改后的力并再定向，而结构欠驱动平台必须先再定向。
AI.conclusion: 齐次分配代价最小化解释了为何最优标称运动可呈欠驱动式，同时全驱动在扰动抑制与瞬态力生成上仍具价值。

title: Diagnosis-Conditioned Spatial Gating and Decoder-Level Supervised Contrastive Learning for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation models can produce fluent text while still containing finding-level inaccuracies. Diagnosis-driven methods improve generation by conditioning on predicted findings, but these predictions do not directly modify the visual patch features provided to the decoder, and global gating applies the same modulation across spatial locations. We introduce a Position-Aware Gate (PAG) that uses predicted finding representations to modulate visual patches spatially without region supervision. We also propose a Decoder-level Supervised Contrastive Loss (DSCL) that structures decoder representations using shared positive findings rather than instance identity. On MIMIC-CXR, PAG+DSCL improves clinical efficacy (CE) F1 from 0.484 to 0.502 over a matched global-gate reference, while PAG and DSCL individually reach 0.491 and 0.495. Without additional fine-tuning, the combined model achieves 0.226 CE F1 on IU X-Ray, compared with 0.211 reported by PromptMRG.

AI.tldr: 提出位置感知门控(PAG)与解码器级监督对比损失(DSCL)，通过预测发现表征空间调制视觉块特征并结构化解码器表征，提升放射报告生成的临床准确性。
AI.motivation: 诊断驱动方法虽改善了报告生成，但预测发现未直接修正解码器输入的视觉块特征，且全局门控对所有空间位置施加相同调制，缺乏空间特异性。
AI.method: PAG：利用预测发现表征在无区域监督下对视觉块进行空间调制；DSCL：在解码器层以共享阳性发现而非实例身份构建正样本的监督对比损失。二者结合。
AI.result: MIMIC-CXR上CE F1由0.484(匹配的全局门控基线)提升至0.502；PAG、DSCL单独分别达0.491、0.495。未经额外微调，在IU X-Ray上达0.226 CE F1，优于PromptMRG的0.211。
AI.conclusion: PAG与DSCL可互补地增强诊断驱动报告生成，在无区域标注条件下实现空间感知调制与表征结构化，并具备跨数据集泛化能力。

title: Fine-Tuning VLM for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Understanding 3D and 2D Rotations
summary: Spatial intelligence is a fundamental skill in multiple domains, such as Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), Medicine, Architecture, and Construction. Recent studies indicate that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still face limitations in spatial reasoning, which inhibits artificial intelligence (AI) from performing practical spatial tasks. Using multiple object-rotation datasets developed for training and evaluation, our experiments demonstrated promising improvements in both 2D and 3D rotation detection. Fine-tuned Google DeepMind-built Gemma-4 mixture-of-experts (MoE) models significantly outperformed fine-tuned Gemma-4 generalist models in predicting rotations defined by both their axes and angles. Fine-tuning also substantially improved angle estimation for 2D representation without requiring an explicit coordinate system. Furthermore, identifiable objects did not improve angle-detection accuracy; instead, objects with prominent linear features showed improved performance.

AI.tldr: 微调Gemma-4 MoE模型可显著提升视觉语言模型在2D与3D物体旋转检测上的表现，尤其在角度预测方面。
AI.motivation: 空间智能在STEM、医学、建筑等领域至关重要，但现有视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空间推理上仍存在局限，难以胜任实际空间任务。
AI.method: 使用多个面向训练与评估的物体旋转数据集，对Google DeepMind的Gemma-4混合专家（MoE）模型与通用模型进行微调，并对比其在2D与3D旋转检测中的表现。
AI.result: 微调后的MoE模型在预测由旋转轴和角度定义的旋转上显著优于通用模型；微调还大幅提升了无需显式坐标系的2D表示角度估计；物体是否可识别并不提升角度检测精度，而具有显著线性特征的物体表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 微调MoE架构能有效增强VLM的旋转与角度估计能力，物体线性特征而非语义可识别性是提升角度检测的关键因素。

title: Dynamic Harness Search: Building Multi-Agent Systems Per-Query via Prediction
summary: Agent harnesses specify the roles, instructions, tools, and communication structure used to solve a task, and the right harness depends on the query. Because the value of each design choice is observable only through execution, tailoring a harness to each query has required either executing alternatives at inference time or costly manual design. We introduce SHIFT, which moves execution out of the per-query search loop. A local LLM architect learns a policy over harness-building actions from search, and a value function that predicts, from measured executions, a utility balancing accuracy against execution cost. For each query, Monte Carlo tree search uses these predictions to construct a harness. Across 9,193 tasks in six benchmarks, from math to document and general-assistant tasks, with a Gemini 3.5 Flash executor, SHIFT attains the highest mean accuracy, about 80%, outperforming 17 baselines that span prompting, prompt optimization, and workflow search, and exceeding the strongest baseline by 7.2 percentage points. A cheaper mode of SHIFT also attains a higher mean accuracy than every baseline while using 32% fewer execution tokens than the strongest baseline. We further show that choosing structure, instructions, and tools jointly beats choosing only instructions or only tools by up to 9.1 percentage points, and that learned value selection identifies more accurate harnesses with lower execution cost from candidate pools.

AI.tldr: SHIFT 将执行从逐查询搜索循环中移出：用本地 LLM 架构师从搜索中学习 harness 构建动作策略与价值函数，再用 MCTS 为每个查询构建定制 harness，在 9,193 个任务上取得约 80% 的平均准确率，超过 17 个基线最优者 7.2 个百分点。
AI.motivation: Agent harness（角色、指令、工具、通信结构）的合适设计取决于具体查询，而各设计选择的价值只能通过执行观测。此前的逐查询定制需要在线执行多种备选方案或在推理时搜索，代价高昂且难以规模化。因此需要一个能把执行开销移出逐查询搜索循环的方法。
AI.method: 提出 SHIFT：由一个本地 LLM 充当"架构师"，从搜索过程中学习关于 harness 构建动作的策略（policy），并学习一个价值函数，从已测量的执行结果中预测兼顾准确率与执行成本的效用。给定查询时，用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）结合上述预测来构建 harness，实现结构、指令与工具三者的联合选择。
AI.result: 在六大基准、9,193 个任务上（涵盖数学、文档与通用助手任务），以 Gemini 3.5 Flash 为执行器，SHIFT 获得最高平均准确率约 80%，优于涵盖提示工程、提示优化与工作流搜索的 17 个基线，比最强基线高 7.2 个百分点。其低成本模式在准确率仍高于所有基线的前提下，执行 token 比最强基线少 32%。联合选择结构、指令与工具比仅选指令或仅选工具最高提升 9.1 个百分点；学习到的价值选择能在候选池中选出更准确且执行成本更低的 harness。
AI.conclusion: 将 harness 设计的执行成本从推理时的逐查询搜索转移到离线学习的策略与价值函数，是可行且高效的；联合优化结构、指令与工具显著优于单一维度优化，且学习式价值选择可同时提升准确率并降低执行成本，说明 harness 定制是提升 agent 性能的关键杠杆。

title: Robot Learning with Visual Predicted Force
summary: Force-aware manipulation typically relies on specialized force or tactile sensors. We show that force-aware manipulation can instead be achieved through visual force prediction from the deformation of a compliant Fin Ray gripper. Our approach trains two models. First, we train a visual force estimator on calibration data and use it to annotate task demonstrations with force estimates. Second, we train an action--force proposal policy on these force-augmented demonstrations to jointly generate candidate robot actions and their associated forces. At test time, we sample candidate actions and the forces they are expected to produce, then execute the action whose predicted force is closest to a target from the demonstrations. We evaluate our approach on berry picking, empty-can grasping, in-hand reorientation, and plug insertion. Our results show that visual force prediction can guide inference-time action selection for contact-rich manipulation without requiring force or tactile sensors at deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需力/触觉传感器的力感知操作方法：通过视觉预测柔性Fin Ray夹爪的变形来估计力，并据此在推理时选择动作。
AI.motivation: 传统力感知操作依赖专用力传感器或触觉传感器，这类硬件增加成本与部署复杂度。作者希望验证：利用柔性夹爪形变的视觉信息即可实现力感知操作，从而在部署时省去力/触觉传感器。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段训练两个模型：1）在标定数据上训练视觉力估计器，用以给任务示范数据标注力估计；2）在力增强示范数据上训练“动作-力”候选策略，同时生成候选动作及其对应预期力。测试时采样多个候选动作及其预期力，执行预测力最接近示范目标力的动作。
AI.result: 在四个任务上评估：浆果采摘、空罐抓取、手内重定向、插头插入。结果表明视觉力预测可有效引导推理阶段的动作选择，在部署时无需力或触觉传感器即可完成接触丰富型操作。
AI.conclusion: 视觉力预测可替代专用力/触觉传感器用于接触丰富型操作，通过推理时基于目标力的动作选择实现力感知操作，为低成本、易部署的力感知操作提供可行路径。

title: Referring Multi-Object Tracking in Moving-Camera Videos via Global Motion Compensation
summary: Referring multi-object tracking (RMOT) takes a video and a language expression as input and tracks all referred objects. Many tracking requirements involve how an object moves rather than how it appears. However, in a video captured by a moving camera, a parked vehicle may appear to move, while a moving vehicle may show little displacement. Existing RMOT methods relate motion with text but do not explicitly remove camera-induced motion. In this paper, we propose extracting residual motion across frames by estimating camera motion in driver-view videos and compare motion characteristics with the query expression. We consider the motion-matching extent and integrate it with the RMOT method's prediction result through late fusion. In the evaluation, we verify the performance gain of taking the motion compensation module as a plug-in across different RMOT hosts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过估计相机运动提取帧间残差运动，并将其与RMOT方法的预测结果进行后期融合，以提升运动相关参照的跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RMOT方法虽将运动与文本关联，但未显式消除相机自身运动带来的干扰，导致在移动相机视频中，静止物体看似运动、运动物体位移却不明显，影响基于运动描述的跟踪准确性。
AI.method: 在驾驶员视角视频中估计相机运动，计算帧间残差运动以去除相机诱导的运动；随后将残差运动特征与查询表达进行运动匹配度量，并通过后期融合将该匹配程度整合进现有RMOT方法的预测结果，作为即插即用模块。
AI.result: 在不同RMOT基线方法上验证，引入运动补偿模块作为插件均可带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式进行相机运动补偿并与RMOT预测进行后期融合，是一种通用且有效的增强策略，可提升RMOT对运动相关表达的处理能力。

title: TCMClinicalReason-Bench: Can Language Models Reason from Pathogenesis to Prescription over Real-World Clinical Cases?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate clinical narratives that are insufficiently grounded in patient-specific evidence. In traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), errors can propagate from etiology and pathogenesis through syndrome diagnosis and treatment principles to prescription generation. We developed TCMClinicalReason-Bench using 2,000 multicenter electronic health record cases to distinguish case-grounded responses from fluent but unsupported diagnostic and therapeutic conclusions. Five general-purpose and two TCM-specific LLMs were evaluated in zero-shot settings. An evidence-constrained rubric assessed seven diagnostic and therapeutic components and three cross-block relations, allowing case-supported alternatives. Qwen3.7-Plus with TCM retrieval served as the automated judge, alongside parallel blinded ratings by five senior TCM clinicians on a 600-case subset. Structural completeness was nearly saturated (99.3-100.0%), but normalized content scores ranged from 40.7% to 54.1%. The five general-purpose models averaged 50.0%, versus 41.3% for the two smaller TCM-specific models. Cross-block logic consistency ranged from 60.8% to 66.8% and correlated moderately with content across cases (Pearson's r = 0.515-0.656). Deficits were greatest in prescription generation, prescription analysis, and symptom-guided modification. In judge stress testing on 100 independent cases, perturbation detection rates across the three relations were 57%, 56%, and 31%, with contradictions detected more reliably than omissions. Separating component quality from cross-block consistency localizes failures missed by endpoint and completeness metrics and identifies where clinician oversight remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 研究构建了TCMClinicalReason-Bench，用2000例多中心电子病历评估9个大模型的中医临床推理，发现结构完整性接近饱和但内容得分仅40.7%-54.1%，失败集中在处方生成环节。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的临床叙述常缺乏患者特异性证据支撑；在中医中，错误会从病因病机沿证候诊断、治则治法逐级传播至处方生成，而现有指标（如终点指标与完整性指标）难以识别这类"流畅但无依据"的推理缺陷，因此需要一个能区分"有病例依据"与"无支撑结论"的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建TCMClinicalReason-Bench，基于2000例多中心电子病历；评估5个通用模型与2个中医专用模型（零样本设置）。采用证据约束评分量表，覆盖7个诊断与治疗组件及3个跨模块关系，允许病例支持的替代答案。以Qwen3.7-Plus结合中医检索作为自动评判，并由5位资深中医临床医师对600例子集进行平行盲评；另在100例独立病例上做评判器压力测试（扰动检测）。
AI.result: 结构完整性接近饱和（99.3%-100.0%），但归一化内容得分仅40.7%-54.1%；5个通用模型平均50.0%，2个较小的中医专用模型为41.3%。跨模块逻辑一致性为60.8%-66.8%，与内容得分呈中度相关（Pearson r = 0.515-0.656）。缺口最大的是处方生成、处方分析与随症加减。压力测试中三种关系的扰动检出率分别为57%、56%、31%，矛盾比遗漏更易被检出。
AI.conclusion: 将组件质量与跨模块一致性分离评估，可定位端点指标和完整性指标所遗漏的失败环节，并明确仍需临床医生监督的关键节点。

title: Dual-Scale Relational Graph Transformers for Ecosystem-Aware Fraud Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted at the Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL) workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Account takeover (ATO) fraud is a growing threat to digital banking, requiring effective detection while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Production systems predominantly rely on tabular models that score sessions in isolation, discarding the relational structure of the underlying interaction network. Although graph-based models exploit relationships among sessions and network entities, they primarily reason over local neighborhoods and therefore capture only part of the problem: fraud risk depends jointly on the local relational structure surrounding a session and the evolving global state of the fraud ecosystem. We present HERMES (HEterogeneous Relational Micro--macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions), a dual-scale architecture that jointly models these complementary scales of information. Micro-GT captures local heterogeneous graph structure through structured, relation-aware attention over a temporally safe session neighborhood. Complementing this local representation, Macro-GT models ecosystem-level context using non-anticipative climate tokens that summarize fraud dynamics, platform shifts, and infrastructure reuse, together with adaptive class prototypes that track representative fraud and benign session patterns over time. Evaluated on more than 130 million high-risk transaction sessions from a leading U.S. financial institution, HERMES consistently outperforms production and strong graph-based baselines, achieving a 44.44% relative reduction in customer friction and a 24.66% relative improvement in fraud recall over the production system. Ablation and temporal-stability analyses further demonstrate complementary gains from local relational modeling and global ecosystem context across changing fraud regimes.

AI.tldr: HERMES 是一种双尺度异构图 Transformer 编码器，联合建模会话级局部关系结构与欺诈生态的全局演化状态，在美国某大型金融机构超 1.3 亿高风险交易会话上，相较生产系统实现客户摩擦相对降低 44.44%、欺诈召回相对提升 24.66%。
AI.motivation: 账户接管（ATO）欺诈对数字银行威胁日益严重，检测需在降低合法客户摩擦的同时保持有效性。生产系统主要依赖对会话独立打分的表格模型，丢弃了底层交互网络的关系结构；已有图模型虽利用会话与网络实体的关系，但多局限于局部邻域推理，仅捕获问题的一部分。作者认为欺诈风险同时取决于会话周围的局部关系结构与欺诈生态不断演变的全局状态，因此需要双尺度联合建模。
AI.method: 提出 HERMES（HEterogeneous Relational Micro–macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions）双尺度架构。Micro-GT 通过结构化、关系感知的注意力机制，在时间安全的会话邻域上捕获局部异构图结构。Macro-GT 建模生态级上下文，使用非预见性（non-anticipative）"climate tokens"刻画欺诈动态、平台变化与基础设施复用，并引入自适应类别原型，随时间跟踪有代表性的欺诈与良性会话模式。二者联合刻画互补尺度的信息。
AI.result: 在美国某领先金融机构超过 1.3 亿条高风险交易会话上评估，HERMES 持续优于生产基线及强图基线：相较生产系统实现客户摩擦相对降低 44.44%、欺诈召回相对提升 24.66%。消融实验与时间稳定性分析进一步表明，局部关系建模与全局生态上下文在不同欺诈态势变化下均带来互补增益。
AI.conclusion: HERMES 验证了联合建模会话级局部异构图结构与生态级全局演化状态的必要性与有效性，二者提供互补信息，使模型在变化的欺诈态势下保持稳健，并在真实大规模生产场景中同时实现客户摩擦下降与欺诈召回提升。

title: Lie Rarely, Lie Big: Stealthy Insider Attacks on LLM Robot Teams
summary: When a team of robots delegates planning and mutual trust to LLM agents, a single compromised robot can corrupt the shared outcome. We study this threat in a grounded task: a multi-robot survey in which measurements can be verified against the physical world, but every verification costs budget that would otherwise advance the mission. We treat the compromised robot as a stealthy adversary in the system-theoretic sense: it is limited not by an energy bound but by the team's own detectors. We then derive two bounds. First, the probability that the adversary's reports are verified is bounded below in terms of the degrees in the communication graph and the verification budget. Second, the map error caused by any stealthy adversary is bounded above by the value of a linear program over the adversary's bias distributions; its solution is an exchange rate between stealth budget and damage: below a critical verification level the worst stealthy attack tells rare, full-magnitude lies on the records least likely to be verified, and above it the better purchase is small biases hidden in the noise. In experiments where the honest robots are LLM agents, both bounds hold at the budget the attack actually spent. The experiments also show that which records an LLM robot re-checks is unbiased, but how much it re-checks is unpredictable.

AI.tldr: 该研究将"被攻陷机器人"建模为系统论意义上的隐蔽对手（受限于团队自身的检测器而非能耗约束），在"多机器人勘测"这一可验证任务中给出了两个界：对手报告被验证的概率下界（由通信图度数与验证预算决定），以及任何隐蔽对手造成的建图误差上界（可表述为关于对手偏置分布的线性规划，并给出"隐蔽预算-破坏程度"的兑换率：验证水平低于临界值时最优攻击为"对被验证概率最低的记录进行罕见的全幅值撒谎"，高于临界值时则改为"把小幅偏置藏进噪声中"）。在诚实机器人为LLM智能体的实验中，两个界在实际消耗预算处均成立，且发现LLM机器人的"复核哪些记录"是无偏的，但"复核多少"不可预测。
AI.motivation: 多机器人团队将规划与相互信任交给LLM智能体后，一旦有单个机器人被攻陷，其影响会在共享结果中被放大，构成被忽视的安全威胁。论文动机在于刻画这种威胁的定量边界，并理解验证代价（消耗本可用于推进任务的预算）与最终任务损伤之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 采用系统论中的隐蔽对手（stealthy adversary）模型：对手的约束并非能量上界，而是团队自身的检测器能力。研究选取"多机器人勘测"这一有物理世界可对照、但每次验证都消耗预算的基础任务。基于通信图结构与验证预算，推导对手报告被验证概率的下界；并将任意隐蔽对手导致的建图误差上界刻画为一个关于对手偏置分布的线性规划。
AI.result: 两个理论界均得到表达：报告被验证概率的下界由通信图度数与验证预算共同决定；建图误差上界由前述线性规划给出，其解揭示了一种"兑换率"——在临界验证水平之下，最坏隐蔽攻击是对最不可能被验证的记录进行罕见的全幅值撒谎；在临界水平之上，更优的选择是把小幅偏置隐藏在噪声中。在诚实机器人为LLM智能体的实验中，两个界在实际攻击花费的预算处均成立；实验还表明LLM机器人"复核哪些记录"是无偏的，但其"复核的量"不可预测。
AI.conclusion: 论文为多机器人+LLM智能体系统中的单点失陷威胁提供了可量化的理论刻画：验证预算的临界值决定了最优隐蔽攻击形态（罕见全幅撒谎 vs. 噪声中隐藏小幅偏置），并将隐蔽预算映射为可预期的任务损伤。实验验证了界的紧致性与LLM行为特征——复核对象无偏但复核强度不可预测，这提示防御设计不能仅依赖预测LLM的复核量，而需围绕验证预算与通信图结构进行系统性配置。

title: CellSplat4D: PSF-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse Robotic Live-Cell Imaging
summary: A robotic microscope watching living cells cannot afford to look as often as it would like. Every volume it acquires costs photons the specimen does not get back, and time owed to other wells. What such a platform exists to produce is a record of individual cells through time: which cell is which from one volume to the next, and which cell divided into which two. Sampling sparsely breaks that record exactly where it matters, and the fault lies in the acquisition schedule rather than in the analysis software. We fill the gaps by reconstructing them, fitting a 4D Gaussian model to whatever volumes the hardware could afford. The model is a cloud of light-emitting blobs, each carrying a position, a shape and a lifetime. Being continuous in time, it renders any missing volume on demand, decoupling how often the robot analyses from how often it can afford to look. The microscope's point-spread function is measured from the data rather than inherited from acquisition metadata or left to the optimizer, because metadata inflates it and the optimizer cannot recover it at all: a wider blur around a smaller blob fits the images equally well. Each blob's lifetime is stored in frames rather than as a fraction of the recording, so that it denotes a fixed duration on any sequence. Unmeasured timesteps are supervised at coarse scale by a 3D U-Net that predicts the intermediate volume directly and estimates no motion field, since a dividing cell becomes two and no motion describes that. On two Cell Tracking Challenge sequences, a C. elegans embryo and a Chinese Hamster Ovarian (CHO), with fidelity scored per cell nucleus, our reconstruction holds the highest nucleus fidelity at every distance from an acquired frame, has the flattest decay across the gap, and best recovers focal planes it was never shown with graceful degradation across the gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用4D高斯模型对稀疏采样的活细胞显微成像进行时间插值重建，将采集频率与分析频率解耦。模型由带位置、形状与生命周期的发光斑点组成，可连续渲染任意缺失时刻的体积；并从数据中直接测量点扩散函数（PSF）以避免模糊与尺度混淆。在Cell Tracking Challenge的线虫胚胎与CHO两个序列上，该方法在距采集帧的所有距离上细胞核保真度最高、衰减最平缓，并能最好地恢复从未采集的焦平面。
AI.motivation: 机器人显微镜在观测活细胞时无法随意提高采样频率：每次采集都消耗样品无法恢复的光子，并占用其他孔位的时间。而这类平台真正要产出的是细胞随时间的谱系记录——哪个细胞对应下一帧的哪个细胞、哪个细胞分裂为哪两个。稀疏采样恰恰在关键处破坏这一记录，且问题根源在采集时序而非分析软件。因此需要填补缺失时刻的体积，使机器人分析的频率不再受其能负担的成像频率限制。
AI.method: 对硬件能够采集到的体积拟合一个4D高斯模型：模型是一组发光斑点云，每个斑点携带位置、形状和生命周期，在时间上连续，可按需渲染任意缺失体积。显微系统的点扩散函数（PSF）从数据中测量，而非沿用采集元数据（元数据会使其偏大）或交给优化器估计（优化器无法恢复，因为更宽的模糊围绕更小的斑点同样能拟合图像）。每个斑点的生命周期以帧为单位存储而非占整个记录的比例，从而在任何序列上都表示固定时长。对未测量的时间步，用3D U-Net在粗尺度上进行监督，直接预测中间体积而不估计任何运动场（因为分裂细胞变为两个，没有运动场能描述这一过程）。
AI.result: 在Cell Tracking Challenge的两个序列（C. elegans胚胎与Chinese Hamster Ovarian, CHO）上，以每个细胞核为单位评分：所提重建在距采集帧的任意距离上均达到最高的细胞核保真度，在间隙内的衰减最平缓，并且能最好地恢复从未展示过的焦平面，在整个间隙上呈现平滑退化。
AI.conclusion: 将稀疏采样的时间间隙视为可重建的目标而非分析软件的责任，通过4D高斯连续模型与数据驱动PSF测量，实现了采集频率与分析频率的解耦；在细胞核保真度与缺失焦平面恢复上优于对比方法，且不依赖运动场即可处理细胞分裂。

title: On the Steering Dimensionality of Refusal in Language Models
summary: Existing activation steering methods often assume that a high-level concept can be mediated by a single steering direction. To support this, two complementary interventions should be achieved: additive steering should induce the target behavior, while directional ablation should suppress it. Yet behaviors may occupy richer activation geometries beyond a single direction, and semantically similar behaviors may be represented by distinct directions. In this work, we study how many directions can reliably control two different types of refusal behaviors: refusal triggered by the safety alignment and refusal in general contexts. Given the limited expressive capability of a single steering vector, we study the general setting of steering subspaces and introduce the notion of steering dimensionality as the minimum subspace dimensionality required to reliably control a behavior. We characterize sufficient steering subspaces that cover the full extent of the target behavior through both the (monotonic) improvement before the sufficient dimensionality, and the saturation beyond it. Empirically, we find that refusal triggered by safety alignment is 1-dim steerable, while multiple distinct steering directions can achieve comparable control. In contrast, refusal in general contexts exhibits substantially richer activation geometry where even 5-dim steering subspaces fail to reliably capture its full steerable variation. Our results reveal that the activation geometry underlying refusal is highly context-dependent and can be substantially more complex than a single linear steering direction.
