AI.tldr: 本文研究"steering dimensionality"（可靠控制某行为所需的最小子空间维度），发现安全对齐引发的拒答是1维可操控的，而通用语境下的拒答激活几何更丰富，即使5维子空间也难以完全捕捉。
AI.motivation: 现有activation steering方法通常假设高层概念可由单一steering direction中介，要求additive steering诱导目标行为、directional ablation抑制该行为。但行为可能占据比单一方向更丰富的激活几何，语义相似的行为也可能由不同方向表征，因此单一向量的表达能力不足。
AI.method: 研究两类拒答行为：安全对齐触发的拒答与通用语境中的拒答。将问题推广到steering subspace的一般设定，提出"steering dimensionality"概念，即可靠控制某行为所需的最小子空间维度；并通过充分维度前的单调改善与超过后的饱和来刻画能覆盖行为全部范围的充分steering子空间。
AI.result: 安全对齐触发的拒答是1维可操控的，且多个不同steering direction可实现相近控制效果；而通用语境下的拒答呈现显著更丰富的激活几何，即使5维steering subspace也无法可靠捕捉其全部可操控变化。
AI.conclusion: 拒答行为背后的激活几何高度依赖语境，且可能远比单一线性steering direction复杂，说明单方向假设的局限性及子空间方法的必要性。

title: ExpertMuon-Compass: Alignment-Guided Step Sizes for Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models send each token to a few experts, so each expert is trained on a different part of the data, and this part changes during training. With a shared learning rate, Muon applies updates of roughly the same size to expert matrices of the same shape, even when an expert's update is poorly aligned with its current gradient. We here propose ExpertMuon-Compass (Compass), which multiplies the Muon step of each expert by two factors. A family factor compares the cosine between the expert's orthogonalized update and its gradient with the same cosine for the other experts in its layer. A scalar radius aggregates the alignment between corresponding rows of the update and gradient into one step-length multiplier. Compass keeps the update direction and the momentum buffer of Muon. In pretraining on FineWeb-Edu, Compass with Nesterov momentum on all matrices performs as well as or better than Muon, NorMuon, and other optimizers, with weight decay matched to NorMuon in the longer runs. Adding its factors to NorMuon gives the same or a lower loss than NorMuon. Compass is the most effective when the data seen by each expert varies during training, for example, as when the languages of a multilingual corpus arrive in separate blocks. With Compass, the expert load stays balanced, and the router assigns tokens to experts more decisively. We also prove a perturbation bound for the two factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ExpertMuon-Compass（Compass），在 Muon 优化器基础上为每个专家矩阵的更新引入"家族因子"（层内专家间正交更新与梯度余弦的对齐比较）和"标量半径"（将对应行的更新-梯度对齐聚合为步长乘子）两个因子，保持 Muon 的更新方向与动量缓冲，从而自适应调节各专家的更新幅度。
AI.motivation: MoE 语言模型将每个 token 路由给少数专家，各专家训练数据不同且随训练变化。在共享学习率下，Muon 对同形状的专家矩阵施加近似相同大小的更新，即便某专家的更新与其当前梯度对齐很差。这种"一刀切"的步长会损害专家学习效率与负载均衡。
AI.method: 在 Muon 步骤上为每个专家引入两个乘性因子：1）家族因子（family factor）——将该专家正交化更新与其梯度的余弦，与同层其他专家的对应余弦进行比较；2）标量半径（scalar radius）——把更新与梯度对应行之间的对齐信息聚合为一个整体步长乘子。Compass 保留 Muon 的更新方向与动量缓冲，可与 Nesterov 动量及 NorMuon 结合使用。
AI.result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 预训练中，对所有矩阵使用 Nesterov 动量的 Compass 表现与 Muon、NorMuon 等优化器相当或更优（较长训练中权重衰减与 NorMuon 对齐）。将两因子加入 NorMuon 可获得相同或更低的损失。Compass 在每个专家所接触数据随训练变化时最有效，例如多语料库语言分块到达的场景。使用 Compass 后专家负载保持均衡，路由器对 token 的分配更具决定性。作者还证明了两个因子的扰动界。
AI.conclusion: Compass 通过专家级别的方向对齐度量自适应调节 Muon 步长，在不改变更新方向与动量的前提下，提升了 MoE 语言模型的预训练效果、专家负载均衡与路由决策质量，并具备理论上的扰动稳定性保证。

title: DNPush: Distributed Nonparallel Pushing Force Control of Multi-Robot Systems for Object Transportation
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: This letter proposes DNPush, a Distributed Nonparallel Pushing force controller for cooperative object transport without inter-robot communication. Each robot uses local force measurements, a preassigned force weight, and a locally expressed desired transport direction, without requiring an object model, contact locations, a CoM estimate, or moment arm magnitudes online. DNPush regulates nonparallel force magnitudes from local force direction misalignments through a reciprocal-sine law. Under the stated contact conditions, Lyapunov analysis with LaSalle's invariance principle proves convergence to a unique rotational equilibrium, where perpendicular force contributions cancel and the net torque from normal forces is zero. Object velocity converges to the desired transport direction, and suitable contact regions exist for convex polygons. Simulations isolate the reciprocal-sine scaling mechanism, five-robot coordination, and active rotational damping. Hardware experiments with soft tactile differential-drive robots achieve a velocity direction error of 0.61 deg +/- 0.79 deg over five trials with a fixed transport direction and demonstrate object transport through waypoints with three robots.

AI.tldr: DNPush是一种无需机器人间通信的分布式非平行推力控制器，仅用局部力测量、预设力权重和局部表达的期望运输方向，即可实现协作物体运输并保证收敛到唯一旋转平衡。
AI.motivation: 协作物体运输通常依赖机器人间通信、物体模型、接触位置、质心估计或力臂信息，这些在线需求增加了系统复杂度并限制了实际部署，因此需要一种纯局部信息驱动的分布式控制方法。
AI.method: 每个机器人使用局部力测量、预分配力权重与局部表达的期望运输方向；通过倒数正弦律（reciprocal-sine law）依据局部力方向失配调节非平行力幅值。用Lyapunov分析与LaSalle不变性原理证明收敛性，并对凸多边形验证合适接触区域的存在性。
AI.result: 在给定接触条件下收敛到唯一旋转平衡：垂直力分量相互抵消、法向力净力矩为零，物体速度收敛至期望方向。仿真分离验证了倒数正弦缩放机制、五机器人协调与主动旋转阻尼；软触觉差速驱动机器人硬件实验中，固定运输方向下五次试验速度方向误差为0.61°±0.79°，三机器人实现了经路径点的物体运输。
AI.conclusion: DNPush在无通信、无物体模型与在线力臂信息的条件下实现了分布式非平行推力协作运输，理论与实验均验证了其收敛性与实际可行性。

title: Sparse-GS2Mesh: 3D Gaussian Splatting Guided by Novel Stereo Views and 2DGS for Sparse View Surface Reconstruction}
comment: 13, pages, 7 figures, accepted to NIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI workshops
summary: Surface reconstruction under sparse-view settings remains challenging due to limited geometric cues. Volume rendering methods based on signed distance functions often produce over-smoothed surfaces, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), though time-efficient, suffers from incomplete geometry due to the lack of reliable depth supervision and the limitation of being optimized only from given input views. In this paper, we present Sparse-GS2Mesh, a stereo-aware framework for surface reconstruction from sparse views. While 3DGS and stereo matching have been leveraged for surface reconstruction under dense view settings, we extend them to operate effectively under sparse view conditions by first initializing 3DGS using epipolar depth priors to mitigate the 3DGS overfitting problem, followed by our three key components: (I) adaptive baseline selection, (II) fine-tuning with a stereo matching network, and (III) 2D/3D co-regularized fine-tuning. Given a warmed-up 3DGS initialized with epipolar depth, the adaptive baseline selection automatically determines a baseline to synthesize for each sparse view. We then fine-tune 3DGS by backpropagating depth-refining gradients from the stereo matching network, effectively specializing the 3DGS for stereo matching. The 2D/3D co-regularization further helps obtain stable reconstruction, addressing weak geometric cues in close stereo views. Sparse-GS2Mesh achieves a 15\% improvement over state-of-the-art methods in little-overlap settings and comparable results in large-overlap settings. Codes will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: Sparse-GS2Mesh 提出一种立体感知框架，将 3D Gaussian Splatting 与立体匹配结合，通过极线深度先验初始化、自适应基线选择、立体匹配网络微调及 2D/3D 协同正则化，实现稀疏视角下的高质量表面重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下几何线索有限，表面重建困难。基于 SDF 的体渲染易产生过度平滑表面，而 3DGS 虽高效但缺乏可靠深度监督且仅依赖输入视角优化，导致几何不完整。3DGS 与立体匹配虽已用于稠密视角重建，但在稀疏视角下尚缺乏有效方案。
AI.method: 先用极线深度先验初始化 3DGS 以缓解过拟合；随后引入三个关键组件：(I) 自适应基线选择，为每个稀疏视角自动确定合成基线；(II) 利用立体匹配网络微调 3DGS，回传深度细化梯度使其专精于立体匹配；(III) 2D/3D 协同正则化，在近距立体视角下应对弱几何线索以获得稳定重建。
AI.result: 在小重叠设置下相较最先进方法提升约 15%，在大重叠设置下取得可比结果。
AI.conclusion: Sparse-GS2Mesh 将 3DGS 与立体匹配扩展至稀疏视角场景，显著提升小重叠条件下的重建性能，并提供公开代码。

title: Spec2Game: Can LLMs Generate Complete Playable Games from Detailed Specifications?
summary: Generating an executable program does not necessarily mean that it correctly implements the behavioral requirements specified in natural language. To evaluate large language models' ability to realize detailed specifications as complete interactive programs, we introduce Spec2Game, a benchmark that requires models to generate complete Pygame projects from detailed natural-language game specifications. Spec2Game comprises 15 game families and 150 task instances, with one canonical task and nine controlled rule variants per family, spanning three levels of implementation complexity. Using source-code, runtime, and visual evidence, we evaluate generated projects along four dimensions---Executability, Specification Realization, Code Quality, and User-Facing Quality. Across 14 LLMs and 3,330 generated projects, we find that high executability does not imply faithful specification realization. Component-level analysis further shows that models perform substantially better on Game Element Modeling than on Rule and Mechanism Modeling or Goal and Termination Modeling, indicating that faithfully implementing game rules and termination logic remains a major challenge.

AI.tldr: Spec2Game：15个游戏族、150个任务、14个LLM、3,330个生成项目的基准，评估从自然语言规格生成完整Pygame程序的能力。
AI.motivation: 程序可执行不等于正确实现了自然语言描述的行为需求，需要专门基准评估LLM将详细规格转化为完整交互式程序的能力。
AI.method: 构建Spec2Game基准，含15个游戏族、每族1个标准任务加9个受控规则变体、共150个任务实例，覆盖3个实现复杂度层级；利用源码、运行时与视觉证据，从可执行性、规格实现度、代码质量、用户面向质量四个维度评估。
AI.result: 在14个LLM、3,330个生成项目上评估发现：高可执行性并不意味忠实的规格实现；组件级分析显示模型在游戏元素建模上明显优于规则与机制建模、目标与终止建模。
AI.conclusion: 忠实实现游戏规则与终止逻辑仍是LLM生成完整交互程序的主要挑战，Spec2Game为细粒度规格实现评估提供了基准。

title: Ideal Paths for Approximating Logistic Gradient Descent Trajectories at Large Initialization
summary: Modern training on a new task often starts from a previously trained model rather than from scratch, raising the question of how this initialization affects the subsequent training trajectory. Classical implicit-bias results characterize the direction selected by prolonged training, but this direction alone does not provide information regarding the intermediate behavior. We address this question through a geometric approximation of full-batch logistic gradient descent (GD) trajectories on strictly linearly separable data, with large initialization of scale $R$ motivated by prior training. From any limiting normalized initial position, we use minimum-norm projection rules to construct a unique continuous ideal path consisting of finitely many linear segments. The path has two stages: negative-margin correction followed by minimum-margin growth. We prove that, after an explicit two-stage time reparameterization, the fixed-step GD trajectory divided by $R$ converges uniformly to this path on every fixed parameter interval as $R\to\infty$. Further, our quantitative error bounds account for initialization perturbations and the transition between stages. This approximation provides asymptotic formulas for peak evaluation loss and cumulative training loss. In particular, peak evaluation loss can grow linearly in $R$ even when both endpoint losses tend to zero. The cumulative losses in the correction and margin-growth stages, normalized by $R^2$ and $R$, respectively, converge to explicit limits. Experiments on controlled geometries and fixed image features complement our theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从预训练模型（大尺度初始化）出发继续训练时的轨迹几何，给出全批量逻辑回归梯度下降在严格线性可分数据上的理想化近似路径，并证明其收敛性与损失渐近公式。
AI.motivation: 现代训练常从已有模型而非随机初始化开始，因此大尺度初始化如何影响后续训练轨迹成为关键问题。经典隐式偏置结果只刻画长时间训练所选择的方向，无法说明中间过程的行为。
AI.method: 将大尺度初始化 $R$ 下的全批量逻辑回归梯度下降轨迹进行几何近似：从任意极限归一化初始位置出发，利用最小范数投影规则构造一条由有限个线性段组成的唯一连续理想路径；该路径分为负间隔修正与最小间隔增长两个阶段。作者证明在显式两阶段时间重参数化后，固定步长 GD 轨迹除以 $R$ 在每个固定参数区间上随 $R\to\infty$ 一致收敛到该理想路径，并给出考虑初始化扰动与阶段转换的定量误差界。
AI.result: 该近似给出了峰值评估损失与累积训练损失的渐近公式：峰值评估损失即使在两个端点损失都趋于零时仍可随 $R$ 线性增长；修正阶段与间隔增长阶段的累积损失分别经 $R^2$ 与 $R$ 归一化后收敛到显式极限。受控几何与固定图像特征上的实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文刻画了大初始化下逻辑回归梯度下降的完整训练轨迹而非仅极限方向，揭示了损失在训练过程中可能出现的非单调峰值现象，并提供了可量化的误差与损失渐近刻画。

title: PatternDex: Learning Interaction Patterns to Guide Reinforcement Learning of Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Objects
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://patterndex.github.io/PatternDex/
summary: In this paper, we develop a method that enables bimanual dexterous hands to manipulate articulated objects with a high success rate without suffering from an embodiment gap. We observe that the correlation between hand motions and object motions is dictated by the object rather than the hands and can be learned from human-object demonstrations. Based on this observation, we propose PatternDex, a method that learns this correlation and represents it as a token sequence, which we call an interaction pattern. From this pattern, PatternDex estimates the wrist motions and contact points that fit the target robot, and then trains a reinforcement learning policy that exploits these estimates as guidance. Since the guidance fits the target embodiment, the policy explores only the actions that the target robot can execute and thus achieves high success rates. PatternDex also requires only simple fine-tuning to train a new robot, since it can reuse the learned interaction pattern. We evaluate PatternDex with bimanual dexterous hands on human demonstrations from the ARCTIC dataset. PatternDex achieves, on average, a 92.8% success rate with Allegro hands, while the state-of-the-art baseline achieves 52.2%. Also, it achieves success rates above 70% with three other robot hands after fine-tuning alone. Furthermore, we verify that the learned policy transfers well to a real-world task of opening a microwave. Videos and additional results are available at https://patterndex.github.io/PatternDex/

AI.tldr: PatternDex 从人类-物体演示中学习"交互模式"（token 序列），据此估计适配目标机器人的手腕运动与接触点，并用其引导强化学习策略，实现双臂灵巧手操作铰接物体，无需受实体差异（embodiment gap）困扰。
AI.motivation: 双臂灵巧手操作铰接物体存在实体差异（embodiment gap）问题：人类演示的动作无法直接迁移到不同结构的机器人手上，导致策略探索空间过大、成功率低。作者观察到"手部运动与物体运动的关联由物体而非手决定"，因此可从人类-物体演示中学习该关联并复用。
AI.method: 提出 PatternDex：(1) 从人类-物体演示中学习手-物运动关联，并将其表示为 token 序列，称为"交互模式（interaction pattern）"；(2) 由该模式估计适配目标机器人的手腕运动与接触点；(3) 以这些估计作为引导训练强化学习策略，使策略仅在目标机器人可执行的动作空间内探索。新机器人只需少量微调即可复用已学交互模式。
AI.result: 在 ARCTIC 数据集的人类演示上评估双臂灵巧手：使用 Allegro 手平均成功率达 92.8%，而 SOTA 基线仅 52.2%；仅经微调后，在另外三种机器人手上成功率均超过 70%。此外，学习到的策略能良好迁移到真实世界的"打开微波炉"任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习与实体无关的交互模式并将其映射到目标机器人的动作引导，PatternDex 有效缓解了实体差异问题，在仿真与真实任务中均取得高成功率，并具备跨机器人手的良好泛化与微调复用能力。

title: FlashGaze: Training-Free Multi-Scale Patch Pruning For Efficient Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in video understanding, yet efficiently processing long, high-resolution videos remains challenging. Such videos often contain substantial spatiotemporal redundancy, and processing redundant visual tokens can incur avoidable computational overhead. Many existing methods prune visual tokens during or after vision transformer (ViT) encoding, leaving much of the encoding cost unaddressed. Some approaches prune patches before encoding but rely on learned auxiliary networks for patch selection, incurring additional training and inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose FlashGaze, a training-free method that reduces spatiotemporal redundancy before ViT encoding without introducing auxiliary networks. FlashGaze uses pixel-space differences as a proxy for information loss and employs Quadtree Dynamic Programming to jointly optimize patch dropping, merging, and keeping under a fixed budget. Experiments on two MLLM backbones across multiple benchmarks demonstrate substantial efficiency gains while largely preserving accuracy. On Qwen3-VL-8B, FlashGaze retains 98% of the full-input baseline accuracy on LongVideoBench while achieving up to 5.4x and 17x speedups in ViT encoding and MLLM prefill, respectively, and reducing peak GPU memory usage by a factor of 1.8. These efficiency gains enable the model to process videos with more frames and higher resolutions on the same GPU hardware, unlocking video understanding at scales previously out of reach.

AI.tldr: FlashGaze：一种免训练方法，在ViT编码前通过四叉树动态规划降低视频时空冗余，兼顾精度并显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型处理长时高分辨率视频时存在大量时空冗余，冗余视觉token带来可避免的计算开销。现有方法要么在ViT编码中或编码后剪枝（编码成本未解决），要么在编码前剪枝但依赖学习式辅助网络（增加训练与推理开销）。
AI.method: 提出FlashGaze，免训练方法，在ViT编码前降低时空冗余且不引入辅助网络。以像素空间差异作为信息损失的代理，采用四叉树动态规划（Quadtree Dynamic Programming）在固定预算下联合优化patch的丢弃、合并与保留。
AI.result: 在两个MLLM骨干、多个基准上取得显著效率提升同时基本保持精度。在Qwen3-VL-8B上，LongVideoBench保持98%全输入基线精度，ViT编码加速最高5.4倍，MLLM prefill加速17倍，峰值GPU显存降低1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: FlashGaze在相同GPU硬件上支持更多帧、更高分辨率的视频处理，解锁以往难以实现的视频理解规模。

title: CADForge: Agentic Single-View CAD Reconstruction with Explicit Geometry Reasoning
summary: Reconstructing editable parametric CAD models from a single-view image is of great practical value for modern manufacturing, yet remains challenging due to incomplete geometric observations and complex inter-part relationships. To address it, we propose CADForge, an agentic framework that progressively converts a single image into CadQuery programs. CADForge decomposes an object into CAD-meaningful components and performs explicit geometric reasoning for each component, a process that first identifies CAD-relevant constraints and then translates them into precise modeling parameters through mathematical code. The inferred parameters then drive component-wise synthesis of executable CadQuery programs, with a review agent evaluating the resulting geometry and providing targeted feedback for iterative refinement. To further improve robustness and efficiency, CADForge incorporates a failure-guided toolkit construction mechanism to distill accumulated experience into tools, and maintains a compact parametric CAD memory for retrieving modeling context on demand. Experiments on diverse single- and multi-part objects show that CADForge consistently outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality, demonstrating an effective approach to accurate single-view CAD reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出CADForge，一个智能体框架，将单视图图像渐进式转换为可编辑的CadQuery程序，通过组件分解、显式几何推理、审查反馈与工具蒸馏，在单/多部件对象上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 从单视图图像重建可编辑参数化CAD模型对现代制造具有重要实用价值，但由于几何观测不完整、部件间关系复杂，该任务仍具挑战性。
AI.method: CADForge将物体分解为具有CAD语义的组件，并对每个组件进行显式几何推理：先识别CAD相关约束，再通过数学代码将其转化为精确建模参数；推断出的参数驱动组件级可执行CadQuery程序合成；由审查智能体评估生成几何并给出针对性反馈以迭代精化。此外引入失败引导的工具库构建机制，将积累经验蒸馏为工具，并维护紧凑的参数化CAD记忆以按需检索建模上下文。
AI.result: 在多种单部件和多部件对象上的实验表明，CADForge在重建保真度和感知质量上持续优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: CADForge为精确的单视图CAD重建提供了一种有效途径。

title: Consideration Circuits: Depth Separation and Universality Beyond a Single Softmax
summary: Most feature-based choice models, classical and deep, score items and apply a single softmax. We introduce consideration circuits (CC), feature-based models of multi-stage choice defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit (MNL) units. Source units assign probabilities to menu items, and internal units combine predecessor distributions using MNL weights computed from their probability-weighted feature summaries. On a three-item compromise task with fixed non-collinear features, menu-independent random-utility models (RUM), including a single MNL unit, suffer an error bounded away from zero. For CC, in contrast, we establish a sharp depth--norm separation: increasing depth from $2$ to $3$ reduces the optimal maximum taste-vector norm for error $ε$ from $Θ(\log(1/ε)/ε)$ to $Θ(\log(1/ε))$. The depth-$2$ lower bound holds for arbitrary width and menu-independent routing biases, while a five-node depth-$3$ circuit with zero routing biases attains the logarithmic rate. More generally, we characterize two geometric conditions that are necessary and sufficient for approximating arbitrary deterministic choice tables on finite menu families. Under these conditions, depth $3$ suffices, while depth $4$ achieves optimal logarithmic norm scaling whenever the family contains a non-singleton menu. In experiments, standalone tree circuits with fewer than $600$ parameters attain the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (NLL) among the evaluated models on four fixed-pool benchmarks and the Expedia temporal split. As output heads, CC generalize the linear MNL readout and lower mean test NLL for every tested encoder on Expedia and Trivago.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"考虑电路"(CC)：由MNL单元构成的有向无环图式的多阶段特征选择模型。论文在三人妥协任务上证明了深度-范数分离的紧界，刻画了逼近任意确定性选择表的充要几何条件，并在多个基准与Expedia/Trivago上验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 多数基于特征的选择模型（无论经典还是深度）都对物品打分后施加单一softmax，难以刻画多阶段、依赖菜单上下文的决策过程。作者希望构建能表达分阶段选择、并具有理论保证的模型族。
AI.method: 定义考虑电路CC：由MNL单元组成的有向无环图。源单元为菜单项分配概率；内部单元用MNL权重组合前驱分布，权重由概率加权的特征汇总计算得到。理论分析基于三人妥协任务（固定非共线特征），对比菜单独立的随机效用模型（RUM，含单MNL单元）与CC的深度-范数关系，并刻画两个几何条件（逼近任意确定性选择表的充要条件）。
AI.result: 在三人妥协任务上，菜单独立RUM（含单MNL单元）误差有下界、无法趋于零。CC存在尖锐的深度-范数分离：深度2到3使误差ε所需最优最大口味向量范数从Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降至Θ(log(1/ε))；深度2下界对任意宽度与菜单独立路由偏置成立，深度3的五节点零路由偏置电路即达对数速率。两个几何条件为有限菜单族上逼近任意确定性选择表的充要条件，满足时深度3足够，深度4在含非单元素菜单族时达最优对数范数缩放。实验中，参数量不足600的独立树电路在四个固定池基准和Expedia时间划分上取得最低平均测试NLL；作为输出头，CC推广线性MNL读出，并在Expedia与Trivago上为每个测试编码器降低平均测试NLL。
AI.conclusion: CC以DAG化的MNL单元实现多阶段、菜单依赖的选择建模，在理论上给出深度与范数的紧致分离及逼近充要条件，在实验中以极少参数取得更优似然，并可作为通用输出头提升多种编码器性能。

title: Flow Policies as Actions of Skill-Level World Models: Learned and Symbolic Abstractions for Long-Horizon Planning
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm
summary: Latent world models enable robots to plan by predicting the consequences of actions. Planning long tasks with control-rate actions requires many prediction steps, which enlarges the search space and accumulates error. Skill-level actions shorten these sequences, but a symbolic skill vocabulary requires domain knowledge and labeled demonstrations. We construct skill-level actions from the inputs of a flow-matching policy trained on demonstrations segmented into complete skills. The policy maps a noise seed and an observation, optionally with a code or label, to a complete skill execution, so one execution is one world-model transition. On this mechanism we propose four action abstractions with increasing task knowledge: a compressed seed, two discrete codes learned from the demonstrations, and a symbolic label. We evaluate them with a common world-model training procedure and planning framework on simulated block rearrangement tasks that require up to 14 sequential skills. The symbolic label succeeds in over 90% of the tasks that require up to six skills and degrades beyond. Without any label, an object-centric learned code matches it on single-skill tasks and retains half to three quarters of its success on tasks of two to five skills. Ablations attribute much of the label's advantage to its planner knowing which actions are applicable, rather than to the label itself. Beyond six skills the search, not the world model, limits success. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm

AI.tldr: 该论文从流匹配（flow-matching）策略的输入中构造技能级动作，并比较四种递增任务知识的动作抽象（压缩种子、两种离散码、符号标签），在世界模型规划框架下评估长时序任务表现。符号标签在不超过6个技能的任务上成功率超90%，但超过6个技能后搜索而非世界模型成为瓶颈；无标签时对象中心学习码在单技能任务上可与标签持平。
AI.motivation: 控制率（control-rate）动作造成长任务规划中预测步数多、搜索空间大且误差累积。技能级动作可缩短序列，但传统符号技能词汇表依赖领域知识和标注演示，难以获取。因此需要一种从演示数据自动构建技能级动作抽象的方法，并系统探究不同任务知识程度对规划性能的影响。
AI.method: 在分割为完整技能的演示上训练流匹配策略，该策略将噪声种子与观测（可选带码或标签）映射为完整技能执行，使一次执行对应一次世界模型转移。基于此机制提出四种递增任务知识的动作抽象：（1）压缩种子；（2）从演示中学习的两种离散码；（3）符号标签。使用统一的世界模型训练流程与规划框架，在需多达14个顺序技能的模拟积木重排任务上进行评估，并进行消融分析。
AI.result: 符号标签在需不超过6个技能的任务上成功率超90%，超过6个技能后性能下降。无标签时，对象中心学习码在单技能任务上与符号标签持平，在2至5技能任务上保持其成功率的二分之一至四分之三。消融表明，标签优势很大程度源于规划器知晓哪些动作适用，而非标签本身。超过6个技能后，限制成功率的是搜索过程而非世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 从演示训练的流匹配策略输入中可自动构造技能级动作抽象，显著缩短长时序任务的预测与搜索链条。任务知识（如符号标签）带来的收益主要体现在动作适用性先验而非符号表示本身；当技能数超过6时，规划搜索成为主要瓶颈，提示未来工作需改进搜索而非仅提升世界模型精度。

title: OctMesh: A Unified Octree-Hierarchical Framework for Lossless Triangle Mesh Compression
summary: Lossless triangle mesh compression must preserve both vertex positions and connectivity. Octrees support learned point cloud geometry coding and progressive refinement, but extending them to meshes requires a compatible connectivity representation. Unlike the eight occupancy decisions of a voxel, a parent edge can develop into varied child connections, making edge refinement difficult to model with a compact prediction prior. We propose OctMesh, a learned framework that codes geometry and connectivity on a shared octree hierarchy. Its key observation is that octree pooling produces parents with either one child or two to eight children. Child edges are then grouped by their endpoint parents' types and whether the endpoints share a parent. Each candidate group contains children from just one parent or two connected parents. The resulting four categories define small, fixed-shape prediction tasks: connections uniquely determined by the parent graph are inherited without bits, while three neural predictors estimate probabilities for the remaining candidates. These probabilities guide arithmetic coding of the actual edge symbols. Binarized predictions of within-parent connections provide context for predicting connections between different parents. A graph-aware parent feature extractor combines local geometry, parent connectivity and global shape. The connectivity models use dedicated weights at coarse levels and share weights at fine levels. Residual edges and a finest-level face-selection payload complete the reconstruction. On 256 frames from eight MPEG V-DMC test sequences, OctMesh losslessly recovers the finest-level vertex-coordinate, edge and unoriented face sets at an average of 7.033 bits per face, 12.8% below V-Mesh. The same hierarchical representation supports nine levels of progressive vertex-and-edge refinement.

AI.tldr: 提出OctMesh，一种在共享八叉树层级上联合编码几何与连通性的学习式无损三角网格压缩框架，在MPEG V-DMC测试序列上达到平均7.033 bits/face，较V-Mesh降低12.8%。
AI.motivation: 无损三角网格压缩需同时保留顶点位置与连通性。八叉树已支持学习式点云几何编码与渐进细化，但扩展到网格时缺乏兼容的连通性表示。与体素的八个占用决策不同，父边可演化为多样的子连接，导致边细化难以用紧凑的预测先验建模。
AI.method: OctMesh在共享八叉树层级上编码几何与连通性。核心观察是八叉树池化产生的父节点仅有1个子节点或2至8个子节点。子边按端点父节点类型及端点是否共享父节点分组，得到四类候选组，每组仅含单一父节点或两个相连父节点的子节点。据此定义四个小型固定形状预测任务：由父图唯一确定的连接不耗比特直接继承，其余候选由三个神经预测器估计概率并驱动算术编码。父节点内连接的二值化预测为跨父节点连接提供上下文。图感知的父特征提取器融合局部几何、父连通性与全局形状；连通性模型在粗层级使用专属权重、细层级共享权重。残差边与最细层选面负载完成重建。
AI.result: 在8个MPEG V-DMC测试序列的256帧上，OctMesh无损恢复最细层顶点坐标、边与无向面集合，平均7.033 bits/face，较V-Mesh降低12.8%。同一层级表示支持九级渐进顶点与边细化。
AI.conclusion: 通过将网格连通性细化归纳为基于父节点类型的四类固定形状预测任务，OctMesh实现了几何与连通性在共享八叉树上的学习式无损联合编码，兼顾压缩率与渐进细化能力。

title: Dense Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning in a Unified Geometry State
summary: Geometry reasoning is naturally stateful: solving a problem repeatedly alternates between structural proposals and exact deductions. We formulate this process as dense neural-symbolic coupling, in which neural guidance and symbolic execution share a typed state and communicate through executable actions at every search step. Neural proposals contribute theorem instances, constructions, and algebraic bridges; the symbolic runtime applies registered rules, propagates exact constraints, and records provenance. A nested controller allocates computation first between neural and symbolic proposal sources and then among admitted actions. We instantiate the framework in OmniGeo, a single solver for plane, analytic, and solid geometry. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, OmniGeo reaches 94.2%, 88.5%, and 89.8% on FormalGeo7K, Conic10K, and SolidFGeo, respectively (90.8% macro average), and solves 21/30 IMO-AG-30 problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文将几何推理建模为有状态的“密集神经-符号耦合”过程，神经引导与符号执行共享带类型状态并通过可执行动作逐步交互，提出OmniGeo统一求解器，在多个几何数据集上取得高准确率。
AI.motivation: 几何推理本质上是带状态的：求解过程在结构性提议与精确演绎之间反复交替。现有方法多将神经与符号部分割裂处理，难以在搜索的每一步实现紧密交互，因此需要一种能共享状态、逐步通信的神经-符号耦合框架。
AI.method: 将求解过程形式化为密集神经-符号耦合：神经引导与符号执行共享一个带类型（typed）状态，并通过可执行动作在每次搜索步骤中通信。神经提议提供定理实例、构造与代数桥接；符号运行时应用注册规则、传播精确约束并记录溯源信息。采用嵌套控制器，先分配神经与符号提议来源之间的计算资源，再在被采纳的动作间分配。基于该框架实例化出OmniGeo，用于平面、解析与立体几何的统一求解。
AI.result: 在Claude Sonnet 4.6配合下，OmniGeo在FormalGeo7K、Conic10K与SolidFGeo上分别达到94.2%、88.5%、89.8%（宏平均90.8%），并解出IMO-AG-30中的21/30题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将几何求解建模为共享类型状态的密集神经-符号耦合，并通过嵌套控制器分配神经与符号计算，可在平面、解析与立体几何上实现统一且高精度的求解，验证了该框架的有效性与通用性。

title: You May Be Running the Wrong Inception Crop
summary: A decade after its inception, Inception crop has become the standard crop-based data augmentation method for training deep vision models. Not only is its practice of uniformly sampling crop scale and aspect ratio widely adopted, but also its lower and upper bounds, with the scale lower bound being the sole exception that is sometimes tuned. It is therefore surprising that the standard implementation in the TensorFlow / JAX ecosystem samples crop scale with probability density function $f(A) \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{A}}$ unlike the PyTorch counterpart, which follows the original description. Motivated by this discovery, we train 522 ViT-S/16 models on the ImageNet-1k dataset with various training budgets and crop scale distributions. We reach $78.78\pm0.09$ top-1 val. accuracy with 90 epochs of training budget and find that 1. Higher training budget requires stronger augmentation; 2. Lower tail of the distribution of the crop scale determines the augmentation strength of Inception crop; 3. Models trained with higher training budget exhibit sparser saliency, regardless of the crop scale distribution or weight decay. Based on 2. we revisit the performance of Beta crop, whose softer cutoff allows it to optimize model performance across training budgets with less compromise. We replicate 1. and 3. with Scion optimizer in addition to AdamW, suggesting that the results may be general.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现Inception crop在TensorFlow/JAX与PyTorch中采样分布不一致，通过522个ViT-S/16实验重新审视其尺度分布与增强强度的关系。
AI.motivation: Inception crop已成为深度视觉模型训练的标准数据增强手段，其尺度上下界中仅下界偶尔被调，但TensorFlow/JAX的标准实现以f(A)∝1/√A采样裁剪尺度，与PyTorch遵循原始描述的实现存在差异，这一发现促使作者系统研究裁剪尺度分布对训练的影响。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k上训练522个ViT-S/16模型，覆盖多种训练预算与裁剪尺度分布；并在AdamW之外使用Scion优化器进行复现实验。
AI.result: 在90 epoch训练预算下达到78.78±0.09 top-1验证精度。发现：1）更高训练预算需要更强增强；2）裁剪尺度分布的下尾决定Inception crop的增强强度；3）更高训练预算训练的模型显著度更稀疏，且与裁剪尺度分布及权重衰减无关。基于结论2重新评估Beta crop，其更柔和的截断能在不同训练预算下以更小妥协优化性能；结论1和3在Scion优化器上也被复现。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪尺度分布的下尾是决定Inception crop增强强度的关键因素，这解释了Beta crop的优势；训练预算、增强强度与模型显著度之间的关系可能具有普遍性。

title: Learning Task and Motion Plans from Real Demonstrations with Hybrid Flow Matching
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning
summary: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a task plan and the motion that executes it. Generative planners trained on demonstration produce both in one pass, requiring neither a symbolic domain nor search. To date, however, they have relied on thousands of scripted demonstrations of fixed-base arms and executed open loop. This paper presents a hybrid flow matching planner: a single network generates the symbolic plan with masked discrete flow matching and the motion trajectory with continuous flow matching. Unlike prior generative planners, we aim to learn from a much smaller set of demonstrations and to execute the plan in closed loop. Two properties of the data compensate for the small dataset. A demonstration resumed from any of its intermediate actions is itself a demonstration, which multiplies the training samples and enables replanning after every action. Objects of the same kind are interchangeable, which turns demonstrations of one goal into demonstrations of every permuted goal. Our base implementation produces valid plans on 68% of held-out scenes; a training and generation scheme for the discrete plan raises this to 76%, and replanning after every action raises the task completion rate from 40% to 53% in a kinematic simulation. The planner matches the task completion rate of motion-only flow matching policies while additionally providing the symbolic plan, and it outperforms previous hybrid diffusion formulations on both task completion and plan validity. We validate the planner on a real mobile manipulator. Videos and project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning

AI.tldr: 提出混合流匹配规划器，单网络同时生成符号计划（掩码离散流匹配）与运动轨迹（连续流匹配），从小样本演示中学习并闭环执行，仿真与真机验证有效。
AI.motivation: 长时程移动操作需要任务规划与运动执行。现有生成式规划器依赖数千条固定基座机械臂的脚本演示且为开环执行，数据需求大、泛化与鲁棒性差。本文旨在用更少演示学习规划，并实现闭环执行。
AI.method: 混合流匹配规划器：单个网络用掩码离散流匹配生成符号计划，用连续流匹配生成运动轨迹。利用数据两性质补偿小数据：①任一中间动作续接的演示本身即演示，扩增样本并支持每步动作后重规划；②同类物体可互换，将单一目标演示转化为所有排列目标的演示。并设计离散计划的训练与生成方案。
AI.result: 基础实现在留出场景上生成有效计划的比例为68%，离散计划训练与生成方案提升至76%；每步重规划使运动学仿真任务完成率由40%升至53%。完成率与纯运动流匹配策略相当，且额外提供符号计划；在任务完成与计划有效性上优于先前的混合扩散方案。在真实移动机械臂上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 混合流匹配规划器可从小样本演示中学习符号计划与运动轨迹，并支持闭环重规划，兼顾计划有效性与任务完成率，具备真机可行性。项目页面：https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning

title: A Geometric-Transformation Feature-Adaptive Manifold Restoration Method for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
summary: The semantic information of objects in remote sensing images is typically invariant to geometric transformations from the dihedral group D4. However, SAM3-based open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) methods often exhibit inconsistent responses to different geometric transformations. To exploit this property and improve the stability of OVSS for remote sensing images, we propose a feature-adaptive manifold repair method based on dihedral-group geometric transformations. First, we introduce multi-scale harmonic-guided D4 view selection (MH-D4VS) to select complementary candidate views from a set of geometrically transformed views. Next, we propose original-view-anchored adaptive manifold repair (OAMR), which uses the original view as an anchor and reliable cross-view information to selectively repair locally unreliable visual features. Finally, we develop pixel decoder test-time adaptation (PD-TTA) for SAM3, which fine-tunes only the parameters of the GroupNorm layers online during inference, thereby enhancing the model's ability to adapt to sample-level distribution shifts. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves an average mIoU of 55.6% across eight remote sensing semantic segmentation benchmarks and delivers consistent performance improvements under different SAM3-based inference frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于二面体群几何变换的特征自适应流形修复方法，以提升遥感图像开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中目标的语义信息通常对二面体群 D4 的几何变换具有不变性，但基于 SAM3 的开放词汇语义分割方法对不同几何变换的响应往往不一致，导致分割稳定性不足。
AI.method: 方法包含三个模块：（1）多尺度调和引导 D4 视图选择（MH-D4VS），从几何变换视图集合中选取互补候选视图；（2）以原视图为锚点的自适应流形修复（OAMR），利用原视图作为锚点及可靠的跨视图信息，选择性修复局部不可靠的视觉特征；（3）像素解码器测试时适应（PD-TTA），在推理阶段仅在线微调 GroupNorm 层参数，增强模型对样本级分布偏移的适应能力。
AI.result: 在八个遥感语义分割基准上平均 mIoU 达到 55.6%，并在不同基于 SAM3 的推理框架下均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 利用 D4 几何变换特性进行特征自适应流形修复，可有效提升基于 SAM3 的遥感 OVSS 稳定性与分割性能。

title: VIGIL: Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop for Spreadsheet Question Answering
summary: Enterprise agents should improve from delayed feedback without allowing every correction to rewrite system behavior. We study continual harness learning for corpus-level spreadsheet question answering. Building on FiCo (Find-then-Compute), a static retrieval-and-execution backbone, we introduce VIGIL (Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop). Within a question, VIGIL verifies and repairs diversely prompted Structured Query Language (SQL) candidates. Across episodes, delayed labels update only a contract calibrator and query/result-column selector. The base model, prompts, retriever, and recorded candidate pool remain fixed in the continual-learning protocol. With the gold workbook and expected type supplied, the ungated and dual-gated full-replay variants reach 82.4% and 82.0% forward accuracy over 79 documents, from a 75.8% static baseline. The dual gate has the larger retrospective gain (2.7 versus 2.3 points), and its 6.3-point forward gain has a 95% t-interval of 5.6-6.9. In a separate stricter split that excludes 16 documents and 380 questions from fitting and online promotion, the accuracy-only gate raises mean held-out accuracy across ten final harnesses from 80.3% to 86.7%. Calibrator-only adaptation gains 5.9 points, close to the combined 6.4-point gain. Yet three of 26 gate-approved updates reduce held-out accuracy relative to their incumbents, so replay-buffer non-regression does not imply held-out non-regression. MiMoTable and external-task case studies test within-task verification and reuse the same promote-or-retain discipline. Overall, the results support bounded, auditable harness adaptation while revealing where finite replay gates fail to generalize beyond their promotion buffers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VIGIL（Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop），在 FiCo 静态检索-执行骨架上实现语料级电子表格问答的持续 harness 学习：问题内做 SQL 候选验证与修复，跨回合仅用延迟标签更新 contract 校准器与查询/结果列选择器；并用门控回放缓冲提升前向与留出精度，同时揭示有限回放门无法保证留出非退化。
AI.motivation: 企业代理需要从延迟反馈中改进，但不能让每次纠正都改写系统整体行为。因此需要一个有界、可审计的持续学习机制：仅在受限组件上适应，保持基础模型、提示、检索器与候选池固定，避免灾难性重写。
AI.method: 基于 FiCo（Find-then-Compute）静态检索-执行主干，构建 VIGIL：问题内对多种提示生成的 SQL 候选进行验证与修复；跨回放回合中，延迟标签仅更新 contract 校准器和查询/结果列选择器，基础模型、提示、检索器及已记录候选池保持冻结。比较无门控、双门控与 accuracy-only 门控的全回放变体，并以 replay-buffer 非退化作为晋级条件（promote-or-retain）。
AI.result: 在 79 份文档上，提供 gold workbook 与期望类型时，无门控与双门控全回放变体前向准确率达 82.4% 与 82.0%，静态基线为 75.8%；双门控回溯增益更大（2.7 vs 2.3 点），前向增益 6.3 点，95% t 区间 5.6–6.9。在排除 16 份文档、380 个问题的更严格划分下，accuracy-only 门控将十个最终 harness 的平均留出准确率从 80.3% 提升至 86.7%；仅校准器适应增益 5.9 点，接近组合增益 6.4 点。但 26 次门控批准更新中有 3 次使留出准确率低于被替换版本，说明回放缓冲非退化不代表留出非退化。MiMoTable 与外部任务案例研究验证了任务内验证与同一 promote-or-retain 纪律。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持有界、可审计的 harness 适应，同时指出有限回放门在推广到晋级缓冲之外时可能失效，即回放非回归不足以保证留出集非回归。

title: How RL Reshapes LLM Reasoning: Transferability, Coverage, and Scaling Laws
summary: Recent studies on reinforcement learning (RL) report seemingly conflicting evidence about large language model (LLM) reasoning. Training on mathematics can improve performance in other domains, yet gains in Pass@1 can coincide with lower Pass@$N$ than the base model. This raises a fundamental question: does RL expand an LLM's reasoning boundary, or merely reweight its existing reasoning space? We revisit these phenomena across Qwen and Gemma model families, showing both cross-domain gains and forgetting, while coverage at large sampling budgets increases on some tasks and decreases on others. Detailed analysis of solution traces before and after RL indicates a shift in the reasoning strategies the model employs, motivating a two-stage autoregressive policy model that separates \emph{strategy selection} from problem-specific execution. Within this framework, we prove how RL's implicit bias reshapes strategy preferences, allowing gains on some tasks while suppressing strategies required by others. This mechanism can also broaden or narrow coverage at a given sampling budget even without expanding strategy support. We further provide theoretical justifications for log-sigmoid and log-linear scaling laws in RL compute, and evaluate their predictive power. Together, these results connect changes in strategy selection to cross-domain transfer, reasoning coverage, and compute scaling.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨强化学习（RL）究竟扩大还是仅重新加权LLM的推理空间，通过Qwen与Gemma实验、策略选择分析与两阶段自回归策略模型，证明RL主要通过隐式偏置重塑策略偏好，而非扩展策略支持，并给出算力缩放律的理论解释。
AI.motivation: 近期RL研究对LLM推理给出的证据看似矛盾：数学训练能提升其他领域表现，但Pass@1提升可能与Pass@N低于基座模型并存。核心问题是RL到底扩展了LLM的推理边界，还是仅在其已有推理空间内重新分配概率权重，这一根本问题尚未澄清。
AI.method: 在Qwen与Gemma系列模型上复现上述现象，观察跨域增益与遗忘、以及大采样预算下覆盖率有增有减；对RL前后的解题轨迹进行分析以识别推理策略变化；提出两阶段自回归策略模型，将"策略选择"与"问题特定执行"分离；在此框架内理论证明RL隐式偏置如何重塑策略偏好；并对RL算力中的log-sigmoid与log-linear缩放律给出理论论证并评估其预测能力。
AI.result: 实验显示RL同时带来跨域增益与遗忘，大采样预算下覆盖率在部分任务上升、部分任务下降；轨迹分析表明模型所用推理策略发生转移；理论分析证明RL隐式偏置会改变策略偏好，可在不扩展策略支持的情况下使某些任务增益而抑制其他任务所需策略，并在给定采样预算下拓宽或收窄覆盖率；log-sigmoid与log-linear缩放律得到理论支持并具备一定预测力。
AI.conclusion: RL并未真正扩展LLM的推理边界，而主要是通过隐式偏置重塑策略选择偏好，这统一解释了跨域迁移、推理覆盖率变化与算力缩放三方面现象，为理解RL对LLM推理的作用提供了策略选择视角的理论与实证框架。

title: Distributed Cascade Force Control of Soft-Tactile-Based Multi-robot System for Object Transportation
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. Published in the 2024 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
summary: In this paper, we present a distributed cascade force control system (DCFC) for multiple robots with the aim of pushing a rigid object towards a desired moving target without their inter-robot communication. These mobile robots are equipped with 360-degree vision-based soft tactile sensors utilized to determine contact location and resultant impact force. By investigating the dynamics of moving rigid objects on the flat, we proposed a distributed cascade control. The inner loop control incorporates contact force and positioning, ensuring the robots' pushing contact and application of the desired force to the object. The outer loop control coordinates the robots to push the object in a desired direction without inter-robot communication, regardless of the unknown object mass. The stability and convergence of the system are verified using the Lyapunov stability theory. We also conducted simulation and real-word experiments to validate the performance of the proposed control method, and the experimental results showcase the successful coordination of multiple robots in pushing an object towards a moving desired direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分布式级联力控系统（DCFC），使多机器人无需机器人间通信即可将刚性物体推向移动目标；通过360度视触觉软传感器感知接触位置与合力，采用内环（接触力与定位）和外环（无通信协同定向）级联控制，并用Lyapunov理论验证稳定性，仿真与实机实验验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同推动刚性物体至移动目标通常依赖机器人间通信，而通信受限或不可用时协同难以实现；同时物体质量未知、目标移动等因素增加了控制难度。因此需要一种无需机器人间通信的分布式力控方法。
AI.method: 机器人配备360度视触觉软传感器以确定接触位置与合力；基于平面上移动刚性物体的动力学分析，设计分布式级联控制：内环控制融合接触力与定位，保证机器人接触并施加期望力；外环控制在无机器人间通信条件下协同各机器人将物体推向期望方向，且不依赖已知物体质量；采用Lyapunov稳定性理论验证系统稳定性与收敛性。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验验证了所提控制方法的性能，实验结果表明多机器人能够成功协同将物体推向移动的期望方向。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的DCFC可在无机器人间通信、物体质量未知的条件下，实现多机器人对刚性物体的协同推动并跟踪移动期望方向，稳定性与收敛性由Lyapunov理论保证，仿真与实机实验证实了方法的可行性与协同性能。

title: Rethinking Long-Video Efficiency: A Joint Allocation Perspective on Frames, Pixels, and Front-End Latency
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi
summary: Efficient long-video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) is often framed as selecting informative frames or visual tokens at a fixed native resolution. We show that per-frame resolution can instead be traded for denser temporal coverage, while front-end decoding latency depends on the size of the candidate pool rather than the final token budget. An empirical study across multiple VLMs and long-video benchmarks yields three findings: dense low-resolution sampling outperforms sparse native-resolution sampling at matched token budgets; resolution-sensitive tasks benefit from selected high-resolution frames; and front-end decoding dominates wall time for hour-long videos. Motivated by these findings, we introduce LoHi, a training-free, single-pass framework that combines a dense low-resolution video stream with sparse high-resolution image frames through the VLM's native video and image pathways. LoHi-Anchor selects high-resolution frames using codec I-frame metadata, while LoHi-SemDiv uses query relevance and visual diversity over CLIP features. Across three long-video benchmarks, LoHi improves average accuracy by 10.6 percentage points over the native-resolution baseline at a matched token budget and by 5.2 percentage points over the strongest prior efficiency method. It also reduces front-end decoding latency by up to 7x on hour-long videos. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi

AI.tldr: 论文提出LoHi框架，证明在固定token预算下，可用低分辨率密集帧换取更密时间覆盖，并辅以稀疏高分辨率帧，兼顾效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解中，VLM通常通过固定原生分辨率下选择信息帧或视觉token来实现高效处理，忽略了分辨率与时间覆盖之间的权衡，且前端解码延迟受候选池大小影响而非最终token预算。
AI.method: 提出LoHi，一种免训练、单遍框架，将密集低分辨率视频流与稀疏高分辨率图像帧通过VLM原生视频和图像通道结合。其中LoHi-Anchor利用编解码器I帧元数据选择高分辨率帧，LoHi-SemDiv基于CLIP特征的查询相关性和视觉多样性选择高分辨率帧。
AI.result: 在三个长视频基准上，匹配token预算下平均准确率比原生分辨率基线提升10.6个百分点，比最强先前效率方法提升5.2个百分点；在长达一小时的视频上前端解码延迟最多降低7倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明分辨率与时间覆盖可相互替换，密集低分辨率采样在匹配预算下优于稀疏原生分辨率采样，结合稀疏高分辨率帧可兼顾分辨率敏感任务，LoHi在精度和延迟上均显著优于现有方法。

title: LMBuild: Evaluating LLM Agents for Generating Buildable and Functional Structures
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly capable of generating complex 3D structures, with the potential to reshape how objects are designed and realized in the physical world. Yet, producing elegant geometry is fundamentally different from producing objects that can be built and perform their intended functions. Existing evaluations largely focus on geometric quality while overlooking physical realizability. We introduce LMBuild, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on generating buildable and functional structures. LMBuild represents generated objects as assembled structures comprising part decompositions, joints, materials, and sequences. To support reproducible evaluation, we provide a unified framework consisting of: (1) an interactive environment in which agents can use tools to retrieve, create, and place components to construct objects; (2) a curated benchmark that repurposes established CAD datasets and augments them with knowledge from Wikipedia; and (3) a evaluation framework covering structural soundness, functional affordance, design quality, and physical realization. Evaluations across 30 systems reveal several intriguing findings: (a) Soundness and alignment are no longer the primary bottlenecks for frontier closed-source models, while functional affordance and physical operability remain substantially more challenging; (b) stronger models more effectively create new components, whereas weaker models tend to rely on retrieval; and (c) providing functional specifications substantially improves part completeness, kinematics, and physical operability. These results show that generating real-world structures requires deeper reasoning about functional affordances, mechanics, and designing and creating novel components. We expect LMBuild to provide a foundation for measuring progress and incentivizing research toward agents that generate buildable and functional structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LMBuild，一个评测 LLM 智能体生成"可建造且具功能性"三维结构的基准，涵盖零件分解、连接、材料与装配序列，并提供交互环境、基准数据集与四维评测框架，在 30 个系统上进行了评测。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 生成评测过度关注几何质量，忽视对象能否在物理世界中被建造并实现功能；而"生成优雅几何"与"生成可建造、可使用的对象"本质不同，缺乏可复现的物理可实现性评测手段。
AI.method: LMBuild 将生成对象表示为包含零件分解、连接（joints）、材料和装配序列的装配结构，并构建统一框架：(1) 可交互环境，智能体通过工具检索、创建、放置组件；(2) 整理后的基准，改造既有 CAD 数据集并用维基百科知识增强；(3) 评测框架，覆盖结构稳固性、功能可供性、设计质量与物理可实现性四个维度。
AI.result: 对 30 个系统的评测揭示：(a) 前沿闭源模型在稳固性与对齐上已非主要瓶颈，而功能可供性与物理可操作性仍显著困难；(b) 更强的模型更善于创建新组件，较弱模型倾向依赖检索；(c) 提供功能规格可显著提升零件完整性、运动学与物理可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 生成真实世界结构需要更深入地推理功能可供性、力学机制以及新组件的设计与创造；LMBuild 为衡量进展、推动面向可建造且具功能性结构生成的智能体研究提供基础。

title: Principled Top-$k$ Selection for Language Models with Hybrid Gradients
summary: Selecting the best $k$ items out of $m$ candidates is a critical component of modern large language model systems, such as document selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs). However, training these selection modules remains challenging due to weak gradient signals and suboptimal exploration-exploitation tradeoffs. Furthermore, prior works often rely on heuristics, lacking principled objectives and approaches that explicitly model and solve the top-$k$ selection problem. In this work, we propose a principled objective for training selection modules, whose gradient naturally provides richer training signals in a hybrid form---containing a supervised-gradient component and a policy-gradient component. We show that the selection problem becomes harder as $m$ increases, and our algorithm converges at rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$, with the optimal upper bound achieved by balancing between bias and variance. Practically, we apply our method to a set of tasks involving top-$k$ selection, including synthetic regression problems, RAG, and MoE systems, showing that our method outperforms the baselines in next-token prediction perplexity and QA accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向 top-$k$ 选择模块的原则性训练目标，其梯度天然融合监督梯度与策略梯度分量，算法以 $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ 收敛，并在合成回归、RAG、MoE 等任务上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现代 LLM 系统中的 top-$k$ 选择（如 RAG 的文档选择、MoE 的专家路由）至关重要，但训练选择模块存在梯度信号弱、探索-利用权衡不佳的问题；已有工作多依赖启发式，缺乏对 top-$k$ 选择问题显式建模与求解的原则性目标与方法。
AI.method: 提出一个原则性目标函数用于训练选择模块，其梯度以混合形式给出更丰富的训练信号，包含监督梯度分量与策略梯度分量；理论分析表明选择难度随候选数 $m$ 增大而提升，算法收敛率为 $O(1/\sqrt{T})$，并通过偏差-方差平衡达到最优上界。
AI.result: 在涉及 top-$k$ 选择的多类任务上验证，包括合成回归问题、RAG 与 MoE 系统；相比基线，在下一 token 预测困惑度和 QA 准确率上均取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 top-$k$ 选择模块提供了具备理论保证的原则性训练框架，兼顾丰富梯度信号与最优收敛率，并在实际 LLM 相关任务中验证了有效性。

title: ExStereo: Lifting 2D Vision-Language-Action Models to 3D with Explicit Stereo Representations
summary: Three-dimensional perception is critical for robotic manipulation, particularly for high-precision tasks, as recovering metric depth and precise 3D object positions from monocular RGB observations is inherently ill-posed. However, many Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely solely on RGB observations for perception. Leveraging recent advances in foundation models for stereo matching, we introduce ExStereo, a stereo module that augments pre-trained 2D VLAs with 3D perception. ExStereo reconstructs scene geometry from stereo image pairs and renders multi-view observations as an explicit stereo representation for stereo feature extraction. The action tokens from the action expert selectively attend to the resulting stereo tokens through our proposed action-stereo cross-attention mechanism, enabling the policy to generate robot actions conditioned on 3D scene information. To learn robust 3D representations, we introduce a mid-training stage before task-specific post-training, using a self-supervised learning objective on large-scale stereo data. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two publicly available VLAs, $π_{0.5}$ and SmolVLA, and evaluate them in simulation and on a real-world bimanual PiPER platform. Across both settings, VLAs fine-tuned with ExStereo consistently outperform baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of stereo perception for robotic manipulation. Our project website is at: https://exstereo-vla.github.io/ExStereo/.

AI.tldr: ExStereo 通过立体匹配基础模型为仅依赖RGB的VLA模型补充3D感知，利用多视角立体表征与action-stereo交叉注意力生成以3D场景信息为条件的机器人动作，在仿真与真实双机械臂平台上均超越基线。
AI.motivation: 三维感知对机器人操作尤其是高精度任务至关重要，而从单目RGB恢复度量深度和精确3D物体位置本质上是病态问题；但许多VLA模型仅依赖RGB观测进行感知，缺乏3D信息。
AI.method: 提出ExStereo立体模块：基于立体匹配基础模型，从立体图像对重建场景几何，并将多视角观测渲染为显式立体表征以提取立体特征；通过action-stereo交叉注意力机制，使动作专家的动作token选择性地关注立体token，从而以3D场景信息为条件生成动作；并在任务特定后训练前引入中期训练阶段，利用大规模立体数据上的自监督学习目标学习鲁棒的3D表征。
AI.result: 在仿真环境和真实双机械臂PiPER平台上，对两个公开VLA模型π0.5与SmolVLA进行微调验证，ExStereo微调的VLA在两种设置下均一致优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明立体感知可有效增强机器人操作能力，为预训练2D VLA补充3D感知是一条可行且有效的技术路径。

title: Trust the View That Sees the Target: Mining Cross-View Conflicts for Reliability-Gated Disaster Damage Assessment
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures; Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 5th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Searching and Mining Large Collections of Geospatial Data (GeoSearch '26), held November 3-6, 2026, in Riverside, California, USA
summary: After a disaster, building damage is assessed from overhead tiles and ground-level photographs, and most methods fuse the two views symmetrically, trusting both equally for every building. This paper focuses on the samples where that assumption fails: the conflict cases, on which two independently trained single-view models disagree. We mine such cases from three paired collections (inspection photographs from the 2025 Eaton wildfire and street-view panoramas from Hurricanes Ian and Milton, each matched to very-high-resolution overhead tiles), where they make up 10-33% of the data. On these samples an oracle that simply trusts the correct view beats every fusion method we tested by 0.37-0.41 accuracy, and the gap survives longer training, calibration, and backbone changes. We recover part of it with a visibility-conditioned reliability gate: a linear model that decides which view to trust from building-visibility features, calibrated per-view confidences, and the disagreement itself. On the wildfire data the gate is the only method that significantly beats calibrated probability averaging (+0.051 on conflicts, p=0.0001) and end-to-end fusion (+0.072, p<10^-4); on the panoramic datasets it matches them. A controlled field-of-view experiment explains why: cropping panoramas toward the building doubles the benefit of fusion, whereas random crops of the same size do not. Finally, the spatial density of conflicts predicts tile-level damage without labels (Spearman r=0.615, p=0.001). Mining conflicts turns "does fusion help?" into "which view should be trusted, where, and why?".

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过挖掘单视角模型冲突样本来评估和改进多视角融合，并设计可见性条件可靠性门控，在野火数据上显著优于校准概率平均与端到端融合。
AI.motivation: 灾后建筑损伤评估通常融合航拍瓦片与地面照片，但多数方法对称地同等信任两个视角。作者关注该假设失效的冲突样本，即两个独立训练的单视角模型发生分歧的样本，从而将问题从"融合是否有用"转为"在何处、为何应信任哪个视角"。
AI.method: 从三个配对数据集（2025年Eaton野火的巡检照片、Hurricanes Ian与Milton的街景全景，均匹配超高分辨率航拍瓦片）中挖掘冲突样本，占比10–33%。提出可见性条件可靠性门控：基于建筑可见性特征、逐视角校准置信度及分歧本身，用线性模型决定信任哪个视角。并进行视野可控实验，将全景裁剪朝向建筑与随机等尺寸裁剪对比。
AI.result: 在冲突样本上，简单信任正确视角的oracle比所有测试的融合方法准确率高0.37–0.41，且该差距在更长训练、校准与骨干网络更换后依然存在。门控在野火数据上是唯一显著优于校准概率平均（冲突上+0.051，p=0.0001）与端到端融合（+0.072，p<10^-4）的方法；在全景数据上与二者持平。朝建筑裁剪使融合收益翻倍，随机裁剪则无此效果。冲突的空间密度可无标签预测瓦片级损伤（Spearman r=0.615，p=0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 挖掘冲突样本可揭示对称融合的局限，可见性条件可靠性门控能部分恢复oracle差距，且冲突空间密度可作为无标签损伤预测信号。

title: Language-Conditioned Token and Reasoning Efficiency in Large Language Models: A Paired Cross-Lingual Study Protocol
comment: 32 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Prospective paired study protocol; no confirmatory model outcomes are reported
summary: Large language models incur language-dependent representation and inference costs, but existing comparisons often conflate input language, assigned observable-trace language, and answer realization. We specify a prospective paired study that separates these interfaces while holding the semantic item, checkpoint, and answer oracle fixed. The initial design instantiates 240 exactly scored items rendered from templates in English and seven non-English languages, three distinct-lineage open-weight checkpoints, three trace-token budgets, 22 input- and trace-language conditions, a fixed answer reserve, and a separately counted delimiter: 47,520 initial core runs before prospective sample-size selection. RQ1-RQ3 estimate input and trace effects by intention-to-treat with failure-inclusive terminal accounting and test answer realization by cloning a sealed prefix and runtime-native KV state into eight crossed branches. Pre-freeze independent language review, fixed-form ASCII selectors, and code/surface/solver agreement constrain the realization test. H1-H5 share one Holm family and a global simultaneous component band. A secondary randomized experiment compares one-long-attempt and complete K-short-attempt policies at equal trace allowance under frozen seeds and oracle-blind aggregation; it is a full-policy contrast because answer capacity differs. Outcomes include exact token spans, correctness, latency, runtime-exposed memory, and qualified same-host operating-system-reported energy over prespecified hardware rails. The protocol separates tokenizer expansion, observable-trace cost, and answer-realization cost without treating visible traces as internal cognition or operating-system estimates as physical cross-device energy. No confirmatory model outcome is reported; result fields remain disabled until the frozen evidence ledger passes independent verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个前瞻性配对实验方案（尚无结果），将大模型的"语言成本"拆分为输入语言、可观测轨迹语言与答案实现三个接口，在固定语义项、检查点和答案oracle前提下比较英/非英语表现，并给出主实验与第二阶段随机实验的设计框架。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型跨语言成本比较常将输入语言、被分配的可观测轨迹语言与答案实现混为一谈，导致语言相关表征与推理成本的结论含义不清。需要一套前瞻性配对设计将这三类接口分离，同时固定语义项、模型检查点与答案oracle，以获得可归因的效应估计。
AI.method: 前瞻性配对研究设计：240个精确计分项目，由模板渲染为英语及7种非英语语言；3个不同谱系的开源权重检查点；3种轨迹token预算；22种输入/轨迹语言条件；固定答案预留；分隔符单独计数。初始核心运行47,520次（样本量先于前瞻性选择）。RQ1–RQ3用意向性治疗（ITT）估计输入与轨迹效应，采用含失败的终态记账；答案实现检验通过克隆密封前缀与运行时原生KV状态到8个交叉分支实现。冻结前独立语言审查、固定形式ASCII选择器、代码/表面/求解器一致性共同约束实现检验。H1–H5共用一个Holm族与全局同时置信带。次级随机实验在相同轨迹配额下比较"一次长尝试"与"完整K次短尝试"策略，固定种子、oracle盲聚合，属全策略对比（因答案容量不同）。
AI.result: 无确证性模型结果报告；结果字段在冻结证据台账通过独立验证前保持禁用。结果指标包括精确token跨度、正确性、延迟、运行时暴露内存及在预设硬件轨内限定的同主机操作系统报告能耗。
AI.conclusion: 该协议将tokenizer扩展、可观测轨迹成本与答案实现成本三者分离，且不将可见轨迹等同于内部认知、也不将操作系统能耗估计等同于跨设备物理能量。方法学上的核心贡献是接口分解与预注册式证据治理。

title: Clean: Second-order LLM Training at Linear Memory Cost via Nyström Sketching
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) entails a fundamental trade-off: memory-efficient optimizers such as Adam discard cross-parameter curvature, whereas full-curvature methods such as SOAP can accelerate convergence at prohibitive memory costs. We introduce Clean, a memory-efficient and full-curvature optimizer designed to resolve this bottleneck. Clean leverages the randomized Nystrom method to accurately approximate the left and right preconditioners in SOAP, and to reduce the optimizer's memory complexity from quadratic to linear in terms of model dimensions. We subsequently reintegrate the off-subspace components to capture curvature information beyond the low-rank approximation, preserving rich curvature at minimal memory cost. We further propose Q-Clean, a low-precision variant that aggressively compresses optimizer states. Q-Clean reduces optimizer memory consumption by \textbf{over 50\%} compared to Muon when pre-training a LLaMA-1.3B architecture, all while maintaining strong and competitive predictive performance. Notably, Clean operates with a smaller optimizer-state footprint than standard AdamW while reaching AdamW's final performance \textbf{26\% faster} in wall-clock time. Furthermore, our methods uniquely enable the pre-training of a 13B-parameter model on a single 80GB GPU, providing a scalable, efficient, and accessible approach to large-scale model optimization.

AI.tldr: Clean 是一种内存高效的全曲率优化器，利用随机 Nystrom 方法将 SOAP 的左右预条件器从二次内存复杂度降至线性，并重新整合非子空间分量以保留丰富曲率信息；其低精度变体 Q-Clean 进一步压缩优化器状态。
AI.motivation: LLM 训练存在根本性权衡：Adam 等内存高效优化器丢弃跨参数曲率，而 SOAP 等全曲率方法虽能加速收敛但内存开销过高。本文旨在解决这一内存与收敛速度之间的瓶颈。
AI.method: Clean 采用随机 Nystrom 方法精确近似 SOAP 中的左、右预条件器，将优化器内存复杂度从关于模型维度的二次降为线性；随后重新整合非子空间分量，以在极低内存成本下捕获低秩近似之外的曲率信息。并进一步提出低精度变体 Q-Clean，激进压缩优化器状态。
AI.result: 在预训练 LLaMA-1.3B 架构时，Q-Clean 相比 Muon 将优化器内存消耗降低超过 50%，同时保持强劲且有竞争力的预测性能。Clean 的优化器状态占用小于标准 AdamW，却在墙钟时间上比 AdamW 快 26% 达到其最终性能。此外，本文方法首次支持在单张 80GB GPU 上预训练 13B 参数模型。
AI.conclusion: Clean 与 Q-Clean 为大规模模型优化提供了一种可扩展、高效且易于使用的方法，在显著降低内存占用的同时保持甚至提升收敛效率与预测性能。

title: Tackling Sim-to-Real Mismatch Through Sampling-Based Disturbance Observers: From Analytical Models to Learned World Models
comment: 15 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables. Project website: https://sampling-based-dob.github.io/
summary: Robotic controllers increasingly rely on analytical models, simulators, cost-query interfaces, and learned world models. However, physical deployment can deviate from nominal assumptions, and additional disturbances may arise even when the model itself is accurate. In control systems, disturbance observers (DOB) are widely used to estimate such unmeasured effects from nominal models and measured feedback. Classical DOB formulations are generally built around explicit plant models. This paper develops the sampling-based disturbance observer (SDOB), extending the DOB principle to a broader range of models, including simulators and learned world models, through state-rollout or cost-query interfaces. SDOB separates two observable channels: state-effect disturbances, for which the feedback state differs from its prediction, and cost disturbances, for which the same query state receives different costs as the perceived environment changes. Diverse simulation and real-robot experiments across traditional and learned models demonstrate the effectiveness of SDOB in compensating for sim-to-real mismatch and improving control performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于采样的扰动观测器（SDOB），将经典DOB原理从显式被控对象模型扩展到仿真器和学习世界模型，通过状态推演或代价查询接口分离并估计状态效应扰动与代价扰动。
AI.motivation: 机器人控制器日益依赖解析模型、仿真器、代价查询接口和学习世界模型，但物理部署常偏离名义假设；即使模型本身准确，仍可能出现额外扰动，而经典DOB通常仅围绕显式被控对象模型构建，难以适用于仿真器和学习模型。
AI.method: 提出采样型扰动观测器（SDOB），通过状态推演或代价查询接口，将DOB原理推广到仿真器与学习世界模型；其核心是分离两条可观测通道——状态效应扰动（反馈状态偏离预测）与代价扰动（感知环境变化导致同一查询状态获得不同代价）。
AI.result: 在传统模型与学习模型上开展了多种仿真和真实机器人实验，结果表明SDOB能有效补偿仿真到现实的失配并提升控制性能。
AI.conclusion: SDOB可作为经典DOB的泛化形式，在仅有状态推演或代价查询接口的黑箱模型下实现扰动估计，为仿真器与学习世界模型驱动的机器人控制提供扰动补偿能力。

title: Synthetic-to-Real ViT-Based Pose Estimation of a Noncooperative UAV
summary: Remote pose estimation of noncooperative Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from imagery is critical, as they cannot be influenced or instrumented in advance. Deep-learning-based approaches offer a promising solution; however, their development is constrained by the cost and difficulty of acquiring large-scale real-world datasets with accurate pose labels. Synthetic imagery provides an alternative, but models trained on synthetic data must overcome the synthetic-to-real domain gap to generalize to real-world imagery. This work investigates the inherent synthetic-to-real generalization capability of a Vision Transformer (ViT)-based model for monocular UAV pose estimation. The proposed approach employs a self-supervised DINOv2 backbone and is trained exclusively on labeled synthetic imagery while being evaluated on labeled real-world imagery. Pose ambiguity-aware strategies are incorporated during training and inference to address ambiguities arising from the projection of a three-dimensional target onto a two-dimensional image plane and from target symmetries. An $α$-$β$ filter is further integrated during inference to improve pose estimations. To assess the model under operational requirements, it is evaluated in terms of Mean Angular Error (MAE) and inference time, both before and after filtering, using a real-world dataset containing 77,077 labeled UAV images. Before filtering, the model achieves an MAE of $19.18^{\circ}$ and an inference time of $13.25$ ms, whereas after filtering, these values are $8.74^{\circ}$ and $13.42$ ms, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于ViT的单目无人机位姿估计在合成到真实场景下的泛化能力，使用DINOv2自监督骨干、位姿歧义感知策略及α-β滤波，在真实数据集上实现滤波后MAE 8.74°、推理时间13.42毫秒。
AI.motivation: 非合作无人机无法预先干预或加装设备，只能远距离视觉估计位姿；深度学习方案受限于大规模真实标注数据获取成本高、难度大，而合成数据训练的模型面临合成到真实的域间差异问题，因此需验证模型固有的跨域泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用DINOv2自监督ViT骨干，仅在带标注的合成图像上训练，在带标注的真实图像上评估；训练与推理阶段引入位姿歧义感知策略，处理三维目标投影到二维图像平面及目标对称性带来的歧义；推理阶段集成α-β滤波器以改善位姿估计。
AI.result: 在包含77,077张带标注无人机图像的真实数据集上，滤波前MAE为19.18°、推理时间13.25毫秒；滤波后MAE降至8.74°、推理时间13.42毫秒。
AI.conclusion: ViT-based模型具备一定的合成到真实域泛化能力，结合歧义感知策略与α-β滤波可在基本不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升单目无人机位姿估计精度。

title: EnvDreamer: Large-Scale Multimodal-to-Environment Generation for Embodied AI
summary: Large datasets and high capacity models have accelerated progress in vision and language. This work introduces a platform aimed at bringing comparable gains to embodied learning, world models, and robotics. We present EnvDreamer, a framework that uses large language and vision language models to generate Unreal Engine 5 environments for embodied AI and robot training. EnvDreamer enables sampling of large, diverse, interactive, customizable, and validator passed virtual environments for training and evaluation across navigation, interaction, and manipulation. We illustrate the platform with a large set of generated scenes and simple baselines. Policies trained on EnvDreamer generated environments, without explicit mapping or human task supervision, achieve competitive results on multiple embodied benchmarks spanning navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation. EnvDreamer also supports image-conditioned reconstruction for real-to-sim studies. Finally, we release EnvDreamer-20k, a dataset of 20,000 validator passed environments with task programs, scene graphs, trajectories, and metadata to support reproducible benchmarking.

AI.tldr: EnvDreamer 是一个利用大语言与视觉语言模型生成 Unreal Engine 5 虚拟环境的框架，用于具身 AI 与机器人训练的规模化环境生成。
AI.motivation: 视觉与语言领域因大规模数据和高容量模型取得快速进展，但具身学习、世界模型与机器人领域尚缺乏可比拟的规模化环境与数据支撑，因此需要一个能大规模生成多样、可交互、可定制的虚拟环境的平台。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型与视觉语言模型自动生成 Unreal Engine 5 环境；支持采样大规模、多样、可交互、可定制且通过校验的虚拟环境，覆盖导航、交互与操作任务；并支持图像条件下的重建以用于 real-to-sim 研究。
AI.result: 在无显式建图与人工任务监督的情况下，于 EnvDreamer 生成环境上训练的策略在导航、重排与操作等多个具身基准上取得竞争性结果；同时发布 EnvDreamer-20k 数据集，包含 20,000 个通过校验的环境及任务程序、场景图、轨迹与元数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为具身 AI 与机器人学习提供了可扩展的虚拟环境生成平台与大规模数据集，支持可复现的基准评测与 real-to-sim 研究。

title: FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel
summary: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出 FTD-GNO，将图神经算子的高维连续积分核解耦为低维逐模态函数，用 CP、TT、Tucker 张量分解实现核的代数重构，无需显式生成全边核张量，从而显著降低内存与参数开销。
AI.motivation: 标准图神经算子（GNO）用单一神经网络参数化积分核，并在图边上评估核交互；在高分辨率或大邻域下带来显著的计算与内存开销，需要一种更节省内存的算子学习框架。
AI.method: 提出 Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator（FTD-GNO）：把高维连续积分核分解为低维逐模态（mode-wise）函数，并以经典张量分解格式（CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker）实例化核，实现积分算子的代数重构，避免显式物化完整的逐边核张量，同时保留 GNO 的连续算子学习结构。
AI.result: 理论复杂度分析表明，FTD-GNO 显著降低高维核构建相关的参数与激活内存成本；实验中峰值内存低于对应的未分解图积分基线，训练时间更短；Fourier-graph 实验显示 FTD 能提升混合算子中图积分层的效率，并具有良好可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: FTD-GNO 通过张量分解的因式化核表示，在保持连续算子学习能力的同时有效缓解 GNO 的内存与计算瓶颈，是一种内存高效且可扩展的图神经算子框架。

title: GJK-CBF: Control Barrier Functions for Convex Rigid Body Collision Avoidance on SE(3)
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Demo video: https://youtu.be/eDvscHhGIj0. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Code will be released upon publication
summary: Collision avoidance among convex bodies is a fundamental problem in robotics. Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) provide a practical framework for real-time safety filtering due to their computational efficiency. For general convex bodies, exact separation measures, such as distance or scaling factor, are typically computed through optimization. Existing CBF formulations often obtain the required gradient via differentiable optimization (diffOpt), adding computational overhead. In contrast, we leverage the Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi (GJK) algorithm to obtain the current witness pair---the pair of points realizing the minimum distance or penetration depth---and formulate a CBF, termed GJK-CBF, whose gradient is constructed directly from the relative rigid-body motion of the witness pair, without resorting to diffOpt. This formulation applies to both 2D and 3D environments across a broad class of convex body pairs, provided that at least one in each one-to-one interaction is strictly convex. The proposed GJK-CBF is validated in various scenarios, including multi-robot position swapping in both 2D and 3D, navigation through a vertical slit in 3D, and its applicability to manipulators. The results demonstrate collision-free motion across all scenarios while reducing the conservativeness introduced by geometric approximations, particularly in narrow environments.

AI.tldr: 提出GJK-CBF：利用GJK算法得到witness pair，直接从刚体相对运动构造CBF梯度，避免可微优化开销，在2D/3D多场景实现无碰撞运动。
AI.motivation: 凸体间的碰撞避免是机器人学基础问题。CBF因计算高效而适用于实时安全滤波，但一般凸体的精确分离度量（距离或缩放因子）需通过优化求解。现有CBF方法常依赖可微优化（diffOpt）获取所需梯度，带来额外计算开销。因此作者希望在不使用diffOpt的前提下，高效构造CBF梯度。
AI.method: 采用Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi（GJK）算法获取当前witness pair，即实现最小距离或穿透深度的一对点；据此构造名为GJK-CBF的控制障碍函数，其梯度直接由witness pair的相对刚体运动构造，无需可微优化。该方法适用于2D与3D环境，覆盖广泛的凸体对，前提是每个一一交互中至少有一个体是严格凸的。
AI.result: 在多种场景中验证了GJK-CBF，包括2D与3D多机器人位置交换、3D竖直狭缝导航以及机械臂应用。结果表明：所有场景均实现无碰撞运动，同时减少了由几何近似引入的保守性，尤其在狭窄环境中效果显著。
AI.conclusion: GJK-CBF通过GJK的witness pair直接构造梯度，绕开了可微优化的计算开销，在保持实时性的同时实现凸体碰撞避免，并在狭窄环境中显著降低几何近似带来的保守性，具备向机械臂等应用推广的潜力。

title: A differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics
summary: Recent advances in generative world models have increased interest in digital models that reproduce both the appearance of real objects and their response to physical interaction. Three-dimensional reconstruction techniques, including 3D Gaussian Splatting, capture detailed surface geometry and appearance from images and videos. However, extending these representations beyond plausible animation to mechanically interpretable models for constitutive behavior, boundary conditions, and inverse parameter identification remains less explored. In this work, a differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) model is proposed for forward simulation and inverse analysis of deformable solids. The observed object is first reconstructed from multi-view calibrated visual dataset as a 3DGS rendering model. An envelope-based procedure then generates an independent SPH support for the solid-mechanics model, avoiding the direct use of rendering primitives as mechanical particles. A reference-configuration Lagrangian transfer maps SPH deformation to Gaussian positions and covariances, thereby coupling the physical model and the image observation model while preserving a differentiable computational path. The SPH formulation supports linear elastic, hyperelastic, and Kelvin--Voigt viscoelastic responses, together with fixed, free, and Robin-type boundary conditions. Numerical studies validate the SPH response against finite-element results, assess accuracy and efficiency against a conventional model using Gaussian centers as surface SPH particles, and demonstrate forward simulations on beam, bridge, and liver-shaped examples. Inverse analyses further estimate constitutive and boundary parameters from rendered deformation observations, including noisy cases, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed model for mechanics-based parameter identification from image data.

AI.tldr: 提出可微拉格朗日耦合3DGS-SPH模型，实现可变形固体的正演仿真与逆向参数辨识。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS等重建技术能还原外观与几何，但难以支撑具有力学可解释性的本构行为、边界条件与逆参数辨识。
AI.method: 从多视角标定数据重建3DGS模型；用包络法生成独立SPH支撑，避免直接以渲染基元作力学粒子；通过参考构型拉格朗日映射将SPH变形传递至高斯位置与协方差，保持可微路径；支持线弹性、超弹性、Kelvin-Voigt黏弹性及固定/自由/Robin边界。
AI.result: 数值算例将SPH响应与有限元对比，评估精度与效率（对比以高斯基元中心为表面粒子的常规模型），在梁、桥及肝脏形算例上完成正演仿真；逆分析从渲染变形观测（含噪声）估计本构与边界参数。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为从图像数据进行基于力学的参数辨识提供了可行途径。

title: MOIRA: Mass-Oriented Indexing with Ragged Attention for Long-Context Decoding
summary: Long-context decoding is limited by memory bandwidth, because every output token reads the KV cache of every layer. Sparse decoding reduces this cost by reading only part of the KV cache. We observe that the number of pages a query needs varies widely across KV heads, layers and steps. Fixed budgets are simple, but they are sized for demanding cases and tuned per workload; adaptive budgets follow this variation more flexibly, but existing designs pay for it with extra selection cost or training. At the kernel level, FlashAttention-3 (FA3) and FlashInfer are designed for rows of similar length: with page lists whose length differs per KV head, they either pad the lists (forfeiting much of the sparse saving), leave thread blocks unbalanced, or rely on a host-side plan that runs outside the CUDA graph. We propose MOIRA, a training-free sparse decode path in vLLM whose budget adapts per KV head and per layer. For every request, layer, KV head and step, a coverage rule keeps the smallest set of pages whose estimated attention mass reaches a fraction $γ$. A new kernel, self-planning attention, lets each thread block derive its own share of the work from the list lengths, so the whole decode step stays inside the CUDA graph. On an H200, at RULER's 128k context, MOIRA with $γ=0.99$ matches dense accuracy while reading about 30% of the pages and reduces the time per output token (TPOT) by 2.2-2.5$\times$ relative to dense FA3; with $γ=0.98$ it reduces TPOT by 2.7$\times$ and stays within the noise of dense. Under high serving load it raises throughput by up to 51%. These results suggest that a budget adapted per head and layer, paired with a kernel that keeps such budgets inside the CUDA graph, makes sparse decoding both flexible and fast.

AI.tldr: MOIRA提出一种免训练的自适应稀疏解码方案，按KV头和层动态调整页预算，配合自规划注意力核，在128k上下文下读取约30%页即可匹配稠密精度，TPOT降低2.2-2.7倍，高负载吞吐提升最高51%。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码受显存带宽限制，因为每个输出token都要读取所有层的KV cache。稀疏解码可缓解，但查询所需页数在KV头、层和步之间差异很大：固定预算需要按最苛刻情形设定并逐工作负载调优，自适应预算虽更灵活，但现有设计需付出额外选择开销或训练成本。此外FA3和FlashInfer面向等长行设计，遇到每KV头页列表长度不一的情况只能填充（损失稀疏收益）、造成线程块负载不均，或依赖CUDA图之外的host端规划。
AI.method: MOIRA是vLLM中免训练的稀疏解码路径，预算按每个KV头和每层自适应。对每个请求、层、KV头和步，用覆盖规则保留估计注意力质量达到比例γ的最小页集合。提出新的自规划注意力核，让每个线程块根据列表长度自行推导工作量份额，使整个解码步保持在CUDA图内。
AI.result: 在H200、RULER 128k上下文下，γ=0.99时MOIRA匹配稠密精度，读取约30%的页，相比稠密FA3将每输出token时间（TPOT）降低2.2-2.5倍；γ=0.98时TPOT降低2.7倍且在稠密结果的噪声范围内。高服务负载下吞吐提升最高51%。
AI.conclusion: 按头和层自适应的预算，配合能将此类预算保持在CUDA图内的核，使稀疏解码既灵活又快速。

title: PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaLoRA，通过自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识、梯度零空间投影及秩感知步长调节，实现LoRA持续学习中梯度缩放的动态最优控制，在50任务长序列基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LoRA的持续学习方法几乎都依赖固定小学习率作为限制梯度幅度的启发式手段，缺乏理论指导说明这种限制强度应如何随任务累积而演化。作者揭示即使在零空间投影等方向性约束下，有限精度更新仍会沿多个方向泄漏到历史知识子空间，且历史知识有效秩增长会使累积遗忘加剧，因此需要自适应的幅度限制来平衡稳定性与可塑性。
AI.method: 在方向性约束（如零空间投影）下分析有限精度更新向历史子空间的泄漏现象；建立各向异性泄漏模型，推导梯度步长最优缩放（即幅度限制本身）的调度律 s* = √(R/c)，其中 R 为历史更新的有效秩。基于该理论提出PaLoRA：通过自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识，将梯度投影到先前任务的零空间，并施加秩感知的自适应步长调节。
AI.result: 实验表明PaLoRA相较现有方法持续取得改进，在长时程设置下表现尤为突出，在具有挑战性的50任务ImageNet-A与ImageNet-R基准上准确率提升约4%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明最优幅度限制应随历史知识有效秩自适应增长，以平衡稳定性与可塑性；提出的调度律 s* = √(R/c) 与PaLoRA方法为LoRA持续学习中梯度缩放提供了理论指导，并在长序列任务中验证了其有效性。

title: $R^2$-WAM: Repair-and-Reject Post-Training for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) emerge as a promising foundation for policy refinement by predicting the consequences of sampled actions. However, visually plausible predictions can mislead policy refinement if they fail to reflect the input actions. To address this mismatch, we introduce $R^2$-WAM, a two-stage repair-and-reject post-training framework that first improves the consistency of predicted futures with input actions, then uses these futures to select inferior action samples for negative fine-tuning. The repair stage grounds imagination in observed robot behavior through a kinematic alignment score that measures agreement between predicted and demonstrated motion, enabling the predicted video to faithfully reflect its input actions. Using the repaired video model, the rejection stage compares imagined outcomes of sampled and demonstrated actions, selectively applying negative fine-tuning to samples whose predicted task progress falls below the demonstrated reference by a prescribed margin. Together, the two stages extend video prediction from representation learning to consequence-based policy refinement without additional environment interaction or changes to the inference procedure. $R^2$-WAM achieves 93.8% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 across clean and randomized settings. On the long-horizon real-world Fold Shirt task, it achieves 87.5% average success, compared with 0% for Fast-WAM.

AI.tldr: 提出R²-WAM两阶段"修复-拒绝"后训练框架，使世界动作模型的视频预测忠实反映输入动作，并用于策略精炼；在RoboTwin 2.0达93.8%、真实叠衣任务达87.5%平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测采样动作的后果为策略精炼提供基础，但视觉上合理的预测可能与输入动作不一致，从而误导策略精炼；需要解决这一"预测-动作"错配问题。
AI.method: 两阶段后训练框架：1) 修复阶段——引入运动学对齐分数（kinematic alignment score），衡量预测运动与演示运动的一致性，使预测视频忠实反映输入动作；2) 拒绝阶段——利用修复后的视频模型比较采样动作与演示动作的想象结果，对预测任务进展低于演示参考且超过预设阈值的样本施加负向微调。无需额外环境交互或改动推理流程。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0的干净与随机化设置下平均成功率达93.8%；在长时程真实世界叠衬衫（Fold Shirt）任务上平均成功率87.5%，而Fast-WAM为0%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将视频预测从表征学习拓展至基于后果的策略精炼，验证了预测忠实性与负样本筛选相结合的有效性，显著提升长时程真实任务表现。

title: Any-scale Object Detection using Arbitrary-scaled Images
summary: This paper proposes any-scale object detection using arbitrary-scale super-resolution for continuously rescaling object images, while general multi-scale object detection uses discretely rescaled appearance representations. However, a naive usage of super-resolution produces many false-positive detections if many super-resolution images are independently fed into an object detector. Our method suppresses these false positives by predicting scale proposal maps, each of which represents a set of pixels appropriate for each super-resolution scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于任意尺度超分辨率的任意尺度目标检测方法，通过预测尺度提议图来抑制朴素超分辨率带来的大量误检。
AI.motivation: 现有多尺度目标检测使用离散缩放的外观表示，无法实现连续尺度下的检测；而直接对图像进行超分辨率缩放并独立送入检测器会产生大量误检。
AI.method: 利用任意尺度超分辨率对目标图像进行连续重缩放，实现任意尺度目标检测；通过预测尺度提议图（每个图表示适用于某一超分辨率尺度的一组像素）来抑制误检。
AI.result: 尺度提议图能够有效抑制朴素超分辨率方案产生的误检，从而实现任意尺度的目标检测。
AI.conclusion: 通过尺度提议图选择各尺度下适合的像素，可在连续尺度上开展目标检测并控制误检。

title: From Latent Space to Jacobian Space: Measuring, Evading, and Training Against Safety-Content Accessibility
summary: Output-only safety monitoring sees only the end of a model's computation, yet the model computes its answer before emitting it: what it is internally poised to say is safety-critical. Jacobian-space (J-space) readouts, linear maps from hidden states to the output vocabulary via the model's input-output Jacobian, have been proposed as a window on behaviorally accessible internal content, and a first safety protocol (JADR) showed that danger recognition is readable there. What remains unknown is how this accessible content relates to the latent-space safety geometry studied by representation engineering, and how safety training shapes it. We introduce two quantitative bridges: (i) a transport-amplification profile $A_\ell$, measuring how strongly a latent safety direction is carried toward output space by each layer's Jacobian, and (ii) a paired base-vs-tuned protocol that attributes accessibility to training provenance. Across four small model pairs (135M to 1.5B, three lens-fit seeds), tuned checkpoints concentrate recognition in upper-middle layers, and at 0.5B DPO installs refusal while J-space recognition drops to chance: training can widen the accessibility gap exactly where behavioral safety looks best. A deployment audit closes the loop: monitor-aware GCG-style suffixes suppress the prompt-side monitor at zero behavioral cost at every scale; only a learned monitor rung resists its own adaptive re-attack; the training-time defense fails its re-attack at every penalty weight; steering shows the amplification profile is descriptive, not causal; and continuous-prefix optimization fails where discrete search succeeds.
