Safety monitoring, training, and evaluation must operate on accessibility itself, not on outputs alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究仅凭输出无法监控模型内部"即将说出的内容"，通过构建 Jacobian 空间的传输-放大剖面 $A_\ell$ 与基座-微调配对协议，揭示安全训练会扩大潜在安全方向与输出空间可读性之间的"可及性鸿沟"，并发现部署中的监控感知对抗后缀可在零行为代价下绕过提示侧监控。
AI.motivation: 现有安全监控只能观测模型计算的终点（输出），但模型在输出前已在内部完成答案计算，因此"内部准备说出的内容"具有安全关键性。J-space 读数（经模型输入-输出 Jacobian 从隐状态到输出词表的线性映射）被提出作为观察行为可及内部内容的窗口，JADR 协议已证明危险识别在该空间中可读。但尚不清楚：这种可及内容与表征工程研究的潜在空间安全几何之间有何关系，以及安全训练如何塑造它。论文旨在建立二者之间的定量桥梁并揭示训练导致的监控盲区。
AI.method: 提出两个定量工具：(i) 传输-放大剖面 $A_\ell$，度量每一层的 Jacobian 将潜在安全方向传递到输出空间的强度；(ii) 基座 vs 微调配对协议，将可及性归因于训练的来源（provenance）。实验覆盖四对小模型（135M 到 1.5B，三个 lens 拟合种子）。此外进行部署审计：monitor-aware GCG 风格后缀攻击、学习式监控阶梯的再攻击、不同惩罚权重下的训练时防御再攻击，以及连续前缀优化与离散搜索的对比、steering 的因果检验。
AI.result: 微调检查点将危险识别集中在中上层；在 0.5B 上，DPO 安装了拒绝行为，但 J-space 识别降至随机水平——即训练恰好在行为安全表现最好的地方扩大了可及性鸿沟。部署审计显示：monitor-aware GCG 风格后缀在所有规模下均以零行为代价压制提示侧监控；只有学习式监控阶梯能抵抗其自身的自适应再攻击；训练时防御在所有惩罚权重下都未能通过再攻击；steering 表明放大剖面是描述性的而非因果性的；连续前缀优化失败而离散搜索成功。
AI.conclusion: 安全监控、训练与评估必须直接作用于"可及性"本身，而不能仅基于输出。潜在空间安全几何与输出侧可读性之间存在由训练塑造的鸿沟，且可被监控感知的对抗手段利用，表明当前仅依赖输出的安全范式不足。

title: Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFDNO，用输入自适应的Takenaka-Malmquist正交基替代FNO固定傅里叶基与硬截断，在9个PDE基准上取得最优或近最优表现。
AI.motivation: FNO依赖固定傅里叶基与硬频率截断，难以刻画非周期、局部化及细尺度解结构；经典SAFD需昂贵贪心极点搜索，计算代价高。
AI.method: 用神经极点预测器摊销随机极点选择，由潜在特征直接构建自适应TM正交基；在Hardy空间对解析分支系数做可学习滤波，保留谱算子的全局感受野。
AI.result: 在9个PDE基准中，6个规则网格问题均优于强神经算子基线；在Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes上提升显著；零样本超分辨率更强，细网格部署下性能退化更小。
AI.conclusion: 输入自适应TM系统是固定谱表示的有力替代方案，为神经算子学习提供更灵活的谱基选择路径。

title: PreAct-Nav: Agentic Reasoning Before Action for Urban Navigation
summary: Urban navigation requires embodied agents to pursue long-horizon goals through local decisions based on egocentric observations. However, existing agentic navigation methods often struggle to translate distant goals into coherent local decisions in large-scale physical environments. Their reliance on linguistic reasoning over transient observations or limited history constrains anticipation of the consequences of actions and future conditions, despite the importance of such foresight for navigating long and complex urban routes. To bridge this gap, we propose PreAct-Nav, an agentic navigation framework that equips frozen policies with anticipatory reasoning for robust urban navigation. Our central idea is to anchor local decisions in persistent medium-horizon subgoals, assess the consequences of predicted actions before execution, and continually update the reasoning context using actual outcomes. At its core, a navigation memory module maintains the active subgoal and relevant experience across decisions, translating distant goals into actionable intermediate objectives. We further introduce a predictive world sandbox that uses an action-conditioned world model (AC-WM) to forecast world dynamics conditioned on candidate movements. A vision-language model (VLM) reasoner interprets these predictions under the current subgoal to retain or revise actions. After execution, real observations are used to assess outcomes, correct inconsistent assumptions, and update memory to continue or reformulate the subgoal. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the proposed PreAct-Nav improves action selection through memory updates and visual prediction, with more pronounced gains on longer routes and routes with more turns.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreAct-Nav 框架，通过持久的中程子目标、动作条件世界模型预测与记忆更新，实现城市导航中的前瞻性决策。
AI.motivation: 城市导航需智能体基于自中心观测做局部决策以完成长程目标。现有方法难以将远距离目标转化为连贯的局部决策，依赖对短暂观测或有限历史的语言推理，缺乏对动作后果与未来状态的前瞻能力，而这在长而复杂的城市路线中至关重要。
AI.method: 框架核心包含三部分：(1) 导航记忆模块，跨决策维护激活子目标与相关经验，将远距离目标转化为可执行的中间目标；(2) 预测性世界沙盒，使用动作条件世界模型（AC-WM）基于候选动作预测世界动态；(3) VLM 推理器在子目标下解读预测，决定保留或修正动作；执行后用真实观测评估结果、纠正不一致假设并更新记忆，以延续或重构子目标。整个流程为冻结策略赋予前瞻推理能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PreAct-Nav 通过记忆更新与视觉预测改进了动作选择，在更长路线与转弯更多的路线上提升更显著。
AI.conclusion: 将局部决策锚定于持续的中程子目标、执行前评估预测动作后果并持续以真实结果更新推理上下文，可有效提升城市长程导航的鲁棒性。

title: LoCoSplat: Real-Time Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Minimal 3D Reasoning
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) increasingly aggregates multi-view evidence with heavy learned 3D networks. We propose LoCoSplat (Local-Context Splatting), motivated by the observation that a Gaussian is a local primitive: once depth is predicted, what the 3D stage must add (scale, rotation, opacity) depends on the point cloud around each anchor, and a fixed local average of that neighbourhood is enough to supply it, no heavy network required. LoCoSplat realises exactly this average: it splats a 16-d linear projection of the point features into a fine and a coarse grid and reads both back at each anchor with a 0.14M-parameter pointwise MLP; with no learned 3D network and no dynamic sparse computation, its whole encoder runs as one fp16 CUDA graph. On RealEstate10K, LoCoSplat outperforms every prior feed-forward method on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS at 6, 12, and 24 views, with a margin that widens as views densify (+3.3 PSNR over VolSplat, the prior voxel-aligned state of the art, at 24 views) and grows further under zero-shot transfer to ACID and fine-tuning on ScanNet. It reconstructs a 6-view scene in 33 ms on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, the fastest of seven feed-forward methods and $4.2\times$ faster than the previous state of the art, trains $2.7\times$ faster ($5.9\times$ at 24 views), and uses $6.7\times$ less inference memory.

AI.tldr: LoCoSplat利用高斯是局部基元的特性，用固定局部邻域平均替代重型3D网络，以16维特征双网格splat实现轻量前馈3D高斯溅射重建。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法依赖重型学习式3D网络来聚合多视角证据，计算与内存开销大。作者观察到高斯本质是局部基元：一旦预测出深度，3D阶段所需的scale、rotation、opacity仅取决于每个锚点周围的点云，其固定局部平均即可满足，无需复杂网络。
AI.method: 将点特征的16维线性投影splat到精细与粗糙两个网格，再在每个锚点处读回，经0.14M参数的点式MLP输出高斯属性；无学习式3D网络、无动态稀疏计算，整个编码器可作为一个fp16 CUDA graph运行。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K上6/12/24视角均超越所有前馈方法（PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS），24视角比VolSplat高+3.3 PSNR；零样本迁移至ACID及ScanNet微调进一步提升。单张RTX PRO 6000上6视角重建33 ms，为七种方法中最快，比前SOTA快4.2倍，训练快2.7倍（24视角5.9倍），推理内存减少6.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 验证了“高斯为局部基元”这一观察的有效性，表明固定局部上下文平均足以替代重型3D网络，实现更快、更省内存且精度更高的前馈3DGS重建。

title: Bidirectional Preference Synthesis: Learning Prompt-Conditioned Preferences from Boundary Failures
summary: Correction-based offline preference pipelines commonly treat model failures only as rejected responses under the original prompt. This supervision is incomplete for boundary failures: responses that violate the given instruction yet coherently satisfy a nearby intent or constraint setting. We introduce Bidirectional Preference Synthesis (BPS), a data-construction method for standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that makes this missing prompt dependence explicit. For each validated boundary failure, BPS keeps the conventional forward pair under the original prompt and adds a reverse pair under a synthesized achieved prompt, so the same response is rejected where it is wrong and chosen where it is right, without changing the DPO objective, training a reward model, or requiring online sampling. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, BPS preserves original-side pairwise ranking while raising achieved-side ranking accuracy from 6.8% to 62.3% on held-out crossed anchors, with a similar shift under a Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe. A blind human audit supports the intended reverse preference direction, and downstream evaluations show the clearest separation from Forward-DPO in multilingual multi-turn instruction following, with consistent capability-retention patterns on agentic, tool-use, and code checks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向偏好合成（BPS），通过为边界失败样本同时构造原始提示下的前向偏好对与合成\"达成提示\"下的反向偏好对，使同一回复在错误处被拒绝、在正确处被优选，在不改变DPO目标、无需奖励模型或在线采样的前提下补全缺失的提示依赖监督。
AI.motivation: 现有基于纠错的离线偏好流程仅把模型失败当作原始提示下的被拒回复，这种监督对\"边界失败\"不完整——即回复违反了给定指令，却连贯地满足了某个相近的意图或约束设定。核心缺失的是提示（prompt）依赖性：同一回复的对错取决于用哪个提示来判定。
AI.method: BPS是一种数据构造方法，直接用于标准DPO。针对每个经校验的边界失败样本，保留原始提示下的常规前向偏好对，并额外引入一个在合成\"已达成提示\"下的反向偏好对，从而让同一回复在其错误语境下被拒、在其正确语境下被选。方法不改动DPO目标函数，不训练奖励模型，也不需要在线采样。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上，BPS在保留原始侧成对排序的同时，将留出交叉锚点上的\"达成侧\"排序准确率从6.8%提升至62.3%；在Kimi-K2.6跨教师探测下出现类似变化。盲测人工审核支持预期的反向偏好方向；下游评测中，在多语言多轮指令跟随任务上与Forward-DPO分离最明显，并在智能体、工具调用与代码检查上呈现一致的能力保持模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模边界失败中缺失的提示依赖性，BPS以极低的方法成本（不改目标、不加奖励模型、不需在线采样）显著修正了达成侧排序并保持原始侧排序与下游能力，为纠正式离线偏好数据构造提供了一种有效且可扩展的补充方案。

title: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization
summary: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过统一的奇异模动力学框架，分析优化器几何与深度如何共同决定深度矩阵分解中的谱偏置，给出多种优化器下奇异模的诞生、饱和与衰减规律。
AI.motivation: 矩阵与曲率型优化器的成功引发了对更新几何如何塑造学习的关注。深度矩阵分解中，减缓梯度下降的几何会通过延迟小奇异模出现来偏向低秩解，但当归一化或曲率校正削弱或消除这种减缓时，该谱偏置是否仍然存在尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在显式平衡与对齐假设下，建立统一的奇异模动力学框架，推导欧氏梯度下降、SignGD与瞬时Adam近似的逐坐标更新、Muon与累积Shampoo的谱更新、以及K-FAC块曲率模型中奇异模的诞生、饱和和衰减律。
AI.result: 结果并非“低秩偏置由强到弱”的简单排序：SignGD与理想Muon消除发散发势垒，并在有限时间将无支撑模驱动为零；累积Shampoo最初保留GD的深度依赖势垒，随后累积梯度产生追赶阶段，同时使原本活跃的模更持久；无阻尼K-FAC消除分解诱导的减缓但保留目标奇异值排序，而正阻尼引入谱阈值，低于该阈值的慢GD相律重新出现。
AI.conclusion: 归一化、累积状态、阻尼和深度可被直接解释为控制训练中模何时出现、持续和消失的机制。

title: Nudge Before You Push: Physics-Aware Navigation via Tactile Probing
summary: Visually identical containers can conceal loads that require different handling decisions. We present TANav, which uses a brief nudge to measure push resistance for navigation under a site-defined handling boundary. TacPhys reads the force sequence, with optional RGB-D and kinematics, into a mass estimate for push authorization. A repeated-patrol planner weighs probe and route costs, requests a second contact when useful, and reuses observations across visits. In simulation, TacPhys approaches a resistance-only Bayes reference and reduces missed pushes from 28.7% to 5.5% relative to peak-force thresholding at comparable low-risk operating points. In repeated-patrol simulation, TANav recovers 90% of the oracle's path saving, more than halves human interventions relative to always-detour, and reduces boundary violations from 4.3% to 2.9% relative to RGB-D-only probing. On a quadruped manipulator with a Hall-array fingertip, offline zero-shot MAE is 0.28-1.07 kg on containers up to 2.82 kg. Force-rise calibration at 3 kg gives 93.5% pooled offline accuracy (86.4% on non-cube episodes); a separate raw-peak rule gives 15 of 20 correct online decisions on unseen boxes.

AI.tldr: TANav通过导航中一次轻微推碰测量推阻，结合TacPhys力序列质量估计实现按站点处理边界的推开授权，在仿真与四足机械臂上减少了漏推、人工干预与边界违规。
AI.motivation: 外观完全相同的容器可能承载需要不同处理决策的物品，仅凭视觉难以判断，需要一种低成本、可在线执行的探测与授权机制。
AI.method: 提出TANav框架：用一次短促推碰测量推阻，并由TacPhys将力序列（可选RGB-D与运动学）映射为质量估计以做推开授权；重复巡逻规划器权衡探测与路径成本，必要时请求二次接触，并在多次访问间复用观测。
AI.result: 仿真中TacPhys接近仅用阻力的贝叶斯参考，在相当低风险工作点将漏推从28.7%降至5.5%；重复巡逻仿真中TANav恢复oracle路径节省的90%，相对始终绕行减少一半以上人工干预，相对仅RGB-D探测将边界违规从4.3%降至2.9%。四足机械臂配Hall阵列指尖，离线零样本MAE为0.28-1.07 kg（容器至2.82 kg），3 kg力上升标定离线汇总准确率93.5%（非立方体86.4%），原始峰值规则在未见箱体上20次在线决策正确15次。
AI.conclusion: 通过短促推碰的力感知与巡逻规划相结合，可在视觉不可区分容器场景下显著提升推开决策安全性与导航效率，并在真实四足平台上验证零样本质量估计与在线决策可行性。

title: SelectOccFlow: Selective Spatiotemporal Aggregation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction
summary: Comprehensive 3D scene understanding for autonomous driving requires modeling geometry, semantics, and motion. However, camera-based occupancy and scene flow prediction are sensitive to unreliable spatial and temporal aggregation, caused by semantically incompatible image features, misaligned historical observations, and incomplete voxel structures. To address this issue, we propose SelectOccFlow, a selective spatiotemporal aggregation framework that progressively refines contextual evidence across image, temporal, and voxel domains. To obtain semantically compatible image evidence, we design Semantic-Guided Sampling (SGS) to regulate feature sampling with semantic priors. Since reliable image evidence alone cannot resolve temporal inconsistency, we then present State-Conditioned Temporal Aggregation (SCTA) to selectively retrieve historical evidence according to voxel states. To further enhance the structural completeness of voxel representations, we introduce Extent-Aware Spatial Aggregation (ESA), which exploits directional structural support to refine foreground geometry. Experiments on OpenOcc demonstrate that SelectOccFlow achieves a state-of-the-art OccScore of 44.9, improving the previous best by +4.2%. It also maintains competitive occupancy performance on Occ3D-nus and improves the mean OccScore under nuScenes-C corruptions by +11.1%, demonstrating improved robustness to visual corruptions. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/muchen1021/SelectOccFlow.

AI.tldr: 提出SelectOccFlow选择性时空聚合框架，通过语义引导采样、状态条件时序聚合与范围感知空间聚合，逐步细化图像、时序与体素域证据，提升占用与场景流预测的精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需同时建模几何、语义与运动。基于相机的占用与场景流预测对不可靠的时空聚合敏感，主要源于语义不兼容的图像特征、未对齐的历史观测以及不完整的体素结构。
AI.method: 该框架包含三个模块：(1) 语义引导采样（SGS），用语义先验规范特征采样以获得语义兼容的图像证据；(2) 状态条件时序聚合（SCTA），依据体素状态选择性检索历史证据以缓解时序不一致；(3) 范围感知空间聚合（ESA），利用方向性结构支撑精化前景几何。
AI.result: 在OpenOcc上取得44.9的OccScore，较此前最优提升+4.2%；在Occ3D-nus上保持有竞争力的占用性能；在nuScenes-C多种损坏下平均OccScore提升+11.1%，鲁棒性增强。
AI.conclusion: SelectOccFlow通过跨图像、时序与体素域的选择性时空聚合，有效提升占用与场景流预测精度及对视觉损坏的鲁棒性，源代码将公开。

title: Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence: Self-Guided Attention Steering to Mitigate Sycophancy and Stubbornness
summary: Reliable language models should resist unsupported user pressure while effectively using objective contextual information. However, models may exhibit sycophancy by yielding to unsupported user pressure or contextual stubbornness by failing to update their answers when relevant contextual information warrants revision. Evaluating interventions for these failures separately can obscure whether mitigating one failure exacerbates the other. To assess this trade-off, we introduce CoPE-Bench with six conditions per question: a neutral baseline, correct or incorrect user pressure, contextual information consistent with or conflicting with the neutral answer, and a joint condition combining incorrect claims with conflicting contextual information. To regulate the influence of user pressure and contextual information, we propose SPAE (Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence), a training-free framework that uses the model's own judgments to identify relevant tokens, suppressing user pressure and amplifying contextual information through token-level attention steering. On average across five backbones, SPAE reduces pressure following by 18.8 percentage points and increases joint-condition updating by 5.5 percentage points relative to the strongest baseline in the main comparison. In two-turn dialogue, it improves joint-condition updating by an average of 13.2 percentage points over the strongest prompting baseline. The source data and codes can be found at https://github.com/03Grant/sycophancy-and-stubbornness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CoPE-Bench 基准与无训练的 SPAE 框架，联合评估并缓解语言模型的谄媚与语境固执问题，通过 token 级注意力引导同步减少压力屈从并增强证据更新。
AI.motivation: 可靠的语言模型应在抵御无依据的用户压力的同时有效利用客观语境信息。但模型可能表现出两类对立失效：谄媚（屈从于无依据的用户压力）与语境固执（在相关语境信息要求修正时未能更新答案）。若分别评估针对这两类失效的干预措施，会掩盖"缓解一种失效是否加剧另一种失效"的问题，因此需要同时评估二者权衡。
AI.method: 提出 CoPE-Bench，每题含六种条件：中性基线、正确或错误的用户压力、与中性答案一致或冲突的语境信息，以及将错误主张与冲突语境结合的联合条件。并提出无训练框架 SPAE（Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence），利用模型自身判断识别相关 token，通过 token 级注意力引导抑制用户压力、放大语境信息。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型上平均而言，相较主对比中最强基线，SPAE 将使压力屈从降低 18.8 个百分点，联合条件更新率提升 5.5 个百分点；在两轮对话中，联合条件更新率相较最强提示基线平均提升 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SPAE 能在不加剧语境固执的前提下显著抑制谄媚，并提升模型依据客观语境更新答案的能力，为同时调控用户压力与语境证据的影响提供了有效、免训练的方案。

title: A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers
summary: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对 ReLU 网络精确计算 max 函数所需的深度问题，对六个实输入给出了显式"六边形恒等式"，用可手工验证的解析证明确认两层隐藏层足够，并构造出隐藏宽度为 17 和 41、零偏置、有理权重的显式网络。
AI.motivation: 精确计算 max 函数是研究 ReLU 网络深度的标准测试问题。已知通过计算机辅助构造，两个隐藏层对最多十二个输入足够，但这些结果依赖程序验证，缺乏可自包含、手工检验的解析证明。作者希望为六输入情形提供显式、可解释且不依赖验证程序的证明。
AI.method: 通过计算机辅助搜索发现一个显式的"六边形恒等式"；该恒等式的局部结构给出自包含的解析证明，证明过程通过显式消去（cancellation）完成，可完全手工检查，无需运行验证程序。并据此构造显式 ReLU 网络。
AI.result: 对六个实输入，给出了两层隐藏层即可精确计算 max 函数的解析证明；所得显式网络隐藏层宽度分别为 17 与 41，偏置为零，权重为有理数。
AI.conclusion: 六输入的 max 函数存在深度为两隐藏层的显式 ReLU 网络，其正确性可由纯解析、可手工验证的恒等式证明，降低了此前结果对计算机辅助验证的依赖。

title: RobotUse: Allocating Computation, Context, and Decisions
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://robotuse-team.github.io/
summary: Robot agents must connect their intended actions to observed outcomes while retaining the context needed to revise their choices over repeated attempts. Existing interfaces often leave these choices inside predefined tools or require agents to manage detailed execution code and its growing history. We introduce RobotUse, a robot agent harness that organizes computation, context, and decisions around specifying and revising physical actions. Agents visually select targets and poses, while the backend handles geometry, motion planning, and control. Subagents retain detailed interactions within each subgoal and return the information needed for subsequent decisions. Continual harnessing lets agents learn from execution by updating a persistent playbook. On RoboLab, RobotUse achieves 45% task success, outperforming CaP-X by 6.7 percentage points while maintaining compact decision contexts and reducing reliance on predefined action abstractions. Furthermore, we show that RobotUse learns from real-world execution despite imperfect feedback and transfers what it learns to subsequent tasks. Project page is available at https://robotuse-team.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 RobotUse——一种机器人智能体 harness,将计算、上下文与决策组织在"指定与修订物理动作"周围。智能体通过视觉选择目标与位姿,后端处理几何、运动规划与控制;子智能体保留子目标内的细节交互并返回后续决策所需信息;持续 harness 使智能体通过更新持久化 playbook 从执行中学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人智能体需要将意图动作与观测结果关联,并保留上下文以在多次尝试中修正决策。现有接口要么把选择封装在预定义工具内,要么要求智能体管理详细的执行代码及其不断增长的历史,导致决策上下文臃肿、依赖预定义动作抽象。
AI.method: RobotUse harness:1) 智能体在视觉上选择目标与位姿,后端负责几何、运动规划与控制;2) 子智能体在每个子目标内保留详细交互,只向上层返回后续决策所需信息;3) 持续 harnessing 机制,通过更新持久化 playbook 实现从执行中学习。
AI.result: 在 RoboLab 上达到 45% 任务成功率,较 CaP-X 高出 6.7 个百分点,同时保持紧凑的决策上下文并减少对预定义动作抽象的依赖;此外,RobotUse 能在不完美反馈下从真实世界执行中学习,并将所学迁移到后续任务。
AI.conclusion: RobotUse 通过以动作指定与修订为中心的 harness 设计,在紧凑上下文、低预定义抽象依赖下提升任务成功率,并支持从真实执行中持续学习与跨任务迁移。

title: TRIM-ReID: Duplication-Aware Token Reduction and Modality-Aligned Interaction for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
summary: Multi-modal object re-identification exploits complementary RGB, near-infrared (NIR), and thermal-infrared (TIR) observations to retrieve target objects. However, existing methods commonly employ visual encoders optimized for global image-text alignment and select tokens using learned importance scores. Such designs fail to preserve fine-grained identity cues or explicitly account for token redundancy, resulting in underrepresented local evidence and duplicated tokens that lead to noisy and costly cross-modal interaction. To address this gap, we propose TRIM-ReID, a compact framework that unifies dense feature extraction, intra-modal token reduction, and inter-modal aligned interaction. Specifically, semantically rich and spatially coherent patch features are extracted by Dense Identity Representation (DIR), which leverages DINOv3 to preserve fine-grained identity information. We then introduce Token Diversity Mining (TDM) to identify complementary local evidence and construct compact modality-specific token sets by suppressing repetitive patches while preserving informative diversity. Retained tokens are subsequently fused by Modal Relational Interaction (MRI) to enable effective information exchange across modalities, while a triangular alignment loss explicitly regularizes their joint relationships to maintain cross-modal semantic consistency under independent token selection. Extensive experiments on RGBNT201, RGBNT100, and MSVR310 demonstrate that TRIM-ReID achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TRIM-ReID紧凑框架，通过稠密特征提取、模态内令牌约简与模态间对齐交互，解决多模态目标重识别中局部身份线索不足与令牌冗余问题，在三个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态重识别方法多采用面向全局图文对齐的视觉编码器，并依据学习的重要性分数选择令牌。这类设计既无法保留细粒度的身份线索，也未显式考虑令牌冗余，导致局部证据被弱化、令牌重复，进而引发跨模态交互噪声大、计算开销高。
AI.method: TRIM-ReID统一了三个环节：1）稠密身份表示（DIR），基于DINOv3提取语义丰富、空间连贯的patch特征以保留细粒度身份信息；2）令牌多样性挖掘（TDM），识别互补的局部证据，抑制重复patch，构建紧凑的模态特定令牌集合；3）模态关系交互（MRI）融合保留令牌实现跨模态信息交换，并引入三角对齐损失显式正则化令牌间的联合关系，在独立令牌选择下维持跨模态语义一致性。
AI.result: 在RGBNT201、RGBNT100和MSVR310三个数据集上的大量实验表明，TRIM-ReID取得了当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: TRIM-ReID通过稠密特征提取、模态内令牌约简与模态间对齐交互的统一设计，有效保留细粒度身份线索并抑制令牌冗余，显著提升多模态目标重识别的性能与效率。

title: ShadowMiner v1 - An Experience Report on Implementing and Measuring a Problem-and-Hypothesis Discovery Engine
summary: ShadowMiner v1 is a system that automatically discovers research problems and generates hypotheses from AI papers. It is a nine-stage pipeline. It structures documents into a knowledge graph and finds graph gaps in it - structural blind spots in research. These graph gaps are included in the LLM generation prompt. Each generated hypothesis is then verified by checking whether it is already covered by existing research, scoring its quality, and checking that the facts it relies on are accurately drawn from its sources. This report does not propose a new generation or evaluation technique. It describes our experience of implementing and applying ideas from prior work, and measuring whether each one actually contributed.

AI.tldr: ShadowMiner v1 是一个从 AI 论文中自动发现研究问题并生成假设的九阶段流水线系统，通过构建知识图谱、识别图谱缺口、结合 LLM 生成假设，并对假设进行覆盖性、质量与事实准确性三重验证。
AI.motivation: 解决研究问题自动发现的需求，将论文结构化并定位研究中的结构性盲点，以引导假设生成。
AI.method: 九阶段流水线：将文档组织为知识图谱，识别图谱缺口（研究中的结构性盲点），将缺口纳入 LLM 生成提示，随后对每个假设进行三步验证——检查是否已被现有研究覆盖、评分其质量、核实其所依赖事实是否准确源自出处。本文不提出新的生成或评估技术，而是报告实现与应用既有工作的经验并测量各环节的实际贡献。
AI.result: 报告未给出具体量化指标，主要成果是对各既有环节实际贡献的实证测量与经验总结。
AI.conclusion: ShadowMiner v1 通过整合既有方法构建了可运行的问题发现与假设生成系统，并强调对流程各组件贡献进行经验性评估的重要性，而非提出新方法。

title: Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning
comment: 38 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/PeterXingyuZhao/cross-trait-transfer
summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"阈下学习"中的跨特质迁移现象，提出有向特质迁移矩阵以量化教师模型某一特质对学生模型其他特质偏好的影响，揭示特质聚类结构及学习动态规律。
AI.motivation: 阈下学习中学生模型可经由语义无关的输出习得教师模型的行为特质，但该现象依赖微弱统计模式，机制隐晦。作者希望跳出单一特质的视角，理解教师-学生对之间特质是如何传递与相互作用的，尤其是某一特质数据如何改变学生对其他特质的偏好（跨特质迁移）。
AI.method: 提出有向特质迁移矩阵：以学生答案的对数概率增益为度量，量化在某一教师特质下生成的数据对其他特质偏好的影响。在此基础上分析迁移矩阵的聚类结构，并尝试用输出分布指标与表征层面指标解释跨特质结构；进一步开展学习动态分析与多特质交互实验。
AI.result: 迁移矩阵显示出相关特质的聚类，学生有时会形成与教师特质相似但非完全相同的偏好；跨特质结构可被输出分布指标与表征指标部分捕捉。学习动态呈现从广泛共享偏移到特质特异性迁移的演进过程；多特质实验表明对立特质可增强这种分化。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了特质迁移与竞争中的显著统计结构，为理解阈下学习中隐藏偏好如何在模型间传递提供了更广阔的视角。

title: DiVeR: Decision-Critical Verifier Learning for VLA Test-Time Scaling
summary: Scaling robot data and model capacity has improved Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, but further progress is constrained by the high cost of robotic data. Verifier-guided test-time scaling offers an efficient alternative by sampling multiple action candidates and selecting the one most likely to lead to task success at inference time. Existing classification-based verifiers learn from trajectory-level outcomes but treat all visited states equally, even though their value for candidate discrimination can vary across a trajectory. At many states, plausible actions are similar and provide limited discrimination signal, while only a sparse set of decision-critical states admits meaningfully different actions that can substantially affect downstream outcomes. To address this, we propose DiVeR, which estimates decision criticality from the dispersion of sampled action representations. DiVeR then uses this signal to reweight verifier learning toward states where action selection is most consequential, without requiring step-level annotations or additional environment interaction. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world experiments on a Franka Research 3 robot, DiVeR consistently improves task success through more effective verifier-guided action selection, while adding negligible verifier inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出DiVeR，通过采样动作表示的离散度估计决策关键性，对验证器学习重加权，聚焦关键状态，在LIBERO、RoboCasa及真实机器人上提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA策略受限于机器人数据采集的高成本；验证器引导的测试时扩展是高效替代方案。但现有基于分类的验证器只用轨迹级结果学习，平等对待所有访问状态，忽略了各状态对候选动作区分能力的差异：多数状态下的候选动作相似、区分信号有限，只有稀疏的决策关键状态才包含能显著影响后续结果的不同动作。
AI.method: 提出DiVeR：从采样动作表示的离散度（dispersion）估计决策关键性，据此对验证器学习重加权，使学习集中在动作选择最关键的状态；无需步级标注，也无需额外环境交互。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboCasa以及Franka Research 3真实机器人实验中，DiVeR通过更有效的验证器引导动作选择，持续提升任务成功率，且验证器推理开销几乎可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 利用动作表示离散度估计决策关键性并对验证器训练重加权，是一种无需额外标注或交互、开销极低的有效方法，可提升VLA策略在测试时的动作选择质量。

title: Beyond Plausibility: Verifiable Fine-Grained Image Editing on Structured Assets
summary: Fine-grained image editing requires more than producing a visually plausible result: an editor must execute the requested attribute change precisely while leaving everything else intact. However, existing benchmarks leave a critical gap between realism and verifiability: benchmarks built on realistic images typically rely on human or vision--language model judgments, while deterministic evaluation has largely focused on synthetic shape canvases, with application-oriented extensions primarily limited to charts. This makes it difficult to determine precisely how much of a requested edit was executed, where unintended changes occurred, and whether small differences between models reflect genuine editing capability or evaluator uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we present VeriEdit-Bench, a benchmark for fine-grained, instruction-faithful image editing across realistic structured assets with deterministic, four-axis evaluation. Its 1,740 cases are compiled from the source code of 153 Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) graphics, charts, web interfaces, and presentation slides. Controlled source-code edits preserve the original visual context while yielding exact target images, pixel-level edit masks, and explicit edit specifications, enabling reproducible scoring along four axes: edit fidelity, preservation, localization, and magnitude. Evaluating eleven editors, we find that even the strongest model remains far from full credit; rankings for the same recoloring operation reverse between charts and SVG graphics; and outputs with similar pixel-accuracy profiles can still differ substantially in localization and change magnitude. This decomposition yields graded, verifiable feedback and exposes model-specific capability and failure profiles that holistic scores or evaluator-dependent judgments may obscure.

AI.tldr: 提出 VeriEdit-Bench，一个基于 SVG 源码的可确定性评估的细粒度图像编辑基准，包含 1,740 个案例，从编辑保真度、保持性、定位性和变化幅度四个维度对 11 个编辑模型进行评估，揭示现有整体评分所掩盖的能力与失败模式。
AI.motivation: 细粒度图像编辑不仅要求视觉合理，更需精确执行目标属性修改且保持其余内容不变。但现有基准存在真实性与可验证性之间的鸿沟：基于真实图像的基准依赖人工或视觉语言模型判断，而确定性评估多局限于合成形状画布，应用型扩展也主要限于图表。这导致难以精确判断请求编辑被执行的程度、意外修改发生的位置，以及模型间的细微差异究竟反映真实编辑能力还是评估器的不确定性。
AI.method: 构建 VeriEdit-Bench 基准，涵盖真实结构化资产，采用确定性四轴评估。1,740 个案例由 153 个 SVG 图形、图表、网页界面和演示幻灯片的源代码编译而成。通过对源代码进行受控编辑，在保留原始视觉上下文的同时生成精确的目标图像、像素级编辑掩码和明确的编辑规范，从而支持可复现的四轴评分：编辑保真度、保持性、定位性和变化幅度。基于此对 11 个编辑器进行评测。
AI.result: 即使最强模型也远未达到满分；同一重着色操作在图表与 SVG 图形之间的排名出现反转；像素精度分布相似的输出在定位性和变化幅度上仍可能存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 该四轴分解提供了分级、可验证的反馈，并揭示了整体评分或依赖评估器的判断可能掩盖的模型特定能力与失败模式，弥补了真实性与可验证性之间的基准空白。

title: Functionally Equivalent or Not? Graph-Grounded Differential Surrogate Execution for Code Equivalence
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: Determining whether two programs are functionally equivalent is central to code modernization, patch validation, refactoring, and code-generation evaluation. Yet the usual signals are incomplete: tests cover only finite inputs, textual similarity confuses implementation with behavior, and unconstrained LLM judgments are difficult to audit. Direct execution is often impossible when a program depends on an obsolete, licensed, unavailable, or unsafe environment. We introduce FEAgent, a selective equivalence assessor agent that combines typed program-graph evidence with differential surrogate execution. FEAgent first aligns public interfaces and behaviorally relevant graph anchors, then issues bounded queries over call-flow, control-flow, data-flow, type, import, and effect relations. Next, a branch-aware generator agent proposes discriminating inputs, and two blinded LLM surrogates independently predict source and target observables. Every claim and predicted divergence is recorded in an evidence ledger. A deterministic reconciler then returns EQUIVALENT, INEQUIVALENT, or UNCLEAR rather than forcing a verdict when paths are uncovered or evidence conflicts. We evaluate FEAgent on function-level equivalence and repository-level bug patches, where the existing oracle is a benchmark label or a passing test suite. Every disagreement with that oracle is adjudicated by direct execution, revealing errors in benchmark labels and behavioral divergences missed by unit-test-only scoring. On EquiBench, execution confirms FEAgent's disagreements with published labels on 216 of 1,200 evaluated pairs (18.0%); on SWE-bench Verified, 94 of 331 test-passing agent patches (28.4%) diverge from the reference patch. FEAgent thus serves as an audit layer between testing and formal verification, keeping its evidence reviewable and its uncertainty explicit without claiming a proof of equivalence.

AI.tldr: FEAgent是一种"选择性等价性评估智能体"，通过融合带类型的程序图证据与差分代理执行，输出EQUIVALENT/INEQUIVALENT/UNCLEAR三态判定，可作为测试与形式化验证之间的审计层。
AI.motivation: 判断两段程序是否功能等价对代码现代化、补丁验证、重构及代码生成评估至关重要，但现有信号均不完整：测试仅覆盖有限输入，文本相似性混淆实现与行为，无约束的LLM判断难以审计；且当程序依赖过时、受限许可、不可获取或不安全的环境时，直接执行往往不可行。
AI.method: FEAgent先对齐公开接口与行为相关的图锚点，随后在调用流、控制流、数据流、类型、导入与效应关系上发起有界查询；再由分支感知的生成器智能体提出具有区分力的输入，由两个盲化的LLM代理独立预测源与目标的观测量；每项论断与预测到的分歧均记入证据台账；最后由确定性协调器返回EQUIVALENT、INEQUIVALENT或UNCLEAR，而非在路径未覆盖或证据冲突时强行给出结论。
AI.result: 在函数级等价性与仓库级缺陷补丁任务上评估（以基准标签或通过的测试套件为oracle），对所有与oracle的不一致用直接执行进行裁定，揭示了基准标签错误及仅靠单元测试评分所遗漏的行为分歧。在EquiBench上，执行确认FEAgent在1,200对中的216对（18.0%）与已发表标签不一致；在SWE-bench Verified上，331个通过测试的智能体补丁中有94个（28.4%）与参考补丁存在行为分歧。
AI.conclusion: FEAgent可作为测试与形式化验证之间的审计层，其证据可审查、不确定性显式表达，同时并不宣称等价性证明。

title: Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning
summary: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应KL-BAPG（A-KL-BAPG），通过有限固定罚燃烧期加带保护的递增罚阶段，使Gromov-Wasserstein问题的可行性差距渐近消失，并获得原问题的平稳性保证。
AI.motivation: GW问题因非凸目标与耦合边际约束而难以求解；BAPG虽交替更新成本低，但其固定罚松弛会留下持久的可行性差距，且其平稳性保证仅针对松弛问题而非原GW问题。
AI.method: A-KL-BAPG先进行有限固定罚燃烧，再进入带保护的递增罚阶段；尾部迭代复用BAPG的交替行/列更新，并对延迟幂步回溯，直至满足受Sinkhorn启发的投影直径保护条件。
AI.result: 证明每次迭代回溯有限终止、可行性差距渐近消失；得到加权平方校正残差的最佳迭代O(1/log N)界，并在支撑正则条件下给出原GW问题平稳累积点的存在性。实验显示其在精度、目标值、可行性与平稳性间取得更优平衡；图对齐任务中可行性差距降低62–99%、投影平稳残差降低28–98%，异构域适应中也呈现类似优势。
AI.conclusion: A-KL-BAPG在保持与固定罚KL-BAPG相当精度和目标值的同时显著改善可行性与平稳性，且其平稳性保证面向原始GW问题，区别于固定罚BAPG。

title: A Unified Dynamics Framework for Reinforcement Learning and Classical Control of a Six-DOF Pipeline-Tracking ROV in NVIDIA Isaac Sim
summary: Reinforcement learning controllers for underwater vehicles are usually trained against one physics representation and deployed against another, so reported performance does not always describe behavior outside training. This paper presents a pipeline-tracking architecture for a six-degree-of-freedom remotely operated vehicle (ROV) in which one Universal Scene Description (USD) scene supplies the real BlueROV2-Heavy mass, added-mass, damping, buoyancy, and thruster parameters to both halves of the system: a vectorized NumPy implementation of Fossen's marine-craft equations, and an interactive NVIDIA Isaac Sim deployment applying the identical equations as PhysX forces at every step. The Coriolis-centripetal term is the primary dynamics model in both branches; a controlled ablation on PPO and TRPO shows that including it does not destabilize either algorithm and modestly improves tracking, about 19 percent lower standoff RMS error for TRPO. Five reinforcement learning algorithms, PPO, soft actor-critic, TD3, DDPG, and TRPO, are trained against one environment, reward, and randomized evaluation harness through a checkpoint-compatibility layer scoring any policy with the same code. The pipeline is extended with six classical baselines, PID, sliding-mode, fuzzy logic, feedback linearization, model predictive control, and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, driven by the same guidance geometry and thruster allocation as the learned policies. Under Coriolis-enabled dynamics, PPO, TRPO, and feedback linearization reach the strongest combination of 100 percent success and competitive accuracy; PID, fuzzy control, and the neuro-fuzzy baseline also reach 100 percent success with looser tracking; DDPG and TD3 each show a specific, explainable failure mode rather than a general weakness of off-policy learning; and classical control remains a strong baseline against the best learned policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种六自由度ROV管线跟踪架构，通过单一USD场景为Fossen方程的NumPy向量化实现与Isaac Sim部署提供同一套水动力参数，并系统比较5种强化学习算法与6种经典控制基线。
AI.motivation: 水下航行器强化学习控制器通常在一种物理模型上训练、在另一种物理模型上部署，导致所报告性能无法可靠反映训练分布之外的行为，因此需要建立训练—部署物理一致、可复现比较的评测框架。
AI.method: 以一个USD场景统一提供BlueROV2-Heavy的质量、附加质量、阻尼、浮力与推力器参数，同时驱动两条支路：NumPy向量化Fossen海洋航行器方程实现，以及Isaac Sim中以相同方程作为每步PhysX力的交互式部署。以科里奥利—向心项为主要动力学模型，在PPO与TRPO上进行受控消融。通过检查点兼容层用同一代码在统一环境、奖励与随机化评测装置上训练与评估PPO、SAC、TD3、DDPG、TRPO五种算法，并扩展六种经典基线（PID、滑模、模糊逻辑、反馈线性化、模型预测控制、自适应神经模糊推理系统），采用相同制导几何与推力分配。
AI.result: 引入科里奥利—向心项不会破坏PPO或TRPO的稳定性，并小幅提升跟踪性能，TRPO的站位RMS误差约降低19%。在启用科里奥利动力学时，PPO、TRPO与反馈线性化达到100%成功率与较优精度的最佳组合；PID、模糊控制与神经模糊基线同样达到100%成功率但跟踪精度较松；DDPG与TD3各自表现出特定且可解释的失效模式，而非离策略学习的一般性缺陷；经典控制仍是对抗最优学习策略的强基线。
AI.conclusion: 训练与部署共享同一物理表示可提升强化学习水下控制结论的可迁移性；在本ROV管线跟踪任务中，最优学习策略与经典控制性能相当，离策略算法的失效具有可解释的算法特异性而非范式缺陷。

title: Detecting Defects that Matter: An Application-Driven Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Manufacturing and Retail Logistics (VAND 4.0 Challenge)
summary: Existing Anomaly Detection benchmarks are saturated and often unrealistic. As part of the VAND 4.0 Challenge, we introduce a hidden-test, application-driven benchmark across two deployment-critical domains: industrial manufacturing and retail logistics. In the Industrial Track (MVTec AD 2), the results reveal that unsupervised anomaly segmentation remains challenging: the best regular-setting method achieves only ~57\% pixel-level $SegF_1$, indicating substantial room for improvement. Zero-shot approaches trail by ~15 $SegF_1$ points, confirming that task-specific training on normal data remains essential for precise defect localization. Robustness to distribution shifts remains a key open challenge and DINOv3-backbones clearly dominate this track. In the Retail Track (Kaputt 2), the results reveal that (1) supervised defect detection is approaching saturation for common defect types; (2) the best off-the-shelf VLM approach trails specialized models by ~28 AP, confirming that currently VLMs cannot replace fine-tuned detectors, (3) reference images did not prove helpful for top-performing approaches. Performance collapses on rare defects (spillage ~53 AP, missing units ~27 AP), where the supervised ceiling is bounded by data availability. To drive future progress in this domain, we provide a new low-prevalence retail AD dataset (Kaputt-Rare). Across both tracks, computational efficiency is assessed as a first-class metric combining performance, throughput, memory, and power consumption. We introduce a novel metric for measuring efficiency and reveal that that top-performing methods rely on heavy architectures while efficiency is largely neglected. Overall, we conclude that the community needs (a) more efficiency-aware method development, and (b) true anomaly detection approaches for rare defects and shifting conditions. https://sites.google.com/view/vand4-cvpr2026/challenge

AI.tldr: 介绍 VAND 4.0 挑战赛中的隐藏测试、应用驱动异常检测基准，覆盖工业制造与零售物流两大领域，揭示无监督分割仍具挑战、VLM 尚不能替代微调检测器、效率被普遍忽视，并发布低发生率数据集 Kaputt-Rare。
AI.motivation: 现有异常检测基准已趋饱和且不贴近实际应用，缺乏隐藏测试、跨分布漂移与效率等维度的评估，因此需要面向真实部署场景的新基准来驱动方法进步。
AI.method: 作为 VAND 4.0 挑战赛的一部分，构建覆盖工业制造（MVTec AD 2，工业赛道）与零售物流（Kaputt 2，零售赛道）的隐藏测试应用驱动基准；评估常规设置、零样本方法、DINOv3 骨干、现成 VLM 与专用模型，并将性能、吞吐、内存与功耗合并为效率指标，同时提出新的效率度量并发布低发生率零售数据集 Kaputt-Rare。
AI.result: 工业赛道：最佳常规方法像素级 SegF1 仅约 57%，零样本方法落后约 15 个 SegF1 点，分布漂移鲁棒性仍是开放挑战，DINOv3 骨干在该赛道明显占优。零售赛道：常见缺陷的监督检测接近饱和；最佳现成 VLM 落后专用模型约 28 AP；参考图像对顶尖方法无帮助；稀有缺陷性能崩塌（spillage 约 53 AP、missing units 约 27 AP），监督上限受数据可得性约束。效率方面：顶尖方法依赖重型架构，效率普遍被忽视。
AI.conclusion: 社区需要（a）更注重效率的方法开发，以及（b）针对稀有缺陷和漂移条件的真正异常检测方法。

title: Do Tool Calls Execute as Intended? Measuring and Repairing Intent-Execution Correspondence in LLM Agents
summary:
Agents built on large language models (LLMs) build and run software through tool calls. A call reaches its program through several hops, and any hop can change the call without notice. When the changed call fails, the agent retries a correct call, which costs users time and money. Benchmarks and failure analyses do not see the change, because they read the call and its result but not what a hop received. We define intent-execution correspondence (IEC) as the property that the executed action matches the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract. Our protocol observes what each hop received without executing the call, and names the first hop that changed it by the receiver's own parser. IntAct then delivers the call in a form that this hop cannot alter, or refuses the call. We build IEC-Bench from the changes observed in real-world use, with chains of dependent calls under the execution paths of 4 widely-used harnesses.
  In 47,828 shell calls within production sessions, Claude Code's Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error. All 10 measured harnesses change a call. Trajectory-based judgment attributes 95.1% of the production failures to the LLM, although the path caused more than half of them. On IEC-Bench, the path raises the token cost per passed task 2.4 times (up to 12.3 times). A hop that changes a call also hides the changes after it, so 55.1% of the failures on one path appear only after its first hop is repaired. IntAct, deployed in a commercial product, recovers 79.2% of the failures with a changed call. Harnesses should therefore be designed and tested hop-by-hop to ensure a correct call executes as intended or is refused.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"意图-执行一致性(IEC)"概念，揭示LLM智能体工具调用在多层传输中会被中间环节（hop）静默篡改，导致调用失败或错误执行；设计协议IntAct定位首个篡改环节并安全投递或拒绝对应调用，在真实生产与自建基准上验证了问题的普遍性与方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过工具调用构建和运行软件，一次调用要经过多个环节（hop）才能到达程序，任一环节都可能在不被察觉的情况下改变调用。现有基准与失败分析只读取调用及其结果，却看不到各环节实际接收到的内容，因而无法发现这种篡改。当被篡改的调用失败时，智能体重试正确调用，浪费用户时间与金钱，且失败常被错误归咎于LLM本身。
AI.method: 1) 定义"意图-执行一致性(IEC)"：执行动作需与工具契约下所发出调用所意指的动作相符。2) 设计观测协议：在不执行调用的前提下观测每个环节接收到的内容，并利用接收方自身的解析器定位首个改变调用的环节。3) IntAct机制：以该环节无法修改的形式投递调用，或直接拒绝对应调用。4) 构建IEC-Bench：基于真实使用中观测到的改动，在4个常用harness的执行路径下构造依赖调用链。
AI.result: 在生产会话的47,828次shell调用中，Claude Code的Bash工具改变了12.0%带代码、转义序列或长文本的调用；在反斜杠被改动的调用里，80.7%在无任何报错的情况下执行了错误动作。所测10个harness均会改变调用。基于轨迹的判断将95.1%的生产失败归因于LLM，但其中超过一半实由路径引发。在IEC-Bench上，该路径使每个通过任务的token成本上升2.4倍（最高12.3倍）。篡改调用的环节还会掩盖其后的改动，某路径上55.1%的失败在修复首个环节后才显现。IntAct已在商业产品中部署，可恢复79.2%发生调用改动的失败。
AI.conclusion: harness应按环节逐一设计与测试，确保正确的调用按意图执行，或被明确拒绝，从而保障智能体工具调用的意图-执行一致性。

title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRFT框架，通过让LLM智能体从自身在注入攻击下的失败轨迹中学习，并借助专家模型生成对比安全与最优动作的结构化自反思推理，从而提升对抗提示注入的鲁棒性；实例化的SR-Agent在静态与自适应基准上显著降低攻击成功率并保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在工具增强环境中广泛部署，但依赖外部输入使其易受提示注入攻击而劫持任务目标。现有安全对齐方法依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，难以泛化到自适应攻击模式，因此需要一种能从失败经验中学习、更好泛化到新型攻击的鲁棒性训练方案。
AI.method: 提出Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning（SRFT）训练框架：不被动模仿专家行为，而是让智能体接触通过注入攻击构造的被污染轨迹，并利用专家模型生成结构化的自反思推理，对比不安全动作与最优动作。该反思监督训练智能体识别恶意指令、推理其后果并保持与原始用户意图的对齐。基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与Qwen3-8B实例化为SR-Agent。
AI.result: 在静态和自适应提示注入基准上评估，SRFT显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能，并在自适应攻击下展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过自反思从失败中学习，是构建鲁棒且安全LLM智能体的一个有前景的方向。代码已开源。

title: FreeLoc: Online Floorplan Localization via Diffusion-Aided Pose Refinement
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: Floorplans provide compact and widely available geometric maps for indoor localization, but existing high-performing floorplan-based methods still convert them into dense scene-specific offline databases, tying accuracy, storage, and runtime to the sampling resolution of the discretized pose space. We present FreeLoc, an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats the floorplan as a directly queryable geometric map. FreeLoc introduces an efficient online geometric querying and diffusion-aided refinement scheme, which retrieves plausible pose anchors through on-the-fly floorplan ray querying and refines them into accurate continuous pose estimates. For sequential localization, FreeLoc develops an online likelihood construction strategy that bridges single-frame localization and probabilistic temporal fusion by constructing likelihoods from coarse-sampled candidates and refined pose hypotheses, enabling histogram-filter-based temporal fusion without offline databases. Experiments demonstrate real-time online inference and state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential localization, while real-world results validate practical deployability in indoor robotic localization scenarios.

AI.tldr: FreeLoc是一种在线RGB室内定位框架，将平面图作为可直接查询的几何地图，通过在线射线查询与扩散细化实现连续位姿估计，并支持无需离线数据库的时序融合，达到实时且SOTA的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能的基于平面图的定位方法需将平面图转换为密集的场景专用离线数据库，导致精度、存储和运行时间受限于离散位姿空间的采样分辨率。作者希望摆脱这种离线数据库依赖，实现在线、可直接查询平面图的定位。
AI.method: 提出FreeLoc：1）高效的在线几何查询与扩散辅助细化方案，通过即时平面图射线查询（on-the-fly floorplan ray querying）检索合理的位姿锚点，并细化得到精确的连续位姿估计；2）面向序列定位的在线似然构建策略，利用粗采样候选和细化后的位姿假设构建似然，衔接单帧定位与概率时序融合，从而实现基于直方图滤波的时序融合而无需离线数据库。基于在线RGB输入，将平面图作为可直接查询的几何地图。
AI.result: 实验表明FreeLoc在单帧和序列定位任务上均实现实时在线推理并达到当前最优（SOTA）性能；真实世界实验结果验证了其在室内机器人定位场景中的实际可部署性。
AI.conclusion: FreeLoc通过在线几何查询与扩散细化、以及无需离线数据库的在线似然构建，实现了高精度、实时的RGB-平面图室内定位，具备实际部署价值，避免了传统方法对离散离线数据库的依赖。

title: AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture
summary: Agricultural visual models are typically evaluated for either recognition or localization, but reliable diagnosis requires identifying what is present and localizing the evidence. Agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets carry rich semantic labels but rarely link them to image regions, and adding such annotations by hand is costly at scale. We introduce AgroGround, a large-scale dataset for grounded agricultural recognition: identifying plant diseases and other agricultural targets and localizing their image regions. An automated pipeline converts the labels of eight agricultural VQA datasets into annotations for disease lesions and whole objects, producing 794,850 instruction examples. Healthy images provide negative supervision for disease queries, teaching the model to return empty predictions. We fine-tune a shared vision-language model on known-target grounding instructions combined with instructions requiring both recognition and localization. We evaluate predicted identities, regions, joint correctness, and healthy-image abstention on 1,480 human-verified images disjoint from all training data. Grounding-only fine-tuning reduces recognition accuracy from 51.8\% to 29.1\%, while adding recognition-and-localization instructions raises it to 72.6\%. With images and annotations held fixed, combining the two formats raises joint accuracy from 19.2\% to 43.3\% at comparable grounding. Healthy negatives raise abstention on healthy images to 95.0\%, and reinforcement learning improves lesion-level grounding. The resulting 2B model exceeds its annotation teacher in grounding F1 on our benchmark and on the external PlantSeg test set. AgroGround establishes a benchmark for grounded agricultural recognition, measuring joint correctness of identity and localization along with abstention on healthy images. The code is available at https://github.com/AB-Abdulla/AgroGround.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgroGround，一个大规模"有定位的农业识别"数据集与基准，通过自动化流程将8个农业VQA数据集标签转为病害病灶与整体目标的定位标注，共794,850条指令样本，并训练共享视觉语言模型同时完成识别与定位，联合准确率从19.2%提升至43.3%，健康图像拒答率达95.0%。
AI.motivation: 农业视觉模型通常只评估识别或定位单一能力，但可靠诊断需要同时判断"是什么"并定位"证据在哪里"。现有农业VQA数据集语义标签丰富却缺乏区域级标注，人工标注成本高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 构建自动化流水线，将8个农业VQA数据集的标签转换为病灶级与整体对象级的定位标注，生成794,850条指令样本；健康图像作为负监督用于疾病查询，引导模型输出空预测。在共享视觉语言模型上联合微调两类指令：已知目标定位指令，以及要求同时识别与定位的指令；并采用强化学习优化病灶级定位。在1,480张人工核验图像（与训练数据完全不相交）上评估预测身份、区域、联合正确性与健康图像拒答。
AI.result: 仅定位微调使识别准确率从51.8%降至29.1%，加入"识别+定位"指令后回升至72.6%；在图像与标注固定的条件下，混合两种格式使联合准确率从19.2%升至43.3%，定位性能相当。健康负样本将健康图像拒答率提升至95.0%，强化学习进一步改善病灶级定位。所得2B模型在本基准及外部PlantSeg测试集上的定位F1超过其标注教师模型。
AI.conclusion: AgroGround为"有定位的农业识别"建立了基准，同时衡量身份与定位的联合正确性及健康图像拒答能力，并表明识别与定位指令协同训练对联合性能至关重要。

title: AgentPersonaBench: Benchmarking Persona-Driven User Simulation
summary: We introduce AgentPersonaBench (APB), a benchmark evaluating whether persona conditioning faithfully steers downstream agent behavior. While language models are increasingly deployed for persona-driven user simulation, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate conversational styling or self-reports rather than authentic behavioral fidelity. APB evaluates latent persona adherence one trait at a time, embedding each target trait within a complete synthetic profile without explicitly naming the trait or disclosing the test. Ground-truth adherence is verified strictly from observable actions across four interaction surfaces of increasing realism: survey, chat, web (interactive web environments), and app (desktop software environments). APB comprises 2,460 tasks spanning 867 traits, verified through automated audits and expert review. Our evaluation of 20 frontier model arms demonstrates that high-fidelity user simulation is already attainable: leading models achieve up to 84.7% full-pass adherence under unprompted conditions. At the same time, APB identifies clear behavioral boundaries: adherence drops across interaction modalities (only 37.9-64.3% pass all four surfaces), multi-attribute demands degrade retention, and competing model families exhibit pronounced behavioral divergence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AgentPersonaBench (APB)，一个评估人格条件（persona conditioning）能否忠实驱动下游智能体行为的基准。APB 每次针对单一潜在特质进行评测，将其嵌入完整合成画像中，且不显式命名特质或透露测试意图；通过问卷、聊天、网页、应用四种真实度递增的交互界面，从可观测行为严格验证人格遵循度。基准包含 2,460 个任务、涵盖 867 个特质，经自动化审计与专家复核验证。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多用于人格驱动的用户模拟，但现有基准主要评估对话风格或自我报告，而非真实的行为保真度，缺乏对人格条件是否真正驱动行为的严谨检验。
AI.method: 提出 APB 基准：逐特质评估潜在人格遵循度，将目标特质嵌入完整合成画像而不点名特质、不披露测试；从四种真实度递增的交互界面（问卷、聊天、网页、应用）的可观测动作中验证真值遵循度；构建 2,460 个任务、覆盖 867 个特质，并通过自动化审计和专家评审双重验证；对 20 个前沿模型配置进行评测。
AI.result: 评测显示高保真用户模拟已可实现：领先模型在无提示条件下全通过遵循率达 84.7%。同时 APB 揭示明显的行为边界：跨交互模态遵循度下降（仅 37.9%–64.3% 通过全部四种界面），多属性要求会削弱特质保持，不同模型家族间存在显著行为差异。
AI.conclusion: APB 提供了评估人格驱动智能体行为保真度的严格基准，表明前沿模型已具备较高的人格模拟能力，但仍存在跨模态衰减、多属性退化及家族间分歧等局限，为人格条件化用户模拟的进一步研究指明方向。

title: Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging
summary: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.

AI.tldr: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）相对离策略方法的精度优势主要来自训练设计选择与超参调优，而非算法本身；精心调优的离策略基线（SFT、软标签蒸馏）可达到几乎相同的精度，且训练成本低14.8–23.1倍。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型后训练中，基于同一基础检查点训练多个专家模型并合并其能力已成常态，近期趋势认为多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）优于传统离策略方法。但MOPD带来更高的推理与环境交互成本，因此有必要检验其精度增益究竟来自算法本身，还是来自训练设计选择与超参优化。
AI.method: 开展受控的自蒸馏研究，覆盖两种多教师设置、4个模型、11个基准；对比离策略方法（监督微调SFT、软标签蒸馏）与混合教师前缀蒸馏、MOPD。同时复现并重新审视4项已发表的在线策略与离策略蒸馏对比，在SFT基线使用拒绝采样的教师轨迹并独立调参后重新评估；此外考察免训练的权重合并方法作为替代方案。
AI.result: 四种方法取得几乎相同的精度，但MOPD的训练GPU时耗为SFT的14.8–23.1倍。四项已发表对比中，在线策略方法的报告增益在SFT基线采用拒绝采样教师轨迹并独立调参后大幅缩小。简单的权重合并可在数分钟CPU合并时间内恢复专家能力，但当模型规模减小、任务干扰增大时精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果对MOPD近期报告的增益提出质疑，表明经过精心调优的更高效离策略基线是可行业替代方案；权重合并可作为免训练的补充手段，但其效果受模型规模与任务干扰影响。

title: Now You Feel It, Now You See Me: Digital-Twin-based Teleoperation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Teleoperation is becoming increasingly important for collecting high-quality demonstrations to teach robots dexterous manipulation skills. For dexterous manipulation, bare-hand tracking provides a practical way to control robotic hands and demonstrate coordinated finger movements without gloves or exoskeletons. However, this type of teleoperation faces two key feedback limitations: a lack of force feedback and visual feedback of occluded region. The absence of force feedback hinders precise and safe manipulation, as operators must infer contact force visually rather than feel them directly. Occlusion by objects or other robot parts impairs the assessment of hand positions, approach distances, and pre-grasp configurations suited to the object's shape. To address these limitations, we propose a digital-twin-based augmented reality (AR) teleoperation interface that integrates bare-hand tracking, bimanual robotic hands, and virtual representations of the robot and task objects. The interface renders tactile measurements on robot hand meshes as visuo-force feedback. Furthermore, it offers a user-controlled virtual view panel or occlusion-aware transparency rendering to provide occlusion-mitigating visual feedback. We evaluated the interface through user studies involving Task 1 and Task 2, examining how force visualization and visual assistance support demonstration collection in tasks requiring careful force regulation and manipulation under occlusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于数字孪生的AR遥操作界面，结合裸手追踪、双臂机械手及机器人/物体的虚拟表征，通过视觉力反馈和遮挡缓解视觉反馈解决遥操作中的力觉缺失与遮挡问题，并通过两项任务的用户研究进行评估。
AI.motivation: 遥操作对采集高质量机器人灵巧操作演示至关重要，裸手追踪无需手套或外骨骼即可实现灵巧手控制。但此类遥操作存在两大反馈局限：缺乏力反馈（操作者只能凭视觉推断接触力，影响精确与安全操作）和遮挡区域的视觉反馈缺失（物体或其他机器人部件遮挡会干扰手部位置、接近距离及适配物体形状的预抓取姿态判断）。
AI.method: 提出基于数字孪生的增强现实（AR）遥操作界面，集成裸手追踪、双臂机械手以及机器人和任务物体的虚拟表征。界面将触觉测量数据渲染到机械手网格上，作为视觉-力反馈；同时提供用户可控的虚拟视角面板或遮挡感知透明渲染，以实现缓解遮挡的视觉反馈。
AI.result: 通过包含任务1和任务2的用户研究对界面进行评估，考察力可视化和视觉辅助如何支持在需要精细力调节和遮挡条件下操作的演示采集任务。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数字孪生AR遥操作界面通过视觉-力反馈与遮挡缓解视觉反馈，针对裸手遥操作中的力觉缺失和遮挡问题提供解决方案，并在用户研究中验证其对演示采集任务的支持作用。

title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
summary: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. Evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems reveals a sharp improvement in Task success beginning with Claude Opus 5, rising from below 5\% to over 15\%, while substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remain. We further find that worlds that look better could work worse: better visual fidelity does not always lead to higher task success. This echoes the broader gap between perceptual realism and factual correctness observed in generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自主视频到仿真"（autonomous video-to-simulation）任务，并构建Video2World基准（222个重建实例，源自189个机器人及人类演示视频），用于评估前沿编码智能体能否端到端地从真实视频自动构建交互式仿真环境。实验显示从Claude Opus 5起任务成功率由不足5%跃升至15%以上，但与人工辅助重建仍有显著差距，且发现视觉保真度更高并不必然带来更好的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 构建交互式仿真器是扩展具身数据规模的重要途径，但现有流程严重依赖人工环境搭建与标定，成本高、效率低。作者希望探究前沿基础模型与编码智能体能否将这一过程完全自动化，从而突破人工依赖瓶颈。
AI.method: 将"自主视频到仿真"形式化为一个软件工程任务：智能体观察具身视频，构建对应的仿真环境与机器人行为，并通过执行反馈迭代优化重建结果。为此提出Video2World基准，包含222个重建实例（源自189个机器人及人类演示视频），并沿几何保真度、动态保真度、功能正确性三个维度进行评测，以刻画空间感知、物理推理与可执行交互能力。
AI.result: 在9种前沿编码智能体系统上的评测显示，自Claude Opus 5起任务成功率出现明显跃升，从低于5%提升至15%以上；但与人工辅助重建相比仍存在较大差距。此外还发现"看起来更好的世界未必更可用"：更高的视觉保真度并不总是带来更高的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 自主视频到仿真已初步可行但远未成熟，编码智能体在端到端自动化重建上展现出进步势头，却仍难以企及人类辅助水平。视觉真实感与功能正确性之间存在脱节，这与生成模型中普遍观察到的感知真实性与事实正确性之间的鸿沟相呼应，提示未来评测与优化需更关注功能正确性而非仅追求视觉保真。

title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出TrustMed-RL，一个基于罕见病病例与2.4万余张人工标注图像面板构建的、可进行长程证据化诊断的医学视觉-语言策略模型，在诊断准确率与证据获取上超越多个开放权重与闭源基线。
AI.motivation: 医学语言模型常能在检查不完整、推理缺乏依据的情况下给出正确诊断，缺乏长程、以证据为基础的诊断能力，因此需要构建能够整合问诊、查体、检验、专科会诊与文献检索的诊断策略。
AI.method: 基于PubMed罕见病病例与超过24,000张人工标注图像面板构建TrustMed-RL；通过状态依赖动作整合问诊、检查、检验、专科咨询和文献检索；训练一个8B视觉-语言策略模型，采用临床适配的GiGPO与覆盖率校正的诊断奖励。
AI.result: 在2,500例评测中诊断准确率37.1%，优于所有评测的开放权重基线，较监督微调提升12.4个百分点；在额外要求获取至少50%支持性检验证据时达32.5%，超出GPT-4o 6.8个百分点；在MTMedDialog上超越所有评测基线，在AgentClinic上超越多个27–32B模型；200条被诊断接受的测试轨迹中，83.0%获医生给出的证据落地性评分4–5分（满分5分）。
AI.conclusion: 医生评估表明该模型的诊断轨迹可信，并与人类诊断推理相一致，验证了以证据为基础的长程诊断策略的有效性。

title: Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data
summary: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.

AI.tldr: 提出IICN，将插补器与(n+1)类判别器在单一分类目标下对抗联合训练，理论证明全局最优时实现缺失坐标边缘化并达到贝叶斯最优分类，实验优于插补-再分类管线与生成式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有缺失特征分类方法多将插补与分类解耦，插补结果虽可能合理，但对预测未必有信息量，导致分类性能受限。
AI.method: IICN将插补器与一个(n+1)类判别器联合对抗训练，判别器需区分n个真实类别与一个额外的"插补"类，整体由单一类别监督分类目标驱动。
AI.result: 理论上证明在全局最优处，插补器与判别器共同实现缺失坐标上的边缘化，并给出贝叶斯最优分类器；在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10及含自然缺失的表格数据集上，IICN优于经典插补-再分类管线与近期生成式基线，鲁棒性与准确率更强。
AI.conclusion: IICN通过插补与分类的联合对抗训练，使插补面向预测任务，理论上达贝叶斯最优，实证上在多种缺失场景中取得更好性能。

title: PB-STDG: A Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy Guidance Algorithm for a Drone Road System
summary: In recent years, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) or drones have been increasingly adopted in urban environments for applications such as parcel delivery, infrastructure inspection, emergency response, and drone light shows. A non-negligible issue is how to manage the increasing number of drones operated by different entities, to enable them to cooperatively avoid potential collisions and determine conflict-free short-term flight paths in urban airspace. This paper presents a Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy (PB-STDG) guidance algorithm for a structured Drone Road System (DRS). PB-STDG extends the original STDG algorithm by introducing a prediction mechanism that enables drones to anticipate the decisions of neighboring drones using additional information shared in beacon packets, aiming to address the over-conservative behavior observed in the STDG algorithm. Several simulation scenarios are conducted to evaluate and compare the proposed algorithm with STDG. The results show that PB-STDG improves traffic efficiency while maintaining a safety level comparable to that of STDG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy (PB-STDG)引导算法，用于结构化无人机道路系统(DRS)中多无人机无冲突短时路径规划。PB-STDG在STDG基础上引入预测机制，通过信标包共享信息预测邻机决策，以克服原算法过度保守的问题。仿真表明其在保持与STDG相当安全水平的同时提升了交通效率。
AI.motivation: 近年来无人机在城市环境中的包裹配送、基础设施巡检、应急响应和灯光表演等应用日益增多，随之而来的关键问题是：如何管理由不同主体操控的大量无人机，使其能够协同避碰，并在城市空域中确定无冲突的短时飞行路径。
AI.method: 提出PB-STDG（Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy）引导算法，面向结构化无人机道路系统(DRS)。该算法扩展了原有STDG算法，引入预测机制，使无人机能够利用信标包(beacon packets)中共享的附加信息预判邻近无人机的决策，从而缓解STDG的过度保守行为。
AI.result: 设计了多组仿真场景，将所提算法与STDG进行对比评估。结果显示，PB-STDG在保持与STDG相当安全水平的前提下，提升了交通效率。
AI.conclusion: PB-STDG通过预测邻机决策有效改善了STDG的过度保守问题，在结构化DRS中实现了安全性与交通效率的良好平衡。

title: Multi-Crop Leaf Disease Recognition: A Unified Benchmark and Cross-Region Study
summary: Deep learning models for crop leaf disease recognition routinely report near-perfect accuracy yet are typically trained and evaluated on a single dataset collected under controlled laboratory conditions, leaving their behavior under realistic cross-region domain shift poorly understood. We introduce MLD (Multi-crop Leaf Disease) dataset, a unified multi-region benchmark that combines six public crop-disease datasets from the USA, Asia, and Africa into a shared hierarchical taxonomy spanning 18 crops, 56 crop-disease classes (including one healthy class per crop) making 167,427 images. We define standardized single-source and pooled multi-source evaluation protocols that explicitly probe cross-region generalization. We also investigate whether exploiting the inherent crop-to-disease dependency via a hierarchical formulation (HiLeaD) that conditions disease prediction on the predicted crop improves recognition under cross-region shift. Under the HiLeaD, the model trained on PlantVillage achieves 99.07% in-domain disease F1 but collapses to 12.88% when tested on PlantDoc, exposing a severe cross-region domain gap. The model trained on the pooled MLD dataset partly recovers cross-region disease F1 from 12.88% to 39.64% on PlantDoc (HiLeaD), achieving a 26.76 percentage point improvement. The hierarchical formulation provides a consistent additional gain, ranging from 1.71 to 4.88 percentage points in disease F1 over the flat baseline under the MLD dataset indicating that progress in this area is currently limited more by data coverage and diversity than by model design.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出现有作物叶片病害识别模型在实验室数据上近乎完美但跨区域泛化差，提出跨区域多作物基准MLD（6个数据集、18种作物、56个病害类、167,427张图像）与单源/多源评估协议，并用分层建模HiLeaD验证跨域表现。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习作物叶片病害识别研究多在同一实验室受控数据集上训练与评估，报告近乎完美的准确率，但其在真实跨区域域偏移下的行为缺乏了解，泛化能力被高估。
AI.method: 构建MLD（Multi-crop Leaf Disease）统一多区域基准，整合来自美国、亚洲和非洲的6个公开作物病害数据集，建立共享层级分类体系（18种作物、56个作物-病害类别，每作物含1个健康类，共167,427张图像）；定义标准化单源与多源池化评估协议以显式检验跨区域泛化；提出HiLeaD分层公式，利用作物-病害固有依赖，以预测作物为条件预测病害。
AI.result: HiLeaD下，PlantVillage训练的模型域内病害F1达99.07%，在PlantDoc上骤降至12.88%，暴露严重跨区域域差；在MLD池化数据上训练后，PlantDoc病害F1由12.88%恢复至39.64%（提升26.76个百分点）；分层公式相比扁平基线在MLD上稳定增益1.71至4.88个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 当前该领域的进展更多受限于数据覆盖度与多样性，而非模型设计；分层建模可带来一致的小幅增益，但跨区域泛化仍需通过更广泛、多样的数据来解决。

title: TimeNet: An Extensible Unified Data Infrastructure for Next-Generation Temporal Foundation Models
summary: Temporal Foundation Models (TFMs) aim to generalize across domains, datasets, and tasks. Yet, their development remains constrained by fragmented, task-specific data formats, annotations, and processing pipelines. We introduce TimeNet, an open-source data standard and scalable infrastructure that decouples temporal data from task definitions and represents signals, metadata, annotations, and supervision in a shared, extensible data model. TimeNet supports multimodal signals with regular, irregular, or ordinal time axes and expresses different task families (including classification, forecasting, temporal localization, question answering, generation, and editing) as reusable views over the same recordings. This shared representation enables heterogeneous time-series datasets to be combined for large-scale model training across domains, modalities, and tasks. We demonstrate TimeNet by transcoding datasets with 1.5M task instances spanning diverse domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision, while retaining practical I/O performance relative to native formats. TimeNet enables an existing TFN training pipeline to support joint training on a configurable number of heterogeneous datasets through configuration changes alone. We show this capability by training TFM across multiple datasets and tasks, obtaining a 14% F1 score improvement compared with models trained on individual datasets. These results show that TimeNet provides the data and systems foundation needed to move beyond task- and dataset-specific TFMs toward models that can learn jointly across heterogeneous domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision from a common data model.

AI.tldr: TimeNet：开源时间序列数据标准与可扩展基础设施，通过统一数据模型解耦数据与任务定义，支持异构数据集联合训练，跨多数据集/任务训练 TFM 获得 14% F1 提升。
AI.motivation: 时间基础模型（TFMs）目标是在跨域、跨数据集、跨任务上泛化，但当前发展受限于碎片化的、任务特定的数据格式、标注与处理流程。
AI.method: 提出 TimeNet，一个开源数据标准与可扩展基础设施，将时序数据与任务定义解耦，用共享、可扩展的数据模型表示信号、元数据、标注与监督。支持具有规则、非规则或序数时间轴的多模态信号，并将分类、预测、时序定位、问答、生成、编辑等任务族表达为对同一记录的可复用视图，从而可组合异构时序数据集进行大规模跨域、跨模态、跨任务训练。
AI.result: 通过转码数据集验证，涵盖 150 万个任务实例，覆盖多域、多模态、多时间尺度与多种监督形式，同时保留相对原生格式的实用 I/O 性能。仅通过配置变更即可使现有 TFN 训练流程支持可配置数量异构数据集的联合训练；跨多数据集与任务训练 TFM，相比在各单数据集上训练的模型获得 14% F1 提升。
AI.conclusion: TimeNet 提供了所需的数据与系统基础，推动 TFM 超越任务特定与数据集特定的局限，走向基于统一数据模型、跨异构域、模态、时间尺度与监督形式联合学习的模型。

title: Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS
summary: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

AI.tldr: 在NASA C-MAPSS的FD001/FD003上训练1D CNN、LSTM与小型Transformer（RUL上限125、PHM08评分），并用IG、遮挡、末层注意力三种归因图做删除/插入忠实性、抗噪稳定性、种子一致性与RUL分箱余弦一致性检验；结论是IG与遮挡忠实度相近、Transformer注意力便宜且平滑但忠实度弱，且抗输入噪声稳定≠抗重训练稳定，工程报告推荐遮挡或IG。
AI.motivation: 当前深度RUL模型在C-MAPSS上已成常规，传感器-时间步热力图也随处可见，但"看起来像机理"的热力图不等于工程师可据以行动的归因。XAI-for-PdM文献对忠实性、稳定性等关键核验仍普遍缺报，本文旨在用一套严格的归因评估协议，区分哪些解释方法真正驱动RUL输出、哪些只是可视化装饰。
AI.method: 在官方FD001与FD003划分上训练三种标准架构：1D CNN、LSTM、小型Transformer编码器，采用分段RUL上限125循环与PHM08非对称评分（预测精度是前提而非主张）。对每个模型附加三种归因图：Integrated Gradients、遮挡（occlusion）、末层注意力。评估指标包括删除/插入忠实性、传感器尺度噪声下Spearman稳定性、跨训练种子一致性、RUL分箱内余弦一致性；并辅以AI4I 2020失效数据集的表格树重要性对照。
AI.result: LSTM上Integrated Gradients与遮挡的忠实度相近；Transformer注意力代价低、时间上平滑但忠实度弱。三种归因图在5%输入噪声下几乎不变，但IG/遮挡在两个LSTM训练种子间仅中等一致，说明抗传感器抖动稳定性与抗重训练稳定性并非一回事。AI4I 2020上树重要性呈现相同的删除模式。整体上，指标聚焦于"移除top单元后RUL输出是否改变"以及"哪种图能经受5%输入扰动"。
AI.conclusion: 对于面向维修工程师阅读的C-MAPSS类报告，推荐使用遮挡或Integrated Gradients，并将原始注意力权重仅视为可视化手段而非解释依据；同时应明确区分输入扰动稳定性与重训练稳定性两类评估。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement of Visuomotor Policies through Local Recovery Supervision
summary: Visuomotor policies can execute familiar tasks yet lack the corrective behavior needed after their own mistakes. We present a framework for recursive self-improvement through local recovery supervision. Each round audits the current policy, generates corrective demonstrations at supported failure states, and uses them to update the policy that drives the next round of collection. An offline auditor locates unresolved failures using coarse and dense temporal evidence and specifies observable repair goals. A fixed multimodal agent acts as a tool-using teacher, generating recovery actions through observation, computation, execution, and feedback. The frozen student tests whether each teacher endpoint supports further progress. If continuation fails, the system restores that endpoint and extends the demonstration. Action-level quality assessment then defines continuous training windows with aligned observations, quality weights, and validity masks. Only the student is deployed. In a preliminary LIBERO-Goal study, recovery-augmented post-training achieves 88 successful episodes out of 100 validation scenes, compared with 78 for original-data continuation from the same $π_0$ checkpoint. An earlier BC-RNN study on robomimic Can improves success from 102/130 to 112/130 using 26 local recovery segments. Both comparisons match 2,000 additional optimization steps.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过局部恢复监督实现递归自我改进的视觉运动策略框架：审计当前策略、在失败状态生成纠正示范并更新策略，仅部署学生模型。LIBERO-Goal初步研究中恢复增强后训练达88/100，优于基线78/100；robomimic Can由102/130提升至112/130。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉运动策略能执行熟悉任务，但在自身犯错后缺乏纠正行为（恢复能力）。为解决该缺陷并实现策略的递归自我改进，需要一种在失败状态提供局部恢复监督的机制。
AI.method: 框架含四部分：(1)离线审计器用粗粒度与稠密时序证据定位未解决的失败，并指定可观测的修复目标；(2)固定多模态智能体作为工具型教师，通过观察—计算—执行—反馈生成恢复动作；(3)冻结的学生模型检验每个教师端点能否继续推进，若失败则回退该端点并延长示范；(4)动作级质量评估定义连续训练窗口，配套对齐观测、质量权重与有效性掩码。每轮审计策略、生成纠正示范、更新策略以驱动下一轮采集，仅部署学生模型。
AI.result: LIBERO-Goal初步研究中，恢复增强后训练在100个验证场景中成功88个，而同一π0检查点用原始数据继续训练为78个；早期在robomimic Can上的BC-RNN研究使用26个局部恢复片段将成功率从102/130提升到112/130。两组对比均匹配2,000额外优化步数。
AI.conclusion: 局部恢复监督可有效提升视觉运动策略的错误纠正能力与任务成功率，且仅需少量恢复片段、在同等优化预算下即优于原始数据继续训练，为该类策略的递归自我改进提供了可行路径。

title: RPFQ-ViT: Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization for Extremely Low-Bit Weights in Vision Transformers
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Current preprint version; camera-ready revision forthcoming
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance on image recognition and mobile vision applications, but their high-dimensional linear projections and attention computations still impose substantial storage and inference costs. Extremely low-bit quantization is a promising solution, yet ViTs often suffer severe accuracy degradation because conventional real-valued scalar codebooks are poorly matched to the directional geometry of Transformer projections. We present RPFQ-ViT, a Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization method that quantizes paired channels in two-dimensional phase planes, enabling low-bit codes to better preserve projection directions while recovering magnitude with lightweight scaling. RPFQ-ViT serves as a drop-in QAT replacement for nn.Linear and does not modify the standard real-valued attention, normalization, or activation computation graph. On ImageNet-1K, RPFQ-ViT-B/16 reaches 79.33% Top-1 / 94.48% Top-5 under W2/A4, Swin-T reaches 79.30% Top-1 / 94.79% Top-5 under W2/A8, and DeiT-S reaches 77.41% Top-1 / 93.11% Top-5 under W2/A8. Ablations, phase-geometry analysis, and direction-preservation metrics show that channel pairing, learnable rotation, phase-anchor learning, and residual phase refinement each improve quantization quality. We further deploy RPFQ-ViT image-classification models on native iOS and Android runtime stacks; with 2-bit packed weights, model size shrinks by roughly $5.4$-$7.1\times$ relative to FP32 and end-to-end on-device latency drops by $1.4$-$1.6\times$. All ImageNet results trained in our codebase use a matched 300-epoch recipe and are reported as mean accuracies over three independent runs. These results show that RPFQ-ViT provides a favorable trade-off among accuracy, compression, and practical mobile deployment for extremely low-bit ViTs.

AI.tldr: RPFQ-ViT 提出一种旋转相位坐标系量化方法，将成对通道在二维相位平面内量化，实现极低位 ViT 量化并保持投影方向，兼顾精度、压缩与移动端部署。
AI.motivation: ViT 的高维线性投影与注意力计算带来显著存储与推理开销；极低位量化虽具潜力，但传统实值标量码本难以匹配 Transformer 投影的方向性几何，导致精度严重下降。
AI.method: 将成对通道放入二维相位平面进行量化，用低比特码保留投影方向、以轻量缩放恢复幅度；作为 nn.Linear 的即插即用 QAT 替代，不改动标准实值注意力、归一化与激活计算图。关键组件包括通道配对、可学习旋转、相位锚点学习与残差相位精化。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K 上，ViT-B/16 在 W2/A4 达 79.33% Top-1 / 94.48% Top-5，Swin-T 在 W2/A8 达 79.30% / 94.79%，DeiT-S 在 W2/A8 达 77.41% / 93.11%。消融与相位几何、方向保持指标验证各组件有效性。部署于 iOS/Android 原生运行时，2-bit 打包权重使模型体积缩小约 5.4–7.1×，端到端设备延迟降低 1.4–1.6×。所有结果基于 300 epoch 配方，报告三次独立运行的均值。
AI.conclusion: RPFQ-ViT 在精度、压缩率与移动端实际部署之间取得良好折衷，为极低位 ViT 提供了可行方案。

title: CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of Black-Box Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: The deployment of Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents in critical domains must be preceded with a pipeline to evaluate the alignment of the RL agent with complex multi-objective specifications and robustness under real-world environmental drift. However, to protect intellectual property, the RL agent may be delivered for evaluation as opaque executable or remote API, which makes traditional evaluation techniques based on the internals of the policies infeasible. To address this gap, CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of black box RL policy is proposed in this paper.
