The CORE-RL pipeline introduces a Unified Reliability Metric that formally integrates early task termination and safety constraint violations, preventing unsafe policies from masking failures through premature episode halts. By subjecting the policy to a noise certification envelope of perceptual noise, actuation noise and change in environment dynamics, the pipeline computes the finite-sample Clopper-Pearson bounds on unified reliability metric and Hoeffdings' lower bound on reward and safety cost. The pipeline then defines safe operational design domain to report high-confidence certificates for safety and expected performance. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate the CORE-RL pipeline's ability to automatically reject non-compliant policies and map the safe Operational Design Domain (ODD) of safety-aware policies. Thus CORE-RL provides an evaluation framework towards a quantitative, transparent and reproducible, statistical rationale necessary to safely evaluate, compare, and deploy black box RL solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CORE-RL，一个面向黑盒强化学习策略的置信度导向可靠性评估流水线，通过统一可靠性指标与统计下界证书，实现安全合规性与鲁棒性的量化评估。
AI.motivation: 在实际关键领域部署 RL 智能体前，需要评估其与复杂多目标规范的对齐性及在环境漂移下的鲁棒性。但出于知识产权保护，RL 策略常以不可解释的可执行文件或远程 API 形式交付，导致依赖策略内部结构的传统评估方法不可行，因此存在评估空白。
AI.method: CORE-RL 引入统一可靠性指标（Unified Reliability Metric），将早停任务终止与安全约束违规形式化整合，避免不安全策略通过提前终止回合掩盖失败。该流水线对策略施加包含感知噪声、执行噪声与环境动态变化的噪声认证包络，计算统一可靠性指标的有限样本 Clopper-Pearson 置信界，以及奖励与安全代价的 Hoeffding 下界，并据此定义安全操作设计域（ODD）以报告高置信度的安全与期望性能证书。
AI.result: 在连续控制任务上的实验表明，CORE-RL 能自动拒绝不合规策略，并刻画安全感知策略的安全操作设计域（ODD）。
AI.conclusion: CORE-RL 为黑盒 RL 方案的安全评估、比较与部署提供了定量、透明、可复现且具统计学依据的评估框架。

title: First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 First-Order Steering，将激活引导重新表述为权重更新矩阵的一阶近似（由引导强度向量参数化），并给出近似误差的理论界；进一步提出 HeRD-Merging 模型合并方法以最小化该误差项，从而生成更准确、可组合的引导向量。
AI.motivation: 激活引导虽能在推理时操控模型行为，但如何组合多个引导向量以同时实现多种目标行为仍具挑战；而模型合并中由权重适配所表示的目标行为可高精度组合。因此，将权重适配转化为激活引导向量，有望借助模型合并的经验生成可组合的引导向量，实现同时性的推理期行为控制。
AI.method: 作者提出 First-Order Steering，把激活引导形式化为权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，由引导强度向量参数化，并为该一阶近似的误差建立理论界；随后设计 HeRD-Merging 模型合并流程，通过最小化一阶近似误差项，提升一阶引导的准确性。
AI.result: 该方法生成的引导向量在控制单一行为与组合行为上均比现有激活引导方法更准确；同时 HeRD-Merging 达到与传统模型合并基线相当的性能，且其产生的权重适配可导出更准确的一阶引导向量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将激活引导与模型合并理论联系，一阶引导与 HeRD-Merging 兼顾了模型合并的组合优势与激活引导的推理期操控能力，为多行为同时控制提供了更准确、可组合的方案。

title: VICON: Visual-Inertial-Contact based Hand-Object Tracking for Manipulation Datasets
summary: Learning dexterous manipulation benefits from human demonstration datasets that capture diverse and natural hand-object interactions. In particular, contact points and forces provide supervision on where and how strongly to interact, which cannot be fully captured by motion trajectories alone. However, methods for jointly capturing hand and object motion, contact points, and forces remain limited. Moreover, severe occlusion from hand-object interaction challenges accurate tracking of both hands and objects. To address these limitations, we present a Visual-Inertial-CONtact based hand-object tracking (VICON) framework. It holistically captures both hand and object motion along with contact information during manipulation, even under severe occlusion. First, we adopt a visual-inertial glove and an RGB-D camera for accurate hand tracking, and redesign the glove to incorporate contact sensing. Specifically, force-sensitive resistors (FSRs) are placed on the glove based on human grasp frequency to synchronously record contact states and calibrated normal forces. Second, without requiring pre-existing CAD models, we estimate object poses using RGB-D images and a mesh reconstructed from a monocular video. We propose factor-graph-based object trajectory estimation that fuses object-pose estimates weighted by visibility under hand-object occlusion, FSR measurements, and a hand-motion prior. Across 40 motion-capture sessions with five objects, VICON achieves a 2.5% failed-frame rate compared with 50.9-64.6% for the baselines, with median errors of 3.9 mm and 3.0 degrees under occlusion. Using VICON, we construct a dataset containing synchronized hand-object motion, contact points, and normal forces, and will publicly release an expanded dataset covering 10 object categories at https://github.com/VICON-dataset/dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出 VICON 视觉-惯性-接触融合框架，实现严重遮挡下手部与物体运动及接触信息的联合捕捉，并构建同步数据集。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作学习需要包含接触点与接触力的人类演示数据，但现有方法难以联合捕捉手部/物体运动、接触点与力，且手物交互造成的严重遮挡导致跟踪精度差。
AI.method: 1) 采用视觉-惯性手套加 RGB-D 相机进行手部跟踪，并依据人类抓取频率在手套上布置力敏电阻（FSR）以同步记录接触状态与标定法向力；2) 无需已有 CAD 模型，用 RGB-D 图像与单目视频重建网格估计物体位姿；3) 提出基于因子图的物体轨迹估计，融合按可见性加权的物体位姿估计、FSR 测量与手部运动先验。
AI.result: 在 5 个物体、40 次动作捕捉会话中，失效帧率仅 2.5%，而基线为 50.9%–64.6%；遮挡条件下中位误差为 3.9 mm 与 3.0 度。基于 VICON 构建了包含同步手物运动、接触点与法向力的数据集。
AI.conclusion: VICON 可在严重遮挡下鲁棒联合捕捉手物运动与接触信息，显著优于基线，并将在 GitHub 公开发布覆盖 10 类物体的扩展数据集。

title: Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to convert medical images into diagnostic texts to assist in clinical decision-making and alleviate the workload of physicians. Although existing methods have made extensive progress in cross-modal interaction and the incorporation of external priors, the distribution shift of underlying representations and the undifferentiated rigid coupling of heterogeneous information cause weak visual abnormality cues to be easily diluted by massive text priors and generation inertia during decoding. To overcome this bottleneck, inspired by cognitive science, we propose a novel two-stage Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing (HSA-HER) framework. First, the model introduces an explicit homogeneous distribution constraint in the underlying latent space to effectively eliminate the cross-modal distribution shift between visual and textual features, thereby extracting purified visual features as semantic anchors that accurately align with diseases. Second, for heterogeneous clinical evidence composed of visual features, local entities, and global retrievals, we design a hierarchical expert routing mechanism guided by these disease semantic anchors. This mechanism abandons the undifferentiated rigid coupling paradigm. Specifically, it dynamically activates expert networks to perform targeted mining and semantic reconstruction on multi-source evidence, and adaptively allocates fusion weights. Extensive experiments on three mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSA-HER achieves state-of-the-art performance, accurately depicting complex imaging details and key diagnostic information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSA-HER两阶段框架，通过同质语义对齐与层次化专家路由解决放射报告生成中的跨模态分布偏移与异质信息刚性耦合问题，在三个基准数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 放射报告生成旨在将医学图像转为诊断文本以辅助临床决策、减轻医师负担。现有方法在跨模态交互与外部先验引入方面已有进展，但潜在表示的分布偏移以及异质信息的无差别刚性耦合，导致微弱的视觉异常线索在解码时容易被海量文本先验和生成惯性所稀释。
AI.method: 受认知科学启发，提出两阶段HSA-HER框架。第一阶段在底层潜在空间引入显式的同质分布约束，消除视觉与文本特征间的跨模态分布偏移，提取与疾病精准对齐的纯净视觉特征作为语义锚点。第二阶段针对由视觉特征、局部实体和全局检索构成的异质临床证据，设计以疾病语义锚点引导的层次化专家路由机制，摒弃无差别的刚性耦合范式：动态激活专家网络对多源证据进行定向挖掘与语义重构，并自适应分配融合权重。
AI.result: 在三个主流基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HSA-HER达到了最先进性能，能够准确刻画复杂的影像细节与关键诊断信息。
AI.conclusion: 同质语义对齐与层次化专家路由的结合有效缓解了分布偏移与信息刚性耦合两大瓶颈，提升了放射报告生成的准确性与临床可用性。

title: Asking Earns Nothing: Scoring the Decision to Act in BFCL Multi-Turn
summary: An agent that lacks the information it needs should ask rather than act, and the task definitions of agent leaderboards say so. BFCL multi-turn builds two of its four categories around a turn on which the model is supposed to ask, and its scorer never looks at that turn: the gold trajectory there is empty, the checker skips it, and the scripted user cannot answer, so asking earns nothing, guessing costs nothing on that turn, and asking twice loses the item. The benchmark also contains the control experiment for that decision. A should-ask item is a base item with one piece of information removed from one turn, so the same request appears twice at the same turn index, once complete and once not: on the first the model should make the call that changes the world, on the second it should ask. We score one decision per pair, whether the model attempted a world-changing call on that turn, read off the stored trajectories with no LLM judge; acting always and asking always both score 50. On the 223 pairs that pose this decision, gpt-5.4 attempts the call on 83.4% of the complete turns and holds back on 78.0% of the incomplete ones, the best decision accuracy of seven models at 80.7%; on the same items the official score ranks it sixth and puts first a model that lands in the middle here. One added line telling gpt-5.4 not to ask pushes it toward acting on both sides of the pair, so its decision accuracy shows no detectable change, while its official score rises by 13.5 to 23.5 points on the two should-ask categories and on the base twins; the opposite line, telling gemma-4-31B-it to ask first, improves its decision by 4.5 points and gains no official score. The score moves with the push toward action, not with the decision. We release the pairs, a turn-level scorer that runs on any BFCL output directory without an API key, and 31 manually verified bad items.

AI.tldr: BFCL多轮基准的"应询问"类别其评分器并不检查该回合（gold轨迹为空、检查器跳过、脚本用户无法回答），导致询问无收益、猜测无代价；作者用223对"应询问/基线"配对直接测量该决策，发现官方得分与真实决策准确率脱节，甚至随"推动行动"而上升。
AI.motivation: 智能体在信息不足时应先询问而非行动，BFCL多轮基准的任务定义也如此声称，但其"应询问"两个类别的评分器完全不看该询问回合：gold轨迹在该回合为空、检查器跳过、脚本化用户无法作答。结果是询问得不到奖励、猜测在该回合没有代价、重复询问反而丢分，评测信号与所声称的能力目标错位，因此需要一个能隔离并测量"该问还是该做"这一决策的对照实验。
AI.method: 利用基准自带的对照设计：一个should-ask条目即从某一回合移除一条信息的基线条目，于是同一请求在同一回合索引出现两次（一次完整、一次不完整），完整时应执行改变世界的调用，不完整时应询问。对每对只评一个决策——该回合是否尝试了改变世界的调用，直接读取已存储轨迹判定，不使用LLM评判。另做提示干预实验：对gpt-5.4加入"不要询问"、对gemma-4-31B-it加入"先询问"的一行指令，比较决策准确率与官方得分的走向。
AI.result: 在223对条目上，gpt-5.4在83.4%的完整回合尝试调用、在78.0%的不完整回合克制，决策准确率80.7%，为七个模型中最优；同一批条目上其官方得分排第六，而排第一的模型在此处仅居中。加入"不要询问"一行后，gpt-5.4在配对两侧都更倾向行动，决策准确率无可检测变化，但官方得分在两个should-ask类别及基线孪生条目上提升13.5至23.5分；反向指令（"先询问"）使gemma-4-31B-it决策提升4.5分，官方得分无提升。此外人工核验出31个坏条目。
AI.conclusion: 官方得分跟随的是"倾向行动"的偏置，而非"该不该问"的决策质量，说明BFCL多轮的should-ask评分并未度量其声称所测的能力。作者发布配对数据、可在任意BFCL输出目录上运行、无需API key的回合级评分器，以及31个经人工核验的坏条目，以支持对询问决策的可靠评测。

title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
summary: Self-evolving reasoning models learn from their own generated questions, yet repeated self-training can lead to performance collapse. In this paper, we investigate why performance deteriorates over successive rounds and how to sustain self-evolution. Our analysis identifies two recurring quality problems in self-generated questions: invalid questions and repeated variants of the same mathematical questions. First, invalid questions become more prevalent across rounds, and answer-consistency filtering further increases their proportion in training data. Second, existing question diversity controls based on lexical similarity can miss mathematically equivalent questions expressed in different ways, which leads to question diversity collapse in later training rounds. Building on these findings, we introduce R-Quest, which uses question validity and novelty feedback to guide self-evolution. We first train the solver to recognize and reject invalid questions, then use its judgments to guide questioner rewards and filter solver training data. To avoid question repetition, we use a frozen base model to compare sampled question pairs and provide novelty feedback. Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.

AI.tldr: 论文分析自演化推理模型性能崩溃的成因，发现自生成问题存在无效问题与数学等价重复两类质量缺陷，提出R-Quest，通过问题有效性与新颖性反馈引导自演化，在12个基准上取得最佳平均表现并在10轮自演化中稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 自演化推理模型依赖自生成问题进行自我训练，但反复自训练会导致性能崩溃。论文旨在揭示性能随轮次下降的原因，并寻求维持自演化的方法。
AI.method: 分析发现自生成问题的两类质量问题：无效问题随轮次增多，且答案一致性过滤会进一步抬高其比例；基于词汇相似度的多样性控制无法识别不同表述的数学等价问题，导致后期问题多样性崩溃。据此提出R-Quest：先训练solver识别并拒绝无效问题，再用其判断引导questioner奖励并过滤solver训练数据；同时利用冻结基模型比较采样问题对，提供新颖性反馈以避免问题重复。
AI.result: 在两个模型族、共12个基准（数学推理、通用领域推理、代码生成）上，R-Quest持续取得最高平均性能；在10轮自演化中保持稳定增益，最终轮达到峰值，比R-Zero高出17.32分。
AI.conclusion: 自演化崩溃主要由无效问题累积与数学等价问题导致的多样性崩溃引起；引入问题有效性与新颖性反馈可有效缓解该问题，实现长期稳定的自演化性能提升。

title: Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization
summary: Most vision-language-action models represent future motion as fixed-rate action chunks, tying temporal resolution and prediction horizon to a fixed output budget. This pointwise representation wastes capacity on highly correlated neighboring actions, leaves temporal continuity and smoothness to be learned implicitly, and forces a tradeoff between long-horizon coverage and the local precision required for contact-rich manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce Vela, a vision-language-action foundation model that represents future robot behavior as continuous trajectories. Vela combines a compact spline-based action representation with motion-dependent temporal support and a shared action interface for heterogeneous embodiments, allowing a fixed output budget to adapt its temporal resolution across motions. We pretrain Vela on large-scale multi-embodiment robot data and evaluate it on LIBERO-X, EBench, and two real-world long-horizon tasks, egg-cake cooking and potato shredding, obtaining promising results across simulation and physical manipulation. These results highlight the potential of continuous action representations as a foundation for future embodied foundation models. Project page and more results: https://clementine24.github.io/Vela/ .

AI.tldr: 提出Vela视觉-语言-动作基础模型，将未来机器人行为表示为连续轨迹，通过基于样条的动作表示与运动相关时间支持，使固定输出预算能自适应调整时间分辨率，在仿真与真实长时序任务上取得有前景的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型将未来运动表示为固定速率的动作块，导致时间分辨率与预测时域被固定输出预算绑定；逐点表示在高度相关的相邻动作上浪费容量，时间连续性与平滑性只能隐式学习，并迫使长时域覆盖与接触密集操作所需的局部精度之间产生权衡。
AI.method: Vela将未来机器人行为建模为连续轨迹，融合紧凑的基于样条的动作表示、运动相关的时间支持（motion-dependent temporal support），以及面向异构本体的共享动作接口，使固定输出预算可在不同运动间自适应调整时间分辨率；并在大规模多本体机器人数据上进行预训练。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-X、EBench以及两个真实世界长时域任务（egg-cake cooking 与 potato shredding）上进行评估，在仿真与物理操作中均取得有前景的结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了连续动作表示作为未来具身基础模型基础的潜力。

title: Localization Lens for Improving Medical Vision-Language Models
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI)
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in clinical tasks. However, they often struggle to understand anatomical structures and spatial positioning, which are crucial for medical reasoning. To address this, we propose a localization-aware enhancement to the Med-VLM pipeline, introducing improvements at three levels: data,architecture, and alignment. First, we introduce localization lens, a set of expert-validated representations that provide richer anatomical and positional context. However, as these representations increase input complexity, we integrate pixel shuffle within the model architecture to filter and refine representations, enhancing spatial information processing while preserving anatomical continuity. Lastly, to effectively align the localization lens representations with textual features, we incorporate decoupled contrastive loss (DCL) alongside the standard loss function. This ensures better feature discrimination and robustness, particularly in data limited medical settings. Through extensive evaluations on medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) datasets, we show that our methodology improves localization-driven performance across different Med-VLM architectures. Our analysis of localization-based questions further reveals that improvements in anatomy and spatial reasoning directly enhance the overall accuracy of Med-VQA upto 6.2%. The proposed approach is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing Med-VLM pipelines. The dataset, code, and trained models will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向医学视觉语言模型的定位感知增强方法，从数据、架构与对齐三个层面改进，显著提升医学视觉问答中解剖与空间推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型（Med-VLMs）在临床任务中表现较强，但在理解解剖结构与空间定位方面存在明显不足，而这对于医学推理至关重要。
AI.method: 采用三层改进：(1) 数据层引入 localization lens，即经专家验证的表征集合，提供更丰富的解剖与位置上下文；(2) 架构层集成 pixel shuffle，在增加输入复杂度时对表征进行过滤与精炼，增强空间信息处理并保持解剖连续性；(3) 对齐层在标准损失之外引入解耦对比损失（DCL），加强视觉表征与文本特征的对齐，提升特征判别力与鲁棒性，尤其适用于数据受限的医学场景。方法为模型无关设计，可无缝集成到现有 Med-VLM 流程。
AI.result: 在 Med-VQA 数据集上的广泛评估表明，该方法在不同 Med-VLM 架构上均提升定位驱动性能；对定位类问题的分析显示，解剖与空间推理的改善使 Med-VQA 整体准确率最高提升 6.2%。
AI.conclusion: 定位感知增强能有效弥补 Med-VLMs 在解剖与空间理解上的短板，且具有模型无关性，可通用集成；数据集、代码与训练模型将开源发布。

title: MERCI Cards: An LLM Evaluation and Deployment Framework for High-Stakes Domains
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional workflows, engineers and researchers require principled protocols to systematically track, monitor, and improve model performance across deployment cycles. We present a mathematical framework for iterative LLM evaluation and deployment, and demonstrate its application to AI systems used in criminal justice. Our framework formalizes LLM integration in high-stakes, high-risk, and resource-constrained domains across model selection, rubric design, evaluations and deployment via a weighted multi-objective optimization. We demonstrate that MERCI Cards can guide improvements of the system across deployment iterations, direct developer attention toward under-performing areas, and focus user attention on validation and error-correction in the LLM's outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出面向高风险、资源受限领域LLM迭代评估与部署的数学框架，将其形式化为加权多目标优化问题，并在刑事司法AI系统中验证MERCI Cards的引导作用。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被日益部署到高风险专业工作流，工程师与研究者需要一套有原则的协议，以系统性地跟踪、监控并改进模型在部署周期中的性能，而现有工作缺乏此类形式化、可迭代的评估与部署方法。
AI.method: 构建迭代式LLM评估与部署的数学框架，将模型选择、评分标准设计、评估与部署等环节在高风险、高风险及资源受限场景下的LLM集成形式化为加权多目标优化问题，并引入MERCI Cards作为支撑工具。
AI.result: 在用于相关司法场景的AI系统上演示了该框架的应用，表明MERCI Cards能够引导系统在多次部署迭代中的改进，将开发者注意力导向表现欠佳的环节，并促使用户关注LLM输出的验证与纠错。
AI.conclusion: 该数学框架与MERCI Cards为高风险、资源受限领域的LLM迭代评估与部署提供了可操作的原则性协议，有助于持续改进系统性能并明确开发者与用户的关注重点。

title: What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle
summary: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.

AI.tldr: 提出递归预测闭包原理，并据此设计可训练程序。
AI.motivation: 递归压缩中，需跨长路径保持有效的信息更易损失。
AI.method: 基于变分刻画推导有限预测测试与经验预测亏缺，构造松弛半空间约束并投影更新。
AI.result: 在四类任务中匹配或优于宿主模型，递归或记忆需求越重增益越大。
AI.conclusion: 递归接口处的预测保持是递归压缩的通用训练原则。

title: Safe Ergodic Control for Multi-Robot Systems via Quadratic Programming
summary: Ergodic control drives robots to spend time in each region in proportion to a spatial distribution of interest, making it well suited for dense spatiotemporal environmental monitoring. Existing safe ergodic controllers rely on offline trajectory optimization or hierarchical architectures, which limit real-time applicability and decouple the ergodicity objective from the safety constraint. This paper presents a quadratic programming (QP)-based controller that treats ergodicity and safety jointly. We first introduce a Gaussian-kernel ergodic metric that, unlike the classical indicator-based metric, is time differentiable. This allows the exponential decay of the metric to be imposed as a time-varying control barrier function (CBF) constraint, relaxed by a slack variable, alongside hard CBF constraints for region containment and inter-robot collision avoidance. We establish that the resulting QP remains feasible from any safe initial configuration and that, up to the slack term, the ergodic metric decays exponentially. Simulations show improved performance over baseline methods, and experiments with three aerial vehicles validate the work on real hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于二次规划（QP）的遍历控制方法，将遍历性与安全性在同一优化中联合处理，采用可微的高斯核遍历度量并构建时变控制障碍函数约束，在保证可行性与安全的前提下实现遍历度量指数衰减，仿真与三架飞行器实验验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全遍历控制器依赖离线轨迹优化或分层架构，导致实时性不足，且将遍历性目标与安全约束解耦处理，难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出基于QP的控制器，同时处理遍历性与安全性：引入高斯核遍历度量（区别于经典指示度量，具有时间可微性）；将其指数衰减要求作为时变控制障碍函数（CBF）约束，并以松弛变量放松，同时加入区域保持与机器人间避碰的硬CBF约束。
AI.result: 理论上证明了该QP从任意安全初始构型出发均保持可行，且除松弛项外遍历度量呈指数衰减；仿真结果优于基线方法，并通过三架空中飞行器实验在真实硬件上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了遍历性与安全性的联合实时控制，克服了离线优化与分层架构的局限，为密集时空环境监测提供了具备可行性保证的QP求解框架。

title: EgoExo-Next:Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Visual-Option Next-State and Cross-View Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly evaluated for egocentric and cross-view video reasoning, yet existing benchmarks largely focus on semantic event understanding, temporal relations, or correspondence between already observed views, leaving their ability to reason directly about future visual states underexplored. We introduce EgoExo-Next, a visual-option benchmark for dynamic visual-state reasoning, where models must identify how an observed action trajectory subsequently appears rather than predict only an action label or textual description. EgoExo-Next contains 2,503 human-curated four-choice questions from six public egocentric and ego--exo video sources and comprises four interconnected subtasks that evaluate egocentric next-state prediction, bidirectional ego--exo state correspondence, exocentric next-state prediction, and their composition in Ego-to-Exo Next-State. Extensive evaluation of proprietary, open-source, and spatial reasoning VLMs reveals a substantial human--model gap, with the best model achieving 43.81\% average accuracy compared with 98.55\% for humans, and the largest degradation occurring on the composed Ego-to-Exo task. These results suggest that current VLMs remain substantially limited in dynamic visual-state reasoning, particularly when temporal progression and cross-view reasoning must be composed. The benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/yutongli2024/EgoExo-Next}.

AI.tldr: 提出 EgoExo-Next 基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在动态视觉状态推理上的能力，包含 2,503 道四选一问题与四个子任务，结果显示模型与人类差距显著。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型基准多聚焦语义事件理解、时序关系或已观测视角间的对应关系，忽视了模型对未来视觉状态的直接推理能力，尤其缺乏对时序演进与跨视角推理的组合能力评估。
AI.method: 构建 EgoExo-Next 视觉选项基准，从六个公开的第一人称及第一人称-第三人称视频源中整理 2,503 道人工校验的四选一问题，设计四个相互关联的子任务：第一人称下一状态预测、双向自-他视角状态对应、第三人称下一状态预测，以及二者组合的 Ego-to-Exo 下一状态推理。随后对专有、开源及空间推理类视觉语言模型进行广泛评测。
AI.result: 评测显示模型与人类存在显著差距：最佳模型平均准确率仅 43.81%，而人类达 98.55%；性能下降最明显的是需组合时序与跨视角推理的 Ego-to-Exo 任务。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在动态视觉状态推理方面仍存在明显局限，尤其在需要组合时序演进与跨视角推理时表现薄弱。基准已公开：https://huggingface.co/datasets/yutongli2024/EgoExo-Next。

title: What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly
summary: A coding agent is a language model wrapped in a harness: the system prompt, the tool set, and the context management that turn a chat model into something that can work inside a repository. Production harnesses ship releases daily, vendors advertise pass-rate gains from harness changes, and leaderboards mix harnesses freely. What is rarely measured is how much the harness itself moves the score when the model is held fixed. We run five models through three production harnesses, Claude Code, mini-SWE-agent, and OpenCode, on SWE-bench Verified, and rerun the same configurations to calibrate how much a score moves when nothing changes but the run. On 447 tasks and the two models we ran there, Claude Code and mini-SWE-agent, the heaviest and the lightest harness, are equivalent within five points. On a 45-task hard subset and five models, swapping the harness flips as many tasks as rerunning the same harness, 13% in both cases, and the tasks a harness wins in one run are not the tasks it wins in the next. The one harness effect that clears the noise is a loss, not a gain: OpenCode trails by up to 9 points on the large pool, and on one model half of that gap sits in runs its output cap cut short. What the harness does decide is the bill. With the same model, the same tasks, and one price list, cost per task differs by up to 3x across harnesses. The gap is set at the first call, by the preamble of system prompt and tool schemas each harness sends with every step, and scaled by the number of steps; per-step growth and per-call tool output differ far less. The provider's price for cached input scales the bill and does not reorder it. The rerun data also give the resolution a harness comparison needs: at the discordance we observe, 45 tasks catch a 13-point gap only half the time and no gap with 80% power, and 447 tasks resolve 5 points, still coarser than the gains many harness changes claim.

AI.tldr: 在固定模型、仅更换生产级harness的受控实验中，harness对SWE-bench Verified分数的真实影响远小于宣传：同分布任务上最重与最轻的harness差距在5分以内，换harness与重跑同harness都翻转约13%任务；唯一显著效应是OpenCode的分数损失（最多9分，部分源于输出上限截断），而harness真正决定的是成本——每任务费用可差3倍，主要由系统提示与工具schema的固定前缀开销驱动。
AI.motivation: 编码agent由语言模型与其harness（系统提示、工具集、上下文管理）共同构成，生产harness每日发布、厂商宣称通过harness改动获得通过率提升，排行榜也自由混用不同harness。然而业界很少测量在模型固定时，harness本身对分数的贡献究竟有多大，导致harness相关的分数增益缺乏可信的因果归因与统计校准。
AI.method: 将5个模型接入3个生产harness（Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent、OpenCode），在SWE-bench Verified上评测，并重复运行相同配置以校准"什么都不变、仅重跑"带来的分数波动。实验分两档：447个任务的大池与45个任务的困难子集。通过同一价格表计算每任务成本，并分解为固定前缀（系统提示+工具schema）开销、每步增长与每次调用工具输出三部分，同时考察缓存输入定价的影响；并用重跑数据做统计功效分析。
AI.result: 在447任务、Claude Code与mini-SWE-agent两模型上，最重与最轻的harness分数差距在5分以内。在45任务困难子集、5模型上，换harness与重跑同harness翻转任务比例均为13%，且某次运行获胜的任务在下次运行中并不稳定。唯一超越噪声的harness效应是负面损失：OpenCode在大池上最多落后9分，其中某模型上一半差距来自其运行被输出上限截断。成本方面，同模型、同任务、同价目表下每任务成本跨harness最多差3倍，差距由首次调用时发送的固定前缀决定并按步数放大；每步增长与每次调用工具输出差异较小，缓存输入价格只缩放账单总额而不改变排序。功效分析显示：在观测到的翻转率下，45任务只能以50%概率检出13分差距、对任意差距达到80%功效则无法检出；447任务可分辨5分，仍粗于多数harness改动所宣称的增益。
AI.conclusion: harness对固定模型下的任务通过率影响有限，且大部分表面差异可被运行间噪声解释，因此排行榜上混用harness的分数比较与厂商基于harness改动的通过率声明需要更谨慎的统计校准；相反，harness最确定、最可复现的影响体现在成本上，主要由每步重复发送的系统提示与工具schema前缀主导。要可靠比较harness，需要比当前常用评测更大的任务规模：45任务不足以支撑13分差距的宣称，447任务也仅能分辨约5分。

title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨用户行使"被遗忘权"时，其行为方式（自适应性与集体性）如何影响AI模型行为，并从随机优化角度揭示理论差距，进而利用数据估值技术设计删除请求者以显著改变模型行为。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘被视为让用户在AI模型中行使"被遗忘权"的有前途方法。然而，用户行使该权利时可能对模型行为产生影响，但现有研究未明确界定用户的不同行为模式及其潜在效果。本文旨在探究用户行为（自适应性与集体性）如何影响模型行为，并揭示群体用户行为差异带来的理论与实际影响。
AI.method: 1）定义用户在请求删除数据时可能采取的两种行为类型：自适应性和集体性；2）将用户目标与随机优化理论结果相联系，分析不同行为用户的群体效应理论差距；3）利用数据估值技术设计删除请求者，以在实际场景中显著改变模型行为；4）在计算机视觉任务上进行实验，对比不同用户行为模型的影响，并尝试分离自适应性及集体性的作用。
AI.result: 理论分析揭示了具备与不具备自适应性和集体性行为的用户群体在影响模型行为上的理论差距；基于数据估值设计的删除请求者能在现实场景中显著改变模型行为；计算机视觉实验展示了不同用户行为模型的差异化效果，并初步分离了自适应性与集体性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 用户行使被遗忘权时的行为模式（自适应性与集体性）会显著影响模型行为，且群体效应存在理论上的差异。通过数据估值技术可设计出有效改变模型行为的删除请求者，这为理解并管理机器遗忘中的用户行为提供了新视角。

title: CoDance: Learning Reactive and Compliant Human-Humanoid Interaction from Video
summary: Partnered human-humanoid interaction couples locomotion with continuous physical contact. A humanoid needs to coordinate with a person's motion while responding to interaction forces and maintaining stable and natural movement. We present CoDance, a framework for learning reactive and compliant human-humanoid interaction from video. We study partnered dancing as a challenging instantiation, where a humanoid coordinates its footsteps with a moving partner and maintains continuous two-hand contact. Given a single video of two human dancers, CoDance retargets their motions into a robot reference and a moving partner. We introduce a multi-link compliance augmentation that transforms the kinematic demonstration into force-aware training data by adapting the robot reference under structured forces at both hands. Policies trained on this data follow the observed partner while preserving the demonstrated locomotion style and responding compliantly to physical interaction. In simulation, the policies adapt their footsteps to changes in the partner and reproduce approximately 80% of the wrist displacement encoded by the augmented demonstrations. On a physical humanoid, CoDance enables sustained two-hand dancing with a human partner including repeated transitions between forward and backward motions.

AI.tldr: 提出CoDance框架，从单段双人舞蹈视频中学习反应式、柔顺的人-人形机器人协同交互，实现持续双手接触的舞蹈。
AI.motivation: 人-人形机器人协同交互需在连续物理接触下协调运动，既要跟随人的动作、响应交互力，又要保持稳定自然的运动。双人舞蹈是这一难题的典型场景：机器人需配合移动的伙伴协调步态并维持双手持续接触，现有方法难以兼顾运动风格保持与力柔顺响应。
AI.method: 1）从单段双人舞蹈视频出发，将两人动作重定向为机器人参考运动与移动伙伴；2）提出多连杆柔顺增强（multi-link compliance augmentation），在双手施加结构化力，把运动学示范转化为力感知训练数据；3）在该数据上训练策略，使其在跟随伙伴的同时保持示范步态风格并柔顺响应物理交互。
AI.result: 仿真中，策略能随伙伴变化自适应调整步态，并复现约80%的增强示范所编码的手腕位移；在实体人形机器人上实现与人类伙伴持续双手共舞，包括前进与后退动作的反复切换。
AI.conclusion: CoDance表明可从视频示范中有效学习兼具运动风格保持与力柔顺性的人-人形机器人协同舞蹈，为人形机器人在连续物理接触下与人类协作提供了可行路径。

title: TAME:Topology-Aware Text-Driven Motion Editing across Heterogeneous Humanoid Skeletons
summary: Text-driven motion editing modifies an existing motion sequence according to a text instruction while preserving the content of the source motion. Existing methods are typically built for a single, fixed skeletal topology, which limits their use in animation pipelines where characters differ in joint count and skeletal hierarchy. We present Topology-Aware Motion Editor (TAME), a flow-matching transformer that edits motions on humanoid skeletons of varying topology. TAME represents motion as per-joint, per-frame tokens and models interactions among joints, across frames, and with the text instruction through skeletal, temporal, and text cross-attention layers. To make the skeletal attention follow each character's hierarchy, TAME replaces full joint attention with Topology-Constrained Skeletal Propagation (TCSP), which restricts attention to one-hop kinematic neighbors in the skeleton's adjacency matrix. We further introduce Edit-Focused Representation Alignment (EFRA), a self-distilled representation alignment strategy that aligns student features with cleaner EMA-teacher features exclusively on edit-relevant joint-time tokens, making edits faithful to the instruction. To make this setting trainable and comparable, we construct TopoMotionFix, a multi-topology extension of MotionFix with seen- and unseen-topology evaluation protocols. TAME outperforms previous methods in edit alignment and source preservation on MotionFix and reliably edits motions on unseen skeletons in TopoMotionFix.

AI.tldr: 提出TAME——一种拓扑感知的流匹配Transformer，可在不同拓扑的人形骨骼上按文本指令编辑动作，通过拓扑约束骨骼传播与编辑聚焦表征对齐，并构建TopoMotionFix多拓扑基准，实现跨骨骼编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动动作编辑方法针对单一固定骨骼拓扑，无法适用于关节数量与层级结构各异的角色，限制了在动画流水线中的应用。
AI.method: 将动作表示为逐关节逐帧token；通过骨骼、时间、文本三类交叉注意力建模交互；用拓扑约束骨骼传播（TCSP）将骨骼注意力限制在邻接矩阵中的一跳运动学邻居；用编辑聚焦表征对齐（EFRA）自蒸馏策略，仅在编辑相关的关节-时间token上对齐学生特征与更干净的EMA教师特征；构建TopoMotionFix多拓扑数据集及见/未见拓扑评测协议。
AI.result: 在MotionFix上的编辑对齐与源动作保持方面优于先前方法；在TopoMotionFix上能可靠编辑未见骨骼的动作。
AI.conclusion: TAME实现了跨拓扑人形骨骼的文本驱动动作编辑，兼顾编辑忠实性与源内容保持，并具备对未见骨骼的泛化能力。

title: CRAFT: An Agentic Spreadsheet Form Filling System with Template Awareness
summary: Spreadsheet form filling requires agents to consolidate external evidence, ground values to precise cells, and preserve irregular template structure. Errors in early edits can overwrite labels or misalign fields, undermining later decisions. We propose CRAFT, a template-aware agent framework that connects reflective validation to constrained local repair. Instead of treating reflection as a free-form request to regenerate the workbook, CRAFT grounds detected errors to spreadsheet regions, restores corrupted template state when necessary, and re-grounds plausible writable slots before subsequent edits. A Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder (RASG) proposes writable cells, while label-slot hints and protected regions constrain subsequent edits. We introduce FormFillBench, with 327 forms across Instruction-Only and Multi-File tracks. Compared with the strongest baselines, CRAFT improves pair accuracy by 8.51 and 23.38 percentage points on these tracks, respectively. Component-removal experiments support structural adjudication and slot re-grounding within the pipeline, and the framework retains its relative advantage among the methods evaluated with a second backbone. The code and benchmark FormFillBench are available at https://github.com/Glllllly/CRAFT.

AI.tldr: 提出模板感知智能体框架CRAFT，通过反思验证与受约束局部修复实现电子表格填表，并发布FormFillBench基准。
AI.motivation: 电子表格填表需整合外部证据、将值精确定位到单元格并保持不规则模板结构；早期编辑错误会覆盖标签或导致字段错位，进而影响后续决策。
AI.method: CRAFT将反思从自由生成工作簿转为受约束修复：把检测到的错误定位到表格区域，必要时恢复受损模板状态，并在后续编辑前重新定位可写槽位；采用Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder (RASG)提出可写单元格，并用标签-槽位提示与受保护区域约束后续编辑。
AI.result: 构建FormFillBench（含Instruction-Only与Multi-File两条赛道，共327个表单）；相比最强基线，CRAFT在两条赛道上的配对准确率分别提升8.51和23.38个百分点；组件移除实验支持结构裁决与槽位重定位的作用，且更换第二骨干后仍保持相对优势。
AI.conclusion: 模板感知的反思-修复与槽位重定位机制能有效提升电子表格填表准确率与鲁棒性；代码与基准已开源。

title: LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems
summary: Pretrained flow models are now widely used as generative priors in science and vision, where inference-time guidance enables test-time constraints without retraining. Existing methods use projection, posterior sampling, or iterative optimization of the generative trajectory. We propose LyapuFlow, an alternative based on Lyapunov feedback control. At each sampling step, LyapuFlow predicts the terminal sample towards which the current flow is evolving, and evaluates the constraint violation on this prediction. Then, we compute the minimum-norm control that satisfies a prescribed Lyapunov decrease condition. The resulting control remains inactive when the uncontrolled dynamics already reduce the constraint violation at the prescribed rate. Otherwise, it provides a corrective update within a feedback trust region that prevents the control from dominating the pretrained dynamics. We demonstrate LyapuFlow in both data and latent spaces, outperforming alternatives spanning different mechanisms for test-time constraint enforcement in scientific machine learning and image inverse problems.

AI.tldr: LyapuFlow 提出用 Lyapunov 反馈控制在预训练流模型的采样过程中施加测试时约束，通过预测终点样本并计算满足 Lyapunov 下降条件的最小范数控制，在不重训练的前提下实现约束满足。
AI.motivation: 预训练流模型广泛用作生成先验，推理时引导可在不重训练的情况下施加约束，但现有方法（投影、后验采样、迭代优化轨迹）存在不足，需要一个更具原则性的控制框架来平衡约束满足与预训练动力学保持。
AI.method: 在每一步采样中预测当前流演化趋向的终点样本，评估该预测上的约束违反程度；随后计算满足规定 Lyapunov 下降条件的最小范数控制。当无控动力学已按给定速率减小约束违反时控制保持不激活，否则在反馈信任域内施加修正更新，防止控制主导预训练动力学。
AI.result: 在数据空间和隐空间中均验证了 LyapuFlow，在科学机器学习和图像逆问题的测试时约束施加任务上优于不同机制的其他替代方法。
AI.conclusion: Lyapunov 反馈控制为流模型的测试时约束提供了一种有效且可推广的替代方案，能自适应地在约束满足与保持预训练先验之间取得平衡。

title: VAMPS: Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning
summary: Learning robot policies directly on physical systems remains difficult because data collection is costly and policy exploration can be unsafe. We introduce Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning (VAMPS), a framework that uses Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control to train reusable policies without human demonstrations. VAMPS supports two training modes. For one-step proprioceptive policies, it operates iteratively in simulation: the policy warm-starts MPPI, and the refined trajectories provide new supervision as the policy changes. A learned terminal value improves short-horizon planning, while an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) critic guides the policy update. Iterative refinement outperforms training once on frozen MPPI data, and we transfer the learned locomotion policy to a Unitree Go2. For visuomotor policies, VAMPS operates directly from real-robot data. MPPI uses task-specific state estimates to plan and execute trajectories while recording RGB and sensor observations on a Flexiv Rizon 10S. Action Chunking with Transformers predicts action chunks, reducing the effective prediction horizon, and is trained offline on this fixed dataset. We demonstrate visuomotor pick-and-place and force-aware whiteboard erasing. In the latter task, the policy additionally observes the measured $6$-D wrench and desired normal force. These results show that VAMPS can learn policies either in simulation followed by hardware transfer or directly from autonomously collected real-robot data.

AI.tldr: VAMPS 提出用 MPPI 采样规划代替人类示范来训练可复用策略，支持仿真迭代训练一步本体感知策略并迁移到真机，也支持在真实机器人数据上离线训练视触觉策略。
AI.motivation: 直接在物理系统上学习机器人策略面临数据采集成本高、策略探索不安全的问题，因此需要一种无需人类示范、可安全高效获取监督信号的策略学习框架。
AI.method: 以 MPPI 控制为核心生成并精炼轨迹，提供两种训练模式：其一，一步本体感知策略在仿真中迭代训练，策略为 MPPI 提供热启动，精炼轨迹作为新监督，配合学习到的终端价值改善短时域规划，并用 IQL critic 指导策略更新；其二，视触觉策略直接用真机数据，MPPI 借助任务相关状态估计规划并执行轨迹，同步记录 RGB 与传感器观测，再用 ACT 预测动作块以缩短有效预测时域并离线训练。
AI.result: 迭代精炼优于在冻结 MPPI 数据上单次训练；学习到的运动策略成功迁移至 Unitree Go2；在 Flexiv Rizon 10S 上实现了视触觉抓取放置和力感知白板擦拭，后者策略额外观测 6 维力/力矩与期望法向力。
AI.conclusion: VAMPS 表明既可先在仿真中学习再迁移到硬件，也可直接从自主采集的真机数据学习策略，为无示范、可扩展的机器人策略学习提供了统一途径。

title: FASTER: Fast Adjoint Stochastic Transport for Endpoint Refinement in Reward-Guided Image Editing
summary: Reward-guided image editing at test time seeks to improve a specified reward while preserving source content and visual plausibility. Many existing approaches optimize candidates through pretrained generation processes, making repeated adjustment depend on costly large-model execution and, in some cases, backbone backpropagation. We develop a theoretical framework that jointly accounts for reward, source preservation, and pretrained-prior preferences, allowing the desired output distribution to be specified separately from the dynamics used to realize it. Based on this framework, we introduce FASTER, which trains a small network for each source and objective to perform inexpensive editing, while pretrained and reward models provide feedback on candidate outputs. By reusing each candidate and its feedback across multiple small-network updates, FASTER reduces repeated sampling and supervision queries without placing the pretrained generative backbone inside the inner optimization loop. On SD3, FASTER leads all four target metrics and several validation metrics among the evaluated methods. Compared with the evaluated baseline that optimizes controls along pretrained generation trajectories, FASTER achieves editing-time speedups of up to \({6.91\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 3 and \({24.14\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 1.5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出理论框架统一刻画奖励、源保持与预训练先验偏好，并据此提出FASTER：为每个源图与目标训练小网络进行轻量编辑，用大模型仅提供反馈，避免将生成骨干放入内循环优化，实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 测试时奖励引导图像编辑需在提升指定奖励的同时保持源内容与视觉合理性。现有方法多经由预训练生成过程优化候选样本，重复调整依赖昂贵的大模型推理，有时还需骨干网络反向传播，效率低下。
AI.method: 建立联合考虑奖励、源保持与预训练先验偏好的理论框架，将期望输出分布与实现该分布的动力学过程解耦。基于该框架提出FASTER：针对每个源图与目标训练一个小型网络执行低成本编辑，预训练模型与奖励模型只对候选输出提供反馈；通过在多次小网络更新间复用同一候选及其反馈，减少重复采样与监督查询，且不将预训练生成骨干置于内层优化循环。
AI.result: 在SD3上，FASTER在所评估方法中于四项目标指标及若干验证指标上均领先。与沿预训练生成轨迹优化控制量的基线相比，编辑阶段在Stable Diffusion 3上最高加速6.91倍，在Stable Diffusion 1.5上最高加速24.14倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将输出分布的指定与实现动力学分离，并用小型编辑网络替代大模型内循环优化，可在保持编辑质量与源内容的同时大幅降低测试时计算开销。

title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
summary: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: RAGrasp：基于本地采集RGB-D模板的检索增强平面抓取流水线，无需端到端重训练，在真实试验中对已见物体20/20、未见物体19/20抓取成功。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取预测器多依赖大规模公开或合成数据集进行任务特定训练，面向新部署场景需重新端到端训练；且模板与实际部署的相机、机器人、夹爪及工作空间感知条件不一致，导致适应性差。
AI.method: 以部署相机、机器人、夹爪在目标工作空间采集的带抓取标注RGB-D模板构建模板记忆；用自监督DINOv2视觉特征结合外观与深度线索提示SAM2分割查询物体；采用两阶段几何-语义检索级联选择模板，由置信度门控在两种抓取迁移估计器间选择；迁移抓取经掩码支撑与轮廓接触约束细化后，进行标定后的2D到3D转换。
AI.result: 真实世界试验中，已见物体抓取成功20/20，未见物体19/20；在评估设定内表现出面向部署的抓取自适应能力，并对测试的视角与光照变化具备容忍性。
AI.conclusion: RAGrasp表明，仅依赖少量本地标注即可实现部署特定的平面抓取自适应，无需端到端重训练，并在所测视角与光照变化下保持稳健。

title: S$^3$N: A Spherical Spiral Scanning Network for Weather Forecasting
summary: Machine learning-based weather prediction (MLWP) has achieved strong performance in global weather forecasting. Recent Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelation (HEALPix)-based methods use the HEALPix (HP) grid to avoid area distortion near the poles of conventional latitude-longitude (LL) grids. However, existing HP-based approaches often use pointwise mapping methods and process HP pixels within separate base faces or local windows. Consequently, the mapping may introduce reconstruction errors and cross-face communication depends on handcrafted boundary handling or shifted windows. We propose the Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S$^3$N) to address both limitations. First, L2Proj provides a bidirectional method for mapping atmospheric fields between the LL and HP grids through an $L^2$ projection of their continuous finite-element representations. Second, the Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS) block uses cross-latitude attention to guide selective state-space updates along four global pole-to-pole spiral paths. This design enables continuous information propagation across HP base-face boundaries without additional boundary-processing mechanisms. Experiments show that S$^3$N achieves better results at 4-, 7-, and 10-day lead times, and exhibits slower error growth in long-range forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S³N)，用 L2Proj 双向映射 LL/HP 网格并减少重构误差，用 AQSS 沿四条极到极螺旋路径做注意力引导的状态空间扫描，实现跨底面无缝信息传播，在 4/7/10 天预报上更优且长程误差增长更慢。
AI.motivation: HEALPix (HP) 网格可避免传统经纬度 (LL) 网格在极区面积畸变，但现有基于 HP 的 MLWP 方法多采用逐点映射，并在独立底面或局部窗口内处理像素，导致映射存在重构误差，跨底面通信依赖手工边界处理或平移窗口。
AI.method: 1) L2Proj：通过对大气场的连续有限元表示做 L² 投影，实现 LL 与 HP 网格之间的双向映射；2) Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS)：用跨纬度注意力引导选择性状态空间更新，沿四条全局极到极螺旋路径扫描，从而在无需额外边界处理机制的情况下实现跨 HP 底面边界的连续信息传播。
AI.result: 在 4、7、10 天预报时效上取得更好结果，并在长程预报中表现出更慢的误差增长。
AI.conclusion: S³N 同时缓解 HP 映射重构误差与跨底面通信依赖手工处理的问题，验证了 L2Proj 与 AQSS 组合在球面天气预测中的有效性。

title: Optimal Control with Learned Critics under Unmodeled State Dependencies
comment: Keywords: Model Predictive Control, Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, iLQR, Value Function Approximation. Presented at 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin TX, USA
summary: Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides a structured and constraint-aware mechanism for decision-making, but its reliance on optimization-friendly analytical dynamics models limits its use in tasks with contacts and other hard-to-model state dependencies. Model-free reinforcement learning avoids explicit modeling assumptions but typically requires large amounts of interaction data. We present a learning-based MPC framework that combines the data efficiency and structure of local model-based planning with learned components that compensate for incomplete dynamics and finite-horizon myopia. The method augments a nominal analytical model with a residual dynamics network that learns missing state-dependent effects from data and combines the resulting planner with a learned action-value critic that injects long-horizon MDP structure into the local iLQR optimization. To make this practical at reinforcement-learning scale, we develop a GPU-accelerated batched iLQR solver that evaluates learned dynamics and critic networks inside the optimal-control loop and solves thousands of trajectory-optimization problems in parallel. The complete system is integrated into a robotics simulator, enabling scalable model-based reinforcement learning under incomplete dynamics. Experiments on biased and incompletely modeled control tasks show that the approach improves closed-loop control performance while preserving the model-based structure needed for efficient constrained trajectory optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种学习型MPC框架，在解析模型上叠加残差动力学网络，并以学习到的动作价值critic为局部iLQR注入长时域MDP结构，配合GPU批量iLQR求解器实现可扩展的基于模型强化学习。
AI.motivation: MPC依赖对优化友好的解析动力学模型，难以处理接触等难以建模的状态依赖；而无模型强化学习虽无建模假设，却需要大量交互数据。作者希望兼顾模型规划的数据效率与结构，以及学习组件对动力学不完整和有限时域短视的补偿能力。
AI.method: 以标称解析模型为基础，附加残差动力学网络从数据中学习缺失的状态依赖效应；将所得规划器与学习到的动作价值critic结合，把长时域MDP结构注入局部iLQR优化。为在强化学习规模上可行，开发GPU加速的批量iLQR求解器，在最优控制循环内评估学习到的动力学与critic网络，并行求解数千个轨迹优化问题，并集成到机器人仿真器中。
AI.result: 在存在偏差与建模不完整的控制任务上，该方法提升了闭环控制性能，同时保留了基于模型结构所需的约束轨迹优化效率。
AI.conclusion: 学习型MPC能够在动力学不完整条件下实现可扩展的基于模型强化学习，兼具数据效率、约束处理能力与长时域决策结构。

title: EagleDepth: Efficient Fine-Grained Depth Estimation via Pixel Diffusion Decoder
summary: Recovering detailed geometry from high-resolution images is critical for precise perception of the surroundings and objects. However, existing methods which use latent-space modeling and VAE reconstruction can compromise geometric details. Furthermore, decoding from latent codes introduces substantial inference overhead. To address those issues, we present EagleDepth, an efficient framework for high-resolution monocular depth estimation that combines the geometric priors of latent diffusion with fine-grained pixel-space generation. Our key idea is to retain depth-aware latent representations as guidance while generating the final depth map directly in pixel space. We train the latent and pixel components sequentially: first, we fine-tune a pretrained latent diffusion model using paired RGB--depth supervision; then, we adapt a pretrained pixel diffusion decoder, PiD, to predict depth conditioned on the learned features. Training of the pixel component starts at 1024 resolution and continues across multiple resolutions up to 4K. The latent branch processes resized, lower-resolution RGB images, while the pixel branch generates depth at the target resolution, bypassing the original VAE decoder. This design preserves learned geometric knowledge without requiring the latent backbone to operate at the output resolution. On five commonly used depth estimation datasets and the high-resolution Synth4K dataset, our framework achieves state-of-the-art depth estimation performance, with faster inference and better preservation of fine structures and object boundaries.

AI.tldr: EagleDepth：结合潜空间扩散几何先验与像素空间生成的高分辨率单目深度估计框架，在像素空间直接生成深度图，避免VAE重建损失与解码开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜空间建模与VAE重建的方法会损害几何细节，且从潜编码解码带来大量推理开销，难以满足高分辨率图像精确感知的需求。
AI.method: 保留具备深度感知的潜表示作为引导，同时在像素空间直接生成最终深度图。分阶段训练：先以RGB-深度配对数据微调预训练潜扩散模型；再用学到的特征条件化预训练像素扩散解码器PiD预测深度。像素分支从1024分辨率开始并逐步扩展至4K；潜分支处理缩放后的低分辨率RGB，像素分支在目标分辨率输出，绕过原始VAE解码器。
AI.result: 在五个常用深度估计数据集及高分辨率Synth4K数据集上达到SOTA性能，推理更快，细结构与物体边界保持更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过潜空间引导+像素空间生成的分工设计，可在无需潜骨干运行于输出分辨率的情况下保留几何知识，实现高效高分辨率单目深度估计。

title: Causally Fair Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, complete, and transform information in settings where their outputs can shape consequential decisions, raising concerns about their impact on demographic disparities. In this context, causal inference provides a principled basis for assessing fairness, because it attributes observed disparities to the mechanisms that generated them, which a purely statistical approach cannot do even with infinite data. In LLM generation, a query may request several causally related variables, each of which is both an outcome of interest and a possible cause of other outputs, and the information supplied in the prompt need not follow a topological or a temporal order. This calls for methods that can analyze and selectively remove disparities from such a flexible generation process. In this paper we introduce Causally Fair Generation with LLMs (CFG, for short). CFG extracts relevant concepts, grounds generation in a reference population and causal diagram, and removes user-selected causal effects. CFG also allows pathways deemed justifiable for the task's utility to be retained, which is known in legal literature as business necessity. Further, we provide formal guarantees for our method when eliminating all discriminatory causal effects in the adapted population model, under appropriate causal assumptions. We evaluate CFG with four LLMs in three real-world settings based on population data and on a synthetic dataset with a known causal ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CFG（Causally Fair Generation with LLMs），一种基于因果推断的 LLM 公平生成方法，可提取概念、以参考人群与因果图约束生成，并选择性移除用户指定的因果效应，同时保留业务必要性路径，并在适当因果假设下给出形式化保证。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多地参与生成、补全与转换信息，其输出可影响重大决策，因而引发对人口统计学差异的担忧。因果推断能将观测到的差异归因于产生它们的机制，这是纯统计方法即使有无穷数据也无法做到的。而 LLM 生成中，一个查询可能请求多个因果相关变量，每个变量既是关注的结果又是其他输出的潜在原因，且提示中提供的信息未必遵循拓扑或时间顺序，因此需要能分析并选择性移除这类灵活生成过程中差异的方法。
AI.method: 提出 CFG 方法：提取相关概念；将生成建立在参考人群与因果图之上；移除用户选定的因果效应；并允许保留对任务效用而言可正当化的路径（法律文献中称为 business necessity）。此外，在适当的因果假设下，对在适配后的人群模型中消除所有歧视性因果效应提供形式化保证。
AI.result: 在三种真实世界场景下基于人口数据，以及在一个具有已知因果真值的合成数据集上，使用四个 LLM 对 CFG 进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: CFG 为 LLM 的灵活生成过程提供了可分析与选择性移除差异的因果公平框架，兼顾任务效用所需的正当路径，并在适当假设下具备消除歧视性因果效应的形式化保证，且在真实与合成设置中经四个 LLM 验证。

title: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出HarA，一种基于分层信用分配的方法，利用FGW重心度量推演语义新颖性并重加权token级优势，提升group-based RLVR的探索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有group-based RLVR方法（如GRPO）对同一结果的所有token分配统一优势，忽略了不同token在推理行为上的贡献差异；已有基于局部信号（token位置或熵）的信用分配改进，难以捕捉推理行为相对于当前策略的全局语义新颖性。
AI.method: 将每个采样推演表示为token隐状态与位置的分布，对同结果的所有推演计算Fused Gromov-Wasserstein（FGW）重心，以刻画当前策略下的潜在推理模式；用当前推演与重心之间的FGW距离贡献度量推理元素的语义新颖性；针对FGW求解代价高的问题，引入锚点引导线性化，将其转化为可用Sinkhorn算法高效求解的Wasserstein形式；最终依据新颖性信号对group-based RLVR的token级优势进行重加权。
AI.result: 在三种group-based RLVR方法上开展广泛实验，该即插即用方法有效增强LLM探索能力，在多个推理基准上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: HarA通过潜在空间中的语义新颖性度量实现细粒度、灵活粒度的token级信用分配，为group-based RLVR提供了一种可插拔的探索增强方案。

title: TUCO: Curating Simulation Demonstrations for Sim-to-Real Robot Policy Co-Training
summary: Simulation demonstrations can supplement scarce real-world data for robot policy co-training. However, the value of using data curation to actively select these demonstrations for sim-to-real co-training remains underexplored. Existing curation methods also lack a unified criterion for measuring trajectory-level utility and set-level coverage from closed-loop target behavior. To address these gaps, we present the first systematic study of data curation for sim-to-real robot policy co-training and propose Trajectory-level Utility and set-level Coverage Optimization (TUCO). TUCO uses influence functions to trace how each source demonstration affects target-domain scoring rollouts. Our key insight is that these effects can be decomposed into an overall contribution to target return and variation across rollouts, providing a common closed-loop basis for measuring trajectory utility and set coverage. We further propose a performance-aligned subset optimizer that combines these measures in a unified curation objective to reduce redundancy and select complementary demonstrations. Extensive experiments on RoboMimic and OmniReset establish the value of active simulation data curation for sim-to-real policy co-training and show that TUCO achieves state-of-the-art performance across single-simulator, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real settings.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究 sim-to-real 机器人策略联合训练中的数据固化问题，提出 TUCO 方法，通过影响力函数将源示教对目标域得分轨迹的影响分解为整体贡献与跨轨迹变异，统一度量轨迹级效用与集合级覆盖，并设计性能对齐的子集优化器，在 RoboMimic 与 OmniReset 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 仿真示教可弥补真实数据稀缺以支持机器人策略联合训练，但如何主动筛选这些示教（数据固化）的价值尚缺乏探索；现有固化方法也缺少基于闭环目标行为的统一准则，无法同时刻画轨迹级效用与集合级覆盖。
AI.method: 提出 TUCO（Trajectory-level Utility and set-level Coverage Optimization）。利用影响力函数追踪每条源示教对目标域评分 rollout 的影响，将影响分解为目标回报的整体贡献与跨 rollout 的变异性，从而在同一闭环基础上度量轨迹效用与集合覆盖；进一步提出性能对齐的子集优化器，在统一固化目标中融合两项度量，减少冗余并选择互补示教。
AI.result: 在 RoboMimic 与 OmniReset 上的大量实验验证了主动仿真数据固化对 sim-to-real 策略联合训练的价值，TUCO 在单仿真器、sim-to-sim 及 sim-to-real 三种设置下均达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 主动的仿真数据固化对 sim-to-real 策略联合训练具有明确价值；基于闭环影响力的轨迹效用与集合覆盖统一准则及相应子集优化器是有效且通用的方案，可推广至多种仿真到真实迁移场景。

title: Frozen in a Frame: The Velocity Blind Spot in JEPA World Models
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables. Code, model checkpoints, and project page are available via links in the paper
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling train an encoder so a predictor maps a current embedding and action to the next frame's embedding, always from a single rendered frame. This has a structural blind spot: a renderer without motion blur draws a scene from configuration alone, so a single-frame embedding carries no velocity information, for any encoder, including the official released LeWM weights. We confirm this on official checkpoints across four real benchmarks (PushT, Reacher, Cube, TwoRoom): every linear velocity probe sits at or below chance while position probes reach R^2 about 0.95. We introduce RateIdent, a three-stage diagnostic protocol, and TI-JEPA, a lightweight fix splitting the latent into a pose code and an explicit finite-difference motion code, predicted jointly. Across three physically grounded environments, TI-JEPA gives a significant, seed-robust gain on a stop-at-goal planning task over a matched-memory baseline, e.g. 55% lower final distance on Pendulum (p=3.2x10^-10) and 64% on CartPole (p=5.1x10^-15). We reproduce this at official ViT-Tiny plus AdaLN-transformer scale, then push the same recipe onto real dm_control Reacher photographs trained from scratch, where TI-JEPA's branch separation exceeds the memory-having baseline's by roughly 38x, the paper's largest margin. Against a same-footprint recurrent RSSM-style predictor, TI-JEPA matches or beats its rollout accuracy on two of three environments, stays separately probeable for pose and motion, and wins outright on the most coupled one. A checkable formal argument and six evaluated environments show single-frame targets are the wrong object to predict when velocity matters, and a small, interpretable structural change fixes it with no privileged supervision. Code, checkpoints, and the project page are linked below the title.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出单帧JEPA世界模型存在结构性缺陷：单帧嵌入不含速度信息，并提出RateIdent诊断协议与TI-JEPA修复方案。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型始终以单张渲染帧作为预测目标，而渲染器（无运动模糊）仅根据配置绘制场景，导致单帧嵌入不可能携带速度信息。作者在四个真实基准的官方checkpoint上验证：线性速度探针处于或低于随机水平，而位置探针R^2约0.95，说明这是结构盲区而非训练不足。
AI.method: 提出RateIdent三阶段诊断协议用于检测该盲区；提出TI-JEPA轻量修复方法，将隐变量拆分为姿态码（pose code）与显式有限差分运动码（motion code），并进行联合预测。
AI.result: 在三个物理环境中，TI-JEPA在stop-at-goal规划任务上相对等记忆基线取得显著且跨随机种子稳健的提升（Pendulum最终距离降低55%，p=3.2e-10；CartPole降低64%，p=5.1e-15）。在官方ViT-Tiny+AdaLN-transformer规模复现，并迁移至真实dm_control Reacher照片从零训练，其分支分离度超过有记忆基线约38倍（论文最大差距）。与同规模循环RSSM式预测器相比，在三个环境中的两个上rollout精度持平或更优，姿态与运动可分别探测，并在耦合最强的环境上胜出。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的形式化论证与六个环境评测表明：当速度重要时，单帧目标并非合适的预测对象；一个小的、可解释的结构性改动无需特权监督即可修复该问题。

title: Understanding Generative AI Use in Programming MOOCs: The Role of Course Context and Learner Characteristics
summary: The increasing availability of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT and code-completion assistants, raises questions about how learners integrate these tools into learning activities, particularly in MOOCs that attract diverse participant populations. This study examines the use of GenAI in two programming MOOCs taught in Estonian that differ in duration, workload, topic complexity, and assignment volume: About Programming (4 weeks, 26 expected hours, n = 187) and Introduction to Programming (8 weeks, 78 expected hours, n = 182). Post-course questionnaire data were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods to examine self-reported adoption, usage frequency, and purposes of GenAI use across courses and learner backgrounds. The results show that GenAI adoption was widespread in both MOOCs, with no statistically significant differences by gender, age, education level, or prior programming experience. However, participants in the longer, more extensive MOOC reported significantly higher usage frequency and were more likely to use GenAI for debugging and idea generation. Reported usage frequency for code explanation and debugging was also higher in the longer course. Exploratory analyses found limited relationships between GenAI use and learning-related outcomes. The findings suggest that course context may play a greater role than learner characteristics in shaping how GenAI tools are used. These results provide implications for instructional design and guidance in programming education.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过问卷调查与non-parametric统计方法，比较两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC中学习者对生成式AI的使用情况，发现AI采用率普遍较高且与性别、年龄、教育程度、编程经验无关，但课程情境（时长、工作量、复杂度）显著影响使用频率与用途。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT、代码补全助手）日益普及，学习者如何将其整合进学习活动尚不明确，尤其在参与者背景多元的MOOC环境中，有必要探究采用情况、频率与用途是否受课程特征或学习者背景影响。
AI.method: 选取两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC——About Programming（4周，26预期学时，n=187）与Introduction to Programming（8周，78预期学时，n=182），二者在时长、工作量、主题复杂度与作业量上存在差异。课程结束后发放问卷，采用non-parametric统计方法分析自我报告的GenAI采用、使用频率与用途，并按课程及学习者背景进行组间比较，另做探索性分析考察GenAI使用与学习结果的关系。
AI.result: 两门MOOC中GenAI采用率均较高，且按性别、年龄、教育程度、先前编程经验均无统计显著差异。但在时长更长、内容更广的MOOC中，参与者报告的使用频率显著更高，更倾向于将GenAI用于debugging与idea generation；code explanation与debugging的使用频率在长课程中亦更高。探索性分析显示GenAI使用与学习相关结果之间关系有限。
AI.conclusion: 课程情境可能比学习者特征在塑造GenAI使用方式上发挥更大作用，即使用模式更多由课程设计特征而非个体差异决定。研究结果为编程教育中的instructional design与学习者引导提供启示。

title: Checkable NTK Positivity and Finite-Width Gradient Descent for Scalar- and Vector-Valued PINNs with Strong-Form, Weak-Form, and Nonlocal Linear Constraints
summary: We give checkable positive-definiteness criteria for the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK) and high-probability finite-width gradient-descent guarantees for scalar- or vector-valued physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with linear constraints. The constraints may be strong-form differential rows of any fixed finite order, including coupled systems, with any linear initial or boundary conditions; weak-form residual and boundary functionals; or finite-measure nonlocal observations such as integral, nonlocal-diffusion, and Dirac-data rows, all in any dimension. For each class, positive definiteness of the limiting NTK is equivalent to a rank condition on a finite coefficient, functional, or moment matrix of the fixed design: a certificate computed before training that detects structural zero modes. The model hypotheses are those of an ordinary two-layer PINN, a smooth nonpolynomial activation with bounded symmetric initialization, and are met by standard choices such as $\tanh$ with uniform initialization. Given a certificate, explicit width and step-size conditions ensure, with high probability, that the empirical NTK retains at least half the limiting gap and that full-batch gradient descent decreases the training loss geometrically at every iteration. Controlled experiments check the certificates and the finite-width mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文为带线性约束的物理信息神经网络（PINN）建立了可检验的极限神经切核（NTK）正定判据，并给出有限宽度下梯度下降的高概率收敛保证。
AI.motivation: PINN 的收敛与可训练性缺乏理论保证：约束（微分方程残差、初边值条件、非局部观测）会引入结构性零模态，导致 NTK 退化、训练停滞。需要一种训练前即可计算、可验证的判据来识别并排除这些退化情形，并将无限宽度理论转化为有限宽度的实际保证。
AI.method: 针对标量或向量输出的两层 PINN（光滑非多项式激活、有界对称初始化，如 tanh + 均匀初始化），统一处理强形式任意有限阶微分行（含耦合系统）、任意线性初边值条件、弱形式残差与边界泛函、以及有限测度非局部观测（积分、非局部扩散、Dirac 数据）行，维度任意。核心方法是将极限 NTK 的正定性等价为固定设计的一个有限系数/泛函/矩矩阵的秩条件，得到训练前可计算的证书，用于检测结构零模态。
AI.result: 对每一类约束，极限 NTK 正定 ⟺ 相应有限矩阵满足秩条件；给定证书后，导出了显式的宽度与步长条件，使得以高概率经验 NTK 保留至少一半的极限谱间隙，且全批量梯度下降每次迭代训练损失几何下降。受控实验验证了证书的有效性与有限宽度机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把 PINN 的可训练性归约为一个有限维秩条件证书，并首次（在该一般性下）将无限宽度 NTK 谱间隙转化为有限宽度梯度下降的几何收敛保证，覆盖强/弱形式与非局部约束，为 PINN 设计提供了可操作的理论工具。

title: RMMBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robotic Mobile Manipulation
comment: Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), November 9-12, 2026, Austin, TX, USA
summary: Although the advancement of vision-language models (VLMs) has endowed robots with enhanced environmental understanding and task reasoning, a comprehensive evaluation methodology is important to advance the integration of VLMs in robotic navigation and manipulation. However, current benchmarks lack a comprehensive method to evaluate diverse robotic tasks, and evaluation metrics remain relatively constrained, making it difficult to assess the embodied capabilities of VLMs in a thorough and fine-grained manner. To address this issue, we propose RMMBench, an evaluation benchmark that requires robots to understand language instructions and perform long-horizon tasks in continuous spaces. RMMBench seamlessly integrates high- and low-level embodied tasks into a unified framework, constructing a "navigation-manipulation" task suite comprising 70 canonical task scenarios that range from localized manipulation to long-horizon composite navigation. The results reveal that leading VLMs still face major challenges in spatial localization when performing mobile manipulation tasks, and also highlight the necessity of enhancing the spatial perception capability of robots during long-horizon interactions. RMMBench can be accessed at https://mxxq-stack.github.io/rmmbench-project/

AI.tldr: 提出RMMBench，一个面向视觉语言模型（VLM）具身能力评测的基准，将高、低层具身任务统一到"导航-操作"任务套件中（70个典型任务场景），用于评估VLM在语言指令理解与长时程连续空间任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: VLM已提升机器人的环境理解与任务推理能力，但将VLM集成到机器人导航与操作中仍需完善的评测方法。现有基准缺乏对多样化机器人任务的综合评测手段，评测指标也较为有限，难以全面、细粒度地衡量VLM的具身能力。
AI.method: 提出RMMBench评测基准：要求机器人理解语言指令并在连续空间中执行长时程任务；将高层与低层具身任务无缝集成到统一框架，构建包含70个典型任务场景的"导航-操作"任务套件，覆盖从局部操作到长时程复合导航的任务范围。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，领先的VLM在移动操作任务中仍面临显著的空间定位挑战，同时凸显了在长时程交互中增强机器人空间感知能力的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RMMBench为VLM的具身能力提供了更综合、细粒度的评测途径，揭示了当前VLM在空间定位与长时程交互中的不足，指明空间感知能力提升是未来关键方向。基准已公开：https://mxxq-stack.github.io/rmmbench-project/

title: WASP: Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs for Fetal Brain MRI-Ultrasound Learning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 21 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely regarded as the optimal sensor for fetal brain analysis due to its superior soft-tissue contrast and anatomical detail. However, its high cost and operational burden make it invasive and difficult to obtain at scale. Ultrasound (US), in contrast, is cheap, safe, and routinely acquired, and as a result it has produced substantially larger datasets and a growing ecosystem of pretrained models. This asymmetry raises a natural question: Can we teach a US-only model to understand fetal MRI from only a limited set of examples? The standard recipe, training a foundation model on subject-to-subject paired MRI-US scans, is not viable since no such paired fetal dataset is publicly available. In this paper we address this gap with Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs (WASP), a framework that formulates cross-modal correspondence as an entropic Optimal Transport problem driven by clinical metadata, in particular Gestational Age (GA) and diagnostic planes, enabling the fitting of a lightweight alignment module that lifts MRI representations into the US latent space, without fine-tuning the backbone. Empirically, WASP yields its largest gains when MRI is unseen by the model during pretraining (on USFM, GA estimation error drops from 21.9 to 17.4 days and standard plane classification accuracy climbs from 61.9% to 69.0%), while providing smaller, backbone-dependent refinements for backbones pretrained on both modalities (e.g., BioMedParse GA estimation error from 6.5 to 6.0 days and SAM-Med2d plane accuracy from 83.3% to 88.1%). Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP.

AI.tldr: WASP 将跨模态对应建模为基于临床元数据（胎龄与诊断切面）驱动的熵正则最优传输问题，训练轻量对齐模块把胎儿 MRI 表征映射到超声潜空间，无需微调主干，从而用少量样本让纯超声模型理解 MRI。
AI.motivation: 胎儿 MRI 软组织对比和解剖细节优异，但成本高、操作负担重，难以规模化获取；超声廉价、安全、常规采集，已积累大规模数据与预训练模型生态。二者数据规模不对称，引出核心问题：能否仅用少量样本让纯超声模型理解胎儿 MRI？标准做法（基于同一受试者配对 MRI-US 的配对数据训练基础模型）不可行，因为公开数据集中不存在配对的胎儿 MRI-US 数据。
AI.method: 提出弱对齐时空配对（WASP）框架。将跨模态对应关系形式化为熵正则最优传输（entropic Optimal Transport）问题，由临床元数据（胎龄 GA 和诊断切面）驱动，学习一个轻量级对齐模块，将 MRI 表征提升/映射到 US 潜空间；过程中不微调主干网络。
AI.result: 当预训练阶段模型未见过 MRI 时收益最大：在 USFM 上，GA 估计误差从 21.9 天降至 17.4 天，标准切面分类准确率从 61.9% 提升至 69.0%。对同时在两种模态上预训练的主干，改进较小且依赖主干：BioMedParse 的 GA 估计误差从 6.5 天降至 6.0 天，SAM-Med2d 的切面准确率从 83.3% 提升至 88.1%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: WASP 表明，在缺乏配对胎儿 MRI-US 数据的情况下，通过临床元数据驱动的弱对齐时空配对与最优传输对齐模块，可将 MRI 表征有效迁移到超声潜空间；该方法的增益在 MRI 未被预训练见过时最为显著，为跨模态胎儿脑影像分析提供了可行路径。

title: Trinity: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models with a Self-Verifier
comment: NeurIPS'26 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models (VLMs), a form of self-improvement in which a model generates its own training data from unlabeled images, are a promising route toward agents that expand their reasoning capability in an unsupervised manner, without relying on ever-larger annotation budgets. Existing methods pair a Questioner that proposes problems with a Solver that answers them, but reward both roles mainly by agreement among sampled answers. Agreement is a weak proxy for truth: it cannot tell whether a question is grounded in the image, whether the proposed reference answer is right, or whether a confident majority is wrong in the same way. We present Trinity, in which one VLM plays three roles, Questioner, Solver, and Verifier, and the Verifier is a self-verifier: an exponential moving average (EMA) of the policy itself, requiring neither labels nor an external judge. The Verifier screens every generated question for image grounding and answer correctness before it becomes supervision, scores Solver reasoning against the image, and adjudicates disputes between the reference answer and a strong Solver consensus, correcting the reference and penalizing the Questioner when the consensus is right. Trained on images alone, Trinity improves Qwen3-VL-8B on mathematical visual reasoning and on science benchmarks with biology content, for example, +8.6 points on the biology split of SciVQR and +12.8 on MathVerse, and its reward dynamics behave as a healthy self-play curriculum should. These results suggest that a self-evolving multimodal agent can strengthen its scientific reasoning from unlabeled scientific images alone, with the model itself serving as the verifier.

AI.tldr: Trinity 让同一个 VLM 扮演出题者、解题者和验证者三种角色，其中验证者是策略自身权重的 EMA 副本，无需标签或外部评判，仅用无标注图像即可实现视觉语言模型的自进化训练。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化 VLM 方法中，出题者与解题者的奖励主要依赖采样答案间的一致性，而一致性是真实性的弱代理：无法判断问题是否锚定于图像、参考答案是否正确，也无法识别"自信的多数"是否以相同方式出错。因此需要一种更可靠的、无需外部监督的验证机制。
AI.method: 提出 Trinity，单个 VLM 同时充当三种角色：Questioner（出题）、Solver（解题）、Verifier（验证）。Verifier 是策略自身的指数移动平均（EMA）版本，即自验证器，不需要标签或外部评判。Verifier 的作用包括：筛选每个生成问题是否图像锚定与答案正确，合格后才作为监督信号；对 Solver 的推理相对于图像进行打分；在参考答案与强 Solver 共识发生分歧时进行裁决，当共识正确时修正参考答案并惩罚 Questioner。
AI.result: 仅在图像上训练，Trinity 提升了 Qwen3-VL-8B 在数学视觉推理与含生物学内容的科学基准上的表现，例如在 SciVQR 生物学分项上提升 +8.6 分，在 MathVerse 上提升 +12.8 分；其奖励动态表现出健康自博弈课程应有的行为特征。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，自进化多模态智能体可以仅凭无标注的科学图像增强自身科学推理能力，且模型本身即可充当验证者。

title: A Bird's-Eye View of Iterative Reward Design
summary: Designing effective reward functions in RL typically requires substantial expertise and trial and error. Recent work automates this process with LLM-based systems that generate and iteratively improve reward code using policy feedback. However, these methods are often hard to compare because they differ in implementation details, feedback assumptions, and evaluation environments. To address this, we introduce a Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design (BIRD) that expresses existing methods in a unified configuration and evaluation space. This lets us compare algorithms directly, ablate individual design choices, and prototype new components under matched feedback conditions and policy-training budgets. Across MuJoCo, Meta-World, Assistax, and HumanoidBench, we identify a small set of simple design choices that consistently improve performance. Combining these choices yields significantly better performance than the evaluated methods from prior work. Our results highlight the strength of simple baselines and motivate further study of when additional algorithmic complexity improves iterative reward design. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/bird.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BIRD基准，将基于LLM的迭代式奖励设计方法统一到同一配置与评估空间，从而直接比较算法、消融设计选择并在受控条件下原型化新组件。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中设计有效奖励函数通常依赖专家经验与反复试错。近期虽有基于LLM的系统自动生成并迭代改进奖励代码，但各方法在实现细节、反馈假设与评估环境上不一致，难以直接比较。
AI.method: 构建BIRD（Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design）基准，在统一的配置与评估空间下表达已有方法，支持算法直接比较、单独设计选择消融，并在匹配的反馈条件与策略训练预算下原型化新组件。评估覆盖MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax与HumanoidBench。
AI.result: 识别出一小组能持续提升性能的简单设计选择；将这些选择组合后，性能显著优于所评估的先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了简单基线的强大效果，并呼吁进一步研究在何种情况下增加算法复杂度才能改进迭代式奖励设计。

title: EvoMem-VLA: State-Evolution Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on current observations and lose task-relevant evidence once it leaves view, limiting performance on long-horizon, memory-dependent tasks. Existing efforts incorporate compressed historical features or sparse visual keyframes. However, isolated snapshots can leave the policy uncertain about what changed during past interactions and which action should follow. To overcome this limitation, we propose EvoMem-VLA, which constructs state-evolution memory by explicitly encoding and retaining observed changes between historical states. These change representations preserve evidence of interaction outcomes, allowing the policy to track task progress beyond isolated snapshots. Specifically, we introduce conditional delta tokenization to encode ordered frame pairs into directional, source-conditioned delta tokens, each associated with its corresponding state evidence. A shared VLM backbone supports task-adaptive routing: normal long-horizon tasks follow a direct action route, whereas multi-stage tasks use a subtask route that generates an executable subtask as an additional input for action generation. With a single jointly trained policy for each simulation benchmark, EvoMem-VLA achieves success rates of 80.7\% on RMBench, 82.0\% on RoboMME and 83.8\% across four real-world tasks spanning two robot embodiments. These results represent substantial improvements over the previous state of the art in all three evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: EvoMem-VLA通过显式编码历史状态间的变化构建"状态演化记忆"，并用条件式差分分词与共享VLM骨干的自适应路由提升长时程记忆依赖任务表现，在RMBench、RoboMME及真实任务上均超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多数VLA模型仅依赖当前观测，任务相关证据一旦离开视野即丢失，难以应对长时程、依赖记忆的任务。现有做法使用压缩历史特征或稀疏视觉关键帧，但孤立快照无法让策略判断过去交互中发生了什么变化、以及下一步该执行什么动作。
AI.method: 提出EvoMem-VLA，构建状态演化记忆：显式编码并保留历史状态之间的观测到的变化，以变化表示作为交互结果的证据。具体引入条件式差分分词（conditional delta tokenization），将有序帧对编码为有方向、源条件化的delta token，并关联对应状态证据。共享VLM骨干支持任务自适应路由：普通长时程任务走直接动作路径，多阶段任务走子任务路径，先生成可执行子任务作为动作生成的额外输入。
AI.result: 每个仿真基准使用单一联合训练策略，成功率在RMBench达80.7%、RoboMME达82.0%，跨两种机器人本体的四个真实世界任务平均83.8%，三项评测设置均显著优于此前SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模状态间的变化而非仅保留孤立快照，可有效保留交互结果证据、跟踪任务进展；配合任务自适应路由的统一策略在多类长时程与多阶段任务上取得一致且显著的性能提升。

title: Organize Primitives into Semantic Parts: Reinforcement Reasoning for 3D Segmentation
summary: Primitive-based 3D segmentation offers a compact and explicit alternative to dense surface prediction, naturally supporting structural abstraction and boundary localization. However, geometric decomposition alone does not determine how primitives should be organized into semantic parts: a single part may span multiple primitives, while geometrically similar or touching primitives may belong to different parts. We therefore introduce RePart (Reinforcement Part Reasoning), which formulates primitive-to-part organization as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and learns semantic organization through trajectory-level reinforcement reasoning. RePart constructs a Composable Primitive Workspace from fine-grained superquadrics and applies a merge-and-stop policy whose decisions are optimized by their downstream effects on the resulting partition rather than local primitive compatibility. The inferred part identities are then mapped back to the original mesh through Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling, preserving accurate surface boundaries beyond the primitive approximation. On PartNet, RePart achieves the strongest results across all four aggregate partition metrics; on 3DCoMPaT++, it obtains the highest RI and SC without target-dataset fine-tuning. These results demonstrate that reinforcement reasoning provides an effective mechanism for organizing geometric primitives into semantic parts while retaining dense segmentation accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/EngineeringAI-LAB/RePart.

AI.tldr: RePart将图元到语义部件的组织建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，用轨迹级强化推理学习合并-停止策略，并通过边界感知表面标注映射回原网格，在PartNet和3DCoMPaT++上取得领先的分割结果。
AI.motivation: 基于图元的三维分割紧凑且显式，支持结构抽象与边界定位，但几何分解本身无法决定图元如何组织成语义部件：同一部件可能跨越多个图元，而几何相似或相接的图元可能属于不同部件。因此需要一种面向语义组织的推理机制。
AI.method: 提出RePart，将图元到部件的组织形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，通过轨迹级强化推理学习语义组织。方法从细粒度超二次曲面构建可组合图元工作空间，采用合并-停止策略，其决策以下游分割效果而非局部图元兼容性为优化目标；推断出的部件身份再经边界感知表面标注映射回原始网格，以保留精确表面边界。
AI.result: 在PartNet上，RePart在四项聚合分割指标上均取得最佳结果；在3DCoMPaT++上，无需目标数据集微调即获得最高的RI和SC。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，强化推理为将几何图元组织为语义部件提供了有效机制，同时保持稠密分割精度，说明轨迹级决策优化可弥补纯几何分解在语义组织上的不足。

title: Reactivating Alignment: Defending LLMs from Jailbreaks via Intention-Aware Input-Output Matching
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that conceal harmful intent within complex adversarial prompts. Existing defenses primarily rely on input perturbation or harmful-output suppression, but they rarely model where malicious intent resides, resulting in brittle protection and excessive over-refusal.
  We propose SENTINEL, a plug-and-play, generation-time jailbreak defense that reframes mitigation as an intent extraction problem. Our key insight is that instruction-tuned LLMs exhibit strong input--output semantic consistency: regardless of jailbreak complexity, generated outputs tend to align with the attacker's true intent. SENTINEL exploits this property by matching semantically aligned input--output regions to extract intention-revealing subsequences, scores these subsequences using refusal-direction projections to estimate harmfulness, and halts generation when necessary. Experiments on HarmBench across multiple LLMs show that SENTINEL reduces jailbreak success rates to close to 5\% while maintaining low over-refusal. We further demonstrate robustness to adaptive attacks and provide a mechanistic interpretation: SENTINEL re-distributes jailbreak features from alignment blind spots to aligned regions.

AI.tldr: SENTINEL：一种即插即用的生成时越狱防御方法，将防御重构为意图抽取问题，通过匹配输入-输出语义一致区域提取揭示意图的子序列，并以拒绝方向投影评估危害性，将越狱成功率降至约5%且保持低过度拒绝。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM越狱防御主要依赖输入扰动或有害输出抑制，很少对恶意意图所在位置进行建模，因而防护脆弱且过度拒绝严重。
AI.method: 基于指令微调LLM具有强输入-输出语义一致性的洞见，SENTINEL在生成时匹配语义对齐的输入-输出区域以抽取揭示意图的子序列；再通过拒绝方向投影对这些子序列打分以估计危害性，并在必要时终止生成。方法为即插即用式防御。
