AI.result: 在HarmBench上对多个LLM的实验表明，SENTINEL将越狱成功率降至接近5%，同时保持较低的过度拒绝；并对自适应攻击具备鲁棒性。机制分析显示其将越狱特征从对齐盲区重新分配到已对齐区域。
AI.conclusion: SENTINEL验证了以意图抽取为核心的生成时防御范式，兼顾强防护与低过度拒绝，并提供了可解释的机制性理解。

title: A multi-stage probabilistic framework to estimate gas-fired generator performance during extreme winter weather
summary: Extreme winter weather has repeatedly disrupted gas-fired power generation in the United States, yet the plant-level data needed to systematically quantify outage risk remain proprietary. Using publicly available weather and electricity demand data together with anonymized generator contingency records from the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), we develop a three-stage Bayesian probabilistic framework for estimating winter-driven generator performance. Applied to New York State (2013--2022), the framework sequentially estimates: the hourly probability of a generator contingency event, the expected net available capacity conditioned on an event occurring, and the event duration. Colder conditions and higher electricity demand are associated with higher failure probability, lower retained capacity, and longer event duration. Under the most severe observed stress conditions, estimated mean hourly event probability reaches 24\% , while expected mean net available capacity falls to 13\% of nameplate rating. Full outage events have a median duration of 12.7 hours, while partial derating event duration increases from 2.4 to 7.1 hours with capacity loss severity. The proposed framework establishes a transferable baseline that utilities with access to plant-level records can directly extend to obtain more precise reliability estimates for operational planning and resource adequacy assessment.

AI.tldr: 利用公开气象与电力需求数据及NERC匿名机组故障记录，构建三阶段贝叶斯框架，量化冬季极端天气下发电机组的停运风险。
AI.motivation: 极端冬季天气反复中断美国燃气发电，但现有系统性量化停运风险所需的机组级数据多为专有数据，难以获取。
AI.method: 提出三阶段贝叶斯概率框架：依次估计机组故障事件的逐时概率、事件发生条件下的期望净可用容量、以及事件持续时间；以纽约州2013—2022年为案例。
AI.result: 更冷条件与更高电力需求对应更高故障概率、更低保留容量和更长持续时间；最严重观测应力下，估计平均逐时事件概率达24%，期望平均净可用容量降至铭牌容量的13%；完全停运事件中位持续时间12.7小时，部分降额事件持续时间随容量损失严重程度由2.4小时增至7.1小时。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可迁移的基准方法，拥有机组级记录的电力公司可直接扩展以获得更精确的可靠性估计，用于运行规划与资源充裕性评估。

title: Social Navigation for Tour-guide Robot
comment: 5 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Social Robot Navigation, IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: We propose a force-based model for social navigation of a tour-guide robot. Social forces due to various factors like obstacles, user position and heading, have been accounted for in the model. We claim that each one of these forces makes the robot more sociable to the user and we design an experimental setup for evaluation. In the experiment, the user follows an autonomous robot to a destination in a known map, while undertaking a few simple sub-tasks in the middle, which serve as distractions. For each participant, we run several rounds of the experiment, each with different forces and a shortest path, A*-search baseline model. Using per-round subjective indicators, we propose to study the effect of our force model on constructs such as: follow-ability, perceived safety, and perceived intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于力的导游机器人社会导航模型，将障碍物、用户位置与朝向等因素建模为社会力，并设计用户跟随实验，通过与A*最短路径基线对比，用主观指标评估各力对跟随性、感知安全感和感知智能的影响。
AI.motivation: 导游机器人需要在导航中兼顾社会性，使用户愿意并能够顺利跟随。传统最短路径（A*）导航虽高效，但未考虑用户位置、朝向等社会因素，可能导致跟随体验差、安全感与智能感不足。因此作者希望量化各类社会力对机器人社会性的贡献。
AI.method: 提出一种基于力的社会导航模型，将障碍物、用户位置、用户朝向等建模为社会力，并假设每种力都能提升机器人对用户的社会性。设计实验：用户在已知地图中跟随自主机器人前往目的地，途中完成若干简单子任务作为干扰。每位参与者进行多轮实验，每轮采用不同的力组合，并与A*最短路径基线模型对照。通过每轮的主观指标进行评估。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或定量结果，仅说明采用每轮主观指标来研究该力模型对跟随性（follow-ability）、感知安全感（perceived safety）和感知智能（perceived intelligence）等构念的影响。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张在导游机器人社会导航中引入多种社会力能提升机器人对用户的社会性，并规划通过用户跟随实验与A*基线对比，系统评估各力对跟随性、感知安全感和感知智能的作用。

title: ConEx: Human-Interpretable Saliency Maps via Concept-Aware Attribution
summary: Many visual explanation methods in computer vision highlight pixel importance but struggle to link these low-level cues to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting their interpretability and trustworthiness. We introduce Concept-based Explanations (ConEx), a novel framework that bridges saliency visualization with concept-based reasoning to provide both faithfulness and interpretability. ConEx automatically discovers class-specific concepts and represents them through concept activation vectors (CAVs), learned without manual supervision using an architecture-specific masking mechanism that reduces noise introduced by the segmentation masks to enhance concept purity. ConEx generates faithful saliency maps that reveal where each concept appears in the image and how it contributes to the prediction. To evaluate the reliability of these learned concepts, we propose two complementary metrics, Vector-Concept Match (VCM) and Concept-Class Match (CCM), that quantify concept alignment and enable direct comparison with existing methods. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that ConEx achieves state-of-the-art performance on faithfulness, segmentation, and concept-quality benchmarks. Overall, ConEx advances the field toward truly interpretable and concept-grounded explanations in vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出ConEx框架，将显著性可视化与概念推理结合，自动发现类特定概念并生成忠实显著图，实现可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉解释方法多高亮像素重要性，但难以将低层线索关联到语义概念，限制了解释性与可信度。需要一种既能保持忠实性又能提供概念级可解释性的方法。
AI.method: ConEx自动发现类特定概念，并通过概念激活向量（CAVs）表示；借助架构特定的掩码机制在无人工监督下学习CAVs，减少分割掩码噪声以提升概念纯度；生成忠实显著图，揭示每个概念出现位置及其对预测的贡献。同时提出VCM与CCM两个互补指标量化概念对齐。
AI.result: 在多种设置下的实验表明，ConEx在忠实性、分割和概念质量基准上均达到state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: ConEx推动了视觉模型向真正可解释、概念基础的显著性解释发展。

title: Semantic Causal-Factor Inference from Aviation Incident Narratives Using A Variational Autoencoder with Cosine-Similarity-Based Reconstruction
summary: Aviation accident and incident investigations generate extensive unstructured textual information containing evidence relevant to the causes and contributing factors of safety occurrences. Automatically extracting such information is challenging because causal evidence may be distributed across long and complex investigation narratives. This study proposes a semantic causal-factor inference framework combining natural language processing with a variational autoencoder (VAE) to learn the relationship between aviation investigation narratives and expert-reported probable causes. Investigation narratives and their corresponding probable causes are transformed into numerical representations, after which the encoder maps narrative representations to a probabilistic latent space. The decoder estimates representations of the corresponding probable causes and is trained using an objective that combines Kullback-Leibler divergence with cosine-similarity-based semantic reconstruction. The framework was evaluated using 20,919 finalized U.S. National Transportation Safety Board investigation reports from 2005 to 2020. On the held-out test set, the predicted and expert-reported probable-cause representations achieved a mean cosine similarity of 0.786 (SD = 0.120). The predicted representations also yielded interpretable terms associated with causal information in the reports. The results demonstrate the potential of probabilistic latent representation learning for AI-assisted extraction of causal information from aviation safety narratives while retaining expert investigation as the basis for formal causal determination.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种结合自然语言处理与变分自编码器（VAE）的语义因果因素推断框架，从航空事故调查叙事中自动学习与专家判定可能原因之间的映射关系，并在20,919份NTSB报告上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 航空事故与事件调查会产生大量非结构化文本，其中包含与安全事件原因及促成因素相关的证据。但因果证据往往分散在冗长复杂的调查叙事中，自动提取困难，因此需要一种能够建模叙事与专家报告原因之间关系的方法。
AI.method: 框架将调查叙事及其对应的可能原因转化为数值表示；编码器将叙事表示映射到概率潜空间，解码器估计对应可能原因的表示；训练目标结合Kullback-Leibler散度与基于余弦相似度的语义重构损失，从而学习叙事与因果因素之间的潜在语义关系。
AI.result: 使用2005至2020年间20,919份美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）最终调查报告进行评估。在留出测试集上，预测的可能原因表示与专家报告的可能原因表示达到平均余弦相似度0.786（标准差=0.120），预测表示还产生了与报告中因果信息相关的可解释术语。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，概率潜表示学习在AI辅助从航空安全叙事中提取因果信息方面具有潜力，同时仍应以专家调查作为正式因果判定的基础。

title: CEENs: Causality-enforced evolutional networks for solving time-dependent partial differential equations
summary: Despite the growing popularity of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), their applicability in the long-time integration of partial differential equations (PDEs) remains constrained. We argue that this problem stems from the lack of consideration of temporal causality in the original PINN formulation, resulting in a bias towards satisfying governing equations at later times before learning the initial condition and hence leading to erroneous solutions. To this end, we propose a novel method that seamlessly integrates temporal causality into the training process. Drawing inspiration from classical numerical methods where the temporal causality is reflected, we divide the time domain into nonoverlapping subintervals, assign a unique neural network to each subinterval, and construct a loss function founded on the integral form of PDEs within these subintervals. The proposed networks undergo sequential training, beginning with the initial time step. Our method demonstrates significant improvement in accuracy for long-time simulations of various PDE problems where the original PINN method fails while it requires less computational cost and memory compared to the PINN method. A parallelization algorithm is provided to further enhance the computational efficiency, showing a significant speedup for solving time-dependent PDEs.

AI.tldr: 提出将时间因果性显式融入PINN训练的方法：把时间域划分为不重叠子区间，每个子区间分配独立神经网络，基于PDE积分形式构造损失，并从初始时刻起顺序训练，从而提升长时间积分精度并降低计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: 原始PINN公式未考虑时间因果性，训练时倾向于先满足较晚时刻的控制方程而非先学习初始条件，导致长时间PDE积分出现错误解，限制了PINN在长时间求解中的适用性。
AI.method: 借鉴经典数值方法中体现时间因果性的思路，将时间域划分为不重叠子区间；为每个子区间分配一个独立神经网络；在这些子区间内基于PDE的积分形式构造损失函数；网络从初始时间步开始顺序训练。此外提供并行化算法以进一步提升计算效率。
AI.result: 在多个PDE问题的长时间模拟中，原始PINN失败而所提方法精度显著提升；相比PINN计算成本和内存需求更低；并行算法在求解时间相关PDE时显示出显著加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式引入时间因果性，将时间域分段并顺序训练子区间网络，可有效解决PINN长时间积分精度差的问题，同时降低计算与内存开销，并可借助并行化进一步加速。

title: FLEX-WAM: Flexible Block-Causal World-Action Models for Long-Horizon Imagination and Planning
summary: World--action models (WAMs) promise a unified model that predicts action-conditioned futures, generates feasible actions, and supports planning in imagination. However, existing joint video--action models often use computationally heavy, fixed-horizon backbones ill-suited to streaming inference and stable long-horizon open-loop rollouts. We introduce FLEX-WAM, a Flexible and Efficient Block-Causal World--Action Model for unified simulation and policy inference. FLEX-WAM supports variable-length contexts and non-causal prediction horizons, as well as infinite autoregressive generation frame by frame or block by block. Its block-causal, KV-cacheable architecture combines axial attention and blockwise diffusion forcing to enable efficient real-time rollout and deployment-time latency--throughput tradeoffs without retraining. Joint training can nevertheless produce plausible futures that weakly respond to commanded actions. We address this failure mode by balancing state and action flow-matching gradient contributions across the state--action diffusion-noise grid and regulating world-model sampling using Forward-Dynamics (FD) elasticity, an efficient training-time proxy for action responsiveness. Across simulated and real-world datasets, FLEX-WAM achieves superior multi-step prediction quality and latency while producing stable joint state--action rollouts for thousands of steps. As a joint action proposer and simulator within MCTS, it solves long-horizon PushT and all five OGBench Puzzle-4x4 tasks entirely in imagination. On a bimanual OpenArm-based robot, a single checkpoint jointly serves as a play policy and expected-outcome predictor, enabling real-time identification and collection of model--reality mismatches for future self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLEX-WAM，一种灵活高效的块因果世界-动作模型，支持可变长度上下文、非因果预测视野以及逐帧/逐块的无限自回归生成，并在仿真与真实数据上实现稳定的长时程联合状态-动作推演。
AI.motivation: 现有联合视频-动作模型多采用计算量大、固定视野的主干网络，不适合流式推理与稳定的长时程开环推演；同时联合训练产生的未来预测对指令动作响应较弱。
AI.method: FLEX-WAM采用块因果、可KV缓存的架构，结合轴向注意力与分块扩散强制，实现高效实时推演与部署时延迟-吞吐权衡；针对动作响应弱的问题，通过平衡状态-动作扩散噪声网格上的状态与动作流匹配梯度贡献，并用前向动力学弹性（FD elasticity）这一训练时代理来调节世界模型采样。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界数据集上，FLEX-WAM在多步预测质量和延迟方面表现更优，能产生数千步稳定的联合状态-动作推演；作为MCTS中的联合动作提议器与模拟器，完全在想象中解决了长时程PushT和全部五个OGBench Puzzle-4x4任务；在双臂OpenArm机器人上，单一检查点同时充当策略与预期结果预测器，实现模型-现实不匹配的实时识别与采集。
AI.conclusion: FLEX-WAM通过块因果架构与动作响应调节机制，实现了高效、稳定的长时程世界-动作建模，并具备统一策略推理与想象规划的部署能力，为未来自我改进提供支持。

title: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Workshops (SA Workshops '26)
summary: We present a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six cameras with wide baselines. To achieve robust dynamic reconstruction under such sparse views, our framework integrates three components. (1) Region-adaptive spatial priors: We use foreground masks to guide Gaussian initialization and mask voting to control densification separately for the dynamic foreground and static background. Background geometry is regularized using monocular depth aligned to metric scale. (2) Motion-consistent temporal priors: We provide supervision at intermediate times through frame interpolation and constrain projected Gaussian motion with estimated optical flow. (3) Generative assistance: We place virtual cameras in the widest angular gaps and restore their rendered images using a diffusion-based model conditioned on camera poses. The restored images are iteratively incorporated into training as pseudo-supervision. On the validation set, our framework improves full-frame PSNR from 25.60 dB for the baseline to 29.75 dB. On the official test benchmark, it achieves 30.04 dB full-frame PSNR and 27.88 dB foreground PSNR, ranking first overall in the Sparse-View Track.

AI.tldr: 面向SIGGRAPH Asia 2026体积视频挑战赛稀疏视角赛道（仅6台大基线相机），提出4D高斯溅射框架，融合区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验与扩散模型生成式辅助，将验证集全帧PSNR从25.60 dB提升至29.75 dB，官方测试达30.04 dB全帧/27.88 dB前景PSNR，位列稀疏视角赛道总排名第一。
AI.motivation: 任务要求在仅6个大基线相机下进行动态场景重建，稀疏视角导致初始化不稳定、稠密化失控、时间监督不足及视角覆盖缺失，动态重建鲁棒性难以保证，因此需引入多源先验与生成式补充来缓解欠约束问题。
AI.method: 在4D高斯溅射基础上引入三部分：（1）区域自适应空间先验：以前景掩码引导高斯初始化，用掩码投票分别控制动态前景与静态背景的稠密化，并用对齐到度量尺度的单目深度正则化背景几何；（2）运动一致时间先验：通过帧插值在中间时刻提供监督，并用估计光流约束高斯投影运动；（3）生成式辅助：在最大角度间隙放置虚拟相机，用相机位姿条件化的扩散模型修复其渲染图像，并作为伪监督迭代加入训练。
AI.result: 验证集全帧PSNR由基线25.60 dB提升至29.75 dB；官方测试基准达到全帧PSNR 30.04 dB、前景PSNR 27.88 dB，取得稀疏视角赛道总排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 将区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验与扩散生成式伪监督结合，可有效增强稀疏大基线条件下的4D高斯溅射动态重建能力，并在该挑战赛稀疏视角赛道取得领先性能。

title: InferOpt: Constrained Multi-Objective Search for LLM Inference Configurations
summary: Serving an LLM means setting dozens of inference-time knobs, from per-layer KV retention to per-layer expert counts. Practice sets them with mechanism-specific heuristics that return a single operating point and do not scale to layer-wise search spaces. We recast inference configuration as constrained multi-objective black-box optimization and build InferOpt, a reusable search framework that requires only variable bounds, a deterministic resource cost, and an evaluation hook. InferOpt searches on a frozen sampled proxy set, rejects over-budget candidates before any model call, tightens the budget adaptively, and re-validates Pareto representatives on full-scale dataset. One pipeline covers a 28-dimensional continuous KV space (Qwen2.5-7B) and a 26-dimensional discrete MoE space (DeepSeek-V2-Lite). On KV, post-prefill pruning cuts the 16K cache by 64.4% and TPOT by 22.9--48.5%, and the searched layer-wise budget by InferOpt beats a matched uniform budget by 7.3% and 14.0% of the Full KV reference points. On MoE, a searched top-k schedule by InferOpt removes 43.0% of routed token--expert pairs while staying within 0.59 points of the default, closer than the matched-budget baselines. Against Random Search, NSGA-II, and MOTPE, InferOpt leads on both spaces, taking the best proxy hypervolume and the lowest retention on KV and staying closest to the uncompressed reference at the lowest experts on MoE.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM推理配置（如KV保留率、MoE专家数）形式化为受约束的多目标黑箱优化问题，提出可复用搜索框架InferOpt，在KV缓存与MoE专家两个层wise搜索空间上均优于Random Search、NSGA-II与MOTPE。
AI.motivation: 现有实践依赖针对特定机制的启发式规则来设置推理期旋钮，只能返回单一工作点，无法扩展到逐层（layer-wise）的大规模搜索空间，也难以在资源预算约束下平衡多个目标。
AI.method: 将推理配置重铸为受约束多目标黑箱优化；构建InferOpt通用搜索框架，仅需变量边界、确定性资源代价与评估钩子。其流程包括：在冻结的采样代理集上搜索、在任何模型调用前拒绝超预算候选、自适应收紧预算、在全规模数据集上重新验证Pareto代表点。同一流水线覆盖28维连续KV空间（Qwen2.5-7B）与26维离散MoE空间（DeepSeek-V2-Lite）。
AI.result: KV方面：prefill后剪枝使16K缓存减少64.4%、TPOT降低22.9--48.5%；InferOpt搜索的逐层预算相比匹配的均匀预算，分别提升Full KV参考点的7.3%与14.0%。MoE方面：搜索得到的top-k调度去除43.0%的routed token--expert对，同时与默认配置差距在0.59个百分点内，优于匹配预算基线。对比Random Search、NSGA-II和MOTPE，InferOpt在两个空间上均领先：KV上取得最佳代理hypervolume与最低保留率，MoE上在最低专家数下最接近未压缩参考。
AI.conclusion: InferOpt作为与机制无关的可复用搜索框架，能有效处理连续与离散、高维的逐层推理配置空间，在压缩率与性能保持上一致优于启发式与通用多目标优化基线，具备跨模型、跨机制的通用性。

title: Specific Algorithmic Interpretability of Neural Networks: A Case Study on Textures
summary: We develop a principled framework for constructing neural networks whose specific parameter realizations admit an explicit algorithmic interpretation. Existing algorithm-inspired architectures can explain the computational structure of a network, yet after standard training the learned parameters need not retain a clear relation to the motivating algorithm. We address this gap as follows. First, we model each data point as a sample of a class-dependent stochastic process and assume that statistics of this process can be estimated from a single sample and these statistics are sufficient to distinguish the classes. We then construct a neural network whose initial parameters exactly implement an algorithm for estimating these statistics, making the network fully interpretable. To account for mismatch between the idealized model and real data, we fine-tune this network while controlling its deviation from the algorithmic initialization. The trained network hence roughly retains the interpretation of the initial network. A PAC-Bayesian analysis yields a uniform generalization bound whose complexity term scales with the fine-tuning radius, providing a statistical motivation for our approach. We instantiate the framework for texture classification using the scattering transform to estimate the discriminative statistics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个原则化框架，通过将神经网络初始参数设置为实现显式统计算法的网络，并在微调时约束其偏离程度，使训练后网络仍保留可解释的算法结构，并用PAC-Bayes泛化界证明其统计合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有"算法启发式"架构虽能解释网络的计算结构，但标准训练后的参数往往与原始动机算法失去明确联系，导致可解释性无法保持。
AI.method: 1) 将每个数据点建模为类相关随机过程的采样，假设其统计量可从单样本估计且足以区分类别；2) 构造初始参数精确实现该统计量估计算法的神经网络，使其完全可解释；3) 为应对理想模型与真实数据的失配，在限制偏离算法初始化的前提下微调网络；4) 用PAC-Bayes分析给出泛化界，其复杂度项随微调半径缩放。
AI.result: 网络经微调后大致保留初始网络的可解释性；PAC-Bayes泛化界的复杂度项随微调半径缩放，为该策略提供统计动机；在纹理分类任务上以散射变换估计判别统计量来实例化该框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在理论上为算法初始化加受约束微调提供了泛化保证，在实践上以纹理分类为例，实现了训练后仍具算法可解释性的神经网络。

title: Robust Surgical Robotic Instrument Tracking via Sequential Multi-Cue Fusion and Sim-to-Real Self-Training
summary: Efficient and robust tracking of surgical robotic instruments is important for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, yet remains challenging due to the complexity of surgical scenes and the unconventional geometry of surgical instruments. Keypoint-based approaches are efficient, but their performance depends on reliable feature detection. Improving these detectors with real-world supervision is difficult because accurate real-world annotations are costly to obtain at scale. To address this limitation, we introduce a tracker-guided self-training framework that adapts a model pretrained on synthetic images to unlabeled real-world videos. Given measured robot joint states, an uncertainty-aware EKF recursively corrects the instrument pose and the observable joint angles by comparing projected model features with detected keypoints, shaft boundaries, and mask-derived cues. An RTS smoother subsequently refines the resulting trajectory, which is projected into pseudo-labels for fine-tuning the feature detector without laborious pose annotations. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate consistent improvements from self-training across all evaluated keypoint metrics, and the resulting model outperforms prior approaches in both accuracy and runtime. The code and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种由跟踪器引导的自训练框架，将合成图像上预训练的关键点检测器适配到无标注的真实手术视频，从而提升手术器械跟踪的准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人器械的高效鲁棒跟踪对机器人辅助微创手术至关重要，但手术场景复杂、器械几何形状特殊。基于关键点的方法效率高，却依赖可靠的特征检测，而真实场景的精确标注获取成本高昂，难以大规模监督训练。
AI.method: 提出跟踪器引导的自训练框架：利用已知的机器人关节状态，通过不确定性感知的EKF递归校正器械位姿与可观测关节角，方法为将投影的模型特征与检测到的关键点、轴边界及掩膜线索进行比对；随后用RTS平滑器优化轨迹，并将其投影为伪标签，用于微调特征检测器，无需费力的位姿标注。
AI.result: 在真实世界视频上的实验表明，自训练在所有评估的关键点指标上均带来一致提升，所得模型在准确率和运行时间上均优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效缓解了真实标注稀缺问题，实现了从合成到真实场景的高效迁移，兼顾精度与速度，代码与数据将在论文发表后公开。

title: Task-Sensitive Geometry of Representation Transfer for Object Detection under Image Degradation
summary: Object detection under image degradation can benefit from clean-image supervision, but aggregate gains do not imply that transferred representation changes are uniformly useful. We study how clean task knowledge affects degraded-image representations and whether local responses to structured representation directions can be characterized geometrically. Using paired clean and Gaussian-degraded BDD100K images, we show that clean-teacher distillation improves observed detection accuracy while producing heterogeneous object-level transfer. We isolate a representation component complementary to direct clean-teacher alignment and map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge. Controlled interventions rescue 13.22% of objects lost under the distilled representation, versus 4.30% under norm-matched random perturbations, with very low harm on preserved objects. We introduce task-sensitive geometry, a gradient-derived channel-space geometry constructed from normalized detection-loss gradients. On a reserved cohort, mapped-complement orientation within this frozen geometry is positively associated with local intervention-response magnitude after controlling for intervention magnitude (partial Spearman $ρ$ = 0.242, 95% CI [0.108, 0.359]). The relationship eplicates on independent data ($ρ$ = 0.180) and with RT-DETR-L ($ρ$ = 0.227), but not for the direct clean-teacher residual family, and it weakens for large interventions. Routing rules and specialized distillation objectives based on these signals do not yield statistically reliable gains over CLEANKD. These results support a local, direction-family-dependent task-sensitive geometry while showing that converting such structure into improved global training remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究干净图像监督如何影响退化图像的目标检测表征，提出"任务敏感几何"（task-sensitive geometry）来分析表征方向与局部干预响应之间的关系，发现互补表征分量可挽救13.22%的丢失目标，且其在该几何中的取向与响应幅度正相关（偏Spearman ρ=0.242），但将此类结构转化为全局训练增益仍待解决。
AI.motivation: 图像退化条件下的目标检测可受益于干净图像监督，但总体精度提升并不意味着迁移的表征变化普遍有效。作者希望探究干净任务知识如何影响退化图像表征，以及能否从几何角度刻画表征方向上的局部响应。
AI.method: 使用成对的干净与高斯退化BDD100K图像；采用干净教师蒸馏，识别与直接对齐互补的表征分量，并通过正交桥（orthogonal bridge）映射到蒸馏学生空间；进行受控干预并设置范数匹配的随机扰动对照；构建由归一化检测损失梯度导出的梯度式通道空间几何（任务敏感几何），并在冻结几何中检验映射互补方向的取向与局部干预响应幅度的关联。
AI.result: 蒸馏表征下干预可挽救13.22%的丢失目标，而范数匹配随机扰动仅4.30%，对保留目标伤害极低。在保留队列中，映射互补方向在冻结几何中的取向与局部干预响应幅度正相关（偏Spearman ρ=0.242，95% CI [0.108, 0.359]），并在独立数据（ρ=0.180）与RT-DETR-L（ρ=0.227）上复现；但该关系不适用于直接干净教师残差族，且在大幅干预时减弱。基于这些信号的路由规则与专门蒸馏目标相较CLEANKD未取得统计可靠增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持存在一种局部的、依赖方向族的任务敏感几何；但将此结构转化为全局训练性能的改进仍是开放问题。

title: VCLMU: Mechanism-Centric Virtual Cell World Modeling for Perturbation Response
comment: This paper was accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 workshop on AI for drug discovery
summary: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations is a central capability for virtual cells and a key step toward computational modeling of biological interventions. Most existing models directly map an unperturbed molecular profile and perturba- tion to the resulting observation without explicitly representing the latent cellular transition induced by the intervention. We introduce a mechanism-centric virtual cell world model that represents cellular state as a set of Latent Mechanism Units (LMUs) and treats genetic perturbations as actions on these latent states. Each LMU combines a reusable identity grounded in multimodal biological evidence with an observation-specific state, allowing a perturbation to induce mechanism- specific stochastic transitions before decoding the resulting transcriptional response. We train VCLMU through two-stage pretraining, first on around 200K pseudo-bulk perturbation profiles and then on gene-aligned single-cell perturbation data. Across six perturbation-disjoint benchmarks, VCLMU consistently improves perturbation- specific response recovery over strong baselines while maintaining competitive global response accuracy. We further analyze learned LMUs through enrichment between perturbation responses and LMU gene sets and show that they capture structured biological response programs. These results support mechanism-level latent state transition as a useful formulation for virtual cell models that aim to predict and interpret cellular responses to biological interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出机制中心的虚拟细胞世界模型 VCLMU，将细胞状态表示为潜机制单元（LMU），把基因扰动视为对这些潜状态的行动，通过两阶段预训练在六个扰动不相交基准上提升扰动特异性响应恢复能力，并保持有竞争力的全局响应精度。
AI.motivation: 预测细胞对基因扰动的响应是虚拟细胞的核心能力，也是生物干预计算建模的关键步骤。现有大多数模型直接从扰动前分子谱与扰动词映射到观测结果，没有显式地表示干预所诱导的潜在细胞状态转变，因而缺乏机制层面的可解释性。
AI.method: 提出 VCLMU：以潜机制单元（LMU）集合表示细胞状态，将基因扰动视为作用在潜状态上的行动。每个 LMU 结合了基于多模态生物学证据的可复用身份（identity）与观测特异性状态（state），使扰动在解码转录响应前先诱导机制特异性的随机转移。训练采用两阶段预训练：先在大约 20 万条伪批量（pseudo-bulk）扰动表达谱上预训练，再在基因对齐的单细胞扰动数据上训练。
AI.result: 在六个扰动不相交（perturbation-disjoint）基准上，VCLMU 相比强基线一致地提升了扰动特异性响应恢复（perturbation-specific response recovery），同时保持竞争性的全局响应精度（global response accuracy）。通过对扰动响应与 LMU 基因集之间的富集分析，表明 LMU 捕获了结构化的生物学响应程序。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持“机制层面的潜状态转移”是虚拟细胞模型的一种有用建模形式，可用于预测并解释细胞对生物干预的响应。

title: MaDeL: Manifold-Decomposed Feature Losses for Generative Modeling
summary: Generative models are often trained with isotropic objectives such as mean-squared error. For data concentrated near a low-dimensional manifold, however, such losses conflate displacement along the manifold, which may represent valid variation, with displacement away from it, which produces invalid samples. This mismatch is especially problematic in sparse, highly constrained domains, where ambient-space regression can encourage off-manifold interpolation. We ask whether a generative objective can distinguish manifold-parallel variation from manifold-orthogonal deviation directly from data, without explicitly estimating the manifold. We introduce a manifold-decomposed feature loss (MaDeL) that learns complementary representations from corrupted observations: one is trained to recover the clean sample, while the other is trained to recover the corruption. We show that, under a feature bottleneck, their Jacobians align with the tangent and normal spaces, exactly for linear manifolds and locally for smooth manifolds. Together, these representations define an anisotropic objective that separately measures intrinsic variation and off-manifold deviation. Across synthetic, Earth and climate science, and torsion-angle benchmarks, MaDeL improves support recovery and average angular $W_1$ under single-step sampling; on protein backbones, it reduces steric clashes across one- and few-step sampling budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出流形分解特征损失MaDeL，将生成建模中的位移分解为流形切向（有效变化）与法向（偏离流形）两部分，构造各向异性目标，在合成、地球与气候科学、扭转角及蛋白质骨架等基准上改善支撑恢复、角向W1并减少空间冲突。
AI.motivation: 各向同性的生成目标（如均方误差）在数据集中于低维流形附近时，会把沿流形的位移（有效变化）与离流形的位移（无效样本）混为一谈。在稀疏、强约束领域，这种环境空间回归会鼓励离流形插值。作者希望在不显式估计流形的前提下，直接从数据中区分平行与正交分量。
AI.method: MaDeL通过两个互补表示从被破坏的观测中学习：一个表示用于恢复干净样本，另一个用于恢复破坏项。在特征瓶颈下，作者证明二者雅可比分别对齐流形切空间与法空间（线性流形精确成立，光滑流形局部成立）。据此定义各向异性目标，分别度量内在变化与离流形偏差。
AI.result: 在合成数据、地球与气候科学及扭转角基准上，MaDeL在单步采样中提升了支撑恢复与平均角向W1；在蛋白质骨架上，在单步与少步采样预算下均减少了空间冲突（steric clashes）。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解流形切向/法向位移构建的各向异性损失，可在无需显式流形估计的情况下缓解离流形插值问题，并在多类约束域上优于各向同性目标。

title: Robust 2D Traversability Mapping for Construction AMRs via Failure-Mode-Aware Fusion of LiDAR Geometry and Monocular Semantics
comment: Extended version of a paper presented at the 5th Workshop on Future of Construction, IROS 2026
summary: Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) on active construction sites face severe navigational challenges: geometry-based traversability mapping (e.g., LiDAR) misses visually hazardous but geometrically flat surfaces like wet mud and ponding concrete, while abrupt geometry on drivable speed-breakers and inclines produces phantom obstacles. We propose a real-time, failure-mode-aware multimodal traversability pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, where LiDAR is the primary geometric safety estimate and monocular semantics act as a selective, class- and confidence-gated corrective signal. The representation retains distinct traversable classes, namely flat road, terrain, and rocky terrain, while flagging construction hazards. We also release a multimodal construction-site dataset from a custom AMR: four closed-loop ROS 2 sequences from two active sites (RGB, depth, LiDAR, IMU, GPS-RTK, odometry) plus 506 annotated frames across 28 semantic classes. By projecting LiDAR onto dense semantic masks, resolving sparsity via morphological in-painting, and applying failure-mode-aware fusion with Patchwork++, the system corrects complementary geometric failure modes for a local AMR costmap.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对活跃施工现场中AMR导航的可通行性感知问题，提出一种运行于NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上的实时、故障模式感知的多模态可通行性流水线，以LiDAR为主几何安全估计、单目语义为选择性校正信号，并发布了配套多模态施工场地数据集。
AI.motivation: 活跃施工现场给自主移动机器人（AMR）带来严重导航挑战：基于几何的可通行性建图（如LiDAR）无法识别视觉上危险但几何平坦的表面（如湿泥、积水混凝土），而可行驶减速带和坡道上的几何突变又会产生虚假障碍物；两类互补的几何失效模式亟需多模态感知来修正。
AI.method: 在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上构建实时多模态可通行性流水线：LiDAR作为主要几何安全估计，单目语义作为选择性的、按类别与置信度门控的校正信号；表示层保留平坦道路、地形、岩石地形等不同可通行类别并标记施工危险；将LiDAR投影到稠密语义掩码上，通过形态学修复解决稀疏性，并结合Patchwork++进行故障模式感知融合，输出局部AMR代价地图；同时发布自研AMR采集的多模态施工现场数据集。
AI.result: 发布了来自两个活跃场地的四段闭环ROS 2序列（RGB、深度、LiDAR、IMU、GPS-RTK、里程计）以及506帧标注图像（涵盖28个语义类别）的多模态施工现场数据集；通过投影、形态学修复与Patchwork++融合，系统修正了互补的几何失效模式并生成局部AMR代价地图。
AI.conclusion: LiDAR主几何估计与单目语义选择性校正相结合的多模态、故障模式感知可通行性流水线，可有效弥补纯几何方法在施工现场的失效模式，并在嵌入式平台上实现实时运行，同时数据集为该场景研究提供了多模态基准。

title: FLASHSWIN: Unlocking Large Windows and Dense Tokens in Swin Vision Transformers with Memory Efficient Attention
summary: High-resolution vision backbones have long been forced to trade away local token density to afford larger receptive fields. Hierarchical Swin transformers impose this compromise because standard windowed attention materializes an $M^2\times M^2$ score matrix per window, incurring $O(M^4)$ memory as windows or token grids grow. Furthermore, Swin adds a learned relative-position bias elementwise to attention scores, requiring full materialization of the score matrix and its gradient. This keeps Swin and SwinV2 trapped in a small-window($M=8,16$), coarse-token regime with patch size $4\times4$ ($p=4$), limiting performance for fine-grained tasks. We introduce FLASHSWIN, which replaces standard windowed attention with a FlashAttention implementation that computes exact softmax attention without materializing the score matrix, reducing per-window memory from $O(M^4)$ to $O(M^2)$. This enables higher token density and larger receptive fields without inflating memory overhead. Training memory is flat across window sizes: at a $32\times32$ window, FLASHSWIN-T requires only $12.4$\,GB, unchanged from $8\times8$, compared to $70/90$\,GB for SwinV2/V1-T. However, applying FlashAttention directly to Swin creates a trade-off: bypassing the score matrix precludes Swin's additive relative-position bias, forfeiting spatial information in exchange for memory efficiency. FLASHSWIN restores position information as window-local learnable 2D RoPE, making large windows and dense token grids both affordable and accurate. At matched scale, FLASHSWIN-T outperforms Swin variants. With dense tokens and wide windows ($p=2,M=32$), the same Tiny model reaches $84.1\%$ ImageNet-1K, $44.1$ COCO box AP, and $47.28$ ADE20K mIoU---gains of $+1.3$, $+5.1$, and $+1.82$ over SwinV2-T at $M=16$, respectively. At fixed $M=32$, halving the patch size yields roughly $3\times$ larger gains in boundary quality than in mIoU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FLASHSWIN，用 FlashAttention 替换 Swin 的标准窗口注意力，将单窗口内存从 O(M^4) 降至 O(M^2)，并以窗口局部可学习 2D RoPE 补偿相对位置偏置，从而支持大窗口与稠密 token，在分类、检测、分割任务上均超越 SwinV2-T。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视觉骨干长期面临局部 token 密度与大感受野之间的取舍。分层 Swin 因标准窗口注意力需显式生成 M^2×M^2 的 score 矩阵，内存随窗口/网格增大达 O(M^4)；同时其可学习相对位置偏置需对 score 矩阵逐元素相加，必须完整物化前向与梯度，导致 Swin/SwinV2 被困在小窗口（M=8,16）、粗 token（patch 4×4）体制下，细粒度任务性能受限。
AI.method: 用 FlashAttention 实现精确 softmax 注意力，避免物化 score 矩阵，将单窗口内存由 O(M^4) 降至 O(M^2)，从而在不增加内存的前提下支持更大窗口与更高 token 密度。由于绕过 score 矩阵会丧失 Swin 的加性相对位置偏置，作者改用窗口局部可学习的 2D RoPE 恢复位置信息，兼顾大窗口、稠密网格与准确性。
AI.result: 训练内存随窗口大小保持平坦：32×32 窗口下 FLASHSWIN-T 仅需 12.4 GB，与 8×8 相同，而 SwinV2/V1-T 为 70/90 GB。同规模下 FLASHSWIN-T 优于 Swin 变体；在稠密 token + 宽窗口（p=2, M=32）时，Tiny 模型达到 ImageNet-1K 84.1%、COCO box AP 44.1、ADE20K mIoU 47.28，相比 M=16 的 SwinV2-T 分别提升 +1.3、+5.1、+1.82。固定 M=32 时，patch size 减半带来的边界质量增益约为 mIoU 增益的 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过 FlashAttention 与窗口局部可学习 2D RoPE 的结合，FLASHSWIN 打破了大窗口/稠密 token 的内存瓶颈，在保持精确注意力的同时显著提升细粒度视觉任务性能，为高分辨率视觉骨干提供了一种高效可扩展的注意力方案。

title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
summary: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models（CMDMs）统一抽象，并给出首个免训练、免数据的加速器 ManifoldCache，利用条件分数的正交分解确定噪声调度中点作为安全缓存边界。
AI.motivation: 科学生成中扩散模型需满足物理/化学/生物施加的硬几何约束，但推理极慢（每样本需数百至数千次神经函数评估）。已有加速方法在该类任务上均失效：量化受限于高维体积算子内存、剪枝破坏约束保真度、快速ODE求解器使轨迹偏离约束流形、特征缓存对约束几何不敏感并在高噪声区引发模式混淆。
AI.method: 将医学体积、分子构象、蛋白骨架设计、晶体结构预测、多视图3D场景等八类模型统一为 CMDMs，目标分布支撑于外部约束映射定义的流形上。基于条件分数可正交分解为强制约束满足的法向分量与流形内导航的切向分量，提出 ManifoldCache：免训练、免数据，无需校准数据与训练开销。理论上证明噪声调度中点是尖锐的安全缓存边界，并证明在安全相位内更深的网络块可获得更大的可认证缓存步长。
AI.result: 理论上证明：在噪声调度中点之前缓存误差有界；之后缓存则保证严格正比例的轨迹出现模式混淆，且该差距持续到边界。同时证明深层网络块因分数分解经块雅可比传播而具备更大可认证缓存步长。
AI.conclusion: ManifoldCache 是首个面向 CMDMs 从第一性原理设计的免训练、免数据加速器，为受硬约束的科学扩散生成提供了有理论保证的加速方案。

title: Measuring Effective Data Resolution in Guided Diffusion Posteriors
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Guided diffusion samplers are increasingly used to reconstruct physical fields from sparse observations, but standard diagnostics do not say how much of the reconstruction was actually determined by the data. We introduce effective data resolution for black-box generative posteriors: a comparison between the resolution warranted by the inverse problem, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{ref}}$, and the resolution realised by the sampler, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$. A perturbation estimator measures $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$ and the spatial map $R(x,x)$ from sampler queries alone. We validate the estimator against exact references and use it to study guided diffusion. The resulting measurements show that guidance weight can strongly alter apparent information transfer, that mean, spread and resolution are not jointly corrected by one weight even with an exact prior and score, and that resolution fidelity does not follow reliably from the apparent principledness of a guidance rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效数据分辨率"概念，通过对比逆问题应得的分辨率 dof_ref 与采样器实际实现的分辨率 dof_samp，来衡量引导扩散采样器重建中有多少信息真正由数据决定。
AI.motivation: 引导扩散采样器被广泛用于从稀疏观测重建物理场，但标准诊断方法无法说明重建结果中究竟有多少是由数据决定的，即缺乏对数据信息传递量的量化评估手段。
AI.method: 提出黑箱生成后验的"有效数据分辨率"，比较逆问题 warranted 的分辨率 dof_ref 与采样器实现的分辨率 dof_samp；用一个扰动估计器仅通过采样器查询来测量 dof_samp 以及空间映射 R(x,x)，并与精确参考进行验证。
AI.result: 估计器经精确参考验证有效；应用于引导扩散研究后发现：引导权重能强烈改变表观信息传递量；即使先验和分数精确，单一权重也无法同时校正均值、离散度和分辨率；分辨率保真度并不能可靠地从引导规则表面上的"合理性"推断出来。
AI.conclusion: 有效数据分辨率提供了评估生成式后验信息传递的诊断工具，揭示了引导扩散中引导权重对信息传递的显著影响及现有引导规则在分辨率保真度上的不可靠性。

title: Neural Barriers: An Online Certifiable Learning-enhanced Adaptive High Order Safety Critical Control
summary: Control barrier functions are an effective model-based tool to formally certify the safety of a system. However, transferring their theoretical guarantees to real-world robotics systems requires high model fidelity. For example, payloads or wind disturbances can cause significant model perturbations to an aerial vehicle, leading to safety compromises. In this work, we propose a certifiable online learning-enhanced robust adaptive control barrier function, which adapts to disturbances using a Neural ODE and quantifies its adaptation uncertainty with conformal prediction. Our approach guarantees safety at all time under unknown time-varying model disturbances. It adopts a conservative strategy when the adaptation uncertainty is high; and efficiently adapts to reduce controller conservativeness as it receives more data. Our approach provides a provable safety guarantee with a probability bound under suitable Lipschitz smoothness assumptions on the underlying model and trajectory. These results demonstrate the potential of our method as a practical safety controller for robotics system operating under model perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可认证的在线学习增强鲁棒自适应控制障碍函数（CBF），用 Neural ODE 适应扰动、用共形预测量化适应不确定性，在未知时变模型扰动下实现全程安全保证。
AI.motivation: 控制障碍函数虽能基于模型形式化地认证系统安全性，但其理论保证依赖高保真模型；实际机器人系统（如飞行器）中载荷变化或风扰会引起显著模型扰动，导致安全性失效，因此需要能在模型扰动下仍具安全保障的控制方法。
AI.method: 提出可认证的在线学习增强鲁棒自适应 CBF：使用 Neural ODE 学习并适应扰动，利用共形预测（conformal prediction）量化适应过程的不确定性；当适应不确定性高时采取保守策略，随着数据积累逐步适应以降低控制器保守性；在底层模型与轨迹满足适当 Lipschitz 光滑性假设下，给出概率形式的安全保证。
AI.result: 在未知时变模型扰动下实现了全程安全性保证，并提供了在合适 Lipschitz 光滑性假设下具有概率界的安全性理论保证；同时通过不确定性驱动的保守—自适应机制，在获得更多数据后有效降低控制保守性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法表明，将在线学习（Neural ODE）与不确定性量化（共形预测）结合进鲁棒自适应 CBF，可作为一种在模型扰动下运行的机器人系统的实用安全控制器。

title: COMPASS: Comet Object Measurement Pipeline with Automated Selection and Scoring
summary:
Summary: The single-cell gel electrophoresis ('comet') assay is a widely used technique for quantifying DNA damage at the individual cell level. However, image analysis often relies on manual inspection or semi-automated software, which can be labor-intensive, difficult to reproduce, and sensitive to image quality and comet morphology. COMPASS automates comet assay image analysis by combining deep learning-based comet segmentation with damage measurement and automated comet selection. The pipeline produces standardized DNA damage measurements while offering robust detection, reducing manual effort and improving reproducibility through transparent selection and optional manual review.
  Availability and implementation: COMPASS is implemented in Python and is freely available at https://github.com/ rsinghlab/COMPASS. Installation instructions, pretrained weights, and example usage are provided in the repository.
  Contact: jack_roberts2@brown.edu, ritsingh@illinois.edu
  Supplementary information: Available onlime upon publication.

AI.tldr: COMPASS是一个开源Python工具，将深度学习彗星分割、损伤测量与自动化彗星筛选整合为流程，实现彗星实验（单细胞凝胶电泳）图像分析的自动化，输出标准化的DNA损伤测量结果，降低人工成本并提升可重复性。
AI.motivation: 彗星实验是单细胞水平量化DNA损伤的常用技术，但其图像分析多依赖人工判读或半自动软件，存在劳动强度大、结果难以复现、对图像质量与彗星形态敏感等问题。
AI.method: 将基于深度学习的彗星分割与损伤测量、自动化彗星筛选相结合，构建端到端的自动化图像分析流程，并支持透明的筛选机制与可选的人工复核。
AI.result: 实现稳健的彗星检测，产出标准化的DNA损伤测量值；减少人工投入，并通过透明筛选与可选人工复核提升可重复性。工具以Python实现，在GitHub（https://github.com/rsinghlab/COMPASS）免费开放，提供安装说明、预训练权重与使用示例。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS为彗星实验图像分析提供了免费、可复现的自动化解决方案，有助于降低人工依赖、提高DNA损伤定量的一致性与标准化程度。

title: Towards Credible Agent-Based Policy Simulations: Disentangling Opportunities and Preferences in a Financial Inclusion Case Study of Egypt
summary: Credibility is a central topic for agent-based models intended to support policy-making. Simulations must not only represent the target scenarios and their core dynamics but also demonstrate that their assumptions, parameters, and outputs are empirically grounded and sufficiently accurate for their intended use. This paper addresses this challenge by presenting a general modelling framework, aligned with the Capability Approach, for building credible policy simulations that rely on data and domain-expert knowledge. It then demonstrates how it can be contextualised and implemented to study the social challenge of financial inclusion in Egypt, building on an agent-based model that represents heterogeneous individuals and firms behaving according to their financial states, barriers, opportunities, and preferences. The model is fitted to real-world data in two stages, initialisation and calibration, which respectively build representative synthetic populations and estimate behavioural parameters. By fixing the feasibility parameters, which determine agents' opportunities, and calibrating preference parameters across different population groups, we are able to distinguish and analyse the role of institutional and social barriers in the system, as well as the role of agents' motivations and priorities. This calibration stage provides transparent and group-specific hypotheses about the drivers of observed financial-inclusion gaps, which can further be analysed as gaps between agents' opportunities and realised outcomes, a very relevant insight for policy-making. This paper is thus a step towards improving the credibility and usefulness of policy simulations, strengthening the relationship between the model, the real target system, and the stakeholders who will use it. The code is available at: \url{https://www.comses.net/codebase-release/df8383cb-f49b-4f09-8cce-73603b59adcc/}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Capability Approach的通用建模框架，用于构建基于数据和领域专家知识、具有可信度的政策仿真，并在埃及金融普惠问题中实例化，通过两阶段拟合（初始化与校准）区分制度/社会壁垒与个体动机的作用。
AI.motivation: 面向政策的基于智能体模型需要具备可信度：不仅要刻画目标情景及核心动态，还要证明其假设、参数和输出有经验依据且精度足以支撑预期用途。现有政策仿真在可信度与经验扎根方面仍面临挑战，本文旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一个与Capability Approach对齐的通用建模框架，用于构建依赖数据和领域专家知识的可信政策仿真；将其情境化并实现于埃及金融普惠研究，基于一个表示异质个体与企业、按其金融状态、壁垒、机会与偏好行为的智能体模型。模型分两阶段拟合真实数据：初始化（构建代表性合成人口）与校准（估计行为参数）。具体做法是固定决定智能体机会的可行性参数，并对不同人群分组校准偏好参数。
AI.result: 通过固定可行性参数并跨人群校准偏好参数，能够区分并分析系统中制度与社会壁垒的作用，以及智能体动机与优先事项的作用；校准阶段给出关于已观测金融普惠差距驱动因素的透明且分组的假设，并可进一步将差距分析为智能体机会与实际结果之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提升了政策仿真的可信度与实用性，加强了模型、真实目标系统与利益相关者之间的关系，是迈向更可信政策仿真的一步；代码已公开。

title: On the Trade-off Between Information Loss and Generalization in Sparse Attention
summary: To mitigate the quadratic complexity bottleneck of the Transformer, sparse attention has emerged as a pivotal technology. Despite the extensive empirical success of sparse Transformers, the theoretical understanding of sparse attention remains fragmented. In particular, two fundamental questions remain unclear: (1) How does sparsification affect the information fidelity of attention mechanisms? (2) How does this information loss interact with the generalization behavior of the model? To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a systematic analysis of the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence and of the generalization gap of sparse attention mechanisms. Specifically, we first characterize the approximation error via the JS divergence. Through an order-statistics-based concentration analysis of the truncation mass alpha --- where the attention scores are assumed to be independent and identically distributed sub-Gaussian random variables with parameter sigma --- the JS divergence between the full attention distribution and the sparse attention distribution is shown to admit the closed form log 2 + ((1 - alpha)/2) log(1 - alpha) - ((2 - alpha)/2) log(2 - alpha). Subsequently, we derive a generalization bound through Rademacher complexity, quantified by O(gamma * sqrt(M/n) * (sqrt(log(3eL/M)) + sqrt(pi)/2)). Furthermore, building on a mutual-information-based generalization bound together with an entropy and covering-number analysis of the sparse hypothesis class, we obtain the sparsity-dependent generalization bound O(sqrt((M/(2n)) * (log(eL/M) + log(1 + 2/epsilon)))). Our analysis shows that sparsity reduces the complexity of the considered hypothesis class while introducing approximation error that can be quantified by the JS divergence. These findings provide a theoretical characterization of the trade-off between information fidelity and generalization in sparse Transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文对稀疏注意力机制进行理论分析：用JS散度刻画稀疏化带来的近似误差，并通过Rademacher复杂度与互信息-泛化界推导出两个泛化界，揭示了信息保真度与泛化之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽在缓解Transformer二次复杂度方面取得广泛经验成功，但理论理解仍较零散，两个基本问题尚不清晰：(1)稀疏化如何影响注意力机制的信息保真度；(2)这种信息损失如何与模型泛化行为相互作用。
AI.method: 首先用JS散度刻画近似误差：在注意力分数为独立同分布sub-Gaussian（参数sigma）的假设下，通过基于序统计量的截断质量alpha的集中分析，给出全注意力分布与稀疏注意力分布间JS散度的闭式解。随后通过Rademacher复杂度推导泛化界；并基于互信息的泛化界，结合稀疏假设类的熵与覆盖数分析，得到依赖稀疏度的泛化界。
AI.result: JS散度闭式解为 log2 + ((1-alpha)/2)log(1-alpha) - ((2-alpha)/2)log(2-alpha)；Rademacher复杂度泛化界为 O(gamma*sqrt(M/n)*(sqrt(log(3eL/M)) + sqrt(pi)/2))；稀疏度依赖的泛化界为 O(sqrt((M/(2n))*(log(eL/M) + log(1 + 2/epsilon))))。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明，稀疏化在降低假设类复杂度的同时引入可用JS散度度量的近似误差，从理论上刻画了稀疏Transformer架构中信息保真度与泛化之间的权衡。

title: GR-LIO: A Local Ground-Aware LiDAR-Inertial Odometry System Using Body-to-Ground Height
summary: LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) is widely used for state estimation in ground-based autonomous mobile robots. However, the geometric constraints provided by the local ground surface remain largely underexploited in existing LIO systems. This paper proposes a filter-based local ground-aware LIO framework that explicitly incorporates local ground plane geometry into the state estimation process to improve both localization accuracy and computational efficiency. Specifically, a local ground plane is parameterized by the robot orientation and the body-to-ground (B-G) height and continuously propagated within the state estimation process. Based on the proposed B-G geometry model, a propagated local ground plane enables efficient and reliable ground segmentation. The segmented ground points are then incorporated into the filter update through point-to-plane geometric constraints, improving both state estimation accuracy and efficiency. Furthermore, a planar motion update is introduced to exploit the propagated local ground plane as an additional geometric constraint, effectively suppressing vertical drift and improving estimation robustness. To address the initially unknown B-G height, an efficient initialization strategy is developed, followed by an online calibration procedure for continuous refinement. The proposed system is evaluated on several public benchmark datasets and self-collected real-world datasets covering diverse operating scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms representative LIO methods in terms of both localization accuracy and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于滤波器的局部地面感知LIO框架，将局部地面平面几何显式建模进状态估计中，以提升定位精度与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LIO系统对局部地面提供的几何约束利用不足，地面信息未被充分利用以提升状态估计性能。
AI.method: 以机器人姿态和体-地（B-G）高度参数化局部地面平面并在状态估计中连续传播；基于B-G几何模型实现高效可靠的地面分割，并通过点到面约束将地面点融入滤波更新；引入平面运动更新作为额外几何约束以抑制垂直漂移；针对初始未知的B-G高度，设计高效初始化策略并进行在线标定持续精化。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准数据集及自采集的真实场景数据集上，该方法在定位精度与计算效率上均持续优于代表性LIO方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入局部地面平面几何约束可有效提升LIO的定位精度、鲁棒性与计算效率，为地面移动机器人状态估计提供了一种有效方案。

title: Decouple, Purify and Unite: Semantic-Structural Prototype Learning for Federated Medical Segmentation
summary: Federated learning enables medical institutions to train a global model without sharing data, yet feature heterogeneity from diverse scanners or protocols remains challenging. Existing representation-based methods face two limitations: 1) Incomplete Contextual Representation Learning: single-layer or coupled representations overlook multi-level structural cues and entangle regional semantics with boundary details. 2) Layerwise Style and Aggregation Biases: domain-specific style discrepancies across intermediate layers degrade prototypes, while aggregation that overlooks client distribution shifts can further amplify bias. We propose FedBCS+, federated decoupled contextual alignment with style-purified aggregation. We employ Frequency-domain Style Recalibration (FSR) in prototype construction to decouple content-style representations and extract style-purified prototypes. Built upon these purified features, Decoupled Contextual Prototype Alignment (DCPA) explicitly decouples multi-level features into semantic and structural prototypes and aligns regional semantics and fine-grained anatomical structures separately. Style-purified Semantic Prototype Aggregation (S2PA) measures each client's purified prototype divergence from the global consensus and adaptively reweights aggregation toward under-represented clients to reduce consensus bias. On five heterogeneous medical segmentation benchmarks spanning histopathology, MRI, ultrasound, and colonoscopy, FedBCS+ achieves the highest mean Dice among the compared methods. A convergence analysis further characterizes how aggregation and alignment affect the optimization bound.

AI.tldr: 提出FedBCS+框架，通过频域风格重校准、解耦上下文原型对齐与风格纯化聚合，解决联邦医学分割中的特征异质性问题，在五个基准上取得最高平均Dice。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不共享数据的前提下为医疗机构训练全局模型，但来自不同扫描仪或协议的**特征异质性**仍是难题。现有基于表征的方法存在两点局限：1）**上下文表征学习不完整**：单层或耦合表征忽略多层级结构线索，且将区域语义与边界细节纠缠在一起；2）**层级风格与聚合偏差**：中间层的域特定风格差异会劣化原型，而忽略客户端分布偏移的聚合会进一步放大偏差。
AI.method: 提出**FedBCS+**（联邦解耦上下文对齐与风格纯化聚合）。包含三个模块：1）**频域风格重校准（FSR）**：在原型构建中解耦内容-风格表征，提取风格纯化原型；2）**解耦上下文原型对齐（DCPA）**：将多层级特征显式解耦为语义原型与结构原型，分别对齐区域语义与细粒度解剖结构；3）**风格纯化语义原型聚合（S2PA）**：度量各客户端纯化原型与全局共识的偏差，自适应地向欠代表客户端加权聚合，以降低共识偏差。
AI.result: 在涵盖组织病理学、MRI、超声与结肠镜的**五个异质医学分割基准**上，FedBCS+在对比方法中取得最高的平均Dice。收敛性分析进一步刻画了聚合与对齐对优化界的影响。
AI.conclusion: FedBCS+通过解耦内容-风格表征、多层级语义-结构对齐及分布感知的自适应聚合，有效缓解联邦医学图像分割中的特征异质性与聚合偏差，并具备理论收敛性支撑。

title: EvoCast: Reliable Autonomous Research Agents for Iterative Forecasting Architecture Evolution
comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/18e0-x/EvoCast
summary: Deep time-series forecasting models have rapidly diversified, yet adapting them to a specific task still requires extensive expert effort in model selection, mechanism diagnosis, architecture design, implementation, and evaluation. Existing AutoML methods are constrained by predefined search spaces, while general-purpose LLM research agents lack reliable control over experimental protocols and model promotion. We introduce EvoCast, a fully autonomous research-agent system for iterative forecasting architecture evolution. EvoCast first establishes and diagnoses a task-specific baseline through executed mechanism ablations, then generates evidence-grounded research directions from dataset characteristics, diagnostic results, prior rounds, and failure records. Its central design, cognition-authority separation, assigns open-ended hypothesis generation and code implementation to LLM agents, while deterministic program authorities control source-edit boundaries, canonical evaluation, and promotion decisions. Experimental outcomes are accumulated as evidence to guide subsequent rounds. Results show that EvoCast completes complex architecture modifications with higher implementation success and lower agent-side token/time cost, and develops task-specific architectures that outperform selected baselines, strong forecasting models, and agent baselines in three real-world forecasting cases. The code is available at https://github.com/18e0-x/EvoCast.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoCast，一个全自主研究智能体系统，用于时间序列预测架构的迭代演化，通过"认知-权限分离"设计实现开放假设生成与确定性程序管控的结合。
AI.motivation: 深度时间序列预测模型日益多样，但将其适配到特定任务仍需在模型选择、机制诊断、架构设计、实现与评估上投入大量专家精力。现有 AutoML 方法受限于预定义搜索空间，而通用 LLM 研究智能体又缺乏对实验协议和模型晋升的可靠控制。
AI.method: EvoCast 首先通过执行机制消融建立并诊断任务特定基线；随后基于数据集特征、诊断结果、历史轮次与失败记录生成有证据支撑的研究方向。其核心设计为"认知-权限分离"（cognition-authority separation）：将开放式假设生成与代码实现交由 LLM 智能体负责，而由确定性程序权威控制源码编辑边界、规范化评估与晋升决策；实验结果作为证据累积以指导后续轮次。
AI.result: EvoCast 能以更高的实现成功率和更低的智能体侧 token/时间成本完成复杂架构修改，并在三个真实世界预测案例中开发出优于所选基线、强预测模型及智能体基线的任务特定架构。
AI.conclusion: EvoCast 证明了将开放式 LLM 研究与确定性程序管控相结合，可自主完成时间序列预测架构的迭代演化，突破预定义搜索空间与实验协议失控的限制。代码已开源。

title: UnAct: Gradient-Free Unlearning via Targeted Activation Intervention
summary: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of designated training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Retrain-free methods such as Selective Synaptic Dampening (SSD) and its label-free variant LFSSD avoid full retraining but still require backpropagation and parameter importance computed over the entire dataset. We ask: what happens when a deletion request arrives with only a few images of the class to be forgotten? To answer this question, we introduce UnAct, a gradient-free class-unlearning method that needs only forward passes over the forget images. UnAct scores late-layer units by their responses, attenuates the most responsive connections, and repeats this for up to 20 rounds using no gradients, no labels, and no retained data. On ResNet-18 trained with CIFAR-10, CIFAR-20, and CIFAR-100, UnAct is competitive with SSD and LFSSD when forgetting entire classes and, unlike them, never collapses the network when forget data is scarce. On ResNet-18, across all tested sizes, UnAct's retain accuracy stays within 2.5 points of retraining, while SSD and LFSSD, at their full-class operating points, lose up to 86 points on some classes. With five forget images on CIFAR-10, UnAct's distance to retraining is 0.21 points, against 67 for LFSSD and 90 for SSD, and re-selecting SSD's threshold at each size with an oracle does not close the gap. In preliminary transfer to ViT-B/16, UnAct's distance to retraining is 11.5 against 33.7 for SSD, and a request is 19x faster than SSD when SSD computes its importance at request time. The code is available at https://github.com/abdulmuizz0903/UnAct

AI.tldr: UnAct：一种无梯度、无标签、无需保留数据的类别遗忘方法，仅需对遗忘图像做前向传播，在遗忘数据稀缺时显著优于SSD与LFSSD。
AI.motivation: 现有免重训方法（SSD、LFSSD）虽避免全量重训，但仍需反向传播并在全数据集上计算参数重要性；当删除请求仅含少量（如5张）待遗忘类图像时，这类方法会失效甚至使网络崩塌。
AI.method: 提出UnAct：无梯度类别遗忘。仅对遗忘图像做前向传播，按响应为后层单元打分，衰减响应最强的连接，最多迭代20轮；不使用梯度、标签和保留数据。
AI.result: ResNet-18在CIFAR-10/20/100上，遗忘整类时UnAct与SSD、LFSSD相当；遗忘数据稀缺时不崩溃。所有测试规模下保留精度与重训相差≤2.5点，而SSD/LFSSD在其全类工作点部分类损失高达86点。CIFAR-10仅5张遗忘图像时，UnAct距重训0.21点，LFSSD为67、SSD为90，且用oracle逐规模重选SSD阈值也无法缩小差距。ViT-B/16初步迁移：UnAct距重训11.5，SSD为33.7；请求时计算重要性时快19倍。
AI.conclusion: UnAct在少量遗忘数据场景下兼具有效性、稳定性与效率，克服了SSD/LFSSD对全量数据与反向传播的依赖，具备向ViT等架构迁移的潜力。

title: TacGELLO: Tactile Contact Feedback for a 3D-Printed Teleoperation Leader
summary:
Passive leader arms transmit an operator's motion without returning remote contact or load cues. TacGELLO uses the existing servos of a 3D-printed leader for tactile contact feedback at the gripper trigger and current-based load cues at the arm joints. AnySkin contact detection activates a trigger position hold, while changes in follower joint current adjust leader-servo output limits to command resistance during lifting.
  Across six UR3 sessions with one operator, sent-command tracking error was 0.15--0.36$^\circ$ RMSE, with estimated trajectory lag of 82--98\,ms. Tactile onset was logged in 60 of 62 segmented TacGELLO grasp intervals. Median commanded closure after tactile or width-based contact references was 0.7--2.1\,mm with TacGELLO and 13.0--13.9\,mm with the original interface.

AI.tldr: TacGELLO 利用3D打印主臂的现有舵机，在夹爪扳机处提供触觉接触反馈、在关节处提供基于电流的负载提示，使被动式主臂具备力/触觉回馈能力。
AI.motivation: 被动式主臂仅传递操作者运动，不返回远端接触或负载信息，操作者缺乏力觉与触觉反馈。
AI.method: 利用现有舵机实现反馈：AnySkin 接触检测触发扳机位置保持；从臂关节电流变化调整主臂舵机输出限幅，在提升时提供阻力提示。
AI.result: 6次UR3实验中指令跟踪误差为0.15–0.36° RMSE，估计轨迹滞后82–98 ms；触觉起始在62个抓取区间中的60个被记录；触觉或宽度接触参考后的中位闭合指令为0.7–2.1 mm（TacGELLO）对比13.0–13.9 mm（原接口）。
AI.conclusion: TacGELLO 以低成本方式为被动主臂补充触觉与负载反馈，显著提升抓取闭合的精细度。

title: Knossos and Ariadne: Benchmarking and Learning Complete Diagram Topology Extraction with Vision-Language Models
summary: Structural diagrams are widely used to represent complex systems and relational information across scientific, engineering, procedural, and spatial domains. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have become increasingly capable of recognizing diagram elements and reasoning about their content, while complete diagram topology extraction remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study diagram-to-graph topology extraction: extracting all diagram entities and the complete relations among them. To enable large-scale supervised training and systematic evaluation of this task, we introduce Knossos, a benchmark of 19,200 diagrams across six diverse domains, with 245,179 nodes and 439,740 edges. Its symbolic generation process provides exact alignment between rendered diagrams and annotations of complete topology, relation types, and connector geometry. To address the modeling challenge of complete topology extraction, we also present Ariadne, a structured framework that decomposes the task into node inventory extraction and source-conditioned edge prediction. Extensive experiments show that training on Knossos substantially improves complete topology extraction in smaller open-source VLMs. Ariadne further improves over one-step extraction under matched supervision, demonstrating the additional benefit of structured decomposition. It achieves the highest average Edge F1 among the evaluated methods on Knossos, while both backbone variants also improve over their unadapted counterparts on the real-world external benchmark. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/bangwayne/knossos_Ariadne_Public.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"图到图拓扑抽取"任务，提出大规模基准Knossos（6领域、19200图、245179节点、439740边）与结构化框架Ariadne，将任务分解为节点清单抽取与源条件边预测，实验证明二者显著提升完整拓扑抽取性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽能识别图元素并推理内容，但完整图拓扑抽取（实体+全部关系）仍研究不足，且缺乏大规模监督数据与系统评测基准，模型建模也具挑战。
AI.method: 构建Knossos基准，通过符号化生成保证渲染图与完整拓扑、关系类型、连接线几何标注的精确对齐；提出Ariadne框架，将完整拓扑抽取分解为节点清单抽取与源条件边预测两个子任务。
AI.result: 在Knossos上训练显著提升小型开源VLM的完整拓扑抽取能力；Ariadne在同等监督下优于一步式抽取，在Knossos上取得最高平均Edge F1；两种骨干变体在真实外部基准上均优于未适配版本。
AI.conclusion: Knossos与Ariadne为图到图拓扑抽取提供了标准化数据与有效方法，验证了结构化分解的优越性及在真实场景中的泛化潜力，代码与基准已开源。

title: Action-Consequence Alignment for Reliable Planning and Self-Improving in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models learn to predict observed transitions, yet low prediction error alone does not guarantee reliable planning. Inspired by self tickling experiments in neuroscience showing that disrupting motor sensory correspondence increases prediction mismatch, we examine whether learned world models preserve an analogous action consequence correspondence.The results show nearby alternatives can receive lower prediction errors despite producing physical outcomes farther from the recorded target. With that future treated as a goal, this reveals a concrete prediction planning mismatch: the model assigns a lower cost to an action that achieves the target less accurately. To mitigate this gap, we introduce Action Consequence Alignment (ACA), a training objective that complements forward prediction by penalizing the prediction error advantage of locally searched alternatives over factual actions without additional model components or environment interactions during training. The same principle can also guide additional data collection for self improvement. We demonstrate that across diverse environments and evaluation settings, ACA improves planning performance and reduces real goal error, while ACA guided data collection outperforms random local sampling. These results support action consequence alignment as a practical principle for bridging predictive learning and reliable planning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"动作后果对齐"（ACA）训练目标，通过惩罚局部搜索替代动作相对于真实动作的预测误差优势，弥合潜在世界模型中预测低误差与可靠规划之间的不匹配，提升规划性能并降低真实目标误差。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型虽能学习预测观测到的状态转移，但仅靠低预测误差无法保证可靠的规划。受神经科学中"自我挠痒"实验启发（干扰运动-感觉对应关系会增加预测误差），作者检验学习到的世界模型是否保留了类似的"动作后果对应关系"。结果发现：邻近的替代动作虽然物理结果偏离记录目标更远，却能获得更低的预测误差；当把该未来状态视为目标时，模型会给"更不准确地达成目标"的动作赋予更低代价，从而暴露出具体的"预测-规划不匹配"。
AI.method: 提出动作后果对齐（Action Consequence Alignment, ACA）训练目标：在正向预测的基础上，额外惩罚局部搜索得到的替代动作相对于真实动作所具有的预测误差优势。该方法不引入额外模型组件，训练期间也无需与环境交互。同一原则还可用于指导额外的数据采集以实现自我改进。
AI.result: 在多种环境和评估设置下，ACA均改善了规划性能并降低了真实目标误差；此外，基于ACA引导的数据采集优于随机局部采样。
AI.conclusion: 动作后果对齐是桥接预测学习与可靠规划的一项实用原则。

title: COSMOS: Soft Mechanism Mixtures with Verifiable Routing for Long-Horizon PDE Forecasting
summary:
Neural operators offer an efficient alternative to classical PDE solvers, but most learn a monolithic map per equation family and discretization. Real systems are compositional: transport, diffusion, wave, and reaction processes can act simultaneously. Existing mixture-of-experts operators typically use sparse top-$K$ routing, although concurrent physics is naturally a blend rather than a discrete choice.
  We propose COSMOS (Cooperative Operator Specialists with Mechanism-level Operator Soft-routing), a soft mechanism-mixture neural operator. Four process-biased specialists remain active at every step and are continuously mixed by a learned gate, with their features fused by a small network. Specialists share a coarse latent grid, while a zero-initialized full-resolution residual restores detail lost through the bottleneck. We also introduce an operator-splitting compositional benchmark with known mixture weights $w^\star$ per trajectory.
  Against family-tuned FNO under 20-step rollouts, an initial 3-seed evaluation suggested gains on diffusion--reaction, parity on Navier--Stokes, and weaker shallow-water performance. An 11-seed audit showed that the diffusion--reaction gain was unstable, motivating caution in small-seed rollout comparisons and precluding a reliable accuracy-win claim on these families. Ablations show that uniform routing or removing the specialist mixture substantially degrades stable-regime rollouts. On the labeled benchmark, dense soft routing yields $2.2\times$ lower error than hard top-1 routing at identical fusion; using generator weights $w^\star$ at inference further lowers rollout error to $0.034$, diagnosing limitations of the learned gate. However, routing labels do not align with the specialists' intended mechanisms: COSMOS supports compositional accuracy, not mechanism identity.

AI.tldr: 提出软机制混合神经算子COSMOS：四个过程偏置专家始终保持激活并由学习门控连续混合，配合零初始化全分辨率残差；同时给出算子分裂组合基准。密软路由优于硬top-1路由，但精度增益不稳定且路由标签不与机制身份对齐。
AI.motivation: 真实物理系统具有组合性，输运、扩散、波动与反应等过程常同时作用；现有神经算子多为按方程族与离散化的单体映射，而混合专家算子普遍采用稀疏top-K路由，将并发的物理过程当作离散选择，与物理本质不符。
AI.method: 提出COSMOS软机制混合神经算子：四个过程偏置专家在每步都保持激活，由学习到的门控连续混合，其特征经小型网络融合；专家共享粗潜网格，零初始化的全分辨率残差恢复瓶颈丢失的细节。另构建带已知混合权重w*的算子分裂组合基准，并做路由与专家消融及推理期使用生成权重w*的诊断实验。
AI.result: 与按族调优的FNO在20步滚动下比较：初始3种子评估显示扩散-反应有增益、Navier-Stokes持平、浅水较差；11种子复核表明扩散-反应增益不稳定，说明小种子滚动比较需谨慎，无法就这些族给出可靠精度胜出结论。消融显示均匀路由或移除专家混合显著降低稳定区间的滚动表现。在带标签基准上，同融合方式下密软路由误差比硬top-1路由低2.2倍；推理时使用生成权重w*进一步将滚动误差降至0.034，揭示学习门控的局限。但路由标签与专家预期机制不对齐。
AI.conclusion: COSMOS通过软机制混合与全分辨率残差支持组合式精度，密软路由明显优于硬top-1路由，但跨族精度优势不稳定，需避免小种子结论；且其路由标签并不对应专家机制身份，即模型支持组合精度而非机制可辨识性。

title: Building A Multi-Sensor Platform For Autonomous Driving Research: Challenges and Lessons Learned
summary: This paper reports on the challenges encountered and lessons learned during the development and deployment of a flexible multi-sensor platform for autonomous driving research. It aims to serve as a reference for researchers developing new multi-sensor systems. As the need for reliable, diverse datasets increases, novel environments and sensing configurations are essential to tackle real-world operational challenges. Consequently, many research groups create custom multi-sensory data collection platforms, where fundamental issues, such as mechanical design, sensor calibration, power management, and time synchronization, arise regardless of sensor types. We reflect on these challenges and share key insights to guide future platform designs, enhancing reproducibility and robustness in autonomous vehicle testing. We also summarize the mitigation strategies we adopted, for instance, system-wide time synchronization using GNSS timing and NTP protocols, custom calibration routines for different sensor configurations, and design practices to improve reliability and data integrity during field deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文反思了在开发与部署面向自动驾驶研究的灵活多传感器平台过程中遇到的挑战与经验教训，分享了设计洞见与缓解策略，旨在为后续多传感器平台设计提供参考。
AI.motivation: 可靠、多样的数据集需求增长，需要在真实环境与新传感配置下采集数据，因此众多研究团队自建多传感器采集平台，而机械设计、传感器标定、电源管理、时间同步等基础问题普遍存在。
AI.method: 以自研灵活多传感器平台为对象，总结其开发与实地部署中的挑战，并梳理所采用的缓解策略，包括基于GNSS授时与NTP协议的系统级时间同步、面向不同传感器配置的定制标定流程，以及提升可靠性与数据完整性的设计实践。
AI.result: 归纳了多传感器平台开发中的共性关键问题，并给出了可复用的缓解方案与经验洞见。
AI.conclusion: 所总结的经验与设计实践可指导未来平台设计，提升自动驾驶测试的可复现性与鲁棒性。

title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
summary: Sparse-view novel view synthesis is a central problem in 3D content creation, but diffusion-based approaches remain limited by iterative denoising, making multi-view generation expensive at inference time. We introduce NAMVIS, a diffusion-free framework that reformulates multi-view image synthesis as geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression. Instead of generating target views through repeated denoising, NAMVIS predicts discrete visual tokens through a small number of coarse-to-fine scale steps, while sampling all tokens within each scale and across target views in parallel. To anchor this generation process to explicit camera geometry, we propose Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding, which injects source and target camera transformations into both target-view self-attention and source-to-target cross-attention at every resolution. NAMVIS further combines global conditioning with dense geometry-aware cross-attention, enabling the model to preserve source-view appearance while maintaining target-view consistency. Across Objaverse, GSO, and OmniObject3D, NAMVIS outperforms diffusion-based baselines in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while running over 3 times faster than the evaluated diffusion baselines under the same evaluation setting. These results suggest that geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression is a promising and efficient alternative to diffusion for sparse-view multi-view synthesis. Additional qualitative results, videos, and resources are available at https://corl-team.github.io/namvis/

AI.tldr: NAMVIS将稀疏视角多视图合成重构为几何条件下的"下一尺度自回归"生成框架，通过并行预测离散视觉令牌替代迭代去噪，在保持几何一致性的同时实现超过3倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽在稀疏视角新视图合成中表现优异，但其迭代去噪过程导致多视图生成推理成本高昂，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出无扩散框架NAMVIS：将多视图合成建模为几何条件下的由粗到细的下一尺度自回归，每个尺度内及跨目标视图的令牌并行采样；设计多尺度投影位姿编码，在每一分辨率的自注意力与源到目标交叉注意力中注入源/目标相机变换；结合全局条件与密集几何感知交叉注意力，以保持源视图外观与目标视图一致性。
AI.result: 在Objaverse、GSO和OmniObject3D数据集上，NAMVIS在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上均优于扩散基线，且在相同评测设置下推理速度提升3倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，几何条件下的下一尺度自回归是稀疏视角多视图合成中一种有前景且高效的扩散替代方案。更多定性结果、视频与资源见项目主页。

title: Autonomous Structuring of Radiology Reports Across Modalities at Archive Scale Using an Open-Weight Large Language Model
summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate an open-weight large language model (LLM) pipeline that converts an entire archive of free-text radiology reports into structured reports without human oversight. Materials and Methods: In this retrospective study, a pipeline with 150 hierarchically organized templates was developed at one center and tested at a second center on reports from 2010 to 2025. The open-weight model gpt-oss-120B selects the template in three constrained-decoding steps and fills it on one local graphics processing unit. Template selection was scored against expert labels on 914 randomly sampled reports of five modalities, structuring quality on 920 radiography and CT reports corrected field by field by five residents. The pipeline then processed the complete archive of the second center. Proportions are reported with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Results: An optimal template set was selected for 74.4% of reports (680 of 914; 95% CI: 71.5%, 77.1%) and an appropriate set for 82.3% (752 of 914; 95% CI: 79.7%, 84.6%), 87.7% for single-region and 54.1% for multi-region reports. Macro semantic textual similarity between output and corrected reference was 0.95 for radiography and 0.97 for CT, residents left 88.7% of 24,638 fields unchanged, and unsupported content was flagged in 1.0% and 1.5% of reports. Of 2,186,982 archive reports, 96.5% received structured output, 2,401,544 structured reports, at 1,258 reports per hour on one graphics processing unit. Conclusion: An open-weight LLM pipeline structured a complete multimodality report archive without human oversight with high content fidelity. Multi-region reports remained the main source of template errors.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并评估了一个基于开源大语言模型（gpt-oss-120B）的流水线，可在无人工监督下将整个自由文本放射学报告档案转换为结构化报告，并以多中心数据验证其模板选择准确性、结构化质量与大规模处理效率。
AI.motivation: 放射学报告多为自由文本，缺乏结构化信息，限制了下游数据利用；而人工结构化成本高、不可扩展。研究旨在验证开源权重LLM能否在无人工监督条件下，高保真地完成全档案、多模态报告的结构化转换。
AI.method: 回顾性研究。在一中心开发、另一中心（2010—2025年报告）测试。构建含150个层级化模板的流水线，开源模型gpt-oss-120B通过三步约束解码完成模板选择与填充，仅需一块本地GPU。模板选择以914份随机抽样报告（五种模态）的专家标注为参照评分；结构质量由5名住院医师对920份X线与CT报告逐字段校正评估。随后处理第二中心完整档案。比例以Wilson 95%置信区间（CI）报告。
AI.result: 最优模板集选中率74.4%（680/914；95% CI：71.5%—77.1%），合适模板集82.3%（752/914；95% CI：79.7%—84.6%），单区域报告87.7%、多区域报告54.1%。输出与校正参考的宏观语义文本相似度为X线0.95、CT 0.97；住院医师在24,638个字段中88.7%未做修改；无支持内容分别仅在1.0%和1.5%的报告中被标记。完整档案2,186,982份报告中96.5%获得结构化输出，共生成2,401,544份结构化报告，单块GPU处理速度达1,258份/小时。
AI.conclusion: 开源权重LLM流水线可在无人工监督下完成全模态报告档案的结构化，内容保真度高；多区域报告仍是模板错误的主要来源。

title: LocusRL: Diagnosing LLM Reward and Policy Interventions in Competitive Games
summary:
Large language models can intervene in reinforcement learning through both reward design and action selection, yet aggregate performance offers an incomplete account of what these interventions actually do. Similar returns can conceal different learning mechanisms, while plausible rewards can induce undesirable behavior. We introduce LocusRL, a diagnostic framework that connects controlled reward-policy comparisons with audits of reward judgments, signal delivery, optimization objectives, and executed actions. The framework traces performance differences to testable explanations and checks targeted corrections through executable rules and counterfactual replay.
  Across two evaluation batches covering ten Connect Four training seeds, we uncover seed-dependent reversals in intervention effects and show how tracing actual updates changes their interpretation: historical Qwen training operates through reward-weighted teacher-action likelihood. A separate matched three-seed reward-direction experiment distinguishes sensitivity to a learning signal from its usefulness. With terminal rewards held fixed, a sign-reversed dense oracle yields a 2.8% aggregate win rate, compared with 57.2% for terminal-only training and 46.7% for the positive dense oracle. Thus, a reward can strongly influence learning without improving performance. At the decision level, counterfactual replay verifies a winning correction to a diagnosed action error. Complementary experiments in Leduc and reward-validation studies in Goofspiel extend the analysis to imperfect-information settings, revealing how reference-label definitions and validation-data exposure affect intervention assessment.
  Together, these findings show why evaluating LLM interventions requires tracing how their outputs become learning signals and actions. LocusRL turns aggregate outcomes into actionable diagnoses and verifiable corrections.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LocusRL 诊断框架，将受控的奖励-策略对比与对奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标和执行动作的审计相连接，把 LLM 介入强化学习的聚合性能差异追溯为可检验解释，并通过可执行规则与反事实回放验证针对性修正。
AI.motivation: LLM 既可通过奖励设计也可通过动作选择介入强化学习，但聚合性能无法完整说明介入的实际作用：相近回报可能掩盖不同学习机制，看似合理的奖励也可能诱发不良行为。因此需要能追溯"输出如何变成学习信号与动作"的诊断方法。
AI.method: LocusRL 框架：以受控奖励-策略对比为核心，配合对奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标与执行动作四类环节的审计；将性能差异追溯为可检验解释，并用可执行规则与反事实回放检验针对性修正。实验涵盖两个评估批次、十个 Connect Four 训练种子，以及匹配的三种子奖励方向实验（固定终端奖励）、Leduc 实验与 Goofspiel 奖励验证研究。
AI.result: 发现介入效果存在依赖种子的反转，并表明追踪实际更新会改变解释：历史 Qwen 训练通过奖励加权的教师动作似然起作用。奖励方向实验中，符号反转的稠密 oracle 聚合胜率仅 2.8%，而仅终端奖励训练为 57.2%、正向稠密 oracle 为 46.7%——说明奖励可强烈影响学习却不提升性能。反事实回放验证了针对已诊断动作错误的有效修正；在不完全信息场景中，参考标签定义与验证数据暴露会影响介入评估。
AI.conclusion: 评估 LLM 介入必须追踪其输出如何转化为学习信号与动作；LocusRL 将聚合结果转化为可操作的诊断与可验证的修正。

title: Emergency Obstacle Avoidance Maneuvers in Differential-Drive Mobile Robots
summary: Emergency obstacle avoidance requires a mobile robot to brake or change its heading within the available distance. This paper investigates the dependence of maneuver performance and odometric error on approach speed for a differential-drive robot. A footprint-clearance analysis and a normalized wheel-motion index provide a kinematic description of five braking and turning maneuvers. The principal experiment comprises 540 block-randomized trials on tile, of which 539 are retained, at commanded approach speeds of 45, 55, and 65 cm/s. An overhead camera provides an independent pose reference. When encoder, gyro, and camera heading changes are evaluated over complete motion records, the mean encoder discrepancy increases by 4.7-5.1 degrees for the two reverse-spin maneuvers between the lowest and highest speeds; the arc and brake-assisted pivot change by less than 0.4 degrees. Larger encoder discrepancy is associated with lower avoidance success after adjustment for distance, speed, maneuver, day, and turn direction. Gyro discrepancies remain approximately 3 degrees for the reverse spins. Estimated reaction distances for 90% success and their uncertainty quantify the maneuver trade-offs. The results support speed-specific empirical characterization of emergency maneuvers and distinguish encoder error from recovery motion and measurement-window mismatch.

AI.tldr: 本文通过540次随机分组试验，研究差速驱动机器人在45、55、65 cm/s接近速度下五种制动与转向避障机动的位置估计误差与机动性能的依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 紧急避障要求移动机器人在可用距离内完成制动或转向，需要量化机动性能与码盘（里程计）误差如何随接近速度变化，以支持速度相关的经验性紧急机动表征。
AI.method: 采用足印间隙分析与归一化车轮运动指标对五种制动和转向机动进行运动学描述；在瓷砖地面上开展540次分块随机试验（保留539次），指令接近速度为45、55、65 cm/s；使用顶置相机提供独立位姿参考，比较编码器、陀螺仪与相机在完整运动记录上的航向变化。
AI.result: 在最低与最高速度之间，两种反向旋转机动的编码器平均航向偏差增加4.7–5.1°；圆弧与制动辅助枢轴机动的变化小于0.4°。在控制距离、速度、机动类型、日期与转向方向后，较大的编码器偏差与较低的避障成功率相关。反向旋转的陀螺仪偏差保持约3°。并给出90%成功率下的估计反应距离及其不确定性以量化机动权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对紧急机动进行分速度的经验性表征，并将编码器误差与恢复运动及测量窗口不匹配区分开来。

title: Investigating Spatiotemporal Redundancy in Video Transformer for Collision Anticipation
summary: In worker-equipment proximity monitoring, video transformers are widely used for collision anticipation and have demonstrated strong performance. However, their accuracy comes with substantial computational demands, creating a tension with the need for low-latency inference on mobile robots and the pursuit of lower-carbon computation in construction. To address this, this study investigates where computation within an established video transformer is redundant and whether that redundancy can be removed without materially degrading predictive performance. Using VideoMAEv2-Base on the Nexar Collision Prediction dataset, we first examine how collision-relevant information evolves across network depth and then investigate two complementary forms of redundancy: structured capacity redundancy in multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and spatiotemporal redundancy in the token stream. Linear probes show that interpretable motion cues, including flow magnitude, looming, and approach versus retreat, are most accessible at intermediate layers, whereas collision-label discrimination strengthens toward the final layer. Token redundancy is axis-specific: adjacent temporal-token similarity reaches 0.970 in later layers, while spatial similarity falls to 0.297, indicating substantially greater redundancy across time than across space. Exploiting this asymmetry, temporal token merging reduces backbone computation from 356.99 to 178.50 GFLOPs and latency from 12.69 to 7.21 ms per clip, a 1.76x speedup, while mean average precision changes only from 0.7478 to 0.7443. Importance-guided retention of 50% of MLP units preserves an AUC of 0.753, compared with 0.529 under matched random retention, and reveals that pruning alters score calibration before discriminative ranking collapses. These findings establish a new pathway for pursuing faster algorithms through targeted temporal token compression and neuron pruning.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析视频Transformer在工人-设备碰撞预警中的计算冗余，发现中间层蕴含可解释运动线索、时间token冗余远高于空间冗余，据此进行时间token合并与MLP神经元剪枝，在几乎不损失精度的情况下实现1.76倍加速。
AI.motivation: 视频Transformer在碰撞预判中精度高但计算量大，与移动机器人低延迟推理需求及建筑领域低碳计算目标相矛盾，因此需探究其计算冗余是否可被去除而不显著损害预测性能。
AI.method: 基于Nexar Collision Prediction数据集使用VideoMAEv2-Base，先用线性探针分析碰撞相关信息随网络深度的演化，再研究两类冗余：MLP中的结构化容量冗余，以及token流中的时空冗余；并据此进行时间token合并与重要性引导的MLP单元保留（剪枝）。
AI.result: 线性探针显示flow magnitude、looming、approach versus retreat等运动线索在中间层最易获取，碰撞标签判别力向末层增强；token冗余具轴向特异性，后层时间token相似度达0.970而空间相似度降至0.297。时间token合并使骨干计算从356.99降至178.50 GFLOPs、单片段延迟从12.69降至7.21 ms（1.76倍加速），mAP仅从0.7478变为0.7443；保留50% MLP单元维持AUC 0.753，而随机保留仅0.529。
AI.conclusion: 研究确认视频Transformer存在可针对性利用的时空冗余与容量冗余，揭示剪枝先影响分数校准、后导致判别排序崩溃的规律，提出通过时间token压缩与神经元剪枝实现更快算法的新路径。

title: Decide, Ask, or Defer: Clinical LLMs under Incomplete Evidence
comment: Preprint. Accepted to the Main Track of the NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop
summary: Clinical LLMs must decide not only what diagnosis to produce, but also whether the available evidence is sufficient for autonomous decision making. Binary DECIDE/ABSTAIN formulations merge distinct non decision states and do not explicitly evaluate information acquisition. We introduce a DECIDE/ASK/DEFER formulation together with a blinded protocol that prevents models from using evidence completeness metadata. We evaluate Qwen, Gemini, and GPT on 200 matched clinical evidence states constructed from DDXPlus. The models show substantial differences in action selection under identical evidence, with disagreement in 137 of 200 states. For Qwen, a matched targeted versus random analysis shows that selected information changes the likelihood of a subsequent autonomous decision more clearly than diagnostic correctness. Its matched DECIDE/ABSTAIN baseline further reveals a safety autonomy tradeoff: the three action policy rescues some erroneous autonomous decisions but also removes some correct autonomous deci sions. These results show that separating information acquisition from clinician deferral exposes behavior that binary abstention hides, without yielding a uniformly improved decision policy.

AI.tldr: 提出 DECIDE/ASK/DEFER 三态决策范式与盲化协议，在 200 个匹配临床证据状态上评测 Qwen、Gemini、GPT，揭示二元 DECIDE/ABSTAIN 所掩盖的行为差异与“安全性—自主性”权衡。
AI.motivation: 临床大模型不仅需给出诊断，还需判断现有证据是否足以支持自主决策。现有二元 DECIDE/ABSTAIN 设定将不同的“非决策状态”混为一谈，且未显式评估信息获取行为，从而掩盖了模型在证据不足时的真实策略。
AI.method: 提出 DECIDE/ASK/DEFER 三态表述，将“主动获取信息”与“转交临床医生”相区分；设计盲化协议，阻止模型利用证据完整性等元数据。基于 DDXPlus 构建 200 个匹配的临床证据状态，对 Qwen、Gemini 和 GPT 进行评测；对 Qwen 进一步开展“定向 vs. 随机”信息获取的匹配分析，以及与 DECIDE/ABSTAIN 基线的对照。
AI.result: 相同证据下不同模型的动作选择差异显著，200 个状态中有 137 个出现分歧。对 Qwen 的匹配分析显示，所选信息对后续自主决策可能性的影响比诊断正确性更明显。与 DECIDE/ABSTAIN 基线对比揭示安全性—自主性权衡：三态策略挽救了一些错误的自主决策，但也移除了部分正确的自主决策。
AI.conclusion: 将信息获取与临床医生转交分离，能够暴露二元弃权范式所隐藏的模型行为；但该三态策略并未带来一致更优的决策方案，而是呈现明确的安全性与自主性权衡。

title: One-Step Generation via Riemannian Wasserstein Gradient Flows
