summary: Recently, Drifting Models and Wasserstein Gradient Flows have attracted substantial attention because they move iterative distributional refinement to training and amortize it into a generator, enabling fast inference. However, existing formulations have been developed largely for continuous Euclidean domains, such as image spaces, where particles admit unconstrained additive updates. On constrained spaces, these updates can leave the valid domain or ignore its geometry, making them unsuitable targets for training. Recent work has adapted updates to these spaces, but has focused on particular fields or offered limited empirical comparison. We derive and compare several geometry-aware fields within a common training framework for one-step generators. We test the method on data with different structures and obtain competitive one-step results in each setting. The best-performing field varies by task, showing why the choice of objective matters in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Drifting Models 与 Wasserstein 梯度流推广到受约束空间，在同一单步生成器训练框架下推导并比较了多种几何感知场（geometry-aware fields），在具有不同结构的数据上均取得有竞争力的单步生成结果，且发现最优场因任务而异，说明目标函数选择在实践中至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有 Drifting Models 与 Wasserstein 梯度流主要针对连续欧氏域（如图像空间）设计，其粒子更新为无约束的加性形式。在受约束空间上，此类更新可能越出有效域或忽略空间几何结构，难以作为训练目标。近期虽有工作将更新适配到特定约束空间，但多局限于特定领域且缺乏系统的实证比较。
AI.method: 在一个统一的单步生成器训练框架下，推导并比较多种几何感知场（geometry-aware fields）；在具有不同结构的数据上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在各设定下均获得有竞争力的单步生成结果；表现最优的场因任务不同而变化。
AI.conclusion: 将分布精炼目标推广至受约束空间时，几何感知目标函数的选择对实际性能有显著影响，不存在普适最优的场，需针对具体任务进行选择。

title: FOCUS: Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Change Detection for Uncertainty-Aware Semi-Static Scenes
summary: Autonomous robots operating over long periods must keep their environmental memory up to date as the world changes between visits. In semi-static environments, an object may be replaced in place by a different but geometrically and semantically similar instance, making the identity change difficult to detect from geometry or coarse semantics alone. We present FOCUS, an uncertainty-aware framework for object-level change detection and map maintenance. We formulate semi-static memory maintenance as probabilistic inference that fuses geometric likelihood with appearance likelihood rendered from a 3D Gaussian map. A recursive three-state estimator maintains whether each mapped object is PERSISTED, REPLACED, or REMOVED. To account for imperfect 3DGS rendering, we model the rendered appearance evidence probabilistically rather than using it as a direct change score, with the model parameters automatically calibrated from a change-free replay of the initial mapping session. We evaluate our method on a new Isaac Sim warehouse benchmark with ambiguous in-place replacements and on the real-world TorWIC dataset. It improves object-level replacement F1 from 0.20 to 0.84 over a probabilistic baseline and transfers to real-world data without manual parameter retuning.

AI.tldr: 提出FOCUS框架，用概率推断融合几何与3D高斯渲染外观证据，对地图中物体进行PERSISTED/REPLACED/REMOVED三态递归估计，实现半静态环境下的物体级变化检测与地图维护。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的自主机器人需要在多次访问间更新环境记忆。半静态环境中，物体可能被几何与语义相似的另一实例原地替换，仅凭几何或粗粒度语义难以识别身份变化。
AI.method: 将半静态记忆维护建模为概率推断，融合几何似然与由3D高斯地图渲染的外观似然；用递归三态估计器判断每个地图物体处于PERSISTED、REPLACED还是REMOVED；针对3DGS渲染不完美，将渲染外观证据按概率建模而非直接用作变化分数，模型参数通过初始建图会话的无变化重放自动校准。
AI.result: 在带有歧义原地替换的新Isaac Sim仓库基准及真实TorWIC数据集上评估，物体级替换F1由概率基线的0.20提升至0.84，并可迁移到真实数据而无需手动重新调参。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS表明，把外观渲染证据纳入概率化不确定性建模并自动校准，可显著提升半静态环境下物体级变化检测与地图维护性能，并具备仿真到真实的泛化能力。

title: Probabilistic Pedestrian Forecasts from a Handheld Phone: World-Frame Heat Maps, Visual-Inertial Height Drift, and Evaluation without Ground Truth
summary: A pedestrian with a phone could be shown where nearby people will be in the next few seconds, if the forecast stays on the ground while the phone moves, is calibrated, and needs only a monocular camera and visual-inertial odometry (VIO). We build and evaluate such a system. People are detected, lifted onto the floor by ray-plane intersection, tracked in a gravity-aligned metric frame, and forecast as per-step probability maps by a small U-Net trained with a negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss on bird's-eye (SDD) and first-person (EgoTraj-Bench) trajectories. On handheld ADVIO recordings, vertical VIO drift and the user's own changes of level silently rescale monocular ground positions (by 87% within 90 s on one clip; on another, all tracks are lost for the last 31% of the clip); keeping the camera's height above the floor constant under a low-pass-filtered altitude avoids this, though it lags on escalators. On the SDD and EgoTraj-Bench test splits, the final forecaster lowers the NLL at 4.8 s by 1.51 and 1.37 nats relative to a fitted constant-velocity Gaussian. Lacking ground truth for people in handheld video, we score forecasts against the tracker's own later raw measurements. In an internally pre-registered evaluation on seven held-out clips, the final forecaster's NLL is lower than the benchmark-fitted baseline's at 1.2, 2.4 and 4.8 s (by 0.17, 0.23 and 0.47 nats; 95% intervals over people exclude zero), but by less than half as much as on the development clips. Exploratory analyses cut both ways: resampling clips instead of people widens the intervals to include zero at 1.2 and 2.4 s, and once both forecasters are recalibrated on the development clips the network is significantly better only at 1.2 s; but two clips run with ADVIO's reference poses favour the network much more when re-run with the phone's own poses. We discuss what such self-consistency scores can and cannot show.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建并评估了一个仅用单目相机与VIO、在地面参考系中预测附近行人未来数秒位置的手持手机系统，并提出需保持相机离地高度恒定以抑制漂移；在新数据集上预测性能优于恒速基线，但在严格留出集上增益减半。
AI.motivation: 手持手机用户可能希望获知附近行人未来几秒的位置，但现有方法依赖多传感器或先验地图，且单目VIO在垂直方向漂移与用户改变楼层时会静默缩放地面定位，导致预测不可靠。
AI.method: 检测行人并经射线—平面相交投影到地面；在重力对齐的度量坐标系中跟踪，并以低通滤波高度固定相机离地高度；用小型U-Net以NLL损失在SDD鸟瞰与EgoTraj-Bench第一人称轨迹上训练，输出逐步概率图；在ADVIO手持录制上评估，因缺乏行人真值，以跟踪器自身后续原始测量作为评分参考。
AI.result: 垂直VIO漂移与用户变层会静默缩放单目地面位置（某片段90秒内达87%，另一片段末31%轨迹全失），固定离地高度可避免该问题但在扶梯上滞后。SDD与EgoTraj-Bench测试集上4.8秒NLL相对拟合恒速高斯降低1.51与1.37 nats。七个留出片段预注册评估中，最终预测器在1.2/2.4/4.8秒NLL分别低0.17/0.23/0.47 nats（95%区间不含零），但增益不足开发片段的一半；按片段重采样则1.2与2.4秒区间含零，双预测器在开发片段重校准后网络仅1.2秒显著更优。
AI.conclusion: 地面参考系加高度约束可有效缓解手持单目VIO漂移，学习式概率预测优于恒速基线；但基于自洽性（而非真值）的评分其证据强度有限，留出集与重采样下增益不稳定，需谨慎解读其能力边界。

title: Label Agreement Does Not Measure Authorization
summary: Many groups now delegate label ontology and metadata harmonization to agentic LLM pipelines. We built one and audited it. Our aggregate scores looked healthy, but the pipeline kept failing in ways they did not show, so we set out to find what they hid. Label agreement asks whether a proposed label matches a reference. It does not ask whether the agent was entitled to propose it, whether the output was complete enough to act on, or whether the label moved when the evidence moved. We measured those three separately on COBRE and FBIRN, two schizophrenia and control neuroimaging cohorts from different consortia, and they come apart, from label agreement and from each other. Showing the agent an upstream proposal barely moves label agreement, 0.857 to 0.870, while agreement on the chosen action doubles, 0.409 to 0.830. Output that parses as JSON still drops a required field on 10% of one model's cases and 33% of the other's. And an agent that replays its first answer scores perfectly on original cases and zero once we change the evidence that decides them. Downstream, a row-order error that none of these metrics reports erases most of the diagnostic signal. So we measure these properties apart, pair each with a control, and gate commitment on the result, which makes failures visible and easy to route to a person. None of this prevents failure. Our reference labels are rule-derived, so agreement with them means consistency, not correctness. Code is available at https://github.com/amir-sbg/Label-Agreement-Does-Not-Measure-Authorization.

AI.tldr: 本文对一个用于标签本体与元数据协调的智能体式 LLM 流水线进行审计，指出标签一致率等聚合指标掩盖了三类关键失败模式，并提出了分别度量、配以对照、以结果门控承诺的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 当前许多团队将标签本体与元数据协调工作委托给智能体式 LLM 流水线，而聚合分数看似健康，但流水线持续以聚合指标无法显现的方式失败。标签一致率只回答"提议标签是否与参考标签匹配"，却不回答智能体是否有权提出该标签、输出是否完整到可据以行动、以及证据变化时标签是否随之变化。
AI.method: 在 COBRE 与 FBIRN 两个来自不同联盟的精神分裂症与对照神经影像队列上，分别独立测量三项属性：(1) 授权性（agent 是否有权提出该标签，以"所选动作一致率"为代理）；(2) 输出完整性（JSON 解析成功但必需字段缺失的比例）；(3) 证据敏感性（改变决定标签的证据后，标签是否随之改变，通过"重放首答"的智能体在原始案例与变更证据案例上的表现对照）。每项属性均配以对照条件，并将承诺（commitment）门控于测量结果之上。此外还考察了下游的行序错误对诊断信号的影响。
AI.result: 三项属性彼此分离且与标签一致率分离。展示上游提议仅使标签一致率从 0.857 微升至 0.870，而所选动作一致率从 0.409 升至 0.830（翻倍）。解析为合法 JSON 的输出仍在一个模型 10%、另一个模型 33% 的案例中丢失必需字段。重放首答的智能体在原始案例上得分完美，但在证据变更后得分为零。下游一个未被上述任何指标捕捉的行序错误抹除了大部分诊断信号。
AI.conclusion: 应当将上述属性分开度量、各自配以对照，并据结果门控承诺，从而使失败可见且易于路由至人工处理。该框架不能防止失败。由于参考标签为规则导出，与之一致仅意味着一致性而非正确性。代码已开源。

title: Target-free Latent Safety Alignment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that induce harmful behaviors and circumvent safety alignment. To defend against such attacks, adversarial training paradigms have been proposed to first simulate failure modes and then train the model to correct them, yielding promising improvements in safety alignment. However, these methods typically construct adversarial samples either by encouraging fixed harmful target completions or by performing targeted activation ablation derived from fixed benign--harmful data pairs. As a result, the generated adversarial samples tend to induce homogeneous harmful behaviors that poorly reflect the diversity of behaviors elicited by real-world jailbreak attacks. This behavior-level narrowness fundamentally limits their robustness. To address this issue, we propose a target-free adversarial training framework that generates adversarial samples in an unsupervised manner. By amplifying and diversifying behavior-level shifts in the model's latent space, our approach produces semantically diverse adversarial samples that induce a wide range of harmful behaviors. This expanded behavioral coverage exposes more diverse failure modes and thereby improves safety alignment. To quantify this effect, we use semantic entropy as an output-level measure of adversarial behavioral diversity. Empirically, our method elicits diverse harmful behaviors in the target model, substantially mitigating behavioral narrowness and improving robustness to jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出无目标对抗训练框架，通过放大并多样化潜空间中的行为级偏移，以无监督方式生成语义多样的对抗样本，缓解对抗样本行为同质化问题，提升LLM对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗训练防御方法构造对抗样本时，要么鼓励固定的有害目标补全，要么基于固定的良性-有害数据对进行定向激活消融。这导致生成的对抗样本诱发同质化的有害行为，无法反映真实越狱攻击所引发行为的多样性，这种行为层面的狭窄性从根本上限制了防御的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出无目标（target-free）对抗训练框架，以无监督方式生成对抗样本。核心做法是放大并多样化模型潜空间中的行为级偏移，从而产生语义多样、能诱发多种有害行为的对抗样本。采用语义熵作为输出层面的对抗行为多样性度量指标。
AI.result: 在目标模型上成功诱发多样化的有害行为，显著缓解了行为狭窄性问题，并提升了对越狱攻击的鲁棒性；语义熵指标定量刻画了对抗行为多样性的提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 扩大对抗样本的行为覆盖范围可暴露更多样的失效模式，从而改善安全对齐；无目标、无监督的对抗样本生成是缓解现有对抗训练行为同质化瓶颈的有效途径。

title: Spacecraft Rendezvous Trajectory Generation with Modular Constraints via Diffusion Model Composition
summary: Emerging mission classes such as on-orbit servicing, satellite inspection, and active debris removal require trajectory design methods that are adaptable to a variety of mission scenarios. We present a diffusion-based trajectory generation approach for rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) that enables flexible configuration of mission constraints. First, individual energy-based diffusion models are trained to satisfy distinct constraints such as approach cone and sensor line-of-sight from a set of optimized trajectories. Then, at inference time, the learned energy models can be composed with one another, or with an analytically defined energy field, to enforce specific constraint combinations. We validate this framework with the composition of a learned approach cone model and a learned sensor line-of-sight model, as well as a learned approach cone model and synthetic obstacle avoidance model, both of which yield constraint satisfaction rates that are within 1 percentage point of the single-constraint models or higher. These results indicate that our compositional diffusion framework can provide a modular approach to RPO trajectory design and enable reconfiguration for new constraint combinations without requiring model retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散模型的RPO轨迹生成框架，通过能量模型的可组合性实现多约束灵活配置，无需重训练即可满足新约束组合。
AI.motivation: 在轨服务、卫星巡检与主动碎片清除等新兴任务需要适应多种任务场景的轨迹设计方法，传统方法难以灵活组合与重构约束条件。
AI.method: 先针对单一约束（如接近锥、传感器视线）分别训练独立的基于能量的扩散模型；推理时将已学习的能量模型相互组合，或与解析定义的能量场组合，以施加特定约束组合。
AI.result: 验证了"学习接近锥模型+学习传感器视线模型"及"学习接近锥模型+合成避障模型"两种组合，约束满足率与单约束模型相差在1个百分点以内或更高。
AI.conclusion: 该组合式扩散框架为RPO轨迹设计提供了模块化途径，可在无需重训练的情况下为新约束组合实现重构。

title: ThyCLIPNet: A BiomedCLIP-Guided Lightweight Attention-Enhanced DeepLabV3+ Framework for Robust Thyroid Nodule Segmentation
summary: Accurate thyroid ultrasound segmentation is often challenged by low contrast, speckle noise, and unclear boundaries. Although recent methods have improved segmentation accuracy, many rely on resource-intensive architectures or lack explicit integration of multiscale features with global biomedical visual guidance. In this paper, we introduce ThyCLIPNet, a lightweight semantic-guided hybrid encoder-decoder framework that integrates BiomedCLIP-derived biomedical semantic guidance into a lightweight multi-scale CNN segmentation pipeline. The encoder integrates MobileNetV2 with efficient channel attention, while atrous spatial pyramid pooling and a custom convolutional block attention module enrich bottleneck features. The decoder combines hierarchical skip connections and lightweight attention refinement with a BiomedCLIP-guided gated fusion pathway that projects vision-only global biomedical embeddings into decoder feature space and selectively integrates them through semantic-local fusion and spatial gating. To the best of our knowledge, ThyCLIPNet is among the first lightweight thyroid ultrasound segmentation frameworks to use BiomedCLIP's vision encoder alone for image-only global semantic guidance without text prompting. Experiments on TG3K, TN3K, DDTI, and PKTN achieve dice similarity coefficients of 96.22%, 87.58%, 84.73%, and 80.70%; intersection over union scores of 92.72%, 77.91%, 73.51%, and 67.64%; and 95th-percentile hausdorff distances of 3.75, 16.38, 18.23, and 10.86, respectively. ThyCLIPNet uses 8.55M parameters and 22.99G FLOPs. Overall, the results support integrating global biomedical semantic guidance with lightweight multi-scale CNN representations for robust and computationally efficient thyroid ultrasound segmentation. Source code: https://github.com/Tasnim-Jahan/ThyCLIPNet. [Abstract shortened for arXiv. See PDF for full abstract.]

AI.tldr: ThyCLIPNet：一种轻量级语义引导的混合编码器-解码器框架，仅利用BiomedCLIP视觉编码器提供图像级全局生物医学语义引导，结合多尺度CNN实现高效的甲状腺超声分割。
AI.motivation: 甲状腺超声分割受低对比度、斑点噪声和边界模糊困扰；现有方法虽提升精度，但多依赖高资源架构，且缺乏多尺度特征与全局生物医学视觉引导的显式融合。
AI.method: 提出轻量级语义引导混合编码器-解码器框架。编码器将MobileNetV2与高效通道注意力结合，瓶颈处使用空洞空间金字塔池化与自定义卷积块注意力模块增强特征；解码器结合分层跳跃连接与轻量注意力精炼，并引入BiomedCLIP引导的门控融合通路，将纯视觉全局生物医学嵌入投影到解码器特征空间，通过语义-局部融合与空间门控选择性整合。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将全局生物医学语义引导与轻量级多尺度CNN表示相结合，实现稳健且计算高效的甲状腺超声分割；该框架是较早仅用BiomedCLIP视觉编码器（无需文本提示）进行图像级全局语义引导的轻量级甲状腺超声分割方法之一。

title: $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$: Guiding Agent Evolution from Pattern Recognition to Solution Invention
summary: We propose $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ (TRIZ exponentiated by an agent), a general R\&D automation paradigm that combines TRIZ inventive theory with LLM-driven agent evolutionary search. TRIZ's 40 inventive principles and contradiction matrix provide structured, explainable directions for solution generation, replacing random or untyped mutation with theory-guided ideation. Functional information (FI), operationalized under a frozen reference contract, is combined with TRIZ Ideality to measure useful and harmful function on a commensurable information scale, while hard gates keep promotion distinct from metric improvement. We validate $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ in cybersecurity--an adversarial and rapidly evolving domain--on PowerDuck GOOSE, CICIoT2023, and CIC-DDoS2019. Under paired-rerun protocols with protocol fingerprinting and hard-gate validation, the legacy experiments yield absolute F1 improvements of $+2.88$, $+4.23$, and $+0.15$ percentage points, respectively. A completed 45-activity CICIoT2023 campaign further increases macro-F1 from $0.8325$ to $0.8483$, but does not pass its frozen promotion gate. Every result remains traceable from contradiction identification and TRIZ principle selection to code transformation, evaluation metrics, and promotion decision.

AI.tldr: 提出TRIZ^a——将TRIZ发明理论与LLM智能体进化搜索相结合的通用研发自动化范式，并在网络安全任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 传统自动化研发中的随机或无类型变异缺乏结构化、可解释的生成方向，需要理论指导的创意机制。
AI.method: 融合TRIZ的40条发明原理与矛盾矩阵提供结构化生成方向；将功能信息(FI)在冻结参考契约下操作化，并结合TRIZ理想度在可比信息尺度上度量有用/有害功能；用硬门控区分"晋升"与"指标改善"。
AI.result: 在PowerDuck GOOSE、CICIoT2023、CIC-DDoS2019上，配对重跑协议下F1绝对提升分别为+2.88、+4.23、+0.15个百分点；CICIoT2023的45活动campaign将macro-F1从0.8325提升至0.8483，但未通过冻结晋升门控。
AI.conclusion: TRIZ^a在对抗性快速演化域中有效且全程可追溯（从矛盾识别、原理选择到代码变换、评估指标与晋升决策）。

title: BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: As large language models (LLMs) grow in parameter count, model storage and parameter memory traffic have become major bottlenecks to efficient deployment. Codebook-based weight quantization reduces these costs, but imbalanced nearest-codeword assignments during fitting can leave some codewords insufficiently updated, limiting effective codebook utilization. To address this limitation, we propose Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization (BARQ), which improves quantization quality through balanced fitting of existing codebooks. Specifically, we first compute joint soft assignments between weight blocks and codewords through entropically regularized optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted reconstruction costs, ensuring equal positive fitting mass for every codeword in the exact solution. We then refine the codewords through an assignment-weighted barycentric update, which we prove minimizes the fitting objective for fixed assignments. For finite Sinkhorn iterations, the implemented update retains this optimality provided all codeword masses exceed the denominator floor. Finally, we discard the soft assignments and use the refined codebook for standard hard nearest-codeword encoding, with our analysis establishing sufficient conditions for reducing hard-quantization distortion and evaluation loss. Across multiple LLMs, BARQ achieves lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy than the evaluated baselines at comparable bit budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/chenhangcuisg-code/BARQ.

AI.tldr: BARQ通过熵正则化最优传输实现权重块与码字的均衡软分配，并采用分配加权重心更新精炼码字，提升基于码本的权重量化质量，在多种LLM上以相同比特预算取得更低困惑度和更高零样本精度。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM参数量增长，模型存储与参数内存访问成为高效部署的主要瓶颈。基于码本的权重量化可降低成本，但拟合过程中最近码字分配不均衡会导致部分码字更新不足，限制码本的有效利用率。
AI.method: 提出BARQ（Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization）。首先通过带均匀边缘约束的熵正则化最优传输计算权重块与码字的联合软分配，并引入曲率加权重构代价，使精确解中每个码字的正拟合质量相等；随后以分配加权的重心更新精炼码字，并证明其在固定分配下最小化拟合目标；在有限Sinkhorn迭代下，只要所有码字质量超过分母下限，该更新仍保持最优性；最后丢弃软分配，用精炼后的码本进行标准硬最近码字编码。
AI.result: 理论上给出了降低硬量化失真与评估损失的充分条件；在多个LLM上，BARQ在可比比特预算下比所评估基线取得更低的困惑度和更高的平均零样本准确率。
AI.conclusion: 均衡拟合可有效提升码本利用率，BARQ在保持硬编码部署兼容性的同时改善了量化质量，代码已开源。

title: Bayesian Data Augmentation for DNN Retraining with Binomial Outcomes in Vision-Based UAV Landing
summary:
In GPS-denied or cluttered urban environments, vision-based landing is essential for reliable UAV missions. Real-world landing sites are often unstructured and highly variable, requiring strong generalization by the perception system. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) trained with synthetic data augmentation offer a scalable solution for learning landing-site features across diverse vehicle and environmental states. However, computationally expensive DNN retraining, along with challenging performance validation via test flights, limits exhaustive model fine-tuning and necessitates an optimized retraining pipeline. In this work, we deploy a Bayesian data augmentation framework integrated with a photorealistic simulator featuring high-fidelity vehicle dynamics to iteratively retrain the helipad detector DNN, maximizing landing performance as the objective function.
  We validate our framework with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, demonstrating improved landing performance and tighter confidence intervals on predicted landing outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于贝叶斯数据增强与高保真仿真器的迭代重训练框架，用于优化无人机停机坪检测DNN，在GPS拒止及杂乱城市环境中提升视觉着陆性能。
AI.motivation: GPS拒止或杂乱城市环境下，视觉着陆对无人机任务可靠性至关重要。真实着陆场地非结构化、变化大，要求感知系统具备强泛化能力。合成数据增强训练的DNN可扩展地学习着陆点特征，但DNN重训练计算昂贵、试飞验证困难，限制了穷举式微调，因此需要优化重训练流程。
AI.method: 将贝叶斯数据增强框架与具备高保真飞行动力学的逼真仿真器集成，以着陆性能为目标函数，迭代重训练停机坪检测DNN。
AI.result: 在逼真仿真器中，针对不同环境条件与飞行器状态开展实验，着陆性能得到提升，预测着陆结果的置信区间更紧致。
AI.conclusion: 该贝叶斯数据增强驱动的迭代重训练流程可有效提升视觉着陆性能并提高预测可靠性，为资源受限下的DNN优化提供了可行方案。

title: ARISE: Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation for Interpretable IBD Assessment
summary: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) requires frequent imaging-based assessment, yet interpretation of modalities such as wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) and intestinal ultrasound remains heavily dependent on specialist expertise. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate significant potential in multimodal medical image analysis, but their clinical adoption is hindered by their insufficient domain-specific reasoning, susceptibility to hallucination, scarcity of high quality training data in fine-grained diagnostics and limited interpretability. We introduce ARISE (Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation), an autonomous planning framework that models few-shot medical image understanding as a sequential agentic workflow. ARISE structures agent execution into a transparent 5-stage workflow: hypothesis generation, image-grounded evidence summarization, evidence-conditioned refinement, symbolic verification, and final diagnosis. We apply ARISE to IBD assessment across two independent patient cohorts: wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) images for Crohn's disease and B-mode ultrasound data for ulcerative colitis. ARISE consistently improves diagnostic performance over baseline VLMs while exposing where reasoning succeeds or fails, providing a more interpretable basis for clinical decision support and realistic deployment.

AI.tldr: ARISE：一种将少样本医学图像理解建模为顺序智能体工作流的自主规划框架，通过5阶段透明流程提升IBD影像诊断性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 炎症性肠病（IBD）需要频繁影像评估，但无线胶囊内镜（WCE）和肠道超声等模态的判读高度依赖专家经验。视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态医学图像分析中潜力显著，但临床落地受限于领域推理不足、易产生幻觉、细粒度诊断所需高质量训练数据稀缺以及可解释性有限。
AI.method: 提出ARISE（自适应智能体推理与图像接地自评估），将少样本医学图像理解建模为顺序智能体工作流，包含透明的5阶段执行流程：假设生成、图像接地证据总结、证据条件化精炼、符号化验证、最终诊断。
AI.result: 在两个独立患者队列上应用于IBD评估：用于克罗恩病的无线胶囊内镜（WCE）图像，以及用于溃疡性结肠炎的B型超声数据。ARISE相较基线VLM持续提升诊断性能，同时揭示推理成功或失败的具体环节。
AI.conclusion: ARISE为临床决策支持与真实场景部署提供了更具可解释性的基础，在提升诊断性能的同时增强了推理过程透明度。

title: Recursive Improvement of a Differentiable Scientific Software Ecosystem
summary: Differentiable programming connects scientific computation with gradient-based inference, learning and design. Extending these capabilities across a heterogeneous software ecosystem requires specialized effort to implement derivatives, integrate interfaces and evaluate quality. AI coding agents can accelerate this transformation, but translating their capabilities into useful scientific software requires identifying research needs and evaluating how well implementations meet them. We present an environment for agent-driven evolution of differentiable scientific software that connects demand identification, development and quality evaluation. A unified differentiation interface exposes reusable derivative rules alongside existing numerical routines, allowing research tasks to share these capabilities. Research requirements guide development, with implementations assessed through independent derivative checks, workflow tests and performance evaluation. Validated software, research programs and tests become shared resources for subsequent studies. We construct and validate automatic differentiation extensions across 20 packages spanning physical, chemical and biological modeling, with research workflows demonstrating reuse across tasks. Benchmarks demonstrate computational savings over finite differences in gradient evaluation and complete parameter estimation. Research-driven revisions make previously unsupported workflows differentiable, correct derivatives of scientific observables and eliminate redundant computation. Quantum-control and thermal-design studies revise objectives in response to physical evaluation, improving designs while reusing existing derivatives. This work provides a practical approach to expanding differentiable programming across established scientific software and organizing AI agents around the recursive improvement of a shared computational ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向AI编码智能体的"可微分科学软件演化环境"，将需求识别、开发与质量评估贯通，通过统一微分接口在20个物理、化学、生物建模包中构建并验证自动微分扩展，实现研究工作的复用与可微化。
AI.motivation: 可微分编程将科学计算与基于梯度的推断、学习与设计相连接，但在异构软件生态中扩展这些能力需大量实现导数、集成接口和评估质量的工作。AI编码智能体虽可加速此过程，但需识别研究需求并评估实现是否满足，缺乏将智能体能力转化为可用科学软件的组织化方法。
AI.method: 构建一个智能体驱动的可微分科学软件演化环境，联通需求识别、开发与质量评估。设计统一微分接口，将可复用导数规则与既有数值例程并列暴露，使不同研究任务共享这些能力；以研究需求指导开发，并通过独立导数校验、工作流测试与性能评估对实现进行评测；经验证的软件、研究程序与测试成为后续研究的共享资源。在覆盖物理、化学、生物建模的20个包上构建并验证自动微分扩展。
AI.result: 研究流程在多个任务间展示复用能力；基准测试显示在梯度评估和参数估计上相较有限差分具有计算节省。以研究驱动的修订使此前不受支持的工作流变得可微、修正了科学观测量的导数并消除冗余计算。量子控制与热设计研究依据物理评估修正目标，在复用已有导数的同时改进了设计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种在既有科学软件中扩展可微分编程、并围绕共享计算生态的递归改进来组织AI智能体的实用方法。

title: Understanding Clustering in Slot Attention via Particle Dynamics
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the DynaFront workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Studying attention through the lens of interacting particle dynamics has shown how token clustering can emerge from the underlying dynamics. We extend this perspective to slot attention, a method for object-centric image segmentation and representation learning in which learned components obscure how much of the clustering behaviour is intrinsic to the attention dynamics. We therefore introduce simplified slot attention (SSA), a parameter-free variant whose dynamics are connected to soft $k$-means clustering and which provides a straightforward mechanistic explanation for the emergence of object-centric representations. On the Pascal VOC dataset, SSA achieves performance comparable to that of slot attention, demonstrating that competitive object-centric segmentation can be achieved without learned neural-network components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出简化槽注意力（SSA），一种无参数变体，其动力学与软 k-means 聚类相关，在 Pascal VOC 上取得与槽注意力相当的以对象为中心的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于将注意力理解为相互作用粒子动力学，已有工作表明 token 聚类可从底层动力学中涌现；但槽注意力中可学习组件掩盖了聚类行为的来源，难以判定有多少是注意力动力学内禀的。
AI.method: 方法：提出简化槽注意力（SSA），移除全部可学习神经网络参数，构造其动力学与软 k-means 聚类的联系，从而给出以对象为中心表示涌现的机制性解释。
AI.result: 结果：在 Pascal VOC 数据集上，SSA 的性能与槽注意力相当，说明无需学习神经网络组件即可实现有竞争力的以对象为中心分割。
AI.conclusion: 结论：槽注意力的对象中心分割能力主要源自注意力动力学本身，而非依赖可学习组件，为理解此类模型提供了简洁的机制解释。

title: Learning Coordinated Visuomotor Box-Pushing from Solo Demonstrations
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Multi-robot imitation learning, particularly in settings where visuomotor policies are deployed in a communication-free, onboard decentralised style, represents an attractive paradigm. However, its realisation remains insufficiently understood, largely due to the difficulty of collecting collective demonstrations, since a single operator cannot control many robots simultaneously. Meanwhile, unlike coupled collaborative manipulation, many coordinated tasks achieve system-wide efficiency primarily through minimising inter-robot interference. This structure motivates us to study whether data collected by a teleoperated single-robot can be leveraged for large-scale coordinated box-pushing as a testbed. We systematically investigate dataset creation strategies and lightweight policy architectures. In particular, experiments with up to 40 robots highlight the difficulty of acquiring effective coordination solely through passive observation of other operating robots, revealing a concrete bottleneck for multi-robot research.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究无通信、机载去中心化条件下的多机器人模仿学习，以大规模协同推箱为测试平台，探讨能否利用单机器人遥操作数据驱动多机器人协调，并系统考察数据集构建策略与轻量策略架构。
AI.motivation: 多机器人模仿学习（尤其是无通信、机载去中心化的视觉运动策略）颇具吸引力，但难以落地，核心障碍在于集体演示数据难以采集——单个操作者无法同时控制多台机器人。同时，许多协同任务（不同于紧耦合协同操作）的系统级效率主要来自最小化机器人间干扰，这一结构促使作者探究单机器人遥操作数据能否被复用于大规模协同推箱。
AI.method: 以大规模协同推箱为测试平台，系统研究数据集的构建策略（含对其它作业机器人的被动观测）与轻量级策略架构，并在最多40台机器人的规模下开展实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅依靠对其它运行机器人的被动观测，难以获得有效的协调能力，揭示了多机器人研究中的一个具体瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 单机器人遥操作数据向多机器人协同的迁移存在明显局限；被动观测不足以支撑有效协调，这为后续多机器人模仿学习的数据与算法研究指明了关键问题。

title: Super-Resolution in The Right Latent Space: A Frozen Vision-Foundation Substrate
summary: In an image latent space, the embeddings of high-resolution, natural, and sharp images form a manifold. Degradation of high-resolution images pushes their embeddings off this manifold. Real-world super-resolution (SR) then becomes the task of mapping the degraded embedding back onto this manifold --- not anywhere on the manifold, but to the point that preserves what the input still carries, both its semantics and pixel details. Every published method implements this mapping in a reconstruction-oriented latent space or pixel space. We claim these spaces are the wrong substrates for SR. Low-resolution and degraded images are embedded far from the manifold, making the mapping difficult and expensive. The lack of semantic information in these substrates also makes it difficult to navigate to the faithful point on the manifold, causing severe hallucination when degradation is heavy. Thus, restoring in a suitable latent space is crucial to the SR task. We show that the latent space of 23 fused layers of a frozen DINOv3-L is one such space that makes the SR task easier. Degraded images are embedded near the manifold. Moreover, this substrate contains a hierarchy of information, from pixel record to degradation robust semantics, guiding the model to find the faithful point on the manifold. On this substrate, a 415M decoder is trained under reconstruction and adversarial objectives to map the degraded embeddings back and decode to pixel space in one pass. The resulting model, RAESR, attains the best fidelity--perception trade-off among state-of-the-art adversarial and diffusion-based restorers on RealSR, DRealSR, LSDIR and DIV2K-Val, at 37 ms per 512 by 512 image on a single H20 GPU. Swapping the substrate for a VAE latent under an identical recipe loses on every metric.

AI.tldr: 论文提出真实世界超分辨率（SR）应在合适的潜空间中进行，而非重建导向的潜空间或像素空间。作者发现冻结的DINOv3-L第23层融合特征是一种理想基底：退化图像嵌入靠近高分辨率流形，且包含从像素记录到退化鲁棒语义的层级信息。基于此训练415M解码器得到RAESR，在多个基准上取得最优保真度-感知权衡，单张512×512图像仅需37ms。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像的嵌入在潜空间中构成流形，退化图像嵌入偏离该流形，真实世界SR即将其映射回流形上保留语义与像素细节的忠实点。现有方法均在重建导向的潜空间或像素空间中实现该映射，但作者认为这些空间是错误的基底：低分辨率与退化图像嵌入远离流形导致映射困难且昂贵；这些基底缺乏语义信息，难以导航到流形上的忠实点，退化严重时产生严重幻觉。因此，在合适的潜空间中恢复对SR任务至关重要。
AI.method: 作者指出冻结DINOv3-L的23个融合层的潜空间是理想基底，退化图像嵌入靠近流形，且包含从像素记录到退化鲁棒语义的信息层级，可引导模型找到流形上的忠实点。在该基底上训练一个415M参数解码器，采用重建与对抗目标，将退化嵌入映射回来并一次前向解码到像素空间，形成模型RAESR。作为对照，在相同配方下将基底替换为VAE潜空间。
AI.result: RAESR在RealSR、DRealSR、LSDIR和DIV2K-Val上，于当前最先进的对抗式与扩散式复原器中取得最优的保真度-感知权衡，单张512×512图像在单块H20 GPU上耗时37ms。将基底替换为VAE潜空间后，在相同配方下所有指标均劣于RAESR。
AI.conclusion: 合适的潜空间基底对真实世界SR至关重要。冻结DINOv3-L融合层潜空间因退化嵌入接近流形且富含层级语义信息，使SR任务更易完成；基于该基底的RAESR在保真度-感知权衡上优于现有方法且推理高效。消融表明VAE潜空间作为基底在所有指标上均不如该选择。

title: Strong Helps Weak: Directional Cross-Modal Alignment Transfer in Multi-modal LLMs
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong modality understanding by pairing a large language model (LLM) with an encoder for a target modality such as vision, video, or audio. However, improving an MLLM's capability for a given modality typically requires additional training on large modality-specific datasets, incurring substantial data collection and compute costs. Model merging offers an alternative, but it is often infeasible for data-scarce, large per-sample size, or domain-specific modalities (\textit{e.g.}, audio and video), where same-modality model variants are rarely available. In this work, we characterize an intriguing asymmetric phenomenon: merging a well-aligned, data-rich source-modality MLLM into a data-scarce target-modality MLLM substantially improves the target on its own benchmarks. Our theoretical and empirical analyses show that this gain stems from enhanced alignment between modality-specific and textual tokens, induced by the stronger donor modality. Specifically, we derive a mutual-information lower bound that is monotonic in alignment-related quantities and strongly correlated with downstream MLLM performance. Building on this principle, we propose Directional Cross-modal Alignment Transfer (DCAT), a novel framework that transfers textual alignment from a strong, well-aligned source (donor) modality to a weak target (recipient) modality, boosting target-modality performance without further fine-tuning. We further show that the alignment-enhancing objective admits a closed-form weight-space solution computed from only a small calibration set. DCAT outperforms existing model-merging methods, offering an efficient path toward cross-modal alignment transfer. Project page with code is available at \url{https://seohoiki3215.github.io/DCAT_project_page}

AI.tldr: 提出DCAT框架，通过将数据丰富的源模态MLLM合并进数据稀缺的目标模态MLLM，实现跨模态对齐迁移，无需额外微调即可提升目标模态性能。
AI.motivation: 提升MLLM某模态能力通常需大量该模态专属数据训练，成本高；模型合并虽为替代方案，但对数据稀缺、单样本大或领域特定的模态（如音频、视频）往往不可行，因为缺少同模态模型变体。
AI.method: 发现并刻画一种非对称现象：将良好对齐、数据丰富的源模态MLLM合并进数据稀缺的目标模态MLLM可显著提升目标性能。理论与实证分析表明收益源于源模态诱导的模态token与文本token间对齐增强。推导出与对齐量单调、且与下游性能强相关的互信息下界。据此提出DCAT框架，从强对齐源模态（donor）向弱目标模态（recipient）迁移文本对齐；并证明该对齐增强目标存在闭式权重空间解，仅需小型校准集即可计算。
AI.result: DCAT在性能上优于现有模型合并方法，为跨模态对齐迁移提供高效路径。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态对齐可非对称地迁移：强对齐源模态向弱目标模态的方向性迁移能提升目标模态基准表现，且存在仅依赖小校准集的闭式解，是一种高效、无需微调的模型合并方案。

title: LoRA's Second Descent Extends Beyond Parameter Parity
summary: Double descent has sparked considerable interest, with recent work relating it to the data, the model and the learning configuration. Practical fine-tuning commonly involves training a small adapter on top of frozen pretrained weights, as in low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The adapter's rank is the hyperparameter that sets its capacity, yet how this rank relates to double descent has not been well explored. We quantify this relation under label noise on four vision backbones and a 7B language model with a module-matched rank sweep (MMRS), which extends past full rank and compares every rank with dense fine-tuning of the same modules, paired by seed. On DeiT-Tiny, risk is lowest at rank one and rises sharply as the adapter becomes able to fit the noisy labels, forming an interpolation cliff. Past the peak, risk falls again, but every tested post-peak rank that still saves parameters remains above dense risk. Rank-one LoRA outperforms dense fine-tuning on three of the four vision backbones, consistent with strong regularization at small rank. LoRA thus exhibits a second descent, but matches dense risk only after losing its parameter advantage, first on DeiT-Tiny at four times dense's projection weights. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lora-second-descent-C7B5.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模块匹配秩扫描(MMRS)量化LoRA适配器秩与双下降现象的关系：在标签噪声下，风险随秩先升后降，形成插值悬崖与第二下降，但LoRA只有在失去参数优势后才追平稠密微调风险。
AI.motivation: 双下降现象已受到广泛关注，且已有工作将其与数据、模型和学习配置联系起来。实际微调常采用在冻结预训练权重上训练小型适配器（如LoRA），其中秩是决定容量的关键超参数，但秩与双下降的关系尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出模块匹配秩扫描(MMRS)：在四个视觉骨干网络和一个7B语言模型上，于标签噪声条件下进行秩扫描，扫描范围超越满秩，并将每个秩与相同模块的稠密微调按随机种子配对比较。
AI.result: 在DeiT-Tiny上，风险在秩为1时最低，随适配器开始拟合噪声标签而急剧上升，形成插值悬崖；越过峰值后风险再次下降，但所有仍节省参数的峰值后秩的测试风险均高于稠密风险。秩为1的LoRA在四个视觉骨干中的三个上优于稠密微调，符合小秩强正则化的特性。
AI.conclusion: LoRA确实表现出第二下降，但只有在失去参数优势后才追平稠密风险——在DeiT-Tiny上首次发生在投影权重达到稠密的四倍时。因此LoRA的第二下降存在，但其参数效率优势与下降后的风险表现存在权衡。

title: Dataset-Free Compliant Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Dynamic Online Posture
summary: Most humanoid loco-manipulation controllers require human motion data to learn whole-body coordination and posture, leaving policies reliant on external sources to provide this data. We present OCLO (Online-posture Compliant LOco-manipulation), a humanoid loco-manipulation system trained without human motion data and commanded only through two end-effector targets. Because these targets do not uniquely determine whole-body posture, OCLO generates pelvis height and torso orientation online using an analytic reachability prior, further refined through policy-in-the-loop sampling with a task-agnostic cost. OCLO also learns whole-body compliance by displacing end-effector references according to measured forces through a spring-damper model, encouraging the legs, waist, and pelvis to yield to external loads. In simulation, using the reachability prior leads to a 77.8% success rate in acquiring the commanded reference, a vast improvement over the 37.8% success rate accomplished without the prior. Further, refinement reduces end-effector orientation error across all evaluated tasks. The same posture module improves a pretrained SONIC controller on four of five tasks. Without compliance training, policies tend to lose balance under disturbances rather than sacrifice tracking. On a Unitree G1, OCLO maintains balance under end-effector disturbances that cause its ablations to fail and performs seven loco-manipulation tasks, including crouched walking and picking up a box from a low surface. Project website: https://oclo-humanoid.github.io/

AI.tldr: OCLO 是一种无需人类运动数据、仅由双末端执行器目标指令驱动的类人全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）系统，在线生成骨盆高度与躯干姿态，并学习全身柔顺性。
AI.motivation: 现有类人移动操作控制器大多依赖人类运动数据来学习全身协调与姿态，导致策略必须依赖外部数据源。作者希望摆脱这一依赖，仅用末端执行器目标指令完成训练，但末端目标无法唯一确定全身姿态，因此还需在线解决姿态生成与柔顺性问题。
AI.method: 1）输入仅为两个末端执行器目标，不含人类运动数据；2）利用解析可达性先验（analytic reachability prior）在线生成骨盆高度与躯干朝向；3）通过策略在环采样（policy-in-the-loop sampling）与任务无关代价进行细化；4）基于弹簧-阻尼模型，按实测外力偏移末端参考，学习全身柔顺性，使腿、腰、骨盆顺应外载。
AI.result: 仿真中，使用可达性先验使获取指令参考的成功率达 77.8%，远高于无先验的 37.8%；细化步骤在所有评估任务上均降低末端朝向误差。该姿态模块还在五项任务中的四项上提升了预训练 SONIC 控制器表现。无柔顺训练时策略在扰动下更倾向于失去平衡而非牺牲跟踪精度。在 Unitree G1 真机上，OCLO 能在导致消融版本失败的末端扰动下保持平衡，并完成七项移动操作任务，包括下蹲行走和从低处取箱。
AI.conclusion: 无需人类运动数据即可训练类人移动操作策略，解析可达性先验与在线细化可有效解决末端目标欠约束全身姿态的问题，学习式柔顺性对维持扰动下的平衡至关重要，方法在仿真与真实 G1 平台上均得到验证。

title: Lollypop: Camera-to-Motion-Capture Calibration Verification with a Reference Target
comment: Accepted at IEEE SENSORS 2026. 4 pages, 3 figures
summary: Camera-to-motion-capture (mocap) calibration is essential for using mocap as ground truth in robotics, AR/VR, and other computer vision tasks. However, the calibration can drift after deployment, while calibration residuals and visual inspection provide limited independent verification. We present Lollypop, a fiducial-mocap reference target for independent calibration verification. The target couples an ArUco fiducial with a mocap marker constellation so the visual center and tracked centroid represent the same physical point. Given a candidate calibration, verification projects the mocap point into the image and measures its disagreement with the detected fiducial center. Experiments show sub-pixel nominal error, sensitivity to controlled extrinsic perturbations, and increasing error during an illustrative mixed-handling sequence.

AI.tldr: 提出 Lollypop——一种将 ArUco 基准标记与动捕标记星座耦合的参考目标，可在部署后对相机-动捕标定进行独立验证。
AI.motivation: 相机-动捕标定是机器人、AR/VR 等任务中将动捕作为真值的前提，但部署后标定会发生漂移，而标定残差与人工目视检查的独立验证能力有限。
AI.method: 设计一个基准-动捕参考目标：将 ArUco 标记与动捕标记星座耦合，使视觉中心与被跟踪质心对应同一物理点。给定候选标定后，将动捕点投影到图像并与检测到的基准标记中心比对，测量二者不一致程度。
AI.result: 名义误差达亚像素级；对受控外参扰动具有敏感性；在一段示例性的混合操作序列中误差随操作持续增大。
AI.conclusion: Lollypop 为相机-动捕标定提供了独立、可量化的验证手段，可检测部署后漂移，弥补标定残差和目视检查的不足。

title: Bounds, Decompositions and Null Behaviour of KRATOS: A Mathematical Specification of a Recognition-Comparability Diagnostic
summary: KRATOS is a group-structured bibliometric diagnostic that compares the distribution of documents (participation) with the distribution of citation weight (recognition) over a fixed, finite universe of analytical groups. This note gives its complete mathematical specification and derives the properties that govern its interpretation. Beyond bounds and equality conditions for each component, we show that the recognition-alignment score depends on citation data only through ratios of group mean citation rates to the corpus mean; that the composition ceiling of the participation--recognition factor is an affine function of the total variation distance to the uniform reference; and that the factor itself satisfies Fréchet-type bounds in terms of this ceiling and a participation-weighted recognition score. We establish an exact logarithmic decomposition of the composite index, an ordering between the primary and a reciprocal-symmetric recognition score, invariance properties, and closed-form first and second moments of the recognition ratios under global and stratified permutation nulls. These results explain why composite orderings can be sensitive to small groups, heavy-tailed citation distributions and metadata reassignment. All results are verified numerically with an accompanying script. The specification concerns measurement structure only; it does not define a measure of epistemic change or justice.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了KRATOS群体结构文献计量诊断指标的完整数学规范，并推导了其解释性性质。
AI.motivation: KRATOS通过比较固定分析群体总体中文献的参与分布与引用权重的认可分布来进行诊断，但需要完整的数学规范以支撑其解读。
AI.method: 提供KRATOS的数学规范，并对各成分推导界限与等式条件；分析认可对齐分数、参与-认可因子的构成上限、Fréchet型界限、对数分解、得分排序、不变性以及全局与分层置换零假设下认可比的矩。
AI.result: 认可对齐分数仅通过群体平均引用率与语料均值的比值依赖引用数据；构成上限是与均匀参考的总变差距离的仿射函数；因子满足Fréchet型界限；得到精确对数分解、主分数与对称倒数认可分数的排序、不变性以及闭合形式的前两阶矩。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果解释了为何复合排序对小组、重尾引用分布和元数据重分配敏感；所有结果均通过脚本数值验证；该规范仅涉及测量结构，不定义认知变化或正义的度量。

title: Length Generalization Needs Proper Regularization
summary: Length generalization is the ability of sequential models to perform well on context lengths unseen during training. In this work, we show that the challenge of achieving length generalization is related not only to architectural choices such as positional encoding and the attention mechanism but also to the training procedure itself. We study how regularization affects length generalization and find that weight decay can hinder extrapolation. In contrast, dropout improves extrapolation when its placement within the architecture is reconsidered. In that regard, we show that the standard placement of dropout before layer normalization introduces a systematic distributional mismatch, and that applying dropout just before the linear projection resolves this issue. For example, a modified SmolLM3 with sliding window attention, continually pre-trained with dropout, can extrapolate perfectly to 64$\times$ on Needle-in-a-Haystack and far beyond the pre-training context size on RULER and HELMET. Mamba2 also benefits from dropout, suggesting an architecture-agnostic nature of the problem. We further propose Variance-Preserving Affine Dropout (VPAD), a new dropout strategy that substantially reduces the resulting pre-activation variance mismatch, leading to further extrapolation improvements in transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示长度泛化不仅取决于架构（位置编码、注意力机制），也与训练过程本身相关：权重衰减会损害外推，而dropout在改变放置位置后可改善外推，并据此提出保持方差的仿射dropout（VPAD）。
AI.motivation: 以往对长度泛化的研究多聚焦于架构设计（如位置编码和注意力机制），而忽视了训练过程的作用。作者希望探究正则化手段如何影响模型在训练时未见过的上下文长度上的表现。
AI.method: 1) 系统研究正则化对长度泛化的影响，比较权重衰减与dropout；2) 分析dropout在层归一化（LayerNorm）之前这一标准放置方式所引入的系统性分布失配，提出将dropout置于线性投影之前；3) 提出方差保持仿射dropout（VPAD），以减少激活值（pre-activation）方差失配；4) 在SmolLM3（滑动窗口注意力）、Mamba2等模型上进行持续预训练验证。
AI.result: 权重衰减阻碍外推，而重新安排放置位置的dropout提升外推能力。修改后的SmolLM3在Needle-in-a-Haystack上可完美外推至64倍长度，在RULER和HELMET上远超预训练上下文规模。Mamba2同样受益，表明该问题与架构无关。VPAD进一步降低预激活方差失配，在Transformer上带来额外的外推提升。
AI.conclusion: 长度泛化是一个与架构和训练过程均相关的问题；正则化策略（尤其是dropout的位置与形式）对长度外推至关重要。将dropout移至线性投影前、并采用VPAD可有效缓解分布失配、提升外推性能，且该结论具有跨架构的通用性。

title: Benchmarking Generative Trajectory Models for Active-Inference Control
comment: Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026). 16 pages, including appendix and references; 4 figures. Code: https://github.com/lyeeonardo/generative-trajectory-benchmark
summary: Learning from trajectory demonstrations offers a route to active-inference control of complex systems whose dynamics are difficult to model explicitly. We introduce generative active-inference control (GenAIF), in which one generative trajectory model learns from demonstrations and measured action interventions to supply a goal-conditioned policy distribution and a state-to-observation likelihood mapping. From this control design, we derive three model requirements: (i) useful action proposals, (ii) accurate prediction under imposed actions, and (iii) probabilistic observation evidence for belief updating and expected information gain. We benchmark diffusion, autoregressive Transformers, conditional variational autoencoders (CVAEs), and flow matching in a MuJoCo manipulation task with multiple physical conditions. Diffusion delivers the strongest control across the tested dynamics, while CVAE combines comparable short-horizon prediction with much faster inference. Correct conditioning is decisive, and trajectory reuse offers further computational savings. With the same frozen models, a hidden-dynamics experiment demonstrates prompt belief adaptation after an unannounced tilt change; subsequent instability identifies sustained inference as a remaining challenge. These findings support the use of shared generative trajectory models to connect action proposal, controlled prediction, and observation evidence within GenAIF.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式主动推理控制（GenAIF），用共享生成轨迹模型同时提供目标条件策略与状态-观测似然；在MuJoCo操作任务中对比扩散、自回归Transformer、CVAE与流匹配，扩散控制最优，CVAE推理更快，共享模型可支撑信念更新与自适应。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统动力学难以显式建模，现有主动推理控制通常依赖显式动力学模型；希望借助轨迹演示学习一个生成式轨迹模型，替代显式建模来支撑主动推理控制。
AI.method: 提出GenAIF：单一生成轨迹模型从演示与动作干预数据中学习，同时输出目标条件策略分布和状态到观测的似然映射；据此推导三项模型要求（有用动作提议、给定动作下准确预测、用于信念更新与期望信息增益的概率观测证据）；在含多种物理条件的MuJoCo操作任务上基准测试扩散、自回归Transformer、CVAE与流匹配。
AI.result: 扩散模型在测试动力学下控制性能最强；CVAE在短时域预测相当的前提下推理速度显著更快。正确的条件化至关重要，轨迹复用可进一步节省计算。冻结模型在未预告倾斜变化实验中表现出提示后的信念自适应，但随后出现不稳定，表明持续推理仍是挑战。
AI.conclusion: 共享生成轨迹模型可统一动作提议、受控预测与观测证据，支撑GenAIF框架；扩散与CVAE各有优势，持续推理下的稳定性是未来关键问题。

authors: André C. P. L. F. de Carvalho
title: Active-DiNTS: Active Differentiable Network Topology Search
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Extends material from the first author's PhD thesis (University of Sao Paulo / La Rochelle Universite, 2024)
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has proved to be a strong alternative to manual network design, but applying it to 3D medical image segmentation is limited by two well-known costs, large annotation budgets and multi-GPU clusters. Thus, this paper introduces Active-DiNTS (Active Differentiable Network Topology Search), an approach that embeds pool-based Active Learning (AL) into a bi-level differentiable topology search to perform architecture discovery and label curation jointly. At each query round, unlabeled MRI volumes are ranked by one of three uncertainty signals (Entropy, Variance, or Standard Deviation), and only the top-ranked volumes are sent to an oracle for annotation. The new labels feed two interlocked stages. Network weights are updated in an outer loop, while the macro/micro topology of a U-Net-style backbone is refined in an inner loop. Three AL regimes (weights-only, topology-only, joint) expose the speed-accuracy trade-off. Evaluations on the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) Task01 BrainTumour benchmark showed that Active-DiNTS surpasses DiNTS, C2FNAS, and nnU-Net in Dice, with gains of about 10 percentage points on Edema and 5 points on Non-Enhancing core, on a single GPU and using a fraction of the labeled volumes. The discovered architectures are denser and more FLOP-heavy than prior baselines, but remain competitive in trainable parameters and peak memory; the fastest search variant finishes in under 0.25 GPU-days, over 27x faster than the eight-GPU DiNTS search. Together, these results indicate that pairing differentiable NAS with active data acquisition is a practical recipe for accurate 3D segmentation under realistic constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Active-DiNTS，将基于池的主动学习嵌入双层可微拓扑搜索，在单GPU、少量标注条件下联合进行3D医学图像分割的架构发现与标签筛选，性能超过DiNTS、C2FNAS与nnU-Net。
AI.motivation: NAS在3D医学图像分割中受限于两大成本：庞大的标注预算与多GPU集群需求。论文旨在降低标注量并减少算力依赖，使架构搜索在现实约束下可行。
AI.method: 将基于池的主动学习嵌入双层可微拓扑搜索框架。每轮查询用三种不确定性信号（熵、方差、标准差）对未标注MRI体数据进行排序，仅将排名靠前的体数据送交标注。新标签驱动两个互锁阶段：外循环更新网络权重，内循环细化U-Net式主干的宏/微观拓扑。设置三种主动学习模式（仅权重、仅拓扑、联合）以体现速度—精度权衡。
AI.result: 在MSD Task01脑肿瘤基准上，Dice超过DiNTS、C2FNAS与nnU-Net；Edema约提升10个百分点，Non-Enhancing core提升约5个百分点；仅用单GPU和部分标注量。搜索到的架构更稠密、FLOP更高，但可训练参数与峰值内存仍有竞争力；最快搜索变体在0.25 GPU-day内完成，比八GPU的DiNTS快27倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 将可微NAS与主动数据获取相结合，是在现实约束下实现高精度3D分割的实用方案。

title: LatentIndex: Cross-Layer Sharing with Layer-Specific Selection for Sparse Attention
summary: Sparse attention reduces core-attention computation, but its indexers still incur repeated selection work and per-layer key-cache storage. Reusing selected indices across layers reduces this overhead but constrains multiple layers to the same token set. We introduce LatentIndex, which extends the latent-sharing principle of Multi-head Latent Attention across indexer layers. Each layer group constructs a shared latent cache from its first layer's hidden states, while layer-specific scoring enables independent token selection. Absorbing key decoders into queries enables direct scoring of the shared cache without reconstructing historical per-layer keys. We develop training-free calibration and investigate a training-aware instantiation of this principle. To balance quality and computation, a hierarchical selection (HS) variant lets followers independently refine a shared candidate set proposed by the anchor. With four-layer sharing, LatentIndex reduces logical indexer-cache storage by 61.1% on DeepSeek-V3.2. Across DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, training-free LatentIndex improves head-wise attention-mass recall over IndexCache by up to 3.28 percentage points while maintaining RULER and LongBench performance close to native DSA. HS further achieves 2.30-2.72 times decode indexer speedups over DSA across 8K-128K contexts, retaining most of LatentIndex's recall. LatentIndex offers a new perspective on cross-layer indexing: sharing continuous representations rather than discrete selections enables efficient reuse while preserving layer-specific token selection.

AI.tldr: LatentIndex 将 MLA 的潜在共享思想扩展到稀疏注意力的 indexer 层，通过共享潜在缓存与层特定打分实现跨层索引复用，在保持精度的同时显著降低缓存开销与解码延迟。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽降低了核心注意力计算量，但各层的 indexer 仍存在重复的选择计算与逐层 key-cache 存储开销。已有跨层复用所选索引的方案会将多层限制为同一 token 集合，损害灵活性，因此需要一种既能复用又能保留层特定 token 选择的方法。
AI.method: 提出 LatentIndex，把 Multi-head Latent Attention 的潜在共享原则扩展到 indexer 层：每个层组基于首层隐藏状态构建共享潜在缓存，各层通过层特定打分独立选择 token；将 key decoder 吸收进 query，从而直接对共享缓存打分而无需重建历史逐层 key。方法包含免训练校准与一种训练感知实例化；并提出分层选择（HS）变体，由锚层提出共享候选集、后续层独立精炼，以平衡质量与计算。
AI.result: 四层共享设置下，LatentIndex 在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上将逻辑 indexer-cache 存储降低 61.1%。在 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5 上，免训练 LatentIndex 相比 IndexCache 将 head-wise attention-mass recall 提升最多 3.28 个百分点，同时 RULER 与 LongBench 性能接近原生 DSA。HS 变体在 8K–128K 上下文下相对 DSA 实现 2.30–2.72 倍解码 indexer 加速，并保留 LatentIndex 的大部分 recall。
AI.conclusion: LatentIndex 为跨层索引提供了新视角：共享连续表示而非离散选择，可在保持层特定 token 选择的同时实现高效复用。

title: Proximal Causal Learning under Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Estimating treatment effects from observational data typically relies on the No Unmeasured Confounding Assumption (NUCA), which rarely holds in practice. Proximal causal learning (PCL) addresses unmeasured confounding via proxy variables, yet existing methods require the proxy variables to be pre-specified. Thus, we propose PCL-U, a framework that learns proxy variables directly from observed covariates. PCL-U uses neural encoders to decompose covariates into treatment-inducing, outcome-inducing, and shared proxies, guided by minimax mutual information objectives, and obtains causal estimates through a practical moment-based risk function. Experiments on benchmarks show that PCL-U matches or outperforms existing baselines. Besides, there are two types of synthetic datasets with varying dimensions and confounding strengths that illustrate that our method maintains stable estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出PCL-U框架，从观测协变量中自动学习代理变量以估计因果效应，缓解未测量混杂假设难以满足的问题，并在基准与合成数据上匹配或优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计处理效应通常依赖"无未测量混杂假设"(NUCA)，该假设在现实中很少成立。近端因果学习(PCL)借助代理变量处理未测量混杂，但现有方法要求代理变量预先指定，限制了实用性。
AI.method: PCL-U使用神经编码器将协变量分解为三类代理："诱导处理的代理"、"诱导结果的代理"以及"共享代理"；通过极小极大互信息(minimax MI)目标进行引导学习；并借助实用的矩条件风险函数(moment-based risk function)获得因果效应估计。实验包含基准数据集以及两类不同维度和混杂强度的合成数据集。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，PCL-U匹配或优于现有基线方法；在两类不同维度与混杂强度的合成数据集上，方法保持稳定的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: PCL-U能够直接从观测协变量中学习代理变量，免去人工预指定代理的需求，为存在未测量混杂的因果效应估计提供了可行且稳健的方案。

title: Virtual model control for compliant reaching under uncertainties
summary: Virtual Model Control (VMC) is an approach to design a controller for force-controlled robots in complex uncertain environments. While this method was primarily investigated for legged robot locomotion in the past, it can be more generally applicable to other types of robotic systems. This paper investigates the VMC framework for reaching tasks in a force-controlled robotic arm. We propose six different approaches to designing virtual models in order to achieve reaching tasks in environments with obstacles and uncertainties. A force-controlled 8 degree-of-freedom humanoid robot was used to validate the proposed approach in the real world. We conducted three experiments to test the performance of VMC controllers in terms of predictability, sensitivity to external force, and adaptability against known and unknown obstacles. Experimental analyses show that, even though the proposed approach needs to sacrifice accuracy and trajectory optimality, it enables us to design complex reaching motions under uncertainties, in an intuitive and extendable manner.

AI.tldr: 本文将虚拟模型控制(VMC)框架从传统的腿式机器人运动扩展到力控机械臂的到达任务，提出六种虚拟模型设计方法，并在8自由度人形机器人上完成真实世界验证。
AI.motivation: VMC此前主要用于腿式机器人运动控制，其是否可推广至其他力控机器人系统（如机械臂到达任务）尚缺乏研究，尤其是在存在障碍物与环境不确定性时如何直观、可扩展地设计控制器。
AI.method: 提出VMC框架用于力控机械臂到达任务，设计六种不同的虚拟模型方案；使用力控8自由度人形机器人在真实环境中开展三组实验，分别评估控制器的可预测性、对外部力的敏感性，以及对已知和未知障碍物的适应性。
AI.result: 实验表明所提VMC控制器在障碍物与不确定性环境下能够完成复杂到达动作，具有良好的可预测性与适应性；但需牺牲一定的精度和轨迹最优性。
AI.conclusion: VMC可推广至力控机械臂的到达任务，为不确定性环境下的复杂运动设计提供了一种直观且易于扩展的方法，尽管以精度与轨迹最优性为代价。

title: MOXIE: Discovering Alternative Explanations for Biomedical Image Classifiers
summary: Segment-based explanation methods such as LIME return a single explanation for each prediction, computed from one fixed image segmentation. This hides two important facts: a prediction can be supported by many different sets of image segments, and the segmentation itself shapes which explanations can be found. We introduce MOXIE (Multi-Objective eXplanation Imaging Engine), an evolutionary framework that searches for segment subsets that preserve the classifier's confidence while keeping as little of the image as possible. Instead of one explanation, MOXIE returns a Pareto front of alternative explanations that range from compact to highly faithful. We evaluate MOXIE with NSGA-II and four segmentation methods (SLIC, Felzenszwalb, Watershed and Voronoi) on BloodMNIST and HAM10000 datasets, using the same evaluation budget as LIME. Results show that MOXIE achieves a higher hypervolume than LIME on every image. LIME's explanations often appear convincing, yet the classifier's confidence collapses when only the highlighted segments are shown. MOXIE's fronts reveal how much of the image is needed to preserve the model's confidence and which contextual regions influence it. We also find that segmentation strongly affects evaluation: methods with unequal segment sizes appear most compact when segments are counted. These results show that alternative explanations provide a more complete view of a model's decision than a single explanation.

AI.tldr: 提出MOXIE进化框架，用多目标搜索替代单次分割解释，输出Pareto前沿式的多组替代解释。
AI.motivation: LIME等基于分割的解释方法对每个预测只返回单一解释，且依赖固定分割。这掩盖了两个事实：同一预测可由多组不同片段支持；分割方式本身决定了能发现何种解释。因此需要能同时权衡紧凑性与保真度、并揭示分割敏感性的多解释框架。
AI.method: MOXIE（Multi-Objective eXplanation Imaging Engine）：进化算法框架，搜索既保留分类器置信度又尽量少用图像的片段子集。采用NSGA-II，并结合SLIC、Felzenszwalb、Watershed、Voronoi四种分割方法，在BloodMNIST与HAM10000数据集上，以与LIME相同的评估预算运行，输出从紧凑到高保真的Pareto前沿解释集合。
AI.result: MOXIE在每张图像上的hypervolume均高于LIME。LIME解释看似可信，但仅显示高亮片段时分类器置信度崩溃；MOXIE的前沿揭示了维持模型置信度所需图像比例及起作用的上下文区域。分割方式显著影响评估：按片段计数时，片段大小不均的方法显得最紧凑。
AI.conclusion: 替代解释集合比单一解释更完整地刻画模型决策，并表明分割选择是解释评估中的重要混淆因素。

title: SEIS: Self-Evolving Inference Systems
summary: Inference systems determine how fast and how cheaply language models can be served, so making them faster has direct practical value. However, prior work focuses mostly on optimizing certain parts such as kernels or memory within the large system. In this work, we take a holistic approach and apply agentic self-evolution to optimize the whole system end-to-end. Our SEIS (Self-Evolving Inference Systems) autonomously optimizes the entire mini-sglang engine without human intervention through iterative sessions with inherited experiences and code changes. Serving Qwen3-0.6B on H100, the resulting engine reaches 3.27X the throughput of the original mini-sglang implementation and beats SOTA engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and SGLang in the single-request workload. The correctness of the optimized inference engine by SEIS is tested in terms of numerical difference and downstream accuracy on math and long-context retrieval tasks. The code and session histories show that the speedup comes from redesigning the whole engine and that building on earlier sessions beats independent attempts. These results suggest that agentic self-evolution can optimize a complex system end-to-end. The evaluation also has to evolve with the engine, and letting agents evolve it is a natural next step.

AI.tldr: 提出SEIS（自演化推理系统），用智能体自演化对整个推理引擎做端到端优化。在H100上服务Qwen3-0.6B时，吞吐达原始mini-sglang的3.27倍，单请求场景优于vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、SGLang，并通过数值差异与下游精度测试验证正确性。
AI.motivation: 推理系统的速度直接影响语言模型服务的成本与效率，具有实用价值。但既有工作多聚焦于系统中局部组件的优化（如kernel、内存），缺乏对整体系统的端到端优化视角。
AI.method: 采用整体性（holistic）方法，将智能体自演化（agentic self-evolution）应用于整个系统优化。SEIS无需人工干预，通过带继承经验的迭代会话与代码修改，自主优化完整的mini-sglang引擎，从而端到端重塑整个引擎。
AI.result: 在H100上服务Qwen3-0.6B，所得引擎吞吐为原始mini-sglang实现的3.27倍，单请求负载下超越vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、SGLang等SOTA引擎。正确性通过数值差异及数学、长上下文检索任务的下游精度测试。代码与会话历史显示加速源于整体引擎重设计，且基于早期会话优于独立尝试。
AI.conclusion: 智能体自演化能够对复杂系统进行端到端优化；评估方式也需随引擎演化，让智能体自动演化评估是自然的下一步。

title: Weight Decay and Neuron Condensation: A Three-Stage Analysis of Two-Layer ReLU Networks
summary: Weight decay is widely used as a regularization technique in neural network training, yet its role in neuron condensation (parameter direction alignment) remains unclear. Starting from a parameter initialization in the neural tangent kernel regime, we characterize training dynamics under weight decay through three stages: rapid fitting, amplitude compression, and neuron condensation. Using a two-layer ReLU network, we analyze a residual correlation field that governs both neuron amplitudes and directions. During rapid fitting, the residual approaches a quasi-static equilibrium maintained by weight decay while the tangent kernel remains nearly unchanged. In the early stage of amplitude compression, kernel decay amplifies the residual correlation field, whose isolated attracting extrema provide candidates for condensation directions. As neuron amplitudes stabilize, we bound the drift of attracting extrema and demonstrate contraction of neuron directions around them, leading to neuron condensation. This staged analysis provides a dynamical understanding of how weight decay promotes a condensed representation, beyond reducing parameter norms.

AI.tldr: 该论文在神经正切核(NTK)机制下刻画权重衰减训练动力学的三个阶段，揭示其如何通过残差相关场驱动神经元方向对齐(凝聚)的动力学机制。
AI.motivation: 权重衰减虽广泛用作正则化手段，但其对"神经元凝聚"(参数方向对齐)的作用尚不清晰，需要从动力学角度给出理论解释。
AI.method: 从NTK机制下的参数初始化出发，用两层ReLU网络分析支配神经元幅度与方向的"残差相关场"，将训练动力学划分为快速拟合、幅度压缩、神经元凝聚三个阶段进行分析。
AI.result: 快速拟合阶段残差趋于由权重衰减维持的准静态平衡而核近似不变；幅度压缩早期核衰减放大残差相关场，其孤立吸引极值成为凝聚方向候选；幅度稳定后可界定吸引极值漂移，并证明神经元方向向其收缩，形成凝聚。
AI.conclusion: 该分阶段分析从动力学上说明了权重衰减如何促成凝聚表示，其作用超出单纯减小参数范数。

title: When to Switch: Reliable Action-Chunk Extension for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models serve as unified policies for robotic manipulation, yet their expensive inference forces robots to pause between policy calls, resulting in stop-and-go execution that interrupts smooth motion and prolongs task completion. Extending the action chunk reduces policy calls and hence these pauses, but predicting farther into the future makes long-chunk execution unreliable. To understand where this unreliability arises, we analyze action errors within long chunks and find that they concentrate around transitions between manipulation subskills, growing sharply with chunk length. This suggests the importance of transition timing, i.e., when to switch subskills within a chunk. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RACE (Reliable Action-Chunk Extension), a framework that predicts the transition timing from an auxiliary one-step denoising pass and conditions action generation on it. By learning and conditioning on transition timing, RACE reduces errors at subskill transitions and enables reliable execution of longer action chunks. Across simulation benchmarks, RACE outperforms fine-tuning at the same chunk length; with 2x longer chunks, it surpasses recent state-of-the-art and efficient VLAs in success rate, and with 4x longer chunks, it remains competitive. On a real robot, RACE uses 4x longer chunks, which reduces the idle time caused by stop-and-go execution by about 5x, while achieving a higher success rate than fine-tuning with the same chunk length. Code and a real-robot demo are available at https://github.com/Seonghoon-Yu/RACE-VLA

AI.tldr: 提出RACE框架，通过预测并条件化"子技能切换时刻"来实现长动作块可靠执行，减少VLA模型推理暂停带来的停顿并提升成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型推理开销大，导致机器人在策略调用间停顿，形成停走式执行，破坏动作平滑性并延长任务完成时间。延长动作块可减少调用次数，但长块预测的远端动作不可靠。作者发现长块误差集中在操作子技能之间的转换处，并随块长急剧增大，说明子技能切换的时机（transition timing）是关键。
AI.method: RACE通过一次辅助的一步去噪（one-step denoising）过程预测子技能切换时刻，并将该时序信息作为条件注入动作生成，使模型学习并条件化于transition timing，从而降低子技能转换处的误差。
AI.result: 仿真基准上，同块长下RACE优于微调；2倍块长时成功率超过近期SOTA与高效VLA；4倍块长时仍具竞争力。真机上用4倍长块，将停走式执行的空闲时间减少约5倍，且成功率高于同块长微调。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并条件化子技能切换时刻可有效缓解长动作块的误差累积，实现更长动作块的可靠执行，减少推理停顿并提升任务成功率，代码与真机演示已开源。

title: DriftSR: One-Step Real-World Image Super-Resolution via Distribution Drifting
summary: One-step real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) offers efficient inference, but recovering realistic and perceptually rich details often relies on score distillation or adversarial learning, introducing additional trainable components and making optimization more cumbersome. To this end, we propose DriftSR, a one-step Real-ISR framework that leverages pretrained diffusion priors through distribution drifting. Specifically, we perform drifting in the frozen intermediate representation space of a pretrained diffusion model, without introducing an additional task-specific feature encoder. Building on this space, we introduce Spatial Feature Drifting, which treats spatial features rather than entire images as distributional samples, enabling denser supervision for distribution alignment. To mitigate structural deviations, we further introduce Structure-Modulated Guidance, which adaptively refines drifting guidance according to local structural consistency with the LQ input. Consequently, DriftSR optimizes only the one-step generator, without auxiliary distillation branches or adversarial discriminators. Extensive experiments on three real-world benchmarks demonstrate that DriftSR delivers high-quality super-resolution reconstruction with efficient one-step inference.

AI.tldr: DriftSR是一种单步真实世界图像超分辨率框架，通过在预训练扩散模型的冻结中间表征空间中执行分布漂移来利用扩散先验，仅优化单步生成器，无需蒸馏分支或对抗判别器。
AI.motivation: 单步Real-ISR推理高效，但恢复真实且感知丰富的细节通常依赖分数蒸馏或对抗学习，这引入额外可训练组件并使优化变得繁琐。作者希望在不增加辅助模块的前提下利用预训练扩散先验。
AI.method: 提出DriftSR，在冻结扩散模型的中间表征空间进行分布漂移，无需额外任务特定特征编码器。具体包括：空间特征漂移（Spatial Feature Drifting），将空间特征而非整幅图像作为分布样本，实现更密集的分布对齐监督；结构调制引导（Structure-Modulated Guidance），依据与LQ输入的局部结构一致性自适应精炼漂移引导，缓解结构偏差。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，DriftSR能实现高质量超分辨率重建，并保持高效的单步推理。
AI.conclusion: DriftSR仅优化单步生成器，无需辅助蒸馏分支或对抗判别器，即可借助预训练扩散先验实现高效且高质量的单步真实世界图像超分辨率。

title: PermVLA: Factorization Order as a Regularizer for VLA Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly learn action chunks through a fixed left-to-right (LTR) factorization, although the same expert trajectory distribution admits many valid chain-rule factorizations. We identify factorization order as an overlooked regularization choice and introduce causally anchored permutation (CAP), which samples action reveal orders with a tunable chronological prefix. Its auxiliary objective trains one shared policy to predict actions from different known subsets of the same expert chunk, while deployment retains deterministic LTR control. We call this conditional-set augmentation: it creates multiple conditional prediction problems from one expert chunk without adding demonstrations. This discourages reliance on the single chronological prefix used by ordinary teacher forcing. Controlled experiments show that CAP consistently outperforms standard LTR training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the same advantage appearing in cross-dataset CALVIN evaluation. A diagnostic that measures the expected squared difference between a chunk's joint log likelihood under two reveal orders verifies that CAP training internalizes agreement across reveal orders. These findings position sampled subset-conditioned auxiliary objectives as a general recipe for constructing VLA regularizers, illustrated by an extension to diffusion action generators.

AI.tldr: 本文指出VLA策略普遍采用固定的从左到右（LTR）动作块分解方式，并提出因果锚定置换（CAP）：以可调的时间前缀采样动作揭示顺序，通过条件集合增强的辅助目标让共享策略学习从不同已知子集预测动作，而部署时仍保持确定性LTR控制，从而获得一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 同一专家轨迹分布可支持多种链式法则分解，但现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略固定使用从左到右（LTR）分解来学习动作块。作者将分解顺序视为被忽视的正则化选择，旨在缓解普通teacher forcing对单一时间前缀的依赖。
AI.method: 提出因果锚定置换（CAP）：采样动作揭示顺序并保留可调的时间前缀；设计辅助目标，让一个共享策略从同一专家动作块的不同已知子集中预测动作，形成条件集合增强，在不增加示范数据的情况下构造多个条件预测问题。部署阶段仍使用确定性LTR控制。文中还给出一个诊断指标，度量同一动作块在两种揭示顺序下联合对数似然的期望平方差，并扩展到扩散动作生成器。
AI.result: 在LIBERO与LIBERO-Plus上，CAP持续优于标准LTR训练；在跨数据集CALVIN评估中同样表现出优势。诊断指标验证CAP训练使模型内化不同揭示顺序之间的一致性。扩展实验表明该方法可用于扩散动作生成器。
AI.conclusion: 采样到的子集条件辅助目标可作为构建VLA正则化器的一般性配方；分解顺序是与LTR不同的有效正则化选择，CAP通过条件集合增强提升策略泛化与一致性，并具备向其他动作生成范式推广的潜力。

title: PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints
summary: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PHASEGATE，将 LLM 推理阶段（prefill/decode）作为 CPU 检索任务准入信号，为两阶段分别标定并发上限，从而在统一内存设备上兼顾检索吞吐与 LLM 延迟。
AI.motivation: 端侧助手在统一内存系统上同时运行 GPU 端 LLM 推理与 CPU 端检索。饱和的本地检索负载会显著抬升 LLM 解码延迟（p95 增加 60-61%），而 prefill 延迟影响较小（5.7-6.9%），说明不同推理阶段对检索干扰的敏感度差异大，需要更细粒度的准入控制。
AI.method: 将 LLM 阶段作为独立 CPU 检索的准入信号。PHASEGATE 分别标定 prefill 与 decode 的并发上限（在 base-M4 上取 4 和 1）。设置阶段盲的对照方法 TimeGate，使用相同的两个并发上限但不观测 LLM 阶段，仅依据标定得到的调度表执行。
AI.result: 在积压队列下，PHASEGATE 达到最佳可行固定策略聚合检索吞吐的 2.0 倍，且在全部 7 次留出运行中两项 p95 LLM 延迟指标均控制在无检索基线的 1.25 倍以内。TimeGate 吞吐相近，但每次运行都违反输出 token 延迟限制。M2 与 M2 Pro Mac mini 复现了策略排序；输出长度扫描显示，随着 decode 占比上升，PHASEGATE 的优势收窄。
AI.conclusion: LLM 推理阶段是有效的 CPU 检索准入信号；阶段感知的并发控制可同时提升检索吞吐并满足延迟约束，而阶段盲调度难以稳定满足输出 token 延迟限制，且该优势在 decode 主导的负载下减弱。

authors: Tommaso Van Der Meer Andrea Garulli
title: End-to-End Safe Social Navigation via Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning and Probabilistic Perception
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026
summary: Autonomous social navigation requires balancing efficiency, physical safety, and social compliance. Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods provide a viable and effective solution but often rely on unrealistic assumptions, such as the knowledge of humans' position and velocity. In this paper, we introduce JESSI (JAX-based E2E Safe Social Interpretable navigation), a lightweight end-to-end RL framework that maps raw LiDAR scans directly to kinematically feasible control commands. JESSI enhances safety via Dirichlet-parameterized continuous action spaces and deterministic bounding, while an integrated attention-based perception module extracts probabilistic human states for interpretable, socially aware decision-making. Through extensive simulations and real-world deployment on a differential-drive robot, we demonstrate that jointly optimizing the RL policy with a supervised perception signal in a multi-task paradigm enhances social behavior. Ultimately, JESSI is able to balance high navigation success rates and superior social behaviors compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出JESSI，一种轻量级端到端RL社交导航框架，直接将原始LiDAR扫描映射为运动学可行控制指令，无需依赖人类位置与速度的先验知识。通过Dirichlet参数化连续动作空间与确定性边界提升安全性，并集成注意力感知模块提取概率性人类状态以实现可解释的社交决策。仿真与真机实验表明，多任务范式下联合优化RL策略与监督感知信号可增强社交行为，在成功率与社交性能上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 自主社交导航需在效率、物理安全与社交合规之间取得平衡。强化学习方法虽有成效，但普遍依赖不切实际的假设，例如已知人类的位置和速度。本文旨在消除这一假设，直接从原始LiDAR数据实现端到端的安全且可解释的社交导航。
AI.method: JESSI是一个基于JAX的轻量级端到端RL框架。输入为原始LiDAR扫描，输出为运动学可行的控制指令。安全方面采用Dirichlet参数化的连续动作空间与确定性边界约束；感知方面集成基于注意力的感知模块，提取概率性人类状态，用于可解释且具社交意识的决策。训练上采用多任务范式，将RL策略与监督感知信号联合优化。
AI.result: 通过大量仿真及在差速驱动机器人上的真实部署验证：与RL策略联合优化的监督感知信号在多任务范式下能增强社交行为；JESSI在高导航成功率与优异社交行为之间取得平衡，整体优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: JESSI证明了无需人类状态先验知识、仅凭原始LiDAR即可实现兼顾效率、安全与社交合规的端到端导航，多任务联合优化感知与策略是提升社交行为的关键，具备实际部署可行性。

title: RSure-Agent: Reliable Use of Tool Observations for Remote Sensing Agents
comment: The demo is available at https://github.com/airs101/RSure-Agent (code will be released for further research)
summary: Remote sensing agents rely on perception, measurement, and raster analysis tools to solve Earth observation tasks. We refer to their judgments and quantitative results about ground objects as tool observations. However, these observations are subject to substantial uncertainty and may be incorrect even when the tools execute successfully. When agents accept incorrect observations, the errors can propagate through subsequent reasoning and cause task failure. We analyze 1,229 execution trajectories across three remote sensing agent benchmarks. On each benchmark, at least 88.1% of tasks depend on tool observations. Among these tasks, at least 22.7% contain incorrect observations despite successful tool execution. These errors propagate to the final answer in at least 82.0% of affected tasks on each benchmark. To address this problem, we propose RSure-Agent, a framework for verifying tool observations and limiting error propagation. We introduce a verifiable observation protocol that requires tools to return process evidence for the agent to verify their observations. We also construct a task-tool reliability prior from offline task feedback. The prior summarizes each tool configuration's past performance across task types and provides a task-specific reference for verification. Using process evidence and this prior, RSure-Agent decides whether to accept an observation, request additional evidence, or reject it. We evaluate RSure-Agent on EarthBench, ThinkGeo, TerraLogic, and CHOICE-420. Across the three agent benchmarks, RSure-Agent reduces the error propagation rate by 21.3 to 25.9 percentage points relative to the base configuration with verification and the prior disabled. On CHOICE-420, it improves overall accuracy over direct answering by 5.71 percentage points on average across 11 backbone models. On EarthBench, it reduces the tool-call ratio by 25.9% relative to Earth-Agent.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析遥感智能体工具观测的可信性问题，并提出RSure-Agent框架，通过可验证观测协议与任务-工具可靠性先验来验证观测、抑制错误传播，在多个基准上显著降低错误传播率并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 遥感智能体依赖感知、测量与栅格分析工具完成地球观测任务，但其对地物做出的判断与定量结果（即工具观测）存在较大不确定性，即使工具成功执行也可能出错。若智能体接受错误观测，错误会沿后续推理传播并导致任务失败。作者通过分析1,229条执行轨迹发现：各基准中至少88.1%的任务依赖工具观测，其中至少22.7%的任务包含错误观测，且这些错误在至少82.0%的受影响任务中传播到最终答案，因此亟需验证工具观测并限制错误传播。
AI.method: 提出RSure-Agent框架，包含两部分：(1) 可验证观测协议，要求工具返回过程证据，供智能体核验观测；(2) 从离线任务反馈中构建任务-工具可靠性先验，汇总各工具配置在各类任务上的历史表现，为验证提供任务相关参考。基于过程证据与先验，RSure-Agent决定接受观测、请求补充证据或拒绝该观测。
AI.result: 在EarthBench、ThinkGeo、TerraLogic和CHOICE-420上评测。在三个智能体基准上，相较禁用验证与先验的基础配置，RSure-Agent将错误传播率降低21.3至25.9个百分点。在CHOICE-420上，11个骨干模型平均准确率较直接回答提升5.71个百分点。在EarthBench上，相较Earth-Agent工具调用比例降低25.9%。
AI.conclusion: 工具观测的可信性是遥感智能体的关键瓶颈，错误观测普遍存在且易传播至最终答案；RSure-Agent通过可验证观测协议与任务-工具可靠性先验有效验证观测并抑制错误传播，在多个基准上均取得一致改进，同时减少不必要的工具调用。

title: Efficient Neural Surrogates for Linear Radiation Transport on the Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks
summary: Linear radiation transport equations (RTEs) form the simulation foundations underpinning design and analysis tasks in nuclear engineering, inertial confinement fusion, medical imaging, and astrophysics, but resolving the high-dimensional phase space at engineering fidelity remains expensive enough that outer-loop workflows, such as design optimization, uncertainty quantification, and parameter sweeps, are routinely budget-bound on traditional solvers. Neural surrogates promise to relax this bottleneck by amortizing simulation cost across thousands of downstream queries, but the architectural choices and engineered inductive biases that make a surrogate accurate on one transport problem do not transfer straightforwardly across model families. We benchmark two parameter-matched neural surrogate architectures, the physics-attention Transolver and the multi-scale graph network Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet (BSMS-MGN), as end-to-end approximations of the final-time particle concentration for the two-dimensional linear RTE on the canonical Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks. An ablation across Fourier features and region-weighted training loss exposes strongly architecture-dependent inductive-bias preferences, indicating that design choices common to physics-informed surrogate workflows must be revisited per architecture rather than imported across model families, and that downstream utility depends on per-QoI sensitivity rather than a single field-level score. The model training recipe, training data, and evaluation pipeline are released alongside this paper to support reproduction, transfer to related transport problems, and evaluation as amortized forward-model components in larger outer-loop simulation workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文对两种参数对齐的神经代理架构（物理注意力Transolver与多尺度图网络BSMS-MGN）在二维线性辐射输运方程（RTE）的Lattice与Hohlraum基准上进行了端到端基准测试。
AI.motivation: 线性辐射输运方程（RTE）是高维相空间问题，工程精度下的求解成本高昂，使得设计优化、不确定性量化、参数扫描等外环工作流受制于传统求解器的计算预算。神经代理可通过摊销仿真成本来突破该瓶颈，但适用于某一输运问题的架构选择与归纳偏置难以跨模型族迁移。
AI.method: 以二维线性RTE的最终时刻粒子浓度为预测目标，在标准Lattice和Hohlraum基准上，对两种参数对齐的神经代理架构——物理注意力模型Transolver与多尺度图网络BSMS-MGN——进行端到端近似基准测试；同时开展消融实验，考察傅里叶特征与区域加权训练损失的影响。并发布训练方案、训练数据与评测流程。
AI.result: 消融实验揭示了强烈依赖架构的归纳偏置偏好：傅里叶特征和区域加权损失的效应因架构而异，说明物理信息代理工作流中常见的通用设计选择不能跨模型族直接照搬，须针对每种架构重新审视；下游实用性取决于针对具体关注量（QoI）的敏感性，而非单一的全场级评分。
AI.conclusion: 神经代理架构的归纳偏置偏好在模型族间不可迁移，设计选择需按架构重新评估；评估应以逐QoI敏感性为准。发布的训练配方、数据与评测流程支持复现、迁移至相关输运问题，并可作为摊销前向模型组件嵌入更大的外环仿真工作流。

title: TMAML: Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Time Series Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at Neurips 2026 TS-LIMITS Workshop
summary: Cold-start forecasting, the task of forecasting a time series with little to no historical data, is a common challenge. Addressing it requires approaches that learn quickly from few datapoints and leverage information from related series, typically through static covariates, to generalize well to unseen series. While some global forecasting models can generate cold-start predictions by leveraging information shared across multiple series, they are not optimized for out-of-train-set generalization or adaptation from short histories. In this work, we formulate cold-start forecasting as a few-window learning problem and introduce Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (TMAML), which tailors the model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm, originally developed for few-shot adaptation of neural networks, to deep time series forecasting. TMAML constructs meta-tasks as temporally consistent support-query windows and pairs them with a temporal meta-training and meta-testing procedure, yielding forecasting models that are explicitly optimized for cold-start forecasting. We instantiate TMAML on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and present an initial empirical analysis of forecast accuracy and calibration across three cold-start scenarios: TMAML consistently outperforms or matches a standard ERM-trained TFT, yields better-calibrated forecasts than naive on two of the three scenarios, but does not consistently outperform naive on probabilistic forecast accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将冷启动预测形式化为少窗口学习问题，提出时序模型无关元学习（TMAML），并在Temporal Fusion Transformer上实例化以优化冷启动预测。
AI.motivation: 冷启动预测（历史数据极少或没有）是常见挑战，需要模型能从少量数据快速学习并利用相关序列信息。现有全局预测模型虽能借跨序列共享信息生成冷启动预测，但并未针对训练集外泛化或短历史自适应进行优化。
AI.method: 将冷启动预测建模为少窗口学习问题；提出TMAML，将原本用于神经网络少样本自适应的模型无关元学习（MAML）改造用于深度时序预测；构造时间一致的支持-查询窗口作为元任务，并配套时间元训练与元测试流程；在Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）上实例化TMAML。
AI.result: 在三种冷启动场景下进行初步实证分析：TMAML始终优于或持平标准ERM训练的TFT；在三个场景中的两个上比naive基线具有更好的校准性；但在概率预测精度上未能持续优于naive。
AI.conclusion: TMAML使预测模型显式针对冷启动优化，在点预测精度上表现稳健、在部分场景改善校准性，但概率预测精度相对naive基线尚不稳定，仍需进一步研究。

title: FreeSpeed: Training-Free Speed Control for Generative Robot Policies
comment: 37 pages, 21 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://yuxuanhu9.github.io/FreeSpeed/
summary: Online control of execution speed is essential for deploying robot policies in real-world scenarios, as robots may need to speed up under time constraints or slow down to facilitate human interaction and improve safety. However, imitation-learned policies inherit the execution speed of their demonstrations, and test-time speed modification can introduce unrecoverable out-of-distribution observations, reducing task success. We observe that the directional inconsistency of action chunks reflects task-phase criticality, indicating how aggressively action step lengths can be modified while preserving task success. Based on this observation, we introduce FreeSpeed, a training-free module that post-processes action chunks from pretrained policies. FreeSpeed resamples each predicted chunk at the requested rate, then uses directional inconsistency between adjacent actions as the primary signal for rescaling. This signal adaptively determines how closely the execution speed can approach the requested speed, allowing flexible speed adjustment within the evaluated limits without compromising task success. Across three policy families and 50 simulated tasks, FreeSpeed supports online speed changes, with realized execution rates spanning 0.22x to 2.53x among settings that preserve per-task success. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, FreeSpeed achieves an average success rate of 94.0%, matching the frozen policy's 93.8%, while realizing execution rates from 0.38x to 1.97x.

AI.tldr: FreeSpeed：一种免训练模块，通过动作块方向不一致性信号，实现模仿学习策略执行速度的在线灵活调节。
AI.motivation: 机器人部署需在线调控执行速度（加速满足时限、减速便于交互与安全），但模仿学习策略继承演示速度，测试时变速会引入不可恢复的分布外观测，降低任务成功率。
AI.method: 观察到动作块的方向不一致性反映任务阶段关键性，可指示动作步长可修改程度。FreeSpeed 作为免训练后处理模块：按请求速率对预训练策略预测的动作块重采样，以相邻动作的方向不一致性作为主信号进行重缩放，自适应决定执行速度接近请求速度的程度。
AI.result: 在3类策略家族、50个仿真任务中支持在线变速，保持单任务成功率前提下实际执行速率覆盖0.22x–2.53x；在4个真实操作任务中平均成功率达94.0%，与冻结策略的93.8%相当，实际执行速率为0.38x–1.97x。
