AI.conclusion: FreeSpeed 无需额外训练即可在维持任务成功率的同时，实现跨仿真与真实场景的在线、双向执行速度调节。

title: One Tile, Multiple Instances: Rethinking MIL for Sparse Diagnostic Evidence
summary: In weakly supervised Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification, feature extractors typically compress each image tile into a single global embedding. Consequently, slide-level aggregators are restricted to this coarse tile scale, concealing fine-grained sub-tile evidence from the attention mechanism. We introduce DI-MIL, a framework that decouples encoding context from instance granularity through decomposed instances. By clustering dense spatial tokens from a frozen foundation model within each tile, DI-MIL converts a single tile into multiple independently weighted instance embeddings. As a training-free post-encoding module, DI-MIL integrates seamlessly into existing pipelines without requiring re-encoding or downstream architectural modifications. We evaluate DI-MIL on cytopathology, a challenging testbed where sparse diagnostic signals are easily diluted within standard tiles. Across four datasets, three frozen foundation models, and two attention-based aggregators, DI-MIL demonstrates consistent efficacy, improving 67 of 72 metric-level comparisons, with the largest mean gains reaching 3.64 points under cytopathology-specific backbones. In a broader comparison against seven representative MIL baselines, DI-MIL paired with ACMIL achieves highest mean performance in 33 of 36 backbone-dataset-metric comparisons. Ablations show that direct smaller tiling inflates the extracted tile count by up to 43.3$\times$ with non-monotonic performance, whereas DI-MIL incurs zero additional image-extraction overhead while achieving the strongest overall results. These results establish instance construction as an orthogonal design dimension in MIL, supporting DI-MIL as a cost-efficient solution under sparse diagnostic evidence.

AI.tldr: DI-MIL提出一种免训练的后编码模块，通过聚类tile内密集空间token，将单个tile分解为多个可独立加权的实例嵌入，从而解耦编码上下文与实例粒度，在细胞病理学WSI分类上显著提升多种聚合器性能。
AI.motivation: 弱监督WSI分类中，特征提取器通常将每个图像tile压缩为单一全局嵌入，导致slide-level聚合器只能在此粗糙tile尺度上工作，细粒度的sub-tile证据被掩盖。在细胞病理学等诊断信号稀疏的场景下，这种粗粒度会稀释关键证据。
AI.method: DI-MIL在冻结的基础模型上，对每个tile内的密集空间token进行聚类，将单个tile转换为多个可独立加权的实例嵌入。作为免训练（training-free）的后编码模块，它可直接嵌入现有MIL流程，无需重新编码或修改下游架构。
AI.result: 在4个数据集、3个冻结基础模型和2种注意力聚合器上，DI-MIL在72项指标比较中改善了67项；在细胞病理学专用骨干下最大平均增益达3.64点。与7种代表性MIL基线相比，DI-MIL+ACMIL在36项骨干-数据集-指标比较中的33项取得最高平均性能。消融显示，直接采用更小tiling会使tile数量膨胀最高43.3倍且性能非单调，而DI-MIL不增加任何额外图像提取开销，却取得最佳整体结果。
AI.conclusion: 实例构造是MIL中一个正交的设计维度，DI-MIL在稀疏诊断证据条件下是一种高性价比的解决方案。

title: A Tropical Geometry View of Forgetting: A Per-Unit Projector for Knowledge-Preserving Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on new text degrades what it already does. Replay-free projectors such as Adam-NSCL and GPM forbid one shared subspace of a layer's inputs in every row of the update. The tropical geometry of a ReLU layer shows why this is too coarse. In data space, the units' walls are tropical hypersurfaces whose cells are dual to the upper vertices of a zonotope; in weight space, each old token is a hyperplane, and the tokens cut out a polyhedron, the closure of the weights that keep every token on its side. An exact identity joins the two pictures: the squared change of the layer's output under any weight change splits into in-cell, open-to-closed and closed-to-open terms, and the first two live on the tokens each unit fires on. The identity names a gate-aware per-unit projector, and a budget-separation theorem prices exact protection: it costs a unit the rank of its own open tokens, while a shared subspace pays at least the rank of their union in every row. On OPT-1.3b, where 96% of (token, unit) pairs are closed, the projector forgets less than Adam-NSCL at all six matched budgets from 9 to 60 constrained directions per row, the gap widening from $1.1\times$ to $4.3\times$; with 1/5.5 of the directions it halves the forgetting of Adam-NSCL at GPM's energy threshold. On OPT-6.7b, it matches Adam-NSCL's forgetting at matched budget while learning more. As the theory predicts, the open/closed partition is the operative variable: open tokens beat random, sign-blind and anti-gate token sets on 18 of 18 seed-pairs. In pruning repair, every derivative-based local model of the output error at the dense weights is blind to pairs that open: the minimisers of the gate-weighted objective can leave the polyhedron, the objective's closed-form solution is 1.94 nats worse than no repair on OPT-1.3b, and a convex one-sided penalty bounds the escape.

AI.tldr: 该论文用ReLU层的热带几何刻画微调中的灾难性遗忘，提出门控感知的逐单元投影器，在保护旧知识上优于共享子空间方法（Adam-NSCL、GPM）。
AI.motivation: 微调语言模型会损害其已有能力。现有免回放投影器（如Adam-NSCL、GPM）在更新矩阵的每一行都禁止同一个共享子空间，这种约束过于粗糙，忽略了ReLU单元激活模式的差异，导致保护效率低下。
AI.method: 作者借助ReLU层的热带几何：数据空间中单元"墙"为热带超曲面，其对偶是zonotope上顶点；权重空间中每个旧token是一个超平面，切割出保持各token朝向的权重多面体。由此导出输出平方变化的精确恒等式，分解为in-cell、open-to-closed、closed-to-open三项，前两项仅由各单元激活的token决定。基于该恒等式设计门控感知的逐单元投影器，并给出预算-分离定理，量化精确保护的成本：逐单元需付出自身开放token的秩，而共享子空间每行至少付出并集的秩。
AI.result: 在OPT-1.3b上（96%的(token,unit)对为closed），投影器在每行9至60个约束方向的六个匹配预算下遗忘均少于Adam-NSCL，差距从1.1倍扩大到4.3倍；仅用1/5.5的方向即在GPM能量阈值下将Adam-NSCL的遗忘减半。在OPT-6.7b上，匹配预算下遗忘与Adam-NSCL相当而学习更多。开放/闭合划分是决定性变量：开放token集在18/18个种子对上优于随机、符号盲和反门控token集。在剪枝修复中，稠密权重处所有基于导数的局部误差模型都对"打开"的token视而不见，门控加权目标的闭式解比不修复还差1.94 nats，凸单边惩罚可约束逃逸。
AI.conclusion: ReLU层激活的门控结构（开放/闭合token划分）是持续学习中投影保护的关键变量；逐单元、门控感知的投影器以更少约束方向实现更低的遗忘，显著优于共享子空间方法。该理论同时揭示了基于导数的局部修复模型的盲区，并提供凸惩罚作为补救。

title: Coupling Noisy Pairwise Knowledge to the DAG Posterior for Causal Discovery
summary: External causal reports can improve structure learning from limited observations, but their reliability varies across sources and variable pairs. We introduce HB-NoisyKG, a Bayesian framework that combines observational data with repeated causal reports from sources such as large language models. Each report is a noisy observation of a direct pair state implied by one DAG. A feature-conditioned Beta prior pools information about pair reliability, and a shared error matrix captures systematic mistakes. Alternating inference uses the graph posterior to refine reliability estimates, which determine how reports influence subsequent graph updates. The report likelihood uses only graph pair-state marginals, so the same observation layer supports discrete and continuous likelihoods in graph-only and joint inference. Against an 80-restart no-KG baseline, HB uses at most 80 total restarts and lowers mean SHD from 22.39 to 16.06 on five discrete benchmarks. On a physical light tunnel with random variable IDs and retained descriptions, HB lowers SHD from 39.00 for no-KG to 27.30. On continuous Sachs, graph-only BGe raises AUROC by 0.121 over no-KG Top-K. In a controlled synthetic study, continued updating also reduces mean reliability estimation error and held-out report log loss compared with one-time estimation.

AI.tldr: HB-NoisyKG：将观测数据与大语言模型等来源的重复因果报告结合，用特征条件Beta先验池化可靠性、共享错误矩阵建模系统性错误，交替推断图后验与可靠性，在离散/连续基准上降低SHD并提升AUROC。
AI.motivation: 外部因果报告可从有限观测中改善结构学习，但报告可靠性随来源和变量对而异。既有方法未能同时建模这种异质可靠性与系统性错误，因此需要一种能自适应估计可靠性并据此调节报告影响的贝叶斯框架。
AI.method: 提出HB-NoisyKG贝叶斯框架：每条报告被视为某一DAG所蕴含的直接成对状态的含噪观测；用特征条件Beta先验池化成对可靠性信息，用共享错误矩阵刻画系统性错误；采用交替推断，用图后验精炼可靠性估计，再由可靠性决定报告如何影响后续图更新。报告似然仅依赖图成对状态边际，故同一观测层可支撑离散与连续似然，并兼容仅图推断与联合推断。
AI.result: 在五个离散基准上，相对于80次重启的无KG基线（总重启不超过80次），HB将平均SHD从22.39降至16.06；在随机变量ID并保留描述的物理光隧道中，SHD从39.00降至27.30；在连续Sachs上，仅图BGe使AUROC较无KG Top-K提升0.121；在受控合成研究中，持续更新相比一次性估计进一步降低平均可靠性估计误差与留出报告的log loss。
AI.conclusion: HB-NoisyKG能有效融合含噪外部因果报告与观测数据，通过联合推断可靠性与图结构提升结构学习效果，且适用于离散/连续、仅图/联合等多种设定。

title: The Unexpired Plan: A Free Monitor for Accelerated Diffusion Policies
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Project website (code and videos): https://yizhaojasper.com/unexpired-plan/
summary: Training-free acceleration of a diffusion policy is accepted when an internal similarity signal reports that the shortcut changed nothing. We price every monitor a control loop can afford in closed-loop success rather than feature distance, over $114$ accelerator configurations and four policy families: two accelerators each clear their own gate's bar and log every reuse as certified, while on one task one finishes every episode and the other none. A monitor is two designs, not one --- the statistic it reads, and what it does when that statistic fires. Published gates re-arm after every rejection, and under that response even an oracle handed every forward pass and the exact local action error loses twenty points; absorbing the same statistic costs one point, and most of its speed. What makes a response that never forgets affordable is a statistic that rarely fires, and what it must measure is deviation from the policy the accelerator replaced --- which a chunked policy has already paid for, its last plan not yet expired and free to read. Guarding every call this way cuts per-call compute by $1.55$--$3.09\times$, where any reference-requiring check at the same coverage would have to stop accelerating altogether. On three of our four families the schedule alone already holds the pre-stated $\pm2$-point margin. What the monitor is measurably worth shows in three places: on the fourth family, where it rescues the candidate selection landed on; on four configurations it did not select; and on a contact-rich fifth family, chosen where the schedule was expected to fail and run after every design choice was frozen, where no unmonitored arm at its speed holds the margin and the monitored one does.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散策略（diffusion policy）的免训练加速，主张将监控器的价值以闭环成功率而非特征距离来衡量，并在114种加速器配置与四个策略族上验证：监控器包含"统计量"与"触发响应"两个设计；已发表的"拒绝后重新武装"响应即使给oracle也会掉20分，而"吸收式"响应仅掉1分但损失速度；廉价的关键在于统计量极少触发，且它应度量与加速器所替代策略的偏差——分块策略已为此付过代价，其未过期的上一段计划可免费读取。该守卫将每次调用计算降低1.55–3.09倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略推理昂贵，免训练加速常用内部相似度信号来认证捷径是否"什么都没改变"，但现有做法以特征距离而非闭环任务成功率来评估监控器的价值，且把监控器视为单一设计，忽略了触发后的响应策略这一维度，导致认证信号与实际任务性能脱节。
AI.method: 将监控器解耦为两部分：所读取的统计量，以及触发时所采取的动作（响应）。以闭环成功率对每种监控器定价，覆盖114个加速器配置、四个策略族。对比"拒绝后重新武装"与"吸收式"两种响应；提出统计量应度量"与加速器所替代的原策略的偏差"，并利用分块策略中尚未过期、可免费读取的上一段计划作为参考；对每次调用施加守卫。
AI.result: 两个加速器各自通过自身门槛并将每次复用记为已认证，但在某一任务上一个完成全部回合、另一个为零。已发表的重新武装式门控，即使交给oracle（可获每次前向与精确局部动作误差）也损失20分；吸收同一统计量仅损失1分，但损失大部分速度。"永不遗忘"响应的可负担性来自极少触发的统计量。守卫使每次调用计算降低1.55–3.09倍，而同覆盖率的任何需参考的检查则无法继续加速。四个族中有三个仅靠调度即满足预设±2分容差。监控器的可测价值体现在三处：第四个族中救回了候选选择所落之处；四个未选中的配置；以及在预期调度会失败的接触丰富第五族上，其速度下无监控臂均不满足容差而监控臂满足。
AI.conclusion: 监控器应被理解为"统计量+响应"的二元设计，其价值须以闭环成功率衡量；罕触发的统计量配合吸收式响应使"永不遗忘"的守卫变得可负担，而统计量应度量相对于被替代原策略的偏差，这一参考在分块策略中已可免费获得。该框架在多数情形下把节省计算与保持成功率结合起来，且其增益在调度单独不足时尤为明显。

title: Enhancing Long-Video VLM Embeddings with Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning
summary: Long-video embedding requires capturing sparse query-relevant evidence under a limited visual-token budget. Uniform sampling can miss brief events in videos spanning minutes or hours, whereas encoding more frames in a single context increases memory and computation. We introduce \textbf{Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning} (QASLR), a post-training framework that accumulates evidence across clips while keeping the embedding size fixed. QASLR selects a bounded set of frames, restores their temporal order, and processes them clip by clip with a vision-language backbone. A compact set of persistent think tokens cross-attends to each clip's features, while an embed token reads out a normalized representation after every update. This design integrates evidence across multiple backbone calls without requiring all selected frames to share a single context. Training combines final contrastive learning, step-wise contrastive supervision, and final-embedding self-distillation. Intermediate supervision trains partial-video readouts for retrieval, while self-distillation regularizes them toward the final representation. Query-aware selection produces query-conditioned representations for candidate-set scoring and reranking, whereas query-independent selection enables reusable corpus indexing. Under the full training recipe, HourVideo retrieval Hit@1 increases from 54.2 to 70.7 and from 57.4 to 72.8 for 2B and 8B Qwen3-VL-Embedding backbones, respectively. Gains extend to the evaluated moment-retrieval and video-QA tasks, and the streaming head transfers to a second Qwen-family embedding backbone. These results support streaming latent aggregation as an effective approach to integrating long-video evidence into fixed-dimensional representations.

AI.tldr: QASLR：一种后训练框架，通过流式潜在推理在固定嵌入维度下跨片段累积长视频证据，HourVideo检索Hit@1由54.2提升至70.7（2B）与57.4提升至72.8（8B）。
AI.motivation: 长视频嵌入需在有限视觉token预算下捕捉稀疏的查询相关证据。均匀采样会漏掉数分钟至数小时视频中的短暂事件，而在单一上下文中编码更多帧又会增加内存与计算开销，二者构成矛盾。
AI.method: 提出QASLR后训练框架：选取有界帧集合并恢复其时序顺序，逐片段经视觉-语言骨干处理；一组紧凑的持久think token对每个片段特征做交叉注意力，embed token在每次更新后读出归一化表示，从而在多次骨干调用间整合证据而无需共享单一上下文。训练采用最终对比学习、逐步对比监督与最终嵌入自蒸馏的组合；中间监督训练部分视频读出用于检索，自蒸馏将其正则化向最终表示对齐。查询感知选择产生查询条件表示用于候选集打分与重排序，查询无关选择则支持可复用的语料索引。
AI.result: 在完整训练配方下，HourVideo检索Hit@1从54.2升至70.7（2B）和从57.4升至72.8（8B）Qwen3-VL-Embedding骨干；增益延伸至所评估的时刻检索与视频问答任务；流式头可迁移到第二个Qwen系列嵌入骨干。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持流式潜在聚合是将长视频证据整合为固定维度表示的有效方法。

title: MASBench: Benchmarking LLM-based Multi-Agent Collaboration under Partial Observability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have progressively evolved into the core of autonomous agents. Building on this progress, LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate multiple agents into a synergistic team to accomplish complex tasks that exceed the capabilities of individual agents. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on the agents themselves, but also on how collaboration mechanisms are designed and organized. Note that real-world collaboration is typically partially observable, where each agent can only access partial information about the environment due to physical or privacy-related constraints. However, many existing multi-agent benchmarks assume global observability, and leave limited support for systematically evaluating collaboration mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we introduce MASBench, a multi-agent collaboration benchmark designed under partially observable constraints. It is organized into three progressive task categories: Reasoning, Scheduling, and Game. Through this structure, we progressively evaluate three representative collaboration mechanisms: Protocol, Memory, and Routing. MASBench further provides deterministic evaluation metrics, including performance score, communication cost, and cost effectiveness, to characterize both collaboration outcomes and communication overhead. Experiments across diverse LLM backbones and mechanism configurations offer empirical guidance for effective MAS design. Code is available at: https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MASBench，一个在部分可观测约束下设计的多智能体协作基准，通过推理、调度、博弈三类递进任务，系统评估协议、记忆、路由三种协作机制，并提供确定性指标衡量协作效果与通信开销。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统在完成复杂任务时依赖协作机制设计，但现实协作通常是部分可观测的，而现有基准多假设全局可观测，缺乏对协作机制的系统评估支持。
AI.method: 构建 MASBench 基准，在部分可观测约束下组织为 Reasoning、Scheduling、Game 三类递进任务，对应评估 Protocol、Memory、Routing 三种协作机制；同时提供性能分数、通信成本、成本效益等确定性评价指标，并在多种 LLM 骨干与机制配置下开展实验。
AI.result: 在多种 LLM 骨干和机制配置下的实验为有效 MAS 设计提供了经验性指导。
AI.conclusion: MASBench 填补了部分可观测条件下多智能体协作机制系统评估的空白，可为 MAS 设计与优化提供标准化评测与实证参考。

title: Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.

AI.tldr: 提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss（PAL），用单次 detach 投影步代替多步展开修复，实现更高效精确的约束满足。
AI.motivation: 将学习模型部署到需精确满足约束的场景时，需修复神经预测的约束违反。现有方法在训练中展开多步修复并对残余违反软惩罚，导致计算与内存开销大、修复不收敛时鲁棒性差，且把大部分约束满足工作交给修复过程。
AI.method: PAL 在训练中仅做一次 detach 的投影步，利用该步后的约束残差自适应地加权对原始预测的约束惩罚，替代多步展开修复与软惩罚策略。
AI.result: 在极非线性约束上，PAL 是唯一保持近乎完美可行性的方法；在合成与工程基准上匹配或优于现有方法；在 ACOPF 基准上比 DC3 训练快 2.5 倍；并可在约束评估昂贵（如神经代理）时训练，而展开方法内存不可行。
AI.conclusion: 单次 detach 投影步足以支撑训练中的约束修复，PAL 高效、鲁棒且适用性更强，挑战了常规多步展开修复范式。

title: Demonstration-Calibrated Port-Hamiltonian Retuning for Manipulation Policies
summary: Diffusion and VLA policies for manipulation are often deployed through downstream impedance controllers. The stiffness and damping gains of these controllers affect task success, yet are commonly inherited from data collection rather than selected for the deployed policy. Although empirical gain sweeps can improve performance, they require repeated evaluation rollouts. We introduce PHRetune, an offline method that derives controller gains for a frozen policy without evaluation rollouts or gain search. Our approach learns a port-Hamiltonian model from demonstrations to estimate the effort and energy associated with the policy's predicted actions. The policy is applied to recorded demonstration observations, and its predictions are assessed against demonstration-derived effort and energy budgets. From this comparison, we derive a single gain scale in closed form, adjusting the downstream controller while preserving the policy and its action representation. The gains are fixed before evaluation, without requiring a prior manipulator model, task rewards, policy retraining, or additional runtime computation. Across LIBERO suites, PHRetune improves Diffusion Policy success by up to 9.4 percentage points, with the derived gains achieving the highest observed success rates in empirical gain sweeps. On all four real-world manipulation tasks, PHRetuned Diffusion Policy outperforms the nominal policy, alternative gain-tuning methods, and a policy-retraining baseline. The same procedure improves success with SmolVLA and OpenVLA-OFT on every task, while reducing acceleration and jerk for both VLA backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出PHRetune：一种离线方法，通过从示范中学习端口哈密顿模型，为冻结策略在闭式解下推导下游阻抗控制器的增益缩放，无需评估rollout或增益搜索。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略与VLA策略常通过下游阻抗控制器部署，其刚度与阻尼增益影响任务成功率，但通常沿用数据采集时的设定，而非针对实际部署策略选择。传统经验性增益扫描虽可提升性能，却需要反复评估rollout，代价高昂。
AI.method: 从示范中学习端口哈密顿（port-Hamiltonian）模型，估计策略预测动作对应的effort与能量；将策略应用于记录的示范观测，把其预测与示范导出的effort和能量预算进行比对，从该比较中以闭式解推导出单一增益缩放因子，调整下游控制器，同时保持策略及其动作表示不变。增益在评估前固定，无需先验机械臂模型、任务奖励、策略重训练或额外运行时计算。
AI.result: 在LIBERO套件上，PHRetune将Diffusion Policy成功率最高提升9.4个百分点，所推导增益达到经验增益扫描中的最高成功率。在全部四个真实世界操作任务上，PHRetuned Diffusion Policy优于标称策略、其他增益调优方法及策略重训练基线。同一流程在SmolVLA与OpenVLA-OFT上对每个任务均提升成功率，同时降低两种VLA主干网络的加速度与jerk。
AI.conclusion: PHRetune提供了一种无需评估rollout与增益搜索的离线控制器增益推导方法，可通用地提升扩散策略与VLA策略的部署性能，并改善运动平滑性。

title: Reflection-Robust 6DoF Object Tracking with Light Fields
summary: Tracking the 6DoF pose of a moving rigid object is fundamental to robotics and autonomous driving, but existing trackers assume that object appearance is stable across a sequence, an assumption that breaks down on reflective surfaces whose appearance changes as they mirror the environment. We introduce a light field based reflection-robust 6DoF tracker that turns this apparent nuisance into a pose cue. Per frame, our method recovers depth robustly against reflections, back-projects it into a point cloud, and estimates surface normals. It then decomposes the object's view-dependent appearance into a diffuse albedo and the environment map it reflects, resulting in a relightable surface light field. Starting from a coarse initialization, we relight it by the recovered environment map and optimize the pose on the photometric loss. Because a moving object mirrors new parts of the scene, the environment map fills in as the sequence proceeds, sharpening this signal over time. To evaluate this approach, we introduce a light field tracking dataset re-rendered from a robotic manipulation benchmark at four controlled reflectivity levels, each paired with simulated depth that reproduces how consumer RGB-D sensors fail on shiny surfaces. Additionally, we evaluate on two captured light field sequences. Our method trails the strongest baselines on diffuse objects and is the only one that holds its accuracy on fully reflective objects, where every baseline degrades.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于光场的反射鲁棒6DoF位姿跟踪器，将反射造成的外观变化由干扰转化为位姿线索。
AI.motivation: 现有跟踪器假设物体外观在序列中保持稳定，但反射表面的外观会随环境镜像而变化，导致该假设失效。
AI.method: 逐帧鲁棒恢复抗反射深度并反投影为点云、估计表面法线；将视角相关外观分解为漫反射反照率与所反射的环境贴图，得到可重光照表面光场；在粗糙初始化下用恢复的环境贴图重光照，并基于光度损失优化位姿。
AI.result: 引入一个由机器人操作基准重新渲染的光场跟踪数据集（四个可控反射率等级及模拟消费级RGB-D传感器在光亮表面失效的深度），并在两段实采光场序列上评估；方法在漫反射物体上略逊于最强基线，但在全反射物体上是唯一保持精度的，而所有基线均退化。
AI.conclusion: 利用反射的环境贴图随时间填充并增强光度信号，可实现反射鲁棒的6DoF跟踪。

title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多智能体辩论要超越简单多数投票，需同时满足两个机制：提案供给须浮现正确答案（可恢复余量），读取机制须在投票遗漏时识别正确答案（潜验证辩论LVD）。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论虽能提升推理，但常无法击败简单多数投票。作者认为成功辩论需两个独立机制：一是提案供给必须能浮现正确答案，二是读取机制必须在投票遗漏时识别出该答案。
AI.method: 形式上以"可恢复余量"刻画第一项要求（存在正确提案但多数答案错误的情形）；提出潜验证辩论（LVD）会计模型，使候选提案在最终生成前获得针对答案的验证证据；用受控固定提案干预估计该潜在效应；用带标签与无标签覆盖目标从神经丛（neural-thicket）智能体构建社会以改善提案供给。
AI.result: 受控干预显示正确证据在提案供给固定时改变答案概率与生成决策；在两种骨干网络和匹配预算推理基准上，覆盖选择的社会增加互补提案供给并提升重复随机评估的聚合准确率；轮级控制显示交互带来的增益超过将同一最终化器直接作用于初始提案。
AI.conclusion: 提案覆盖与真值敏感的证据使用是辩论超越投票的两个互补条件。

title: DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm for post-training large language models, reducing the train--test mismatch of conventional distillation by supervising the student on its own generated trajectories. However, existing OPD objectives remain largely token-local and outcome-agnostic, optimizing teacher--student agreement at each prefix despite reasoning quality being determined at the trajectory level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), provides complementary outcome-level supervision but suffers from sparse rewards and coarse credit assignment. We show that OPD and RLVR exhibit complementary blind spots: teacher signals provide dense local guidance but are weakly aligned with rollout correctness, whereas group-relative rewards capture task success but provide coarse token-level credit and vanish on all-failure groups. We introduce DiffGate, an outcome-gated objective that combines GRPO with selective, bounded teacher guidance. Teacher supervision is applied only to failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, and smoothly bounded to prevent extreme teacher--student discrepancies from dominating optimization. The verifier therefore determines \emph{which trajectories} receive teacher guidance, while the teacher provides dense token-level update directions within those trajectories. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B students, DiffGate improves code avg@8 over matched GRPO by $+1.7$ and $+1.8$ points and pass@8 by $+1.6$ and $+5.7$ points, respectively. On mathematics, avg@8 remains within $0.5$ points of GRPO while pass@8 improves by $+1.1$ and $+3.9$ points. Overall, DiffGate improves pass@8 across all four model--domain settings, demonstrating improved solution coverage under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffGate，一种结果门控的蒸馏目标，将GRPO与选择性、有界的教师指导结合：仅对失败轨迹施加教师监督，并按组难度缩放、平滑有界，从而兼顾结果级奖励与稠密token级指导。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy distillation（OPD）目标多为token-local且outcome-agnostic，虽提供稠密局部指导但与轨迹正确性对齐较弱；而RLVR（如GRPO）提供结果级监督，却面临奖励稀疏、credit assignment粗糙、全失败组梯度消失等问题。二者存在互补盲点。
AI.method: DiffGate将GRPO与选择性有界教师指导融合：仅对失败轨迹应用教师监督，并按组难度进行缩放，同时对teacher-student差异做平滑有界处理，防止极端偏差主导优化。验证器决定哪些轨迹获得教师指导，教师在轨迹内提供稠密的token级更新方向。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-0.6B与Qwen3-1.7B学生模型上，代码任务avg@8相比匹配的GRPO分别提升+1.7与+1.8分，pass@8提升+1.6与+5.7分；数学任务avg@8与GRPO差距在0.5分以内，pass@8提升+1.1与+3.9分。四种模型-领域设置下pass@8均有提升。
AI.conclusion: DiffGate通过结果门控的教师指导有效结合了OPD的稠密局部监督与RLVR的结果级监督，在评估协议下改善了解决方案覆盖度，验证了二者互补融合的有效性。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Neuro-Symbolic Drift Anticipation for Reliable Visual SLAM
summary: This paper introduces Hybrid DeepSEE (HDS), a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) neuro-symbolic framework for proactive drift anticipation in Visual SLAM (V-SLAM). While data-driven models offer predictive power, their "black-box" nature often yields physically inconsistent outputs in out-of-distribution (OOD) environments. To address this, HDS integrates neural drift risk estimation with symbolic constraint reasoning. By utilizing a Large Language Model (LLM) as a reasoning bridge, the framework translates qualitative human context into interpretable symbolic constraints. Building upon this architecture, we propose a superior drift anticipation framework that ensures enhanced reliability and consistency in Visual SLAM

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hybrid DeepSEE (HDS)，一种人在回路（HITL）的神经符号框架，用于视觉SLAM（V-SLAM）中的主动漂移预判。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动模型虽具预测能力，但其"黑箱"特性在分布外（OOD）环境中常产生物理上不一致的输出，因此需要提升漂移预测的可靠性与物理一致性。
AI.method: HDS将神经漂移风险估计与符号约束推理相结合，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为推理桥梁，将定性的、人类提供的上下文转化为可解释的符号约束，构建人在回路的神经符号架构。
AI.result: 构建了一个更优的漂移预判框架，在视觉SLAM中实现更高的可靠性与一致性（摘要中未给出具体量化实验结果）。
AI.conclusion: 通过神经符号融合与人在回路机制，HDS缓解了黑箱模型在OOD环境下的物理不一致问题，提升了V-SLAM漂移预判的可解释性与可靠性。

title: PWM: Personalized World Models with Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pretrained world models can generate diverse environments, yet users often want to explore a particular scene specified by their own video. This requires learning the scene's visual identity while retaining the quality of action-conditioned generation. We introduce Personalized World Models (PWM), a framework for customizing interactive world models from short scene videos through online reinforcement learning. In PWM, the support trajectory and its associated controls provide reward feedback on continuations sampled from the current policy. In the GRPO instantiation, group-relative optimization updates a compact LoRA adapter using a unified reward for scene appearance, visual continuity, and motion, while base-policy anchoring regularizes changes to the pretrained generation prior of a frozen Yume-5B backbone. The same adaptation procedure is applied across real and rendered environments. We also instantiate PWM with DiffusionNFT as an alternative reward-guided optimization method for learning the scene-specific adapter. We also introduce PWM-Bench, comprising 150 customization tasks across Indoor, Outdoor, and Gaming, with paired evaluation on held-out continuations. The GRPO and DiffusionNFT instantiations of PWM improve customization over native Yume in 71.3% and 65.3% of the evaluated scenes, respectively, with positive mean gains across all three domains. For the GRPO instantiation, matched SFT comparisons further demonstrate higher mean customization gains and better mean image-quality scores in every domain, while retaining frame-level visual quality close to the pretrained model.

AI.tldr: 提出PWM框架，通过在线强化学习将预训练世界模型定制到用户给定短视频场景，并构建PWM-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 预训练世界模型虽能生成多样环境，但用户往往希望探索由其自身视频指定的特定场景，这要求在保留动作条件生成质量的同时学习该场景的视觉身份。
AI.method: 以短视频及其控制信号作为支持轨迹，为当前策略采样的延续提供奖励反馈；在GRPO实例中，用统一奖励（场景外观、视觉连续性、运动）进行组相对优化，更新紧凑LoRA适配器，并以基础策略锚定正则化，冻结Yume-5B骨干的生成先验；同一适配流程应用于真实与渲染环境；另用DiffusionNFT实例化；并提出含150个定制任务（室内、户外、游戏）及留出延续配对评估的PWM-Bench。
AI.result: GRPO与DiffusionNFT实例分别在71.3%与65.3%的评估场景中优于原生Yume，三个领域均有正向平均增益；GRPO在匹配SFT对比下各领域平均定制增益与平均图像质量得分更高，且帧级视觉质量接近预训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于在线强化学习与轻量LoRA适配的PWM能有效实现场景个性化世界模型，在保持接近预训练帧级视觉质量的同时提升定制效果，并具备跨真实/渲染环境的通用性。

title: RAGStress: A controlled benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation under knowledge-base degradation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is typically evaluated under the implicit assumption that the underlying knowledge base (KB) is clean, leaving the behaviour of RAG systems under realistic KB degradation poorly characterised. We introduce RAGStress, a controlled evaluation benchmark for stress-testing RAG systems under systematic KB corruption. The benchmark pairs four naturalistic corruption types (factual corruption, numeric typo, relevance poisoning, and contradiction injection) with three severity levels (subtle, moderate, and obvious) over a single-KB, metadata-filtered experimental design built from 57 MMLU subjects and 182,546 documents. Across 52,500 model-question-condition evaluations, RAGStress reveals that clean retrieval can mask robustness differences, semantic-fidelity corruptions are substantially more harmful than signal-utility perturbations, no-retrieval accuracy does not predict corrupted-retrieval robustness, and mixed-KB accuracy should not be treated as worst-case robustness. We document the benchmark's intended use, supported claims, and limitations, and provide an artifact bundle including generation scripts, corruption prompts, metadata schema, and evaluation code. RAGStress is intended as a controlled stress test for RAG robustness under KB corruption, not as a general model leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGStress——一个面向RAG系统在知识库损坏条件下鲁棒性的受控评测基准，涵盖四类自然腐败类型与三级严重度，基于57个MMLU科目、182,546篇文档构建，共完成52,500次评估，揭示多项反直觉的鲁棒性规律。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评测普遍隐含假设知识库是干净的，导致RAG系统在真实知识库退化情境下的行为缺乏刻画。作者希望填补这一空白，提供可控、系统的知识库腐败压力测试手段。
AI.method: 构建RAGStress基准：设计四种自然主义腐败类型（事实篡改、数字错字、相关性投毒、矛盾注入）与三个严重度等级（细微、中等、明显），采用单知识库、元数据过滤的实验设计，数据来源于57个MMLU科目、共182,546篇文档，并进行52,500次模型-问题-条件评估。
AI.result: 实验发现：（1）干净检索会掩盖模型间鲁棒性差异；（2）语义保真类腐败比信号效用扰动危害更大；（3）无检索准确率无法预测损坏检索下的鲁棒性；（4）混合知识库准确率不应被视为最坏情况鲁棒性。同时记录了基准的适用场景、可支持结论与局限，并公开生成脚本、腐败提示词、元数据模式与评估代码。
AI.conclusion: RAGStress定位为知识库腐败条件下RAG鲁棒性的受控压力测试工具，而非通用模型排行榜；它为RAG鲁棒性研究提供了可复现、可诊断的评测框架。

title: Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy
summary: Best arm identification under differential privacy is a pure-exploration problem in which both statistical efficiency and privacy protection must be achieved simultaneously. We study fixed-budget best arm identification for bandits under pure $ε$-differential privacy, where the learner must recommend an arm after a prescribed sampling budget while protecting the full transcript. We prove that the optimal exponential decay rate of the error probability is upper bounded by an instance-dependent privacy-aware transportation exponent that differs from the analogous quantity used to characterize the stopping time in fixed-confidence analysis by Jourdan and Azize [2025]. Guided by this exponent, we propose AO-Pri-BAI, an adaptive algorithm that maintains private running estimates through Laplace-tree mechanisms and learns a sampling design through a min--max interaction between hard alternatives and arm allocations. We prove that AO-Pri-BAI satisfies pure $ε$-differential privacy. We also establish that the exponent of the failure probability of AO-Pri-BAI matches the privacy-aware benchmark. Numerical studies show that even in the non-asymptotic setting, AO-Pri-BAI outperforms benchmark algorithms on various instances, complementing the theoretical analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究纯ε-差分隐私下的固定预算最佳臂识别问题，证明了最优错误概率指数衰减率的上界由一个隐私感知传输指数刻画，并提出达到该最优指数的自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI。
AI.motivation: 在差分隐私约束下，学习者需要在保护完整采样记录的同时实现统计效率，而现有固定置信度分析中的刻画量不再适用于固定预算场景，因此需要重新刻画固定预算下的最优误差衰减率并设计相应算法。
AI.method: 将固定预算最佳臂识别建模为纯ε-差分隐私问题；证明最优错误概率指数衰减率上界由实例相关的隐私感知传输指数给出；提出自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI，通过Laplace树机制维护私有运行估计，并在困难备选与臂分配之间通过min–max交互学习采样设计。
AI.result: 证明了AO-Pri-BAI满足纯ε-差分隐私；证明其失败概率指数与隐私感知基准相匹配；数值实验表明即使在非渐近设置下，AO-Pri-BAI在多种实例上优于基准算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了固定预算差分隐私最佳臂识别的隐私感知最优指数刻画，并提出达到该最优指数的实用算法，理论与实验相互印证。

title: Bilinear Flow Policy: Distributional Extrapolation for Goal-Conditioned Visuomotor Imitation
summary: Goal-conditioned imitation learning (GCIL) with flow matching is a promising framework that can represent multimodal behaviors while adapting to diverse, user-specified goals, yet often fails when goals lie outside the demonstration support. To extrapolate to such unseen goals without collapsing multimodality - a problem we call distributional extrapolation - we introduce Bilinear Flow Policy (BFP), a generative visuomotor policy that combines transductive retrieval with a bilinear conditional flow. Given an unseen observation-goal pair, BFP retrieves an "anchor" training example and transductively reformulates the unseen pair as this familiar anchor plus a residual term. For this decomposition to guide action prediction, the residual must compactly encode how the current observation-goal pair differs from the anchor, and the anchor must be chosen so that this difference is predictive of the corresponding action distribution. BFP achieves this with pretrained visual features and a novel learned anchor-selection algorithm. The novel bilinear flow then models how the anchor and the residual jointly determine the multimodal action distribution. We prove that, for bilinear flow under suitable assumptions, action distribution error at unseen goals is bounded by the in-distribution flow-matching error up to problem-dependent factors. Across five manipulation tasks in simulation, BFP achieves 2.63x the out-of distribution success rate of a GCIL policy and 1.36x that of the strongest extrapolation-targeted baseline. On two real-world tasks, BFP improves over GCIL by 32%. Finally, our theory yields practical, pre deployment diagnostics for predicting which trained policies will extrapolate well and to which unseen goal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双线性流策略（BFP），通过转导式检索与双线性条件流结合，解决目标条件模仿学习中目标超出演示支持域的分布外外推问题，在仿真与真实任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 目标条件模仿学习（GCIL）结合流匹配能表征多模态行为并适应多样用户目标，但当目标位于演示支持域之外时常常失败。核心挑战在于：在实现向未见目标外推的同时不破坏多模态性，即"分布外推"问题。
AI.method: BFP 是一种生成式视觉运动策略，包含两个关键组件：（1）转导式检索机制——给定未见观测-目标对，检索一个"锚点"训练样本，将其重构为"熟悉锚点 + 残差项"，残差需紧凑编码当前观测-目标对与锚点的差异，且锚点选择需使该差异对动作分布具有预测性，通过预训练视觉特征与新颖的学习式锚点选择算法实现；（2）双线性条件流——建模锚点与残差如何联合决定多模态动作分布。理论上证明了在适当假设下，双线性流在未见目标处的动作分布误差可由分布内流匹配误差以问题相关因子界定。
AI.result: 在五个仿真操作任务中，BFP 的分布外成功率是 GCIL 策略的 2.63 倍，是最强外推专用基线的 1.36 倍；在两个真实世界任务中，BFP 相较 GCIL 提升 32%。理论还衍生出可用于部署前的诊断方法，预测哪些已训练策略能良好外推以及能外推到哪些未见目标。
AI.conclusion: BFP 通过锚点检索与双线性条件流的结合，在保持多模态性的同时有效实现分布外推，仿真与真机实验验证其优越性，理论上提供了误差界与实用的部署前诊断工具。

title: TRACE: Time-Adaptive Residual Attention Control with Content-Style Decomposition for Training-Free Diffusion Style Transfer
summary: Reference-guided style transfer aims to preserve the semantic structure of a content image while transferring the visual appearance of a style reference. Recent diffusion-based methods achieve impressive stylization quality by exploiting strong pretrained generative priors. However, training-free approaches still face a difficult trade-off among style fidelity, content preservation, and content leakage. Direct style injection may unintentionally transfer semantic content from the style image, while fixed guidance schedules often ignore the time- and state-dependent nature of diffusion sampling. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a training-free diffusion style transfer framework with Time-adaptive Residual Attention Control and Content-Style Decomposition. TRACE first performs offline CLIP-based subspace analysis to separate content and style directions from paired data. During inference, it removes content-related components from the style reference and style-related components from the content reference to reduce leakage. It then injects style information through residual cross-attention and applies uncertainty-aware guidance to adapt the guidance signal at each denoising step. Experiments show that TRACE achieves a favorable trade-off between stylization and preservation. Compared with optimal-control-based baselines, TRACE substantially improves style fidelity (+17.28 CSD and +34.10 SRA). While, compared with stylization methods, it better preserves content structure (+12.80 DINO, +5.52 CLIP-I, and -8.19 LPIPS) and reduces directional semantic leakage by 29.5% in DCL. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pixelchemy-research/TRACE.

AI.tldr: TRACE：免训练扩散风格迁移框架，通过时间自适应残差注意力控制与内容-风格分解，缓解风格保真、内容保留与内容泄漏之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 参考引导风格迁移需在保留内容图像语义结构的同时迁移风格参考的视觉外观。现有基于扩散的免训练方法虽有较强生成先验，但存在三难：直接注入风格会无意迁移风格图中的语义内容（内容泄漏），而固定引导调度忽略了扩散采样过程随时间和状态变化的特性。
AI.method: 提出TRACE，分为三部分：(1) 离线CLIP子空间分析：从成对数据中分离内容方向与风格方向；(2) 推理时分解：从风格参考中剔除内容相关成分、从内容参考中剔除风格相关成分，以降低泄漏；(3) 通过残差交叉注意力注入风格，并采用不确定性感知引导在每个去噪步自适应调整引导信号。
AI.result: 在风格化与内容保留之间取得良好平衡。相比最优控制类基线，风格保真显著提升（CSD +17.28，SRA +34.10）；相比风格化方法，内容结构保留更好（DINO +12.80，CLIP-I +5.52，LPIPS -8.19），并在DCL指标上减少29.5%的方向性语义泄漏。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过时间自适应残差注意力控制与内容-风格分解，有效缓解免训练扩散风格迁移中的内容泄漏与固定引导调度问题，实现风格保真与内容保留的更优权衡。代码已开源。

title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Penumbra，一种面向合规边界的对抗搜索方法，用自适应分配的编辑预算从已验证锚点出发，直到双评估委员会判定翻转，输出跨越合规边界的最小差异响应对，在金融顾问与临床分诊宪法上以更少样本高效覆盖"义务×失败模式"面。
AI.motivation: 代理进入金融、医疗、法律等高风险领域，违规往往没有词汇层面的显著信号，是否构成重大遗漏或披露不足取决于响应"漏掉"了什么。检测这类义务需要找到距离合规翻转仅差一个最小编辑的响应，而每次探测都需一次生成加两次判定，因此监管红队的核心瓶颈是样本效率而非数据量。
AI.method: Penumbra 采用对抗搜索：从已验证的合规锚点出发，在逐步扩大的编辑预算下搜索，直到双评估委员会改变判定，并输出跨越判定变化的两条相邻响应对。候选分配为自适应式（非均匀），优化目标为"失败面"覆盖——每个候选解决的（义务×失败模式）不同单元数。
AI.result: 匹配预算下，自适应分配在 59% 的候选上达到均匀分配全预算的覆盖；等记录数下覆盖失败模式是朴素枚举的 1.43 倍，且增益局限于其目标轴。在金融顾问宪法的 60 条筛选义务上返回 144 对（合规/违规、委员会判为边界两侧、仅差几个词），而直接要求模型同时生成两者的文本几乎无重合。临床分诊宪法的 18 条义务上复现：49 对，同样紧致，最难模式一致。
AI.conclusion: 这类响应对揭示了义务自身条款失效的位置，正是部署代理必须被测试的对照点；搜索成本随边界规模而非文本规模扩展，为高风险领域的合规红队提供了高效可扩展的测试范式。

title: Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models
summary: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.

AI.tldr: 将自动课程学习建模为序列决策问题，指出决定课程决策价值的量与常用局部学习信号所捕捉的信息之间存在差距，并提出结合在线学习进度估计与LLM推理的课程选择方法，在Craftax的256个文本目标基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 自动课程学习能通过随时间选择呈现给智能体的训练经验来提升强化学习效果，但预测此类决策的后果较为困难。常用以指导课程的局部学习信号（如即时学习进度）所包含的信息，不足以反映决定课程决策真实价值的关键量，因此需要引入更丰富的信息来源。
AI.method: 将自动课程学习形式化为序列决策问题；提出一种方法，把在线学习进度估计与LLM提供的两类估计相结合：(i) 当前任务学习所能带来的潜在下游收益，(ii) 当前直接训练某任务是否可能产生进步。方法在自定义基准上评估，包含Craftax中256个文本目标，并在不同课程目标下进行。
AI.result: 在针对单个目标任务进行优化时，方法取得最显著增益；在针对完整任务集进行优化时，收益因学习者跨任务迁移机制不同而有所差异，从学习速度的适度提升到可持续到训练结束的更大增益不等。
AI.conclusion: LLM可利用关于学习问题的更丰富信息，更好地预判课程决策的后果，从而改进自动课程学习；其效果受课程优化目标与学习者跨任务迁移机制的影响。

title: DASH: A da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid Robots as an Accessible Platform for Surgical Robotics Research
summary: Robotic minimally invasive surgery offers well-documented clinical benefits, but the cost and infrastructure requirements of purpose-built platforms limit access in rural and lower-resourced facilities. Recent work has teleoperated general-purpose robots for laparoscopic tasks and in vivo procedures, but relied on handheld instruments coupled through passive linkages rather than native robotic actuation. Instead, we adapt da Vinci Classic and Xi instruments onto general-purpose robots that can integrate in clinical workflows. We present DASH, a da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid platforms, consisting of two types of adapters that require no modification to the instruments themselves. Each adapter is compatible with many robotic platform load capacities, engages the instrument's native latch, and wirelessly identifies inserted tools to load instrument-specific kinematics and coupling matrices. Teleoperated experiments demonstrate the efficacy of DASH and its benefits for enabling research access to surgical robotic platforms.

AI.tldr: DASH 提出两种无需改装器械的适配器，将 da Vinci Classic 与 Xi 器械装配到通用串/人形机器人上，实现外科器械的原生机器人驱动、无线器械识别与运动学加载，并通过遥操作实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 专用手术机器人平台成本高、基础设施要求高，限制了农村与资源匮乏机构的可及性；现有通用机器人腹腔镜/活体操作研究依赖手持器械加被动连杆，未实现器械的原生机器人驱动。因此需要一种可集成到临床工作流的低成本、通用化方案。
AI.method: 提出 DASH（da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid platforms），包含两类适配器，均不改动器械本体；适配器兼容多种机器人负载能力，可啮合器械原生锁扣（native latch），并通过无线方式识别插入的器械，从而加载器械专用运动学与耦合矩阵，随后开展遥操作实验验证。
AI.result: 遥操作实验证明 DASH 有效，并展示了其在为手术机器人平台提供研究访问途径方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: DASH 通过通用适配器把 da Vinci 器械接入通用机器人平台，降低了专用平台依赖，为资源受限场景下的机器人微创手术研究与推广提供了可行路径。

title: Robust Tensor Completion via Reflective Convolution Nuclear Norm Minimization
summary: Robust tensor completion recovers multidimensional data from partial observations corrupted by sparse gross errors. Existing convolutional low-rank models typically construct translated copies using circular continuation, which introduces artificial wrap-around neighborhoods for finite nonperiodic data. We propose reflective convolution nuclear norm minimization (RCNNM), which replaces circular shifts with endpoint-nonrepeating reflection. The resulting lifting has nonuniform entry multiplicities and satisfies a weighted Gram identity that supports both the recovery analysis and the optimization method. Under random sampling and sparse corruption, we establish high-probability exact recovery of the underlying tensor and sparse errors, together with stability under bounded dense perturbations. We further develop a two-block ADMM with a closed-form entrywise tensor update, while singular-value thresholding is implemented through the smaller right Gram matrix. Experiments on synthetic tensors, BSDS color images, and CAVE multispectral images show that RCNNM consistently improves over its circular-lifting counterpart, with the clearest gains near image boundaries. In particular, average boundary-PSNR improvements reach 3.26 dB while global reconstruction quality remains competitive.

AI.tldr: 提出反射卷积核范数最小化（RCNNM），用端点不重复反射替代循环平移构建卷积低秩模型，实现鲁棒张量补全，在理论上给出精确恢复保证并在图像实验中显著提升边界重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有卷积低秩模型通过循环延拓构造平移副本，对有限非周期数据会引入人为的环绕邻域，导致边界处建模失真，影响鲁棒张量补全的精度，尤其损害图像边界区域的重建质量。
AI.method: 用端点不重复的反射操作替代循环移位构建卷积低秩表示；由此得到的提升（lifting）具有非均匀的元素重数，并满足加权Gram恒等式，用于支撑恢复分析与优化求解；提出双块ADMM算法，张量更新为逐元素闭式解，奇异值阈值通过规模更小的右Gram矩阵实现。
AI.result: 在随机采样与稀疏损坏下，证明以高概率精确恢复潜在张量与稀疏误差，并在有界稠密扰动下具有稳定性；在合成张量、BSDS彩色图像与CAVE多光谱图像上，RCNNM一致优于循环提升对应方法，边界处增益最明显，平均边界PSNR提升最高达3.26 dB，同时全局重建质量保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 反射卷积核范数最小化有效缓解了循环延拓带来的边界伪影，兼具理论恢复保证与高效数值算法，是一种更适合有限非周期多维数据的鲁棒张量补全方法。

title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
comment: Accepted at the Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 21 pages (9 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: A verifier for an agent faces rules of two kinds: the ones a fixed check can settle and the ones that require a judge. A team that derives its own checks fixes that split up front. Where the requirements come from outside, as in finance, healthcare and law, the agent enforces rules it did not write, so the split falls to runtime, recurring for every predicate of every rule on every action at a rate no reviewer can audit. Every escalation scheme assumes a model can make that decision itself, that it is self-decidable. Across six corpora, including the EU AI Act, FINRA guidance and a deployed credit agent, we collect roughly 22,000 labels from four models built by three labs. They agree almost perfectly where the answer is obvious and collapse on regulatory text; their errors run in opposite directions, so no model can be trusted as the conservative choice; and on the deployed agent's own rule-set they err together, over-claiming that a fixed check will do, the direction that never gets escalated. We introduce CoVer (corroborate-then-verify), which treats unanimity as a nomination, admitting a predicate only when the check synthesized for it survives intervention, reading fields the agent cannot write and holding under deterministic rewording. That gate rejects most of what corroboration wrongly admits, at a cost in coverage we report rather than tune away. The obvious alternative, agreement with a reference judge, certifies nothing: it climbs from 30% to 77% across calibration bands while the genuinely decidable share does not move, because a judge drawn from the population under indictment ratifies the blind spot it shares. Self-decidability is not a capability to elicit from a model but a boundary the verifier must construct.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoVer（corroborate-then-verify）框架：将多模型一致（unanimity）视为"提名"而非判决，只有当为某谓词合成的固定检查通过干预与改写稳健性检验时才接纳为"可固定检查判定"的谓词；该门控能剔除大部分被一致性错误接纳的谓词，代价是覆盖率下降。
AI.motivation: 在金融、医疗、法律等外部规范驱动的场景中，agent 执行的是自己并未撰写的规则，因此"哪些谓词可由固定检查裁定、哪些需要评判者（judge）"这一划分无法在构建时确定，只能在运行时对每条规则、每个动作反复判定，规模超出人工审计能力。现有升级（escalation）方案都假设模型能自行做出该判断，即"自可判定性（self-decidability）"，但这一假设缺乏依据。
AI.method: 作者在六个语料库（含 EU AI Act、FINRA 指引及一个已部署的信贷 agent）上，从三个实验室的四个模型收集约 22,000 条标注，考察模型在"固定检查是否足够"上的判断一致性、错误方向与误差相关性。基于此提出 CoVer：以多模型一致性作为提名，仅当为该谓词合成的检查在干预（intervention）下存活、读取 agent 无法写入的字段、并在确定性改写下保持稳定时，才将其接纳为可固定检查判定的谓词。
AI.result: 模型在答案显而易见处几乎完全一致，但在监管文本上崩溃；其错误方向相反，因此没有任何单一模型可被当作保守选择；在已部署 agent 的规则集上，模型们则同向出错——共同高估"固定检查足够"，而这恰是从不会被升级的方向。CoVer 的门控拒绝了大部分被一致性错误接纳的谓词，代价是覆盖率下降（作者如实报告而非调优掩盖）。对照方案——与一个参考评判者保持一致——无法提供任何认证：其一致率随校准区间从 30% 升至 77%，而真正可判定谓词的比例并未变化，因为参考评判者来自被质疑的模型群体，会为其共享的盲区背书。
AI.conclusion: 自可判定性不是可从模型中"引出"的能力，而是验证器必须主动构建的边界；一致性只能作为提名信号，必须辅以干预与改写稳健性检验方能确立可固定检查判定的谓词。

title: Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems
summary: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示扩散模型逆问题求解器在输出空间优化的理论缺陷，提出输入空间优化方法FunBCS，并证明其可正确最小化未观测误差，实验中重建误差降低27-64%且加速1.4-2.1倍。
AI.motivation: 从极稀疏观测中恢复PDE系数场是严重病态的逆问题，生成式方法（如扩散模型）已成为编码先验的主流。现有SOTA扩散求解器在函数空间的输出空间（去噪器输出）中寻找物理一致解，但在不连续PDE场景下，作者证明这类输出空间方法无法正确最小化未观测区域的误差，导致重建失败。
AI.method: 提出FunBCS（Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling），一种输入空间优化方法：通过优化去噪器的输入，使去噪器重建结果满足物理一致性。作者从理论上证明FunBCS能够正确最小化未观测误差，并基于理论分析给出在采样过程中动态分配输入空间优化步数的策略。
AI.result: 在四个PDE逆问题（含不连续Darcy流）上评估，FunBCS相比当前SOTA将重建误差降低27%-64%，同时运行速度快1.4-2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 在存在不连续性的PDE逆问题中，输入空间优化优于输出空间优化；FunBCS通过输入空间优化实现了更准确的未观测误差最小化，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Dynamics-Aware Adaptive Corridors with Feasibility-Perturbed Trust-Region SQP for Certified Nonholonomic Motion Planning
summary: Optimisation-based parking planners usually impose collision constraints only at the time samples, so a vehicle corner can cut an obstacle between samples, and no executable trajectory exists until the solver converges. We present a planner for car-like vehicles with reverse gear in which every iterate of the optimisation phase satisfies the discretised dynamics exactly and keeps the whole vehicle rectangle clear of obstacles between the samples. Each time interval receives one convex corridor that holds all vehicle corners at both ends and is shrunk by a sweep margin bounding how far the corner paths leave their chords. Separating half-planes give the corridors a direction out of obstacles when the initial guess is in collision; later, heading-aligned boxes are grown from the speed, curvature and step of the current iterate and rebuilt after accepted steps. A feasibility-perturbed trust-region sequential quadratic programming method projects each step onto the dynamics by feedback and verifies it exactly; the cost decreases monotonically, and once the corridors stop changing, limit points are Karush-Kuhn-Tucker points of the corridor-constrained problem or violate a constraint qualification. On 820 benchmark cases the planner succeeds in 818 without penetration (797 from the first initial guess), none of the 7103 evaluated optimisation-phase iterates is unusable, and it succeeds in 96.5% of the cases when 99% of the initial guesses intersect an obstacle. Its maneuvers take 0.7% longer in the median than those of a similarly certified exact-collision baseline. The guarantees hold for the planning model, not for a physical vehicle.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向带倒挡的类车机器人泊车规划器，保证优化阶段每次迭代均精确满足离散动力学且在采样点之间整车矩形不与障碍碰撞。
AI.motivation: 传统基于优化的泊车规划器仅在时间采样点施加碰撞约束，导致车辆角点在采样间隔内可能切入障碍，且在求解器收敛前不存在可执行轨迹。
AI.method: 为每个时间区间构造一个凸走廊，包含区间两端所有车辆角点，并用扫掠裕度收缩以约束角点路径偏离弦的幅度；初始猜测发生碰撞时用分离半平面给出离开障碍的方向；随后基于当前迭代的速度、曲率与步长生成朝向对齐的箱体，并在接受步后重建。采用可行性扰动信赖域序列二次规划（SQP），通过反馈将每步投影到动力学上并精确验证。
AI.result: 代价单调下降；当走廊不再变化时，极限点为走廊约束问题的KKT点，或违反约束资格条件。820个基准案例中818个成功且无穿透（797个从首个初始猜测即成功），7103个评估的优化阶段迭代无一不可用；当99%初始猜测与障碍相交时成功率达96.5%。中位数机动时长比同类认证的精确碰撞基线长0.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该规划器在规划模型层面提供严格保证（而非物理车辆层面），保证采样间无碰撞与迭代可用性，成功率与轨迹质量优于已有认证基线。

title: Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Preference alignment has become a standard practice for text-to-image diffusion models. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies this process by eliminating explicit reward modeling. Its diffusion variant, Diffusion-DPO, has become a widely adopted baseline. Diffusion-DPO essentially encourages the likelihood of preferred samples while suppressing dispreferred ones. In this paper, we revisit DPO-style alignment methods for diffusion models from the perspective of the manifold hypothesis. Under this view, natural images concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold embedded in the high-dimensional ambient space, whereas DPO directly optimizes preference distributions in the full space without accounting for this geometric structure. This creates a mismatch in the optimization dynamics: it suppresses geometry-preserving tangential updates, while insufficiently restricting hazardous normal-direction updates. This mismatch gradually degrades image quality and diversity. To address this issue, we propose Anisotropic Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization (APO), which replaces the uniform Euclidean treatment of prediction errors with a geometry-aware anisotropic metric derived from the reference model. Concretely, APO adaptively strengthens regularization in directions where the reference denoising function is highly sensitive, while relaxing constraints in directions that permit safe semantic adjustment. This recalibrates preference optimization according to the local manifold geometry, and maintains the original manifold structure. Experiments show that APO achieves strong performance and an average win rate exceeding 60\% against various existing alignment methods across diverse benchmarks. It requires significantly fewer training steps than prior methods, and preserves generation diversity throughout training.

AI.tldr: 本文从流形假设视角重新审视扩散模型的DPO式偏好对齐，指出其在全空间优化偏好分布会忽视图像的低维流形几何结构，导致切向更新被抑制、法向更新约束不足，进而损害图像质量与多样性。为此提出各向异性几何感知偏好优化（APO），用参考模型导出的几何感知各向异性度量替代均匀欧氏度量，在参考去噪函数敏感方向加强正则、在可安全语义调整方向放松约束，从而按局部流形几何重校准偏好优化。实验显示APO在多个基准上对现有对齐方法的平均胜率超过60%，训练步数显著减少且全程保持生成多样性。
AI.motivation: Diffusion-DPO已成为文本到图像扩散模型偏好对齐的常用基线，其本质是提升偏好样本似然、抑制非偏好样本似然。但作者指出，该方法直接在完整高维空间中优化偏好分布，未考虑自然图像集中于低维流形的几何结构。这种几何结构缺失造成优化动力学不匹配：抑制了保持几何的切向更新，同时对有害的法向更新约束不足，最终逐步降低图像质量与多样性。因此需要一种能遵循局部流形几何的对齐方法。
AI.method: 作者提出各向异性几何感知偏好优化（APO）。其核心是用从参考模型导出的几何感知各向异性度量，替代对预测误差的均匀欧氏处理。具体而言，APO在参考去噪函数高度敏感的方向上自适应加强正则化，在允许安全语义调整的方向上放松约束，从而依据局部流形几何重新校准偏好优化，并维持原有的流形结构。
AI.result: 在多种基准上，APO对各类现有对齐方法取得较强性能，平均胜率超过60%。相比先前方法，APO所需训练步数显著更少，并且在整个训练过程中保持生成多样性。
AI.conclusion: 从流形假设视角分析DPO式扩散对齐，可解释其质量与多样性退化的根源在于忽视低维流形几何。APO通过各向异性几何感知度量重校准偏好优化，在有限训练步数下取得高胜率并维持多样性，表明将流形几何纳入偏好优化是有效且高效的方向。

title: Learning to Clarify Underspecified Intents Under Limited Interaction
summary: AI assistants receive requests that leave out information needed for a good outcome, for example about users' preferences or goals. They must then either speculate or ask for more information before proceeding. We reconceptualize this as a value-of-information problem: the assistant should acquire information whose absence causes the greatest avoidable loss in user utility. This is rarely known ex ante; rather, assistants must predict it in order to optimally allocate limited user interactions. We instantiate this problem in image generation and derive a reinforcement learning framework using multi-turn simulated users to maximize utility recovery under uncertainty. In a preregistered study with 456 interactive sessions across 76 human participants, this helped users significantly better match reference images with significantly fewer questions, less total interaction time, and lower cost. This points toward a simple and scalable framework for training language model assistants to better disambiguate user intent by asking more informative questions.

AI.tldr: 将"AI助手信息不足时该问什么"重构为信息价值(Value-of-Information)问题，用多轮模拟用户的强化学习框架训练助手提出信息量最大的问题，并在图像生成任务的人体实验中验证其显著提升效率与效果。
AI.motivation: 用户请求常缺失偏好或目标等关键信息，助手只能猜测或追问。现有做法缺乏对"哪些缺失信息最值得获取"的原则性判断，而这类信息价值事前往往不可知，助手需要在有限交互预算下对其做出预测并最优分配提问资源。
AI.method: 把澄清式提问形式化为价值信息问题：获取"缺失所导致用户效用可避免损失最大"的信息。在图像生成任务上实例化，构建基于强化学习的训练框架，使用多轮模拟用户，在不确定性下最大化用户效用的恢复程度。
AI.result: 预注册研究共76名被试、456次交互会话。相比基线，该框架使用户生成的图像与参考图像匹配度显著更高，同时提问次数显著更少、总交互时间更短、成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果指向一个简单且可扩展的框架，可用于训练语言模型助手通过提出更具信息量的提问来更好地消解用户意图歧义。

title: The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models
summary:
Numerical Linear Algebra (NLA) has consistently played a vital role in advancing science by providing tools to solve fundamental problems encountered in scientific and engineering applications. Over the decades, it has continually evolved to meet the demands driven by successive waves of scientific discovery. For instance, during the 1950s and 1960s, substantial efforts were devoted to developing methods for solving eigenvalue problems that emerged from the rapidly growing field of aerodynamics. This led to the discovery of the LR and QR algorithms. Later the attention turned to the solution of sparse linear systems that were common in applications like computational aerodynamics. Today we are experiencing yet another wave of major scientific advancement and NLA is once more at the heart of its development. This Machine Learning (ML) wave is proving to be utterly disruptive in science and engineering. Many tools in ML particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) are grounded in matrix and tensor methods. As we are approaching Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), it is clear that matrix methods will be called to play an even more significant role. For the numerical linear practitioner the speed of the current change makes it particularly challenging to adapt.
  This is a survey article that centers on machine learning techniques, with a particular focus on large language models. It has two main objectives. The first is to clarify the core concepts behind Large Language Models in a manner accessible to specialists in numerical methods. The second is to examine the key Numerical Linear Algebra concepts employed by LLM techniques, while also highlighting several significant recent contributions of NLA to the field.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，面向数值线性代数（NLA）专家，旨在阐明大语言模型（LLM）的核心概念，并系统梳理LLM技术所依赖的关键NLA概念，同时综述NLA对LLM领域的近期重要贡献。
AI.motivation: NLA长期推动科学进步，并随科学发现浪潮不断演进（如空气动力学催生LR/QR算法，稀疏线性系统求解等）。当前机器学习（ML）浪潮具有颠覆性，LLM高度依赖矩阵与张量方法，且随着AGI临近，矩阵方法的作用将更为重要。然而变化速度过快，使数值线性代数研究者难以适应。因此有必要面向NLA专家澄清LLM的核心概念，并梳理其中的NLA基础与贡献。
AI.method: 采用综述（survey）方法：以机器学习技术、尤其大语言模型为焦点，从数值线性代数的视角对相关概念与方法进行梳理与阐释，并总结NLA在该领域的近期重要成果。
AI.result: 文中指出LLM的许多工具以矩阵和张量方法为基础，并强调NLA在LLM技术中扮演关键角色；同时综述了NLA对LLM领域的若干近期重要贡献。摘要未给出具体技术结果或实验数据。
AI.conclusion: 随着ML/LLM浪潮及AGI的发展，矩阵方法将发挥更重要作用；数值线性代数研究者需要适应这一快速变化。本综述通过面向NLA专家解释LLM核心概念并提炼其依赖的NLA概念，旨在连接NLA与LLM两个领域。

title: What the Guard Misses, the Robot Executes: Implied Harm in VLA Instructions
comment: Under review at the SPAIS 2026 workshop (CoRL 2026)
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) act on instructions without being able to refuse, so screening harmful requests falls to monitors. We test whether these monitors catch ordinary robot tasks requested for harmful reasons, holding the task fixed while varying only how explicitly the intent is stated. $π_{0.5}$ completes the task at every level of explicitness, as often as for harmless controls. Text guards flag nearly every blunt request but few implied ones: up to 95% of implied-harm runs end with the task done and no flag raised, and up to 90% even after recalibrating on robot instructions. Monitoring the model's activations does not close this gap. Linear probes separate harmful from harmless instructions almost perfectly in the base language and vision-language models, but this separation weakens after robot training in two model families, most for implied harm.

AI.tldr: 本文测试视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的安全监控机制，发现文本护栏能拦截直白的有害请求，但对隐含有害意图的请求几乎失效：最多95%的隐含有害任务在无告警情况下被执行，重校准后仍达90%，激活监控也无法弥补这一缺口。
AI.motivation: VLA模型会直接执行指令而无法拒绝，因此筛选有害请求的责任落在外部监控器上。作者想探究：当同一个机器人任务被赋予有害意图时，监控器能否识别出来——尤其是在意图表达由直白到隐含变化的情况下。
AI.method: 保持任务本身不变，仅改变意图表述的明确程度，测试$π_{0.5}$模型是否完成任务以及文本护栏是否会告警；随后对机器人指令重新校准护栏，并进一步用线性探针监测模型激活，比较基础语言模型、视觉-语言模型与机器人训练后模型的区分能力。
AI.result: $π_{0.5}$在所有明确度层级都完成了任务，频率与无害对照相当。文本护栏能标记几乎所有直白请求，但很少标记隐含请求：最多95%的隐含有害运行在任务完成且无告警的情况下结束，即使针对机器人指令重校准后仍高达90%。激活监控未能缩小这一差距。线性探针在基础语言与视觉-语言模型中几乎能完美区分有害与无害指令，但在两个模型家族完成机器人训练后这种区分能力减弱，隐含有害情形尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 现有监控手段难以应对表达隐含的机器人有害请求，机器人训练还会削弱模型内部对有害意图的表征可分性，暴露出VLA安全防护的重要漏洞。

title: VisualErase: Dual-Branch Visual Trajectory Redirection for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure is essential for the safe deployment of text-to-image diffusion models, as they may reproduce harmful, copyrighted, or privacy-sensitive content learned from unconstrained large-scale data. Existing methods typically erase unwanted concepts while preserving general generation capability by redirecting target-related text-to-image mappings. However, recent studies show that erased models may still retain visual generative trajectories of target concepts, leaving them vulnerable to adversarial recovery attacks and revealing a fundamental gap between redirecting text-to-image mappings and truly removing visual knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose VisualErase, a new paradigm that redirects concept-bearing visual generative trajectories toward explicitly defined concept-removed outcomes. To enable this redirection, we use structure-preserving image editing to construct content-aligned, concept-removed counterparts for source images, providing explicit visual endpoints that retain non-target content. We then derive a denoising target from each source-to-counterpart pair and use a dual-branch redirection loss to align both text-conditioned and unconditional predictions with this target, since conditional supervision alone does not explicitly constrain generation without textual guidance. To mitigate the adverse effects of concept erasure on non-target generation, we jointly optimize the redirection loss with a counterpart retention loss that matches denoising predictions from the frozen pretrained model. Across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure, VisualErase limits the maximum attack success rate over seven attacks to 0%, 8%, and 0.1%, respectively, while retaining general generation quality. These results highlight the importance of visual trajectory redirection for robust concept erasure beyond text-to-image mappings alone.

AI.tldr: 提出VisualErase，一种将承载概念的视觉生成轨迹重定向到显式"概念移除"结果的概念擦除新范式，在风格、名人、裸露擦除任务上大幅降低攻击成功率（最高分别可降至0%、8%、0.1%）并保持通用生成质量。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型可能复现有害、受版权保护或隐私敏感内容，因此概念擦除对其安全部署至关重要。现有方法主要通过对目标相关文本到图像映射进行重定向来擦除概念，但近期研究表明被擦除模型仍保留目标概念的视觉生成轨迹，易受对抗恢复攻击，暴露出"重定向文本到图像映射"与"真正移除视觉知识"之间的根本差距。
AI.method: 提出VisualErase，将承载概念的视觉生成轨迹重定向至显式定义的概念移除结果。具体地：(1) 利用结构保持的图像编辑为源图像构造内容对齐、概念移除的对应图像，提供保留非目标内容的显式视觉端点；(2) 由每对源图像-对应图像推导去噪目标，并采用双分支重定向损失，同时对齐文本条件预测与无条件预测；(3) 引入对应图像保持损失，匹配冻结预训练模型的去噪预测，以缓解擦除对非目标生成的负面影响，并与重定向损失联合优化。
AI.result: 在风格、名人、裸露三类擦除任务上，VisualErase将七种攻击的最大攻击成功率分别限制在0%、8%和0.1%，同时保持通用生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅重定向文本到图像映射不足以实现稳健的概念擦除，视觉轨迹重定向对于鲁棒概念擦除具有重要意义，VisualErase为弥合"重定向映射"与"真正移除视觉知识"之间的差距提供了有效途径。

title: PyINE: A Framework for Scalable Elicitation and Oversight via Code Execution
summary: Reasoning models can remain capable of solving a task while still defaulting to cheaper but misleading shortcuts. This creates a central oversight problem: when a model gives an answer with plausible but incomplete reasoning, can an overseer determine whether that output should be trusted? To study this problem, we introduce PyINE, a framework for scalable elicitation and oversight using instrumented Python programs as a verifiable execution substrate. In PyINE, programs define task environments, execution traces provide authoritative labels for outcomes and intermediate facts, and task variants can be generated mechanically rather than through static human annotation. We instantiate the framework in PyINE-v1, a first release built from nearly one million deterministic execution traces and over 500,000 matched LLM-generated code variants used for counterfactual evaluation. Using standard RL with verifiable rewards on cue-varied tasks, we train a shortcut-following model that improves substantially at predicting execution outcomes while still making systematic errors when misleading human-facing cues conflict with the program's realized behavior. We then evaluate activation probes, trained text classifiers, prompted judges, and a lightweight debate protocol as overseers of this model. We find that performance pooled at the dataset level can hide weak coverage of the failures that matter most: cheap learned overseers often miss rare shortcut-driven errors, while stronger model-based checks are more balanced but substantially costlier and harder to turn into reliable thresholded decisions. PyINE-v1 turns this failure-mode coverage problem into a reusable experimental setting for developing oversight methods that are verifiable, failure-mode-aware, and cost-sensitive.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PyINE框架，以可插桩的Python程序作为可验证的执行基底，构建近百万条执行轨迹与50万余个匹配代码变体，训练出"走捷径"的推理模型，并系统评测多种监督方法，揭示数据集层面平均性能会掩盖对关键失败模式的覆盖不足。
AI.motivation: 推理模型往往在仍能完成任务的同时，默认采用更省力但具误导性的捷径。当模型给出看似合理却不完整的推理时，监督者难以判断该输出是否可信。现有研究缺乏可扩展、可验证、能机械生成任务变体的实验环境来研究这一问题。
AI.method: 提出PyINE框架：用可插桩的Python程序定义任务环境，执行轨迹为结果与中间事实提供权威标签，任务变体可机械生成而非依赖静态人工标注。基于此发布PyINE-v1，由近百万条确定性执行轨迹与50万余个匹配的LLM生成代码变体构成，用于反事实评估。以标准RL与可验证奖励在提示线索变化的任务上训练一个捷径跟随模型，并评测激活探针、文本分类器、提示式评判者以及轻量辩论协议等监督者。
AI.result: 训练的捷径跟随模型在预测执行结果上有明显提升，但当误导性的人类面向线索与程序实际行为冲突时仍产生系统性错误。评测发现：数据集层面汇总的性能会掩盖对最重要失败的覆盖不足——廉价的学习型监督者常漏掉罕见的捷径驱动错误，而更强的基于模型的检查更均衡但成本显著更高，且难以转化为可靠的阈值化决策。
AI.conclusion: PyINE-v1将失败模式覆盖问题转化为可复用的实验场景，为开发可验证、失败模式感知且成本敏感的监督方法提供了基础。

title: Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression
summary: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

AI.tldr: 提出正则化对偶平均演员-评论家(RDA2C)，将回放数据视为累积对偶目标而非单纯离策略样本，通过对聚合优势标签拟合对偶分数模型并经由熵镜像映射导出策略，获得有限时间值间隙分解，在MuJoCo与Atari上超过PPO并匹配SAC。
AI.motivation: 现有演员-评论家方法虽利用回放提高样本效率，但历史数据通常仅被当作当前策略改进更新的离策略样本，其优势估计只服务于最近一次更新，未被充分利用。作者希望赋予回放新的角色，使历史优势估计直接累积进入演员目标。
AI.method: 提出RDA2C：在正则化对偶平均框架下，后续策略由累积的策略改进反馈决定。方法存储带评论家估计优势标签的状态-动作样本，对聚合数据集拟合对偶分数模型Z_θ，并用熵镜像映射从累积分数模型导出当前策略，使回放定义经验对偶目标。理论分析建立有限时间值间隙分解，将正则化对偶平均项与陈旧回放监督拟合误差、评论家偏差、有限缓冲方差、回放覆盖误差分离，并给出各误差有界的假设。
AI.result: RDA2C可接受任意评论家的优势标签。使用GAE标签时，在8个MuJoCo任务中6个、12个Atari游戏中8个超过PPO；在8个MuJoCo任务中6个超过最接近的对偶平均基线AAPDA；使用twin-Q标签时，在匹配批大小与更新频率下匹配SAC的性能。
AI.conclusion: RDA2C通过对偶平均视角重新定义回放的作用，使历史优势估计直接贡献于演员目标，兼具理论保证与跨任务、跨优势标签来源的实证优势，表明累积对偶目标是一种有效的策略优化途径。

title: Transporting Unsecured Stacked Payloads with a Quadrupedal Robot via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
summary: Transporting unsecured payloads with legged robots over uneven terrain requires balancing locomotion performance and payload stability, since aggressive motion can destabilize the payload even when the robot remains stable. We study quadrupedal transportation of unsecured stacked boxes on an edgeless torso-mounted board without dedicated payload sensors or active carrier mechanisms. To address this trade-off, we propose Payload-Adaptive Multi-Objective Reinforcement learning for Transportation (PAMORT). PAMORT trains a multi-objective base policy conditioned on a preference vector that weights locomotion and payload-stability reward groups, then trains a weight adjuster on the frozen policy to adapt this preference online from proprioception. In simulation, PAMORT achieves comparable or better overall transportation success than a corresponding single-objective baseline across different payload configurations, including an unseen three-box stack, despite training only with two boxes. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 demonstrate zero-shot transfer to slopes and steps at or beyond the training difficulty, with mean success rates of 0.850 for PAMORT and 0.675 for the baseline across eight tasks. These results demonstrate robust unsecured-payload transportation with online adaptation of the locomotion--payload trade-off from proprioceptive information.

AI.tldr: 提出PAMORT：面向四足机器人运输未固定堆叠箱体的载荷自适应多目标强化学习框架，通过在线调整运动—载荷稳定性偏好实现鲁棒运输。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人在崎岖地形运输未固定载荷时，需权衡运动性能与载荷稳定性：即使机器人稳定，激进运动仍可能导致载荷失稳。且任务中无专用载荷传感器、无主动承载机构，仅在无边缘躯干托板上放置堆叠箱体，难以直接获取载荷状态。
AI.method: 提出PAMORT（Payload-Adaptive Multi-Objective Reinforcement learning for Transportation）。先训练以偏好向量为条件的多目标基础策略，偏好向量对运动奖励组与载荷稳定性奖励组进行加权；再在冻结的基础策略上训练权重调节器，基于本体感知（proprioception）在线自适应调整偏好权重。
AI.result: 仿真中，PAMORT在不同载荷配置下整体运输成功率与对应单目标基线相当或更优，并泛化到仅用两箱训练时未见过的三箱堆叠。Unitree Go2真机实验实现零样本迁移到训练难度及以上的斜坡与台阶，八项任务平均成功率PAMORT为0.850、基线为0.675。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅依靠本体感知信息即可在线自适应运动—载荷权衡，实现未固定载荷的鲁棒运输；PAMORT在仿真与真机上均优于单目标基线，并具备对未见堆叠配置与更高难度地形的泛化能力。

title: PortraitAes: Intent-Conditioned Structured Portrait Aesthetics Assessment
summary: Portrait aesthetic assessment assigns comparable scores according to how effectively human-centered images fulfill their photographic intent. These scores support data filtering, candidate selection, and preference modeling in image-generation pipelines. Existing methods typically predict a single aesthetic score or use general-purpose MLLMs without conditioning on photographic intent. This omission matters because the same blur, pose, lighting, or framing choice may serve one photographic intent but undermine another. These models thus learn context-agnostic aesthetic priors and yield inconsistent, inaccurate, misleading judgments for portraits with distinct photographic objectives. We introduce PortraitAes-Bench, an 11K-scale benchmark that decomposes this task into intent-conditioned subjudgments. Expert-authored rubrics define nine photographic intents, six first-level dimensions, and 22 secondary criteria. They support a structured pipeline for intent routing, specialist assessment, verification, and score fusion. Following this structure, we train PortraitAes with multi-task supervision. We then improve score comparability through Gaussian score calibration and within-dimension cross-image ranking. On the standard benchmark, PortraitAes achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.924 and a Spearman rank correlation of 0.934. On the hard-case set, its Pearson correlation is 0.829 and its Spearman rank correlation is 0.795. Across both sets, PortraitAes outperforms the evaluated general-purpose MLLMs and specialized aesthetic baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出人像美学评估基准 PortraitAes-Bench（11K规模、意图条件下的子判断）及模型 PortraitAes，通过多任务监督、高斯分数校准与维度内跨图排序，在标准基准上达 Pearson 0.924 / Spearman 0.934，难例集上达 0.829 / 0.795，优于通用 MLLM 与专用美学基线。
AI.motivation: 现有人像美学评估方法通常只预测单一美学分数，或使用未以"摄影意图"为条件的通用多模态大模型。作者指出这一缺陷至关重要：同样的模糊、姿态、光线或构图选择，可能服务于某一种摄影意图，却会损害另一种意图。因此这些模型学到的是与语境无关的美学先验，对具有不同摄影目标的人像会给出不一致、不准确甚至误导性的判断。此外，这些分数在图像生成流程中用于数据过滤、候选筛选与偏好建模，精度不足会直接影响下游效果。
AI.method: 1) 构建 PortraitAes-Bench，一个 11K 规模基准，将任务分解为"意图条件下的子判断"；2) 由专家撰写评分细则，定义 9 种摄影意图、6 个一级维度与 22 项二级准则，并支撑"意图路由 → 专家评估 → 验证 → 分数融合"的结构化流水线；3) 依据该结构，以多任务监督训练 PortraitAes；4) 通过高斯分数校准（Gaussian score calibration）与维度内跨图像排序（within-dimension cross-image ranking）提升分数可比性。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，PortraitAes 的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.924，Spearman 秩相关系数为 0.934；在难例集上，Pearson 为 0.829，Spearman 为 0.795。在两个集合上均优于所评估的通用 MLLM 与专用美学基线。
AI.conclusion: 将人像美学评估显式地条件化于摄影意图，并配合专家细则驱动的结构化分解与校准排序，可显著提升评估的准确性、一致性与可比性，且优势在难例上依然保持。

title: Toward a Locally Deployable Agentic Co-Scientist: Small-Model Planning for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the AI for Drug Discovery Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Early-stage computational drug discovery requires coordinating heterogeneous scientific tools across multi-step workflows. We present a lightweight, tool-augmented framework in which a locally deployable compact language model plans calls to 18 modular tools. A Unified Molecular Schema maintains shared molecular records, while a plug-in interface supports tool replacement and extension. We construct 1,263 manually refined query-plan pairs through workflow-graph path coverage and apply LoRA fine-tuning to three compact model families. Under the query-level split, all fine-tuned models generate fully parseable and schema-compliant plans on 47 held-out cross-group queries. Llama 3.2-3B achieves a tool-selection F1 of 0.998, sequence exact match of 0.979, and argument F1 of 0.960. Under the stricter workflow-grouped split, which excludes identical ordered tool sequences across partitions, sequence exact match reaches 0.452 to 0.548, highlighting the remaining difficulty for compact models in generating complete workflow paths unseen during training. These results demonstrate the feasibility of compact, locally deployable planning while identifying compositional generalization as an important direction for further improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级工具增强框架，用本地可部署的紧凑语言模型规划对18个模块化工具的调用，通过统一分子Schema与插件接口实现工具替换扩展，并基于1263个精修查询-计划对进行LoRA微调；在查询级划分下性能接近饱和，但在更严格的工作流分组划分下序列精确匹配仅为0.452–0.548，表明组合泛化仍是紧凑模型的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 早期计算药物发现需要在多步工作流中协调异构科学工具，而现有方案往往依赖大型模型或云端服务，难以本地部署与灵活扩展。作者希望验证紧凑模型能否胜任工具调用的规划任务，并明确其在未见工作流上的泛化能力边界。
AI.method: 提出轻量级、工具增强的规划框架：紧凑语言模型在本地部署并生成工具调用计划，覆盖18个模块化工具；使用统一分子Schema维护共享分子记录，通过插件式接口支持工具替换与扩展。基于工作流图的路径覆盖策略构建1263个手工精修的查询-计划对，并对三个紧凑模型家族进行LoRA微调，分别在查询级划分与工作流分组划分下评估。
AI.result: 在查询级划分下，所有微调模型对47个跨组留出查询均生成可完整解析且符合Schema的计划；Llama 3.2-3B取得工具选择F1 0.998、序列精确匹配0.979、参数F1 0.960。在排除跨划分相同有序工具序列的工作流分组划分下，序列精确匹配降至0.452–0.548。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明紧凑、可本地部署的规划方案在药物发现工作流中具有可行性，但紧凑模型在生成训练中未见的完整工作流路径时仍存在明显困难，组合泛化是后续改进的重要方向。

title: Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models
summary: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了神经图编辑距离(GED)模型的跨图集合迁移能力,发现同集合内性能与跨集合迁移之间存在显著差距,多源训练可显著提升零样本迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 神经GED方法在标准的同数据集(within-dataset)评估下表现优异,但这些模型能否跨图集合迁移尚不清楚。传统评估仅提供泛化能力的部分视角,需要更广泛的异构图集合评估。
AI.method: 在多种图数据集上使用精确GED监督,对一系列具有代表性的基于学习的GED方法进行系统性跨集合迁移研究,并分析源-目标方向及集合结构特征对迁移行为的影响。
AI.result: 同集合性能与跨集合迁移之间存在明显差距:在训练集合上表现良好的模型,在结构不同的数据上往往丧失优势。多源集合训练可显著改善零样本迁移,并为新目标集合的有限监督提供更好的起点。迁移行为随源-目标方向及所涉集合的结构特征而变化。
AI.conclusion: 传统同集合评估仅能部分反映神经GED模型的泛化行为,应推动在异构、多样图集合上的更广泛评估。

title: Dual-Rate Force-Image Control with Model-Based Orientation Limits for Robotic Ultrasound
summary: Robotic ultrasound couples a high-rate contact-force loop with slower, delayed image feedback, so image-guided ultrasound probe rotation can perturb contact force before the resulting image response is observed. We derive a closed-form orientation-rate limit that bounds the modeled rotation-induced estimated-force excursion over a finite horizon while accounting for disturbance rejection by the fast force loop. The limit depends on local contact stiffness, force-loop gains, a conservative rotation-to-force gain bound, the excursion budget, and the prediction horizon. We implement this model in a dual-rate controller with timestamp-based delay reconstruction and joint-torque-based force estimation, and evaluate it on a curved gelatin phantom using paired controller comparisons and component ablations. Relative to unconstrained image guidance, the proposed rate-limited controller reduced first-second root-mean-square (RMS) estimated-force error by 0.40 N while increasing cue-convergence time by 0.94 s. A fixed rate cap near the analytically predicted ceiling produced no resolvable difference in force error and converged 0.32 s faster, indicating that the principal practical value of the model is the rate-design rule rather than online prediction.
