AI.conclusion: MagServo表明无需解析磁模型或位姿估计，直接基于潜在磁特征的分层学习控制可实现高精度、鲁棒的6-DoF磁伺服，并具备良好的泛化能力。

title: CGDD-Net: Context-Guided Dynamic Detail Modeling for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
summary: Accurate retinal vessel segmentation requires features that capture vascular geometry while preserving information for fine-scale reconstruction. We propose CGDD-Net, a context-guided dynamic detail modeling network that connects adaptive feature extraction to a shared decoder pathway. Context-Guided Scale-Adaptive Deformable Encoding (CSDE) combines fixed-grid convolution with deformable local attention to capture vascular patterns at multiple spatial extents. Spatially Adaptive Multi-Kernel Gating (SAMG) selects receptive-field responses at each location. Dynamic Cross-Scale Detail Fusion (DCDF) aligns the gated intermediate features and compresses them into an eight-channel representation, which is reused at three decoder resolutions together with selected encoder skips. This design consolidates intermediate information before decoding instead of transferring each middle-stage feature through a separate direct skip. On DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, STARE, and HRF, CGDD-Net achieves AUC values of 0.9824, 0.9938, 0.9895, and 0.9874, with F1 scores of 0.8323, 0.8102, 0.8510, and 0.8157, respectively. The complete model contains 1.96 million trainable parameters. In cumulative ablations, the full model improves F1 over the internal baseline by 2.48, 0.61, and 3.49 percentage points on DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, and STARE. Twelve directed cross-dataset experiments further characterize transfer without target-domain adaptation. The results support shared intermediate detail delivery as an effective, parameter-compact architecture for retinal vessel segmentation. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/lixincheng-xcl/CGDD-Net}.

AI.tldr: 提出CGDD-Net视网膜血管分割网络，通过上下文引导的动态细节建模与共享解码路径，在四个数据集上取得高AUC/F1且参数量仅1.96M。
AI.motivation: 视网膜血管分割需同时捕获血管几何特征并保留细尺度重建信息；同时需避免将每个中间层特征经独立直接跳连传输，以提高参数效率与信息整合能力。
AI.method: 包含三个模块：CSDE将固定网格卷积与可变形局部注意力结合以捕获多尺度血管模式；SAMG在每位置选择感受野响应；DCDF对齐门控中间特征并压缩为八通道表示，在三个解码分辨率复用并结合选定编码器跳连。
AI.result: DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE、HRF上AUC分别为0.9824、0.9938、0.9895、0.9874，F1分别为0.8323、0.8102、0.8510、0.8157；模型可训练参数1.96M；累积消融中F1分别提升2.48、0.61、3.49个百分点；另进行12组有向跨数据集实验。
AI.conclusion: 共享中间细节传递是一种有效且参数紧凑的视网膜血管分割架构。

title: Agent Behavior as Code: Efficient and Robust LLM Agents with Programmatic Specifications
summary: AI agents based on foundation models (FMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities to perform complex open-ended tasks. However, they face some common challenges in practice: (a) agent behavior can deviate drastically even for semantically similar tasks, leading to catastrophically propagated errors; (b) high cost and latency due to FM calls, repeated in full whenever a task recurs with different inputs; (c) FMs' limited context and instruction following capability confine how well agents manage the ever-growing execution context and follow complex plans. We introduce $\textbf{A}$gent $\textbf{B}$ehavior as $\textbf{C}$ode $\textbf{Agent}$ (ABCAgent), which uses a symbolic program (e.g., Python code with potential neural functions) to fully specify the agent's behavior at runtime, with a powerful FM agent editing that program for flexibility. Behavior is thus specified without premature variable binding, and its execution is deterministic. We evaluate ABCAgent on six agent benchmarks, two of which we construct to test how well a derived program generalizes to variants of the task it was written for. ABCAgent matches a model-matched neural agent on GAIA and augmented GAIA, and surpasses it where robustness and long control flows matter: 98.3% against 97.3% on GSM-Symbolic ($p = 0.001$), 71.9% against 47.4% $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ on the telecom domain of $τ^2$-bench ($p = 0.0001$), and more records written correctly at every loop length on our control-flow-augmented WorkArena benchmark. For more parametric task families, ABCAgent is also significantly superior in efficiency. Without authoring a new program, ABCAgent solves 92.6% of GSM-Symbolic instances and 20.1% of augmented GAIA variants, which yields $5.2\times$ lower latency and $7.0\times$ lower cost on GSM-Symbolic, 19% lower cost on augmented GAIA, and $9.5\times$ lower agent latency on $τ^2$-telecom.

AI.tldr: 提出 ABCAgent，用符号程序（含神经函数的 Python 代码）在运行期完整刻画智能体行为，由强 FM 智能体编辑程序以保证灵活性；行为无过早变量绑定、执行确定，在多项基准上提升鲁棒性、长控制流表现与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于基础模型的智能体存在三类实践问题：(a) 语义相近任务上行为差异大，错误会灾难性传播；(b) FM 调用成本高、延迟大，任务以不同输入重现时需完整重跑；(c) FM 上下文与指令遵循能力有限，难以管理不断增长的执行上下文与复杂计划。
AI.method: 提出 ABCAgent（Agent Behavior as Code Agent）：用符号程序（如带潜在神经函数的 Python 代码）在运行时完整指定智能体行为，行为以无过早变量绑定的方式定义，执行具有确定性；同时由强大的 FM 智能体编辑该程序以获得灵活性。在六个智能体基准上评估，其中两个为自行构建，用于测试所派生程序对任务变体的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在 GAIA 与 augmented GAIA 上 ABCAgent 与同模型神经智能体持平；在鲁棒性与长控制流关键场景中超越之：GSM-Symbolic 98.3% vs 97.3%（p=0.001），$τ^2$-bench 电信域 $Pass^4$ 71.9% vs 47.4%（p=0.0001），在控制流增强的 WorkArena 上各循环长度写入记录数均更正确。对更参数化的任务族效率显著更优：无需新写程序即可解决 92.6% GSM-Symbolic 实例与 20.1% augmented GAIA 变体，GSM-Symbolic 延迟降低 5.2×、成本降低 7.0×，augmented GAIA 成本降低 19%，$τ^2$-telecom 智能体延迟降低 9.5×。
AI.conclusion: 以符号程序作为智能体行为的完整运行时规范并由 FM 编辑，可同时获得确定性执行、更强鲁棒性与长控制流表现，并在参数化任务族上显著降低延迟与成本。

title: Variance-Optimal Control Variates for Learning with Black-box Feedback
summary: Modern models increasingly learn through black-box oracles such as humans, optimization solvers, and external tools that provide feedback without exposing their internal mechanisms. A common remedy is to learn an (action-)value function as a control variate. In this paper, we first observe that even an exact action-value function can be arbitrarily far from variance-optimal. We show that this gap arises because the value function minimizes the noise in each action's own gradient term, while an action can still affect the rest of the gradient estimator through shared parameters. A simple unbiased correction, at no extra oracle cost, can still reduce its variance by an arbitrarily large factor. Motivated by this, we then prove that the residual variance can be decomposed exactly by actions with no cross terms. This decomposition yields a closed-form variance-minimizing correction for neural-network parameters, which can be computed by a simple projection. Empirically, our correction consistently reduces the variance left by the value function and improves learning across all tasks. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/Zihao-Kevin/black_box_opt.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出精确的动作价值函数作为控制变量未必方差最优，并提出一种无偏、无需额外oracle成本的闭式方差最小化修正，可显著降低梯度估计方差并改善学习。
AI.motivation: 在黑箱oracle（人类、优化求解器、外部工具）提供反馈的场景中，常通过学习（动作）价值函数作为控制变量来降低梯度估计方差；但论文发现即使价值函数精确，其方差也可能任意远离最优，这一现象此前未被充分认识。
AI.method: 1) 分析价值函数在方差层面的偏差来源：价值函数只最小化每个动作自身梯度项的噪声，而动作仍可通过共享参数影响梯度估计器其余部分；2) 提出一种简单的无偏修正，不增加额外oracle调用即可将方差降低任意倍数；3) 证明残差方差可完全按动作分解且无交叉项；4) 基于该分解导出针对神经网络参数的闭式方差最小化修正，可通过简单投影计算。
AI.result: 该修正能一致地降低价值函数残余的方差，并在所有任务上改善学习效果；实验代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 精确动作价值函数并非方差最优控制变量，其残余方差具有可精确分解的结构；利用该结构可得到闭式投影形式的方差最小化修正，从而在无额外oracle成本下提升黑箱oracle学习性能。

title: Do VLAs Understand and Adapt to the Objects They Handle, or Simply Replay Learned Behaviors?
summary: This paper asks whether VLA generalization is grounded in a global understanding of objects' physical properties that enables policies to adapt their motion to unseen setups, or if policies simply replay the motions they've learnt that happen to succeed in new setups. The former reflects genuine generalization; the latter reflects incidental robustness. We first examine awareness of physical properties in seven VLAs by applying linear probing and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to their activations. We find that physical properties, including mass, fragility, deformability, friction and size are less decodable than non-physical properties such as semantic category, material, sound and price in nearly every modality stream. Compared with their base VLMs, robot pre-training weakens the linear encoding of physical properties in the language stream. Neither pre-training nor downstream fine-tuning strengthens the alignment between physical-property differences and activation distances. We then ask whether the weak physical information present in these activations shapes the actions a VLA generates. In a controlled LIBERO case study, we increase the mass of an in-domain object and signal the change through language or vision. Most VLAs use similar lifting behaviour for the heavier and original-mass objects, leading to task success declines. The few exceptions change their behaviour in response to lexical or visual cues rather than to mass itself. These results suggest that VLAs encode physical properties weakly and do not reliably use them to adapt their motion.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验VLA模型的泛化究竟源于对物体物理属性的全局理解，还是对已学动作的复现。通过线性探针与RSA分析七个VLA的表征，并在LIBERO中改变物体质量，发现物理属性编码普遍弱于非物理属性，且模型难以据此调整动作，属于"偶然鲁棒性"而非真正泛化。
AI.motivation: 作者希望厘清VLA在新场景中的成功来源：是真正基于物体物理属性理解而自适应地调整运动，还是仅仅复现了恰好奏效的已学动作。前者为真正的泛化，后者只是偶然的鲁棒性。这一区分对评估机器人基础模型的泛化能力至关重要。
AI.method: 研究分两步：第一，对七个VLA的激活进行线性探针与表征相似性分析（RSA），比较质量、易碎性、可变形性、摩擦、尺寸等物理属性与语义类别、材质、声音、价格等非物理属性的可解码性，并与基础VLM对比，考察预训练与下游微调的影响。第二，在受控的LIBERO案例中增大域内物体质量，并通过语言或视觉信号提示该变化，观察模型动作是否随之调整。
AI.result: 在几乎所有模态流中，物理属性的可解码性均低于非物理属性；相比基础VLM，机器人预训练削弱了语言流中对物理属性的线性编码；预训练与下游微调均未增强物理属性差异与激活距离之间的对齐。在LIBERO案例中，多数VLA对增重物体与原质量物体采用相似的抬升行为，导致任务成功率下降；少数例外是依据词汇或视觉线索而非质量本身改变行为。
AI.conclusion: VLA对物理属性的编码较弱，且不能可靠地利用这些信息调整运动。其在新设置下的成功更多体现为偶然鲁棒性，而非基于物理理解的真正泛化。

title: ReMAP: Restoring the Perceptual Cycle with Reasoning-Time Latent Visual Memory
summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reason for longer, attention to the initial visual input diminishes, weakening visual grounding. Visual memory reintroduces visual evidence during reasoning. We conduct a controlled analysis of visual memory along three axes: curation, organization, and access. We find that local evidence benefits from global context, compact latent representations balance accuracy and visual-context cost, and the utility of memory access depends on the reasoning state. Guided by these findings, we propose ReMAP (Reasoning-Time Memory-Augmented Perception), which couples two complementary latent memories: a static, question-conditioned Global memory that preserves scene and cross-image context, and a dynamic Local memory that uses this context as an anchor while selecting and re-encoding region-level evidence according to the current reasoning state. Both memories return compact latent tokens inserted into the reasoning sequence, and a reinforcement-learning access policy trained with branched rollouts decides when to continue reasoning or invoke Global or Local memory. On ten benchmark families, ReMAP outperforms prior visual-memory methods on all four multi-image benchmarks, exceeding the strongest prior results on MuirBench and MIMIC by 8.38 and 14.84 percentage points. Across four backbone families, enabling memory access improves over the same trained model with memory disabled, and on shared V*Bench, CV-Bench-2D, and MuirBench questions ReMAP reduces the visual tokens entering the reasoning sequence by 51.0-76.8% relative to the native-resolution backbone. Further analyses show that Global and Local memory form distinct yet complementary latent representations. Together, these components restore the perceptual cycle by letting the reasoning state trigger targeted visual retrieval, with the retrieved evidence guiding subsequent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ReMAP框架，通过全局与局部潜在记忆在推理时重新引入视觉证据，缓解多模态大模型长推理中的视觉基础弱化问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型推理越长，对初始视觉输入的注意力越弱，导致视觉基础（visual grounding）退化。作者希望让视觉证据在推理过程中被重新调用，以恢复感知-推理循环。
AI.method: 从curation（记忆内容筛选）、organization（记忆组织方式）、access（记忆访问时机）三轴做受控分析。基于发现提出ReMAP：耦合两种互补潜在记忆——静态、问题条件的Global记忆（保留场景与跨图上下文）和动态Local记忆（以全局上下文为锚，依据当前推理状态选择并重编码区域级证据）。两者返回紧凑潜在token插入推理序列；用分支rollout训练的强化学习访问策略决定继续推理或调用Global/Local记忆。
AI.result: 在十个基准族上，ReMAP在四个多图基准全面超越先前视觉记忆方法；MuirBench与MIMIC分别领先最强基线8.38与14.84个百分点。在四个骨干族上，启用记忆访问均优于同模型禁用记忆；在V*Bench、CV-Bench-2D、MuirBench共享问题上，视觉token相对原生分辨率骨干减少51.0-76.8%。分析显示Global与Local记忆形成互补的潜在表示。
AI.conclusion: ReMAP通过让推理状态触发针对性视觉检索、并让检索到的证据引导后续推理，恢复了感知循环，兼具精度与视觉token效率优势。

title: DICE: Decoupling Capability from Intervention Necessity in LLM Tutoring
summary: Fluent guidance is not the same as useful intervention. LLM tutors are typically trained to generate the next teacher utterance, implicitly assuming that every student turn warrants a response. However, our experiments indicate that this conflates tutoring capability (what to say) with intervention necessity (whether to say it). We introduce DICE, a framework that decouples intervention decisions from response generation by first selecting an explicit pedagogical action. To calibrate this action selection policy, we define Intervention Value (IV), a rollout-grounded counterfactual metric that compares each action against non-intervention. IV shows that many prescribed interventions provide little or no marginal benefit. We further introduce DICE-Bench, a multi-variant math tutoring benchmark with skill-preserving problem variants for session-level evaluation. Using IV-weighted and KL-regularized policy optimization, DICE learns to intervene selectively while preserving tutoring effectiveness. In simulated tutoring sessions, DICE reduces the over-intervention rate to near zero while guiding students to correct solutions in approximately 3-4 fewer turns on average than existing Socratic tutoring baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DICE 框架，将教学中的"是否干预"决策与"如何回应"生成解耦，通过显式选择教学动作实现选择性干预。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 辅导模型通常被训练为预测下一句教师话语，隐含假设"学生的每个回合都需要回应"，从而混淆了辅导能力（说什么）与干预必要性（是否该说）。实验表明大量规定性干预几乎没有边际收益，因此需要解耦决策与生成。
AI.method: 提出 DICE 框架：先进行显式教学动作选择，再生成回应。定义 Intervention Value (IV)——一种基于 rollout 的反事实指标，用非干预作为对照来评估每个动作；采用 IV 加权与 KL 正则化的策略优化来校准动作选择策略。同时构建 DICE-Bench 多变体数学辅导基准，含保持技能不变的问题变体以支持会话级评估。
AI.result: 在模拟辅导会话中，DICE 将过度干预率降至接近零，并比现有苏格拉底式辅导基线平均少用约 3-4 个回合即可引导学生获得正确解法，同时保持辅导有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将干预决策与回应生成解耦、并以反事实干预价值校准策略，可使 LLM 辅导实现更经济且有效的选择性干预，避免无谓的过度指导。

title: Repeated-Measure Leakage, Distribution Shift, and Reliability under Partial Observation in Patient World Models
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Selected for oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS) Replication Package: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/AUZVR
summary: Patient world models are increasingly proposed for longitudinal prediction, intervention-aware reasoning, and clinical-trial simulation. Causal or clinical intervention validity is distinct from predictive generalization and reliability; before making stronger claims, the underlying predictive state should generalize across patients, survive realistic shifts and missing observations, and expose failure through meaningful reliability signals. We evaluate these prerequisites in a deliberately narrow setting: short-horizon digital-biomarker forecasting from PhysioNet GaitPDB, comprising 165 participants, 306 recordings, and 51,129 context-future pairs. Using persistence, ridge, MLP, GRU, Transformer, and a compact JEPA-style predictor, we build an evaluation ladder that progressively removes raw temporal overlap, same-recording familiarity, and same-patient familiarity before testing unseen-patient generalization. For GRU, NMSE rises from 0.1227 under random-window splitting to 0.1393 after eliminating raw train-test overlap and to 0.1961 under patient holdout. Among 54 participants with repeated recordings, exposure to a different recording from the same patient improves GRU NMSE from 0.2177 to 0.1556, while a recording-excluded identity hypothesis is not supported at the participant level. Under participant-held-out evaluation, MLP and Transformer are statistically indistinguishable. Study shift, a four-times-longer prediction gap, and partial observation further degrade performance; under 50% temporal masking, Transformer NMSE rises to 0.611 while MC-dropout predictive variance falls. We do not claim a longitudinal or intervention-aware simulator. Instead, the results support a prerequisite evaluation stack of patient separation, repeated-measure controls, shift, missingness, and uncertainty validation before stronger patient-world-model claims are trusted.

AI.tldr: 本文在窄设定（PhysioNet GaitPDB短时程数字生物标志物预测，165名受试者、306段记录、51,129个上下文-未来对）中，系统检验患者世界模型应具备的先决条件——预测状态的患者间泛化、对真实分布偏移与缺失观测的稳健性、以及有意义的不确定性信号。
AI.motivation: 患者世界模型常被宣称可用于纵向预测、干预感知推理和临床试验仿真，但因果/临床干预效度与预测泛化及可靠性是两回事。在提出更强主张前，底层预测状态应先满足：跨患者泛化、在真实偏移与缺失观测下仍成立、并通过有意义的可靠性信号暴露失败。
AI.method: 在PhysioNet GaitPDB上构建分层的评估阶梯：使用persistence、ridge、MLP、GRU、Transformer和紧凑的JEPA式预测器，逐步去除原始时间重叠、同记录熟悉性和同患者熟悉性，最后测试未见患者泛化；并考察study shift、四倍预测间隔、部分观测（50%时间掩码）及MC-dropout不确定性。
AI.result: GRU的NMSE从随机窗口划分的0.1227升至去除原始训练-测试重叠后的0.1393，再到患者留出下的0.1961。54名有重复记录的受试者中，接触同患者另一段记录使GRU NMSE由0.2177改善至0.1556，但受试者层面上不支持"排除该记录的身份假设"。患者留出评估下MLP与Transformer统计上不可区分。研究偏移、四倍预测间隔和部分观测进一步降低性能；50%时间掩码下Transformer NMSE升至0.611，而MC-dropout预测方差反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 本文不宣称构建了纵向或干预感知的仿真器；结论支持一套先决条件评估栈——患者分离、重复测量控制、偏移、缺失性和不确定性验证——在信任更强的患者世界模型主张之前应先行通过。

title: Adaptive Mean Flow for Responsive Closed-Loop Robot Control
summary: Diffusion- and flow-based robot policies have recently become widespread in robotic Imitation Learning (IL) due to their high performance and ability to model continuous and multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising procedure used by these models introduces significant prediction latency, hindering high-frequency closed-loop robot control and leading to jittery, unstable motion when frequent updates to the robot's action predictions are used. Therefore, it is common practice to train models to predict chunks of actions that can be executed sequentially without feedback, even when this reduces responsiveness and may mean the most recent state information is not used. In this article, we present Adaptive Mean Flow (AMF), a flow-based IL method that enables smooth and responsive, fully closed-loop robot control. AMF uses Mean Flow, which is an accelerated form of Flow Matching (FM), to minimize prediction latency. To ensure smoothness and consistency across predictions, AMF uses a corrupted version of the trajectory from the previous step when predicting new robot actions, with the signal-to-noise ratio increasing over the time parameter of the trajectory. This discourages large changes in the prediction from one step to the next, while allowing freedom to adapt the predictions for future steps. We evaluate AMF across a wide range of simulated and real robot tasks and demonstrate significantly improved performance compared with baselines. Code: https://github.com/akselva/Adaptive-mean-flow-RoboticIL.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应平均流（AMF）方法，将Mean Flow加速采样与基于轨迹腐蚀的时序一致性机制结合，实现平滑、响应式的全闭环机器人控制，在大量仿真与真实任务中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略与流匹配策略虽能建模连续多模态动作分布、性能优越，但其迭代去噪过程带来显著预测延迟，难以支撑高频闭环控制；频繁更新动作预测会导致抖动与不稳定。因此常见做法是预测动作块并顺序开环执行，但这牺牲了响应性，且可能无法利用最新状态信息。
AI.method: AMF是一种基于流的模仿学习方法：1）采用Mean Flow（Flow Matching的加速形式）以最小化预测延迟；2）在预测新动作时，使用上一步轨迹的腐蚀版本作为条件，且信噪比随轨迹时间参数递增。该设计抑制相邻预测间的剧烈变化以保证平滑与一致性，同时保留为未来步骤调整预测的自由度。
AI.result: 在广泛的仿真与真实机器人任务上评估AMF，与基线方法相比性能显著提升。
AI.conclusion: AMF能够实现平滑且响应迅速的全闭环机器人控制，兼顾低延迟与预测一致性，验证了加速流模型与轨迹腐蚀条件机制组合在机器人模仿学习中的有效性；代码已开源。

title: LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration
summary: Recently, unified high-definition image restoration has attracted considerable attention; however, existing models tend to excessively increase their depth in pursuit of improved generalization, which often yields only limited gains. Meanwhile, loop-based learning paradigms have drawn widespread attention due to their low parameter counts and strong regression capability, as exemplified by GPT-6 and looped Transformers. In this paper, we introduce the loop learning paradigm to address restoration tasks that require cross-domain learning. Specifically, we propose LoopMoEVR, a loop-based mixture-of-experts model capable of handling degraded ultra-high-definition (UHD) inputs. First, a degradation-conditioned low-rank loop embedding is designed to construct input-dependent stage conditions. Second, a spatio-temporal iterative adaptive normalization module, termed IterAda3DN, is developed to fuse local features with global loop context, thereby performing position-wise affine modulation. Finally, the expert branches further integrate the attention-updated local and global video states with the loop conditions to generate dedicated modulation parameters, while an input-conditioned depth predictor adaptively configures the number of loop iterations. With only approximately 0.884M trainable parameters, the proposed model uniformly handles UHD video dehazing, deraining, denoising, and low-light enhancement tasks, achieving state-of-the-art restoration performance on both public benchmarks and real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopMoEVR，将循环学习范式引入统一高清图像/视频修复，以约0.884M可训练参数在UHD去雾、去雨、去噪和低光增强任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有统一高清修复模型为提升泛化能力而不断加深网络深度，但收益有限；同时循环学习范式（如looped Transformers）以低参数量和强回归能力受到关注，因此作者希望将循环学习引入需要跨域学习的修复任务。
AI.method: 提出LoopMoEVR，一种面向退化UHD输入、基于循环的混合专家模型。核心设计包括：(1) 退化条件低秩循环嵌入，构建输入相关的阶段条件；(2) 时空迭代自适应归一化模块IterAda3DN，融合局部特征与全局循环上下文以进行逐位置仿射调制；(3) 专家分支将注意力更新的局部与全局视频状态同循环条件结合，生成专用调制参数；(4) 输入条件深度预测器自适应配置循环迭代次数。
AI.result: 仅约0.884M可训练参数，统一处理UHD视频去雾、去雨、去噪和低光增强任务，在公开基准与真实场景上均取得state-of-the-art修复性能。
AI.conclusion: 循环学习与混合专家的结合可在极低参数量下实现跨域统一UHD视频修复，为高清修复提供高效新范式。

title: MemTrace: State-Consistent Memory for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary: As coding agents take on long-horizon software evolution tasks spanning multiple files and stages, longer execution trajectories introduce two coupled challenges: (1) accumulated histories strain context budgets, and (2) repository changes can invalidate earlier execution evidence. Existing approaches address these challenges through techniques like larger context windows, compression, retrieval, or repository representations, but often fail to reconstruct a consistent task state after a context refresh or verify whether recalled evidence remains valid. Thus, we introduce MemTrace, a provenance-aware memory system that preserves execution history and aligns its reuse with the evolving task (e.g., iterative cross-file repair) and repository state. MemTrace stores history as immutable Memory Traces anchored to key information (e.g., files, symbols, tests), and organizes their execution order and dependencies in a Memory Trace Graph. When context is constrained, working memory retains only compact Memory Anchors, from which the agent can reconstruct the latest execution state and locate evidence relevant to its next action. Before restoring historical evidence, MemTrace checks its validity against the current repository state and retrieves only what the next action requires. Across three complementary long-horizon coding benchmarks, MemTrace consistently outperforms all fully evaluated baselines under the same backbone and harness, improving DeepSWE pass@1 by 21.2 points, SWE-EVO Resolved Rate by 4.4 points, and SWE-Milestone Score by 17.8 points under Codex CLI.

AI.tldr: MemTrace 是一个溯源感知的记忆系统，将执行历史存为不可变的 Memory Traces 并以 Memory Trace Graph 组织，通过 Memory Anchors 在上下文受限时重建最新执行状态，并在恢复证据前校验其相对于当前仓库状态的有效性，从而支持长时程跨文件软件演化任务。
AI.motivation: 长时程软件演化任务（跨多文件、多阶段）带来两个耦合问题：1）累积历史挤占上下文预算；2）仓库变更可能使早先的执行证据失效。现有方法（更大上下文窗口、压缩、检索、仓库表示）往往无法在上下文刷新后重建一致的任务状态，也无法验证召回证据是否仍然有效。
AI.method: MemTrace 将执行历史存储为锚定于关键信息（如文件、符号、测试）的不可变 Memory Traces，并用 Memory Trace Graph 组织其执行顺序与依赖关系。在上下文受限时，工作记忆仅保留紧凑的 Memory Anchors，智能体据此重建最新执行状态并定位与下一步动作相关的证据。在恢复历史证据前，MemTrace 会对照当前仓库状态检查其有效性，仅检索下一步动作所需内容。
AI.result: 在三个互补的长时程编码基准上，MemTrace 在相同 backbone 与 harness 下持续优于所有完整评估的基线：Codex CLI 下 DeepSWE pass@1 提升 21.2 个点，SWE-EVO Resolved Rate 提升 4.4 个点，SWE-Milestone Score 提升 17.8 个点。
AI.conclusion: 溯源感知的记忆机制可有效缓解长时程编码智能体的上下文压力与证据失效问题，在多个长时程基准上取得一致且显著的性能提升。

title: DASH: Fast, Valid Counterfactuals for Deep Networks via Batched Directional Search
summary: Counterfactual explanations are most useful when they can be generated with low latency, remain close to the factual input, and satisfy input-domain, categorical, and actionability constraints. Achieving these objectives simultaneously is challenging for deep neural networks. Heuristic methods are often fast but may return invalid counterfactuals, whereas exact methods can certify global proximity but may not finish within practical time limits. We introduce DASH, a batched heuristic search method for finding close, valid, and actionable counterfactuals for deep neural networks under $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$, and $\ell_\infty$ objectives. DASH uses directional Lipschitz bounds and local affine models to generate anchors, then ranks and expands promising regions with batched network evaluations. We compare DASH against nine prior heuristic methods and time-limited exact mixed-integer baselines on four tabular datasets, with network depths from 2 to 32, and evaluate scalability on PBMC3k. Across 9,000 tabular query-norm cases, DASH returns a valid counterfactual within $5\%$ of the best heuristic-observed valid distance in $94.6\%$ of cases, with a median CPU search runtime of $0.061$ s. PGD-bisect, the baseline with the highest pooled within-$5\%$ coverage, meets this criterion in $41.1\%$ of cases, with a median runtime of $0.298$ s. These results show that the proposed search maintains high valid proximity across norms while keeping its search runtime practical.

AI.tldr: 提出DASH，一种批量启发式搜索方法，能在低延迟下为深度神经网络生成接近、有效且可操作的反事实解释，在ℓ1、ℓ2、ℓ∞目标下表现优于九种启发式方法与时间受限的精确混合整数基线。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释需同时满足低延迟、贴近原始输入以及满足输入域、类别和可操作性约束，但深度神经网络很难同时实现。启发式方法快却可能产生无效反事实，精确方法能保证全局邻近性却难以在实用时间内完成。
AI.method: DASH采用方向性Lipschitz界与局部仿射模型生成锚点，再通过批量网络评估对有潜力的区域进行排序和扩展，从而在ℓ1、ℓ2、ℓ∞目标下搜索反事实。
AI.result: 在四个表格数据集（网络深度2至32）上与九种启发式方法及时间受限精确混合整数基线比较，并在PBMC3k上评估可扩展性。在9,000个表格查询-范数案例中，DASH在94.6%的情况下返回距离最佳启发式观测有效距离5%以内的有效反事实，中位CPU搜索时间0.061秒；而覆盖率最高的基线PGD-bisect仅41.1%，中位运行时间0.298秒。
AI.conclusion: DASH在保持实用搜索运行时间的同时，能在不同范数下维持较高的有效邻近性，证明其兼顾了低延迟与解释质量。

title: Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise for Consistent Asynchronous Replanning in Generative Robot Policies
summary: Continuous asynchronous replanning is essential for real-time generative robot policies, but independent stochastic initialization can cause mode switching and inconsistent continuation across action chunks. We propose Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise (EAPN), which introduces structured stochasticity at both inter-chunk and intra-chunk levels. Across replanning steps, EAPN propagates a shared noise trajectory and aligns it with the actual execution displacement, establishing execution-aligned inter-chunk correlation. Within each action chunk, it models temporal correlation along action time. The aligned stochastic history is further combined with committed action context to condition subsequent generation, allowing new chunks to continue from execution-consistent generative states rather than restart from independent noise. We evaluate EAPN on D3IL, Kinetix, LIBERO, and real-world manipulation tasks. EAPN improves multimodal behavior consistency on D3IL and achieves an average success rate of 88.59% on Kinetix. On LIBERO, it remains robust and maintains strong task performance even under long inference delays. Real-robot experiments further achieve 90.0% success on Object Storage and 96.7% on bimanual Cloth Folding, demonstrating reliable continuous execution under asynchronous replanning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise (EAPN)，通过在 chunk 间与 chunk 内引入结构化随机性，缓解异步重规划中的模式切换与不一致延续问题。
AI.motivation: 实时生成式机器人策略需要连续异步重规划，但独立随机初始化会导致动作 chunk 间的模式切换与延续不一致。
AI.method: EAPN 在重规划步间传播共享噪声轨迹，并将其与实际执行位移对齐，建立执行对齐的 chunk 间相关性；在每个动作 chunk 内建模动作时间上的时序相关性；并将对齐后的随机历史与已提交动作上下文结合，条件化后续生成，使新 chunk 从执行一致的生成状态延续，而非从独立噪声重启。
AI.result: 在 D3IL、Kinetix、LIBERO 及真实机器人操作任务上评估。D3IL 上多模态行为一致性提升；Kinetix 上平均成功率 88.59%；LIBERO 上保持鲁棒，在长推理延迟下仍维持强任务性能；真实机器人上 Object Storage 成功率 90.0%，双臂 Cloth Folding 成功率 96.7%。
AI.conclusion: EAPN 通过执行对齐的结构化噪声实现了异步重规划下可靠且连续的机器人操作执行。

title: PCLM: Small-target localization with frozen CLIP via prototype contrast and local magnification
summary: Small targets occupy few patches in a vision-language encoder, so spatial features often mix object appearance with surrounding content. We propose Prototype Contrast and Local Magnification (PCLM), a support-conditioned localization method that uses a frozen CLIP encoder. Five masked support images per class define foreground and background prototypes through equally weighted regional features. Their difference provides a shared scoring direction for query patches, explicitly comparing target evidence with the demonstrated background. Nine overlapping query windows are enlarged and encoded independently to sample small targets more densely. Reprojection and coverage averaging combine their scores into a continuous localization map. The class direction occupies 2 KiB regardless of support count and transfers unchanged across datasets with mapped categories. On 5,047 small-target queries from VOC, COCO, ADE20K and Oxford-IIIT Pets, PCLM achieves higher mean pixel AP than every evaluated text-conditioned localization baseline on each dataset under our evaluation protocol. Gains over the strongest scene-dataset baselines range from 5.63 to 13.23 percentage points. At comparable measured latency, local magnification improves scene small-target AP by 4.51 to 5.68 points over whole-canvas enlargement. Factorial experiments show that prototype contrast increases the benefit of local observation, including under matched image-coordinate filtering. Support-budget experiments show that additional examples refine category estimation without increasing representation size or query-time scoring cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PCLM方法，用冻结CLIP编码器做支撑条件的小目标定位：以五张掩码支撑图构建前景/背景原型，其差值形成类别评分方向，并对九个重叠查询窗口独立放大编码，最终融合为连续定位图。
AI.motivation: 小目标在视觉-语言编码器中占用的图像块极少，导致空间特征常把目标外观与周围内容混淆，定位精度受限。
AI.method: PCLM基于冻结CLIP编码器：每类五张掩码支撑图通过等权区域特征构建前景与背景原型，原型差值给出查询图像块的共享评分方向，显式对比目标证据与示例背景；将九个重叠查询窗口分别放大并独立编码以密采样小目标；通过重投影与覆盖率平均融合各窗口得分，得到连续定位图。类别方向仅占2 KiB且与支撑数量无关，在映射类别下可跨数据集直接迁移。
AI.result: 在VOC、COCO、ADE20K、Oxford-IIIT Pets的5,047个小目标任务查询上，PCLM在所用评测协议下于每个数据集均取得高于所有文本条件定位基线的平均像素AP；相较最强场景数据集基线提升5.63至13.23个百分点；在相近实测延迟下，局部放大比全画布放大在场景小目标AP上高4.51至5.68点；因子实验表明原型对比增强了局部观测收益（包括匹配图像坐标过滤条件下）；支撑预算实验显示增加示例可细化类别估计，且不增加表示规模或查询时评分成本。
AI.conclusion: 原型对比与局部放大可协同提升冻结CLIP下的小目标定位性能，且类表示紧凑、可跨数据集迁移、查询成本不随示例数增长。

title: GitSwarm: Decentralized Compounding Inference
summary: Long-horizon problem solving and scientific research require computation to accumulate across successive attempts. Partial solutions, experimental findings, and unsuccessful approaches can inform later work, yet most inference-time computation is organized around individual trajectories or candidates rather than a persistent body of reusable work. We call this paradigm compounding inference: organizing inference-time computation so that intermediate work persists and can be inspected, extended, combined, or challenged by subsequent computation. We instantiate compounding inference in GitSwarm, an asynchronous system where homogeneous agents independently decide how to advance a task while collaborating through structured persistent memory. Agents explore, experiment, verify, refine, and synthesize previous work in a shared, branch-able Git repository. Atomic commits preserve intermediate artifacts, while explicit semantic dependencies record how later contributions build on work across branches. We evaluate GitSwarm on long-horizon problem solving and sustained GPU-backed experimental research. On IMOProofBench-Advanced, GitSwarm solves all 30 problems in one run using GPT-5.5. On ProgramBench, it achieves a $79.4\%$ mean score, versus $65.1\%$ for the strongest reported baseline under the stated budget. On three neural architecture research tasks (Residual Matrix Transformer, Looped Transformer, NanoChat), GitSwarm improves upon the starting architectures through successive experimentation. Beyond final performance, we measure whether computation accumulates: on ProgramBench, $94.7\%$ of contributions are subsequently built upon, while the selected solution's ancestry covers $82-93\%$ of the contribution graph. These results show that inference-time computation can accumulate across otherwise independent episodes, forming an evolving body of work that subsequent inference can reuse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"复利式推理"(compounding inference)范式，并构建GitSwarm系统，通过共享、可分支的Git仓库让多个同质智能体异步协作、持久化并复用中间成果，在长程推理与实验研究任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 长程问题求解与科学研究需要计算能在多次尝试间累积：部分解法、实验结果乃至失败路径都可为后续工作提供信息。然而当前多数推理时计算(inference-time computation)是按单条轨迹或候选者组织的，而非面向一个可持续复用、可累积的工作体。作者因此提出复利式推理范式，旨在让中间工作持久化并可被后续计算检视、扩展、组合或质疑。
AI.method: 在GitSwarm系统中实例化该范式：这是一个异步系统，同质(homogeneous)智能体各自独立决定如何推进任务，并通过结构化持久记忆协作。智能体在共享、可分支的Git仓库中探索、实验、验证、精炼与综合既有工作；原子提交(atomic commits)保存中间产物，显式语义依赖(explicit semantic dependencies)记录后续贡献如何跨分支构建于前作之上。评估覆盖长程问题求解与持续的GPU实验研究。
AI.result: 在IMOProofBench-Advanced上，使用GPT-5.5一次运行即解决全部30道题。在ProgramBench上平均得分79.4%，而最强已报告基线在给定预算下为65.1%。在三个神经架构研究任务（Residual Matrix Transformer、Looped Transformer、NanoChat）上，GitSwarm通过逐步实验改进了初始架构。除最终性能外，还度量了计算是否真正累积：ProgramBench中94.7%的贡献随后被建基于其上，被选中解法的祖先链覆盖贡献图的82–93%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，推理时计算能够在原本相互独立的回合之间实现累积，形成一个不断演化的工作体，供后续推理复用。这验证了复利式推理范式的可行性与有效性。

title: KALEIDO: Input-Space Adaptation of a Vision Model for Time-Series Forecasting Through Gated Fold Geometries
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS)
summary: Time-series foundation models buy zero-shot forecasting with large temporal corpora; a vision model needs none, since a natural image implicitly embeds the patterns a forecaster must model, and an ImageNet-pretrained masked autoencoder forecasts a series by inpainting a rendering of it. A rendered series is not a natural image, however, and closing that gap takes temporal-aware adaptation. We show that the rendering geometry - how the series is folded and drawn - is a controllable, mixable axis for it. Kaleido detects the dominant periods, renders a rule-generated set of fold geometries, combines the inpaintings with a convex per-position gate fit on validation only, and fuses the result with the zero-shot output at one fixed share, with no per-dataset hyperparameter beyond the baseline's published settings. Training only LayerNorm (0.05%), Kaleido lowers MSE by 13% against the published zero-shot baseline on LTSF and, frozen, by 6.6%; on GIFT-Eval it improves the baseline by 7.4% in MASE and 19.3% in CRPS.

AI.tldr: Kaleido通过"折叠几何"这一可控可混合的维度，改造基于图像修复的零样本时间序列预测器：检测主周期、生成规则化的折叠几何渲染、对修复结果做凸式位置门控融合，再以固定比例与零样本输出融合。仅训练0.05%的LayerNorm参数即可显著超越零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型依赖大规模时序语料来实现零样本预测，而视觉模型无需如此——自然图像本身隐含了预测器所需建模的模式，ImageNet预训练的掩码自编码器可通过"修复"序列的渲染图来完成预测。但渲染出的序列并非自然图像，弥合这一域差距需要时序感知的适配。本文提出：渲染的几何方式（序列如何被折叠并绘制）正是这样一条可控且可混合的适配轴。
AI.method: Kaleido首先检测序列的主导周期，据此生成一组由规则导出的折叠几何；对每种几何渲染图分别做修复预测，再用仅在验证集上拟合的凸式逐位置门控（per-position gate）组合这些修复结果；最后以固定份额与零样本输出融合。除基线已公开的设置外，不使用任何逐数据集超参数，且仅训练LayerNorm层（占参数量的0.05%）。
AI.result: 仅训练LayerNorm时，Kaleido在LTSF上将MSE相对已发布的零样本基线降低13%；冻结状态下降低6.6%。在GIFT-Eval上，MASE提升7.4%，CRPS提升19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 渲染几何为基于视觉的时间序列预测提供了有效且可混合的适配维度。Kaleido以极少的可训练参数（0.05%的LayerNorm）和零逐数据集调参，在多个基准上一致且显著地超越零样本基线，验证了时序感知的几何适配在缩小渲染图与自然图像域差距上的价值。

title: Propagating Elevation-Map Uncertainty Through the Contact Maximum in Closed Form
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: Risk-aware planners score paths on uncertain elevation maps using the path cost's mean and standard deviation. Modeling rigid contact, however, requires computing a maximum over several uncertain cells. First-order propagation loses accuracy here by differentiating at only a single cell, while Monte Carlo sampling requires a full path evaluation per draw. We compute the moments of that contact maximum in closed form using Clark's pairwise recursion. By tracking each contact's covariance against the shared map cells, we propagate the smooth remainder using exact Gaussian quadratic-form identities. A contest-depth calibration, fitted once on two design traverses, closes the aggregate standard-deviation shortfall that remains. On 317 held-out rover path segments, scored against a Monte Carlo reference from the same belief, every pre-registered criterion was met. The corrected Clark fold cuts the median error of the mean from linearization's 2.3% to 0.19% and attains the lowest error in the conditional value at risk (CVaR) at the 90% level of every method tested. A benchmark plan costs just 5.5 microseconds on a GPU. These accuracy gains concentrate at contested contacts. While they seldom change which path is chosen on this terrain, the fold still selects the reference-best path in 98% of decisions against linearization's 93 to 96%. On a second dataset the mean transfers, though the risk number does not.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Clark成对递推的闭式矩传播方法，用于不确定高程地图上机器人路径的接触最大值风险评估，精度显著优于线性化并保持GPU实时性。
AI.motivation: 风险感知规划器依赖路径代价的均值与标准差评估不确定地形，但刚体接触建模需对多个不确定栅格取最大值；一阶传播仅在单个栅格处求导导致精度损失，蒙特卡洛需每次采样完整评估路径，代价过高。
AI.method: 采用Clark成对递推闭式计算接触最大值的矩；通过跟踪每个接触相对共享地图栅格的协方差，利用精确高斯二次型恒等式传播平滑余项；再用一次基于两条设计路径拟合的contest-depth校准修正聚合标准差的残余缺口。
AI.result: 在317条留出巡视器路径段上、以同一信念的蒙特卡洛为基准，各项预注册标准均达成：修正Clark折叠将均值中位误差由线性化的2.3%降至0.19%，在90%水平CVaR上取得所有方法中最低误差；GPU上基准规划仅耗5.5微秒；精度提升集中于争议接触处，98%决策选中参考最优路径（线性化为93–96%）；第二数据集上均值可迁移，风险数值不可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 闭式Clark矩传播在保持微秒级GPU效率的同时大幅提升接触风险估计精度，但精度增益对路径选择的实际影响有限，且风险指标的跨数据集泛化性不足。

title: Representation--Behavior Alignment for Explainable Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural way to make video anomaly detection more explainable. However, their final decisions do not always fully use the discriminative information contained in their hidden states, an issue we refer to as representation--behavior misalignment. We decompose this gap into a capacity component that measures discriminative information never aggregated into the readout position, and a directional component that measures the angular mismatch between the optimal and the native normal--abnormal axis at that position. Across multiple video anomaly detection benchmarks and MLLM backbones the directional component dominates, and residual-stream tracing shows that native-axis separability rises sharply in several mid-to-late attention layers. Because both components are governed by attention rather than MLP updates, we propose Representation--Behavior Alignment (RBA), a parameter-efficient method that adapts those layers using video-level labels alone while updating about 0.012\% of the backbone parameters. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RBA improves native-readout performance and better aligns the model's decision direction with discriminative representations, and it produces anomaly decisions and explanations through a single generative process.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在视频异常检测中存在"表征-行为失配"问题，将其分解为容量分量与方向分量，发现方向分量占主导，并提出参数高效的RBA方法予以对齐。
AI.motivation: MLLM为视频异常检测提供了更具可解释性的途径，但其最终决策并未充分利用隐藏状态中蕴含的判别信息，即表征与行为之间存在失配，这一缺陷制约了检测性能与解释质量，因此需要系统刻画并修复该缺口。
AI.method: 作者将失配分解为两个分量：容量分量（从未被聚合到读出位置的判别信息）与方向分量（读出位置上最优正常-异常轴与原生轴之间的角度失配）。通过多基准与多骨干实验定位主导因素，并借助残差流追踪定位关键层。基于"两个分量均由注意力而非MLP更新主导"的发现，提出Representation-Behavior Alignment (RBA)，一种仅使用视频级标签、更新约0.012%骨干参数的参数高效适配方法，针对中后段注意力层进行调整。
AI.result: 在多个视频异常检测基准与MLLM骨干上，方向分量占主导；残差流追踪显示原生轴可分性在若干中后段注意力层显著上升。在三个基准上，RBA提升了原生读出性能，使模型决策方向与判别表征更好对齐，并通过单一生成过程同时产出异常判定与解释。
AI.conclusion: MLLM视频异常检测的核心瓶颈在于决策方向而非信息容量，且该问题由注意力层主导、可通过极少量参数更新加以纠正；RBA以极低参数代价实现表征与行为对齐，并统一了异常判定与解释生成。

title: From Memory to Guide: Spatio-Temporal Composer for Procedural Coding Memory
summary: Memory-augmented agents typically integrate procedural knowledge by injecting retrieved skills directly into text prompts. This approach dangerously equates readable text with reliable execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce From Memory to Guide, a novel paradigm that transitions procedural memory from passive text delivery to active, inference-time policy adaptation. We instantiate this paradigm through the Spatio-Temporal Composer, an active policy compiler that explicitly manages exactly how and when retrieved knowledge should be applied. Rather than treating skills as plug-and-play modules, Composer dynamically aligns historical knowledge with current environmental constraints (spatial adaptation) and precisely dictates its applicable lifecycle (temporal orchestration). It actively transforms static memories into strictly bounded Runtime Guides---equipping the agent with localized objectives and behavioral guardrails without requiring a single parameter update. Extensive evaluations on 13 demanding, long-horizon software engineering tasks in EngramBench demonstrate the clear advantages of this architecture. Composer not only robustly prevents context mismatch but drives an absolute pass-rate increase of 7.2 percentage points on the most complex tasks, while simultaneously slashing the main agent's token usage by 32.2%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"From Memory to Guide"新范式，将程序性记忆从被动文本注入转变为推理时的主动策略适配，并通过Spatio-Temporal Composer实现，在13项长周期软件工程任务上绝对通过率提升7.2个百分点、主智能体token消耗下降32.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体通常将检索到的技能直接注入文本提示，这种"可读即可靠"的假设存在风险，容易导致上下文不匹配、执行不可靠。
AI.method: 提出From Memory to Guide范式，将程序性记忆由被动文本投递转为推理时的主动策略适配；具体实现为Spatio-Temporal Composer——一个主动策略编译器，通过空间适配将历史知识与当前环境约束动态对齐，通过时间编排限定其适用生命周期，把静态记忆转化为严格边界的Runtime Guides（局部目标与行为护栏），无需任何参数更新。
AI.result: 在EngramBench的13项高难度长周期软件工程任务上，Composer能稳健避免上下文不匹配，在最复杂任务上绝对通过率提升7.2个百分点，同时主智能体token使用量减少32.2%。
AI.conclusion: 激活式、推理时的策略适配机制优于被动记忆注入，在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低token开销，为记忆增强智能体提供了新的设计方向。

title: TIMBRE: Teaching Time Series Forecasters to Read, Remember, and Reconcile
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/stephen-guan-researcher/TIMBRE ; Checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/XinyuGuan/TIMBRE
summary: Event-informed forecasting requires translating reports and historical responses into changes to a numerical forecast. We propose TIMBRE (Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence), which combines source-aware representation, state-conditioned response transfer, and reliability-guided fusion before a frozen forecast head. A separate readout adjusts interval widths while preserving the median. In a single-seed, one-epoch development study of 13 tasks, TIMBRE improves MAE over ordinary fusion on eight tasks but over native Chronos-2 on only two. Disabling response transfer in the trained model reduces BTC and AULF MAE by 47.04% and 6.81%, respectively. These findings identify sensitivity to learned response transfer rather than a general forecasting advantage. Missing development-set scores and the absence of retrained ablations limit attribution to individual evidence mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出TIMBRE框架，将事件报告与历史响应转化为数值预测修正，但在13任务单种子单轮开发实验中仅证明其对"学习到的响应迁移"敏感，而非通用预测优势。
AI.motivation: 事件驱动的预测需要把文本报告与历史响应映射为对数值预测的具体修改，而现有方法缺乏源感知表征、状态条件下的响应迁移以及可靠性引导的融合机制。
AI.method: TIMBRE在冻结的预测头之前整合三部分：源感知表征（source-aware representation）、状态条件响应迁移（state-conditioned response transfer）、可靠性引导融合（reliability-guided fusion）；并附加独立读出层，在保持中位数不变的前提下调整区间宽度。
AI.result: 在13个任务的单种子、单轮开发实验中，TIMBRE在8个任务上MAE优于普通融合，但仅在2个任务上优于原生Chronos-2。在训练模型中禁用响应迁移后，BTC与AULF的MAE分别下降47.04%与6.81%。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明模型表现对"学习到的响应迁移"高度敏感，而非具备通用预测优势；由于缺少开发集分数且未做重训练消融，无法将效果归因于单个证据机制。

title: Conditional Trajectory Peaks: Single-Pass Multimodal Policies over Action Chunks
summary: Multimodal imitation learning requires diverse executable futures under the same observation and consistent behavior across replanning cycles. We present Conditional Trajectory Peaks (CTP), a single-pass policy framework that jointly predicts complete action-chunk candidates, probability masses, and trajectory scales. Distribution-Aware Peak Specialization (DAPS) specializes trajectory peaks using trajectory-level posterior responsibilities and mass- and scale-modulated overlap constraints. Evidence-Gated Trajectory Belief Transport (ETBT) maintains cross-chunk consistency through geometric correspondence between exchangeable candidate sets, while allowing current policy evidence to override historical constraints. CTP achieves a coverage score of 91.40% on Push-T; success rates of 100.0%, 79.72%, and 84.44% on D3IL Avoiding, Aligning, and Sorting-2, respectively. On LIBERO, CTP achieves an average success rate of 97.25%. In real-world dual-arm experiments, CTP preserves both placement modes in a two-plate task, succeeding in all 50 trials. On bottle uprighting and pen placement into a holder, it maintains success rates comparable to $π_{0.5}$ while reducing policy inference latency from 218.24 ms to 75.80 ms. These results demonstrate that single-pass trajectory modeling can combine multimodal behavior, closed-loop consistency, and efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出单次前向推理策略框架CTP，联合预测动作块候选、概率质量与轨迹尺度，以DAPS实现多模态峰特化、以ETBT保证跨块一致性，在多任务与真实双臂实验中兼顾多模态、闭环一致性与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 多模态模仿学习需同时满足两点：同一观测下存在多样且可执行的未来轨迹，以及在反复重规划周期中行为保持一致。现有方法难以在单次推理中兼顾多模态表达与跨块闭环一致性，且往往推理延迟较高。
AI.method: CTP为单次（single-pass）策略框架，一次前向即联合输出若干完整动作块候选、对应概率质量与轨迹尺度，从而免去多步采样。DAPS（分布感知峰特化）利用轨迹级后验责任度对轨迹峰进行特化，并施加受概率质量与尺度调制的重叠约束，以抑制候选间冗余或塌缩。ETBT（证据门控轨迹信念传输）在可交换候选集合之间建立几何对应以维持跨块一致性，同时允许当前策略证据覆盖历史约束。
AI.result: Push-T覆盖率91.40%；D3IL的Avoiding、Aligning、Sorting-2成功率分别为100.0%、79.72%、84.44%；LIBERO平均成功率97.25%。真实双臂实验中，双盘任务保留两种放置模式，50次试验全部成功；在扶正瓶子与放笔入架任务上成功率与π_{0.5}相当，同时将策略推理延迟由218.24 ms降至75.80 ms。
AI.conclusion: 单次轨迹建模可同时实现多模态行为表达、闭环重规划一致性与高效推理，验证了CTP框架在多任务与真实双臂场景中的有效性。

title: RoMod: Temporal Routing Modulation via Mixture-of-Experts for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Intermediate-layer features from multimodal large language models have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection (VAD), yet the origin of their discriminative power remains unclear. We study this question using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, whose explicit expert structure and sparse activation make their internal computation easier to inspect. With a fully frozen backbone and no additional training, we find that anomaly-related evidence is concentrated in a small set of experts. These experts recur across layers, spontaneously specialize in different anomaly types, and together form a dynamic routing subnetwork. We further show that the output channels most strongly influenced by these experts are also the hidden dimensions that contain the most anomaly-relevant information. Routing statistics can therefore serve as an internal anomaly cue that complements semantic features.Based on these findings, we propose RoMod, an efficient VAD framework trained with only \(5\%\) of weakly labeled videos. RoMod includes a Routing-Modulated Fusion module, RoMF, and a Routing-aware Temporal Network, RoTN. RoMF uses routing signals to adaptively recalibrate hidden semantic channels. Its design also prevents the routing branch from bypassing semantic features and making predictions on its own. RoTN captures the temporal evolution of anomalies from onset to persistence and termination. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RoMod achieves state-of-the-art performance while running substantially faster than dense backbones of comparable size.

AI.tldr: 本文借助稀疏MoE大模型探究多模态大模型中间层特征在视频异常检测中判别力的来源，发现异常证据集中于少量跨层复现、自发专业化的专家，构成动态路由子网络，据此提出仅用5%弱标注视频训练的RoMod框架。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的中间层特征在视频异常检测（VAD）中展现出强大潜力，但其判别力的来源尚不清楚，缺乏对内部计算机制的解析，限制了方法的可解释性与高效利用。
AI.method: 选用稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，因其专家结构与稀疏激活便于内部计算分析。在完全冻结骨干且不训练的条件下，定位异常相关证据所在专家，分析其跨层复现、异常类型专业化及动态路由子网络特性，并验证受专家影响最强的输出通道即异常相关信息最丰富的隐藏维度。基于此提出RoMod框架，含路由调制融合模块RoMF（用路由信号自适应重校准隐藏语义通道，并防止路由分支绕过语义特征独立预测）与路由感知时序网络RoTN（刻画异常从起始到持续再到终止的时序演化），仅用5%弱标注视频训练。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，RoMod达到最先进性能，且运行速度显著快于规模相当的稠密骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: 路由统计量可作为内部异常线索，补充语义特征；揭示MoE专家级稀疏激活与异常证据的对应关系，为高效、可解释的VAD提供新思路。

title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative block denoising, and multi-branch speculative decoding accelerates this process by verifying a main branch together with multiple draft branches in a single forward pass. While prior DLLM acceleration methods primarily exploit temporal redundancy across denoising steps, we identify a complementary redundancy axis within each speculative verification step: multi-branch computational redundancy. During speculative verification, draft branches inherit most tokens from their parents while unmasking a small set of additional positions, causing large portions of hidden states to remain highly similar across branches. We propose SpecFold, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this multi-branch redundancy to reduce the cost of multi-branch speculative verification. Algorithmically, SpecFold performs token-level residual gating and selectively reuses parent computation through folded attention and FFN while preserving residual hidden states. Systemically, a Triton kernel implementation translates this fine-grained reuse into end-to-end throughput gains through efficient sparse multi-branch execution. SpecFold is orthogonal to temporal caching and compatible with existing DLLM speculation strategies. Across two DLLM families, five models, and five standard benchmarks, SpecFold achieves up to 1.64x throughput over Spiffy and up to 1.99x over vanilla decoding, while maintaining comparable task performance.

AI.tldr: SpecFold: 利用多分支投机验证中的计算冗余，通过token级残差门控与折叠加注意力/FFN实现算法-系统协同设计，提升DLLM吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过迭代块去噪生成文本，多分支投机解码可在单次前向中验证主分支与多个草稿分支。现有DLLM加速方法主要利用去噪步骤间的时间冗余，但忽略了每个投机验证步骤内的另一冗余维度——多分支计算冗余：草稿分支继承父分支大部分token，仅解掩少量位置，导致分支间隐藏状态高度相似。
AI.method: SpecFold采用算法-系统协同设计。算法上，执行token级残差门控，通过折叠加（folded attention）和FFN选择性复用父分支计算，同时保留残差隐藏状态。系统上，采用Triton内核实现，通过高效稀疏多分支执行将细粒度复用转化为端到端吞吐增益。
AI.result: 在两类DLLM家族、五个模型和五个标准基准上，SpecFold相比Spiffy最高提升1.64倍吞吐，相比vanilla解码最高提升1.99倍，同时保持可比的任務性能。
AI.conclusion: SpecFold与时间缓存正交，兼容现有DLLM投机策略，通过挖掘多分支冗余有效降低多分支投机验证成本，实现显著吞吐加速而不损失任务性能。

title: Multi-Agent Spectrum Sharing
summary: This project explores how multiple cognitive radars can learn to share limited wireless spectrum with other radio users without interfering with one another. Using machine learning (ML), each device independently decides where and how widely to transmit within a fixed 100 MHz band. The system analyzes real or simulated signal activity to detect which parts of the spectrum are currently in use and which are open. Based on this information, the devices adapt their transmission choices to avoid crowded frequencies while making efficient use of available space. The goal is to develop a flexible, scalable approach to spectrum sharing that could support future wireless communication systems. Experimental results using both over-the-air software-defined radio (SDR) recordings and simulated environments demonstrate that the proposed meta-learning approach consistently balances competing objectives better than conventional reinforcement learning (RL) methods in multi-agent spectrum-sharing scenarios. Across five multi-agent benchmark environments, our proposed method achieved the highest average reward among the primary baseline algorithms while simultaneously maintaining low collision rates and stable transmission behavior.

AI.tldr: 本工作研究多认知雷达在100 MHz固定频段内共享频谱的问题，各设备借助元学习独立决策发射的中心频率与带宽，以规避占用频段并高效利用空闲频谱。基于SDR实测与仿真环境的实验表明，所提元学习方法在五类多智能体基准环境中取得最高平均奖励，同时保持低碰撞率与稳定的发射行为，优于传统强化学习方法。
AI.motivation: 无线频谱资源有限且多用户共存，认知雷达需与其他无线电用户共享频谱而不互相干扰。传统强化学习在多智能体频谱共享中难以同时兼顾多项相互竞争的目标（如高奖励、低碰撞、行为稳定），因此需要更灵活、可扩展的频谱共享方法。
AI.method: 采用机器学习（ML）策略：每个设备在固定100 MHz频带内独立决定发射位置与带宽；系统分析真实或仿真信号活动，识别频谱中被占用与空闲的部分；设备据此自适应调整发射选择以避开拥挤频段。核心方法为元学习（meta-learning），并与传统强化学习（RL）基线算法在多智能体频谱共享场景中进行对比。
AI.result: 在五个多智能体基准环境（含over-the-air SDR实测记录与仿真环境）中，所提元学习方法在所有主要基线算法中取得最高平均奖励，同时保持低碰撞率和稳定的发射行为，一致性地在相互竞争的目标间取得更优平衡。
AI.conclusion: 元学习为多智能体频谱共享提供了一种灵活且可扩展的解决方案，在兼顾奖励、碰撞率与行为稳定性方面优于传统RL方法，有望支撑未来无线通信系统中的频谱共享需求。

title: Radar2Plan: Benchmarking 4D Radar for End-to-End Open-Loop Ego-Trajectory Planning
summary: Adverse weather and poor illumination remain major challenges for robust ego-trajectory planning in mobile autonomy. 4D radar offers reliable sensing under adverse conditions and direct radial-velocity measurements. However, sensing robustness does not necessarily translate into robust downstream planning, while existing 4D radar benchmarks focus primarily on perception rather than trajectory planning. We present Radar2Plan, a modular benchmark for open-loop ego-trajectory planning using real-world 4D radar data. Radar2Plan connects sensor encoders, scene representations, and planning heads through common interfaces, enabling controlled comparisons between different sensor and planner configurations. Using DSERT-RoLL and MAN TruckScenes, we evaluated seven combinations of camera, 4D radar, and LiDAR in four representative planning baselines and 12 weather and illumination conditions under a unified protocol. To our knowledge, Radar2Plan is the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating real-world 4D radars for autonomous driving planning. Experiments show that 4D radar alone supports competitive ego-trajectory planning and robust performance under adverse conditions. Sensor-configuration comparisons further demonstrate its complementary value to other modalities, while revealing dependencies on sensor combination and planning architecture. The modular design also supports additional datasets, sensing modalities, and planners, providing a flexible foundation for future research on radar-based autonomous driving planning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Radar2Plan，这是首个专门评估真实世界4D雷达用于自动驾驶轨迹规划的模块化基准，通过统一接口连接传感器编码器、场景表示与规划头。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气与低光照是移动自主系统轨迹规划的主要挑战。4D雷达在恶劣条件下具备可靠感知能力并提供直接径向速度测量，但感知鲁棒性未必能转化为下游规划的鲁棒性，且现有4D雷达基准主要聚焦于感知而非轨迹规划，缺乏面向规划的统一评估平台。
AI.method: Radar2Plan采用模块化设计，通过公共接口连接传感器编码器、场景表示与规划头，实现不同传感器与规划器配置的可控对比。作者使用DSERT-RoLL与MAN TruckScenes数据集，在统一协议下评估了相机、4D雷达与LiDAR的七种组合，覆盖四种代表性规划基线及12种天气与光照条件，采用开环自我轨迹规划范式。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅使用4D雷达即可支持具有竞争力的自我轨迹规划，并在恶劣条件下保持鲁棒性能。传感器配置对比进一步显示4D雷达对其他模态具有互补价值，同时揭示了性能对传感器组合与规划架构的依赖性。
AI.conclusion: Radar2Plan是首个面向自动驾驶规划的4D雷达真实世界评估基准，其模块化设计可扩展至更多数据集、感知模态与规划器，为基于雷达的自动驾驶规划研究提供了灵活基础。

title: How Does Geometry Enter Generated Motion?
comment: 43 pages, 13 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://liweihan1107.github.io/samelaw/
summary: Under a fixed physical law, the visible geometry of a scene determines how motion must change. We ask how video generators realize this relationship. We fix the law and the initial state and change only the geometry drawn in the first frame, within matched families of tracks and deflectors, and compare each generated trajectory with the simulator prediction for that geometry. Paired interventions change one thing at a time: a local bump, the height of a barrier, the words of the prompt, the length of the clip. Across nine image-to-video models, geometry is preserved and shapes the motion: the speed of the ball follows the drawn undulation of a track. A physical state would carry this response forward, and here the generated motion parts from the law. The mean slope barely accelerates the ball, successive contacts fail to compose through a consistent state, an edit ahead of the ball alters its motion before it arrives, and the ball climbs over barriers higher than its release point. Two global conditions organize the global trajectory: text strongly controls the destination, while clip length strongly controls timing in the open-weight models tested. The pattern persists with photographed first frames. Current video generation thus behaves as geometry-conditioned motion synthesis whose evolution of state differs systematically from that of a fixed physical law.

AI.tldr: 论文通过配对干预实验（改变赛道几何、障碍高度、提示词、视频长度）系统比较九个图生视频模型与物理模拟器的轨迹，发现模型能保持几何并让运动受几何调制，但状态演化系统性偏离固定物理定律。
AI.motivation: 在固定物理定律下，场景的可见几何决定了运动必须如何变化。作者想探究视频生成模型是如何实现这一"几何—运动"关系的：它们究竟是在模拟物理状态，还是仅仅在做几何条件下的运动合成。
AI.method: 固定物理定律与初始状态，只改变首帧中绘制的几何（在匹配的轨道与偏转器家族内），将每个生成轨迹与模拟器针对该几何的预测做对比。采用配对干预，每次只改一个变量：局部凸起、屏障高度、提示词文字、片段长度。共测试九个图生视频模型，并使用实拍首帧进行验证。
AI.result: 几何被保持并调制运动：小球速度跟随轨道绘制的起伏变化。但生成运动与物理定律出现分歧——平均斜率几乎不使球加速；连续接触无法通过一致状态组合；球前方的编辑会在球到达之前改变其运动；球能爬过高于其释放点的屏障。两个全局因素组织整体轨迹：文本强烈控制目的地，片段长度强烈控制时序（在测试的开源权重模型中）。该模式在实拍首帧下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成表现为"几何条件化的运动合成"，其状态演化系统性地不同于固定物理定律下的演化。

title: ForkPilot: Self-Evolving Policy for Retrospective Search in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Interactive language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through long-horizon, multi-call reasoning, where errors in beliefs or actions can compound across tool interactions. Retrospective search can recover from such failures but is prone to misallocation. Delayed outcomes obscure the contribution of intermediate search decisions, leading to Attribution Complexity, while evolving execution evidence leads to Adaptation Complexity, where previously learned estimates become stale. To address these challenges, we first introduce Search Value Dynamics (SVD), which characterizes the evolving trade-off between the gain and cost of retrospective search. Building on SVD, we propose ForkPilot, a self-evolving two-stage policy-learning framework. In the first stage, ForkPilot learns a search-value policy offline from completed trajectories through automatically constructed outcome comparisons. In the second stage, it makes search decisions based on current observations and then self-evolves by incorporating newly completed trajectories into subsequent policy updates. We evaluate ForkPilot across 6 diverse benchmarks and 7 widely used LLM backbone families, including four open-source families, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Opus 4.8 in a production agentic system, against 9 competitive baselines, including a real-world harness deployment used by hundreds of thousands of paid users. ForkPilot achieves comparable state-of-the-art performance while reducing token usage by up to 59.2%, demonstrating its efficacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Search Value Dynamics（SVD）刻画回溯搜索的收益-成本动态权衡，并据此设计自进化两阶段策略学习框架ForkPilot，在6个基准、7个LLM骨干上达到SOTA性能并将token消耗最多降低59.2%。
AI.motivation: 交互式语言模型智能体在长时程、多次调用的推理中，信念或动作错误会随工具交互不断累积。回溯搜索可缓解此类失败，但存在搜索资源错配问题：延迟反馈使中间搜索决策的贡献难以归因（Attribution Complexity），同时执行证据不断演化使已学估计过时（Adaptation Complexity）。
AI.method: 首先提出Search Value Dynamics（SVD），刻画回溯搜索增益与成本之间的动态权衡。基于SVD提出ForkPilot——自进化两阶段策略学习框架：第一阶段通过自动构造的结果对比，从已完成轨迹中离线学习搜索价值策略；第二阶段基于当前观测做搜索决策，并将新完成的轨迹纳入后续策略更新以实现自进化。
AI.result: 在6个多样化基准和7个主流LLM骨干家族（含4个开源家族、GPT-5.6 Sol、Opus 4.8，并部署于生产级智能体系统）上与9个竞争基线（含服务数十万付费用户的真实harness部署）对比，ForkPilot在达到可比SOTA性能的同时，token使用量最多减少59.2%。
AI.conclusion: ForkPilot通过建模回溯搜索的动态价值权衡并采用离线学习加在线自进化的两阶段策略，有效缓解归因与适应复杂性，在保持SOTA性能的同时显著降低token开销，验证了其有效性。

title: Separating Decision Time from Decision Quality in the Real-Time Gap of Distilled Deciders: Evidence from a Game and a Conveyor Simulator
comment: 80 pages including supplementary material. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems
summary: Real-time agents are often evaluated with the world paused, or with decision time rounded to whole ticks (tick conversion). Tick conversion predicts almost no loss for a learned decider whose hit accuracy falls by 14.8 percentage points (pp) on the same games in asynchronous play. We instead split the decider's gap to a zero-latency teacher into time and quality components. In ViZDoom, we train a small decider by imitating a scripted teacher, run the game on wall-clock time, and add a control in which the teacher waits for a call to the decider's server before deciding. On a Windows host, three preregistered studies put the time component at 6.5-8.7 pp and the quality component at 6.3-8.6 pp. On a Linux host that skips 0.08-0.09% of ticks, the time component disappeared (-0.1 pp; paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.4, 0.0]) while the quality component remained (5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]). Retraining on teacher-labelled states from the decider's own play (DAgger) improved it on new games on both hosts (2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] and 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]), a preregistered partial success. Imposing one delay schedule on every arm in live play left a quality component of 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5] on 100 new games, and retraining cut the decider's disagreement with the teacher on its own states from 22.7% to 14.9%. In a conveyor simulator with a 400 ms deadline, delay past it erased the quality component. A latency-matched control whose delays match the decider's shows which remedy to try.

AI.tldr: 该研究将实时智能体决策延迟造成的性能损失分解为"时间成分"与"质量成分"，通过 ViZDoom 实验与传送带模拟器验证，发现二者可分离，且延迟匹配对照可指示应采用何种补救措施。
AI.motivation: 实时智能体常在世界暂停或决策时间取整到整帧（tick conversion）的条件下评估，这会严重低估异步真实运行时的性能损失：同一学习决策器在异步对局中命中率下降 14.8 个百分点，而取整评估几乎预测不出损失。作者希望更精确地拆解这一差距的成因。
AI.method: 以 ViZDoom 为平台，训练一个小型决策器模仿脚本教师，在墙上时钟时间下运行游戏；加入"教师等待决策器服务器调用后再决策"的对照。将决策器与零延迟教师的差距分解为时间成分与质量成分；在 Windows 与 Linux 主机上开展三项预注册研究；用 DAgger 在决策器自身对局中由教师标注的状态上再训练；在实时对局中对所有实验组施加统一延迟表；并在带 400 ms 截止时间的传送带模拟器中检验延迟超限效应；另设延迟匹配对照。
AI.result: Windows 主机上，时间成分为 6.5–8.7 pp，质量成分为 6.3–8.6 pp。Linux 主机跳过 0.08–0.09% 的帧，时间成分消失（-0.1 pp，配对 95% bootstrap 区间 [-0.4, 0.0]），而质量成分仍存在（5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]）。DAgger 再训练在两台主机的新对局上均有提升（2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] 与 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]），属预注册的部分成功。统一延迟表下，100 局新游戏中质量成分仍为 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5]；再训练将决策器在自身状态上与教师的不一致率从 22.7% 降至 14.9%。在 400 ms 截止时间的传送带模拟器中，超过截止时间的延迟会消除质量成分。延迟匹配对照可显示应尝试哪种补救措施。
AI.conclusion: 实时决策性能损失可分解为时间与质量两部分，二者在不同系统条件下表现不同：时间成分依赖于帧丢失等系统特性，质量成分则更稳健。DAgger 再训练可缓解质量成分，但受截止时间约束；延迟匹配对照有助于选择合适的改进策略。取整式评估会系统性低估实时系统的真实损失。

title: I-BFM: Reward-Conditioned Robust Humanoid Interaction via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
summary: Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) have recently shown that a single humanoid policy can support diverse whole-body control, but extending such generality to physical interaction remains challenging. We introduce I-BFM, to our knowledge the first BFM for humanoid-object interaction. Rather than relying on task-specific policies or reference tracking, I-BFM learns a shared representation of the coupled dynamics among the humanoid, objects, and their contacts using forward-backward representations and unsupervised reinforcement learning. Given a downstream task reward, the same policy can be directly conditioned on a latent command to execute closed-loop interaction without task-specific policy optimization. To improve interaction control over different time scales, we further train the policy with both short-horizon interaction targets and longer-horizon goal targets. A single I-BFM policy performs carrying, pushing, and kicking, while also supporting goal reaching, motion tracking, stylistic control, and long-horizon task chaining. More importantly, it remains effective after large deviations from nominal execution: on Carry, I-BFM achieves 94.3% nominal success and retains 89.3% success after robot falls, compared with 1.3% for a planning-based baseline. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 further demonstrate diverse loco-manipulation behaviors, rapid recovery from interaction failures and external disturbances, and task chaining without task-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向人形-物体交互的行为基础模型I-BFM，基于前向-后向表征与无监督强化学习学习人形、物体及接触耦合动态的共享表征，单一策略可执行搬运、推、踢等多种任务，并在大偏差与扰动下保持鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有行为基础模型虽能让单一人形策略支持多样化全身控制，但将其泛化能力扩展到物理交互仍具挑战；传统方法依赖任务专用策略或参考轨迹跟踪，难以应对交互中接触动态的复杂性与执行偏差。
AI.method: 采用前向-后向表征与无监督强化学习，学习人形、物体及其接触之间耦合动态的共享潜表征；给定下游任务奖励时，同一策略可直接以潜指令为条件执行闭环交互，无需任务专用策略优化；同时用短时域交互目标与长时域目标目标联合训练策略，以改善不同时间尺度上的交互控制。
AI.result: 单一I-BFM策略可完成搬运、推、踢，并支持目标到达、运动跟踪、风格控制与长时域任务链；在Carry任务上实现94.3%标称成功率，机器人跌倒后仍保持89.3%成功率，而基于规划的基线仅1.3%；在Unitree G1真机实验中展示了多样移动操作行为、交互失败与外部扰动后的快速恢复及无需任务专用再训练的任务链。
AI.conclusion: I-BFM将行为基础模型的通用性拓展至人形-物体交互，无需任务专用策略或参考跟踪即可实现多任务闭环控制，并在大幅执行偏差和扰动下保持鲁棒，验证了其仿真与真机部署的有效性与泛化能力。

title: SemCam: Semantic Camera Motion Control for Video Generation
summary: Controlling the camera relative to a moving subject in an existing video is challenging: behaviors such as maintaining a frontal view require the camera to adapt to the subject's changing position and orientation, making the desired trajectory difficult to specify in advance. Existing camera-controlled video-to-video methods typically rely on explicit trajectories or reference motions, which do not directly express these dynamic camera--subject relationships. We introduce semantic camera motion control, a novel video-to-video task in which a reference video and a target motion label specify the desired subject-relative camera behavior without an explicit target trajectory. Our method, SemCam, learns to realize this behavior while preserving source content. It combines shared-basis low-rank adaptation with motion-conditioned modulation, while a background-consistency loss encourages fidelity in regions visible in both reference and target videos. We construct 661 paired videos covering eight semantic camera behaviors and evaluate on a separate 109-scene benchmark using subject-relative motion metrics, appearance measures, and a user study. SemCam achieves a semantic-motion success rate of 68.6%, compared with 45.3% for Vista4D, the strongest evaluated baseline, while maintaining comparable subject identity preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义相机运动控制"这一新颖的视频到视频任务，并设计SemCam方法，在无需显式目标轨迹的情况下，根据参考视频与目标运动标签实现主体相对相机行为，同时保持原始内容。
AI.motivation: 在现有视频中控制相机相对于运动主体的行为（如保持正面视角）具有挑战性：相机需随主体位置与朝向变化而调整，导致期望轨迹难以预先指定。现有相机控制类视频到视频方法依赖显式轨迹或参考运动，无法直接表达这种动态的"相机—主体"关系。
AI.method: SemCam将共享基低秩适配（shared-basis low-rank adaptation）与运动条件调制（motion-conditioned modulation）相结合，并引入背景一致性损失（background-consistency loss），以鼓励在参考视频与目标视频中均可见区域的保真度。
AI.result: 构建了包含661对视频、覆盖8种语义相机行为的数据集，并在独立的109场景基准上使用主体相对运动指标、外观度量与用户研究进行评估。SemCam的语义运动成功率达68.6%，而最强基线Vista4D为45.3%，同时保持了相当的主体身份保持效果。
AI.conclusion: 语义相机运动控制可作为一种有效的新任务范式，SemCam在无需显式轨迹的条件下显著优于现有基线，为视频相机控制提供了新的思路。

title: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
summary: Recursive language-model agents decompose tasks and delegate subtasks to child instances of the same policy, forming a tree of work. Training them, however, is hard: the final outcome is verifiable, but the self-invented intermediate subtasks are numerous and carry no ground truth. Existing methods score each node with a verifier or judge, which is costly at scale and blind to decomposition quality. We argue that a recursive agent must learn three coupled capabilities within one set of weights: decomposing problems into subtasks, solving them, and evaluating the outcomes, each requiring its own training signal. SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) turns evaluation into a learned capability of the policy itself. Before delegating, the parent writes a rubric of weighted success criteria for each child subtask; a ranking objective against verified outcomes then trains rubric generation so that the criteria track genuine subtask success. In addition, a complementary leaf-coverage signal provides direct credit for task decomposition. Our central finding is that \emph{training} the policy to generate aligned rubrics is what drives the gains: because the same weights both evaluate and execute, learning to judge subtasks sharpens the agent's ability to solve them. Notably, external supervision is also reduced: the judge is consulted only to train the rubric generator, while solving is trained against the agent's own rubric scores, which outperform direct use of the judge. Beyond training, the learned rubric doubles as an inference-time selector for tree search. On TextCraft-Synth and TextWorld-Sync, SERA improves over strong recursive-agent baselines by 5.38 and 13.14 points on average, and rubric-guided tree search at inference adds a further 2.43 points on TextWorld-Sync.

AI.tldr: SERA将"自评估"变成递归语言模型智能体策略自身的一项可学习能力：父节点在委派子任务前生成带权重的评分标准（rubric），并通过与已验证结果对齐的排序目标训练该标准生成，使同一套权重既能评估子任务又能求解子任务。
AI.motivation: 递归智能体把任务分解为子任务并委派给同策略的子实例，形成工作树。训练难点在于：最终结果可验证，但自行发明的中间子任务数量多且没有真值标注。现有方法用验证器或裁判对每个节点打分，规模上代价高，且对分解质量不敏感。作者主张递归智能体需在同一套权重中学习三种耦合能力——分解、求解、评估，各需独立训练信号。
AI.method: SERA（Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents）把评估内化为策略的习得能力。父节点在委派前为每个子任务撰写由加权成功准则构成的rubric；用一个针对已验证结果的排序目标来训练rubric生成，使准则真实追踪子任务成功与否。另加一个互补的叶子覆盖信号，为任务分解提供直接信用分配。关键设定是同一套权重既做评估又做执行。外部监督被削弱：裁判只在训练rubric生成器时被咨询，而求解阶段以智能体自身rubric分数为目标，其表现优于直接使用裁判。推理阶段，习得的rubric还充当树搜索的选择器。
AI.result: 在TextCraft-Synth与TextWorld-Sync上，SERA相较强递归智能体基线平均分别提升5.38与13.14个点；推理时的rubric引导树搜索在TextWorld-Sync上再增2.43个点。
AI.conclusion: 核心发现是：训练策略生成"对齐的rubric"才是增益来源——由于同一权重既评估又执行，学会评判子任务反过来锐化了智能体求解子任务的能力。该方法同时降低了对外部监督的依赖，并使习得rubric在训练之外可作为推理期树搜索的组件复用。

title: GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAM，一种面向冻结时序基础模型的检索增强框架，通过提取并利用模型系统性偏差生成逐预测步修正，提升零样本预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强方法利用相似历史窗口的真实未来值来修正TSFM预测，但真实未来值中既包含基础模型已捕获的可预测成分，又包含难以迁移的样本特有随机波动。相比之下，预测误差中反复出现的系统性模型偏差更能刻画冻结TSFM的失效模式，是更有价值的修正信号。
AI.method: GRAM包含两个模块：1）幅度记忆模块（AMM），按幅度对预测误差进行缩放，并聚合为可检索的误差原型；2）原型图模块（PGM），建模原型之间的关系，以聚合一致性偏差信息并抑制随机波动。在线预测阶段，GRAM检索并扩展与当前查询相关的原型，生成逐预测步（per-horizon）修正以精炼原始TSFM预测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种基础模型上的实验表明，GRAM能够持续提升预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模并检索冻结TSFM的系统性预测偏差而非直接利用历史真实未来值，可在幅度归一化与图结构聚合的帮助下有效抑制随机波动，为TSFM提供通用且有效的检索增强修正方案。

title: Robotizing Human Videos with Physically Consistent Interactions
summary: Human videos offer scalable manipulation data, but the embodiment gap between human hands and robot manipulators limits their direct use. Existing video-editing methods replace hands with rendered robots, yet inaccurate interaction reconstruction and compositing can produce inconsistent grasps and implausible robot-object occlusions. We address these failures from two complementary physical aspects: interaction geometry and scene visibility. First, an interaction-aware contact reconstruction module combines hand-object segmentation with mesh-level contact prediction to recover dense 3D contacts, then converts them into temporally stabilized grasps for parallel-jaw grippers. Second, a depth-aware compositing module uses scene and robot depth to enforce physically consistent robot-object occlusions. The resulting videos preserve the interaction structure of human demonstrations in a robot-compatible form and are co-trained with robot demonstrations. Using identical human videos and robot data, we compare against robot-only training and the original Masquerade pipeline. Across four RoboTwin tasks and two Diffusion Policy visual encoders, our method achieves the highest average success rates, with especially strong gains under out-of-distribution scene variation. Real-world deployment further shows that the proposed co-training approach improves robustness to visual distractors when the task geometry is observable, while performance on depth-sensitive grasps remains limited by the single-camera setup.

AI.tldr: 该论文从交互几何与场景可见性两个物理层面改进人手视频到机器人操作数据的转换，通过接触重建与深度感知合成生成机器人兼容视频，并与机器人演示协同训练，在RoboTwin任务与真实部署中取得更优成功率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 人类视频蕴含可扩展的操作数据，但人手与机器人末端执行器之间存在具身差异，难以直接利用。现有视频编辑方法用渲染机器人替换人手，却因交互重建不准确与合成不当，导致抓取不一致及机器人-物体遮挡不合理。
AI.method: 方法包含两个模块：(1) 交互感知接触重建模块，结合手-物分割与网格级接触预测恢复稠密3D接触，并将其转换为时序稳定的平行夹爪抓取；(2) 深度感知合成模块，利用场景与机器人深度信息强制实现物理一致的机器人-物体遮挡。生成的视频保留人类演示的交互结构且与机器人兼容，并与机器人演示进行协同训练。
AI.result: 在相同人类视频与机器人数据下，与仅机器人训练及原始Masquerade流程对比，该方法在四个RoboTwin任务、两种Diffusion Policy视觉编码器上取得最高平均成功率，在分布外场景变化下提升尤为显著。真实世界部署表明，协同训练方法在任务几何可观测时提升了对视觉干扰物的鲁棒性，但深度敏感抓取仍受单相机设置限制。
AI.conclusion: 从交互几何与场景可见性两方面进行物理约束的视频编辑，可有效缩小具身差距，将人类视频转化为机器人兼容的操作数据；协同训练在仿真与真实场景均带来成功率与鲁棒性提升，而深度敏感抓取受限于单相机设置仍是待解决问题。

title: Construction and Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Near-Real-Time Fire Detection from MTG FCI Imagery
summary: Geostationary satellite observations are important for wildfire detection and monitoring. The current study evaluates machine learning models for MTG FCI near-real-time fire detection in 1- and 2-km spatial configurations and compares them with threshold-based algorithms. The models were trained and evaluated using VIIRS fire reference data across diverse ecological regions in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. The key results are that 1-km models significantly outperform both their 2-km variants and operational threshold products. The constructed 1-km models achieved F1 scores higher by up to 0.36 compared to baseline products. Importantly, the 1-km models detected small fires with higher probability compared to competing models. Finally, the models robustly detected fires up to 260 min earlier than baseline products. To support opensource applications, our trained models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了用于MTG FCI近实时火点检测的机器学习模型，在1 km与2 km空间配置下与阈值算法比较，1 km模型显著优于2 km变体及业务阈值产品，F1最高提升0.36，并能更早最多260分钟检出火情，模型已开源。
AI.motivation: 地球静止卫星观测对野火检测与监测具有重要价值，需评估机器学习模型在MTG FCI近实时火点检测中的表现，并与传统阈值算法进行比较，以提升检测性能。
AI.method: 在1 km与2 km空间配置下训练并评估机器学习模型，使用覆盖欧洲、非洲和中东多样生态区的VIIRS火点参考数据进行训练与验证，并与阈值型业务产品对比。
AI.result: 1 km模型显著优于2 km变体和业务阈值产品，F1分数最高提升0.36；1 km模型对小火的检出概率更高；模型可比基线产品最多提前260分钟稳健检出火情。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习模型（尤其1 km配置）在MTG FCI近实时火点检测中优于阈值算法，具备更优精度与更早预警能力；训练模型已公开以支持开源应用。

title: VideoResearchAgent: Grounded Task Synthesis and Sim-to-Real RL for Open-Web Video Research
summary: Existing deep research agents are designed primarily for text- and image-based web sources, while video reasoning systems typically assume that relevant videos are provided in advance. We study open-web video research, where an agent must autonomously discover relevant videos, navigate their temporal content, and ground answers in visual evidence. Training such agents at scale is challenging as live video interaction is slow and unreliable, whereas fixed local simulation can induce retrieval-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to the open web. We introduce VideoResearchAgent, a scalable training framework to address these challenges. First, we introduce controllable task synthesis pipeline to synthesize multi-hop research tasks from timestamped visual evidence while filtering text-only shortcuts. Second, we build a field-aligned local video simulator that preserves deployment-facing search and watch interactions while accelerating video search by a factor of 34.5-64.6. Third, we introduce Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO (RDR-GRPO), which diversifies candidate rankings, distractors, metadata, and result structure during training to reduce overfitting to simulated retrieval. On Video-BrowseComp, the VideoResearchAgent trained using Qwen3.5-4B achieves 40.48% accuracy, comparable to Gemini-3-Flash-Preview, while reducing cumulative API-token consumption by 74.9% relative to the untrained model. Together, these results establish an accurate and efficient training recipe for open-web video research.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoResearchAgent 训练框架，解决开放式网络视频研究中自主检索与时间定位难题，在 Video-BrowseComp 上以 Qwen3.5-4B 达到 40.48% 准确率，媲美 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview，并降低 74.9% 的累计 API token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体主要面向文本与图像网页源，而视频推理系统通常假设相关视频已预先提供。本文研究开放式网络视频研究（open-web video research）：智能体需自主发现相关视频、导航其时间内容并将答案锚定在视觉证据上。规模化训练此类智能体面临两大挑战：实时视频交互缓慢且不稳定；固定的本地模拟会诱发检索特定的捷径，无法迁移到开放式网络。
AI.method: VideoResearchAgent 是可扩展训练框架，包含三部分：(1) 可控任务合成流水线，从带时间戳的视觉证据合成多跳研究任务，同时过滤纯文本捷径；(2) 面向真实场景对齐的本地视频模拟器，保留部署端的搜索与观看交互，并将视频搜索加速 34.5–64.6 倍；(3) Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO（RDR-GRPO），在训练中多样化候选排序、干扰项、元数据与结果结构，以减少对模拟检索的过拟合。
AI.result: 在 Video-BrowseComp 上，使用 Qwen3.5-4B 训练的 VideoResearchAgent 达到 40.48% 准确率，与 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 相当；相较未训练模型，累计 API token 消耗降低 74.9%。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果共同确立了面向开放式网络视频研究的准确且高效的训练方案。

title: Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.

AI.tldr: 提出 MAESTRO 方法，将多目标对齐（MOA）建模为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，用在线镜像下降更新对抗性 Dirichlet 偏好分布，单次端到端 RL 训练一个 prompt 条件化策略，在多个任务上以最低训练成本取得最优 Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: 人类价值具有多面性（helpfulness、harmlessness、humor 之间存在权衡），且不同用户偏好不同的权衡点。现有多目标对齐方法存在缺陷：要么每个偏好训练一个模型，要么事后插值若干独立对齐的专家，要么训练单一条件模型但不考虑应在哪些偏好上训练。由于偏好单纯形中的"困难区域"依赖于具体目标，这些方法使困难区域训练不足，未能充分发挥单一模型的潜力。
AI.method: MAESTRO（Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization）将 MOA 表述为偏好分布上的 minimax 问题，端到端训练一个 prompt 条件化策略，用 RL 对抗一个对抗性偏好分布——该分布为 Dirichlet 分布，通过在线镜像下降（online mirror descent）向当前策略表现最差的偏好方向更新，而非固定分布。
AI.result: 在 HH-RLHF、BeaverTails 及一个摘要任务上（最多三个目标），MAESTRO 在单次训练运行中于大多数任务取得最优 Pareto 前沿，且在所比较方法中训练成本最低。最大优势出现在固定偏好分布导致训练不足的困难区域，证实单一 prompt 条件化模型能够自行覆盖目标间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过将偏好分布作为对抗性变量进行 minimax 优化，单一 prompt 条件化策略可自主覆盖整个目标权衡空间，尤其在困难区域显著优于现有方法，同时训练成本更低。

title: Talk, Render, Act: Integrating Social Gesture and Digital Face with Synchronized Speech for Conversational Humanoid Robot
summary: Expressive humanoid interaction requires speech, facial animation, and body gestures to form a coherent response. However, many full-body humanoid robots produce speech and gestures without a visually expressive face, while talking-face animation and robot gesture generation are typically developed separately. We present Talk, Render, Act (TRABot), an agent-based framework comprising specialized agents for motion-atom construction, dialogue generation, motion planning, and facial animation. First, to produce natural and semantically meaningful gestures, we construct Robot-Ready Semantic Motion Atoms by segmenting long-form, G1-retargeted BEAT2 motion into units with natural gesture boundaries, human-verified communicative functions, and feasible trajectories.
