Second, to preserve semantic order and coordinate body motion with the spoken response, we introduce a Semantic-Conditioned Compositional Planner. Given an ordered semantic function sequence and an estimated response duration, the planner selects approved atoms to realize the longest feasible action sequence while accounting for transitions and neutral recovery. Finally, we deploy a Streaming Face-Speech-Body Integration system on a physical G1 humanoid, combining streaming dialogue audio, audio-driven facial animation, and semantically planned body motion in a unified real-time interaction loop. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that TRAbot achieves the best overall performance among all compared conditions in terms of naturalness, expressiveness, and multimodal coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出TRABot：一个基于智能体的框架，通过语义运动原子、语义条件组合规划器与流式面部-语音-身体集成系统，在G1人形机器人上实现语音、面部动画与身体动作协调一致的实时交互。
AI.motivation: 表达性人形交互需语音、面部动画与身体手势协调统一；但许多全身人形机器人缺乏富有表现力的面部，且说话人脸动画与机器人手势生成通常被分开研究，导致多模态不一致。
AI.method: TRABot由多专用智能体组成：运动原子构建、对话生成、运动规划与面部动画。1）构建Robot-Ready Semantic Motion Atoms：将G1重定向的长时BEAT2动作按自然手势边界切分，标注人工验证的交际功能，并筛选可行轨迹。2）语义条件组合规划器：给定有序语义功能序列和估计响应时长，选择已批准原子以生成最长可行动作序列，并考虑过渡与中性恢复。3）在物理G1人形上部署流式面部-语音-身体集成系统，将流式对话音频、音频驱动面部动画与语义规划身体动作统一到实时交互回路中。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明，在自然度、表现力与多模态一致性方面，TRABot在所有对比条件中总体表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: TRABot证明了将语义运动原子、组合规划与流式多模态集成相结合，可有效提升人形机器人交互的自然性、表现力与多模态协调性。

title: Recurrent Latent Visual Search for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding is a critical capability for GUI agents powered by vision-language models, helping them execute user instructions by locating the corresponding elements in screenshots. Single-step grounding struggles with small elements and dense layouts, motivating multi-step visual search. However, existing approaches commonly rely on textual reasoning misaligned with visual space or costly multi-round interactions with external visual tools. To make multi-step visual search an explicit spatial process within the model, we propose ReLaViS, which performs Recurrent Latent Visual Search in a single interaction round. At each step, a spatial search head uses the hidden state to query the screenshot's visual tokens, producing a spatial search distribution that explicitly represents the search focus. This distribution then aggregates the visual tokens into latent visual evidence, which is recurrently fed back as the next input embedding to condition subsequent search. We further introduce a GUI-aware coarse-to-fine inductive bias through trajectories constructed from flat element annotations, supervising search from the global interface through intermediate element groups to the target. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, ReLaViS improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy by 3.1 percentage points to 56.3% with only a 3.5% increase in inference FLOPs and outperforms the matched single-step baseline on all five benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出ReLaViS，将多步视觉搜索内化为模型内部的空间过程，在单轮交互中完成递归潜空间视觉搜索，提升GUI grounding性能。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding中，单步定位在小元素和密集布局上表现不佳，需要多步视觉搜索；但现有方法依赖与视觉空间不对齐的文本推理，或需要与外部视觉工具进行代价高昂的多轮交互。
AI.method: ReLaViS在单轮交互内进行递归潜空间视觉搜索。每步由空间搜索头用隐藏状态查询截图的视觉token，生成显式表示搜索焦点的空间搜索分布；该分布聚合视觉token为潜空间视觉证据，并递归反馈为下一步输入嵌入以条件化后续搜索。同时利用扁平元素标注构造轨迹，引入GUI感知的由粗到细归纳偏置，监督从全局界面经中间元素组到目标的搜索过程。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B，ReLaViS将ScreenSpot-Pro准确率提升3.1个百分点至56.3%，推理FLOPs仅增加3.5%，并在全部五个基准上超过匹配的单步基线。
AI.conclusion: 将多步视觉搜索显式化为模型内部的空间过程是有效且高效的，能在极小计算开销下显著提升GUI grounding性能。

title: Monitorability Disposition in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of large reasoning models (LRMs) is a common way to detect misbehavior in real-world practice. However, current monitoring is passive: a separate model inspects the session only after execution. This means harm may already have occurred before it is caught. An active alternative is to have the model self-report its misbehavior as it happens. Whether models are willing to do this, however, is unknown. We introduce "monitorability disposition": a model's willingness to make itself monitorable and stay monitored throughout inference when warranted. We measure it as the fraction of warranted cases in which a model self-reports its own misbehavior via tool calls to available monitoring channels. We evaluate four LRMs on three misbehaviors (sycophancy, reward hacking, and bias) while varying the available monitors (AI and human) and the pressure to use the monitoring tools. We find that when tool use is optional, models self-report in only about 16% of warranted cases on average. Increasing tool-use pressure does not improve reporting where it matters: high-severity misbehavior is never self-reported. Models also systematically select the monitor they perceive as least strict. Overall, we identify monitorability disposition as a new contributing factor to model monitorability: when sufficiently strong, it keeps models seeking monitorability throughout inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可监控性倾向"（monitorability disposition）概念，即模型在推理过程中主动让自身可被监控并保持被监控的意愿，并以模型通过工具调用自报不当行为的比例来量化该倾向，发现现有大型推理模型在需要自报时大多保持沉默。
AI.motivation: 现有对大型推理模型思维链的监控是被动的：由独立模型在会话执行完毕后才进行审查，因此危害往往在被发现之前就已发生。主动方案是让模型在不当行为发生时自行上报，但模型是否愿意这么做尚属未知，这构成了本文的研究动机。
AI.method: 提出"可监控性倾向"这一构念，定义为当存在正当理由时模型使自己可被监控、并在整个推理过程中保持被监控状态的意愿；操作化为"有正当理由的案例中，模型通过工具调用向可用监控渠道自报不当行为的比例"。实验对四种大型推理模型、三类不当行为（谄媚、奖励黑客、偏见）进行评估，并变化可用监控者（AI 与人类）以及使用监控工具的压力。
AI.result: 当工具使用为可选时，模型平均仅在约16%的正当案例中自报不当行为；提高工具使用压力并不能改善关键场景下的上报：高严重程度的不当行为从未被自报。此外，模型会系统性地选择其感知中最不严格的监控者。
AI.conclusion: "可监控性倾向"被识别为影响模型可监控性的一个新贡献因素：当该倾向足够强时，模型会在整个推理过程中持续寻求可监控性，作为被动式事后监控的主动补充路径。

title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

AI.tldr: PIT-GCL 是一个双塔结构感知框架，用序列、Cα 点云与持久同调描述子独立编码蛋白，经交叉注意力软对接，在三个二分类相互作用基准上总体优于序列、结构感知与任务专用基线。
AI.motivation: 蛋白结合预测对靶点识别、结合剂设计与大规模筛选至关重要，但难度高：结合同时依赖序列、三维几何与全局结构组织。AlphaFold3、Boltz-2 等折叠模型提升了结构预测，但其置信度输出（pLDDT、pTM、ipTM）并非为二分类结合预测设计；而专用结构感知预测器往往需要结合态复合物结构，在筛选规模下不可得。
AI.method: 提出 PIT-GCL，双塔结构感知框架，每条链仅由氨基酸序列、Cα 点云与全局持久同调描述子独立编码。每个塔将残基 ESM-2 嵌入与拓扑摘要结合，拓扑摘要来自 Vietoris-Rips 过滤的 H0 与 H1 持久景观；随后用结构感知 Transformer 处理 token，其中成对 Cα 距离作为学习到的注意力偏置。双向交叉注意力模块在两个单蛋白表示之间做隐空间软对接。训练目标为二分类交叉熵与 NT-Xent 对比损失的组合。
AI.result: 在三个二分类相互作用基准上评估：PPIRef 上的通用 PPI、STAG 上的 TCRpMHC 结合、PPB-Affinity 上的整链配对。在该文的评测下，PIT-GCL 在通用 PPI 上优于代表性序列方法、结构感知方法与任务专用基线；在 PPB-Affinity 上是唯一高于随机水平的方法；在 TCR-pMHC 上于固定决策阈值下领先，但被任务专用序列模型超越。
AI.conclusion: 由于第一阶段对每个蛋白独立编码，其表示可预计算并在候选对之间复用，便于大规模筛选，是该框架的实用优势。

title: Controllable and Photorealistic Pedestrian Risky Motion Generation for End-to-End Driving Safety Evaluation
summary: Evaluating end-to-end autonomous driving under rare, safety-critical vehicle-pedestrian interactions requires photorealistic, sensor-level scenarios. However, trajectory-based scenario generators cannot synthesize raw visual observations, whereas video-based approaches lack controllability. To bridge this gap, we present ControlPed, a novel framework that combines trajectory-level conflict synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to generate photorealistic, motion-controllable safety-critical scenarios. Built upon HazardPed, a dataset derived from 10,352 traffic videos comprising 422 conflict trajectories, HD maps, and 857 annotated 3D human motions, ControlPed first generates conflict trajectories, lifts them into 3D human motion sequences via text-conditioned motion diffusion, and finally renders multi-view sensor observations using animatable 3DGS avatars. Safety evaluation in 88 rendered photorealistic scenarios reveals that seven leading end-to-end driving models suffer a severe performance drop, with their mean HDScore plunging from 88.8 to 47.4, exposing major failure modes under dangerous pedestrian behaviors. The dataset and testing benchmarks will be released to facilitate safety assessment of vehicle-pedestrian interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出 ControlPed 框架，将轨迹级冲突合成与 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）结合，生成照片级真实且运动可控的安全关键车辆-行人交互场景，用于端到端自动驾驶安全评估。
AI.motivation: 评估端到端自动驾驶在罕见、安全关键的车辆-行人交互中的表现，需要照片级真实的传感器级场景。然而，基于轨迹的生成器无法合成原始视觉观测，而基于视频的方法又缺乏可控性，二者之间存在空白。
AI.method: ControlPed 基于 HazardPed 数据集（源自 10,352 段交通视频，包含 422 条冲突轨迹、高清地图和 857 条标注的 3D 人体运动）。流程为：首先生成冲突轨迹，通过文本条件运动扩散模型将其提升为 3D 人体运动序列，最后使用可动画的 3DGS 虚拟人渲染多视角传感器观测。
AI.result: 在 88 个渲染出的照片级真实场景中进行安全评估，发现七个主流端到端驾驶模型性能严重下降，其平均 HDScore 从 88.8 骤降至 47.4，暴露了在危险行人行为下的主要失效模式。
AI.conclusion: ControlPed 弥合了轨迹级与视频级场景生成的差距，能够生成照片真实且运动可控的安全关键场景，有效揭示端到端驾驶模型的安全缺陷；数据集与测试基准将开源以促进车辆-行人交互的安全评估。

title: Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection
summary: DETR-style detectors use one-to-one bipartite matching during training to assign object queries to ground-truth objects, enabling end-to-end set prediction without non-maximum suppression (NMS). However, without an explicit de-duplication procedure, multiple queries can still produce highly similar hypotheses for the same object, making training unstable and predictions less decisive. Inspired by the sequential ordering of NMS, we propose DETRNN, a plug-and-play module that turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement. DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder. This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy. Experiments on multiple DETR-style detectors show consistent gains with comparable efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用模块DETRNN，将无序object queries按置信度-相似度排序成竞争感知序列，用RNN沿序递归精炼，减少冗余预测、稳定训练并提升检测精度。
AI.motivation: DETR类检测器采用一对一二分匹配实现无NMS的端到端集合预测，但缺少显式去重机制，多个query仍会对同一目标产生高度相似的假设，导致训练不稳定、预测判别性不足。
AI.method: 受NMS顺序执行思想启发，DETRNN基于先验预测构建显式的置信度与相似度排序，将无序object queries转化为具有竞争感知的顺序序列，再沿该顺序用RNN对query进行递归精炼，从而在decoder内部建模query间的竞争关系。
AI.result: 在多个DETR类检测器上实验，均取得一致的性能提升，且效率相当。
AI.conclusion: 有序递归精炼能有效减少冗余预测、稳定优化过程并提升最终检测精度，验证了在decoder中显式建模query竞争关系的有效性。

title: Are We Measuring Scientific Intelligence? Rethinking the Evaluation of AI Scientists
comment: [Oral] NeurIPS 2026 Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop
summary: AI agents can now carry out data-driven scientific analyses end to end, and benchmarks assess them by giving an agent a question and a dataset and scoring its final answer against a fixed key. These benchmarks assume that a correct answer was derived from the supplied data, a property we call evidence grounding. However, an agent can also reach the key from prior knowledge or by ruling out the other options, and a score based on a single run cannot tell these cases apart. We show how to test this assumption and find that it often fails. For each question, we build versions of its data files in which the evidence for the answer is left intact, withdrawn or reversed, check each edit with a pre-registered reference statistic, and run the same agent on every version. We then measure evidence-grounded accuracy, which credits a correct answer only if the agent also responds when the evidence is withdrawn and follows it when it is reversed. We evaluate three agent scaffolds and five models on 18 single-cell questions from BAISBench and four synthetic problems from GeneBench-Pro. On the single-cell questions, the Claude agents are 95% accurate and answer 83% correctly without any data, but their evidence-grounded accuracy is only 41%. Hiding gene names raises the share of runs that follow reversed evidence from 58% to 93% on ten gene tasks, suggesting that prior knowledge competes with the supplied data. The benchmark score and LLM judges can also reward answers that ignore the changed evidence. Measuring scientific intelligence rather than recall therefore requires checking whether answers follow the evidence and whether scores reward them for it.

AI.tldr: 提出"证据接地"检验框架，通过撤销/反转数据证据并配合预注册统计量，测出代理真实依赖数据的准确率，发现现有基准分数高估科学能力。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动科学分析基准假定正确答案源于所给数据（证据接地），但代理也可能靠先验知识或排除法命中答案，单次运行的分数无法区分二者，从而高估科学智能而掩盖记忆/先验依赖。
AI.method: 为每个问题构造数据文件的三个版本：证据保留、证据撤销、证据反转，用预注册参考统计量核验每次编辑，并在所有版本上运行同一代理；提出"证据接地准确率"指标，只有当代理在证据撤销时改答、在证据反转时跟随反转证据，才计正确。在 BAISBench 18 个单细胞问题与 GeneBench-Pro 4 个合成问题上评估 3 种代理支架和 5 个模型。
AI.result: 单细胞问题上 Claude 代理准确率 95%，但在无任何数据时仍答对 83%，证据接地准确率仅 41%。在 10 个基因任务中隐藏基因名后，跟随反转证据的运行比例从 58% 升至 93%，表明先验知识与所给数据相互竞争。基准分数与 LLM 评判者也会奖励忽视改变证据的答案。
AI.conclusion: 衡量科学智能而非记忆，必须检验答案是否跟随证据，以及评分机制是否为此给予奖励。

title: CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CURIO，一个好奇驱动的测试时学习框架，通过内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）为策略提供预测误差奖励，补充任务反馈，缓解强化学习中过早抑制低奖励但潜在有希望方向的问题，在数学发现与单细胞去噪任务上均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 开放式发现需要从反复尝试中学习，同时持续探索价值尚不明确的方向。冻结的大语言模型（LLM）搜索虽可在上下文中复用先前解，但无法根据测试问题上的成功与失败更新模型；而强化学习虽能实现适应，却可能因过度偏好高奖励轨迹而过早压制低奖励但潜在有希望的方向。
AI.method: 提出CURIO框架，引入内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）。ICWM学习策略隐藏状态表示中的转移，并在策略top-k选择之外的采样token上提供预测误差奖励。使用epoch归一化与退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。
AI.result: 在六个数学发现任务及单细胞去噪任务上，采用8B至235B的Qwen3骨干模型测试：三次运行均值在五个数学目标上优于仅任务奖励的RL对照组，在Circle Packing上匹配最佳已报告性能；在所有测试规模的两个留出语料上均提升去噪Score与MSE。相对增益在Hadamard上达18.3%，去噪Score达10.8%。代码多样性度量显示生成程序具有更大的结构变异。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心可作为开放式发现学习的互补探索信号，支持在测试时持续学习并提升性能与多样性。

title: Arm-wise Compositional Generalization in Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Generalization in multi-arm collaboration can be studied as composing familiar atomic skills in new ways across arms. However, existing evaluations offer limited insight into which training and architectural choices support this ability under different coordination requirements. We introduce \textbf{ACG-Bench}, a benchmark for \emph{Arm-wise Compositional Generalization} that provides a common testbed for studying skill recomposition in dual-arm policies. It contains 23 task--condition pairs across 8 task families, with 6 in-domain conditions and 17 unseen compositions covering reordering, synchronization, their combination, and cross-task composition. All methods receive the same per-arm atomic prompts, and success requires achieving the task goal while satisfying physical milestones and specified order or timing constraints. Using $π_{0.5}$ as a common vision-language-action backbone, we compare representative data-augmentation and architectural strategies with shared source data and a common evaluation protocol. Our architectural study examines arm-token grouping, skill-specific LoRA adapters (SkillLoRA), and arm-wise attention (AWA), highlighting the complementarity of skill-conditioned parameters and attention structure. Combining these choices yields \textbf{AE-VLA}, which achieves 21.53\% generalization success in simulation, compared with 2.94\% for Single $π_{0.5}$, 3.06\% for MA-VLA, and 5.53\% for two independently controlled $π_{0.5}$ policies. On physical SO101 robots, AE-VLA reaches 39.00\% mean success across five unseen conditions, compared with 10.00\% for the strongest baseline. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing dual-arm policies that generalize beyond fixed training routines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ACG-Bench 双臂组合泛化基准，并基于共享的 π0.5 视觉-语言-动作骨干系统比较数据增强与架构策略，最终提出 AE-VLA，在仿真与真机上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 多臂协作的泛化可被理解为以新方式组合熟悉的原子技能，但现有评测无法揭示在不同协调需求下，哪些训练与架构选择能支撑这种能力，缺乏统一测试平台。
AI.method: 构建 ACG-Bench 基准，包含 8 个任务族、23 个任务-条件对（6 个域内条件与 17 个未见组合，覆盖重排序、同步、二者组合及跨任务组合）；所有方法输入相同的逐臂原子提示，成功需同时满足任务目标、物理里程碑与顺序/时序约束。以 π0.5 为统一 VLA 骨干，在共享源数据与统一评测协议下比较数据增强与架构策略，架构研究涵盖臂 token 分组、技能专属 LoRA 适配器（SkillLoRA）与臂间注意力（AWA），并组合为 AE-VLA。
AI.result: 仿真中 AE-VLA 泛化成功率达 21.53%，显著高于 Single π0.5 的 2.94%、MA-VLA 的 3.06% 与两个独立控制 π0.5 策略的 5.53%；在实体 SO101 机器人上，AE-VLA 在五个未见条件下平均成功率为 39.00%，最强基线仅 10.00%。
AI.conclusion: 技能条件化参数与注意力结构具有互补性；该工作为设计能超越固定训练流程、具备泛化能力的双臂策略提供了实证指导。

title: Long-MDR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Deep-Research Agents
summary: The next generation of multimodal research agents must reason over long-lived research histories rather than short model completions. During a single task, an agent may repeatedly search the web, inspect visual evidence, revisit earlier hypotheses, and accumulate tens of thousands of tokens of multimodal context. Despite this trend, online RL for multimodal research agents remains largely confined to shorter contexts and interaction horizons. We push online RL training to 128k context and 75+ tool-interaction turns. To our knowledge, this is the first online multimodal deep-research RL study trained at 128k context, and the first trained with a 75 tool-turn horizon. Scaling to this regime exposes several practical limitations of conventional RL training. Early in training, weak policies make poor use of large interaction budgets, causing expensive rollouts with little reward improvement. Later, policy entropy can collapse before performance has saturated, prematurely ending useful learning. We introduce Long-MDR, a three-component training recipe designed specifically for this setting: On-Policy Distillation Warmup, Progressive Horizon Expansion, and Entropy-Triggered Rescue. Together, these techniques improve both the learning efficiency and stability of long-horizon RL, enabling continued gains in a regime where direct training is slow and costly. At a 50-turn evaluation budget, our RL-trained Long-MDR-9B ranks first on five of six benchmarks among the compared 7B-9B agents.

AI.tldr: 本文面向长时程多模态深度研究智能体的在线强化学习训练，提出将训练规模推进至128k上下文与75+工具交互轮次的方案，并给出Long-MDR三组件训练配方，在50轮评估预算下，Long-MDR-9B在6个基准中的5个上位列7B-9B智能体第一。
AI.motivation: 新一代多模态研究智能体需在长时程研究历史（而非短模型补全）上进行推理：单任务中可能反复搜索网页、检查视觉证据、回溯早期假设，累积数万token的多模态上下文。然而，多模态研究智能体的在线强化学习仍局限于较短上下文与交互时程。将在线RL推向128k上下文与75+工具轮次会暴露传统RL训练的实践性局限：训练早期弱策略无法有效利用大交互预算，产生昂贵但奖励提升甚微的rollout；后期策略熵可能在性能饱和前崩塌，导致有效学习过早终止。
AI.method: 提出Long-MDR，一种专为长时程在线多模态深度研究RL设计的三组件训练配方：1）On-Policy Distillation Warmup（在策略蒸馏预热）；2）Progressive Horizon Expansion（渐进式时程扩展）；3）Entropy-Triggered Rescue（熵触发救援）。训练规模为128k上下文、75+工具交互轮次。
AI.result: 这些技术共同提升了长时程RL的学习效率与稳定性，使得在直接训练缓慢且昂贵的场景下仍能持续获得性能增益。在50轮评估预算下，RL训练的Long-MDR-9B在六个基准中的五个上，于所比较的7B-9B智能体中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 该工作据称是首个在128k上下文下训练的在线多模态深度研究RL研究，也是首个在75工具轮次时程下训练的研究；其提出的Long-MDR配方有效缓解了长时程在线RL中的低效rollout与策略熵崩塌问题，在长时程多模态研究任务上取得领先性能。

title: Zero-Shot Time-Series Question Answering via Decoupled Perception and Reasoning
summary: Time-series question answering (TSQA) requires grounding linguistic queries and diverse answer formats in complex numerical observations. However, existing methods heavily overfit to specific datasets and struggle to generalize when input series, question contexts, and answer requirements shift simultaneously. To address this challenge, we propose TSHarness, an agentic framework that establishes a decoupled workflow for cross-dataset zero-shot TSQA. At its core, TSHarness divides and conquers numerical perception and contextual reasoning via a structured Time-Series Perception State (TPS). Guided by a reusable memory of analytical knowledge, a learned Tool Selector adaptively invokes numerical tools to extract salient statistical and temporal features into the TPS. The answering agent then performs semantic reasoning over the TPS to generate target outputs, triggering iterative re-perception through the feedback loop when evidence is deemed insufficient. By separating numerical feature extraction from question-specific reasoning, TSHarness eliminates the need for target-side training or answer feedback, providing a generalizable, cost-efficient foundation for zero-shot TSQA.

AI.tldr: 提出TSHarness，一个解耦式智能体框架，通过结构化时间序列感知状态（TPS）实现跨数据集零样本时间序列问答。
AI.motivation: 现有TSQA方法严重过拟合于特定数据集，当输入序列、问题上下文与答案要求同时变化时泛化能力差。
AI.method: TSHarness将数值感知与上下文推理解耦，以结构化时间序列感知状态（TPS）为核心；借助可复用分析知识记忆，学习式工具选择器自适应调用数值工具，将显著统计与时序特征抽取到TPS；答题智能体在TPS上进行语义推理生成输出，证据不足时经反馈回路触发迭代式重感知。
AI.result: 通过分离数值特征抽取与问题特定推理，TSHarness无需目标侧训练或答案反馈，为跨数据集零样本TSQA提供通用且低成本的基础。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式感知—推理工作流可缓解过拟合并提升零样本迁移能力，是TSQA的可行通用范式。

title: Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Collaborative, Open, and Decentralized Training of Foundation Models (CODEC-FM). 13 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

AI.tldr: 在125M/400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}分块的因果语言模型预训练上，token预算对齐地比较贪心分块局部学习与端到端反向传播，量化损失差距并分解辅助设计（网络结构×训练目标），给出可操作的干预方向。
AI.motivation: 贪心分块局部学习通过局部辅助损失训练梯度隔离的块、消除块间反向传播，块间通信仅前向、各块可独立更新优化器，天然契合去中心化模型并行。它在图像分类上接近端到端训练，小Transformer上已知以更差的最优损失换取并行加速，但在更大规模自回归LM预训练中损失差距如何变化、哪些辅助设计能缩小差距，尚缺乏测量。
AI.method: 在125M与400M参数、Chinchilla最优token预算下，做token预算匹配的实证研究，块数K∈{1,2,4}；将辅助设计分解为两个维度：网络架构（MLP辅助器 vs. Transformer辅助器）与训练目标（如多token预测MTP），并按块边界位置系统消融。
AI.result: (i) 与端到端的差距从K=2到K=4扩大一倍以上，但K=4时从125M到400M差距缩小；(ii) 用Transformer辅助器替换MLP是强力的网络侧干预，可回收22–41%的差距；(iii) MTP辅助目标在第一块边界有效，加到更深边界反而有害，仅限首块时得到最佳K=4配置（400M下+0.062 vs. +0.075 nats）；(iv) 部署式逐块执行将激活内存最多降低2.2×。
AI.conclusion: 该工作定位为有实证支撑的方法方向而非成型方法：局部目标应在各边界上选择性地施加未来预测压力，同时抑制绕过预测内容的捷径。

title: STC-MPM: Coupled Deformation, Progressive Damage, and Cut Formation in Soft-Tissue Cutting
summary: Cutting is a recurring operation in robotic au tomation, from food preparation to surgical tissue resection. For highly compliant targets, blade motion may deform or displace the material rather than advance the intended cut, while progressive failure changes load transfer and subsequent tool tissue interaction. A computational description must therefore connect cut formation to the evolving mechanical response, rather than specifying the incision independently of material failure. We present STC-MPM (Soft Tissue Cutting with the Material Point Method), a framework that couples finite-strain deformation, history-driven continuum damage, and configurable post-failure treatment. Damage initiates only when a tensile strain history exceeds a material threshold within the blade process zone. Progressive degradation changes stress transmission before the post-failure policy is applied, while the remaining tissue continues to deform, move, and interact with the tool. Numerical scalpel studies using delayed particle deactivation follow this response through insertion and withdrawal. Under identical blade motion, reducing the damage-rate limit leaves the first recorded damage time unchanged but delays and increases peak reaction force, delays particle deactivation, and increases the fixed-cohort displacement statistic at maximum insertion. The matched comparison illustrates how post-initiation failure evolution alters subsequent tool loading and recorded material motion. STC-MPM thus supports joint analysis of cut formation and accompanying tissue response without a pre-inserted cutting interface.

AI.tldr: 提出STC-MPM框架，将有限应变变形、历史驱动连续损伤与可配置后失效处理耦合，实现无预置切割界面的软组织切割仿真。
AI.motivation: 机器人自动化中的切割（如食品处理、手术组织切除）面对高顺应性目标时，刀片运动可能使材料变形或移位而非推进预定切割，且渐进失效会改变载荷传递与刀具-组织交互。因此计算描述必须将切割形成与演化的力学响应相连接，而非独立于材料失效来指定切口。
AI.method: STC-MPM：耦合有限应变变形、历史驱动连续损伤与可配置后失效处理。损伤仅在拉伸应变历史在刀片过程区内超过材料阈值时起始；渐进退化先改变应力传递，再施加后失效策略，同时残余组织继续变形、移动并与刀具交互。算例采用延迟粒子失效（delayed particle deactivation）的数值手术刀研究，跟踪插入与拔出过程。
AI.result: 在相同刀片运动下，降低损伤速率上限不改变首次记录的损伤时刻，但会延迟并提高峰值反作用力、延迟粒子失效，并增大最大插入时的固定队列位移统计量。该配对比较表明，损伤起始后的失效演化会改变后续刀具载荷与所记录的材料运动。
AI.conclusion: STC-MPM支持在无预置切割界面条件下，对切割形成及其伴随的组织响应进行联合分析。

title: F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM
summary: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出 F2SLAM，将前馈3D模型的几何预测直接转化为优化原生的目标权重测量，附着在持久稠密因子图上，通过高频局部跟踪与低频多视角刷新双流约束同一组位姿、逆深度及可选内参，实现单一稠密BA优化。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D模型具有强多视角几何先验，而在线SLAM主要依赖局部测量、长序列易累积漂移。现有结合方式多把前馈预测当作外部几何状态，在优化后再对齐或融合，导致更广的多视角证据始终处于精化SLAM状态的优化器之外，无法有效抑制漂移。
AI.method: F2SLAM 将前馈几何转换为优化原生的目标权重测量并挂接到持久稠密因子图上。采用双频流：高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性；低频流利用更广的多视角上下文，在状态一致性检查后有选择地刷新已有测量。两流通过单一稠密BA共同约束相同的位姿、逆深度和可选相机内参。
AI.result: 在多个基准上方法均取得稳定的强轨迹估计，并在标定与未标定设置下改善稠密重建。未标定配置下，在Replica数据集上平均ATE RMSE由最强前馈基线的0.030 m降至0.002 m。
AI.conclusion: 将前馈几何内化为优化原生测量、并与在线SLAM共置于同一因子图优化中，能够有效利用多视角先验抑制漂移，同时兼容未标定场景，兼顾轨迹精度与稠密重建质量。

title: BACAM: Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging for Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: Model merging offers a way to integrate the capabilities of specialized experts, but existing agent merging methods typically require all of them to be available at once. We study continual agent merging, which integrates incoming experts sequentially without retaining previously merged experts. Yet merging in parameter space or feature subspaces does not ensure that the merged model acquires an incoming expert's behavior on interaction trajectories. Moreover, updates toward a new expert can disrupt the merged model's previously integrated interactive behavior. Therefore, we propose Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging (BACAM), which learns parameter-wise merging gates from candidate-generated trajectories using expert-guided behavioral supervision. Task-level stability-plasticity control and tensor-level conflict-aware update budgets limit interference with existing capabilities while allowing new ones to be acquired. The learned gates are folded into the model weights without additional inference-time parameters. Across four interactive tasks - web shopping, tool use, information retrieval, and embodied interaction - BACAM achieves an average success rate of 62.82%, exceeding the strongest evaluated merging baseline by 21.69 percentage points. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/shuaitongli/BACAM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出行为感知持续智能体合并方法（BACAM），通过从候选生成轨迹中学习参数级合并门控，实现无需保留历史专家的持续智能体能力整合，在四类交互任务上平均成功率62.82%，较最强基线提升21.69个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体合并方法通常要求所有专家同时可用，而实际场景中专家可能按顺序到达，无法保留已合并专家；同时在参数空间或特征子空间进行合并无法保证合并模型在交互轨迹上习得新专家的行为，且面向新专家的更新会破坏既有的已整合交互行为。
AI.method: 提出行为感知持续智能体合并（BACAM）：利用专家引导的行为监督，从候选生成轨迹中学习参数级合并门控；引入任务级稳定性-可塑性控制与张量级冲突感知更新预算，在获取新能力的同时限制对既有能力的干扰；学习到的门控被折叠进模型权重，不增加推理时参数。
AI.result: 在网页购物、工具使用、信息检索和具身交互四类交互任务上，BACAM 实现平均成功率 62.82%，超越最强合并基线 21.69 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: BACAM 为持续智能体合并提供了一种有效方案，能够在顺序接收专家且不保留历史专家的条件下，无额外推理开销地整合多专家交互能力，并显著优于现有合并基线。

title: Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models
summary: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出时序链路预测中的负采样方式使模型对"谁发起交互"（源节点活跃度）视而不见，提出仅含不到20个参数的源节点活跃度建模（SNAM），可独立或作为插件显著提升多种模型性能与速度。
AI.motivation: 交互包含两部分：谁决定行动、以及选择对谁行动。现有时间链路预测研究集中在后者的目标选择建模，作者证明标准负采样（保留真实源、替换目标）会从最优得分中精确抵消源活跃度因子，导致模型永远得不到学习该信号的奖励，从而构成一个系统性盲点。然而在源不同的历史/归纳式负采样下，该因子反而成为主导信号。
AI.method: 提出源节点活跃度建模SNAM：将源活跃度建模为自激事件强度，用精确的点过程似然拟合历史中已存在的衰减交互计数，参数少于20个；该模块可单独使用（不看目标节点），也可作为插件叠加在TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD等冻结得分上，无需重新训练。
AI.result: SNAM单独使用即在五种数据集中四种上于历史负采样下优于DyGFormer和TPNet；作为插件使四种不同设计的模型在几乎所有骨干-数据集组合上AP提升，最高达25个点；完整模型在13个数据集、三种协议下对11个基线排名第一；在百万级事件流上训练一个epoch比TPNet和DyGFormer快9-100倍。
AI.conclusion: 源节点活跃度是时间链路预测的一个盲点，且能够以低成本、可迁移的方式加以弥补，代码已开源。

title: Towards Quadruped-Provided Localization and Active Tracking for Micro-UAVs
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted version (before peer review) of a paper accepted at CLAWAR 2026, Cranfield, UK, 14 to 16 September 2026. The published version, titled "Towards Quadruped-Provided Localization and Active Tracking for Nano-UAVs", will appear in the CLAWAR 2026 proceedings (Springer, Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems)
summary: Micro unmanned aerial vehicles (micro-UAVs) are small enough to reach confined spaces that larger robots cannot access, but too small to carry the sensing and computing power required for autonomous flight. We move the localization stack entirely off the aerial platform onto a quadruped robot with a 7-degree-of-freedom (DOF) arm, which supplies the micro-UAV (27 g bare, 42 g with fiducial markers) its full 6-DOF pose. A camera at the arm's end-effector detects AprilTag fiducial markers on the drone and composes that observation with the quadruped's own self-localization to place the drone in a shared map frame, so the ground robot localizes its partner, rather than only tracking it relative to the camera. The arm acts as an actively-controlled observer, repositioning to keep the drone in view as both robots move; the drone carries only an inertial measurement unit and fuses the external pose to fly commanded setpoints. In lab flights the external pose is accurate to 12-16 mm, enough to fly the drone autonomously within 2-5 cm of motion-capture-fed control. Having the quadruped actively follow the drone reduces the tracking error from 11.0 cm to 6.9 cm by holding the camera in the close range, where the markers are most accurate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将微型无人机的定位栈完全迁移到配备7自由度机械臂的四足机器人上，由机械臂末端相机检测无人机上的AprilTag，结合四足自身定位为无人机提供6自由度位姿，实现微型无人机自主飞行。
AI.motivation: 微型无人机（裸机27 g，带标记42 g）体积小可进入狭窄空间，但载荷与算力不足以自主飞行；现有方案通常依赖外部动捕或机载传感，难以兼顾小型化与自主性。
AI.method: 在四足机器人7自由度机械臂末端安装相机，检测无人机上的AprilTag基准标记；将该观测与四足机器人自身定位相融合，把无人机置于共享地图坐标系中。机械臂作为主动观测器动态调整位姿以保持无人机在视野内，无人机仅携带IMU并融合外部位姿跟踪设定点。
AI.result: 实验室飞行中外部位姿精度为12–16 mm，足以支持无人机自主飞行，与动捕驱动的控制误差在2–5 cm以内；四足主动跟随无人机将跟踪误差从11.0 cm降至6.9 cm，因为相机保持在近距离使标记检测最准确。
AI.conclusion: 通过将定位计算卸载到地面四足-机械臂系统，可为资源受限的微型无人机提供高精度外部6自由度位姿，实现接近动捕质量的自主飞行；主动观测策略进一步提升了跟踪精度。

title: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment
summary: Streaming head-avatar reenactment aims to animate a reference image according to a live driving video, requiring robust motion transfer, long-term identity stability, and low latency. Existing methods often rely on specialized identity or motion representations, which can discard useful visual information and inherit failure modes from external extractors. In addition, many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising an entire video clip before producing its output, making continuous low-latency streaming difficult. We introduce PixReenact, a pixel-conditioned streaming reenactment framework built on causal video diffusion. PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations. To separate reference identity from driver motion, we train with cross-identity pseudo supervision together with corrective objectives anchored to the original reference and driving inputs. Long self-rollouts reduce autoregressive drift, while state-aware dual-teacher distillation separately addresses cold-start and steady-state generation. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment, particularly under challenging conditions such as extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining the reference identity over long streams. A 4-NFE rolling student continuously emits four frames per update with a mean emission latency of 239 ms.

title: Runtime Authorization of Self-Generated Subgoals in Long-Horizon Tool-Using AI Agents
summary:
Long-horizon tool-using AI agents create subgoals, replan, delegate work, and compose sibling results. Per-tool permission checks cannot establish that a changing goal graph remains within the principal-approved task. We address this authorization gap in a finite structured domain with one principal and one authorization root. Each proposed goal-graph mutation carries a version-bound witness that its continuation traces, resources, obligations, invariants, and closing condition refine the active root contract; every protected effect is rechecked at an atomic commit boundary. Free-form goal text supplies no authority.
  We prove trace-policy and modeled forbidden-state preservation under explicit mediation, abstraction, freshness, and atomicity assumptions, plus conditional root-success preservation, a separation result for memoryless allowlists, exact finite-domain decidability, and universal-safety monotonicity under sound abstraction refinement. An executable model explores 340 states and 419 transitions. Across 96 matched cases covering 25 structural schemas, the complete mechanism commits zero forbidden states in 48 drifted cases and completes all 48 benign counterparts. Two public upstream runtime paths execute 258 native dispatches across 32 cases, with every case-level decision and receipt chain matching. A frozen host-local study covers 129 synthetic one-factor-at-a-time cells, all matching fixed decisions and reasons. A history-aware continuation comparator blocks every modeled bad trace prefix but commits all operations in 11 cases whose violations lie in typed resources, freshness, or explicit-join evidence outside its trace projection. Within the registered structured domains, runtime authorization preserves useful replanning while preventing self-generated subgoals from becoming a source of new authority.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向长时程工具使用智能体的、版本绑定的"目标图变更见证"授权机制，以根契约细化关系替代逐工具权限检查，在有限结构域内证明并实验验证其安全性、可判定性与实用性保留。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体会生成子目标、重规划、委派与结果组合，目标图动态可变；而逐工具权限检查无法保证变化后的目标图仍处于主体批准的任务范围内，形成授权缺口。同时，自由文本目标不应被赋予任何权威。
AI.method: 在单主体、单授权根的有限结构域内，要求每次目标图变更携带版本绑定的见证，证明其继续轨迹、资源、义务、不变量与关闭条件细化当前根契约；所有受保护效果在原子提交边界重新校验。方法包含执行模型（340状态、419转移）、两个公共上游运行时的原生调度测试、冻结的主机本地单因素实验，以及一个历史感知的继续比较器对照。
AI.result: 在显式中介、抽象、新鲜性与原子性假设下证明轨迹策略与建模禁止状态保持，并给出条件式根成功保持、无记忆允许列表的分离结果、有限域精确可判定性及健全抽象细化下的通用安全单调性。96个匹配案例（25种结构模式）中，48个漂移案例零禁止状态提交，48个良性对应案例全部完成；两个上游运行时路径在32个案例中执行258次原生调度，逐案例决策与收据链一致；129个合成单因素单元全部与固定决策及理由一致；历史感知比较器阻断所有建模的坏轨迹前缀，但对11个违规位于类型化资源、新鲜性或显式连接证据（超出其轨迹投影）的案例仍全部提交。
AI.conclusion: 在注册的结构化域内，运行时授权既能保留有用的重规划能力，又能阻止自生成子目标成为新权威来源。

title: ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: ResOPD 通过在稀疏教师接口下对词表尾部进行残差化聚合，实现无偏且低方差的 on-policy 蒸馏反向 KL 梯度估计。
AI.motivation: on-policy 蒸馏需传输稠密教师分布，带来通信与显存瓶颈，实际系统只能用稀疏接口（采样 token 分数或 Top-k 分布）。但稀疏设定存在两难：采样 token 估计无偏却梯度方差大，直接优化 Top-k 目标则引入系统性偏差。
AI.method: 提出 ResOPD（Tail Residualization）：将未观测词表聚合为一个可观测的粗粒度尾部事件，计算其精确聚合梯度，仅对尾部内部残差进行采样，从而在相同稀疏 payload 下获得无偏的全词表反向 KL 梯度估计，且无需额外教师查询或前向传播。
AI.result: 在评估设定中显著降低梯度方差，稳定在线训练动态，并提升下游性能；相同稀疏 payload 下实现大幅方差缩减。
AI.conclusion: ResOPD 是一种高效、即插即用的稀疏 on-policy 蒸馏方差缩减原语。

title: AUTOPILOT An Advanced Perception, Localization and Path Planning Techniques for Autonomous Vehicles Using YOLOv7 and MiDaS
comment: Published in the 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing Technologies and Applications (ICACTA), IEEE
summary: Self driving vehicles have emerged as a reliable technology that has the capability to transform transportation and mobility. The development of self driving cars requires significant advances in a number of areas, including perception, localization, decision making, and control. This research paper is based on the project implementation of the combination of object detection using YOLO (You Only Look Once), depth sensing using MiDaS for the localization and perception of obstacles, perspective transform, and decision making for path planning in self driving cars. The contemporary state of the technology for object detection, depth sensing, localization, and path planning evaluates the performance of the combined system through simulations and experiments. The results show that the combination of YOLO and MiDaS provides a new robust system for object detection and depth sensing. This research paper contributes to the advancement of self driving car technology and provides new and innovative approaches to the perception and localization of obstacles in the environment. Keywords: YOLO, MiDaS, perception, localization, decision making

AI.tldr: 本文结合YOLO目标检测、MiDaS深度感知、透视变换与决策路径规划，在仿真与实验中验证了该组合系统用于自动驾驶障碍物感知与定位的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶被视为可变革交通出行的可靠技术，但其发展在感知、定位、决策与控制等关键环节仍需重大突破，尤其需要更稳健的障碍物感知与定位方案。
AI.method: 基于项目实现，将YOLO目标检测、MiDaS单目深度感知、透视变换以及用于路径规划的决策模块进行组合集成，并通过仿真与实验评估系统性能。
AI.result: 仿真与实验结果表明，YOLO与MiDaS的结合为环境中的目标检测与深度感知提供了一种新的鲁棒系统。
AI.conclusion: 研究推动了自动驾驶技术的发展，并为环境障碍物的感知与定位提供了新颖方法，同时对该领域主流技术现状进行了评估。

title: ArticuTable: Generating Instance-Level Interactive Rigid-Articulated 3D Tabletop Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Embodied agents benefit from 3D environments that combine visual fidelity to real-world observations with physical interactivity. Existing single-image tabletop reconstruction methods recover plausible scene geometry but typically represent objects as monolithic rigid bodies, limiting interaction to whole-object rigid motion and precluding executable part-level articulation. Meanwhile, recovering a scene layout consistent with the input view remains challenging because a single observation may admit multiple plausible pose-scale configurations. We present ArticuTable, a single-image 3D tabletop reconstruction framework that recovers both executable part-level articulation and an input-view-consistent scene layout. For object modeling, we introduce generation-robust articulation modeling (GRAM), which combines joint fitting guided by a multimodal large language model with semantic state reasoning to recover reliable joint parameters and valid motion ranges from imperfect monolithic proxy meshes, thereby converting them into executable articulated assets. For scene layout, we introduce progressive semantic-geometric scene registration (PSGSR), which progressively narrows the pose-scale search space under complementary metric, planar, and input-view constraints and resolves orientation ambiguity through structure-aware semantic correspondences, yielding a scene layout consistent with the input view. We further contribute ArticuTable-100, a curated collection of 100 simulation-ready tabletop scenes. Extensive evaluation, including a user study, demonstrates strong performance across visual fidelity, input-view consistency, articulation quality, physical plausibility, and simulation readiness.

AI.tldr: ArticuTable：单图桌面场景重建框架，同时恢复可执行部件级关节运动与输入视角一致的场景布局；含GRAM关节建模与PSGSR场景配准，并贡献ArticuTable-100数据集。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要兼具真实视觉保真度与物理交互性的3D环境。现有单图桌面重建虽能恢复合理几何，但通常将物体表示为整体刚体，交互仅限整体刚性运动，无法进行部件级可执行关节操作；同时单视角存在多解（位姿-尺度歧义），难以保证与输入视角一致的场景布局。
AI.method: 提出ArticuTable框架，包含两个模块：（1）生成鲁棒关节建模（GRAM）：以多模态大语言模型引导的联合拟合，结合语义状态推理，从不完美的整体代理网格中恢复可靠关节参数与有效运动范围，转化为可执行关节资产；（2）渐进式语义-几何场景配准（PSGSR）：在度量、平面与输入视角等互补约束下逐步缩小位姿-尺度搜索空间，并通过结构感知语义对应解决朝向歧义。
AI.result: 构建ArticuTable-100（100个可仿真桌面场景的精选数据集）；大量实验（含用户研究）表明在视觉保真度、输入视角一致性、关节质量、物理合理性与仿真可用性方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过将单图重建从整体刚体拓展到可执行部件级关节资产，并显式约束输入视角一致性，ArticuTable为具身交互提供了仿真就绪的3D桌面场景，配套数据集可支撑后续研究。

title: Do LLMs Understand Sequential Structure? A Controlled Study of Inference and Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents and simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they can recover latent sequential structure beyond surface action frequencies. This distinction is critical for behavioral simulation, where actions are often shaped by prior context rather than marginal frequencies alone. We study this question using controlled two-player Rock--Paper--Scissors interactions and a one-player stochastic n-gram continuation task. Across these experiments, we test whether LLMs can identify latent strategies, follow simple Markov rules, and sustain higher-order conditional dependencies. Our framework separates distribution matching from conditional rule following. Results show that longer context does not improve identification, correct recognition does not ensure faithful simulation, and higher-order dependencies substantially degrade rule recovery. Apparent behavioral fidelity can therefore mask incorrect generative mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控的石头-剪刀-布双人交互和一阶/高阶n-gram延续任务，检验LLM能否恢复潜在序列结构。结果显示更长上下文不提升识别、正确识别不保证忠实模拟、高阶依赖显著降低规则恢复，表面行为保真可能掩盖错误的生成机制。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作交互代理与行为模拟器，但其是否真正捕捉到序列背后的潜在结构（而非仅匹配表面动作频率）尚不清楚。这一区分对行为模拟至关重要，因为行动往往由先前上下文塑造，而非仅由边际频率决定。
AI.method: 采用受控实验设计：双人石头-剪刀-布交互（检验潜在策略识别）与单人随机n-gram延续任务（检验简单马尔可夫规则遵循与更高阶条件依赖维持）。框架将分布匹配与条件规则遵循分离评估，并比较不同上下文长度、识别正确性与规则恢复程度的关系。
AI.result: 更长的上下文并未改善策略识别；正确识别潜在策略并不确保忠实的生成模拟；高阶条件依赖显著降低规则恢复能力。表面行为保真度可能掩盖不正确的生成机制。
AI.conclusion: LLM的行为相似性不等于机制一致性，评估行为模拟器需区分分布匹配与条件规则遵循；仅凭输出表面的行为保真可能得出误导性结论。

title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出SFlexRCA——一种无拓扑、可扩展且轻量的IIoT根因分析框架，通过将多元遥测转换为紧凑正交表示并进行共享线性建模，摆脱图构建与大规模参数增长，在三个公开数据集及树莓派边缘设备上验证了定位精度与部署效率。
AI.motivation: IIoT系统由互连组件产生高维传感器遥测数据，故障会在系统内传播；传统根因分析方法多依赖显式拓扑/图结构、消息传递或按变量与时滞增长参数，在资源受限的IIoT环境中难以扩展和部署。
AI.method: SFlexRCA为无拓扑（topology-free）框架：将多元遥测转化为紧凑的正交表示（orthogonal representations），并采用共享的轻量线性建模（shared lightweight linear modeling），避免显式图构建、消息传递以及按变量或时滞的参数增长。在BATADAL、SWaT、WADI三个公开IIoT数据集上评估，与10个统计、因果及非因果基线对比，指标涵盖RCA准确率、训练效率、推理时延与内存占用；并在Raspberry Pi 3、Raspberry Pi 5上测推理效率与内存，在Pi 5上测能耗；另开展时间上下文敏感性、架构与损失组件、替代表示的消融分析。
AI.result: SFlexRCA在RCA准确率、训练效率、推理时延与内存消耗上表现良好，在BATADAL上即使正常工况训练数据有限仍保持较强定位性能；共享紧凑架构避免了因果与图方法带来的参数增长；轻量架构支持在资源受限的IIoT边缘设备（Raspberry Pi 3/5）上高效部署，Pi 5上的能耗也被测量验证。
AI.conclusion: SFlexRCA以无拓扑、共享线性建模的方式，在保持根因定位能力的同时显著降低参数规模与计算/内存开销，适用于资源受限的IIoT边缘部署；消融实验进一步说明了时间上下文、架构与损失设计及表示选择的作用。代码已开源。

title: Encoded but Not in Control: Revealing the Grounding Gap in Vision-Language Robot Policies
summary: Instruction following is central to language-conditioned robot policies: language should determine what to do when the same scene permits multiple valid actions. Yet successful execution alone cannot establish whether a policy follows the instruction or infers the task from the scene. We study this ambiguity through scene-preserving instruction interventions, using valid target substitutions, arbitrary nouns, and unrelated sentences while holding the scene fixed. We evaluate vision-language-action (VLA) policies and world-action models (WAMs) in simulation and in real-world experiments. Our analysis addresses three questions: (a) Does task success imply instruction following? When instructions request a different visible object, all evaluated policies predominantly approach and pick up the incorrect original target associated with the scene. (b) Is this failure caused by language insensitivity? Instruction perturbations affect task performance. A layerwise action lens shows intermediate action predictions respond to these perturbations. Linear probes accurately recover instructed targets, indicating modified instructions are encoded despite rarely determining target selection. (c) Why does encoded language fail to control action? Attention analysis indicates weak instruction-token contributions to action generation. Target-token attention can remain focused on the original object, revealing a mismatch between target encoding and visual grounding. UMAP and shared non-negative matrix factorization show target information remains accessible within representations increasingly organized by scene identity. Our findings expose a grounding gap concealed by nominal success and provide a diagnostic framework. They further establish a concrete criterion for progress: policies should reliably follow valid changes in user intent, even when they conflict with scene-favored behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"保持场景不变的指令干预"（合法目标替换、任意名词、无关句子）系统检验VLA策略与世界动作模型，发现任务成功并不等于遵循指令：策略多按场景偏好抓取原目标。语言扰动会影响表现且被中间层编码（线性探针可恢复目标），但指令token对动作生成的贡献弱，目标token注意力仍锁定原物体，呈现出"编码—视觉落地"错配的落地鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 语言条件机器人策略的核心在于：当同一场景允许多种有效动作时，应由语言决定做什么。然而仅凭执行成功无法区分"遵循指令"与"从场景推断任务"，二者存在歧义，亟需一套能剥离场景线索的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出场景保持的指令干预范式：固定场景，只改变指令（合法目标替换、任意名词、无关句子）。在仿真与真实环境中评测VLA策略与世界动作模型（WAM）。分析手段包括：逐层动作透镜（layerwise action lens）观察中间动作预测、线性探针解码指令目标、注意力分析衡量指令token对动作生成的贡献、UMAP与共享非负矩阵分解（NMF）刻画表征组织方式。
AI.result: (a) 任务成功不蕴含指令遵循：当指令要求另一可见物体时，所有被评测策略仍主要去接近并抓取与场景关联的原目标。(b) 失败并非源于语言不敏感：指令扰动会改变任务表现；逐层动作透镜显示中间动作预测对扰动有响应，线性探针能准确恢复被指令的目标，说明改后指令已被编码，却极少决定目标选择。(c) 编码语言为何不控制动作：注意力分析显示指令token对动作生成贡献微弱，目标token注意力可长期停留在原物体上，暴露目标编码与视觉落地的错配；UMAP与共享NMF显示目标信息仍可获取，但表征日益按场景身份组织。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了被"名义成功"掩盖的落地鸿沟（grounding gap），提供了一个可复用的诊断框架，并给出明确的进展判据：策略应能可靠遵循用户意图的合法改变，即使该改变与场景偏好行为相冲突。

title: MGPO: Manifold-Guided Diffusion Alignment for Task-Aware Dataset Distillation
summary: Diffusion-based dataset distillation (DD) suffers from a fundamental objective mismatch: likelihood-driven diffusion models prioritize density approximation over the discriminative decision boundaries required for downstream tasks. Beyond semantic mismatch, relying solely on density also leads to geometric coverage loss, where generated samples collapse into a few high-density modes and fail to cover the manifold's structural diversity. We propose Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO), which reformulates DD as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and achieves Dual-Space Alignment via a pixel-space discriminative reward and a latent-space geometric reward guided by a class-wise Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). The discriminative reward enforces class separability, while the MST-based geometric reward encourages generated latents to cover a sparse geometric skeleton of each class, jointly addressing both failure modes. We further provide an idealized analysis that motivates the MST-based reward, including a Hausdorff approximation bound and a subsampling bound independent of the dataset size. The reward-modular design extends to structured tasks such as object detection and segmentation by substituting the frozen task reward model. Extensive experiments show MGPO consistently outperforms existing methods, including a +8.0% mIoU gain on segmentation under low-budget settings.

AI.tldr: MGPO将扩散数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，通过像素空间判别奖励与潜空间MST几何奖励实现双空间对齐，联合解决语义错配与几何覆盖损失，在分类与结构化任务上均超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的数据集蒸馏存在根本性目标错配：似然驱动的扩散模型优先近似密度分布，而非下游任务所需的判别性决策边界；仅依赖密度还导致几何覆盖损失，生成样本坍缩到少数高密度模态，无法覆盖流形的结构多样性。因此需要同时解决语义错配与几何覆盖两种失效模式。
AI.method: 提出Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization（MGPO），将数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，通过像素空间的判别奖励与潜空间的几何奖励实现双空间对齐，其中几何奖励由逐类最小生成树（MST）引导。判别奖励强化类间可分性，MST几何奖励促使生成潜变量覆盖每类的稀疏几何骨架。方法还提供理想化分析，包括Hausdorff近似界与与数据集规模无关的子采样界。奖励模块化设计可通过替换冻结任务奖励模型扩展到目标检测、分割等结构化任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MGPO持续优于现有方法，在低预算设置下分割任务取得+8.0% mIoU提升。
AI.conclusion: MGPO通过判别奖励与MST几何奖励的双空间对齐，有效缓解扩散数据集蒸馏中的语义错配与几何覆盖损失，并具备向结构化任务扩展的模块化能力，实验验证其优越性。

title: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be studied as adaptive tool granularity selection. The most direct training signal for this problem is to compare the consequences of atomic and skill choices available from the same state. Based on this view, we propose CIPO, a Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization framework for adaptive tool granularity. CIPO constructs executable skills through budget-constrained mining of successful tool-use trajectories and trains granularity decisions with counterfactual branch rollouts. For each base rollout, CIPO branches at the first eligible granularity decision and replaces the chosen action with a feasible atomic or skill alternative. The paired outcome difference serves as a supplementary reward for policy optimization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model backbones show that CIPO improves task success and decision efficiency over baselines. Further analyses show that CIPO learns effective skill use by improving the choice between atomic tools and composite skills based on the current state, without simply increasing skill frequency.

AI.tldr: 提出CIPO框架，将LLM agent的技能使用建模为自适应工具粒度选择问题，通过反事实想象策略优化训练粒度决策。
AI.motivation: LLM agent通过多步工具交互解决复杂任务，轨迹中常含重复的局部工具序列，可视为复合"技能"。但原子工具与复合技能共存时，技能使用成为策略问题：agent需判断当前状态需要原子级精细控制还是技能级抽象。作者主张应将其作为自适应工具粒度选择问题研究，最直接的训练信号来自比较同一状态下原子与技能选择的后果。
AI.method: CIPO（Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization）：通过预算约束的挖掘从成功工具使用轨迹中构建可执行技能；用反事实分支rollout训练粒度决策——对每条基础rollout，在首个符合条件的粒度决策点分支，将所选动作替换为可行的原子或技能替代方案，配对的结果差异作为策略优化的补充奖励。
AI.result: 在多个基准与模型backbone上，CIPO相比基线提升了任务成功率与决策效率；进一步分析表明CIPO通过依据当前状态改进原子工具与复合技能之间的选择来学习有效技能使用，而非单纯增加技能使用频率。
AI.conclusion: 有效的技能使用应被视为自适应工具粒度选择，反事实分支比较提供了直接有效的训练信号，CIPO验证了该视角的有效性。

title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScopeSAE，按 token 选择预测相关的建模子空间，而非固定按层，缓解了逐层 SAE 的特征利用率低、字典冗余高和缺乏行为基础等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 SAE 主要按层训练，建模子空间被层身份固定，与真正驱动每个预测的 token-层状态无关。作者认为这一约束导致逐层 SAE 出现特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏直接行为基础等局限。
AI.method: 通过归一化梯度归因，将每个预测归因到最具影响力的 token-层状态，从而按 token 选择建模子空间，并在该预测相关子空间上学习特征。
AI.result: 出现“重建优于原始”效应：SAE 回写重建的下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活。通过干预分析和 KL 微调对照实验，证明该效应源于预测相关子空间而非架构变化；并在有效特征数、可解释性、利用率和字典冗余上优于逐层基线。
AI.conclusion: 以预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间，可得到更有用、更具行为意义的特征。

title: VLA-ZO: Fast Zeroth-Order Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Adapting vision-language-action (VLA) models to deployment-time distribution shifts is important for reliable robotic operation, but conventional first-order adaptation can exceed the memory budget of inference-oriented deployment platforms. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a forward-only alternative with inference-level memory, but accurate gradient estimation requires many perturbation queries, making naive ZO prohibitively slow for large VLA models. We present VLA-ZO, a framework for fast ZO adaptation that exploits the structure of VLA computation. By confining adaptation to the action side, VLA-ZO keeps the expensive vision-language prefix frozen and reuses its conditioning states across perturbation queries and optimizer steps, while schedule-aware prefetching hides state-transfer overhead. On LIBERO camera-viewpoint shifts, VLA-ZO reduces end-to-end adaptation time by 25.59$\times$ at $q=16$ and 32.54$\times$ at $q=64$ relative to baseline ZO, while improving average task success from 48.27% without adaptation to 58.17% and 63.58%, respectively. These results show that making ZO faster can make larger query budgets practical, providing a promising path toward resource-efficient VLA adaptation on deployment platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出VLA-ZO框架，通过将零阶适配限制在动作端并复用冻结视觉-语言前缀的条件状态，实现大模型VLA在部署时分布偏移下的快速、低内存适配。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在部署时面临分布偏移，需在线适配以保证可靠操作。但传统一阶适配的内存需求超出面向推理的部署平台预算；零阶优化虽为仅前向、内存占用接近推理水平，却因梯度估计需要大量扰动查询而速度过慢，难以用于大型VLA模型。
AI.method: VLA-ZO利用VLA计算结构：将适配限定在动作端，保持昂贵的视觉-语言前缀冻结，并在多次扰动查询与优化器步之间复用其条件状态；同时采用调度感知的预取机制隐藏状态传输开销。
AI.result: 在LIBERO相机视角偏移任务上，相较于基线ZO，VLA-ZO在q=16时端到端适配时间减少25.59倍，q=64时减少32.54倍；平均任务成功率从无适配的48.27%分别提升至58.17%（q=16）和63.58%（q=64）。
AI.conclusion: 提升ZO速度可使更大的查询预算变得可行，为部署平台上资源高效的VLA适配提供了有前景的路径。

title: Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting for Diffusion Sampling Acceleration
summary: We propose Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting (HybridFF), a training-free, plug-and-play framework for accelerating diffusion sampling. To capture local smoothness, long-range trends, and complex non-monotonic variations when modeling feature evolution, HybridFF first estimates coefficients using moving least squares (MLS) for each of multiple complementary basis families and then combines the corresponding predictors using fusion weights. In addition to the choice of basis functions, the fusion weights also play a critical role. We introduce two strategies to balance quality and speedup. HybridFF (Fixed) prioritizes efficiency with model-specific fusion weights calibrated on a small set and held constant during inference. HybridFF (Adaptive) updates the fusion weights online using branch reliability scores computed from an exponential moving average of full-step prediction errors, improving prediction fidelity and generation quality under aggressive caching while retaining substantial acceleration. Experiments across DiT-XL/2, FLUX.1-dev, SD3.5-Large, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate a favorable speedup--quality trade-off over representative single-basis forecasters and caching baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练、即插即用的扩散采样加速框架HybridFF，通过多基函数预测器融合预测特征演化，并提供Fixed与Adaptive两种权重策略平衡质量与加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型采样迭代次数多、推理开销大；现有缓存/预测式加速方法多采用单一基函数建模特征演化，难以同时刻画局部平滑、长程趋势与复杂非单调变化，导致加速与生成质量难以兼顾。
AI.method: HybridFF为training-free、plug-and-play框架。对多种互补基函数族分别用移动最小二乘（MLS）估计系数，得到各自预测器，再以融合权重组合。融合权重有两种策略：Fixed使用在小子集上校准的模型专属固定权重，侧重效率；Adaptive基于全步预测误差的指数移动平均（EMA）计算分支可靠性分数，在线更新融合权重，在激进缓存下提升预测保真度与生成质量。
AI.result: 在DiT-XL/2、FLUX.1-dev、SD3.5-Large与HunyuanVideo上实验，相较代表性单基函数预测器与缓存基线，取得更优的加速—质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 多基函数融合与权重自适应设计能有效提升扩散采样加速的质量—速度折中点，验证了基函数选择与融合权重均为关键因素。

title: EmoRSS: Mitigating Emotion-Induced Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
summary: Emotional expression can influence the safety decisions of large language models (LLMs), offering a potential avenue for improving safety alignment. Existing studies have mainly focused on how emotional expressions facilitate attacks under harmful requests, while overlooking their effects on benign requests. We find that emotional expression can also systematically increase refusal tendencies on benign requests, leading to unnecessary over-refusal. Based on this observation, we propose emotion-guided refusal subspace steering (EmoRSS), an activation-steering method that mitigates emotion-induced over-refusal while preserving refusal behaviour on harmful requests. Specifically, we first identify a refusal-sensitive layer using layer-wise linear probes and construct a refusal subspace from sparse autoencoder (SAE) features aligned with the probe direction. Next, we use paired regular and emotional requests with the same queries to estimate the mean activation shift in the features defining the refusal subspace. Finally, we decode this shift into an activation intervention vector and apply it in the reverse refusal direction during inference, without updating the backbone parameters. Experiments on two LLMs show that, when requests contain emotional expressions, our method achieves a more favourable trade-off between refusing harmful requests and answering benign ones than prior over-refusal mitigation baselines, while better preserving general task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文发现情感表达不仅可在有害请求下促成攻击，还会在良性请求上系统性地提高拒答倾向，导致过度拒答；为此提出EmoRSS激活引导方法，在保留对有害请求拒答的同时缓解情感诱发的过度拒答。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注情感表达如何在有害请求下促进攻击，忽视了其对良性请求的影响。作者发现情感表达会系统性地提高良性请求的拒答倾向，造成不必要的过度拒答，因此需要一种既能缓解情感诱发的过度拒答、又不损害对有害请求拒答能力的对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出EmoRSS（情感引导的拒答子空间引导）。首先用逐层线性探针识别对拒答敏感的层，并基于与探针方向对齐的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征构建拒答子空间；随后用相同查询的成对常规请求与情感请求，估计拒答子空间特征上的平均激活偏移；最后将该偏移解码为激活干预向量，在推理时沿反向拒答方向施加干预，且不更新主干参数。
AI.result: 在两个大语言模型上的实验表明，当请求包含情感表达时，本方法在“拒答有害请求”与“回答良性请求”之间取得了优于既有过度拒答缓解基线的权衡，同时更好地保持了通用任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 情感表达对良性请求的过度拒答影响被确证可通过激活层干预加以缓解；EmoRSS作为一种无需参数更新的推理期引导方法，能有效改善安全对齐中的过度拒答问题，并兼顾通用能力。

title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"潜意识学习"（subliminal learning）中数据需求量的来源，通过"潜意识引导"（subliminal steering）测试平台，证明软监督（KL）从数百条载体样本即可恢复教师特质向量，而硬监督（NLL）即使数万条也远不达标，并将差异归因于Fisher矩阵下的噪声线性逆问题。
AI.motivation: 已发表的潜意识学习演示通常需要数万条载体样本才能让学生继承教师的行为特质，但这一巨大数据需求的成因尚无解释。作者希望弄清"数据需求量从何而来"，并区分是特质揭示本身需要大数据，还是标签噪声抑制才需要大数据。
AI.method: 以潜意识引导为测试平台：教师特质为已知残差流向量Δ_T，转移可直接作为参数恢复来度量。在相同载体前缀下对比token级硬NLL监督与全分布软KL监督。将引导向量蒸馏建模为含噪线性逆问题：载体任务通过Fisher矩阵F局部映射特质，梯度指向FΔ_T，梯度下降表现为逐步减小阻尼的F逆运算。在Qwen2.5-7B与Gemma-2-9B上验证四项预测。
AI.result: 初始时两种目标梯度近乎共线且均与Δ_T对齐差；迭代优化后出现分化：软监督从数百条载体近乎精确恢复Δ_T，硬监督即使数万条仍远低于此。实验确认四项预测：初始梯度的Fisher畸变、从陡到平方向的恢复排序、随数据规模移动的最优逆深度，以及从固定提示池重采样补全与新增提示效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 在此设定下，大规模载体数据集主要不是为了揭示特质，而是为了抑制被Fisher逆运算放大的标签噪声。软监督能以极少数据实现特质恢复，硬监督则需大量数据来压制噪声，这解释了潜意识学习数据需求量的来源。

title: Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. They act by first predicting how a task should be performed and then decoding the actions from that future. However, the remaining actions are invalid once execution drifts from the prediction. Simply replanning from the already out of distribution state rarely restores what the task still requires; existing execution monitors decide when to stop, but not what to restore. We observe that the answer is already in hand: the future the WAM predicted before acting depicts exactly the states it intended to pass through. We introduce FAVOR (Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery), a lightweight framework that keeps these predicted frames as anchors and uses them for verification and recovery. An Anchor Verifier compares each observation with its anchor, together with the executed actions, to flag deviations that break the task. Anchor-Guided Recovery uses a vision-language model to turn the flagged anchor into a short corrective instruction. Under strengthened instruction guidance, the WAM executes this instruction to return to the intended future. It then resumes the task. FAVOR raises the task success of the base WAM from 97.85% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 72.60% to 72.98% on LIBERO-Plus without modifying the policy.

AI.tldr: 提出FAVOR框架，将世界动作模型预测的未来帧作为锚点，用于执行偏差验证与在线恢复，无需修改策略即可提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）先预测任务未来再据此解码动作，但一旦执行偏离预测，剩余动作即失效；从已分布外的状态重新规划往往无法恢复任务所需，现有执行监控只能判断何时停止，却无法决定恢复什么。
AI.method: FAVOR包含两部分：Anchor Verifier将每次观测与其锚点（WAM预测的未来帧）及已执行动作比对，标记破坏任务的偏差；Anchor-Guided Recovery利用视觉-语言模型将标记的锚点转为简短纠正指令，WAM在增强指令引导下执行该指令以回到预期未来，随后恢复任务。全程不修改策略。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上基础WAM任务成功率由97.85%提升至98.10%，在LIBERO-Plus上由72.60%提升至72.98%。
AI.conclusion: 保留并复用WAM预测的未来帧作为锚点，可为执行偏差提供验证依据与恢复目标，是一种轻量、免策略修改的性能增强方案。

title: When and What to Prune? Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA
summary: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAPrune，一种免训练的视觉token剪枝框架，用于加速VLA模型推理。它利用小规模校准集观察action-to-visual注意力随层变化，在注意力模式可靠后再选择剪枝层，并采用双路径剪枝规则，剪除87.5%视觉token的同时实现最高1.718倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法多采用固定剪枝方案（如在预设层剪枝一次或均匀间隔层剪枝），基于注意力分数或特征多样性判定可剪token。但这对VLA模型存在风险：早期层模型尚不清楚哪些视觉区域对动作重要，初次看似不重要的token可能在模型结合视觉观测与语言指令后变得有用。
AI.method: 提出SAPrune，一种免训练的VLA推理视觉token剪枝框架。不使用固定层剪枝，而是用小校准集观察action-to-visual注意力在各层的变化，待注意力模式变得更可靠后再选择剪枝层。在每个选定层采用双路径剪枝规则：一条路径保护被强关注的视觉token不被剪除，另一条路径防止有用的周边上下文被丢弃。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、SIMPLER及真实世界机器人任务上，SAPrune剪除87.5%的视觉token，实现最高1.718倍推理加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: SAPrune通过数据驱动的剪枝层选择与双路径剪枝规则，在免训练条件下显著降低VLA推理的视觉token开销并加速推理，同时维持任务成功率，验证了自适应剪枝时机与上下文保护对VLA模型的重要性。

title: How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Project page with videos: https://hhjj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/ Code: https://github.com/hhjj233/P-control-SG
summary:
Generating corner-case scenarios with appropriate adversity in a simulation environment is critical for testing an autonomous vehicle (AV) software stack's safety performance before deployment. Existing autonomous-driving scenario generators can enforce specific behavior, adversity, or feasibility conditions, but they provide limited control over how extreme a generated scenario is relative to plausible futures in the same traffic context. This study represents the adversity of a generated scenario as its percentile in the conditional distribution of future risk given the observed history. This view supports calibrated answers to two questions: how "corner" a generated corner-case scenario is and how its "cornerness" can be fine-tuned.
  To this end, we formulate history-conditioned risk-percentile requests and learn a reference risk distribution that maps each requested percentile to a physical risk target. We then use a percentile-conditioned joint diffusion model with sampling-time risk guidance to generate multi-agent futures, together with a reference-based criterion for evaluating percentile realization.
  Experiments use the minimum post-encroachment time (PET) between the ego and its surrounding vehicles as the risk surrogate on highD. On the primary evaluation set, our method realizes 1,422 of 1,440 requests within a 0.05 percentile tolerance (98.75%), with mean percentile error 0.00673 and PET-target error 0.00991 seconds. The resulting interface connects context-relative risk specification, physical realization, and evaluation through a common risk scale. Project website and videos of generated scenarios are available at https://hhj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/.

AI.tldr: 该研究将自动驾驶corner-case场景的"极端程度"定义为未来风险的百分位数（相对条件分布），并提出百分位条件联合扩散模型加采样期风险引导，可按请求的百分位生成多智能体未来轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶场景生成器虽能施加特定行为、逆境或可行性约束，但难以控制生成场景相对于同一交通语境下合理未来分布的极端程度，也缺乏对"cornerness"的标定与微调手段。
AI.method: 把生成场景的逆境性表示为"给定观测历史的条件未来风险分布中的百分位"；建立history-conditioned risk-percentile请求形式；学习一个参考风险分布，将请求百分位映射为物理风险目标；采用percentile-conditioned joint diffusion model，在采样阶段加入risk guidance以生成多智能体未来；并提出基于参考的百分位实现评估准则。以ego车与周边车辆的最小PET作为风险代理，在highD数据集上验证。
AI.result: 在主评估集1,440个请求中实现1,422个落在0.05百分位容差内（98.75%），平均百分位误差0.00673，PET目标误差0.00991秒。
AI.conclusion: 该接口以统一的风险标度打通了"上下文相对风险指定—物理实现—评估"三个环节，实现了可标定、可微调的corner-case场景生成。

title: Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差视觉信用优化（RVCO），将token级信用分配建模为守恒的路由问题，在保持奖励、rollout与优势估计不变的前提下，通过视觉干预证据响应与预算化熵路由器分配序列效用，在四个模型族、七个推理基准上超越强RLVR基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态推理中的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）面临信用分配难题：结果奖励只给出整条轨迹的价值，而未说明该价值应如何分摊到产生它的各个决策（token）上。现有方法缺乏对token级信用的精确、稳定分配机制。
AI.method: RVCO将token信用视为守恒的路由问题：1）通过受控视觉干预获得每个token的证据响应；2）用轨迹内稳健坐标去除偶然性尺度；3）用预算化熵路由器按感知依赖度分配固定总量的序列效用；4）残差支撑路径保证每个有效位置获得正信用；5）解析校正精确恢复预设信用质量。所得信用场具备选择性、有界性、全支撑性，且对响应局部分数平移不变，并将硬token选择作为极限情形纳入。
AI.result: 在四个模型族与七个推理基准上，RVCO相较强RLVR基线提升了准确率，同时保持后期优化稳定性、损坏鲁棒性与有竞争力的训练成本。奖励、rollout与组相对优势估计均保持不变，仅改变token级信用的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: RVCO表明，在不改动RLVR标准组件（奖励、采样、优势估计）的情况下，仅重新设计token级信用分配几何即可有效提升多模态推理性能，为信用分配提供了一种守恒、可控且可解析校正的新范式。

title: GAMBIT: Learning to Plan Continuous Multi-Robot Trajectories
summary: GAMBIT is an opening chess move in which a player sacrifices a piece, typically a pawn, to gain a positional advantage later in the game. Analogously, in multi-robot coordination, individual robots may need to forgo locally reward-maximising behaviours to improve overall team performance. Such self-sacrificial behaviours are difficult to capture with manually designed heuristics, particularly in dense, interaction-rich environments. Focusing on double-integrator continuous dynamics, this work studies how to learn such coordinated heuristics over motion primitives for multi-robot trajectory execution. Our framework, GAMBIT, first learns coordinated motion-primitive selection through imitation learning and subsequently fine-tunes the policy through reinforcement learning. We further introduce a safeguarded rollout mechanism with backup trajectories that guarantees collision-free execution at all times. Experiments demonstrate that GAMBIT substantially outperforms a range of baselines, including centralised motion planners and decentralised reactive planners, while exhibiting strong scalability. In particular, it coordinates over a thousand robots with planning latency below a few hundred milliseconds in continuous domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GAMBIT 框架，通过模仿学习预训练结合强化学习微调，实现多机器人运动基元层面的协同选择，并利用带后备轨迹的安全回滚机制保证全程无碰撞，可协调千余机器人、规划延迟仅数百毫秒。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协调中，个体常需放弃局部最优行为以换取整体团队收益，这种类"弃子"的自我牺牲式行为难以用人工启发式规则刻画，在密集且交互频繁的环境中尤为困难。因此需要一种能自动学习此类协同启发式的方法。
AI.method: 面向双积分器连续动力学，在运动基元层面学习协同启发式：先通过模仿学习获得协同运动基元选择策略，再用强化学习对其微调；同时引入带后备轨迹（backup trajectories）的安全回滚机制，确保执行过程始终无碰撞。
AI.result: 实验表明，GAMBIT 显著优于集中式运动规划器与分散式反应式规划器等基线，并具备良好的可扩展性：可协调超过一千个机器人在连续域中运行，规划延迟低于几百毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 将"弃子"式的自我牺牲协同思想引入多机器人运动基元学习，配合模仿学习与强化学习的组合训练及安全回滚保障，可在密集交互场景中实现高效、可扩展且无碰撞的多机器人协调。

title: Answer with Evidence: Consistency-Aware Grounded Visual Question Answering for Roadside Traffic Scenes
