summary: Roadside traffic reasoning requires every free-form textual claim to be backed by visual evidence. Existing grounded multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit say-point mismatch, in which the textual answer contradicts the bounding boxes the model localizes. Evaluation metrics that score answers and boxes separately leave this failure unpenalized. We trace the mismatch to the conventional answer-then-ground factorization, which commits to a numerical claim before any object is enumerated. To measure it, we build RoadSceneVQA-G, a benchmark of 34.7K question-answer pairs in which every free-form answer is linked to the set of boxes that witnesses it, and we propose the Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) evaluation suite. To address it, we introduce Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA), which reverses the generation order so that answer-evidence agreement becomes a property of the output structure, and Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO), a reinforcement learning stage that uses the union of multiple rollouts as a recall teacher without ground-truth boxes. EtA raises say-point consistency from 26.6\% to 93.7\% and grounding F1 from 52.2\% to 73.0\%, and ECPO further increases F1 to 75.6\% without per-box supervision. On gRefCOCO, the same framework outperforms the strongest compared method, indicating that it transfers beyond traffic scenes. The project is available at \url{https://github.com/GuanRunwei/RoadSceneVQA-G}.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大模型的"说-点不一致"问题，构建了RoadSceneVQA-G基准并提出AGC评测套件，同时提出先枚举后回答（EtA）框架与枚举一致性策略优化（ECPO）方法加以解决。
AI.motivation: 路边交通推理要求每条自由形式的文本主张都有视觉证据支撑。现有基于定位的多模态大模型常出现"说-点不一致"，即文本答案与模型定位的边界框相矛盾。而将答案与框分开评分的评测指标无法惩罚这种失败。作者将这一不一致的根源追溯到传统的"先回答后定位"分解方式——在枚举任何物体之前就已锁定数值主张。
AI.method: 1）构建RoadSceneVQA-G基准，包含34.7K问答对，每个自由形式答案都链接到见证它的边界框集合；2）提出答案-定位一致性（AGC）评测套件；3）提出先枚举后回答（EtA）框架，反转生成顺序，使答案-证据一致性成为输出结构的固有属性；4）提出枚举一致性策略优化（ECPO）强化学习阶段，利用多次 rollout 的并集作为召回教师，无需真值框监督。
AI.result: EtA将说-点一致性从26.6%提升至93.7%，定位F1从52.2%提升至73.0%；ECPO在没有逐框监督的情况下进一步将F1提升至75.6%。在gRefCOCO上，该框架优于最强对比方法，表明其可迁移至交通场景之外。
AI.conclusion: 通过改变生成顺序并引入一致性强化学习，可在无需真值框监督的条件下显著提升多模态模型答案与视觉定位的一致性，且方法具备跨领域迁移能力。项目已开源。

title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
summary: Continual skill evolution enables LLM agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on determining not only what to change, but also why a change is justified and when it should become persistent guidance. However, existing experience-driven methods can lose the behavioral evidence and task contexts supporting edits. Moreover, a global validation outcome provides an incomplete judgment of its constituent changes: locally supported corrections may be discarded with a rejected revision, while evidence may require further experience to inform useful updates. To this end, we introduce EVISKILL, an evidence-driven framework that organizes execution observations into Replayable Evidence Cards and synthesizes edits with explicit links to their supporting contexts. Targeted replay verifies these edits through re-execution and provides feedback for correction. Across epochs, EVISKILL preserves evidence and provisionally retains supported edits for further refinement, while global validation governs their incorporation into the final skill. Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.

AI.tldr: EVISKILL是一个证据驱动的持续技能进化框架：将执行观测组织为可重放的证据卡片，把技能修改与其支撑上下文显式关联，通过定向重放验证编辑并反馈修正，同时区分局部证据与全局验证来暂存有支持的修改。
AI.motivation: 持续技能进化需判断改什么、为何改合理、何时持久化，但现有经验驱动方法易丢失支撑编辑的行为证据与任务上下文；且全局验证对组成性修改的评判不完整，局部有支持的修正可能随被拒修订一起被丢弃，而部分证据需更多经验才能形成有效更新。
AI.method: 提出EVISKILL框架：将执行观测组织为Replayable Evidence Cards，合成与支撑上下文显式链接的编辑；用targeted replay通过重执行验证编辑并提供修正反馈；跨epoch保留证据、暂存有支持的编辑以待继续精炼，最终由全局验证决定是否并入最终技能。
AI.result: 在三个交互式基准、六种LLM骨干上开展实验，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过以证据为中心组织经验、显式关联编辑与上下文、并以定向重放与分层验证相配合，可在不更新模型参数的前提下更可靠地实现LLM智能体的持续技能进化。

title: TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models
summary: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出结构化稀疏自编码器TSAE，用于分解时序预测模型的隐藏状态，并配套TSEVAL审计协议，在ETT数据集上以冻结PatchTST验证其在重构误差、NFRE与特征切换率上的优势。
AI.motivation: 时序预测模型的可解释性对能源调度、工业运营与环境监测等关键决策至关重要。现有输入归因方法只能识别重要变量与时间段，难以揭示模型内部特征；而标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）的目标函数未直接约束跨变量结构或时间连续性，导致插桩得到的特征缺乏可解释的结构性依据。因此需要一个能同时刻画跨变量组织与时间演化的结构化SAE及其评估协议。
AI.method: TSAE将隐藏状态分解为可单独检查的特征：(1) 通过共享字典与按变量路由的私有字典组织跨变量结构；(2) 采用门控编码将"特征检测"与"幅度估计"解耦；(3) 依据原始片段相似度约束相邻稀疏编码的变化，从而支持变量上下文、激活强度与时间演化的分析。此外引入预测一致性微调，以保持冻结预测器的输出不被破坏。配套的TSEVAL协议分别审计保真度、特征一致性与物理校准。
AI.result: 在冻结PatchTST、ETTh1/ETTh2/ETTm1数据集、三随机种子的实验中，TSAE在相近的每token活跃度下，于五种SAE中取得最低的隐藏状态重构误差、归一化预测重构误差（NFRE）与特征切换率；NFRE相较次优均值下降4.3%–26.4%。选择性、物理相关性与校准方面存在依赖数据集的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结构化字典路由、门控编码与时间连续性约束可在不牺牲预测保真度的前提下提升SAE特征的保真度与时间稳定性。但保真度与时间稳定性的改善并不能自动保证语义有效性，仍需TSEVAL中独立的语义验证来支撑特征解释。

title: Inspect Robots: Evaluating the Capabilities and Safety of Embodied AI
comment: Submitted to The Science of Physical AI Safety (SPAIS) Workshop at CoRL 2026
summary: General purpose language models are increasingly able to control robotic hardware. Understanding the capabilities and safety of these models when embodied is therefore increasingly important for understanding their societal impact and risks. To this end, we introduce Inspect Robots, a modular, open-source framework for developing and running evaluations of embodied agents. Inspect Robots pairs customizable, reusable abstractions for specifying physical evaluations and analyzing their results with infrastructure that automates evaluation setup, execution and termination. We demonstrate Inspect Robots by using it to evaluate the capabilities and safety of six policies based on frontier language models. Inspect Robots has seen significant early uptake, receiving nearly 100,000 downloads in the three months since its release.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 Inspect Robots——一个模块化、开源的具身智能体评估框架，用于系统化评估语言模型控制机器人硬件时的能力与安全性，并已获得广泛应用。
AI.motivation: 通用语言模型日益具备控制机器人硬件的能力，因此理解这类模型在具身场景下的能力与安全性，对评估其社会影响与风险愈发重要。
AI.method: 提出 Inspect Robots 框架，采用模块化、开源设计，提供可定制、可复用的抽象组件来定义物理评估并分析结果，同时配套自动化评估搭建、执行与终止的基础设施；并用该框架评估了六个基于前沿语言模型的策略。
AI.result: 成功演示了对六个基于前沿语言模型的策略在能力与安全性方面的评估；框架发布三个月内下载量接近 10 万次。
AI.conclusion: Inspect Robots 为具身智能体评估提供了模块化、开源且自动化的解决方案，并已在早期获得显著的社区采用。

title: Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.

AI.tldr: Mobile-4DGS：面向移动端实时静态与动态高斯渲染的统一轻量框架，通过蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合、属性条件SH增强、多视角Alpha致密化剪枝、紧凑4D表示及深度序复用，显著降低存储与渲染开销。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在新视角合成上表现优异，但静态与动态高斯表示部署到资源受限移动设备面临三大障碍：存储量大、图元冗余、逐帧计算代价高。现有方法缺乏统一支持移动端实时静态与动态渲染的轻量方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator，将高阶辐射残差压缩进一阶SH；2) 设计Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement模块，其预测偏移在推理前预烘焙；3) 提出Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning策略，抑制冗余图元并保持多视角一致性；4) 动态场景采用紧凑显式4D表示：二阶高斯运动、可学习时间支撑、二值静动态划分，无需运行时变形网络即可连续时间建模；5) 基于该划分提出Depth-Order Certificate，复用已提交深度序，减少重投影、排序、合并与索引缓冲更新。
AI.result: 静态与动态场景的大量实验表明，Mobile-4DGS在保持有竞争力视觉质量的同时，大幅降低存储和渲染开销，在移动设备上实现实时3D与4D高斯泼溅。
AI.conclusion: Mobile-4DGS为移动端提供了统一的轻量高斯渲染框架，兼顾视觉质量与实时性能，代码已开源。

title: CI-JEPA: A Counterfactual Analysis of Latent Representations in Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Learning
comment: This article has been accepted for the International Symposium on Smart Systems, Algorithms & Applications 2026 (IS3A3 2026), Tezpur Central University, India
summary: Self-supervised visual representation learning learns useful features without manual annotations during representation training. The image-based joint-embedding predictive architecture (I-JEPA) predicts latent representations of masked image regions, but its objective does not explicitly model responses to specified visual interventions. We introduce CI-JEPA, a counterfactual intervention-aware extension that learns to predict the representation change $ΔZ = Z_{\mathrm{CF}} - Z$ between an original image and a modified counterpart. We assess representation robustness through selective sensitivity: stronger responses to task-relevant semantic changes than to nuisance changes. Experiments on Flowers102 use flower-center occlusion as a candidate semantic intervention and background blur and tint as candidate nuisance interventions. With frozen-encoder linear probing, CI-JEPA achieves a best validation accuracy of 78.14\%, compared with 77.55\% for both the pretrained ViT-B/16 and the I-JEPA baseline, a gain of 0.59 percentage points. The reported mean $L_2$ representation changes are 4.42 for center occlusion, 3.48 for background tint, and 2.83 for background blur. This ordering is consistent with relative semantic selectivity for the evaluated interventions, rather than complete nuisance invariance. The accuracy comparison is complementary and does not establish improved robustness over the baselines. These controlled image modifications provide a framework for studying intervention-induced changes in JEPA representations; they do not establish causal feature discovery or robustness to all visual changes.

AI.tldr: 提出CI-JEPA，将I-JEPA扩展为反事实干预感知学习，预测原图与修改图之间的潜在表示变化ΔZ；以Flowers102上"选择性敏感性"评估表示鲁棒性，线性探测准确率78.14%（较基线提升0.59个百分点），中心遮挡的表示变化最大（4.42），高于背景着色（3.48）与背景模糊（2.83）。
AI.motivation: 自监督视觉表示学习无需人工标注即可学到有用特征；I-JEPA通过预测被掩码图像区域的潜在表示来学习，但其目标函数并未显式建模对指定视觉干预的响应，因而缺乏对"表示对何种变化敏感"的直接刻画。作者希望引入反事实视角，使表示学习直接关注干预引起的表示变化，并据此考察表示的选择性敏感性。
AI.method: 提出CI-JEPA：在I-JEPA基础上的反事实干预感知扩展，学习预测原图与修改后对应图之间的表示变化ΔZ = Z_CF − Z。鲁棒性通过"选择性敏感性"衡量，即对任务相关语义变化应有更强响应、对无关（nuisance）变化响应更弱。在Flowers102上，以花朵中心遮挡作为候选语义干预，以背景模糊和背景着色作为候选无关干预；采用冻结编码器的线性探测进行评估，并报告各干预下的平均L2表示变化。
AI.result: 冻结编码器线性探测下，CI-JEPA最佳验证准确率为78.14%，相比预训练ViT-B/16与I-JEPA基线的77.55%提升0.59个百分点。平均L2表示变化为：中心遮挡4.42、背景着色3.48、背景模糊2.83，即顺序为语义干预 > 着色 > 模糊。
AI.conclusion: 表示变化排序与所评估干预下的相对语义选择性一致，而非完全的无关不变性。准确率对比仅具补充性质，不足以证明相对基线提升了鲁棒性。这些受控图像修改为研究JEPA表示中干预引起的变化提供了框架，但并不能确立因果特征发现能力，也不能证明对所有视觉变化的鲁棒性。

title: Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Code, run records, and figure scripts: https://github.com/Helios-YQH/llm-from-scratch
summary: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

AI.tldr: 本文在1B规模上对GRPO进行双向研究：分析估计器选择对学习信号的影响，以及退化奖励信号对学习结果的影响。在GSM8K上从零实现训练OLMo-2-0425-1B并进行受控扫描。四项主要发现：提示词的零样本/少样本差异是一阶决策因素；估计器变体差异在种子噪声范围内；离策略场景中裁剪机制是关键；弱验证器对RL的损害远小于对测试时选择的影响。
AI.motivation: 研究GRPO在1B小规模下的行为特性，理解估计器选择如何影响学习信号，以及退化奖励信号如何影响学习内容，从而为RL训练中奖励质量与算法设计的权衡提供实证指导。
AI.method: 在GSM8K数据集上，用从零实现的GRPO训练OLMo-2-0425-1B模型，进行受控扫描实验，包括验证器质量实验（同步退化训练奖励和测试时选择器），对比不同估计器变体、提示词设置（零样本与3-shot）、是否使用裁剪（GRPO-style clipping与GSPO）等条件。
AI.result: 1）零样本提示下基础模型仅达0.08%（输出为退化续写而非错误答案），几乎无组携带梯度；3-shot提示达18.3%使训练成功。2）1B规模下估计器变体差异在种子噪声内，Dr. GRPO在两个种子上均领先。3）离策略场景中，无裁剪比率的训练相对在线策略损失4-6分，而GRPO式裁剪和GSPO完全恢复。4）弱验证器在RL中代价远低于测试时选择：10%翻转验证器下RL保留91%和106%的可获得增益，而选择仅保留57%；仅格式验证器下RL保留16-30%增益，选择几乎为零。
AI.conclusion: 提示词设计是GRPO训练成功的一阶决定因素；1B规模下估计器选择影响有限；离策略训练中裁剪机制至关重要；弱验证器对RL训练的损害显著小于对测试时选择的影响，翻转噪声可被组归一化优势与Adam缩放精确消除，残余为二阶方差效应。

title: Dual Variational Autoencoders for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Low-Cost Robotic Navigation
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures. Published in Image and Vision Computing under a CC BY 4.0 license
summary: Vision-based autonomous navigation for low-cost robots remains a fundamental challenge, primarily due to the significant gap between simulated training environments and real-world operational conditions. Direct policy transfer from simulation is often ineffective, while training exclusively on real data is impractical. We propose a hybrid transfer learning framework that effectively bridges the sim-to-real gap by combining domain randomization with feature-level domain adaptation. Our method employs a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, trained on an extensive set of 45225 simulated images and a minimal set of only 4556 real-world samples. This architecture learns a compact, common latent representation space that aligns the distributions of both domains. The adaptation process is further enhanced by two complementary data augmentation techniques designed to expand the limited real-world data. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves an average success rate of almost 91% on image classification tasks for real-world indoor navigation, significantly outperforming both simulation-only and real-world-only training. We validate these findings through a direct, real-world deployment, where the proposed policy successfully guides a low-cost robot in a reactive exploration task. Furthermore, we validate the model's efficiency through a rigorous computational estimation, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4 and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. This work presents a practical solution for developing effective and efficient navigation policies for low-cost robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 提出混合迁移学习框架，结合域随机化与特征级域适应，用双卷积VAE共享解码器对齐仿真与真实域分布，在仅4556张真实样本下实现约91%的室内导航分类成功率，并可部署于低算力嵌入式平台。
AI.motivation: 低成本机器人的视觉自主导航受制于仿真训练环境与真实工况之间的显著差异：直接进行仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的策略迁移往往失效，而完全依赖真实数据训练又不现实。因此需要一种能有效弥合sim-to-real差距、且数据与算力开销均可控的迁移学习方案。
AI.method: 构建混合迁移学习框架，将域随机化（domain randomization）与特征级域适应（feature-level domain adaptation）相结合。采用双卷积变分自编码器（dual convolutional VAE）架构，两域共享同一解码器，在45225张仿真图像与仅4556张真实样本上联合训练，学习一个紧凑的公共潜表示空间以对齐两域分布；并引入两种互补的数据增强技术来扩充有限的真实数据。
AI.result: 在真实室内导航图像分类任务上平均成功率达到约91%，显著优于仅用仿真数据训练与仅用真实数据训练的基线；通过真实世界直接部署验证，所提策略成功引导低成本机器人完成反应式探索任务；经严格的计算量评估，模型适用于Raspberry Pi 4、NVIDIA Jetson Nano等资源受限嵌入式平台。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低成本机器人系统提供了一种实用、高效且可部署的导航策略开发方案，证明在真实数据极度稀缺的条件下，通过共享潜空间对齐与数据增强可实现可靠的sim-to-real迁移。

title: BossouChimpanzee: Long-term Chimpanzee Video Dataset
summary: We describe the BossouChimpanzee video dataset, a unique long-term visual record of wild chimpanzees at an outdoor laboratory for field experiments in Bossou, Guinea, spanning three decades (1988-2018) and comprising over 1,200 hours of continuous video recordings collected through collaborative fieldwork and research. In this paper, we outline the history and scientific contributions of the experimental paradigm and video archive, provide key statistics and details on the structure of the main video dataset, and release an initial ~74h snapshot, BossouChimpanzee70h, covering 23 identified individuals focused on chimpanzee individual and action recognition, ahead of the full video resource. This dataset represents a valuable resource for cognitive and behavioural research in ethology and a rich benchmark for training and evaluating machine learning models on audiovisual data from the wild.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍BossouChimpanzee视频数据集：记录了野外黑猩猩长达三十年（1988-2018）、超1200小时的连续视频，并首发约74小时子集BossouChimpanzee70h，用于个体与动作识别。
AI.motivation: 野外黑猩猩的长期视听行为数据稀缺，缺乏可供认知与行为研究及机器学习模型训练评测的野生场景基准资源。
AI.method: 依托几内亚Bossou户外实验站的长期合作野外观测，梳理实验范式与视频档案的历史和科学贡献，统计并说明主视频数据集结构，先行发布约74小时、涵盖23个已识别个体的快照数据集BossouChimpanzee70h，聚焦黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别。
AI.result: 形成跨度三十年、超1200小时的连续视频档案，并发布约74小时、含23个已识别个体、面向个体与动作识别的初始子集。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为动物行为学的认知与行为研究提供稀缺资源，也为野生视听数据的机器学习模型训练与评测提供丰富基准，后续将发布完整视频资源。

title: Why, Where, How: Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding for Code Repair in NL2SQL
summary: SQL queries that large language models write from natural language questions can execute successfully yet produce incorrect results, so execution alone does not reveal what to fix. An error taxonomy says why the query is wrong, but not where to look or how to change it. Existing methods can guide SQL correction through feedback, error reports, or generated plans alongside an unmasked query. We introduce TEG(Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding), which turns a supplied diagnosis into a structured correction input for natural language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) correction. Type-specific rules map each error type to construct classes to reconsider and an edit operation to request. TEG masks the selected constructs in the query when applicable and states that operation in an edit instruction. TEG generates candidate corrections from this input, uses execution feedback to guide candidate selection, and repeats the process one annotation at a time for queries with several errors. On NL2SQL-BUGs, TEG reaches 47.3 single-error execution accuracy and 37.0 overall with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across the model sizes and thinking modes evaluated in the main comparison, TEG outperforms all evaluated baselines on single-error queries, even when the baselines receive the same error-type annotations. With predicted types, TEG stays above direct LLM correction and ErrorLLM on single-error queries.

AI.tldr: TEG将错误类型诊断转化为结构化纠错输入，通过构造屏蔽与编辑指令引导LLM逐步修正NL2SQL查询，在NL2SQL-BUGs上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: SQL查询能执行成功却返回错误结果，仅凭执行无法定位需修复之处；错误分类学只说明"为何错"，不指明"看哪里"和"如何改"。现有方法依赖反馈、错误报告或生成计划，缺乏对纠错位置与操作的明确引导。
AI.method: TEG（Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding）把已有诊断转化为结构化纠错输入：类型特定规则将每种错误类型映射到需重新考虑的构造类与一个编辑操作；对适用情形屏蔽（mask）查询中选定构造，并在编辑指令中陈述该操作；据此生成候选修正，用执行反馈筛选候选，并对多错误查询逐一标注、迭代重复。
AI.result: 在NL2SQL-BUGs上，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct达到47.3的单错误执行准确率和37.0的总体准确率；在主对比的所有模型规模与思考模式下，TEG在单错误查询上优于全部评估基线（即使基线获得相同错误类型标注）；在使用预测类型时，TEG仍高于直接LLM纠错与ErrorLLM。
AI.conclusion: 将错误分类学显式落地为"构造屏蔽+编辑指令"的结构化纠错输入，能有效提升NL2SQL纠错的定位与修改能力，且在多错误场景可逐条迭代处理。

title: Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published work demonstrating an online Multi-Armed Bandit framework successfully deployed at an $O(B)$ scale for uncurated short-form video discovery. Our solution pairs a multi-stage candidate generation pipeline with a low-latency serving infrastructure. By initializing the exploration framework with image-specific priors derived from a deep visual quality model, the system minimizes exploration costs and dynamically serves optimal thumbnails at serving time. Global deployment demonstrates statistically significant improvements in core user discovery and engagement metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并部署了一个面向全球O(B)级别短视频平台的全自动实时缩略图优化系统，用动态数据驱动选择替代静态默认帧，首次证明在线多臂老虎机框架可在O(B)规模的非人工策划短视频场景中成功落地。
AI.motivation: 与长视频内容不同，大量短视频发布时没有创作者人工选择的缩略图，形成"非策划语料"（uncurated corpus）。传统的静态默认帧无法有效支撑短视频发现与消费，因此需要在海量视频上自动生成并优化缩略图。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成：（1）多阶段候选生成流水线（multi-stage candidate generation pipeline）；（2）低延迟服务基础设施（low-latency serving infrastructure）；（3）在线多臂老虎机（Multi-Armed Bandit）探索框架，并利用深度视觉质量模型得到的图像级先验（image-specific priors）进行初始化，以降低探索成本，在服务时动态下发最优缩略图。
AI.result: 系统在全球范围部署后，核心用户发现与参与度指标（discovery and engagement metrics）取得统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首篇证明在线多臂老虎机框架能够在O(B)规模的非策划短视频发现场景中成功部署的公开工作，验证了候选生成+低延迟服务+先验初始化探索的端到端框架在超大规模短视频场景下的有效性与可行性。

title: DexForge: High-Fidelity Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
summary: Human demonstrations offer rich examples of precise dexterous manipulation and a promising source of robot training data. However, high-fidelity reproduction of demonstrated motions and hand-object interactions across robot embodiments remains challenging under physical constraints. We present DexForge, a differentiable physics-grounded framework for converting human video demonstrations into high-fidelity robot trajectories. We reconstruct spherical-Gaussian object models and hand-object motion from visual observations, then build a differentiable simulator combining efficient Gaussian collision detection with existing differentiable dynamics. Based on this simulator, DexForge combines contact-aware kinematic retargeting with force-aware dynamics retargeting: robot-adapted stable contacts guide kinematic reference construction and subsequent gradient-based control refinement for precise physical motion reproduction. Experiments on 130 DexYCB and HOT3D demonstrations across seven dexterous hands show success-rate gains of approximately 35-53 percentage points over the baseline, with object position and orientation tracking errors on successful trajectories reduced by approximately 34-67% and 71-78%, respectively. Further experiments demonstrate open-loop transfer to MuJoCo and real-robot execution. Our project page is available at https://wmz1226.github.io/DexForge/

AI.tldr: DexForge：基于可微物理的人手视频→机器人高保真轨迹转换框架
AI.motivation: 人手演示包含丰富的精细灵巧操作样本，是机器人训练数据的理想来源；但受物理约束限制，跨本体高保真复现演示动作及手-物交互仍很困难。
AI.method: 从视觉观测重建球面高斯物体模型与手-物运动；构建结合高效高斯碰撞检测与现有可微动力学的可微仿真器；在此基础上提出接触感知运动学重定向与力感知动力学重定向：先由机器人适配的稳定接触引导运动学参考构建，再经基于梯度的控制细化实现精确物理运动复现。
AI.result: 在130条DexYCB与HOT3D演示、七种灵巧手上，成功率较基线提升约35–53个百分点；成功轨迹的物体位置与姿态跟踪误差分别降低约34–67%与71–78%；并验证了向MuJoCo的开环迁移与真机执行。
AI.conclusion: DexForge 通过可微物理将人手演示转化为高保真机器人轨迹，显著提升跨本体复现精度，并具备仿真到真机的迁移能力。

title: Revisiting Ground-Truth Synthesis from High-Speed Video: Exact Validity Conditions and an Audited Consumer Capture Corpus
summary: Motion-deblurring datasets are commonly synthesised by averaging $N$ consecutive high-frame-rate frames and labelling the result with the central frame. We show that this label is unbiased for every capture timing only when the window is odd and the frames' sample durations are equal. An even window shifts every label by a fixed fraction of the blur length, even under perfect timing. Unequal durations are subtler: their mean misalignment is zero, so dataset statistics cannot reveal them, yet when the offset cannot be read from the blur they convolve the supervision rather than adding noise to it. Auditing 51 smartphone clips recorded at a nominal 240 fps, we find 19 captured near 176 fps, a behaviour recorded only in the container's timing tables. In a controlled test the parity choice costs a fitted linear deblurring filter far more than these timing irregularities do, and interpolation labels, unlike blur labels, can be repaired with the true frame times. We provide a tool that checks both conditions without decoding, and will release the clips and their timing tables.

AI.tldr: 本文证明运动去模糊数据集合成标签仅在奇数窗口且各帧采样时长相等时无偏；偶数窗口会造成固定比例的标签偏移，时长不等则把偏差卷积进监督信号。作者审计了51段标称240fps的手机视频，发现19段实际接近176fps，并提出无需解码的检测工具。
AI.motivation: 运动去模糊数据集普遍通过平均N个连续高帧率帧并以中心帧作为标签来合成。作者质疑该标注在一般采集时序下是否真正无偏，尤其是窗口奇偶性与帧采样时长不一致这两个常被忽视的条件。
AI.method: 从理论上分析平均N帧所得模糊与中心帧标签之间的对齐关系，分别推导偶数窗口和不等采样时长下的偏差形式；对51段标称240fps的智能手机视频进行时序表审计；并通过受控实验比较奇偶性选择与时序不规则对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的影响；同时提供无需解码即可检查上述两个条件的工具。
AI.result: 偶数窗口即使时序完美也会使每个标签偏移固定比例的模糊长度；不等采样时长的平均错位为零，因此无法从数据集统计中发现，但当偏移无法从模糊中读出时会把偏差卷积进监督信号。审计发现51段视频中有19段实际接近176fps，且这一信息仅记录在容器的时序表中。受控实验中，奇偶性选择对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的影响远大于时序不规则性，插值标签则可用真实帧时间修复。
AI.conclusion: 运动去模糊数据集的标准合成协议存在系统性标注偏差，偶数窗口和不等采样时长是两类独立且隐蔽的误差来源。作者呼吁在数据集合成中检查窗口奇偶性与真实帧时长，并提供了无需解码的检测工具，同时将公开视频及其时序表。

title: SharpDraft: Accelerating Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Cardinality-Aware Query Scaling
summary: Long-form reasoning makes inference expensive, and speculative decoding mitigates this cost by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel. Its speedup, however, can fade as context grows and draft acceptance declines. We focus on attention-mass dilution: as softmax normalizes over more visible Keys, the mass concentrated on the highest-scoring Keys can decrease. We introduce SharpDraft, a training-free method that counteracts this effect through cardinality-aware Query scaling, without the computational overhead of online adaptation. Under explicit assumptions, we derive an exact top-$k$ mass correction and deploy a closed-form fixed-slope approximation. Across AIME-26, GPQA-Diamond, and LongGenBench Diary, SharpDraft achieves $2.59$-$3.19\times$ geometric-mean end-to-end speedups over target-only autoregressive decoding when applied to DFlash, PARD, and EAGLE 3.1. With DFlash, it improves decoding speed and outperforms full-parameter and LoRA-based online adaptation in end-to-end speedup, while matching the unmodified drafter's reported peak allocated GPU memory.

AI.tldr: SharpDraft是一种免训练的推测解码方法，通过基数感知的Query缩放抵消注意力质量稀释效应，在多个基准上实现2.59–3.19倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 长文本推理成本高昂，推测解码虽能并行验证草稿token以加速，但随着上下文增长，草稿接受率下降导致加速效果衰减。作者将其归因于注意力质量稀释：softmax在更多可见Key上归一化时，最高分Key所集中的质量会下降。
AI.method: 提出SharpDraft，一种免训练方法，通过基数感知的Query缩放来对抗注意力质量稀释，避免在线自适应的计算开销。在显式假设下推导出精确的top-k质量校正，并采用闭式固定斜率近似。
AI.result: 在AIME-26、GPQA-Diamond和LongGenBench Diary上，应用于DFlash、PARD和EAGLE 3.1时取得2.59–3.19倍几何平均端到端加速（相对仅目标模型自回归解码）。以DFlash为例，其提升了解码速度，端到端加速优于全参数与LoRA在线自适应方法，同时GPU峰值显存与原草稿模型持平。
AI.conclusion: SharpDraft通过免训练的基数感知Query缩放缓解注意力质量稀释，在长上下文推测解码中稳定提升加速比，且不增加显存开销，优于现有在线自适应方案。

title: Learning under Localized Minority Imbalance
summary: Class-imbalance methods implicitly assume that the minority class is uniformly undersampled relative to the majority class. However, in many real-world settings, minority instances may be disproportionately under-observed in certain regions of the feature space. For example, small businesses that go bankrupt may disappear from records, while those that survive remain visible, making bankruptcy appear less common among small firms than it actually is. This gives rise to localized minority imbalance (LMI), a challenge that is often overlooked and extends beyond general class-count imbalance. We show that under LMI, existing imbalance mitigation techniques can fit observation-induced biases in the training data and generalize poorly to under-observed regions of the true minority distribution. To address this, we propose a tree-based stratified approach that recursively partitions the feature space with the goal of reducing within-stratum LMI distortion. For each resulting stratum, we pair its majority instances with the full observed minority set and train a base classifier to create an ensemble. Extensive experiments over benchmark tabular datasets simulated with LMI show that our stratified ensembling approach outperforms popular and state-of-the-art imbalance mitigation techniques. We also introduce a gold-standard evaluation protocol that uses unbiased test sets, and demonstrate that conventional hold-out evaluation from the same LMI-biased data can substantially mislead performance. Overall, our results highlight that the cause of imbalance is as important as the correction method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"局部少数类不平衡"(LMI)概念，并给出基于树的层化集成方法及无偏评估协议来解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有类别不平衡方法隐含假设少数类相对多数类是均匀欠采样的；但现实中少数样本在特征空间某些区域可能被不成比例地漏观测（如小企业破产后从记录中消失），形成LMI。作者指出在LMI下现有方法会拟合观测偏差，对真实少数类分布中观测不足的区域泛化很差，这一问题被普遍忽视。
AI.method: 提出基于树的层化(stratified)方法：递归划分特征空间，目标是降低层内LMI失真；对每个分层，将其多数类实例与全部观测到的少数类集合配对，训练一个基分类器，从而构成集成模型。
AI.result: 在模拟LMI的表格基准数据集上，该层化集成方法优于流行及最先进的类别不平衡缓解技术；同时引入使用无偏测试集的黄金标准评估协议，证明基于同一LMI偏置数据做常规留出评估会严重误导性能判断。
AI.conclusion: 不平衡的成因与纠正方法同等重要；忽视LMI会导致方法失效与评估失真，需同时修正数据偏差与评估协议。

title: Towards Robust Prehensile Manipulation in Open-Ended Environments
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Intrinsically Motivated Open-ended Learning (IMOL 2025)
summary: We propose to use Quality-Diversity (QD) algorithms to solve robotic prehensile manipulation tasks in open-ended environments. Our approach enables the efficient discovery of a wide range robust grasp configurations, which serve as reliable starting points for generating diverse prehensile manipulation trajectories on articulated objects. The resulting diversity in manipulation behaviors enhances generalization and adaptability, enabling effective deployment continuously evolving open-world settings.

AI.tldr: 提出用质量-多样性（QD）算法求解开放环境下的机器人抓取式操作任务，高效发现大量鲁棒抓取构型，作为多样化操作轨迹生成的可靠起点。
AI.motivation: 开放、持续演化的环境中，机器人抓取式操作需要兼具鲁棒性与多样性的行为。传统优化方法通常只追求单一最优解，难以提供可靠的起始抓取与多样化轨迹，导致泛化性和适应性不足。
AI.method: 采用质量-多样性（Quality-Diversity）算法，在行为空间中同时优化解的质量与多样性，从而高效发现广泛的鲁棒抓取构型；以这些构型为可靠起点，为铰接物体生成多样的抓取式操作轨迹。
AI.result: 能够高效发现大量鲁棒的抓取构型，并在此基础上生成多样化的操作轨迹，形成覆盖行为空间的多解集合。
AI.conclusion: 所产生行为的多样性提升了泛化能力与适应性，使机器人可在持续演化的开放世界环境中有效部署。

title: Kinematics-Centric Continuous Sign Language Retrieval with Gloss-Guided Boundary-Aware Alignment
summary: Sign language-text alignment remains a fundamental challenge for text-driven sign language understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on appearance-heavy RGB representations, which entangle motion semantics with visual variations and lead to ambiguous motion-language grounding. In this paper, we reformulate sign language-text alignment in a structured kinematic space and propose a kinematics-centric framework that adopts 3D SMPL-X motion as the primary representation. By explicitly modeling the kinematic dynamics of signing in a unified motion space, our approach reduces reliance on appearance signals and yields more semantically consistent representations. To capture the compositional nature of sign language, we introduce a gloss-guided local alignment mechanism that leverages gloss temporal spans as weak supervision to decompose continuous motion into coherent segments and establish fine-grained motion-text correspondences, thereby reducing ambiguity in localizing word-level semantics in continuous signing. Furthermore, we develop a visual distillation strategy, where RGB signals serve as privileged supervision during training to provide complementary contextual cues, while being completely removed at inference time. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art bidirectional retrieval performance on CSL-Daily and competitive results on PHOENIX-2014T. These results highlight the effectiveness of kinematic representations and explicit local grounding for sign language-text alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文将手语-文本对齐重构到结构化运动学空间，以3D SMPL-X动作为主表征，结合手语词汇引导的局部对齐与视觉蒸馏策略，在CSL-Daily和PHOENIX-2014T上取得优异检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖外观密集的RGB表征，将运动语义与视觉变化纠缠在一起，导致动作-语言 grounding 模糊，难以实现精确的手语-文本对齐。
AI.method: 提出以运动学为中心的框架，采用3D SMPL-X运动作为主表征，在统一运动空间中显式建模手语运动动态；引入gloss引导的局部对齐机制，以gloss时间跨度作为弱监督，将连续动作分解为连贯片段并建立细粒度动作-文本对应；同时设计视觉蒸馏策略，训练时以RGB信号作为特权监督提供互补上下文，推理时完全去除。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，该方法在CSL-Daily上实现最先进的双向检索性能，在PHOENIX-2014T上取得具竞争力的结果，验证了运动学表征与显式局部 grounding 对手语-文本对齐的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以运动学表征替代外观密集表征，并结合显式局部对齐与视觉蒸馏，可有效缓解动作-语言 grounding 歧义，提升手语-文本双向检索性能。

title: LexiHorizon: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Deep Search
summary: Deep search agents tackle complex knowledge tasks through iterative retrieval, multi-hop reasoning, and evidence synthesis across multiple sources. Existing approaches typically assume relatively stable retrieval systems and operate over short-horizon tool interaction. However, when retrieval is sensitive to query formulation, even a semantically appropriate query may fail to surface critical evidence because of mismatched entity names, aliases, or keyword combinations. Recovering from such failures requires repeated query reformulation and longer interaction trajectories. This setting poses a distinct training challenge, as the policy must sustain long-horizon query exploration while managing an expanding volume of retrieved content. We propose LexiHorizon, a framework for training search agents over long horizons that expands the trajectory context budget, manages accumulated retrieval content using a window over recent tool observations while preserving the reasoning history, and introduces an outcome-gated search-effort reward that provides a bounded bonus for tool invocations to trajectories with nonzero answer reward. Experiments on XBench, WebWalkerQA, and BrowseComp-ZH show that the resulting 9B model consistently outperforms both its base model and MiroThinker-1.7-mini, with maximum absolute gains of 8.7 and 23.8 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that combining an extended context budget with reasoning-preserving context management benefits long-horizon deep search agents.

AI.tldr: 提出LexiHorizon框架，通过扩展轨迹上下文预算、面向工具观测的窗口化上下文管理与结果门控的搜索努力奖励，训练长时程深度搜索智能体，9B模型在多个基准上超越基座模型与MiroThinker-1.7-mini。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索智能体通常假设检索系统相对稳定，且只在短时程内进行工具交互。但检索对查询表述敏感，即使语义合理的查询也可能因实体名、别名或关键词组合不匹配而无法召回关键证据，需要反复改写查询并拉长交互轨迹。这一设定带来独特训练难点：策略既要维持长时程查询探索，又要管理不断膨胀的检索内容。
AI.method: LexiHorizon框架包含三点：1）扩展轨迹上下文预算；2）对累积的检索内容采用最近工具观测窗口进行管理，同时保留推理历史；3）引入结果门控的搜索努力奖励，对答案奖励非零的轨迹给予有界的工具调用奖励。
AI.result: 在XBench、WebWalkerQA和BrowseComp-ZH上，所得9B模型持续优于其基座模型和MiroThinker-1.7-mini，最大绝对增益分别为8.7和23.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将扩展的上下文预算与保留推理的上下文管理相结合，有利于长时程深度搜索智能体的表现。

title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
summary: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

AI.tldr: D-DOIT 是一种免训练、面向离散扩散模型的通用奖励适配方法，通过离散 Doob h-变换重加权逆转移概率实现引导采样，在调控 DNA 设计与蛋白质逆折叠任务上优于现有免训练引导基线。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型（尤其是掩码式）在生成建模中广泛应用，但将其适配到通用奖励函数仍具挑战。现有免训练引导方法多依赖奖励梯度或昂贵的未来 rollout，且连续扩散的引导机制（如漂移修正）无法直接迁移到以类别型 token 揭示转移为特征的离散扩散上。因此需要一种仅用奖励值、无需梯度且计算高效的离散适配方法。
AI.method: 提出 D-DOIT，将适配建模为从奖励倾斜的目标分布中采样，并通过离散扩散逆核的 Doob h-变换实现该传输。与连续扩散不同，D-DOIT 推导出离散 Doob h-变换，通过重加权逆转移概率而非添加漂移修正来引导采样，且仅使用奖励值而非奖励梯度。为避免昂贵的未来 rollout，每个引导步采样候选下一状态，用模型预测头将各候选补全为干净序列，以奖励 oracle 评估，并按与奖励成正比的概率重采样下一状态。此外引入可选的后期 best-of-K 精化，仅在去噪末端分支轨迹，避免全轨迹的 K 倍开销。
AI.result: 在调控 DNA 设计与蛋白质逆折叠基准上，D-DOIT 优于免训练引导基线：在提升增强子活性与细胞类型特异性的同时保持序列自然度，并在蛋白质逆折叠上取得最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: D-DOIT 为离散扩散模型提供了一种无需训练、无需奖励梯度且计算高效的通用奖励适配框架，验证了离散 Doob h-变换在类别型转移上的有效性，并在生物序列设计任务中展现出实用价值。

title: Visual Swarm Navigation via Deep Reinforcement Learning and Evolutionary Hybrid Design
comment: 46 pages, 21 figures. Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence under a CC BY 4.0 license
summary: Swarm robotics presents a robust and cost-effective paradigm for advanced automation in complex, dynamic environments, such as those encountered in search and rescue or environmental monitoring. A fundamental challenge for this field is the data-driven design of decentralized controllers capable of generating emergent collective behaviors. This paper proposes a novel, AI-driven hybrid methodology for the automatic synthesis of swarm robotic controllers for autonomous visual navigation. This approach synergistically combines multi-agent reinforcement learning with neuro-evolutionary strategies, specifically leveraging implementations of the cross-entropy method and the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy to optimize a pre-trained individual navigation policy. The underlying deep architecture is engineered for low-cost, resource-constrained platforms, utilizing a compact neural network that relies exclusively on monocular camera imagery. This vision-based design emphasizes computational and energy efficiency, a critical requirement for practical swarm deployments. Experiments, performed in a high-fidelity physics simulator, demonstrate that the resulting controllers enable robust and scalable collective exploration of diverse indoor environments. The controller trained using our cross-entropy method achieves superior exploration coverage, visiting 36.20% more regions compared to the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy. Critically, our best vision-based policy achieves exploration performance statistically comparable to traditional methods relying on more expensive distance sensors, while delivering a significant 31.40% average reduction in energy consumption. These findings validate an effective and economically viable autonomous control system, establishing a path for deploying highly efficient collective intelligence in real-world engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI驱动的混合方法，将多智能体强化学习与神经进化策略（交叉熵法、协方差矩阵自适应进化策略）结合，合成基于单目视觉的群体机器人自主导航控制器，在仿真中实现稳健可扩展的集体探索，并以更低能耗达到与距离传感器方法相当的探索性能。
AI.motivation: 群体机器人在搜救、环境监测等复杂动态环境中具有鲁棒、低成本的自动化潜力，但核心难题在于以数据驱动方式设计能产生涌现式集体行为的去中心化控制器。同时，实用化部署要求控制器适配资源受限平台，兼顾计算与能量效率。
AI.method: 提出AI驱动的混合控制综合方法，协同结合多智能体强化学习与神经进化策略，具体采用交叉熵法（CEM）与协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）对预训练的个体导航策略进行优化。底层采用紧凑型神经网络，仅依赖单目相机图像，面向低成本、资源受限平台设计。
AI.result: 在高保真物理仿真器中进行实验。基于CEM训练的控制器探索覆盖率更优，访问区域比CMA-ES多36.20%；最佳视觉策略的探索性能在统计意义上与传统依赖更昂贵距离传感器的方法相当，同时平均能耗降低31.40%。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了一套有效且经济可行的自主控制系统，表明仅凭单目视觉与轻量神经进化优化即可在群体机器人中实现高效集体智能，为真实工程应用中部署高能效集体智能提供了路径。

title: Shadow Feature Refinement Network: Progressive Feature Refinement based on Knowledge Distillation for Effective Shadow Removal
summary: In the field of deep learning, has seen significant advancements; however, shadow removal remains a persistent challenge owing to the variable sizes and colors of shadows influenced by lighting conditions. This study proposes a novel shadow feature refinement network (SFR-Net), which leverages supervised learning, feature refinement loss, and knowledge distillation to enhance shadow removal performance. A dedicated post-processing algorithm is further introduced to restore natural color consistency in the generated shadow-free images. We evaluated our method on two public datasets: the adjusted image shadow triplet dataset (ISTD+) and the shadow removal dataset (SRD), which demonstrate strong generalization capabilities under diverse conditions. On ISTD+, our model achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.4627 and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.9382 across the entire image. On SRD, it recorded an RMSE of 4.3781 and an SSIM of 0.9341. These comprehensive results show that our approach performs competitively across both shadow and non-shadow regions while setting a promising direction for robust and perceptually natural shadow removal. Code is available at https://github.com/DongHyun99/SFRNet.

AI.tldr: 提出SFR-Net阴影特征细化网络，结合监督学习、特征细化损失与知识蒸馏，并引入后处理算法恢复自然颜色一致性，在ISTD+和SRD数据集上取得具有竞争力的去阴影效果。
AI.motivation: 阴影的大小和颜色随光照条件变化，导致阴影去除任务长期存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出SFR-Net（阴影特征细化网络），采用监督学习、特征细化损失和知识蒸馏提升去阴影性能；并引入专用后处理算法，恢复生成的无阴影图像的自然颜色一致性。
AI.result: 在ISTD+上全图RMSE为3.4627、SSIM为0.9382；在SRD上RMSE为4.3781、SSIM为0.9341，在阴影与非阴影区域均表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在多种条件下展现较强的泛化能力，为稳健且感知自然的阴影去除提供了有前景的方向。代码已开源。

title: Memory Canonicalization: A Framework and Benchmark for Cross-Model Drift in Persistent LLM Memory
summary: Persistent memory for Large Language Models (LLMs) has matured rapidly: systems such as MemGPT/Letta, Mem0, and Zep now provide agents with tiered, temporally-aware, model-agnostic external storage, while the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes access to memory servers. A less addressed problem is that an identical stored memory object, retrieved by two different LLMs under otherwise identical conditions, may not be interpreted the same way, factually or emotionally. This paper proposes memory canonicalization: a write-time pipeline that detects ambiguity, conditional structure, and emotional loading in a raw memory object and rewrites it into an explicit, structurally disambiguated canonical form, with emotional valence represented as a separate field rather than inferred from tone. We formalize the pipeline, define a companion Cross-Model Semantic Drift / Emotional Consistency Score benchmark (CMSC-E), and report results from a three-arm pilot using 176 synthetic memory objects and three downstream model families. We find an uncorrected improvement in cross-model emotional consistency for fully canonicalized memory relative to raw memory (+0.050, 95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086], paired t-test p = 0.010), but this result does not survive Bonferroni, Holm, or Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the six comparisons tested. None of the factual-drift (CMSD) comparisons reach significance at any correction level. We report these results as exploratory rather than confirmatory and outline needed follow-up work, including larger samples, independent judge models, human-validated rendering, and preregistration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"记忆规范化"（memory canonicalization）：在写入阶段检测原始记忆对象中的歧义、条件结构与情感负载，并将其改写为显式、结构上消歧的规范形式，情感效价作为独立字段表示。作者形式化该流程并定义跨模型语义漂移/情感一致性评分基准（CMSC-E），用176个合成记忆对象和三个下游模型家族开展三臂试点。结果显示完全规范化记忆的跨模型情感一致性存在未校正的提升（+0.050，95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086]，配对t检验 p=0.010），但该结果在六项比较的Bonferroni、Holm或Benjamini-Hochberg校正下均不显著；事实漂移（CMSD）比较在任何校正水平下均不显著。作者将其定位为探索性结果，并提出后续工作方向。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM持久记忆系统（如MemGPT/Letta、Mem0、Zep）已提供分层、时序感知、模型无关的外部存储，MCP也标准化了记忆服务器访问，但存在一个较少被关注的问题：同一存储记忆对象在被两个不同LLM于其他条件相同的情况下检索时，可能在事实或情感层面被不同地解读。论文旨在通过写入时规范化来缓解这种跨模型解读不一致。
AI.method: 提出memory canonicalization写入时流水线：检测原始记忆对象中的歧义、条件结构与情感负载，并改写为显式、结构上消歧的规范形式，情感效价作为独立字段而非从语气推断。形式化该流水线，并定义配套基准CMSC-E（Cross-Model Semantic Drift / Emotional Consistency Score）。开展三臂试点，使用176个合成记忆对象与三个下游模型家族。
AI.result: 完全规范化记忆相对原始记忆在跨模型情感一致性上呈现未校正的提升（+0.050，95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086]，配对t检验 p=0.010）；但该结果在六项比较的Bonferroni、Holm或Benjamini-Hochberg校正下均不成立。事实漂移（CMSD）的所有比较在任何校正水平下均未达显著。
AI.conclusion: 作者将上述结果报告为探索性而非验证性结论，并指出需开展后续工作：扩大样本量、使用独立评判模型、进行人工验证的渲染，以及预注册。

title: A Graph-Based Inspection and Intervention Tool for Assessing Mechanistic Learning in PINNs
comment: This is a developmental work which was submitted to NeurIPS workshops. Useful feedback was obtained and an improved version is being developed
summary: We ask whether physically meaningful correspondences discovered inside a trained scientific model remain meaningful outside the conditions under which they were discovered. We introduce GIIT (Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool), which represents governing physics as a computational physics dependency graph, maps graph nodes to internal network components via sensitivity- and trend-based discovery, and tests the resulting mapping under targeted intervention. Evaluating on temporal extrapolation out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes of increasing severity, we find that temporal extrapolation is associated with layer-wise correspondence drift and reduced functional correspondence. Specifically, while the model achieves low physics residual in-distribution (1.915 x 10-4 on full ID and 1.01 x 10-4 on an ID sub-window t in [0.5, 0.8]), the functional mapping changes even before leaving the training domain, and the shift continues as the evaluation window extends beyond the training domain: residual error increases from 2.81 x 10-2 on the boundary-crossing window (t in [0.5, 1.5]) to 3.30 x 10-1 on severe OOD (t in [1, 2]), accompanied by a systematic leftward shift of internal layer mappings, where the average winner layer index drops from 5.71 (ID) to 3.00 (ID sub-window) down to 2.29 (severe OOD). Only 2 of 7 physical nodes maintain stable layer assignments across the boundary-crossing window, and only 1 of 7 under severe extrapolation, revealing potential internal functional correspondence changes before severe degradation in conventional output metrics. Additional results for linear oscillatory systems are further detailed in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GIIT工具，通过物理依赖图与网络内部组件的映射及干预实验，发现科学模型在时序外推OOD下存在层间对应漂移与功能对应减弱，且该映射变化早于常规输出指标的严重退化。
AI.motivation: 探究在训练条件下发现的物理有意义对应关系，是否在训练条件之外仍然成立。这一问题的动机在于：模型在分布内输出误差很低，并不意味着其内部学到的物理机制具有可迁移性，需要新的诊断手段来检验内部功能对应的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出GIIT（Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool，基于图的检查与干预工具）：将支配物理表示为计算物理依赖图，通过基于敏感性与趋势的发现方法把图节点映射到网络内部组件，并在定向干预下检验所得映射。在严重程度递增的时序外推OOD区间上进行评估。
AI.result: 时序外推伴随逐层对应漂移与功能对应性下降。分布内物理残差很低（完整ID为1.915×10⁻⁴，ID子窗口t∈[0.5,0.8]为1.01×10⁻⁴），但功能映射在离开训练域之前就已改变，并随评估窗口外扩持续偏移：残差从跨越边界窗口（t∈[0.5,1.5]）的2.81×10⁻²升至严重OOD（t∈[1,2]）的3.30×10⁻¹。同时内部层映射系统性左移，平均获胜层索引由ID的5.71降至ID子窗口的3.00、再降至严重OOD的2.29。仅有7个物理节点中的2个在跨越边界窗口保持稳定层分配，严重外推下仅1个稳定，表明在常规输出指标严重退化之前，内部功能对应已发生变化。线性振荡系统的补充结果见附录。
AI.conclusion: 物理上可解释的内部对应关系并不随训练条件之外的外推而稳定保持；GIIT能够揭示隐藏在低输出误差之下的内部功能对应变化，可作为科学模型可解释性与外推可靠性诊断工具。层映射的系统性左移与稳定节点数骤降，说明常规输出指标不足以反映内部机制的真实退化。

title: A Taxonomy on Collective Awareness
summary: As robotic teams tackle increasingly complex tasks in dynamic and unstructured environments, effective coordination requires agents to maintain accurate, aligned representations of their environment, teammates, and mission state. We argue that Mutual Awareness, Shared Situational Awareness, and Team Situational Awareness --- three concepts widely invoked in the multi-robot systems literature --- are not interchangeable: they form a containment hierarchy in which each type subsumes the previous in scope, and span a distribution spectrum from fully individualized understanding (MA) to fully uniform understanding (SSA), with TSA occupying a mixed position. We establish this through a two-dimensional taxonomy organized along the object of awareness and awareness distribution axes. Treating these terms as synonyms obscures the precise coordination requirements each imposes on a robotic system. A Search and Rescue case study with heterogeneous aerial and ground robots grounds each taxonomy position in concrete coordination requirements. These findings provide a conceptual foundation for principled specification, design, and comparison of collective awareness in multi-robot systems.

AI.tldr: 该文辨析多机器人系统文献中常被混用的三个概念——相互意识（MA）、共享态势感知（SSA）与团队态势感知（TSA），提出它们构成包含层级，并以二维分类框架加以界定。
AI.motivation: 随着机器人团队在动态、非结构化环境中执行日益复杂的任务，智能体必须维持对环境、队友与任务状态的准确且对齐的表示。然而文献中MA、SSA、TSA三词常被当作同义词使用，掩盖了各自对协调的具体要求。
AI.method: 提出一个二维分类法：一是意识对象（object of awareness）轴，二是意识分布（awareness distribution）轴；据此论证三者构成范围上逐级包含的层级关系，并分布于从完全个体化理解（MA）到完全一致理解（SSA）的谱系上，TSA则处于混合位置。
AI.result: 通过以异构空中与地面机器人的搜救（Search and Rescue）案例研究，将分类法中每一位置对应到具体的协调需求，验证了该分类框架的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 将三者视为同义词会模糊其对机器人系统施加的精确协调要求；该研究为多机器人系统中集体意识的原则化规格说明、设计与比较提供了概念基础。

title: Riemannian Shape Analysis of the Corpus Callosum in Kendall Space: Aging and Alzheimer's Disease
summary: The corpus callosum (CC) is a major white-matter structure and a well-established marker of brain aging, but most studies quantify it using scalar summaries that discard its boundary geometry. We present a Riemannian shape-space framework for analyzing age-related morphological change in the midsagittal CC, applied to the OASIS-1 cohort. Each contour is represented by $128$ landmarks and embedded into Kendall shape space, where translation, rotation, and scale are removed. We derive a multivariate geodesic regression with exact Riemannian gradients and use the fitted age-velocity field to localize age-related deformation to five anatomical sub-regions. In the cognitively normal cohort ($n = 252$), geodesic regression outperforms the Euclidean linear benchmark ($R^2 = 0.1355$ vs.\ $0.1216$). Regional energy is posterior-dominant: the Splenium carries $41.4\%$ and the Isthmus $23.8\%$ of total age-related shape change, together accounting for $\sim 65\%$ despite comprising only $\sim 35\%$ of landmarks. Signed projections confirm the ordering (Splenium $r = 0.570$; Isthmus $r = 0.473$). In contrast, age explains less than $0.5\%$ of shape variance in Alzheimer's disease ($n = 88$), indicating that the disease disrupts the healthy aging trajectory. A tangent-space classifier achieves an age-group AUC of $0.791$ from the 2D contour alone, exceeding a recent volumetric benchmark ($0.67$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Kendall形状空间的黎曼测地回归框架，分析OASIS-1队列胼胝体正中矢状面随年龄的形态变化，发现后部区域（Splenium、Isthmus）主导老化形变，而阿尔茨海默病破坏了健康老化轨迹。
AI.motivation: 传统研究多使用标量摘要（如面积、厚度）量化胼胝体，丢弃了其边界几何信息，无法刻画精细的形态变化。
AI.method: 将每条轮廓表示为128个地标并嵌入Kendall形状空间（去除平移、旋转、尺度），推导具有精确黎曼梯度的多元测地回归，并利用拟合的年龄-速度场将老化形变定位到五个解剖子区域。
AI.result: 认知正常队列（n=252）中测地回归优于欧氏线性基准（R²=0.1355 vs 0.1216）；区域能量呈后部主导，Splenium占41.4%、Isthmus占23.8%，合计约65%却仅占约35%的地标；有符号投影证实该排序。阿尔茨海默病队列（n=88）中年龄解释的形状方差不足0.5%。切空间分类器仅用2D轮廓实现年龄组AUC=0.791，超过近期体积基准（0.67）。
AI.conclusion: 形状空间测地回归能有效捕捉胼胝体随年龄的几何形变，揭示后部区域主导的老化模式；阿尔茨海默病显著破坏健康老化轨迹，且基于轮廓的形状特征在年龄组分类上优于传统体积指标。

title: AutoSciBench: Autonomous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Scientific Agents
summary: As agents rapidly evolve, existing benchmarks can become saturated, limiting their ability to distinguish capabilities and reveal remaining failure modes. Particularly in scientific domains, constructing and updating benchmarks requires substantial time, labor, and domain expertise, making it difficult to keep evaluation aligned with advances in agent capabilities. We address this challenge by investigating whether scientific-agent benchmarks can be automatically generated and iteratively adapted as agent capabilities evolve. We introduce AutoSciBench, a framework that represents each task as a high-level concept specifying the scientific domain, data modality, and required reasoning approach, together with a low-level recipe specifying how the question, environment, and ground-truth answer are constructed and verified. Agents attempt to solve each task, producing solver trajectories and corresponding judge feedback which AutoSciBench uses to revise the recipe or concept, closing observed shortcuts and shifting tasks toward raw-data re-examination, interpretation of intermediate results, and evidence integration. Experience distilled from completed refinement trajectories further guides new concept generation, allowing lessons from earlier task refinement to inform subsequent benchmark construction. Starting from existing benchmarks, we evaluate AutoSciBench across computational biology, materials science, and clinical imaging. Generated benchmarks reduce average solver accuracy by 22.4 and 25.5 percentage points relative to the human-curated benchmarks in computational biology and materials science, respectively, while generated tasks receive higher average quality ratings across all three domains, suggesting that scientific-agent evaluation can adapt as agent capabilities advance.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoSciBench框架，可自动生成并迭代自适应地演进科学智能体基准，通过概念-配方双层表示与求解-评判反馈闭环修补捷径，在计算生物学、材料科学与临床影像三域生成更高质量且更具区分度的评测任务。
AI.motivation: 智能体能力快速演进导致现有基准趋于饱和，难以区分能力差异并暴露残余失效模式；而科学领域基准的构建与更新需大量时间、人力与领域专业知识，难以与智能体进展保持同步，因此需要可自动生成并随能力演化的基准方法。
AI.method: AutoSciBench将每个任务表示为高层"概念"（科学领域、数据模态、所需推理方式）与低层"配方"（问题、环境、真值答案的构造与验证方式）。智能体求解任务产生求解轨迹与评判反馈，框架据此修订配方或概念，封闭已观测到的捷径，将任务转向原始数据重检、中间结果解读与证据整合；从已完成精炼轨迹中蒸馏的经验进一步指导新概念生成，使前期精炼经验反哺后续基准构建。
AI.result: 在计算生物学、材料科学与临床影像三个领域，以现有基准为起点进行评估：生成基准使求解器平均准确率相对人工策划基准分别下降22.4与25.5个百分点（计算生物学与材料科学），同时在三个领域上生成任务的平均质量评分均更高。
AI.conclusion: 科学智能体评测可随智能体能力进步而自适应演化，自动生成与迭代精炼的基准能够缓解饱和问题、提升区分度与质量，为科学领域智能体评测提供可持续扩展的路径。

title: Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value
summary: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出软件世界模型（SWM），通过"探索—学习—行动"三阶段预测代码变更的爆炸集（受影响的组件），在合成与真实库上优于静态可达性分析。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体修改某仓库时可能悄然破坏下游服务、库或数据存储。每次动作后穷举运行集成测试不现实，因此智能体需在执行前预测破坏。现有软件世界模型只预测智能体自身观测，而静态变更影响分析仅识别变更可能传播的位置，均不足以预测具体破坏对象。
AI.method: SWM分三阶段：1）探索（Explore）：从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更，优先关注观测失败与依赖图矛盾的区域；2）学习（Learn）：用这些执行结果微调语言模型以预测下游破坏；3）行动（Act）：将采样预测转化为各消费方的破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移以及决定是否值得再执行一次。
AI.result: 在留出的合成系统上，SWM将爆炸集F1从静态可达性的0.431提升至0.571±0.037，排序遗憾降低一半以上，并在全部九个评估检查点提升迁移收益。两种方法互补：可达性在图中有表示的依赖上更强，而SWM能恢复因图未捕捉的耦合导致的失败。在留出的真实库上，预测结构化失败结果（而非仅标量风险）对下游决策质量至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 将变更影响预测建模为更广泛系统的世界模型，并预测结构化失败结果而非仅标量风险，可更有效地指导变更排序、迁移等下游决策，且与静态可达性分析互补。

title: Odyssey: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for Long-Horizon Real-World Driving with Explicit Navigation Routes
summary: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end driving requires continuous rollouts that reveal how earlier decisions affect subsequent driving. However, existing benchmarks evaluate only short segments and fail to capture later consequences. Ambiguous directional commands also obscure the intended navigation objective. We introduce Odyssey, a closed-loop benchmark for long-horizon driving comprising 100 scenarios, each reconstructed from a 100-second nuPlan driving log to preserve the context of navigation maneuvers and traffic interactions. To provide a consistent navigation objective, Odyssey replaces directional commands with explicit standard-definition (SD) map routes that specify which roads to follow, while sensor-based planning determines local driving actions. Throughout these rollouts, diffusion-based refinement of 3DGS-rendered images reduces rendering artifacts along the ego trajectory. To assess how effectively planners follow these routes and prepare for upcoming maneuvers, we introduce SD Route Compliance and Pre-Lane Change Score. These assessments are complemented by RouteDS, which extends the Driving Score with penalties for SD-route deviations and failed lane preparation. We adapt state-of-the-art planners, including vision-language-action (VLA) models, and evaluate their navigation performance using these metrics. Odyssey highlights open questions in route representation and integration for E2E driving. Benchmark code and adapted baselines will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出Odyssey闭环基准，用100秒nuPlan日志重建100个长时程场景，以SD地图路线替代方向指令作为导航目标，并引入SD Route Compliance、Pre-Lane Change Score与RouteDS指标评估端到端驾驶规划器的长时程导航能力。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端驾驶的闭环评测仅评估短片段，无法揭示早期决策对后续驾驶的长期影响；同时模糊的方向性指令会掩盖真实的导航目标，导致难以一致地衡量规划器是否按预期路线行驶。
AI.method: 构建Odyssey闭环基准：100个场景，每个由100秒nuPlan驾驶日志重建，保留导航操作与交通交互上下文；用显式标准清晰度（SD）地图路线替代方向指令以提供一致导航目标，局部驾驶动作仍由基于传感器的规划决定；rollout过程中采用基于扩散的3DGS渲染图像细化以减少自车轨迹上的渲染伪影；提出SD Route Compliance与Pre-Lane Change Score指标，并扩展Driving Score形成RouteDS（对SD路线偏离与变道准备失败施加惩罚）；适配包括VLA模型在内的先进规划器进行评测。
AI.result: 在Odyssey上评估了包括视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在内的多种先进规划器的导航表现，通过SD Route Compliance、Pre-Lane Change Score和RouteDS量化其路线遵循与变道准备能力，揭示了端到端驾驶在路线表征与集成方面仍存在的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: Odyssey提供了长时程闭环评测方案与配套指标，弥补了现有基准在长时程后果评估与导航目标一致性上的不足，并指出路线表征与集成是端到端驾驶的关键待解问题；基准代码与适配基线将公开。

title: WILLIE: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Wound Classification, Segmentation, and Localization
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Published in Proceedings of the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC 2026), PMLR 340:1243-1263. Code: https://github.com/Qian-Group-HRI/Willie
summary: Chronic wound management affects over 8.2 million patients in the United States and imposes substantial clinical and economic burden. Clinical wound assessment commonly involves three coupled tasks: identifying wound type, delineating wound boundaries, and localizing the wound region for measurement and monitoring. Despite this clinical coupling, existing machine learning approaches typically address wound classification, segmentation, and localization using separate models. We present WILLIE, a unified framework and benchmark for wound classification, segmentation and localization that enables systematic evaluation of multi-task wound analysis under a common protocol. WILLIE harmonizes three public wound datasets into a shared benchmark and compares unified models across three scaling configurations against 10 single-task baselines. The best model achieves 91.88% classification accuracy, 91.41% Dice, and 96.23% AP@0.5 while producing all three outputs in a single forward pass. Beyond aggregate performance, our results show that segmentation-derived localization outperforms dedicated detection baselines in this benchmark, suggesting that box-based localization may be unnecessary for spatially coherent wound targets. Our findings highlight that effective multi-task learning in healthcare imaging depends not only on shared representations, but also on task formulation, compatibility, and benchmark design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WILLIE，一个统一伤口分类、分割与定位的框架与基准，将三个公开数据集统一为共同协议，比较统一模型与10个单任务基线，最佳模型以单次前向传播同时输出三任务结果。
AI.motivation: 慢性伤口管理影响美国超820万患者，临床评估涉及伤口类型识别、边界勾画与区域定位三个耦合任务，但现有机器学习方法通常用独立模型分别处理分类、分割和定位，缺乏统一评估协议，任务间的临床耦合性未被充分利用。
AI.method: WILLIE将三个公开伤口数据集协调统一为共享基准，在统一协议下系统评测多任务伤口分析；采用三种缩放配置的统一模型，并与10个单任务基线进行对比。
AI.result: 最佳模型达到91.88%分类准确率、91.41% Dice和96.23% AP@0.5，且全部三个输出均在单次前向传播中完成；分割衍生的定位在该基准上优于专用检测基线。
AI.conclusion: 对空间连贯的伤口目标，基于框的定位可能并非必要；医疗影像中有效的多任务学习不仅依赖共享表征，还取决于任务表述、任务兼容性与基准设计。

title: R1A-PC: Physics-Guided Electromagnetic Inversion of Three-Dimensional Human Point Clouds in Complex Static Environments
summary: Recovering three-dimensional human geometry from electromagnetic measure?ments in a complex static environment is difficult because strong multipath responses from walls, floors, and other objects obscure the weak target per?turbation. We propose R1A-PC, a physics-guided method that reconstructs a 2048-point human cloud from paired complex fields measured with and without the target. Complex background subtraction emphasizes target-induced ampli?tude and phase changes, while the background field remains available as an environmental condition. A frequency-balanced discrete Born adjoint produces a three-dimensional spatial knowledge map. At each of two bounded deformation stages, the decoder combines complex measurement features, background fea?tures, and multiscale physical features queried at the current point coordinates; the second stage queries again after the first coordinate update. We analyze the residual of paired subtraction, the weighted normal-operator structure of the raw adjoint, and the feasible set of the predicted cloud. In a held-out background generated by full-wave simulation under a fixed acquisition geometry, R1A-PC obtains a squared Chamfer distance of 0.001434 m2 and an F-score of 0.963080 at 0.05 m. Compared with TopNet, the Chamfer distance decreases by 70.28%. Removing physical guidance or background subtraction increases the Chamfer distance by 242.06% or 241.18%, respectively. Experiments across background layouts and poses support the complementary roles of paired subtraction and position-dependent adjoint features.

AI.tldr: 提出R1A-PC物理引导方法，从有/无目标配对复场中重建2048点人体点云，加权伴随生成三维空间知识图，两阶段有界变形解码，Chamfer距离0.001434 m²、F-score 0.963080@0.05 m，较TopNet降低70.28%。
AI.motivation: 复杂静态环境中墙、地板等强多径响应会淹没微弱的目标扰动，导致三维人体几何重建困难；需要同时利用环境背景信息与目标引起的场扰动，以削弱多径干扰并保持物理一致性。
AI.method: R1A-PC为物理引导方法：对配对复场做复背景相减以突出目标幅相变化，背景场作为环境条件保留；采用频率均衡的离散Born伴随生成三维空间知识图；解码器在两个有界变形阶段融合复测量特征、背景特征与在当前点坐标处的多尺度物理特征，第二阶段在第一次坐标更新后再次查询。并分析配对相减残差、原始伴随的加权法算子结构与预测点云可行集。
AI.result: 在固定采集几何下全波仿真生成的留出背景中，R1A-PC的平方Chamfer距离为0.001434 m²，0.05 m处F-score为0.963080；相较TopNet，Chamfer距离降低70.28%。去除物理引导或背景相减分别使Chamfer距离增加242.06%和241.18%。跨背景布局与姿态实验验证了配对相减与位置相关伴随特征的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 复背景相减与位置相关伴随物理特征具有互补性，可在强多径静态环境下实现高精度三维人体点云重建；消融与跨布局/姿态实验表明两类信息缺一不可。

title: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
summary: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

AI.tldr: TempoBridge：以共同源条件化为核心的迁移建模范式，将破坏性单细胞快照建模为源细胞初始化的潜空间输运，用微批最优传输提供训练耦合、条件流匹配学习速度场，推理时无需目标表达或OT计算，在留出供体、基因组合与化合物上均优于scGen、scGPT-scratch、CellFlow等基线。
AI.motivation: 破坏性单细胞测量只能获得非配对的群体快照，无法追踪同一细胞跨条件的响应；此外，仅依赖局部细胞状态与转移请求不足以区分不同源群体之间的响应差异，因此需要一个能利用源群体整体信息、统一刻画时间、遗传与化学扰动的迁移建模范式。
AI.method: 提出TempoBridge，一种共同源条件化的输运公式：源细胞初始化潜空间输运并提供固定的经验群体摘要；速度场同时接收该摘要、演化中的细胞状态、流时间以及结构化转移描述符。训练时用微批最优传输（OT）为条件流匹配提供耦合路径，推理时既不需要目标表达也不需要OT计算。通过移除源上下文、用随机配对替换OT、用静态残差回归替换流匹配等方式开展消融。
AI.result: 在留出供体上Energy distance为0.129，优于scGen的0.144；在Seen 2/2设定下遗传平均表达L2误差为2.261，优于scGPT-scratch的3.156；在留出化合物上条件平均药效相关性为0.598，优于CellFlow适配器的0.561。时间维度消融显示，去除源上下文、以随机配对替代OT或以静态残差回归替代流匹配后，平均分布误差均升高。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了共同源条件化输运公式在留出供体、基因组合与化合物上的预测有效性，表明源群体摘要与OT引导的流匹配是提升跨扰动迁移预测的关键。

title: Traversability-Aware Cooperative Path Planning for Human-UGV Casualty Evacuation
summary: Heterogeneous multi-robot path planning is a well-studied problem in which agents with disparate kinematic and dynamic models must coordinate to achieve shared objectives. These formulations, however, treat all agents as robotic-their cost models are mechanical and their traversability is sensor-derived. In human-robot teaming, the human partner remains relegated to command and supervisory roles rather than being modeled as a physical co-navigator with distinct mobility constraints and dynamic energy reserves. This work investigates joint path planning for a two-agent human-UGV team in search-and-rescue casualty retrieval scenarios. We model the human agent using the Pandolf-Santee metabolic cost model with fatigue-modulated speed, and the UGV using a rolling-resistance energy model with terrain-dependent speed limits. By exploiting the complementary traversability of each agent-the human's ability to traverse dense vegetation and shallow water versus the UGV's superior speed on open terrain and roads-we optimize casualty transfer locations, termed switch points, to minimize total mission time. Evaluated across multiple synthetic 1km2 environments with procedurally generated elevation and land-cover data, the optimized strategy reduces mean mission time by 5.3% relative to a human-only baseline and by 7.0% relative to a naive human-UGV strategy without switch point optimization, while reducing human energy expenditure by 17.8% relative to baseline. Notably, the naive strategy reduces human energy expenditure by a larger margin (22.4%) but incurs a 2% increase in mission time relative to baseline, illustrating that switch point optimization is necessary to realize time savings from human-UGV teaming.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人-UGV双智能体在搜救伤员转运中的联合路径规划，将人类建模为具有代谢成本与疲劳约束的物理协作导航者，通过优化切换点来利用双方地形互补性以最小化总任务时间。
AI.motivation: 现有多机路径规划将智能体均视为机器人，成本模型为机械式、可通行性由传感器获取；在人机团队中人类仅被赋予指挥或监督角色，未被建模为具有独特移动约束和动态能量储备的物理协同导航者，因此需要将人类纳入联合路径规划框架。
AI.method: 针对两智能体人-UGV团队的搜救伤员回收场景，人类采用Pandolf-Santee代谢成本模型并结合疲劳调制速度，UGV采用滚动阻力能量模型并考虑地形依赖的速度限制；利用二者互补可通行性（人类可穿越茂密植被和浅水，UGV在开阔地形和道路上速度更优），优化伤员转运位置即切换点（switch points），以最小化总任务时间。在多个1 km²合成环境（程序化生成高程与土地覆盖数据）上评估。
AI.result: 优化策略相较纯人类基线平均任务时间减少5.3%，相较未优化切换点的朴素人-UGV策略减少7.0%；相较基线人类能量消耗减少17.8%。值得注意的是，朴素策略使人类能耗降低幅度更大（22.4%），但相较基线任务时间增加2%，表明切换点优化对于实现人-UGV团队的时间节省是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 将人类作为具有代谢成本和疲劳约束的物理协同导航者纳入联合路径规划，并通过切换点优化利用人与UGV的地形互补性，可同时降低任务时间和人类能量消耗；缺乏切换点优化的朴素协同策略虽能更大程度降低能耗，却会导致任务时间上升，凸显切换点优化在人机团队路径规划中的必要性。

title: IRSTD-Agent: Agentic Infrared Small Target Detection via Zoom-Guided Interaction Learning
summary: Infrared small-target detection plays an important role in maritime monitoring and aerial surveillance. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer promising capabilities for visual understanding, existing MLLM-based approaches struggle to precisely localize infrared small targets. In this paper, we propose IRSTD-Agent, an agentic framework for infrared small target detection through dynamic visual search. The framework enables an MLLM to adaptively determine where and at what scale to inspect an image and progressively gather fine-grained visual evidence for precise target localization. Five complementary visual tools (PROPOSAL, ZOOM, DETECT, DROP and REFINE) support object candidate discovery, adaptive observation, target localization, hypothesis rejection, and target extent refinement, together enabling a coordinated search process over original-resolution images. To teach the MLLMs to conduct this search, we introduce Zoom-guided Interaction Learning, which uses annotation-derived interaction trajectories to supervise tool selection and the corresponding arguments. Through extensive experiments on WideIRSTD-Full and IRSTD-1k datasets, we demonstrate that IRSTD-Agent outperforms the evaluated vision-language models and enhances the precise localization capabilities of MLLMs in IRSTD tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IRSTD-Agent，一种基于动态视觉搜索的红外小目标检测智能体框架，使多模态大模型能自适应决定在何处、以何种尺度检查图像，并通过五个互补视觉工具逐步收集细粒度视觉证据以实现精准定位，在WideIRSTD-Full和IRSTD-1k数据集上优于所评估的视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测在海上监控与空中监视中意义重大。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）虽具备视觉理解潜力，但现有基于MLLM的方法难以精确定位红外小目标。
AI.method: 提出IRSTD-Agent智能体框架：让MLLM自适应决定检查位置与尺度，渐进式收集细粒度视觉证据。设计五个互补视觉工具——PROPOSAL（候选发现）、ZOOM（自适应观察）、DETECT（目标定位）、DROP（假设剔除）、REFINE（目标范围细化），在原始分辨率图像上协同搜索。并引入Zoom引导的交互学习（Zoom-guided Interaction Learning），利用标注衍生的交互轨迹监督工具选择及其参数。
AI.result: 在WideIRSTD-Full和IRSTD-1k数据集上的大量实验表明，IRSTD-Agent优于所评估的视觉语言模型，并提升了MLLM在IRSTD任务中的精确定位能力。
AI.conclusion: IRSTD-Agent通过智能体化的动态视觉搜索与交互学习，有效弥补了MLLM在红外小目标精确定位上的不足。

title: Beyond Instruction Following: Learning Grounded Skill-Following with Skill Contracts
summary: Instruction following typically enforces discrete, response-level requirements, whereas an expert-authored skill prescribes procedural requirements spanning multiple phases and environment interactions. Given such a skill, we train the executor to execute all required phases instead of focusing solely on the final answer. We therefore introduce Grounded Skill-Following, which requires an agent to execute a fixed, expert-authored skill across its required phases by grounding decisions in environment observations. To achieve verifiable procedural execution, we formulate each skill as a skill contract combining visible skill instructions with an explicit contract runtime. The runtime specifies required phases, admissible actions, permitted transitions, and accepted termination. This structure provides a dense, verifiable training signal throughout execution. We leverage this by introducing Verified Progress Credit, which assigns rewards upon the initial completion of contract milestones and aggregates them into the trajectory return to guide policy optimization. During rollout, the contract runtime continuously tracks state transitions to provide Contract-State Feedback, which indicates whether the latest action is accepted and guides the agent toward valid next actions. To measure procedural compliance, we introduce the Protocol Completion Rate (PCR), defined as reaching accepted termination through all required phases, and decouple it from the final Task Outcome. Jointly trained with our framework, Qwen3.5-4B achieves Protocol Completion Rates of 99.27% on Math and 99.96% on Search, while slightly outperforming original baselines in Task Outcome (82.95% and 46.61%, respectively). Controlled studies examine how skill instructions, training signals, and contract-state feedback affect both metrics, while withholding interventions evaluate behavioral dependence on observation content.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Grounded Skill-Following 任务与 skill contract 框架，通过可验证的过程信号（Verified Progress Credit、Contract-State Feedback）训练智能体完成专家技能的全部阶段，并引入协议完成率（PCR）作为过程合规指标。
AI.motivation: 传统指令跟随只关注离散的、应答级别的最终结果要求，而专家撰写的技能规定的是跨多个阶段、需要与环境交互的程序性要求。仅关注最终答案会忽视执行过程，因此需要一种能让智能体在环境观测基础上，完整执行各必需阶段的可验证过程化范式。
AI.method: 将每项技能形式化为 skill contract，由可见的技能指令与显式 contract runtime 组成；runtime 规定必需阶段、可容许动作、允许的状态转移与可接受的终止条件。基于此提出 Verified Progress Credit，在合约里程碑首次完成时给予奖励并聚合为轨迹回报以指导策略优化；同时在 rollout 时由 runtime 持续追踪状态转移，提供 Contract-State Feedback，指示最近动作是否被接受并引导下一步合法动作。以 PCR（通过所有必需阶段并达到可接受终止）衡量过程合规性，并与最终任务结果解耦。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-4B 联合训练后在 Math 上 PCR 达 99.27%、Search 上达 99.96%，任务结果分别为 82.95% 与 46.61%，略优于原基线。对照实验考察了技能指令、训练信号与合约状态反馈对两项指标的影响；withholding interventions 评估了行为对观测内容的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的过程化合约结构能提供稠密训练信号，使智能体在保持甚至提升任务结果的同时实现高协议完成率，表明过程合规与任务结果可解耦并共同优化。

title: Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer
summary: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.

AI.tldr: 提出Asymmetric SupCon预训练目标，在台湾NHIRD上预训练时序Transformer编码器并迁移至美国MIMIC-IV与EHRSHOT，验证跨国家EHR表征迁移有效性。
AI.motivation: 跨机构、跨国家的EHR表征迁移受限于临床编码、患者群体与医疗流程的显著差异，现有方法难以直接迁移。
AI.method: 1) 提出Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning（Asymmetric SupCon），基于负性临床结局的异质性，仅聚集共享目标阳性结局的患者，不显式拉近负性轨迹；2) 在台湾NHIRD的398万患者纵向记录上预训练时序Transformer编码器；3) 通过结合直接映射与嵌入检索的混合语义映射流程实现异构临床词表间的迁移。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV上，NHIRD预训练持续优于随机初始化，并大幅缩小与任务特定域内预训练的差距；在EHRSHOT上，迁移模型在事件性疾病预测中展现强少样本性能；消融实验显示Asymmetric SupCon在四项任务中的三项取得最优AUPRC，第四项仅比Standard SupCon低0.003 AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: 非对称对比预训练是任务特定跨国家EHR表征迁移的有效方法。

title: MarvisNav: Making Memory Visible on Route Choices for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
summary: When searching for an object, people choose their next move by considering both likely target locations and places already explored. The current view can cue place-associated memories, bringing target relevance and prior exploration into the same spatial context. In many zero-shot object navigation (ZSON) methods, however, vision-language models (VLMs) infer promising search areas from egocentric images, while exploration history is represented separately, e.g., as text or maps. This separation either requires an additional fusion step or leaves the correspondence between memory and route choices implicit for the VLM to recover. We instead make exploration memory directly visible on visual route choices. We propose MarvisNav, a ZSON framework that maintains a topological graph and projects candidate nodes together with their exploration states onto egocentric views as memory-bearing visual route choices. These states capture local exploration progress beyond binary visitation. By binding exploration state directly to each visual candidate, MarvisNav enables the VLM to jointly evaluate target relevance and exploration state without a separate post-hoc fusion or reranking stage. Without policy training, MarvisNav achieves state-of-the-art performance on HM3D (81.2% SR and 42.5% SPL), while remaining competitive on MP3D. It also outperforms representative VLM-based methods with far fewer VLM calls (e.g., 7.5% of WMNav). Real-robot experiments across diverse scenes further validate its practical deployability. Beyond MarvisNav, our study shows that memory representation shapes VLM decisions and ZSON performance, highlighting that effective memory use depends not only on its availability, but also on how it is represented. Code and project page will be available at \url{https://wangjincheng1998.github.io/MarvisNav/}.

AI.tldr: MarvisNav将探索记忆直接可视化在自我中心视角的路由候选上，使VLM联合评估目标相关性与探索状态，在ZSON任务上无需策略训练即达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本物体导航（ZSON）中，VLM从自我中心图像推断搜索区域，而探索历史以文本或地图形式单独表示，二者分离导致需额外融合步骤，或使记忆与路线选择的对应关系对VLM而言隐式难恢复。作者认为记忆的表示方式本身会影响VLM决策与ZSON性能。
AI.method: 提出MarvisNav框架：维护拓扑图，将候选节点及其探索状态投影到自我中心视图上，形成"承载记忆的视觉路由选项"。探索状态刻画局部探索进度而非二元是否访问，从而把探索状态直接绑定到每个视觉候选上，使VLM无需事后融合或重排序即可联合评估目标相关性与探索状态；方法无需策略训练。
AI.result: 在HM3D上达到81.2% SR与42.5% SPL的SOTA，MP3D上保持竞争力；VLM调用量远少于代表性VLM方法（如仅为WMNav的7.5%）；多种场景的真实机器人实验验证了部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: 记忆表示形式塑造VLM决策与ZSON性能，有效利用记忆不仅取决于其可得性，还取决于其表示方式。

title: Learning Conditional Source Distribution via Flow Reversal for Temporal Flow Matching
