summary: We introduce CNP-Flow, a flow matching framework for temporal generation that learns conditional source distributions through flow reversal. Whereas standard conditional flow matching (FM) incorporates conditioning through the vector field and draws source samples from a standard Gaussian, CNP-Flow uses a conditional noise predictor (CNP) to produce an isotropic Gaussian source for each temporal condition. The CNP is supervised by source samples obtained through flow reversal, which maps observed targets backward through a pretrained FM model. A three-stage pipeline pretrains the FM model, trains the CNP, and fine-tunes the FM model using the learned source distribution, while preserving the FM backbone architecture. Across video prediction, video interpolation, and 7-DoF Franka robot motion planning, CNP-Flow consistently improves generation quality. It also matches baseline performance with fewer function evaluations. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cnpflow

AI.tldr: 提出CNP-Flow，一种通过流反转学习条件源分布的流匹配框架，用于时序生成任务。
AI.motivation: 标准条件流匹配（FM）仅通过向量场引入条件信息，源样本始终从标准高斯采样，无法针对时序条件自适应地构造源分布，限制了生成质量与效率。
AI.method: CNP-Flow使用条件噪声预测器（CNP），为每个时序条件生成各向同性高斯源分布。CNP由流反转得到的源样本监督：将观测目标经预训练FM模型反向映射获得。采用三阶段管线——预训练FM模型、训练CNP、用学到的源分布微调FM模型，且保持FM骨干架构不变。
AI.result: 在视频预测、视频插值和7自由度Franka机器人运动规划任务上，CNP-Flow一致提升生成质量，并在更少函数评估次数下达到基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过流反转学习条件源分布可有效增强条件流匹配的时序生成能力，兼具质量与效率优势。

title: Memadapter: Counterfactual Adaptation Against Memory-induced Sycophancy
summary: Long-term memory enables LLM-based agents to retain and reuse information across tasks and sessions, supporting personalization and long-horizon interactions. However, persistent memories can also induce sycophancy, causing agents to over-align with users' historical beliefs even when they are inaccurate, outdated, or inconsistent with objective evidence. Existing mitigation methods assume that memory-induced sycophancy originates from biased or incorrect memories and attempt to reduce this risk by filtering such memories at different stages of the memory pipeline. However, in the real world, objective and correct memories can still induce sycophancy, and the same memory can warrant different influence across different contexts. To this end, we propose MemAdapter, a novel framework that adaptively integrates retrieved memories to support objective and reliable reasoning. Specifically, MemAdapter consists of three components: (i) Counterfactual Induction, which leverages counterfactual reasoning to uncover the potential risk of retrieved memories; (ii) Context-Aware Reflection, which calibrates the inferential influence of each retrieved memory in light of the current task via self-reflection; and (iii) Evidence-Based Reasoning, which grounds the final response in appropriate evidence while preserving the legitimate influence of memory. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that MemAdapter consistently improves memory reliability across diverse scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/MemAdapter.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemAdapter 框架，通过反事实归纳、上下文感知反思与证据推理，自适应整合检索到的记忆，缓解由客观正确记忆也可能引发的谄媚问题，在三个基准上提升记忆可靠性。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使 LLM 智能体可跨任务与跨会话保留并复用信息，支持个性化与长程交互；但持久记忆也会诱发谄媚，使智能体过度迎合用户历史信念，即使这些信念不准确、过时或与客观证据冲突。现有缓解方法假设记忆引发的谄媚源自偏见或错误记忆，并在记忆流水线不同阶段过滤这类记忆；然而现实中客观且正确的记忆同样可能引发谄媚，且同一记忆在不同上下文中应具有不同影响权重。
AI.method: MemAdapter 由三个组件构成：(i) 反事实归纳（Counterfactual Induction），利用反事实推理揭示检索记忆的潜在风险；(ii) 上下文感知反思（Context-Aware Reflection），通过自我反思依据当前任务校准每条检索记忆的推理影响；(iii) 证据推理（Evidence-Based Reasoning），在保留记忆合法影响的同时将最终回复锚定于适当证据。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的大量实验表明，MemAdapter 在多样化场景中持续提升记忆可靠性。代码开源于 https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/MemAdapter。
AI.conclusion: 记忆引发的谄媚并非仅源于错误或偏见记忆，客观正确的记忆亦可诱发该问题，且记忆影响应随上下文动态调整；MemAdapter 通过自适应整合检索记忆，实现客观可靠的推理，是缓解记忆诱导谄媚的有效方案。

title: How Should Teachers Be Prepared? RL on Student-Induced States for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves the reasoning capabilities of small language models through token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. Yet can teachers that excel at solving problems independently also guide student reasoning effectively? Prior work shows that when student prefixes follow reasoning paths that differ from the teacher's own or contain errors, teachers can be less accurate when continuing from these prefixes than when solving problems independently. To this end, we propose Prep-OPD, which uses reinforcement learning (RL) before distillation to train the teacher to adapt to the student's existing reasoning state and correct course when errors arise. Training optimizes teacher continuations from fixed student prefixes using final-answer correctness as the reward. The prepared teacher then trains the student through trajectory guidance and token-level supervision. We evaluate Prep-OPD on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the teacher and Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B as students. With the 4B teacher and 1.7B student, Prep-OPD improves average accuracy over standard OPD and the strongest baseline, Relay-OPD, by 8.28 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments further show that teacher RL conditioned on student-generated prefixes yields higher student accuracy than problem-start teacher RL with and without handoff on Qwen3-1.7B. Reusing the same prepared teacher also improves Qwen3-0.6B.

AI.tldr: Prep-OPD通过在蒸馏前用强化学习训练教师模型适应学生推理状态并纠错，从而提升小模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy distillation依赖教师在学生生成轨迹上进行token级监督，但教师独立解题能力强并不代表能从学生偏离或含错的前缀继续有效引导，导致继续准确率低于独立解题。
AI.method: 先对教师做RL：以固定学生前缀为条件、以最终答案正确性为奖励，优化教师续写与纠错能力；再用该"预备教师"对学生进行轨迹引导与token级监督。
AI.result: 在八个数学推理基准上，教师Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，学生Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B；1.7B学生上平均准确率较标准OPD和最强基线Relay-OPD分别提升8.28和2.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以学生前缀为条件的教师RL优于从问题起始的教师RL（含/不含handoff）；同一预备教师可复用于Qwen3-0.6B并带来提升。

title: ArtifactArena: Evaluating Models by What They Build in the Physical World
summary: To evaluate the frontier, we must measure models not by what they say, but by what they can engineer and build in grounded physical environments. We introduce \textsc{ArtifactArena}, an open-ended platform where models face a physically grounded hardware-software co-design challenge: engineering fully functional robots to compete in a simulated arena. We evaluate a frontier model's zero-shot, verifier guided refinement, and open-ended physical design capabilities through three harnesses that refine their bot artifacts based on text descriptions, physics simulator feedback, and gameplay data. We benchmark these capabilities with an Elo ranking of frontier models derived from head-to-head tournaments between their artifacts. By releasing this framework and tournament infrastructure for ongoing community submissions, we establish a living, non-saturating testbed to continuously measure the expanding limits of open-ended intelligence in the physical world. Please visit \href{https://artifactarena.ai}{https://artifactarena.ai} for more information.

AI.tldr: 提出ArtifactArena，一个开放式的硬件-软件协同设计物理环境测试平台，通过让模型设计完整机器人并在模拟竞技场中进行对抗，以Elo排名衡量前沿模型能力。
AI.motivation: 评估前沿模型不应只看其言语输出，而应衡量其在真实物理环境中的工程与构建能力；现有基准难以持续衡量开放式智能在物理世界中的极限。
AI.method: 构建ArtifactArena平台，设置物理落地的硬件-软件协同设计挑战（设计完整可用机器人参与模拟竞技）；通过三种测试框架评估模型能力：零样本、基于验证器的迭代改进、以及开放式物理设计；改进依据文本描述、物理模拟器反馈和博弈数据；通过模型产出机器人之间的对战锦标赛得出Elo排名。
AI.result: 建立了基于成果（机器人对战）的Elo排名体系，用于对前沿模型的物理设计与工程能力进行量化比较。
AI.conclusion: 开放该框架与锦标赛基础设施，支持社区持续提交，形成持续生长、不饱和的测试床，以长期衡量开放式智能在物理世界中不断扩展的边界。

title: CleanMDM: Clean Motion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Motion Cleanup
summary: Motion capture data is rarely directly usable, as they typically exhibit missing segments, jitter, drift and contact artifacts. Traditionally, corrupted motions are cleaned by animators through the manual identification of keyframes from noisy motion, subsequent keyframe correction, and interpolation between corrected keyframes to reconstruct coherent motion. While the rise of generative motion models has made automatic cleanup feasible, most approaches operate as black box denoisers with limited controllability, making it difficult to preserve reliable segments or enforce specific user intents. Inspired by animation workflows, we present CleanMDM, a unified multimodal motion cleanup framework that formulates cleanup as masked conditional generation with plug-and-play conditions. This single model supports arbitrary combinations of noisy 3D motion, sparse 2D keyframes, sparse 3D keyframes, and text. This design enables both automatic cleanup without additional user annotation and controllable cleanup under multimodal guidance. To further improve motion realism, we incorporate the Latent Motion Quality Discriminator (LMQD) to better match kinematic distributions and reduce skating, jitter, and interpenetration artifacts, and we apply Mesh-Aware Contact Projection as a test-time optimization step to enhance contact and physical consistency. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that CleanMDM consistently outperforms prior cleanup and generation baselines, and that low cost conditions (text and 2D keyframes) provide reliable controllability gains in multimodal cleanup scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出CleanMDM，将动作清理统一建模为掩码条件生成，支持噪声3D动作、稀疏2D/3D关键帧与文本的即插即用组合条件，实现自动与可控清理。
AI.motivation: 动作捕捉数据常存在缺失片段、抖动、漂移与接触伪影，难以直接使用。传统需动画师人工识别噪声动捕中的关键帧、校正并插值重建连贯动作，成本高；而现有生成式自动清理方法多为黑箱去噪器，可控性差，难以保留可靠片段或落实用户意图。
AI.method: 受动画制作流程启发，提出统一多模态动作清理框架CleanMDM，将清理表述为带即插即用条件的掩码条件生成，单一模型支持噪声3D动作、稀疏2D关键帧、稀疏3D关键帧与文本的任意条件组合，兼顾无需额外标注的自动清理与多模态引导的可控清理；此外引入隐空间动作质量判别器（LMQD）以更贴合运动学分布，减少滑步、抖动与穿模伪影，并在测试时应用网格感知接触投影优化以增强接触与物理一致性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，CleanMDM持续优于现有清理与生成基线；同时低成本条件（文本与2D关键帧）在多模态清理场景中带来可靠的可控性提升。
AI.conclusion: CleanMDM以掩码条件生成为统一范式，结合LMQD与网格感知接触投影，在实现高质量自动动作清理的同时提供灵活的多模态可控性，验证了低成本条件用于可控清理的有效性。

title: A Safe Action Is Not Enough: Feasible-Future Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary:
A safe action is not necessarily a viable one. Under a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, an action can be likely and locally admissible yet leave no policy-supported route to safe task completion. We call this the feasibility-likelihood gap: likelihood ranks the current action, whereas feasibility depends on the futures that remain after it.
  We derive the exact next-block marginal of the history-conditioned policy-environment trajectory law restricted to safe task completion. The derivation exposes a candidate-dependent feasible-future mass with two roles: its support records whether safe completion remains possible under the frozen continuation process, and its magnitude measures how much weighted safe-completion mass is preserved. Exact evaluation is impractical online, so we develop a selective finite-candidate approximation, derive conditions for recovering the best retained viable candidate, and instantiate it as an alarm-triggered, training-free reranker.
  On Safety-CHORES, VICS-G lowers mean cumulative safety cost by 1.9%-57.5% across six settings while remaining within 2.5 percentage points of policy sampling in success and 0.82 steps in mean episode length. The resulting decoder is tied to an exact policy-relative safe-completion target, yet requires neither retraining of the base policy nor online trajectory rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可行性-似然性差距"概念，推导出安全的下一块边缘分布，并据此设计免训练的重排序器VICS-G。
AI.motivation: 在冻结的VLA策略下，一个动作可能既高概率又局部可行，却使后续无法再完成安全任务；似然排序只看当前动作，而可行性取决于该动作之后剩余的未来。
AI.method: 推导限制于安全任务完成的历史条件策略-环境轨迹律的精确下一块边缘分布，得到依赖候选的可行未来质量（支持集判定是否仍可能安全完成，幅值度量保留的加权安全完成质量）；由于在线精确评估不可行，提出选择性有限候选近似，给出恢复最佳保留可行候选的条件，并实现为报警触发、免训练的重排序器。
AI.result: 在Safety-CHORES上，VICS-G在六种设定下将平均累积安全代价降低1.9%-57.5%，同时成功率与策略采样相差不超过2.5个百分点，平均回合长度相差0.82步。
AI.conclusion: 所得解码器与精确的策略相对安全完成目标绑定，且无需重训基策略，也不需要在线轨迹rollout。

title: EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization
comment: 45 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables, accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems (ECOPs), such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), possess inherent symmetries under the two-dimensional Euclidean group E(2), including rotations, reflections, and translations. Existing learning-based methods, including recent diffusion-based methods, rely on data augmentation or regularization to approximate E(2)-equivariance. This paper presents EDISCO, the first discrete diffusion model for ECOPs with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions over node-index solutions. EDISCO introduces an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network coupled with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling provides efficient multi-step inference. This design gives EDISCO a local geometric inductive bias: edge neighborhoods with the same relative geometry and combinatorial context are represented consistently regardless of absolute position or orientation, making learning more efficient and inference more robust than non-equivariant methods. EDISCO outperforms previous learning-based state-of-the-art solvers on synthetic TSP from 100 to 10000 nodes and CVRP from 50 to 2000 customers, while using only 33-50% of the training instances. Trained only on uniform synthetic data, EDISCO also outperforms competing learning-based baselines under spatial distribution shift and CVRP constraint-tightness shift. Code is available at https://github.com/ValleyC/EDISCO.

AI.tldr: EDISCO是首个面向欧氏组合优化问题（ECOP）的、具有精确E(2)不变生成分布的离散扩散模型，在TSP和CVRP上以更少训练数据超越现有学习型求解器。
AI.motivation: TSP、CVRP等欧氏组合优化问题在二维欧氏群E(2)下（旋转、反射、平移）具有内在对称性，但现有学习方法（含扩散模型）仅通过数据增强或正则化来近似E(2)等变性，未能精确建模，导致学习效率与推理鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 提出EDISCO：在离散边变量上构建分类连续时间马尔可夫链，并设计E(2)等变的边评分网络，使生成的解分布具有精确E(2)不变性；通过精确后验采样实现高效多步推理，赋予模型局部几何归纳偏置——相同相对几何与组合上下文的边邻域表征一致，不受绝对位置与朝向影响。
AI.result: 在100至10000节点的合成TSP和50至2000客户的CVRP上超越此前学习型最优求解器，且仅使用33%–50%的训练实例；仅在均匀合成数据上训练，在空间分布偏移与CVRP约束紧度偏移下仍优于对比学习型基线。
AI.conclusion: 精确E(2)不变性为ECOP求解带来更强的泛化与鲁棒性，EDISCO以更少数据取得更优性能，验证了几何等变建模在组合优化中的有效性；代码已开源。

title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
summary: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}

AI.tldr: SimForcing 提出仿真引导的机器人世界模型框架，通过潜在运动蒸馏迁移仿真动作知识并引入多块仿真条件与无分类器引导，在真实机器人视频上取得最优视觉生成指标且可助力下游策略学习。
AI.motivation: 动作条件机器人世界模型需同时精确响应机器人轨迹并保持真实视觉动态，但异构机器人视频难以兼顾二者。仿真可提供结构化运动监督，然而外观差异阻碍直接迁移，且不准确的仿真预测会误导真实视频生成。
AI.method: 提出 SimForcing 框架：1）通过潜在运动蒸馏从仿真教师模型中迁移运动知识，在潜空间对齐时间变化以内化运动先验并削弱外观差异；2）引入多块仿真条件结合条件丢弃（condition dropout），利用预测的仿真轨迹而不盲目依赖其精度；3）设计仿真条件无分类器引导（CFG）统一上述两点，在内部化运动知识与仿真潜变量引导的预测间取得平衡，联合训练的单一学生模型同时生成仿真条件与真实域视频，推理时无需额外世界模型。
AI.result: 在 Bridge 数据集上，SimForcing 在无外部具身预训练条件下取得最优 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 与 FVD；在 InternData-A1 上的评测进一步验证其跨机器人数据集的适用性；用该世界模型初始化视觉-语言-动作模型可提升 LIBERO 成功率，表明其对下游策略学习具有价值。
AI.conclusion: 仿真既可提供可迁移的运动知识，又可充当可控参考，SimForcing 借此实现高质量动作条件视频生成，并展现出跨数据集泛化与助力下游策略学习的潜力。

title: A Strong Baseline for Evaluating Vision Encoders in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Evaluating vision encoders requires metrics that reliably predict their downstream performance in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Although recent studies have shown that cross-modal metrics can better capture such performance, unimodal metrics remain the dominant choice in practice. In this work, we revisit cross-modal evaluation of vision encoders through large-scale experiments. We identify important limitations in both the experimental design and methodological formulation of prior approaches. After addressing these limitations and introducing simple improvements, we propose RAVEL, a training-free method based on cross-modal nearest-neighbor retrieval. Despite its simplicity, RAVEL achieves state-of-the-art performance across our experiments, outperforming prior methods by a substantial margin. Our results demonstrate that simple cross-modal metrics, when evaluated under a careful and comprehensive setup, can provide a strong basis for evaluating vision encoders for MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视视觉编码器的跨模态评估，指出既有工作在实验设计与方法构建上的局限，并提出免训练的跨模态最近邻检索指标RAVEL，在实验中大幅超越先前方法，达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 评估视觉编码器需要能可靠预测其在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中下游性能的指标。尽管已有研究表明跨模态指标更能反映下游性能，实践中仍以单模态指标为主。因此有必要系统重审跨模态评估的有效性。
AI.method: 通过大规模实验重新审视视觉编码器的跨模态评估，识别先前工作在实验设计与方法论表述上的重要局限；在解决这些局限并引入简单改进后，提出RAVEL——一种基于跨模态最近邻检索的免训练（training-free）方法。
AI.result: 尽管方法简单，RAVEL在各项实验中取得最优（state-of-the-art）表现，并显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 在严谨、全面的实验设置下，简单的跨模态指标可为面向MLLMs的视觉编码器评估提供可靠依据。

title: CreativeFlow: A One-to-Many Analogical Relation Transfer Method for 3D Asset Generation
comment: 3 pages. To appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Posters (SA Posters '26), Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, December 2026
summary: Inspired by cognitive science, we present CREATIVEFLOW, an analogical generation framework that explicitly models analogical divergent thinking to mitigate creative homogenization in text-to-3D pipelines. Our method derives a series of meaningful yet relationally similar source-target asset pairs, each featuring distinct geometric configurations. Expert evaluations demonstrate that our framework substantially enhances creative novelty and visual fascination. This workflow and its resulting assets establish a foundational dataset and benchmark for future relation-aware 3D model training.

AI.tldr: CREATIVEFLOW 是一个受认知科学启发的类比生成框架，通过显式建模类比发散思维来缓解文本到3D流程中的创意同质化问题。
AI.motivation: 文本到3D生成流程存在创意同质化问题，生成结果趋于雷同，缺乏创意新颖性。
AI.method: 借鉴认知科学，提出类比生成框架CREATIVEFLOW，显式建模类比发散思维，推导出一系列有意义但关系相似的源-目标资产对，每对具有不同的几何构型。
AI.result: 专家评估表明，该框架显著提升了创意新颖性与视觉吸引力；其工作流与生成的资产为未来关系感知的3D模型训练建立了基础数据集与基准。
AI.conclusion: CREATIVEFLOW 有效缓解了文本到3D管线的创意同质化，并为关系感知3D模型训练提供了数据集和基准。

title: Trinity: One Differentiable Physics for Training, Refining and Scoring Generative Floorplanners
comment: Shih-Ying Yeh and Tzu-Sian Wang contributed equally. 85 pages, 65 figures, 67 tables. Project page: https://kohaku-lab.github.io/Trinity/ Code: https://github.com/Kohaku-Lab/Trinity Models: https://huggingface.co/KBlueLeaf/Trinity
summary: Floorplanning arranges the blocks of a chip and decides their shapes under objectives that press blocks together, short wirelength and a small outline, and constraints that hold them apart, non-overlap, clusters, MIB shapes and boundary blocks. Recent diffusion placers train on reference layouts alone and leave this coupled system to guidance, post-hoc loops and a legalizer, reporting only the endpoint, which hides what the generator contributes. We re-implement four of them under one recipe on FloorSet, score raw, refined and legalized layouts on one scale, and propose Trinity, a flow-matching floorplanner whose six differentiable functions for the constraints and objectives are its training loss term, the energy of a closed-form refiner after sampling and the base of a soft cost for every stage. The network thus learns the correction prior placers apply in their samplers, and sampling needs no guidance. Stage by stage, the training term lowers a plain transformer's raw soft cost by 26% and matters most at short budgets, the shared refiner decides more of the final cost than the generator and matches a ported placer's loop in 16 to 660 times fewer steps, Trinity's refined soft cost is 36% below the best ported pipeline, the soft cost ranks settings as the contest's hard cost does, and on the FloorSet val set the pipeline reaches a mean hard cost of 1.014 in 1.63 s per case.

AI.tldr: 该论文在统一配方下复现四种扩散布局器并引入Trinity——一个将六个可微约束/目标函数同时用作训练损失、采样后闭式精修器能量与各阶段软代价基座的流匹配布局流程，实现无需引导的采样并显著降低软/硬代价。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散布局器仅基于参考布局训练，将耦合的布局系统交给引导、事后循环与合法化器处理，且只报告最终结果，掩盖了生成器本身的贡献；同时缺乏在统一尺度下对原始、精修与合法化布局的公平评测。
AI.method: 在FloorSet上以统一配方复现四种扩散布局器，对原始、精修与合法化布局在统一尺度上打分；提出Trinity流匹配布局器，其六个针对约束与目标的可微函数同时作为训练损失项、采样后闭式精修器的能量以及各阶段软代价的基础，使网络学习放置器采样器中的修正先验，采样无需引导。
AI.result: 训练项将普通Transformer的原始软代价降低26%且在短预算下最关键；共享精修器决定最终代价的比重大于生成器，并以少16至660倍的步数匹配移植布局器的循环；Trinity精修后软代价比最佳移植流程低36%；软代价对设置的排序与竞赛硬代价一致；在FloorSet验证集上，每例1.63秒达到平均硬代价1.014。
AI.conclusion: 将约束与目标的可微函数统一为训练损失、精修能量与软代价基座，可让流匹配布局器自主学习修正先验、免去引导，并在统一评测下超越复现的扩散布局流程，同时软代价可作为硬代价的可靠代理。

title: Physics Residual Dynamics and Reduced Order Whole-Body Planning for Obstacle Aware Human Robot Cloth CoTransportation
summary: Human--robot co-transportation of deformable objects requires predicting object deformation during motion, since obstacle clearance depends on both the grasp points and the unactuated interior. We present a hierarchical planning framework that combines a learned cloth model with a reduced-order whole-body model of a dual-arm mobile manipulator. A physics-residual conditional recurrent variational autoencoder (p-cRVAE) predicts the full cloth configuration from grasp-point observations by learning a residual correction to a computationally efficient linearized physics model, limiting error accumulation over 40-step planning horizon. The predicted cloth dynamics are embedded in a model predictive path integral (MPPI) planner using a reduced-order representation of a dual-arm mobile manipulator that preserves the non-holonomic base constraint and arm workspace limits. An MPC layer subsequently refines the sampled motion into smooth, executable references for whole-body control. The reduced-order formulation achieves tracking performance comparable to the full 17-DoF model while reducing computation time by approximately 80%. Across four co-transportation scenarios and two carrying speeds, the proposed framework maintains cloth-obstacle clearance where a corner-following baseline results in collisions, while whole-body refinement reduces final cloth deformation from 0.93\,m to 0.28\,m.

AI.tldr: 提出分层规划框架，将学习式布料模型与双臂移动机械臂降阶全身模型结合，实现人-机器人协同搬运可变形物体的避障与形变控制。
AI.motivation: 人-机器人协同搬运可变形物体时，避障间隙同时取决于抓取点与不可控的物体内部形变，因此需要在运动中预测布料形变，而现有方法难以兼顾预测精度与规划实时性。
AI.method: 1) 物理残差条件循环变分自编码器（p-cRVAE）：以抓取点观测为条件，对高效线性化物理模型学习残差修正，预测完整布料构型；2) 将预测布料动力学嵌入MPPI规划器，采用保留非完整基座约束与机械臂工作空间限制的双臂移动机械臂降阶模型；3) MPC层对采样运动进行细化，生成平滑可执行的全身控制参考。
AI.result: 降阶模型在保持与完整17-DoF模型相当跟踪性能的同时，计算时间减少约80%；在四种协同搬运场景与两种搬运速度下，所提框架维持布料-障碍物间隙，而沿角跟随基线发生碰撞；全身细化将最终布料形变从0.93 m降至0.28 m。
AI.conclusion: 结合残差学习布料预测与降阶全身模型的层次化规划，可在保证实时性的前提下有效实现人-机器人协同搬运可变形物体的避障与形变抑制。

title: Prism: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Native 2K Joint Video-Audio Generation Model Training
summary: Natively training joint video-audio generation models at higher resolutions empowers them to learn richer visual details and sharper motion dynamics. However, full attention incurs quadratic cost and, as resolution increases, spreads attention over increasingly redundant tokens, diluting learning signals for informative content and disrupting pretrained priors. Existing sparse attention methods either target training-free acceleration or overlook the unique structure of joint video-audio data, where cross-modal interactions are inherently concentrated around sound-producing regions. To address this, we propose Prism, a dynamic sparse attention framework for natively training joint video-audio generation models at 2K. In particular, Prism organizes the token sequence into spatiotemporal macro-zones, enabling the attention structure to adapt to local content. For each zone, it estimates local information structure via video feature variance along the channel and feature norms from the audio-to-video cross-attention, jointly capturing how visual content varies directionally and how strongly audio influences each visual region. Based on these signals, Prism dynamically assigns a tailored block shape to each zone, applying finer partitioning along axes of rapid visual content variation and strong audio-visual coupling. This encourages tokens within each block to remain semantically coherent, allowing block-level features to capture both visual content and joint video-audio interaction patterns. Prism further adopts a hybrid block selection strategy to dynamically determine per-query sparsity. Experiments show that Prism achieves 2.5$\times$ training speedup compared to full attention, while surpassing it in generation quality.

AI.tldr: Prism：面向2K原生联合视频-音频生成的动态稀疏注意力框架，通过时空宏区块形状分配与混合块选择实现2.5倍训练加速并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 在高分辨率下原生训练联合视频-音频生成模型可获得更丰富的视觉细节与更清晰的运动动态，但全注意力计算量呈二次增长；随着分辨率升高，注意力被越来越多冗余token稀释，削弱了有效内容的学习信号并破坏预训练先验。现有稀疏注意力方法要么只面向免训练加速，要么忽视联合视频-音频数据的独特结构——跨模态交互本质上集中在发声区域附近。
AI.method: Prism将token序列组织为时空宏区（spatiotemporal macro-zones），使注意力结构适配局部内容。对每个区，利用视频特征沿通道的方差与音-视频跨注意力特征范数估计局部信息结构，联合刻画视觉内容的方向性变化与音频对视觉区域的影响强度。据此为每个区动态分配定制块形状：在视觉内容快速变化与视听耦合强的轴上采用更细的分区，使块内token保持语义一致性，块级特征可同时捕捉视觉内容与联合视听交互模式。此外采用混合块选择策略动态确定每个query的稀疏度。
AI.result: 相比全注意力，Prism实现2.5倍训练加速，同时在生成质量上超过全注意力基线。
AI.conclusion: Prism通过面向联合视频-音频数据结构的动态稀疏注意力设计，在2K分辨率原生训练场景下兼顾效率与质量，验证了内容自适应块形状与跨模态耦合信号在稀疏注意力中的有效性。

title: AECG: Asymmetric Experience Consolidation and Governance In Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on memory to transform execution trajectories into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet repeated retrieval also makes memory errors persistent: memory pollution arises when outdated, weakly supported, or spuriously successful procedures become recurring components of future reasoning. Multi-agent execution introduces an additional structural risk. Scope collapse occurs when procedural knowledge escapes the coordination scope in which it was shown effective and is repeatedly reused at incompatible decision levels, allowing local errors to influence cascades of downstream decisions. Meanwhile, task-level failures provide ambiguous supervision because they rarely reveal which recalled knowledge was responsible. We introduce AECG, a framework for asymmetric experience consolidation and governance for multi-agent systems. AECG turns memory from static experience storage into a dynamic reliability-governance loop, preserving coordination scope and using multi-scale, confidence-aware reliability to detect degradation. It then combines degradation with downstream impact to prioritize high-risk knowledge under a bounded review budget, applies targeted interventions, and reactivates revised skills only after paired replay. Across three multi-agent frameworks and four benchmarks, AECG achieves the best score in 11 of 12 framework--benchmark settings and improves over the strongest competing memory method by as much as 10.23 percentage points; removing scope preservation reduces accuracy by up to 16.89 points. AECG thereby reframes multi-agent memory from passive accumulation into auditable reliability governance. Code is available at https://github.com/fenhg297/AECG

AI.tldr: AECG 提出面向多智能体系统的非对称经验整合与治理框架，将记忆从静态存储转化为动态可靠性治理循环，通过保留协调作用域、多尺度置信感知的可靠性检测、受限预算下的高风险管理及配对回放后再激活，显著提升多框架多基准表现。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统依赖记忆将执行轨迹转化为可复用的程序性知识，但重复检索会使记忆错误持续化：过期、弱支持或虚假成功的程序被反复复用形成记忆污染。多智能体执行还带来结构性风险，即作用域塌缩——程序性知识脱离其被验证有效的协调作用域，在不相容决策层级上被复用，导致局部错误沿下游决策级联传播。同时，任务级失败监督信号模糊，难以定位是哪条被召回知识导致失败。
AI.method: AECG 将记忆由静态经验存储改造为动态可靠性治理循环：保留协调作用域；采用多尺度、置信感知的可靠性度量检测知识退化；将退化程度与下游影响结合，在有限审查预算下优先处理高风险知识；施加针对性干预；仅在配对回放验证通过后重新激活修订后的技能。
AI.result: 在 3 个多智能体框架与 4 个基准上，AECG 在 12 个“框架—基准”组合中的 11 个取得最优，较最强竞争记忆方法最多提升 10.23 个百分点；移除作用域保留机制后准确率最多下降 16.89 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: AECG 将多智能体记忆由被动积累重新定义为可审计的可靠性治理，验证了作用域保留与可靠性治理对抑制记忆污染与作用域塌缩的关键作用。

title: MAGIC: Topology-Aware Analytic Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Graph few-shot class-incremental learning (GFSCIL) requires a model to continually recognize emerging classes from only a few labeled nodes while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Beyond the catastrophic forgetting inherited from conventional graph continual learning, GFSCIL presents two distinctive challenges: extremely limited novel-class supervision causes severe overfitting, while cross-session edges---edges connecting newly arriving nodes with historical nodes---alter historical propagation neighborhoods and thereby induce representation drift. We propose MAGIC, a replay-free GFSCIL framework that combines a frozen graph representation backbone (e.g., an intrinsically parameter-free backbone such as SGC or a pretrained graph foundation model) with closed-form analytic continual learning. To alleviate novel-session overfitting, MAGIC learns a topological prior from the base graph that can characterize both homophilous and heterophilous relations, and injects this prior through Potts Markov random field inference to refine supervision for novel classes. To mitigate representation drift, MAGIC transfers previous predictions from the old representations of affected historical nodes to their updated representations through drift-aware analytic distillation. Experiments across five datasets and eight baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of MAGIC. Under the 5-shot setting, MAGIC improves Mean Accuracy and Final Accuracy by 5.48 percentage points and 9.33 percentage points on average, and reduces Performance Drop by 10.78 percentage points on average compared with the best baselines. MAGIC also shows clear advantages under the 1- and 3-shot settings, with larger gains as the number of supports increases. Moreover, MAGIC requires substantially less training time.

AI.tldr: MAGIC是一个免回放的图少样本类增量学习框架，结合冻结图表示骨干与闭式解析持续学习，通过拓扑先验注入和漂移感知解析蒸馏，同时缓解新类过拟合与表示漂移。
AI.motivation: 图少样本类增量学习（GFSCIL）除常规图持续学习的灾难性遗忘外，还面临两个特有挑战：一是新类监督极少导致严重过拟合；二是跨会话边（新节点连接历史节点）改变历史传播邻域，引发表示漂移。
AI.method: MAGIC采用免回放框架，由冻结图表示骨干（如无参数的SGC或预训练图基础模型）与闭式解析持续学习构成。针对新会话过拟合，从基图学习可刻画同配与异配关系的拓扑先验，并通过Potts马尔可夫随机场推断注入以精炼新类监督；针对表示漂移，通过漂移感知解析蒸馏，将受影响历史节点旧表示上的历史预测迁移到更新后的表示上。
AI.result: 在五个数据集、八个基线上验证有效。5-shot下，相比最佳基线，平均精度与最终精度平均提升5.48与9.33个百分点，性能下降平均减少10.78个百分点；1-shot与3-shot同样具优势，且随支持样本增多增益更大，训练时间也显著更少。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC通过拓扑先验引导监督与漂移感知解析蒸馏，有效缓解GFSCIL中的新类过拟合与表示漂移，在多种少样本设定下均优于现有基线，且训练更高效。

title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
comment: 33 pages, 14 figures, 17 tables. Project page: https://affordcraft.github.io Code: https://github.com/AffordCraft/AffordCraft
summary: Robot learning in simulation depends on the objects the simulator offers. Many tasks need objects with separate parts, joints that allow the required motion, and physical properties that remain valid under contact. Existing methods recover this structure anew for every image: generative models predict parts and joints that mostly fail to settle or move in simulation, and general-purpose agents need a long session of model calls for each photograph. AffordCraft builds such an asset from a single RGB image and a task instruction by retrieval instead of generation: it locates the object and the part to operate, selects a matching entry from a library of articulated assets, and fits it to the image while keeping its parts and joints intact. Without any box or mask marking the object, AffordCraft produces a physically valid asset for 1,703 of 2,000 photographs from 31 categories. Five generative methods pass on at most 45% of the same photographs and, at the median, need 10 to 78 times our GPU time per valid asset. On 50 cluttered images, 162 of 237 annotated objects pass the same physical test after automatic detection. Growing the library from 141 to 11,372 entries needs no change to the method and raises category coverage from 46% to 100% and the share of selections with the requested label from 18% to 51%. We also build manipulation tasks from the constructed assets, both with single objects and in composed scenes; policies trained on scripted demonstrations complete both kinds of tasks from initial states unseen in training.

AI.tldr: AffordCraft 通过检索而非生成，从单张 RGB 图像和任务指令构建物理有效的铰接式仿真资产，成功率达 85.15%，显著优于生成式方法。
AI.motivation: 仿真机器人学习依赖仿真器提供的物体，但许多任务需要具有独立部件、可动关节及在接触下保持有效物理属性的物体。现有方法对每张图像重新恢复此结构：生成模型预测的部件和关节大多无法在仿真中稳定或运动，通用智能体则需为每张照片进行长时间模型调用。
AI.method: AffordCraft 通过检索而非生成构建资产：定位物体及待操作部件，从铰接资产库中选择匹配条目，并将其拟合到图像，同时保持其部件与关节完整。
AI.result: 在无边界框或掩码标注的情况下，AffordCraft 为来自 31 个类别的 2,000 张照片中的 1,703 张生成物理有效资产（约 85%）。五种生成式方法在相同照片上通过率至多 45%，且每个有效资产的中位 GPU 耗时是我们的 10 至 78 倍。在 50 张杂乱图像中，自动检测后 237 个标注物体有 162 个通过相同物理测试。资产库从 141 增至 11,372 条无需更改方法，类别覆盖率从 46% 升至 100%，选定条目含所需标签的比例从 18% 升至 51%。
AI.conclusion: 基于构建资产可搭建操作任务（含单物体及组合场景），在脚本演示上训练的策略能从训练未见初始状态完成两类任务。

title: Render to Reason: Novel-View Semantic Prediction Improves Spatial Understanding in VLMs
summary: Recent works augment Vision-Language Models with geometry features from pretrained 3D models, expecting that the geometric signal will boost spatial reasoning. However, we find that simply fusing geometry features and training on standard spatial QA yields only marginal improvements on high-level multi-hop tasks. We attribute this gap to a training-signal problem: standard spatial QA can be largely answered from visual features and language priors, so the geometry pathway receives weak gradients and fails to integrate with the visual features. To provide a training signal that requires geometry, we propose \textbf{novel-view semantic rendering} as an auxiliary training task that requires the model to predict the semantic layout of an unobserved viewpoint, inspired by humans' ability to mentally simulate novel viewpoints during spatial reasoning. This task encourages joint use of both pathways: geometry provides pose-dependent visibility, while vision provides semantic content. Our auxiliary task yields consistent improvements over the geometry-augmented baseline across all three benchmarks (up to +1.6 on VSI-Bench, +2.2 on ReVSI, +2.9 on our 3D-Point-QA dataset) and our full model surpasses prior open-source methods on VSI-Bench and on ReVSI. Project page: https://yuqunw.github.io/Render2Reason/.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出几何增强视觉语言模型在空间推理上提升有限，原因是标准空间问答可从视觉特征与语言先验回答，几何通路梯度弱；提出"新视角语义渲染"辅助训练任务，强制联合使用几何与视觉通路，在三个基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将预训练3D模型的几何特征注入视觉语言模型以增强空间推理，但实际仅带来边际提升，尤其在高阶多跳任务上。作者将其归因于训练信号问题：标准空间问答大多可仅凭视觉特征与语言先验作答，导致几何通路获得微弱梯度，无法与视觉特征有效融合。
AI.method: 提出"新视角语义渲染"（novel-view semantic rendering）作为辅助训练任务，要求模型预测未观测视角的语义布局，灵感来自人类在空间推理中在脑内模拟新视角的能力。该任务强制两条通路协同：几何通路提供依赖位姿的可见性，视觉通路提供语义内容。
AI.result: 相较于几何增强基线，该方法在全部三个基准上取得一致提升：VSI-Bench最高+1.6，ReVSI最高+2.2，自建3D-Point-QA数据集最高+2.9；完整模型在VSI-Bench与ReVSI上超越已有开源方法。
AI.conclusion: 几何信号要真正提升空间推理，关键在于设计需要几何信息才能完成的训练任务；新视角语义渲染通过迫使模型联合利用几何与视觉通路，有效缓解训练信号不足问题并提升多跳空间推理性能。

title: From Scientific Observations to Mechanisms: Benchmarking Hypothesis Generation by AI Scientists
summary: Data-driven mechanistic hypotheses are essential to scientific discovery because they explain how underlying processes produce observed phenomena. AI agents and AI scientists increasingly support scientific data analysis. However, their ability to turn empirical findings into mechanistic hypotheses remains insufficiently examined. To address this gap, we introduce MechHypoBench, the first benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents and AI scientists can generate such hypotheses from empirical data. It combines paper-derived mechanisms from 14 scientific fields with real-world datasets containing 17.98 million records. The construction retains the observational complexity of empirical data while providing a specified underlying mechanism. Agents analyze the observations and propose open-form hypotheses. We develop an evaluation framework that assesses open-form mechanistic hypotheses through their consequences under withheld conditions. Experiments with general agents and AI scientists reveal a substantial gap between generated hypotheses and the underlying mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出MechHypoBench基准，评估AI代理/AI科学家能否从经验数据生成机械论假设；整合14个领域论文机制与1798万条真实数据，通过"在未知条件下推断后果"的评测框架评估开放式机制假设，实验显示生成假设与真实机制存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的机制性假设是科学发现的核心，AI代理/AI科学家日益参与科学数据分析，但其将经验发现转化为机制性假设的能力尚未被充分检验，缺乏相应评测手段。
AI.method: 构建MechHypoBench：融合来自14个科学领域的论文机制与含1798万条记录的真实数据集；在保留经验数据观测复杂性的同时给出明确的底层机制。代理分析观测并提出开放式假设，评测框架以"在扣留（未公开）条件下假设所蕴含的后果"来评估开放式机制假设。
AI.result: 在通用代理与AI科学家上的实验显示，所生成的机制性假设与底层真实机制之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: MechHypoBench首次为AI代理/AI科学家从经验数据提出机制性假设提供测评基准，揭示当前系统在机制推断上的不足，指向提升因果/机制推理能力的方向。

title: One Token Can Be Enough: Bridging Prompting and Activation Steering with Prefix Steering
summary: Prompting guides language model behavior through the initial context, whereas activation steering often intervenes throughout generation. A natural question is whether steering can produce effects on subsequent computation similar to those of prompting. Under fixed-state attention assumptions, we establish sufficient conditions for single- and multi-token steering to match prompt-induced attention-head outputs, and characterize how changes in input representations affect this match and its approximation error. This attention-level connection leads us to ask whether, at the behavioral level, steering can also guide subsequent generation through a brief initial intervention. We study Prefix Steering, which applies existing steering directions and operators over a short span starting at the final prompt token, with no further direct intervention afterward. We examine how intervention duration and strength jointly shape the control-capability trade-off. Across four models and five tasks, intervention over a short span, even a single token, often retains much of full steering's behavioral control while better preserving general capabilities, offering a trade-off competitive with, and in some settings better than, prompting and alternative steering-strength policies. Prefix Steering also remains effective on final-answer formatting tasks after reasoning, suggesting that a brief initial intervention can influence behavior expressed well after steering ends. These findings challenge the common practice of steering every generated token and motivate a more dynamical view of activation steering, in which a brief intervention can alter the trajectory of subsequent generation without continued intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prefix Steering：仅在提示末 token 起始的短片段上施加激活引导，无需后续干预，即可在多个模型与任务上保留大部分行为控制能力并更好保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 提示通过初始上下文影响模型，而激活引导通常在生成全过程持续干预。作者希望探究：引导能否像提示一样，以短暂初始干预影响后续计算与生成，并检验持续干预是否必要。
AI.method: 1) 在固定状态注意力假设下，推导单 token 与多 token 引导匹配提示诱导的注意力头输出的充分条件，并刻画输入表示变化对匹配与近似误差的影响；2) 提出 Prefix Steering，从最终提示 token 开始，在短跨度上应用既有引导方向与算子，之后不再直接干预；3) 考察干预时长与强度的联合作用。
AI.result: 在四个模型、五个任务上，即使仅单 token 的短跨度干预，也常能保留完整引导的大部分行为控制，同时更好保持通用能力，其权衡优于或接近提示与替代的引导强度策略；在推理后的最终答案格式任务上仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 短暂初始干预可影响引导结束后较晚才表现出的行为，挑战了对每个生成 token 都施加引导的常见做法，支持激活引导的更具动态性的观点：一次简短干预即可改变后续生成轨迹。

title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
summary: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RV-ICL，一种免训练方法，将演示视频组织为可导航的分层结构，使 LLM agent 在需要时按需读取从关键帧到短片段的不同粒度内容，从而在规划与执行阶段分别获取任务结构与接触细节。
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本记忆的 LLM agent 只能记录"做了什么"，无法传递"如何做"；而演示视频又难以直接放入上下文：完整视频拖慢每一轮推理，固定关键帧丢失决定抓取成败的接触细节，且 agent 所需的视频信息随阶段变化——规划时关注任务结构，执行时关注每个接触瞬间附近的帧。
AI.method: RV-ICL 将单条演示视频按抓取、释放等子事件构建为层级结构，层级由粗到细：全任务关键帧 → 阶段 → 时刻 → 短片段，并通过只读工具暴露给 agent。agent 在规划前读取粗粒度层级；执行中当某一步需要更多细节时重新进入层级，仅加载当前子目标的对应片段。
AI.result: 在 RPent 基础上，RV-ICL 将 LIBERO-PRO 成功率从 92.6% 提升至 96.5%，LIBERO-Plus 从 86.7% 提升至 95.8%。每个任务仅需一条演示。
AI.conclusion: 将演示视频转化为按需导航的层级结构，而非一次性注入的提示，可在免训练条件下有效弥补文本记忆缺失的过程性知识，显著提升 VLA 策略编排的成功率。

title: Unmentioned Checklist Findings Change How Reinforcement Learning Appears to Improve Chest Radiograph Report Checking
comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables (main text and references pp. 1-19; Supplementary Information as an appendix, pp. 20-40). Submitted to npj Digital Medicine. Code: https://github.com/ali-vosoughi/VerifyGRPO-Rad
summary: Automated checks of radiology reports may rely on AI-generated checklists that leave findings unmentioned. We used reinforcement learning to train a vision-language model to fill in a 12-finding checklist from a chest radiograph without seeing the sentence under test; a separate checking model judged the sentence from the checklist. On held-out patients, a rule-based check and an independent medical checker, neither used in training, measured discrimination gains (Youden index) of 12.6% and 11.8%; only the rule-based check met the prespecified false-alarm criterion. Switching to the training format, which fixes finding order and enters unmentioned findings as absent, raised the training checker's measured gain and lowered the independent checker's, a prespecified comparison that yielded 6.2% (95% interval 2.0% to 10.5%) and, post hoc on held-out patients, 7.7%. Across 8 checking models, acceptance of a label-consistent negative statement about an unmentioned finding ranged from 1.0% to 97.0%. Labels were report-derived, not radiologist-adjudicated.

AI.tldr: 本文使用强化学习训练一个视觉-语言模型，在不看被检查句子的情况下，从胸片生成包含12项发现的清单，再由独立的检查模型依据清单判断句子。在留出患者上，规则式检查器与独立医学检查器测得区分度增益分别为12.6%与11.8%，仅规则式检查器达到预设误报标准。改用固定发现顺序、将未提及发现记为"absent"的训练格式后，训练检查器增益上升而独立检查器下降，预设比较结果为6.2%（95%区间2.0%–10.5%），事后在留出患者上为7.7%。8个检查模型对"未提及发现的标签一致阴性陈述"的接受率为1.0%–97.0%。标签来源于报告本身，未经放射科医生裁定。
AI.motivation: 放射报告自动核查可能依赖AI生成的清单，而此类清单会遗漏某些发现，导致核查不完整。作者希望解决"清单遗漏发现"情形下的核查可靠性问题，并量化不同检查器的表现差异及对未提及发现的处理偏差。
AI.method: 用强化学习训练一个视觉-语言模型，仅凭胸片填充12项发现清单，不接触待测句子；另设独立检查模型根据该清单判断句子。评估在留出患者上进行，采用规则式检查与独立医学检查器（均未参与训练），以Youden指数衡量区分度增益，并预设误报标准。此外比较训练格式（固定发现顺序、未提及发现记为absent）对训练检查器与独立检查器的影响，并在8个检查模型上测量对未提及发现阴性陈述的接受率。
AI.result: 规则式检查与独立医学检查器的区分度增益分别为12.6%和11.8%，仅规则式检查满足预设误报标准。改用训练格式后，训练检查器增益升高而独立检查器增益降低；预设比较结果为6.2%（95%区间2.0%–10.5%），事后留出患者上为7.7%。8个检查模型对标签一致的未提及发现阴性陈述的接受率跨度极大，为1.0%至97.0%。
AI.conclusion: AI生成清单驱动的报告核查在区分度上有一定增益，但表现高度依赖检查器类型与训练格式；不同模型对未提及发现的阴性陈述接受率差异悬殊，提示核查结论可能被格式与清单遗漏所左右。由于标签为报告派生而非放射科医生裁定，结果需谨慎解读。

title: Image Synthesis as an Intermediate for Controllable Time Series Generation
summary: Semantic-driven time-series generation offers a promising way to improve downstream learning in few-shot forecasting, but directly generating numerical sequences from language often fails to preserve the intended temporal structure. We propose VisualBridge, which uses time-series plots as a visual intermediate to bridge high-level temporal semantics and numerical sequences. An MLLM first converts plotted series into structured semantic representations, enabling explicit control over temporal properties such as trend, seasonality, and volatility. We then learn a semantic editing policy with downstream forecasting rewards, allowing the generation process to favor temporal patterns that are beneficial for the target task. The resulting sequences are further modeled by a temporal VAE to produce consistent multivariate augmentations. Experiments on standard public forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that VisualBridge improves few-shot forecasting over conventional augmentation methods, with ablations validating the roles of visual semantic grounding, learned semantic control, and VAE-based generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 VisualBridge，用时间序列图作为视觉中间媒介，将高层时序语义桥接到数值序列，提升少样本预测。
AI.motivation: 语义驱动的时间序列生成有望改善少样本预测，但从语言直接生成数值序列往往难以保持目标时序结构（如趋势、季节性、波动性等）。
AI.method: 1）以时间序列图作为视觉中间表示，由 MLLM 将绘图序列转换为结构化语义表示，实现对时序属性的显式控制；2）基于下游预测奖励学习语义编辑策略，使生成偏向对目标任务有益的时序模式；3）用时序 VAE 对生成序列建模，产出一致的多变量增强样本。
AI.result: 在标准公开预测基准上，VisualBridge 相较传统数据增强方法提升了少样本预测性能；消融实验验证了视觉语义接地、学习式语义控制与 VAE 生成三部分的作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉语义中介与可学习的语义编辑策略，可以更可控地生成符合时序结构的增强数据，从而有效提升少样本预测。

title: Hamiltonian Metric Learning and Energy-Based Training: A Dissipative Geometric Framework for Optimization
summary: Optimization in machine learning is usually expressed through iterative rules that update model parameters using information from the loss landscape. In this work, we study an alternative viewpoint in which parameter optimization is treated as the evolution of a dissipative dynamical system. The model parameters are regarded as generalized coordinates, the loss acts as a potential energy, and a positive-definite metric defines the local kinetic geometry of parameter space. Starting from a variational formulation, we derive the corresponding Hamiltonian dynamics, the geometric force generated by a position-dependent metric, and a metric-compatible Rayleigh dissipation law. The resulting continuous system satisfies a monotonic energy-dissipation relation, while its discrete form allows the influence of curvature on the optimization trajectory to be studied directly. We illustrate the framework using a controlled CIFAR-10 image-reconstruction problem for which the optimum is known analytically. With the image Hessian used as the metric, the curvature dependence of the quadratic modal dynamics is removed. We then reparameterize the same image as a matrix product state, producing a genuinely position-dependent metric and a nonzero geometric force. Poincaré return maps provide a complementary phase-space view of the resulting contraction dynamics. These examples establish HAMLET as a geometric, energy-based framework for studying optimization as dissipative motion in parameter space. On a five-seed MNIST MLP benchmark, HAMLET attains the highest mean test accuracy (97.95\%) and the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (0.0696) among the three evaluated optimizers.

AI.tldr: 将参数优化视为耗散动力系统演化，提出几何、能量化的HAMLET框架，并用图像重建与MNIST基准验证。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习优化多以迭代更新规则描述，仅依赖损失景观信息，缺乏对参数空间几何与能量耗散的显式刻画，因此作者寻求以耗散动力系统视角重新表述优化过程。
AI.method: 把模型参数视为广义坐标、损失视为势能、正定度量定义局部动能几何；从变分形式出发推导哈密顿动力学、位置依赖度量产生的几何力以及度量相容的Rayleigh耗散律；构建连续系统（满足单调能量耗散关系）与离散形式，以直接研究曲率对优化轨迹的影响。实验上用解析最优解可控的CIFAR-10图像重建，将图像Hessian作为度量，并把图像重参数化为矩阵乘积态以产生真正位置依赖的度量与非零几何力，同时用Poincaré回归映射观察相空间收缩动力学。
AI.result: 以图像Hessian为度量时，二次模态动力学的曲率依赖被消除；矩阵乘积态重参数化则产生位置依赖度量与非零几何力；Poincaré回归映射提供了收缩动力学的相空间视角。在五种子MNIST MLP基准上，HAMLET取得三种优化器中最高的平均测试准确率（97.95%）与最低的平均测试负对数似然（0.0696）。
AI.conclusion: 这些例子确立了HAMLET作为几何、能量基框架，可将优化研究为参数空间中的耗散运动，并在基准任务上展现出竞争力。

title: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
summary: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.

AI.tldr: InterMimicGen是一个自我演化的运动模仿框架，通过机器人运动数据与跟踪策略的相互促进，将异构的人-物交互演示转化为可执行的人形机器人运动资源。
AI.motivation: 捕获的人-物交互数据虽为人形机器人移动操作提供了丰富监督，但数据稀疏、异构且无法被机器人直接执行，导致难以直接用于学习。
AI.method: 1）整合动捕人-物交互数据集，在保持全身协调与灵巧手-物关系的前提下重定向为人形机器人参考；2）训练基于物理的通用跟踪器，在仿真中于带灵巧手的人形上执行参考；3）构建数据飞轮：每轮对交互地点和身体执行方式做保持任务语义的小改动，微调跟踪器，仅保留仿真执行成功的变体作为下一轮种子。
AI.result: 实验表明：跨机器人构型的接触保持重定向、单一通用策略实现广泛跟踪、随增强轮次持续增长的可执行运动，以及到真实机器人的迁移均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: InterMimicGen为从异构人类演示到可持续扩展的运动资源库提供了统一路径，服务于人形机器人学习。

title: DynaMesh: Dynamic 3D Texture Generation
summary: We present DynaMesh, a dynamic texture generation method for 3D meshes. Given a textureless shape and a text prompt describing an effect, our method produces an appearance that evolves while the object's geometry remains unchanged. Previous works on dynamic 3D content generation have focused on motion, where an object's geometry and position change while keeping its appearance the same. Methods on texture generation sit on the other side of the problem, painting appearance onto a shape as a fixed surface property and not as an evolving process. Neither addresses a visual effect that propagates on a 3D object. A natural route consists of two generators: a video model that shows the effect from a single view, and an image-to-3D generator that lifts each frame to 3D. However, the latter has no notion of time, so running it per video frame produces a sequence that flickers, loses effect details, and yields a different mesh at every video frame. Our method addresses these failures by conditioning a video model on a render of the mesh and the prompt to obtain a reference video, then running a frozen image-to-3D generator on the video with two changes. The conditioning of each frame is blended over a temporal window, and low-rank adapters are fit per shape to restore the lost details. The mesh is encoded once for the whole sequence, so geometry is constant by construction, and the output is a single mesh with a texture per frame. Applied to various objects and effects, DynaMesh substantially improves over recent video-to-4D and texturing methods, and can generalize its temporal effect to different shapes never seen during training. Our project page is at https://threedle.github.io/dynamesh/.

AI.tldr: DynaMesh 是一种动态纹理生成方法：给定无纹理三维网格与描述效果的文本提示，生成几何不变、外观随时间演化（效果在表面传播）的纹理序列。
AI.motivation: 现有动态三维生成研究聚焦于运动（几何与位置变化、外观不变），而纹理生成则将外观视为固定表面属性而非演化过程，二者均无法处理"在三维物体上传播的视觉效果"。直接采用"视频模型 + 逐帧图像到三维生成器"的两阶段方案会因图像到三维模型缺乏时间概念，导致序列闪烁、细节丢失、每帧网格不一致。
AI.method: 以网格渲染图与文本提示为条件驱动视频模型，得到参考视频；再用冻结的图像到三维生成器处理该视频，并做两处改动：1）将每帧的条件在时间窗口内进行混合（temporal window blending）；2）针对单个形状拟合低秩适配器（LoRA）以恢复丢失细节。网格在整个序列中仅编码一次，因此几何在构造上保持恒定，最终输出为单一网格及逐帧纹理。
AI.result: 在多种物体与效果上，DynaMesh 显著优于近期视频到四维（video-to-4D）与纹理化方法，并能将时间效果泛化到训练中未见过的不同形状上。
AI.conclusion: DynaMesh 通过时间条件混合与逐形状低秩适配，解决了逐帧图像到三维生成导致的时序不一致与细节丢失问题，实现了几何恒定、外观演化的动态纹理生成，并具备跨形状泛化能力。

title: Safe Context Switching for Agents in the Wild: Mitigating Subspace Interference via Orthogonal Adaptation
summary: Most Large Language Models exhibit a fundamental tension between two sequential tasks, such as logical reasoning and safety alignment. The high-variance internal states required for sophisticated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) deduction can geometrically interfere with latent representations encoding safety constraints. We identify this phenomenon as Sequential Subspace Interference, showing that standard fine-tuning on logical tasks such as multi-step mathematics and code generation can result in a 23.3% interference penalty on alignment benchmarks, substantially weakening the model's safety priors. This Reasoning Drift is not adequately captured by current adaptation methods because gradients for logical tasks are rarely orthogonal to safety objectives. To address this issue, we propose AURA (Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation), a spectral regularization framework that enforces Spectral Independence between reasoning and safety. By explicitly estimating the null space of the alignment manifold and constraining reasoning updates to its orthogonal complement, AURA enables models to improve logical reasoning without compromising safety. Empirically, AURA recovers 23.0% of the lost performance while preserving greater than 0.98 cosine fidelity to the safe state, demonstrating that reasoning and alignment can be effectively decoupled through geometric regularization.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了大语言模型中推理与安全对齐之间的"序列子空间干扰"现象，并提出AURA频谱正则化框架，通过几何解耦实现推理能力提升与安全保持。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在逻辑推理与安全对齐两类序列任务之间存在根本性张力：复杂思维链（CoT）推理所需的高方差内部状态会几何性地干扰编码安全约束的潜在表示。现有适配方法难以应对这一"推理漂移"，因为逻辑任务的梯度很少与安全目标正交，标准微调会导致显著的干扰惩罚（23.3%），削弱模型安全先验。
AI.method: 提出AURA（Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation，自适应唯一残差分配）频谱正则化框架，强制推理与安全之间实现"频谱独立性"。具体通过显式估计对齐流形的零空间，并将推理更新约束到其正交补空间，从而在不损害安全的前提下提升逻辑推理。
AI.result: AURA恢复了23.0%的损失性能，同时保持与安全状态大于0.98的余弦保真度，证明推理与对齐可通过几何正则化实现有效解耦。
AI.conclusion: 推理能力与安全对齐能够通过几何正则化方法有效解耦。AURA验证了频谱独立性约束在缓解序列子空间干扰方面的有效性，为多任务序列学习中的能力保持问题提供了新的几何视角与解决方案。

title: Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas?
summary: We evaluate language models' capability to generate novel research ideas through the lens of compression. We aim to lower-bound the potentially tiny probability that a language model generates the essence of a future research idea without any hints. Rather than estimate this probability through expensive repeated sampling, our Priced Guidance framework measures the compression cost: how many additional bits of information are needed to guide the model to recover the target idea. We prove that if the model can recover the target idea with at most K bits of guidance in expectation, then it can generate the idea without any guidance with probability at least $2^{-K}$. In our framework, the language model, called the generator, can pose a sequence of multiple-choice questions and specify a probability distribution over possible answers. A guide, which is a language model with access to the target idea, selects answers. If a selected answer has prior probability p, the generator pays $-\log_2 p$ bits. The generator aims to produce an idea that matches the essence of the target idea with minimal cumulative cost. This cumulative cost equals, up to an additive constant, the number of bits of information sent by the guide. Using this methodology, we evaluate five generator LLMs (Opus 5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM 5.3) on the core ideas in 87 recent high-quality deep learning papers and we use LLM as judge to determine whether the generated idea matches the target in terms of the central research object and defining mechanism. Fable 5.1 achieves the lowest median compression cost at 69.9 bits, substantially lower than gzip's median of 5,712 bits for losslessly compressing the summary of the target idea. A uniform ensemble of Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Astra further reduces the median compression cost to 55.8 bits and improves the generation probability lower bound by 18,000 times.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Priced Guidance 框架，用"压缩代价"（引导生成目标想法所需的信息比特数）来度量语言模型生成新颖研究想法的能力，并证明无提示生成概率下界为 2^{-K}。在 87 篇深度学习论文的核心想法上，Fable 5.1 取得最低中位压缩代价 69.9 比特，三模型集成进一步降至 55.8 比特。
AI.motivation: 直接通过昂贵重复采样来估计语言模型"无提示生成未来研究想法本质"的极小概率不可行，需要一种更高效、有理论保证的度量方法，将其转化为可计算的信息论量。
AI.method: 提出 Priced Guidance 框架：生成器（语言模型）可连续提出多选题并给出各答案的概率分布；持有目标想法的引导模型选择答案；若所选答案先验概率为 p，生成器付出 −log₂ p 比特代价。当生成器以最小累计代价产出与目标想法本质相符的想法时，该累计代价（至多相差常数）等于引导所传递的信息比特数。理论上证明：若模型在期望至多 K 比特引导下能恢复目标想法，则无引导生成该想法的概率至少为 2^{-K}。评估中使用 LLM 作为评判，判断生成想法在核心研究对象与定义机制上是否匹配目标。
AI.result: 在 87 篇近期高质量深度学习论文的核心想法上评测五个生成器模型（Opus 5、Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol、GLM 5.3）。Fable 5.1 取得最低中位压缩代价 69.9 比特，远低于 gzip 无损压缩目标想法摘要的中位数 5,712 比特。Fable 5.1、Opus 5 与 Astra 的均匀集成进一步将中位压缩代价降至 55.8 比特，并将生成概率下界提升约 18,000 倍。
AI.conclusion: Priced Guidance 提供了一种有理论下界支撑、成本可控的评估范式，将"新颖想法生成"问题转化为信息压缩问题；实验表明当前顶尖语言模型能以数十比特量级的引导恢复研究想法本质，集成还可显著降低成本并大幅提高生成概率下界。

title: Deep Prior Learning for Embodied Perception
summary: Embodied systems need geometric perception that exploits available observations beyond images alone. Recent feed-forward 3D models incorporate geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth. However, handling noisy poses, preserving accurate priors, and recovering physical scale require more than simply accepting these inputs. We introduce \emph{Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer} (VPGGT), a VGGT-based framework that extends OmniVGGT for prior-aware embodied perception. We formulate sensor-motivated pose corruptions from ground-truth trajectories for training and introduce a parameter-free \emph{prior residual connection} (PRC) to mitigate \emph{prior dilution}, where predictions are less accurate than their supplied pose priors. Our noise formulation targets camera poses; supplied intrinsics and depth receive no additional corruption. We further introduce \emph{Metric Global Attention}, which conditions a global scale token on available pose and depth scales and predicts a shared metric scaling factor for the geometric outputs. Experiments across four datasets show that \emph{PRC} improves translation-direction accuracy and joint pose AUC over a matched training baseline when camera priors are provided for all views, under both exact and corrupted poses. These results support explicit prior access during refinement as a useful addition to feature-level conditioning.

AI.tldr: 提出VPGGT框架，通过先验残差连接(PRC)和度量全局注意力，在含噪位姿下实现先验感知的具身几何感知。
AI.motivation: 具身系统需要超越图像本身的几何感知，现有前馈3D模型虽引入相机位姿、内参和深度等几何先验，但在处理含噪位姿、保留精确先验以及恢复物理尺度方面仍存在不足；尤其是"先验稀释"问题——预测精度甚至低于其输入的先验。
AI.method: 基于VGGT扩展OmniVGGT，构建先验感知框架。1) 从真值轨迹中模拟传感器驱动的位姿扰动用于训练（内参和深度不做额外加噪）；2) 引入无参数的先验残差连接(PRC)缓解先验稀释；3) 提出度量全局注意力(Metric Global Attention)，以可用位姿与深度尺度为条件调节全局尺度token，预测共享的度量缩放因子。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，当为所有视图提供相机先验时（精确位姿与含噪位姿两种设置），PRC在平移方向精度和联合位姿AUC上均优于匹配的训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式的先验访问作为特征级条件化的补充，在几何精化过程中具有实用价值。

title: Look Before You Leap: Thermodynamic Arbitration of Parametric and Non-Parametric Knowledge in LLM Agents via Self-Regulating Memory Architectures
summary: The architecture of modern LLMs consists of a profound cognitive polarization. LLMs possess implicit intuition encoded in their parameters, yet rely on a disconnected, explicit mechanism to access the outside world. Agentic frameworks have not bridged this gap; instead, models are often compelled into pathological "induced amnesia." Under the prevailing "Retrieve-Always" paradigm, agents must distrust their internal knowledge, making every user interaction a "tabula rasa" event that must be checked externally. This creates reflexive dependence that can be thermodynamically wasteful, cognitively fragile, and susceptible to irrelevant context. We propose a return to first principles, operationalizing the biological maxim "Look Before You Leap." We introduce MARTA (Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture), a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges parametric and non-parametric knowledge. Rather than treating retrieval as mandatory, MARTA models it as a cost, taking the leap only when perceived internal inadequacy warrants external information. By allowing the agent to gauge the entropy of its own thoughts before acting, MARTA enables deliberative retrieval and uncertainty-aware decision making. Our approach suggests that giving agents the capacity for introspection can restore a more efficient balance between internal knowledge and external information.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前大语言模型智能体普遍采用"总是检索"范式，导致其不信任内部参数化知识、产生"诱导性失忆"，造成热力学浪费、认知脆弱与对无关上下文的敏感。为此提出神经符号框架MARTA，将检索视为一种成本，仅在内部知识不足时才触发外部检索，从而实现深思熟虑的检索与不确定性感知决策。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM存在"认知极化"：参数中隐含直觉性知识，却依赖一套与参数割裂的显式机制访问外部世界。现有智能体框架未能弥合这一鸿沟，反而在"总是检索"范式下强迫模型放弃内部知识，使每次交互都成为"白板"事件，形成反射性依赖，带来热力学浪费、认知脆弱和易受无关上下文干扰等问题。作者希望回归第一性原理，践行"三思而后行"的理念。
AI.method: 提出MARTA（Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture），一个神经符号框架，用于桥接参数化知识与非参数化知识。其核心是不把检索当作强制步骤，而是建模为一种成本；只有当智能体感知到自身内部知识不足时，才"迈出那一步"进行外部检索。通过让智能体在行动前评估自身思维的熵，MARTA实现深思熟虑的检索与不确定性感知的决策。
AI.result: 这是一篇立场/方法提出型论文，摘要未报告具体实验数据或定量结果。其论断性结论是：赋予智能体内省能力，可以在内部知识与外部信息之间恢复更高效的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张放弃"总是检索"的默认范式，转而采用基于元认知的按需检索。通过让智能体对自身知识状况进行内省并据此决定是否检索，MARTA在保持决策质量的同时提升效率，为弥合参数化与非参数化知识的鸿沟提供了一条神经符号路径。

title: What Will Post-Training Fix? Per-Problem Gains Are Shared Across Independent RL Runs, and Existing Checkpoints Predict Them Better Than A Priori Signals
summary: Data selection, curricula and the evaluation of post-training recipes all assume that we can tell, before training, which problems a model will improve on. We test this assumption directly. For two base models, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, we evaluate eighteen post-training runs on up to 1532 competition math problems with many samples per problem, and compare signals available before training against a noise ceiling derived from the agreement between disjoint subsets of runs. Three findings hold on both base models. What post-training fixes is shared: independent runs agree on which rarely solved problems improve, with a noise ceiling of about 0.9, yet the two base models agree with each other only at rho=0.25 - the shared component belongs to the base model, not to the problem. A priori signals capture a minority of it: base pass rate, the likelihood of a correct solution, a larger model's pass rate and their combinations explain only 0.30 and 0.24 of the explainable variance in gains. Existing checkpoints are the better predictor: the per-problem gains of a single checkpoint from another family predict a new run better than every a priori signal, alone or combined (0.52 vs. 0.33 and 0.34 vs. 0.17 against the combined signals). The conclusions hold on problems from 2025-2026 competitions and when the baselines on the two sides of every comparison are estimated independently. We propose the noise ceiling as a standard companion to per-problem signals.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了"训练前可预测模型会在哪些问题上提升"这一假设，发现增益主要由基座模型决定而非问题本身，先验信号仅能解释少数可解释方差，而现有checkpoint的逐题增益是更好的预测器。
AI.motivation: 数据选择、课程学习和后训练配方评估通常假设：在训练前就能判断模型会在哪些问题上取得提升。作者直接检验这一假设，并希望为逐题信号提供一个衡量其预测上限的标准参照。
AI.method: 在两个基座模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 与 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B）上，对至多1532道竞赛数学题进行18次后训练运行，每题多次采样；将训练前可获得的信号与由不同运行子集间一致性导出的"噪声天花板"进行比较。为避免共享基线带来的偏差，所有比较两侧的基线均独立估计。
AI.result: 后训练所修复的是共享成分：独立运行在"哪些罕见被解出的问题会提升"上高度一致（噪声天花板约0.9），但两个基座模型之间一致性仅为rho=0.25，说明共享成分属于基座模型而非问题本身。先验信号只捕捉到其中少数：基座通过率、正确解的可能性、更大模型的通过率及其组合，分别仅解释增益可解释方差的0.30和0.24。现有checkpoint预测更优：来自另一家族的单个checkpoint的逐题增益，其预测新运行的效果优于所有先验信号（无论单独或组合），达0.52 vs. 0.33、0.34 vs. 0.17。结论在2025–2026竞赛题上依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 训练前信号对逐题增益的预测能力有限，而基座模型属性比问题属性更能决定提升模式；现有checkpoint是最佳预测器。作者建议将噪声天花板作为逐题信号的标配伴随指标。

title: Monocular markerless biomechanics for clinically interpretable gait assessment in spinal cord injury
summary: Three-dimensional gait analysis guides rehabilitation after spinal cord injury but depends on marker-based motion capture and force plates, which few clinics have. Monocular markerless pipelines have been established in fewer healthy adult cohorts but not in neurological cohorts. We present the SCAI SCI Gait dataset, comprising 239 adult individuals with spinal cord injury with synchronized video, motion capture, and force-plate measurements, we fitted a parametric body mesh to a single sagittal-view video, driving an anthropometrically scaled OpenSim model via virtual markers. Markerless lower-body kinematics showed state-of-the-art agreement with motion-capture measurements (r = 0.68-0.90, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 4.18-6.49 degrees), and accurate kinematics-based predicted ground-reaction forces closely matched those measured by force plates (r = 0.85-0.87, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 2.13-2.19 Newton per kg). Furthermore, conditional-dependence graph analysis with Markov blankets revealed that waveform components were conditionally associated with functional independence, and speed-stratified clustering revealed distinct mechanical strategies among individuals walking at similar speeds. These findings establish the use of monocular video as a scalable approach for clinically meaningful biomechanical assessment and data-driven phenotyping in patients with spinal cord injury. Github: https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/SCAI-SCI-Gait

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCAI SCI Gait数据集（239名脊髓损伤成人，同步视频、动作捕捉与测力台），仅用单目矢状面视频拟合参数化人体网格并以虚拟标记驱动OpenSim模型，实现无标记下肢运动学与地面反作用力预测，结果与临床金标准高度一致，并揭示运动波形组件与功能独立性间的条件关联及速度分层下的机械策略差异，为脊髓损伤临床生物力学评估与表型分型提供可扩展方案。
AI.motivation: 三维步态分析对脊髓损伤康复有指导价值，但依赖基于标记点的动作捕捉系统和测力台，绝大多数临床机构不具备该条件。无标记单目视频方法此前仅在较少的健康成人队列中得到验证，尚未在神经系统疾病队列中建立。
AI.method: 构建SCAI SCI Gait数据集，包含239名脊髓损伤成人的同步视频、动作捕捉与测力台测量；对单个矢状视角视频拟合参数化人体网格，通过虚拟标记驱动经人体测量学缩放的OpenSim模型，从而估计下肢运动学并预测地面反作用力；进一步采用条件依赖图分析与马尔可夫毯、以及按速度分层的聚类分析。
AI.result: 无标记下肢运动学与动作捕捉测量达到当前最优一致性（r = 0.68–0.90，p < 0.001，RMSE = 4.18–6.49 度）；基于运动学预测的地面反作用力与测力台实测吻合良好（r = 0.85–0.87，p < 0.001，RMSE = 2.13–2.19 N/kg）。条件依赖图与马尔可夫毯分析显示波形组件与功能独立性存在条件关联；速度分层聚类揭示相同步速个体间存在不同的机械策略。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明单目视频可作为可扩展途径，用于脊髓损伤患者具有临床意义的生物力学评估与数据驱动表型分析。

title: GFGE: Unifying Explainable AI Methods through an Interpretation Framework
summary: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) encompasses methods that draw on different sources of information and address different explanatory needs. A common framework is needed to describe how this information becomes evidence and is communicated as an explanation for a particular recipient. We propose the General Framework for Generating Explanations (GFGE), grounded in interpretative frameworks and the complementary activities of \emph{sense-reading} and \emph{sense-giving}. Its conceptual foundation is the Interpret/Explain Schema (IES), which connects an analyst's interpretation of system evidence, the communication of a selected account, and the recipient's interpretation of that account. GFGE operationalises this schema through five roles: data interpretation, model interpretation, output interpretation, optional post-hoc analysis, and aggregation. A role-typed operation graph records method-specific dependencies, while evidence records retain the sources, assumptions, and limitations of explanatory claims. The explanatory question, audience, and context guide the procedure. We instantiate GFGE for attribution, surrogate, counterfactual, concept and prototype, intrinsic rule, argumentation, and language-model methods. These instantiations show how intrinsic, post-hoc, and hybrid workflows can be represented through the same roles while preserving their distinct evidential requirements. GFGE provides a common basis for analysing explanation workflows, tracing communicated claims to their evidence, and identifying unresolved explanatory dependencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成解释的通用框架GFGE，以"解释图式"（IES）为概念基础，通过五个角色和角色化操作图统一描述不同类型的XAI方法，从而实现解释工作流的可追溯性与可比性。
AI.motivation: XAI方法来源多样、面向不同解释需求，缺乏统一框架来描述信息如何转化为证据并被传达为面向特定接收者的解释。
AI.method: 提出GFGE框架，基于解释性框架及"意义读取"与"意义赋予"两类互补活动；以IES连接分析者对系统证据的解读、选定说明的传达及接收者的解读；通过五个角色（数据解释、模型解释、输出解释、可选的事后分析、聚合）实现，并利用角色化操作图记录方法依赖，证据记录保留来源、假设与局限；解释问题、受众与情境指导流程。
AI.result: GFGE被实例化于归因、代理模型、反事实、概念与原型、内在规则、论证及语言模型等方法，表明内在、事后与混合工作流可用同一组角色表示，同时保留各自不同的证据要求。
AI.conclusion: GFGE为分析解释工作流、将传达的主张追溯至其证据、识别未解决的解释依赖提供了共同基础。

title: How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TEMPO，一种时间距离规划目标，通过在学习到的潜在地图中度量状态间的环境步数，修正冻结世界模型规划器的度量缺陷，无需奖励或策略即可显著提升多步规划性能。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通过将候选动作序列的想象终态与目标做潜在距离排序来规划，但该距离衡量"终态与目标的相似度"而非"距离目标还有多远"，导致目标需多步规划才能到达时排序失效。
AI.method: TEMPO不修改世界模型，仅用训练世界模型时已有的示范数据，学习冻结潜在空间中的一张小型映射图，使同一回合中两状态间的距离反映其环境步数差，并将该时间距离融入规划器代价。方法无需奖励、策略或成功标签，属于代价而非模型，适用于每状态单潜在向量、以潜在距离规划的冻结世界模型。
AI.result: 在11个仿真环境（迷宫导航、桌面推动、机械臂控制、三维操作等）上用LeWM与PLDM规划器评估：一个最多增加0.3%算术开销的小型MLP，使两规划器在所有目标距离上均有提升，包括其评估中的单步设定；TwoRoom中距目标三步任务LeWM由36%提升至99%；在广泛2D/3D导航、到达与操作任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将规划代价从状态外观相似度改为时间距离，可在不训练或改动世界模型的前提下有效解决多步目标规划中的排序失真问题，方法轻量、通用且与现有潜在距离规划器兼容。

title: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
summary: Stochastic order-independent transparency enables efficient and elegant rendering of primitive-based radiance fields like 3D Gaussian Splatting models, but remains impractical due to the inherent visible noise in the output. We propose a principled approach to minimize high-frequency noise, addressing its sources at the representation and image synthesis level. During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从表示与图像合成两个层面抑制随机透明渲染噪声的原则性方法，实现高效的3DGS随机透明渲染。
AI.motivation: 随机顺序无关透明能高效优雅地渲染3D高斯泼溅等基元辐射场，但输出固有的可见噪声使其难以实用。作者希望从噪声来源（表示与图像合成）入手，系统性地消除高频噪声。
AI.method: 在随机渲染阶段，采用基于历史的空域重采样加速图像收敛，并用时域重要性重采样保证相机移动下的时间一致性；在训练阶段，引入颜色正则项隐式降低3DGS模型沿视射线的方差。整体在基于Vulkan的渲染器上实现与优化。
AI.result: 在低采样与高采样下均有效抑制噪声；每像素1样本时相比先前随机方法PSNR提升约13 dB；并快速收敛到排序3DGS，平均L1误差低于10^-4。
AI.conclusion: 通过在表示层与合成层协同降噪，随机顺序无关透明渲染的噪声问题被显著缓解，兼顾效率与画质，使该方案具备实用潜力。

title: Learning from imperfect teachers for low-resource acoustic generalization
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) improves low-resource acoustic learning by enriching one-hot supervision with the softened predictive distribution of a fixed teacher network. However, a teacher trained with limited or imbalanced annotations may produce a biased distribution whose components are not uniformly reliable. Although this distribution can still encode useful knowledge, direct full-distribution matching may also transfer teacher-induced biases, thereby distorting the student's decision boundary and degrading its generalization performance. To address this limitation, we propose Boundary-Anchored Mass-Partitioned Distillation (BA-MPD), a logit-based distillation objective composed of Boundary-Anchored Correction (BAC) and Mass-Partitioned Distillation (MPD). BAC addresses missing ground-truth labels in the set of the teacher's top predictions by swapping the true label for the lowest-ranked entry of the set, thus keeping the mass and uncertainty of the set unchanged. MPD then distills this corrected distribution through separate losses that enforce relational consistency within the set, balance the mass between high- and low-confidence groups, and weight lower-confidence dependencies. Ultimately, BAC and MPD together suppress harmful ranking errors and noisy low-confidence details, while retaining all useful teacher information. Experiments on two acoustic benchmarks under multiple label budgets show that BA-MPD consistently improves over supervised-learning baselines and vanilla KD while remaining competitive with strong logit-based KD baselines. Cross-budget results further show that BA-MPD remains effective when the teacher and student models use mismatched label budgets, demonstrating its ability to exploit imperfect teachers across supervision gaps. Implementation available at https://github.com/ShuanglinLi/BA-MPD.

AI.tldr: 提出 BA-MPD 知识蒸馏目标，通过边界锚定纠错与质量划分蒸馏抑制教师偏见，在低资源声学任务上稳定优于监督基线与原始 KD。
AI.motivation: 低资源场景下教师网络由有限或不平衡标注训练，其软化分布各分量可靠性不均，直接全分布匹配会把教师偏见迁移给学生，扭曲决策边界并损害泛化。
AI.method: BA-MPD 为基于 logit 的蒸馏目标，含两部分：(1) Boundary-Anchored Correction (BAC)：当教师 top 预测集合中缺失真实标签时，用真实标签替换该集合中排名最低的条目，保持集合总质量与不确定性不变；(2) Mass-Partitioned Distillation (MPD)：分项损失分别约束集合内关系一致性、平衡高/低置信度组之间的质量、并对低置信度依赖加权。
AI.result: 在两个声学基准、多个标签预算下，BA-MPD 持续优于监督学习基线与原始 KD，并与强 logit-based KD 基线相当；跨预算实验中教师与学生标签预算不匹配时仍有效。
AI.conclusion: BAC 与 MPD 协同可抑制有害的排序错误与低置信噪声细节，同时保留教师有用信息，证明其在监督差距下利用不完美教师的能力。

title: Pessimistic Minimax Learning for Public-Private Information Games under Unilateral Coverage
summary: We study offline learning in two-player zero-sum contextual games with public and private information, motivated by strategic settings such as auctions and negotiations with private valuations. We introduce unilateral prescriptive concentrability and show that asymmetric information can change offline coverage through its effect on equilibrium behavior. For finite state-action spaces, we develop a pessimistic algorithm with an $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ exploitability rate, matching the standard sample-size dependence for fully observed minimax games. We further develop a pessimistic policy mirror descent framework, PPA-PMD, for general function approximation and obtain a unified $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$ exploitability rate with no-regret actor updates. Together, these results provide the first theoretical framework for offline equilibrium learning under public-private information constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究具有公开与私人信息的两玩家零和情境博弈中的离线学习问题，提出单边规定可集中性概念，并给出悲观算法与PPA-PMD框架，分别达到$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$和$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$的可利用度速率。
AI.motivation: 论文动机来自拍卖、议价等具有私人估值的策略场景，关注在公开-私人信息约束下离线均衡学习的理论空白。作者指出非对称信息会通过影响均衡行为而改变离线覆盖条件，因此需要新的可集中性刻画与算法框架。
AI.method: 方法上，作者引入单边规定可集中性（unilateral prescriptive concentrability）来刻画公开-私人信息下的离线覆盖。针对有限状态-动作空间，设计悲观算法；进一步提出悲观策略镜像下降框架PPA-PMD，适用于一般函数逼近，并结合无遗憾的参与者更新。
AI.result: 在有限状态-动作空间中，所提悲观算法取得$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$的可利用度速率，与完全观测极小极大博弈的标准样本量依赖相匹配；在一般函数逼近下，PPA-PMD获得统一的$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$可利用度速率。
AI.conclusion: 论文为公开-私人信息约束下的离线均衡学习提供了首个理论框架，表明非对称信息可通过均衡行为影响离线覆盖，并给出相应的悲观学习算法与速率保证。

title: Generating the Wild: Individual-Consistent Image-to-Video Generation for Wildlife
summary: Individual-level wildlife identification often suffers from data scarcity, as varying observations of the same animal under diverse poses, viewpoints, and motions are rarely available. Image-to-video (I2V) generation offers a promising way to mitigate this limitation by synthesizing additional observations from a single reference image. However, existing I2V models mainly emphasize global layout, semantics, and motion, and therefore often fail to preserve fine-grained local appearance cues that distinguish one wildlife individual from another, such as fur texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour transitions. We observe that these identity-critical cues are closely related to high-frequency information. To address this challenge, we propose WildIcon, a high-frequency-guided I2V framework for wildlife individual consistency. Specifically, WildIcon introduces a frequency-aware identity encoding branch that extracts individual-specific high-frequency cues from the reference image. Combined with isolated foreground information, the resulting identity tokens are then injected into cross-attention blocks as identity conditioning. Building on a frozen backbone with lightweight identity adaptation, WildIcon preserves fine-grained identity cues visible in the reference image while retaining the motion controllability and semantic fidelity of the base I2V model. In addition, to support the training and evaluation of wildlife individual-consistent I2V, we construct WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset with high-quality, temporally coherent clips and individual-level identity labels. Experiments on I2V generation and downstream animal re-identification (ReID) show that WildIcon achieves stronger individual consistency than existing baselines, and that its filtered outputs can serve as useful candidate training augmentations for downstream ReID.

AI.tldr: 提出WildIcon，一种高频引导的图像到视频生成框架，用于野生动物个体一致性识别；并构建WildlifeVid数据集，实验证明其在个体一致性和下游ReID任务上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 野生动物个体识别面临数据稀缺问题：同一动物在不同姿态、视角和运动下的观测难以获取。现有I2V生成模型主要关注全局布局、语义和运动，难以保留区分个体的细粒度局部外观线索（如皮毛纹理、条纹边界、斑点分布、轮廓过渡）。作者观察到这些身份关键线索与高频信息密切相关。
AI.method: WildIcon包含：1）频率感知身份编码分支，从参考图像提取个体特异的高频线索；2）结合隔离的前景信息生成身份token，注入交叉注意力模块作为身份条件；3）基于冻结主干网络加轻量身份适配，在保留细粒度身份线索的同时维持基础I2V模型的运动可控性与语义保真度。此外构建WildlifeVid数据集，含高质量时序连贯片段和个体级身份标签，支持训练与评估。
AI.result: 在I2V生成和下游动物重识别（ReID）实验中，WildIcon比现有基线实现更强的个体一致性；其过滤后的输出可作为下游ReID的有效候选训练增强数据。
AI.conclusion: 高频引导的身份编码与轻量适配策略能有效提升I2V生成的野生动物个体一致性，并为下游ReID提供有价值的数据增强，缓解野生动物个体级数据稀缺问题。

title: When Agent Context Goes Stale: Incoherence in Volatile Agent Context
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted to the AgenticOS Workshop at SOSP 2026
summary: Modern agents increasingly ground their reasoning in observations returned by tools, such as file contents read from a workspace. However, the data sources underlying these observations may later be modified by users, other agents, or external tools, while the model retains only the stale content in its context window. Existing agent runtimes provide little support for notifying the model that a previously observed fact has become stale, causing agents to reuse outdated observations and make incorrect claims about the current workspace state. We propose Concord, a context coherence framework that maintains the consistency between tool observation in agent context and the mutable sources from which they were derived.
