Concord links each observation to its source, detects source changes, and uses configurable handling policies to update, annotate, or suppress stale context before reuse. Concord is applicable across different agent runtimes and external resources, and can be easily extended to new runtime-resource settings. We implement Concord as a general framework, and instantiate a concrete use case to assess its effectiveness. We construct ConcordBench, where previously observed file contents become stale after subsequent edits. Across three evaluated frontier models, Concord produces answers consistent with the restored workspace state in all evaluated cases under these constructed conditions, matching the oracle on recover count for this benchmark, while using 46.4% fewer tokens than the strongest non-oracle baseline.

AI.tldr: Concord：一种上下文一致性框架，将工具观察结果与其可变来源绑定，检测来源变更并按策略更新/标注/抑制陈旧上下文，在ConcordBench上使三个前沿模型的回答全部与恢复后的工作区状态一致。
AI.motivation: 智能体日益依赖工具返回的观察（如工作区文件内容）进行推理，但这些数据来源可能在之后被用户、其他智能体或外部工具修改，而模型上下文中仅保留陈旧内容。现有智能体运行时缺乏"已观察事实已过期"的提示机制，导致智能体复用过期观察、对当前工作区状态作出错误断言。
AI.method: 提出Concord上下文一致性框架：为每个观察结果建立到其来源的链接，检测来源变更，并在复用前通过可配置的处理策略对陈旧上下文进行更新、标注或抑制。框架适用于不同智能体运行时与外部资源，且易于扩展到新的"运行时-资源"组合。作者将其实现为通用框架并实例化一个具体用例，同时构建ConcordBench基准，其中先前观察到的文件内容在后续编辑后变为陈旧。
AI.result: 在三个被评估的前沿模型上，Concord在所构造条件下对所有被评估案例均给出与恢复后工作区状态一致的答案，在该基准的recover count上匹配oracle，且比最强的非oracle基线少用46.4%的token。
AI.conclusion: Concord通过维护工具观察与可变来源之间的一致性，有效缓解了智能体复用陈旧观察的问题，在无需oracle的条件下达到与oracle相当的恢复能力，并显著降低token开销，具备跨运行时与资源的通用性和可扩展性。

title: Beyond Overparameterization: Provable Learning of Input-Convex Multi-Layer Polynomial Networks with Active Queries
summary: The theoretical understanding of multi-layer neural networks is largely confined to overparameterized settings, which obscure parameter identifiability and incur high sample complexity. Neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides a general theory for wide networks, but does not offer efficient sample-complexity guarantees. Recent feature-learning results go beyond kernel methods for single-neuron, multi-index, and hierarchical targets. However, the analysis is often restricted to shallow or specific architectures and to the overparameterized regime. We break this paradigm to achieve parameter-level recovery of deep target networks, albeit by using active data queries. Specifically, we study $L$-layer polynomial networks with even degree-$k$ monomial activations and nonnegative higher-layer weights. This structure makes the target network input-convex, while the optimization landscape remains highly nonconvex with respect to the parameters. Leveraging input convexity and active queries, we propose \textbf{ASPIRE} (\textbf{A}ctive \textbf{S}am\textbf{P}ling for \textbf{I}terative \textbf{R}ecovery via \textbf{E}igendirections), a layerwise sampling-based diagonalization algorithm that recovers all network parameters to $δ$-accuracy with sample complexity $ \widetilde O_{k,L}\left(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e}\right) $ in polynomial time. To our knowledge, this is the \emph{first} parameter-recovery guarantee for deep target networks whose exponent grows only polynomially with depth, as well as the \emph{first} justification for the effectiveness of using high-quality data in neural network training, with a remarkably \emph{exponential} separation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPIRE算法，通过主动查询和输入凸性，实现深度多项式网络的参数级恢复，其样本复杂度随深度仅呈多项式指数增长，首次为高质量数据在神经网络训练中的有效性提供了指数级分离的理论依据。
AI.motivation: 现有深度网络理论分析多局限于过参数化情形，导致参数不可识别且样本复杂度过高。NTK理论虽适用于宽网络，却无法给出高效的样本复杂度保证。近年来的特征学习研究虽超越核方法，但多局限于浅层或特定架构及过参数化区域。本文旨在打破这一范式，实现深度目标网络的参数级恢复。
AI.method: 研究对象为L层多项式网络，激活函数为偶次k阶单项式，且高层权重非负，使目标网络具备输入凸性，而参数优化景观仍高度非凸。作者利用输入凸性与主动查询，提出ASPIRE（基于特征方向的迭代恢复主动采样）算法——一种逐层、基于采样的对角化算法，逐层恢复网络全部参数。
AI.result: ASPIRE可在多项式时间内以δ精度恢复所有网络参数，样本复杂度为 \widetilde O_{k,L}(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e})，即指数随深度仅呈多项式增长。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次给出深度目标网络的参数恢复保证，其指数仅随深度多项式增长；同时首次在理论上证明了使用高质量数据训练神经网络的有效性，并展现出显著的指数级分离优势。

title: EchoDino: A pediatric foundation model for transferable echocardiographic analysis across the lifespan
summary: Echocardiography is the most widely used cardiac imaging modality, yet interpretation demands integrating visual evidence across global anatomy, localized structures and dynamic cardiac motion. Machine-learning models have automated individual tasks, but they are typically built for a single purpose and depend on expensively labeled datasets - a barrier particularly acute in pediatric care, where data are scarce and anatomy changes with age. Here we present EchoDino, a self-supervised foundation model for echocardiography, created by adapting the DINOv3 framework to 3.7 million frames from 1.7 million unlabeled pediatric echocardiography videos. With its encoder frozen, EchoDino produces representations that capture global context, local anatomy, and dense spatial detail. We introduce Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling (MEMS) to select the most informative frames for video-level analysis. Across nine pediatric and adult datasets, EchoDino outperformed strong baseline models, raising view-classification accuracy from 0.609 to 0.889 and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for structural-heart-disease detection from 0.811 to 0.872, while also cutting age-estimation error from 3.857 to 1.389 years, achieving the best segmentation accuracy and lowering ejection-fraction errors. By generalizing from label-free pediatric data to adult echocardiography, EchoDino offers a versatile foundation for cardiac image analysis across the lifespan.

AI.tldr: EchoDino是一个基于DINOv3框架、在170万例无标注儿童超声心动图视频的370万帧上自监督预训练的心脏超声基础模型，配合MEMS帧采样策略，在多种儿童与成人数据集上超越强基线，实现跨年龄段泛化。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图是应用最广的心脏影像模态，但其判读需整合全局解剖、局部结构与动态心脏运动等多层次视觉证据。现有机器学习模型多为单一任务定制，且依赖昂贵的标注数据；在儿科场景下，数据稀缺、解剖结构随年龄变化，这一瓶颈尤为突出。因此需要一个不依赖标注、可跨任务与跨年龄段泛化的基础模型。
AI.method: 将DINOv3自监督框架适配至超声心动图领域，构建EchoDino基础模型：预训练语料为170万例无标注儿童超声心动图视频中的370万帧。冻结编码器后，所得表征同时涵盖全局场景上下文、局部解剖结构与稠密空间细节。并设计Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling（MEMS），为视频级分析筛选信息量最高的帧。
AI.result: 在九个儿童与成人数据集上，EchoDino均优于强基线模型：视图分类准确率由0.609提升至0.889；结构性心脏病检测的ROC曲线下面积由0.811提升至0.872；年龄估计误差由3.857年降至1.389年；同时取得最优分割精度并降低射血分数误差。
AI.conclusion: EchoDino证明了从无标注儿童数据预训练的表征可泛化至成人超声心动图，为覆盖全生命周期的通用心脏图像分析提供了基础模型范式。

title: Fusion is the New Mutation: Bandit-Guided Evolution on Workflow Graphs
summary: Automated agentic workflow optimization relies on costly evaluations, making it essential to allocate a limited evaluation budget effectively. Multi-parent fusion can reuse designs from previously discovered workflows, but identifying promising parent combinations requires learning from limited fusion feedback. We introduce DAGO (Directed Acyclic Graph Optimization), a contextual-bandit-guided framework that learns which parent workflows to fuse under a limited evaluation budget. DAGO formulates each candidate parent combination as an arm, represented by pretrained embeddings of its constituent workflows' code and prompts. A diagonal LinUCB policy learns a shared reward model across arms and balances exploitation of arms with high predicted offspring quality against uncertainty-driven exploration. After an arm is selected, an LLM generates a child workflow through summary-guided fusion, and the child's validation score serves as the reward for updating the bandit. A shared directed acyclic graph maintains discovered workflows and their multi-parent lineage, providing an expanding pool of parents for subsequent arm proposals. Across six benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning, code generation, and question answering, DAGO achieves the highest macro-average score among the evaluated baselines. Under matched validation-evaluation budgets, it improves over AFlow from 80.3 to 81.7 while reducing aggregate search expenditure by 11.2%. Ablation studies show that LinUCB-guided arm selection outperforms both random selection and its exploration-free variant, supporting the value of feedback-driven selection and exploration-exploitation balance.

AI.tldr: DAGO：一种上下文bandit引导的自动智能体工作流优化框架，通过LinUCB学习父工作流组合选择策略，在有限评估预算下实现多父融合优化。
AI.motivation: 自动智能体工作流优化依赖高昂的评估成本，需有效分配有限评估预算。多父融合可复用已发现的工作流设计，但识别有潜力的父代组合需要从有限的融合反馈中学习，这一选择问题尚未被有效解决。
AI.method: 将每个候选父代组合建模为一个臂，用其组成工作流代码与提示词的预训练嵌入表示；采用对角LinUCB策略学习跨臂共享的奖励模型，在开发高预测子代质量与不确定性驱动探索之间平衡；选定臂后由LLM通过摘要引导融合生成子工作流，并以子代验证分数作为奖励更新bandit；共享有向无环图维护已发现工作流及其多父谱系，为后续臂提议提供不断扩展的父代池。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和问答三类共六个基准上，DAGO取得所评估基线中最高的宏平均分数；在匹配验证-评估预算下，相较AFlow从80.3提升至81.7，同时减少11.2%的总搜索开销；消融实验表明LinUCB引导的臂选择优于随机选择及无探索变体。
AI.conclusion: 反馈驱动的臂选择与探索-开发平衡对多父融合工作流优化具有重要价值，DAGO在有限评估预算下实现了更优性能与更低搜索成本。

title: Physics-Augmented Graph Transformers for Patch-Antenna Forward and Inverse Design
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026), Atlanta, USA. Code, dataset and Colab demo: https://github.com/AviEpstein/GNN-for-Antenna-design
summary: Full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulation enables accurate patch-antenna analysis but is computationally expensive for large-scale forward prediction and inverse design. We present a mesh-native, physics-augmented graph-learning framework that treats radiation-pattern prediction as signal reconstruction on an irregular surface mesh. For the forward problem, a GPS graph transformer is trained with Physics-Augmented Intermediate Supervision (PAIS), an auxiliary node-level objective that predicts complex surface currents, the physical intermediate linking geometry to radiation. PAIS improves multiple GNN backbones at no inference-time cost, while shuffled-current and non-physical controls show the gain comes from physical correspondence. Direction-conditioned decoding and a differentiable radiation-integral consistency loss further exploit this structure. On an 80,000-sample CST benchmark, GPS+PAIS reaches MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67, generalizes to a PCA split, and transfers zero-shot to canonical patches. For inverse design, surrogate-filtered diffusion beats nearest-neighbor retrieval by 32% relative MSE.

AI.tldr: 提出网格原生、物理增强的图学习框架，将辐射方向图预测建模为非规则表面网格上的信号重建；前向用GPS图Transformer结合物理增强中间监督（PAIS），并以方向条件解码与可微辐射积分一致性损失强化物理结构；反设计用代理模型过滤的扩散模型，性能优于最近邻检索。
AI.motivation: 全波电磁仿真相对于大规模前向预测与反向设计计算代价过高，需要兼顾精度与效率的替代方法。
AI.method: 1）网格原生图学习框架，将辐射方向图预测视为非规则表面网格上的信号重建；2）前向采用GPS图Transformer，训练时引入物理增强中间监督（PAIS），以节点级辅助目标预测复表面电流这一连接几何与辐射的物理中间量；3）引入方向条件解码与可微辐射积分一致性损失；4）反设计采用代理模型过滤的扩散模型。
AI.result: PAIS在无额外推理开销下提升多种GNN骨干；打乱电流与非物理对照实验表明增益来自物理对应关系。在80,000样本CST基准上，GPS+PAIS取得MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67，可泛化到PCA划分，并零样本迁移到规范贴片。反设计方面，代理过滤扩散较最近邻检索相对MSE降低32%。
AI.conclusion: 物理中间监督与辐射积分一致性约束能有效提升图神经网络电磁代理建模的精度与泛化能力，且扩散式反设计优于检索式方法。

title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
comment: Technical report on the open-source T2AV model. GitHub: https://github.com/kandinskylab/kandinsky-6
summary: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920$\times$1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Kandinsky 6.0 Video系列基础扩散模型（Lite 3B与Pro 29B），通过双流CrossDiT架构实现文本到音视频的同步生成，支持T2AV/I2AV模式，输出5秒44kHz同步音频视频并可超分至Full-HD 1080p，性能优于前代并对标领先模型，且以MIT许可开源。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型多聚焦于视觉模态，难以生成与画面在时间与语义上严格同步的高质量音频（如唇形同步），缺乏统一的音视频联合生成基础模型；同时社区需要开放可复现的权重与代码以推动多媒体生成研究。
AI.method: 采用双流CrossDiT架构，将预训练视频流与新训练的音频流通过双向交叉注意力连接以实现时序与语义对齐；采用连续预训练策略，先在音频语料上从零训练音频流，再在成对音视频数据上联合训练且保持单模态保真度；随后进行监督微调、基于强化学习的后训练与蒸馏；内置超分模型将输出提升至1920×1080。
AI.result: 模型可生成5秒、44kHz的同步音视频，支持T2AV与I2AV及唇形同步；超分后达Full-HD。在人评估中，Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro显著优于前代Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并与领先音视频生成模型保持竞争力，尤其语音质量表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可扩展的音视频联合扩散生成方案，验证了双流CrossDiT与连续预训练的有效性，并以MIT许可开源代码、检查点与diffusers集成，加速多媒体生成的开放研究与部署。

title: Readable Before Actionable: Causal Tracing of Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: Indirect prompt injection causes LLM agents to follow commands embedded in external data. A probe may distinguish instructions from data without identifying a state edit that changes the next action. We study this gap through counterfactual role probes, component-wise activation patching, and separate interventions on AgentDojo trajectories. Role decoding survives changes in content and format. In controlled Qwen tests, it precedes strong tool-choice effects from patches along an independently estimated role direction. On AgentDojo, directions estimated from hijacked and resisted training trajectories reduce attack success at pre-action and injected-span positions, but have little effect at random positions. In longer Qwen trajectories, single-position edits become less effective at later layers; span-wide and repeated edits reduce attack success on the same evaluation set. Removing the learned channel subspace preserves role decoding, yet effective intervention directions transfer poorly across the tested channels. These findings distinguish a readable role signal from an effective behavioral intervention: depth matters in controlled tool choice, while position and context also matter in attack trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文研究间接提示注入中"角色信号可被读出"与"能否有效干预模型行为"之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 间接提示注入使LLM智能体遵循嵌入外部数据中的指令。现有探针虽能区分"指令"与"数据"，却未必能识别真正改变下一步动作的状态编辑。作者旨在探究这一"可读性"与"行为可干预性"的鸿沟。
AI.method: 采用反事实角色探针、组件级激活修补（activation patching），并在AgentDojo轨迹上实施分离式干预。通过独立估计的"角色方向"进行控制实验（Qwen），并在劫持/抵抗训练轨迹上估计方向，在不同位置（动作前、注入片段、随机位置）施加干预；另对长轨迹比较单点编辑、跨片段编辑与重复编辑，并移除学习到的通道子空间进行对照。
AI.result: 角色解码对内容与格式变化保持稳健；在受控Qwen测试中，角色解码先于沿角色方向的强工具选择效应。在AgentDojo上，于动作前与注入片段位置施加方向干预可降低攻击成功率，而随机位置几乎无效。长轨迹中单点编辑在较深层效果变差，跨片段与重复编辑可降低攻击成功率。移除所学通道子空间后角色解码仍保留，但有效干预方向在通道间迁移性差。
AI.conclusion: 可读的角色信号不等同于有效的行为干预：在受控工具选择中"深度"至关重要，而在攻击轨迹中位置与上下文同样关键。

title: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code
summary: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaKernelBench，用同一问题的跨 DSL（CuTe DSL 与 TIRx）配对变体，量化从一次尝试中蒸馏的技能是否能迁移、提升另一次尝试，揭示迁移收益高度条件化。
AI.motivation: 现有 GPU kernel 优化智能体把经验存入知识库或蒸馏为技能，而 kernel 基准只评测单次实现的正确性与速度，未衡量被保留经验的复用价值；缺少对"同问题、跨 DSL 知识迁移"的度量。
AI.method: 构建 74 个问题（六族融合子图），每个问题提供 CuTe DSL 与 TIRx 两个仅 DSL 不同的变体。智能体先单独尝试每个变体，并将所学蒸馏为自然语言技能（无论源尝试是否通过验证均进行传递）；技能作为唯一额外输入，驱动同一模型在其他 DSL 上做技能条件化尝试。在每次尝试预算匹配的条件下，将技能条件化尝试与同一变体的单独尝试对比，评测正确性与端到端运行时。
AI.result: 覆盖六个模型、两个迁移方向：相对单独尝试的配对提升范围为 -19% 至 +29%。四个模型在两个方向上均有增益，但每个模型、每个方向都有 16%–45% 的问题出现回退。迁移结果取决于源尝试相对目标单独尝试的水平，而非仅源是否成功：源优于目标时 71% 的比较获得提升，源劣于目标时 54% 出现回退。
AI.conclusion: MetaKernelBench 补充了实现质量类指标，专门度量同问题跨 DSL 的 kernel 知识迁移；跨 DSL 技能迁移存在真实但不对称、条件性的收益，需按源/目标相对水平而非仅源成功与否来判断。

title: StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.

AI.tldr: StageVLN是一种训练框架，通过特权空间与轨迹引导塑造导航表征，在不改变推理路径、不增加推理期几何编码器的前提下显著提升VLN性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN策略受益于大规模视觉语言模型（VLM）提供的语义先验，但标准动作监督未显式约束中间表征保留场景几何、相对朝向或全局情节进度。引入深度估计器、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型可提供此类结构，但会带来额外计算、内存开销及推理期架构依赖，不利于部署。
AI.method: 提出StageVLN训练框架：冻结的几何基础模型为分层导航器状态提供多层次空间引导；相对朝向（relative-heading）与专家路线进度（expert-route progress）目标提供互补的轨迹状态监督。所有辅助组件仅用于训练，部署时移除，保持原始推理路径。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE验证未见集上，StageVLN以4B参数骨干取得56.3% SR与51.4% SPL，且推理期无需额外几何编码器。在RxR-CE上取得54.3% SR，且不依赖额外导航训练数据与推理期几何编码器。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期的特权空间与轨迹监督即可将几何与进度结构注入导航表征，在保持原推理架构的同时提升VLN性能，避免了部署阶段的额外开销。

title: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
summary: An agent harness is the code that organizes context, maintains state, and coordinates tool calls for a language model. We study how to improve the harness under a limited evaluation budget while keeping model weights fixed. Our method, MESH-Harness, organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined. It uses shared module representations and full-covariance LinUCB to score candidate combinations based on predicted performance and exploration value. Mixed-start coordinate ascent selects complete configurations for evaluation without enumerating the combinatorial space. Validation traces then guide local code edits, and the resulting candidates are incorporated into fixed-capacity role-specific pools for subsequent recombination. On text tasks, retrieval-augmented mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive scientific tasks, MESH-Harness outperforms Meta-Harness by 5.70, 7.01, 2.00, and 5.00 points, respectively, under matched candidate-evaluation budgets. Iterative harness optimization improves MESH-Harness by 5.63-7.79 points over its first-round configurations. For the reported configurations, aggregate test-time cost is 44.2% lower than that of Meta-Harness, while total cost including search is 14.6% lower. These results show that combining module-level design reuse with feedback-driven compositional search can systematically improve agent harnesses while keeping overall optimization cost under control.

AI.tldr: 提出 MESH-Harness，将智能体执行框架（harness）分解为带显式角色接口的功能模块，结合共享模块表示、全协方差 LinUCB 与混合起点坐标上升进行组合搜索，在固定模型权重和有限评估预算下系统提升框架性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多关注模型权重或提示工程，而组织上下文、维护状态、协调工具调用的 harness 代码同样关键。在模型权重固定且评估预算受限的条件下，如何高效改进 harness 尚缺乏系统方法，且组合式配置搜索空间庞大、验证代价高。
AI.method: 将 harness 组织为功能模块，每个模块具备显式的角色专用接口，允许不同实现被替换与重组；使用共享模块表示与全协方差 LinUCB，依据预测性能与探索价值对候选组合打分；采用混合起点坐标上升（mixed-start coordinate ascent）在不枚举组合空间的情况下选出完整配置进行评估；再依据验证轨迹进行局部代码编辑，并将新候选纳入固定容量的角色专用池以支持后续重组。
AI.result: 在匹配候选评估预算下，MESH-Harness 相较 Meta-Harness 在文本任务、检索增强数学推理、代码生成和交互式科学任务上分别高出 5.70、7.01、2.00、5.00 分；迭代式 harness 优化相比其首轮配置再提升 5.63–7.79 分。就所报告的配置而言，聚合测试时成本比 Meta-Harness 低 44.2%，包含搜索在内的总成本低 14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将模块级设计复用与反馈驱动的组合搜索相结合，可在控制整体优化成本的同时系统性地改进智能体 harness，为固定模型权重下的框架优化提供了可行路径。

title: Operational Abstractions of Neural Network Concepts via Topological Representations
summary: Concept-based methods provide a semantic level for interpreting and manipulating learned representations, but existing editing approaches are typically specialized to particular interventions and do not provide a common and editable representation of concept organization. To achieve this, we introduce Topological Concept Representations (TCR), a post-hoc operational abstraction that jointly characterizes the concepts encoded in a learned representation and their relationships. TCR constructs an intermediate concept space from concept recoverability and interaction scores, and compactly encodes its organization through topology. Interventions are expressed through modifications of this abstraction that are propagated back to the underlying learned representation. This allows different concept-level operations to share the same optimization framework and separates the desired concept organization from the mechanism to achieve it. We establish stability and reparameterization-invariance properties of TCR and its connections to existing concept-editing formulations. We use TCR to disentangle concepts as a preprocessing step for existing erasure methods, improving worst-group accuracy by 21.89 on average at comparable concept leakage. We further use TCR to transfer concepts from teacher to student models, improving concept recoverability by up to 5.54 while also improving or maintaining competitive test top-1 accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出拓扑概念表示（TCR），一种事后操作抽象，联合刻画学得表示中的概念及其关系，提供统一可编辑的概念组织表示，并以同一优化框架支持多种概念级编辑操作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概念的方法虽提供语义层面的解释与操控，但编辑方法往往针对特定干预专门设计，缺乏统一且可编辑的概念组织表示。
AI.method: 从概念可恢复性与交互分数构建中间概念空间，用拓扑紧凑编码其组织；干预通过修改该抽象并回传到原学得表示，从而共享优化框架并将理想概念组织与实现机制解耦。论文还证明了TCR的稳定性与重参数化不变性，及其与现有概念编辑形式化的联系。
AI.result: 将TCR用于解耦概念作为现有擦除方法的预处理，在概念泄漏相当的情况下平均提升最差组准确率21.89；用于教师到学生的概念迁移，概念可恢复性最多提升5.54，同时保持或提升具有竞争力的测试top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: TCR为概念组织提供了统一、稳定且可编辑的表示，可兼容多种概念级操作，并在概念解耦与概念迁移任务中验证了有效性。

title: Difference Feature Map Distillation: Transferring Inter-Sample Relational Knowledge Towards Efficient Transformer-Based Tracking
comment: Published in the 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV)
summary: In autonomous driving perception, visual object tracking systems must satisfy stringent latency and power constraints while remaining robust in complex and dynamic environments. Although transformer-based trackers achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, their substantial computational and memory overheads hinder deployment on real-time, resource-constrained platforms. To move toward this goal, we propose Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD), a novel relational distillation framework tailored for transformer-based visual object tracking. Unlike conventional feature distillation methods that minimize point-wise discrepancies (e.g., mean squared error) between teacher and student feature representations, DFM-KD transfers knowledge through inter-sample feature differences, explicitly aligning the relational structure of the feature space. By distilling how the teacher models appearance variation and consistency across samples, rather than enforcing similarity in absolute activations, DFM-KD enables the student to better capture the structural dynamics of visual changes within a batch. As a result, the distilled model exhibits enhanced feature robustness and improved tracking performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DFM-KD consistently outperforms conventional feature-level distillation methods in both tracking precision and success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出DFM-KD关系型知识蒸馏框架，通过蒸馏样本间特征差异而非逐点匹配来迁移知识，提升基于Transformer的视觉目标跟踪学生模型的特征鲁棒性与跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知中，跟踪系统需满足严格的延迟与功耗约束。基于Transformer的跟踪器虽精度领先，但计算与内存开销大，难以部署于实时、资源受限平台，因此需要压缩。
AI.method: DFM-KD：一种面向Transformer视觉目标跟踪的关系型蒸馏框架。不同于最小化教师与学生特征逐点差异（如MSE）的传统特征蒸馏，该方法通过样本间特征差异迁移知识，显式对齐特征空间的关系结构；蒸馏教师对批次内样本间外观变化与一致性的建模方式，而非强制绝对激活值相似。
AI.result: 学生模型能更好捕捉批内视觉变化的结构动态，获得更强的特征鲁棒性；大量实验表明DFM-KD在跟踪精度与成功率上均持续优于常规特征级蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过关系型（样本间差异）蒸馏替代逐点特征匹配，可在保持Transformer跟踪精度的同时降低模型负载，为资源受限平台上的实时跟踪部署提供有效途径。

title: AgentDiscover: Autonomous Discovery with Minimal Search Scaffolding
summary: Frameworks that use large language models for scientific discovery typically rely on a fixed, human-designed algorithm that decides what the model sees at each step, leaving the model only the role of proposer. The model knows nothing of the search beyond what it is shown. As models grow more capable, a question arises: does a search strategy chosen by a human before the run scale better than promoting the model from proposer to planner and letting it own the search? The Bitter Lesson suggests that choosing the strategy in advance is the kind of hand-designed structure that general methods eventually outscale. We introduce AgentDiscover, in which a coding agent plans the search using its context as working memory, runs experiments, and records every attempt in a database of ideas, candidates, and their relations. This database serves as the agent's long-term memory and is structured so that the selection rules of classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and Monte Carlo tree search each reduce to a single query, which the agent is free to use, combine, or replace. A server maintains the database and steers the agent after every submission, keeping it on course over long runs. In our experiments, AgentDiscover is more cost-efficient than existing frameworks, reaching better scores at lower cost. On tasks in kernel engineering, biology, algorithm design, and mathematics, AgentDiscover outperforms prior discovery frameworks. Its programs would have placed first among human competitors in seven past AtCoder heuristic contests, and on eleven mathematical and systems optimization tasks it matches or exceeds every baseline that uses the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/mhdfb/AgentDiscover.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentDiscover 框架，将大语言模型从"提议者"升级为"规划者"，让其自主掌控科学发现搜索过程。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现框架依赖人类预先设计的固定算法来决定模型每一步看到什么，模型仅充当提议者，对搜索全局一无所知。随着模型能力增强，问题在于：人类事先选择的搜索策略是否比让模型自己掌控搜索更具扩展性？依据"苦涩教训"，预先设好的策略属于手工设计结构，最终会被通用方法超越。
AI.method: AgentDiscover 让编码智能体以自身上下文作为工作记忆来规划搜索、执行实验，并把每次尝试记录进一个包含想法、候选方案及其关系的数据库。该数据库既作为智能体的长期记忆，又被设计为使 MAP-Elites、蒙特卡洛树搜索等经典算法的选择规则各自简化为一次查询，智能体可自由使用、组合或替换。服务器维护数据库并在每次提交后引导智能体，确保长程运行不偏离方向。
AI.result: AgentDiscover 比现有框架更具成本效益，以更低成本达到更高分数。在内核工程、生物学、算法设计与数学等任务上优于此前的发现框架。其生成的程序在七场过往 AtCoder 启发式竞赛中可获人类选手第一名；在十一项数学与系统优化任务上追平或超过所有使用相同模型的基线。
AI.conclusion: 将模型从提议者提升为搜索规划者，比人类预先设定搜索策略更具扩展性，印证了"苦涩教训"的观点。代码已开源于 https://github.com/mhdfb/AgentDiscover。

title: Calibrated Weak Supervision for Post-Harvest Burned-Cropland Mapping Under Label Scarcity
summary: Mapping post-harvest burned cropland is difficult when fires are small and fragmented and reliable labels are scarce. We developed a calibrated weak-supervision framework for Punjab, India, using Sentinel-2 spectral change, VIIRS active-fire context, and MODIS MCD64A1 as a coarse external calibration and agreement reference. Three pseudo-label recipes, five feature representations, and linear, tree-based, boosted, and neural classifiers were evaluated using nested district-held-out cross-validation over three seeds and five folds. NBR and dNBR were excluded from classifier inputs. The best configuration used the very-strict recipe, a multilayer perceptron, and the full optical feature set (mean Cohen's kappa 0.395, AUROC 0.753, F1 0.747, balanced accuracy 0.703); Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were practically tied. Higher agreement with held-out pseudo-labels did not establish improved label correctness or independent burned-area accuracy. For deployment, a Random Forest with the very-strict recipe and full optical features was retained. An externally calibrated threshold of 0.60 yielded district-level MODIS agreement of R-squared 0.636, a mapped-to-MODIS burned-area ratio of 1.005, and Spearman correlation of 0.779 with district fire counts. Pixel-level MODIS agreement remained modest (F1 0.205, kappa 0.093). Zero-shot transfer to Haryana was promising (mean kappa 0.641), but Punjab cross-year stability was weak, and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 feature concatenation did not improve the optical baseline. Optical observations ended before the seasonal fire context, limiting coverage of late burns. The framework supports district-scale burden assessment and hotspot screening, with limited support for exact scar boundaries or temporally stable annual mapping.

AI.tldr: 该研究为印度旁遮普邦开发了一个校准式弱监督框架，利用Sentinel-2光谱变化、VIIRS活跃火点与MODIS MCD64A1进行外部校准，识别小块破碎的收获后焚烧农田，并评估其在不同分类器与特征组合下的性能与局限。
AI.motivation: 收获后焚烧农田常表现为小面积、破碎化火点，可靠标签稀缺，导致制图困难；同时需要为区域尺度焚烧负荷评估与热点筛查提供可行的技术方案。
AI.method: 构建校准式弱监督框架：以Sentinel-2光谱变化为主要依据，结合VIIRS活跃火点上下文和MODIS MCD64A1作为粗尺度外部校准与一致性参考；设计三种伪标签规则、五种特征表示，并比较线性、树模型、提升模型与神经网络分类器；采用嵌套式地区留出交叉验证（3个随机种子×5折）；分类器输入排除NBR与dNBR。
AI.result: 最优配置为very-strict伪标签规则+多层感知机+完整光学特征集（平均Cohen's kappa 0.395、AUROC 0.753、F1 0.747、平衡准确率0.703）；Random Forest、XGBoost与LightGBM性能基本持平。与留出伪标签更高一致性并不能证明标签正确性或独立燃烧面积精度提升。部署采用Random Forest+very-strict规则+完整光学特征，外部校准阈值0.60时，地区级MODIS一致性R²=0.636、制图/ MODIS燃烧面积比=1.005、与地区火点数的Spearman相关=0.779；像元级MODIS一致性仍有限（F1 0.205、kappa 0.093）。零样本迁移至哈里亚纳邦表现较好（平均kappa 0.641），但旁遮普邦跨年稳定性弱；Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2特征拼接未优于纯光学基线；光学观测在季节性火灾背景前结束，限制了对晚季焚烧的覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可支持地区尺度焚烧负荷评估与热点筛查，但对精确火烧迹地边界识别和时间上稳定的年度制图支持有限。

title: Rotated, but How Far? Diagnosing and Improving Object-Rotation Reasoning in VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can detect that an object has rotated across views, but cannot reliably tell by how much. We introduce OR-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark for object-rotation reasoning with eight tasks covering rotation detection, rotation magnitude estimation, and multi-view rotation reasoning. Across 12 VLMs, the gap is stark: the strongest models approach 100% accuracy on detection, yet even coarse magnitude estimation is near chance. When asked for exact angles, models place 91.8--100% of their predictions on just $0^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $180^\circ$, a failure we term canonical-angle collapse. This collapse persists even without visual input. Representation probing shows that missing information is only part of the explanation. Although rotation information becomes less recoverable at finer granularity, substantial coarse-grained information remains, and a simple linear probe outperforms the models' generated answers. This suggests that VLMs underuse rotation information they already encode. We therefore propose RotationCue, a lightweight decoder that recovers coarse rotation information from the VLM's own frozen representations and feeds it back to the model as intermediate textual context. Across three VLMs, RotationCue improves every model--task combination on OR-Bench, raising macro-average accuracy by 7.9--12.6 points while preserving general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出细粒度物体旋转推理基准 OR-Bench，揭示视觉语言模型存在"标准角度塌缩"现象，并通过 RotationCue 解码器缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽能判断物体在视角间发生旋转，却无法可靠估计旋转幅度。作者希望系统性地刻画这一能力缺陷，并探究其成因是信息缺失还是信息未被充分利用。
AI.method: 1) 构建 OR-Bench 基准，含 8 项任务，覆盖旋转检测、旋转幅度估计与多视角旋转推理；2) 评测 12 个 VLM；3) 通过表征探针（linear probe）分析旋转信息的可恢复性；4) 提出 RotationCue——一个轻量解码器，从 VLM 冻结表征中恢复粗粒度旋转信息，并以中间文本上下文形式回馈模型。
AI.result: 最强模型在旋转检测上接近 100% 准确率，但粗粒度幅度估计近乎随机；精确角度预测中 91.8%–100% 集中在 0°、90°、180°，即"标准角度塌缩"，且无视觉输入时依然存在。探针显示模型仍编码了可用的粗粒度旋转信息，线性探针优于模型生成答案。RotationCue 在三个 VLM 上提升所有模型—任务组合，宏平均准确率提高 7.9–12.6 个百分点，且保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: VLM 旋转推理失败不能仅归因于信息缺失，而是对已编码信息的利用不足；通过从冻结表征中解码并显式回馈旋转线索，可有效提升细粒度旋转推理性能。

title: EnGRICH: Enhancing Generative Reward Modeling with Critiques from Humans
summary: Generative reward models (GRMs) are important for LLM optimization. Unlike scalar reward models, GRMs generate natural-language critiques alongside preference judgments, providing finer-grained evaluation signals. Their effectiveness depends heavily on critique reliability. However, existing GRM training typically uses final preference correctness as outcome supervision. Because the preference outcome space is highly constrained, unreliable critiques can still yield correct outcomes and thus be reinforced. Recent work leverages human critiques for process supervision, but such critiques are scarce and are often reduced to scalar rewards, leaving their fine-grained evaluative information underutilized. We argue that evaluative criteria learned from human critiques can be generalized to broader outcome-only preference data. To this end, we propose \textbf{EnGRICH}, a GRM training framework that pairs the GRM with a training-time MetaCritic learned from a small set of human critiques. MetaCritic constructs response-specific rubrics and uses them to evaluate the evidence coverage and correctness of generated critiques. The resulting signals provide both process rewards for fine-grained credit assignment and structured guidance for exploring better critiques. During GRM training, MetaCritic is further optimized to generalize human-grounded evaluative criteria to outcome-only data. At inference, the trained GRM operates independently. Experiments across seven reward-model benchmarks show that EnGRICH consistently improves over competitive baselines, while further analyses validate the effectiveness of its core mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EnGRICH，一种生成式奖励模型（GRM）训练框架，通过引入从少量人类批判中学得的 MetaCritic 构造响应特定评分准则，对 GRM 生成的批判进行过程监督，从而在仅有结果偏好数据的情况下提升批判可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有 GRM 训练多以最终偏好正确性作为结果监督信号，但偏好结果空间高度受限，导致不可靠的批判仍可能产生正确结果并被强化；而人类批判虽可用于过程监督，却数量稀缺且常被简化为标量奖励，其细粒度评价信息未被充分利用。作者认为，从人类批判中学到的评价准则可以泛化到更广泛的结果偏好数据上。
AI.method: 提出 EnGRICH 框架：为 GRM 配备一个训练期 MetaCritic，该 MetaCritic 从少量人类批判中学习，针对具体响应构建评分准则（rubrics），并据此评估生成批判的证据覆盖度与正确性。由此产生的信号既提供细粒度信用分配的过程奖励，也为探索更优批判提供结构化指导。训练过程中进一步优化 MetaCritic，使其将人类评价准则泛化至仅有结果的数据；推理时 GRM 独立运行。
AI.result: 在七个奖励模型基准上的实验表明，EnGRICH 相比多个强基线取得一致提升，进一步分析验证了其核心机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 从人类批判中习得的评价准则可有效泛化至仅有结果偏好的数据，MetaCritic 驱动的过程监督能显著提升 GRM 批判可靠性；推理阶段无需 MetaCritic，GRM 可独立部署。

title: E$^2$-OPSD: Taming Entropy Overshoot in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision without a second model: one network acts as teacher with the reference solution and as student with only the problem. We identify a specific failure mode of this recipe. During training, student token entropy rises past the teacher's and remains elevated, a pattern we call entropy overshoot. We trace it to both sides of distillation. The reference-conditioned teacher is confident along its answer-directed reasoning path, but this confidence transfers poorly to student-generated prefixes, making its supervision overly tied to answer-specific cues rather than reusable reasoning patterns; meanwhile, the forward KL used by OPSD continually diffuses the student's predictive distribution without pulling it back. We introduce E$^2$-OPSD to address both causes. Exemplar-guided teaching replaces the current answer with a retrieved solved neighboring problem, providing transferable reasoning guidance without revealing the destination and better matching student-reachable states. Entropy-aware distillation uses the student-teacher entropy gap to determine the direction and strength of each token's correction. E$^2$-OPSD improves math reasoning by up to 4.3 points in mean@16 over OPSD, while out-of-domain evaluations show gains over the corresponding base models of up to 4.9 points in mean@16 and 5.5 points in pass@8. Despite these gains, E$^2$-OPSD remains simple, requiring no additional forward passes or networks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现on-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)存在"熵过冲"失效模式，并提出E²-OPSD，通过示例引导教学与熵感知蒸馏同时修正教师端与学生端问题，在数学推理与域外任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: OPSD无需第二个模型即可提供密集的token级监督，但存在特定失效模式：训练中学生的token熵超过教师并持续升高（熵过冲）。作者希望定位该问题根源并加以解决。
AI.method: 作者将熵过冲归因于蒸馏两端：(1)以参考答案为条件的教师在其答案导向的推理路径上过度自信，这种自信难以迁移到学生生成的前缀，导致监督过度依赖答案特定线索而非可复用推理模式；(2)OPSD使用的forward KL不断扩散学生预测分布却缺乏拉回机制。为此提出E²-OPSD：Exemplar-guided teaching用检索到的已解邻近问题替换当前答案，提供可迁移的推理引导而不泄露最终答案，并更好匹配学生可达状态；Entropy-aware distillation利用学生-教师熵差决定每个token修正的方向与强度。
AI.result: E²-OPSD在数学推理上相较OPSD的mean@16最高提升4.3分；域外评估中相较对应基模型mean@16最高提升4.9分、pass@8最高提升5.5分。同时方法保持简洁，无需额外前向传播或网络。
AI.conclusion: E²-OPSD通过同时针对教师端监督质量与学生端分布扩散两个成因，有效缓解熵过冲，在无需额外模型或计算开销的前提下显著提升推理性能。

title: T-JEPA: A Temporal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Learning Better Remote Sensing Representations
summary: Earth observation (EO) data provide rich temporal supervision, yet existing remote sensing foundation models mainly exploit sequential observations through imposing predefined pairwise relations or aggregating holistic reconstruction context. We seek to further exploit the sparse and nonuniform temporal sampling inherent in EO sequences as supervisory signals. To this end, we propose T-JEPA, a temporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns time-gap-conditioned latent transitions. A shared single-frame encoder processes each observation, while a temporal predictor estimates the complete target latent field from a masked source latent representation and the actual elapsed time. Across multiple temporal intervals, these predictive constraints organize observed states into structured latent trajectories. Asymmetric metadata injection mitigates shortcut learning, and direct supervision across multiple temporal scales proves more effective than recursively rolling out intermediate states. In parallel, masked pixel reconstruction provides complementary supervision for preserving spatial details. Under matched pre-training data and throughput, T-JEPA achieves leading transfer performance on both static and temporal tasks. Analyses further reveal that T-JEPA learns representations with time-gap-dependent transition predictability and coherent latent dynamics, while maintaining strong cross-period consistency, representation diversity, and semantic discriminability.

AI.tldr: 提出T-JEPA，一种时间联合嵌入预测架构，利用地球观测序列中稀疏、非均匀的时间采样作为监督信号，学习以时间间隔为条件的潜在状态转移，在静态与时间任务上取得领先的迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型主要通过对观测序列施加预定义的成对关系或聚合整体重建上下文来利用时序信息，未能充分挖掘EO序列固有的稀疏且非均匀的时间采样所蕴含的监督价值。
AI.method: 采用共享的单帧编码器处理每个观测；时序预测器由掩码后的源潜在表示与实际经过时间，估计完整的目标潜在场；在多个时间间隔上施加预测约束，将观测状态组织为结构化潜在轨迹；使用非对称元数据注入缓解捷径学习；跨多个时间尺度进行直接监督（优于递归滚动中间状态）；同时以掩码像素重建作为补充监督以保留空间细节。
AI.result: 在与基线匹配的预训练数据和吞吐量条件下，T-JEPA在静态和时间任务上均取得领先的迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: T-JEPA学到的表示具有依赖时间间隔的转移可预测性与连贯的潜在动态，同时保持较强的跨周期一致性、表示多样性和语义可判别性。

title: Learning Field Reconstruction from Incomplete Data by Globally Correcting Local Estimates
summary: Reconstructing physical fields from training samples that are always incomplete requires learning spatial structure from fragmented observations.Existing context--query work establishes how held-out observations provide valid training targets, but this does not make the complete-field distribution identifiable when every training field is incomplete.With finite data, weak evidence of sharp transitions and localized variations can further favor averaged predictions that attenuate local detail.A structural prior is therefore needed to favor plausible completions; local spatial relationships offer one grounded in the observations.We propose a locally constructed, globally revisable estimator that explicitly learns local field estimates and subsequently corrects them using full-domain observations.A shared coordinate-conditioned predictor learns from incomplete patches, allowing relatively well-observed neighborhoods to provide direct supervision of local structure.Its overlapping predictions are reconciled into an observation-conditioned consensus field.A full-domain estimator retains the original observations and learns a residual correction around this frozen field estimate, allowing locally constructed structure to be revised by broader evidence.The local estimate serves as both an explicit input, accompanied by its discrepancies with the observations, and a prediction starting point that the global model can revise.On three real-world ocean datasets with authentic observation gaps, our estimator achieves the lowest MSE and highest PSNR on withheld source-supported values, reducing MSE by 28.9\%--34.5\% against the strongest external baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对训练样本本身不完整、完整场分布不可辨识的问题，提出一种"局部构造、全局修正"的结构化估计器：先用共享坐标条件预测器从残缺patch学习局部场估计并融合为观测条件共识场，再用全域估计器在冻结的局部估计上学习残差修正，在三个真实海洋数据集上取得最低MSE和最高PSNR。
AI.motivation: 从训练样本重建物理场时，观测总是不完整的，需要从碎片化观测中学习空间结构。已有的context-query方法虽然通过留出观测提供了有效训练目标，但当每个训练场都不完整时，完整场分布仍不可辨识。在有限数据下，尖锐过渡和局部变化的弱证据会进一步偏向平均化预测，削弱局部细节。因此需要一种结构先验来支持合理的补全，而局部空间关系正是植根于观测的一种先验。
AI.method: 提出一个局部构造、全局可修正的估计器，显式学习局部场估计，再借助全域观测进行修正。1）共享的坐标条件预测器从残缺patch学习，使观测较充分的邻域能直接监督局部结构；2）将其重叠预测融合为观测条件共识场；3）全域估计器保留原始观测，在该冻结的局部估计周围学习残差修正，使局部构造的结构被更广证据修正。局部估计既作为显式输入（并附带其与观测的残差），也作为全局模型的预测起点。
AI.result: 在三个具有真实观测缺口的真实海洋数据集上，该估计器在留出的源支持值上取得最低的MSE和最高的PSNR，相比最强外部基线MSE降低28.9%–34.5%。
AI.conclusion: 局部空间关系为不完整训练样本下的物理场重建提供了有效的结构先验。通过局部构造估计与全域残差修正的两阶段设计，模型既能保留局部细节，又能被全域证据修正，显著优于现有基线。

title: LogSig-SSM: Time-Series Modelling with Multi-Scale Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables
summary: Time-series data are often sampled irregularly at high frequencies and exhibit long-range dependencies, which makes long-horizon modelling difficult. Continuous-time models such as neural controlled differential equations (NCDEs) and neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) can handle irregular sampling, but they scale poorly to long sequences. Selective state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba scale linearly with sequence length, but they provide limited recurrent mixing across hidden dimensions within a single block. We propose LogSig-SSM (Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models), which first compresses long multivariate time series into a shorter sequence of tokens using multi-scale windowed log-signatures, and then processes these tokens with a selective SSM backbone. LogSig-SSM is scalable and robust to irregular sampling, combining log-signature tokens that capture higher-order cross-channel interactions with a selective SSM that models long-range dependencies. The model also admits a continuous-time interpretation as an NCDE/NRDE-style system driven by a log-signature-based input, in which selectivity induces an input-dependent rescaling of the latent dynamics. Across four benchmarks, namely long-sequence classification on UEA, high-frequency physiological regression on PPG-DaLiA, multivariate weather forecasting, and irregularly sampled clinical prediction on PhysioNet Sepsis, LogSig-SSM outperforms or matches strong SSM and continuous-time baselines while training up to $30\times$ faster and using up to $37\times$ less GPU memory than Mamba on the longest sequences.

AI.tldr: LogSig-SSM 用多尺度窗口对数签名将长多元时间序列压缩为短 token 序列，再交由选择性 SSM 建模，兼顾不规则采样鲁棒性与长程依赖，在四个基准上性能领先且比 Mamba 训练更快、显存更省。
AI.motivation: 时间序列常以高频、不规则方式采样且具有长程依赖，长时程建模困难。NCDE/NRDE 等连续时间模型能处理不规则采样，但难以扩展到长序列；Mamba 等选择性 SSM 可线性扩展，但单块内隐藏维度的循环混合能力有限。
AI.method: 提出 LogSig-SSM：先用多尺度窗口对数签名（log-signature）将长多元序列压缩为较短的 token 序列，再用选择性 SSM 主干处理；对数签名 token 捕获高阶跨通道交互，选择性 SSM 建模长程依赖。该模型还可解释为由对数签名输入驱动的 NCDE/NRDE 式连续时间系统，其中选择性导致潜在动力学的输入相关重缩放。
AI.result: 在四个基准上——UEA 长序列分类、PPG-DaLiA 高频生理回归、多元天气预测、PhysioNet Sepsis 不规则采样临床预测——LogSig-SSM 优于或持平强 SSM 与连续时间基线，且在最长序列上训练速度比 Mamba 快至多 30 倍，GPU 显存占用少至多 37 倍。
AI.conclusion: LogSig-SSM 通过将多尺度窗口对数签名压缩与选择性 SSM 结合，为长序列、不规则采样的多元时间序列建模提供了一种可扩展且高效的新范式。

title: Direction-Conditioned Policies for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) learns representations that estimate goal reachability, yet its policy remains conditioned on raw goals and therefore does not directly exploit the geometry encoded by its critic. We introduce Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a method built around a small modification to CRL: DCP selects previously visited states as waypoints during online training and conditions the policy on their direction and distance in representation space. At deployment, DCP applies the same interface directly to the final goal, requiring neither waypoint selection nor planning. Across nine navigation and manipulation tasks, DCP attains higher final success rates than CRL on seven tasks and spends more time near the goal on seven. Controlled maze experiments further show that DCP captures shortest-path geometry more accurately and that the supplied direction causally influences the actor's behavior. We identify waypoint coverage and ranking as limits to exploration, and show that learned candidate generation improves goal reaching in two controlled mazes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方向条件策略（DCP），通过对对比强化学习（CRL）进行小幅修改，使策略以表征空间中的方向与距离为条件，从而直接利用critic所学几何结构，在部署时无需路径点选择或规划。
AI.motivation: CRL能学到估计目标可达性的表征，但其策略仍以原始目标为条件，未能直接利用critic中编码的几何信息，导致表征与策略之间的几何优势未被充分利用。
AI.method: DCP在在线训练中选取曾访问过的状态作为路径点，将策略条件设为这些路径点在表征空间中的方向与距离；部署时同一接口直接作用于最终目标，无需路径点选择或规划。针对探索局限，识别出路径点覆盖与排序问题，并采用学习式候选生成。
AI.result: 在九个导航与操作任务中，DCP在七个任务上获得更高最终成功率，并在七个任务上更多时间停留在目标附近；受控迷宫实验表明DCP更准确地捕捉最短路径几何，且所给方向对actor行为具有因果影响；学习式候选生成在两处受控迷宫中提升了目标到达能力。
AI.conclusion: DCP以极小改动将CRL的表征几何转化为可执行策略条件，改善目标到达表现，且方向条件具有因果作用；路径点覆盖与排序是探索的主要瓶颈，学习式候选生成可部分缓解。

title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the $60$-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a $0.74$ dB PSNR gain and a $28.5\%$ reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over $547$ samples. At a $60$-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by $12\times$ relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a $1.6\%$ reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练混合线性注意力框架HLA-WM，利用GDN仿射结构缓存分块转移摘要，结合相机几何检索历史片段并重组为查询特定的循环状态，缓解长程遗忘。在60秒基准上提升全部六项一致性/相机控制指标，PSNR+0.74dB、旋转误差-28.5%，历史状态内存降低12倍，吞吐损失≤1.6%。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频世界模型需持久记忆以维持场景一致性。Softmax注意力依赖增长的KV缓存，内存代价高；GDN等循环线性注意力以固定大小状态压缩历史，内存高效，但存在严重的���程遗忘：远处但相关的场景信息被后续状态更新逐步衰减。
AI.method: 提出HLA-WM，免训练的混合线性注意力框架，将粗粒度几何引导检索与细粒度循环线性状态计算相结合。利用GDN的仿射结构缓存紧凑的分块（chunk-wise）转移摘要，基于相机几何检索与场景相关的历史块，并将其重组为查询特定的循环状态。
AI.result: 在60秒的SANA-WM-Bench上，无需额外训练即在全部六项重访一致性与相机控制聚合指标上提升基础自回归生成器：PSNR+0.74dB，旋转误差降低28.5%；下游精修后仍保持提升。并泛化至MBench-A，在547个样本、全部四个子集与全部推理模式下一致提升三项重访一致性指标。60秒上下文下，历史状态内存较全KV缓存降低12倍，推理吞吐损失至多1.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可选择性寻址的循环记忆能在保持GDN效率优势的同时改善长程场景回忆。

title: Sibyl: An Efficient Small-large Model Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Tasks
summary: Small language models (SLMs) offer a promising foundation for on-device agents through low-latency, resource-efficient inference, yet limited reasoning and planning capabilities constrain their performance on long-horizon tasks requiring multi-step interaction with the environment. Step-level collaboration between SLMs and larger cloud-hosted models can bridge this gap, but identifying states that warrant cloud assistance remains challenging: the contribution of each cloud call is entangled with subsequent actions and can be assessed only from the final task outcome. Compounding this challenge, the SLM must balance two competing objectives: maximizing task success and minimizing cloud calls. To address this, we propose Sibyl, an algorithm that trains SLM agents to selectively consult cloud models at the step level and internalize their guidance for subsequent decisions, achieving strong task performance with minimal cloud reliance. Sibyl follows a three-stage training pipeline that (1) builds a robust base policy through consultation-free self-evolving reinforcement learning (RL); (2) cold-starts consultation behavior via decisive-disagreement state mining; and (3) jointly optimizes consultation decisions and guidance internalization through consultation-aware RL. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that Sibyl, using only a 0.6B-parameter model, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including agent training and routing methods, by 95.2% and 80.4% in success rate while averaging only 0.8 and 3.9 cloud calls per trajectory, respectively.

AI.tldr: Sibyl通过三阶段训练SLM智能体在步骤级别选择性地求助云端大模型并内化其指导，用0.6B小模型在ALFWorld和WebShop上以极少云调用次数显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型（SLM）适合端侧智能体的低延迟、资源高效推理，但推理与规划能力有限，难以完成需要与环境多步交互的长时程任务。SLM与云端大模型的步骤级协作可弥合此差距，但难点在于：难以识别哪些状态值得求助云端，因为每次云调用的贡献与后续动作纠缠，只能从最终任务结果评估；同时SLM需在最大化任务成功率与最小化云调用两个相互竞争的目标间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出Sibyl算法，训练SLM智能体在步骤级别选择性地咨询云端模型，并将指导内化用于后续决策。采用三阶段训练流程：(1)通过无咨询的自演化强化学习（RL）构建稳健的基础策略；(2)通过"决定性分歧"状态挖掘对咨询行为进行冷启动；(3)通过咨询感知RL联合优化咨询决策与指导内化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop实验中，仅使用0.6B参数模型的Sibyl在成功率上分别超越包括智能体训练与路由方法在内的最先进基线95.2%和80.4%，同时每条轨迹平均仅需0.8和3.9次云调用。
AI.conclusion: Sibyl证明步骤级选择性云咨询配合指导内化，可使小型端侧智能体以极低云端依赖实现强任务表现，为SLM与云端大模型的高效协作提供了可行方案。

title: Revealing After Overwriting: An Exponential POMDP OPE Lower Bound under History-Dependent Logging
summary: Multi-step revealing can make off-policy evaluation tractable under memoryless logging. With history-dependent logging, state decodability and target-relevant evidence can separate. For every horizon $H\ge3$, we construct two exactly realizable POMDPs with four actions, at most four states per layer, a known logger, and a memoryless target. Action overlap, history coverage, and observation-only revealing remain bounded independently of $H$, yet the target values differ by $1/2$ and the KL divergence between the logged laws is $Θ(4^{-(H-1)})$, forcing exponential sample complexity. Logger memory makes states distinguishable, while reset erases the model-distinguishing evidence preserved by the target. A separate construction retains this barrier with common, known observation-only revealing operators. Under action and history coverage, we give a finite-class OPE guarantee using common observable value representations that remain valid at every history. The sample bound depends polynomially on their second-moment cost. In the common-operator construction, the same value direction has constant marginal decoding cost but exponential history-conditioned cost. Finally, on a fixed four-action continuum, we derive matching passive and budgeted readout rates. With one known channel and unit read cost, early reads are optimal. With unknown sensor bias, early reads alone remain exponentially costly. Combining them with post-reset calibration gives sample complexity independent of $H$ when both read types receive fixed positive expected budgets per trajectory.

AI.tldr: 该文研究记忆性日志下的离策略评估（OPE）可解性：构造了H≥3时目标仅依赖记忆less策略、日志器却记忆化的POMDP，证明即使动作重叠率、历史覆盖率和仅观测可揭示性均与H无关有界，目标值差1/2而日志分布KL散度为Θ(4^{-(H-1)})，导致指数级样本复杂度；并给出在动作与历史覆盖下的有限类OPE保证及主动读出速率的最优策略。
AI.motivation: 多步揭示可使记忆less日志下的离策略评估变得可处理，但当日志器具有历史依赖性时，状态可解码性与目标相关证据可能分离，导致基于揭示的直觉失效。作者希望刻画这种分离的严重程度，并找出在何种附加条件下OPE仍可学习。
AI.method: 构造性反例与正例分析：对每个H≥3构造两个可精确实现的POMDP（4动作、每层至多4状态、已知日志器、记忆less目标），使动作重叠、历史覆盖、仅观测可揭示性一致有界而目标值相差1/2、日志律KL为Θ(4^{-(H-1)})；另构造保留该屏障的公共已知仅观测揭示算子版本。随后在动作与历史覆盖假设下，用公共可观测值表示给出有限类OPE保证，样本界对二阶矩代价多项式依赖。最后在固定四动作连续统上推导被动与预算读出的匹配速率，分析已知通道与未知传感器偏置下早读/复位后校准的最优性。
AI.result: 1) 存在指数级下界：目标值差1/2而日志分布KL仅Θ(4^{-(H-1)})，样本复杂度随H指数增长；2) 日志器记忆使状态可区分，但重置抹除了目标保留的模型区分证据；3) 相同屏障可在公共已知仅观测揭示算子下复现；4) 在动作与历史覆盖下给出有限类OPE保证，样本界对可观测值表示的二阶矩代价多项式依赖；5) 公共算子构造中同一价值方向边际解码代价常数而历史条件代价指数级；6) 固定四动作连续统上被动与预算读出速率匹配；已知通道且单位读取代价时早读最优；未知传感器偏置下单独早读仍指数昂贵，早读结合复位后校准在两类读出均有固定正期望预算时样本复杂度与H无关。
AI.conclusion: 历史依赖日志会使状态解码与目标相关证据分离，即使覆盖率与揭示性指标有界也可能导致指数级样本复杂度；但在动作与历史覆盖的有限类设定下仍可获得多项式依赖的OPE保证，且通过合理分配早读与复位后校准预算可消除对H的指数依赖。

title: Robust Local Optimization Done Right
summary: RANSAC scoring and local optimization (LO) impose different robustness requirements, motivating the separation of hypothesis selection from refinement. We systematically isolate the effects of robust-loss shape, incorrectly specified inlier scales, and optimization strategy on essential matrix, fundamental matrix, and homography estimation. A profile-marginal score marginalizes the nuisance inlier scale and selects an inlier partition, from which we estimate the scale that sets the LO loss width; this makes LO robust to an inlier scale specified too large, whereas one specified too small degrades selection itself. Refinement needs gradient from correspondences the seed currently rejects: optimizers that reweight from current residuals stay pinned to their seed, whereas methods with broad basins recover strongly perturbed seeds yet degrade accurate score-selected hypotheses, so basin size alone is insufficient to assess RANSAC LO. Joint half-quadratic optimization balances the two and is the most consistent strategy across model classes. An optimizer matched to the profile-marginal score, which never decreases it, does not reach the best accuracy, challenging the prescription that scoring and refinement objectives should match. Composed from these findings, our RANSAC reduces the median essential-matrix pose error of a state-of-the-art RANSAC on PhotoTourism from 2.23 degrees to 1.58 degrees with a correctly specified inlier scale and from 38 degrees to 6.2 degrees when it is grossly misspecified (128x too large).

AI.tldr: 该论文系统解耦了RANSAC中鲁棒损失形状、内点尺度设定与局部优化策略对本质矩阵、基础矩阵和单应估计的影响，提出profile-marginal评分与联合半二次优化，并在PhotoTourism上显著降低位姿误差。
AI.motivation: RANSAC的评分（假设选择）与局部优化（refinement）对鲁棒性的要求不同，因此需要将两者分离研究；同时内点尺度常被错误设定，其影响与优化策略的交互尚未被系统阐明。
AI.method: 采用profile-marginal评分对内点尺度这一冗余参数进行边缘化，并据此选择内点划分，进而估计出用于设定局部优化损失宽度的尺度；系统对比不同鲁棒损失形状、错误内点尺度及优化策略（当前残差重加权法、宽吸引域方法、联合半二次优化）在本质矩阵、基础矩阵与单应估计中的表现。
AI.result: 尺度设得过大时，profile-marginal评分使局部优化保持鲁棒；设得过小时则连选择本身都会退化。仅靠吸引域大小不足以评估RANSAC局部优化：重加权法会被种子“钉住”，宽吸引域法能恢复强扰动种子却会损害评分已选出的准确假设。联合半二次优化在各类模型上最为一致。与profile-marginal评分匹配且不使其下降的优化器并未达到最高精度。最终方法在PhotoTourism上将中位本质矩阵位姿误差从2.23°降至1.58°（尺度正确），并在尺度严重错误（放大128倍）时从38°降至6.2°。
AI.conclusion: 评分与refinement应解耦设计，二者目标无需一致；内点尺度的两阶段处理（选择时边缘化、优化时估计）是提升RANSAC鲁棒性的关键。

title: MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training
summary: Autonomous research seeks sustained model improvements through iterative experimentation and feedback. LLM agents show promise in automating machine learning and language-model post-training, but their ability to sustain multimodal improvement remains unclear. We introduce MMPostTrainBench, a benchmark spanning eight tasks in image, audio, video, and joint audio-video understanding and image-grounded software repair. Agents operate from a common base model within fixed budgets, using development feedback before independent evaluation of their submitted models. Evaluation covers target and non-target model outcomes, iterative model improvement and selection, and research integrity. Across all eight tasks, 52.1% of model--task means fall below the base, and evaluated submissions also exhibit non-target regressions. Model performance does not consistently improve across research iterations, and agents do not reliably select the best evaluated candidate for submission; final submissions trail that candidate by up to 5.38 percentage points. Extending autonomous research from text-only to multimodal tasks introduces additional sources of error in perception, cross-modal alignment, and temporal grounding. The observed regressions and selection gaps highlight the need to balance targeted improvements with non-target capability preservation and to retain gains across research iterations. These requirements motivate MMResearch, a multimodal research framework that connects media-grounded evidence to hypotheses and interventions, carries findings across rounds through hierarchical memory, and retains candidates using development evaluation. Added to existing code-agent runtimes, it improves submitted-model accuracy by up to 7.75 percentage points for Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code and 2.33 points for GPT-5.6-sol with Codex.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多模态自主研究基准 MMPostTrainBench，揭示现有 LLM 智能体在多模态迭代研究中的系统性退化与选择缺陷，并提出 MMResearch 框架加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在自动化机器学习与语言模型后训练中展现潜力，但其能否持续提升多模态能力尚不明确；需要量化评估多模态自主研究的可行性、稳定性与完整性。
AI.method: 构建 MMPostTrainBench 基准，涵盖图像、音频、视频及音视频联合理解、图像锚定软件修复共八项任务；智能体在同一基础模型与固定预算下，先利用开发反馈迭代实验，再独立评估提交模型。评估维度包括目标/非目标模型表现、迭代改进与候选选择、研究诚信。进一步提出 MMResearch 框架：将媒体证据与假设、干预相连接，通过分层记忆跨轮次传递发现，并基于开发评估保留候选，可挂载于现有代码智能体运行时。
AI.result: 全部八项任务中，52.1% 的模型—任务均值低于基线，且提交模型出现非目标能力回退；性能未随研究迭代持续提升；智能体无法可靠选出最优候选，最终提交比最优候选低至多 5.38 个百分点。引入 MMResearch 后，Claude Opus 4.8 + Claude Code 提交模型准确率提升至多 7.75 个百分点，GPT-5.6-sol + Codex 提升 2.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 从纯文本扩展到多模态自主研究引入了感知、跨模态对齐与时间定位等额外误差来源；需在针对性改进与非目标能力保持之间取得平衡，并确保跨迭代增益的留存。MMResearch 通过证据驱动的假设—干预链路与分层记忆有效提升提交模型质量。

title: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides denser token-level supervision and better computational efficiency than Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, this denser supervision may introduce substantial noise and training instability. Existing improvements often rely on high-variance per-token statistics and introduce extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. Based on the advantage formulation in RLVR, we analyze the OPSD objective from the same perspective, incorporating outcome correctness signals. We find that vanilla OPSD imposes insufficient penalties and excessive rewards on incorrect trajectories because it applies a fixed divergence objective regardless of outcome correctness. Furthermore, the reliability of teacher supervision is associated with both trajectory outcome and the cumulative average teacher entropy along the rollout. Based on these observations, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD), which dynamically adapts both the divergence objective and distillation position according to binary outcome rewards and the cumulative average teacher entropy. Extensive experiments show that OG-OPSD consistently improves the performance of vanilla OPSD and multiple strong baselines in mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and out-of-distribution tasks across Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales, as well as Qwen3-VL-2B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD)，从 RLVR 优势视角重新审视 OPSD 目标，揭示其惩罚不足与奖励过度的问题，并依据二值结果奖励与累积平均教师熵动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置，从而稳定训练并提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 相比 RLVR 提供更密集的 token 级监督与更高计算效率，但这种密集监督会引入大量噪声与训练不稳定；现有改进依赖高方差的逐 token 统计，并引入额外超参与权衡。
AI.method: 借鉴 RLVR 中的优势公式化，从同一视角分析 OPSD 目标并纳入结果正确性信号；发现 vanilla OPSD 无论结果是否正确都施加固定的散度目标，导致对错误轨迹惩罚不足、奖励过度；进一步发现教师监督可靠性同时与轨迹结果及 rollout 过程中的累积平均教师熵相关；据此提出 OG-OPSD，依据二值结果奖励与累积平均教师熵动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置。
AI.result: 在数学推理、多模态推理及分布外任务上，OG-OPSD 在 Qwen3 1.7B、4B、8B 以及 Qwen3-VL-2B 上一致优于 vanilla OPSD 与多个强基线。
AI.conclusion: OG-OPSD 通过将结果正确性信号与教师熵纳入自蒸馏目标，缓解了 vanilla OPSD 的惩罚不足与奖励过度问题，实现了更强且更稳定的推理性能，且无需引入高方差统计或复杂超参数。

title: A new design of a fall detection system integrating landmark identification and deep learning techniques
summary: This article introduces an innovative system that integrates landmark identification with deep learning to enhance fall detection accuracy and reliability. By utilizing advanced computer vision techniques, such as Media Pipe for spatial recognition, the system effectively differentiates between routine movements and actual falls. The integration of landmarks with a deep learning prediction algorithm minimizes false alarms, ensuring timely responses to genuine falls. Comprehensive experimentation underscores the system's versatility across various scenarios, emphasizing its potential to improve safety and independence for older adults. The training process demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy, stabilizing by the 40th cycle, while error rates decline significantly during the initial cycles. Real-time experiments, involving both male and female participants aged 8 to 50, recorded a remarkable 95% detection rate of falls, demonstrating the system's effectiveness and promising future applications in elder care and smart health monitoring environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将关键点识别与深度学习相融合的跌倒检测系统，利用MediaPipe进行空间识别以区分日常动作与真实跌倒，实时实验检测率达95%。
AI.motivation: 提升跌倒检测的准确性与可靠性，降低误报，保障老年人安全并增强其独立性，服务于养老照护与智能健康监测场景。
AI.method: 整合计算机视觉关键技术（MediaPipe）实现人体关键点/空间识别，并将关键点与深度学习预测算法相结合，用于区分常规动作与真实跌倒；通过系统化实验验证多场景适用性。
AI.result: 训练过程中准确率稳步上升并在第40个周期趋于稳定，错误率在初期周期显著下降；涉及8至50岁男女参与者的实时实验取得95%的跌倒检测率。
AI.conclusion: 关键点识别与深度学习的融合可有效提升跌倒检测性能并抑制误报，系统具备跨场景适应性，在老年照护与智能健康监测领域具有良好应用前景。

title: CASE: Cost-Aware Stopping for Efficient Long-Video Agents
summary: Long-video agents can actively gather question-relevant evidence, but they typically leave a central decision implicit: when has the agent seen enough to answer? We propose CASE, a plug-in termination framework that frames this decision as policy-conditioned sequential stopping. At each causal checkpoint, CASE combines an auxiliary multiple-choice assessment of accumulated evidence with the host agent's execution state. From complete native trajectories, we construct a cost-aware target that compares answering now with stopping later along the same search path, accounting jointly for answer correctness and the full cost of continued reasoning. A lightweight Ridge regressor learns this decision gap and produces STOP/CONTINUE decisions. We evaluate three vision-language models with VideoSeek and AVP. On Video-MME, end-to-end accuracy changes by +0.67 percentage points on average while CASE reduces model-token use by 53.63%. The same frozen policies then transfer zero-shot to LongVideoBench and MLVU, with end-to-end accuracy changes of +3.38 and +4.58 points while saving 58.78% and 51.28% of model tokens, respectively. Across all agent-model-benchmark combinations, CASE attains the highest accuracy-efficiency Pareto-frontier coverage among the compared stopping methods (83.3%) at the selected operating points. Online execution preserves this favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off and additionally reduces measured runtime by 54.1% on average. CASE provides a plug-in termination framework for long-video reasoning agents, enabling them to decide when further evidence acquisition is no longer worthwhile.

AI.tldr: 提出CASE——一种即插即用的长视频智能体终止决策框架，将"何时停止"建模为策略条件下的序贯停止问题，兼顾正确率与推理成本。
AI.motivation: 长视频智能体虽能主动收集与问题相关的证据，但通常缺少一个核心决策机制：判断已积累证据是否充分到足以作答，往往依赖隐式或固定策略，导致过度推理与算力浪费。
AI.method: 在因果检查点处，结合对已积累证据的辅助多项选择评估与宿主智能体的执行状态；从完整原生轨迹构建成本感知目标，比较"当前作答"与"沿同一搜索路径继续"的收益，联合建模答案正确性与继续推理的完整成本；用轻量Ridge回归器学习该决策差距，输出STOP/CONTINUE。
AI.result: 在Video-MME上，端到端准确率平均变化+0.67个百分点，模型token使用减少53.63%；冻结策略零样本迁移至LongVideoBench与MLVU，准确率分别变化+3.38与+4.58个百分点，token节省58.78%与51.28%；在所有智能体-模型-基准组合中，精度-效率Pareto前沿覆盖率最高（83.3%）；在线执行保持有利权衡并将实测运行时平均降低54.1%。
AI.conclusion: CASE为长视频推理智能体提供了一个通用即插即用的终止框架，使其能判断何时进一步获取证据已不再值得，在几乎不损失甚至提升准确率的同时显著降低token消耗与运行时。

title: Discrete Action Matching: Learning Stochastic Dynamics from Samples via State Graphs
summary: Learning population dynamics from unpaired temporal marginals is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires structural assumptions on the underlying dynamics. We introduce $\textit{Discrete Action Matching}$ (DAM), a finite-state counterpart of Action Matching based on discrete Wasserstein geometry. For a prescribed marginal path and transport geometry, we derive an action-minimization objective for its canonical minimum-kinetic-energy current. Our key observation is that the density dependence of the discrete action reduces to neighboring density ratios. Along an empirical interpolation of the snapshots, DAM first estimates these ratios and then learns an action potential. The learned fields also define a graph-supported Markov sampler. Experiments on controlled synthetic dynamics and real mouse gastrulation data evaluate marginal reconstruction and interpolation. Additional experiments approximate numerical surface-transport paths from paired samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出离散作用匹配（Discrete Action Matching, DAM），基于离散 Wasserstein 几何，从无配对时间边缘分布中学习种群动力学。通过将离散作用对密度的依赖化简为相邻密度比，DAM 先估计密度比再学习作用势，同时得到图支撑的马尔可夫采样器。
AI.motivation: 从无配对的时间边缘分布学习种群动力学是一个不适定逆问题，需要引入对底层动力学的结构假设。现有方法（如连续域作用匹配）不直接适用于有限状态空间，因此需要构建离散情形的对应框架。
AI.method: 提出 Discrete Action Matching（DAM），即 Action Matching 的有限状态版本，建立在离散 Wasserstein 几何之上。对给定的边缘路径与传输几何，为其规范的最小动能流导出作用最小化目标。核心观察是离散作用对密度的依赖可化简为相邻密度比。在快照的经验插值上，DAM 先估计这些密度比，再学习作用势，所得场同时定义图支撑的马尔可夫采样器。
AI.result: 在受控合成动力学和真实小鼠原肠胚形成数据上评估了边缘重建与插值；额外实验从配对样本近似数值表面传输路径。
AI.conclusion: DAM 为有限状态下的种群动力学学习提供了基于离散 Wasserstein 几何的作用最小化框架，兼具边缘重建、插值与图支撑马尔可夫采样能力，并在合成与真实生物数据上得到验证。

title: Vision-enabled detection of safety helmet compliance in construction zones
summary: In the rapidly evolving field of construction management, worker safety remains a top priority. This paper introduces an innovative vision-based system for real-time detection of helmet compliance, specifically designed for construction sites, utilizing advanced computer vision techniques and machine learning algorithms within the YOLO (you only look once) framework. Our system leverages high-resolution video feeds from strategically positioned cameras to monitor adherence to safety regulations regarding helmet usage. By employing deep learning methodologies, the system effectively identifies individuals not wearing helmets, thereby significantly mitigating the risk of head injuries among workers. Our training and validation results revealed an impressive precision exceeding 97% at mAP@0.5 for both helmeted and non-helmeted individuals. Furthermore, our experiments demonstrate exceptional detection accuracy, demonstrating the system's resilience under varying lighting conditions and diverse worker movements. The consistent decrease in loss and improvement in metrics throughout training validates the effectiveness of the YOLOv8 model in enhancing recognition performance. The implications of this research extend beyond mere regulatory compliance, opening avenues for innovative applications in occupational safety management. This study highlights the critical role of technology in protecting lives and lays the groundwork for future advancements in smart construction environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于YOLOv8的视觉实时安全帽佩戴检测系统，用于工地安全合规监测；在自建训练与验证集上，戴帽与未戴帽目标的mAP@0.5精度均超过97%，并在不同光照与工人运动条件下表现出较强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 建筑行业工作危险性高，头部伤害风险突出；传统人工巡查安全帽佩戴情况效率低、覆盖有限，难以满足实时监管需求。因此需要一种可自动、实时识别未佩戴安全帽人员的视觉系统，以降低头部伤害风险并提升职业安全管理水平。
AI.method: 采用基于YOLO框架的计算机视觉与深度学习方案，具体以YOLOv8模型为核心。利用布设在工地关键位置的高分辨率摄像头视频流作为输入，通过目标检测识别戴安全帽与未戴安全帽的人员，实现对安全帽佩戴合规性的实时监控。模型经训练与验证评估，采用mAP@0.5与损失变化等指标衡量性能，并测试其在光照变化和工人不同运动状态下的检测表现。
AI.result: 训练与验证结果显示，对戴安全帽和未戴安全帽两类目标，mAP@0.5精度均超过97%；实验表明检测精度较高，在变化光照条件与多样工人运动情形下仍具鲁棒性。训练过程中损失持续下降、各项指标持续提升，验证了YOLOv8在提升识别性能方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明基于YOLOv8的视觉检测系统可有效实现工地安全帽佩戴的实时合规监测，其意义不仅限于满足监管要求，还为职业安全管理中的创新应用提供可能。研究强调技术在保障生命安全中的关键作用，并为未来智慧工地环境的发展奠定基础。

title: PharmAgent: Constraint-Aware Search with Frozen Language Models for Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization must improve target activity and satisfy developability constraints within limited evaluation budgets. Classical methods require tailored rules or training to incorporate chemical instructions and property feedback. Frozen language models can condition edits on this information, but need explicit constraint control and relevant experience. We therefore present PharmAgent, a constraint-aware molecular search method driven by adaptive external state. Its Lagrangian controller translates violations in accepted states into accumulated constraint pressure, keeping this history separate from current property measurements. Structure-indexed replay complements this feedback with relevant evaluated transitions that guide subsequent proposals. As a curriculum progressively activates constraints, candidates and the incumbent are compared under the same current objective, and the accepted state determines the next multiplier update. We derive an exact identity that characterizes how accepted-state violations accumulate in the controller's multipliers. Across five tasks with five independent runs, PharmAgent achieves a summed area under the target-score curves (AUC) of 3.9208 in target-only search, improving over MOLLEO by 37.3%. With online constraints, it achieves a property-adjusted AUC of 0.7076, improving over the strongest online baseline, ExLLM, by 53.8%. These results rank first among all evaluated methods in both target-only and constraint-aware search. The online comparison covers all five baseline frameworks. The full system leads every ablation variant in target quality, property-adjusted performance, and Pareto hypervolume. All five molecular cases reach feasible final states, documenting target gains and trade-offs.

AI.tldr: PharmAgent：一种基于自适应外部状态的约束感知分子搜索方法，通过拉格朗日控制器、结构索引回放与课程式约束激活，在有限评估预算下实现分子优化，性能显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 分子优化需在有限评估预算内提升目标活性并满足可开发性约束。经典方法需定制规则或训练才能融入化学指令与性质反馈；冻结语言模型虽能以此条件化编辑，但缺乏显式约束控制与相关经验。
AI.method: 提出PharmAgent，由自适应外部状态驱动。拉格朗日控制器将已接受状态中的违约转化为累积约束压力，并与当前性质测量分离；结构索引回放提供相关已评估转移引导后续提议；课程式逐步激活约束，候选与当前解在同一目标下比较，接受状态决定下一步乘子更新。并推导刻画接受状态违约在乘子中累积的精确恒等式。
AI.result: 在五任务五独立运行中，仅目标搜索的累计AUC达3.9208，较MOLLEO提升37.3%；在线约束下性质调整AUC为0.7076，较最强在线基线ExLLM提升53.8%。两类搜索均排名第一，在线比较覆盖全部五个基线框架；完整系统在目标质量、性质调整性能与Pareto超体积上均优于所有消融变体，五个分子案例均达可行终态。
AI.conclusion: PharmAgent通过约束感知的自适应外部状态、拉格朗日乘子累积与结构索引回放，在仅目标与约束感知两类分子搜索中均取得领先性能，并验证了各组件贡献与可行终态的达成。

title: ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection
summary: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出ReDiffNet，一种以模态可靠性为条件的差分表征网络，用于低光UAV RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测，在DroneVehicle与VEDAI上分别取得85.3%和73.9%的mAP50。
AI.motivation: 低光UAV RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测对照明变化、车灯眩光、局部阴影与热响应退化敏感，导致模态可靠性在空间上分布不均；同时车辆视觉尺度小，进一步削弱边界、方向线索与热响应。因此，如何依据局部模态可靠性选择可信观测，并在模态偏好模糊区域挖掘互补判别信息，是构建有效多模态表征的关键。
AI.method: ReDiffNet以模态可靠性同时引导证据选择与互补恢复：1）退化感知可靠性学习，估计相对空间可靠性；2）不确定性引导的差分恢复，利用跨模态差异恢复模糊区域的互补线索；3）可靠性条件重建，将保留证据与恢复证据整合为统一表征。
AI.result: 在DroneVehicle与VEDAI数据集上分别达到85.3%与73.9%的mAP50，验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以局部模态可靠性为条件、结合差分恢复的多模态表征策略，可有效缓解空间变化的模态可靠性问题与小目标定向检测困难，提升低光UAV RGB-红外车辆检测性能。

title: A Three-Dimensional Reverse-Projection Method for Sparse Point Cloud Completion and Its Application to High-Speed Train Nose Reconstruction
summary: Holes in LiDAR scans of environments with glass windows remain an unresolved problem in three-dimensional reconstruction. This study presents a pipeline for point cloud acquisition, filtering, completion, and surface reconstruction to address sparse sampling and missing window regions in scans of a high-speed train nose. FAST-LIVO2 provides the initial point cloud through multisensor odometry and mapping, and moving least squares (MLS) smooths the observations. We then introduce three-axis projection-based subdivision and interpolation with reverse hole boundary identification, referred to as three-axis reverse completion. The method interpolates missing regions from observations around each hole. Greedy projection triangulation, Poisson surface reconstruction, and a Marching Cubes-based pipeline generate meshes from the completed point cloud. Experiments on a proportionally scaled display model of a high-speed train nose show that the proposed method fills missing point cloud regions around the glass windows. Under the evaluation setting used in this study, greedy projection triangulation yields lower geometric distance errors than the other two reconstruction pipelines. The pipeline supports non-contact digital modeling of train nose geometry and provides a practical approach to reconstructing objects with glass windows.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一套面向含玻璃窗高速列车头部的点云获取-滤波-补全-曲面重建流水线，采用"三轴反向补全"方法填补玻璃窗区域的缺失点云，并通过实验比较三种网格重建方法的几何误差。
AI.motivation: 含玻璃窗环境的LiDAR扫描存在孔洞问题，是三维重建中尚未解决的难题；高速列车头部扫描中存在稀疏采样与玻璃窗区域点云缺失，需要非接触式数字化建模手段予以弥补。
AI.method: 流水线包含四个环节：采用FAST-LIVO2通过多传感器里程计与建图获得初始点云；使用移动最小二乘（MLS）平滑观测；提出基于三轴投影的细分与插值方法，结合反向孔洞边界识别（即"三轴反向补全"），从每个孔洞周边的观测插值缺失区域；最后用贪婪投影三角化、Poisson曲面重建及基于Marching Cubes的流水线分别生成网格。
AI.result: 在按比例缩放的高速列车头部展示模型上实验，所提方法成功填补了玻璃窗周围缺失的点云区域；在本研究的评价设置下，贪婪投影三角化的几何距离误差低于另外两种重建流水线。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线支持列车头部几何的非接触式数字建模，为重建含玻璃窗物体提供了一种实用方法。

title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
summary: Computer-use agents need to capture procedural knowledge of how people use software. User telemetry offers a scalable source of this knowledge. However, learning reusable skills from these logs requires addressing three challenges: (1) Goal Underspecification, since logs do not record the goal behind each action; (2) Non-Replayability, since past activity cannot be replayed to evaluate skill updates; and (3) Interleaved Trajectories, since logs may mix several tasks without marking their boundaries. To address these, we introduce TeleTune, a framework for learning a textual skill library from offline logs without recorded goals, cannot be replayed during optimization, and may interleave tasks. TeleTune uses action-prediction errors on logged trajectories to propose library edits and keep only those that improve held-out action-prediction accuracy, which we call skill-guided progress. The learned workflows also enable retrieval of demonstrations that cover the subgoals of a new task. At test time, the agent is provided with the learned library and the workflow-based retrieved demonstrations. Experiments on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web show that TeleTune outperforms random retrieval, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and their combination. We find that the best baseline varies by setting, whereas TeleTune achieves average success rates of 77.1% and 80.6%, respectively, improving over the strongest baseline on each benchmark by 6.7% and 7.7%. Under the heaviest perturbation of the WorkArena training data,TeleTune keeps the highest average success rate at 68.5%, 6.3% above the strongest baseline. Our analyses show (1) skill optimization and workflow-based retrieval are complementary, (2) optimizing on fixed logs costs 5 to 75 times fewer tokens than validating the same edits with live episodes, (3) skill-guided progress tracks the live success rate.

AI.tldr: TeleTune：从不可重放的离线用户日志中学习文本化技能库，用动作预测误差提出并筛选技能编辑，兼顾技能优化与工作流检索，在WorkArena和Online-Mind2Web上显著超越随机检索与AWM等基线。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体需要掌握人们操作软件的程序性知识，用户遥测日志是可扩展的来源。但从日志中学习可复用技能面临三大挑战：目标欠明确（日志未记录动作背后的目标）、不可重放（无法重放历史活动来评估技能更新）、轨迹交错（日志可能混合多个任务且无边界标记）。
AI.method: 提出TeleTune框架，在无目标记录、不可重放、任务可能交错的离线日志上学习文本技能库。核心是用日志轨迹上的动作预测误差来提议技能库编辑，只保留能提升留出集动作预测准确率（称为skill-guided progress）的编辑。学得的工作流还可用于检索覆盖新任务子目标的演示；测试时向智能体提供学习到的技能库与基于工作流检索的演示。
AI.result: 在WorkArena与Online-Mind2Web上，TeleTune优于随机检索、Agent Workflow Memory（AWM）及二者组合；最强基线随设定变化，而TeleTune平均成功率分别为77.1%和80.6%，较各基准最强基线提升6.7%和7.7%。在WorkArena训练数据最重扰动下，TeleTune保持最高平均成功率68.5%，高出最强基线6.3%。分析表明：技能优化与工作流检索互补；在固定日志上优化的token消耗比用实时回合验证同样编辑少5至75倍；skill-guided progress能跟踪实时成功率。
AI.conclusion: TeleTune表明，无需目标标注、无需重放、且任务交错的离线用户日志可用于学习可复用文本技能库，且技能优化与基于工作流的检索具有互补性；基于动作预测误差的离线优化是低成本且与实时成功率一致的技能筛选信号，为计算机使用智能体的程序性知识获取提供了可扩展路径。

title: How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark
summary: Backtests of LLM trading agents often assume that every order fills at the closing price. We ask whether this choice changes only reported returns or also the order of the agents. Five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines trade the same synthetic price paths under six execution settings, from near-ideal fills to latency, spread, participation, and impact stresses. The main experiment contains $2{,}462$ runs with matched decision frequencies and paired market paths. On the compressed two-asset board, agreement between the near-ideal and default-stress rankings falls to Kendall $τ_b=0.21$ in the high-volatility regime, compared with $0.82$ in the calm regime. The seed-bootstrap intervals, $[0.00,0.52]$ and $[0.48,0.94]$, are wide and overlap. On a fixed 11-policy board, agreement rises from 0.24 with two assets to 0.85 with ten; the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from the wider settings we tested. Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized. The experiment does not compare LLM trading skill. It shows that, on a short horizon, an execution convention can become part of the benchmark's headline. Execution assumptions and rank stability should be reported alongside returns.

AI.tldr: 在合成价格路径上，用5个LLM信号策略与7个经典基线在6种执行设定下做2462次配对回测，发现执行假设不仅改变收益，还会改变策略排名：高波动下近理想与默认压力设定的排名一致性仅Kendall τ_b=0.21（平静期为0.82），且资产数量从2增到10时一致性由0.24升至0.85。
AI.motivation: LLM交易智能体的回测常假设每笔订单以收盘价成交，作者想检验这一执行惯例是仅影响报告收益，还是会改变策略之间的相对排序，即执行假设是否会成为基准头条结论的一部分。
