AI.method: 设计匹配决策频率与配对市场路径的合成价格路径实验，让5个提示式LLM信号策略与7个经典基线在6种执行设定（从近理想成交到延迟、买卖价差、参与率与市场冲击压力）下交易；主实验共2462次运行，采用Kendall τ_b衡量排名一致性，并用种子自助法给出区间；同时在2资产压缩板与固定11策略板上改变资产数量。
AI.result: 2资产压缩板上，高波动区制下近理想与默认压力设定的排名一致性降至Kendall τ_b=0.21，平静区制为0.82；自助区间分别为[0.00,0.52]与[0.48,0.94]，较宽且重叠。固定11策略板上，一致性随资产数从2增至10由0.24升至0.85，2资产点估计与更宽设定差异明显。排名变化与换手率相关，且与买入持有基线的比较还取决于该锚的初始化方式。
AI.conclusion: 该实验不用于比较LLM的交易能力，而是表明在短周期上，执行惯例可能进入基准的头条结论。因此执行假设与排名稳定性应与收益一并报告。

title: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
summary: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察了后训练量化VLA策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化性，发现量化策略在分布内性能不降的情况下对细微环境变化变得脆弱，且动作偏差集中于少数rollout状态。为此提出PIVOT-Q：一种面向脆弱状态的On-Policy蒸馏框架，仅用7.4%的蒸馏预算即优于全状态蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化虽在标准评测下能保持VLA性能，但其是否保留全精度模型的鲁棒性与泛化性尚不明确；既有恢复方法多采用全局蒸馏，未区分状态的重要性差异。
AI.method: 提出PIVOT-Q（Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning），一种脆弱性感知的On-Policy Distillation框架：以冻结的全精度策略为教师，在量化学生rollout中筛选脆弱状态，用短视界上的折扣累积偏差识别脆弱状态，施加阶段平衡的稀疏监督，并用Behavioral Anchor防止不必要改动。
AI.result: 在七种LIBERO-Plus环境变体上，PIVOT-Q在多种VLA骨干与量化方法上均实现一致的鲁棒性恢复，所有设置下持续优于全状态蒸馏，且仅使用其7.4%的状态级蒸馏预算。
AI.conclusion: 量化VLA策略的鲁棒性恢复需要针对脆弱状态的选择性干预而非全局蒸馏；教师指导效果依赖偏差大小（高偏差状态促进泛化、低偏差状态可能损害泛化），PIVOT-Q据此实现了高效且有效的后量化恢复。

title: Controllable Road Marking Generation
summary: Lane and road markings provide critical guidance for vehicle navigation and multi-agent coordination, yet authoring them at scale remains a manual workflow that limits quantitative analysis and scenario testing. We introduce Controllable Road Marking Generation, which synthesizes a missing center-region marking layout from a drivable-area mask, optional outer-ring markings, and a textual description. Our benchmark uses deterministic, metadata-derived prompts and three output channels: lane dividers, road dividers, and pedestrian crossings. We develop a conditional bird's-eye-view (BEV) pipeline that combines (i) a text-conditioned latent rectified-flow DiT trained with a topology-aware auxiliary loss, (ii) Gaussian-blurred training targets that stabilize learning of thin, sparse markings, and (iii) Structured Gaussian Render (SGR), a training-free post-process that recovers crisp divider geometry by extracting polylines, fitting cubic Bézier curves, and re-rendering them as anisotropic super-Gaussian primitives. On 4,597 Argoverse~2 test tiles, our system achieves Buffered F1 of 80.8 and clDice of 50.2, compared with 38.8 and 24.6 for an adapted state-of-the-art mask-refinement baseline. On Waymo dataset, it yields 88.0 Buffered F1 and 66.2 clDice. Component ablations show complementary connectivity gains from topology-aware supervision and SGR. Text-editing experiments reveal that stronger guidance improves edit success but also increases changes to non-target structures. We see this framework as a step toward simulation-ready road-marking variation, automated map completion, and early-stage infrastructure design exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出可控道路标线生成任务：由可行驶区域掩码、可选外环标线及文本描述合成缺失的中心区域标线布局，基于条件BEV流水线在Argoverse 2与Waymo上显著优于掩码精修基线。
AI.motivation: 车道与道路标线对车辆导航和多智能体协同至关重要，但大规模标注仍依赖人工流程，限制了定量分析与场景测试。因此需要可自动合成标线布局的方法，以支持仿真、地图补全和早期基础设施设计探索。
AI.method: 任务定义为从可行驶区域掩码、可选外环标线和文本描述生成缺失的中心区域标线，输出车道分隔线、道路分隔线与人行横道三个通道，采用确定性、元数据派生的提示构建基准。方法为条件BEV流水线，包含：(i) 文本条件潜空间rectified-flow DiT，配合拓扑感知辅助损失训练；(ii) 高斯模糊训练目标以稳定细稀疏标线学习；(iii) 免训练后处理SGR（Structured Gaussian Render），通过提取折线、拟合三次贝塞尔曲线并以各向异性超高斯基元重渲染，恢复清晰分隔线几何。
AI.result: 在4,597个Argoverse 2测试瓦片上，Buffered F1为80.8、clDice为50.2，而适配的最先进掩码精修基线仅为38.8和24.6；在Waymo数据集上达到88.0 Buffered F1与66.2 clDice。消融实验表明拓扑感知监督与SGR在连通性上具有互补增益。文本编辑实验显示更强引导提升编辑成功率，但也增加对非目标结构的改动。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为面向仿真的道路标线变体生成、自动化地图补全及早期基础设施设计探索迈出一步，但文本引导强度与结构保持之间存在权衡。

title: AI Safety via Debate is Compromised by Cognitive Biases
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has played a central role in making large language models responsive to human instructions. However, human evaluators often favor flattering or persuasive responses over truthful ones, creating incentives for models to appeal to evaluators at the expense of accuracy. AI safety via debate has been proposed as a way to improve the supervision of language models: in this paradigm, two agents argue opposing positions and challenge each other's claims, potentially exposing falsehoods to the adjudicator. A central premise of AI safety via debate is that truthful arguments are easier to defend than false ones under adversarial scrutiny. In this work, we investigate whether this advantage persists when debaters use rhetorical strategies that exploit biases in human judgment. Inspired by competitive debate, we construct 68 LLM-generated dialogues about detective mysteries with known culprits, spanning four interventions: anchoring, fallacy oversight, pro-jargon, and verbosity. We apply each intervention to either the side advocating for the true culprit or the side advocating for an innocent suspect, allowing us to distinguish influence on adjudication from correctness. In a study with 369 participants, we find that, pooled across bias types, these interventions significantly shift judgments toward the manipulated side. These findings expose a vulnerability in debate-based supervision: human adjudication is sensitive to manipulative rhetorical strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验"辩论式AI安全监督"中真实论证是否必然优于虚假论证，发现当辩手使用操纵性修辞策略时，人类裁决者的判断会显著偏向被操纵一方。
AI.motivation: RLHF使大模型遵循人类指令，但人类评估者常偏好谄媚或有说服力的回答而非真实的回答，从而激励模型牺牲准确性去迎合评估者。基于辩论的AI安全监督被视为改进监督的途径，其核心前提是：在对抗性审视下真实论证比虚假论证更容易辩护。本文旨在检验当辩手利用人类判断偏差的修辞策略时，这一优势是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 受竞技辩论启发，构建68个由LLM生成、具有已知凶手的侦探谜题对话，涵盖四类干预：锚定效应（anchoring）、谬误监督（fallacy oversight）、术语灌输（pro-jargon）、冗长性（verbosity）。将每种干预应用于"主张真凶"一方或"主张无辜嫌疑人"一方，以区分对裁决的影响与正确性。共369名参与者参与实验。
AI.result: 在合并所有偏差类型后，这些干预策略显著地将参与者的判断推向被操纵的一方。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了基于辩论的监督机制存在脆弱性：人类裁决易受操纵性修辞策略影响，真实论证未必在对抗性辩论中占据优势。

title: InteractionBench: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Streaming Video Systems
summary: A video assistant must speak when its instruction warrants a response and stay silent otherwise. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates this decision for the complete system of model, memory, and response controller. InteractionBench covers query responses, event triggers, and ongoing updates in 1,060 interactions over 812 videos, with 69 negative streams and 53 suites that pair counted events with look-alike near misses. It scores content accuracy, timing accuracy, and silence compliance on the video clock. Timely speech costs silence across systems. Polled Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 77.8 timing accuracy but 10.9 silence compliance. A native real-time interaction system reaches 29.2 silence compliance at 66.8 timing accuracy, yet emits on 89.9% of negative streams. No open-weight system clears a third of the near-miss suites. Fewer replies help only when chosen, as random deletion merely trades timing for silence. Offline scores miss these failures and mispredict online behavior. Adding restraint is costly, as the native system's controller adds little by itself and agentic systems add it only at about 30 s per poll.Project page: https://www.enxinsong.com/projects/interactionbench/ Code: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/InteractionBench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/InteractionBench/InteractionBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InteractionBench，一个评估"模型+记忆+响应控制器"完整系统"该说才说、不该说则静默"能力的基准，覆盖 812 个视频、1,060 次交互，从内容准确性、时序准确性与静默合规性三方面打分，揭示现有系统在"适时发言"与"保持沉默"之间的严重权衡。
AI.motivation: 视频助手应在其指令要求回应时发言、否则保持沉默，但现有评测普遍缺少对这一"发言/沉默"决策能力的系统衡量，尤其缺少对近失误（near miss）事件与负样本流（negative streams）的测试，导致离线分数无法预测在线行为。
AI.method: 构建 InteractionBench 基准，包含 1,060 次交互、812 个视频、69 条负样本流与 53 个套件（将计数事件与形似的近失误配对）；以视频时钟为基准，同时评测内容准确性、时序准确性和静默合规性；对轮询式模型（Qwen3-VL-8B）、原生实时交互系统以及 agentic 系统进行对比实验，并检验随机删减回复的效果。
AI.result: 及时发言以牺牲静默为代价：轮询式 Qwen3-VL-8B 时序准确率 77.8%，但静默合规仅 10.9%；原生实时系统静默合规 29.2%、时序准确率 66.8%，却在 89.9% 的负样本流上误发出声；无开源权重系统能通过三分之一以上的近失误套件；随机删除回复只是以时序换静默，仅在"有选择地少回"时才有益；离线分数无法预测上述在线失败。此外，加入克制能力代价高：原生系统控制器自身贡献有限，agentic 系统每次轮询约需 30 秒。
AI.conclusion: InteractionBench 揭示当前视频交互系统在"适时发言"与"保持沉默"之间难以兼顾，离线指标与在线行为存在系统性偏差；提升克制能力需要专门设计且成本高昂，亟需面向完整系统（含控制器与记忆）的在线评测范式。

title: Hallucination Across the Reasoning Lifecycle: Interface Visibility, Causal Evidence, and Release Control in Large Reasoning Models
comment: 35 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Electronic supplementary materials S1-S7 are included as ancillary files
summary: Reasoning errors can propagate into later decisions and memory. This survey synthesizes 312 papers and first-party reports on text-based reasoning hallucinations around three questions: what evidence is observable, what study designs establish, and which corrective actions the evidence supports. UIPCA records unsupported premises (U), invalid inferences (I), dependent reuse (P), visible answer-trace consistency (C), and action-policy failures (A). Across 58 reviewed sources, no comparison establishes that a specified intervention improves reasoning while reducing factual reliability under matched conditions. The synthesis connects diagnosis to verification, repair, selective release, and persistent-state control across memory, tools, and training feedback.

AI.tldr: 该综述综合312篇论文与一手报告，围绕可观测证据、研究设计可确立的结论及证据支持的纠正措施三个问题，系统梳理文本推理幻觉；并提出UIPCA记录框架，涵盖无支撑前提、无效推断、依赖复用、可见答案-轨迹一致性与动作策略失效。
AI.motivation: 推理错误会传播到后续决策与记忆中，因此需要系统梳理文本推理幻觉的可观测证据、研究设计效力与可支持的纠正措施，以连接诊断与验证、修复、选择性发布及跨记忆、工具与训练反馈的持久状态控制。
AI.method: 综述方法：综合312篇论文与一手报告；在58个受审来源中检查比较性证据；提出UIPCA编码框架，分别记录无支撑前提（U）、无效推断（I）、依赖复用（P）、可见答案-轨迹一致性（C）与动作策略失效（A）。
AI.result: 在58个受审来源中，没有任何比较能够确立：在匹配条件下，某一特定干预在提升推理能力的同时降低了事实可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 综述将幻觉诊断与验证、修复、选择性发布以及跨记忆、工具与训练反馈的持久状态控制相连接，强调证据支持范围有限且需匹配条件下的严格比较。

title: Advectra: Asymmetric Latent Transport for Non-Stationary Physics
summary: Many latent neural operators represent input and output fields in a stationary latent chart. In particular, common latent routing mechanisms use fixed or shared assignment weights for feature projection and reconstruction, limiting their ability to model transport-dominated systems where coherent structures move relative to fixed coordinate frames. We propose Advectra, a transport-aware latent operator that introduces a regularized kinematic coordinate map to decouple source and target coordinate systems. This yields an approximately co-moving latent reference frame and enables asymmetric feature aggregation and reconstruction. Combined with a geometry-aware ordering mechanism for state-space models, Advectra captures advective dynamics while maintaining stable global interactions. Advectra achieves the best performance among evaluated geometry-constrained and form-free baselines on advection-dominated benchmarks, including passive scalar transport in Navier--Stokes flows and Rayleigh--Taylor instability, while demonstrating strong generalization on real-world engineering tasks. These results highlight the benefit of explicit moving-frame structure in neural operators for non-stationary physics.

AI.tldr: 提出Advectra，一种输运感知隐式算子，通过正则化运动学坐标映射解耦源/目标坐标系，实现近似共动隐式参考系与非对称特征聚合重建，在平流主导基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式神经算子多在静止隐式坐标图中表示输入输出场，其隐式路由机制采用固定或共享的分配权重进行特征投影与重建，难以建模相干结构相对固定坐标框架运动的输运主导系统。
AI.method: 引入正则化运动学坐标映射，解耦源坐标系与目标坐标系，形成近似共动的隐式参考框架，支持非对称特征聚合与重建；并结合面向状态空间模型的几何感知排序机制，在捕捉平流动力学的同时维持稳定的全局交互。
AI.result: 在平流主导基准（含Navier-Stokes流中的被动标量输运与Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性）上，Advectra优于所评估的几何约束基线与无形约束基线；在真实工程任务上亦表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了在神经算子中引入显式移动框架结构对非定常物理建模的收益。

title: OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies
summary: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM)，将有限基准测试中发现的注意力发散现象转化为运行时故障预警信号，在无需失败标注训练的情况下提前停止未知场景中的VLA策略故障。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略仅在少量标准指令基准上评估，而部署场景无法穷尽测试。作者希望把系统性测试与运行时保障连接起来：测试揭示成功与失败执行间的注意力差异，并利用该信号在有限测试集之外阻止失败。
AI.method: 通过动作模板与物体的成对组合生成场景化指令，并单独测试保持语义的改写指令。在每个动作查询处，将梯度加权视觉注意力通过物体掩码投影，并按指令角色分组比较。用动态时间规整（DTW）将注意力过程与成功参考对齐，再用成功回合上的保形校准（conformal calibration）设定持续偏差的早期停止阈值，名义误停目标α=0.05。
AI.result: 87个基准外案例在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA和π0.5上均暴露问题行为：无一完成24条可行指令，不可行或危险请求也触发行为替换。OGAM在四个策略上于20秒预算内以5–12秒中位时间停止87–100%的失败回合，观测误停率为3–5%，且无需失败标注训练。
AI.conclusion: 有限测试可识别出支持在线干预的注意力模式，使系统能在故障完全展开前介入；注意力监控将测试与运行时保障有效衔接。

title: A Spatiotemporal Semantic Importance-Guided Unified Compression and Editing Framework for AI-Generated Videos
summary: AI-generated videos are rapidly increasing in volume, duration, and resolution, creating growing demands for efficient storage and transmission. Unlike natural videos captured from the physical world, AI-generated videos are samples from a learned generative distribution, where semantic structures are critical to content consistency, while many local textures and stochastic details can be plausibly regenerated. This distinction suggests that compression should preserve semantically important spatiotemporal information rather than reconstruct every pixel of a particular generative sample. Beyond reconstruction, AI-generated videos also create a practical need for prompt-based editing, where users expect to modify generated content while preserving its original spatiotemporal semantics. Motivated by these observations, we propose a unified compression and editing framework for AI-generated videos that incorporates a frozen video generator as a reusable generative prior. Within this framework, we design three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques that respectively address what to transmit, how much to transmit, and how to use the transmitted side information. First, an innovation selection method projects the latent discrepancy using spatiotemporal semantic importance, so that the selected innovations prioritize semantic invariants over replaceable generative variations. Second, a frame-adaptive bit allocation method estimates the nonuniform semantic demands of latent frames and allocates more innovations to frames requiring stronger semantic preservation. Third, a unified reconstruction and editing method continuously adjusts the influence of the transmitted side information, enabling the same compressed representation to provide strong guidance for faithful reconstruction or serve as a flexible semantic anchor for structure-preserving prompt-driven editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向AI生成视频的统一压缩与编辑框架，以冻结的视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，并设计三项时空语义重要性引导技术，分别解决传输什么、传输多少以及如何使用边信息的问题。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频在数量、时长和分辨率上快速增长，带来存储与传输效率需求。与自然视频不同，AI生成视频是学习到的生成分布的样本：语义结构对内容一致性至关重要，而许多局部纹理和随机细节可以被合理再生成。因此压缩应保留语义重要的时空信息，而非重建特定生成样本的每个像素。此外，AI生成视频还存在基于提示词的编辑需求，用户希望修改生成内容同时保留原始时空语义。
AI.method: 提出面向AI生成视频的统一压缩与编辑框架，引入冻结的视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，并设计三项时空语义重要性引导技术：1）创新选择方法，利用时空语义重要性投影潜空间差异，使选中的创新优先保留语义不变量而非可替换的生成变化；2）帧自适应比特分配方法，估计潜帧的非均匀语义需求，为需要更强语义保留的帧分配更多创新；3）统一重建与编辑方法，连续调节传输边信息的影响，使同一压缩表示既能为忠实重建提供强引导，也能作为结构保持的提示驱动编辑的灵活语义锚点。
AI.result: 摘要为方法性描述，未给出具体实验数据或量化结果；其预期效果是提升AI生成视频的压缩效率，并支持基于提示词的语义保持编辑。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，针对AI生成视频的压缩与编辑可统一在一个生成先验驱动的框架下：通过按时空语义重要性选择与分配创新，并灵活调节边信息的影响，可同时服务于忠实重建和结构保持的提示驱动编辑。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Stable Temporal Abstraction for Language Model Agents
summary: Hierarchical reinforcement learning improves long-horizon control by organizing primitive actions around persistent subgoals and assigning credit at multiple temporal scales. Recent hierarchical language agents bring these benefits to interactive tasks by explicitly separating subgoal planning from action execution. We observe, however, that an explicit hierarchy does not by itself determine how stable the resulting temporal abstraction is: the learned boundary policy may replace the subgoal almost every turn, making it effectively transient, or retain a subgoal after it has stopped being appropriate. We call this temporal abstraction instability. We propose Stable Temporal Abstraction via Constrained Optimization (STAC), a constrained boundary-policy optimization method that represents premature replanning and stale persistence as constraint costs. STAC applies the resulting Lagrangian costs only to the sampled boundary decision, leaving the underlying algorithm's rewards, critic targets, subgoal advantages, and primitive-action advantages unchanged. Across two backbones and two benchmarks, STAC improves success over a strong hierarchical baseline by $8.1$ and $7.9$ points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen3-0.6B, and by $23.5$ and $15.8$ points with Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: 论文提出STAC方法，通过约束优化稳定层级语言智能体的时间抽象边界策略，在两个骨干模型和两个基准上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 层级强化学习通过子目标提升长时程控制，近期层级语言智能体将子目标规划与动作执行显式分离。但作者观察到显式层级本身并不能决定时间抽象的稳定性：边界策略可能每轮都替换子目标（过早重规划/瞬态），或在不适用时仍保留子目标（陈旧坚持），即"时间抽象不稳定"问题。
AI.method: 提出Stable Temporal Abstraction via Constrained Optimization (STAC)，一种约束边界策略优化方法。将过早重规划和陈旧坚持表示为约束代价，并将由此得到的拉格朗日代价仅应用于被采样的边界决策，保持底层算法的奖励、critic目标、子目标优势与原始动作优势不变。
AI.result: 在两个骨干模型和两个基准上，STAC较强层级基线提升显著：Qwen3-0.6B下ALFWorld提升8.1分、WebShop提升7.9分；Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct下分别提升23.5分和15.8分。
AI.conclusion: 显式层级结构不足以保证时间抽象的稳定性；通过约束优化对边界决策进行针对性调整，可在不干扰底层学习信号的前提下有效缓解时间抽象不稳定，带来一致且显著的性能提升。

title: METRO: Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator
summary: State-of-the-art neural operators scale to complex meshes via slice-and-process architectures, yet many rely on linear compatibility scores for latent tokenization. Under common feature normalization, such scores are equivalent to isotropic Euclidean clustering, while without normalization they induce unbounded linear decision regions. In both cases, they lack slice-specific anisotropic locality, which can lead to redundant and entangled latent slices. To address this, we propose Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO), a geometry-aware routing mechanism that replaces linear projection with a learnable Mahalanobis metric. By enabling each latent slice to learn a local anisotropic tensor, METRO shapes receptive fields into exponentially localized, oriented ellipsoids that naturally align with flow features like boundary layers and wakes. As a drop-in replacement, METRO yields consistent improvements across both Transformer and Mamba backbones. Empirically, our method achieves substantial performance gains on irregular domains, outperforming baselines on both standard PDE benchmarks and complex industrial design tasks. Finally, METRO exhibits enhanced robustness in out-of-distribution regimes across varying Reynolds numbers and geometric configurations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出METRO，一种用可学习马氏度量替代线性投影的几何感知路由机制，使每个潜在切片学习局部各向异性张量，形成指数局部化的定向椭球感受野，从而提升神经算子在复杂网格上的性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的先进神经算子通过切片处理架构扩展到复杂网格，但许多依赖线性兼容性分数进行潜在令牌化。在常见特征归一化下，这类分数等价于各向同性欧氏聚类；不归一化时则产生无界线性决策区域。两种情况都缺乏切片特定的各向异性局部性，导致潜在切片冗余且纠缠。
AI.method: 提出Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator（METRO），即度量增强的令牌路由算子。它是一种几何感知路由机制，用可学习的马氏度量（Mahalanobis metric）替代线性投影，使每个潜在切片能够学习局部各向异性张量，将感受野塑造为指数局部化、有方向的椭球，自然对齐边界层和尾流等流动特征。可作为即插即用模块替换现有组件。
AI.result: 作为即插即用替代方案，METRO在Transformer和Mamba两类骨干网络上均取得一致提升。在非规则域上获得显著性能增益，在标准PDE基准和复杂工业设计任务上均优于基线。此外，METRO在不同雷诺数和几何配置的分布外场景中表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: METRO通过引入可学习马氏度量实现几何感知的各向异性路由，克服了线性兼容性分数在局部性和决策区域上的局限，为复杂网格上的神经算子提供了通用、有效且鲁棒的改进方案。

title: Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADPO，一种无模型的扩散策略安全优化方法，结合预测性首次命中可达性估计与累积成本预算反馈，在十个连续控制安全任务上取得竞争性的奖励-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略虽能为连续控制强化学习提供表达力强的动作分布，但安全感知的在线扩散策略优化研究不足，尤其是无需显式动力学模型、仅利用预测性可达性信息的方法尚待探索。
AI.method: RADPO学习折扣首次命中可达性价值，捕捉成本事件的折扣风险并对较早发生的事件赋予更大权重，用该信号塑造奖励；另设类似对偶变量的乘子，依据实际回合成本相对于预设预算调整塑造强度；扩散演员通过对奖励评论家评分的候选动作进行加权去噪回归来改进。方法无需学习动力学模型、无需通过评论家求动作梯度，也无需对逆扩散采样器求导。
AI.result: 在十个连续控制安全任务上，RADPO取得有竞争力的奖励-成本权衡，在若干任务上相比基线大幅降低约束违反。理论上建立了可达性价值的性质，并证明累积可达性惩罚是未来折扣累积成本的保守代理。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实证分析表明，将可达性与累积预算反馈相结合，是构建安全感知扩散策略的可行途径。

title: FairRSFM: A Biome-Aware Benchmark and Debiasing Framework for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
summary: Remote sensing foundation models (RSFMs) are commonly evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide systematic performance disparities across ecological regions. We introduce FairRSFM, a biome-aware benchmark for evaluating ecological group robustness in RSFMs. FairRSFM maps georeferenced samples from 14 terrestrial biome classes into six ecologically meaningful macro-groups and evaluates models under a unified frozen-backbone evaluation protocol. The benchmark covers four downstream datasets: m-EuroSAT, m-BigEarthNet, m-SA-Crop-Type, and MMEarth20K with Dynamic World label maps. Using Prithvi-EO-2.0, SatMAE, and DOFA across three random seeds, we show that aggregate performance consistently masks biome-dependent disparities across architectures and tasks. For example, Prithvi-EO-2.0 reaches 90.98% overall macro-F1 on m-EuroSAT but a mean worst-group score of only 83.72%, while m-SA-Crop-Type drops from 27.30% overall mIoU to 18.47% in the Xeric and Mineralogical group. We further evaluate Biome-Orthogonal Linear Probing (BOLP), Dynamic Biome Reweighting (DBR), and GroupDRO as complementary mitigation baselines. Their effectiveness is model- and task-dependent; for example, BOLP improves Prithvi-EO-2.0 worst-group F1@opt on m-BigEarthNet from 46.12% to 50.27% without updating the RSFM backbone. FairRSFM provides a reusable protocol for diagnosing and mitigating ecological robustness gaps in remote sensing foundation models. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/aminurhossain/FairRSFM.

AI.tldr: 提出 FairRSFM：一种生物群落感知的遥感基础模型生态群体鲁棒性基准，揭示聚合指标掩盖的生物群落性能差异，并评估多种缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 遥感基础模型（RSFM）通常仅用聚合指标评估，这类指标会掩盖不同生态区域间的系统性性能差异，缺乏对生态群体鲁棒性的针对性诊断工具。
AI.method: FairRSFM 将 14 个陆地生物群落类的带地理坐标样本映射为 6 个生态宏观组，在统一冻结骨干评估协议下构建基准，涵盖 m-EuroSAT、m-BigEarthNet、m-SA-Crop-Type 及带 Dynamic World 标签图的 MMEarth20K 四个下游数据集；使用 Prithvi-EO-2.0、SatMAE、DOFA 三个模型在三个随机种子下评估，并比较 Biome-Orthogonal Linear Probing（BOLP）、Dynamic Biome Reweighting（DBR）与 GroupDRO 三种缓解基线。
AI.result: 聚合性能始终掩盖随架构与任务而变的生物群落相关差异，例如 Prithvi-EO-2.0 在 m-EuroSAT 整体 macro-F1 达 90.98%，但平均最差组仅 83.72%；m-SA-Crop-Type 整体 mIoU 由 27.30% 降至 Xeric and Mineralogical 组的 18.47%。缓解方法效果依赖模型与任务，如 BOLP 在 m-BigEarthNet 上将 Prithvi-EO-2.0 最差组 F1@opt 从 46.12% 提升至 50.27%，且无需更新 RSFM 骨干。
AI.conclusion: FairRSFM 提供了可复用协议，用于诊断并缓解遥感基础模型中的生态鲁棒性差距；代码与数据集已公开。

title: CodeForge-MA: Execution-Verified Multi-Agent Learning with Language-Conditioned LoRA for Multilingual Code Generation
summary: Large language models for code generation often fail on execution, multilingual coverage, and contamination control, especially under frozen backbone constraints. We present CodeForge-MA, a unified framework that improves code synthesis through a multi-agent data forge, execution verified reinforced instruction tuning, and a language conditioned mixture of LoRA adapters. Four specialized agents, Composer, Reviewer, Executor, and Curator, iteratively refine instruction code pairs, validate them with tests, and filter duplicates and benchmark leakage. During training, we combine masked supervised fine tuning with a test driven reinforcement objective to align generations with executable correctness. For the larger model, we use sparse expert routing over low rank adapters to improve cross language transfer while keeping the base model unchanged at inference. Experiments show that joint data, objective, and adapter design yields robust gains across programming languages.

AI.tldr: CodeForge-MA 通过多智能体数据锻造、执行验证强化指令微调与语言条件 LoRA 混合，在冻结基座约束下提升代码生成的执行正确性、多语言覆盖与去污染能力。
AI.motivation: 大模型代码生成在执行通过率、多语言覆盖和基准污染控制方面常表现不佳，且在冻结基座模型约束下改进尤为困难。
AI.method: 提出统一框架 CodeForge-MA，包含三部分：(1) 多智能体数据锻造：Composer、Reviewer、Executor、Curator 四个专用智能体迭代优化指令-代码对，用测试验证并过滤重复与基准泄漏样本；(2) 执行验证的强化指令微调：将掩码监督微调与测试驱动的强化学习目标结合，使生成对齐可执行正确性；(3) 语言条件 LoRA 混合：在较大模型上对低秩适配器采用稀疏专家路由，提升跨语言迁移，同时推理时保持基座模型不变。
AI.result: 实验表明，数据、训练目标与适配器三方面的联合设计可在多种编程语言上取得稳健的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化数据构造、训练目标与适配器结构是提升代码生成质量的有效途径，且无需改动基座模型即可实现推理阶段的部署友好性。

title: Private Component-by-Component Learning
summary: We study differentially private learning problems in the realizable setting, where a hypothesis is specified by $k$ components. A direct iteration of private component learners is obstructed by a simple difficulty: an approximate choice of the next component may destroy exact realizability of the labeled sample, even when the next component is locally accurate. We restore realizability using the LabelBoost procedure of Beimel, Nissim, and Stemmer [SODA '15, Algorithmica '21] and recycle data through two alternating reservoirs. The resulting learner, for a target privacy $\varepsilon$, pays only $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ overhead relative to the active sample requirement of a single component learning step at target accuracy $Θ(α/k)$. For learning $d$-dimensional halfspaces over a finite coordinate grid of size $L$, exact realizability makes the direct component-depth objective quasi-concave. Instantiating the framework with the IPConcave algorithm of Nissim, Tsfadia, and Yan [SODA '26] and with the quasi-concave optimizer of Cohen, Lyu, Nelson, Sarl'os, and Stemmer [STOC '23] yields a realizable sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot \min\{d^{2.5} \log^*L, \:\: d^{2.5} + d^{1.5} 2^{\log^*L}\}\right),$ which improves on the previously known bound of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot\min\{\frac{1}α\cdot d^{5.5}\log^*L,\:\: d^{2.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\right).$ We also apply the framework to Boolean compositions: given proper private learners for classes $H_1,\ldots,H_k$, we obtain a proper private learner for $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ for any fixed Boolean function $G:\{0,1\}^k\to\{0,1\}$. Compared with the closure theorem of Alon, Beimel, Moran, and Stemmer [COLT '20], this reduces the overhead on a common component sample bound from $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可实现设定下的差分隐私学习问题，通过LabelBoost恢复精确可实现性并配合双交替蓄水池回收数据，将多分量学习的隐私代价降至 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$，并在半空间学习与布尔组合上给出改进的样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在可实现设定下，假设由 $k$ 个分量构成，直接迭代调用隐私分量学习器会破坏带标签样本的精确可实现性：即便下一个分量局部准确，其近似选择也可能使精确可实现性失效。因此需要一种机制在迭代过程中恢复可实现性，并高效利用样本。
AI.method: 采用 Beimel、Nissim、Stemmer 的 LabelBoost 过程恢复精确可实现性，并通过两个交替蓄水池（two alternating reservoirs）回收数据，构建分量迭代学习框架。对有限坐标网格（大小 $L$）上的 $d$ 维半空间学习，利用精确可实现性使直接分量深度目标呈拟凹性，再分别实例化 IPConcave 算法与拟凹优化器。
AI.result: 目标隐私 $\varepsilon$ 下，框架相对单个分量学习步骤（目标精度 $\Theta(\alpha/k)$）的活跃样本需求仅付出 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ 开销。半空间学习得到可实现样本复杂度 $\widetilde{O}(\frac{1}{\varepsilon\alpha}\min\{d^{2.5}\log^* L,\ d^{2.5}+d^{1.5}2^{\log^* L}\})$，优于先前 $\widetilde{O}(\frac{1}{\varepsilon\alpha}\min\{\frac1\alpha d^{5.5}\log^* L,\ d^{2.5}2^{\log^* L}\})$。对布尔组合，给定 $H_1,\ldots,H_k$ 的正当隐私学习器，可为任意固定布尔函数 $G$ 构造 $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ 的正当隐私学习器，将公共分量样本界上的开销从 $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ 降至 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$。
AI.conclusion: 通过 LabelBoost 与双交替蓄水池恢复/维持精确可实现性，本文为可实现设定下的多分量隐私学习提供了统一框架，显著降低了隐私开销；该框架在半空间学习与布尔组合问题上均改进了先前已知样本复杂度，并将闭包定理的开销从线性 $k$ 改善至 $\sqrt{k}$ 量级。

title: EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables (11 pages main text, 4 pages appendix)
summary: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

AI.tldr: 提出EpicWorldModel，用流匹配目标训练随机JEPA世界模型，以流预测方差作为探索信号，提升部分可观测下的潜在规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于JEPA的潜在世界模型本质上是确定性的，在完全可观测场景中表现良好，但当历史观测与动作对应多种可能未来（如遮挡导致）时会失效，需要随机性建模能力。
AI.method: 联合训练EpicWorldModel预测器与其潜在表示空间，当条件历史中缺失目标相关场景内容时，用流匹配（flow-matching）目标直接预测多个潜在未来状态；并用流预测方差（与预测熵上界相关）作为探索引导信号，融入基于CEM的规划。
AI.result: 在潜在规划实验中取得最佳或同等性能，成功率相比LeWorldModel最高提升约22%。
AI.conclusion: 随机JEPA结合流匹配预测方差作为不确定性信号，可在部分可观测环境中兼顾目标达成与对遮挡目标可能区域的探索。

title: Gauss-Map Variation for Image Denoising: Geometric Analysis and an Anderson--Accelerated Majorization--Minimization Method
summary: We propose a Gauss-map variation (GMV) model for image denoising that measures the spatial variation of the tangent-plane projectors of the scaled image graph. We establish an equivalent representation of the regularizer in terms of the corresponding Gauss map and, using differential geometric tools including tubular coordinates and the Frenet frame, analyze its behavior across general $C^2$ and piecewise $C^2$ boundaries. The resulting estimates provide edge- and corner-contrast preservation properties. To solve the proposed model, we introduce a bilinear decomposition involving a unit normal field and a scalar magnitude field and develop an Anderson-accelerated majorization--minimization algorithm. The normal field subproblem admits an explicit pointwise majorization--minimization update, which is combined with an Anderson acceleration. For both $L^1$ and $L^2$ data fidelity terms, we establish sufficient decrease and boundedness of the iterates and prove that the generated sequence converges to a critical point of the penalized model. Numerical experiments on synthetic and natural images demonstrate the boundary preserving capability of the proposed model and its competitive performance in removing Gaussian and impulsive noise.

AI.tldr: 提出高斯映射变分（GMV）图像去噪模型，度量缩放图像图切平面投影子的空间变化，建立等价正则项表示并分析其边界行为，设计Anderson加速MM算法求解，兼顾边缘与角点对比保持。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪中需在去除噪声的同时保持边缘与角点等几何结构。既有正则项对边界（尤其角点）的对比保持缺乏严格的几何刻画，作者希望借助微分几何工具构造一种能显式描述并保持边界特征的正则化模型。
AI.method: 1) 构造高斯映射变分模型，以缩放图像图的切平面投影子的空间变化作为正则项；2) 给出该正则项基于高斯映射的等价表示，并用管状坐标、Frenet标架等微分几何工具分析其在一般C^2与分段C^2边界上的行为；3) 求解上采用单位法向量场与标量幅值场的双线性分解，设计Anderson加速的majorization-minimization算法，法向量子问题具有显式逐点MM更新；4) 对L^1与L^2两种数据保真项证明迭代序列的充分下降性、有界性及收敛到惩罚模型的临界点。
AI.result: 几何分析给出边缘与角点对比保持性质的估计；理论上证明了算法迭代的充分下降与有界性，并证明序列收敛到临界点；在合成图像与自然图像上的数值实验表明模型具备边界保持能力，在去除高斯噪声与脉冲噪声方面具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GMV模型为图像去噪提供了一种基于高斯映射与切平面投影子的几何正则化框架，兼具边界保持的理论保证与高效的加速求解算法，在边缘与角点保持的去噪任务中表现良好。

title: SkillGATE: Gate-Aware Monte Carlo Tree Search for Skill Retrieval
summary: Skill Retrieval (SR) aims to identify the most relevant skills from external skill libraries, and becomes increasingly challenging as libraries grow in scale and diversity. Existing methods either rank skills independently or rely on predefined graph propagation and hierarchical routing, making them vulnerable to semantic distractors, local trapping, and early routing errors. We formulate SR as an adaptive information-foraging process that coordinates region-level navigation with skill-level selection according to the utility and uncertainty observed during search. Based on this formulation, we propose SkillGATE, a graph-guided hierarchical retrieval framework with Gate-Aware Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). SkillGATE constructs a graph-preserving hierarchical index and performs adaptive retrieval through selection, expansion, simulation, and backpropagation. G-PUCT guides action selection, expansion explores new regions, simulation evaluates candidate skills, and backpropagation updates search statistics. Experiments on six SR benchmarks show that SkillGATE consistently improves diverse retrieval and reranking backbones, achieving a 16.3\% improvement in overall R@1 over the strongest retriever-based baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/Edwinbe/SkillGATE-v1/.

AI.tldr: 该论文将技能检索（SR）建模为自适应信息觅食过程，提出结合门控感知蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的图引导分层检索框架 SkillGATE，在六个基准上平均 R@1 提升 16.3%。
AI.motivation: 外部技能库规模与多样性不断增长，使技能检索（SR）日益困难。现有方法要么独立地对技能排序，要么依赖预定义的图传播与层次路由，因而容易受到语义干扰项、局部最优陷阱以及早期路由错误的影响。
AI.method: 将 SR 形式化为自适应信息觅食过程，依据搜索中观察到的效用与不确定性，协调区域级导航与技能级选择。基于该形式化提出 SkillGATE：构建保持图结构的分层索引，并通过选择、扩展、模拟和反向传播进行自适应检索；其中 G-PUCT 指导动作选择，扩展用于探索新区域，模拟用于评估候选技能，反向传播用于更新搜索统计。
AI.result: 在六个 SR 基准上，SkillGATE 持续提升多种检索与重排骨干模型的表现，相较最强的基于检索器的基线，整体 R@1 提升 16.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将技能检索重构为图引导的自适应信息觅食问题，并用门控感知 MCTS 统一区域导航与技能选择，可有效缓解语义干扰、局部陷阱与早期路由错误，为大规模技能库检索提供了通用且有效的框架。

title: Best-of-$N$ Guidance for Test-time Diffusion Alignment
summary: Diffusion models achieve strong generative performance but often struggle to align generated samples with human preferences measured by a reward model. A simple yet effective algorithm for test-time alignment is Best-of-$N$ (BoN) sampling, which draws $N$ i.i.d. samples from a pre-trained diffusion model and outputs the single highest-reward sample. Despite its empirical success, BoN makes limited use of reward information, as it is incorporated only at the final selection stage without influencing the reverse diffusion trajectory during sampling. Consequently, BoN sampling does not improve the average alignment of generated samples and is primarily suited to single-output settings. We propose Best-of-$N$ Guidance (BoNG), a novel method that integrates the principle of BoN sampling directly into the reverse diffusion process. BoNG performs online BoN selection over denoising particles and adjusts the reverse diffusion process to steer the particle population toward higher-reward regions during generation. Specifically, by introducing an asymmetric guidance interaction among denoising particles, BoNG uses the current BoN particle as a guidance signal to the rest of the particle population. This particle-level interaction reshapes the sampling process toward higher-reward regions, enabling BoNG to improve not only the final best sample beyond Vanilla BoN sampling, but also the average quality of generated samples. Over 36 empirical comparisons, BoNG achieves the best performance in 29 cases, ranking first in 80.56% of the comparisons against SMC and Vanilla BoN sampling. BoNG also supports multi-output capability, achieving 1.3$\times$ ImageReward score of the latest sample-based guidance method with a 1.6$\times$ speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/BoNG.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Best-of-N Guidance (BoNG)，将BoN采样原理融入反向扩散过程，通过在去噪粒子间引入非对称引导交互，在线进行BoN选择并引导粒子群向高奖励区域移动，从而同时提升最优样本和平均生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成性能强，但生成样本常难以与人类偏好（由奖励模型度量）对齐。Best-of-N (BoN)采样虽简单有效，但仅在最终选择阶段使用奖励信息，不影响反向扩散轨迹，因此无法提升样本的平均对齐程度，且主要用于单输出场景。
AI.method: 提出BoNG方法，将BoN采样原则直接整合进反向扩散过程：在去噪粒子上进行在线BoN选择，并通过在去噪粒子间引入非对称引导交互，用当前BoN粒子作为其余粒子群的引导信号，从而调整反向扩散过程，使粒子群向更高奖励区域演化。
AI.result: 在36项实证比较中，BoNG在29项取得最佳表现，相对SMC和Vanilla BoN采样在80.56%的比较中排名第一；同时支持多输出能力，图像奖励得分达到最新基于采样的引导方法的1.3倍，并有1.6倍加速。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: BoNG通过粒子级交互将BoN思想嵌入扩散采样过程，不仅超越Vanilla BoN的最优样本质量，还提升了生成样本的平均质量，并具备多输出能力与效率优势。

title: CentriQ: Calibration-Free Quantization of Diffusion Transformers via Exact Mean Centering
comment: Code and project page will be released soon
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation, but their sampling cost limits deployment. Quantizing both weights and activations to 4 bits reduces this cost, yet existing methods fall short in one of two ways. Calibration-based methods are tied to a specific checkpoint and prompt distribution, whereas data-free Hadamard rotation, effective for LLMs, loses quality on DiTs. We show that this loss has a structural cause. Adaptive layer-norm conditioning adds a per-token mean to the activations, and at the widths of the evaluated DiTs, the Hadamard rotations used by data-free methods cannot spread this mean uniformly across coordinates. A single dominant direction therefore survives the rotation and sets the quantization range. We introduce CentriQ, a calibration-free quantizer that centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 full-precision branch, so that per-token scales follow in closed form without data. Weights are fitted under a robust $\ell_p$ objective that tracks the dense mode of each group and discounts heavy tails. Across three DiTs, CentriQ matches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant at 4 bits, whereas calibration-free weight quantizers with plain per-token activation quantization collapse or degrade substantially. CentriQ outperforms the strongest calibration-free method reported to date at 2-bit weights. It is also the first calibration-free method to retain usable image quality at 2-bit activations.

AI.tldr: CentriQ：一种免校准的DiT 4-bit量化方法，通过token中心化+旋转+rank-1均值分支解决Ada-LN导致的量化范围被单方向主导问题，匹配校准式SVDQuant质量。
AI.motivation: DiT采样成本高，4-bit权重与激活量化可降本。现有方法两类缺陷：校准法绑定特定checkpoint与prompt分布；data-free的Hadamard旋转在LLM有效但在DiT上质量下降。作者指出该损失有结构性原因：Ada-LN条件化给激活加上per-token均值，而在所评测DiT的宽度下Hadamard旋转无法将该均值均匀分散到各坐标，导致单一主导方向存活并决定量化范围。
AI.method: CentriQ为免校准量化器：先对每个token做中心化，再旋转，并通过一个rank-1全精度分支精确恢复均值，从而在无需数据的情况下以闭式解得到per-token scale；权重在鲁棒ℓp目标下拟合，追踪每组的密集模式并抑制重尾。
AI.result: 在三个DiT上，CentriQ在4-bit下匹配校准式SVDQuant的质量；而采用普通per-token激活量化的免校准权重量化方法崩溃或显著退化。在2-bit权重下优于迄今最强的免校准方法，并且是首个在2-bit激活下仍保持可用图像质量的免校准方法。
AI.conclusion: 激活中per-token均值与Hadamard旋转的不匹配是DiT免校准量化的关键瓶颈；token中心化加rank-1全精度均值恢复可在免校准下达到校准方法的4-bit质量，并首次把免校准推向2-bit激活可用。

title: Level-of-Token Diffusion
summary: Image and video diffusion models allocate equal computation to every region, even when the intended scene calls for varying levels of detail. The spatial distribution of detail can often be anticipated before generation, indicating where computation can be reduced. We introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion, a framework that turns this knowledge into an explicit multiresolution token layout (Level-of-Token layout) for adaptive and efficient generation. Tokens represent rectangular patches of varying sizes and shapes, allocating finer tokens where detail is needed and coarser tokens elsewhere. We adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to LoT layouts through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, preserving full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while processing only a reduced token sequence. LoT Diffusion enables layout-adaptive generation while preserving pretrained generative priors. We demonstrate LoT with layouts derived from semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Across image and video generation, LoT offers favorable quality-efficiency tradeoffs, with significant speedups determined by the layout's token budget. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/.

AI.tldr: LoT Diffusion 通过显式的多分辨率 token 布局（Level-of-Token layout），在生成前确定细节空间分布，从而在图像与视频扩散模型中实现自适应、高效的计算分配，在保留预训练生成先验的同时获得显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现有图像与视频扩散模型对每个区域分配相同计算量，即使目标场景不同区域的细节需求差异很大。而细节的空间分布往往在生成前就能预测，这为按需分配计算、降低冗余提供了依据。
AI.method: 提出 Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion 框架。将细节先验转为显式的多分辨率 token 布局：token 表示不同尺寸与形状的矩形 patch，细节处用更细 token，其他区域用更粗 token。通过 patch-wise 非对称 flow 参数化及多分辨率 token 嵌入，将预训练扩散 transformer 适配到 LoT 布局，在仅处理精简 token 序列的同时，每个去噪步仍保持全分辨率 flow 预测。
AI.result: 用来自语义掩码、边界框、纹理方差、景深线索以及智能体规划的布局进行验证。在图像与视频生成任务中，LoT 在质量-效率权衡上表现良好，加速幅度由布局的 token 预算决定。
AI.conclusion: LoT Diffusion 支持布局自适应生成并保留预训练生成先验，为细节分布可预测的生成场景提供了一种兼顾质量与效率的自适应计算分配方案。

title: The Functional Structure of Post-Compression Recovery in Low-Rank LLMs
summary: Different low-rank compression methods can produce compressed LLMs that respond differently to the same post-compression recovery procedure, and relative advantages observed between methods at the compression endpoint may shrink, grow, or even reverse after recovery. We ask whether this recovery heterogeneity reflects functional structure beyond scalar loss evolution, and how that structure evolves throughout recovery. Our results establish that this heterogeneity reflects a reproducible compression-induced functional structure, which we formalize as recovery pressure. To characterize this structure consistently throughout recovery, we develop a standardized functional characterization within each backbone that is applicable across heterogeneous low-rank methods. The primary backward characterization reveals reproducible module-wise structure across independent probes, while a complementary forward-only characterization recovers related structure without loss or backpropagation. We further find that recovery pressure measured at the endpoint is associated with subsequent recovery response; during recovery, its module-wise structure is reorganized non-uniformly, and localized updates induce distributed responses beyond directly updated modules. Further evidence indicates that tracking this evolving structure provides a complementary functional view of recovery progress alongside scalar loss.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现低秩压缩后的 LLM 对同一恢复过程的响应存在异质性，并将这种异质性形式化为可复现的"恢复压力"（recovery pressure），提出标准化的功能表征方法追踪其在恢复过程中的演化。
AI.motivation: 不同低秩压缩方法产生的压缩模型对同一恢复微调过程的响应差异显著，压缩终点观察到的相对优劣可能在恢复后缩小、扩大甚至反转。作者试图探究这种恢复异质性是否反映标量损失演化之外的功能结构，以及该结构在恢复过程中如何演变。
AI.method: 作者提出"恢复压力"这一概念来形式化压缩诱导的功能结构，并在同一骨干网络内建立标准化的功能表征方法，使其适用于异构的低秩压缩方法。主要采用基于反向传播的表征（跨独立探针揭示可复现的模块级结构），并辅以一种仅前向、无损失与反向传播的互补表征。
AI.result: 主要反向表征在不同独立探针下呈现可复现的模块级结构；仅前向表征可恢复相关结构；终点测得的恢复压力与后续恢复响应相关联；恢复过程中模块级结构发生非均匀重组；局部更新会引发超出直接更新模块的分布式响应。
AI.conclusion: 恢复异质性反映了可复现的压缩诱导功能结构（恢复压力）。追踪该演化结构可在标量损失之外提供对恢复进度的互补功能视角。

title: Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) generate sequences by iteratively replacing masked tokens with model predictions. At each denoising step, the decoder chooses which positions are sufficiently confident to commit. Existing decoding methods typically rely on softmax confidence, which can be miscalibrated. We introduce BayesER (BAYESian Entropy-based Reordering), a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that uses predictive uncertainty to guide token commitment. In BayesER, we construct a lightweight approximate posterior centered at the pretrained checkpoint, similar to Laplace-LoRA but without training LoRA adapters. We average predictions over posterior samples and use predictive entropy to prioritize reliable positions. We examine how posterior predictions affect position ordering and token selection across benchmarks spanning code generation, mathematical reasoning, planning, and molecular generation. We show that BayesER reduces sequence-level calibration error while preserving or improving accuracy relative to common decoding schemes, including confidence-threshold decoding. Additionally, a posterior fitted on one code-generation dataset reduces calibration error on another without refitting, suggesting that Bayesian uncertainty may provide a transferable signal for more reliable MDLM decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出 BayesER，一种贝叶斯后验解码框架，用预测熵指导 MDLM 的 token 提交顺序，在多个基准上降低序列级校准误差并保持或提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有 MDLM 解码依赖 softmax 置信度来决定哪些位置可提交，但该置信度常存在校准偏差，导致提交顺序不可靠。
AI.method: 在预训练检查点附近构建轻量近似后验（类似 Laplace-LoRA，但无需训练 LoRA 适配器），对后验样本的预测取平均，用预测熵对位置进行优先级排序，以指导位置排序与 token 选择。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理、规划和分子生成等基准上，相比置信度阈值解码等常见方案，BayesER 降低序列级校准误差并保持或提升准确率；在某一代码数据集上拟合的后验可无需重拟合即迁移到另一数据集并降低校准误差。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯不确定性可提供可迁移的信号，实现更可靠的 MDLM 解码。

title: KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling
summary: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose KineWorld, a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0. KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出KineWorld，将机器人运动学从运动条件扩展到生成监督的空间分配，用运动学传输提升与传输感知扩散对稀疏交互区域加权监督，提升具身世界模型的动作后果预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型采用均匀加权的视觉生成目标，与具身预测需求不一致；即使引入显式运动条件，仍会低估对交互至关重要的空间稀疏变化。
AI.method: KineWorld框架包含两部分：Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) 由指令机器人运动构建渲染器导出、相机对齐的传输场；Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) 在视频潜变量网格上校准其运动支撑，并通过均匀分布与传输聚焦分布的归一化混合对future-RGB flow matching进行重加权。使用RoboTwin 2.0的ALOHA-AgileX双臂操作数据训练。
AI.result: 单视角评估EWMScore-P为68.95，多视角评估TWB-Score为54.82。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持从外观拟合转向动作后果建模，以服务于具身决策。

title: Imagine to Act: High-Fidelity Data Synthesis via Image Editing World Model for Scalable GUI Agent Training
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating complex digital workflows across diverse applications. However, training highly capable and generalizable agents fundamentally relies on massive, high-fidelity visual-action trajectories, which are notoriously difficult to acquire. While human demonstrations are unscalable, existing GUI world models rely on text descriptions or HTML rendering, discarding crucial pixel-level visual details like icons and layout styles. To address this issue, we introduce Infinite-Dreamer, a simulation-free data synthesis method powered by a pixel-level Image Editing World Model. By conceptualizing GUI transitions as image editing tasks, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to describe action-induced UI changes as structured delta-text. We then fine-tune an image editing backbone to controllably synthesize realistic screenshot transitions. We utilize this model to generate both single-frame visual robustness data and multi-step imaginary trajectories. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we fine-tune the Qwen3-VL baseline solely on the synthesized data to obtain Infinite-Actor, and evaluate it on AndroidWorld, MobileWorld, and AndroidControl-Curated benchmarks. Infinite-Actor consistently outperforms the Qwen3-VL baselines across scales: Infinite-Actor-8B improves AndroidWorld Pass@1 by +4.45 and nearly doubles the MobileWorld Pass@3 success rate, while Infinite-Actor-2B improves Pass@1 by +9.05. Code is available at https://github.com/swaydy-n/Infinite-Dreamer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Infinite-Dreamer，一种基于像素级图像编辑世界模型的免仿真数据合成方法，用于生成 GUI 智能体训练数据，并训练出性能显著提升的 Infinite-Actor。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体的训练依赖大量高保真视觉-动作轨迹，但这类数据难以获取：人工演示不可扩展，而现有 GUI 世界模型多依赖文本描述或 HTML 渲染，丢失了图标、布局样式等关键像素级视觉细节。
AI.method: 将 GUI 状态转移建模为图像编辑任务，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）把动作引发的 UI 变化描述为结构化 delta-text，再微调图像编辑骨干网络，从而可控地合成真实感截图转移；基于该模型生成单帧视觉鲁棒性数据和多步想象轨迹。
AI.result: 仅用合成数据微调 Qwen3-VL 得到 Infinite-Actor，在 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld、AndroidControl-Curated 上均稳定优于基线：Infinite-Actor-8B 在 AndroidWorld Pass@1 提升 +4.45，MobileWorld Pass@3 成功率近乎翻倍；Infinite-Actor-2B 的 Pass@1 提升 +9.05。
AI.conclusion: 像素级图像编辑世界模型能够有效合成高保真 GUI 轨迹数据，替代难以扩展的人工演示，显著提升 GUI 智能体的能力与泛化性。

title: What Does Fréchet Distance Measure? A Directional Decomposition
summary: The Fréchet distance is a de facto standard for evaluating generative models across domains, appearing as FID for images and FVD for videos. It summarizes the discrepancy between generated and reference distributions in a single scalar, with lower values typically interpreted as better generation quality. However, this scalar view can obscure what drives the comparison. For example, in COCO dataset, increasing the number of diffusion sampling steps improves ImageReward scores yet worsens (increases) FID. Motivated by this mismatch, we seek to make the Fréchet distance more interpretable by uncovering where the discrepancy lies. To this end, we introduce directional Fréchet distance, the expected squared projection of the optimal transport displacement onto a given direction. Across our image, video, and protein case studies, we find that a small number of interpretable directions account for much of the distance. We use these directions to explain the FID increase in terms of semantic concepts represented by CLIP embeddings, quantify FVD's bias toward per-frame appearance, and revisit the interpretation of Protein FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方向性Fréchet距离（directional Fréchet distance），通过将最优传输位移投影到给定方向上，揭示Fréchet距离差异的具体来源，使其更具可解释性。
AI.motivation: Fréchet距离（如图像的FID、视频的FVD）是评估生成模型的标准指标，但单一标量值掩盖了分布差异的具体驱动因素。例如在COCO数据集上，增加扩散采样步数会提升ImageReward分数却使FID变差（增大），这种矛盾表明标量视角的局限性，因此需要使Fréchet距离更具可解释性。
AI.method: 提出方向性Fréchet距离，即最优传输位移在给定方向上的投影平方的期望值。通过该方法在图像、视频和蛋白质三个案例中寻找贡献大部分距离的可解释方向，并利用CLIP嵌入所代表的语义概念来解释这些方向。
AI.result: 在图像、视频和蛋白质案例研究中发现，少数可解释方向即可解释大部分Fréchet距离。具体地，用这些方向解释了COCO上FID的上升，量化了FVD对逐帧外观的偏向，并重新审视了Protein FID的解释。
AI.conclusion: 方向性Fréchet距离能有效揭示Fréchet距离差异的来源，将其从单一标量扩展为可解释的方向分解，为生成模型评估提供了更深入的洞察。代码已开源。

title: Component-Level Evaluation of Adaptive PINN Training for CFD-Oriented Crystal Growth Simulation
summary: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) training minimizes a weighted combination of partial differential equation (PDE), boundary-condition, and initial-condition losses. Because adaptive methods modify these weights during training, their weighted total losses are not always directly comparable. We compare fixed-weight PINN, gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN), and a rule-based adaptive controller (AgenticPINN) under matched settings on a heat-equation benchmark and a simplified Czochralski-oriented thermal-fluid problem. In the crystal-growth MLP experiment, adaptive control reduced the PDE residual from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-6}$, while the boundary-condition loss increased from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$. On the heat-equation benchmark, GNPINN achieved the lowest relative $L_2$ field error (0.054), whereas AgenticPINN obtained the smallest PDE residual but a relative $L_2$ error of 1.368. Gaussian-process surrogates were additionally evaluated using case-wise holdout tests on corrected Czochralski CFD parameter sweeps. The temperature-field error for the temperature sweep was approximately 6%, whereas the axial-velocity error for the crystal-rotation sweep was approximately 42%. These findings show that adaptive control can improve equation satisfaction while weakening other physical constraints. PINN training should therefore be evaluated using separate PDE, boundary-condition, and solution-error metrics rather than weighted total loss alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究对比固定权重PINN、梯度归一化PINN与规则自适应控制器在热传导基准及简化的Czochralski热流问题上的表现，并结合高斯过程代理模型做留出验证，指出自适应权重会改善PDE残差但可能削弱边界条件，强调应分项评估PINN。
AI.motivation: PINN训练最小化PDE、边界条件与初始条件损失的加权和，而自适应方法在训练中动态调整权重，导致不同方法的加权总损失不可直接比较，因此需要探究自适应控制对各类物理约束的真实影响。
AI.method: 在匹配设置下对比固定权重PINN、梯度归一化PINN（GNPINN）与规则自适应控制器（AgenticPINN），在热方程基准和简化的Czochralski取向热流问题上训练；并额外用基于案例的留出测试评估高斯过程代理模型在修正后的Czochralski CFD参数扫描上的表现。
AI.result: 晶体生长MLP实验中，自适应控制将PDE残差从约1e-5降至1e-6，但边界条件损失从约1e-5升至1e-2；热方程基准上，GNPINN取得最低相对L2场误差0.054，而AgenticPINN虽PDE残差最小，相对L2误差却为1.368；高斯过程代理在温度扫描中温度场误差约6%，在晶体旋转扫描中轴向速度误差约42%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应控制可提升方程满足程度，但可能削弱其他物理约束。因此PINN训练应采用PDE、边界条件与解误差等分项指标评估，而不能仅依赖加权总损失。

title: RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models
comment: The code and checkpoints are available at $\href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{\text{this https URL}}$
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration (\ie, multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting (\ie, sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher's multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks (\eg, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants (\eg, Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance (\ie, $<1\%$ drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup (\eg, $\sim25\times$ on H100). Our code and checkpoints are available via this \href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{link}.

AI.tldr: RealtimeWAM 通过一步动作生成与异步推理，在近乎无损性能下显著加速 World Action Model 的端到端推理。
AI.motivation: 现有高效 WAM 采用 MoT 架构并只计算一次视频表征供动作专家复用，但仍受限于专家内部迭代（多步动作去噪）与专家间等待（视频与动作专家顺序执行）两大推理瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 RealtimeWAM：（1）Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD)，在局部一致性基础上引入冻结教师多步 rollout 终点的显式监督，解决局部-全局误差差距，实现准确的一步动作生成；（2）Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP)，通过按块共享视频 KV cache，仅在动作注意力实际消费前同步，从而消除专家级等待。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 等基准及 Fast-WAM、Faster-WAM 等模型变体上，性能近乎无损（下降 <1%），同时端到端显著加速（H100 上约 25 倍）。
AI.conclusion: RealtimeWAM 有效缓解 WAM 的两大效率瓶颈，在保持精度的同时实现大幅加速，代码与权重已开源。

title: Weave Mamba Fusion: Global Cross-Scale Interaction for Lightweight Face Detection
summary: Feature pyramid methods, from FPN to BiFPN, have achieved strong performance in face detection by fusing multi-scale features. However, detecting faces under unconstrained conditions, such as small scale, occlusion, and extreme pose, remains difficult, as it requires global cross-scale dependencies that local fusion cannot model. State space models such as Mamba provide global context with linear complexity by scanning features as a sequence, and therefore offer a promising direction for this problem. Nevertheless, such a scan needs the two pyramid scales combined into a single feature map, and the way they are combined determines whether cross-scale structure is preserved. Summation collapses the two scales before the scan, so the scan has no cross-scale structure to exploit, while concatenation keeps both scales but at far higher cost. To address this, we propose \textbf{Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)}, which interleaves two adjacent pyramid scales column by column so that each step of a horizontal bidirectional SS2D scan moves from one scale to the other. With partial-channel processing and parameter-free de-weaving, WMF enables efficient cross-scale interaction while preserving feature structure. Integrating WMF into every fusion node yields \textbf{WeaveBiFPN}, the neck of our \textbf{WeaveFace} detector. On WIDER FACE, WeaveFace achieves 91.41\% mean AP with only 0.34M parameters and 1.16 GFLOPs, outperforming prior detectors under 0.5M parameters. Its largest gains are on the Hard subset, where it reaches 87.14\% AP. The code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/dohun-mat/WeaveMambaFusion}.

AI.tldr: 提出 Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF) 模块，通过逐列交织相邻金字塔尺度实现跨尺度双向 SS2D 扫描，构建 WeaveBiFPN 与 WeaveFace 检测器，在 WIDER FACE 上以 0.34M 参数、1.16 GFLOPs 达到 91.41% mAP。
AI.motivation: 无约束人脸检测（小尺度、遮挡、极端姿态）需要全局跨尺度依赖，而 FPN/BiFPN 等局部融合方式无法建模。Mamba 类状态空间模型以线性复杂度提供全局上下文，但其扫描需将两个金字塔尺度合并为单一特征图：求和会在扫描前塌缩尺度结构，拼接则保留结构但开销过高。
AI.method: 提出 Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)：将相邻两个金字塔尺度按列逐列交织，使水平双向 SS2D 扫描的每一步在两个尺度间交替移动，从而在扫描中保留跨尺度结构；结合部分通道处理与无参数 de-weaving 实现高效跨尺度交互。将 WMF 集成到每个融合节点构成 WeaveBiFPN，作为 WeaveFace 检测器的 neck。
AI.result: 在 WIDER FACE 上，WeaveFace 以仅 0.34M 参数和 1.16 GFLOPs 取得 91.41% 平均 AP，优于参数量低于 0.5M 的先前检测器；在 Hard 子集上增益最大，达到 87.14% AP。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过逐列交织的 SS2D 扫描，WMF 在保留跨尺度结构的同时以低计算成本实现全局跨尺度建模，为超轻量人脸检测提供了有效方案。

title: Have I Scene This Before? Spatially Grounded Conversational Memory for Complex Queries in Egocentric Assistants
summary: Egocentric assistants must connect what users say with what they see across long interaction histories. We formalize this challenge as Spatially grounded Conversational Reasoning (SpaCR): cross-scene, recall-oriented, and counterfactual spatial queries that combine user-stated facts with geometric evidence. Direct vision-language models incur high inference costs and context limits as histories grow, while keyframe selection and retrieval can omit objects or evidence needed for complete recall. We propose Spatially grounded Conversational Memory (SpaC-MEM), an object-centric working memory that uses 3D reconstruction and segmentation to ground conversational information in persistent physical objects. It compresses multimodal histories while preserving spatial evidence and allowing object-specific facts to be updated through dialogue. We also introduce Ego-SpaCR, a benchmark comprising 620 ScanNet video sessions augmented with 95 task-oriented conversations and 3,100 evaluation queries. SpaC-MEM achieves the highest overall answer accuracy among the evaluated methods and improves object recall while requiring substantially fewer reference input tokens than native-video baselines. Removing 3D spatial information substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of preserving spatial and conversational evidence together.

AI.tldr: 本文将第一人称助手连接用户话语与视觉观察的挑战形式化为 SpaCR 任务，提出以物体为中心的工作记忆 SpaC-MEM，并构建 Ego-SpaCR 基准，验证其在高召回、低 token 消耗上的优势。
AI.motivation: 第一人称助手需在长交互历史中将用户所述与所见关联，但现有视觉语言模型推理成本高、上下文受限，关键帧选择与检索又可能丢失完整召回所需的物体或证据。
AI.method: 形式化 Spatially grounded Conversational Reasoning（SpaCR）任务；提出 SpaC-MEM，一种以物体为中心的工作记忆，利用 3D 重建与分割将对话信息锚定到持久物理物体，压缩多模态历史并保留空间证据，支持通过对话更新物体特定事实；构建 Ego-SpaCR 基准（620 段 ScanNet 视频会话、95 段任务导向对话、3,100 条评测查询）。
AI.result: SpaC-MEM 在评估方法中取得最高总体回答准确率，提升物体召回率，且参考输入 token 显著少于原生视频基线；去除 3D 空间信息后性能大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 以物体为中心、融合空间与对话证据的记忆机制能有效支撑长历史下的空间接地对话推理，同时保持较低 token 开销。

title: Hidden in the Comments: A Context-Injection Attack Surface in Code LLMs
summary: Code large language model (Code LLM) assistants generate code from heterogeneous development contexts, including open files, imported modules, pasted snippets, and comments, much of which may originate from untrusted sources. We investigate whether insecure instructions embedded in such contexts can steer Code LLMs toward vulnerable code without access to model weights or training data. We evaluate ten open-weight Code LLMs spanning 3B--13B parameters, including four base and six instruction-tuned models, across ten web-application weakness classes. We compare completion tasks containing insecure instructions embedded as code comments with benign tasks without malicious instructions. Attack-condition completions contained a medium-or-higher weakness in {\bf 77.4--92.3}\% of cases, compared with {\bf 1.7--5.1}\% in the benign condition. Base and instruction-tuned models averaged 86.5\% and 84.5\% vulnerable outputs, respectively; equivalence testing and three matched model pairs indicated reductions of at most 8.1\% after instruction tuning. Susceptibility showed no clear association with model scale or specialization. Among vulnerable attack outputs, 86.2--91.0\% were rated high or critical, and the effect persisted without the pattern-based detector. Post-generation screening reduced but did not eliminate the risk, the strongest screen leaving roughly one-third undetected. These findings identify inference-time context injection as a substantial attack surface and motivate provenance-aware training objectives.

AI.tldr: 论文研究代码大模型（Code LLM）能否被上下文中嵌入的不安全指令诱导生成漏洞代码，发现攻击成功率高达77.4–92.3%，远高于良性条件下的1.7–5.1%。
AI.motivation: Code LLM 助手在异构开发上下文中生成代码，这些上下文（开放文件、导入模块、粘贴片段、注释等）常来源于不可信渠道。作者希望探究：在不访问模型权重或训练数据的前提下，上下文中嵌入的不安全指令是否会将 Code LLM 引导至生成脆弱代码，从而识别推理阶段的上下文注入这一攻击面。
AI.method: 评估10个开放权重 Code LLM（3B–13B参数，含4个基座模型与6个指令微调模型），覆盖10类Web应用弱点。对比将不安全指令以代码注释形式嵌入的补全任务与无恶意的良性任务，并通过等效性检验与三组配对模型比较指令微调的影响，同时考察模型规模、专业化程度、基于模式的检测器及生成后筛查的效果。
AI.result: 攻击条件下77.4–92.3%的补全包含中等及以上弱点，良性条件下仅1.7–5.1%；基座与指令微调模型平均脆弱输出率分别为86.5%与84.5%，指令微调后降幅最多8.1%。易感性同模型规模或专业化无关；脆弱输出中86.2–91.0%被评为高或严重级别，移除基于模式的检测器后效应仍存在；生成后筛查降低了风险但未消除，最强筛查仍漏检约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 推理阶段的上下文注入构成实质性的攻击面，现有筛查手段不足以完全缓解，亟需面向来源感知（provenance-aware）的训练目标来应对该风险。

title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
summary: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出H-JEPA，一种端到端训练分层动作条件JEPA世界模型的方法，每层在各自潜空间中预测更远的未来，规划自上而下进行，在四个仿真导航/操作环境及DROID真实机器人视频上优于扁平JEPA。
AI.motivation: 长时程规划需要在不同时间尺度与抽象层次上进行推理，而现有任务无关的JEPA世界模型仅在单一时间尺度或共享潜空间中的多时程上进行预测与规划，难以有效处理数据中跨不同时间尺度演变的因素。
AI.method: 提出H-JEPA：端到端训练一整套分层的动作条件JEPA，每一层在自身学习到的潜空间中预测更远的未来。规划采用自上而下方式：顶层优化朝目标的进展，每层的预测成为其下层规划器的子目标。当数据中的因素以分离的时间尺度演化时，高层丢弃快速、不可预测的细节，保留较慢的任务相关状态。并以逆动力学监督将该方法扩展到真实机器人视频。
AI.result: 在四个仿真导航与操作环境中，分层规划优于扁平JEPA；在Visual AntMaze上，三级层次将成功率从18%提升至73%，且规划器计算量更少。消融实验表明收益来自时间分解与高层目标表示两方面。结合逆动力学监督后，方法可扩展到DROID的多样化真实机器人视频，层次结构以更低规划器计算量提升离线规划保真度。
AI.conclusion: 分层、动作条件的JEPA世界模型通过在各自潜空间中进行多时间尺度预测与自上而下的子目标规划，显著提升长时程规划的成功率与效率，并具备向真实机器人视频迁移的潜力。

title: Certification of Real Images through Calibrated Content Authentication
summary: Generative models can synthesize high-quality inauthentic multimedia content that is already being misused at scale. We evaluate twenty deepfake detectors against ten generators released in the last four years and find accuracy decreasing over time, from near-perfect 99.5% to 76%. Adversarial perturbations further reduce every baseline detector to below 2% accuracy, effectively inverting the detector's assigned label. We argue that this unreliability reflects a fundamental ambiguity: generators can reproduce authentic content exactly (e.g., through memorization), so content alone cannot reveal the true provenance label.For this reason, content produced by a generator must admit a faithful reconstruction by that same generator, and finding such a reconstruction makes synthetic provenance plausible and authenticity plausibly deniable.We therefore propose and evaluate a detection paradigm that outputs a calibrated prediction of whether authenticity is plausibly deniable: a faithful reconstruction by any known generator establishes plausible deniability, while calibration bounds how often content from known generators fails to be reproduced. Our evaluation shows that (i) our detector can be calibrated so that at most 1% of generated content is wrongly certified, an operating point at which most baseline detectors reach near-zero recall, including the strongest with 93% accuracy; (ii) calibrating a stricter security threshold on attacked samples preserves this bound against adaptive adversaries within the evaluated bounded-perturbation attack space, whose perturbations break every baseline, but does not cover arbitrary adversarial transformations; and (iii) post-hoc verifiability is eroding, as 1,116 of 3,000 Reddit images resist reproduction by a 2022 generator, but only 55 to 79 resist reproduction by 2024 generators.

AI.tldr: 论文评估20个深度伪造检测器对10个生成器的效果，发现准确率随时间从99.5%降至76%，对抗扰动可将其降至2%以下；作者提出"合理推诿"检测范式，通过生成器忠实重建来判断真实性是否可合理否认，并在校准下将误认证率控制在1%以内。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器面对新一代生成器准确率持续下降，且对抗扰动可轻易使其失效。作者认为这种不可靠性源于根本性的歧义：生成器能通过记忆等方式精确重现真实内容，因此单凭内容本身无法揭示真实来源标签，需要一种新的检测范式来应对这一本质难题。
AI.method: 作者提出并评估一种输出"真实性是否可合理否认"校准预测的检测范式：若任一已知生成器能对该内容实现忠实重建，则判定合成来源可信、真实性可合理否认；通过校准限制已知生成器内容无法被重现的频率。此外，还针对受攻击样本设定更严格的安全阈值以抵御有界扰动攻击下的自适应对手。
AI.result: （i）该检测器可校准至最多1%的生成内容被错误认证，而多数基线检测器在此操作点召回率接近零，包括准确率93%的最强基线；（ii）在校准更严格阈值后，对有界扰动攻击空间内的自适应对手仍能保持该界限，而这些扰动可破坏所有基线检测器，但无法覆盖任意对抗变换；（iii）事后可验证性正在减弱：3000张Reddit图片中，2022年生成器无法重现1116张，而2024年生成器仅有55至79张无法重现。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明内容本身无法可靠揭示来源标签，检测器准确率随时间下降且易受对抗攻击，凸显现有范式的根本局限。作者提出的"合理推诿"校准检测范式在严格误认证界限下优于所有基线，并对有界扰动攻击具鲁棒性。但事后可验证性随生成器迭代快速削弱，2024年生成器已能重现绝大多数真实图像，说明该防御能力面临持续侵蚀的威胁。

title: DelegationBench: Measuring When AI Agents Should Ask Before Acting
summary: AI agents that send emails, edit files, and make purchases must decide when to act on their own and when to check with the user first. This decision is usually evaluated by showing a model a proposed action, asking whether it should proceed, and scoring agreement with human labels. We introduce DelegationBench to test whether such scores can be trusted. It has 156 scenarios with four possible responses (act, ask for permission, ask for missing information, refuse), and most scenarios come in matched pairs that change a single feature: whether the action was requested, what is at stake, whether it can be undone, or who will see it. Across ten models from five families, agreement scores mislead in three ways. A simple keyword rule, which we wrote after seeing the benchmark, agrees with our annotators more often than eight of the models, yet its decision changes in only 9 of 48 matched pairs. Equivalent ways of asking the same question change how often a model acts by up to 52.5 percentage points. And every model stops to ask the user less often when it must carry out the task with tools than when it judges a proposed action. When rules are stated explicitly, the same models follow them almost perfectly, so the gaps are not explained by a general inability to follow rules. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools and recommend reporting these properties separately rather than as one score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DelegationBench，用于检验AI智能体"自主行动 vs. 征求用户许可"决策评估分数是否可信。基准包含156个场景、四类应答，多数成对设计仅改变单一特征。在五个家族十个模型上，一致性分数暴露三类误导：简单关键词规则胜过八个模型、等价问法导致行动率差达52.5个百分点、使用工具执行时模型更少询问用户。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常把"是否应执行提议动作"的模型判断与人类标注做一致性打分。作者质疑该单一分数能否真实反映智能体的委托决策能力，因此需要构建能揭示评估脆弱性的基准。
AI.method: 构建 DelegationBench：156个场景，四种应答（执行、请求许可、索取缺失信息、拒绝）；多数场景为匹配对，仅改变一个特征（是否被请求、风险大小、可否撤销、谁会看到）。评测五个家族共十个模型，并引入事后编写的简单关键词规则作为对照，分析问法等价性与"判断动作"vs."用工具执行"两种模式差异。
AI.result: 一致性分数在三方面误导：（1）简单关键词规则与标注者一致性高于十个模型中的八个，但其决策在48个匹配对中仅9个发生变化；（2）等价提问方式使模型行动率变化最高达52.5个百分点；（3）所有模型在必须用工具执行任务时，比仅判断提议动作时更少停下来询问用户。当规则被明确陈述时，模型几乎完美遵循。
AI.conclusion: 单一一致性分数会掩盖委托决策的关键缺陷；规则遵循能力不足并非主因。作者发布基准与评估工具，建议分别报告上述性质而非合并为一个分数。

title: Arithmetic Actor Heads and Training Stabilization for Out-of-Distribution Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can deteriorate under out-of-distribution (OOD) magnitude shifts. Starting from soft actor-critic (SAC) and its Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) predecessor, we study the causal-symbolic BAPR (CS-BAPR) family. The practical method combines six training-stabilization settings with alternative actor heads: a Neural Addition Unit (NAU) with a Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU)-inspired quadratic correction, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), or a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with rectified linear unit (ReLU) or hyperbolic-tangent activations.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于SAC与BAPR，提出因果符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）族，通过六种训练稳定化设置并替换actor头部（NAU+二次修正、KAN、ReLU-MLP或tanh-MLP）以提升OOD幅度偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习策略在分布外（OOD）幅度偏移下性能会显著退化，需提升策略鲁棒性。
AI.method: 从SAC及其贝叶斯遗忘式分段鲁棒（BAPR）前身出发，构建因果符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）族；实际方法结合六种训练稳定化设置，并采用替代actor头部：带NMU风格二次修正的NAU、KAN，以及使用ReLU或tanh激活的MLP。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅描述了方法构成与实验设置。
AI.conclusion: 提出CS-BAPR方法族以应对OOD幅度偏移，具体效果需进一步实验验证。

title: TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models
summary: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.8% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 2.1% and 0.8% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.0% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TAPDreamer，一种针对世界动作模型（world action models）的迁移性对抗攻击。它仅利用公开编码器、无需查询目标策略，即可构造固定局部扰动补丁，在多个机器人基准上将近乎全部任务成功率降至零。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型是通用机器人控制的重要基础，但其依赖的摄像头输入一旦被篡改，就会破坏跨任务与动作策略共享的视觉表征。已有攻击需要访问目标模型输出（针对动作或预测未来），泛化性与实用性受限。作者希望证明：仅凭公开编码器即可构造跨任务、跨架构迁移的局部扰动，从而揭示共享视觉编码器的安全风险。
AI.method: 提出 TAPDreamer 攻击。核心洞见是：patch 引起的注意力权重与 value 向量交互，会把近乎相同的表征偏移广播到远超 patch 覆盖范围之处，且该偏移在跨任务观测中保持稳定。基于此，TAPDreamer 用来自单一源任务的六帧图像，最大化干净表征与打补丁表征之间的全局 L1 距离，从而构造一个固定的、可迁移的局部扰动。整个过程不需要任何目标策略查询。
AI.result: 在闭环评测中，每个基准只需一个冻结补丁（约占输入 6.5%）：FastWAM 在 40 个 LIBERO 任务上成功率从 97.7% 降至 0.0%，在 50 个 RoboTwin 任务上从 90.8% 降至 0.0%；而匹配的随机补丁仍分别保持 81.5% 与 79.2% 的成功率。同一批补丁使两个 DreamWAM 配置的成功率降至 2.1% 与 0.8%，使 Motus 降至 10.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅保护下游动作生成并不足够：针对世界动作模型的防御必须同时保护共享视觉编码器，以抵御持久性的局部扰动。

title: fMRI-TAMCL: Text-Anchored Supervised Multimodal Contrastive Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Classification
summary: Resting-state fMRI is important in the classification of brain disorders, but highly multimodal and exhibits strong multisite heterogeneity. Existing methods fuse images, BOLD-based functional connectivity, and phenotypic data modalities. Unlike other medical imaging datasets, rs-fMRI datasets rarely include a text modality, so they are generated from phenotypic data or BOLD activations. These text generation methods rely on fixed assumptions for subjects, sites, devices, and protocols, leading to poor generalization across datasets. We propose fMRI-TAMCL, a text-anchored multimodal contrastive learning framework that integrates fMRI images, sparse FC, and generated subject-specific text. Its Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation module generates BOLD activation text, while Feature-Value Serialization module generates phenotypic text. All three modalities are encoded as clustered graphs, projected onto a shared unit hypersphere space, aligned using pairwise, text-anchored supervised contrastive learning, and fused with attention. fMRI-TAMCL proves its generalization capability across five datasets outperforming 29 baselines with 78.6%-86.4% accuracy in downstream classification.

AI.tldr: 提出fMRI-TAMCL文本锚定多模态对比学习框架，融合fMRI图像、稀疏功能连接与生成文本，在五个数据集上分类准确率达78.6%–86.4%，优于29个基线。
AI.motivation: 静息态fMRI在脑疾病分类中重要，但具有高度多模态性和强多站点异质性。已有方法融合图像、基于BOLD的功能连接和表型数据；然而rs-fMRI数据极少包含文本模态，现有文本生成方法依赖对受试者、站点、设备和协议的固定假设，导致跨数据集泛化能力差。
AI.method: fMRI-TAMCL包含：Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation模块生成BOLD激活文本，Feature-Value Serialization模块生成表型文本；三种模态均编码为聚类图，投影到共享单位超球面空间，通过成对、文本锚定的监督对比学习对齐，并以注意力机制融合。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上验证泛化能力，下游分类准确率为78.6%–86.4%，优于29个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成受试者自适应文本并采用文本锚定的监督对比学习对齐多模态表示，可有效缓解rs-fMRI跨站点异质性与文本缺失问题，提升跨数据集泛化性能。

title: More Claims, Less Evidence: Bounded Verification of AI-Generated Digital Knowledge Artifacts
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 28th International Conference on Asia-Pacific Digital Libraries (ICADL 2026)
summary: Digital libraries, repositories, and AI-mediated knowledge services increasingly rely on generative systems to produce summaries, descriptions, and other multi-claim knowledge objects. Yet generation can scale far more easily than verification capacity: a reviewer may need to decide whether an object is suitable for publication or downstream use after checking only a small fraction of its claims. This creates a fundamental gap between claim-level verification and confidence in the object as a whole. The central question is therefore what a successful partial check implies about the reliability of the complete artifact when its size grows but the verification budget does not. This paper contributes a Bayesian model of bounded verification centered on the Predictive Value of Pass (PVP). The model predicts that evidentiary value decreases as artifacts grow under fixed verification capacity, improves with larger verification budgets, and is especially fragile when errors are sparse. Controlled experiments on FEVEROUS and FEVER support these predictions and show that adding supported claims around a fixed number of false or unsupported claims can make passing more likely while making a pass less informative. The model further yields the minimum verification budget required to maintain a target PVP, providing a practical component for AI-assisted quality-assurance workflows in which generated knowledge objects must be checked before publication or downstream use.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"通过预测价值"(PVP)的贝叶斯有界验证模型,刻画验证预算固定而知识对象规模增长时,部分抽检通过所能提供的证据价值衰减规律。
AI.motivation: 数字图书馆、知识库与AI知识服务依赖生成系统批量产出多论断知识对象,但生成能力远超验证能力:审阅者只能检查极小比例论断,却需据此判断整体是否可用。这形成"论断级验证"与"对象整体置信度"之间的根本缺口。核心问题是:当对象规模增长而验证预算不变时,成功部分抽检对完整对象可靠性能说明什么。
