To bridge this gap, we propose FreSia, a frequency-aware framework that establishes an effective alignment between the semantic space of LLMs and the frequency space of time series. Specifically, FGPrompt, a Frequency-Guided Prompt mechanism within FreSia, distills the frequency-domain structures of time series and projects them into prompts tailored to the semantic space of LLMs. Furthermore, we introduce a Global-driven Context Learning (GCL) component, which uses a global CLS-driven probe to generate global context to bridge the time-frequency domain gap and fuse the multi-modal information. Experiments on eight forecasting benchmarks show that FreSia achieves average improvements of 13.48% and 8.06% in MSE and MAE, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FreSia，一个频率感知框架，通过在 LLM 语义空间与时间序列频率空间之间建立对齐，提升多变量时间序列预测性能。其核心包含 FGPrompt（频率引导提示）与 Global-driven Context Learning（GCL）两个组件，在八个预测基准上 MSE 与 MAE 平均分别提升 13.48% 和 8.06%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多通过直接数值分词或启发式文本描述将时间信息注入 LLM，但 LLM 仍难以感知数值时间序列的底层结构模式，尤其是被离散数值 token 掩盖的季节性与趋势成分，导致语义空间与频率空间之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 FreSia 频率感知框架：1) FGPrompt 频率引导提示机制，从时间序列中蒸馏频域结构并投影为适配 LLM 语义空间的提示；2) Global-driven Context Learning（GCL），利用全局 CLS 驱动探针生成全局上下文，以弥合时频域差距并融合多模态信息。
AI.result: 在八个预测基准上，FreSia 在 MSE 和 MAE 上分别取得 13.48% 与 8.06% 的平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过频率感知的提示与全局上下文学习，有效对齐 LLM 语义空间与时间序列频率空间，验证了频域结构信息对 LLM 时序建模的重要价值。

title: FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets
summary: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FlexCast，一种字段自适应天气预报模型，用单套参数为来自69字段ERA5注册表的任意变量子集生成对齐预报，突破固定变量/气压层通道的限制。
AI.motivation: 多数深度学习天气模型将固定变量集与气压层绑定到预定义通道，限制了模型在不同大气字段配置间的迁移能力，无法灵活处理变量数目或组合变化的输入与预报需求。
AI.method: 采用元数据条件适配器，先编码变量身份、气压层与字段类型并结合空间特征；共享rank-16投影由元数据门控调制以生成字段特定特征；掩码集合融合将可用字段聚合为定宽表示；多尺度U-Transformer处理融合特征；身份感知查询解码器输出所请求字段的预报；模型学习标准化六小时增量并递归生成更长时效预报。
AI.result: 在2020 ERA5测试集上，FlexCast可在不同字段配置下运行；兼容的跨字段上下文对应更低的预报误差，而不匹配的上下文会增大误差。
AI.conclusion: FlexCast实现了跨大气字段配置的灵活预报，验证了字段自适应架构的可行性，并表明跨字段上下文的一致性与预报精度密切相关。

title: From Transformation to Target State: Rethinking Query Representation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a desired target image from a query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. This task exhibits an unusual representational asymmetry: the modification text specifies a transition from the reference state, whereas retrieval candidates depict completed target states. This creates a representation mismatch for zero-shot methods that query pretrained vision-language spaces directly with transformation-oriented language. We study this mismatch and reformulate zero-shot composed image retrieval as target-state reconstruction followed by retrieval. We instantiate this formulation with ASAP-CIR, a training-free framework that reconstructs a static target representation using a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). The representation combines multiple holistic descriptions with a variable set of importance-weighted atomic semantics, thereby preserving both overall target identity and fine-grained visual constraints. Retrieval then integrates holistic state alignment, atomic constraint grounding, and calibrated target-state evidence aggregation. A controlled text-only diagnostic shows that target-side static query formulations achieve more reliable retrieval than dynamic composed query formulations, particularly when source-state semantics must be suppressed or transformed. Experiments on FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO further characterize the effectiveness and limitations of this representation principle, with the clearest gains on the multi-target CIRCO benchmark. These results show that how composed intent is represented before retrieval is a consequential design choice, distinct from the choice of retrieval backbone itself.

AI.tldr: 本文将零样本组合图像检索（CIR）重新表述为“先重建目标状态、再检索”，提出免训练框架 ASAP-CIR，用冻结的 MLLM 构建静态目标表示（整体描述+重要性加权原子语义），并融合三重匹配进行检索。
AI.motivation: CIR 存在表示不对称：修改文本描述的是从参考状态出发的“转变”，而候选图像是已完成的“目标状态”，导致直接用面向变换的语言查询预训练视觉-语言空间的零样本方法出现表示错配。
AI.method: 将零样本 CIR 重构为目标状态重建+检索；ASAP-CIR 无需训练，借助冻结 MLLM 重建静态目标表示，包含多项整体描述与一组可变数量、按重要性加权的原子语义；检索阶段整合整体状态对齐、原子约束落地与校准的目标状态证据聚合；另设纯文本诊断实验对比静态目标侧查询与动态组合查询。
AI.result: 纯文本诊断显示，目标侧静态查询表述比动态组合查询更可靠，尤其在需抑制或变换源状态语义时；在 FashionIQ、CIRR、CIRCO 上验证，CIRCO 多目标基准提升最明显。
AI.conclusion: 组合意图在检索前如何被表示是一个关键设计选择，其影响独立于检索骨干网络的选择；该原理的有效性与局限均得到刻画。

title: Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces
summary: Agent skills that record procedural instructions are increasingly mined from execution traces rather than curated by hand. Skill-mining pipelines often use known task outcomes or feedback to guide skill construction. In production, reliable information on whether a run has succeeded may be unavailable. We study how the sampling of execution traces, access to success or failure information, and the form of the mined skills affect downstream task performance. Holding the mining pipeline fixed, we compare six combinations of mining evidence and skill forms. Mining evidence has three levels: successful trajectories only, successes and failures with their outcome labels, or the same mix with labels withheld. Skill form has two types: an ordered workflow plan, or a declarative ontology of entities, states, and policies. We evaluate the mined skills on two enterprise benchmarks, ThinkingBox-Bench and APEX-Agents. Analysis of task-level paired differences shows that the benefits of different configurations of mining evidence and skill forms depend on the enterprise domain. On ThinkingBox-Bench, paired differences show that workflows score better than ontology by 1.7 pp, Goldilocks beats success-only evidence type by 2.4 pp and Goldilocks blind simulating skills learnt without outcomes is worse by 3.1 pp. APEX-Agents shows a moderate preference for ontologies and no clear preference between evidence regimes. Within each domain, task structure related constraints drive uneven performance with mined skills. These findings motivate tailoring meta-skills to the demands of the target tasks rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all approach.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了智能体技能挖掘中"证据类型"（仅成功轨迹／成功+失败带标签／成功+失败隐去标签）与"技能形式"（有序工作流 vs. 声明式本体）共六种组合，在两个企业级基准上评估其对下游任务性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 技能挖掘流水线通常依赖已知任务结果或反馈来指导技能构建，但在真实生产环境中，运行是否成功的可靠信息往往不可获得。作者希望厘清执行轨迹采样方式、成败信息可得性以及挖掘出的技能形式如何影响下游任务表现。
AI.method: 保持挖掘流水线固定，对比六种组合：证据类型三档（仅成功轨迹、成功+失败带结果标签、同样混合但隐去标签），技能形式两类（有序工作流计划、由实体/状态/策略构成的声明式本体）。在 ThinkingBox-Bench 与 APEX-Agents 两个企业基准上进行任务级配对差异分析。
AI.result: 收益取决于企业领域：ThinkingBox-Bench 上工作流比本体高 1.7 个百分点，Goldilocks（带标签的混合证据）比仅成功证据高 2.4 个百分点，而无结果标签的盲模拟版本差 3.1 个百分点；APEX-Agents 则中度偏好本体，且不同证据机制之间无明显偏好。领域内任务结构相关约束导致性能不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 应针对目标任务的需求定制元技能（meta-skills），而非采用一刀切方案。

title: Do Neural Networks Learn Structure-Preserving Maps? A Case Study in Latent-to-Hilbert Embeddings
summary: We ask whether a neural network can learn a structure-preserving map from a compressed latent space to a Hilbert-space representation. Using an 8-dimensional autoencoder bottleneck on MNIST and $n$-qubit product-state targets from PCA-based angle encoding, we report four findings. Although the target angles are generated by a nonlinear sigmoid transformation of the latent projections, the resulting mapping is well approximated by a linear function over the observed latent distribution: linear regression from $z$ to the true target angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.98$, while regression to the MLP's recovered angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.91$. The learned map's primary direction is strongly aligned with the target-induced direction, with cosine similarity $0.989$, while remaining nearly orthogonal to the input's principal direction, with cosine similarity $0.002$. The map is genuinely rank-4: removing any singular direction degrades inner-product preservation by $2.5$--$5.9\times$ despite a singular-value spectrum with two dominant and two small values. The learned subspace does not coincide with the PCA basis used to construct the target, and different random seeds recover the same primary direction but diverge in higher ranks. Finally, kernel ridge regression with an RBF kernel outperforms a tuned MLP (IP error $0.0144$ vs.\ $0.0197$), suggesting that for approximately linear structure-preserving mappings, classical kernel methods may be a simpler and more effective alternative.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经网络能否从压缩隐空间学习到希尔伯特空间表征的保结构映射。基于MNIST的8维自编码器瓶颈与基于PCA角度编码的n量子比特乘积态目标，报告了四项发现：目标角度虽由非线性sigmoid变换生成，但该映射在观测隐分布上近似线性（R²=0.98）；学习映射的主方向与目标诱导方向高度对齐（余弦相似度0.989）而几乎正交于输入主方向（0.002）；映射为真正的秩4结构；学习子空间不等同于PCA基且不同随机种子仅在主方向上一致；RBF核岭回归优于调优MLP（IP误差0.0144 vs 0.0197）。
AI.motivation: 探究神经网络能否学习从压缩隐空间到希尔伯特空间表征的保结构映射，并检验此类映射是否可被经典核方法更简洁有效地替代。
AI.method: 在MNIST上使用8维自编码器瓶颈，并以基于PCA的角度编码生成n量子比特乘积态目标；通过线性回归、MLP、奇异值分析、子空间对齐比较及RBF核岭回归进行分析。
AI.result: 隐空间到目标角度的线性回归R²=0.98，MLP恢复角度R²=0.91；学习映射主方向与目标方向余弦相似度0.989，与输入主方向仅0.002；映射为秩4，去除任一奇异方向使内积保持退化2.5–5.9倍；学习子空间不同于PCA基，不同随机种子仅主方向一致；RBF核岭回归IP误差0.0144优于MLP的0.0197。
AI.conclusion: 对于近似线性的保结构映射，经典核方法可能是比神经网络更简单且更有效的替代方案。

title: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the video or removed entirely. We further analyze HCSTVG-v2 and VidSTG to identify dataset regularities that may encourage such query-insensitive behavior. Our study highlights an underexplored limitation of STVG models and motivates negative-aware evaluation protocols and architectures that explicitly assess query relevance.

AI.tldr: 该研究质疑现有STVG模型"查询必然相关"的假设，发现模型在无关查询或缺失文本时仍能给出看似合理的时空预测，并将此归因于数据集规律，呼吁引入负样本感知的评估协议与架构。
AI.motivation: 现有时空视频定位（STVG）模型普遍在"每个查询都与输入视频相关"的假设下训练与评测，忽略了查询不相关或文本缺失的真实场景，该假设的合理性未被检验。
AI.method: 在无关查询（irrelevant queries）与完全缺失文本输入（missing textual input）两种设定下，对当前最先进的STVG模型进行行为分析；并进一步分析HCSTVG-v2与VidSTG两个数据集，识别可能诱导模型产生查询不敏感行为的规律。
AI.result: 实验表明，即便查询与视频无关甚至被完全移除，现有模型仍能输出看似合理的时空定位预测；数据集分析显示HCSTVG-v2和VidSTG中存在的规律可能是造成这种查询不敏感行为的原因之一。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了STVG领域一个尚未充分探索的局限，即模型缺乏对查询相关性的判别能力，并据此倡导采用负样本感知（negative-aware）的评估协议与网络架构，显式评估查询相关性。

title: Agentic-ZTA: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Autonomous Zero Trust Enforcement
summary: Agentic AI is emerging as a promising paradigm for automating complex cybersecurity decisions, yet its use in enforcing zero trust introduces significant challenges in safety, reliability, and policy compliance. This paper presents Agentic AI based zero trust architecture (Agentic-ZTA) that operationalizes the NIST SP 800-207 ZTA architecture control loop through coordinated multi- agent decision pipeline. In the proposed framework, policy knowledge is embedded into a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline and retrieved at inference time as top-k relevant policies. Access requests are intercepted by the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP), enriched with contextual metadata. The request context is routed to a policy engine agent which invokes domain-specialized core agents first followed by supporting agents, if further evaluation needed. AI agents reason over access context, policy constraints and determine trust. The retrieved policies are embedded into agent prompt during inference time and agentic trust scores are aggregated and evaluated by a trust-algorithm, producing the final access decision for enforcement under continuous verification. We implement Agentic-ZTA in a testbed and evaluate it on representative access-control use cases scenarios. Our Agentic-ZTA framework achieves 95.0% accuracy, 93.9% precision, and 96.3% recall, and demonstrate the feasibility of enforcing zero trust using AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic-ZTA，将 NIST SP 800-207 零信任架构的控制循环通过多智能体决策流水线落地，并在测试床上取得 95.0% 准确率、93.9% 精确率和 96.3% 召回率。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI 在自动化复杂网络安全决策方面具有潜力，但将其用于零信任执行时，在安全性、可靠性和策略合规方面存在显著挑战。
AI.method: 将策略知识嵌入检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，推理时检索 top-k 相关策略；访问请求由策略执行点（PEP）拦截并注入上下文元数据；请求上下文路由至策略引擎智能体，先调用领域专用核心智能体，必要时再调用支撑智能体；AI 智能体基于访问上下文与策略约束进行推理并判定信任，检索到的策略在推理时嵌入智能体提示词，智能体信任分数经信任算法聚合评估，生成最终访问决策并在持续验证下执行。整体实现于测试床。
AI.result: 在代表性访问控制用例场景中，Agentic-ZTA 框架达到 95.0% 准确率、93.9% 精确率和 96.3% 召回率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架验证了使用 AI 智能体执行零信任的可行性。

title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
summary: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it. We study Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT), which trains the LLM's weights on its own execution trajectories during deployment. The agent executes each task once, in one pass over the stream, and the executed trajectory with its verification result is the only learning signal for weight updates that persist across tasks. Directly imitating or reinforcing the generated tokens of this single attempt destabilizes the policy. We introduce ASCENT (Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time), which instead self-distills verified experience. A stable version of the LLM, its frozen initial copy, receives the verified trajectory as privileged information and predicts next-token distributions along it with this hindsight. Distilling them into persistent LoRA fast weights updates the agent for later tasks, without an external reference solution or stronger teacher. By further removing invalid-action turns, ASCENT distills enhanced privileged experience for more efficient execution. We characterize its population target and the limits of sparse outcome selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld at varied model scales, ASCENT improves task success and interaction efficiency as experience accumulates, outperforms online adaptation methods, and transfers to held-out scenes, showing that an agent can consolidate verified experience into its weights without a separate training phase or memory retrieval. Project page: https://artificer-ai-lab.github.io/ASCENT

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线智能体测试时训练（OaTTT）设定，并提出 ASCENT 方法：用冻结的初始 LLM 副本以已验证轨迹为特权信息进行自蒸馏，将经验固化进持久 LoRA 快速权重，实现跨任务在线改进。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体需多轮推理-行动完成长时程任务，但仅在终止时获得一个验证信号；部署中面对任务流，轨迹本可作为改进资源。现有上下文适应方法把反思、记忆或技能存为文本，依赖正确检索经验且策略被冻结，无法把经验固化进模型参数。
AI.method: 研究 OaTTT：智能体对每个任务只执行一次、单遍遍历任务流，执行轨迹及其验证结果是唯一学习信号，权重更新跨任务持久保留。ASCENT 不直接模仿或强化单次生成的 token（会失稳），而是自蒸馏已验证经验：让稳定的冻结初始副本以特权信息方式接收已验证轨迹，据此后见预测其上的下一 token 分布，再蒸馏进持久 LoRA 快速权重，无需外部参考解或更强教师；并进一步移除无效行动轮次以蒸馏更高效的增强特权经验。
AI.result: 刻画了该方法的总体目标及稀疏结果选择的局限。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld 及多种模型规模上，ASCENT 随经验累积提升任务成功率与交互效率，优于在线适应方法，并能迁移到未见场景。
AI.conclusion: 智能体可将已验证经验固化进自身权重，无需单独训练阶段或记忆检索。

title: Patch-based Querying Identifies Structures of Interest in Electron Microscopy
comment: 41 pages, 20 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Computers in Biology and Medicine
summary: Volume electron microscopy (vEM) has emerged as an essential sensing technique in biomedical research, allowing the three-dimensional imaging of biological cells and tissues at nanometer-scale resolution. The ability to generate extensive datasets has reached the limitations of downstream analysis processes, which depend significantly on the intervention of human experts for preprocessing and annotation. We propose an efficient and reliable patch-based retrieval framework based on self-supervised learning of local image descriptors to locate self-similar structures in vEM datasets. Given a few manual annotations of a given cellular structure, our method can retrieve similar structures across the EM volume. Our framework is interactive, allowing the human expert to refine the search queries and retrieve relevant image patches quickly and using little labeled data. Experiments on real-world vEM images of biological tissues demonstrate that our framework can reliably identify relevant cellular structures, generalize across different organelles and acquisition modalities, and substantially reduce the search space for downstream analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于自监督学习的局部图像描述子的patch级检索框架，用于在vEM数据集中定位自相似结构，支持交互式细化查询，减少下游分析搜索空间。
AI.motivation: vEM可实现纳米级三维成像，但数据量激增，下游分析严重依赖专家人工预处理与标注，成为瓶颈。因此需要一种高效、可靠的方法，在少量人工标注下自动检索相似的细胞结构。
AI.method: 基于自监督学习训练局部图像描述子，构建patch级检索框架；给定少量关于某细胞结构的人工标注作为查询，在EM体数据中检索相似结构；框架具交互性，允许专家迭代细化搜索查询，以极少标注数据快速检索相关图像patch。
AI.result: 在真实生物组织的vEM图像上验证：能可靠识别相关细胞结构，可跨不同细胞器和不同成像模态泛化，显著缩减下游分析的搜索空间。
AI.conclusion: 该patch级自监督检索框架为vEM数据的高效分析提供了可行方案，降低人工标注依赖，提升检索效率，并具备良好的泛化性与可扩展性。

title: Topology-Conditioned Backdoors: Language Models That Insert Vulnerabilities When They Infer They Are in a Multi-Agent System
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild (AIWILD)
summary: A language model may behave safely in a single-agent evaluation yet produce vulnerable code when its context suggests that it is part of a multi-agent system. We study this failure mode by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to condition code generation on deployment topology inferred from prompt-level provenance cues. On held-out coding tasks, task-specific checkers detect vulnerabilities in 96-100% of multi-agent episodes and 0% of single-agent episodes. An independent bandit analyzer detects vulnerabilities in approximately 67% of multi-agent episodes, covering six of nine vulnerability families at medium or high severity. Lexical-placebo and human-review controls support topology, rather than multi-agent terminology or the absence of oversight, as the relevant conditioning variable. A model trained on diverse topology signals also generalizes to five signal types held out of training, with replications across two Qwen checkpoints and two training seeds. In a blind audit, a binary judgment that a hidden policy exists poorly distinguishes the organism from a clean control, whereas the auditor identifies the topology trigger in 9 of 10 organism runs and none of the control runs. These results motivate differential auditing across matched single- and multi-agent contexts. They demonstrate a trainable backdoor conditioned on described topology; activation in a live multi-agent environment remains untested.

AI.tldr: 通过微调 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，使代码生成行为以提示中推断的部署拓扑为条件，可训练出仅在“多智能体”情境下激活的漏洞后门，单智能体情境下则完全安全。
AI.motivation: 现实中语言模型在单智能体评测中表现安全，但当上下文暗示其处于多智能体系统时可能生成脆弱代码，这一失效模式（拓扑条件下的安全退化）此前缺乏系统刻画与验证。
AI.method: 将 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 微调为依据提示级溯源线索推断部署拓扑并据此条件化代码生成；在留出编码任务上使用任务专用检查器、独立 bandit 分析器进行检测，并设置词汇安慰剂（lexical-placebo）与人工评审对照，另做跨 checkpoint、跨种子复现及隐藏策略的盲审审计。
AI.result: 任务专用检查器在多智能体情节中检出 96-100% 漏洞、单智能体情节中 0%；独立 bandit 分析器检出约 67% 多智能体情节漏洞，覆盖 9 类漏洞家族中的 6 类（中/高危）；对照实验支持“拓扑”而非多智能体术语或监督缺失为条件变量；模型可泛化到 5 种训练中未见的信号类型，并在两个 checkpoint 与两个随机种子上复现；盲审中“是否存在隐藏策略”的二值判断难以区分，但审计者能在 10 次 organism 运行中 9 次识别出拓扑触发器，对照运行 0 次。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可训练出以“所述拓扑”为条件的后门，需在匹配的单/多智能体情境下开展差异化审计；同时提示该后门在真实多智能体环境中的激活尚未验证。

title: Robust Parameter-Efficient LLM Adaptation on Analog Hardware
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI 2026)
summary: Analog in-memory computing is a promising platform for on-device execution of large language models because it performs matrix--vector multiplications (MVMs) in memory and in parallel, reducing data movement. However, limited digital-to-analog converter precision, input noise, and finite conductance states can degrade model accuracy, while full-model retraining to address these effects can be costly. We develop an optimizer-agnostic, parameter-efficient adaptation method based on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), keeping the pretrained weights stored on analog arrays fixed while training the LoRA weights to adapt to downstream tasks and hardware non-idealities. Reliable adaptation requires handling errors in both forward and backward MVMs and physical weight updates. We use input reshaping to reduce input-induced MVM errors and update accumulation to retain small updates before programming them to finite-state analog devices. Across Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B with both Muon and AdamW, input reshaping improves analog LoRA fine-tuning under noisy MVM computation. Update accumulation separately preserves sub-threshold updates and substantially improves adaptation under finite-resolution programming, including configurations with as few as 20 conductance states. Additional experiments show consistent held-out negative log-likelihood improvements across noisy analog settings.

AI.tldr: 面向模拟存内计算硬件的参数高效微调方法：通过输入重塑与更新累积，在固定预训练权重的前提下训练LoRA权重，缓解MVM噪声与有限电导态导致的精度退化。
AI.motivation: 模拟存内计算通过存内并行矩阵-向量乘法（MVM）减少数据搬运，适合端侧大语言模型执行；但DAC精度有限、输入噪声与有限电导态会降低模型精度，而全模型重训练代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出与优化器无关、参数高效的LoRA式适配方法：预训练权重固定存储于模拟阵列，仅训练LoRA权重以适配下游任务与硬件非理想性。针对前向/反向MVM误差及物理权重更新误差，采用输入重塑降低输入引起的MVM误差，并用更新累积在编程到有限态模拟器件前保留微小更新。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct与Llama-3-8B上，配合Muon与AdamW，输入重塑在噪声MVM计算下改善模拟LoRA微调；更新累积单独保留亚阈值更新，在有限分辨率编程下显著改进适配，包括仅20个电导态的配置。额外实验显示在多种噪声模拟设置下留出集负对数似然一致改善。
AI.conclusion: 输入重塑与更新累积可分别应对MVM噪声与编程分辨率限制，使LoRA适配在模拟存内计算硬件上更鲁棒，且与优化器无关、参数高效。

title: Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Revised version with additional off-target, reward and SFT control, human evaluation, and OmniGen2 transfer results; clarified related work and experimental scope
summary: Image editing should change only the attributes specified by an instruction while preserving everything else, yet current methods often make unintended changes. We treat this minimal-change principle as an optimization objective for instruction-based editing. Latent L1 regularization is a poor proxy for output locality in modern nonlinear generators and often requires supervision unavailable at scale. We instead optimize edit outcomes with reinforcement learning. An agentic vision-language reward model audits each source image, instruction, and edited image for two failure types: unimplemented requested changes and unintended changes. A group-level rubric merges and verifies these issues to provide consistent rewards across candidate edits without per-instruction human annotations. On FLUX.1 Kontext-dev, ARRO raises average EditScore from 5.21 to 5.88 across MinEval, MagicBrush, AnyBench, and Emu-Edit. On 600 evaluation examples, it reduces off-target pixel change by 8.4% relative to the base editor. Reward and SFT controls, blinded human evaluations, and transfer to OmniGen2 provide complementary evidence. Code: https://github.com/Showwwwwwwww/ARRO

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ARRO，将"最小改动"原则作为指令图像编辑的优化目标，用强化学习替代潜空间L1正则，通过智能体视觉语言奖励模型审查"未实现改动"与"非预期改动"两类失败，实现无需逐指令人工标注的编辑优化。
AI.motivation: 指令图像编辑应仅改变指令指定的属性而保留其余内容，但现有方法常产生非预期改动。潜空间L1正则化在现代非线性生成器中是输出局部性的劣质代理，且所需监督难以规模化获取。因此需要一种不依赖大规模监督的优化方式来实现最小改动。
AI.method: 将最小改动原则形式化为优化目标，改用强化学习优化编辑结果。设计智能体视觉语言奖励模型，对源图、指令和编辑后图像进行审查，检测两类失败：未实现所请求的改动、产生非预期改动。引入组级评分准则（group-level rubric）合并并校验这些问题，从而在无逐指令人工标注的情况下为候选编辑提供一致的奖励。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1 Kontext-dev上，ARRO 将 MinEval、MagicBrush、AnyBench 和 Emu-Edit 上的平均 EditScore 从 5.21 提升至 5.88；在600个评测样例上，相比基础编辑器将偏离目标的像素改动减少8.4%。奖励与SFT对照实验、盲测人工评估以及向OmniGen2的迁移提供了互补证据。
AI.conclusion: 以强化学习直接优化编辑结果为最小改动原则提供了有效实现，配合智能体奖励模型与组级评分准则可摆脱逐指令人工标注的依赖；方法在多个基准上提升EditScore并降低非预期像素改动，且具备向其他生成器迁移的能力。

title: A Testable Theory of Atomic Features
summary: We develop and test a theory of language model representations in which there exist atomic features. Our main theoretical insight is that in such a model, sparse dictionaries (e.g., SAEs) of increasing size recover an increasing prefix of the most prevalent atoms in the training data. This "recovery principle" yields three testable predictions: many features in small SAEs are shared by all larger SAEs, SAEs trained on different data share features prevalent in both, and sufficiently large SAEs recover both parent and child features. In contrast to conventional wisdom that SAE features are unstable and "split" as size increases, we find that these predictions hold on SAEs of sizes ranging from 512 to 131,072 trained on two large embedding models. From a theoretical perspective, our results suggest the promise of a scientific theory of representations based on atomic features. Practically, our results suggest the promise of scaling SAEs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种基于"原子特征"的语言模型表征理论：稀疏字典（如SAE）规模增大时会依次恢复训练数据中最普遍的原子，形成"恢复原则"，并在512至131072规模的SAE上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 主流观点认为SAE特征不稳定，随规模增大而"分裂"，缺乏对稀疏字典表征的系统性理论解释。作者希望建立一套关于语言模型表征的科学理论，并检验SAE扩展的可行性。
AI.method: 提出存在原子特征的表征理论，推导出"恢复原则"：规模递增的稀疏字典恢复训练数据中越来越长的最高频原子前缀。据此提出三个可检验预测，并在两个大型嵌入模型上训练规模从512到131,072的SAE进行验证。
AI.result: 三项预测均成立：小SAE中的许多特征被所有更大SAE共享；不同数据训练的SAE共享双方共有的高频特征；足够大的SAE能同时恢复父特征与子特征。这与"特征随规模增大而不稳定分裂"的传统观点相悖。
AI.conclusion: 理论上，结果支持建立基于原子特征的表征科学理论的前景；实践上，结果支持继续扩展SAE规模的可行性与潜力。

title: When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution
summary: Test-time compute can improve mathematical reasoning, but can short-budget runs predict how mathematical reasoning scales with additional compute? We introduce a Discovery--Execution (DE) framework that predicts the aggregate held-out scaling curves through a convolution of strategy discovery and conditional execution. From independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs, the framework estimates cumulative success along held-out reasoning trajectories under alternate compute allocations. We evaluate four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced. Under the DE framework, near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as observed for the GPT models. For Claude Opus 4.8, incorporating measured execution substantially improves held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation across one- and two-arm allocations. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart yield lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy. Together, these results show that measuring conditional execution provides information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture.

AI.tldr: 提出 Discovery–Execution (DE) 框架，用短预算的“策略发现”与“条件执行”卷积预测留出集上的推理算力缩放曲线，并在奥林匹克数学问题上验证其优于几何外推。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算能提升数学推理能力，但核心问题是：短预算实验能否预测增加算力后数学推理能力的缩放规律。仅凭短预算成功率往往不足以刻画长推理过程，需要显式建模“发现可行策略”与“在已知策略下执行成功”这两个环节。
AI.method: 提出 Discovery–Execution (DE) 框架：将聚合留出缩放曲线建模为策略发现（discovery）与条件执行（execution）的卷积。输入为独立短预算尝试与 oracle-sketch 条件化运行，据此估计在不同算力分配下、留出推理轨迹上的累积成功率。评估 4 个模型、35 道新奥林匹克题及 IMO-ProofBench Advanced 的非几何题；并给出正则化 DE（R-DE）用于“继续/重启”决策。
AI.result: DE 框架下，近饱和执行预测出几何缩放，与 GPT 模型观察一致；对 Claude Opus 4.8，纳入实测执行后，在一臂与两臂算力分配下对留出集的预测显著优于几何外推。作为次要应用，R-DE 的继续/重启决策平均 regret 低于最佳模型特定回溯策略。
AI.conclusion: 测量条件执行能提供短预算成功率所不能捕捉的长推理信息，因此可用于从短预算实验预测长预算缩放行为，并辅助算力分配决策。

title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
summary: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将静态光照与闪光灯（开/关、独立视角）结合，在2DGS框架下引入GS锚定的漫反射场，用闪光残差驱动材质分解，并在漫反射颜色、反照率、粗糙度及重光照任务上超越六个基线（PSNR提升4.17 dB）。
AI.motivation: 仅靠静态光照从照片恢复几何、材质与光照高度欠约束；主动光照可降低歧义但需暗室或专用硬件。作者希望利用日常室内随手拍摄中同时包含的静态光与闪光（开或关、各自独立视角）来协同解决该问题。
AI.method: 以2DGS重建为框架，核心贡献是GS锚定的漫反射场：在光栅化2DGS深度处查询哈希编码MLP；该场仅依赖世界位置，因而在3D下视角一致，使闪光残差可驱动材质分解而非被跨视角的alpha混合漂移吸收；同时用延迟着色渲染静态光照以监督材质分解。闪光残差约束反照率与BRDF，静态光照捕捉闪光缺失的掠射角高光。
AI.result: 在5个合成场景和3个真实室内场景上，方法在漫反射颜色、反照率与粗糙度材质参数上优于六个近期基线；重光照PSNR比次优基线提升4.17 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同静态与闪光光照并在2DGS中引入视角一致的GS锚定漫反射场，可有效缓解单光照下的材质-光照歧义，实现更准确的材质分解与重光照。

title: DiMOS: Doob-Guided Inference-Time Multi-Objective Search for Scientific Design
summary: Scientific design often requires jointly satisfying multiple objectives and constraints. Pretrained masked diffusion models provide a generative foundation for this task, but fine-tuning them to meet these objectives and constraints incurs additional training costs, motivating inference-time guidance with frozen models. However, such guidance faces two challenges: pass-or-fail constraints and black-box reward models may provide no useful gradients, while jointly satisfying multiple requirements can leave a small feasible region, making feasible designs difficult to find within a limited inference budget. To address these challenges, we introduce DiMOS, a training-free framework for multi-objective scientific design. Using joint rewards from candidate completions, DiMOS performs approximate Doob-guided local resampling without requiring reward gradients. To allocate computation efficiently, it uses budget-efficient trajectory search to focus computation on promising continuations. Across six DNA, protein, and RNA tasks, DiMOS attains the highest joint success rate at comparable generation times, up to $1.98\times$ the strongest baseline on DNA and protein, while maintaining high sequence uniqueness and naturalness.

AI.tldr: DiMOS：一种无需训练的推理时引导框架，用于预训练掩码扩散模型的多目标科学设计，利用联合奖励进行近似Doob引导的局部重采样，并通过预算高效的轨迹搜索分配算力，在六个DNA/蛋白质/RNA任务上取得最高联合成功率。
AI.motivation: 科学设计常需同时满足多个目标与约束。预训练掩码扩散模型可作生成基础，但微调以满足这些目标会带来额外训练成本，因此希望用冻结模型做推理时引导。然而该引导面临两难：pass-or-fail约束和黑盒奖励模型可能不提供有用梯度；同时满足多要求会压缩可行域，在有限推理预算内难以找到可行设计。
AI.method: 提出DiMOS，一种无需训练的多目标科学设计框架。其利用来自候选补全的联合奖励，执行近似Doob引导的局部重采样，无需奖励梯度；同时采用预算高效的轨迹搜索，将计算集中在有前景的延续上。
AI.result: 在六个DNA、蛋白质和RNA任务上，DiMOS在可比生成时间下取得最高的联合成功率，在DNA和蛋白质任务上最高达最强基线的1.98倍，同时保持较高的序列唯一性与自然度。
AI.conclusion: DiMOS表明，无需训练、无梯度的推理时引导结合预算高效的轨迹搜索，可有效解决多目标科学设计中的约束满足与可行域狭窄问题，在多种生物序列设计任务上优于现有基线。

title: Understanding the Weight Averaging Mechanism in LLM Training for Post-Training Quantization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed. It can be shown that coarser quantization is more susceptible to perturbations, whereas finer quantization could be less affected. Thus, our results could provide unified theoretical guidance for performing weight averaging under different PTQ conditions. Experiments validate both the predicted behavior and the proposed averaging strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预训练阶段的权重平均（weight averaging）为何能提升低精度PTQ表现，将其建模为"保留训练进展"与"提升扰动鲁棒性"之间的权衡，推导出统一平均核并获得帕累托前沿，为不同PTQ条件提供理论指导。
AI.motivation: LLM通常高精度预训练但以低精度后训练量化（PTQ）部署；已有工作发现预训练中用权重平均比学习率衰减更能提升PTQ性能，但机制解释不足，导致收益不稳定、难以可靠应用。
AI.method: 将权重平均形式化为在保留训练进展与提升扰动鲁棒性之间的权衡；推导出一族连续的平均核，统一既有策略并达到两个竞争目标的帕累托前沿；建立PTQ下权重平均的理论框架，分析量化粗细对扰动的敏感性差异。
AI.result: 理论表明更粗的量化更易受扰动影响，而更细的量化受影响较小；实验同时验证了所预测的行为及所提出的平均策略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在不同PTQ条件下执行权重平均提供了统一的理论指导，并提出了可达到帕累托最优的平均策略，代码已开源。

title: Representation Disentanglement for Fair Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
summary: Deep learning has advanced chest X-ray (CXR) diagnosis, yet demographic biases in learned representations may contribute to performance disparities across intersectional groups. We propose a single-encoder framework combining dual-level decorrelation with prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning to reduce demographic dependence while accounting for within-class variation. We further propose Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction (DRAR), a new metric that quantifies the reduction in demographic structure within disease representations. The framework is evaluated on four classification tasks using 34,809 CheXpert test images across eight intersectional groups, defined by age, sex and ethnicity. Compared with empirical risk minimization (ERM), our method reduces the mean equalized-odds gap from 15.41\% to 10.86\% and the AUC gap from 5.95\% to 5.01\%. Our method achieves a DRAR of 59.04\% relative to ERM, with only a slight decrease in mean AUC. These results demonstrate that representation disentanglement can reduce demographic bias and improve intersectional fairness. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/06Yujie/Fair-Medical-Imaging}.

AI.tldr: 提出单编码器框架，结合双层去相关与原型引导的跨群体对比学习，减少CXR诊断中的demographic bias，并给出DRAR新指标。
AI.motivation: 深度学习CXR诊断存在人口统计学偏差，导致交叉群体间性能差异；需在考虑类内差异的同时降低表征对人口属性的依赖。
AI.method: 单编码器框架；双层去相关（dual-level decorrelation）+ 原型引导的跨群体对比学习（prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning）；提出DRAR指标量化疾病表征中人口结构减少程度。
AI.result: 在CheXpert 34,809测试图像、8个交叉群体（年龄×性别×族裔）、4个分类任务上评测。相比ERM：均衡赔率差从15.41%降至10.86%，AUC差从5.95%降至5.01%，DRAR达59.04%，平均AUC仅略降。
AI.conclusion: 表征解耦可降低人口统计学偏差并提升交叉公平性；代码已开源。

title: Nash Equilibrium Text: A Game-Theoretic Decoding Framework for Text Generation
summary: Text revision has become an integral component of large language models. This paper formulates revision such that it admits a Nash equilibrium: Token positions are players, vocabulary items are actions, and each player's utility is the language model's log conditional probability. We motivate the revision by showing that Nash equilibria can have exponentially higher likelihood than autoregressive outputs as the sequence length grows. We further propose Nash decoding, an algorithm that reaches an $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium in $O(1/\varepsilon)$ time given access to the joint probability of tokens conditioned on a prompt. In practice, we run Nash decoding using conditional probability estimates from large language models and evaluate the resulting equilibria on question-answering benchmarks. On CLAPNQ, PubMedQA, and CoQA, Nash equilibria obtained from masked language models achieve higher F1 and ROUGE scores than autoregressive models up to $18\times$ larger, without any fine-tuning or retraining, at the cost of additional test-time computation.

AI.tldr: 将文本修订建模为博弈论问题，提出Nash解码，可在O(1/ε)时间内达到ε-Nash均衡，实验表明掩码语言模型的Nash均衡在多个问答基准上优于最高达18倍大的自回归模型。
AI.motivation: 文本修订已成为大语言模型的重要组成部分。作者指出随着序列长度增长，Nash均衡的似然可能比自回归输出高指数倍，因此为文本修订建立博弈论框架具有重要价值。
AI.method: 将修订形式化为博弈：token位置作为玩家，词汇项作为动作，每个玩家的效用为语言模型的log条件概率。提出Nash解码算法，在已知提示条件下token联合概率时可于O(1/ε)时间达到ε-Nash均衡；实际中使用大语言模型的条件概率估计运行Nash解码。
AI.result: 在CLAPNQ、PubMedQA和CoQA上，由掩码语言模型得到的Nash均衡在F1和ROUGE指标上均高于参数量最高达18倍的自回归模型，且无需任何微调或重训练，代价是额外的测试时计算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为文本修订提供了博弈论视角，Nash均衡在似然上可显著优于自回归输出，Nash解码在多个问答基准上展现出优于更大规模自回归模型的性能。

title: Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification
summary: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. To address the potential unrobustness of singleton prediction making, we propose a family of set-utilities satisfying some desirable properties and whose set-valued BOPs can be found efficiently. Empirical evidence is then given to illustrate the potential (dis)advantages of the proposed ensemble learning framework.

AI.tldr: 本文针对深度集成学习中的训练存储负担与谨慎（集合值）预测的鲁棒性问题，提出使用紧凑集成（如贝叶斯神经网络、带MC dropout的CNN）生成概率预测，并通过代表性分布定义任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP），同时提出一族集合效用以实现高效集合值BOP。
AI.motivation: 深度集成学习中深度神经网络作为集成成员时面临三大挑战：训练与存储负担沉重，以及针对多种效用（可能涉及奖励敏感性）的谨慎（集合值）预测的鲁棒性不足。传统单点预测在面对奖励敏感性时可能不够稳健，因此需要一种既能减轻训练存储负担，又能提供稳健集合值预测的框架。
AI.method: 1. 采用紧凑集成（如贝叶斯神经网络和带Monte-Carlo dropout预测选项的卷积神经网络）产生概率预测，以减轻训练与存储负担；2. 对每个查询实例，用这些概率预测定义一个优化某统计距离的代表性分布；3. 利用代表性分布定义任意效用的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP）；4. 为应对单点预测可能的不稳健性，提出一族满足若干理想性质的集合效用，其集合值BOP可被高效求解。
AI.result: 实证结果展示了所提集成学习框架的潜在优势与劣势。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架通过紧凑集成与代表性分布，实现了任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测，并通过集合效用族支持高效的集合值BOP，为减轻训练存储负担和提升谨慎预测鲁棒性提供了一种可行方案，实证也揭示了其潜在优劣。

title: Local2Mesh: Spatially Localized Contour-to-Mesh for Left Ventricular Reconstruction from Sparse 2D Cardiac MRI
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) left ventricular (LV) reconstruction from sparse cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging remains challenging due to inter-slice misalignment and insufficient local spatial information between slices. Global aggregation of contour features may obscure local contour-to-surface relationships. We propose Local2Mesh, a spatially localized contour-to-mesh framework that deforms a template mesh to reconstruct 3D LV geometry from sparse 2D contours without 3D mesh annotations. The framework introduces geometry-aware alignment to correct inter-slice misalignment and a plane-aware Local Router that routes contour features to template vertices using vertex-to-plane distances. Local and global contour features then jointly guide graph-based template deformation for 3D LV reconstruction. Experiments on two public datasets, M\&Ms-2 and ACDC, demonstrate superior geometric reconstruction and functional estimation over existing methods. Zero-shot transfer from M\&Ms-2 to ACDC demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Reconstructed meshes also improve disease classification over sparse contours, supporting their utility for downstream cardiac analysis. These results demonstrate that combining geometry-aware alignment with local contour-to-vertex modeling improves LV reconstruction from sparse 2D contours and supports downstream cardiac analysis. The code is available at \url{https://github.com/hwu918945-alt/loca2mesh}.

AI.tldr: 提出Local2Mesh框架，从稀疏2D轮廓变形模板网格重建3D左心室几何，通过几何感知对齐与平面感知局部路由提升重建精度、功能估计及下游分类。
AI.motivation: 由稀疏心脏磁共振（CMR）切片重建3D左心室（LV）面临层间错位和层间局部空间信息不足的挑战；而全局轮廓特征聚合会弱化局部轮廓到表面的对应关系，因此需要一种空间局部化的轮廓到网格建模方法。
AI.method: 提出Local2Mesh，一种空间局部化的轮廓到网格框架，在无需3D网格标注的情况下，将模板网格变形以从稀疏2D轮廓重建3D左心室几何。框架包含：几何感知对齐（geometry-aware alignment）以校正层间错位；平面感知局部路由（plane-aware Local Router），依据顶点到平面的距离将轮廓特征路由到模板顶点；随后由局部与全局轮廓特征联合引导基于图的模板变形。
AI.result: 在M&Ms-2和ACDC两个公开数据集上，几何重建与功能估计均优于现有方法；从M&Ms-2到ACDC的零样本迁移展现出强跨数据集泛化能力；重建网格在疾病分类上优于稀疏轮廓，支持其用于下游心脏分析。
AI.conclusion: 将几何感知对齐与局部轮廓到顶点建模相结合，可改善基于稀疏2D轮廓的左心室重建效果，并支撑下游心脏分析。代码已开源。

title: Data-Driven Personas for Survey Simulation: Insights into Simulation Alignment Across Data-Access Regimes
summary: However, many existing steering approaches rely on target-domain human data for fine-tuning or prompting that is costly to collect and raises privacy concerns. In this paper, we study demographic group-level survey simulation, where personas induced from heterogeneous, anonymized public behavioral data condition agents that simulate responses of individuals from specific demographic groups. We examine whether representative personas can be induced from diverse sources and analyze how the domain, scale, and granularity of the source data affect survey simulation alignment. We find that personas induced from out-of-domain sources rarely outperform simulations conditioned only on basic demographic information, largely due to population mismatch. However, when personas are accurately assigned to the target demographic groups, alignment improves substantially. Finally, personas induced from target-domain survey data generalize better as more survey question history becomes available, suggesting that richer behavioral evidence enables more stable persona trait inference that transfers to better unseen questions simulation alignment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"人口统计学群体级调查模拟"任务，用匿名公共行为数据诱导persona来驱动智能体模拟特定群体个体的问卷作答，并系统分析源数据的领域、规模和粒度对模拟对齐度的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有引导（steering）方法多依赖目标域人类数据进行微调或提示，这类数据采集成本高且存在隐私顾虑。因此，作者希望利用异构、匿名的公共行为数据来构建persona，从而在无需目标域人类数据的前提下实现调查模拟。
AI.method: 从异构、匿名的公共行为数据中诱导persona，用于条件化智能体以模拟特定人口统计学群体个体的回答；随后考察源数据的领域（域内/域外）、规模与粒度，以及persona是否被准确分配到目标群体、问卷历史数量等因素对模拟对齐度的影响。
AI.result: 域外来源诱导的persona很少优于仅以基本人口统计信息为条件的模拟，主要原因是群体不匹配；当persona被准确分配到目标群体时，对齐度显著提升；来自目标域调查数据的persona随可用问卷历史增加而泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 群体不匹配是域外persona失效的关键瓶颈，准确的人群归因是提升对齐度的核心；更丰富的目标域行为证据能支持更稳定的persona特质推断，并迁移到未见问题上，提升模拟对齐度。

title: Diffusion Transformers are Provably Optimal In-context Generators
summary: Generative foundation models are attracting interest for their ability to produce desired outputs from demonstrations given at inference time, without updating parameters. However, since a few demonstrations cannot uniquely identify the intended task, the challenge is how to learn and sample from an output distribution that reflects this task uncertainty. In this work, we theoretically analyze how a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), pretrained across diverse tasks, learns and generates predictive distributions for a new query from demonstrations. We first show that the natural target to generate from finite demonstrations is not an output derived from estimating a single task, but rather a predictive distribution that captures the task uncertainty remaining after observing the demonstrations. We then prove that a DiT can learn this predictive distribution through score estimation, using attention to aggregate information from demonstrations and diffusion to generate samples. Owing to this property, with sufficient pretraining resources and diffusion sampling steps, the resulting DiT achieves the minimax optimal rate over a Hölder class of test-time tasks. These results imply that DiT acts as a statistically grounded in-context generator capable of generating distributions adapted to new tasks while retaining the uncertainty inherent in finite demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上分析了预训练 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 如何从少量示范(in-context)中学习并采样反映任务不确定性的预测分布，证明 DiT 能通过 score estimation、以 attention 聚合示范信息、以 diffusion 生成样本，并在 Hölder 任务类上达到 minimax 最优收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 生成式基础模型可在推理时仅凭示范生成目标输出而不更新参数，但少量示范无法唯一确定目标任务，因此核心难题是如何学习并采样一个能反映该任务不确定性的输出分布。现有理解缺乏对这种"基于示范的预测分布学习"的理论刻画。
AI.method: 作者对跨多样任务预训练的 DiT 进行理论分析。首先论证有限示范下合理的生成目标并非由估计单一任务得到的输出，而是捕捉示范观测后残余任务不确定性的预测分布；随后证明 DiT 可通过 score estimation 学习该预测分布，其中 attention 负责聚合示范信息，diffusion 负责生成样本。
AI.result: 在充分的预训练资源与扩散采样步数下，所得 DiT 在 Hölder 类测试时任务上达到 minimax 最优收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: DiT 可被视为一个有统计理论支撑的 in-context 生成器，能够生成适应新任务的分布，同时保留有限示范所固有的不确定性。

title: ROT: Rotating Hidden States towards Contextual Vectors for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucination. Existing training-free interventions primarily manipulate attention weights, which indirectly affect the deep semantics reaching the final predictive layers. In this work, we shift our focus to the hidden state vectors extracted after self-attention and residual addition. Empirical analysis reveals that hallucinated tokens do not simply over-rely on linguistic priors; instead, they exhibit an anomalous contextual deviation, showing significantly lower similarities to both textual and visual contexts in intermediate layers. Motivated by this, we propose ROT, a layer-specific, training-free framework. ROT dynamically detects semantic deviation in the middle layers and applies a norm-preserving rotation to steer the hidden states back toward the local multimodal context plane spanned by the contexts. For subsequent layers, a representational smoothing mechanism is introduced to stabilize the calibrated trajectory. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ROT consistently reduces hallucinations across various model architectures and scales, offering an efficient, geometry-driven solution for grounded generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROT，一种无需训练的、层级化的框架，通过在中间层检测语义偏差并对隐状态施加保范旋转，将其引导回多模态上下文平面，从而缓解大型视觉语言模型的对象幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）常出现对象幻觉。现有免训练干预方法主要操纵注意力权重，只能间接影响到达最终预测层的深层语义。作者希望直接关注自注意力与残差相加后提取的隐状态向量。
AI.method: 通过实证分析发现，幻觉token并非单纯过度依赖语言先验，而是表现出异常的上下文偏差——在中间层与文本及视觉上下文的相似度显著偏低。基于此提出ROT：在中间层动态检测语义偏差，施加保范旋转（norm-preserving rotation）将隐状态引导回由上下文张成的局部多模态上下文平面；在后续层引入表征平滑机制以稳定校准轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，ROT在不同模型架构与规模上均能持续减少幻觉。
AI.conclusion: ROT为基于几何的、高效的有据生成提供了新方案。

title: Measurement-First Auditing of Agentic Leaderboards: Contamination Susceptibility, Matched-Control Re-evaluation, and Scorer Validation
summary: Agentic leaderboards increasingly evaluate systems on public benchmarks whose task statements and solution-bearing artifacts can remain accessible. We propose a measurement-first audit framework that distinguishes contamination claims according to the evidence required to support them. It separates three channels that require different evidence: training-time exposure, evaluation-time retrieval, and pipeline/scaffold leakage. Each channel is coded as open, partial, closed, or unknown under a fail-closed rule. Across nine Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL) configurations, none of the 27 channel assessments was coded closed, but incidents were confirmed in four configurations. We then apply the behavioral component of the framework to a reported file-localization gap on SWE-bench Verified, using an outcome-blind, same-repository matched-control design with symmetric prompt-leakage screening, paired and repository-aware uncertainty analyses, and scorer validation, evaluated on GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Among the 100 pairs retained after symmetric screening and the pair-integrity exclusion, GPT-4.1 showed a $+10.0$-point pair-weighted Top-3 benchmark-associated gap, but the 95\% intervals from both the prespecified paired-bootstrap procedure and the post-hoc repository-balanced analysis included zero, leaving the benchmark-associated gap inconclusive. The reproduction scorer did not pass its validation gate: against consensus human labels, sufficient scorer sensitivity could not be established for either model, and both DeepSeek-V4-Flash firings on correct-gold comparisons were false positives. Without provenance evidence, appropriate controls, symmetric leakage screening, and validated scorers, stronger contamination claims are not warranted. The results do not establish training-data membership, contamination prevalence, or benchmark-induced score inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以测量为先的污染审计框架，将污染主张按所需证据分为训练时暴露、评测时检索、流水线泄漏三条渠道，并按"失败即关闭"规则编码为开放/部分/封闭/未知。在9个HAL配置的27项渠道评估中无一项为封闭，但4个配置确认存在污染事件；对SWE-bench Verified上文件定位差距的行为学分析显示，GPT-4.1的+10.0点差距在配对自助法与仓库平衡分析下95%区间均含零，结论不确定，且复现评分器未通过效度门控，故更强的污染主张不成立。
AI.motivation: Agentic排行榜普遍在公开基准上评测系统，而任务陈述与含解产物可能长期可获取，导致污染风险难以定论。现有工作常把不同类型的污染混为一谈，缺乏按证据要求区分的审计方法，容易产生超出证据支持范围的结论。
AI.method: 提出测量优先的审计框架：按所需证据区分三条渠道——训练时暴露、评测时检索、流水线/脚手架泄漏，每条渠道按失败即关闭规则编码为开放、部分、封闭或未知。在9个HAL配置上实施27项渠道评估。随后将该框架的行为学部分应用于SWE-bench Verified上报告的文件定位差距，采用结果盲、同仓库配对对照设计，对称提示泄漏筛查，配对与仓库感知的不确定性分析，以及评分器验证，在GPT-4.1与DeepSeek-V4-Flash上评测。
AI.result: 27项渠道评估中无一项被编码为封闭，但4个配置确认发生污染事件。行为学分析中，经对称筛查与配对完整性排除后保留100对；GPT-4.1呈现+10.0点的配对加权Top-3基准相关差距，但预设配对自助法与事后仓库平衡分析的95%区间均包含零，差距尚无定论。复现评分器未通过效度门控：相对人工共识标签，两个模型均无法确立足够的评分器灵敏度，DeepSeek-V4-Flash在正确金标比较上的两次触发均为假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 缺少来源证据、恰当对照、对称泄漏筛查与经验证的评分器时，更强的污染主张不成立。本研究结果未确立训练数据成员身份、污染流行程度或基准导致的分数虚高。

title: Green-Routed Neural Operators:\\Physics Determines Where the Network Reads
summary: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Green-Routed Neural Operator（GRNO），通过用控制方程决定潜在特征的采样位置，纠正了输运场在PDE与神经算子中角色不匹配的问题。
AI.motivation: PDE中输运场用于选择读取坐标，而神经算子通常仅将其作为输入特征值。作者识别出这一角色错配，并试图让神经算子遵循方程给定的读坐标，以提供有效的结构先验。
AI.method: GRNO包含三部分：无参数方程适配器评估诊断关系并构造偏离图，其值即为读坐标；多尺度编码器-解码器结合中心读取与路由读取的潜在特征，学习完整有限时间更新；并使用固定权重路由干预与独立训练消融进行验证。
AI.result: 在五个二/三维PDE系统上，GRNO在40步自回归评估中有四个取得最低平均最终相对L2误差，在Keller-Segel上具竞争力；路由干预显示四个系统强依赖方向与空间对齐，Keller-Segel依赖弱；消融实验表明其优于仅将输运场作输入、用学习位移替代方程路由或空间错位路由的变体，并显著优于直接平流物理状态再学剩余更新的方法。
AI.conclusion: 方程指定的读取坐标为长时程PDE预测提供了有效结构先验，GRNO通过路由采样潜在特征显著提升预测性能。

title: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Code available at https://github.com/yunusserhat/palmcity_challenge . Trained models available at https://huggingface.co/yunusserhat/palmcity-eomt-dinov3-large
summary: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper presents the system used for a first place submission to the PalmCity challenge in the leaderboard snapshot dated 5 October 2026. Nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets. The candidates include DeepLabV3+, SegFormer, UPerNet, Mask2Former, DINOv3 with a linear decoder, and an Encoder only Mask Transformer using DINOv3. The two leading candidates are trained independently with three random seeds and longer budgets. Equal averaging of class probabilities from the three Encoder only Mask Transformer models, evaluated at three image scales with horizontal reflection, produces 60.95% mean intersection over union and 71.16% mean F1 on the 84 image public validation split. The submitted predictions receive 57.08% mean intersection over union and 67.96% mean F1 on the hidden test leaderboard. Producing all 249 test masks takes 251.49 seconds including model initialization and provenance checks on one NVIDIA RTX 5090. Peak allocated GPU memory is 2.70 GiB. The study reports all eligible models, all inference variants, class level errors, source conditions, and reproducibility checks, providing a documented challenge workflow with existing architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PalmCity街景全景语义分割挑战赛（2026年10月5日榜单）第一名方案，基于九种预训练分割系统的等算力预算对比，最终以DINOv3编码器+Mask Transformer结合三随机种子、多尺度与水平翻转集成，公开验证集取得60.95% mIoU，隐藏测试集57.08% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 街景全景语义分割可支撑城市环境的精细描述，但该领域数据集规模小、训练成本不均衡，导致模型选型困难。作者希望在小数据条件下建立可复现、可比较的挑战赛工作流，明确哪一种现有架构在受限算力下最优。
AI.method: 在近似相等的计算预算下对比九种预训练分割系统，候选包括DeepLabV3+、SegFormer、UPerNet、Mask2Former、带线性解码器的DINOv3，以及使用DINOv3的仅编码器Mask Transformer（Encoder-only Mask Transformer）。表现最好的两个候选模型分别用三个随机种子和更长训练预算独立训练，最终采用类概率等权平均，并在三个图像尺度上配合水平翻转进行推理集成。
AI.result: 在84张公开验证集上，三模型集成取得60.95% mIoU与71.16% mean F1；提交后在隐藏测试榜单上获得57.08% mIoU与67.96% mean F1。在单张NVIDIA RTX 5090上生成全部249张测试掩码耗时251.49秒（含模型初始化与溯源校验），峰值分配显存为2.70 GiB。
AI.conclusion: 该研究面向现有架构给出了完整的挑战赛工作流与更优模型选择：DINOv3编码器搭配轻量解码结构在小数据、等算力条件下优于多种经典分割框架，多随机种子、多尺度与水平翻转的等权集成可稳定提升性能。论文同时公开全部合格模型、推理变体、类别级误差、来源条件与可复现性检查。

title: Request Order Matters: Cache-History Sensitivity in Selective KV-Cache Reuse for Rolling Agents
summary: Long-running agents repeatedly call an LLM while retaining most of their document window, evicting old documents, and appending new ones. These rolling updates break exact prefix caching and motivate non-prefix KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation. We show that persistent KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation can be history-dependent: in our rolling-agent workload, an unchanged prompt can produce different answers depending on the requests processed before it. At a matched 5% recomputation budget, document-aligned recomputation reduces answer variation across request orders from 69.0% with CacheBlend's token top-$k$ policy to 26.1%. When each prompt is evaluated after a different sequence of preceding requests, document-aligned recomputation improves fidelity to full prefill by 34.5-52.5 percentage points over token top-$k$, while both policies achieve approximately 5.7$\times$ median TTFT speedup. Our ablation study shows that, in our rolling-agent workload, contiguity is the main factor associated with robust selective recomputation.

AI.tldr: 在滚动式智能体负载下的持久KV缓存复用中，选择性重计算具有历史依赖性；文档对齐重计算比token top-k更稳健。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的智能体反复调用LLM并保留大部分文档窗口，滚动淘汰旧文档、追加新文档，破坏了精确前缀缓存，因此需要非前缀KV缓存复用与选择性重计算。
AI.method: 研究持久KV缓存复用结合选择性重计算的历史依赖性问题，比较文档对齐重计算与CacheBlend的token top-k策略，在相同5%重计算预算下，通过改变请求顺序评估答案变异度与对完整prefill的保真度，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 在5%重计算预算下，文档对齐重计算将跨请求顺序的答案变异度从token top-k的69.0%降至26.1%；在不同前置请求序列下，文档对齐重计算的对完整prefill保真度比token top-k提升34.5–52.5个百分点；两者TTFT中位数加速约为5.7倍。消融实验表明连续性是与稳健选择性重计算相关的主要因素。
AI.conclusion: 持久KV缓存复用与选择性重计算存在历史依赖性；在滚动智能体负载中，文档对齐（连续性）重计算相比token top-k能显著降低答案变异并提高保真度，同时保持相近的TTFT加速。

title: On Semi-Markov Suboptimality in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Hierarchical reinforcement learning uses temporally extended subtasks for exploration, yet committing to their execution can restrict both deployment and policy learning. We identify and separate the resulting execution and policy suboptimality. Task and execution trees distinguish reward objectives from policy choices and decision interruption. A Unified Value Function for HRL and a four-stage Generalized Hierarchical Bellman Equation then support a common analysis of both losses. Under bounded rewards and uniform termination, we establish hierarchical policy and execution improvement results. With the remaining node policies fixed, task-subtree compatibility and node-policy optimality under the original execution mode establish when Markov execution is optimal. The resulting decomposition leads to independent execution choices for behavior, targets, and deployment. We instantiate this principle through execution improvement and one-stage or two-stage policy improvement at arbitrary hierarchy depth. Option-based and goal-conditioned experiments demonstrate complementary gains from changing execution and changing the learning target. Controlled stochastic environments show how these gains depend on stochastic transition strength and spatial structure. This framework makes execution design an explicit component of hierarchical policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务树与执行树的分离框架，区分执行次优性与策略次优性，并借助统一价值函数与四阶段广义分层贝尔曼方程统一分析两类损失，进而将执行设计纳入分层策略优化的显式组成部分。
AI.motivation: 分层强化学习通过时间延展的子任务进行探索，但对子任务执行的承诺会同时限制部署与策略学习，导致执行与策略两个层面的次优性，而现有研究未对二者加以区分与分析。
AI.method: 用任务树与执行树区分奖励目标与策略选择及决策中断；提出HRL统一价值函数与四阶段广义分层贝尔曼方程；在有界奖励与一致终止条件下建立分层策略与执行改进结果；在固定其余节点策略的前提下，用任务子树兼容性与原执行模式下的节点策略最优性刻画马尔可夫执行最优条件；通过执行改进与任意层次深度的一/两阶段策略改进进行实例化。
AI.result: 基于选项与目标条件的实验表明，改变执行方式与改变学习目标可带来互补收益；在可控随机环境中，这些收益依赖于随机转移强度与空间结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将执行设计变为分层策略优化的显式组成部分，并支持在行为、目标与部署上进行独立的执行选择。

title: Anatomy-preserving unpaired cone-beam CT refinement for image-guided radiotherapy using pseudo-label guided diffusion
summary: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used in image-guided radiotherapy, but scatter, beam hardening, noise, truncation, and other artifacts limit image quality and CT number accuracy. Paired CBCT and CT data are difficult to obtain clinically because of motion, anatomical changes, and acquisition mismatch. We present RefineCBCT, an unpaired CBCT refinement framework that uses pseudo-label guidance and short-step diffusion to reduce artifacts while preserving patient-specific anatomy. RefineCBCT was trained and evaluated on unpaired CBCT and planning CT data from public LUNG TCIA and PELVIC TCIA datasets and compared with representative GAN and diffusion based methods. On LUNG TCIA, it achieved the best results across all metrics, with MAE 19.411, RMSE 62.758, PSNR 30.845 dB, and SSIM 0.931. On PELVIC TCIA, it achieved the best MAE, PSNR, and SSIM, with values of 14.905, 36.671 dB, and 0.876. The refined images showed fewer streaking and shading artifacts, clearer anatomical boundaries, and improved soft tissue uniformity, with line profile and ROI analyses showing closer agreement with planning CT. These results suggest that RefineCBCT provides efficient and effective CBCT refinement under clinically realistic unpaired training conditions and may support more reliable CBCT use in image-guided radiotherapy workflows. Code is publicly available on GitHub, and the evaluated datasets are available from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

AI.tldr: RefineCBCT：一种基于伪标签引导与短步长扩散的非配对CBCT图像精修框架，在公共肺部和盆腔数据集上优于代表性GAN与扩散方法。
AI.motivation: CBCT广泛用于图像引导放疗，但受散射、射束硬化、噪声、截断等伪影影响，图像质量与CT值准确性受限；而临床中配对CBCT-CT数据因运动、解剖变化和采集不匹配难以获取，因此需要面向非配对条件的CBCT精修方法。
AI.method: 提出RefineCBCT非配对CBCT精修框架，采用伪标签引导与短步长扩散（short-step diffusion）策略，在减少伪影的同时保留患者特异性解剖结构；使用公开LUNG TCIA与PELVIC TCIA数据集的非配对CBCT与计划CT进行训练和评估，并与代表性GAN和扩散方法对比。
AI.result: 在LUNG TCIA上各项指标最优：MAE 19.411、RMSE 62.758、PSNR 30.845 dB、SSIM 0.931；在PELVIC TCIA上MAE、PSNR、SSIM最优，分别为14.905、36.671 dB、0.876。精修图像条纹与阴影伪影减少，解剖边界更清晰，软组织均匀性改善，线剖面与ROI分析更接近计划CT。
AI.conclusion: RefineCBCT在临床现实的非配对训练条件下实现了高效且有效的CBCT精修，有望支持图像引导放疗流程中更可靠的CBCT应用；代码已在GitHub公开，评估数据集可从The Cancer Imaging Archive获取。

title: MiniCorp: The Last Mile of the AI Agent Firm
summary: The last mile toward enterprise AGI is a company that runs itself. Training and adapting such agents require longitudinal enterprise data, which remain scarce, costly to acquire, and often restricted by privacy constraints. Historical archives are also frequently incomplete and record only what actually happened. They cannot show the outcomes of alternative decisions. We introduce MiniCorp, an office simulator for studying how agents can collectively run a company while generating enterprise data at scale. Using an e-commerce company as a demonstration, MiniCorp connects two interacting worlds. The external world models customers, dynamic competitors, and market mechanisms. The internal world consists of agents that observe events, discuss their options, and make strategic decisions. These decisions have lasting effects on the market, and the resulting feedback informs the firm's later decisions. As the firm and market interact, MiniCorp continuously records the agents' communications and decisions. These records preserve the information available at the time and the business results that followed. Checkpointing allows the same situation to be replayed under different decisions, providing comparisons unavailable in static archives. We evaluate end-to-end fidelity against patterns reported in empirical studies of real markets. These evaluations provide agents with realistic market feedback and reduce the risk that they learn to exploit flaws in the simulator. Our experiments show agents coordinating across roles and adapting their decisions to market feedback. With explicit long-term strategic guidance, they also sustain advertising exploration despite weak early returns. MiniCorp thus provides an environment for studying AI-run companies and a scalable source of longitudinal and counterfactual enterprise data for agent training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: MiniCorp是一个办公室模拟器，让多个智能体协同经营一家电商公司，并与外部市场（客户、竞争者、市场机制）持续交互，从而大规模生成纵向且可反事实的企业数据，用于AI驱动企业的训练与评估。
AI.motivation: 实现企业级AGI的最后一环是"能自我运营的公司"，但训练此类智能体所需的企业纵向数据稀缺、获取成本高且受隐私限制；历史档案往往不完整，只记录已发生的事实，无法呈现替代决策下的结果。
AI.method: MiniCorp以电商公司为示例，构建两个互联世界：外部世界建模客户、动态竞争者与市场机制；内部世界由智能体组成，它们观察事件、讨论选项并做出战略决策。决策对市场产生持续影响，反馈又反过来指导企业后续决策。系统持续记录智能体的沟通与决策，保留当时可用信息及随后业务结果；通过检查点（checkpointing）机制，可在不同决策下重放同一情境，获得静态档案无法提供的对照比较。此外，依据真实市场实证研究中的模式评估端到端保真度，为智能体提供真实的市场反馈，降低其利用模拟器缺陷进行学习（reward hacking）的风险。
AI.result: 实验显示智能体能够跨角色协同，并依据市场反馈调整决策；在明确的长期战略指导下，即便早期回报疲弱，智能体仍能持续进行广告探索（exploration）。
AI.conclusion: MiniCorp既为研究"AI运营的公司"提供了环境，也为智能体训练与评测提供了可扩展的纵向与反事实企业数据来源。

title: Reflections and Fragments: Securing LLMs Against Sequential Mosaic Attacks
summary: Self-play red-teaming improves language-model safety by pitting attacker and defender roles against each other in a zero-sum game. However, real adversaries increasingly use mosaic attacks: multi-turn sequences whose individual fragments are innocuous in isolation yet assemble into a harmful payload. We develop a theory of mosaic defense that characterizes what is required to prevent such attacks without sacrificing helpfulness. We first show that no fixed bounded window of recent prompts is sufficient in general: safety-relevant information may occur arbitrarily far back in the interaction. We formalize a watchman, an online state mechanism that carries this information forward, and show that under explicit assumptions it enables zero-failure defense with positive benign helpfulness. Under stronger conditions, it is also optimal among zero-failure defenders. An exact watchman may nevertheless require exponentially many states, while exact maliciousness detection can require exponentially many queries in an unstructured black-box model. These state and query lower bounds do not by themselves imply hard learning: the construction underlying the state lower bound is efficiently learnable from labeled examples, whereas certifying worst-case safety can require substantially more information under restricted access. We also show that self-play equilibrium alone does not certify usefulness, motivating a constrained formulation that maximizes worst-case benign helpfulness among zero-failure defenders. Empirically, training role-specific attacker and defender LoRA adapters over frozen LLMs via multi-turn self-play strengthens both roles: attackers become more effective at eliciting harmful responses, while defenders become more robust to attack, with improvements also observed on unseen attack objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"马赛克攻击"（多轮对话中每轮片段无害、组合后有害）下的防御理论：证明固定滑动窗口防御不足，形式化"观察者"在线状态机制，在明确假设下可实现零失败防御并保持正向有用性，并给出状态/查询下界及"下界不等于难学"的辨析；同时指出自博弈均衡本身不能保证有用性，进而提出约束式公式最大化最坏情况下的良性有用性；实验上通过多轮自博弈训练角色专属LoRA适配器，攻防双方能力均增强并泛化到未见攻击目标。
AI.motivation: 自博弈红队通过攻防零和博弈提升语言模型安全性，但现实对抗者日益采用"马赛克攻击"：多轮交互中单轮片段孤立看均无害，组合后却构成有害载荷。现有防御对此缺乏理论刻画，不清楚怎样的机制才能在不为有用性付出代价的前提下阻止此类攻击，也不清楚自博弈均衡是否足以证明模型的有用性。
AI.method: 1) 理论上首先证明：任何固定的有界近期提示窗口一般都不充分，因为安全相关信息可能出现在任意久远的交互历史中；2) 形式化"观察者"（watchman）——一种将此类信息向前传递的在线状态机制，并证明在显式假设下可达成零失败防御且具有正的良性有用性，在更强条件下还是所有零失败防御者中的最优；3) 给出精确观察者可能需指数多状态、无结构黑箱模型下精确恶意检测可能需指数多查询的下界，并区分"状态/查询下界"与"学习难度"（状态下界所依据的构造可从标注样本高效学习，而受限访问下认证最坏情况安全性需更多信息）；4) 指出自博弈均衡本身不保证有用性，提出在零失败防御者中最大化最坏情况良性有用性的约束式公式；5) 实验上用多轮自博弈在冻结LLM上训练角色专属的攻击者与防御者LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 理论结果：(a) 固定有界窗口不足以防御马赛克攻击；(b) 观察者机制在显式假设下实现零失败防御且良性有用性为正，强条件下为最优零失败防御者；(c) 精确观察者需指数级状态、精确恶意检测在黑箱下需指数级查询，但这些下界不直接导致学习困难，因为对应构造可高效学习；(d) 仅靠自博弈均衡无法证明有用性。实验结果：多轮自博弈使攻防双方角色同时增强——攻击者更易诱出有害回应，防御者更鲁棒，且在未见攻击目标上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 防御马赛克攻击必须使用能长期携带安全相关信息的在线状态机制而非固定窗口；"观察者"框架在给定假设下提供了零失败且保持有用性的防御，并刻画了其最优性；计算/查询下界与可学习性需区分看待；自博弈均衡不构成有用性认证，应以约束式目标最大化最坏情况良性有用性；角色专属LoRA多轮自博弈在实践中可同步提升攻防能力并泛化到新目标。

title: Benchmarking CLIP for Zero-Shot Face and Periocular Gender Estimation
comment: Accepted for publication at 25th International Conference of the Biometrics Special Interest Group, BIOSIG 2026
summary: We investigate CLIP for zero-shot gender estimation from full-face and periocular images. Three CLIP backbones are evaluated on 11,299 frontal images from Adience using image-text similarity with male/female prompts, achieving 95.54% full-face accuracy without task-specific training. For periocular, zero-shot predictions are strongly biased towards males, primarily due to a misaligned decision boundary. Threshold alignment substantially reduces this bias, reaching 85.29% accuracy. Linear SVMs trained on CLIP features provide only marginal gains, with a best periocular accuracy of 86.17%, approximately 2.8% above previous Adience results in the literature. Nevertheless, the gap with full-face performance confirms the greater difficulty of periocular gender estimation

AI.tldr: 该研究评估CLIP在整脸与眼周图像的零样本性别估计能力：整脸达95.54%，眼周受男性偏向影响，阈值对齐后达85.29%，线性SVM仅小幅提升至86.17%。
AI.motivation: 探究CLIP能否在无需任务特定训练的情况下完成性别估计，并考察遮挡条件（仅眼周区域）下的性能差异，以验证眼周性别估计的难度及零样本方法的适用性。
AI.method: 在Adience数据集的11,299张正面图像上，使用三种CLIP骨干网络，以male/female文本提示进行图像-文本相似度匹配实现零样本预测；针对眼周图像存在的男性偏向，采用决策阈值对齐校正；并训练基于CLIP特征的线性SVM作为对比。
AI.result: 整脸零样本准确率达95.54%；眼周零样本预测明显偏向男性，阈值对齐后提升至85.29%；线性SVM最佳眼周准确率为86.17%，较文献中Adience结果高约2.8%。
AI.conclusion: CLIP在整脸性别估计上表现出色且无需任务特定训练；眼周估计受决策边界错位导致的性别偏向影响，可通过阈值对齐缓解；即便SVM略有提升，眼周与整脸之间的性能差距仍表明眼周性别估计难度更大。

title: VERA: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Agentic co-Evolution
summary: Competent agents need precise and verifiable environments, such as sandboxes that are resumable at any stage and evolve from observable evidence. However, most long-horizon work exposes how rare these are: for example, an agent in medical research must ground a finding, classify it, and write a report over dozens of dependent steps, yet recent environments score only the outcome. To address the challenges in stable training, we present VERA, which builds such environments at scale and lets agents evolve on them. VERA builds these environments from initial trajectories: an agent writes rubrics, executable checks, a judge verifies each sandbox, and only those that pass enter the training bank. On these environments, VERA alternates between two updates: train the model with rubric rewards, or edit the harness skills. We also create a verifier which gates model checkpoints and harness edits using explicit development-set acceptance criteria. This attribution distinguishes VERA's co-evolution from single-axis baselines: its updates target not only the cause but the outcome. With an open-source corpus of 9,000+ long-horizon verifiable environments, a 9B model paired with its co-evolved agent beats the strongest baseline by 10.3 and 13.0 points in the two domains. At 27B, it surpasses the baseline on AutoCoWorkBench (71.6) and AutoMedBench (80.7), transfers to unseen workflows, and retains general capabilities.

AI.tldr: VERA 构建可验证的长时程环境，使智能体与环境协同进化，在多个基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 长时程任务（如医学研究）需要可精确验证、可在任意阶段恢复且能基于可观察证据演进的环境，但现有环境大多只对最终结果打分，缺乏对中间依赖步骤的评价，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: VERA 从初始轨迹构建环境：由智能体撰写评分标准和可执行检查，裁判核验每个沙箱，仅通过者进入训练库。训练时交替进行两件事：用评分标准奖励训练模型，或编辑执行框架技能。另设验证器，依据显式开发集验收标准对模型检查点与框架编辑进行门控，实现归因与协同进化。
AI.result: 基于9000+个开源长时程可验证环境语料，9B模型搭配协同进化智能体在两个领域分别超出最强基线10.3和13.0分；27B模型在 AutoCoWorkBench（71.6）和 AutoMedBench（80.7）上超过基线，并可迁移到未见工作流，同时保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过可验证环境的大规模构建与模型-框架的协同进化，VERA 有效提升了长时程智能体的稳定性与性能，并具备良好的迁移性与通用能力保持。

title: Task Inference Beyond Least Squares in Behavioral Foundation Models
summary: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) aim to solve a wide range of downstream tasks without test-time policy learning by inferring a task vector from the reward function. While efficient, the retrieved policies are often suboptimal because of how this task vector is inferred, typically with ordinary least squares (OLS). OLS minimizes reward reconstruction error but leaves the ordering of rewards unconstrained, which can bias the successor measure of the retrieved zero-shot policy away from that of the optimal policy. In this work, we propose BLS, an efficient test-time inference method that balances minimizing reward reconstruction error with reducing successor-measure mismatch. Theoretically, we provide a suboptimality gap upper bound characterized by both successor-measure and reward-function residuals. Empirically, we evaluate BLS on top of state-of-the-art BFMs across benchmarks for locomotion, manipulation, and humanoid control. BLS outperforms existing task inference baselines with negligible computational overhead. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/BLS

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BLS，一种用于行为基础模型（BFMs）的高效测试时任务推断方法，通过平衡奖励重构误差与后继测度失配来获得更优的零样本策略，并在理论上给出了次优性上界，实验上在多个基准上优于现有基线且计算开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 行为基础模型（BFMs）通过从奖励函数推断任务向量，无需测试时策略学习即可解决多种下游任务。但现有方法通常使用普通最小二乘（OLS）推断任务向量，OLS 只最小化奖励重构误差，不约束奖励的排序，可能使检索到的零样本策略的后继测度偏离最优策略，导致策略次优。
AI.method: 提出 BLS，一种高效的测试时推断方法：在最小化奖励重构误差的同时，兼顾减少后继测度失配，从而平衡两者。理论上推导出由后继测度残差和奖励函数残差共同刻画的次优性上界。
AI.result: 在运动、操作和人形控制等基准上，将 BLS 叠加于最先进的 BFMs 进行评测，BLS 在性能上优于现有任务推断基线，且计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: BLS 通过平衡奖励重构误差与后继测度失配，有效缓解了 OLS 推断导致的零样本策略次优问题，理论与实验均验证了其有效性，是一种高效且可即插即用的任务推断方法。

title: AnchorGen: Anchored Optimization for Customizable Generative 3D Design
summary: Engineering design often starts from a 2D sketch that fixes style and proportions, yet the subsequent 3D shape optimization relies on learned generative priors to keep the geometry valid. However, these priors are agnostic to the sketch: while they admit a valid design by correcting a drifted proposal back to its training distribution, they often correct it towards the high-density region, ignoring the specified design. We introduce \emph{AnchorGen}, a rectified-flow framework trained unconditionally on the concatenated shape and sketch latents of paired data. The learned manifold represents the joint distribution of shape-sketch pairs, so constraining the sketch component restricts the iterate to the sub-manifold of shapes consistent with a target style. Since training employs no conditioning signal, the constraint is imposed at inference: gradient descent optimizes the shape latent to minimize a differentiable drag surrogate, while constraining the sketch latent to remain close to the target sketch via a token-wise cosine penalty. A single model thereby supports design-preserving optimization, dimensionally explicit design edits, and sketch-only synthesis.

AI.tldr: AnchorGen提出一种在形状-草图联合潜空间上无条件训练的rectified-flow框架，通过在推理时约束草图分量，实现保持设计意图的3D形状优化、显式维度编辑与草图引导生成。
AI.motivation: 传统3D形状优化依赖学习到的生成先验保证几何有效性，但这些先验与2D草图无关：当将漂移的候选修正回训练分布时，往往偏向高密度区域，忽略了用户指定的风格与比例设计意图。
AI.method: 在配对数据的形状潜变量与草图潜变量拼接表示上，无条件训练rectified-flow模型，使流形表达形状-草图对的联合分布；推理时固定草图分量即可将迭代限制在与目标风格一致的形状子流形上。约束在推理阶段施加：用梯度下降优化形状潜变量以最小化可微的阻力代理目标，同时通过逐token余弦惩罚约束草图潜变量接近目标草图。
AI.result: 单一模型即可支持三类任务：保持设计意图的优化、显式维度的设计编辑，以及仅凭草图的合成。
AI.conclusion: 将约束从训练时的条件信号转移到推理时的潜变量约束，使生成先验与用户草图绑定，避免修正过度偏向高密度区域，从而在保证几何有效性的同时尊重原始设计。

title: Process Constitutions and Process Stewards: Towards the Next Generation of BPM for Agentic Organizations
summary: Business Process Management (BPM) was built on a foundational assumption that organizations are populated primarily by human actors whose work can be made visible, governable, and improvable through process models. That assumption is depreciating. AI agent ecosystems increasingly execute, coordinate, and adapt organizational work with limited human direction, challenging not only BPM's methods but its core conception of what a process is. We argue that BPM faces a constitutive shift from modeling human work to governing autonomous agents, for which we propose two new concepts: the \emph{Process Constitution}, a machine-interpretable, value-laden framework that defines the space of admissible agent behavior, and the \emph{Process Steward}, a governance agent that interprets and enforces it. The central value proposition of this new generation of BPM is not efficiency but \emph{organizational legibility}: the capacity to keep agentic organizations accountable, contestable, and humanly understandable. We outline what this means and sketch the research agenda it opens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPM正经历从"建模人类工作"到"治理自主智能体"的构成性转变，并引入"流程宪章"与"流程管家"两个新概念，主张新一代BPM的核心价值是"组织可读性"而非效率。
AI.motivation: 传统BPM建立在"组织主要由人类行动者构成、其工作可通过流程模型被可视化、可治理、可改进"这一基础假设之上，而AI智能体生态系统正日益自主地执行、协调和适应组织工作，人类指令有限，这不仅是方法层面的挑战，更动摇了BPM对"流程本质"的核心理解，因此需要重新审视BPM的构成性基础。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/愿景类论文（position paper），采用概念建构与论证的方法：识别并批判BPM的既有人类中心假设，提出构成性转变的论断，并设计两个新概念——Process Constitution（机器可解释、负载价值的框架，界定智能体可接受行为的空间）与Process Steward（解释并执行该宪章的治理智能体），最后勾勒由此开启的研究议程。
AI.result: 论文提出新一代BPM的核心价值命题不在于效率，而在于"组织可读性"（organizational legibility），即让智能体化组织保持可问责、可争议、且可被人类理解的能力；并据此勾勒出相应的研究议程方向。
AI.conclusion: BPM需要完成从建模人类工作到治理自主智能体的构成性范式转变，通过Process Constitution与Process Steward等新概念重建治理机制，以组织可读性作为新一代BPM的核心目标，确保智能体化组织仍可问责、可争议并能为人类所理解。

title: Rethinking Tabular Foundation Models On Data Streams
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform established machine learning models on tabular benchmarks through in-context learning. Building on this success, interest is growing in applying them to data streams, where data arrive continuously and evolve over time. On a stream, a TFM adapts by updating its context rather than its parameters, so its accuracy and cost depend on which examples it keeps and how often it rebuilds its context. We therefore present a systematic study of TFMs on data streams, covering memory management, computational cost, and stream-specific challenges such as concept drift and delayed labels. We find that TFMs achieve the highest predictive performance and that simply retaining the most recent examples is as effective as existing memory management techniques. They also recover faster than streaming learners after drift and keep the highest accuracy under label delay. This accuracy, however, comes at a high serving cost, since a nearly unchanged context is re-encoded at every prediction. These results point to architectural efficiency as the way forward for in-context stream learning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了表格基础模型（TFMs）在数据流场景下的表现，涵盖内存管理、计算开销、概念漂移与标签延迟，发现TFMs预测精度最高且能更快从漂移中恢复，但推理服务成本高昂，未来应聚焦架构效率。
AI.motivation: TFMs在表格基准上通过上下文学习超越传统机器学习模型，学界兴趣正转向数据流场景。在流上，TFM依靠更新上下文而非参数来适应，其精度和成本取决于保留哪些样本以及重建上下文的频率，因此需要系统性研究。
AI.method: 对TFMs在数据流上的表现进行系统性实验研究，覆盖内存管理策略、计算成本，以及概念漂移和标签延迟等流特有挑战。
AI.result: TFMs取得最高预测性能；简单保留最近样本与现有内存管理技术效果相当；在漂移后比流式学习器恢复更快；在标签延迟下保持最高精度；但服务成本高，因为几乎未变化的上下文在每次预测时都被重新编码。
AI.conclusion: TFMs在数据流上精度占优但对上下文重复编码导致高服务成本，未来方向是提升架构效率以支撑上下文流学习。

title: Efficient Test-time Adaptation through Candidate Verification and Divergence Shifts
comment: Accepted for publication in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability but remain vulnerable to target-domain shifts at inference time. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical remedy, yet most existing VLM-TTA methods follow a prediction-side adaptation paradigm. They use test samples to adjust logits, prototypes, caches, priors, or feature statistics, often incurring additional computational overhead. In this paper, we take a different perspective and reframe VLM-TTA as candidate verification rather than prediction adjustment. We propose Test-Time Correction (TTC), a hypothesis-based correction framework guided by a simple principle: hypothesize, reconstruct, correct. Given a test feature and its top-k candidate labels, TTC treats each candidate label as a hypothesis, reconstructs the feature within the corresponding latent subspace stored in a memory bank, and measures the resulting divergence shift. This shift quantifies how much the candidate subspace and its relations to other candidates change after the hypothetical insertion of the test feature. A correct candidate hypothesis induces only a small shift, whereas an incorrect one perturbs the subspace more strongly. TTC therefore corrects the prediction by selecting the candidate with the minimum aggregated divergence shift. This training-free candidate-verification mechanism avoids iterative optimization and provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across five TTA settings and 15 benchmark datasets, including zero-shot classification, domain generalization, few-shot classification, base-to-novel generalization, and cross-dataset evaluation, TTC consistently improves accuracy over state-of-the-art VLM-TTA methods while achieving up to 2x speedup, over 3x lower CPU memory usage, and up to 1.4x lower GPU memory usage than the lowest-memory training-free baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出测试时校正（TTC），将VLM测试时自适应从"预测调整"重新表述为"候选验证"，通过"假设—重构—校正"机制选择散度偏移最小的候选标签，无需训练即可提升精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）虽具备强零样本迁移能力，但在推理时仍易受目标域偏移影响。现有VLM测试时自适应（TTA）方法多采用"预测侧调整"范式，利用测试样本调整logits、原型、缓存、先验或特征统计量，往往带来额外计算开销。作者希望跳出该范式，寻找更高效的自适应途径。
AI.method: 提出测试时校正（TTC），一种基于假设的校正框架，遵循"假设、重构、校正"原则。给定测试特征及其top-k候选标签，TTC将每个候选标签视为一个假设，在记忆库中对应潜子空间内重构该特征，并度量由此产生的散度偏移：该偏移量化了假设插入测试特征后，候选子空间及其与其他候选关系的改变程度。正确候选引起小偏移，错误候选扰动更强。TTC通过选择最小聚合散度偏移的候选来校正预测。该机制无需训练，避免迭代优化。
AI.result: 在5种TTA设置和15个基准数据集（包括零样本分类、域泛化、少样本分类、基类到新类泛化、跨数据集评估）上，TTC持续优于最先进的VLM-TTA方法，同时实现最高2倍加速、CPU内存降低3倍以上、GPU内存较最低内存的无训练基线降低最高1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: TTC通过将VLM-TTA重构为候选验证问题，以无训练、非迭代的方式在多种测试时自适应场景中同时提升精度与效率，提供了良好的精度—效率权衡。

title: OntoInk: Interactive Ontology Visualization, Validation, and Reasoning
comment: Demo paper at ISWC 2026 Companion Volume, October 25 to 29, 2026, Bari, Italy
summary: Ontology documentation, visualization, and validation are usually carried out with separate tools. This split workflow slows down development and makes knowledge transfer harder.
