We present OntoInk, an open-source MkDocs plugin that brings these activities together. Within a single documentation-as-code pipeline, OntoInk renders interactive ontology diagrams, validates instance data against SHACL shapes, runs OWL\,DL reasoning, and supports inline Turtle editing. General-purpose diagram plugins for MkDocs cannot parse RDF, dereference IRIs, overlay SHACL constraints, or run OWL reasoning. Compared with standalone ontology visualization tools, OntoInk embeds interactive and editable diagrams directly into documentation pages. A live demo and source code are available at \url{https://ise-fizkarlsruhe.github.io/ontoink/}.

AI.tldr: OntoInk 是一个开源 MkDocs 插件，在同一 documentation-as-code 流水线中集成本体可视化、SHACL 验证、OWL DL 推理与内联 Turtle 编辑。
AI.motivation: 本体文档、可视化与验证通常依赖彼此独立的工具，分散的工作流降低开发效率并增加知识转移难度。
AI.method: 实现 OntoInk 插件：在单一 MkDocs 文档即代码流程中渲染交互式本体图、依据 SHACL 形状验证实例数据、执行 OWL DL 推理，并支持内联 Turtle 编辑。相较通用 MkDocs 图形插件，其具备解析 RDF、解引用 IRI、叠加 SHACL 约束与执行 OWL 推理能力；相较独立本体可视化工具，其将交互式可编辑图直接嵌入文档页面。
AI.result: 提供在线演示与源代码（https://ise-fizkarlsruhe.github.io/ontoink/）。摘要未报告定量评测结果。
AI.conclusion: OntoInk 通过一体化文档流水线整合本体可视化、验证与推理，缓解工具割裂带来的效率与知识转移障碍。

title: FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis
summary: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell's morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET (Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FACET，一种将蛋白质定位生成建模为"因子化非对称条件"的概率生成框架，在保持高效率的同时显著提升细胞图像合成的空间精度与生物学意义。
AI.motivation: 从氨基酸序列与细胞形态学上下文出发，实现未成像蛋白质的"计算定位"（in silico localization），可突破荧光显微镜只能同时成像有限数量蛋白质的瓶颈。然而两个条件的作用并不对称：形态学上下文与目标在空间上对齐，而序列是非空间的，需要决定蛋白质依赖的定位，且不同蛋白质间既共享粗尺度模式、又存在蛋白特异的精细变化。现有生成器将二者联合条件化，未区分各自解释的部分，导致建模效率与表达力受限。
AI.method: 提出 FACET（Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport），将上述结构作为显式归纳偏置编码进概率生成框架：序列语义仅从上下文未解释的残差中学习；跨蛋白共享的粗尺度定位规律通过语义记忆（semantic memory）建模；蛋白特异变化被约束为有界残差（bounded residual）。此外引入保方差状态投影（variance-preserving state projection），使 FACET 能借助预训练扩散预测器执行连续随机传输，参数量开销极小。
AI.result: 在留出蛋白质上，FACET 相比主干匹配基线在 Human Protein Atlas 上空间重叠度提升 34.3%，OpenCell 上提升 14.0%；FID 分别降低 27.2% 和 46.5%，且网络评估次数减少 75%。方法还显著提升蛋白质关联结构恢复能力，并给出更优校准的预测；消融实验表明各设计选择贡献互补。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，高质量、高效且具生物学意义的细胞图像合成，关键在于"因子化非对称条件"这一设计，而非单纯依赖生成器容量。

title: Bayesian Optimization in Sequence-to-Architecture Latent Space for Zero-Shot NAS
summary: Zero-shot Neural Architecture Search removes the prohibitive cost of traditional NAS, but its search process is typically based on the evolutionary algorithm (EA); lacking an explicit model of the objective, it often resorts to a near-random search through mutation. Bayesian Optimization offers a principled alternative by modeling the objective and aggregating information across iterations, but scales poorly to the high-dimensional, discrete, graph-structured spaces of modern NAS, restricting its use to only small networks. In this paper, we bring Bayesian Optimization to zero-shot NAS for large-scale architectures by learning a latent space via a Variational Autoencoder trained to reconstruct a novel prefix encoding of architectures and propose a proxy scalarization that combines several zero-shot proxies into a single Bayesian Optimization objective. After only 10,000 iterations of the proposed search algorithm (8 hours on a single GPU), our method found a network architecture which under the given model parameter count constraints achieves state-of-the-art results on three separate tasks -- image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将贝叶斯优化引入零样本神经架构搜索（Zero-shot NAS），通过VAE学习架构的潜在空间并结合多种零样本代理的标量化目标，在大型网络空间上高效搜索。仅用10,000次迭代（单GPU 8小时）即找到在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割三个任务上达到SOTA的架构。
AI.motivation: 零样本NAS虽消除了传统NAS的高昂成本，但其搜索过程通常基于进化算法，缺乏显式目标模型，常退化为近似随机的变异搜索。贝叶斯优化通过建模目标并跨迭代聚合信息提供了有原则的替代方案，但在现代NAS的高维、离散、图结构空间中扩展性差，仅适用于小型网络。因此需要一种能将贝叶斯优化扩展到大规模零样本NAS的方法。
AI.method: 1) 训练变分自编码器（VAE）以重构一种新颖的架构前缀编码（prefix encoding），从而学习架构的连续潜在空间；2) 提出一种代理标量化（proxy scalarization），将多个零样本代理指标组合为单一的贝叶斯优化目标；3) 在该潜在空间中执行贝叶斯优化搜索。
AI.result: 在仅10,000次搜索迭代（单GPU 8小时）后，方法在给定模型参数量约束下找到的网络架构，在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割三个独立任务上均取得state-of-the-art结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过VAE潜在空间建模与零样本代理标量化，贝叶斯优化可成功扩展至大规模零样本NAS，显著提升搜索效率（8小时单GPU）并找到跨任务泛化性强的SOTA架构。

title: Grounded Joint-Attention Other-Play for Zero-Shot Coordination
summary: Joint attention - the human ability to share a common visual or cognitive focus with others - enables a meeting of minds that lets us coordinate even with unfamiliar partners. In this work we investigate whether equipping AI agents with a similar mechanism can enable such zero-shot coordination. We introduce Mutual Attention for zero-shot TEaming (MATE): a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning method inspired by human joint attention. MATE encourages agents to coordinate their actions by aligning their visual attention on scene-salient objects during the interaction rather than relying on arbitrary partner-dependent conventions established during training. Unlike symmetry-breaking approaches that merely prevent brittle conventions from emerging, MATE actively promotes coordination through an environment-grounded signal that is naturally shared across partners. We evaluate MATE on three benchmarks: our Card Alignment Game, designed to isolate brittle convention formation, and the more challenging Level-Based Foraging and OvercookedV2 benchmarks. Our experiments consistently show that a joint-attention-inspired signal improves coordination with unknown partners, underlining MATE's potential as a general coordination mechanism that complements and surpasses symmetry-breaking approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MATE方法，受人类联合注意启发，通过让AI智能体在交互中对齐视觉注意，实现零样本协调。
AI.motivation: 人类能借助联合注意与陌生伙伴共享视觉/认知焦点，从而实现高效协调。作者希望将这一机制引入AI智能体，使其也能在零样本条件下与未知伙伴协作，并克服现有方法依赖训练中形成的、脆弱的伙伴相关约定这一局限。
AI.method: 提出MATE（Mutual Attention for zero-shot TEaming），一种受联合注意启发的多智能体强化学习方法。它鼓励智能体在交互中将视觉注意对齐到场景中显著物体上，以环境为基础的信号促进协调，而非依赖任意且伙伴相关的约定。
AI.result: 在三个基准上评估MATE：为隔离脆弱约定形成而设计的Card Alignment Game，以及更具挑战性的Level-Based Foraging和OvercookedV2。实验一致表明，联合注意启发的信号能提升与未知伙伴的协调表现。
AI.conclusion: 联合注意机制可作为通用协调机制，补充并超越对称性破除（symmetry-breaking）方法。

title: The Effect of Missingness-Pattern Mismatch on Method Selection for Time-Series Classification: A Controlled Empirical Study
summary: Classifiers for time-series classification are commonly selected on validation data, but the temporal pattern of missing observations at deployment may differ from the pattern seen during validation. We examine whether such a mismatch affects validation-based classifier selection. In a controlled $2 \times 2$ design, validation and test sets of 64 univariate UCR datasets were masked with either random point missingness or circular block missingness at six rates from 5% to 30%, imputed by linear interpolation, and used to select among three prespecified candidates: 1NN-DTW, MiniRocket with a Ridge classifier, and a statistical-feature Random Forest. Training data remained complete, and selections made under matched and mismatched validation patterns were compared on the same masked test sets. Mismatched validation reduced the test balanced accuracy of the selected classifier by 1.14 percentage points on average (95% CI 0.79 to 1.51), with losses on 49 of the 64 datasets. The loss was negligible at 5% missingness and increased to 2.46 percentage points at 30%. It was concentrated in point-masked deployment (1.84 percentage points), where block-masked validation shifted selection away from the usually best candidate, while the effect for block-masked deployment was small and not significant. Mismatch changed the selected classifier in 35.5% of paired comparisons, but a changed selection did not always reduce performance. A supplementary analysis with non-wrapping linear blocks reproduced these findings with a larger effect (1.67 percentage points). Matching the missingness pattern of validation data to the expected deployment pattern is therefore a simple safeguard for method selection, particularly at higher missingness rates.

AI.tldr: 验证集与测试集缺失模式不匹配会降低时间序列分类器选择的效果，平均损失1.14个百分点，且在点缺失部署下尤为明显。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类器通常基于验证数据选择，但部署时的缺失观测模式可能与验证时不同，作者旨在考察这种不匹配是否影响基于验证的分类器选择。
AI.method: 采用2×2受控设计，对64个单变量UCR数据集的验证集和测试集施加随机点缺失或循环块缺失（缺失率5%–30%共六档），用线性插值填充，在三个预设候选（1NN-DTW、带Ridge分类器的MiniRocket、统计特征随机森林）中选择；训练数据保持完整，并在相同掩码测试集上比较匹配与不匹配验证模式下的选择结果。
AI.result: 不匹配验证使所选分类器的测试平衡准确率平均下降1.14个百分点（95% CI 0.79–1.51），64个数据集中有49个出现损失；5%缺失率时损失可忽略，30%时升至2.46个百分点；损失集中于点缺失部署（1.84个百分点），此时块缺失验证使选择偏离通常最优的候选，而块缺失部署的效应较小且不显著；不匹配在35.5%的配对比较中改变了所选分类器，但改变选择并不总是降低性能；非环绕线性块的补充分析复现该结论且效应更大（1.67个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 将验证数据的缺失模式与预期部署模式匹配，是方法选择的简单保障措施，在高缺失率下尤为重要。

title: EORestore-Agent: Fidelity-Guided Agentic Restoration of Remote Sensing Images with Composite Degradations
summary: Remote sensing images often carry composite degradations, in which haze, cloud, noise, blur, low light, and low resolution coexist. Restoring them requires deciding which tool to apply, in what order, and when to stop, yet no clean reference is available at inference time to verify these decisions. All-in-one models trained on single degradations converge to a narrow PSNR band as degradations accumulate. To formulate real-world remote sensing restoration as a traceable trajectory, we present EORestore-Agent, which replaces this unmeasurable objective with reference-free, verifiable per-step decisions. A fine-tuned vision-language model reports all residual degradation types, whose tool pools are scored together, so the restoration order emerges from step-wise selection. A relative quality scorer, trained with full-reference supervision on synthetic degradation chains, predicts the changes in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS from the current image to each candidate. A step is accepted only when no predicted change is negative and the predicted PSNR gain is positive. Otherwise, the agent keeps the current image. On a synthetic Landsat-8 benchmark with six degradation types, EORestore-Agent improves PSNR by 2.3 to 3.2 dB over the strongest retrained all-in-one baseline on composites of two to six degradations, whereas zero-shot natural-image agents fall below the degraded input in PSNR in 17 of 18 settings. Replacing the learned scorer with no-reference quality differences costs 1.1 to 4.6 dB. The remaining harmful steps are small and cluster near the acceptance threshold. Sentinel-2 examples illustrate transfer to real atmospheric degradation without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EORestore-Agent，将遥感图像复合退化恢复建模为可追踪的逐步决策轨迹，用无参考但可验证的单步判断替代不可测的全局目标。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像常同时存在雾、云、噪声、模糊、低光和低分辨率等复合退化；恢复时需决定用什么工具、按什么顺序、何时停止，但推理时没有干净参考无法验证决策。仅在单一退化上训练的一体化模型在退化累积时性能收敛到狭窄的 PSNR 区间。
AI.method: EORestore-Agent 使用微调视觉语言模型报告所有残余退化类型，将其工具池共同打分，使恢复顺序由逐步选择自然涌现；用合成退化链以全参考监督训练相对质量评分器，预测当前图像到各候选输出的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 变化；仅当所有预测变化非负且 PSNR 增益为正时接受该步，否则保留当前图像。
AI.result: 在含六种退化的合成 Landsat-8 基准上，对二至六种退化的复合情形，EORestore-Agent 比最强的重训一体化基线提升 PSNR 2.3–3.2 dB；零样本自然图像智能体在 18 种设置中有 17 种低于退化输入；用无参考质量差替代学习评分器损失 1.1–4.6 dB；剩余有害步骤幅度小且集中于接受阈值附近；Sentinel-2 示例显示无需重训即可迁移到真实大气退化。
AI.conclusion: 以无参考、可验证的逐步决策替代不可测的全局目标，可有效实现复合遥感退化恢复，并具备向真实数据的迁移能力。

title: RocketAgent: A Long-Horizon Engineering Agent for Multidisciplinary Design of Liquid-Rocket Thrust Chambers
summary: Liquid-rocket thrust-chamber design involves interdependent analyses in which downstream constraints can require earlier design decisions to be revisited. Managing these dependencies across heterogeneous tools requires consistent design information and coordinated updates throughout the workflow. We present RocketAgent, a long-horizon engineering agent for multidisciplinary preliminary design of liquid-rocket thrust chambers. A single plan-owning Coding Agent coordinates engineering skills for performance sizing, subsystem optimization, geometry generation, and multiphysics assessment. A provenance-aware knowledge graph supports method selection, while a typed Design Intermediate Representation maintains shared parameters, artifacts, and decisions. Revision-aware checks invalidate affected results and block superseded inputs, with consequential changes subject to engineering approval. In a representative simulation-based design, RocketAgent continued from an infeasible cooling search through an engineer-authorized operating-point revision, identified feasible subsystem designs, and coordinated subsequent geometry generation and multiphysics assessment to support final configuration selection. Separate module tests assessed surrogate predictions and nozzle adaptation. A two-configuration comparison across three controlled scenarios verified the expected dependency invalidations and superseded-input blocking before solver execution. The representative case demonstrates sustained coordination across a multidisciplinary design workflow, while the controlled tests establish the behavior of the revision mechanisms supporting that execution.

AI.tldr: 提出 RocketAgent——面向液体火箭推力室多学科初步设计的长时程工程智能体，由单一规划主导的 Coding Agent 协调性能 sizing、子系统优化、几何生成与多物理场评估等工程技能，依托溯源知识图谱与类型化设计中间表示管理共享参数与依赖，并通过修订感知机制实现结果失效与过时输入阻断。
AI.motivation: 液体火箭推力室设计涉及相互依赖的多学科分析，下游约束常迫使回溯修改上游决策；跨异构工具管理这些依赖需要一致的设计信息与全流程协同更新。现有工作缺乏能够长时程协调多学科流程并保证设计信息一致性的智能体方案。
AI.method: RocketAgent 采用单一规划主导的 Coding Agent，统筹性能 sizing、子系统优化、几何生成、多物理场评估等工程技能；用溯源感知知识图谱支持方法选择，用类型化 Design Intermediate Representation 维护共享参数、产物与决策；引入修订感知检查，使受影响结果失效并阻断被取代的输入，重大变更需工程审批。
AI.result: 在代表性仿真设计中，从不可行的冷却搜索出发，经工程师授权的工况点修订后识别出可行子系统设计，并协调后续几何生成与多物理场评估以支持最终构型选择。分模块测试评估了代理模型预测与喷管适配。三组受控场景下的双构型对比验证了预期的依赖失效与求解器执行前的过时输入阻断。
AI.conclusion: 代表性案例表明该智能体可在多学科设计流程中维持长时程协同，受控测试则确立了支撑该执行的修订机制行为，二者共同验证了 RocketAgent 在液体火箭推力室初步设计中的可行性与依赖管理有效性。

title: Robust Ensemble Guidance for Scientific Inverse Problems
summary: Ensemble guidance combines pretrained diffusion priors with black-box forward models to solve inverse problems without differentiating through the physical simulator. However, observation coordinates with large predictive spread or extreme residuals can dominate the ensemble correction, degrading reconstruction accuracy. We show that two simple modifications, weighting and clipping, substantially improve this correction. Our method, Robust Ensemble Guidance (REG), uses ensemble predictive spread to balance observation scales and adaptively clips standardized residuals to limit the influence of extreme discrepancies. Both operations reuse existing particles and forward predictions, requiring no additional denoiser or forward-model evaluations. Under a local linear Gaussian model, we derive conditions for reduced one-step estimation risk, bound the influence of individual observation coordinates, and characterize when these benefits persist with finite ensembles. Experiments on Navier-Stokes inversion, black-hole imaging, and acoustic full-waveform inversion demonstrate improved reconstruction over the underlying ensemble solver. In particular, REG increases black-hole reconstruction PSNR by 6.2-8.2 dB across three observation regimes and reduces Navier-Stokes reconstruction error by 26.4\% in a matched-budget comparison. These findings highlight the importance of observation heterogeneity and residual influence in designing reliable generative solvers for scientific inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出鲁棒集成引导（REG），通过“加权+截断”两项简单改动改进集成引导的修正项，在不增加额外去噪器或正演模型评估的前提下提升科学反问题重建精度。
AI.motivation: 集成引导（ensemble guidance）将预训练扩散先验与黑箱正演模型结合，可在不穿越物理模拟器求导的情况下求解反问题。但观测坐标之间预测散布大或残差极端时，这些坐标会主导集成修正，导致重建精度下降，即观测异质性与残差影响未被妥善处理。
AI.method: 提出 Robust Ensemble Guidance（REG）：1）利用集成的预测散布对观测尺度进行加权平衡；2）对标准化残差进行自适应截断，限制极端差异的影响。两项操作复用现有粒子与正演预测，不需要额外的去噪器或正演模型评估。理论上在局部线性高斯模型下推导一步估计风险降低的条件，界定单个观测坐标的影响上界，并刻画有限集成下收益的保持条件。
AI.result: 在 Navier-Stokes 反演、黑洞成像与声学全波形反演上，REG 均优于基础集成求解器：在三种观测设置下黑洞重建 PSNR 提升 6.2-8.2 dB；在匹配预算比较中 Navier-Stokes 重建误差降低 26.4%。
AI.conclusion: 观测异质性与残差影响力是设计可靠生成式科学反问题求解器的关键因素；加权与截断是低成本且有效的鲁棒化手段。

title: MoCAR: Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression for Continuous Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Autoregressive generation is natural for language, where predicted tokens can be directly reused as the next prediction state, but trajectory forecasting lacks such a clean token: motion is continuous, multimodal, and expressed in local coordinate frames that evolve with the predicted trajectory. We present MoCAR (Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression), a decoder-only framework that casts trajectory forecasting as next-code prediction in a coordinate-aware continuous latent space. MoCAR learns a continuous motion-code space from endpoint-normalized trajectory segments, where each code jointly captures local trajectory geometry and the reference-frame transition induced by that segment. Historical motion codes are used as a teacher-forced prefix, future codes are generated autoregressively under temporal, map, agent, and mode interactions, and predicted codes persist in latent memory while decoded endpoints update the local scene context. This enables rollout without trajectory-space re-tokenization, trajectory queries, goal candidates, or proposal-and-refinement pipelines. On Argoverse (AV) benchmarks, MoCAR achieves top-tier performance with a simple single-stage architecture, transfers strongly from AV2 to AV1 in zero-shot evaluation, and improves on turn-heavy scenarios. Ablations confirm that the learned continuous motion-code space, latent alignment, weak KL regularization, and joint tokenizer-predictor optimization are essential for stable latent autoregression.

AI.tldr: MoCAR将轨迹预测转化为坐标感知连续隐空间中的下一码预测，采用decoder-only自回归框架，在Argoverse基准上取得顶级性能，并具备强零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 语言自回归可自然复用预测token作为下一状态，但轨迹预测缺乏此类干净token：运动是连续的、多模态的，且表达在随预测轨迹演化的局部坐标系中，难以直接套用语言式自回归范式。
AI.method: 提出MoCAR（Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression），一种decoder-only框架。从端点归一化轨迹片段学习连续motion-code空间，每个码同时编码局部轨迹几何与参考系转移；历史码作为teacher-forced前缀，未来码在时间、地图、智能体与模态交互下自回归生成；预测码保存于latent memory，解码端点更新局部场景上下文。无需轨迹空间重token化、轨迹查询、目标候选或proposal-and-refinement流程。
AI.result: 在Argoverse（AV）基准上以简单单阶段架构达到顶级性能，AV2到AV1零样本迁移表现优异，转弯密集场景有提升。消融实验证实连续motion-code空间、latent alignment、弱KL正则与tokenizer-predictor联合优化对稳定隐式自回归至关重要。
AI.conclusion: MoCAR证明通过坐标感知连续motion-code的下一码预测，可实现无重token化、无候选提案的简洁单阶段轨迹预测，并保持强泛化能力，其中关键设计要素经消融验证均为必要。

title: Benchmarking Jailbreak Guardrails for Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents powered by large language models and vision-language models are increasingly deployed in physical environments, but jailbreak attacks can induce these agents to perform physically harmful actions. A growing number of guardrail methods have been proposed to intercept dangerous behavior before it is executed, yet existing safety benchmarks evaluate the embodied models themselves, leaving it unclear how well these guardrails actually defend an embodied agent in practice. We present the first systematic evaluation of jailbreak guardrails for embodied agents. To compare guardrails under identical conditions, we build a pluggable evaluation framework that treats the embodied agent as a fixed backend and each guardrail as a module that can intervene at the perception, planning, or control stage. We subject six representative guardrails to template-based and automated jailbreak attacks as well as safe instructions, and assess them at the system level along three dimensions: defense effectiveness, measured by the bypass rate and the hazard success rate in the simulator; usability, measured by the false-positive rate and the task completion rate on safe instructions; and efficiency, measured by the latency overhead added at runtime. Experiments on guardrails that span different intervention stages, decision mechanisms, and input modalities reveal a clear trade-off among the three dimensions, and show that no single guardrail dominates in all settings. We further analyze how intervention stage, decision mechanism, and input modality shape safety outcomes, and we offer practical guidance for selecting and designing guardrails for embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 首个针对具身智能体越狱防护的系统性评测：搭建可插拔框架，在感知/规划/控制阶段插入六种防护，用模板化与自动化越狱及安全指令测试，从防御效果、可用性、效率三维度评估，揭示三者权衡且无单一防护全面占优。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体（由LLM/VLM驱动）已进入物理环境，越狱攻击可诱导其执行物理有害动作；虽已有诸多防护方法，但现有安全基准只评测具身模型自身，防护在真实具身智能体中究竟能提供多强防御尚不清楚，缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建可插拔评测框架：将具身智能体视为固定后端，每个防护作为可在感知、规划或控制阶段干预的模块，从而在相同条件下比较。对六种代表性防护同时施加模板化越狱、自动化越狱攻击及安全指令，并在系统层面从三个维度评测：防御效果（旁路率、模拟器中危害成功率）、可用性（误报率、安全指令任务完成率）、效率（运行时延迟开销）。
AI.result: 实验覆盖不同干预阶段、决策机制与输入模态的防护，发现三者之间（防御效果、可用性、效率）存在明确权衡，且没有任何单一防护在所有设置下占优；并进一步分析了干预阶段、决策机制与输入模态如何影响安全结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为具身智能体越狱防护提供了首个系统评测，表明防护设计需在防御效果、可用性与效率间取舍，并据此给出了选择与设计具身智能体防护的实用指导。

title: Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs
comment: Accepted to the Collaborative, Open, and DECentralized training of Foundation Models workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Collaborative learning typically exchanges model parameters: federated clients communicate updates, while independently adapted foundation models are combined by exchanging adapters or checkpoints. This makes communication scale with model size and requires local specializations to be reconciled in weight space, where interference is common. We ask whether knowledge can instead be shared through model behavior on task-unrelated inputs. We introduce Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL), a collaborative learning primitive in which participants adapt a common model locally, probe it with task-unrelated inputs, and transmit only the resulting carrier outputs. A coordinator pools these outputs and distills them into a shared model. The primitive supports one-shot foundation-model composition through carrier completions and iterative federated learning through carrier logits, without transmitting model updates or requiring task-related proxy data. In LLM composition, compared with LoRA averaging, DSL achieves higher preference retention (94.56% vs. 87.76%) and a larger GSM8K gain over the base model (22.0 vs. 0.6 points), while reducing upload by 30.6-49.0$\times$. In federated classification, DSL reaches 96.83% on MNIST with 8.9$\times$ less uplink than FedAvg and provides lower-communication operating points on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet. These results establish random-carrier outputs as a practical communication primitive for knowledge sharing across distinct collaborative learning paradigms.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式潜隐学习（DSL）协作学习原语：参与者本地适配共享模型后，用任务无关输入探测并只传输“载体输出”，由协调者汇聚后蒸馏进共享模型，从而在不传输模型参数的情况下实现知识共享，并大幅降低通信量。
AI.motivation: 传统协作学习（联邦客户端交换参数、独立基础模型交换适配器或检查点）存在两个问题：通信量随模型规模增长；本地特化需在权重空间中调和，容易产生干扰。作者希望探索能否改用“模型在任务无关输入上的行为”来传递知识，从而绕开权重空间的合并与高通信开销。
AI.method: 提出 DSL 原语：参与者先在本地适配一个公共模型，再用任务无关输入进行探测，仅传输由此产生的载体输出；协调者汇聚这些输出并蒸馏进共享模型。该原语支持两种形态：通过载体补全实现一次性基础模型组合，通过载体 logits 实现迭代式联邦学习；全程不传输模型更新，也不需要任务相关的代理数据。
AI.result: 在 LLM 组合任务中，与 LoRA 平均相比，DSL 偏好保持率更高（94.56% vs. 87.76%），相对基模型的 GSM8K 提升更大（22.0 vs. 0.6 分），同时上传量减少 30.6–49.0 倍。在联邦分类中，DSL 在 MNIST 上达到 96.83%，上行通信比 FedAvg 少 8.9 倍，并在 CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 上提供更低通信量的工作点。
AI.conclusion: 随机载体输出可作为实用的通信原语，用于跨不同协作学习范式（一次性基础模型组合与迭代联邦学习）的知识共享，在保持或提升性能的同时显著降低通信开销。

title: Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Guidance for Non-Blind Image Deblurring
summary: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful image priors for training-free posterior sampling in image restoration. To guide this sampling process, frequency-aware methods progressively incorporate measurement information across frequency bands, facilitating coarse-to-fine reconstruction. However, existing methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. In this work, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance to separate frequency activation from attenuation-aware spectral regularization. Specifically, a progressive low-to-high frequency schedule determines the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components. To stabilize the sampling process, we also introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations. For a fixed endpoint energy, we provide a KL-regularized path-space interpretation. In practice, we construct time-dependent guidance through local energy corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on natural-image benchmarks demonstrate strong PSNR and SSIM performance across challenging non-blind deblurring settings, even at higher measurement noise levels.

AI.tldr: 提出频率解耦后验引导方法，将频率激活与衰减感知谱正则化显式分离，结合局部轨迹正则器提升基于扩散模型的图像复原性能。
AI.motivation: 现有频率感知方法虽然逐步引入各频段的测量信息以实现由粗到精重建，但未显式区分频率激活与退化引起的衰减，导致对非激活频率间衰减差异建模不足，限制了复原质量。
AI.method: 提出频率解耦后验引导：(1) 用渐进低频到高频调度确定激活测量频段；(2) 由核导出的衰减图对非激活分量施加选择性谱先验；(3) 引入局部轨迹正则器抑制空间上不规则的"状态到干净图"偏差；对固定端点能量给出KL正则化的路径空间解释；实践中通过Tweedie插值近似进行局部能量校正来构造时变引导。
AI.result: 在自然图像基准的多种非盲去模糊设置下，即使测量噪声更高，仍取得较强的PSNR与SSIM表现。
AI.conclusion: 将频率激活与衰减感知谱正则化解耦、并辅以局部轨迹正则化，能有效提升基于预训练扩散模型的无训练后验采样的复原精度与稳定性。

title: On Impact of Loss Function on the Performance of Neural Networks in Melanoma Diagnosis
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Melanoma is the deadliest type of skin cancer, whose early diagnosis is crucial for patients' survival. Image classification using deep learning models has shown promising results for melanoma diagnosis. However, the performance of these models on the melanoma datasets such as SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset is a challenge due to the class imbalance. One of the methods to deal with this challenge is using loss function modifications. In this work, we have investigated the effect of different loss functions on the performance of deep neural networks. We trained these networks using focal loss, logit-adjusted softmax cross-entropy (CE) loss, and weighted softmax CE loss, and we report different metrics for evaluating performance and uncertainty calibration. Our results suggest that focal loss delivers a good combination of performance in terms of AUC and uncertainty calibration in terms of expected calibration error (ECE) simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究了不同损失函数对深度神经网络在SIIM-ISIC黑色素瘤分类任务（类别不平衡）上的性能影响，并报告了性能与不确定性校准指标。
AI.motivation: 黑色素瘤是致死率最高的皮肤癌，早期诊断对患者生存至关重要。深度学习图像分类已显示出潜力，但SIIM-ISIC等黑色素瘤数据集存在类别不平衡问题，严重影响模型性能，因此需要有效的应对方法。
AI.method: 采用损失函数修改策略，分别使用focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax交叉熵（CE）损失以及加权softmax CE损失训练深度神经网络，并报告性能评估与不确定性校准的多项指标。
AI.result: 结果显示，focal loss能同时在AUC性能与不确定性校准（以期望校准误差ECE衡量）两方面取得良好的综合表现。
AI.conclusion: 在类别不平衡的黑色素瘤分类任务中，focal loss在性能与不确定性校准间实现了较优的平衡，是一种值得采用的损失函数选择。

title: Does Explainability Survive Data Drift?
summary: Model performance monitoring is a standard practice in machine learning deployments. Detection performance is tracked continuously, and model decay is expected as the relationship between the feature and target variables degrades, a phenomenon known as concept drift. Explanation fidelity, however, is rarely monitored with the same discipline, even in domains such as financial systems, healthcare, and other regulated environments where explanations are required for governance purposes. This paper investigates whether explanations can decay under data drift, even when the feature-target relationship remains stable, and whether explanations produced before drift occurs remain faithful to the decisions of the model that replaces them. Using the IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection dataset, we find statistically significant covariate shift but no statistically significant evidence of concept drift under the implemented conditional-drift tests, thereby providing an empirical setting in which input distributional change can be studied separately from detectable changes in the feature-target relationship. Local explanations are generated with ExIFFI and evaluated at three levels: path validity, structural behaviour, and fidelity under controlled intervention. Results show that while prior explanations retain substantial decision relevance to a retrained model, they are consistently less faithful than newly generated explanations, with no evidence of a systematically widening gap across the evaluated windows. The study shows that explanation fidelity requires its own monitoring, that structural stability of explanations does not guarantee functional fidelity, and that explanations should be treated as artifacts tied to the model that produced them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数据漂移下解释保真度的衰减问题：在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据上确认存在显著协变量偏移但无显著概念漂移，用ExIFFI生成局部解释并从路径有效性、结构行为、干预保真度三层评估，发现旧解释虽仍有决策相关性但保真度系统性低于新解释，故解释需独立监控。
AI.motivation: 模型性能（如检测性能）在部署中被持续监控并预期随概念漂移而衰减，但解释保真度在金融、医疗等受监管、需为治理提供解释的领域中很少被同等监控。作者希望探究：在特征—目标关系保持稳定、仅发生数据漂移时，解释是否也会衰减；漂移前生成的解释对新模型是否仍忠实。
AI.method: 使用IEEE-CIS交易欺诈检测数据集，通过条件漂移检验确认存在统计显著的协变量偏移但无显著概念漂移，从而构造可将输入分布变化与特征—目标关系变化分离的实验环境；用ExIFFI生成局部解释，在路径有效性、结构行为、受控干预下的保真度三个层面评估旧解释与重训模型新解释的差异。
AI.result: 漂移前生成的解释对重训模型仍保留较强的决策相关性，但其保真度始终低于新生成的解释；在所评估的时间窗口内，未发现两者差距系统性扩大的证据。
AI.conclusion: 解释保真度需要自身的监控机制；解释的结构稳定性并不保证其功能保真度；解释应被视为依附于生成它的模型的产物，而非可跨模型迁移的独立对象。

title: Joint Class-Time Learning for Video Classification with Multi-Instance Partial-Label Learning
summary: Multi-instance partial-label learning (MIPL) addresses inexact supervision in both the instance and label spaces, which can be applied to video classification. However, bag-level labels do not explicitly supervise the correspondence between candidate classes and temporal evidence. We propose {\ours}, which couples label disambiguation with temporal evidence allocation through a joint class--time assignment. Occupancy-regularized spherical matching associates contextualized video features while learning nonuniform temporal mass and discouraging excessive concentration. During training, candidate-restricted inference recomputes the assignment within the candidate label set. A dual-marginal KL projection then constructs a structured teacher that incorporates momentum-refined class beliefs while preserving the proposal's temporal occupancy. A single plan-level KL objective aligns the full-space predictor with this teacher. Our analysis characterizes when candidate re-solving differs from masking and shows that, under the stated construction, the joint objective decomposes into class-marginal and class-conditional temporal supervision. We construct VCMIPL benchmarks from Breakfast, DoTA, and FineAction using model-generated candidate labels and evaluate the method across four feature representations. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that PIVOTMIPL outperforms existing MIPL algorithms in both effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出PIVOTMIPL，通过联合类别-时间分配，将标签消歧与时间证据分配耦合，解决多示例偏标签学习（MIPL）中包级标签无法监督候选类别与时间证据对应关系的问题。
AI.motivation: MIPL同时处理示例空间与标签空间的不精确监督，可应用于视频分类。但包级标签无法明确监督候选类别与时间证据之间的对应关系，存在监督不足问题。
AI.method: 设计占用正则化球面匹配，关联上下文视频特征，学习非均匀时间质量并抑制过度集中；训练中采用候选受限推理，在候选标签集内重算分配；通过双边缘KL投影构建结构化教师，融合动量精炼的类别信念并保留提议的时间占用；以单一计划级KL目标对齐全空间预测器与教师。
AI.result: 理论分析刻画了候选重解与掩码的差异，并证明在该构造下联合目标可分解为类别边缘监督和类别条件时间监督；基于Breakfast、DoTA、FineAction构建VCMIPL基准，使用模型生成候选标签，在四种特征表示上评估，实验表明该方法在有效性与效率上均优于现有MIPL算法。
AI.conclusion: PIVOTMIPL通过联合类别-时间分配统一标签消歧与时间证据分配，配合结构化教师蒸馏，在多特征表示的VCMIPL基准上实现更优的有效性与效率。

title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 研究数据增强对不平衡数据集（黑色素瘤分类）模型校准的影响，发现不同增强方法能改善不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 在医学图像分类尤其是黑色素瘤诊断中，准确的预测不确定性量化与模型校准对患者诊疗意义重大。数据增强既可用于提升校准，又能扩充数据以改善不平衡数据集的模型性能，但数据增强（作为对部分原始数据的变换）对不平衡数据集模型校准的影响尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 在SIIM-ISIC 2020黑色素瘤分类数据集上训练神经网络，设置两种条件：使用与不使用数据增强，并比较两种情况下AUC与期望校准误差（ECE）的差异。
AI.result: 结果表明，使用不同数据增强方法可以改善不确定性校准。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强是改善不平衡医学图像分类任务中模型校准的有效手段，为黑色素瘤诊断中的不确定性量化提供了实证支持。

title: GNN-CB: A Graph Neural Network Competition Benchmark for Human and LLM Evaluation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 28 pages, 16 figures, 4 tables. Benchmark and leaderboards: https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks; however, their ability to solve graph-structured machine learning problems remains largely unexplored. In particular, no benchmark currently evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously solve end-to-end Graph Neural Network (GNN) coding tasks under realistic competition settings. To address this gap, this paper introduces GNN-CB, the first competition-based benchmark for evaluating both humans and LLMs on GNN coding tasks. GNN-CB consists of 18 curated competitions spanning node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction across diverse graph categories, domains, and difficulty tiers. All submissions are evaluated through a unified automated pipeline with hidden test sets and standardized scoring. Human participants solve tasks under controlled competition constraints, while LLMs are evaluated using a frozen zero-shot prompting protocol based on a plan-then-code paradigm with bounded execute-and-repair loops. The benchmark additionally supports both non-agent and autonomous agent-based evaluation within the same protocol. Under our evaluated protocol, LLMs rarely match Human Top performance and show less stable performance across competitions. No single model dominates: a few competitions are won by LLMs, yet humans still hold the top score on most tasks. We release GNN-CB as a living benchmark with automated evaluation infrastructure, dynamic leaderboards, and reproducible execution pipelines. Beyond benchmarking, GNN-CB provides a practice-oriented resource for studying GNN implementation across progressively diverse graph-learning tasks. The benchmark and evaluation framework are publicly available at https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GNN-CB，首个基于竞赛形式、同时评测人类与大语言模型（LLM）在图神经网络（GNN）编码任务上端到端能力的基准，涵盖18个多层级、多领域的图任务，结果显示LLM整体难以匹敌人类顶尖表现且稳定性不足。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在编码与推理基准上表现优异，但其自主解决图结构机器学习问题（尤其是端到端GNN编码）的能力尚缺乏评测。现无基准能在真实竞赛设定下衡量该能力，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建GNN-CB基准：包含18个精选竞赛，覆盖节点级、边级、图级预测，横跨多种图类别、领域与难度层级；采用统一自动化流水线，配合隐藏测试集与标准化评分。人类在受控竞赛约束下解题；LLM采用冻结的零样本提示协议，基于"先规划后编码"范式并设有有界执行-修复循环；同一协议同时支持非智能体与自主智能体两种评测方式。
AI.result: 在所评测协议下，LLM极少能达到人类顶尖水平，且跨竞赛表现稳定性较差；无单一模型占据主导——虽有少数竞赛由LLM夺冠，但多数任务最高分仍由人类保持。
AI.conclusion: GNN-CB作为"活基准"发布，提供自动化评测基础设施、动态排行榜与可复现执行流水线，并作为面向实践的资源，用于研究跨多样图学习任务的GNN实现；基准与评测框架已公开。

title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication to BHI 2026
summary: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: MS-Exam-Gen是一个可复现框架，用于构建与审计面向多发性硬化MRI（MS-MRI）文本知识的MCQ基准；从66篇来源抽取4,289个检索块，生成3,058题候选基准（16主题/53子主题），在12个LLM端点产生36,696条预测，准确率跨度42.8个百分点（89.7%–46.9%）。
AI.motivation: 生物医学大模型评估需要可审计地考察狭窄、不断演进且以来源为依据的亚专科知识。MS-MRI是高风险文本知识测试场景：正确推理依赖当前诊断标准、标准化采集与报告知识、纵向监测概念、病灶形态学及疑难模仿病变识别，故需要一个来源接地、可复现的评测基准构建与审计方式（不评估直接影像判读）。
AI.method: 框架组合六类环节：专家来源索引、面向考试的主题归纳、证据接地的MCQ生成、自动化质量审计、同族一致性筛查、经验性校准。基于66篇来源语料索引为4,289个检索块，覆盖标准、协议、报告与鉴别诊断，最终锁定3,058题候选基准（16主题、53子主题）。
AI.result: 在12个主流LLM端点上完成评估，获得36,696条题目级预测，准确率跨度42.8个百分点（89.7%至46.9%）；其中25.5%的题目被至少四个端点答错。生成后审计显示，刷新式构建降低了可测量的答案线索；选项顺序测试表明绝对MCQ分数仍具位置敏感性。生成的构建标签仅为元数据，而非经心理测量学验证的类别。
AI.conclusion: 由于专家裁定与完整选项顺序平衡尚属未来工作，MS-Exam-Gen并非临床认证考试，应被理解为自动筛选、来源接地的候选基准及可复现审计流程，用于题目级与主题特异性的LLM评估。

title: Efficient Graph Generation via Direct Prediction and Flow Matching
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (Oral)
summary: Generative modeling of graph-structured data is crucial for tasks ranging from drug discovery to social network simulation. Among these models, denoising diffusion models have achieved great success in graph generation by learning to progressively reverse a process that adds noise to the original graph. However, the standard noise-prediction approach of diffusion models is suboptimal for graph data. The goal for a graph generative model is to learn the clean graphs' topological properties, such as connectivity and degree distribution. Because a diffusion model that predicts noise does not explicitly learn these topological properties, it is challenging for the model to output graphs with the desired structural statistics. To address this challenge, we introduce Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM), a novel graph transformer model guided by two goals: predict clean graphs and improve sampling efficiency. Distinct from the prevailing diffusion approach, DiGFM employs a continuous flow-matching paradigm and integrates direct graph prediction. Specifically, DiGFM maps the prior noise distribution to the clean graph distribution via a multi-step process: the model repeatedly predicts the underlying clean graph, and a transformation is employed to convert the model output to the velocity vector that points in the direction toward the clean graph distribution. This design enables DiGFM to generate high-quality samples using only 2.5% to 15.6% of the steps required by diffusion-based models, which leads to a 5.3x to 257x speedup in wall-clock inference time. Experiments demonstrate that DiGFM outperforms or matches prior state-of-the-art models across general graph benchmarks and molecular datasets, generating graphs with strong adherence to ground-truth structural statistics at significantly faster inference speeds.

AI.tldr: 提出DiGFM，一种基于图Transformer的连续流匹配图生成模型，通过直接预测干净图而非噪声，显著提升结构统计保真度并大幅加速采样。
AI.motivation: 图生成模型的目标是学习干净图的拓扑性质（如连通性、度分布）。然而主流扩散模型采用噪声预测范式，并不显式学习这些拓扑属性，导致难以生成具有期望结构统计特性的图。
AI.method: DiGFM采用连续流匹配范式并集成直接图预测。它将先验噪声分布映射到干净图分布：模型反复预测潜在的干净图，再通过一个变换将模型输出转换为指向干净图分布方向的velocity向量。模型基于图Transformer构建。
AI.result: DiGFM仅需扩散模型2.5%–15.6%的采样步数，实现5.3x至257x的墙钟推理加速；在通用图基准与分子数据集上超越或匹配当前最优模型，生成的图对真实结构统计具有高度贴合性。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接预测干净图并以流匹配替代噪声预测，DiGFM在保证甚至提升生成质量的同时，实现了显著更快的推理速度，为图生成提供了高效且结构保真的好方案。

title: VepAgent: Bridging Causal-Transition via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Video Event Prediction
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in video understanding, yet their reliance on retrospective summarization and text-centric priors often limits their ability to bridge unobserved causal transitions when applied to Video Event Prediction (VEP). To address this, we propose VepAgent, an agentic framework that integrates causal-transition reasoning with tool-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) for robust VEP. Unlike prior methods that passively project future trajectories from historical dependencies, our approach explicitly models the logical progression from terminal observed states to future events. Specifically, we first construct futurebench-4K, a high-quality chain-of-thought dataset for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) that effectively bridges the causal-logic gap by structuring the deduction of unobserved intermediate states. Subsequently, we develop a diagnostic tool library integrating state tracking, frame retrieval, and region magnification, enabling the agent to dynamically augment reasoning with external tools to recover missing spatio-temporal evidence and resolve visual ambiguities during inference. Moreover, we propose a composite reward mechanism that jointly optimizes prediction accuracy, causal coherence, and reliable prior, compelling the agent to rely on genuine visual grounding rather than superficial textual similarities. Extensive evaluations on FutureBench and NEPBench datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming larger MLLMs and validating the empirical effectiveness of our agentic, future-oriented reasoning paradigm.

AI.tldr: 提出 VepAgent 智能体框架，将因果转移推理与工具增强强化学习结合用于视频事件预测（VEP），并构建 FutureBench-4K 思维链数据集与诊断工具库，在 FutureBench 与 NEPBench 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在视频事件预测中依赖回溯式摘要与文本中心先验，难以跨越未观测到的因果转移，无法有效衔接已观测末端状态与未来事件之间的逻辑缺口。
AI.method: 1) 构建 FutureBench-4K 高质量思维链数据集用于监督微调，通过结构化推导未观测中间状态弥合因果逻辑缺口；2) 设计包含状态跟踪、帧检索与区域放大的诊断工具库，使智能体在推理时动态调用外部工具恢复缺失时空证据、消解视觉歧义；3) 提出联合优化预测准确率、因果连贯性与可靠先验的复合奖励机制，促使智能体依赖真实视觉 grounding 而非表面文本相似性。
AI.result: 在 FutureBench 与 NEPBench 数据集上的大量评估表明，该方法达到最先进性能，显著优于规模更大的多模态大模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模从观测末端状态到未来事件的逻辑推演，并结合工具增强强化学习，可有效提升视频事件预测的鲁棒性与准确性，验证了面向未来的智能体推理范式的实证有效性。

title: Auditable Clinical Timeline Reconstruction with Provenance-Aware Evidence Graphs
summary: A patient-timeline reconstruction system is auditable only if it keeps the mentions behind each answer, records how facts were revised, and declines to answer when the evidence is not in the text. This study tests these three properties on a fully synthetic corpus (1,000 patients, 3,353 notes, 220 revision edges). Two provenance-aware Evidence Graph operators reduced the node-plus-edge count to 67% and 63% (77-78% of serialized size) while preserving every answer and mention link across 6,813 query points answerable by recency; a fixed-window baseline returned no value for 53.4% of points, unflagged. On evidence-unavailable controls that announce the omission, a BioClinicalBERT gate and a zero-shot LLM gate responded mainly to the announcement. On marker-free controls, BERT abstained on 0 of 81 notes while its accuracy fell from 93.8% to 59.3% across all three relation classes; the LLM's coverage fell from 75.6% to 27.7% on notes its own model family judged undeterminable. Against 482 regenerated gold spans, the LLM's cited evidence reached recall 0.850 and precision 0.864; BERT's span head, trained without span labels, did not localize evidence. A temporally versioned provenance graph stored abstentions as typed, queryable edges. The clean task admits a 0.651-accuracy shortcut, and results describe implementation behaviour on synthetic data, not clinical performance.

AI.tldr: 本文在合成病历语料上检验患者时间线重建系统的三项可审计属性（保留证据提及、记录事实修订、证据不足时拒答），并用溯源感知的Evidence Graph算子压缩图规模而不损失答案与提及链接。
AI.motivation: 患者时间线重建系统只有在同时满足三点时才可审计：保留每个答案背后的提及、记录事实如何被修订、以及当文本中没有证据时拒绝回答。现有系统多只关注答案准确率，缺少对这三项属性的联合评估与实现检验。
AI.method: 构建完全合成语料（1,000名患者、3,353份笔记、220条修订边），在6,813个可用近因回答的查询点上评估两种溯源感知Evidence Graph算子；以固定窗口基线作对照；用BioClinicalBERT门控与零样本LLM门控测试证据缺失控制与无标记控制；用482个重新生成的gold span评估引用证据的召回与精确度；并采用带时间版本化的溯源图将弃答存为带类型的可查询边。
AI.result: 两种算子将节点加边数量降至67%与63%（序列化大小为77–78%），同时保留全部答案与提及链接；固定窗口基线对53.4%的查询点未返回任何值且未标记。在宣布省略的控制上，两个门控主要响应省略声明；在无标记控制上，BERT对81份笔记弃答0次，三类关系准确率从93.8%降至59.3%；LLM覆盖率从75.6%降至27.7%。对482个gold span，LLM引用证据召回0.850、精确0.864，而未经span标签训练的BERT span头未能定位证据。
AI.conclusion: 时间版本化溯源图可将弃答作为带类型、可查询的边存储，从而实现三类可审计属性的可操作化。但干净任务存在0.651准确率的捷径，且结果仅描述合成数据上的实现行为，不代表临床性能。

title: No Concept Escapes the Audit: Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate prohibited content, which motivates concept erasure through machine unlearning. Most erasure methods intervene at the text interface, through prompt modification or localized updates to text-conditioning weights, and they are evaluated by what the model outputs for given prompts. Such evaluation cannot see what the network still encodes. Latent-space auditing, which bypasses text conditioning and probes the denoising network directly, shows that erased concepts remain recoverable from internal representations. We find that this also holds for methods built to be robust against adversarial prompts, and that the problem grows with the number of erased concepts. We propose Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models (AVCE), a framework that grounds erasure in the model's latent representations. AVCE audits the embedding neighborhood of each concept and condenses the discovered vulnerable directions into an anchor at the weakest geometric point. It edits cross-attention and self-attention projections in closed form at this anchor, then fine-tunes the two pathways with pathway-level auditing losses, using orthogonal gradient projection to consolidate multiple concepts. Experiments on SD v1.5, SDXL, and Flux 1.0 across object, explicit-content, and artistic-style unlearning show that AVCE reduces attack success rates by 5.07x and improves auditing scores by 3.84x over the strongest baseline, while preserving competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出AVCE框架，通过潜在空间审计实现可验证的概念擦除，在多个扩散模型上显著降低攻击成功率并提升审计分数。
AI.motivation: 主流概念擦除方法在文本接口干预（提示修改或文本条件权重局部更新），仅以给定提示的输出评估效果，无法检测网络内部仍编码的信息。潜在空间审计绕过文本条件直接探测去噪网络，揭示被擦除概念仍可从内部表示中恢复，且此问题对对抗提示鲁棒的方法同样存在，并随擦除概念数量增加而加剧。
AI.method: AVCE框架将擦除根植于潜在表示：审计每个概念的嵌入邻域，将发现的脆弱方向凝练为最弱几何点的锚点；在该锚点以闭式解编辑交叉注意力和自注意力投影；然后用路径级审计损失微调两条路径，并采用正交梯度投影整合多个概念。
AI.result: 在SD v1.5、SDXL和Flux 1.0上，针对物体、显式内容和艺术风格擦除任务，AVCE相较最强基线将攻击成功率降低5.07倍，审计分数提升3.84倍，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: AVCE通过潜在空间审计驱动的擦除，实现了可验证的概念擦除，有效应对传统文本接口方法的内部编码残留问题。

title: Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了在现代VLA策略中接入affordance（可供性）预测头的正确方式，发现在LIBERO基准上，采用stop-gradient保护主干、并通过主动初始化的残差桥接将中间头特征注入动作专家，能以不足1%的额外参数达到96.2%成功率，媲美复杂的AffordanceVLA（95.8%）。
AI.motivation: 稠密可供性监督是VLA策略有吸引力的辅助信号，但朴素地协同训练affordance头会严重损害指令跟随能力，因此需要明确"如何正确接线"以在保留性能的同时利用该辅助信号。
AI.method: 在LIBERO上开展受控研究：主干通过stop-gradient读取，并将中间头特征经可学习桥接重注入动作专家；对注入拓扑（拼接vs残差）与桥初始化（零vs随机）进行同预算2×2消融；并用两个探针（真值affordance作为输入、推理时置零）分析机制。
AI.result: stop-gradient是前提条件：允许affordance梯度回传主干会使策略降至85.5%，低于无头基线93.1%。在主干受保护下，初始化是主导因素；最优接线为主动初始化的残差桥，达96.2%，与AffordanceVLA（95.8%）相当而额外参数不足1%。探针显示真值affordance作为输入有害；推理置零表明懒桥仅起训练期正则作用，而主动桥为承重结构。
AI.conclusion: 将affordance头接入VLA的关键在于：以stop-gradient隔离主干、并采用主动初始化的残差桥接注入中间特征；此时辅助头从正则器变为承重组件，可在极低参数开销下取得最优性能。

title: Bridging the Evidence-to-Execution Gap:A Reflective Agent for Multi-Objective Peptide Design
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over scientific literature to devise design strategies, yet fail to reliably implement them for biological sequences. While protein generative models learn sequence patterns, they lack the capacity to incorporate literature evidence for multi-step reflective reasoning, forming an evidence-to-execution gap between scientific reasoning and sequence manipulation. We present EASER (Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection), a reflective agent bridging reasoning and sequence generation via a learned property interface of offline-trained, fixed low-rank matrices. The agent steers a diffusion generator by combining these matrices, proposing intervention hypotheses (anchors, editable positions, control coefficients) grounded in retrieved evidence, sequence context and past results. A Probe-and-Steer mechanism validates interventions and allocates samples according to predicted property responses, with outcome reflection informing subsequent decisions. Evaluated on multi-objective antimicrobial peptide design (optimizing activity, non-hemolysis and non-toxicity), explicit hypothesis formulation delivers better multi-objective performance than direct action generation under identical decision conditions. Ablation studies verify the importance of evidence retrieval, episodic history, reflection and Probe-and-Steer. Over six repeated trials, EASER obtains the highest mean hypervolume and lowest mean IGD+ on screened candidates compared with competing baselines. Our work demonstrates how an executable property interface and iterative feedback link scientific reasoning to targeted peptide sequence generation.

AI.tldr: 提出EASER，一个反思型智能体，通过基于离线训练固定低秩矩阵的可学习属性接口，将文献证据推理与扩散生成器的肽序列设计相连接。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能基于科学文献推理设计策略，却难以可靠地将其落实到生物序列实现上；蛋白质生成模型虽学习序列模式，但无法融入文献证据进行多步反思推理，导致科学推理与序列操作之间存在"证据到执行"的鸿沟。
AI.method: EASER通过离线训练、固定的低秩矩阵构建可学习属性接口以桥接推理与序列生成。智能体结合这些矩阵来操控扩散生成器，基于检索证据、序列上下文与历史结果提出干预假设（锚点、可编辑位置、控制系数）；并采用Probe-and-Steer机制验证干预、依据预测属性响应分配样本，用结果反思指导后续决策。
AI.result: 在多目标抗菌肽设计任务（优化活性、非溶血性、非毒性）上，显式假设构建在相同决策条件下优于直接动作生成；消融实验验证了证据检索、情景历史、反思与Probe-and-Steer的重要性；六次重复试验中，EASER在筛选候选上取得最高平均超体积与最低平均IGD+。
AI.conclusion: 可执行的属性接口与迭代反馈能够将科学推理与靶向肽序列生成相连接，为证据驱动的生物序列设计提供了可行范式。

title: Task Vector Descent: Learning from Non-IID Batches
summary: A central challenge in continual learning is to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what the model has already learned. This challenge appears in language model training when training data comes from various domain-, user-, or task-specific distributions that are encountered unevenly over time. In such settings, successive minibatches are temporally clustered by distribution instead of being sampled i.i.d. from the overall data mixture. Training on temporally clustered data induces a stability-plasticity tradeoff. Adapting the model to the active distribution can improve the model on the active distribution but may lead to a performance degradation on data it previously trained on. We find that this tradeoff intensifies with longer exposure to the same distribution. We therefore ask if the parameter displacement produced by such a sequence (the task vector) should be fully retained or applied partially. We compare applying the full displacement ($λ=1$) with partial integration, which scales the task vector by $λ$ before applying it to the continuing model and scales the optimizer state by the same coefficient. Across continual pretraining, pretraining from random initialization, supervised post-training, and reinforcement post-training, we find that intermediate values of $λ$ often improve average continuing-model performance relative to full integration, particularly after longer same-distribution sequences. In continual-pretraining experiments with both controlled streams and naturally defined adaptation sequences, task-vector scaling outperforms full integration at the matched learning rate, showing that its benefits are not reproduced by learning-rate scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 研究持续学习中任务向量的部分整合（按系数λ缩放）相比完全整合（λ=1）的效果，发现中间λ值常能提升持续模型平均性能，尤其在长时间同分布训练后。
AI.motivation: 持续学习面临稳定性-可塑性权衡：训练数据来自不同领域/用户/任务分布且遭遇不均衡，连续的小批量按分布时间聚集而非i.i.d.采样。适应当前分布会提升该分布性能但损害旧数据表现，且该权衡随同分布暴露时间延长而加剧。因此需探究任务向量应完整保留还是部分应用。
AI.method: 对比完全整合（λ=1，直接应用任务向量）与部分整合：在将任务向量应用到持续模型前按λ缩放，同时对优化器状态按相同系数缩放。涵盖持续预训练、随机初始化预训练、监督后训练、强化学习后训练四种场景进行验证。
AI.result: 在四种训练场景中，中间λ值往往比完全整合获得更好的持续模型平均性能，尤其在较长同分布序列后更明显。在受控数据流和自然定义的适应序列的持续预训练实验中，任务向量缩放在匹配学习率下优于完全整合，说明其收益无法仅靠学习率缩放解释。
AI.conclusion: 部分整合任务向量（按中间λ缩放任务向量和优化器状态）是一种有效缓解持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡的方法，其收益在多种训练范式和数据流下均有体现。

title: Readout Blindness: VLM Scores Miss the Spatial Direction Their Frozen Encoders Retain
summary: CLIP-like vision-language models remain a cornerstone of multimodal systems, yet their scores stay near chance on directed spatial relations, such as whether one object is left of another. We call this failure readout blindness and analyze, theoretically and empirically, why deployed scores miss the direction: when scoring rules treat the subject and object symmetrically, direction cancels regardless of encoder training. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Antisymmetric Displacement Readout (ADR), which aligns caption words with image patches in the frozen features and scores each relation by the signed displacement between matched object centroids. Notably, ADR succeeds without additional training or learned parameters, thereby demonstrating that directional information remains in the frozen encoder. However, text and world priors can inflate accuracy, so we further introduce prior deflation, which measures the benefit of the image-text pairing as the grounded gain over a null that pairs each item with an unrelated image. Extensive experiments across encoder families show that ADR substantially improves over deployed scores, which remain near chance on most direction-balanced sets even for fine-tuned encoders. Compared with more complex readouts, ADR outperforms the evaluated MLLM likelihood readouts and is competitive with their chat inference at a small fraction of the computation. These results support our claim that directional information can be recovered from frozen features by an appropriate readout. Our implementation and evaluation kit will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: CLIP类视觉语言模型在方向性空间关系上近乎随机，作者将其归因为"readout blindness"，提出无需训练、无学习参数的Antisymmetric Displacement Readout（ADR），并引入prior deflation消除文本与世界先验的虚高，实验证明冻结特征中仍保留方向信息。
AI.motivation: CLIP类模型是多模态系统基石，但在"左/右"等有向空间关系判别上得分接近随机水平。作者希望从理论与实证上说明这种失败源于评分规则本身，而非编码器丢失了方向信息。
AI.method: 理论分析指出：当评分规则对称对待主语与宾语时，方向信息会相互抵消，与编码器训练方式无关。据此提出ADR：在冻结特征中将caption词与图像patch对齐，用匹配到的物体质心之间的有符号位移（signed displacement）对每个关系打分，无需额外训练或可学习参数。另引入prior deflation：以"每个条目与不相关图像配对"为null基线，用grounded gain衡量图文配对的真实收益，抑制文本与世界先验带来的准确率虚高。
AI.result: 跨多个编码器家族的实验显示，ADR显著优于现有评分方式；后者在多数方向均衡数据集上即使经过微调也仍接近随机。与更复杂的readout相比，ADR优于所评估的MLLM似然readout，并以极小计算量与它们的chat inference相当。
AI.conclusion: 有向空间信息仍存在于冻结编码器特征中，只要采用合适的readout即可恢复；ADR与prior deflation为评估此类能力提供了更可靠的方案，实现与评测工具将公开。

title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
summary: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索型智能体在工具源失效时"判断"与"行动"的分离：即便智能体97-100%认定结果无用，多数仍不停止依赖该工具；只有在外挂集成步骤（连续五次判定无用后强制作答）时，停止才真正由证据驱动。
AI.motivation: 智能体的工具持续返回无用结果时理应停止使用，但此前缺乏对"判断"与"停止行为"是否一致的受控检验，也缺少可复现的干预手段。
AI.method: 构建带可控源失效的检索环境，将智能体对结果的判断与其停止行为分离测量：对比在长短不一的"判定无用"结果序列后于同一步停止的差异（该对比对时钟/截止时间驱动的停止为零）；测试七个智能体，并施加提示线索、允许凭记忆作答、推理模式、声明预算、停止规则与调用成本等干预；提出并要求实现"连续五次判定无用后强制作答"的集成步骤；最后在300个新问题上进行预注册复现。
AI.result: 七个智能体97-100%将失效源结果判为无用，但多数极少据此停止；提示线索只改变"何时停"而非"依据什么停"；允许凭记忆作答与推理模式会导致不顾证据的提前停止；声明预算使7-8B模型的停止移至截止点；提示中的停止规则或调用成本最多被部分遵循；仅在强制集成步骤下停止才随证据变化。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的判断与行动存在系统性分离，证据驱动的停止需要外部机制强制；集成步骤对每个模型都提升了失效源场景的成功率，在预算翻倍时保持停止点不变，且当智能体已声明判断时无需额外判断调用；预注册复现确认了该分离与规则效果。

title: BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series
summary: Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BeliefGraph-JEPA，一种结构化潜在世界模型，将未来驱动因素的影响分解为类型化潜在效应状态，经滚动预测与图路由传递至各目标节点，并接入联合嵌入预测架构，在四类多目标系统中优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 动作条件时间序列预测需刻画未来动作与外生强迫如何通过部分可观测、延迟和持续性各异的效应影响多个目标。直接条件化使效应的演化与目标特异影响隐含于预测器中，静态关系图又无法追踪演化中的效应，因此需要一个显式表示未来驱动影响的结构化潜在机制。
AI.method: BeliefGraph-JEPA 将驱动因素影响分解为类型化潜在效应状态，这些状态在未来驱动下向前滚动（future rollout），并通过图路由到目标特异节点，构成联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的预测基；同时以容量受控的残差补充直接驱动信息。
AI.result: 在临床、农业、环境与工业四个多目标系统上，框架优于多种预训练与有监督的已知未来协变量基线。匹配控制实验分别分离了潜在动态、未来滚动、图路由与残差容量的作用，其中未来滚动与图优先的残差路由在四个系统中均提升预测表现。
AI.conclusion: 以结构化潜在效应状态显式建模未来驱动影响的演化与路由，可有效提升动作条件多目标时间序列预测，且未来滚动与图路由是其中的关键增益来源。

title: SPIN: Image Immunization Against Diffusion Editing via Single-Step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods
summary: Diffusion models have greatly advanced instruction-guided image editing, while also raising concerns about unauthorized image manipulation. Image immunization addresses this risk by adding imperceptible perturbations to an input image to disrupt subsequent edits. Since editing requests are unknown at image release, protection should remain effective beyond the instruction used to construct the perturbation. Existing immunization methods either require costly full-trajectory backpropagation or use intermediate objectives whose effects may be weakened by subsequent denoising. Meanwhile, a single inference path provides limited feedback about alternative denoising continuations. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{SPIN}, a framework for image immunization via one-step projection over local stochastic trajectory neighborhoods. Starting from an early denoising state, \textsc{SPIN} generates stochastic neighboring states under the same instruction and predicts their clean latents through one-step projection without full unrolling. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average deviation of these predictions from a clean-edit reference, encouraging the perturbation to disrupt multiple possible editing outcomes. Experiments on two image editors demonstrate substantial gains in protection performance, with \textsc{SPIN} outperforming compared methods across all six metrics under seen instructions and in the more challenging unseen instruction setting.

AI.tldr: 提出SPIN框架，通过在局部随机轨迹邻域上进行一步投影来实现图像免疫，无需完整轨迹反传，在两种图像编辑器上全面超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型推动了指令引导的图像编辑，但也带来未经授权图像篡改的风险。图像免疫通过向输入图像添加不可感知扰动来破坏后续编辑。由于图像发布时编辑指令未知，保护需在构建扰动的指令之外依然有效。现有免疫方法要么需要昂贵的全轨迹反向传播，要么使用中间目标，其效果可能被后续去噪削弱；同时单一推理路径对替代去噪延续提供的反馈有限。
AI.method: SPIN从早期去噪状态出发，在同一指令下生成随机邻近状态，并通过一步投影预测其干净潜变量，无需完整展开。随后优化有界输入扰动，以最大化这些预测与干净编辑参考之间的平均偏差，从而破坏多种可能的编辑结果。
AI.result: 在两种图像编辑器上的实验表明，SPIN在保护性能上取得显著提升，在已见指令下的全部六项指标以及更具挑战性的未见指令设定中均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: SPIN通过局部随机轨迹邻域的一步投影，实现了高效且泛化性强的图像免疫，验证了在未知编辑指令下仍保持有效保护的可行性。

title: Copies or Sources? Measuring How LLM Aggregators Count Restated Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) restate observations as a matter of course: relays forward them, shared boards repeat them and discussion rounds echo them. An aggregator that pools such messages should count sources, not statements. We convert a reported probability into units of independent readings, which assigns every restatement a copy weight, 0 for an aggregator that counts sources and 1 for one that counts every statement, and yields the implied decision under any cost structure. Three testbeds hold the evidence fixed and vary how it is restated: message logs with an exact Bayesian oracle, web documents with appended copies, and logs written by LLM agent teams under four communication protocols. Across four models from three providers, a forwarded copy counts for 0.06 to 0.42 of a new reading, mostly because some replies count every statement. On 5% to 40% of logs that state one reading three times, the reported belief implies an early commitment that the oracle never makes. The models that count copies least and most on controlled logs do so on web copies and agent-written logs as well. A one-paragraph declaration of what a copy contributes brings the copy weight on controlled logs to 0.08 or less. A rule that has agents refer to readings instead of restating them cuts belief-implied early commitment from 11.2% to 1.1% and preserves genuine corroboration.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出，基于LLM的多智能体系统中，转发、共享板与讨论轮次会重复陈述同一观测；聚合器应按独立信源而非陈述条数计数。作者将报告概率折算为独立读数单位，为每次重述赋予"复制权重"（按信源计数为0，按陈述计数为1），并在三类测试平台（带贝叶斯oracle的消息日志、附有副本的网页文档、四种通信协议下的LLM团队日志）上验证。四个模型（三家提供商）中，一次转发副本仅相当于0.06–0.42次新读数；在5%–40%的"同一读数被陈述三次"的日志中，报告信念隐含了oracle从未做出的过早承诺。一段关于"副本贡献多少"的声明可将受控日志的复制权重降至≤0.08；要求智能体"引用"而非"重述"读数，可将信念隐含的过早承诺从11.2%降至1.1%，同时保留真实印证。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统天然会重述观测：中继转发、共享板重复、讨论轮复述同一信息。若聚合器把这些重复消息当作独立证据累加，会导致过度自信与过早决策。因此需要一种度量方法，量化"重复陈述"相对于"独立读数"的真实证据价值，并识别其引发的错误承诺。
AI.method: 将报告概率转换为"独立读数单位"，为每次重述分配复制权重：按信源计数的聚合器权重为0，按每条陈述计数的聚合器权重为1，并可推出任意代价结构下的隐含决策。设置三类测试平台，固定证据内容、仅改变重述方式：(1) 带精确贝叶斯oracle的消息日志；(2) 追加了副本的网页文档；(3) 四种通信协议下LLM智能体团队撰写的日志。测试跨三家提供商的四个模型。另设置两种干预：一是加入一段关于副本贡献的声明；二是要求智能体引用而非重述读数。
AI.result: 跨四个模型，一次转发副本仅相当于0.06–0.42次新读数，主因是一些回复把每条陈述都计数。在5%–40%的"同一读数被陈述三次"的日志上，报告信念隐含了oracle不会做出的过早承诺。受控日志中计数副本最少与最多的模型，在网页副本与智能体撰写日志上表现一致。一段关于副本贡献的声明使受控日志的复制权重降至0.08或更低。要求智能体引用而非重述读数，使信念隐含的过早承诺从11.2%降至1.1%，并保留真实印证。
AI.conclusion: LLM多智能体系统的聚合应按独立信源计数，而非按陈述条数计数；重复转发的证据价值远低于新读数，并会诱发过早承诺。通过简短声明或"引用而非重述"的规则，可有效降低复制权重与过早承诺，同时不损失真实印证，为多智能体信念聚合设计提供了可操作的规范。

title: Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping for Off-Policy Subgoal Value Learning
summary: Off-policy hierarchical reinforcement learning must estimate the values of high-level decisions while the low-level policy changes. HIRO adapts replay data through subgoal relabeling, but after a label change, the value update targets the relabeled subgoal instead of the subgoal the high-level policy originally needed to update. We propose Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping (HTB), which evaluates specified subgoals under the current low-level policy while retaining accumulated task rewards. Remaining execution time distinguishes subgoal continuation from a new high-level decision. Together with primitive-action conditioning, it enables off-policy Bellman updates based on the stationary environment transition law. HTB combines these one-step updates with multi-step suffix returns and truncated relabeling, reducing dependence on intermediate value estimates. A shared value component supports learning across actions, while nonnegative residuals constrain upward corrections relative to that component. At a fixed mixture weight of 0.95, HTB achieves 32.8% AntFall success versus 9.6% for matched local HIRO over five paired seeds at 10M environment steps. Ablations identify contributions from recursive continuation and mixed supervision; fixed-policy tests show more accurate predictions for actions whose returns were excluded from fitting.

AI.tldr: HTB（Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping）通过时间感知的资格评估与混合监督，解决HIRO子目标重标记后的值更新错位问题，在AntFall上以32.8%对9.6%显著超越匹配的局部HIRO。
AI.motivation: 离策略分层强化学习需在低层策略不断变化时评估高层决策的价值，而HIRO对回放数据进行子目标重标记后，值更新的目标变成了重标记后的子目标，而非高层策略原本需要更新的子目标，导致更新目标错位、价值估计不准确。
AI.method: 提出HTB：在当前低层策略下评估指定子目标，同时保留累积任务奖励；用剩余执行时间区分"子目标延续"与"新的高层决策"；结合原始动作条件，实现基于平稳环境转移律的离策略Bellman更新；将单步更新与多步后缀回报、截断式重标记结合以降低对中间价值估计的依赖；使用共享价值分量支持跨动作学习，并以非负残差约束相对该分量的向上修正。
AI.result: 在混合权重固定为0.95时，10M环境步数、五对配对种子上，HTB在AntFall任务成功率达32.8%，匹配的局部HIRO为9.6%；消融实验表明递归延续与混合监督均有贡献；固定策略测试显示，对未参与拟合的动作，HTB的回报预测更准确。
AI.conclusion: HTB通过时间感知的资格评估与多步/截断混合监督，修正了子目标重标记带来的更新目标错位，在不依赖中间价值估计的情况下实现更准确的离策略分层值学习，显著提升样本效率与最终性能。

title: BabelFake: A Multilingual Audio-Visual DeepFake Benchmark
comment: 25 pages (8 main paper + ack), 25 pages total, 8 figures, under submission
summary: Reliable and practical audio-visual DeepFake detection requires benchmarks that reflect diverse linguistic contexts and modern data synthesis pipelines for visual as well as audio manipulations. However, existing datasets predominantly contain footage of English-speakers, often include outdated manipulation types, or overlook the audio modality. Further, many datasets feature individuals who did not consent to be used in DeepFake creation. We introduce BabelFake, a multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark recorded with consenting participants. BabelFake contains 399k clips (1,323 hours) from 496 individuals spanning five languages (English, German, Italian, French, Spanish). Our modular data generation pipeline pairs 11 modern video manipulation methods with 4 voice cloning engines, distinguishing visual-only (face swapping) and joint audio-visual manipulations (lip synchronization and portrait animation). By benchmarking state-of-the-art detectors, we show that detection difficulty depends on the audio-visual generation pairing, with substantial performance degradation when authentic audio is preserved. Cross-language/demographic evaluation reveals sensitivity varying across detector architectures and training data, while human evaluation reveals that perceived realism and machine-detection difficulty do not necessarily align.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BabelFake，一个多语言、经被摄者同意的音视频 DeepFake 基准数据集，包含 5 种语言、496 人、399k 片段（1,323 小时），并基于 11 种视频篡改方法与 4 种语音克隆引擎构建模块化生成流程。基准测试表明检测难度取决于音视频生成配对方式，跨语言/人口统计评估揭示检测器敏感度差异，且人类感知真实性与机器检测难度并不一致。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频 DeepFake 数据集存在三大局限：以英语母语者为主、缺乏语言多样性；篡改类型过时或忽略音频模态；且许多数据集使用了未同意被用于 DeepFake 制作的个体素材。因此，构建一个反映多样语言环境、涵盖现代数据合成流程且经同意的基准，对于可靠、实用的音视频 DeepFake 检测至关重要。
AI.method: 作者构建了模块化数据生成流程，将 11 种现代视频篡改方法与 4 种语音克隆引擎配对，区分仅视觉篡改（换脸）与音视频联合篡改（唇形同步、人像动画）。据此生成 BabelFake 数据集，包含来自 496 名同意参与者的 399k 片段（1,323 小时），覆盖英语、德语、意大利语、法语、西班牙语五种语言。随后对当前最先进的检测器进行基准测试，并进行跨语言/人口统计评估与人类评估。
AI.result: 基准测试结果显示：检测难度取决于音视频生成配对的组合方式，当保留真实音频时检测器性能显著下降；跨语言与人口统计评估表明不同检测器架构与训练数据下的敏感度存在差异；人类评估则揭示感知真实性与机器检测难度并不必然一致。
AI.conclusion: BabelFake 提供了一个多语言、经同意、涵盖现代音视频合成管线的 DeepFake 基准，弥补了现有数据集在语言多样性、篡改时效性与音频模态上的不足，并为检测器的鲁棒性、跨语言泛化及人机感知差异研究提供了重要测试平台。

title: Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Accepted (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents), Paris
summary: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.

AI.tldr: 用GRPO在不同规模Gemma模型上训练多议题双边议价卖方智能体，发现规模越大RL增益越大，且提高学习率在多数规模上更优；提示先用学习率调参再下"小模型不会议价"的结论。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正逐步承担完整客户体验，未来可能代表企业或客户进行买卖；小模型规模化更省成本，但尚不清楚强化学习能否把小模型训练成胜任的卖方。既有对比可能低估小模型潜力（学习率未调优、评测买方单一）。
AI.method: 在程序化效用奖励上用GRPO训练4个Gemma检查点（约2.3B–31B有效参数），覆盖多议题双边议价；统一在1,152场谈判上评测，对手为训练中未见过的两个前沿买方模型。所有规模使用相同学习率1e-6；另做提高学习率（3倍、10倍）与训练步数变化的探索性对照，并与两个前沿卖方模型直接对局比较。
AI.result: 同一学习率下，RL相对基座的增益随规模上升：2.3B为+0.001，31B为+0.078。学习率提高3倍（步数相同或更少）在各规模均超过共同学习率：+0.032（2.3B）至+0.081（4.5B）。以卖方身份与两个前沿模型探索性比较：12B（3倍率）得分高于两者，但其未训练基座已与二者相当；4.5B（3倍率）与两者无显著差异，且可单张48GB GPU运行。2.3B（10倍率）提升合并得分，但增益集中于与训练池同族的评测买方。作者强调每个规模仅训练一次、最小两个检查点架构不同，故未拟合缩放律。
AI.conclusion: 学习率调优可能是小模型议价能力的主要瓶颈：未调参易得出"小模型学不会谈判"的错误结论。评测应使用来自多个模型家族的买方，以避免同族偏好造成增益虚高；小模型在调优后可具备成本效率优势（如4.5B单卡可训可跑）。

title: Groupwise Distortion Guarantees for Preference-Based Alignment
summary: Preference-based alignment methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) aggregate pairwise preferences to learn an LLM policy, but a natural goal is maximizing social welfare (average cardinal utility), which comparisons alone need not identify. Gölz, Haghtalab, and Yang (GHY) measure the gap by distortion: the worst-case ratio between the welfare of the best fixed lottery (distribution over responses) and of the learned lottery. They show NLHF is optimal when every user receives the same lottery. Account-based LLMs, however, have information about their users and can serve different lotteries to different people. We give an efficient algorithm, GLHF, that learns a single group-conditioned policy from one comparison per user. Under individual Bradley--Terry comparisons, GLHF asymptotically matches GHY's optimal population distortion bound simultaneously on every group in a prespecified, possibly overlapping collection, with sample complexity growing logarithmically in the number of groups and inversely with the smallest group mass. A sharper guarantee for groups with similar preferences approaches distortion of one when members share a feasible favorite response. In experiments using human coffee ratings and synthetic LLM-generated ratings, GLHF lowers distortion in every evaluated group and substantially reduces worst-group distortion relative to NLHF and other group-agnostic baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GLHF 算法，从每个用户一次成对比较中学习单一的分群条件策略，在个体 Bradley–Terry 比较下可同时在预设（可重叠）的每个群体上渐近达到 GHY 最优总体失配界，样本复杂度对群体数对数增长；相似偏好群体可获得更锐利的界（失配趋近 1）；实验表明其降低各族失配并显著改善最差群失配。
AI.motivation: 基于偏好的对齐方法（RLHF、NLHF）通过聚合成对偏好学习 LLM 策略，但自然目标是最大化社会福利（平均基数效用），而仅有比较信息并不必然能够识别效用。GHY 用失配（distortion）刻画该差距，并证明 NLHF 在每个用户获得相同彩票时为最优。然而，账户式 LLM 掌握用户信息，可为不同人群提供不同彩票，因此需要研究"分群条件化"策略能否在保持可比理论保证的同时提升福利。本文即针对这一空白展开。
AI.method: 作者提出高效算法 GLHF，从每个用户仅需一次的比较数据中学习一个统一的分群条件策略（group-conditioned policy）。理论分析基于个体 Bradley–Terry 比较模型，在预设的、可重叠的群体集合上，使 GLHF 同时在每个群体上渐近匹配 GHY 的最优总体失配界；样本复杂度随群体数量对数增长，并与最小群体质量成反比。对于偏好相近的群体，给出更锐利的保证：当成员共享一个可行最优响应时，失配趋近于 1。实验使用真实人类咖啡评分数据与合成 LLM 生成评分进行验证。
AI.result: 理论结果：GLHF 在每个预设群体上渐近达到 GHY 的最优总体失配界，样本复杂度对群体数呈对数依赖、对最小群体质量呈反比依赖；对偏好相似群体，失配可趋近 1（即福利最优）。实验结果：在人类咖啡评分与合成 LLM 评分上，GLHF 在每个评估群体中均降低失配，并相比 NLHF 及其他忽略群体的基线显著降低最差群失配（worst-group distortion）。
AI.conclusion: GLHF 表明，利用用户账户信息进行分群条件化的偏好对齐，可在仅需每人一次比较的低样本成本下，同时为多个（可重叠）群体提供与总体最优相当的福利保证，并在相似偏好群体上进一步提升至接近最优。这为超越群体无关对齐、实现更公平且福利更优的 LLM 策略学习提供了理论与实证支持。

title: MeSD: Multi-Evidence Self-Distillation for VideoLLM
summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides reliable outcome supervision for VideoLLMs, sequence-level rewards offer limited token-level guidance. On-policy self-distillation addresses this limitation by conditioning a self-teacher on privileged information to provide dense token-level supervision. However, aggregating heterogeneous evidence within a single teacher context obscures cross-evidence agreement and conflict. A further challenge lies in determining whether teacher guidance should refine reward-based updates or provide corrective supervision for failed trajectories. To address these issues, we propose MeSD, a multi-evidence self-distillation framework for VideoLLMs. MeSD constructs three evidence-conditioned teachers with shared parameters, using the ground-truth answer as a common semantic context while separately incorporating temporal and spatial evidence. Given the same student-generated prefixes, MeSD evaluates evidence-specific preferences relative to the Answer Teacher and fuses teacher-common preferences with gated teacher-specific residuals. Furthermore, MeSD introduces Verification-Guided Optimization to classify trajectories as Success, Failure, or Indeterminate. For Success and Indeterminate trajectories, MeSD refines token-level advantage magnitudes while preserving reward-derived signs. For verified failure trajectories that contain the required evidence, MeSD applies failure-conditioned distillation, using reverse-KL correction toward the fused distribution. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MeSD，一种面向VideoLLM的多证据自蒸馏框架，通过构建三个证据条件教师并引入验证引导优化，实现更精细的token级监督。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习仅提供序列级奖励，缺乏token级指导；现有在线自蒸馏虽用特权信息提供稠密监督，但在单一教师上下文中聚合异质证据会掩盖证据间的一致性与冲突，且难以判断教师指导应"精修奖励更新"还是"为失败轨迹提供纠正性监督"。
AI.method: MeSD构建三个共享参数、以真实答案为共同语义上下文并分别融入时序与空间证据的证据条件教师。对学生生成前缀，计算各证据相对"答案教师"的偏好，融合教师共性偏好与门控的教师特异性残差。同时提出验证引导优化，将轨迹分为成功、失败、不确定三类：对成功与不确定轨迹，保持奖励符号不变并精修token级优势幅度；对包含所需证据的已验证失败轨迹，采用反向KL向融合分布进行失败条件蒸馏纠正。
AI.result: 在多个视频基准上的实验表明，MeSD相较强化学习与自蒸馏基线均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 多证据条件教师结合验证引导的轨迹分类与差异化蒸馏策略，可为VideoLLM提供更精准的token级监督，优于现有RL与自蒸馏方法。

title: AI-Decision Checkpoints for AI-Augmented Business Process Management: Framework and Educational Instantiation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents are increasingly embedded in operational business processes. Yet Business Process Management (BPM) curricula and frameworks still largely treat artificial intelligence (AI) as an add-on technology, leaving graduates (as potential future process developers) unprepared to reason about AI as a first-class design element of end-to-end processes. This paper addresses that gap by proposing \emph{AI-decision checkpoints}: explicit moments in a process development trajectory where process developers identify AI-candidate sub-processes, assess expected effects on time, cost, quality, and flexibility, consider legal and organisational constraints, and document a reasoned decision to adopt, constrain, or reject specific AI components. The checkpoints are instantiated through a fictitious customer onboarding process as a \textit{BPM Teaching Case}, embedded in a lifecycle-driven framework spanning six modules that combine process modeling, simulation, workflow execution with AI agents, and process mining, with each module's output serving as the next module's input. A preliminary formative reflection draws on instructor observations, submitted artifacts, and discovered process maps from learning-management-system logs.
