We argue that multimodal safety evaluation should therefore report a \emph{controllability profile} alongside behavioral classification, separating representation-level detectability, cross-modal specificity, intervention sensitivity, and benign-preserving selectivity. Using implicit toxicity as a stress case, we instantiate this profile on LlavaGuard and Qwen3.5 with sparse feature decompositions. LlavaGuard admits localized handles with a narrow benign-preserving intervention range and modest downstream safety gains, whereas Qwen3.5 supports strong representation-level readout but no comparable selective-control regime under the tested operators. These results show that internal readout and controllability can diverge. Future multimodal safety benchmarks should therefore report not only behavioral safety metrics, but also whether safety-relevant internal signals can be intervention-tested and controlled within a validated operating range.

AI.tldr: 论文主张多模态安全评估除行为分类外，还应报告"可控性画像"，涵盖表征层可检测性、跨模态特异性、干预敏感性与保良性选择性；以隐性毒性为压力测试，在 LlavaGuard 与 Qwen3.5 上实证了内部可读性与可控性可以分离。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 安全评估多停留在输入级与输出级的分类判断。这类分类虽必要，但无法揭示安全状态在模型内部是否"可达"或"可控"。作者认为，仅有行为层面的安全指标，会掩盖安全相关内部信号能否被干预测试并控制在有效操作区间内的关键问题，因此需要引入表征层面的可控性评估维度。
AI.method: 提出"可控性画像"评估框架，将行为分类与四个表征层面维度分离报告：表征层可检测性、跨模态特异性、干预敏感性、保良性选择性。选取隐性毒性作为压力场景，在 LlavaGuard 与 Qwen3.5 上使用稀疏特征分解实例化该画像，通过定位特征"手柄"并施加干预，检验可读性与选择性控制区间。
AI.result: LlavaGuard 存在局部化操纵手柄，但保良性干预区间狭窄，下游安全增益有限；Qwen3.5 具备较强的表征层读出能力，但在所测试算子下缺乏可比的选择性控制机制。结果表明，内部读出与可控性并不同步，两者可以发生分离。
AI.conclusion: 内部可读性不蕴含可控性。未来多模态安全基准除行为安全指标外，还应报告安全相关内部信号是否可被干预测试并在经验证的操作区间内受到控制，即把可控性画像纳入标准评估报告。

title: Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning
summary: Real-world deployment of active learning typically forces practitioners to choose an acquisition strategy before any data is labeled. This is a daunting task: strategy performance varies widely across settings (e.g. datasets, surrogate models) and cannot be assessed without deployment. Existing strategy selection methods explore one strategy from a portfolio at each round and identify the optimal one using bandit feedback or model retraining. Many acquisition rounds are therefore spent exploring strategies rather than collecting the most informative data. Such overhead is a major barrier to AL-driven design of high-throughput experiments, such as genetic perturbation screens and directed evolution, where AL runs consist of only a few rounds with large batch sizes. This regime permits a natural alternative: acquiring data using multiple AL strategies within a single batch. We refer to this as soft strategy selection and introduce FractAL, a method specifically designed for this task. FractAL infers a per-strategy reward using influence-function-based data attribution, which requires no additional retraining, and then computes budget shares for each strategy in the portfolio using online mirror descent. We benchmark FractAL across 7 setups spanning classification, regression, and genetic perturbation effect prediction. The results highlight that strategy selection is a hard problem: every existing method performs worse than random sampling on at least one setup. FractAL, however, matches or outperforms every baseline, including random sampling, on all 7 setups. Its allocations concentrate budget on the strongest strategies in the portfolio while pruning the weakest. FractAL is therefore a reliable choice for real-world deployments, where the optimal strategy is unknown in advance, an important step towards making AL practical for high-throughput experiments and modern scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: FractAL提出"软策略选择"范式：在单个批次内用多种主动学习策略共同采集数据，通过影响函数数据归因推断各策略收益，并用在线镜像下降分配预算份额。在7个涵盖分类、回归与遗传扰动效应预测的任务上，FractAL全部匹配或超越所有基线（含随机采样），并将预算集中于最强策略、剪除最弱策略。
AI.motivation: 实际部署主动学习（AL）时，实践者必须在任何数据被标注之前就选定一种采集策略，而策略表现随数据集、代理模型等设置差异巨大且无法在部署前评估。现有策略选择方法每轮只探索组合中的一个策略，依赖bandit反馈或模型重训练，导致大量轮次被用于探索而非采集最有信息量的数据。这一开销在高通量实验（如基因扰动筛选、定向进化）的AL场景中尤为致命，因为此类任务轮数少、批次大。
AI.method: 论文提出"软策略选择"（soft strategy selection）：不再每轮只选一个策略，而是在单个批次内同时使用多个AL策略采集数据。据此提出FractAL方法：1）利用基于影响函数（influence function）的数据归因推断每个策略的收益（reward），无需额外重训练；2）通过在线镜像下降（online mirror descent）计算组合中各策略的预算份额（budget share），从而在批次内按比例分配采样预算。
AI.result: 在涵盖分类、回归和遗传扰动效应预测的7个实验设置上进行基准测试。结果表明策略选择本身是困难问题：每一种现有方法都至少在某个设置上不如随机采样。而FractAL在全部7个设置上均匹配或超越所有基线（包括随机采样）；其预算分配会向组合中最强的策略集中，同时剪除最弱的策略。
AI.conclusion: FractAL在无法预知最优策略的真实部署场景中是可靠选择，是推动主动学习走向高通量实验与现代科学发现实用化的重要一步。

title: FrontVeg V2: A Training-Free Software Framework for Foreground-Aware Zero-Shot Plant Trait Segmentation in High-Resolution Images of Trellised Crops
summary: FrontVeg V2 is an open-source, training-free software framework for foregroundaware zero-shot segmentation of plant traits in high-resolution images of trellised crops. The pipeline combines monocular depth estimation, automatic foreground extraction using Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding, tiled zero-shot segmentation, Graph-Based Mask Assembly, and geometry-aware fusion. This design enables plant organs and disease symptoms to be segmented while reducing detections arising from neighboring vegetation rows. The current implementation integrates Depth Anything V2 (DAV2) and SAM3 and can be used through both command-line batch processing and a Napari graphical interface. FrontVeg V2 provides a reusable framework for multi-crop, multi-trait digital phenotyping without task-specific model retraining.

AI.tldr: FrontVeg V2 是一个开源、免训练的前景感知零样本分割框架，用于高分辨率棚架作物图像中的植物性状分割。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率棚架作物图像中，邻近植株行会产生大量干扰检测，影响植物器官与病害症状的准确分割；同时任务专用模型需要重复训练。该工作旨在提供一种无需重训练的通用方案。
AI.method: 流水线由五部分组成：单目深度估计、基于谷感知深度阈值（Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding）的自动前景提取、分块零样本分割、基于图的掩码组装（Graph-Based Mask Assembly）以及几何感知融合。当前实现集成 Depth Anything V2（DAV2）与 SAM3，支持命令行批量处理与 Napari 图形界面。
AI.result: 该方法能够分割植物器官与病害症状，同时减少来自邻近植被行的误检测。
AI.conclusion: FrontVeg V2 为多作物、多性状数字表型分析提供了可复用的框架，无需针对特定任务重新训练模型。

title: Normality Constraint Learning: Adapting Foundation Models for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) achieve strong generalization by learning to reconstruct or forecast broad temporal patterns from large-scale time series during pre-training. Yet this strength can become a weakness for anomaly detection: TSFMs may model rare anomalous patterns as effectively as normal ones, allowing anomalies to be accurately reconstructed or forecasted and thus diminishing their reconstruction/forecasting error-based anomaly scores. This paper proposes $\underline{\textbf{N}}$$\textbf{ormality}$ $\underline{\textbf{C}}$$\textbf{onstraint}$ $\underline{\textbf{L}}$$\textbf{earning}$ ($\textbf{NCL}$), a lightweight plug-and-play framework that adapts pre-trained TSFMs for accurate anomaly detection without modifying their pre-trained parameters. Our key insight is to constrain the broad pattern space of TSFMs to the normal structure of a target time series, preventing their broad modeling capability from obscuring abnormal deviations. Specifically, NCL constructs a compact normality subspace from a few normal patch features and adaptively steers each patch feature toward normality within this subspace, guided by contrastive constraints that form compact and discriminative normality manifolds. The calibrated features are aggregated to reinforce normal components and fused with the original TSFM output, amplifying the discrepancy between normal and abnormal observations for the reconstruction/forecasting error-based anomaly scoring. Extensive experiments across diverse TSFM families and benchmarks show that NCL consistently improves anomaly detection performance, providing a generalizable framework for adapting TSFMs to anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NCL（Normality Constraint Learning），一个轻量、即插即用的框架，通过将预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的宽泛模式空间约束到目标序列的正常结构上，在不修改预训练参数的前提下提升异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: TSFM 通过大规模预训练学习重建或预测广泛的时序模式，从而具备强泛化能力。但这种能力在异常检测中反而成为弱点：模型可能将稀有异常模式与正常模式同等建模，使异常也能被准确重建或预测，从而削弱了基于重建/预测误差的异常分数。因此需要一种方法将 TSFM 的建模能力约束到正常结构，凸显异常偏差。
AI.method: NCL 不修改 TSFM 预训练参数，属轻量即插即用框架。具体地：从少量正常 patch 特征构建紧凑的"正常子空间"；在对比约束引导下，将每个 patch 特征自适应地向该子空间中的正常性靠拢，形成紧凑且具判别性的正常流形；随后对校准后的特征进行聚合以强化正常成分，并与原始 TSFM 输出融合，从而放大正常与异常观测之间的差异，增强基于重建/预测误差的异常打分。
AI.result: 在多种 TSFM 家族与多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，NCL 能持续提升异常检测性能，验证了其作为通用框架在将 TSFM 适配到异常检测任务上的有效性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: NCL 通过正常性约束校准 TSFM 特征，缓解其过度建模导致异常被准确重构的问题，为将预训练时间序列基础模型适配到异常检测提供了一个可推广的即插即用解决方案。

title: Joint Estimation of Common-Slope Decay Rates and Spatial Amplitudes Using Parameterized Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
summary: We formulate joint estimation of common-slope decay rates and amplitudes from room impulse responses (RIRs) as parameterized nonnegative matrix factorization with the Itakura--Saito divergence as the loss function (IS-NMF). Estimation at each short-time Fourier transform frequency bin produces detailed reverberation time (RT) curves directly from RIR powers with no backward integration needed. Standard space-alternating generalized expectation-maximization (SAGE) algorithm yields closed-form amplitude updates and a convex subproblem for each decay rate update. To accelerate estimation, we introduce contribution-weighted SAGE, which emphasizes observations where each component contributes strongly to the modeled power. Experiments with synthetic data show accurate recovery of well-separated decays and faster loss reduction than standard SAGE. Application to measured coupled-room RIRs yields frequency-dependent RT curves and reveals complementary space-time contributions of the shared decay components.

AI.tldr: 本文将房间脉冲响应中公共斜率衰减率与幅度的联合估计建模为以Itakura--Saito散度为损失函数的参数化非负矩阵分解(IS-NMF)，用SAGE算法求解并提出贡献加权SAGE加速，在合成与实测耦合房间RIR上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统混响时间(RT)估计依赖Schroeder反向积分等方法，难以直接从RIR功率得到细分频率的RT曲线；同时耦合房间中多个共享衰减分量的联合估计存在困难。作者希望将衰减率与幅度估计统一为参数化分解问题，避免反向积分，并提升估计效率。
AI.method: 将公共斜率衰减率与幅度的联合估计表述为参数化非负矩阵分解，损失函数采用Itakura--Saito散度(IS-NMF)；在每个短时傅里叶变换频率bin上独立估计，直接由RIR功率得到RT曲线。采用标准的空间交替广义期望最大化(SAGE)算法，得到幅度更新的闭式解，且每个衰减率更新对应一个凸子问题。进一步提出贡献加权SAGE，强调各分量对建模功率贡献较大的观测，以加速估计。
AI.result: 合成数据实验表明，该方法能准确恢复分离良好的衰减，且损失下降速度优于标准SAGE。应用于实测耦合房间RIR时，得到随频率变化的RT曲线，并揭示了共享衰减分量在空间与时间上的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 基于IS-NMF与(贡献加权)SAGE的联合估计框架能够直接从RIR功率给出频率相关的RT曲线，无需反向积分，并有效刻画耦合房间中共享衰减分量的时空互补性。

title: Keepsake: Selective Spatial Memory for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation relies on persistent memory to maintain scene consistency. Existing systems follow two strategies to achieve this consistency. Full-history approaches retain all generated observations, causing unbounded storage and retrieval costs. Selective-construction approaches reduce redundancy, but make one-time retention decisions that are never revisited, even as an observation's value changes with the evolving memory bank. Both strategies leave a shared question unresolved: as the generated history evolves, which stored observations should still remain in memory? Our key insight is that the value of a stored observation is not fixed, but relational: it depends on the alternatives currently available in the memory bank. A view supported by many geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be relinquished with little loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should remain regardless of age. We introduce Keepsake, an online, training-free controller for fixed-capacity spatial memory. At each update, Keepsake constructs a pose-appearance graph over retained and newly generated observations, combining camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. A retention priority jointly captures the number of strong substitutes and the similarity of the closest alternative, allowing Keepsake to continually reassess memory value, preserve observations with little alternative support, and evict highly replaceable ones under a fixed budget. The controller modifies only the persistent-memory update; the host generator, denoising schedule, and retrieval rule remain unchanged. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS under a fixed memory budget. On 180-second MemCam trajectories, it retains only 32 of 5,397 frames while reducing FVD by 35.1%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Keepsake，一种在线、免训练的空间记忆控制器，将存储观测的价值视为依赖记忆库中替代项的关系量，通过姿态-外观图与保留优先级，在固定容量下持续重估并淘汰可替代观测，从而提升长时相机控制视频生成的一致性。
AI.motivation: 长时相机控制视频生成依赖持久记忆维持场景一致性。现有两类策略各有缺陷：全历史方法保留所有生成观测，导致存储与检索成本无界；选择性构建方法虽减少冗余，但保留决策一次性做出、从不重新评估，而观测价值会随记忆库演化而变化。二者共同未解决的问题是：随着生成历史演化，哪些已存观测仍应留在记忆中。
AI.method: 核心洞见是存储观测的价值并非固定，而是关系性的，取决于记忆库中当前可用的替代项：若有大量几何与视觉相似的替代视图，则该观测可被舍弃而覆盖损失很小；若替代项稀少，则无论新旧都应保留。Keepsake 在每次更新时，对保留观测与新生成观测构建姿态-外观图，结合相机姿态邻近性与视觉相似性。保留优先级同时编码强替代项数量与最近替代项的相似度，从而持续重估记忆价值，在固定预算下保护缺乏替代支持的观测、淘汰高度可替换的观测。该控制器仅修改持久记忆更新，不改变宿主生成器、去噪调度与检索规则。
AI.result: 在 MemCam 与 WorldMem 上，固定记忆预算下 Keepsake 改善了 FVD 与 LPIPS。在 180 秒 MemCam 轨迹上，仅保留 5,397 帧中的 32 帧，同时将 FVD 降低 35.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆保留视为随记忆库演化的关系性决策，可在固定容量约束下显著提升长时视频生成的一致性与存储效率；该方法免训练、在线运行，且与宿主生成器解耦，具备良好的通用性与即插即用特性。

title: AgentPrivArena: Evaluating and Auditing Real-world AI Agent Privacy
summary: The rapid advancement of LLM agents has enabled systems to autonomously perform complex tasks through external tools, but their growing access to personal data introduces significant privacy risks. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate LLM agent privacy through simulated trajectories and outcome-based metrics, limiting their ability to capture privacy risks arising during multi-step agent execution. In this work, we introduce AgentPrivArena, a framework for evaluating privacy risks in realistic LLM agent workflows. AgentPrivArena integrates authentic MCP tools and self-hosted services within a reproducible execution environment. We further propose trajectory-level privacy metrics that quantify unnecessary information access beyond final response leakage. Building on this framework, we introduce AgentPrivAudit, a runtime auditing approach for monitoring privacy violations during agent execution. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLM agents reveal substantial privacy risks overlooked by existing evaluation paradigms, highlighting the importance of trajectory-level auditing for trustworthy agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentPrivArena 框架与 AgentPrivAudit 运行时审计方法，用于在真实 MCP 工具环境下评估 LLM 智能体工作流的隐私风险，并引入轨迹级隐私指标。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体可自主调用外部工具完成复杂任务，但其对个人数据的访问日益增多，带来显著隐私风险。现有基准主要基于模拟轨迹与结果导向指标进行评估，难以捕捉多步执行过程中产生的隐私风险。
AI.method: 提出 AgentPrivArena：在可复现执行环境中集成真实 MCP 工具与自托管服务；提出轨迹级隐私指标，量化最终响应泄露之外的不必要信息访问；基于该框架提出 AgentPrivAudit 运行时审计方法，在执行过程中监测隐私违规。
AI.result: 在先进 LLM 智能体上的大量实验揭示了被现有评估范式忽视的大量隐私风险。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级审计对可信智能体部署至关重要。

title: When Low Prediction Error Misleads Planning: Diagnosing Representation, Dynamics, and Decision Failures in Latent World Models
summary: The component that dominates a latent world model's prediction error need not be the one whose repair most improves action selection. We show this by comparing action sequences from identical physical starts and separating endpoint error into a candidate-pool center and action-relative responses. Across four model families and four tasks, a confirmation pool of 256 new starts per task and 300 shared candidates per start shows that center error dominates MSE in 14/16 model-task cells. Yet in six of these cells, an oracle that corrects only the action-relative responses yields better physical rank correlation and top-30 elite quality than one that corrects only the center, while leaving more latent MSE (family-wise corrected intervals). The preference differs across the evaluated settings: a separate LeWorldModel (LeWM) study that executes oracle-selected actions favors center repair on PushT and on Reacher with a render-matched goal. Matched-candidate tests localize ordering loss: for LeWM, encoding realized endpoints raises physical Spearman from 0.464 to 0.975 on that Reacher setting and from 0.193 to 0.631 on PushT (64 starts per task), while Cube's encoded-goal cost remains uninformative. A 72-run objective study improves selected response diagnostics, while incremental closed-loop planning gains remain unconfirmed. These results separate error magnitude from the decision effects of oracle correction and motivate evaluating representation, prediction, and planning as separate stages.

AI.tldr: 论文区分了世界模型预测误差中"候选池中心误差"与"动作相对响应误差"，发现误差幅值最大的成分未必对动作选择最关键，纠正动作相对响应在部分任务上更能改善物理排序与精英候选质量，并主张将表示、预测与规划分阶段评估。
AI.motivation: 普遍假设是：主导潜在世界模型预测误差的成分，也是修复后最能改善动作选择的成分。论文旨在检验这一假设是否成立，即误差幅值与误差对决策的影响是否一致。
AI.method: 从相同物理初始状态出发比较动作序列，将端点误差分解为候选池中心误差与动作相对响应误差；在4个模型族、4个任务上构建确认池（每任务256个新起点、每起点300个共享候选）；使用仅修正动作相对响应的oracle与仅修正中心误差的oracle进行比较，考察物理秩相关、top-30精英质量及潜在MSE；另做LeWM执行oracle所选动作的研究、匹配候选实验及72次运行的目标函数研究。
AI.result: 中心误差在14/16个模型-任务单元中主导MSE；但其中6个单元里，仅修正动作相对响应的oracle在物理秩相关和top-30精英质量上优于仅修正中心误差的oracle，同时保留更多潜在MSE（经family-wise校正区间）。偏好随设定变化：LeWM执行研究在PushT和render-matched goal的Reacher上偏好中心修复。匹配候选测试定位排序损失：LeWM在该Reacher设定上编码真实端点使物理Spearman由0.464升至0.975，PushT由0.193升至0.631（每任务64起点）；Cube的编码目标代价仍无信息量。72次运行的目标函数研究改善了所选响应诊断，但闭环规划的增量收益尚未确认。
AI.conclusion: 误差幅值与oracle修正的决策效应可分离，主导预测误差的成分不一定是修复后最能提升动作选择的成分；应将表示、预测与规划作为独立阶段分别评估。

title: VGGT-Bridge: Beyond Sequential Pose Graphs via Coarse-Stride Skip Edges
summary: Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction. However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames. Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph. Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift. To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining. By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint. We further turn VGGT's first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures. VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.

AI.tldr: 提出VGGT-Bridge，通过长程跳连边约束非相邻分块，缓解链式漂移，在多个数据集上降低ATE。
AI.motivation: 前馈视觉几何Transformer（如VGGT）虽能单次前向完成稠密3D重建，但二次注意力复杂度使其难以扩展到上千帧长序列。分块对齐框架通过将长序列拆成重叠块并拼接位姿图来应对，但现有方法仅连接顺序相邻块，导致逐帧小误差沿链累积成大规模漂移。
AI.method: VGGT-Bridge在无需重训练的情况下引入长程跳连边，直接约束非相邻分块。具体做法是在稀疏采样的粗分块上运行VGGT，使每个粗分块将相距较远的细分块桥接为单一直接约束；同时将VGGT的首帧尺度偏置转化为漂移校正，通过反向输入选定粗分块实现，并采用环感知策略使该反转与现有回环闭合兼容。
AI.result: 相较SwiftVGGT基线，VGGT-Bridge在KITTI Odometry上ATE降低28.3%，在Virtual KITTI上降低18.8%，在Waymo Open上降低10.0%，在所有分块对齐方法中取得最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入长程跳连边并复用VGGT的首帧尺度偏置，VGGT-Bridge有效抑制了分块对齐框架中的链式漂移，在多个自动驾驶数据集上显著优于现有分块对齐方法。

title: GPlaceRL: An Open-Source Graph Reinforcement Learning Framework for Detailed Placement
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for placement optimization, particularly when combined with graph neural networks (GNNs) that capture circuit connectivity. However, most learning-based placement approaches focus on floorplanning, macro placement, or global placement, while detailed placement refinement remains relatively unexplored. In this paper, we present GPlaceRL, an open-source graph reinforcement learning framework for detailed placement refinement. GPlaceRL represents legalized placements as graphs and provides a modular environment for studying graph encoders, policy architectures, reward formulations, and local placement actions. To demonstrate the capabilities of GPlaceRL, we conduct a systematic evaluation of proximal policy optimization (PPO) policies with graph attention network (GAT) encoders in a per-design optimization setting. Across five placement benchmarks, the best greedy evaluation results achieve HPWL improvements ranging from $3.27\%$ to $32.87\%$. The results highlight the importance of compact GAT architectures and flexible local action spaces for placement optimization. Overall, GPlaceRL provides a reproducible and extensible framework for systematic research on RL-based detailed placement refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GPlaceRL——一个面向详细布局优化的开源图强化学习框架，将合法化布局表示为图，模块化支持图编码器、策略架构、奖励设计与局部布局动作的研究，并在5个基准上系统评测PPO+GAT，取得3.27%–32.87%的HPWL改进。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的布局方法多集中于floorplanning、宏单元布局或全局布局，详细布局细化（detailed placement refinement）仍相对缺乏探索；同时缺少可复现、可扩展的研究平台来系统比较图编码器、策略结构、奖励形式与局部动作设计。
AI.method: 提出GPlaceRL开源图强化学习框架：将合法化布局建模为图，提供模块化环境以研究图编码器、策略架构、奖励公式与局部布局动作；在per-design优化设定下，系统评估采用图注意力网络（GAT）编码器的近端策略优化（PPO）策略。
AI.result: 在5个布局基准上，最优贪心评估取得HPWL改进，范围为3.27%至32.87%；结果凸显紧凑型GAT架构与灵活局部动作空间对布局优化的重要性。
AI.conclusion: GPlaceRL为基于强化学习的详细布局细化研究提供了可复现、可扩展的框架，支持对图编码器、策略架构、奖励与动作的系统性研究。

title: An equality condition for the Dobrushin bound on attention rollout and how often it holds in trained transformers
summary:
The Dobrushin coefficient of each attention-rollout factor satisfies $κ(\frac12(I+A))\le\frac12(1+κ(A))$, and multiplying these inequalities over layers bounds the coefficient of the whole rollout. We characterise exactly when the layerwise bound is tight: equality holds if and only if some token pair attaining $κ(A)$ is mutually self-dominant - each of the two attends to itself at least as strongly as the other attends to it. The condition is far from automatic: uniformly random stochastic matrices satisfy it only 24-30% of the time.
  When tested on the head-averaged attention of each individual input and restricted to content tokens - image patches, words or tabular features, excluding cls, register and separator tokens - the condition holds for essentially every input at every layer of DINOv2 (three model sizes), RoBERTa and DistilBERT. In the supervised models DeiT-B and ViT-B/16 it holds for 91% and 64% of input-layer pairs respectively, with all failures occurring late in depth. In FT-Transformer trained on two standard tabular benchmarks it holds for only 11-44% of input-layer pairs. The special tokens account for almost all failures in DINOv2 and the language models: when they are included, the condition holds for only 82-97% of input-layer pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 attention-rollout 的 Dobrushin 系数逐层上界的紧性条件，给出等式成立的精确刻画，并在多种视觉、语言与表格模型上大规模检验该条件的成立比例。
AI.motivation: Attention rollout 用多层 attention 矩阵乘积刻画信息传播，其 Dobrushin 系数可通过逐层不等式 κ((I+A)/2) ≤ (1+κ(A))/2 逐层相乘来上界。但该逐层界何时紧、在真实模型中是否成立，此前缺乏刻画与实证，因此需要明确等式条件并检验其普遍性。
AI.method: 理论上刻画逐层界取等的充要条件：存在一对达到 κ(A) 的 token 对互为"自支配"（各自对自身的注意力不低于对方对它的注意力）。实证上对每个输入的 head-averaged attention 逐层计算该条件，并区分内容 token（图像 patch、词、表格特征）与特殊 token（cls、register、separator），在 DINOv2（三种规模）、RoBERTa、DistilBERT、DeiT-B、ViT-B/16、FT-Transformer 上统计成立比例，并以均匀随机随机矩阵作为对照基线。
AI.result: 均匀随机随机矩阵仅 24–30% 满足该条件。仅限内容 token 时，DINOv2（三种规模）、RoBERTa、DistilBERT 几乎每个输入每一层都满足；DeiT-B 与 ViT-B/16 分别为 91% 和 64%，失败全部出现在较深层。FT-Transformer 在两个表格基准上仅 11–44% 的输入-层对满足。特殊 token 是 DINOv2 与语言模型近乎全部失败来源：纳入后成立比例降至 82–97%。
AI.conclusion: 逐层界取等等价于存在互为自支配的极值 token 对，该条件并非自动成立。它在自监督视觉与语言模型的内容 token 上几乎普遍成立，在监督 ViT 中大致成立且失败集中于深层，而在表格 FT-Transformer 中明显不成立；特殊 token 是主要破坏因素。这表明 rollout 逐层界紧性高度依赖模型类型与 token 构成。

title: Analysis of SWIR Imaging Detection Performance Under Adverse Environmental Conditions for Autonomous Driving Systems
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Short-wave infrared (SWIR) imaging has emerged as a promising modality for autonomous driving, yet its practical benefits over RGB remain poorly characterized across diverse conditions. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of paired RGB and SWIR object detection on the RASMD dataset, covering four weather conditions and two real-time detection architectures, with various fine-tunings evaluated against a unified ground truth. Overall, RGB demonstrates comparable or superior performance in most scenarios, while RF-DETR exhibits greater robustness across varying conditions. Beyond aggregate metrics, we propose a sensor-dominance mining framework that combines multi-model agreement with targeted manual inspection to identify scenarios where one sensing modality provides more reliable detections using largely unannotated paired data. This analysis reveals that SWIR offers clear advantages in four safety-critical situations, including windshield glare, water droplets on the windshield, low-contrast object visibility, and long-range vehicle detection. The findings suggest that SWIR should be viewed as a complementary modality that enhances perception in rare but challenging conditions. The datasets will be available upon request, and all code and trained model weights are publicly released at https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了RASMD数据集上配对RGB与短波红外(SWIR)目标检测性能，并提出传感器优势挖掘框架，发现SWIR仅在眩光、挡风玻璃水滴、低对比度目标、远距离车辆四类安全关键场景中具有明确优势，应作为互补模态。
AI.motivation: SWIR成像被视为自动驾驶的潜在模态，但其相对RGB的实际收益在多样条件下仍缺乏充分的量化表征，需要系统性的对比研究来厘清二者适用边界。
AI.method: 在RASMD数据集上对配对的RGB与SWIR目标检测进行系统性对比，覆盖四种天气条件与两种实时检测架构，并采用多种微调策略，统一标注基准评测；此外提出"传感器优势挖掘"框架，结合多模型一致性与定向人工检查，在基本无标注的配对数据中定位某模态检测更可靠的场景。
AI.result: 总体上RGB在多数场景中表现相当或更优，RF-DETR在多种条件下鲁棒性更强；SWIR在四类安全关键情形中优势明显：挡风玻璃眩光、挡风玻璃水滴、低对比度目标可见性以及远距离车辆检测。
AI.conclusion: SWIR应被视为一种互补模态，用于在稀有但困难的条件下增强感知能力；数据集可按需获取，代码与训练权重已在指定仓库公开。

title: polyview: A Python package for multi-view machine learning
summary: Multi-view learning jointly exploits multiple complementary representations of the same data and has become increasingly important in machine learning. However, the Python ecosystem lacks actively maintained, unified tooling for end-to-end multi-view workflows. In this paper, we present polyview, a Python package that provides tools for multi-view embedding, clustering, fusion, and view augmentation, as well as for handling incomplete views, all compatible with scikit-learn. The library offers a unified interface for composing heterogeneous multi-view workflows, including seamless transitions between multi-view and single-view stages. It is built around a core set of classes and utilities that enable composition of different methods and straightforward implementation of new ones. We illustrate the package on five real multi-view datasets and compare its components based on canonical correlation analysis with those of two established libraries. polyview aims to be both a practical toolkit for benchmarking and prototyping multi-view methods and a foundation for future research and development in this area.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 polyview——一个基于 Python、兼容 scikit-learn 的多视图学习统一工具包，覆盖多视图嵌入、聚类、融合、视图增强及不完整视图处理，通过五个真实多视图数据集验证，并与两个成熟库的 CCA 组件进行比较。
AI.motivation: 多视图学习通过联合利用同一数据的多种互补表示，在机器学习中日益重要；但 Python 生态缺乏活跃维护、统一的端到端多视图工作流工具，制约了方法基准测试与原型开发。
AI.method: 提出 polyview 包，提供多视图嵌入、聚类、融合、视图增强及不完整视图处理工具，全部兼容 scikit-learn。该库以一组核心类与实用工具为核心，支持异构多视图工作流的组合编排，并实现多视图与单视图阶段之间的无缝切换，便于复用现有方法及实现新方法。
AI.result: 在五个真实多视图数据集上展示了该包的使用，并基于典型相关分析（CCA）将其组件与两个成熟库的对应组件进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: polyview 既是用于多视图方法基准测试与原型开发的实用工具包，也为该领域的后续研究与开发提供了基础平台。

title: Cut Binary Cross Entropy: Efficient Large-Vocabulary Loss and Gradient Kernels for Sequential Recommendation
summary:
Industrial sequential recommender systems operate over massive item catalogs (e.g., 10^5--10^7 items). Multi-label recommendation models are trained with Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss over the full vocabulary, but standard BCE materializes a dense [B, N, V] logits tensor in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), incurring prohibitive $O(BNV)$ memory and fatal Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors. While chunked loss optimizations exist for Softmax Cross-Entropy in LLMs, large-scale multi-label BCE optimization remains unexplored across deep learning ecosystems.
  We propose CutBCE, an exact, hardware-accelerated BCE loss and gradient operator implemented in JAX and Pallas for large-vocabulary workloads. CutBCE introduces (1) an exact fused reformulation evaluating dense background loss and sparse target corrections; (2) a custom Vector-Jacobian Product (VJP) with a dedicated Pallas TPU backward kernel computing logit tiles on-chip in both passes so logits and their gradients never reside in HBM; (3) dynamic VMEM budgeting and sharding-aware collective hoisting for distributed meshes; and (4) count-based zero-overhead training metrics. On single-chip TPU v5e/v6e mini-benchmarks, CutBCE eliminates OOM errors with up to 91.9% speedup. On 8-chip TPU slice training for multi-label SASRec with 876k items (Yambda-50M), CutBCE reduces peak HBM by 65.7% (>14 GiB saved per chip) and increases training speed by 225.9% with comparable accuracy. CutBCE is open-sourced at https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/RecML/blob/main/recml/core/ops/binary_cross_entropy_ops.py.

AI.tldr: CutBCE 是一种精确、硬件加速的 BCE 损失与梯度算子，在 JAX/Pallas 中实现，用于大词表多标签推荐，通过片上计算 logits 避免 HBM 物化，显著降低显存并提升训练速度。
AI.motivation: 工业级序列推荐系统的物品目录规模极大（10^5–10^7），多标签推荐使用全词表 BCE 损失训练。但标准 BCE 会在 HBM 中物化稠密的 [B, N, V] logits 张量，带来 O(BNV) 的显存开销并导致 OOM。大语言模型中已有针对 Softmax 交叉熵的分块损失优化，但大规模多标签 BCE 优化在深度学习生态中仍属空白。
AI.method: 提出 CutBCE，包含四个核心设计：(1) 精确的融合重公式，分别计算稠密背景损失与稀疏目标修正；(2) 自定义 VJP 及专用 Pallas TPU 反向 kernel，在前向与反向中均于片上计算 logit 瓦片，使 logits 及其梯度不落 HBM；(3) 动态 VMEM 预算与分片感知的集合通信提升（collective hoisting），适配分布式 mesh；(4) 基于计数、零开销的训练指标。
AI.result: 在单芯片 TPU v5e/v6e 微型基准上，CutBCE 消除 OOM 错误并带来最高 91.9% 的加速。在 8 芯片 TPU 切片上训练 876k 物品词表（Yambda-50M）的多标签 SASRec 时，CutBCE 将峰值 HBM 降低 65.7%（每芯片节省超 14 GiB），训练速度提升 225.9%，且精度相当。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: CutBCE 是面向大词表多标签推荐的首个精确 BCE 损失与梯度算子优化方案，通过片上 logit 计算和内存预算管理，在不损失精度的前提下解决 OOM 并大幅提升训练效率，具有良好的工程可复现性（已开源）。

title: Multitask Conditional Generative Adversarial Network Enables Automatic Whole Knee Cartilage and Menisci Segmentation and Reliable T1\r{ho} and T2 Quantification Without High-Resolution Morphological Images
summary: Early osteoarthritis detection through quantitative MRI (qMRI) requires accurate cartilage and meniscus segmentation, traditionally necessitating time-consuming, costly 3D high-resolution Double Echo Steady-State (DESS) MRI scans. This study developed a multi-task conditional generative adversarial network (MT-cGAN) to simultaneously synthesize DESS-like images and segment tissues directly from qMRI echo images. This retrospective study evaluated 508 knee MRI volumes from 361 subjects (mean age: $40.4 \pm 12.2$ years; 179 female) across three cohorts. Ground truth segmentation masks were generated from DESS images using a pretrained model with manual correction, and $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ maps were computed from magnetization-prepared angle-modulated partitioned $k$-space spoiled gradient echo snapshots (MAPSS) echo images. MT-cGAN was trained to jointly synthesize DESS-like images and segment cartilage and meniscus directly from echo images. Model performance was evaluated using Dice score for segmentation accuracy and coefficient of variation (CV) for $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification. MT-cGAN achieved the highest segmentation performance, mean Dice score 0.84 (range: 0.80--0.86) across all cartilage and meniscus compartments and significantly outperformed the state-of-the-art conditional GAN model with transfer learning (mean Dice, 0.82; $p < 0.001$, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). For relaxometry quantification, MT-cGAN demonstrated the highest consistency with the reference DESS protocol, yielding the lowest CV ($T_{1ρ}$: 1.84%, $T_2$: 1.81%). The proposed MT-cGAN accurately segmented cartilage and menisci while providing reliable $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification directly from echo images. By eliminating the need for separate morphological DESS scans, this workflow reduces required scan times to facilitate the clinical translation of qMRI.

AI.tldr: 提出MT-cGAN，从qMRI回波图像直接合成DESS样图像并分割软骨与半月板，免去额外DESS扫描，Dice达0.84，T1ρ/T2的CV最低（1.84%/1.81%）。
AI.motivation: 早期骨关节炎的定量MRI（qMRI）依赖准确的软骨与半月板分割，而传统上需要耗时、昂贵的3D高分辨率DESS扫描，限制了qMRI的临床推广。
AI.method: 回顾性纳入三个队列、361名受试者的508个膝关节MRI体数据。以DESS图像经预训练模型生成并人工校正的分割掩膜为金标准，由MAPSS回波图像计算T1ρ与T2图。构建多任务条件生成对抗网络（MT-cGAN），从回波图像同时合成DESS样图像并分割软骨和半月板。以Dice评价分割精度，以变异系数（CV）评价T1ρ、T2定量一致性。
AI.result: MT-cGAN分割性能最优，各软骨与半月板分区平均Dice为0.84（范围0.80–0.86），显著优于带迁移学习的最先进条件GAN（平均Dice 0.82，p<0.001，Wilcoxon符号秩检验）。在松弛定量方面与参考DESS方案一致性最高，CV最低（T1ρ 1.84%，T2 1.81%）。
AI.conclusion: MT-cGAN可从回波图像准确分割软骨与半月板并提供可靠的T1ρ、T2定量；通过免除单独的形态学DESS扫描缩短扫描时间，有助于推动qMRI的临床转化。

title: You Changed Your Mind, The Model Didn't: Demystifying Intent in Multi-Turn Dialogue
summary: When a large language model handles a multi-turn task and a user proposes a change but ultimately rejects it, the model should continue as if nothing changed. We find a surprising failure: merely mentioning a rejected change can derail task execution, even when the user's final intent remains unchanged. To systematically study language model behavior under evolving user intent, we introduce Intent-Eval, a controlled benchmark spanning tool actions, code, databases, and mathematics. Across diverse tasks, models are vulnerable to both rejected proposals and superseded requirements, consistent with mentioned-as-in-effect confusion: conversational content is treated as active requirements even after it has been rejected or replaced. Accuracy degradation can deepen or persist as interaction continues, highlighting the need to distinguish what has been mentioned from what remains in effect. Building on this insight, we propose Intent-OPSD, a decision-conditioned on-policy self-distillation framework with Teacher and Student initialized from the same model. The frozen Teacher provides active-intent supervision from the complete task matching the user's decision, training the Student on the full dialogue to follow active requirements reflecting user intent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Intent-Eval基准，揭示大模型在用户意图演化（拒绝的提案、被取代的需求）下出现"提及即生效"混淆的失败模式，并提出Intent-OPSD决策条件化的在策略自蒸馏框架予以缓解。
AI.motivation: 多轮任务中用户常提出变更后又否决或替换该变更，模型应忽略已失效内容继续执行。然而模型即便在最终意图不变时也会被执行被拒绝的变更所"带偏"，说明其无法区分"被提及"与"仍生效"的需求，且这种精度下降会随交互持续加深或持续存在，因此需要系统化研究并给出解决方案。
AI.method: 1）构建Intent-Eval受控基准，覆盖工具调用、代码、数据库与数学任务，系统评测模型在演化用户意图下的行为；2）归纳出"提及即生效"混淆（mentioned-as-in-effect confusion）这一失效机制；3）提出Intent-OPSD——一种决策条件化的在策略自蒸馏框架，教师与学生由同一模型初始化，冻结教师依据与用户决策匹配的完整任务提供"活跃意图"监督，学生则在完整对话上训练以遵循反映用户意图的活跃需求。
AI.result: 在多种任务上，模型对"被拒绝的提案"和"被取代的需求"均表现出脆弱性，accuracy出现下降，且该下降会随交互推进而加深或持续，验证了"提及即生效"混淆的存在。
AI.conclusion: 模型需学会区分对话中被提及的内容与仍然生效的需求；Intent-Eval为评测该能力提供了受控平台，Intent-OPSD则通过决策条件化的在策略自蒸馏提供了一种有效缓解思路。

title: Poisson-GENERIC Neural Operators: Exact Metriplectic Structure in Function Space via Casimir Entropies
summary: Existing thermodynamically consistent neural operators impose the GENERIC degeneracy conditions by projecting the reversible operator onto the complement of the entropy gradient. This makes the operator state-dependent and forfeits the Jacobi identity, so the result is metriplectic-degenerate rather than metriplectic. We instead obtain degeneracy the way GENERIC does. For nonlinear transport, the reversible operator $L$ is the compatible Lie-Poisson pencil $αD+λ(uD+Du)$; otherwise it is a constant, trivially Poisson Fourier multiplier. On an augmented state $(u,s)$ with a latent entropy density, $S=\int s$ is a Casimir of $L$, so $L\,δS/δz=0$ holds identically without projection. The energy combines a fixed mechanical quadratic, a learned gauge-free potential, and a convex internal energy. The friction operator $M=AA^\top$ satisfies $M\,δE/δz=0$ pointwise, and its Onsager parity structure permits diffusion and damping while provably excluding transport. For any parameters, skewness, positivity, both degeneracies, and the Jacobi identity (on the resolved band for the Lie-Poisson term) hold to machine precision. Heat conduction and damped waves admit exact closed-form friction operators, the second law bounds physical energy under a checkable curvature condition, and a discrete-gradient integrator yields exact discrete first and second laws. On four PDEs in 1D and 2D with three backbones (FNO, Transolver, CNO), the model wins 61 of 72 seed-level comparisons against same-backbone unconstrained baselines, learns the exact transport and wave symbols, matches the true dissipation rate within 13% on heat and Burgers, and dissipates nothing on advection. A constant-$L$ ablation isolates the cost of exact Jacobi as the loss of Burgers, while a learned-entropy ablation injects energy on every reversible-irreversible problem.

AI.tldr: 提出一种按 GENERIC 原生方式构造简并条件的神经算子：以相容 Lie-Poisson 铅笔作为可逆算子、以新息陈熵为 Casimir，并用满足 Onsager 奇偶性的摩擦算子，使反对称性、正性、双简并性与 Jacobi 恒等式在机器精度内成立，在四个 PDE、三种骨干网络上显著优于同类无约束基线。
AI.motivation: 现有热力学一致神经算子通过把可逆算子投影到熵梯度补空间来强制 GENERIC 简并条件，导致算子依赖状态并丧失 Jacobi 恒等式，仅得到"度规辛退化"而非真正的度规辛结构。本文旨在不依赖投影、从根本上获得简并性，从而同时保持双简并性、Jacobi 恒等式与物理结构。
AI.method: 在增广状态 (u,s) 上引入潜熵密度 s，令 S=∫s 为可逆算子 L 的 Casimir，使 L·δS/δz=0 恒等成立。非线性输运时 L 取相容 Lie-Poisson 铅笔 αD+λ(uD+Du)，否则取常数、平凡 Poisson 的 Fourier 乘子。能量由固定力学二次项、学习到的无规范势能与凸内能构成。摩擦算子取 M=AAᵀ，逐点满足 M·δE/δz=0，其 Onsager 奇偶结构允许扩散与阻尼而可证排除输运。对热传导与阻尼波动方程给出精确闭式摩擦算子，并采用离散梯度积分器保证离散第一、第二定律精确成立。
AI.result: 对任意参数，反对称性、正性、双简并性与 Jacobi 恒等式（Lie-Poisson 项在可分辨频带上）均以机器精度成立。第二定律在可检验曲率条件下为物理能量提供上界。在 1D 与 2D 的四个 PDE、三种骨干（FNO、Transolver、CNO）上，模型在同骨干无约束基线的 72 组种子级比较中赢下 61 组，学到精确的输运与波动符号，在热传导与 Burgers 上耗散率与真实值误差在 13% 以内，在平流方程上不产生耗散。常数 L 消融表明精确 Jacobi 的代价是丧失 Burgers 能力，而学习熵消融则在每个可逆-不可逆问题上注入能量。
AI.conclusion: 通过复刻 GENERIC 的原生简并机制而非投影，可在神经算子中严格恢复双简并性与 Jacobi 恒等式，并在保持精确物理结构的同时获得优于无约束基线的精度与泛化，验证了精确几何结构对学习复杂不可逆动力学的重要性。

title: Lens3D: Target-Conditioned Visual Foveation for Fine-Grained 3D Understanding
summary: Existing 3D large language models often overlook fine-grained attributes and less visually salient objects and parts, even when relevant evidence is present in scene videos. We introduce Lens3D to improve fine-grained object understanding through external visual assistance and knowledge transfer. Its LensUnd pipeline adopts 3D localization to select informative, complementary views for an external 2D vision-language model, supporting fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object question answering. LensDistill transfers the resulting fine-grained knowledge to 3D LLMs through detailed caption supervision, enabling captioning from native inputs without external VLM calls. We also construct LensBench, a held-out evaluation set of 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. Experiments with Video-3D LLM and 3DRS demonstrate that LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object captioning while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance. These results establish the feasibility of transferring externally acquired fine-grained knowledge into native 3D LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Lens3D，通过外部视觉辅助与知识蒸馏提升 3D 大语言模型的细粒度物体理解能力，并构建 LensBench 评测集验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 大语言模型常忽视细粒度属性以及视觉显著性较低的物体和部件，即使场景视频中已包含相关证据，模型仍难以捕捉这些细节信息。因此，需要一种方法来增强 3D LLM 对细粒度物体的理解能力。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心组件：LensUnd 流水线利用 3D 定位为外部 2D 视觉语言模型选择信息丰富且互补的视角，支持细粒度物体描述、小物体定位和细粒度物体问答；LensDistill 通过详细描述监督将外部获得的细粒度知识迁移到 3D LLM 中，使模型无需调用外部 VLM 即可基于原生输入生成描述。此外还构建了 LensBench 评测集。
AI.result: LensBench 包含 2,068 个物体的留出评测集，每个物体配有三条银标准参考描述。在 Video-3D LLM 和 3DRS 上的实验表明，LensDistill 显著提升了细粒度物体描述能力，同时保持了原有的定位和场景级问答性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了将外部获取的细粒度知识迁移到原生 3D LLM 中的可行性。

title: ANT: A Multi-Granularity Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Agents Behavior Auditing
summary: The growing adoption of large language model (LLM) agents creates a need for network administrators and security teams to audit agent behavior within organizational networks without inspecting private user content. Network traffic offers an observable source of evidence, but how much it reveals about agent tasks and operations remains unclear. Existing traffic datasets lack the joint task and stage annotations needed to evaluate this question. We introduce ANT (Agent Network Traffic), a dataset providing agent behavior information at risk, scenario, and behavior primitive granularities alongside network traffic. ANT contains 3,114 execution episodes across 20 tasks and five scenarios, comprising 276,417 bidirectional flows and 40,049 behavior primitive segments organized into 47 macro groups. We establish a benchmark for agent risk identification, scenario recognition, and behavior primitive classification using 13 representative traffic analysis baselines. The results show that existing methods recover useful but uneven behavioral signals. They struggle to identify risk when malicious workflows resemble benign tasks and to distinguish scenarios with similar traffic patterns. Primitive classification is more reliable for frequent macro groups and those with distinctive traffic patterns than for rare or semantically similar groups. ANT provides a common basis for developing more precise auditing and forensic analysis of agent behavior from network traffic. Our data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ant-main-suite-7BC0/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ANT 数据集，为 LLM 智能体网络流量提供风险、场景和行为原语三级标注，并建立基准评测 13 种流量分析方法。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在组织网络中被广泛部署，管理者需要在不检查用户私密内容的前提下审计其行为。网络流量是可观测的证据来源，但其对智能体任务与操作的揭示程度尚不明确；现有流量数据集缺乏任务与阶段的联合标注，无法支撑这一问题的评估。
AI.method: 构建 ANT（Agent Network Traffic）数据集，在风险、场景和行为原语三个粒度上提供行为标签并同步采集网络流量，涵盖 20 个任务、5 个场景下的 3,114 个执行 episode，包含 276,417 条双向流和 40,049 个行为原语片段（归入 47 个宏组）；基于 13 种代表性流量分析基线建立智能体风险识别、场景识别与行为原语分类基准。
AI.result: 现有方法能恢复有用但不均衡的行为信号：当恶意工作流与良性任务相似时难以识别风险，对流量模式相近的场景区分能力不足；原语分类在频繁宏组及流量特征鲜明的宏组上更可靠，在稀有或语义相近的宏组上表现较差。
AI.conclusion: ANT 为从网络流量开展更精确的智能体行为审计与取证分析提供了统一基础，数据与代码已公开。

title: Disentangling Task Difficulty from Run-Level Failure in Agent Failure Prediction
summary: Predicting whether an LLM agent will fail has emerged as a promising direction for supporting intervention during execution. Recent approaches report strong predictive performance, often with AUROC values between 0.85 and 0.94. However, predictors are typically trained by pooling runs from many tasks. We hypothesize that part of this performance comes from recognizing that some tasks are harder than others, rather than detecting whether a particular run is heading toward failure. This distinction matters because task-level difficulty supports decisions about where to allocate computation, while run-level prediction is needed to decide whether to intervene in an ongoing trajectory. We study benchmarks with repeated attempts of the same task by the same agent and separate cross-unit comparisons from comparisons between successful and failed runs of the same model-task unit. Across the evaluated corpora, more than 99.93% of the positive-negative pairs underlying pooled AUROC are cross-unit. Accordingly, predictors that never observe the current run can achieve high pooled performance, including a difficulty oracle with AUROC up to 0.945, while remaining at chance within task. Early run-level discrimination is consistently weak across trajectory predictors, released monitors, and hidden-state probes, although it improves later in execution and is stronger for weaker agents. Under fixed token budgets, task-level allocation outperforms abort-only strategies, while early stopping becomes beneficial only when within-task AUROC reaches about 0.84-0.93, far above the 0.50-0.55 range observed for early monitors. These results show that failure prediction should be evaluated not only by outcome accuracy, but by whether the captured signal supports the intended deployment decision.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出LLM智能体失败预测中普遍存在"任务难度识别"与"运行级失败检测"的混淆：池化AUROC指标99.93%以上由跨任务对比构成，导致无需观察当前运行的难度预言机即可获得高AUROC，但在任务内仅达随机水平，故失败预测应以是否支持实际部署决策来评估。
AI.motivation: 近期LLM智能体失败预测研究报告了0.85-0.94的高AUROC，但预测器通常混合多任务运行训练。作者怀疑其中相当部分性能源于识别任务难度差异，而非判断某次具体运行是否走向失败。这一区分至关重要：任务级难度支持计算资源分配决策，而运行级预测才是决定是否干预进行中轨迹的依据，二者对应完全不同的部署决策。
AI.method: 作者选取同一智能体对同一任务多次重复尝试的基准，将评估分解为跨单元比较与同一"模型-任务"单元内成功/失败运行的比较。统计池化AUROC正负样本对中跨单元对的比例，并构造"难度预言机"（从不观察当前运行）作为对照，同时评估轨迹预测器、已发布监控器与隐状态探针在任务内的早期判别能力，并在固定token预算下比较任务级分配与仅中止策略。
AI.result: 在所评估语料中，池化AUROC背后的正负样本对超过99.93%为跨单元对；从不观察当前运行的难度预言机池化AUROC最高达0.945，而在任务内仅为随机水平。早期运行级判别在各类方法中一致偏弱，随执行推进而提升，且在较弱智能体上更强。固定token预算下，任务级分配优于仅中止策略；早停仅在任务内AUROC达约0.84-0.93时才带来收益，远高于早期监控器观察到的0.50-0.55。
AI.conclusion: 失败预测的评估不应只看结果准确率，还需检验所捕获信号是否真正支持预期的部署决策。当前高AUROC大多反映任务难度而非运行失败，早期运行级预测近乎随机，因此报告指标时应明确所测信号对应的是任务分配还是运行干预。

title: Video Encoders Built on Image Representations
summary: The design of a video encoder determines when frames begin to interact and which frame-specific visual evidence remains accessible to the language model. Native video pathways couple neighboring frames during visual encoding, whereas image pathways preserve independently computed frame representations but incur a much larger visual-token cost when all image tokens are forwarded. We ask a basic question: whether a compact video encoder can instead be built on image representations. To answer this question, we separate three operations that are often coupled: per-frame representation, cross-frame token allocation, and temporal interaction. A frozen image encoder first produces frame-specific candidates. A question-aware selector then allocates a fixed token budget across frames using relevance, diversity, and cross-frame correspondence, after which a lightweight learned refiner reads neighboring-frame context and writes residual updates only to the retained anchors. This preserves source positions and keeps the visual output at the fixed budget. Across 13 benchmarks and three vision-language backbones, the resulting pathway matches full-image aggregate performance while using only about 28%-35% of its visual tokens. Specifically, on Qwen3-VL-8B, it achieves a 13-benchmark macro-average of 62.75 with 1,535 visual tokens, compared with 62.58 for the full Image pathway at 4,424 tokens and 59.49 for native Conv3D at 2,212 tokens. On Qwen3-VL-32B, it reaches a 13-benchmark macro-average of 66.28, compared with 66.09 for Image, while providing a 2.16x end-to-end speedup. These results show that compact video encoding does not require early temporal mixing: frame-specific evidence can be preserved first, allocated jointly, and temporally contextualized after selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种建立在图像表征之上的紧凑视频编码路径：冻结图像编码器生成逐帧候选，问题感知选择器在固定token预算下跨帧分配token，轻量refiner再对保留锚点做时序残差更新。在13个benchmark、3个VLM backbone上，该方法以约28%-35%的视觉token达到全Image聚合性能。
AI.motivation: 视频编码器的设计决定了帧间何时交互以及哪些帧级视觉证据能被语言模型访问。原生视频路径在视觉编码阶段耦合相邻帧；图像路径保留独立计算的帧表征，但前传全部图像token时视觉token开销过大。作者追问：能否用图像表征构建紧凑的视频编码器。
AI.method: 将通常耦合的三类操作分离：逐帧表征、跨帧token分配、时序交互。首先由冻结图像编码器产生帧级候选；随后问题感知选择器依据相关性、多样性和跨帧对应关系，在固定token预算下跨帧分配token；最后由轻量可学习refiner读取邻帧上下文，仅对保留的锚点写入残差更新。该设计保持源位置不变，并将视觉输出限制在固定预算内。
AI.result: 在13个benchmark和3个视觉语言backbone上，该路径以约28%-35%的视觉token匹配全Image聚合性能。Qwen3-VL-8B上，以1,535个视觉token取得13-benchmark宏平均62.75，对比全Image路径4,424 token的62.58和原生Conv3D 2,212 token的59.49；Qwen3-VL-32B上达到66.28，对比Image的66.09，并实现2.16倍端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑视频编码不必然依赖早期时序混合：可以先保留帧级证据，再联合分配token，并在选择后进行时序上下文化。

title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
summary: Clinical decision-support outputs can lack an au- ditable link between patient observations, encoded knowledge, conclusions, and recommendations. We present the CKG Clinical Explanation Engine, a downstream layer for a frozen, training-free clinical knowledge-graph reasoner that converts patient inference states and disease knowledge into typed facts, explicit rule-application traces, provenance-linked conclusions, and policy-licensed recommendations. The design separates measurement availability, representation completeness, and disease-specific activation; consequently, observed zero-activation evience is not treated as missing and partial representation is distinct from unobserved evidence. Optional language generation is restricted to symbolically licensed content. Across five usable workbooks (6,720 patients; 20,160 patient-disease traces; 1,021,440 feature-evidence rows), IG-range validity and knowledge provenance were 100%, numerical cross-sheet fidelity was 100% (120,960/120,960), and exported logical/report trace completeness was 100% (20,160/20,160). Availability representation consistency was 99.7028% (1,018,404/1,021,440); all 3,036 disagreements were confined to three systematic feature-cohort patterns. The corpus contained 86,783 observed zero-activation and 139,949 observed partially represented instances. A separate seeded 25-patient end-to-end audit completed without execution failure and passed all pre-specified trace, licensing, provenance, and state-consistency checks. These results establish structural and implementation auditability, not clinical correctness or utility.

AI.tldr: 提出CKG临床解释引擎，将冻结、免训练的临床知识图谱推理器输出转为类型化事实、显式规则痕迹、可溯源结论与受政策许可的建议，实现结构化可审计的解释链。
AI.motivation: 临床决策支持输出往往缺乏患者观测、编码知识、结论与建议之间的可审计联系，难以验证推理过程。
AI.method: 构建CKG Clinical Explanation Engine作为下游层，冻结且免训练；将患者推理状态与疾病知识转化为类型化事实、显式规则应用痕迹、溯源关联结论与政策许可建议；分离测量可得性、表示完整性与疾病特异性激活，避免將观测到的零激活视为缺失；可选语言生成仅限符号许可内容。
AI.result: 五个可用workbook（6,720名患者；20,160条患者-疾病轨迹；1,021,440条特征-证据行）：IG-range有效性与知识溯源均100%；跨表数值保真100%（120,960/120,960）；导出逻辑/报告痕迹完整性100%（20,160/20,160）；可得性表示一致性99.7028%（1,018,404/1,021,440），3,036处不一致集中于三种系统性特征-队列模式；语料含86,783个观测零激活与139,949个观测部分表示实例；独立种子25患者端到端审计无执行失败，通过全部预设痕迹、许可、溯源与状态一致性检查。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立结构与实现层面的可审计性，而非临床正确性或实用性。

title: What Does an Observability Foundation Model Know?
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Main Conference '26. 25 pages
summary: A linear probe can show that a label is recoverable from a model's hidden states, but not whether that goes beyond what the input already reveals, or whether the model uses it. We audit Toto, an observability forecasting foundation model, on the Benchmark of Observability Metrics (BOOM) across five series-disjoint resplits, comparing linear probes on its frozen residual stream with models that read the raw input window and with Toto's architecture stripped of its trained configuration. Short-vs-medium cadence and metric type are more linearly recoverable from Toto's residuals than from the strongest raw-window model in every resplit (macro-F1 0.766 vs. 0.633 and 0.545 vs. 0.498). Domain is nearly tied, and series cardinality is recovered far better from the raw window. MOMENT-base shows related cadence, metric-type, and domain readouts. Recoverability is not use: exchanging Toto's residuals with those of high-burst donors moves a future-burstiness readout as intended but does not make forecasts consistently burstier than a randomized donor. A BOOM-trained coordination probe has negative zero-shot R^2 on the tested external benchmarks. We report each label against its strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文对可观测性预测基础模型Toto进行审计，通过线性探针在BOOM基准的五个重划分上比较其冻结残差流、原始输入窗口模型以及去除训练配置的Toto架构。结果表明，节律与指标类型在残差中比最强原始窗口模型更易线性恢复，但可恢复性并不等同于模型使用该信息。
AI.motivation: 线性探针只能显示标签可从模型隐藏状态中恢复，却无法判断该信息是否超出输入本身已揭示的内容，也无法判断模型是否真正使用了该信息。因此需要对Toto这类可观测性预测基础模型进行更严格的审计，区分"可恢复性"与"实际使用"。
AI.method: 在BOOM基准的五个序列不相交重划分上审计Toto。将Toto冻结残差流上的线性探针，与读取原始输入窗口的模型、以及去除训练配置的Toto架构进行对比。此外进行残差交换实验（用高突发供体的残差替换Toto残差），并在外部基准上测试BOOM训练的协调探针的零样本R^2。
AI.result: 短/中节律与指标类型在Toto残差中比最强原始窗口模型更易线性恢复（宏F1分别为0.766对0.633、0.545对0.498），且在每个重划分上均成立。域几乎持平，序列基数从原始窗口恢复得更好。MOMENT-base呈现相关的节律、指标类型和域读出。残差交换虽能按预期移动未来突发性读出，却未使预测比随机供体更持续地突发。BOOM训练的协调探针在测试的外部基准上零样本R^2为负。
AI.conclusion: 各标签均需针对其最强基线进行报告，可恢复性并不代表模型实际使用该信息。线性探针的可恢复性证据不足以证明模型在下游任务中真正依赖被探测的标签。

title: Signature-Based Feature Learning for Human Activity Recognition: A Reproducible Machine Learning Study of Representation, Depth, and Model Choice
summary: Human activity recognition (HAR) relies on transforming sensor signals into informative representations for classification. Although deep learning and handcrafted features are widely used, the role of representation itself is often not systematically isolated. Signature transforms provide a mathematically grounded way to encode temporal order and cross-channel interactions, but their value for HAR under a fully reproducible and leakage-aware framework remains unclear. To evaluate whether signature-based feature learning improves HAR performance compared with raw-signal baselines, and to assess the effects of embedding strategy, truncation depth, model choice, and sensor configuration. Experiments were conducted on the UCI HAR dataset using a fully reproducible pipeline with the original train--test split preserved and subject-disjoint validation to prevent leakage. Three representations were compared: raw flattened signals, time-augmented paths, and lead--lag transformed paths. Signature features were computed at multiple truncation depths and evaluated using multilayer perceptron (MLP) and Random Forest (RF) classifiers under identical preprocessing and validation procedures. A prior K-means-based feature reduction study was also reproduced for comparison. Signature-based representations improved performance when paired with RF models, the best configuration was time-augmented six-channel signatures at depth 6 using entropy-based RF achieving 0.858 accuracy and 0.859 macro F1, outperforming the strongest raw baseline (0.816 accuracy). Lead--lag representations were competitive at moderate depths but did not surpass the best time-augmented models. MLP models did not exceed raw baselines. Signature-based feature learning can improve HAR, but its benefit depends on alignment between representation design and classifier choice.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了签名变换（signature transform）特征在人类活动识别（HAR）中的价值，在UCI HAR数据集上以可复现且防泄漏的流程比较了原始信号、时间增广路径与lead-lag路径三种表示，发现签名特征配合随机森林可提升性能，但增益取决于表示设计与分类器的匹配。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习与手工特征在HAR中广泛应用，表示本身的作用常未被系统隔离评估；签名变换能数学化地编码时间顺序与跨通道交互，但其在完全可复现、防泄漏框架下对HAR的价值仍不明确。因此需要评估签名特征学习是否优于原始信号基线，并考察嵌入策略、截断深度、模型选择与传感器配置的影响。
AI.method: 在UCI HAR数据集上采用完全可复现流程，保留原始训练-测试划分并使用受试者不相交验证以防止数据泄漏。比较三种表示：原始展平信号、时间增广路径、lead-lag变换路径；在多个截断深度计算签名特征，并在相同预处理与验证流程下用多层感知机（MLP）和随机森林（RF）分类器评估，同时复现先前的K-means特征降维研究作为对比。
AI.result: 签名表示与RF结合时性能提升，最佳配置为时间增广六通道签名、深度6、基于熵的RF，达到0.858准确率与0.859宏F1，优于最强原始基线（0.816准确率）。lead-lag表示在中等深度具竞争力但未超越最佳时间增广模型。MLP模型未超过原始基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于签名的特征学习能够提升HAR性能，但其收益取决于表示设计与分类器选择之间的匹配。

title: Expanding LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Main Conference '26 with a score of 4.33
summary: Extra inference compute is usually spent on sampling more reasoning chains. We study where inside an existing chain an additional continuation should begin. We define expansion utility, the change in correctness from restarting a chain at a stored step, and measure it at every eligible step for nine models on six benchmarks (41 model and benchmark cells). Restart position matters: steps selected on one set of continuations beat uniform placement when scored on disjoint ones, in held-out audits on 5, 16, and 38 cells (+4.25 points [+2.51, +6.63] in a fresh five-cell audit). A fixed rule that restarts from the last eligible steps, always-last, is a strong baseline: our learned router beats uniform placement but shows no detected gain over it, and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500 always-last exceeds the exact self-consistency frontier at matched aggregate generated output by +0.052 [+0.008, +0.098], using 0.774x the aggregate generated output of four-sample self-consistency. Cross-fitted oracle selection still finds held-out headroom beyond declared positional classes, a target for future selectors. Finally, breaking step-label ties by earliest index flips the sign of a pointwise selector's gain over uniform placement in every seed of a five-seed diagnostic with four rollouts per step; randomized ties remove the bias.

AI.tldr: 额外的推理算力通常用于采样更多推理链，本文研究“在已有链条内部从哪一步继续”更有效。作者定义扩展效用（从已存储步骤重启链条后正确率的变化），并在9个模型、6个基准共41个单元上逐步骤测量。结果显示重启位置确实重要，其中“总是从最后一个合格步骤重启”（always-last）是强基线，甚至在部分设定上以更少的聚合生成长度超过精确自洽前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有推理算力扩展主要集中于增加采样链数量，而忽略了在同一链条内部选择“额外延续的起点”这一自由度。论文动机是检验重启位置是否系统性地影响正确率，并判断学习式选择器相较统一放置或简单规则是否具有真实收益。
AI.method: 定义扩展效用为从已存储步骤重启链条后正确率的变化，并在每个合格步骤上进行测量，覆盖9个模型、6个基准、41个模型-基准单元。比较不同放置策略：基于一组延续选出的步骤在不相交延续上评分、统一放置、学习式路由器、固定规则always-last，并进行5、16、38单元留出审计及新五单元审计。还使用交叉拟合的oracle选择评估声明位置类别之外的留出空间，并进行五种子诊断，比较按最早索引打破步骤标签并列与随机打破并列的影响。
AI.result: 重启位置显著影响效果：在一组延续上选出的步骤在不相交延续上优于统一放置，留出审计覆盖5、16、38个单元，新五单元审计提升+4.25点[+2.51, +6.63]。always-last是强基线：学习式路由器优于统一放置，但未检测到相对always-last的增益；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500上，always-last在匹配聚合生成输出时超过精确自洽前沿+0.052[+0.008, +0.098]，仅使用四样本自洽聚合生成输出的0.774倍。交叉拟合oracle选择仍发现声明位置类别之外的留出空间。按最早索引打破步骤标签并列会翻转某逐点选择器相对统一放置增益的符号（五种子诊断中每种子均出现，每步四rollout）；随机打破并列可消除该偏差。
AI.conclusion: 在已有推理链内部，额外延续的起点选择是一个关键变量；简单固定规则always-last已相当强，学习式选择器尚未稳定超越它。oracle分析表明声明位置类别之外仍存在选择空间，可作为未来选择器目标；同时步骤标签并列的打破方式会引入评估偏差，应使用随机打破并列以避免虚假增益。

title: Talk Like You: Imitating How You Speak in Real-Time Talking Head Generation
summary: In daily life, each person exhibits unique speaking habits, leading to subtle yet consistent lip-shape variations even when pronouncing the same word. Although recent talking head generation methods have achieved impressive visual fidelity and lip synchronization, they largely overlook user-specific customization, especially the motion patterns that characterize individual speaking habits. These habits are difficult to model and capture, as their motion patterns are highly fine-grained and often similar across individuals. As a result, many approaches produce overly uniform facial motions and fail to capture diverse, person-specific articulation patterns. To address this, we propose TalkLikeYou, an efficient framework that imitates how a target person speaks in talking head generation. Our method models habit in motion-space and achieves real-time performance through Flow Matching with only one sampling step during inference. We further adopt a two-stage imitation learning strategy to capture subtle distinctions between habits, allowing users to specify a target habit through either a preset style from the dataset or a reference video. In addition, we introduce a new metric PLAD that projects mouth motions onto representative articulation axes to evaluate imitation accuracy and generation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TalkLikeYou generates high-quality talking heads in real-time and significantly improves speaking habit imitation compared with prior methods. The code is available at: https://github.com/BQ-Wang0511/TalkLikeYou

AI.tldr: 提出TalkLikeYou框架，在运动空间中建模个体说话习惯，用单步Flow Matching实现实时说话头生成，并支持通过预设风格或参考视频指定目标习惯，同时提出PLAD指标评估模仿准确性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有说话头生成方法虽在视觉保真度和唇同步上表现优异，但普遍忽视用户个性化定制，尤其是体现个人说话习惯的运动模式。这类习惯高度细粒度且个体间差异微小，难以建模与捕捉，导致生成的面部运动过于统一，无法呈现多样化的个人化发音模式。
AI.method: 在运动空间中对说话习惯进行建模；采用Flow Matching，推理阶段仅需一次采样即可实时生成；引入两阶段模仿学习策略以捕捉习惯间的细微差异，用户可通过数据集预设风格或参考视频指定目标习惯；此外提出新指标PLAD，将嘴部运动投影到代表性发音轴上，用于评估模仿准确性与生成多样性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TalkLikeYou能够实时生成高质量说话头，且在说话习惯模仿方面显著优于现有方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将个性化说话习惯引入说话头生成，通过运动空间建模、单步Flow Matching与两阶段模仿学习，在保证实时性与生成质量的同时实现了有效的习惯模仿，并提供PLAD指标进行量化评估。

title: HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of acting in complex tool-use environments, yet they often fail to recognize when tasks are infeasible and no valid solution exists. Recent work has formalized this reliability gap as the problem of agentic abstention, and existing approaches typically optimize a model or agent harness against a fixed set of tasks, leading to limited generalization to unseen failure modes. We introduce HERA, a framework for harness-environment co-evolution for agentic abstention. HERA consists of (i) a pipeline to automatically construct verifiable pairs of feasible and infeasible tasks by applying controlled environment mutations that transform solvable tasks into cases requiring abstention, and (ii) a co-evolution procedure in which performance failures on previous tasks are used to drive harness adaptation and generate new execution environments and tasks geared towards previous weaknesses. On held-out evaluation tasks, an evolved harness from HERA improves abstention accuracy from 61.7% to 83.3% while improving feasible-task completion from 68.3% to 76.7%, achieving the highest abstention and feasible-task completion among the compared methods. The resulting best harness transfers across 19 other LLMs, improving abstention accuracy by 15.3 percentage points on average without any model-specific optimization, and enabling smaller models to match the performance of more powerful models at an estimated 85% lower cost.

AI.tldr: HERA 提出一种“harness-环境协同演化”框架，用于提升 LLM 智能体在不可行任务上的弃权（abstention）能力，并在留出任务与跨模型迁移上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在复杂工具使用环境中常无法识别任务不可行、不存在有效解的情况。已有 agentic abstention 方法多针对固定任务集优化模型或 harness，泛化到未见失效模式的能力有限。
AI.method: HERA 包含两部分：(i) 通过受控环境变异，将可解任务转化为需要弃权的案例，自动构建可行/不可行任务的可验证配对；(ii) 协同演化流程，利用先前任务上的性能失败驱动 harness 自适应，并生成面向既有弱点的新的执行环境与任务。
AI.result: 在留出评估任务上，HERA 演化出的 harness 将弃权准确率从 61.7% 提升至 83.3%，同时将可行任务完成率从 68.3% 提升至 76.7%，在对比方法中弃权与可行任务完成均最高。最优 harness 可迁移至 19 个其他 LLM，平均弃权准确率提升 15.3 个百分点，无需模型特定优化，并使较小模型以约低 85% 的成本达到更强模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过 harness 与环境的协同演化，HERA 有效缓解了智能体弃权可靠性缺口，并展现出良好的跨模型泛化与成本优势。

title: ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved small-molecule drugs and 565,731 positive DDI pairs. ColdDDI evaluates pairs with zero, one, or two unseen drugs. It also annotates each interaction by whether it changes drug exposure or drug effect, and by whether the biomedical knowledge graph contains shared enzymes, transporters, or targets that can plausibly mediate the interaction. These annotations separate evidence availability from predictive dependence. We evaluate eight conventional DDI methods and 13 LLMs; for open-weight LLMs, we test five prompt patterns and use masking, drug replacement, and channel-sensitivity metrics to probe knowledge utilization. ColdDDI exposes that, in the hardest split where both drugs are unseen, the main performance divide is mediator availability. A fine-tuned 1B LLM recovers 89-93% of interactions with a shared enzyme, transporter, or target, but only 40-62% without such a mediator. More importantly, KG-provided evidence is not always used; several KG-augmented baselines change little when the shared mediator is masked or disrupted, whereas fine-tuned LLMs respond strongly to this intervention. Thus, ColdDDI evaluates knowledge utilization rather than knowledge access alone, showing where cold-start DDI models rely on mechanistic evidence and where they fail despite receiving it. Code is available at https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026.

AI.tldr: ColdDDI是一个可重建的诊断性基准，用于评估冷启动药物相互作用预测中模型是否真正利用了药理学证据。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多报告聚合的边预测分数，无法回答模型在接收分子、文本或知识图谱证据时是否真正使用了支持相互作用的药理学证据。
AI.method: 基于DrugBank 5.1.13构建ColdDDI，含1900个已批准小分子药物和565731个正DDI对，评估0/1/2个未见药物的场景；对每个相互作用标注是否改变药物暴露或药效，以及知识图谱中是否存在可介导该相互作用的共享酶、转运体或靶点。评估8种传统DDI方法和13个LLM，对开源LLM测试5种提示模式，并用掩蔽、药物替换和通道敏感性指标探查知识利用。
AI.result: 在最难的双未见药物划分中，主要性能差异来自中介体可得性：微调的1B LLM对有共享酶/转运体/靶点的相互作用恢复率为89-93%，而无中介体时仅40-62%；多个KG增强基线在共享中介体被掩蔽或破坏时几乎不变，而微调LLM对此干预反应强烈。
AI.conclusion: ColdDDI评估的是知识利用而非仅知识获取，揭示了冷启动DDI模型依赖机制证据的场景以及即使获得证据仍失败的场景。

title: Cross-dataset harmonization for robust endoscopic image analysis
summary: A significant problem in endoscopic image analysis is that the machine learning (ML) models used for this purpose usually underperform when applied on images acquired from endoscopes that are different from those used to acquire the images of their training set. The main difference of the images originating from different endoscopes is their color distributions, which depend both on the image sensors and the light sources used. Although previous studies have highlighted this challenge, to the best of our knowledge it has not been previously explicitly tackled. This study focuses on this problem and proposes very simple but impactful method. It implements a reference-based image harmonization that reduces global appearance differences between endoscopic datasets. Specifically, it extracts global color statistics from a chosen reference dataset in the CIE-Lab color space and applies a statistical channel-wise transformation to map each target image toward the appearance of the images of the reference dataset. The method is evaluated in the context of polyp detection in both flexible colonoscopy and capsule endoscopy datasets using a dataset-level cross validation protocol. The results indicate that the proposed harmonization consistently improves cross-dataset performance up to 30.7%, outperforming relevant baseline and state-of-the-art methods. The results indicate that a substantial part of the generalization gap is driven by low-level appearance variation that can be mitigated without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于参考图像的颜色协调方法，将内镜图像在CIE-Lab空间做通道级统计变换，缩小不同内镜数据集之间的全局外观差异，在结肠镜与胶囊内镜息肉检测中提升跨数据集性能最高达30.7%。
AI.motivation: 内镜图像分析中，ML模型在来自不同内镜设备的图像上泛化性能差。其主因是不同设备的图像传感器与光源导致颜色分布不同。该挑战虽被提及，但此前未被明确处理。
AI.method: 提出简单的参考驱动图像协调方法：从选定参考数据集提取CIE-Lab颜色空间的全局颜色统计量，对每张目标图像施加按通道的统计变换（如均值/方差对齐），将其外观映射至参考数据集分布，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在柔性结肠镜和胶囊内镜息肉检测数据集上，采用数据集级交叉验证协议评估。所提协调方法一致提升跨数据集性能，最高提升30.7%，优于相关基线和最新方法。
AI.conclusion: 泛化差距的相当一部分由低层外观差异造成，可通过无需重训练的简单颜色协调得到缓解。

title: DGA-Muon: Decoupled Geometry-Aligned Adaptive Scaling for Muon
summary: While NorMuon has achieved strong empirical performance in large-scale pretraining by enhancing Muon with row-wise adaptive scaling, its underlying adaptive mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide the first systematic analysis of NorMuon's adaptivity, revealing that it originates primarily from orthogonalization-induced geometry rather than genuine optimization-relevant information. Under exact orthogonalization, the adaptive scaling factors degenerate into a single global scalar for square and wide matrices, while for tall matrices their variation arises from the non-uniform distribution of row energy after orthogonalization. Under approximate orthogonalization, the orthogonality residual introduces additional variation into the scaling factors, leading to the \textit{Orthogonalization--Adaptivity Paradox}: more accurate orthogonalization weakens adaptivity. We further show that NorMuon's rigid row-wise scaling is geometrically misaligned with the one-sided orthogonal structure of tall matrices. Based on the analysis of these limitations, we propose two core design principles that a desirable adaptive mechanism for Muon should satisfy. First, adaptive scaling should be decoupled from orthogonalization, with the scaling factors computed directly from raw gradients. Second, adaptive scaling should be aligned with the shape-dependent orthogonal structure of the polar factor, using row-wise scaling for wide matrices and column-wise scaling for tall matrices. By incorporating several other design considerations, including sum-based second-moment estimates, bias correction, and adaptive clipping of scaling factors, we obtain the Decoupled Geometry-Aligned Muon (DGA-Muon) optimizer. We establish convergence guarantees for DGA-Muon and empirically validate both our theoretical characterization of NorMuon's scaling degeneration and the superiority of DGA-Muon over NorMuon.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析了 NorMuon 的自适应机制，指出其自适应性主要源于正交化诱导的几何结构而非优化相关信息，并据此提出解耦且几何对齐的 DGA-Muon 优化器。
AI.motivation: NorMuon 通过行级自适应缩放增强 Muon，在大规模预训练中表现优异，但其自适应机制缺乏理论理解。作者希望厘清 NorMuon 自适应性的真正来源，揭示其局限，并据此设计更合理的自适应机制。
AI.method: 在精确正交化下分析缩放因子的退化行为：方阵与宽矩阵退化为单一全局标量，高矩阵的变异来自正交化后行能量的非均匀分布；在近似正交化下，正交性残差引入额外变异，形成“正交化—自适应悖论”。基于此提出两条设计原则：自适应缩放应与正交化解耦、直接由原始梯度计算；缩放方向应与极因子的形状相关正交结构对齐（宽矩阵行级、高矩阵列级）。结合求和式二阶矩估计、偏差校正与缩放因子自适应裁剪，得到 DGA-Muon，并给出收敛性保证与实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上刻画了 NorMuon 缩放退化现象及其自适应性来源；证明 DGA-Muon 的收敛性；实验验证了对 NorMuon 缩放退化的理论刻画，以及 DGA-Muon 相对 NorMuon 的优越性。
AI.conclusion: NorMuon 的自适应性主要来自正交化几何而非有效优化信息，其刚性行级缩放与高矩阵的单侧正交结构不匹配。通过解耦自适应与正交化、按形状对齐缩放方向，DGA-Muon 在理论与实验上均优于 NorMuon。

title: When the Cross-Silo Federation Goes Offline: Continual Learning for Site Onboarding with Limited Unlabeled Data
comment: Accepted to the Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 1 figure, plus appendix
summary: An organization often holds too little labeled data to train a model that generalizes, and the records that would supply the rest sit with organizations that cannot release them. Cross-silo federated learning offers a way through, since participants exchange model parameters rather than records, but it ordinarily settles two aspects of the arrangement in advance, the participating sites and the classes the model can predict, and deployment can breach both. A new site joins after training, once the established sites have finished their engagement and gone offline, and its records arrive unlabeled, mixing conditions the model already recognizes with conditions no participant has observed. We present an autonomous three-stage procedure that expands the model entirely at the joining site: reconstruction experts screen for novelty, clustering separates the flagged records into candidate conditions, and class means describe the old classes, all inside one shared representation. Those classes were learned from records that never leave their owners, so the usual defenses against forgetting are unavailable, and the procedure supplies the evidence they would have carried from either of two dissimilar sources, prototypes held by the federation or records held by the joining site. On a real industrial condition-monitoring dataset, run end to end with no label consulted, either source holds old-class accuracy at 0.868 or above with forgetting at most 0.063, and the two differ by 0.021, so a configuration can be chosen by the disclosure it permits rather than the accuracy it delivers. Both keep old- and new-class accuracy in balance where every alternative we measure gives up one for the other, and both retain more of the old classes than distillation- and regularization-based baselines. The balance still holds with only 6 labeled records per arriving condition and 3 retained per old class.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三阶段自主式跨孤岛联邦学习扩展流程，使新站点在无标签数据、旧站点离线条件下同时识别新类并保持旧类性能。
AI.motivation: 组织自有标注数据不足以训练泛化模型，而补充数据分散且不可共享；跨孤岛联邦学习虽以交换参数代替数据，却预先固定参与站点与预测类别，部署时新站点加入、旧站点离线且数据无标签，这两项假定均被打破。
AI.method: 三阶段流程全部在加入站点本地执行：①重构专家筛查新颖样本；②聚类将标记样本划分为候选新类；③类均值刻画旧类，均在同一共享表征空间内完成。由于旧类样本不离开拥有者，常规防遗忘手段不可用，故以两种来源提供证据——联邦持有的原型或加入站点持有的样本。
AI.result: 在真实工业状态监测数据集上端到端运行、全程不查询标签：两种来源均可将旧类准确率维持在不低于0.868，遗忘率至多0.063，二者相差0.021，因此可按披露许可而非精度来选择配置。两者均实现新旧类精度均衡，而所有对比方法均以牺牲一方为代价；对旧类的保持也优于基于蒸馏与正则化的基线。在每类新条件仅6条标注样本、每旧类保留3条时均衡依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 该流程可在旧站点离线、新站点数据无标签的现实约束下自主扩展模型，兼顾新类发现与旧类保持，且性能对证据来源与极少标注样本具有稳健性。

title: VideoTapestry: Query-Adaptive Memory Refinement for Multi-Agent Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding places substantial demands on memory, as answering questions often requires retrieving information distributed across extended temporal spans. Existing approaches broadly follow two paradigms: query-driven exploration, which is sensitive to localization errors, and query-independent memory construction, which may omit question-specific details. We introduce VideoTapestry, a training-free multi-agent framework that adapts a preconstructed hierarchical video memory through coarse-to-fine, query-driven refinement. The preconstructed memory organizes video content into three levels, capturing global narrative context, event-level temporal structure, and fine-grained relational evidence, respectively. To support coarse-to-fine localization and observation, we assign a specialized agent to each level, keeping retrieval and refinement within a scale-specific context. Guided by the query, these agents revisit relevant video regions and enrich layer-wise memories with targeted multimodal observations. Their refinements are assembled according to the original hierarchy into a composite query-adaptive memory, preserving global context in a compact form while retaining fine-grained evidence along query-relevant branches for final reasoning. Compared with direct GPT-5.5 inference, VideoTapestry achieves absolute accuracy gains of 17.2%, 14.9%, 9.8%, and 7.0% on LVBench, LongVideoBench (Long), Video-MME (Long), and EgoSchema, respectively, achieving the state-of-the-art results among all competitors.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练多智能体框架VideoTapestry，通过粗到细的查询驱动精炼，自适应调整预构建的分层视频记忆，在多个长视频理解基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解对记忆要求高，答案常需跨长时间跨度检索信息。现有方法分两类：查询驱动的探索对定位错误敏感；查询无关的记忆构建可能遗漏问题特定细节。因此需要兼顾定位鲁棒性与问题针对性。
AI.method: VideoTapestry为免训练多智能体框架。预先构建三级分层视频记忆，分别捕获全局叙事上下文、事件级时间结构与细粒度关系证据。每一层配备专用智能体，将检索与精炼限制在相应尺度的上下文中，实现粗到细的定位与观察。在查询引导下，各智能体回访相关视频区域，并以有针对性的多模态观察丰富各层记忆。其精炼结果按原始层级组装成复合的查询自适应记忆。
AI.result: 相比直接使用GPT-5.5推理，VideoTapestry在LVBench、LongVideoBench (Long)、Video-MME (Long)、EgoSchema上分别取得17.2%、14.9%、9.8%和7.0%的绝对准确率提升，在所有对比方法中达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: VideoTapestry通过分层记忆与多智能体粗到细的查询驱动精炼，在保持紧凑全局上下文的同时保留查询相关分支的细粒度证据，有效提升长视频理解性能，且无需训练。

title: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
summary: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究异步执行如何改变世界模型控制器中的动作语义，识别出TD-MPC2与DreamerV3两种架构相关的失效模式，并分别提出轻量级执行一致性接口加以纠正，无需修改预训练世界模型。
AI.motivation: 真实控制系统因通信延迟、丢包、乱序和作动器缓冲而常以异步方式执行命令。已有工作多将异步执行视为外部控制扰动，而本文认为它会改变世界模型控制器内部所假设的动作语义，从而引发更深层的规划与归因错误。作者希望厘清异步执行对不同世界模型架构的具体影响，并找到针对性的修正方案。
AI.method: 作者通过受控干预实验（controlled interventions）系统分析异步执行的影响，识别出两类架构相关的失效模式：（1）TD-MPC2等基于规划的控制器在想象动作序列与实际执行动作序列之间存在未来动作时间线不匹配；（2）DreamerV3等循环世界模型可能将观测到的状态转移归因于实际并未施加的命令。基于分析，作者提出两个轻量级执行一致性接口——面向TD-MPC2的Future-Sequence和面向DreamerV3的Applied-Action Feedback，在不修改预训练世界模型的前提下纠正上述不匹配。实验覆盖延迟、丢包、乱序、多种控制域、实测网络轨迹以及进程分离的异步栈。
AI.result: 实验一致支持两种诊断及相应的架构特定修正。分析表明，TD-MPC2在潜在动力学rollout中需要正确的未来动作序列，而DreamerV3需要将每次状态转移及时归因到真正生成它的动作。所提Future-Sequence与Applied-Action Feedback接口在多种异步条件下均能有效纠正时间线不匹配与动作归因错误。
AI.conclusion: 异步执行并非单纯的外部扰动，而是会改变世界模型控制器的动作语义，且失效机制具有架构依赖性。针对TD-MPC2的Future-Sequence和针对DreamerV3的Applied-Action Feedback两种轻量级执行一致性接口能够在不修改预训练世界模型的情况下解决相应问题，为在真实异步控制系统中部署世界模型控制器提供了可操作的设计指引。

title: An LLM-in-the-loop RL Framework for Bioinformatics Feature Selection
summary: High-dimensional bioinformatics data, characterized by a large number of features relative to the number of samples, pose major challenges such as the ``curse of dimensionality,'' leading to overfitting, high computational cost, and poor generalization. Traditional feature selection methods often suffer from limited scalability and adaptability in such domains. We propose an LLM-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (RL) framework for bioinformatics feature selection, where the RL agent formulates feature selection as a sequential decision-making task, while the large language model (LLM) enhances the process in two ways: (1) guiding exploration through domain-informed advice, and (2) providing hybrid rewards that integrate data-driven performance with knowledge-driven evaluation. The LLM also produces explanations to improve interpretability for human experts without altering the RL policy update. Experiments on diverse bioinformatics datasets show that the LLM-in-the-loop framework outperforms baselines, achieves stable performance across downstream models, and converges faster than pure RL.

AI.tldr: 提出一种LLM在环的强化学习框架，用于高维生物信息学特征选择，通过LLM引导探索、提供混合奖励并生成解释，在多个数据集上优于基线，性能稳定且收敛更快。
AI.motivation: 高维生物信息学数据存在特征数远大于样本数的问题，引发"维数灾难"，导致过拟合、计算成本高和泛化性差。传统特征选择方法在此类领域可扩展性和适应性有限。
AI.method: 将特征选择建模为强化学习的序贯决策任务；引入LLM在环机制，具体包括：（1）利用领域知识提供建议以引导探索；（2）提供融合数据驱动性能与知识驱动评估的混合奖励；（3）生成解释以提升对领域专家的可解释性，且不改变RL策略更新。
AI.result: 在多种生物信息学数据集上，该LLM在环框架优于基线方法，在不同下游模型上表现稳定，且比纯强化学习收敛更快。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM与强化学习结合可有效缓解高维特征选择中的可扩展性与适应性问题，兼顾性能、稳定性、收敛速度与可解释性。

title: ChronoWorld: Camera-Controlled Consistent 4D World Generation via Spatiotemporal Cues and Geometric Reflections
summary: While existing camera-controllable video generation models can produce visually compelling sequences, preserving intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal coherence remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose ChronoWorld, an "Observation--State--Reflection" framework that leverages spatiotemporal causal cues and reconstruction priors to generate globally consistent, free-view 4D scenes. Given a context video, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that enforces multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality throughout the generation process. In addition, we develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving consistency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high-fidelity geometry across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出ChronoWorld框架，基于"观测-状态-反思"范式，利用时空因果线索与重建先验生成全局一致的自由视角4D场景。
AI.motivation: 现有相机可控视频生成模型虽能产生视觉上吸引人的序列，但难以保持内在的4D时空一致性。
AI.method: 1) 时空极线因果注意力机制，在整个生成过程中施加多视角极线约束与时间因果关系；2) 重建驱动的几何反射流水线，配合4D检索策略实现动态自评与修正。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ChronoWorld在时空一致、电影级质量的4D场景生成上达到最先进性能，具有强泛化性和跨多样化场景的高保真几何。
AI.conclusion: ChronoWorld通过结合因果注意力与重建反思机制，有效提升自由视角4D场景生成的时空一致性与几何精度。

title: The Review Lottery: Calibrating an Observational Estimator of Peer-Review Noise (ICLR 2017-2025)
summary: How much of a conference accept/reject decision would change if the same paper were reviewed by a different set of reviewers? Running a second independent program committee is the gold standard for answering this, but it is prohibitively expensive: done only twice (NeurIPS 2014 and 2021). We build an observational estimator of this quantity from public review data alone, calibrate it twice, and apply it to nine years of ICLR (2017-2025; 36,113 papers, 134,912 reviews). The estimator decomposes scores with a Bayesian ordered-probit model into paper quality and reviewer noise, maps scores to decisions with a logistic model, and simulates two independent committees (posterior draws B=1,000; committee sizes k=2,3,4). Estimated disagreement rates are 23-30% at k=2 and 18-24% at k=4; 30-50% of accepted papers would be rejected. External calibration: at the NeurIPS 2021 reviewer-count caliber (k=3), the simulated 2021 disagreement rate is 23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%] vs. reported 23.0% (bias +0.3pp); accept precision and committee correlation agree within 5pp and 0.04. Internal calibration: on 18,740 papers with 4+ reviews, random model-free 2+2 reviewer splits agree with the k=2 simulation within 1pp in 2018 and 2021-2025. Longitudinally, we find no robust time trend in reviewer noise over 2017-2025.
