The high accepted-paper flip rates of 2020 and 2021 have distinct mechanisms: the 2020 four-point scale compressed scores (23.7% of papers had zero within-paper variance), and a counterfactual shows coarsening the scale raises disagreement by about 7pp; 2021 instead combined the lowest signal-to-noise ratio in the sample with the most threshold-crowded acceptances. For the LLM era, a 2023 breakpoint test on within-paper score variance finds no break, but the design has almost no power, and no post-2022 review text or confidence data exist, so no LLM attribution is attempted.

AI.tldr: 该论文仅用公开评审数据构建了一个观察性估计器，用于估计"若换一组审稿人，会议接收/拒稿决定会有多大变化"，并在NeurIPS 2021和ICLR内部数据上完成双重校准，随后应用于ICLR 2017-2025共36,113篇论文、134,912条评审。
AI.motivation: 回答"更换审稿人集合后会议决定会改变多少"的黄金标准是运行第二个独立程序委员会，但成本极高，迄今只在NeurIPS 2014和2021实施过两次。作者希望用仅靠公开评审数据即可获得的观察性估计器来替代这一昂贵实验，从而在大规模、长时段上量化审稿噪声对决定的影响。
AI.method: 方法分三步：首先用贝叶斯有序Probit模型（ordered-probit）将评审分数分解为论文质量与审稿人噪声；其次用Logistic模型将分数映射为接收/拒稿决定；最后通过后验抽样（B=1,000次）模拟两个相互独立的程序委员会，委员会规模分别取k=2、3、4。外部校准使用NeurIPS 2021审稿人数（k=3）作为基准；内部校准使用18,740篇有4条以上评审的论文，进行无模型随机2+2拆分，与k=2的模拟结果对比。
AI.result: 估计的不一致率在k=2时为23-30%，k=4时为18-24%；30-50%被接收的论文在换审稿人后会被拒。外部校准：NeurIPS 2021（k=3）模拟不一致率为23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%]，报告值为23.0%，偏差仅+0.3pp；接收精度与委员会相关性分别在5pp和0.04以内吻合。内部校准：在2018年及2021-2025年，随机2+2拆分与k=2模拟在1pp内吻合。纵向看，2017-2025年间审稿人噪声无稳健时间趋势。2020和2021年高翻转率机制不同：2020年四分制压缩了分数（23.7%论文的论文内方差为零），反事实显示粗化评分尺度会使不一致率上升约7pp；2021年则叠加了样本中最低的信噪比与最拥挤的接收阈值。针对LLM时代，2023年论文内分数方差的断点检验未发现断点，但设计功效极低，且2022年后无评审文本或置信度数据，故未尝试归因于LLM。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的观察性估计器在两次独立校准中均与真实数据高度一致（偏差仅0.3pp），表明仅凭公开评审数据即可可靠量化审稿噪声对会议决定的翻转影响，为大规模、跨年度的同行评审稳健性研究提供了低成本工具。研究还揭示了高翻转率年份的不同机制（评分尺度压缩 vs 低信噪比与阈值拥挤），并指出当前数据尚不足以评估LLM对评审的影响。

title: Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models
summary: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer, a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds, achieving 150 to 137,000 times and 133 to 20,000 times speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tracer 框架，在无需预先知道被删除概念的前提下，快速识别未学习扩散模型中已被擦除的概念并估计其数量，速度比 MIA 与暴力搜索快 150–137,000 倍且精度更高。
AI.motivation: 现有针对未学习扩散模型的攻击假设被擦除概念已知，仅关注恢复它们。但现实中模型提供方未必披露删除内容，即使能访问原始基座模型，攻击者也缺乏明确目标。因此论文关注两个被忽视的关键问题：模型中哪些概念被擦除、共擦除了多少。
AI.method: Tracer 通过权重足迹的轻量谱分析高效识别被擦除概念，避免生成与分类图像，从而可在大规模候选词表上高效搜索；引入足迹覆盖目标引导顺序发现以区分多个被擦除概念；通过检测候选置信度在所选概念覆盖擦除足迹时的急剧下降来估计被擦除概念数量，无需标注样本校准。框架仅需轻量线性代数与有限前向探测，不依赖未学习算法先验知识。
AI.result: 在文生图与文生视频骨干网络及多种未学习方法上，Tracer 可在数秒内识别被擦除概念并估计其数量；在图像与视频模型上分别相对 MIA 与暴力搜索取得 150–137,000 倍与 133–20,000 倍加速，且识别准确率显著更高。
AI.conclusion: Tracer 首次系统性地解决未学习扩散模型中“删了什么、删了多少”的问题，以低成本、算法无关的方式实现快速且准确的概念擦除识别与数量估计，为未学习模型审计提供了实用工具。

title: GS-Pool: Object-Level Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Factories, museums and surveyors photograph the same space months apart and need to know which objects changed. When each visit is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a direct comparison of the two reconstructions does not answer this. Training is stochastic, so two reconstructions of an unchanged space never coincide, and the second visit is often a quick re-scan with far fewer photographs. We propose GS-Pool, which takes two independently reconstructed Gaussian fields of the same space and returns the changed objects in each, together with their masks. SAM2 masks of each visit's photographs are lifted onto the Gaussians that render them and merged into an object pool, so every decision is taken once per object in 3D. We introduce a photographic carrier, the 3DGS training loss of each input reconstruction against the other visit's photographs, backpropagated to the Gaussians that rendered each pixel. We combine it with GS-Diff's geometry and colour terms and our distilled DINOv3 features. This evidence is compared with that of the objects present in both visits, which sets a change threshold for each scene. On PASLCD, GS-Pool reaches mIoU/F1 scores of 0.751/0.846 against 0.644/0.758 for GS-Diff, the strongest prior method, a gain of 17%/12%. Its mIoU is also 36%, 40% and 57% above that of O-SCD, PlenoCI and MV-3DCD, and it reaches 0.855 mIoU on CL-Splats, 33% above MV-3DCD. Each changed object is returned as a set of Gaussians with the evidence behind its decision, which an inspector can review in 3D.

AI.tldr: 提出 GS-Pool：对同一空间两次独立 3DGS 重建做对象级变化检测，输出变化对象及其掩码。
AI.motivation: 工厂、博物馆、测量场景需跨月判断同一空间哪些物体发生变化。但两次访问的 3DGS 重建无法直接比较：训练具随机性，未变化空间的重建也不会重合；且第二次访问常为照片远少于首次的快速重扫。因此需要一种对重建不确定性鲁棒的对象级变化检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 将每次访问照片的 SAM2 掩码提升到渲染这些像素的高斯上，合并为对象池，使判定在 3D 中以对象为单位各做一次。2) 引入"摄影载体"：用一次重建的高斯场对另一次访问的照片做 3DGS 训练损失，并反传到渲染各像素的高斯。3) 将其与 GS-Diff 的几何项、颜色项以及蒸馏的 DINOv3 特征结合。4) 与两次访问中均存在的对象证据比较，为每个场景设定变化阈值。
AI.result: 在 PASLCD 上 mIoU/F1 达 0.751/0.846，优于最强基线 GS-Diff 的 0.644/0.758，提升 17%/12%；mIoU 相对 O-SCD、PlenoCI、MV-3DCD 分别高 36%、40%、57%。在 CL-Splats 上 mIoU 达 0.855，比 MV-3DCD 高 33%。每个变化对象以一组高斯及其判定证据返回，可供检查者在 3D 中复核。
AI.conclusion: GS-Pool 将跨次 3DGS 重建的差异比较转化为 3D 对象级的多证据判定，显著超越现有变化检测方法，并提供可审查的证据与高斯集合。

title: Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving
comment: Jiaqi Zhao, Haodong Chen, and Jitai Hao contributed equally
summary:
LLM agents increasingly execute complex workflows involving multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and parallel agents. Efficient serving requires decisions that span two layers with complementary information: the agent harness understands workflow dependencies, context lifecycles, and execution objectives, whereas the inference engine observes request queues, KV-cache state, resource pressure, and execution capabilities. Existing interfaces do not systematically connect these views, limiting workflow-aware execution.
  HEAR, a bidirectional Harness--Engine Pairing protocol for agentic LLM serving. HEAR standardizes how the harness communicates workflow intent and execution requirements and how the engine returns runtime state, capabilities, and outcomes. By separating protocol semantics from optimization policies, HEAR supports diverse coordination strategies without changing workflow or model semantics. We instantiate HEAR for online cache-aware runtime coordination and workload-aware execution-mode selection for agent roles.
  Across four conversational and research-agent benchmarks under memory-constrained, concurrent serving, HEAR achieves a $1.61\times$ batch speedup and reduces median time-to-first-token by $2.23\times$ on SCBench. Mooncake shows that workflow intent and live engine state provide complementary benefits across load regimes. On BrowseComp-Plus and DeepResearchBench, workload-specific configurations yield $1.23\times$ and $2.45\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, without observed task-quality degradation. These results establish HEAR as a reusable coordination substrate for efficient agentic LLM serving.

AI.tldr: HEAR是一种面向智能体LLM服务的双向"框架—引擎"配对协议，通过标准化工作流意图与运行时状态的交换，实现工作流感知的高效调度，在多个基准上取得显著加速。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需执行多轮推理、工具调用与并行智能体等复杂工作流。高效服务需要在两个信息互补的层面做决策：智能体框架掌握工作流依赖、上下文生命周期与执行目标；推理引擎则观测请求队列、KV缓存状态、资源压力与执行能力。然而现有接口未能系统性地连接这两个视图，限制了工作流感知的执行。
AI.method: 提出HEAR——一种面向智能体LLM服务的双向框架—引擎配对协议。该协议标准化了框架如何传达工作流意图与执行需求，以及引擎如何回传运行时状态、能力与结果。通过将协议语义与优化策略分离，HEAR可在不改变工作流或模型语义的前提下支持多种协调策略。作者针对两个场景实例化HEAR：在线缓存感知的运行时协调，以及面向智能体角色的工作负载感知执行模式选择。
AI.result: 在内存受限、并发服务条件下，于四个对话与研究智能体基准上，HEAR在SCBench上实现1.61倍批处理加速，并将首Token延迟中位数降低2.23倍；Mooncake结果表明工作流意图与实时引擎状态在不同负载区间提供互补收益；在BrowseComp-Plus与DeepResearchBench上，工作负载专用配置分别带来1.23倍与2.45倍的端到端加速，且未观察到任务质量下降。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果确立了HEAR作为面向高效智能体LLM服务的可复用协调基底的定位。

title: Delay-coordinate reconstruction and conditional-moment causal diagnostics in stochastic systems
summary: Partial observation and delay-coordinate reconstruction are rooted in deterministic dynamical-systems theory, whereas there are many systems with intrinsic stochasticity. We propose a conditional-moment interpretation of delay-coordinate reconstruction for stochastic systems, in which a delay vector is used to reconstruct conditional moments of a future distribution rather than a unique future sample path. Two complementary arguments motivate this viewpoint. First, the probability density of a stochastic differential equation obeys a deterministic Fokker-Planck equation and, under certain assumptions, is represented by an infinite deterministic hierarchy of moments. Hence, a finite-moment closure suggests a Takens-like finite-dimensional approximation. Second, a discussion based on the Koopman operator theory clarifies that the time evolution of an observable in the Mori-Zwanzig formalism yields a conditional expectation in stochastic systems. Then, the orthogonal "noise" term in the coefficient-space Mori-Zwanzig equation vanishes in the stochastic cases; this result is consistent with the moment-based argument. As an application of this stochastic delay-reconstruction viewpoint, we revisit convergent cross mapping (CCM) for diagnosing certain causal relationships. Although CCM based on the embedding theorem cannot generally be applied to stochastic systems, it is possible to examine certain types of causal relationships by using conditional moments. Using coupled logistic systems with additive and multiplicative coupling mechanisms, we discuss how causal relationships are embedded in stochastic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将延迟坐标重构从确定性系统扩展到随机系统，提出"条件矩"解释：延迟向量用于重构未来分布的条件矩而非唯一未来样本路径，并据此重新审视CCM在随机系统中的因果诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 经典延迟坐标重构与Takens嵌入定理根植于确定性动力系统理论，但许多实际系统具有内在随机性，原始嵌入框架难以直接适用，因此需要为随机系统建立延迟重构的理论解释。
AI.method: 提出随机系统延迟坐标重构的条件矩解释，并用两条互补论证支撑：(1) 随机微分方程的概率密度服从确定性Fokker-Planck方程，在特定假设下可由无限维确定性矩层级表示，有限矩闭合对应Takens式有限维近似；(2) 基于Koopman算子理论，说明Mori-Zwanzig形式中可观测量演化在随机系统下给出条件期望，且系数空间Mori-Zwanzig方程中的正交"噪声"项在随机情形下消失，与矩论证一致；最后以耦合logistic系统（加性与乘性耦合）为算例。
AI.result: 理论上，两条论证相互印证：Fokker-Planck的矩层级支持有限维近似，Mori-Zwanzig中噪声项在随机情形下消失；应用上，基于嵌入定理的CCM一般不能用于随机系统，但利用条件矩可诊断某些类型因果关系，并在加性与乘性耦合的耦合logistic系统中展示了因果关系如何嵌入随机系统。
AI.conclusion: 延迟坐标重构在随机系统中应理解为条件矩重构而非唯一轨迹重构；该视角为随机系统因果诊断提供了理论基础，并使基于条件矩的CCM拓展成为可能。

title: Extending Dynamic World Surface Water Mapping to Sentinel-1 with AlphaEarth Embeddings
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; includes 3 pages of supplementary material
summary: Dynamic World (DW) maps land use and land cover globally at 10 m from Sentinel-2 (S2) imagery, but only for cloud-free observations, which limits where and when surface water can be mapped. We use the DW water class as weak supervision for a Sentinel-1 (S1) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) model so that DW-like water maps can be produced for every S1 acquisition. Google's AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) annual embedding supplies spatial context, while S1 backscatter supplies the acquisition-time observation. On 53 globally distributed scenes with independent annotations of 3 m PlanetScope imagery acquired within 48 h of the S1 overpass, the S1-only model already reaches a pooled water intersection over union (IoU) of 0.77, comparable to 0.75 for the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product, and adding AEF raises it to 0.85. The fused model improves on the S1-only model on 44 of 53 scenes and exceeds OPERA on 48, and on the independent S1S2-Water benchmark it reaches 0.94, compared with 0.87 for OPERA. Optical land-cover products can thus provide scalable training labels for SAR surface water mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以Dynamic World（DW）水类作为弱监督标签训练Sentinel-1 SAR水体提取模型，并融合Google AlphaEarth Foundations年度嵌入提供空间上下文，实现任意S1过境时刻的类DW水体制图。
AI.motivation: DW基于Sentinel-2光学影像提供全球10 m土地覆盖制图，但受云遮挡限制，只能在无云观测时映射地表水，时空覆盖存在缺口；而SAR具备全天候成像能力，却缺乏大规模高质量标签。因此需要一种可扩展的方式将光学产品的标签迁移到SAR水体制图上。
AI.method: 将DW水体类别作为弱监督信号训练S1 SAR模型；以S1后向散射提供成像时刻观测，以AEF年度嵌入提供空间上下文，构建S1-only与S1+AEF融合模型。在53个全球分布场景上，使用S1过境48小时内获取的3 m PlanetScope独立标注进行验证，并与业务化OPERA DSWx-S1产品及独立S1S2-Water基准比较。
AI.result: S1-only模型在53个场景上的汇总水体IoU为0.77，与OPERA DSWx-S1的0.75相当；加入AEF后提升至0.85。融合模型在44/53个场景上优于S1-only模型，在48个场景上超过OPERA；在独立S1S2-Water基准上达到0.94，高于OPERA的0.87。
AI.conclusion: 光学土地覆盖产品可为SAR地表水制图提供可扩展的训练标签，结合SAR成像时刻观测与年度嵌入空间上下文，能够在任意S1采集上生成接近DW质量的水体图，并超越现有业务化产品。

title: FREA: A Multi-Source Expert Benchmark for Reaction Feasibility Verification
summary: As generative models and AI agents propose chemical reactions at a scale beyond expert review, feasibility verifiers decide which proposals enter synthesis planning. But do their decisions agree with chemists across different kinds of candidates? We introduce FREA, a benchmark of 751 reactions labeled by expert chemists under an explicit feasibility criterion, drawn from retrosynthesis model proposals, zero-yield experimental records, edits by large language models (LLMs), and five negative candidate generation methods. Our evaluation finds that no verifier leads across all sources: LLMs given only the criterion are competitive with dedicated verifiers, while forward models perform best on retrosynthesis proposals but reject most feasible edits of recorded reactions at the evaluated operating points. Looking beyond aggregate scores, both forward models perform below chance when separating infeasible alternative disconnections from feasible generated candidates. To study whether negative supervision addresses these weaknesses, we also release a corpus of over 14 million recorded reactions and generated negative candidates. In matched training comparisons, adding a mixture of generated negatives to forward training raises mean AUROC across sources, but these gains do not extend to retrosynthesis proposals. Varying the generation method further shows that the largest gain on generated candidates coincides with worse proposal screening. These findings motivate evaluating verifiers against experts across sources and designing negatives for transfer to model proposals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FREA基准（751个经化学专家标注的反应可行性数据集），系统评估了多种可行性验证器在不同来源候选反应上的表现，发现没有任何验证器能全面领先，并进一步探讨了负样本监督的作用与局限。
AI.motivation: 随着生成模型和AI智能体提出的化学反应规模超出专家审核能力，可行性验证器成为决定哪些提案进入合成规划的关键环节。然而，验证器的判断是否在不同类型候选反应上与化学专家一致，尚不清楚，这构成了本文的核心研究动机。
AI.method: 构建FREA基准，包含751个由专家化学家依据明确可行性标准标注的反应，候选来源于逆合成模型提案、零产率实验记录、LLM编辑以及五种负样本生成方法。对多种验证器（含LLM验证器、前向模型等）进行评估，并发布包含超1400万条记录反应及生成负样本的语料库，通过匹配训练对比研究负样本监督效果。
AI.result: 没有任何验证器在所有来源上全面领先：仅给定标准的LLM与专用验证器表现相当；前向模型在逆合成提案上表现最佳，但在评估操作点上拒绝了大多数已记录反应的可行编辑；两个前向模型在区分不可行替代断键与可行生成候选时表现低于随机水平。在匹配训练对比中，向前向训练加入生成负样本混合物可提升跨来源的平均AUROC，但增益未延伸至逆合成提案；改变生成方法显示，生成候选上增益最大时，提案筛选表现反而更差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，验证器需针对不同来源的候选反应与专家判断进行多样化评估，且负样本设计应着眼于向模型提案的迁移能力，而非仅优化生成候选上的表现。

title: When Does a Diffusion Model Decide What to Draw ?
summary: A diffusion model starts from pure noise and removes it step by step. Somewhere along the way it stops being able to become "anything" and becomes committed to, say, a horse rather than a truck. We measure when this happens, and what a trained model gets wrong about it, on CIFAR-10. The most direct measurement is to freeze a half-finished image, restart the generation from that point many times, and count how often each class comes out. We call this probability the committor. Measured this way, the model settles coarse questions (vehicle or animal?) at roughly twice the noise level of fine ones (which animal?). A much cheaper measurement, the noise level at which a classifier's opinion about two classes splits into two distinct groups, gets the order of these decisions right (rank correlation 0.73-0.88) but not their exact timing. We then compare pretrained models with their

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"committor"（冻结半成品噪声图像并多次重启计数各类别出现频率）测量扩散模型何时从"可变成任何物"转为"锁定某类"，发现粗粒度决策发生在细粒度决策约两倍的噪声水平；一种基于分类器意见分裂的廉价测量能正确排序决策顺序（秩相关0.73–0.88）但无法精确刻画时间。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型从纯噪声逐步去噪，中途会从"可以是任何东西"的模糊状态转向确定某一类别（如马而非卡车）。作者希望量化这一承诺（commitment）发生的时间点，并揭示训练模型在此过程中的偏差。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10上，最直接的测量是冻结半去噪图像，从该点多次重启生成，统计各类别出现频率，称该概率为committor。另采用更廉价的测量：分类器对两个类别的意见分裂为两组的噪声水平。随后对比预训练模型与其……（摘要截断）。
AI.result: 模型对粗粒度问题（车辆还是动物？）的承诺约发生在细粒度问题（哪种动物？）两倍的噪声水平。廉价测量方法在决策顺序上排序正确（秩相关0.73–0.88），但无法准确反映确切时间点。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的语义承诺时间存在层级差异：粗粒度类别先于细粒度类别确定。分类器分裂法可作为决策顺序的廉价代理指标，但不能替代committor进行精确定时。摘要末尾与预训练模型对比的部分因截断无法完整分析。

title: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a $1.80\times$ denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a $2.32\times$ speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练稀疏注意力框架MC-Sparse，通过将相似查询分组、精确选择KV token并缓存元数据（查询组、KV索引、稠密-稀疏残差）在去噪步间复用，在视频与3D生成任务上实现高于现有基线的保真度与更大加速，接近稠密注意力输出且无明显质量损失。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer在长序列生成（视频、高分辨率3D资产）中延迟高，稀疏注意力是主要加速手段，但现有方法在高稀疏度下会损害生成质量与保真度。作者通过受控的oracle对比，将退化归因于三方面：token分组带来的约束、交互选择不准确，以及被丢弃token所丢失的注意力贡献。
AI.method: 提出MC-Sparse：一种免训练框架。它选择单个KV token，同时将相似查询组织为tile对齐的分组以便高效GPU执行；缓存元数据，包括查询分组、基于精确注意力概率选出的KV索引，以及稠密与稀疏注意力输出之间的残差，并在后续去噪步中复用这些元数据。
AI.result: 在视频与3D生成模型上，MC-Sparse对稠密注意力输出的保真度更高、去噪加速比现有稀疏注意力基线更大，且无可见质量退化。相对于稠密注意力，在Minimax-H3-Base上获得1.80×去噪加速，在3D资产生成上获得2.32×加速，质量损失均可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过oracle分析定位稀疏注意力退化的三个来源并针对性设计，MC-Sparse以免训练方式实现高保真、高加速的稀疏注意力，在长序列扩散Transformer生成任务中优于现有基线，兼顾效率与质量。

title: Collective intelligence through aggregation
comment: This is a preprint of a paper published in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B (2026) 381 (1948): 20240454
summary: Suppose a committee, expert panel, or other group is making judgments on some issues, where these may be not just yes/no-questions, such as whether a defendant is guilty, but also variables with many possible values, such as macroeconomic or meteorological variables or travel directions. Furthermore, there may be interconnections between different issues, as in the case of economic or climate variables. How can the group arrive at "intelligent" collective judgments, based on the group members' individual judgments? We investigate three challenges raised by this judgment-aggregation problem. First, reasonable methods of aggregation (such as defining the collective judgment for each issue as the average or median judgment) can produce inconsistent collective judgments. Secondly, many methods of aggregation are manipulable by strategic voting. Finally, not all methods of aggregation are conducive to tracking the truth on the issues in question. We prove new impossibility or possibility theorems on all three challenges, identifying what it takes to produce collective judgments in a consistent, non-manipulable, and truth-tracking manner and thereby to achieve collective intelligence through aggregation. Overall, the median method, though imperfect, performs reasonably well. We also note the relevance of our analysis for non-human group decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究群体对多值、相互关联议题的判断聚合问题，围绕一致性、策略防操纵性与真值追踪三大挑战，给出新的不可能性与可能性定理，结论是多数中位数法虽不完美但表现尚可。
AI.motivation: 现实中的群体判断往往不只是“是/否”问题，还涉及多值变量（如宏观经济、气象变量、旅行方向），且议题之间可能存在相互关联（如经济或气候变量）。因此需要研究如何基于成员个体判断得到“智能”的集体判断。
AI.method: 以判断聚合（judgment aggregation）为框架，考察三类挑战：一是合理聚合方法（如取各议题的平均值或中位数）可能产生不一致的集体判断；二是许多聚合方法易受策略性投票操纵；三是并非所有聚合方法都有助于追踪议题真值。作者针对这三类挑战分别证明新的不可能性或可能性定理，界定实现一致、不可操纵且能追踪真值的集体判断所需条件。
AI.result: 作者在三类挑战上均获得新的不可能性或可能性定理，明确了通过聚合实现集体智能所需满足的条件；并发现中位数方法虽然存在缺陷，但整体表现较为合理。
AI.conclusion: 要在一致性、防操纵与真值追踪三方面同时取得良好效果，聚合方法面临严格的理论约束；中位数方法是在这些约束下相对稳健的选择。该分析对非人类群体决策亦具有参考意义。

title: Training and Scaling Compute-Optimal Physiological Waveform Foundation Models
summary: We investigate the scaling laws and compute-optimal training of physiological waveform foundation models (FMs). We train Aether, a family of over one hundred FMs ranging from 20M to 2.1B parameters, on up to 36.3M hours of physiological waveforms. We construct eight clinical prediction tasks from MIMIC-III and evaluate the FMs through linear probing. The 720M FM outperforms all existing baseline FMs across all eight tasks. A scaling law of model size, pretraining hours, and labeled patients predicts downstream ranking error, i.e. $1-\mathrm{AUROC}$, effectively with $0.5\%$ prediction MAE at held-out resource scales and $0.9\%$ MAE when extrapolating to 2.1B parameters. We present three findings: (1) Compute-optimal training scales both FM size and pretraining hours. Under the fitted law, a $10.0\times$ increase in compute FLOPs scales model size by $1.2\times$ and pretraining hours by $8.2\times$. (2) Larger FMs use waveform data more efficiently, and greater pretraining exposure increases the benefit of model scaling. Starting from 25M parameters and 4.8M pretraining hours, doubling FM size reduces the predicted hours needed for the same performance by $51.8\%$. (3) Pretraining and clinical supervision reinforce each other: more labeled patients increase the return to pretraining, while larger FMs and longer pretraining reduce labeling requirements. For the example of the 720M FM, extending pretraining from 120K to 36.3M hours reduces the predicted patient requirement by $61\%$ at a target ranking error. These findings provide a quantitative training recipe and a promising and durable scaling path for physiological waveform modeling and downstream clinical prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生理波形基础模型的缩放定律与算力最优训练方法，训练了Aether系列（20M–2.1B参数）模型，并给出量化训练配方与临床预测任务上的验证。
AI.motivation: 探索生理波形基础模型是否存在可预测的缩放规律，以及如何在模型规模与预训练时长之间进行算力最优分配，同时量化预训练与临床监督之间的相互增益，为生理波形建模提供可扩展的训练路径。
AI.method: 训练Aether系列100余个基础模型（20M–2.1B参数），预训练数据最多为36.3M小时生理波形；基于MIMIC-III构建8个临床预测任务，采用线性探测（linear probing）评估；拟合模型规模、预训练小时数与标注患者数对下游排序误差（1−AUROC）的缩放定律。
AI.result: 720M模型在全部8个任务上超越所有现有基线基础模型；拟合的缩放定律在留出资源尺度上预测MAE为0.5%，外推至2.1B参数时为0.9%。三项发现：(1) 算力最优训练同时扩展模型规模与预训练时长，算力FLOPs增加10.0倍时模型规模扩大1.2倍、预训练时长扩大8.2倍；(2) 更大模型对波形数据利用更高效，从25M参数、4.8M预训练小时出发，模型规模翻倍可使达到同等性能所需预训练小时减少51.8%；(3) 预训练与临床监督相互增强，标注患者增多提升预训练回报，更大模型与更长预训练降低标注需求，720M模型预训练从120K延长至36.3M小时，在目标排序误差下预测患者需求量减少61%。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了生理波形基础模型的定量训练配方，并证明其具备可持续的缩放路径，能够有效支撑下游临床预测任务。

title: Less Context, Better Geometry: Masked Geometric Encoder for Robust 3D Foundation Models
summary: Recent progress in 3D foundation models has enabled rapid 3D reconstruction and camera calibration by leveraging learned 3D priors from vast amount of spatial data. However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views. In this paper, We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context. During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation. Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出掩码几何编码器（MGE）与锚点引导自适应令牌合并，提升三维基础模型在遮挡与相似视图下的鲁棒性并加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有3D基础模型依赖全对全全局注意力，带来二次复杂度、长序列推理受限，且无约束的跨视图交互会传播来自遮挡视图或视觉相似但几何距离较远视图的不可靠信息。
AI.method: 提出Masked Geometric Encoder（MGE）：训练时策略性地从全局注意力中丢弃帧令牌，并从预训练的全上下文教师模型进行蒸馏，从而学习更丰富的单帧表示并提供中间监督；推理时提出Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging，保留代表性锚点帧，同时合并其余视图中的冗余令牌。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MGE在遮挡与doppelganger视图下性能显著增强，同时在标准基准上保持高性能；相比其他高效推理方法，可在有限视图设置下实现推理加速并持续保持更高的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过在不完整跨视图上下文下学习鲁棒几何表示并结合锚点引导令牌合并，可在提升遮挡鲁棒性的同时实现高效推理，兼顾重建质量与速度。

title: Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables; Supplementary Information included as an appendix; figure source data as ancillary files
summary: Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.

AI.tldr: 该研究用30对力学问题（有效版与人为致不可行版）测试14个语言模型，分别评估"解题正确性"与"对缺陷题的拒答能力"。三个近期模型中90条回复有12条未拒答，其中11条虽指出了缺陷、却仍将原题标为已解。改用"flawed"提示后拒答率显著上升但有效题解题率下降。结论：评测须同时考察两个版本，并区分缺陷识别与上报状态。
AI.motivation: 工程计算题的答案准确率无法反映模型是否能识别并拒答物理上不可行的问题。若模型对缺陷题给出貌似正确的答案，会掩盖其缺乏审慎性判断的风险，因此需要一套能分离"解题能力"与"拒答/识别能力"的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建30对力学问题，每对含一个有效版本和一个通过修改给定值或假设而变得物理不可行（impossible）的版本；由两名独立解题者核验所有答案并确认缺陷版确实物理不可行。测试14个模型，初始提示不告知题目可能有缺陷，要求每条回复标注"solved"或"cannot solve"，拒答定义为标注"cannot solve"或拒绝给出答案。随后对同一提供方的4个模型重测，将选项改为"flawed"并要求其指出并解释缺陷。评估同时采用AI评分者与数值检查，并统计拒答率与有效题解题率的变化显著性。
AI.result: 三个近期模型的90条回复中有12条未拒答缺陷题；其中11条模型自行陈述了缺陷、改答了修正后的问题，却仍把原题标为"solved"。改用"flawed"提示重测后，三个模型拒答率出现统计显著上升，但其中三个模型的有效题解题率下降，呈现拒答与解题能力的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 评测应同时对有效版和缺陷版计分，并明确区分"缺陷识别"（是否察觉到问题不可行）与"上报状态"（是否据此标注拒答），否则会高估模型在工程计算中的可靠性。

title: Graph Data Augmentation via Contrastive Generator Inversion ($\texttt{DCBA}$)
comment: Accepted to 5th Learning on Graphs Conference; Boston, MA, USA; 20-22.11.2026
summary: Graphs provide a natural representation of many complex systems, ranging from social platforms to ecosystems. However, the development of graph-based machine learning methods is often constrained by the limited availability of large and diverse graph datasets. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{DCBA}$, a model-based approach to graph data augmentation that infers the configuration of a synthetic graph generator from an observed network. We instantiate the proposed framework using the $\texttt{ABCD}$ generator, which produces scale-free networks with community structure. Our model learns a joint representation of graphs and generator parametrisations using a multi-positive contrastive objective with soft negative weighting. The learned representation enables the prediction of an $\texttt{ABCD}$ configuration whose stochastic realisations preserve the macrostructural properties encoded by the generator. Experiments show that $\texttt{DCBA}$ recovers generator parameters more accurately and robustly than an algorithmic inverse-modelling baseline. Its downstream utility is further demonstrated in community detection, where inferred configurations used to fine-tune $\texttt{PRoCD}$ improve AMI on average by $161\%$ on synthetic and $273\%$ on real-world networks.

AI.tldr: 提出 DCBA：一种基于模型的图数据增强方法，通过多正对比学习从观测网络反推 ABCD 生成器配置，用于生成保持宏观结构特性的合成图。
AI.motivation: 图机器学习方法的发展受限于大规模、多样化图数据集稀缺。数据增强是缓解该问题的思路，但现有方法多依赖启发式扰动，难以保证生成图的结构合理性。本文希望从观测网络本身推断生成器参数，从而合成结构一致的新图。
AI.method: 以 ABCD（带社区结构的无标度网络生成器）为实例化对象，将图数据增强建模为生成器配置的推断问题。使用多正对比目标并引入软负权重，学习图与生成器参数化配置的联合表示；基于该表示预测 ABCD 配置，使其随机实现保持生成器编码的宏观结构特性。
AI.result: 相比算法式逆建模基线，DCBA 恢复生成器参数的精度与鲁棒性更高；在下游社区检测任务中，用推断配置微调 PRoCD，合成网络上 AMI 平均提升 161%，真实网络上平均提升 273%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，将图增强转化为生成器配置的反演问题，并以对比学习实现，可有效提升合成图的结构保真度与下游任务性能，为图数据增强提供了基于模型的可行范式。

title: The Pushback Paradox: A Two-Probe Diagnostic for Language Model Compliance
summary: Are language models compliant with user instructions? A model that always complies can be stopped but also exploited, while one that always resists can be neither exploited nor stopped. We contribute an open two-probe benchmark that can place any language model on this spectrum. In the active probe, a user instructs the model to act and accept a lower payoff, which measures exploitability. In the passive probe, the user instructs it to wait and give up a higher payoff, which measures stoppability. The two compliance rates combine into a compliance index $κ$. Applied to twelve language models, the benchmark shows that seven mostly follow the instruction in both probes and justify their action by pointing to the instruction. Only Claude Sonnet-4.6 and Claude Opus-4.7 can be stopped without being exploitable, Claude Opus-4.6 and GPT-5-mini resist both instructions, and no model is exploitable but unstoppable. Knowing where a language model sits on the compliance index $κ$ matters for human operators and for multi-agent systems, whether distributed or orchestrated.

AI.tldr: 提出一个开放的双探针基准，将任意语言模型定位在"可被利用—可被叫停"的合规谱系上，用主动探针测可利用性、被动探针测可叫停性，并以合规指数κ综合两项合规率；在12个模型上验证了谱系分布。
AI.motivation: 语言模型对用户指令的合规程度存在两种极端风险：始终合规的模型虽可被叫停，但也易被利用；始终抗拒的模型既不会被利用，也无法被叫停。现有工作缺乏一个能同时量化这两种属性的统一工具，因此作者希望建立一个可将任意模型定位在该谱系上的基准。
AI.method: 设计开放的双探针（two-probe）基准。主动探针中，用户指令模型执行行动并接受较低收益，用以衡量可利用性（exploitability）；被动探针中，用户指令模型等待并放弃较高收益，用以衡量可叫停性（stoppability）。将两项合规率组合为合规指数κ，并对12个语言模型进行评测。
AI.result: 在12个语言模型上，7个模型在两个探针中大多遵循指令，并通过援引指令来为自身行为辩护；仅Claude Sonnet-4.6与Claude Opus-4.7可被叫停而不被利用；Claude Opus-4.6与GPT-5-mini对两项指令均予抗拒；没有任何模型既可被利用又不可被叫停。
AI.conclusion: 模型在合规指数κ上的位置对人类操作者以及分布式或编排式多智能体系统都具有重要意义。

title: Bellman-Centric Learning: Near-Optimal Regret for Linear Bandits with Memory
summary: We study linear bandits with memory, where past actions induce endogenous nonstationarity through an arbitrary known, bounded matrix-valued memory map. To trade off exploration and exploitation while accounting for the memory dynamics, we develop RSM-LinUCB, a Bellman-centric algorithm that learns as in linear bandits and plans as in reinforcement learning. This design admits a novel regret decomposition which separates the memory-induced error from the cumulative reward estimation error along the learner's trajectory. We prove a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde O\big(dRS(M+1)+σd\sqrt T\big)$, where $T$ is the learning horizon, $d$ is the parameter dimension, $M$ is the memory length, $R$ and $S$ bound the memory-map operator norm and reward-parameter norm, respectively, and $σ$ is the sub-Gaussian noise scale. Our results reveal that the multiplicative memory-horizon coupling in prior bounds is not intrinsic: memory only contributes an additive cost, up to logarithmic factors. We also prove a matching minimax lower bound, establishing near-optimality. We further extend the algorithm to generalized linear rewards, preserving this separation with near-optimal memory and leading statistical dependence. Our algorithms outperform the baselines in numerical experiments on synthetic instances and semi-synthetic KV- and semantic-cache tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带记忆的线性赌博机，提出RSM-LinUCB算法，通过新的遗憾分解证明记忆只带来加性代价，并给出匹配的极小极大下界，验证了近最优性。
AI.motivation: 经典线性赌博机假设动作与奖励独立同分布，然而在过去动作通过已知有界矩阵值记忆映射导致内生非平稳性的场景下，探索与利用的权衡需同时考虑记忆动态，已有界中记忆长度与时间范围呈乘性耦合，其内在性存疑。
AI.method: 提出RSM-LinUCB，一种以Bellman为中心的算法：像线性赌博机一样学习，像强化学习一样规划。该设计给出新的遗憾分解，将记忆诱导误差与沿学习者轨迹的累积奖励估计误差分离；并进一步扩展到广义线性奖励。
AI.result: 证明高概率遗憾界为 Õ(dRS(M+1)+σd√T)，其中T为学习时域、d为参数维度、M为记忆长度、R与S分别为记忆映射算子范数和奖励参数范数的界、σ为次高斯噪声尺度；并证明匹配的极小极大下界，确立近最优性。数值实验中在合成实例及半合成的KV缓存与语义缓存任务上优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明先前界中的记忆-时域乘性耦合并非本质：记忆最多只贡献加性代价（至多对数因子）。该分离在广义线性奖励下依然保持，且记忆与统计依赖均达近最优。

title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
summary: Sliders provide an intuitive interface for continuous image editing. In current generative approaches, however, the slider is simply a rescaling of the method's strength parameter, such as an adapter coefficient, a prompt weight, or an interpolation factor. This strength relates poorly to perceptual change. The image can partially revert as the slider moves, long stretches of the range produce no visible difference, and short intervals transform the image abruptly. Remapping the strength could fix this uneven pace, but only if the trajectory is monotone, which current methods do not enforce. We therefore distinguish the slider from the strength, and require perceptual distance from the input to grow linearly with the slider value. We introduce UniSlider, a lightweight LoRA trained on a few-step editing backbone so that its strength approximates this ideal slider. Few-step sampling lets us impose this objective in pixel space without intermediate ground truth, and the backbone's output is preserved at full strength. However, a low-rank adapter cannot make the strength fully uniform. Our slider is thus an inference-time remapping of the strength, obtained by adaptive sampling. Since training optmizes to make the trajectory monotone, this remapping closes the remaining gap without extra training or parameters. On a new benchmark of 300 continuous edits evaluating uniformity, monotonicity, edit fidelity, and identity preservation, UniSlider outperforms all prior methods and is preferred in a user study.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniSlider，将"滑块值"与"强度参数"解耦，训练轻量 LoRA 使感知距离随滑块值线性增长，并通过推理期自适应采样重映射强度，在连续编辑基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式图像编辑中，滑块只是强度参数（adapter 系数、prompt 权重、插值因子）的重新缩放，而该强度与感知变化关系不佳：滑块移动时图像可能部分回退，长区间无可见变化，短区间又突变。重映射强度可以缓解节奏不均，但前提是轨迹单调，而现有方法并未保证单调性。
AI.method: 将滑块与强度分离，要求感知距离随滑块值线性增长；提出 UniSlider——在少步（few-step）编辑骨干上训练的轻量 LoRA，使其强度逼近理想滑块。少步采样无需中间真值即可在像素空间施加该目标，且全强度时保留骨干输出。由于低秩 adapter 无法使强度完全均匀，进一步将滑块实现为推理期的强度重映射，通过自适应采样获得；训练已优化轨迹单调性，因此该重映射无需额外训练或参数即可弥合剩余差距。
AI.result: 在包含 300 个连续编辑、评估均匀性、单调性、编辑保真度与身份保持的新基准上，UniSlider 优于所有先前方法，并在用户研究中获得更高偏好。
AI.conclusion: UniSlider 通过解耦滑块与强度、结合少步训练目标与推理期自适应采样，实现了感知上均匀、单调的连续图像编辑，且不增加额外训练成本或参数。

title: Conditional Rank Allocation for Taxonomy-Aware Medical Language Model Adaptation
summary: Medical question answering spans specialties and clinical operations that may benefit from different adaptation directions. We propose ARBOR, a parameter-efficient method that selects rank-one components from a shared low-rank basis for each question. An additive gate combines question representations, specialty tags, operation tags, and their interaction; a learned coefficient scales the adapter residual. An illustrative separation under orthogonal, equiprobable subtasks shows how conditional selection can avoid an approximation floor faced by a fixed update with the same active rank. This result motivates the design without asserting a corresponding bound for medical corpora. On Qwen3-8B across CMB, CMExam, MedQA, and MedMCQA, five-seed experiments yield 69.69% mean accuracy across benchmarks, exceeding LoRA r16 and MoELoRA by 1.26 and 1.30 percentage points, respectively. The reported advantage over LoRA r16 increases from 0.08 to 1.94 points as training expands from one to seven specialties. Tag perturbations and atom masking support the usefulness of clinical routing, while atom clusters align with the supplied specialty labels (adjusted Rand index 0.62). Calibration, transfer, and measured costs further characterize the method. These findings support structured conditional adaptation for medical QA, while leaving clinical safety and broader deployment untested.

AI.tldr: ARBOR提出一种参数高效适配方法：从共享低秩基中为每个问题选择秩一组件，通过加性门控融合问题表示、专科与操作标签及其交互来缩放适配器残差；在Qwen3-8B的四个医学QA基准上五种子平均准确率69.69%，优于LoRA r16与MoELoRA，且随专科数增加优势扩大。
AI.motivation: 医学问答跨越多个专科与临床操作，不同任务可能需要不同的适配方向，单一固定更新难以兼顾，因此需要条件化、结构化的参数高效适配方式。
AI.method: 从共享低秩基中选择秩一组件作为每个问题的适配器；使用加性门控结合问题表示、专科标签、操作标签及二者交互，并用学习到的系数缩放适配器残差。以正交等概率子任务下的分离示例说明条件选择可避免固定更新在相同有效秩下的近似下限，作为设计动机而非医学语料上的界。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上，CMB、CMExam、MedQA、MedMCQA五种子实验平均准确率69.69%，比LoRA r16和MoELoRA分别高1.26和1.30个百分点；随训练专科数从1增至7，相对LoRA r16的优势由0.08升至1.94个百分点。标签扰动与原子掩蔽支持临床路由的有效性，原子聚类与给定专科标签一致（调整Rand指数0.62）；并给出校准、迁移与成本测量。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持面向医学QA的结构化条件适配，但临床安全性与更广泛部署尚未验证。

title: Sharp Integrality Gaps in Calibration Distance
summary: We study the offline gap between deterministic calibration distance C and its fractional relaxation L for binary unit-weight sequences under total absolute-change cost. We sharpen the offline comparison C <= L + O(sqrt(T)) (Qiao and Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2) to the sharp worst-case order Theta(T^(1/3)). If Delta_T is the supremum of C - L over length-T inputs, then T^(1/3)/1000 <= Delta_T <= 41T^(1/3) for T >= 216. The upper bound holds for every input, while each T >= 216 has a rational lower-bound input. For every input with m distinct forecasts, C <= L + m, and the unrestricted-sample worst-case sparse order is Theta(m). For rational forecasts and accuracy, with binary-encoded multiplicities of separately assignable unit identities, a grid-free polynomial-bit-time procedure returns B <= L <= U, U - B < eta, and an exactly calibrated compact repair of cost at most U + m <= L + m + eta.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二值单位权重序列在总绝对变化成本下，确定性校准距离 C 与其分数松弛 L 之间的离线差距，将原有 C ≤ L + O(√T) 上界改进为最坏情况下的紧确阶 Θ(T^(1/3))。
AI.motivation: 已有工作（Qiao 和 Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2）给出了离线比较上界 C ≤ L + O(√T)，但该上界并非紧确的。本文旨在确定 C 与 L 之间离线差距的精确最坏情况阶，并刻画其与输入结构（如不同预测数量 m）的关系。
AI.method: 针对长度为 T 的二值单位权重序列、总绝对变化成本，定义 Δ_T 为 C − L 在所有长度 T 输入上的上确界；通过构造性上界证明与有理数下界输入构造，确定最坏情况阶；进一步分析含 m 个不同预测的输入，并设计无网格、多项式比特时间的算法，在二进制编码可分别分配的单元多重性下返回界 B ≤ L ≤ U 且 U − B < η，并给出精确校准的紧凑修复。
AI.result: 证明了最坏情况差距为 Θ(T^(1/3))：当 T ≥ 216 时，T^(1/3)/1000 ≤ Δ_T ≤ 41T^(1/3)。上界对每个输入成立，而每个 T ≥ 216 均存在有理数下界输入。对含 m 个不同预测的输入有 C ≤ L + m，且无限制样本最坏情况稀疏阶为 Θ(m)。在有理数预测与精度下，无网格多项式比特时间过程返回 B ≤ L ≤ U，U − B < η，并给出成本至多 U + m ≤ L + m + η 的精确校准紧凑修复。
AI.conclusion: 本文确定了二值单位权重序列离线校准差距的紧确最坏情况阶 Θ(T^(1/3))，显著改进了既有的 O(√T) 上界，并揭示了差距对预测数量 m 的依赖（Θ(m) 稀疏阶），同时提供了高效的多项式比特时间算法以逼近 L 并构造精确校准的紧凑修复。

title: Anatomy-aware Fine-grained Multimodal Fusion for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer T-Staging Prediction Using CT and Radiology Report
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging (IEEE TMI)
summary: Accurate T-staging is crucial for guiding personalized treatment strategies for laryngopharyngeal cancer. However, current clinical practice relies on invasive biopsy procedures, whereas CT-based staging remains challenging due to the complex patterns of tumor invasion. Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that integrates organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging. The framework first constructs an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that captures invasion patterns between primary sites and surrounding organs, then performs Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) so that each organ node aggregates textual evidence from the radiology report, and finally refines this graph representation by injecting organ-specific invasion cues extracted from the report via Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG), yielding a multimodal organ graph that combines spatial and textual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior performance in T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer.

AI.tldr: 提出解剖感知多模态框架，通过器官图与跨模态对齐实现喉咽癌T分期。
AI.motivation: 喉咽癌T分期对个性化治疗至关重要，但现有临床依赖侵入性活检，CT分期因肿瘤侵犯模式复杂而困难。现有计算机辅助方法存在两大问题：1）结构关系建模不足，要么处理整个CT体积缺乏肿瘤相关解剖约束，要么依赖费力的肿瘤分割；2）细粒度跨模态对齐困难，放射报告含器官特异性侵犯细节，但全局特征融合方法难以将单个解剖结构与对应文本描述准确对齐。
AI.method: 提出解剖感知多模态框架，整合器官级CT上下文与放射报告为统一表示。首先构建解剖结构化器官图（AOG），捕捉原发部位与周围器官间的侵犯模式；然后进行器官锚定跨模态对齐（OCA），使每个器官节点聚合放射报告中的文本证据；最后通过报告增强图精炼（REG）注入从报告提取的器官特异性侵犯线索，得到结合空间与文本证据的多模态器官图。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在喉咽癌T分期中取得优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 解剖感知的多模态框架通过器官图建模与细粒度跨模态对齐，有效提升喉咽癌T分期性能，为无创分期提供新思路。

title: Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification
comment: 40th NeurIPS'26 Workshop AI for Chip Design
summary: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made rapid inroads into Electronic Design Automation (EDA), approximately 74.6% of existing studies target static Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, leaving post-simulation verification and interactive waveform debugging largely untouched. We introduce Back-to-the-Future (BTTF), an end-to-end agentic framework that closes this infrastructural gap. BTTF distills massive, unstructured simulation dumps into a normalized relational SQLite database and couples it with a collaborative multi-agent orchestration engine that translates natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories. Across a 150-query benchmark, BTTF attains 95.33% execution accuracy, charting a practical path toward autonomous EDA verification.

AI.tldr: BTTF 是一个端到端智能体框架，将仿真转储归一化为 SQLite 数据库，并用多智能体编排把自然语言验证查询转为模式感知 SQL，在 150 条查询基准上达到 95.33% 执行准确率，填补了 EDA 后仿真验证与交互式波形调试的空白。
AI.motivation: 现代 AI 依赖数十亿晶体管规模的 SoC，但其验证工作流仍高度依赖人工。现有 LLM 在 EDA 中的研究约 74.6% 集中于静态 RTL 代码生成，后仿真验证与交互式波形调试几乎未被覆盖，形成基础设施性空白。
AI.method: 提出 BTTF 框架：一方面将大规模非结构化仿真转储（simulation dumps）提炼为规范化的关系型 SQLite 数据库；另一方面构建协作式多智能体编排引擎，将自然语言验证查询翻译为模式感知（schema-aware）的 SQL，并将信号异常与带版本管理的 RTL 仓库进行关联。
AI.result: 在包含 150 条查询的基准测试上，BTTF 取得 95.33% 的执行准确率（execution accuracy）。
AI.conclusion: BTTF 弥合了后仿真验证阶段的基础设施缺口，为迈向自主化 EDA 验证提供了一条可行路径。

title: Square-Root Regret for Adversarial Multiplayer Bandits without Collision Information or Shared Randomness
summary:
We study adversarial multiplayer bandits with $K$ arms and $2\le m<K$ labeled players, without collision information, shared randomness, or an external communication channel. We design a constructive communication and synchronization protocol with a Monte Carlo public constructor. With probability at least $1-CN^{-32}$ over preprocessing, where $N=2Km(T+1)$, its fixed published output satisfies \[
  R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt T\log^2(2Km(T+1)) \] simultaneously for every oblivious reward sequence chosen after preprocessing. Here $R_T$ is expected regret over the players' private execution randomness. Positive reward observations establish a common learning schedule and synchronize players before learning begins. The cost of delayed communication is charged to the support of positive rewards, ensuring that periods with little useful feedback incur only limited regret. A slow--fast learning procedure then maintains valid reward estimates while assignments and scores are exchanged.

AI.tldr: 研究无碰撞信息、无共享随机性、无外部通信信道的对抗多玩家老虎机问题，提出带蒙特卡洛公共构造器的通信与同步协议，实现同时对所有遗忘型奖励序列成立的近最优遗憾上界。
AI.motivation: 多玩家老虎机在缺乏碰撞信息、共享随机性与外部通信信道时，玩家间协调与学习极为困难；需要设计无需这些资源的通信与同步机制以控制遗憾。
AI.method: 设计构造性通信与同步协议：利用正奖励观测建立共同学习时刻表并在学习前同步玩家；将延迟通信代价计入正奖励支撑集；采用慢-快学习过程在交换分配与分数期间维持有效奖励估计。协议含蒙特卡洛公共构造器，预处理后输出固定发布结果。
AI.result: 在预处理随机性下以概率至少1-CN^{-32}（N=2Km(T+1)），固定发布输出对预处理后选定的每个遗忘型奖励序列同时满足 R_T ≤ C K^{5/2} √T log^2(2Km(T+1))，其中R_T为玩家私有执行随机性下的期望遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 该协议在无碰撞信息、无共享随机性、无外部通信信道的对抗多玩家老虎机中实现了对所有遗忘型奖励序列同时成立的遗憾保证，正奖励支撑集承担通信代价使低反馈期遗憾有限。

title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过自然语言"审读"MM-DiT的上下文token：训练瓶颈网络将中间上下文token映射到冻结LLM输入空间，从而直接询问隐藏表示。发现上下文token很早就编码全局场景语义与未指定属性，信息即使空提示也可解码，且可读性与人类偏好正相关；据此提出Contextual Alignment训练法提升生成质量与分布覆盖。
AI.motivation: MM-DiT在生成过程中通过多模态注意力反复更新文本token，形成动态的"上下文token"，但其功能尚不清楚，缺乏对其内部表示的可解释解读手段。
AI.method: 提出"自然语言审读"框架：训练轻量瓶颈网络，将MM-DiT中间层的上下文token映射到冻结LLM的输入空间，使LLM能直接依据这些隐藏表示回答关于正在生成图像的问题。基于发现，进一步提出Contextual Alignment训练技术，显式强化上下文token中所编码的视觉-语义信息。
AI.result: 上下文token编码了正在生成场景的丰富全局表示：生成特定语义（含提示未充分指定的属性）在去噪早期即可访问，细节随时间逐步可读；即使输入空提示，这些信息仍可解码，说明上下文token从演化中的视觉表示里累积了大量图像特定信息。上下文表示可读性更高的生成样本往往获得更高的人类偏好评分。
AI.conclusion: 上下文token既是理解MM-DiT内部动态的可解释窗口，也是改进生成模型的有效目标；Contextual Alignment可提升生成质量与分布覆盖。

title: TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts
summary: We introduce TasteVal, a benchmark to evaluate the experimental research taste of frontier models. We define research taste as the ability to pick interesting problems to solve, design experiments, and interpret experimental results. TasteVal measures the experimental component of research taste; given a fixed research problem, we measure how well a model iteratively designs experiments and draws conclusions from their outcomes. We operationalize experimental research taste as compute efficiency; a Researcher who reaches the same score as an expert human using half the serial experimental compute has twice the experimental taste. Experimental taste thus acts as a multiplier on experimental compute, making it a key input to forecasts of AI progress. TasteVal consists of 8 novel, challenging, open-ended tasks representative of frontier AI R&D. To isolate taste from coding ability, the model under evaluation acts as a Researcher that iteratively designs experiments while a fixed Coder agent implements them and reports their results. The Researcher executes until either the 40 H100 hour or 120 wall-clock hour budgets are exhausted. We recruit 24 human experts, at least 2 per task, and take the best expert attempt per task as the expert baseline. We evaluate 20 models released between 2023 and 2026. The best-performing model, Opus 5.5, exceeds our expert baseline, with a compute multiplier of 2.3x (95% CI 1.15-4.37), at roughly 1/30 of our baseliners' average per-run cost. On TasteVal, the compute multiplier of frontier models has doubled approximately every 3.0 months since December 2025 (95% CI 1.7-5.0), up from every 14 months between 2023 and December 2025. Measured by final normalized performance, frontier models show no trend break, doubling every 14.6 months. To keep TasteVal uncontaminated, we do not release the tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TasteVal 基准，用“计算效率”量化前沿模型的实验研究品味（experimental research taste），通过 8 个开放式前沿 AI 研发任务、由固定 Coder 代理实现、Researcher 模型迭代设计实验，并与 24 名人类专家的最佳成绩对比。最佳模型 Opus 5.5 达到 2.3x 计算乘数，超越专家基线，且成本约为基线的 1/30；自 2025 年 12 月以来模型计算乘数约每 3.0 个月翻倍，而按归一化性能衡量则无趋势突变。
AI.motivation: 现有评测多关注模型编码或解题能力，却难以衡量“研究品味”这一影响 AI 研发进展的关键要素。作者希望将研究品味中的实验部分可测量化，因为它可作为实验算力的乘数，是预测 AI 进展的重要输入。
AI.method: 将实验研究品味操作化为计算效率：若 Researcher 用一半串行实验算力达到与人类专家相同的分数，则其品味为专家的两倍。TasteVal 包含 8 个新颖、具挑战性、开放式的任务。为隔离品味与编码能力，被评模型仅作为 Researcher 迭代设计实验，由固定 Coder 代理实现并反馈结果；Researcher 运行至 40 H100 小时或 120 墙钟小时预算耗尽。招募 24 名人类专家（每任务至少 2 人），取每任务最佳专家尝试作为专家基线。评估 2023 至 2026 年间发布的 20 个模型。
AI.result: 最佳模型 Opus 5.5 超过专家基线，计算乘数为 2.3x（95% CI 1.15–4.37），每次运行成本约为基线者平均成本的 1/30。TasteVal 上前沿模型的计算乘数自 2025 年 12 月以来约每 3.0 个月翻倍（95% CI 1.7–5.0），而 2023 年至 2025 年 12 月期间约为每 14 个月翻倍。若以最终归一化性能衡量，前沿模型没有出现趋势突变，约每 14.6 个月翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 实验研究品味可被量化为算力乘数，且前沿模型的该能力正在快速提升，其翻倍周期显著短于归一化性能的翻倍周期。为避免污染，TasteVal 的任务不对外发布。

title: Planetary Geospatial Foundation Models: A New Paradigm for Global Public Health
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables (6 main tables, 6 Extended Data tables)
summary: The efficacy of traditional disease prediction is limited by spatial gaps and temporal lags, which impact the timing and targets of resource deployments. Outbreaks escalate undetected, chronic disease burdens are quantified years later, and at-risk populations in data-sparse regions remain unaddressed. Planetary geospatial foundation models complement existing epidemiological workflows to provide operational improvements, encoding multimodal search, mobility, and environmental signals into generalizable place representations. As illustrations of this complementarity, we present independent global health case studies of Google Earth AI's Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) -- a foundation model for geospatial inference -- across four domains (vaccine-preventable, communicable, noncommunicable, maternal mental health), five tasks (spatial extrapolation, interpolation/nowcasting, probabilistic forecasting, prospective forecasting, risk stratification), and four countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo). Across these case studies, PDFM addresses critical surveillance gaps across domains: improving US-Canada border MMR vaccination coverage predictions by capturing cross-border behavioral spillovers domestic models miss; nowcasting cardiovascular disease to accelerate data availability; enhancing short-term municipal Mexican dengue forecasts for timely outbreak vector control; improving forecasts of cholera hotspots; and adding a transferable signal to individual-level postpartum-depression risk prediction in US states the model had never seen, while not replacing individual socioeconomic data or closing demographic screening gaps. Together, these results showcase capabilities of geospatial foundation models for public health surveillance.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证地球空间基础模型PDFM在公共卫生监测中的应用，通过四个国家、四类疾病领域、五类任务的案例研究，证明其能弥补传统疾病预测的空间与时间缺口。
AI.motivation: 传统疾病预测受空间断裂与时间滞后限制，导致疫情未被及时发现、慢性病负担延迟量化、数据稀疏地区人群被忽视，进而影响资源配置的时机与目标。
AI.method: 以Google Earth AI的人群动态基础模型（PDFM）为例，将多模态搜索、移动性与环境信号编码为可泛化的"地点表征"，开展独立全球健康案例研究，覆盖四个领域（疫苗可预防疾病、传染病、非传染性疾病、孕产妇心理健康）、五类任务（空间外推、插值/现时估计、概率预测、前瞻性预测、风险分层）和四个国家（美国、加拿大、墨西哥、刚果民主共和国）。
AI.result: PDFM在多项任务中填补监测缺口：提升美加边境MMR疫苗接种覆盖率预测（捕捉国内模型忽略的跨境行为溢出效应）；现时估计心血管疾病负担以加速数据可用性；增强墨西哥市级短期登革热预测以支持及时病媒控制；改进霍乱热点预测；并在未见过的美国州加入可迁移信号以辅助个体级产后抑郁风险预测。但该模型不能替代个体社会经济数据，也无法弥合人口筛查差距。
AI.conclusion: 地球空间基础模型可作为现有流行病学工作流的有力补充，为公共卫生监测提供可操作的能力提升，但需与个体层面数据结合使用。

title: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation
summary: Bidirectional video diffusion models denoise entire videos in parallel, yet when trained on effectively unlimited in-distribution data from procedural generators, continue to violate physical laws and simple symbolic rules. We introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD), which performs autoregressive diffusion at high noise before switching to parallel diffusion at low noise. The autoregressive phase provides the serial computation needed to coordinate interdependent events and produce valid state transitions while the parallel phase jointly refines the entire video and reduces sampling time relative to fully serial generation. We implement S2PD with two architectures: a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch and a pretrained video model adapted through LoRA fine-tuning with causal attention. Across games, physical simulations, and real video, S2PD follows rules more reliably than matched bidirectional baselines and generates videos with greater temporal stability and sampling efficiency than other serial methods.

AI.tldr: S2PD在高噪声阶段采用自回归扩散、低噪声阶段切换为并行扩散，兼顾序列计算与采样效率，在多类视频生成任务中比双向基线更可靠地遵守规则。
AI.motivation: 双向视频扩散模型虽能并行去噪整段视频，但即便在程序化生成器提供的近乎无限分布内数据上训练，仍会违反物理规律与简单符号规则，说明其缺乏协调相互依赖事件所需的序列计算能力。
AI.method: 提出Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion（S2PD）：在高噪声阶段进行自回归扩散以提供序列计算、协调相互依赖事件并产生有效状态转移，在低噪声阶段切换为并行扩散联合精修整段视频。以两种架构实现：从零训练的像素空间扩散Transformer，以及通过LoRA微调并引入因果注意力的预训练视频模型。
AI.result: 在游戏、物理模拟与真实视频上，S2PD比匹配的双向基线更可靠地遵循规则，且相比其他序列方法具有更高的时间稳定性与采样效率。
AI.conclusion: 在高噪声段引入自回归、在低噪声段并行精修的分阶段扩散策略，可有效提升视频生成对规则与物理约束的遵循度，同时保持采样效率。

title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
summary: Worst-group accuracy (WGA) evaluates a trained predictor but does not characterize how its frozen backbone behaves when a new head is learned. We introduce BiasFlow, a hook-based toolkit for monitoring class-attribute centroid alignment (IBMI), within-class centroid separation (W-IBMI), and feature-projection sensitivity. IBMI is confounded by class-attribute correlation and is not a measure of causal feature reliance. We pair these diagnostics with BiasFlow Regularization (BFR), a supervised, composable class-conditional centroid-alignment penalty. W-IBMI verifies the quantity BFR optimizes; it is scale dependent and does not independently establish attribute removal. Across the reported small-scale benchmarks, adding BFR improves or preserves mean WGA, with gains up to +26.0 pp on UrbanCars. The principal independent stress test freezes CelebA-Std backbones and trains fresh heads on biased data: BFR+GroupDRO improves WGA from 40.7% to 64.1%, while Male probe accuracy decreases from 92.5% to 72.2%. Attribute information remains recoverable, and cross-task results are mixed. A controlled synthetic-watermark ImageNet experiment additionally improves watermark-shift accuracy by +23.0 pp under matched training. These results support evaluating centroid geometry and resistance to biased head retraining alongside WGA, within the tested protocols.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BiasFlow诊断工具（IBMI、W-IBMI、特征投影敏感性）与BFR正则化方法，在冻结骨干重训头部场景下评估质心几何与偏差鲁棒性，UrbanCars上WGA最高提升+26.0 pp，CelebA-Std上WGA从40.7%升至64.1%，但属性信息仍可恢复，跨任务结果不一。
AI.motivation: 最差组准确率（WGA）只能评估已训练好的预测器，无法刻画冻结骨干在新头部学习时的行为，因此需要新的诊断范式来监测类-属性质心对齐与特征偏差鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出基于hook的BiasFlow工具包，监控类-属性质心对齐（IBMI）、类内质心分离（W-IBMI）和特征投影敏感性；并配套BFR——一种有监督、可组合的类条件质心对齐惩罚项，其中W-IBMI用于验证BFR优化的目标量。
AI.result: 在报告的小规模基准上，加入BFR可提升或保持平均WGA，UrbanCars上增益达+26.0 pp；主要独立压力测试中，冻结CelebA-Std骨干并在有偏数据上重训头部，BFR+GroupDRO将WGA从40.7%提升至64.1%，而Male探针准确率从92.5%降至72.2%；合成水印ImageNet实验在匹配训练下将水印偏移准确率提升+23.0 pp。
AI.conclusion: 在测试协议范围内，除WGA外还应评估质心几何与对偏差头部重训的抵抗力；但IBMI受类-属性相关性混淆，并非因果特征依赖度量，W-IBMI具有尺度依赖且不能独立证明属性被移除，属性信息仍可恢复，跨任务结果混合。

title: Voltic: Distinguishing Volatility from Stochasticity in Recurrent Memory
summary: Recurrent sequence models must decide how strongly to overwrite their memory at each token. Read as Bayesian filtering, this write is the gain of a Kalman update, set by uncertainty from two sources that pull it in opposite directions: volatility, how quickly the underlying associations change, and stochasticity, how noisy each observation of them is. First, we show that the update of gated delta-rule memories is the form this filter takes under isotropic uncertainty. Next, we introduce Voltic, a recurrent memory that keeps the covariance anisotropic and makes both noise variances input-dependent, so the write is vector-valued and carries uncertainty accumulated over the sequence. A dense covariance would have to be propagated token by token, ruling out the parallel training these models depend on. We therefore give two assumed-density approximations, diagonal and quasi-diagonal, both of which leave the memory update in delta-rule form and reuse its chunked kernels. On controlled recall tasks in which associations change and observations are corrupted, Voltic leads all baselines. On the task combining volatility and stochasticity, its margin over the strongest baseline is larger at both extrapolation sizes than at the training sizes. In 45M-parameter language models it leads an eight-task reasoning average and achieves higher retrieval accuracy beyond the training context length than gated baselines, at throughput close to those baselines. Deriving the write from an uncertainty recursion therefore makes memory more responsive to change.

AI.tldr: 将循环记忆的写入视为贝叶斯滤波中的卡尔曼增益，由波动性（关联变化速度）与随机性（观测噪声）两类不确定性共同决定；本文提出 Voltic，通过保持各向异性协方差并令两种噪声方差依赖输入，使写入变为向量且携带序列累积不确定性，并用对角/准对角假设密度近似保持 delta-rule 形式与分块并行核，在受控回忆任务与语言模型上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 循环序列模型在每个 token 处需决定以多大强度覆写记忆，这一写入强度本质上是由不确定性决定的卡尔曼增益，而波动性与随机性对增益的作用方向相反。现有门控 delta-rule 记忆只对应各向同性不确定性下的特例，无法表达随序列累积的、方向各异的不确定性，因此记忆对关联变化的响应能力受限。
AI.method: 1) 理论推导：证明门控 delta-rule 记忆的更新等价于各向同性不确定性下贝叶斯滤波的更新形式。2) 提出 Voltic：保持协方差各向异性，并让波动性与随机性两个噪声方差均为输入相关，从而写入为向量值并携带序列累积的不确定性。3) 为避免稠密协方差逐 token 传播破坏并行训练，给出对角与准对角两种假设密度近似，二者均保持记忆更新为 delta-rule 形式并可复用其分块（chunked）核。
AI.result: 在关联变化且观测受损的受控回忆任务上，Voltic 优于所有基线；在同时包含波动性与随机性的任务上，其相对最强基线的优势在两种外推规模下均大于训练规模下的优势。在 45M 参数语言模型上，Voltic 在八项推理任务平均值上领先，并在超出训练上下文长度时取得高于门控基线的检索准确率，吞吐量接近这些基线。
AI.conclusion: 从不确定性递推中推导写入强度，可使记忆对关联变化更具响应性；Voltic 以假设密度近似的方式在保持并行训练效率的同时，实现了更灵活的向量值写入并取得一致的性能提升。

title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
summary: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: 本文提出"宽高比自适应流程图重排"新任务：给定栅格流程图与目标宽高比，生成结构忠实、无幻觉、可编辑的布局。方法为Parse-Style-Layout三阶段智能体流水线，每阶段配主智能体与批判者（确定性约束检查+VLM视觉反馈），输出draw.io可编辑mxGraph XML。在100张流程图×5种宽高比基准上，内容保真度达68.6%，远超先前工作的11.2%–41.4%。
AI.motivation: ML论文中的流程图需在论文单栏、16:9幻灯片、竖版海报、1:1社交图、9:16手机预览等多种画布上复现，同一计算图被强加不同宽高比。若连接被悄悄破坏，会错误呈现方法本身。现有方案各有典型缺陷：图到图模型拉伸方块且无法处理极端比例，文生图智能体系统产生幻觉内容，解析后渲染系统会错误布线。因此需要将宽高比自适应重排确立为独立任务。
AI.method: 提出分解为Parse（解析）、Style（样式）、Layout（布局）三阶段的智能体流水线；每个阶段由一个主智能体搭配一个批判者（critic），批判者结合确定性约束检查与VLM视觉反馈，从而显式校验连通性，防止连接被静默破坏。最终输出draw.io可编辑的mxGraph XML。
AI.result: 在涵盖5种宽高比的100张流程图自建基准上，由Gemini 3.1 Pro评估并经人工判断验证，本方法内容保真度（Content Fidelity）达68.6%，而先前工作仅为11.2%–41.4%。
AI.conclusion: 宽高比自适应流程图重排是一个独立且重要的问题，采用带批判者的三阶段智能体流水线可显著提升结构保真度并抑制幻觉，同时保持输出的可编辑性，为跨画布流程图复用提供了有效方案。

title: From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model
summary: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

AI.tldr: 提出SCION，在单一模型中联合进行生成与自监督表征学习，实现无需标签或预训练模型的自条件生成，在ImageNet 256x256上取得优于依赖预训练模型的基线方法的FID。
AI.motivation: 现有强图像生成模型依赖类标签、冻结的预训练编码器或单独训练的自动编码器，生成因而受限于标注或预训练（标签需人工标注，编码器/自动编码器需在目标域预训练）。本文希望在同一模型中联合生成与自监督表征学习，实现无需标签与预训练的自条件生成。
AI.method: 核心挑战是目标不匹配：对比学习需干净增强视图、偏好粗糙不变语义；流匹配需含噪图像、须保留细粒度与空间布局。提出SCION，核心为单一像素空间编码器，以流时间步与一个嵌入为条件。表征学习中该条件嵌入为跨图像共享的可学习全局向量，编码器[CLS]token产出由对比损失训练的语义表征；生成训练中条件嵌入为图像自身的[CLS]表征，patch token经解码器预测图像；推理时无参考图通过联合学习的嵌入先验采样。采用梯度范数平衡与stop-gradient机制在一次训练中联合优化。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，使用JiT-B配方且无表征引导时SCION达8.92 FID，超过类无条件iREPA（对齐预训练DINOv2，46.44）和RCG（以其为条件，14.27）；使用JiT-L时无引导达5.89 FID，有表征引导达3.47，优于ADM配方的RCG（6.24）。
AI.conclusion: SCION是自监督且自包含的，无需标签或预训练模型，验证了在单一模型中联合生成与自监督表征学习的可行性与有效性。

title: ReMaD: Tuning-free Domain Adaptation for Classification and Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: We introduce Reduced-rank Mahalanobis Distance (ReMaD), a novel prototypical distance-based refinement to classification and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection using pretrained models without finetuning. We use embeddings of the target dataset to fit closed-form distribution statistics in the model's latent space which can classify in-distribution samples and detect OOD samples, all without training or prior knowledge of the OOD data. Building on prototype classification and OOD detection, we analyze the distribution properties of large pretrained models when processing new datasets; based on this analysis, we formulate a simple modification to Mahalanobis Distance to adapt models' latent space distributions to new domains by removing unused features, without the finetuning or hyperparameter searches required by other adaptation procedures. We demonstrate the efficacy of this method to adapt existing large pretrained image embedding models to new classification domains outside their trained capabilities by testing across four target datasets, with competitive performance in both classification and OOD detection.

AI.tldr: ReMaD通过对预训练模型隐空间分布进行闭式统计拟合与降秩马氏距离修正，无需微调或超参搜索即可实现分类与OOD检测的域适配。
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练模型的分类与OOD检测方法通常依赖微调或超参搜索来完成域适配，代价高且需OOD先验知识。作者希望在不微调、不访问OOD数据的前提下，将模型隐空间分布适配到新目标域。
AI.method: 提出降秩马氏距离（ReMaD）：利用目标数据集嵌入在模型隐空间中拟合闭式分布统计量，构建原型分类与OOD检测；分析大预训练模型处理新数据集时的分布特性，据此对马氏距离做简单修正——去除未使用特征以适配新域分布，整个过程无需微调与超参搜索。
AI.result: 在四个目标数据集上验证，将现有大型预训练图像嵌入模型适配到其训练能力之外的新分类域，分类与OOD检测均取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReMaD是一种无需训练、无需OOD先验的轻量级原型距离修正方法，可有效完成跨域分类与OOD检测适配，为预训练模型的下游域迁移提供高效方案。

title: Inferring physical fields in coupled systems with unknown parameters from incomplete observations using physics-constrained attentive neural operators
summary: Given incomplete measurements of a single physical field in a coupled system with unknown parameters, can we infer its full physical state and identify the underlying parameters? This problem is challenging because multiple coupled fields must be reconstructed simultaneously from limited observations of only one, while the system parameters are unknown. In this work, we propose a machine learning framework for full-field reconstruction and parameter identification of unknown physical systems from sparse observations of a single physical field. Specifically, the cross-attention encoder propagates sparse sensor observations onto a regular grid to construct a sensor-conditioned latent representation, while a Fourier neural operator (FNO) decoder captures global spatial dependencies to reconstruct all coupled physical fields. The network parameters and unknown physical parameters are jointly optimized by minimizing observation losses, governing equation residuals, and boundary/initial condition constraints. The proposed approach is validated on two- and three-dimensional lid-driven cavity flows, a two-dimensional cylinder wake, and a two-dimensional non-ideal magnetohydrodynamics problem, demonstrating the recovery performance of unobserved fields and physical parameters from incomplete observations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种机器学习框架，仅凭单一物理场的稀疏观测即可重建耦合系统的全部场并辨识未知物理参数。
AI.motivation: 耦合系统中多物理场相互耦合且系统参数未知，仅凭单一物理场的稀疏/不完全测量难以同时重建全部场并辨识参数，这是本文要解决的核心难题。
AI.method: 采用交叉注意力（cross-attention）编码器将稀疏传感器观测映射到规则网格，构建以传感器为条件的隐表示；采用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）解码器捕捉全局空间依赖以重建所有耦合物理场；通过最小化观测损失、控制方程残差以及边界/初始条件约束，联合优化网络参数与未知物理参数。
AI.result: 在二维与三维顶盖驱动方腔流、二维圆柱尾流以及二维非理想磁流体动力学问题上进行了验证，展示了从稀疏观测中恢复未观测场与物理参数的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够从单一物理场的不完全观测中同时实现耦合系统全场的重建与未知物理参数的辨识，验证了方法的有效性。

title: PACMI: Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents rely on long-term memory to retain and reuse information when performing tasks over long horizons. Existing methods provide limited support for handling memories that become outdated as new observations or domain evidence arrive. Such outdated memories may remain semantically relevant, continue to affect dependent records, and retain value as historical evidence. This calls for two capabilities: dependency tracking to identify downstream effects and historical preservation to retain useful past records. We propose Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation (PACMI), a framework that represents memories and new evidence in a provenance graph with typed dependency edges. PACMI assigns records to a four-state validity lattice, propagates validity changes to dependent memories, and uses the resulting states for retrieval and stale-premise detection. We also introduce a diagnostic benchmark with 100 cases and 300 queries across five domains. The evaluation separates node, context-, and answer-level performance. PACMI achieves the highest final-answer accuracy on this benchmark, and its paired difference from the strongest baseline is significant under an exact McNemar test. The premise checker achieves perfect precision, recall, and F 1 on the controlled query distribution. Cascading propagation primarily improves memorystate correctness: removing it increases final-answer errors from 3 to 11, but the paired difference does not reach the 0.05 significance threshold. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出PACMI框架，用溯源图与四态有效性格处理LLM智能体的过期记忆，实现依赖追踪与历史保留，并在新基准上取得最优终答准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖长期记忆，但现有方法难以处理随新观察或领域证据而变得过期的记忆。这类记忆可能语义上仍相关、影响下游记录并具历史证据价值，因此需要依赖追踪与历史保留两项能力。
AI.method: PACMI将记忆与新证据表示为带类型依赖边的溯源图，把记录映射到四态有效性格，将有效性变化传播至依赖记忆，并利用所得状态进行检索与陈旧前提检测。同时构建含5个领域、100个案例、300条查询的诊断基准，评估分节点级、上下文级与答案级。
AI.result: PACMI在该基准上取得最高终答准确率，与最强基线的配对差异在精确McNemar检验下显著；前提检查器在受控查询分布上取得完美的精确率、召回率与F1；移除级联传播使终答错误由3增至11，但配对差异未达0.05显著阈值。
AI.conclusion: PACMI通过溯源感知的级联失效机制有效支持过期记忆的依赖追踪与历史保留，提升终答准确率与记忆状态正确性；级联传播的收益主要体现在记忆状态层面，其统计显著性仍待更大规模验证。

title: CIPHER-MoE: Balancing Efficiency and Routing Fidelity in Trillion-Scale MoE Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has been widely adopted in recent large language model (LLM) architectures. However, scaling up MoE in LLM training introduces system-level challenges on training, where non-uniform token routing can lead to highly imbalanced workloads across experts and devices, further destabilizing the training process. With trillion-scale LLMs, imbalanced expert workloads further amplify the resource cost of MoE training, resulting in degraded training efficiency and hardware utilization for underloaded experts, while hot experts require additional resources to accommodate excessive workloads. Recent studies address imbalanced MoE training through intricate parallelism strategies or resource reallocation. However, these system-level approaches often introduce additional resource requirements and considerable orchestration complexity, which become increasingly difficult to afford when training trillion-parameter LLMs under constrained computational resources. This work introduces CIPHER-MoE, which mitigates MoE workload imbalance while keeping the router's token-side Top-K selection unchanged. CIPHER-MoE applies affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering with explicit capacity control to reduce hotspot expert workloads without additional hardware resources or complex runtime design. The proposed method has been evaluated on large-scale MoE models, including DeepSeek-V4-Pro, showing up to 64.9 percentage points Top-1 expert workload reduction and 1.10$\times$-1.94$\times$ training acceleration, while preserving the training quality. The source code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CIPHER-MoE，在不改变路由端 token 侧 Top-K 选择的前提下，通过亲和力感知的 Expert-to-Token 过滤与显式容量控制，缓解 MoE 训练中的专家负载不均衡，并实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: MoE 在大语言模型训练中被广泛采用，但非均匀的 token 路由会导致专家与设备间的负载高度不均衡。在万亿参数规模下，这种不均衡会加剧资源开销，使欠载专家效率降低、热点专家需要额外资源；而现有并行策略或资源重分配方案会带来额外资源需求和复杂的编排开销，在算力受限条件下难以承受。
AI.method: 提出 CIPHER-MoE，保持路由器 token 侧 Top-K 选择不变，采用亲和力感知的 Expert-to-Token 过滤，并引入显式容量控制，在不增加硬件资源、不引入复杂运行时设计的情况下降低热点专家负载。
AI.result: 在包括 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在内的大规模 MoE 模型上评估，Top-1 专家负载最高降低 64.9 个百分点，训练加速达 1.10×–1.94×，同时保持训练质量。
AI.conclusion: CIPHER-MoE 以轻量、无需额外硬件的过滤与容量控制方式有效缓解 MoE 训练负载不均衡，兼顾效率与训练质量，源代码即将开源。

title: AdaSpark: Adaptive DSpark with Online Learning for Tree Verification and N-gram Fill
summary:
Block drafters such as DSpark propose ranked candidates for several positions in one forward pass, and a tree verifier checks them in one pass of the target. The number of rows to verify trades the tokens a wider tree is expected to accept against the time a wider verify takes. Most schedulers that choose this number take the verify time from a table or model measured before serving, corrected online by at most one scale factor, and take acceptance from the drafter's confidence estimates or from a map fitted offline.
  AdaSpark learns both quantities while it serves, with no profile, calibration or sweep in advance. It learns which verify widths are worth offering and fits each one's verify time as a function of context. It fits each candidate's acceptance probability to the target's verify outcomes, with the drafter's confidence head as one input, and orders and sizes the tree by that fit instead of by the head. The same model prices n-gram continuations of the request's own text, so drafted and text-derived candidates compete for rows in one best-first order. The width is chosen by pricing time at the long-run decode rate.
  On single- and multi-turn conversations from six public datasets, on three dense targets and one mixture-of-experts target, AdaSpark decodes 1.5-3.1x faster than llama.cpp's DSpark with the same drafters. Our imparo engine with AdaSpark is 1.17-1.52x faster than imparo running with a three-token chain (the default llama.cpp setting); this gain comes from the scheduler alone. Without a width sweep, AdaSpark is never more than 0.3% slower than the best pinned tree width on any dense target or context band. On the mixture-of-experts target it ties the best pinned width, and the other pinned widths from 4 to 16 rows are 5-14% slower.

AI.tldr: AdaSpark 是一种在线学习型推测解码调度器，在服务过程中自适应学习验证宽度与候选接受概率，无需预先 profiling 或超参扫描，从而在多种目标模型上实现 1.5–3.1 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于树验证的推测解码（如 DSpark）需要选择验证行数（宽度），以权衡更宽树带来的额外接受 token 与验证耗时。多数调度器依赖服务前测得的验证时间表/模型（在线仅用一个缩放因子修正），并从 drafter 置信度或离线拟合映射中获取接受率，导致需要预 profiling、离线标定或参数扫描，泛化性与自适应能力受限。
AI.method: AdaSpark 在服务过程中同时在线学习两个量：1）将每种验证宽度的验证时间拟合为上下文函数，并学习哪些宽度值得提供；2）将每个候选的接受概率拟合到目标模型的验证结果上，以 drafter 的置信度头作为输入之一，并据此（而非直接用置信度头）对树进行排序与定宽。同一模型还对请求自身文本的 n-gram 延续进行定价，使草稿候选与文本派生候选在同一 best-first 顺序中竞争行。宽度选择通过按长期解码速率对时间定价来完成。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集的单轮与多轮对话上，针对三个 dense 目标与一个 MoE 目标：AdaSpark 在同一 drafter 下比 llama.cpp 的 DSpark 解码快 1.5–3.1 倍；搭载 AdaSpark 的 imparo 引擎比运行三 token 链（llama.cpp 默认设置）的 imparo 快 1.17–1.52 倍，且增益完全来自调度器。不做宽度扫描时，AdaSpark 在任何 dense 目标或上下文区间上比最佳固定树宽度慢不超过 0.3%；在 MoE 目标上与最佳固定宽度持平，而 4–16 行的其他固定宽度慢 5–14%。
AI.conclusion: AdaSpark 证明无需预先 profile、标定或扫描即可在线学习验证宽度与接受概率，达到与最优固定宽度相当甚至更优的性能，并在多目标、多数据集场景下显著加速推测解码，增益来源于调度策略本身。

title: Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes
summary: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. We showcase the effectiveness of this framework using measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 200 nm. For the reusability of a pre-developed pre-trained model, we additionally leverage transfer learning and show that a new model for slightly differing structures can be re-trained and calibrated with a smaller data set of measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 100 nm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于神经网络的SPM图像分辨率增强框架，用于在保持高通量的前提下获取亚纳米级关键参数；在200 nm线/空结构上验证有效性，并通过迁移学习用100 nm结构的小数据集实现模型复用与再校准。
AI.motivation: 先进半导体节点逼近特征尺寸极限，需要亚纳米分辨率的量测能力，同时不能牺牲在线过程控制所需的高通量。尽管高通量SPM量测设备已进入HVM，但进一步缩短成像时间仍需新手段，作者认为机器学习可用于提升所测图像的分辨率以提取相关参数。
AI.method: 给出设计并使用神经网络分辨率增强器处理SPM图像的通用框架；以实现200 nm间距的线/空结构测量来展示该框架的有效性；为复用已预先开发的预训练模型，引入迁移学习，用100 nm间距线/空结构上采集的较小数据集对新模型进行再训练与校准。
AI.result: 该神经网络分辨率增强框架在200 nm间距线/空结构的SPM测量中展示出有效性；通过迁移学习，针对略有差异的结构（100 nm间距线/空结构）仅需较小数据集即可完成新模型的再训练与校准。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习分辨率增强可作为高通量SPM量测的后续加速路径，所提通用框架可行，并且迁移学习能够降低新结构模型开发所需的数据量与校准成本。

title: Feature identification for parameter extraction and defect detection using machine learning
summary: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. The move towards 3D structures requires extraction of critical dimension parameters from structures which can vary largely from layer to layer. For in-line process control, the necessary automation forces the development of layer and equipment-specific dedicated image processing algorithms. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. With the emergence of ML-based image processing methods, this process of algorithm development for both cases can be accelerated. In this work, we provide the general framework under which the images obtained from high-speed scanning probe microscopy-based systems can be used to train a network for either feature detection for parameter extraction or defect identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用框架，利用高速扫描探针显微镜（SPM）图像训练机器学习网络，用于半导体工艺控制中的特征检测（参数提取）或缺陷识别。
AI.motivation: 先进半导体节点的工艺控制对量测设备不仅提出分辨率与吞吐量的极限要求，还要求提取丰富数据以帮助工程师微调工艺步骤、提升良率。3D结构需从逐层差异很大的结构中提取关键尺寸参数；在线工艺控制所需的自动化迫使开发面向特定层与设备的专用图像处理算法。同时，EUV时代随机缺陷增多，纳米级缺陷检测需在低分辨率下识别特征以满足HVM晶圆厂的吞吐要求，这同样导致定制算法开发。
AI.method: 论文提出一个通用框架，将高速扫描探针显微镜（SPM）系统获取的图像用于训练神经网络，使其能够执行两类任务：特征检测（用于参数提取）或缺陷识别。借助基于机器学习的图像处理方法加速这两类算法的开发流程。
AI.result: 给出了利用高速SPM图像训练网络以完成特征检测/参数提取或缺陷识别的通用框架（摘要未提供具体量化实验结果）。
AI.conclusion: 基于ML的图像处理方法可加速半导体工艺控制中专用算法的开发；高速SPM图像可作为训练数据，支撑特征检测与缺陷识别两类应用。

title: Usefulness of Quantile-Aware Diffusion Modeling for Highly Imbalanced Tabular Data
